abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: 8 sts and 8 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
THROW
With afghan hook and CA, chain 103.
Row 1: Insert hook into 2nd chain from hook, yo, draw yarn through st, * insert hook in next chain, yo, draw yarn through st; repeat from * across – 103 loops on hook.
Second Half of Row: Yo, draw yarn through 1 loop, * yo, draw yarn through 2 loops on hook; repeat from * across until 1 loop remains and counts as first loop of next row.
Rows 2-15: Working in Tunisian Knit Stitch, *insert hook from front to back between both vertical strands of the next st, yo, draw yarn through st; repeat from * across – 103 loops on hook.
Second Half of Row: Yo, draw yarn through 1 loop, * yo, draw yarn through 2 loops on hook; repeat from * across until 1 loop remains and counts as first loop of next row. At end of Row 15, change to CB in last st. Fasten off CA.
Row 16: With CB, repeat Row 2, changing to CC in last st. DO NOT FASTEN OFF CB, but carry up side of work.
Rows 17-18: With CC, repeat Row 2. Fasten off CC at end of Row 18, pick up CB.
Row 19: With CB, repeat Row 2.
Rows 20-26: Using separate balls of color, repeat Row 2 following chart as indicated.
Row 27: With CB, repeat Row 2.
Rows 28-29: Repeat Rows 17 and 18.
Row 30: Repeat Row 19, changing to CA at end of row. Fasten off CB.
Rows 31-94: With CA, repeat Row 2.
Rows 95-109: Repeat Rows 16-30.
Rows 110-124: With CA, repeat Row 2. Fasten off.
Upper and Lower Edging: With right side facing, using L crochet hook, join CA in top right hand corner st.
Row 1: Chain 1, sc in same st as joining and in next 2 sts, ch 3, slip st in last sc made, * sc in each of next 3 sts, ch 3, slip st in last sc made; repeat from * across to last 2 sts, sc in last 2 sts.
Fasten off. Repeat Row 1 on lower edge of afghan.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 7 skeins 313 Aran
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: Square = 7½” (17 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Round 5: Ch 4, * skip next st, dc in next dc, ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next dc, corner, dc in next dc, [ch 1, skip next st, dc in next dc] twice, cable **, dc in next dc, ch 1; repeat from * around, end at **; join to 3rd ch of ch-4.
Round 6: Ch 4, * dc in next dc, [ch 1, skip next st, dc in next dc] twice, corner, dc in next d, [ch 1, skip next st, dc in next dc] 3 times, fpdc around next 4 fptr **, dc in next dc, ch 1; repeat from * around, end at **; join to 3rd ch of ch-4.
Round 7: Ch 4, * dc in next dc, [ch 1, skip next st, dc in next dc] 3 times, corner, dc in next dc, [ch 1, skip next st, dc in next dc] 4 times, cable **, dc in next dc, ch 1; repeat from * around, end at **; join to 3rd ch of ch-4.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew 8 squares together into 6 vertical strips, then sew strips together.
BORDER
Round 1: With right side facing, join yarn in any corner ch-3 space; ** ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) all in corner space, * ch 1, sc in next dc, ch 1, skip next st, [sc in next st, ch 1, skip next st] 5 times, dec, [ch 1, skip next st, sc in next st] 6 times, ch 1, skip next ch, sc in next ch, ch 1, skip seam, sc in next ch, ch 1, skip next ch, [sc in next st, ch 1, skip next st] 6 times, decrease, [ch 1, skip next st, sc in next st] 6 times; repeat from * to next corner; repeat from ** around; ch 1; join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, ** (sc, ch 2, sc) all in ch-2 space, sc in next sc, * ch 1, sc in next sc; repeat from * to next corner; repeat from ** around; ch 1; join.
THROW
Square (Make 48)
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 4; dc in 4th ch from hook, ch 3, [2 dc, ch 3] 3 times all in same ch; join with a slip st to top of beginning ch.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in next dc, corner, * dc in next 2 dc, corner; repeat from * around; join to top of ch-3.
Round 3: Slip st in next 3 dc, ch 3, corner, dc in next dc, cable, * dc in next dc, corner, dc in next dc, cable; repeat from * around; join.
Round 4: Ch 4, * skip next dc, dc in next dc, corner, dc in next dc, ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next dc, fpdc around next 4 fptr **, dc in next d, ch 1; repeat from * around, end at **; join to 3rd ch of ch-4.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® (Solids: 6 oz/170 g; 315 yds/288 m; Heathers: 5 oz/141.7 g; 250 yds/228 m)
Contrast B Dark Country Blue (9711) 2 balls
Contrast F Lt Country Peach (9737) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm]. Motif = Approx 3¾" [9.5 cm] square.
instructions:
MOTIF
With A, make 32.
With B, make 29.
With C, D and G, make 25 each.
With F, make 24.
With E, make 20.
Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 5 (counts as dc and ch 2). (3 dc. Ch 2) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 5.
2nd rnd: Sl st in next ch-2 sp. Ch 3 (counts as dc). (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same ch-2 sp. [Ch 1. Skip next 3 dc. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. Ch 1. Skip next 3 dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
3rd rnd: Sl st in each of next 2 dc and ch-2 sp. Ch 3 (counts as dc). (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same ch-2 sp. [Ch 1. Skip next 3 dc. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next 3 dc. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. Ch 1. Skip next 3 dc. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next 3 dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Motifs tog as shown in Diagram (see page 2).
Edging: 1st rnd: (RS). Join B with sl st in any corner of Afghan. Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work sc evenly around outer edge, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.

abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
gauge: 2.5 hdc and 1.5 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions: Note: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as hdc. With A, ch 33. 1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 31 hdc. 2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. *1 dcbp around next st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 dcbp around next st. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. *1 dcfp around next st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 dcfp around next st. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn. Rep 2nd and 3rd rows for pat until work from beg measures approx 40" [101.5 cm], ending on a WS row. Break A. Join B. With B cont in pat, until work from beg measures approx 59" [150 cm], ending on a RS row. Fasten off.

materials: Caron One Pound (100% Acrylic, 16oz/453.6g, 812yds/742 m skein): #00513 Soft Pink (A), 2 skeins
CROCHET HOOK: Size US H-8 (5 mm) crochet hook, or size to obtain gauge
abbreviations: CL3: *Yo, insert hook in next st, pull up loop, yo, pull thru 2 loops; repeat from * twice in same st, yo, pull thru all 4 loops.
Tr4tog: *(Yo) twice, insert hook in next st, pull up loop, (yo, pull thru 2 loops) twice; repeat from * 3 times, yo, pull thru all 5 loops on hook.
gauge: In Cluster Stitch pattern, 14 sts and 8 rows = 4"/10cm
instructions:
Cluster Stitch Pattern (worked on even number of sts):
Set up row: CL3 into 4th ch from hook, *ch 1, skip 1 ch, CL3 in next ch, repeat from *, turn.
Row 1: Ch 3, skip first CL3, *CL3 in ch 1 sp, ch 1, skip CL3; repeat from *, CL3 in top of turning ch, turn.
Repeat Row 1 for Cluster St pattern.
BLANKET
Using A, ch 118.
Work set up row. Beginning Cluster St pattern Row 1, work until blanket measures 34"/86.5cm. Cut A.
Edging
Join B at a corner, *ch 4, tr4tog, ch 4, sl st into next 2 dc; repeat from * to end, ending with 1 sl st in last dc. Fasten off.
Repeat for each side of blanket.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.
FLOWERS (make 5)
Using C, ch 6, join with sl st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 15 dc into ring, join with sl st in top of ch 3 - 16 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 2 dc in next dc, (1 dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc) 7 times, join with sl st to top of ch 3 - 24 dc. Cut C.
Round 3: Join A, ch 3 (counts as dc), 1 dc into st at base of ch 3, 2 dc in each of the next 23 dc, join with sl st to ch 3 - 48 dc. Cut B.
Round 4: Join B, (ch 4, tr4tog, ch 4, sl st into next 2 dc) 7 times, ch 4, tr4tog, ch 4, sl st into next dc.
Fasten off.
Arrange flowers as desired. Sew in place.

materials: RED HEART® “Eco-Ways™”: 3 balls each 3114 Chamois A, 3520 Aquarium B, 1615 Lichen C, 3360 Mushroom D; 4 skeins 3313 Oyster E.
abbreviations: dc4tog = [yo and draw up a loop in next st, yo and draw through 2 loops] 4 times, yo and draw through all 5 loops on hook.
dc5tog = [yo and draw up a loop in next st, yo and draw through 2 loops] 5 times, yo and draw through all 6 loops on hook.
gauge: Square measures 6” x 6”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Square A (Make 16)
With A, wind yarn around finger for beginning ring, leaving a tail to tighten the ring; insert hook into ring and draw yarn through. Tighten ring after Rnd 1 is completed. Weave in end.
Rnd 1: Ch 3, 4 dc in ring, [ch 3, 5 dc in ring] 3 times, ch 3; join with a slip st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Rnd 2: Join E in same st as joining, ch 3, dc4tog (counts as first dc5tog), ch 5, [slip st in next ch-3 space, ch 5, dc5tog, ch 5] 3 times, slip st in next ch-3 space, ch 5; join to top of first dc5tog. Fasten off.
Rnd 3: Join A in top of any dc5tog; * working over the ch-5 of Rnd 2, (5 dc, ch 3, 5 dc) all in next ch-3 space of Rnd 1, slip st in top of next dc5tog; repeat from * around.
Rnd 4: Ch 3, 4 dc in same st as joining, * skip 2 dc, sc in next dc, skip 2 dc, (5 dc, ch 3, 5 dc) in next ch-3 space, skip 2 dc, sc in next dc, skip 2 dc, 5 dc in next slip st; repeat from * around, end at **; join. Fasten off.
Rnd 5: Join E in any st; ch 1, sc in each dc and sc around and work (sc, ch 3, sc) in each ch-3 space; join. Fasten off.
Rnd 6: Join A in any st; ch 3, dc in each sc around and work (dc, ch 3, dc) in each ch-3 space; join. Fasten off.
Square B (C, D): Make 16 (16, 15) squares same as Square A EXCEPT substitute B (C, D) for A.
Assembly
Sew squares together in 9 rows of 7 squares each as follows:
Rows 1, 5, and 9: A-B-C-D-A-B-C.
Rows 2 and 6: D-A-B-C-D-A-B.
Rows 3 and 7: C-D-A-B-C-D-A.
Rows 4 and 8: B-C-D-A-B-C-D.
Edging
Attach E in the dc after a corner ch-3 space.
Rnd 1: Ch 1, sc in joining; ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook – picot made; * sc in next 3 sts, picot; repeat from * around counting ch-3 spaces (other than the four corners) as one st, skipping seams and counting the corner spaces as 2 sts; join in first sc.
Rnd 2: Ch 5 (counts as dc, ch 2), picot, * ch 2, dc in 2nd of next 3 sc, ch 2, picot; repeat from * around, end at ** adjusting at corners as necessary to keep work flat; join in 3rd ch of ch-5. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® 'Eco-Ways®': 3 Balls 1821 Blue Cloud A
2 Balls each 3372 Petal B and 3313 Oyster C.
abbreviations: Cl: Yo, draw up loop in same ch or ch-space as previous st made, skip next ch or st, draw up loop in next ch or ch-space, yo, draw through all loops on hook.
hdc2tog (hdc dec): [Yarn over, insert hook into next st and draw up a loop] twice. Yarn over, draw through all loops on hook.
Picot: Ch 3, slip st in first ch.
gauge: 7½ Clusters = 4”; 11 rows = 4” in pattern st.
instructions:
With A, ch 122.
Row 1 (Right Side): Hdc in 2nd ch from hook, ch 2, *draw up loop in same ch as previous st, skip next ch, draw up loop in next ch, yo, draw through all loops on hook – Cl made, ch 2; repeat from * to last 2 chs, draw up loop in same ch as previous st, skip next ch, draw up loop in next ch, yo, draw through all loops on hook – 1 hdc, 60 ch-2 spaces and 60 Cls
Row 2: Change to B, turn, ch 1, hdc in first ch-2 space, ch 2, *draw up loop in same ch-space as previous st, skip next st, draw up loop in next ch-space, yo, draw through all loops on hook, ch 2; repeat from * to last st, draw up loop in same ch-space as previous st, draw up loop in hdc, yo, draw through all loops, changing to next color of color sequence – 1 hdc, 60 ch-2 spaces and 60 Cls
Rows 3-93: Repeat Row 2, keeping in color sequence, ending with C Row, change to A in last st. Cut B and C.
Row 94: With A, turn, ch 1, hdc in first ch-2 space, ch 1, *draw up loop in same ch-space as previous st, skip next st, draw up loop in next ch-space, yo, draw through all loops on hook, ch 1; repeat from * to last st, draw up loop in same ch-space as previous st, draw up loop in hdc, yo, draw through all loops.
Do not fasten off.
EDGING
Round 1: With A, turn, ch 1, 3 sc in first Cl, sc in next 119 ch-1 spaces or Cls, 3 sc in last st, turn to work along side edge, sc in next 93 rows, turn to work along opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first st, sc in next 119 ch-1 spaces or sts, 3 sc in last st, turn to work along opposite side edge, sc in next 93 rows, slip st in first st – 436 sts.
Round 2: Sc in each sc, working 3 sc in center st at each corner, slip st in first st – 444 sts.
Round 3: Slip st in next st, *(sc, ch 4, sc) in center st of corner, [ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next st] 61 times, ch 1, skip next st, (sc, ch 4, sc) in center st of corner, [ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next st] 48 times, ch 1, skip next st; repeat from *, slip st in first st.
Fasten off A.
Round 4: With right side facing, join B with slip st in a corner ch-4 space, ch 2, draw up loop in same ch-4 space, draw up loop in next ch-1 space, yo, draw through all loops on hook, ch 1, *[draw up loop in same ch-space as previous st, draw up loop in next ch-space, yo, draw through all loops on hook, ch 1] across to next corner ch-4 space, [hdc2tog, ch 1] twice in ch-4 space, repeat from * around, slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off B.
Round 5: With right side facing, join C with sc in any ch-1 space, ch 3, slip st in first ch – picot made, [sc, picot in next space] around, slip st in first st.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart® Comfort®: 2 balls 4134 Bambi Prints
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 5mm [US H-8] and 5.5mm [US I-9]
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
*, ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Blanket measures 38 X 41” (96.5 x 104 cm) including edging
gauge: 17 dc = 5” (12.5 cm); 9½ dc rows = 5” (12.5 cm) with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Ch 120.
Row 1 (RS): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end, turn – 119 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), dc in each of next 5 sc, * ch 2, skip 5 sc, (dc, ch 1) 3 times and dc in next sc, ch 2, skip 5 sc, dc in each of next 5 sc; repeat from * to last sc, dc in last sc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), dc in each of next 5 dc, * ch 2, (sc, ch 3) in each of next 3 dc, sc in next dc, ch 2, dc in each of next 5 dc; repeat from * to last dc, dc in last dc, turn.
Row 4: Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), dc in each of next 5 dc, * ch 2, skip next 2 spaces, (dc, ch 1) 3 times and dc in next ch-3 space, ch 2, skip next 2 spaces, dc in each of next 5 dc; repeat from * to last dc, dc in last dc, turn.
Rows 5-70: Repeat Rows 3 and 4 alternately.
Row 71: Repeat Row 3.
Row 72: Ch 1, turn, sc in each of first 6 dc, *(ch 2, sc) in each of next 3 ch-3 spaces, ch 2, sc in each of next 5 dc; repeat from * to last dc, sc in last dc, turn.
Do not fasten off.
Edging
Change to smaller hook.
Round 1 (RS): Ch 1, 3 sc in first sc, sc in each of next 2 sc, skip next sc, sc in each of next 2 sc, *(sc in next ch-2 space, sc in next sc) 4 times, sc in next sc, skip next sc, sc in each of next 2 sc; repeat from * to last sc, 3 sc in last sc, sc evenly along side edge to foundation ch working approximately 3 sc for every 2 rows, 3 sc in first foundation ch, sc in each of next 2 ch, skip 1 ch, sc in each of next 2 ch **, [skip next ch, sc in each of next 2 ch] 4 times, sc in next ch, skip next ch, sc in each of next 2 ch; repeat from ** to last ch, 3 sc in last ch, sc evenly along remaining side edge, join with slip st in first sc, turn.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), dc in each st around, working 3 dc in each of 4 corner sts, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3, turn.
Rounds 3 and 4: Ch 1, sc in each st around, working 3 sc in each of 4 corner sts, join with slip st in first sc, turn.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 6 balls each 4601 Off White A and 9520 Seafoam B
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Throw measures 68” long x 45” wide (172.5 x 114.5 cm)
gauge: 9 hdc = 4” (10cm); 5 rows = 4” (10cm) in hdc cl pattern.
instructions:
THROW
With A and B held together throughout, ch 89.
Row 1: Hdc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch counts as first hdc) and in each ch across, turn—88 hdc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc), working in back loops only, hdc in each hdc to beginning ch, hdc in top of beginning ch, turn.
Row 6: Ch 2, hdc cl in same st as beginning ch and next hdc, *ch 1, hdc cl in next 2 hdc; repeat from * to last hdc and beginning ch, hdc cl in last hdc and top of beginning ch, turn—44 hdc cl, 44 ch-1 spaces, and 1 hdc.
Rows 7 and 8: Ch 2, hdc cl in first hdc cl and next ch, *ch 1, hdc cl in next hdc cl and ch; repeat from * to last hdc cl and beginning ch, hdc cl in last hdc cl and top of beginning ch, turn.
Row 9: Ch 2, skip first hdc cl, hdc in each ch and hdc cl to beginning ch, hdc in top of beginning ch, turn—88 hdc.
Rows 10–13: Repeat Rows 2–5.
Rows 14–77: Repeat Rows 6–13 eight times, do not turn at end of Row 77.
EDGING
Round 1: Ch 1, 3 sc in ch, working across ends of rows, sc evenly spaced down first side to foundation ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in each ch to last ch, 3 sc in last ch; working across ends of rows, sc evenly spaced up 2nd side; 3 sc in first hdc of Row 77, sc in each hdc of Row 77; join with slip st to first sc, do not turn.
Round 2: Reverse sc in each sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

abbreviations: Pc (popcorn): Work 5 dc in indicated st, drop loop from hook, insert hook in top of first dc of 5 dc group, replace loop on hook and draw through dc.
Rev sc (reverse sc): Working from left to right, insert hook in next st to right of last st, yo and draw up a loop, yo and draw through 2 loops on hook.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
( ) = work directions in parentheses into the specified st or space.
gauge: Block = 10” square. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions: BLOCK (make 20): Ch 6, join with a slip st to form a ring. Rnd 1 (Right Side): Ch 3 (counts as dc), 15 dc in ring; join to top of beginning ch-3 – 16 dc. Rnd 2: Ch 3, [dc in next 3 dc, (dc, ch 3, dc) in next dc] 3 times, dc in next 3 dc, dc in same ch as joining; join with ch 2, sc in top of beginning ch-3 (counts as ch-3 space here and throughout) – 20 dc and 4 ch-3 spaces. Rnd 3: Ch 3, dc in same st as join, dc in next dc, * pc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc**, (dc, ch 3, dc) in next ch-3-space, d in next 2 dc; repeat from * 3 more times, ending last repeat at **, dc in last ch-3 space; join with ch 2, sc in top of beginning ch-3 – 4 pc, 24 dc and 4 ch-3 spaces. Rnd 4: Ch 3, dc in same st as join, * pc in next dc, dc in next 3 sts, pc in next dc, dc in next dc**, (dc, ch 3, dc) in next ch-3 space, dc in next dc; repeat from * 3 more times, ending last repeat at **, dc in last ch-3 space; join with ch 1, hdc in top of beginning ch-3 (counts as ch-3 space here and throughout) – 8 pc, 28 dc and 4 ch-3 spaces. Note First popcorn of Rounds 5–8 is worked into the base of the beginning chain-3 (same stitch as join). Rnd 5: Ch 3, dc around post of joining hdc, *[pc in next dc, dc in next 3 sts] twice, pc in next dc**, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next ch-3-space; repeat from * 3 more times, ending last repeat at **, 2 dc in last ch-3 space; join with ch 1, hdc in top of beginning ch-3 – 12 pc, 40 dc and 4 ch-3 spaces. Rnd 6: Ch 3, dc around post of joining hdc, *[pc in next dc, dc in next 3 sts] 3 times, pc in next dc**, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next ch-3-space; repeat from * 3 more times, ending last repeat at **, 2 dc in last ch-3 space; join with ch 1, hdc in top of beginning ch-3 – 16 pc, 52 dc and 4 ch-3 spaces. Rnd 7: Ch 3, dc around post of joining hdc, *[pc in next dc, dc in next 3 sts] 4 times, pc in next dc**, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next ch-3-space; repeat from * 3 more times, ending last repeat at **, 2 dc in last ch-3 space; join with ch 1, hdc in top of beginning ch-3 – 20 pc, 64 dc and 4 ch-3 spaces. Rnd 8: Ch 3, dc around post of joining hdc, *[pc in next dc, dc in next 3 sts] 5 times, pc in next dc**, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next ch-3-space; repeat from * 3 more times, ending last repeat at **, 2 dc in last ch-3 space; join with ch 1, hdc in top of beginning ch-3 – 24 pc, 76 dc and 4 ch-3 spaces. Rnd 9: Ch 3, dc around post of joining hdc, dc in same st as join, *dc in each st across to next ch-3 space**, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next ch-3-space; repeat from * 3 more times, ending last repeat at **, 2 dc in last ch-3 space, ch 3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 116 dc and 4 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off. FINISHING: Join blocks into 4 rows with 5 blocks in each row as follows: With right sides of 2 blocks together, working through both thicknesses, join with sc in ch-3 space, sc in each dc across side to next ch-3 space, sc in next ch-3 space. Fasten off. Join remaining blocks together, then join rows together in same manner, working across all blocks of row before fastening off. Border-Rnd 1: With right side facing, join with sc in ch-3 space in any corner, sc in each st around edge, working 3 sc in each of 4 corner ch-3 spaces, sc in each joined ch-3 space and sc in each block joining; join with sl st in first sc. Rnd 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, work rev sc in each remaining st around; join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends. Tassels (make 4): Wrap yarn around cardboard 20 times. Cut end of yarn. Insert a piece of yarn under wraps at top edge of cardboard and make a knot. Cut bottom edge of wraps and remove from cardboard. Wrap a piece of yarn around wrapped yarn about 1” from top edge. Tie a knot and secure ends. Trim bottom edge evenly. Attach 1 tassel to each corner of afghan.

Border Panel 7
With A, repeat border panel 1 across bottom of throw (edge panel 7), joining with slip sts to rows 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15 and 17 of border square 6.

With C, repeat border square 5 in bottom left-hand corner working across bottom edge of edge panel 1, joining with slip sts to rows 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, and 11 of border panel 7.

With right side facing, join E in the first sc of last row of any border panel.

Strips 2–6 only
Round 5: With right side facing, join C with 
sc in marked space, remove marker, 2 sc in 
same space, [3 sc in next ch-1 space] twice, 
(dc, strip join, dc) in next sc, [strip join, sc] 
twice in each of next 30 ch-3 spaces, [strip 
join, dc] twice in next sc, [3 sc in next ch-1 
space] 6 times, (dc, ch 3, dc) in next sc [ch 
3, sc] twice in each of next 30 ch-3 spaces, 
[ch 3, dc] twice in next sc, [3 sc in next ch-1 
space] 3 times; join with slip st in first sc—

across ends of strips, join D with slip st in

in center st of next 3-sc group] 6 times, *{7 
dc in space at join between strips, [(sc, ch 1, 
sc) in center st of next 3-sc group] 6 times} 5 
times, 7 dc in next ch-3 space, slip st in next 
ch-3 space, [5 dc in next ch-3 space, slip st in 
next ch-3 space] 30 times*, 7 dc in next ch-3 
space; repeat from * to * once; join with slip st

Row 3: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), dc in first dc (V-st made), *ch 1, V-st in space between next two 4-dc groups; repeat from * across, ch 1, V-st in top of turning ch, turn—29 V-sts.

Change to larger hook.

Round 3: With A, slip st in next ch-1 space, [ch 2, slip st in next ch-1 space] 4 times, ch 2, slip st in next slip st, *[ch 2, slip st in next ch-1 space] 4 times, ch 2, slip st in next slip st*; repeat from * to * across to next corner 6-tr fan, **[ch 2, slip st in next ch-1 space] 5 times, ch 2, slip st in next slip st; repeat from * around, ch 2; join with slip st in first ch-1 space. Assembly
The squares will be joined from left side to right side, top to bottom using the join as you go method with B. Each of the 9 rows will have 11 clover squares.
Row 1, Square 1: Join B with a ssc over any sc between any of the clover leafs, * ch 5, skip next 5 sts, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next st, [ch 5, skip next 4 sts, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next st] twice, ch 5, skip next 5 sts **, ssc over sc; repeat from * around, end at **; join. Fasten off.
Connecting Squares
Row 1, Squares 2-11: Join B with a ssc over any sc between any of the clover leafs, ch 5, skip next 5 sts, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next st, * [ch 5, skip next 4 sts, in next st, (sc, ch 1, slip st to matching ch-3 loop of Square 1, ch 1, sc in same st)] twice, ch 5, skip next 5 sts, ssc over sc, repeat from * once more (the motif will now be connected at 4 points.) complete Square as for Square 1. Fasten off.
Row 2, Square 1: Join B with a ssc over any sc between the clover leafs, * ch 5, skip next 5 sts, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next st, [ch 5, skip next 4 sts, (sc, ch 1, slip st in ch-3 loop of matching adjacent loop of first Square of Row 1, ch 1, sc in same space)] twice, ch 5, ssc over sc; repeat from * once more (the motif is connected at 4 points.); complete Square. Fasten off.
Connecting Squares
Row 2, Squares 2-11: For the remaining 10 squares of Row 2, connect to the four ch-3 loops of square 1 of Row 2 AND the 3 adjacent ch-3 loops of matching squares on Row 1. Work the remaining motif as in motif 1 of Row 2. Fasten off.
Continue to join squares in this manner until there are 9 rows of 11 squares joined. Weave in ends.
Lots of good luck wishes go into each stitch of this wonderful crocheted throw. Make it for St. Patrick’s Day, a March birthday or any time you want to send a good luck sentiment.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) Tunisian/Afghan hook and G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Beginning cluster (beginning cl) = Ch 2, yo, insert hook in same sp as joining, yo and draw up a lp to height of ch-2, yo and draw through all lps on hook.
Beginning joint st = ch 2, skip next st, yo, insert hook in next st, yo and draw up a lp to height of ch-2, yo and draw through all lps on hook.
Cluster (cl) = [yo, insert hook in specified st, yo and draw up a lp to height of ch-2] twice, yo and draw through all lps on hook.
Long dc = Yo, insert hook under specified st, yo and draw up a lp to height of row in work, [yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] twice.

Tss (Tunisian simple stitch) = One row of Tunisian simple stitch is worked in two steps as follows: Forward Pass (step 1): Sk first vertical bar; *insert hook under next vertical bar, yo and draw up a lp; repeat from * across. Joint st = Yo, insert hook in same st where last lp was drawn up, yo and draw up a lp to height of ch-2, sk next st, yo, insert hook in next st, yo and draw up a lp to height of ch-2, yo and draw through all 5 lps on hook. Return Pass (step 2): Yo and draw through one lp on hook; *yo and draw through 2 lps on hook; repeat from * until only one lp remains on hook (one row of Tss complete).
gauge: 17 Tss + 14 rows = 2"[5 cm] using size G-6 (4mm) crochet hook.
instructions:
NOTES
• Chart shows Tss return pass of each row only.
• Each vertical line on each row on chart represents a vertical bar of an afghan st.
• Each dot on chart represents ch-3 for picot.
CENTER PANEL
With A and afghan hook, ch 40.
1st row: Insert hook in 2nd ch from hook, yo and draw up a lp; *insert hook in next ch, yo and draw up a lp; repeat from * across – 40 lps on hook. Work Tss return pass – 40 Tss. 
2nd to 5th rows: Work Tss forward pass and return pass.
6th row: Work Tss forward pass – 40 lps on hook. For Tss return pass: yo and draw through one lp on hook, [yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] 19 times; ch 3 to be formed into picot on forward pass of next row; [yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] 20 times – 39 Tss and 1 Tss with picot.
7th row: Work Tss forward pass, holding ch-3 lp toward front to form picot – 40 lps on hook. For Tss return pass: yo and draw through one lp on hook, [yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] 18 times; ch 3 for picot, [yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] twice; ch 3 for picot, [yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] 19 times – 38 Tss and 2 Tss with picots. 
Follow each row on chart from A to D. Working Tss forward pass as before and starting with 8th row of chart for Tss return pass, follow chart until Tss return pass of row 23 is completed, then repeat rows 6th to 23rd twelve times more, rows 6th to 14th once and 2nd row five times more.
Last Row: Sk first vertical bar, sl st in next vertical bar and in each vertical bar across. Fasten off.
NARROW PANELS (make 2 panels each with B, C and D) 
With appropriate color yarn and afghan hook, ch 20. 
1st row: Insert hook in 2nd ch from hook, yo and draw up a lp; *insert hook in next ch, yo and draw up a lp; repeat from * across – 20 lps on hook. Work Tss return pass – 20 Tss. 
2nd to 5th rows: Work Tss forward pass and return pass.
6th row: Work Tss forward pass – 20 lps on hook. For Tss return pass: yo and draw through one lp on hook, [yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] 9 times; ch 3 to be formed into picot on forward pass of next row; [yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] 10 times – 19 Tss and 1 Tss with picot.
7th row: Work Tss forward pass, holding ch-3 lp toward front to form picot – 20 lps on hook. For Tss return pass: yo and draw through one lp on hook, [yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] 8 times; ch 3 for picot, [yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] twice; ch 3 for picot, [yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] 9 times – 18 Tss and 2 Tss with picots.
Follow each row on chart from B to C. Working Tss forward pass as before and starting with 8th row of chart for Tss return pass, follow chart until Tss return pass of 23rd row is completed, then repeat rows 6th to 23rd twelve times more, rows 6th to 14th once and 2nd row five times more.
Last Row: Sk first vertical bar, sl st in next vertical bar and in each vertical bar across. Fasten off.
PANEL BORDER
1st row: With crochet hook and right side facing, join D with sl st in lower-right-hand corner of any panel; working across long edge, ch 1, sc in corner, sc in end st of next row; *long dc under 4th afghan st bar below next end st; sk end st behind long dc, sc in end st of next 3 rows; repeat from * across, ending with sc in end st of last 2 rows – 253 sts. Fasten off. Do not turn.
2nd row: With right side facing, join C with sl st in first sc, ch 1, sc in back lp of same sc, sc in back lp of next 2 sts; *long dc under 3rd afghan st bar below next st, sk st behind long dc, sc in back lp of next 3 sts; repeat from * across, ending with sc in back lp of last 5 sts. Fasten off. Do not turn.
3rd row: With right side facing, join B with sl st in first sc, ch 1, sc in back lp of same sc, sc in back lp of next 3 sts; *long dc under 2nd afghan st bar below next st, sk st behind long dc, sc in back lp of next 3 sts; repeat from * across, ending with sc in back lp of last 4 sts. Fasten off. Do not turn.
4th: With right side facing, join A with sl st in first sc, ch 1, sc in back lp of same sc, sc in back lp of next 4 sts; *long dc under first afghan st bar below next st, sk st behind long dc, sc in back lp of next 3 sts; repeat from * across. Fasten off.
Work 1st to 4th rows of Panel Border across other long edge of same panel. Work Panel Border on both long edges of each remaining panel.
JOINING
With lower edge of each panel at same end and right sides facing, join panels along long edges in following order: D, C, B, A, B, C, D. To join panels: Place first two panels side by side. Join D with sl st in lower-right-hand corner of first panel. Working loosely throughout, sl st in back lp of same st as joining; *sl st in back lp of corresponding st on second panel, sl st in back lp of next st on first panel; repeat from * across. Fasten off.
EDGING
1st rnd: With crochet hook and right side facing, join D with sl st in upper-right-hand corner; working in sts of Panel Border and in end sts of rows along narrow edge; work beginning joint st, ch 1; *work joint st, ch 1; repeat from * across to next corner; work cl in corner, ch 1; repeat from * around, working joint sts in back lp of sts along Panel Border. Join with sl st in top of beginning joint st. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join C with sl st in last ch-1 sp made; work beginning cl; ch 1; *work joint st in same sp where last lp was drawn up and in next ch-1 sp; ch 1; repeat from * across to next corner, working end of last joint st in ch-1 sp before next cl; work cl in same sp where last lp was drawn up, ch 1, joint st in same sp where last lp was drawn up and in next ch-1 sp for corner, ch 1**; cl in same sp where last lp was drawn up, ch 1; repeat from * around, ending final repeat at **. Join with sl st in top of beginning cl. Fasten off.
3rd rnd: With B, work same as 2nd rnd.
4th rnd: With A, work same as 2nd rnd.
FINISHING
Weave in all ends.

materials: Bernat® Bundle Up™ (4.9 oz/140 g; 267 yds/244 m) Main Color (MC) Cloud White (74028) 2 balls
Contrast C Little Red Wagon (74024) 1 ball
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch/ch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
HdcCl = Yoh and draw up a loop in next st. Yoh and draw up a loop in same st. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 14 sts and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc.
• When not in use, MC is carried along edge of work. A, B, and C are cut at the end of each row.
Stripe Pat 
With MC, work 6 rows.
With A, work 1 row.
With B, work 1 row.
With MC, work 6 rows.
With A, work 1 row.
With C, work 1 row.
These 16 rows form Stripe Pat.

With MC, ch 111. (Pattern rep is 18 plus 3.)
1st row:  1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). *1 hdc in each of next 6 ch. (Hdc2tog) twice.1 hdc in each of next 6 ch. 2 dc in each of next 2 ch. Rep from * to end of row, ending final rep with 2 dc in last ch. Turn.
2nd row:  Ch 3. 1 dc in first st of row. *1 hdc in each of next 6 sts. (Hdc2tog) twice. 1 hdc in each of next 6 sts. 2 dc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to end of row, ending final rep with 2 dc in last st (top of turning ch-3.) Turn. First 2 rows of Stripe Pat are now in place.  
3rd to 7th rows:  As 2nd row.
8th row:  Ch 3. 1 dc in first st. *1 hdccl in each of next 6 sts. (Hdc2tog) twice. 1 hdccl in each of next 6 sts. 2 dc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to end of row, ending final rep with 2 dc in last st (top of turning ch-3).
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep 2nd to 8th rows for Ripple Pat until work from beg measures approx. 26" [66 cm], ending after a 6th row of Ripple Pat.  Fasten off.

Border
Join MC with sl st to any corner st. Work 2 rnds evenly in sc around Blanket, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc at end of rnd. Fasten off.

materials: Caron® One Pound™ (16 oz/453.6 g; 812 yds/742 m)
Size U.S. J/10 (6 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 10 dc and 5 rows = 4" [10 cm]. Motif = 8" [20.5 cm] square.
instructions:
Motif (make 16 with A, make 24 with B, make 9 with C).
Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring. (See diagram on page 2).
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 3 dc in ring. (Ch 3. 4 dc in ring) 3 times. Ch 3. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
2nd rnd: Ch 5 (counts as dc. Ch 2). *Skip next 2 dc. 1 dc in next dc. (2 dc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in next ch-3 sp.** 1 dc in next dc. Ch 2. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st in 3rd ch of ch 5.
3rd rnd: Ch 5 *Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. (2 dc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in next ch-3 sp.** 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Ch 2. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Join with sl st in 3rd ch of ch 5.
4th rnd: Ch 5. *Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. (2 dc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in next ch-3 sp.** 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 2. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Join with sl st in 3rd ch of ch 5.
5th rnd: Ch 5. *Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. (2 dc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in next ch-3 sp.** 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Ch 2. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 1 dc in each of last 6 dc. Join with sl st in 3rd ch of ch 5. Fasten off.
Finishing
Sew Motifs together as shown in Assembly Diagram on page 2.
Edging: With RS facing, join A with sl st to any corner. Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around all side edges, having 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Super Value (Ombres: 5 oz/142 g; 251 m/275 yds)
Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 40" [101.5 cm] diameter from point to point.
gauge: 13 dc and 7 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 3 counts as dc at beg of rnd.
• Join rnds with sl st to top of ch 3.
Beg at center, ch 5. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 9 dc in ring. Join. 10 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). *1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4. 10 ch-1 sps.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 2 dc in same sp. *3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around. Join. 30 dc.
4th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. *Ch 2. Miss next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * to last dc. Ch 2. Miss last dc. Join. 10 ch-2 sps.
5th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. *(2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) – cluster made in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * to last ch-2 sp. Cluster in last ch-2 sp. Join.
6th rnd: Sl st in each dc across to next ch-2 sp. (Ch 3. 1 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) in same sp – beg cluster made. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Miss next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc.** Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * to last 6 dc. Rep from * to **. Join.
7th rnd: Beg cluster. *1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Miss next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. ** Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * to last 8 dc. Rep from * to **. Join.
8th rnd: Beg cluster. *1 dc in each of next 4 dc. Miss next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc.** Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * to last 10 dc. Rep from * to **. Join.
9th rnd: Beg cluster. *1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Miss next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc.** Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * to last 12 dc. Rep from * to **. Join.
10th rnd: Beg cluster. *1 dc in each of next 6 dc. Miss next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 6 dc.** Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * to last 14 dc. Rep from * to **. Join.
Cont as established, having 1 more dc between point and valley on each rnd, until work from center to outer point measures 20" [51 cm]. Fasten off.

pattern_name: Griddle Stitch Inverse Squares Crochet Blanket
materials: Red Heart® With Love™ (7 oz/x 198; 370 yds/338 m)
Size U.S. J/10 (6 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 12 sts and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Griddle St Pat.
instructions:
Notes:
• When changing yarn colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed in new color, leaving old color at WS of work
• Carry color when not in use across top of previous row and work sts around it to avoid stranding. Give yarn a gentle tug to ensure carried yarn sits flat against top of row.
With B, ch 141.
Beg working Chart in Griddle St Pat indicated below, reading RS rows from right to left and WS rows from left to right, noting first 20-st block is worked once, and 40-st repeat is worked 3 times.
Griddle St Pat
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 dc in next ch. 1 sc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
2nd row:  (WS). Ch 1. *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row for Griddle St Pat until 36-row Chart has been worked a total of 4 times. Finished blanket is 8 blocks tall by 7 blocks wide.
Turn at the end of last row. Break B. Do not fasten off A.
Border:
1st round: (RS). With B, ch 1. Work 1 sc in each st across top of Blanket to last st. Work 3 sc in last st. Work in sc down side of blanket, working 1 sc in side of each sc, and 2 sc in side of each dc. Work around rest of Blanket as established, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd round: Ch 1. Work 1 sc in each st around, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Patons® Canadiana™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 205 yds/187 m) Medium Water Blue (10144) 17 balls
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: HdCL = (Yoh and draw up a loop) 3 times in indicated stitch or space. Yoh and draw through all 7 loops on hook
gauge: 14 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Larksfoot Track Panel (make 4)
See Diagram 1 on page 3.
Ch 21.
1st row: (RS). Dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each of next 4 ch. (Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 dc in each of next 5 ch) twice. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. 19 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sts. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts) twice. 1 sc in top of turning ch. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). *Yoh and draw up a loop in next sc. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Skip next sc. (Yoh) twice and draw up a loop from front to back to front around post of next dc 2 rows below next sc. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through rem 3 loops on hook – Rt Post St made. 1 dc in each of next 3 sc. (Yoh) twice and draw up a loop from front to back to front around post of same dc as last Rt Post St. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice, yoh and draw up a loop in next sc, yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through rem 3 loops on hook – Lt Post St made.** Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. Rep from * once more, then from * to ** once. 1 dc in last sc. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows for pat until work from beg measures 60" [152.5 cm], ending on a 3rd row. Fasten off.
Edging: With RS facing, join yarn with sl st in lower corner. Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around outer edge of Panel, working 3 sc in corners. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Shell Stitch Panel (make 3)
See Diagram 2 on page 3.
Ch 50.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *Ch 1. Skip next 3 ch. [(HdCL. Ch 2) twice. HdCL] in next ch – shell made. Ch 1. Skip next 3 ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Turn. 6 shell repeats.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in first sc. *Ch 2. 1 sc in center HdCL of next shell. Ch 2. 3 dc in next sc. Rep from * across, ending with 2 dc in last sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. (1 hdc. Ch 2. HdCL) in first dc. *Ch 1. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Shell in center dc of next 3 dc. Rep from * across, ending with (HdCL. Ch 2. 1 hdc) in top of turning ch. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first hdc. *Ch 2. 3 dc in next sc. Ch 2. 1 sc in center HdCL of next shell. Rep from * across, ending with 1 sc in last hdc. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 1. Shell in center dc of next 3 dc group. Ch 1. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * across, ending with 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
Rep 2nd to 5th rows for pat until work from beg measures 60" [152.5 cm], ending on a 2nd or 4th row. Fasten off.
Edging: With RS facing, join yarn with sl st in lower corner. Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around outer edge of Panel, working 3 sc in corners (and working same number of sc along each side edge as Larksfoot Track Panel for ease in joining). Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Assemble Panels tog as follows: (Larksfoot Track, Shell Stitch) 3 times. Larksfoot Track.
To join Panels: Place RS of Panels facing each other. With WS facing, working through both thicknesses, join yarn with sl st through back loops only of corresponding corner sc. Ch 1. Working in back loops only, work 1 row of sc up side edge to join Panels. Fasten off.
Note-Joining will leave a ridge/ditch visible along joins on RS of work.
Edging: 1st rnd: (RS). Join yarn with sl st in any corner sc. Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp. Work 1 sc in each sc around Afghan, working 3 sc in each corner sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 4 hdc in same sp as last sl st. 1 hdc in each sc around, working 5 hdc in each corner sc. Join with sl st to top of ch 2.
3rd rnd: Ch 1, working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work reverse sc in each hdc around; join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 2 Skeins each 774 Lt. Raspberry CA, 376 Burgundy CB, 378 Claret CC, 358 Lavender CD, and 776 Dark Orchid CE.
abbreviations: CA, CB, etc. = color A, B, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Afghan measures approximately 40” wide x 48” long.
gauge: Square = 4½” x 4½”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SOLID SQUARE (Make 20-4 in each color): Ch 5; join with a sl st in first ch to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 3, 2 dc in ring, ch 2, [3 dc in ring, ch 2] 3 times; join with a sl st in top of ch-3.
Rnd 2: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in next ch-2 sp, [dc in next 3 dc, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in next ch-2 sp] 3 times; join.
Rnd 3: Ch 3, dc in next 4 dc, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in next ch-2 sp, [dc in next 7 dc, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in next ch-2 sp] 3 times, dc in next 2 dc; join.
Rnd 4: Ch 3, dc in next 6 dc, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in next ch-2 sp, [dc in next 11 dc, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in next ch-2 sp] 3 times, dc in next 4 dc; join – 15 dc between corner sps. Fasten off.
SINGLE-ROW STRIPE SQUARE (Make 20): With color CA, CB, CC, CD or CE, work Rnds 1-3 same as for Solid Square for 4 squares per color, then work Rnd 4 of each square with a different contrasting color.
DOUBLE-ROW STRIPE SQUARE (Make 20): With color CA, CB, CC, CD or CE, work Rnds 1 and 2 same as for Solid Square for 4 squares per color, then work Rnds 3 and 4 of each square with a different contrasting color.
TRIPLE-ROW STRIPE SQUARE (Make 20): With color CA, CB, CC, CD or CE, work Rnd 1 same as for Solid Square for 4 squares per color, then work Rnds 2-4 of each square with a different contrasting color.
HEART (Make 20-4 in each color): Ch 11.
Point-Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 10 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc to last 2 sc; sc2tog; turn – 9 sc.
Rows 3-7: Rep Row 2 – 4 sc at end of Row 7.
Row 8: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice; turn – 2 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc2tog – 1 sc. Fasten off.
Bumps-Row 1: With right side facing and working in rem lps of beg ch, join yarn in the first ch; ch 1, sc in same ch and next 4 ch; turn – 5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across.
Row 3: Sc2tog, sc in next sc, sc2tog. Fasten off.
With right side facing, join yarn in next free lp of beg ch and rep Rows 1-3.
FINISHING: Weave in ends. Sew hearts to Solid Squares, ensuring that the heart and square color are different. Randomly arrange all squares into an 8 square x 10 square grid, and sew together. Edging is worked in short rows across 1 or more squares in different colors. When fastening off, leave a yarn tail to sew the seams between edging sections.
LOWER EDGING-Row 1: With right side facing, join CA in lower left corner of afghan; ch 3, dc evenly across 3 squares; turn.
Rows 2-4: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in next dc and in each dc across and in top of ch-3; turn. Fasten off.
Join CB and work 4 rows dc across next 2 squares of lower edge. Fasten off. Join CC and work 4 rows dc across next 3 squares. Fasten off.
SIDE EDGING: Join CD and work 4 rows dc across row ends of last edging section and next 3 squares. Fasten off. Join CE and work 4 rows dc across next 4 squares. Fasten off. Join CA and work 4 rows dc across one square. Fasten off. Join CB and work 4 rows dc across next 2 squares. Fasten off.
TOP EDGING: Join CC and work 4 rows dc across row ends of last edging section and next 4 squares. Fasten off. Join CD and work 4 rows dc across next 3 squares. Fasten off. Join CE and work 4 rows dc across one square. Fasten off.
SIDE EDGING: Join CA and work 4 rows dc across row ends of last edging section and next 2 squares. Fasten off. Join CB and work 4 rows dc across next 3 squares. Fasten off. Join CD and work 4 rows dc across next 2 squares. Fasten off. Join CE and work 4 rows dc across last 3 squares and row ends of first edging section. Fasten off.
Sew ends of edging sections tog. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 4 Skeins 313 Aran A; 2 skeins each 631 Light Sage B and 406 Medium Thyme C.
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: Motif is 6” across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
MOTIF (Make 88)
With B, ch 7; join with slip st in 1st ch to form ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 5 (counts as tr, ch 1), [tr, ch 1] 15 times in ring; join in 4th ch of ch-5 – 16 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 2: Attach A in any ch-1 space; ch 1, sc in same space, ch 2, * sc in next ch-1 space, ch 2; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off.
Round 3: Attach C in any ch-2 space; ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in same space, ch 1, * 2 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 1; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off.
Round 4: Attach A in any ch-1 space, ch 3, dc in same space, ch 3, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, * 2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 3, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off.

SQUARE (Make 70)
Round 1 (Right Side): With A, ch 6, ([hdc, ch 3] 3 times) all in 6th ch from hook; join to 3rd ch of beginning ch-6 – 4 ch-3 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 3, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in next ch-3 space, * dc in next hdc, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off.

TRIANGLE (Make 34)
Row 1 (Wrong Side): With A, ch 5, (hdc, ch 3, hdc, ch 1, dc) all in 5th ch from hook; turn.
Row 2: Ch 5 (counts as tr, ch 1), dc in 1st dc, dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next hdc, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in next ch-3 space, dc in next hdc, dc in next ch-1 space, (dc, ch 1, tr) all in 4th ch of beginning ch-5. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Following diagram, hold right sides of 2 Motifs together. With A and working through back loops only of both Motifs, sew through center st of any ch-3 space, next ch, next 2 dc, next ch-1 space, next 2 dc, next 2 ch. Fasten off. In this manner, join all pieces according to diagram.

Edging-Round 1: With Right Side facing, attach A in ch-3 space at corner marked with arrow on diagram, ch 5, dc in same space, [ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 1, (dc, ch 3, dc) all in next ch-3 space] 3 times; ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 1, * sc around post of next tr, ch 1, sc in top of next dc, ch 1, sc in center ch, ch 1, sc in top of next dc, ch 1, sc around post of next tr, ch 1, dc in next ch-3 space, ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 1, (dc, ch 3, dc) all in next ch-1 space; ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 1, ** repeat from * across side; *** [(dc, ch 3, dc) all in next ch-3 space, ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 1] 4 times; repeat from ** around; end at ***; join.

Round 2: Ch 1, [sc, ch 1] twice in next ch-3 space; work (sc, ch 1) in each ch-1 space and ([sc, ch 1] twice) in each ch-3 space around; join.

instructions:
THROW

Rows 2–51 (51, 55, 55): Ch 2 (does not count as a st here and throughout), dc in each dc across, turn. Fasten off.

Block [make 5 (6, 7, 8)]
Ch 8; join in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), 15 dc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—16 dc.
Round 2: Ch 5 (counts as first dc, ch 2), dc in next dc, (ch 2, dc) in each dc around, ch 2; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—16 dc and 16 ch-2 spaces
Round 3: Ch 3, 3 dc in first ch-2 space, dc in next dc, ch 5, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next ch-2 space, *ch 5, skip next dc, dc in next dc, 3 dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next dc, ch 5, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * twice, ch 5, skip last dc; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—20 dc and 8 ch-5 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in next dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, [ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] twice, *ch 5, dc in next 2 dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, [ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] twice; repeat from * twice, ch 5; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—28 dc and 12 ch-5 spaces.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, [ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] 3 times, *ch 5, dc in next 3 dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, [ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] 3 times; repeat from * twice, ch 5; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—36 dc, 12 sc, and 16 ch-5 spaces.
Round 6: Ch 3, skip next dc, dc in next 5 dc, skip next dc, dc in next dc, [ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] twice, 3 dc in next sc, [sc in next ch-5 space, ch 5] twice, *dc in next dc, skip next dc, dc in next 5 dc, skip next dc, dc in next dc, [ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] twice, 3 dc in next sc; repeat from * until end; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 7: Ch 3, skip next dc, dc in next 3 dc, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space, 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-5 space, ch 5, sc in center st of next 3-dc group, ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space, 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-5 space, *ch 5, dc in next dc, skip next dc, dc in next 3 dc, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space, 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-5 space; repeat from * until end; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 8: Ch 3, skip next dc, dc in next dc, dc2tog, ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space, ch 5, sc in center st of next 3-dc group, ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space, 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-5 space, ch 5, sc in center st of next 3-dc group; repeat until end; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.

With end tails, seam Blocks together in a 1-row panel.

instructions:
Welcome to The Study of Geometry
From Mikey:  Inspired by the quilting concept of diamonds that burst outward from the centre. Then filled in with a triangle to link them together for a hexagonal shape in the end. This was a summer school stitching project where I had to repeat the semester three times to get it right. I mean, my protractor was off, I’m sure of it but you know, denial is a great thing. What was throwing me into the pond where the angles of getting the triangles to sit correctly with just the precise stitchwork of growth. Like I would say to any student, try, try, try again. It’s easier said than done. Luckily for you, I’ve done the math and when the diamonds went together, I squealed with delight. I had to change my designing technique for this one which made it a worthwhile lesson. I think in future, I may be designing this same way as it seemed to work wonders. So let’s meet at the coffee shop just outside the park where I will have your summer school assignment. Our adventure will take us through the park.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver Pooling®: 6 skeins 8536 Papaya Pooling A

abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Blanket measures 39 x 42" (99 x 106.5 cm) not including edging, or 42 x 45" (106.5 x 114.5 cm) including edging.
gauge: 3 full sc sts per each length of one color in Moss st.
instructions:
MOSS STITCH
Ch an even number of sts.
Row 1: Skip 3 ch, sc in next ch, * ch 1, skip 1 foundation ch, sc in next ch; repeat from * to end, turn.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Repeat Row 3 only for Moss st. 
BLANKET
With A, ch for at least 42" (106.5 cm), with the last loop on hook being the first loop of a new color just after a color change in the yarn.
Row 1 (right side): Skip 3 ch (counts as a st), sc in the 4th ch from hook, * ch 1, sc around the foundation ch (instead of going into a ch st); repeat from * until 5 full color sequences have been completed. The number of sc made in each individual color in the colorway should be 3. Leave remaining ch sts unworked. Undo one st repeat (sc, ch 1), turn.
Note: If at this point you are NOT getting 3 sc per color, then redo the row with a different hook size. Getting 3 sc per color with this yarn is essential to making this technique work.
Row 2 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Note: As you work this row and all remaining rows, you MUST get the correct number of sc in each color in order to maintain the planned color pooling. Change hook sizes, or actual st used, to get the correct color in place.
Row 3 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in the next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Note: The color of the sts on this row will shift to the left or right by 1 st from the previous right side row depending on the colorway and if you are right or left handed. It doesn’t matter which direction the st shifts as long as it is off-set by 1.
Row 4 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in the next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Note: The color of the sts on this row will shift to the left or right by 1 st from the previous wrong side row depending on the colorway and if you are right or left handed. It doesn’t matter which direction the st shifts as long as it is off-set by 1.
Repeat Rows 3 and 4 until 5 full color repeats have been completed lengthwise, ending on a Row 4 (wrong side row).
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Squish or stretch the sts on foundation chain to match the width of the rest of the Blanket. You can slide the sts around along the foundation chain, as with an adjustable ring. Unravel unused foundation ch sts and weave in yarn tail to secure foundation.
Edging
With right side facing, join B with slip st in foundation ch st under last sc of Row 1, being ready to work across foundation edge.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, hdc evenly around, working 3 hdc in each corner st or space; join with slip st in first hdc.
Rounds 2 – 6: Ch 2, dc in camel st of each st around, working 3 dc in camel st of each corner st, join with slip st in first dc.
Fasten off.
Weave in all loose ends.

Turn to work on left edge, ** ch 3, slip st in between rows of Puff st; repeat from ** across to corner. Turn work to the bottom, work as for top edge to corner. Turn work to the right edge, work as for left edge to corner. End with slip st in first ch of beginning ch-3.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), (dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in first ch-3 space, * (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-3 space — Shell made; repeat from * to corner, work (ch 1, Shell, ch 1) in corner; repeat from * to next corner; repeat as established around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3.

Round 4: * Ch 3, slip st in ch-1 space; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in first ch of beginning ch-3.

Using photograph as a guide, with right sides facing, position squares in a grid of 3 squares across and 3 squares down with diagonal slant of rows alternating in direction and with same colors matching. With right sides together and matching yarn, whipstitch squares together.
Special Stitches
block = (Slip st, ch 3, 3 dc) in indicated ch-3 space.
dec-block (decrease block) = Join yarn with slip stitch in ch-3 space of first block of previous row, ch 3, 3 dc in same ch-3 space.
inc-block (increase block) = Ch 6, dc in 4th ch from hook (3 skipped chains count as first ch-3 space) and in next 2 ch.
Notes
1. Blanket is made from squares worked back and forth in rows on the diagonal. Border is worked in joined rounds with right side facing at all times.
2. Blocks are worked into ch-3 space of blocks in previous row.
3. Each row increases by one block until 15 blocks are made, then each row decreases by one block until one block remains.
4. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Cut old color.
5. Place a stitch marker or piece of scrap yarn on any even row to indicate right side of each square.

Round 2: (Sc, ch 2, sc) in first sc, slip st in 
next sc, 3 hdc in next sc, ch 1, slip st in next 
sc, ch 1, 3 hdc in next sc, slip st in next sc; 
join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving 
a long tail for sewing.
Door (make 8) 
With D, ch 13.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook 
and in each ch across, turn—12 sc.
Rows 2–8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Window (make 8) 
With A, ch 4.
Round 1 (right side): Work 11 dc in 4th ch 
from hook (beginning ch count as first dc); 
join in top of beginning ch—12 dc.  
Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join D with 
sc in any dc, 2 sc in next dc, *sc in next dc, 2 
sc in next dc; repeat from * around; change 
to B; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 3: *Ch 2, slip st in next sc; repeat 
from * around; join with slip st in base of 
beginning ch. Fasten off.
Flower (make 16) 
With D, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 8 sc in 2nd ch 
from hook; change to B—8 sc. Do not join.
Round 2: Working in back loops only, *(slip 
st, ch 1, hdc) in next sc, hdc in next sc, ch 1; 
repeat from * around; join with slip st in first 
slip st. Fasten off.
Roof Trim (make 8) 
With B, ch 14.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook 
and in next 3 ch, skip next 2 ch, (dc, [ch 1, 
dc] 4 times) in next ch, skip next 2 ch, sc in
last 4 ch. Fasten off.
Swag Trim (make 16) 
With B, ch 14.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook 
and in each ch across, turn—13 sc.
Row 2: Ch 2, sc in 2nd ch from hook, *slip 
st in next 2 sc, ch 2, sc in 2nd ch from hook; 
repeat from * across to last sc, sc in last sc. 
Fasten off.
FINISHING GINGERBREAD 
HOUSE
Refer to photograph on next page for 
placement of pieces. 
Weave in ends.
Position the roof trim in a “V” near top of 
house and sew in place.
With B, embroider 4 straight stitches on 
window to make window panes. Position 
window above looped fringes and with A, 
back stitch through outer edge of Round 1.
Open looped fringes of Row 15 so each 
space is visible and tack in place. With D, 
embroider a French knot in center of each 
space.
Sew heart in place on upper half of door. 
Center door on house and sew in place. Place 
a flower on each side of door and with A, 
back stitch through outer edge of Round 1.
Sew one end of swag trim between 4th and 
5th looped fringe from side edge and sew 
other end to side edge about 1” (2.5 cm) 
below looped fringes. Repeat with 2nd swag 
trim on opposite edge.
ASSEMBLY
With wrong sides held together and working 
through inner loops with B, sew 2 houses 
together from bottom of roof to lower edge 
of house. Repeat to join 3rd and 4th house 
to form strip. Join remaining 4 houses in 
same manner to form 2nd strip. 
With D, sew strips to each long edge of 
granny square section. 
FINISHING
Border
Note Work multiples of 3 sts.
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, 
join B with sc in any st on edge of granny 
square section, evenly space sc around, 
working 3 sc in center st of 3-sc group on 
each roof; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 2, sc in 2nd ch from hook, *slip 
st next 3 sc, ch 2, sc in 2nd ch from hook; 
repeat from * around; join with slip st in first 
ch. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

gauge: 12 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm]. 14 sts and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
BLANKET
STRIP (Make 6)
See Diagram on page 2.
Ch 2.
1st row: (WS). (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 3 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc.  Ch 1. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 7 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 1. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
Rep last row until there are 41 sts, ending on a RS row.
Work straight as follows:
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 1. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last 4 sts. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 41 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 41 sts.
Rep last 2 rows until longer side edge measures 55½" [141 cm], ending on a 2nd row.
Proceed as follows:
1st row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 39 sts.
Rep last row until there are 5 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of 3 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook. Fasten off.

Sew Strips tog, alternating RS and WS facing to mirror Strips, as shown in photo.

1st row: (RS). Ch 1. Work 1 row of sc evenly across. Turn.
2nd to 8th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off.
Bottom Edging: With RS facing, join yarn with sl st at bottom left corner of Blanket.
Work as given for Top Edging.

abbreviations: dc2tog-over-5 - Double crochet 2 together worked over 5 stitches

instructions: THROW With 2 strands of A held together, ch 124. Row 1: Dc in 6th ch from hook, [ch 1, sk next ch, dc in next ch] 3 times, ch 1, sk next ch, (dc, ch 3, dc) in next ch, *[ch 1, sk next ch, dc in next ch] 3 times, ch 1, sk next ch, dc2tog-over-5, [ch 1, sk next ch, dc in next ch] 3 times, ch 1, sk next ch, (dc, ch 3, dc) in next ch; repeat from * across to last 10 ch, [ch 1, sk next ch, dc in next ch] 5 times, turn—6 'waves'. Row 2: Ch 3, sk next ch-1 sp, dc in next dc, [dc in next ch-1 sp, dc in next dc] 4 times, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next ch-3 sp, *[dc in next dc, dc in next ch-1 sp] 3 times, dc2tog-over-5, [dc in next ch-1 sp, dc in next dc] 3 times, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next st; repeat from * across to last 5 ch-sps (including turning ch-sp), [dc in next dc, dc in next ch-1 sp] 4 times, dc in next dc, dc in 4th ch of turning ch. Cut 1 strand of A and pick up 1 strand of B. Row 3: With 1 strand each of A and B held together, ch 3, sk first 2 dc, [dc in next dc, ch 1, sk next dc] 5 times, (dc, ch 3, dc) in next ch-3 sp, *ch 1, sk next dc, [dc in next dc, ch 1, sk next dc] 3 times, dc2tog-over-3, ch 1, sk next dc, (dc in next dc, ch 1, sk next dc] 3 times, (dc, ch 3, dc) in next ch-3 sp; repeat from * across to last 11 dc, [ch 1, sk next dc, dc in next dc] 5 times, sk last dc, dc in top of turning ch, turn. Row 4: Ch 3, sk next ch-1 sp, dc in next dc, [dc in next ch-1 sp, dc in next dc] 4 times, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next ch-3 sp, *[dc in next dc, dc in next ch-1 sp] 3 times, dc2tog-over-5, [dc in next ch-1 sp, dc in next dc] 3 times, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next ch-3 sp; repeat from * across to last 5 ch-1 sps, [dc in next dc, dc in next ch-1 sp] 4 times, dc in next dc, sk next ch-1 sp, sk next dc, dc in top of turning ch, turn. Cut last strand of A and pick up 1 strand of B. Rows 5 and 6: With 2 strands of B held together, repeat Rows 3 and 4. Cut 1 strand of B and pick up 1 strand of C. Rows 7 and 8: With 1 strand each of B and C held together, repeat Rows 3 and 4. Cut last strand of B and pick up 1 strand of C. Rows 9 and 10: With 2 strands of C held together, repeat Rows 3 and 4. Cut 1 strand of C and pick up 1 strand of A. Rows 11 and 12: With 1 strand each of A and C held together, repeat Rows 3 and 4. Cut last strand of C and pick up 1 strand of A. Rows 13 and 14: With 2 strands of A held together, repeat Rows 3 and 4. Cut 1 strand of C and pick up 1 strand of A. Repeat Rows 3–14 two more times. Repeat Rows 3–12 once more. Fasten off C and A. materials: Red Heart® “Super Saver®” Jumbo: 1 skein 381 Light Blue
abbreviations: crossed dc = Skip next st, dc in next st or space, working in front of last dc, dc in last skipped st or space.
cluster = [Yo, insert hook in next st or space, yo, draw yarn through, yo, draw yarn through 2 loops on hook] 3 times in same st or space, yo, draw yarn through 4 loops on hook.
shell = 5 dc in same st or space.
gauge: 3 clusters and 2 crossed dc = 4”; 6 rows = 4”.
instructions:
Ch 104.
Row 1: Working in back bottom loop of each ch, cluster in 6th ch from hook, *ch 1, skip next 2 ch, dc in next ch, dc in last skipped ch to right of last dc (crossed dc made), ch 1, skip 1 ch, cluster in next ch; repeat from * across ending with ch 1, skip 1 ch, dc in last ch, turn – 20 clusters and 19 crossed dc.
Row 2: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1 here and throughout), skip next ch-1 space, dc in next ch-1 space, dc in last skipped ch-1 space to the right (crossed dc made), *ch 1, cluster in space between next 2 dc of crossed dc, ch 1, crossed dc worked across next 2 ch-1 spaces; repeat from * across ending with ch 1, dc in 4th ch of turning ch, turn.
Row 3: Ch 4, skip next ch-1 space, *cluster in space between next 2 dc of crossed dc, ch 1**, crossed dc worked across next 2 ch-1 spaces, ch 1; repeat from * across, ending last repeat at **, ch 1, dc in 4th ch of turning ch, turn.
Rows 4-49: Repeat rows 2-3, 23 times. At end of last row, do not turn. Do not fasten off.
Round 1 (right side): Working down left-hand side, 2 sc in each row-end st across to next corner, (sc, ch 2, sc) in bottom left-hand corner ch, working across opposite side of foundation ch in 2 loops of each ch, sc in each ch-1 space and in each ch at base of a st, (sc, ch 2, sc) in bottom right corner ch, working up right-hand side, 2 sc in each row-end st across to next corner, (sc, ch 2, sc) in 4th ch of top right-hand turning ch, working across top edge, sc in first ch-1 space, sc in each st and each remaining ch-1 sp across top ending with (sc, ch 2, sc) in last dc, join with sl st in first sc – 100 sc across each side; 4 ch-2 corner spaces.
Round 2 (right side): Ch 1, sc in first sc, *[skip next 2 sc, shell in next sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc] across to next corner, skip next 2 sc, 7 dc in corner ch-2 space, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, join with sl st in first sc, turn.
Round 3 (wrong side): Ch 4, skip next dc, sc in next dc, ch 1, skip next dc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next (center) dc, ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next dc, ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next sc, *[ch 2, sc in center dc of next shell, ch 2, dc in next sc] across to next corner**, ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next dc, ch 1, skip next dc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next (center) dc, ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next dc, ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with sl st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4, turn.
Round 4 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as dc), 4 dc in first st, sc in next sc, *[shell in next dc, sc in next sc] across to next corner, 2 dc in next sc, 5 dc in corner ch-2 space, 2 dc in next sc, sc in next sc; rep from * around, join with sl st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

instructions:
Note:  Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as stitch.

Turn work 90 degrees clockwise.

SPECIAL STITCHES
Bptr (Back post treble crochet) = [Yarn over] twice, insert hook from back side of work to front and to back again around post of the indicated stitch; yarn over and pull up a loop (4 loops on hook), [yarn over and draw through 2 loops] 3 times.
Fptr (Front post treble crochet) = [Yarn over] twice, insert hook from front side of work to back and to front again around post of the indicated stitch; yarn over and pull up a loop (4 loops on hook), [yarn over and draw through 2 loops] 3 times.

NOTES
1. Throw consists of 20 leaf squares surrounded by Basket Weave borders. The leaf squares are arranged into five rows of four leaves each.
2. Throw is worked in one piece, back and forth in rows. The yarn color is changed to work borders and leaf squares in different colors.
3. To change yarn color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Do not fasten off old color until instructed. Carry color not in use up wrong side of piece when next needed.
4. Six balls of yarn are used in each row: Two balls of A for right and left side borders, and one ball for each of the four leaf squares. Use separate balls of A for each side border.
5. Squares can be worked following the written instructions or reading the charts. Read right side rows of charts from right to left. Read wrong side rows from left to right.

materials: Bernat® Baby Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 ds/201 m)
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
gauge: 7 single crochet (sc) and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Chain (Ch) 70.
1st row: [Right Side (RS)]. 1 single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook. *1 double crochet (dc) in next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Repeat (Rep) from * to end of chain. Turn. 69 sts.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. *1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows until Blanket from beginning (beg) measures 50" [127 cm]. Fasten off.
Border
Join yarn with slip stitch (sl st) to top right corner. Ch 3 (counts as dc). Work 1 round (rnd) of dc evenly around all outer edges, having 3 dc in each corner. Join with sl st to first dc. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Soft Baby Steps®”: 2 balls each 9800 Baby Blue A, 9600 White B, and 9935 Blue Earth C.
abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated

gauge: 4 groups of 3 dc and ch-2 spaces = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BLAnKET
Rectangle (Make 9)
Foundation Round: With A, ch 12; (2 dc, [ch 2, 3 dc] twice) all in 4th ch from hook, ch 2, skip 2 ch, dc in next 3 ch, ch 2, skip 2 ch, (3 dc, [ch 2, 3 dc] twice) all in last ch; working on other side of foundation ch, ch 2, skip 2 ch, dc in next 3 ch, ch 2, skip 2 ch; join with a slip st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Round 1: Join B in the last ch-2 space made; ch 3, 2 dc in same ch-2 space, * [ch 2, 3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space] twice (2 corners made) *, [ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space] twice; repeat from * to *; ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 2; join in top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join C in the ch-2 space before the next corner; ch 3, 2 dc in same ch-2 space, ch 2, * (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space (corner), ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 2, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space (corner) *, [ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space] 3 times, ch 2; repeat from * to *; [ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space] twice, ch 2; join. Fasten off
Round 3: Join A in the ch-2 space before the next corner; ch 3, 2 dc in same ch-2 space, * ch 2, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space (corner), [ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space] twice, ch 2, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space (corner) *, [ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space] 4 times; repeat from * to *; ch 2, [3 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 2] 3 times; join. Fasten off.
Sew 3 rectangles together into a strip on the short ends from wrong side, catching back loops only. Make 3 strips in this manner.
Strip Border
Round 1: With right side facing, join C in any corner space; ch 3, 2 dc in same space, * ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * to next corner; ch 2 **, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in corner space; repeat from * around, end at **; 3 dc in same corner space as joining, ch 2; join. Fasten off.
Round 2: Repeat Round 1 with B.
Whether baby is traveling around the block in a stroller or off to relatives house, this blanket will be there to comfort or provide a place to lie down and view the world. Crochet the nine rectangle granny squares in any three colors for a perfect gift.
Round 3: Repeat Round 1 with A.
Sew long edges of strips together to form center of blanket.
Blanket Border
Round 1: Repeat Round 1 of Strip Border with A.
Round 2: Repeat Round 1 of Strip Border with C.
Rounds 3, 4 and 5: Repeat Round 1 of Strip Border with B.
Round 6: Repeat Round 1 of Strip Border with C.
Rounds 7, 8 and 9: Repeat Round 1 of Strip Border with A.
Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Soft Baby”: 2 skeins 7881 Powder Blue CA

abbreviations: CA, CB, CC = Color A, Color B, Color C

gauge: 17 sts = 4”; 12 rows = 4½” in pat. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Gauge Swatch: Ch 35 and work in pat over 34 sts for 12 rows. Swatch should measure 8” wide by 4½” long.
SPECIAL ABBREVIATIONS:
dc2tog = [yo and draw up a lp in next st, yo and draw through 2 lps on hook] twice, yo and draw through all 3 lps on hook.
puff st = [yo and draw up a lp to height of dc] 4 times all in same st, yo and draw through all 9 lps on hook.
To Change Color in Sc: Draw up a lp in last st, drop color in use, draw through both lps with next color to be used.
BLANKET: With CA, ch 154.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 153 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 2, dc in next sc, [dc2tog] twice, * ch 1, [puff st in next sc, ch 1] 5 times, [dc2tog] 6 times; rep from * to last 6 sc, end at **; [dc2tog] 3 times; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts, * sc in next ch-1 sp, [sc in next puff st, sc in next sp] 5 times **, sc in next 6 sts; rep from * to last 3 sts, end at **; sc in last 3 sts changing to CB in last dc; turn. Cut CA.
Row 4: With CB, ch 3, skip first 2 sc, [dc in next sc, skip next sc] twice, * ch 1, [dc in next sc, ch 1] 5 times **, [dc in next sc, skip next sc] 6 times; rep from * to last 6 sts, end at **; [skip next sc, dc in next sc] 3 times; turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each dc and ch-1 sp across; dc in top of ch-3 changing to CC. Cut CB.
Rows 6 and 7: With CC, rep Rows 2 and 3.
