Round 6: Ch 3, dc in each st around, working (dc, tr, dc) in center sc at each corner, slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off. 
ASSEMBLY
Square A: Make 6 Squares with D as first color, G as second color, F as third color, A as last color.
Square B: Make 6 Squares with C as first color, A as second color, E as third color, A as last color.
Square C: Make 6 Squares with F as first color, B as second color, D as third color, A as last color.
Square D: Make 6 Squares with C as first color, A as second color, B as third color, A as last color.
Square E: Make 4 Squares with H as first color, A as second color, C as third color, A as last color.
Square F: Make 4 Squares with G as first color, B as second color, D as third color, A as last color.
Square G: Make 4 Squares with B as first color, E as second color, D as third color, A as last color.
Square H: Make 4 Squares with A as first color, H as second color, C as third color, A as last color.
Square I: Make 4 Squares with G as first color, A as second color, B as third color, A as last color.
Square J: Make 4 Squares with E as first color, A as second color, B as third color, A as last color.
Square K: Make 4 Squares with A as first color, B as second color, F as third color, A as last color.
Square L: Make 4 Squares with D as first color, F as second color, C as third color, A as last color.
FINISHING
Arrange Squares following Assembly Diagram. 
With wrong sides together, slip st Squares together. 
Border: Join A with slip st to corner, *skip 2 dc, 6 tr in next dc, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * evenly spaced around, slip st to first st to join. 
Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: Caron® Cloud Cakes™ (8.5 oz/240 g; 760 yds/695 m)
Size U.S. 7 (4.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 16 dc and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• When working chart, to join new color, work to last loops on hook of first color. Yoh with new color, draw through loops and proceed with new color.
• Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc.
• Carry color not in use loosely across top of previous row and work sts around it.
BLANKET  
With A, ch 226.
Work Chart, noting each square of chart is equal to 2 dc and reading RS rows from right to left and WS rows from left to right . Carry color not in use across top of entire previous row and work sts around it. This will ensure even gauge as all sts will be worked around an extra strand of yarn held across top of previous row. Carry both colors up side of work.
1st row: (RS). Following 1st row of Chart, 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 224 dc.
2nd row: Following 2nd row of Chart, ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row and cont working Chart until Row 20 of Chart is complete.
Rep 1st to 20th rows of Chart for pat until Blanket measures approx 60" [152.5 cm], ending on a 10th row of Chart pat. Fasten off.
Border: With RS facing, join A with sl st to any corner. 
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). Work dc evenly around outer edge, working 5 dc in each corner. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Super Soft™: 7 skeins 4608 Wine.
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 3 cables and 2 shells = 4”; 8 rows = 4” in pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Edging
Round 1: Ch 1, sc evenly spaced around entire afghan, working 3 sc in each corner; join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, * ch 1, sc in front loop of sc just made, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st to first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

Throw
Ch 136.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Dc in 4th ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 134 sts.
Row 2 (Right Side): Ch 3, * cable, skip next dc, 4 dc in next dc, skip next dc; repeat from * to last 3 sts; cable, dc in top of ch-3; turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, * bpdc around next 2 fpdc, shell; repeat from * to last 3 sts; bpdc around next 2 fpdc, dc in top of ch-3; turn.
Row 4: Ch 3, * cable, shell; repeat from * to last 3 sts; cable, dc in top of ch-3; turn.
Repeat Rows 3 and 4 for pattern until 55” from beginning (or desired length). Do not fasten off.
NOTE: To practice the pattern stitch, ch 31 and follow Rows 1-4 below.

Size U.S. M/13 (9 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Daisy = (Pull up 1 loop in Eye of previous Daisy. Draw up 1 loop through same ch as final loop of previous Daisy. Draw up 1 loop in each of next 3 ch. 6 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through all 6 loops on hook. Ch 1 – Eye of Daisy made)
measurements: Approx 491/2" x 60" [125.5 x 152.5 cm] square, excluding tassels.
gauge: 12 sts and 6 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Ch 183.
Set Up: 1st row: (RS). [Draw up 1 loop in 2nd ch from hook (counts as 1 hdc and 1 loop). Draw up 1 loop in each of next 4 ch. 6 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through all 6 loops on hook. Ch 1 - Eye of Daisy made] – First Set-Up Daisy complete. *(Draw up 1 loop in Eye of prev Daisy. Draw up 1 loop through same ch as final loop of prev Daisy. Pull up 1 loop in each of next 3 ch. 6 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through all 6 loops on hook. Ch 1 – Eye of Daisy made.) – Set-Up Daisy complete. Rep from * to last ch. 1 dc in last ch (same ch as final loop of previous Daisy). Turn.
Set Up: 2nd row: (WS). Ch 2 (counts as first hdc). 2 hdc in Eye of first Daisy. 3 hdc in Eye of each Daisy to end of row. 1 dc in final hdc (first ch-1 of last row). Turn. 181 sts.
Last 2 rows form 1 Daisy Stripe.
3rd row: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc). [Draw up 1 loop through 2nd ch from hook. Draw up 1 loop through first dc. Draw up 1 loop through each of next 3 hdc. Yoh and draw though all 6 loops on hook. Ch 1 - Eye of Daisy made] – First Daisy complete. *(Draw up 1 loop through Eye of prev Daisy. Draw up 1 loop through same hdc as final loop from prev Daisy. Draw up 1 loop through each of next 3 hdc. Yoh and draw through all 6 loops on hook. Ch 1 - Eye of Daisy made). Rep from * to end of row. 1 dc in last hdc (same hdc as final loop of prev Daisy). Turn.
4th row: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 2 hdc in Eye of first Daisy. 3 hdc in Eye of each Daisy to end of row. 1 dc in last hdc (top of ch-2). Turn. 181 sts
Last 2 rows form Daisy Stripe Pat.
5th to 74th rows: Rep 3rd and 4th rows 35 times more, ending on a 4th row.
37 Daisy Stripes total.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Tassels (make 38)
Cut 10 x 12" [25.5 x 30.5 cm] strands of yarn. Draw all strands through space at edge of Blanket and fold evenly in half. Wind yarn tightly around strands 1" [2.5 cm] below fold. Fasten securely. Trim ends evenly. Beg at one corner attach one Tassel at each end of every second Daisy Stripe along top and bottom edges of Blanket.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 8 (12) skeins 1562 Jadeite A

measurements: Child Size: About 27 x 46" [68.5 x 117 cm]; Adult Size: About 32 x 58" [81.5 x 147.5 cm]
gauge: 8 sts = about 4" [10 cm]; 5½ rows = 4" [10 cm] in snug sack pattern, using larger hook with 2 strands of yarn held together. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SNUG SACK
Top Ribbing
With larger hook and 2 strands of A held together, ch 9.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across – 8 sc.
Rows 2–105 (127): Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across. Do not fasten off.
Body
Row 1: Ch 1, do not turn, working along side edge, sc in end of each row across—105 (127) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, hdc in each st across.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, dc in each st across.
Rows 4-61 (77): Repeat Rows 2 and 3 for a total of 61 (77) rows in body.
Fasten off, leaving a very long tail for seaming.
With yarn tail, sew side edges of piece together. 
Seam Lower Edge: 
Place sack on flat surface with long seam running down center of back of sack. If desired, pin lower edges together before seaming.
With larger hook and 2 strands of A held together, working along opposite side of foundation and through both thicknesses of lower edge, join yarn with slip st in first st, ch 1, sc in same st, and in each st across. 
Fasten off.
SMILEY EMOJI
Head
With middle size hook and B, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 6 hdc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first hdc—6 hdc.
Note: Work first st of all following rounds in same st as joining.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 hdc in each st around, hdc in space between last st and beginning ch-1; join with slip st in first hdc—13 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st] 6 times, hdc in last st; join with slip st in first hdc—19 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts] 6 times, 2 hdc in last st; join with slip st in first hdc—26 hdc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts] 6 times, hdc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in first hdc—32 hdc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts] 6 times, hdc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in first hdc—38 hdc.
Round 7: Ch 1, [2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 5 sts] 6 times, hdc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in first hdc—44 hdc.
Round 8: Ch 1, [hdc in next 3 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts] 6 times, hdc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in first hdc—50 hdc.
Round 9: Ch 1, hdc in next 2 sts, [hdc in next 3 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 4 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first hdc—56 hdc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Eyes (make 2)
With smallest hook and F, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 6 hdc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first hdc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Smile
With smallest hook and F, ch 25.
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 22 ch, slip st in last ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Using photograph as a guide, sew eyes to head. Curve smile and sew to head.
HEART EYES EMOJI
Head
Make same as Smiley Emoji head.
Eyes (make 2)
With middle size hook and G, ch 4, (2 dtr, 2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc, 2 dtr, ch 3, slip st) in 4th ch from hook.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Smile
With smallest hook and F, ch 2.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook—1 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in sc—2 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, 2 sc in last st—3 sc.
Rows 4–11: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 12: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, skip next st, sc in last st—2 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog—1 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Using photograph as a guide, sew eyes and smile to head.
TONGUE OUT EMOJI
Head
Make same as Smiley Emoji head.
Eyes (make 2)
With smallest hook and F, ch 10.
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, skip next ch, slip st in last 4 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Mouth
With smallest hook and F, ch 2.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook—1 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in sc—2 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, 2 sc in last st—3 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, sc in last st—4 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, 2 sc in each of next 2 sts, sc in last st—6 sc. 
Rows 6–11: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 12: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last st—4 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, sc2tog, sc in last st—3 sc.
Row 14: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in last st—2 sc.
Row 15: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog—1 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Tongue
With smallest hook and G, ch 4.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, 2 sc in last ch—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] twice, sc in last st—7 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, do not turn, work a total of 7 sc evenly spaced along row ends and opposite side of foundation—7 sc.
Rows 4 and 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Using photograph as a guide, bend eyes into an angle and sew to head. Sew last row of tongue to center of mouth. Sew mouth to head, below eyes. Sew lower part of tongue to head.
TEARS OF JOY EMOJI
Head
Make same as Smiley Emoji head.
Eyes (make 2)
With smallest hook and F, ch 9.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 6 ch, slip st in last ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Eyebrows (make 2)
With smallest hook and F, ch 8.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Tears (make 2)
With middle size hook and H, ch 2.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook—1 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in sc—2 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, 2 sc in last st—3 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first st, sc in next st, 2 sc in last st—5 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, skip first 2 sts, 5 dc in next st, skip next st, slip st in last st—5 dc and 1 slip st.
Row 6 (Edging): Do not turn, sc in end of Row 4 and end of next 3 rows, ch 1 at tip of tear, sc in end of each of first 4 rows, slip st in first dc of Row 5.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Mouth
Make same as heart eyes emoji mouth.
Teeth
With smallest hook and E, ch 15.
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 12 ch, slip st in last ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Using photograph as a guide, sew teeth to upper edge of mouth. Sew mouth to head. Curve eyes and sew to head. Curve eyebrows and sew to head, above eyes. Sew tips of tears to outer corner of eyes, continue to sew to head with slight overlap with corners of mouth.
KISS
Upper Lip
With middle size hook and G, ch 17. 
Row 1 (right side): Working in back bumps only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 8 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, sc in last 2 ch—16 sts. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, slip st in first st, sc in next 2 sts, dc in next 10 sts, sc in next 2 sts, slip st in last st.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, slip st in first 2 sts, sc in next st, hdc in next st, dc in next st, 2 dc in next st, hdc in next st, sc in next 2 sts, hdc in next st, 2 dc in next st, dc in next st, hdc in next st, sc in next st, slip st in last 2 sts—18 sts.
Do not fasten off.
Lower Lip
Row 4: Do not turn, work 2 sc in side edge of upper lip, slip st in corner of lower edge of upper lip, ch 16, slip st in opposite corner of lower edge of upper lip, work 2 sc in side edge of upper lip, slip st in first st of Row 3.
Fasten off. 
Row 5 (right side): With right side of piece facing and upper lip at bottom, draw up a loop of G in first ch of lower lip, ch 1, slip st in same ch as joining and in each remaining 15 ch—16 slip sts.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 15 sts, slip st in beginning ch-1—16 sts.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, skip the slip st, slip st in first sc, sc in next st, hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st, [dc in next st, 2 dc in next st] 3 times, dc in next st, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st, sc in next st, slip st in last st—20 sts.
Row 8: Ch 1, turn, slip st in first 6 sts, sc in next st, hdc in next st, [dc in next st, 2 dc in next st] twice, hdc in next st, sc in next st, slip st in next 6 sts, slip st in beginning ch-1—23 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
SMILING POOP (make 2) 
Poop
With middle size hook and C, ch 2. Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook—1 hdc. Row 2: Ch 1, turn, 2 hdc in st—2 hdc. Row 3: Ch 1, turn, 2 hdc in each st across—4 hdc.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, [2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st] twice—6 hdc.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, 3 dc in first st, hdc in next 4 sts, 3 dc in last st—10 sts.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, 3 dc in next st, hdc in next 6 sts, 3 dc next st; leave last st unworked—12 sts.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, 3 hdc in next st, 2 dc in next st, dc in next 6 sts, 2 dc in next st, 3 hdc in next st; leave last st unworked—16 sts.
Row 8: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, slip st in next 2 sts, 5 dc in next st, dc in next 7 sts, 5 dc in next st, slip st in next 2 sts; leave remaining sts unworked—21 sts.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in first 2 sts, 4 hdc in next st, hdc in next 13 sts, 4 hdc in next st, sc in next st; leave remaining sts unworked—24 sts.
Row 10: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, slip st in next 2 sts, (hdc, 3 dc) in next st, 2 dc in next st, dc in next 13 sts, 2 dc in next st, (3 dc, hdc) in next st, slip st in next 2 sts; leave remaining sts unworked—29 sts.
Row 11: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, slip st in next 4 sts, 5 dc in next st, dc in next 15 sts, 5 dc in next st, slip st in next st; leave remaining sts unworked—30 sts.
Row 12: Ch 1, turn, slip st in first 4 sts, (slip st, dc) in next st, 4 dc in next st, dc in next 13 sts, 4 dc in next st, (dc, slip st) in next st; leave remaining sts unworked—29 sts.
Edging: Ch 1, do not turn, work sc sts evenly around entire outer edge of piece; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Eye Whites (make 2)
With smallest hook and E, ch 5.
Row 1: Work 3 hdc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 2 ch, 4 hdc in last ch; working along opposite side of foundation ch, hdc in next 2 ch, hdc in last ch; join with slip st in first hdc—12 hdc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Pupils (make 2)
With smallest hook and F, ch 3.
Row 1: Work 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, (3 sc, slip st) in last ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Sew one pupil to the center of each eye.
Smile
With smallest hook and E, make same as Heart Emoji smile.
Using photograph as a guide, sew eyes and smile to poop.
THUMBS UP (make 2)
With middle size hook and D, ch 11.
Wrist and Palm
Row 1 (right side): Working in back bumps only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—10 sc. 
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st—12 sc. 
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 3 times, sc in last st—16 sc.
Rows 8–12: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 13: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 15 sts—15 sc.
Rows 14–18: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Index Finger
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, turn, sc in first 3 sts; leave remaining sts unworked for other 3 fingers.
Rows 2–9: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 10: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next st, slip st in last st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Middle Finger
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, skip first unworked st of last row of palm following index finger, join D with slip st in next st, ch 1, sc in same st and in next 2 sts; leave remaining sts unworked for other 2 fingers—3 sc.
Rows 2–12: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 13: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next st, slip st in last st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Ring Finger
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, skip first unworked st of last row of palm following middle finger, join D with slip st in next st, ch 1, sc in same st and in next 2 sts; leave remaining sts unworked for pinky finger—3 sc.
Rows 2–10: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 11: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next st, slip st in last st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Pinky Finger
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, skip first unworked st of last row of palm following middle finger, join D with slip st in next st, ch 1, sc in same st and in next 2 sts—3 sc.
Rows 2–8: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next st, slip st in last st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Thumb
With right side facing, join D with slip st in end of Row 8 of palm on pointer finger side of palm.
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in same row end, sc in next 3 row ends—4 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in last st—4 sc.
Rows 6–8: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc2tog, slip st in last st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Using photograph as a guide, fold fingers in half and sew to palm. For first emoji, fold fingers to the right side of the palm. For second emoji, fold fingers to the wrong side of the palm.
FINISHING
Pompoms
Following package directions, make 3 pompoms with G and 2 pompoms with B. Attach pompoms to lower edge of sack, spacing them evenly and alternating colors.
Place snug sack on a flat surface. 
Notes
• If desired, arrange and pin emojis to sack before sewing.
• Insert a magazine inside the sack and behind each emoji as you sew to prevent sewing through both layers of sack.
• Using photograph as a guide, sew emojis to front of snug sack. Sew around entire edge of each emoji to secure to sack.
Weave in any remaining ends.

All in One begin with Color 1

in total. If too much color is 
left at end of rnd, pull back 
some stitches (sts) and slightly 
loosen gauge to re-work sts 
and finish at color change.

some sts and slightly tighten 
gauge to re-work sts and finish

and ch-3 sp.

in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3.

twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 
sp. Join.

in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next 
ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in 
next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. 
Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc 
in first ch-3 sp. Join.

Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 
3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 
sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next 
ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, 
then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first 
ch-3 sp. Join.

Solid Granny Square Motif (make

Work as for Granny Square All in 
One Motifs using B only.

of Blanket.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). Work

materials: Bernat® Baby Sport™ (12.3 oz/350 g; 1256 yds/1148 m)
Size 4 mm (U.S. G/6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
5 yds [4.5 m] of 3/8" [9 mm] wide ribbon.
gauge: 16 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Body of Blanket: Ch 135. 
Foundation row: (WS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. Ch 3. Miss next 4 ch. (1 dc in each of next 7 ch. Ch 3. Miss next 4 ch) 11 times. 1 dc in each of next 4 ch. Turn. 
1st row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 2. [(Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - CL made. Ch 2] twice in next ch-3 sp. [Miss next dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 2. (CL. Ch 2) twice in next ch-3 sp] 11 times. Miss next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in top of turning ch 3. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in next dc. Ch 2. CL in next CL. Ch 2. CL in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2. CL in next CL. Ch 2. (Miss next dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Ch 2. CL in next CL. Ch 2. CL in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2. CL in next CL. Ch 2) 11 times. Miss next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in top of turning ch 3. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 5 (counts as dc and ch 2). 1 dc in next CL. (2 dc in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in next CL) twice. [Ch 3. Miss next 3 dc. 1 dc in next CL. (2 dc in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in next CL) twice] 11 times. Ch 2. Miss next dc. 1 dc in top of turning ch 3. Turn.
4th row: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). CL in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2. Miss next dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 2. [(CL. Ch 2) twice in next ch-3 sp. Miss next dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 2] 11 times. CL in 4th ch of turning ch 5. Ch 1. 1 dc in 3rd ch of turning ch 5. Turn.
5th row: Ch 4 (counts as tr). 1 tr in next ch-1 sp. Ch 2. CL in next CL. Ch 2. Miss next dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Ch 2. (CL in next CL. Ch 2. CL in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2. CL in next CL. Ch 2. Miss next dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Ch 2) 11 times. CL in next CL. Ch 2. 1 tr in 4th ch of turning ch 4. 1 tr in 3rd ch of turning ch 4. Turn.
6th row: Ch 4 (counts as tr). 2 dc in next ch-2 sp. *1 dc in next CL. Ch 3. Miss next 3 dc. 1 dc in next CL. [(2 dc in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in next CL) twice. Ch 3. Miss next 3 dc] 11 times. 2 dc in next ch-2 sp. Miss next tr. 1 tr in top of turning ch 4. Turn.
Rep 1st to 6th rows 8 times more, ending with RS facing for next row.
Lace Edging
1st rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first dc. *Work 123 sc along each side of Blanket and 3 sc in corners. Place marker on 2nd sc of 3 sc corner sts. Join with sl st to first sc. 504 sc. 
2nd rnd: (eyelet rnd). Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch 3). Miss marked st. 1 dc in next sc. *Ch 3. Miss next 3 sc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to marked st. Ch 3. Miss marked st. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 6.
3rd rnd: Sl st in first ch-3 sp. [Ch 3. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - Beg CL made. Ch 2. CL] in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. (CL. Ch 2. CL) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of Beg CL.
4th rnd: Ch 3. Beg CL in same sp as sl st. Ch 2. CL in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2. CL in next CL. *Ch 3. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 3. CL in next CL. Ch 2. CL in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2. CL in next CL. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of Beg CL. Fasten off.
Weave ribbon through eyelet rnd of Lace Border.

materials: RED HEART® “Moon & Stars™”: 5 balls each 3001 Snow A and 3720 Pink Chiffon C, 2 balls 3624 Limeade B.

gauge: 15 dc = 4”; 7 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BLANKET
With B, ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring. 
Rnd 1: Ch 3, 2 dc in ring, [ch 3, 3 dc in ring] 3 times, ch 1, 
hdc in beginning ch-3. 
Rnd 2: Ch 3, dc over st just made, dc in next 3 sts, [(2 
dc, ch 3, 2 dc all in corner ch-3 space), dc in next 3 sts] 3 
times, 2 dc in corner, ch 1, hdc to beginning ch-3. Fasten 
off. 
Rnd 3: Join A in any corner ch-3 space, (ch 3, dc, ch 3, 2 
dc) all in same space, * dc in each st to next corner, ** (2
dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in corner; repeat from * around ending at **;
join to beginning ch-3.
Rnd 4: Ch 3, dc in next st, * (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in next
ch-3 space, dc in each st to corner; repeat from * around,
ending with dc in last 9 sts; join to beginning ch-3. Fasten
off.
Rnd 5: Join C and repeat Rnd 3.
Rnd 6: Repeat Rnd 4. Fasten off.
Rnd 7: Join A in any corner, ch 1, * (sc, ch 3, sc) all in
same corner, sc in each st to next corner; repeat from *
around; join to beginning sc.
Rnds 8-14: Repeat Rnd 7 in following color sequence:
B, A, C, B, C, A, B.
Rnd 15: Join C in any corner, repeat Rnd 3.
Rnd 16: Join B in any corner, repeat Rnd 7.
Rnd 17: Join C in any corner, repeat Rnd 3.
Rnd 18: Join B in any corner, repeat Rnd 7.
Rnd 19: Join A in any corner, repeat Rnd 3.
Rnd 20: Join B in any corner, repeat Rnd 7.
Rnd 21: Join A in any corner, repeat Rnd 3.
Rnd 22: Join C in any corner, (ch 3, dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in
same corner, * ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st; repeat from
* around working (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in each corner; join.
Rnds 23-27: Slip st to corner, (ch 3, dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in
same corner, ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st, * ch 1, skip
ch-1 space, dc in next dc; repeat from * around working (2
dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in each corner; join.
Rnd 28: Join A in any corner, (beg cluster, ch 1, cluster, ch
3, cluster, ch 1, cluster) all in corner, * ch 1, cluster in next
ch-1 space; repeat from * around working (cluster, ch 1,
cluster, ch 3, cluster, ch 1, cluster) all in each corner; join.
Rnd 29: Join B in any corner, repeat Rnd 28.
Rnd 30: Join A in any corner, repeat Rnd 28.
Rnd 31: Join C in any corner, (ch 3, dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in
same space, * 2 dc between cluster; repeat from * around
working (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in corner; join.
Rnds 32-34: Slip st to corner, (ch 3, dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in
same corner, * 2 dc between next group of 2 dc; repeat
from * around working (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in each corner;
join.
Rnd 35: Join A in any corner, (ch 3, dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in
same corner, 2 dc in each st around working (2 dc, ch 3, 2
dc) in each corner; join.
Rnds 36-37: Ch 3, dc in each st around working (2 dc, ch
3, 2 dc) in each corner; join. Fasten off.
Edging
Join C in last st before any corner, ch 1, (sc, ch 3, dc) all in
same st, [sc, ch 3, dc] 2 times in corner, * skip next 2 sts,
(sc, ch 3, dc) all in next st; repeat from * around working
[sc, ch 3, dc] 2 times in each corner; join. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® O’Go™ (Prints: 5 oz/141 g; 236 yds/215 m) Forest (7136) 9 O’Gos
Size U.S. J/10 (6 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dtr = (Yoh) 3 times and draw up a loop in next stitch. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 4 times - double treble crochet.
gauge: 1 Shell + 1 sc = 3" [7.5 cm]; 1st to 5th rows = 3½" [9 cm]
instructions:
Notes:
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull tie to remove.
• For this pattern, colors can be easily separated by gently pulling apart and cutting at the color transition. Each color is ready to use.

With A, ch 152.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 151 sc.

2nd row:  (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Skip next 4 sc. 9 dtr in next sc – shell made. Skip next 4 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * across. Break A. Join B. Turn.

3rd row: With B, ch 5 (counts as tr. Ch-1). 2 tr in first sc. *Ch 2. Skip next 4 dtr. 1 sc in next dtr. Ch 2. Skip next 4 dtr.** (2 tr. Ch 1. 2 tr) all in next sc. Rep from * to last sc, ending at **. (2 tr. Ch 1. 1 tr) in last sc. Turn.

4th row: Ch 5 (counts as dtr). 4 dtr in ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. *Shell in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp. 4 dtr in next ch-1 sp. 1 dtr in 4th ch of turning ch 5. Break B. Join C.

5th row: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in first dtr. *Ch 2. Skip next 4 dtr. (2 tr. Ch 1. 2 tr) in next sc. Ch 2. Skip next 4 dtr. 1 sc in next dtr. Rep from * across, working last sc in top of turning ch 5. Turn.

6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Shell in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * across. Break C. Join D.

7th and 8th rows: With D, as 3rd and 4th rows. Break D. Join E.

9th and 10th rows: With E, as 5th and 6th rows. Break E. Join A.

Rep 3rd to 10th rows for pat, working 2 rows each in each color, until Blanket measures approx 57" [145 cm], ending on a RS row. Fasten off.

Border
1st rnd:  (RS). Join B with sl st to any corner. Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around Blanket, having 3 sc in each corner. Join C with sl st to first sc.

2nd rnd: With C, Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around, working 3 sc in each center sc of corners. Join D with sl st to first sc.

3rd rnd: With D, as 2nd rnd. Fasten off.

instructions:
Panels are made first. Only the first panel is given an edging. Subsequent panels are joined on the left edge to previous panel. All edging rounds are worked on the right side.
PANEL 1
Make 3 in C
Make 2 in D
Ch 16
Row 1: Working in back loops of ch, dc in 4th ch from hook and in next 12 ch, ch 3; turn (beginning ch-3 counts as first d...
remaining_panels: To join panels from top corner to bottom corner: continuing in pattern st, join panels while working left hand side to next panel on the left as follows. materials: Caront® One Pound™ (16 oz/453.6 g; 812 yds/742 m)
Contrast B Med Gray Mix (10617) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
7" [18 cm] piece of cardboard for tassels.
measurements: Approx 48 x 58" [122 x 147.5 cm], excluding tassels.
gauge: 14 sts and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Moss St Pat.
instructions:
Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.

Stripe Pat
With A – 4 rows.
With B – 4 rows.
These 8 rows form Stripe Pat.

BLANKET
With C, ch 168.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Turn. 167 sts (sc and ch-1 sp).

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp and sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.

3rd row: Ch 1. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc.

Rep last 2 rows for Moss St Pat until work from beg measures 6" [15 cm], ending on a 2nd row. Fasten off C.

Note: When working Stripe Pat, do not cut yarn. Carry color not in use loosely up side of work.

With RS facing, join A with sl st to first sc. Cont in Moss St Pat, AT SAME TIME, proceed in Stripe Pat until work from beg measures approx 52" [132 cm], ending with 4 rows of A. Fasten off A.

With RS facing, join C with sl st to first sc.

With C, work in Moss St Pat for further 6" [15 cm]. Fasten off.

Tassels (make 18): Wrap C around a 7" [18 cm] piece of cardboard 30 times. Tie securely at one end. Cut across other end. Wrap A 6 times around tassel 1½" [4 cm] from tied end and fasten securely. Attach Tassel at each corner of Blanket. Attach 7 Tassels evenly spaced across short edges of Blanket.

materials: Bernat® Softee® Baby™ (5 oz/140 g; 362 yds/331 m)
Size U.S. G/6 [4 mm] crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice
gauge: 15 dc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pattern.
instructions:
Note: Ch 3 at beg of rows counts as dc throughout.
With A, ch 141 (multiple of 8 ch + 5). See diagram on page 2.
Foundation row: (WS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 139 sts.
1st row: (RS). Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Skip next dc. (1 dcfp. 1 dc. 1 dcfp) all in next dc. Skip next dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * to last dc. 1 dc in top of ch-3. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Skip next dc. (1 dcbp. 1 dc) in next st. 1 dc in next dc. (1 dc. 1 dcbp) in next st. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 2 dc. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. *Skip next dc. (1 dcfp. 1 dc) in next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. (1 dc. 1 dcfp) in next st. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last dc. 1 dc in top of ch-3. Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. *Skip next dc. (1 dcbp. 1 dc) in next st. 1 dc in each of next 6 sts. Yoh and draw up a loop at back of work, inserting hook from right to left around post of same st as last dc. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Skip next dc. Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at back of work inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through all loops – Dcbp2tog made. 1 dc in same st as last leg of Dcbp2tog. Rep from * to last 8 sts. 1 dc in each of next 5 sts. (1 dc. 1 dcbp) in next st. Skip next dc. 1 dc in top of ch-3. Turn.
Rep last 4 rows 5 times more. Break A.
With B, rep last 4 rows 6 times. Break B.
With C, rep last 4 rows 6 times. Do not break yarn.
Next row: (RS). With C, ch 3. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Do not turn.
Border
1st rnd: (RS). Cont with C, ch 1. Work sc evenly around Blanket, changing colors to match Blanket and having 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
2nd rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around, changing colors to match previous rnd and having 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
Rep last rnd 3 times more. Do not turn.
Next rnd: (RS). Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around changing colors to match previous rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 2 skeins each of 316 Soft White A, 3950 Charcoal E, and 1 skein each of 520 Minty B, 726 Coral C, and 341 Light Grey D
abbreviations: A, B, C, etc. = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
() = work directions in parentheses into same st
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Throw measures about 45 x 60" [114.5 x 152.5 cm]
gauge: 12 sts = 4" [10 cm]; 5 rows = 3" [7.5 cm] in double crochet (dc). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Notes
1. Throw is worked back and forth in rows using different yarn colors and different pattern stitches. Refer to diagram for color and pattern stitch sequences.
2. To change yarn color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Fasten off old color.
3. To work into a stitch "3 rows below" insert the hook in the stitch in the row numbered 3 less than the row you are currently making. For example if you are making Row 29, a stitch "3 rows below" is in Row 29 – 3 = Row 26.
4. To work into the "same" stitch or space, work into the stitch or space in which the previous stitch was worked.

Special Stitches
Cl (3 double crochet cluster) = Yarn over, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook (2 loops remain on hook); [yarn over, insert hook in same stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] 2 times, yarn over, draw through all 4 loops on hook.

dc2tog (double crochet 2 stitches together) = Yarn over, insert hook in first indicated stitch or space, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook (2 loops remain on hook – first leg completed), yarn over, insert hook in next indicated stitch or space, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook; yarn over, draw through all 3 loops on hook (2nd leg completed). Note: A stitch or ch-space is often skipped between the two legs of the dctog in this design.

dc5tog (double crochet 5 stitches together) = [Yarn over, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] 5 times, yarn over, draw through all 6 loops on hook.

dcV (double crochet V stitch) = (Dc, ch 1, dc) in indicated stitch or space. 
hdcV (half double crochet V-stitch) = (Hdc, ch 2, hdc) in indicated stitch or space.
long-slip st (long slip stitch) = Insert hook in indicated stitch 3 rows below, yarn over and pull loop even with current row and through loop on hook. Note: Skip the stitch (covered by the long stitch) in the row in which you would usually work.
long-tr (long treble crochet) = [Yarn over] twice, insert hook in indicated stitch 3 rows below, yarn over and pull up a loop even with current row, [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice.  Note: Skip the stitch (covered by the long stitch) in the row in which you would usually work.
shell = 5 dc in indicated stitch or space.
THROW
With A, ch 122.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across—121 sc.
Wave Pattern
Row 2: With A, ch 3 (counts as first dc), turn, dc in next sc, hdc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, hdc in next sc, *dc in next 3 sc, hdc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, hdc in next sc; repeat from * to last 2 sc, dc in last 2 sc and change to B in last st—14 "waves" with one-half "wave" at beginning and end of row.
Row 3: With B, ch 1, turn, sc in each st across working last sc in top of beginning ch-3—121 sc.
Row 4: With B, ch 1, turn, sc in first 2 sc, hdc in next sc, dc in next 3 sc, hdc in next sc, *sc in next 3 sc, hdc in next sc, dc in next 3 sc, hdc in next sc; rep from * to last 2 sc, sc in last 2 sc and change to A in last st.
Row 5: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in each st across working last sc in top of beginning ch-3—121 sc.
Rows 6–13: Repeat Rows 2–5 twice.
Zig-Zag Pattern
Row 14: With A, ch 1, turn, (sc, ch 3, dc) in first sc, *skip next 2 sc, (sc, ch 3, dc) in next sc; repeat from * to last 3 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in last sc and change to C—40 (sc, ch 3, dc) groups.
Row 15: With C, ch 3 (counts as sc, ch 2), turn, dc in first sc, (sc, ch 3, dc) in each ch-3 space to last ch-3 space, sc in last ch-3 space, ch 2, dc in last sc and change to A—39 (sc, ch 3, dc) groups.
Row 16: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in first dc, ch 3, dc in first ch-2 space, (sc, ch 3, dc) in each ch-3 space across, sc in top of beginning ch-3 and change to C—40 (sc, ch 3, dc) groups.
Rows 17 and 18: Repeat Rows 15 and 16, do not change to C at the end of Row 18.
Row 19: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, 3 sc in each ch-3 space to last ch-3 space, 2 sc in last ch-3 space, sc in last sc—121 sc.
Cluster Pattern
Row 20: With A, ch 2 (counts as first hdc), turn, hdc in next sc, *skip next sc, hdcV in next sc; repeat from * to last 3 sc, skip next sc, hdc in last 2 sc and change to D in last st—58 hdcV.
Row 21: With D, ch 3 (counts as first dc), turn, dc in next hdc, *ch 1, Cl in ch-2 space of next hdcV; repeat from * across, ch 1, dc in last hdc, dc in top of beginning ch-2 and change to A—58 clusters and 59 ch-1 spaces.
Row 22: With A, ch 2 (counts as hdc), turn, hdc in next dc, hdcV in each Cl across, hdc in last dc, hdc in top of beginning ch-3 and change to D—58 hdcV.
Rows 23 and 24: Repeat Rows 21 and 22.
Row 25: Repeat Row 21.
Row 26: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in first 2 dc, *sc in next ch-1 space, sc in next Cl; repeat from * to last ch-1 space, sc in last ch-1 space, sc in next dc, sc in top of beginning ch-3—121 sc. Fasten off A.
Shell Pattern
Row 27: Turn, join E with slip st in first sc, *skip next 2 sc, shell in next sc, skip next 2 sc, slip st in next sc; repeat from * across—20 shells.
Row 28: With E, turn, slip st in first slip st, *sc in each dc of next shell, slip st in next slip st; repeat from * across. Fasten off E.
Row 29: Turn, join A with slip st in first st 3 rows below, ch 4 (counts as tr), *dc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, dc in next sc, tr in next st 3 rows below; repeat from * across.
Row 30: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in each st across working last sc in top of beginning ch-4—121 sc.
Rows 31-36: Repeat Zig-Zag Pattern in Rows 14–19, change to D at end of Row 36.
Laced Columns Pattern
Row 37: With D, ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), turn, skip next sc, dc in next sc, *skip next 2 sc, shell in next sc, skip next 2 sc, dc in next sc, skip next sc, dcV in next sc, skip next sc, dc in next sc; repeat from * to last 8 sts, skip next 2 sc, shell in next sc, skip next 2 sc, dc in next sc, ch 1, skip next sc, dc in last sc—12 shells and 11 dcV.
Row 38: With D, ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), turn, skip first ch-1 space, dc in next dc, ch 2, dc5tog over 5 dc of next shell, ch 2, dc in next dc, *dcV in ch-1 space of next dcV, skip last dc of same dcV, dc in next dc, ch 2, dc5tog over 5 dc of next shell, ch 2, dc in next dc; repeat from * to beginning ch-4, ch 1, dc in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4 and change to B—12 dc5tog and 11 dcV.
Row 39: With B, ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), turn, skip first ch-space, dc in next dc, shell in next dc5tog, dc in next dc, *dcV in ch-1 space of next dcV, skip last dc of same dcV, dc in next dc, shell in next dc5tog, dc in next dc; repeat from * to beginning ch-4, ch 1, dc in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—12 shells and 11 dcV.
Row 40: With B, repeat Row 38 and change to D in last st.
Row 41: With D, repeat Row 39.
Rows 42-44: Repeat Rows 38-40, change to A at the end of Row 44.
Row 45: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in first dc, sc in next ch-1 space, sc in next dc, 2 sc in next ch-2 space, sc in next dc5tog, 2 sc in next ch-2 space, *sc in next 2 dc, sc in next ch-1 space, sc in next 2 dc, 2 sc in next ch-2 space, sc in next dc5tog, 2 sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * to 1 dc before beginning ch-4, sc in next dc, sc in beginning ch-4 space, sc in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—121 sc.
Row 46: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Polka Dot Pattern
Row 47: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * across and change to E in last st—61 sc and 60 ch-1 spaces.
Row 48: With E, ch 2, turn, dc in first ch-1 space (beginning ch-2 and following dc count as first dc2tog), *ch 1, dc2tog working over same ch-1 space and next ch-1 space; repeat from * to last sc, ch 1, dc2tog working over same ch-1 space and last sc and change to A—61 dc2tog and 60 ch-1 spaces.
Row 49: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in first st, sc in next ch-1 space, *ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to last st, sc in last st and change to E—62 sc and 59 ch-1 spaces.
Row 50: With E, ch 3 (counts as dc), turn, dc2tog working over first sc and first ch-1 space, *ch 1, dc2tog working over same ch-1 space and next ch-1 space; repeat from * to last 2 sc, ch 1, dc2tog over same ch-1 space and last sc, dc again in last sc and change to A—60 dc2tog, 59 ch-1 spaces and a dc at the beginning and end of the row.
Row 51: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in first dc, *ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to last dc2tog, ch 1, skip last dc2tog, sc in top of beginning ch-3 and change to E—61 dc2tog and 60 ch-1 spaces.
Rows 52-55: Repeat Rows 48–51, do not change color at end of Row 55.
Row 56: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc and ch-1 space across—121 sc. Fasten off A.
Rows 57–60: Repeat Shell Pattern in Rows 27–30, using D instead of E in Rows 27 and 28.
Rows 61–66: Repeat Zig-Zag Pattern in Rows 14–19.
Rows 67–70: Repeat Shell Pattern in Rows 27–30, using D instead of E in Rows 27 and 28.

Row 2: Ch 3, dc in first 7 dc, dc3tog over next 3 dc, dc in next 6 dc, *3 dc in next dc, dc in next 6 dc, dc3tog over next 3 dc, dc in next 6 dc; repeat from * to last st; 2 dc in top of ch-3; turn.

Ch 1, 3 sc in first dc, *sc in next 6 dc, sc3tog over next 3 dc, sc in next 6 dc, 3 sc in next dc; repeat from * across; working along edge of throw, 3 sc in first color stripe, [2 sc in each of next 3 row-end sts, sc in next row-end st] across, ending with 4 sc in last row-end st, working in opposite side of starting ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in next 7 ch, ** 3 sc in next ch, sc in next 6 ch, sc3tog over next 3 ch, sc in next 6 ch; repeat from ** to last 9 ch; 3 sc in next ch, sc in next 7 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working along other edge of throw, 3 sc in first color stripe, [2 sc in each of next 3 row-end sts, sc in next row-end st] across, ending with 4 sc in last row-end st; join with a slip st in first sc. pattern_name: Which Way Is Up Baby Blanket
materials: Simply Soft (170 g/6. oz;288 m/315 yds)
gauge: In double crochet, 12 sts and 7 rows = 4"/10cm
instructions: NOTES 1. Blanket is worked with two colors throughout. Only one color is worked at a time, the other color is carried under the stitches of the working color. For a clean look, gently pull the yarn before changing colors, to ensure no lose yarn sticks out. 2. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over; yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Carry color not in use UNDER the stitches of the working color. 3. Blanket can be worked by following written instructions, or referring to color chart. BLANKET With A, ch 101. Row 1 (RS): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each remaining ch across, turn—100 sc. Row 2: With A, ch 2 (does not count as dc here and throughout), dc in first 4 sts; *change to C, dc in next 4 sts; change to A, dc in next 4 sts; repeat from * across; change to C, turn—25 stripes of A, and 24 stripes of C. Row 3: With C, ch 2, dc in first st; *change to A, dc in next 4 sts; change to C, dc in next 4 sts; repeat from * across to 3 last sts; change to A, dc in last 3 sts, turn. Row 4: With A, ch 2, dc in first 2 sts; *change to C, dc in next 4 sts; change to A, dc in next 4 sts; repeat from * across to last 2 sts; change to C, dc in last 2 sts, turn. Row 5: With C, ch 2, dc in first 3 sts; *change to A, dc in next 4 sts; change to C, dc in next 4 sts; repeat from * across to last st; change to A, dc in last st; turn. Row 6: Repeat Row 4. Row 7: Repeat Row 3. Row 8: Repeat Row 2. Row 9: With C, ch 2, dc in first 4 sts; *change to A, dc in next 4 sts; change to C, dc in next 4 sts; repeat from * across; change to A, turn. Row 10: With A, ch 2, dc in first st; *change to C, dc in next 4 sts; change to A, dc in next 4 sts; repeat from * across to 3 last sts; change to C, dc in last 3 sts, turn. Row 11: With C, ch 2, dc in first 2 sts; *change to A, dc in next 4 sts; change to C, dc in next 4 sts; repeat from * across to last 2 sts; change to A, dc in last 2 sts, turn. Row 12: With A, ch 2, dc in 3 sts; *change to C, dc in next 4 sts; change to A, dc in next 4 sts; repeat from * across to last st; change to C, dc in last st; turn. Row 13: Repeat Row 11. Row 14: Repeat Row 10. Row 15: Repeat Row 9. Rows 16–29: Repeat Rows 2-15. Rows 30–43: With B (instead of A) and C, repeat Rows 2-15. Rows 44–71: With A (instead of B) and C, repeat Rows 2-15 twice. Row 72: With A, ch 1, sc in each st across. Do not fasten off. FINISHING Border Round 1: With A, ch 2, dc evenly spaced around, working 3 dc in each corner; change to B; join with sl st in first dc. Round 2: With B, ch 1, hdc in each st around, working 3 hdc in each corner; change to C; join with sl st in first hdc. Round 3: With C, ch 1, hdc in each st around, working 4 hdc in each corner; join with sl st in first hdc. Round 4: With C, *ch 4, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with sl st in first sc. Using yarn needle, weave in ends.

instructions:
Note: One corner of Flower Motif has a ‘Stem’ achieved by completing last rnd with sl sts worked in C, and by creating a center stem chain in center.

FLOWER MOTIF  (Make 50).
See Diagram on page 3.
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc. Ch 1). (1 dc. Ch 1) 11 times in ring. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-4. Fasten off A. 12 dc and 12 ch-1 sps.
2nd rnd: Join B with sl st to any ch-1 sp of 1st rnd. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 3 dc in same ch-1 sp as sl st. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back into top of ch-3. Pull dropped loop through st – beg popcorn made. *Ch 2. Popcorn in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around. Ch 2. Join with sl st to top of beg popcorn. Fasten off B.

3rd rnd: Join A with sl st to any ch-2 sp. Ch 3 (counts as dc). (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same sp as sl st. *(With C, ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-2 sp) twice.** With A, ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Ch 1. Join with sl st to top of beg ch-3. With C, sl st in each of next (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc). Join with sl st to next ch-1 sp - for Side Stem. Fasten off.

Stem: Join C with sl st to corner ch-2 sp just worked (same corner as sl sts worked in C). Ch 3. Sl st around ch-2 of 2nd rnd, between 3-dc groups. Ch 2. Join with sl st to unworked dc between popcorns. Fasten off. Bring ends to WS of work, weave in ends and secure.

HALF SQUARE MOTIF (Make 18)
Notes: 
• Half Square Motifs are worked in rows.
• Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc.
• See Diagram on page 3.

With C, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st row: (RS). Ch 3. (3 dc. Ch 2. 4 dc) in ring. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. 3 dc in first dc. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. 4 dc in last dc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. 3 dc in first dc. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 4 dc in last dc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. 3 dc in first dc. Ch 1. (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) twice. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. 4 dc in last dc. Fasten off.

FiNISHING
With A, join Motifs tog following Assembly Diagram using Mattress Stitch, inserting needle into each dc beneath sl sts at ‘Stem’ corners - this helps contrasting sl sts to ‘pop’.

Round 14: (Slip st, ch 5, 2 dc) in first ch-2 space, Bpdc around each dc across to next ch-2 space, *(2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-2 space, Bpdc in each dc across to next ch-2 space; repeat from * around, dc in first ch-2 space; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch; change to B—220 dc and 4 ch-2 spaces.

Round 33 (border round): Slip st in first ch-2 space, ch 3 (counts as first dc), 2 dc in same space, *skip next st, sc in next sc, [skip next st, shell in next st, skip next st, sc in next st] across to last st before next ch-2 space, skip last st*, shell in next ch-2 space; repeat from * twice; repeat from * to ** once, 2 dc in first ch-2 space (beginning ch-3, first 2 dc and last 2 dc count as shell); join with slip st in top of beginning ch—132 shells and 132 sc.

Center
With B, make an adjustable ring.

Round 2: 2 sc in each st around—16 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—24 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—32 sc.
Round 5: *Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—40 sc.
Round 6: *Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc.
Round 7: *Sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—56 sc. Fasten off.
Petal 1
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, join C with sc in any st, sc in next 4 sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Repeat Row 2.
Row 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st across to last st, 2 sc in last st, turn—7 sc.
Rows 5 and 6: Repeat Row 2.
Row 7: Repeat Row 4—9 sc.
Row 8: Repeat Row 2.
Row 9: Repeat Row 4—11 sc.
Rows 10–13: Ch 1, sc2tog in first 2 sts, sc in each st across to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—3 sc.

Petals 2–8
Row 1: With right side of Center facing, skip next 2 sts of Round 6, join C with sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—5 sc.
Rows 2–13: Repeat Rows 2–13 of Petal 1.
Petal Edging Round: With right side of Petals facing, join C with sc in end of any row of any Petal, working in ends of rows, Petal sts, and skipped sts of Center, sc evenly around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING
Sew Flower to center of Blanket, taking care to work only through top layer of Blanket to prevent stitching from appearing on wrong side.
Weave in ends.

Round 2: * Ch 7, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, tr in next 3 ch, hdc in next ch, slip st in next 2 sc; repeat from * around. Fasten off. Sew leaf piece to center of each hexagon. Round 2: Attach E in ring just beyond last sc; [ch 4, 3 tr in ring, ch 4, slip st into ring] twice, * ch 4, [3 dc in next dc] twice, ch 4, slip st in sc; repeat from * twice more. Round 2: Slip st to ch-2 space, ch 3, (dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in same space, [ch 1, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in next ch-2 space] 5 times, ch 1; join. Row 1: Dc in 3rd ch from hook, *3 dc, in next 3 ch work (dc3tog), 3 dc, (3 dc) in next ch; repeat from * across, ending with 2 dc in last ch. Turn.
Row 2: Join B. Ch 3 (counts as first dc), dc in next dc, *3 dc, dc3tog, 3 dc, 3 dc in next dc; repeat from * across, ending with 2 dcs in turning ch. Turn.
Rows 3-28: Repeat Row 2, alternating colors as above.
Fasten off at the end of Row 28. Weave in ends.
Border: Join B with sc in any st, ch 4, tr in same st, 2 tr in each st around, working 5 tr in each corner. Fasten off. Join A with sl st in any st, ch 1, sc evenly around. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. Turn.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein 387 Soft Navy A
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Throw measures approximately 44” [112 cm] x 56” [142 cm] (including edging).
gauge: 6 blocks = 4” [10 cm]; 6 rows = 4” [10 cm] in stitch pattern. Exact gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
Shape First Corner
With A, ch 6.
Row 1 (Right Side): Dc in 4th ch from hook and in next 2 ch; turn – 1 corner block made.
Row 2: Ch 6, dc in 4th ch from hook and in next 2 ch (beginning block made), (slip st, ch 3, 3 dc) all in ch-3 space of previous row (block made); turn – 2 blocks.
Row 3: Ch 6, dc in 4th ch from hook and in next 2 ch, [(slip st, ch 3, 3 dc) all in next ch-3 space of previous row] twice; turn – 3 blocks.
Row 4: Ch 6, dc in 4th ch from hook and in next 2 ch, [(slip st, ch 3, 3 dc) all in next ch-3 space of previous row] 3 times changing to B in last dc; turn – 4 blocks.
Continue in this manner, increasing 1 block at beginning of each row until there are 48 blocks across. AT SAME TIME, work Stripe pattern as follows: 6 rows B, 6 rows C, 6 rows D, 2 rows A. Repeat these 20 rows throughout for stripe pattern.
Shape Second Corner
Note: Mark beginning edge as width of piece. You will be decreasing 1 block at beginning of one row and increasing 1 block at beginning of next row to maintain the same number of blocks across. Follow Notes for changing colors.
Decrease Row 1: Slip st across first 3 dc to ch-3 space of second block of previous row, [(slip st, ch 3, 3 dc) all in next ch-3 space of previous row] to end of row; turn – 48 blocks.
Increase Row 2: Ch 6, dc in 4th ch from hook and in next 2 ch, [(slip st, ch 3, 3 dc) all in next ch-3 space of previous row] to last block, slip st in ch-3 space of last block; turn – 48 blocks.
Keeping in Stripe pattern, repeat last 2 rows until piece measures 43” [109 cm] along marked edge and 55” [140 cm] along unmarked edge.
Shape Third Corner
Keeping in Stripe pattern, repeat Decrease Row 1 every row, decreasing 1 block at beginning of every row until 1 block remains on last row for last corner.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Edging Round: With right side facing, join A in any ch-3 space, ch 3, 4 dc in same space, *[sc in center dc of next block, 5 dc in next ch-3 space] to corner; work 6 dc in corner space; repeat from * around to beginning edge, [sc in center dc of next block, 5 dc in next ch-3 space] to first st, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Holiday”: 6 Balls 6060 Green/Green A; 2 balls each 9090 Red/Red B, and 140 White/Silver C.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: From peak to peak = 6½”; Rows 1-6 = 3” in pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With A, ch 164.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, skip next ch, * sc in next 10 ch, 3 sc in next ch, sc in next 10 ch **, skip next 2 ch; repeat from * across, end last repeat at **; skip next ch, sc in last ch; turn – 163 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in 1st st, skip next st, * sc in next 10 sts, 3 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts **, skip next 2 sts; repeat from * across, end last repeat at **, skip next st, sc in last st; turn.
Rows 3-5: Repeat Row 2, changing to B at the end of Row 5.
Row 6 (Right Side): With B, ch 3, skip 1st two sts, * Popcorn in next st, ch 1, [skip next st, Popcorn in next st, ch 1] 4 times, skip next st, [Popcorn, ch 1] twice all in next st, [skip next st, Popcorn in next st, ch 1] 4 times; skip next st, Popcorn in next st **, skip next 2 sts; repeat from * across, end last repeat at **, skip next st, dc in last st; change to A, turn – 84 Popcorns.
Row 7: With A, ch 1, sc in 1st st, skip 1st Popcorn, [sc in next ch-1 space, sc in next Popcorn] 5 times; 3 sc in next ch-1 space, [sc in next Popcorn, sc in next ch-1 space] 5 times **; skip next 2 Popcorns; repeat from * across, end last repeat at **, skip next Popcorn, sc in top of ch-3; turn – 163 sts.
Rows 8-11: Repeat Row 2, changing to C at end of Row 11.
Row 12: With C, repeat Row 6.
Row 13: With A, repeat Row 7.
Rows 14-113: Repeat Rows 2-12 eight more times, then Rows 2-5 once more. At end of Row 113, do not change color or fasten A off; turn.

BORDER
Top Edge
With A, ch 3, skip next st, * dc in next 10 sts, 3 dc in next st, dc in next 10 sts **, skip next 2 sts; repeat from * across, end last repeat at **, skip next st, 3 dc in next st; turn to work along Side Edge.
Side Edge 1: Dc in side of each sc row, 2 dc in side of each Popcorn row; turn to work along Bottom Edge.
Bottom Edge: Working in unused loops of beginning ch, 3 dc in 1st ch, * dc in next 10 ch, skip next ch, dc in next 10 ch **, 3 dc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * across, end last repeat at **, 3 dc last ch; turn to work along Side Edge.
Side Edge 2: Repeat Side Edge 1; turn to work 2 dc in same st as beginning ch-3; join with a slip st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® (6 oz/170 g; 315 yds/288 m) - Contrast A White (39701) 3 balls
Caron® Simply Soft® (6 oz/170 g; 315 yds/288 m) - Contrast B Soft Pink (39719) 3 balls
Caron® Simply Soft® Collection (6 oz/170 g; 315 yds/288 m) - Contrast C Strawberry (0015) 3 balls
Size U.S. I-9 (5.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Hhdc = Herringbone half double crochet: Yoh. Draw up a loop through next stitch and first loop on hook. Yoh and draw through last 2 loops on hook.
gauge: 16 hhdc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes: To change colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed with new color. Carry yarn not in use across top of previous row and work sts around it to prevent stranding. Ch 2 at beg of row/rnd does not count as st. With C, ch 106.
1st row: (RS). 1 hhdc in 3rd ch from hook and each of next 7 ch. *With B, 1 hhdc in each of next 8 ch. With C, 1 hhdc in each of next 8 ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Turn. 104 hhdc.
2nd to 6th rows: With C, ch 2. 1 hhdc in each of first 8 hhdc. *With B, 1 hhdc in each of next 8 hhdc. With C, 1 hhdc in each of next 8 hhdc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. Break C at end of last row.
7th to 12th rows: With B, ch 2. 1 hhdc in each of first 8 hhdc. *With A, 1 hhdc in each of next 8 hhdc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. Break A at end of 12th row.
13th row: As 2nd row.
Rep 2nd to 13th rows for Gingham Pat until work from beg measures approx 28" [71 cm], ending on 6th row of pat. Fasten off.
Border:
1st rnd: With RS facing, join A with sl st to any corner. Ch 1. 2 hhdc in same sp as sl st. Work in hhdc around having 3 hhdc in each corner and approx 8 hhdc per block of color on sides. 1 hhdc in same sp as first 2 hhdc. Join with sl st to first hhdc. Turn.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hhdc in same sp as last sl st. 1 hhdc in each hhdc around, having 3 hhdc in each corner hhdc. 1 hhdc in same sp as first 2 hhdc. Join with sl st to first st.
3rd and 4th rnds: As 2nd rnd. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Cotton Terry™ (4.2 oz/120 g; 229 yds/209 m)
Contrast A Cotton (48001) 6 balls or 1114 yds/1019 m

Contrast C Celery (48008) 1 ball or 151 yds/138 m

measurements: Approx 52 x 61½" [132 x 156.5 cm], excluding fringe.
gauge: 13 sts and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm] in V-St Pat.
instructions:
Notes:
• Blanket is worked in 6 Striped Panels and seamed together in Finishing.
• Pat is worked over foundation ch multiple of 3 ch +3.
Wide Stripe Pat
Note: Break yarn between color changes to avoid long strands along edge of Panel.
With Color 1, work 8 rows. Join Color 2. Break Color 1.
With Color 2, work 8 rows. Join Color 1. Break Color 2.
Rep last 16 rows 6 times more.
With Color 1, work 8 rows.
These 120 rows form Wide Stripe Pat.
Narrow Stripe Pat
Note: Do not break yarn between color changes, carry yarn when not in use loosely up side of work.
With Color 1, work 2 rows. With Color 2, work 2 rows. Rep last 4 rows 29 times more.
These 120 rows form Narrow Stripe Pat.

PANELS
Make 6 Panels total as follows:
(I) Wide Stripe Panel
Color 1 is B / Color 2 is A.
(II) Narrow Stripe Panel
Color 1 is A / Color 2 is C.
(III) Wide Stripe Panel
Color 1 is A / Color 2 in D.
(IV) Narrow Stripe Panel
Color 1 is E / Color 2 is A.
(V) Wide Stripe Panel
Color 1 is F / Color 2 is A.
(VI) Narrow Stripe Panel
Color 1 is A / Color 2 is G.
See Diagram.
With appropriate Color, ch 42.
1st row: (RS). 2 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 1 dc. Skip next ch. 2 dc). *Skip next 2 ch. 2 dc in next ch. Rep from * to last 2 ch. Skip next ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. 28 dc.
2nd row: Ch 2 (counts as 1 dc). Skip next dc. 2 dc in next sp (between 2 dc). *Skip next 2 dc. 2 dc in next sp (between 2 dc). Rep from * to last 2 dc. Skip next dc. 1 dc in last dc (top of ch-2). Turn. First 2 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.
Rep last row for V-St Pat until 120 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
With A and RS facing, sew Panels tog, as shown in diagram, using invisible mattress stitch and working around yarn carried up side of Panels II and IV to enclose it.
MATTRESS STITCH

Edging rnd: (RS). Join A with sl st to any corner sp. Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around outer edge of Blanket, working 3 sc into each corner sp, and working around yarn carried up side edge of Panel VI. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Top Edging: 1st row: (RS). Join A with sl st to top right corner sc to work across top edge of Blanket. Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across to next corner. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
Bottom Edging: Work as for Top Edging across bottom edge of Blanket.
Fringe: Cut strands of A 10" [25.5 cm] long. Taking 3 strands tog, fold in half and knot into fringe through every other st along top and bottom edges. Trim fringe evenly.

materials: RED HEART® “Baby Blankie™”:  1 ball 8700 Baby Pink.
gauge: In pattern, [Sc, ch 3, cluster, ch 3] twice = 4”; 9 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Ch 77.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, [ch 3, skip next 2 ch, cluster in next ch, ch 3, skip next 2 ch, sc in next sc] 12 times, ch 3, skip next 2 ch, dc in last ch. Ch 1, turn.
Row 2: Sc in first dc, [ch 3, sc in next sc, ch 3, sc in next cluster] 12 times, ch 3, sc in last sc. Ch 6 (counts as dc, ch 3), turn.
Row 3: Skip first sc, sc in next sc, [ch 3, cluster in next sc, ch 3, sc in next sc] 12 times. Ch 1, turn.
Row 4: Sc in first sc, [ch 3, sc in next cluster, ch 3, sc in next sc] 12 times, ch 3, sc in 3rd ch of starting ch-6. Ch 1, turn.
Row 5: Sc in first sc, [ch 3, cluster in next sc, ch 3, sc in next sc] 12 times, ch 3, dc in last sc. Ch 1, turn.
Rows 6 - 69: Repeat Rows 2 – 5 sixteen times. Ch 1, turn.
RUFFLE BORDER
Round 1 (Right Side): 3 sc in first dc (first corner), sc in first ch space, sc in next sc, [2 sc in next ch space, sc in next cluster, 2 sc in next ch space, sc in next sc] 11 times, 2 sc in next ch space, sc in next sc, sc in next ch space, 3 sc in next sc (second corner). Working along edge in ends of rows, sc in first row, 2 sc in next row, [sc in next 3 rows, 2 sc in next row] 16 times, sc in next 2 rows. Working in opposite side of starting ch, 3 sc in first ch (third corner), sc in next ch space, sc in next cluster, [2 sc in next ch space, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next ch space, sc in next cluster] 11 times, 2 sc in next ch space, sc in next sc, sc in next ch space, 3 sc in last ch (fourth corner). Working along edge in ends of rows, 2 sc in first row, [sc in next 3 rows, 2 sc in next row] 16 times, sc in next 3 rows. Join with slip st in first sc (326 sc—72 along top and bottom, 85 along each edge, 3 in each corner).
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), 2 dc in next sc, [dc in next sc, 2 dc in next dc] 162 times. Join with slip st to top of starting ch-3.
Round 3: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), (dc, ch 1) in each dc around. Join with slip st to 3rd ch of starting ch-4.
Round 4: Ch 5 (counts as dc, ch 2), (dc, ch 2) in each dc around. Join with slip st to 3rd ch of starting ch-5.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in same st as slip st, ch 3, (sc in next dc, ch 3) around. Join with slip st to first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.

gauge: 12 sc and 13 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Center Block
Ch 9. See diagram on page 3.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 8 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 7 times more. Do not turn at end of last row.
ROUND 1 (4 blocks)
First Block
Ch 9.
Working into ch 9 and across first side of Center Block, proceed as follows:
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 6 ch. Draw up a loop in next ch. Draw up a loop in sp at side edge of Center Block. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook – joining sc2tog made. Ch 1. Turn.
2nd row: Drop loop of last ch. With WS facing, reinsert hook from front to back through sp at side edge of Center Block, pick up dropped loop and draw through – joining ch to Block made. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc. Joining sc2tog. Ch 1. Turn.
4th row: Joining ch to Block. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn.
5th to 9th Rows: Rep 3rd and 4th rows twice more, then 3rd row once, omitting ch 1 at end of last row. Do not turn at end of last row.
Second Block
Ch 9.
Working into ch 9 and across second side of Center Block, rep 1st to 9th rows as given for First Block.
Third Block
Ch 9.
Working into ch 9 and across third side of Center Block, rep 1st to 9th rows as given for First Block.
Fourth Block
Ch 9.
Working into ch 9 and across fourth side of Center Block, rep 1st to 9th rows as given for First Block.
ROUND 2: (8 blocks)
First Block of Round 2
Foundation row: (RS). Sl st in each of next 8 sts across First Block of Round 1. Ch 9. Do not turn.
Working into ch 9 and across first side of First Block of Round 1, rep 1st to 9th rows as given for Round 1 - First Block.
Second Block of Round 2
Working across second side of same block, proceed as follows:
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Joining sc2tog. 8 sts.
Work 2nd to 9th rows as given for Round 1 - First Block.
Third to Eighth Blocks of Round 2: Work as given for First and Second Blocks of Round 2.
Cont as established, having 4 more Blocks every following Round until work measures approx 42" [106.5 cm] square. Fasten off.
Half Blocks
With RS facing, join yarn with sl st to left corner of first Block of last rnd.
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Joining sc2tog. Ch 1. Turn. 7 sts.
2nd row: Joining ch to Block. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 6 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Joining sc2tog. Ch 1. Turn. 5 sts.
4th row: Joining ch to Block. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sts.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Joining sc2tog. Ch 1. Turn. 3 sts.
6th row: Joining ch to Block. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 2 sts.
7th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Do not turn. 1 st.
Join with sl st to top of Block.
Rep last 7 rows to corner Block.
Proceed as follows:
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 6 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
With RS facing, join yarn with sl st to left corner of last Block worked.
Cont working Half Blocks as established for all 4 sides of Blanket.
Final Edging
With RS facing, join yarn with sl st to any corner st. Ch 2 (does not count as st). Work 1 rnd of hdc around outer edge of Blanket, having 3 hdc in corners. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.

Notes:

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *3 dc in next hdc. 1 sc in next hdc. Rep from * around to last hdc. 3 dc in last hdc. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next dc. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. *Skip next sc. 1 dc in next dc. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * 4 times more. Join.
4th rnd: Sl st in next dc. Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. *(2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Sc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * 4 times more, then from * to ** once. Sc2tog. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *(2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. Skip next st. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. Rep from * 4 times more, then from * to ** once. Skip last st. Join.

7th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 6 dc. *(2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Skip next st. 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Rep from * 4 times more, then from * to ** once. Skip last st. Join.

9th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 9 dc. *(2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in each of next 10 dc. Skip next st. 1 dc in each of next 10 dc. Rep from * 4 times more, then from * to ** once. Skip last st. Join.
10th rnd: Sl st in next dc. Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 10 dc. *(2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in each of next 11 dc. Sc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 11 dc. Rep from * 4 times more, then from * to ** once. Sc2tog. Join.
11th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 12 dc. *(2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in each of next 13 dc. Skip next st. 1 dc in each of next 13 dc. Rep from * 4 times more, then from * to ** once. Skip last st. Join.

note: When joining colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed. Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc. Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
