instructions:
Ch 36 loosely.
Row 1 (right side): Working in back loop of each ch only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—35 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in next 2 sts, *skip next 2 sts, shell in next st, skip next 2 sts, dc in next 3 sts; repeat from * across, turn—4 shells and 15 dc.
Row 3: Ch 3, Fpdc around each of next 2 sts, shell in ch-2 space of next shell, skip remaining sts of the shell, *Fpdc around each of next 3 sts, shell in ch-2 space of next shell, skip remaining sts of the shell; repeat from * to last 3 sts, Fpdc around each of next 2 sts, dc in last st, turn—4 shells, 13 Fpdc, and 2 dc.
Row 4: Ch 3, Bpdc around each of next 2 post sts, shell in ch-2 space of next shell, skip remaining sts of the shell, *Bpdc around each of next 3 post sts, shell in ch-2 space of next shell, skip remaining sts of the shell; repeat from * to last 3 sts, Bpdc around each of next 2 post sts, dc in last st, turn—4 shells, 13 Bpdc, and 2 dc.
Row 5: Ch 3, Fpdc around each of next 2 post sts, shell in ch-2 space of next shell, skip remaining sts of the shell, *Fpdc around each of next 3 post sts, shell in ch-2 space of next shell, skip remaining sts of the shell; repeat from * to last 3 sts, Fpdc around each of next 2 post sts, dc in last st, turn—4 shells, 13 Fpdc, and 2 dc.
Rows 6–23: Repeat last 2 rows 9 more times.
Row 24: Ch 3, Bpdc around each of next 2 post sts, dc in next st, hdc in next st, sc in next ch-2 space, hdc in next st, dc in next st, *Bpdc around each of next 3 post sts, dc in next st, hdc in next st, sc in next ch-2 space,, hdc in next st, dc in next st; repeat from * to last 3 sts, Bpdc around each of next 2 post sts, dc in last st, turn—35 sts.
Do not fasten off. 
Border Round (right side): Ch 1, (sc, ch 3, sc) in first sc (first corner made), sc in each remaining sc to last st, (sc, ch 3, sc) in last sc (2nd corner made); working in ends of rows, work 33 sc evenly spaced across side edge; working across opposite side of foundation ch and working into both free loops of each ch, (sc, ch 3, sc) in first ch (3rd corner made), sc in each remaining ch across to last ch, (sc, ch 3, sc) in last ch (4th corner made); work across remaining side edge in same manner as first side edge; join with slip st in first sc—140 sc (35 sc across each side edge) and 4 corner ch-3 spaces. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 5 skeins 847 Blue Tones A, 1 skein each 336 Warm Brown B, 316 Soft White C, 256 Carrot D, 312 Black E, and 376 Burgundy F
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 3.75mm [F-5 US] (for rattle seam lines), 4mm [G-6 US] (for rattles), 5mm [H-8 US] (for appliques), and 5.5mm [I-9 US] (for blanket)
Yarn needle, large embroidery needle, stitch marker, small amount of stuffing, cat toy for each rattle insert, knee high for each rattle insert, black sewing thread and sewing needle
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.;
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st;
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified;
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 11 sts = 4” (10 cm) in half double crochet; 8½ rows = 4” (10 cm) with largest hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BLANKET
With largest hook and A, ch 69.
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—68 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2 (does not count as a st here and throughout this section), hdc in each st across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until blanket measures 25” (63.5 cm) long.
Border 
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc evenly across ends of rows of first side; working in opposite side of foundation ch, (sc, ch 1, sc) in first ch (corner made), sc in each ch to last ch, (sc, ch 1, sc) in last ch (corner made); sc evenly across ends of rows of other side; (sc, ch 1, sc) in first st (corner made), sc in each st to last st, (sc, ch 1, sc) in last st (corner made); join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), hdc in each st around, working (2 hdc, ch 2, 2 hdc) in each corner ch-space; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Repeat Round 2 until blanket measures 35½” x 35½” (90 x 90 cm).
Next Round: Ch 1, sc in each st around, working (2 sc, ch 2, 2 sc) in each corner ch-2 space; join with slip st in first st.
Repeat last round, as needed, until blanket measures 36” x 36” (91.5 x 91.5 cm).
Fasten off.
Special Stitches
dtr (Double treble crochet) = [Yarn over] 3 times, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] 4 times.
sc2tog (Single crochet 2 together) = insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, (2 loops on hook), insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Special Technique
Adjustable-ring method—Wrap yarn in a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail firmly between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring when instructed.
Notes
1. Blanket is made back and forth in rows, then border is worked in joined rounds.
2. Sixteen appliques of various sport balls are sewn to blanket. Details on balls are added with embroidery.
3. Rattles are made in continuous rounds (spirals). Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
4. Before closing each rattle, insert a small ball with jingle bell inside (cat toy). As a safety precaution, place the cat toy in the toe of a knee high, tie securely, and trim off the excess hosiery. This will contain the pieces if the insert is crushed. Discard the rattle if the insert breaks.
5. Refer to sizes listed above for the appropriate hook for each section.
RATTLE POCKET
With largest hook and A, ch 26.
Row 1 (wrong side): Working in back bumps only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—25 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, *ch 5, skip next 3 sts, sc in next st; repeat from * across, turn—6 ch-5 spaces.
Row 3: Ch 7, sc in 3rd ch of first ch-5 space, *ch 5, sc in 3rd ch of next ch-5 space; repeat from * across, ch 2, dtr in last st (counts as ch 7), turn—5 ch-5 sps and 2 ch-7 spaces.
Row 4: Ch 6, skip first ch-7 space, sc in 3rd ch of first ch-5 space, *ch 5, sc in 3rd ch of next ch-5 space; repeat from * across, ch 5, sc in 4th ch of beginning ch, turn—6 ch-5 spaces. 
Rows 5–16: Repeat Rows 3 and 4 six times.
Row 17: Ch 1, sc in first st, *3 sc in next ch-5 space, sc in next sc; repeat from * across, sc in last ch of beginning ch, turn—25 sc.
Edging
Note When you are instructed to work in a stitch at the end of a row, the stitch may be a ch, sc, or dtr.
Round 1: Ch 1, 3 sc in first sc (corner made), sc in each sc across to last st, 3 sc in last sc (corner made); sc 31 sts evenly across ends of rows of side, working sc in each st and 3 sc in each ch-space; working on opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch (corner made), sc in each ch across to last ch, 3 sc in last ch (corner made), sc 31 sts evenly across ends of rows of next side, working sc in each st and 3 sc in each ch-space; join with slip st in first sc—120 sc (23 sc across top and bottom edge between 3-sc corners and 31 sc across sides between 3-sc corners).
Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each st around working 3 sc in center st of each 3-sc corner; join with slip st in first sc —136 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Using photograph as a guide, position pocket to lower left corner of blanket, placing left side and bottom edge of pocket to edge of Round 1 of border. Sew in place on 3 sides leaving top edge open.
APPLIQUES
Football (make 4)
With hook appropriate to this section and B, ch 2. 
Row 1 (right side): Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st across, turn— 4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, [2 sc in next st] twice, sc in last st, turn—6 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, [2 sc in next st] twice, sc in last 2 sts, turn—8 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts, [2 sc in next st] twice, sc in last 3 sts; change to C at end of row, turn—10 sc. Drop, but do not cut, B.
Rows 6 and 7: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn; change to B at end of Row 7. Cut C.
Rows 8 and 9: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 10: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc), sc in next 8 sts, hdc in last st, turn—10 sts.
Rows 11–13: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. 
Row 14: Repeat Row 10.
Row 15: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last 3 sts; change to C, turn—8 sts. Drop, but do not cut, B.
Rows 16 and 17: Repeat Rows 6 and 7.
Row 18: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last 2 sts, turn—6 sts.
Row 19: Ch 1, sc in first st, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last st, turn—4 sts.
Row 20: [Sc2tog] twice—2 sts. Do not turn.
Edging
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, with right side facing and working in ends of rows, sc evenly around; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
With C, embroider laces on football between Rows 7 and 16.
Basketball (make 4)
With hook size appropriate to this section and D, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first st—6 sc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first st—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, *sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first st—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, *sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first st—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts, 2 sc in next st,*sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first st—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sts, 2 sc in next st,*sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first st—36 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sts, 2 sc in next st,*sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first st—42 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
With E, embroider 2 curved seam lines.
Baseball (make 4)
With hook size appropriate to this section and C, make an adjustable ring.
Rounds 1–5: Work same as Rounds 1–5 of basketball applique—30 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
With F, embroider 2 curved seam lines with hash marks.
Soccer Ball (make 4)
With hook size appropriate to this section and E, make an adjustable ring.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of basketball applique; change to C at end of Round 2—12 sc. Cut E.
Rounds 3–7: Work same as Rounds 3–7 of basketball—42 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
With E, embroider 6 hexagons around Round 2, stitching lower edge of each hexagon over 2 stitches of Round 2. 
RATTLES 
Football
With hook size appropriate to this section and B, ch 30; being careful not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch.
Round 1: Working in back bumps, sc in each ch around-—30 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–4: Sc in each st around.
Round 5: *Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around; change to C at end of round—24 sc. Drop, but do not cut, B.
Rounds 6 and 7: Sc in each st around; change to B at end of Round 7. Cut C.
Round 8: *Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around—18 sts. 
Round 9: Sc in each st around.
Round 10: *Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around—12 sts.
Round 11: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around—6 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Weave tail through last round and pull gently to close opening. Secure tail and weave in end.
Round 12: Working in opposite side of foundation ch, join B with slip st to first ch, ch 1, sc in each ch around—30 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 13 and 14: Sc in each st around.
Rounds 15–21: Repeat Rounds 5–11, inserting rattle mechanism and adding stuffing as you go before opening becomes too small. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Weave tail through last round and pull gently to close opening. Secure tail and weave in end. 
With 2 strands of C held together, embroider laces on football between Rounds 6 and 16.
Basketball
With hook appropriate to this section and D, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around—12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—18 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—24 sc.
Round 5: *Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—30 sc.
Round 6: *Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—36 sc.
Round 7: *Sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—42 sc. 
Rounds 8–17: Sc in each st around.
Round 18: *Sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around—36 sc.
Round 19: *Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around—30 sc.
Round 20: *Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around—24 sc. Insert rattle mechanism and add stuffing as you go before opening becomes too small.
Round 21: *Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around—18 sc.
Round 22: *Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around—12 sc.
Round 23: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Add additional stuffing, if needed. Weave tail through last round and pull gently to close opening. Secure tail and weave in end.
Seam Line (make 3)
With smallest hook and E, work as many ch as necessary to fit seam line around basketball. 
Using photograph as a guide, pin one seam line around circumference of ball and pin each remaining seam line midway between circumference and outer edge. With thread and sewing needle, sew seam lines to ball. 
Baseball
With hook appropriate to this section and C, make an adjustable ring.
Rounds 1–5: Work same as Rounds 1–5 of basketball rattle—30 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Rounds 6–14: Sc in each st around.
Rounds 15–18: Repeat Rounds 20–23 of basketball rattle, inserting rattle mechanism in Round 16 and adding stuffing as you go—6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Add additional stuffing, if needed. Weave tail through last round and pull gently to close opening. Secure tail and weave in end.
With F, topstitch 2 sets of curved seam lines and hash marks around sides of ball.
FINISHING
Using photograph as a guide, pin appliques around border of blanket. With end tails, sew each applique to blanket.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 9 skeins 1914 Berry Red.
abbreviations: LB (large bobble) = [yo and pull up a loop] 5 times in next sc, yo and draw through all 11 loops on hook.
SB (small bobble) = [yo and pull up a loop] 3 times in next sc, yo and draw through all 7 loops on hook.

Fpdc (front post double crochet) = Dc around the post of indicated st as follows: yo, insert hook from front-to back-to front around post and pull up a loop, [yo and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice.
To work a Fpdc in a st 2RB (front post double crochet in a st 2 rows below): skip next sc, and work a Fpdc around the post of the st just below it.
Fpdc3tog (front post double crochet 3 together) = [yo and pull up a loop around post of next Fpdc 2RB, yo and draw through 2 loops on hook] 3 times, yo and through all 4 loops on hook.
gauge: 12 sc = 4” 16 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
THROW
Ch 144.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 143 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in 1st 4 sts, LB in next sc, sc in next 5 sts, LB in next sc, * sc in next 25 sc, LB in next sc, sc in next 5 sc, LB in next sc; repeat from * to last 4 sc, sc in last 4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in 1st sc, Fpdc around sc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around sc 2RB] twice, * sc in next 19 sc, Fpdc around sc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around sc 2RB] twice; repeat from * to last sc, sc in last sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st across.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in 1st sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice, * sc in next 19 sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice; repeat from * to last sc, sc in last sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in 1st 23 sts, SB in next sc, [sc in next 31 sts, SB in next sc] 3 times, sc in last 23 sts.
Row 7: Repeat row 5.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in 1st 4 sts, LB in next sc, sc in next 5 sts, LB in next sc, * sc in next 8 sts, SB in next sc, sc in next 7 sts, SB in next sc, sc in next 8 sts, LB in next sc, sc in next 5 sts, LB in next sc; repeat from * to last 4 sc, sc in last 4 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in 1st sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice, * sc in next 9 sts, skip next sc, Fpdc around SB of Row 6, sc in next 9 sts, [Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, sc in next 5 sts] twice, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB; repeat from * to last sc; sc in last sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in 1st 17 sts, SB in next sc, sc in next 11 sts, SB in next sc, [sc in next 19 sts, SB in next sc, sc in next 11 sts, SB in next sc] 3 times, sc in last 17 sts.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in 1st sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice, * sc in next 6 sts, skip next sc, Fpdc around 1st SB of Row 8, sc in next 2 sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, sc in next 2 sc, Fpdc around next SB of Row 8, sc in next 6 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice; repeat from * to last sc; sc in last sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc in each st across.
Row 13: Ch 1, sc in 1st sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice, * sc in next 4 sc, skip next sc, Fpdc around 1st SB of Row 10, sc in next 2 sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice, sc in next 2 sc, skip next sc, Fpdc around next SB of Row 10, sc in next 4 sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice; repeat from * to last sc; sc in last sc.
Row 14: Repeat Row 2.
Row 15: Ch 1, sc in 1st sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice, * sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, sc in next 2 sc, [Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] 3 times (skip all 3 sc behind these 3 Fpdc), sc in next 2 sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice; repeat from * to last sc; sc in last sc.
Row 16: Repeat row 4.
Row 17: Ch 1, sc in 1st sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice, * sc in next 6 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, sc in next 2 sc, skip next sc, Fpdc3tog, sc in next 2 sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, sc in next 6 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice; repeat from * to last sc; sc in last sc.
Row 18: Repeat row 4.
Row 19: Ch 1, sc in 1st sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice, * sc in next 7 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, sc in next sc, Fpdc around Fpdc3tog 2RB, sc in next sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, sc in next 7 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice; repeat from * to last sc; sc in last sc.
Row 20: Repeat Row 2.
Row 21: Ch 1, sc in 1st sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice, * sc in next 8 sts, [Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] 3 times (skip all 3 sc behind these 3 Fpdc), sc in next 8 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice; repeat from * to last sc; sc in last sc.
Row 22: Repeat row 4.
Row 23: Ch 1, sc in first sc, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice, * sc in next 9 sts, skip next sc, Fpdc3tog, sc in next 9 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB, [sc in next 5 sts, Fpdc around Fpdc 2RB] twice; repeat from * to last sc; sc in last sc; turn.
Row 24: Repeat row 4.
Row 25: Repeat Row 5.
Row 26: Repeat Row 2.
Row 27: Repeat Row 5.
Repeat rows 4-27 9 more times.
Do not fasten off.
Turn work 90 degrees, to work down left side edge.
EDGING
Round 1: with Right Side still facing, ch 1, work 183 sc evenly down left side edge, 3 sc in corner st, 141 sc across lower edge, 3 sc in corner st, 183 sc evenly up right side edge, 3 sc in corner st, 141 sc across top edge, 3 sc in corner st, slip st in 1st sc to join; turn – 660 sc.
Round 2: Ch 4 (counts as 1 dc and 1 ch), skip next sc, ** [dc, ch 1, dc, ch 1, dc] in corner sc, ch 1, skip next sc, * dc in next sc, ch 1, skip next sc; repeat from * to next corner; repeat from ** around; join with a slip st to 3rd of beg 4-ch; turn – 676 sts total.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, sc in each space and dc around, and working 3 sc in each corner dc, slip st in back loop of 1st sc to join; turn – 684 sc.
Round 4: * Ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in front loop of next 3 sts; repeat from * around.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
with Right Side facing, beginning at lower edge, holding hook above and yarn under fabric, work slip st embroidery up each vertical row of bobbles to top of afghan following diagrams.
weave in loose ends.
Abbreviations: 2 RB = 2 rows below; ch = chain; dc = double crochet; sc = single crochet; st(s) = stitch(es); slip st(s) = Slip Stitch(es);

materials: 1 skein each 672 Spring Green C, 706 Perfect Pink D, 316 Soft White E and 718 Shocking Pink F
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 5 mm [US H-8]
Susan Bates® Easy Pom Pon Maker, 1¾" (4.5 cm) diameter
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc;
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified;
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
instructions:
THROW
With B, ch 141.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in second ch from hook and each ch across, turn – 140 sc.
Row 2: With A, ch 3 (counts as 1 dc here and throughout), dc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
Row 4: With C, ch 1, sc in first dc, [ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next dc] 69 times, sc in last dc, turn.
Row 5: With D, ch 1, sc in first sc, ch 1, skip next sc, [sc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, skip next sc] 68 times, sc in last ch-1 space and in last sc, turn.
Row 6: With C, repeat Row 5.
Row 7: With D, repeat Row 5.
Row 8: With C, repeat Row 5.
Row 9: With A, ch 3, dc in each sc and ch-1 space across, turn – 140 dc.
Row 10: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
Row 11: With E, ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn.
Row 12: Ch 3, skip first 2 sc, V-st in next sc, skip next sc, dc in next sc, [skip next sc, V-st in next sc, skip next sc, dc in next sc] 33 times, skip next sc, dc in next sc, ch 1, dc in last sc, turn.
Row 13: Ch 3, dc in next ch 1 space, [skip next dc, V-st in next dc, dc in next ch-1 space] 34 times, dc in each of last 2 dc, turn.
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in each dc and ch 1 space across, turn – 140 sc.
Row 15: With A, ch 3, dc in each sc across, turn.
Row 16: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
Row 17: With F, ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn.
Row 18: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 19: With B, ch 1, sc in each of first 2 sc, [bobble in next sc, sc in each of next 4 sc] 27 times, bobble in next sc, sc in each of last 2 sc, turn.
Row 20: With F, ch 1, sc in each sc and bobble across, turn – 140 sc.
Row 21: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 22 and 23: With A, repeat Rows 2 and 3.
Row 24: With D, repeat Row 4.
Row 25: With C, repeat Row 5.
Row 26: With D, repeat Row 5.
Row 27: With C, repeat Row 5.
Row 28: With D, repeat Row 5.
Rows 29 and 30: With A, repeat Rows 9 and 10.
Rows 31-34: With E, repeat Rows 11-14.
Rows 35 and 36: With A, repeat Rows 15 and 16.
Rows 37 and 38: With B, repeat Rows 17 and 18.
Row 39: With F, repeat Row 19.
Rows 40 and 41: With B, repeat Rows 20 and 21.
Rows 42–136: Repeat Rows 2–41 twice, then repeat Rows 2–16 only once more.
Row 137: With B, ch 1, sc in each dc across, do not turn – 140 sc.
FINISHING
Border
Rotate throw so you are ready to work down left side edge.

Rep last 2 rows to 3 sts.
Next row: Ch 2. Dc2tog. Fasten off.

****HOOD****

Work from ** to ** as given for Blanket
Rep last 2 rows, inc 2 dc on RS rows and 4 dc on WS rows, until straight side edge measures 8" [20.5 cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off.
Sew shaped sides of Hood to top corner of Blanket.

****SPIKE STRIP****

1st Spike: With B, ch 20.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch, Turn. 18 hdc.
**2nd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn. 16 sts.
Rep last row to 4 sts.
Next row: Ch 2. (Hdc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts.
Next row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. Fasten off. **

2nd Spike:  With B, ch 18. With RS facing, join with sl st to 1st foundation ch of Spike just worked. 
1st row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 18 hdc.
Rep from ** to ** as given for First Spike.
Rep 2nd Spike until Spike Strip measures length of center ‘ridge’ created by post sts (from front of Hood, to corner of Blanket). Sew Spike Stripe to ridge.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 2 skeins each 624 Tea Leaf A, 358 Lavender B, 400 Grey Heather C; 3 skeins 315 Artist Print D.

THROW
With double-ended hook and A, ch 120 sts.

Row 2: With A and working from left to right, make a slip knot and draw through 1st loop on hook, * yo and draw through next 2 loops; repeat from * across; DO NOT TURN; working back across row, skip 1st vertical bar, 2 k-st, ** 2 p-st, 2 k-st; repeat from ** across, yo and draw through last vertical bar; turn.
Row 3: With 2nd skein of A, yo and draw through 1st loop on hook, * yo and draw through next 2 loops; repeat from * across; DO NOT TURN; working back across row, skip 1st vertical bar, 2 p-st, ** 2 k-st, 2 p-st; repeat from ** across, yo and draw through last vertical bar; turn.
Row 4: With 1st skein of A, yo and draw through 1st loop on hook, * yo and draw through next 2 loops; repeat from * across; DO NOT TURN; working back across row, skip 1st vertical bar, 2 k-st, ** 2 p-st, 2 k-st; repeat from ** across, yo and draw through last vertical bar; turn.
Rows 5-6: Repeat Rows 3-4. Fasten off both skeins of A.
Row 7: With D, make a slip knot and draw through 1st loop on hook, * ch 3, yo and draw through next 2 loops; repeat from * across; DO NOT TURN; working back across row, k-st across; turn. Fasten off D.
Row 8: With B, make a slip knot and draw through 1st loop on hook, * yo and draw through next 2 loops; repeat from * across; DO NOT TURN; working back across row, skip 1st vertical bar, 2 k-st, ** 2 p-st, 2 k-st; repeat from ** across, yo and draw through last vertical bar; turn.
Row 9: With 2nd skein of B, yo and draw through 1st loop on hook, * yo and draw through next 2 loops; repeat from * across; DO NOT TURN; working back across row, skip 1st vertical bar, 2 p-st, ** 2 k-st, 2 p-st; repeat from ** across, yo and draw through last vertical bar; turn.
Row 10: With 1st skein of B, yo and draw through 1st loop on hook, * yo and draw through next 2 loops; repeat from * across; DO NOT TURN; working back across row, skip 1st vertical bar, 2 k-st, ** 2 p-st, 2 k-st; repeat from ** across, yo and draw through last vertical bar; turn.
Rows 11-12: Repeat Rows 9-10. Fasten off both skeins of B.
Row 13: Repeat Row 7.
Rows 14-18: With C, repeat Rows 8-12.
Row 19: Repeat Row 7.
Rows 20-24: With A, repeat Rows 8-12.
Row 25: Repeat Row 7.
Rows 26-151: [Repeat Rows 8-25] 7 times.
Rows 152-161: Repeat Rows 8-17.
Row 162: With 2nd skein of A, yo and draw through 1st loop on hook, * yo and draw through next 2 loops; repeat from * across; DO NOT TURN; change to D and crochet hook in last st. Fasten off both skeins of A.

With D, ch 3, (slip st, ch 3) evenly around outer edge in sts and ends of rows; join to 1st st. Fasten off.

Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 315 yds/288 m)

abbreviations: Popcorn = Work 4 dc into same stitch or space. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back into first dc of 4 dc group. Pull dropped loop through st. Ch 1 to secure popcorn
measurements: Blanket: Approx 50" x 60" [127 cm x 152.5 cm], excluding fringe. Pillow: 20" [51 cm] square, excluding fringe.
gauge: 10 dc and 5 rows = 4" (10 cm).
instructions:
Notes: 
• Ch 3 at beg of rows counts as dc throughout. 
• Bottom and Top Borders are worked with RS facing throughout. Do not turn at end of rows. 
BLANKET 
Bottom Border: With A, ch 127. 
See diagram on page 3.
**1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (skipped ch-3 counts as dc). 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. 125 dc. Do not turn.
2nd row: (RS). Ch 1. Working from right to left instead of left to right as usual, work 1 reverse sc in front loop only of each dc to last st. 1 reverse sc in top of ch-3. Do not turn. 
3rd row:  (RS). Ch 3. 1 dc in each rem back loop of each dc of row 2 rows down. Do not turn.**
Rep last 2 rows until work from beg measures approx 10" [25.5 cm], ending on a 3rd row. 
Fasten off.
 
***Popcorn Section (alternate RS and WS rows throughout):  
With RS facing, join MC with sl st to first dc. 
1st row: (RS). Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
2nd row: (WS). Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: (RS). Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. *Popcorn in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 11 dc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Popcorn in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Turn.
4th row: As 2nd row.
5th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. *Popcorn in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 11 dc. Rep from * to last 9 sts. Popcorn in next dc. 1 dc in each of last 8 dc.
6th row: As 4th row.***
Rep 3rd to 6th rows for Popcorn Pat until work from beg measures approx 50" [127 cm], ending on a 4th row of pat. 
Next row: (RS). Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Fasten off. 
****Top Border: With RS facing, join A with sl st to first dc. 
1st row: (RS). Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Do not turn.
2nd row: (RS). Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in front loop only of each dc to last st. 1 reverse sc in top of ch-3. Do not turn.
3rd row:  (RS). Ch 3. 1 dc in each rem back loop of each dc of row 2 rows below. Do not turn.
Rep last 2 rows until Top Border matches number of rows in Bottom Border. ****
Do not fasten off.
Edging rnd: (RS). With A, ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc around entire edge of Blanket, matching color changes for Borders and Popcorn Section and working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Fasten off.
Fringe: Cut strands of A 12" [30.5 cm] long. Taking 2 strands tog, fold in half and knot into fringe across top and bottom edges of Blanket. Trim fringe evenly. 
PILLOW
Note: Pillow is worked sideways.
With A, ch 103.
Work from ** to ** as given for Blanket.
Rep last 2 rows until work from beg measures approx 5" [12.5 cm], ending on a 3rd row. 
Fasten off.
With MC, work from *** to *** as given for Blanket until work from beg measures approx 15" [38 cm], ending on a 4th row of pat. 
With A, work from **** to **** as given for Blanket. 
Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Fold piece in half, bringing side edges to meet. Sew 2 side seams using flat seam. Insert pillow form.  Sew last side closed. 
Fringe: Cut strands of A 12" [30.5 cm] long. Taking 2 strands tog, fold in half and knot into fringe across side edges of Pillow. Trim fringe evenly.

instructions:
BLANKET
Square (make 4)
With A, ch 4, join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), 2 dc in ring, [ch 2, 3 dc in ring] 3 times, ch 2; join with slip st in top of beg ch—12 dc and 4 ch-2 spaces.
Round 2: Slip st in next 2 dc, slip st in first ch-2 space, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in each ch-2 space around; join with slip st in top of beg ch—eight 3-dc groups and 4 ch-2 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in next 2 dc, slip st in first ch-2 space, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, 3 dc in space between next two 3-dc groups, *(3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space, 3 dc in space between next two 3-dc groups; repeat from * twice; join with slip st in top of beg ch—36 dc and 4 ch-2 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 3, *dc in each dc to next ch-2 space, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-2 space; repeat from * 3 times, dc in remaining dc; join with slip st in top of beg ch—52 dc and 4 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 5: With right side facing, join B with slip st in same st as join; repeat Round 4—68 dc and 4 ch-2 spaces.
Round 6: Repeat Round 4—84 dc and 4 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 7: With right side facing, join C with slip st in same st as join; repeat Round 4—100 dc and 4 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 8: With right side facing, join B with sc in in any ch–2 space, 2 sc in same space (corner made), *sc in each dc across to next ch-2 space, 3 sc in next ch-2 space (corner made); repeat from * twice; sc in each remaining dc; join with slip st in first sc—100 sc and four 3-sc corners. Fasten off.

Flower (make 4)
With B, ch 3.
Round 1 (right side): Work 10 hdc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch do not count as a st); join in back loop of first hdc—10 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 1, working in back loops only, (hdc, dc) in same st as join, (dc, hdc) in next hdc (petal made), *ch 1, (slip st, ch 1, hdc, dc) in next hdc, (dc, hdc) in next back loop (petal made), repeat from * 3 more times, ch 1; join with slip st in first ch—5 petals.

Notes
1. Blanket is made from 4 squares worked in joined rounds with right side facing, then sewn together. Flowers are worked in joined rounds and sewn to center of each square.
2. Kitty is made separately in continuous (spiral) rounds and sewn to center of blanket. Work tightly to ensure that stuffing does not show through stitches. Do not overstuff and stretch stitches so that stuffing is visible.

Special Stitch
sc2tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

Special Technique
Join with sc = Place a slip knot on hook, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through both loops on hook.

Border
With B, wrong sides held together, and working in inside loops, sew squares together.
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, join C with sc in any st, sc in each st around working 3 sc in center st of each corner; join with slip st in first sc—228 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, sc in next 5 st, *ch 3, hdc in 3rd ch from hook, sc in next 6 sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

KITTY
Head
Beginning at top of head, with A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—18 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—24 sc.
Round 5: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—30 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: *Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—36 sc.
Round 8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: *Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—42 sc.
Rounds 10–18: Sc in each sc around.
Round 19: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around—21 sc.
Round 20: Sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Do not close end. Stuff firmly with fiberfill.

Ear (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—8 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—10 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: *Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—12 sc.
Round 6: *Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—14 sc.
Round 7: *Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—16 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Hold bottom edge flat and weave tail across, pulling slightly to curl ear. Using photograph as a guide, sew ears in place.

Face
With B, ch 2.
Rounds 1–4: Work same as Rounds 1–4 of head—24 sc.
Round 5: Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, *sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * 4 times, sc in last 2 sc—30 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
With embroidery floss and using photograph as a guide for placement, embroider satin sts for eyes, straight sts for mouth and whiskers. With A, embroider satin sts for nose. Sew face on front of head. Sew open edge of head to center of blanket.

Collar
With C, ch 25.
Row 1: Dc in 4th ch from hook, 2 dc in each ch across, turn—44 dc.
Row 2: Ch 1, skip first dc, *3 hdc in next dc, [skip next dc, slip st in next dc] twice; repeat from * around. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing. Sew around neck.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

abbreviations: *  Repeat directions following * as many times as indicated.

3CL  (3 tr cluster stitch) [Yo twice, insert hook into sp and draw up a lp. Yo and draw through 2 lps on hook twice] 3 times, yo and draw through all 4 lps on hook.
4CL  (4 tr cluster stitch) [Yo twice, insert hook into sp and draw up a lp. Yo and draw through 2 lps on hook twice] 4 times, yo and draw through all 5 lps on hook.
P-st  (puff stitch) [Yo, draw up a lp] 4 times in same sp (or st), yo and draw through all 9 lps on hook.
sc2tog  (sc 2 sts together) [Insert hook in next st, yo and draw up a lp] twice, yo and draw through all 3 lps on hook.

instructions:
SQUARES (make 48)
Ch 5. Join ch with a sl st in first ch forming a ring.
Round 1 (right side) Ch 1, [sc, ch 2, tr, ch 2] 8 times in ring, join round with a sl st in first sc—8 petals made.
Round 2 Folding petals over towards you, work as follows: [ch 2, sl st around post of next sc] 8 times—8 ch-2 sps.
Round 3 Sl st in first ch-2 sp, ch 4 (counts as 1 tr), work 3CL in same ch-2 sp, ch 4, 4CL in next ch-2 sp, ch 2, [4CL in next ch-2 sp, ch 4, 4CL in next ch-2 sp, ch 2] 3 times, join round with a sl st in beginning 3CL—8 petals made and 4 corner ch-4 sps.
Round 4 Sl st in first corner ch-4 sp, ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), work (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same ch-4 sp, dc in next 4CL, work 3 dc in next ch-2 sp, dc in next 4CL, *work (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next corner ch-4 sp, dc in next 4CL, work 3 dc in next ch-2 sp, dc in next 4CL; repeat from * around twice more, join round with a sl st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-3.
Round 5 Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), dc in next 2 dc, *work (2 tr, ch 2, 2 tr) in next corner ch-2 sp, dc in next 11 dc; repeat from * around twice more, end work (2 tr, ch 2, 2 tr) in next corner ch-2 sp, dc in last 8 dc, join round with a sl st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-3.
Round 6 Sl st in first dc, ch 3 (counts as 1 dc) work 2 dc in same dc, sc2tog over next 2 dc, *work (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in next corner ch-2 sp, [sc2tog over next 2 dc, work 3 dc in next dc] 4 times, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around twice more, end work (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in last corner ch-2 sp, [sc2tog over next 2 dc, work 3 dc in next dc] 3 times, sc2tog over last dc and sl st of round 5, do not join.
Round 7 Folding last round over towards you, work as follows: ch 3, sl st around post of next sc2tog, *ch 5 for corner, sl st around post of next sc2tog, [ch 3, sl st around post of next sc2tog] 4 times; repeat from * around twice more, end ch 5 for corner, sl st around post of next sc2tog, [ch 3, sl st around post of next sc2tog] 3 times, do not join.
Round 8 Sl st in first ch-3 sp, ch 4 (counts as 1 tr), work 2 tr in same ch-3 sp, work (4 tr, ch 3, 4 tr) in next corner ch-5 sp, *[work 3 tr in next ch-3 sp] 4 times, work (4 tr, ch 3, 4 tr) in next corner ch-5 sp; repeat from * around twice more, end [work 3 tr in next ch-3 sp] 3 times, join round with a sl st in 4th ch of beginning ch-4. Fasten off.
finishing
Sew squares together in 6 strips of 8 squares, then sew strips together.
edging
Round 1 With right side facing, join yarn with a sl st in tr before any corner ch-3 sp, ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), *work (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next corner ch-3 sp, [dc in next 20 tr, work 2 dc in next ch-3 sp, work 1 dc in seam, work 2 dc in next ch-3 sp] 5 times, dc in next 20 tr*, **work (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next corner ch-3 sp, [dc in next 20 tr, work 2 dc in next ch-3 sp, work 1 dc in seam, work 2 dc in next ch-3 sp] 7 times**, dc in next 20 tr; repeat from * to * once more, then repeat from ** to ** once more, end dc in last 19 sts, join round with a sl st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-3.
Round 2 Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, ch 3, *P-st in next corner ch-3 sp, ch 2, skip next dc, [sc in next dc, ch 3, skip next 2 dc, P-st in next dc, ch 2, skip next 2 dc] 25 times, sc in next dc, ch 3*, **P-st in next corner ch-3 sp, ch 2, skip next dc, [sc in next dc, ch 3, skip next 2 dc, P-st in next dc, ch 2, skip next 2 dc] 33 times**, sc in next dc, ch 3; repeat from * to * once more, then repeat from ** to ** once more, join round with a sl st in first sc.
Round 3 Ch 2, sl st in same sc as joining, ch 1, *work ([dc, ch 1] 4 times, dc) in next corner P-st, [ch 1, work (sl st, ch 2, sl st) in next sc, ch 1, work ([dc, ch 1] 3 times, dc) in next P-st] 25 times, ch 1, work (sl st, ch 2, sl st) in next sc, ch 1*, **work ([dc, ch 1] 4 times, dc) in next corner P-st, [ch 1, work (sl st, ch 2, sl st) in next sc, ch 1, work ([dc, ch 1] 3 times, dc) in next P-st] 33 times**, ch 1; repeat from * to * once more, then repeat from ** to ** once more, join round with a sl st in first sl st. Fasten off.

instructions:
BLANKET: With MC, ch 62.
Row 1 (Right Side): Hdc in 3rd ch from hook, [skip next ch, 2 hdc in next ch] 28 times, skip next ch, hdc in last 2 ch; turn – 60 sts and 28 groups.
Row 2: Ch 2, skip first hdc, hdc in next hdc, * group over group; rep from * to last 3 sts; skip hdc of last group in the row below, hdc in next hdc, hdc in top of beg ch changing to CC; turn.
Row 3: With CC, ch 2, skip first 2 hdc, group between first 2 hdc and first group of the row below, * group between groups; rep from * to last 2 sts; skip next hdc, hdc in top of ch-2 changing to MC – 29 groups.
Row 4: With MC, ch 2, * group over group; rep from * to last 2 sts; skip hdc of last group in the row below, hdc in top of ch-2; turn.
Row 5: Rep Row 4 changing to CC in last st.
Row 6: With CC, ch 2, hdc in the space between the first hdc and the first group of the row below, * group between groups; rep from * to last 3 sts; skip last group, hdc between last group and last st, hdc in top of ch-2 changing to MC; turn – 28 groups.
Row 7: With MC, ch 2, skip first hdc, hdc in next hdc, * group over group; rep from * to last 3 sts; skip hdc of last group, hdc in next hdc, hdc in top of ch-2; turn.
Rep Rows 2-7 for pattern until approximately 36” from beg, end by working 2 rows with MC. Fasten off CC.
EDGING-Rnd 1: With right side facing, join MC in any st; ch 1, work sc evenly around all 4 sides, working 3 sc in each corner; join with a sl st in first sc; turn.
Rnd 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around and 3 sc in corner sc; join; turn.
Rnd 3: Ch 1, * sc in sc, (ch 1, hdc, ch 1, sl st) all in next sc; rep from * around adjusting as necessary around corners and at end of rnd; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

instructions:
NOTES
1. Weave in ends as work progresses.
2. To change color, work old color to last yarn over; yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook. Continue work with new color. Do not carry unused yarn colors along; join a new ball for each section of color.
3. On chart, each square represents one single crochet. Read odd-numbered rows from right to left, even-numbered rows from left to right.

TULIP MOTIF (make 10 – 6 in first color combination, and 4 in second color combination)
First color combination: background color A, tulip color B. Second color combination: background color C, tulip color B.

With background color, chain 24.
Row 1 (RS): Sc in second ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—23 sc.
Rows 2–23: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; changing color as shown in tulip chart, turn. Do not fasten off at end of Row 23.

Begin working in rounds.
Round 24: With background color, ch 1, work 21 sc evenly spaced along each edge, working 3 sc in each corner; join with slip st in first sc—96 sc. Fasten off background color.
Round 25: Join tulip color with sc in center sc of any 3-sc corner, 2 sc in same sc (corner made), sc in each sc around, working 3 sc in center sc of each 3-sc corner; join with slip st in first sc—104 sc. Fasten off tulip color.

Surface Slip Stitch Tulip Outline
With RS of motif facing, hold hook on RS of piece and tulip color on WS of piece. Insert hook from RS to WS near edge of tulip, yarn over and draw loop through to RS of piece;
*move hook slightly forward and insert again from RS to WS, yarn over and draw loop through to RS and through loop on hook (surface slip st completed); repeat from * working around entire edge of tulip to outline. Fasten off tulip color.

SOLID MOTIF (make 10 – 6 with D and 4 with E)
Chain 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), 2 dc in ring, ch 2, [3 dc in ring, ch 2] 3 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—12 dc and 4 ch-3 sps.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, [5 dc in next ch-2 sp, dc in next 3 dc] 3 times, 5 dc in last ch-2 sp; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—32 dc.
Round 3: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), [sk next dc, dc in next 3 dc, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next dc (corner made), dc in next 3 dc, ch 1] 3 times, sk next dc, dc in next 3 dc, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next dc (corner made), dc in last 2 dc; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—4 ch-2 corner sps, 4 ch-1 sides sps, and 10 dc along each side.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in first ch-1 space, dc in next 5 dc, [5 dc in next ch-2 sp, dc in next 5 dc, dc in next ch-1 sp, dc in next 5 dc] 3 times, 5 dc in last ch-2 sp, dc in last 4 dc; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—64 dc.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in next 8 dc, [(2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next dc, dc in next 15 dc] 3 times, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next dc, dc in last 6 dc; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—4 ch-2 corner sps and 19 dc along each side.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in each dc around, working 3 sc in each corner ch-2 sp; join with slip st in first sc—88 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, working 3 sc in center sc of each 3-sc corner; join with slip st in first sc—96 sc. Fasten off.
Round 8: Join B with sc in center sc of any 3-sc corner, 2 sc in same sc, sc in each remaining sc around, working 3 sc in center sc of each 3-sc corner; join with slip st in first sc—104 sc. Fasten off B.

FINISHING
Arrange squares according to assembly diagram. Hold neighboring squares with RS together. Whip stitch neighboring sides of squares together, sewing through front loops of each sc only.

Edging
With RS facing, join B with slip st in center sc of any 3-sc corner.
Round 1: Ch 3, 2 dc in same sc as join; work 133 dc evenly spaced along each long edge, and 109 dc evenly spaced along each short edge, working 3 dc in center sc of each 3-sc corner; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—496 dc. Fasten off B.
Round 2: With RS facing, join E with slip st in 3rd dc of any 3-dc corner; ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in next 2 dc, *ch 3, sk next 3 dc, dc in next 3 dc; repeat from * to center dc of next 3-dc corner, ch 3, sk next dc (center dc of 3-dc corner)**, dc in next 3 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—252 dc and 84 ch-3 sps. Fasten off E.
Round 3: With RS facing, join C with slip st in skipped center dc of any 3-dc corner of Round 1, ch 3, working over ch-3 corner sp, 4 dc in same dc as join, *ch 3, sk next 3 dc, working over ch-3 sp, dc in next 3 skipped dc of Round 1; repeat from * to last 3-dc before corner, ch 3, sk next 3 dc**, working over ch-3 corner sp, 5 dc in skipped center dc of 3-dc corner of Round 1; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off C.
Round 4: Join E with slip st in center dc of any 5-dc corner, ch 1, 3 sc in same dc as join, sc in next 2 dc, working over ch-3 sp, sc in next 3 skipped dc of Round 2, *sc in next 3 dc, working over ch-3 sp, sc in next 3 skipped dc of Round 2; repeat from * to next 5-dc corner, sc in next 2 dc**, 3 sc in next dc (center dc of corner), sc in next 2 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 5: Slip st in next 2 sc, ch 3, dc in next 2 sc, *ch 3, sk next 3 sc, dc in next 3 sts; repeat from * to center sc of next 3-sc corner, ch 3, sk next sc (center sc of corner)**, dc in next 3 sc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off E.
Round 6: Join C with slip st in skipped center sc of any 3-sc corner of Round 4, ch 3, working over ch-3 corner sp, 4 dc in same sc as join, *ch 3, sk next 3 dc, working over ch-3 sp, dc in next 3 skipped sc of Round 4; repeat from * to last 3-dc before corner, ch 3, sk next 3 dc**, working over ch-3 corner sp, 5 dc in skipped corner sc of Round 4; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off C.
Round 7: Join B with sc in center dc of any 5-dc corner, 2 sc in same dc as join, sc in next 2 dc, working over ch-3 sp, sc in next 3 skipped dc of Round 5, *sc in next 3 dc, working over ch-3 sp, sc in next 3 skipped dc of Round 5; repeat from * to next 5-dc corner, sc in next 2 dc**, 3 sc in next dc (center dc of corner), sc in next 2 dc, working over ch-3 sp, sc in next 3 skipped dc of Round 5; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 8: Ch 3, dc in each sc around, working 5 dc in center sc of each 3-sc corner; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off B.
Using yarn needle, weave in all ends.

Work diamonds in different colors according to chart or as desired.

Weave in all ends. With wrong side of blanket facing, block lightly.

Let the Sun Shine 
Throw
The sun will definitely shine through the 
gloom with this cheerful crocheted afghan! 
The project uses the join-as-you-go 
technique to make finishing faster.
Notes
1. Throw is made from 35 squares; 18
worked with an A-colored center, and 17
worked with a B-colored center.
2. The squares are arranged in 5 rows of 7
squares each, alternating center colors, and
joined using a “join-as-you- go” technique
while working the last round.
3. Each square is worked in joined rounds
with right side facing at all times.
SQUARE 1
With A, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form 
a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, [sc in ring, ch 3] 8 
times; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc and 8 
ch-3 spaces.
Round 2: (Slip st, ch 1, sc, ch 3, sc) in first 
ch-3 space, (sc, ch 3, sc) in each remaining 
ch-3 space around; join with slip st in first 
sc—16 sc and 8 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: (Slip st, ch 1, sc) in first ch-3 space, 
[ch 4, sc in next ch-3 space] 7 times, ch 4; join 
with slip st in first sc—8 sc and 8 ch-4 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, shell 
in next ch-4 space, *sc in next sc, shell in next 
ch-4 space; repeat from * around; join with 
slip st in first sc—8 sc and 8 shells.
Round 5: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1, dc in same 
sc as joining (first V-st made), ch 2, sc in ch-2 
space of next shell, *ch 2, V-st in next sc, ch 
2, sc in ch-2 space of next shell; repeat from 
* around, ch 2; join with slip st in 3rd ch of
beginning ch—8 sc and 8 V-sts.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in same ch as joining, sc
in next ch-1 space, sc in next dc, 2 sc in next
ch-2 space, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next ch-2
space, *sc in next dc, sc in next ch-1 space,
sc in next dc, 2 sc in next ch-2 space, sc in
next sc, 2 sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from
* around; join with slip st in first sc—64 sc.
Fasten off A.
Throw measures 44” (112 cm) wide and 61” 
(155 cm) long, including border.
Special Stitches
ch-2 join = Ch 1, drop loop from hook, 
insert hook from front to back through 
corresponding ch-2 space of neighboring 
square, place dropped loop back on hook and 
draw through, ch 1.
corner-join = There are two different types 
of corner join. One is used when joining at a 
corner where only 2 squares meet (2 corner 
join). The other is used when joining at a 
corner where 4 squares meet (4 corner join). 
Work the appropriate join for the situation.
2 corner join = Ch 2, drop loop from hook, 
insert hook from front to back through 
corresponding corner ch-4 space of 
neighboring square, place dropped loop back 
on hook and draw through, ch 2.
4 corner join = Ch 2, drop loop from hook, 
insert hook from front to back through 
corresponding corner ch-4 space of first 
neighboring square, place dropped loop 
back on hook and draw through, ch 1, drop 
loop from hook, skip ch-4 space of next 
neighboring square (square diagonally across 
from current square), insert hook from front 
to back through corner ch-4 space of next 
neighboring square, place dropped loop back 
on hook and draw through, ch 2. Note: If you 
are right-handed, the first neighboring square 
is the first square counter-clockwise from 
current square. If you are left-handed, the 
first neighboring square is the first square 
clockwise from current square.
shell = (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in indicated space.
V-st (V-stitch) = (Dc, ch 1, dc) in indicated
stitch.

(corner made), ch 1, skip next sc, dc in next

Round 8: Ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, *2

SQUARES 2–35

Notes
1.The next round joins the current square to

2. Refer to Assembly Diagram to determine

Round 9 (One-Side Joining): With right 
side facing, draw up a loop D in 2nd sc 
immediately following any ch-3 corner space,

next sc, (sc, ch-2 join, sc, corner-join, sc, ch-2
join, sc) in corner ch-3 space, **skip next sc,

sc, (sc, ch-2 join, sc, corner-join, sc, ch-2 join,
sc) in corner ch-3 space; [***skip next sc, (sc,
ch 2, sc) in next sc; repeat from *** to 1 sc
before next corner ch-3 space, skip next sc,
(sc, ch 2, sc, ch 4, sc, ch 2, sc) in corner ch-3
space] twice; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 9 (Two-Side Joining): With right side
facing, draw up a loop D in 2nd sc immediately
following any ch-3 corner space, ch 1, (sc,
ch 2, sc) in same sc as joining, *skip next sc,
(sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc; repeat from * to 1 sc
before next corner ch-3 space, skip next sc,
(sc, ch-2 join, sc, corner-join, sc, ch-2 join,
sc) in corner ch-3 space, [ **skip next sc, (sc,
ch-2 join, sc) in next sc; repeat from ** to 1 sc
before next corner ch-3 space, skip next sc,
(sc, ch-2 join, sc, corner-join, sc, ch-2 join, sc)
in corner ch-3 space] twice; ***skip next sc, 
(sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc; repeat from *** to 1 sc 
before next corner ch-3 space, skip next sc, 
(sc, ch 2, sc, ch 4, sc, ch 2, sc) in corner ch-3 
space; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off D.
FINISHING
Border
With right side facing, draw up a loop of D in 
any ch-2 space following a corner ch-4 space.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same 
ch-2 space as joining, [*(sc, ch 2, sc) in each 
ch-2 space to next seam between squares, sc 
in corner ch-4 space before seam, ch 3, sc in 
corner ch-4 space following seam; repeat from * 
to last square of edge, (sc, ch 2, sc) in each ch-2 
space of last square of edge, (sc, ch 4, sc) in 
corner ch-4 space] 4 times, (sc, ch 2, sc) in last 
ch-2 space; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2 (right side): (Slip st, ch 1, sc, ch 
2, sc) in first ch-2 space, [*(sc, ch 2, sc) in 
each ch-2 space to ch-3 space at seam, (sc, 
ch 2, sc) in ch-3 space; repeat from * to last 
square of edge, (sc, ch 2, sc) in each ch-2 
space of last square of edge, (sc, ch 4, sc) in 
corner ch-4 space] 4 times, (sc, ch 2, sc) in all 
remaining ch-2 spaces; join with slip st in first 
sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Blanket Coastal Collection (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Main Color (MC) Malachite (10802) 5 balls (1010 yds/924m) for Child; 11 balls (2253 yds/2060 m) for Adult
Contrast A Race Car Red (12001) 1 ball (155 yds/142 m) for Child; 2 balls (253 yds/231 m) for Adult
Contrast B Carrot Orange (12002) 1 ball (112 yds/102 m) for Child; 1 ball (217 yds/198 m) for Adult
Sizes U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) and U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hooks or sizes needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Hdcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Child: Approx 22½" [57 cm] wide x 45" [114.5 cm] long (excluding tail). To fit child ages 4 to 8 years. Adult: Approx 34" [86.5 cm] wide x 65" [165 cm] long (excluding tail).
gauge: 7 hdc and 6 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook. 1 ¾ scales and 3 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Scale Pat with smaller hook.
instructions:
The instructions are written for Child size. If changes are necessary for Adult size the instructions will be written thus ( ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to both sizes. Note: Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc throughout. Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as hdc.

FRONT
With smaller hook and MC, ch 27 (39). See diagram on page 4.
1st row: 2 dc in 6th ch from hook. *Ch 1. Skip next 2 ch. 1 dc in next ch. Ch 1. Skip next 2 ch. 2 dc in next ch. Rep from * to last 3 ch. Ch 1. Skip next 2 ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. Skip first dc. *Working around st lengthwise from bottom to top, (4 hdcbp. 1 dcbp) around next dc. Ch 1. Working around st lengthwise from top to bottom, (1 dcbp. 4 hdcbp) around next dc – 1 scale made. Sl st in next dc. Rep from * to end of row, working final sl st in 4th ch of ch-5. 4 (6) scales. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in same st as last sl st. *Ch 1. 1 dc in center of next scale. Ch 1. 2 dc in next sl st. Rep from * to last scale. Ch 1. 1 dc in center of next scale. Ch 1. 2 dc in beg ch-1. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 scale around first 2 dc. *Sl st in next dc. 1 scale around next 2 dc. Rep from * to end of row. 5 (7) scales. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. Sl st to center of next scale. Ch 4. 2 dc in next sl st. *Ch 1. 1 dc in center of next scale. Ch 1. 2 dc in next sl st. Rep from * to last scale. 1 dc in center of last scale. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. Skip first dc. *1 scale around next 2 dc. Sl st in next dc. Rep from * to end of row, working last sl st in 3rd ch of ch-4. Turn.
7th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first hdc of first scale. *Ch 1. 1 dc in center of next scale. Ch 1. 2 dc in next sl st. Rep from * to last scale. Ch 1. 1 dc in center of last scale. Ch 1. 2 dc in last hdc of last scale. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 scale around first 2 dc. *Sl st in next dc. 1 scale around next 2 dc. Rep from * to end of row. 5 (7) scales. Turn.
9th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first hdc of first scale. *Ch 1. 1 dc in center of next scale. Ch 1. 2 dc in next sl st. Rep from * to last scale. Ch 1. 1 dc in center of last scale. Ch 1. 2 dc in last hdc of last scale. Turn.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 scale around first 2 dc. *Sl st in next dc. 1 scale around next 2 dc. Rep from * to end of row. 6 (8) scales. Turn.
Rep 5th to 10th rows rows for Scale Pat 4 (7) times more. 10 (15) scales.
Work even in Scale Pat: 1st row: Ch 1. Sl st to center of next scale. Ch 4. 2 dc in next sl st. *Ch 1. 1 dc in center of next scale. Ch 1. 2 dc in next sl st. Rep from * to last scale. 1 dc in center of last scale. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. Skip first dc. *1 scale around next 2 dc. Sl st in next dc. Rep from * to end of row, working last sl st in 3rd ch of ch-4. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in same st as last sl st. *Ch 1. 1 dc in center of next scale. Ch 1. 2 dc in next sl st. Rep from * to end of row, working final 2 dc in beg ch-1. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 scale around first 2 dc. *Sl st in next dc. 1 scale around next 2 dc. Rep from * to end of row.
Rep last 4 rows to cont working even in Scale Pat, until work from beg measures approx 45 (65) [114.5 (165) cm]. Fasten off.

BACK
With larger hook and MC, ch 18 (26).
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 16 (24) hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. 2 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in each st to last 2 sts. 2 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in last st. Turn. 18 (26) hdc.
3rd and 4th rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. Rep 2nd to 4th rows 11 (17) times more. 40 (60) hdc.
Next row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures approx 45 (65)" [114.5 (165) cm]. Fasten off.

Small Fins (Adult Size: Make 2 with A and 4 with B; Child Size: Make 4 with B).
With smaller hook, ch 19.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 18 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 16 sc.
Rep 2nd row until 6 sts rem.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in last st. Fasten off. 
Fold in half lengthwise, stuff lightly and work 1 row of sc around 2 open sides. Fasten off.

Large Fins (Adult Size: Make 3 with A and 2 with B; Child Size: Make 3 with A).
With smaller hook, ch 31.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 30 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 28 sc.
Rep 2nd row until 6 sts rem.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in last st. Fasten off. 
Fold in half lengthwise, stuff lightly and work 1 row of sc around 2 open sides. Fasten off.

Tail Fin
With larger hook and A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring. See diagram on page 4.
1st rnd: Ch 5 (counts as dc and ch 2). (3 dc in ring. Ch 2) 3 times. 2 dc in ring. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-5.
2nd rnd: Sl st in next ch-2 sp. Ch 5 (counts as dc and ch 2). 2 dc in same sp. *1 dc in each dc to next ch-2 sp. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * twice more. 1 dc in each dc to next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in same sp as ch-5. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-5. Break A.
Join B with sl st in next ch-2 sp.
3rd rnd: Ch 5 (counts as dc and ch 2). 2 dc in same sp. *1 dc in each dc to next ch-2 sp. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) in ch-2 sp. Rep from * twice more. 1 dc in each dc to next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in same sp as ch-5. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-5.
Rep 3rd rnd once more. Break B. Join A. Rep 3rd rnd twice more. 
Child Size Only: Fasten off.
Adult Size Only: Break A. Join B. Rep 3rd rnd twice more. Break B. Join A. Rep 3rd rnd twice more. Fasten off.
Both sizes: Fold Tail Fin in half diagonally. Join A with sl st to corner along fold. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc evenly around edge, working 3 sc in ch-2 sp.

FINISHING
Sew Fins to Front of Sack as shown in photo. Sew Front and Back tog, leaving top of Sack open. Sew Tail Fin to bottom of Sack.

instructions:
Motif

2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc around joining sc. Work 1 hdc in each hdc around, having (2 hdc. Ch 2. 2 hdc) in each corner ch-2 sp. 1 hdc in first ch-2 sp. Ch 2. Join with sl st to top of first hdc. Fasten off.

instructions:
MOTIF: (make 83). With MC, ch 6. Join with sl st to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 15 dc in ring. Sl st in top of ch-3. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join A with sl st to first dc. Ch 3. 1 dc in same dc. (2 dc in next dc) 15 times. Join with sl st in top of ch-3.
3rd rnd: Ch 6. (Miss 1 dc. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 3) 15 times. Join with sl st into 3rd ch of ch-6.
4th rnd: Sl st into first ch-3 sp. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-3 sp) 3 times. Ch 5. 1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Rep from *3 more times, omitting 1 sc at end of last rep. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
5th rnd: Join MC with sl st in first ch-3 sp. Ch 3. 2 dc in same sp as last sl st. 3 dc into each of next 2 ch-3 sps. 9 dc in next ch-5 sp. (3 dc into each of next 3 ch-3 sps. 9 dc in next ch-5 sp) 3 times. Sl st in top of ch-3. Fasten off.

Tassel: (make 12). Cut a piece of cardboard 4½ ins [11.5 cm] wide. Wind MC around cardboard 25 times. Break yarn, leaving a long end and thread end through a needle. Slip needle through all loops and tie tightly. Remove cardboard and wind yarn tightly around loops 3/4 inch [2 cm] below fold. Fasten securely. Cut through rem loops and trim ends evenly. Attach one tassel to each point at top and bottom of Afghan.

abbreviations: * = Repeat directions following * as many times as indicated

gauge: Motif = 6½” diameter (7¼” along each side). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Triangle 1 (make 52)
With A, ch 4; join with slip st to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work beginning cl in ring, [ch 3, cl in ring] 5 times, ch 3; join with slip st in top of beginning cl—6 cl and 6 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join B with slip st in any ch-3 space, ch 3 (counts as dc); *(3 dc, ch 3, tr, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space, skip next cl**; (dc, ch 1, dc) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * 2 more times, ending last repeat at **; (dc, ch 1) in next ch-3 space; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-3—3 tr, 24 dc, 6 ch-3 spaces and 3 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 3: With right side facing, join A with slip st in any ch-1 space, ch 3 (counts as dc); *dc in next 4 dc, 4 dc in next ch-3 space, ch 5, 4 dc in next ch-3 space, dc in next 4 dc**; dc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * 2 more times, ending last repeat at **; join—51 dc and 3 ch-5 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 4: With right side facing, join B with slip st in any ch-5 space, ch 1, (3 sc, ch 2, 3 sc) in same ch-5 space as joining, sc in next 17 dc; [(3 sc, ch 2, 3 sc) in next ch-5 space, sc in next 17 dc] twice; join with slip st in first sc—69 sc and 3 corner ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Triangle 2 (make 52)
Work same as Triangle 1, except use B for Rounds 1 and 3 and A for Rounds 2 and 4.
Assembly
Join motifs into 8 rows of 13 triangles, alternating Triangles 1 and 2, starting and ending with Triangle 1 in 4 rows and Triangle 2 in other 4 rows as follows: With right sides of 2 adjacent triangles together, working through both thicknesses, join with slip st in back loop of first sc on edge, slip st in back loop of each sc across. Fasten off. Join rows together in same manner, alternating rows and joining points of center triangles where 6 triangles meet with slip st in ch-2 spaces on point of center triangles.
Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join A with slip st in first unjoined sc on first triangle on Row 1 in top right-hand corner, ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, ch 1. Work as follows: Skip every even-numbered sc on long edges of triangles. Work (sc, ch 1) in every odd-numbered sc on long edges of triangles (12 sc and 12 ch-1 spaces along long edge of each triangle); work (sc, ch 1) in corner ch-2 space of center triangle where 3 triangles are joined (along top and bottom edges); work (sc, ch 1) in each corner ch-2 space where 2 triangles are joined (outer corners at 4 corners of afghan and along left and right edges of joined Rows 1 and 2, 3 and 4, 5 and 6, 7 and 8); work (sc, ch 1) in joining of center joined triangles where 4 triangles are joined (inner corners along left and right edges of joined Rows 2 and 3, 4 and 5, 6 and 7); join with slip st in first sc. 
Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * around; ch 1, skip next sc; join. At end of Round 3, fasten off.
Finishing
Weave in all ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 3 skeins each 347 Light Periwinkle A and 5851 Denim B, 2 skeins 3945 Blue Suede C, and 1 skein 726 Coral D
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Throw measures 49” [124.5 cm] wide x 61” [155 cm] long.
gauge: Rows 1-7 of Narrow Section = 2½” [6.5 cm] square; Full Block = 12” [30.5 cm] square.
instructions:
Here’s a throw that is at home in most any room. We show it in a traditional sitting room but it would be just as at home in a casual bedroom or on modern first apartment sofa. There are just twenty blocks in two color combinations to crochet.

Blocks are worked in sections working in rows. Narrow Section is worked from lower edge to top edge. Vertical Stripe is worked along one long edge. Wider Section is worked in rows, joining to Narrow Section along Vertical Stripe every row. Work 20 Blocks; 10 with A and B and 10 with A and C. Rounds 1-3 of Border are worked around each Block. Then Blocks are joined together on Round 4. Throw is made up of 5 rows with 4 Blocks in each row, alternating colors and direction.

PATTERN STITCH
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * to end of row.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc and ch-1 space across.
Repeat Rows 2-3 for pattern st.

THROW
Block (Make 10 with A and B and 10 with A and C)
With B or C, ch 8.
Narrow Section
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * to end of row – 4 sc and 3 ch-1 spaces.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc and ch-1 space across – 7 sc.
Rows 4-7: Repeat Rows 2-3 two more times. At end of Row 7, fasten off.
Row 8 (Right Side): With right side facing, join A with a slip st in first st, ch 1, sc in each sc across – 7 sc.
Rows 9-10: Ch 1, turn, repeat Rows 2-3. Fasten off.
Row 11 (Right Side): With right side facing, join B or C with a slip st in first st, ch 1, sc in each sc across – 7 sc.
Rows 12-31: Repeat Rows 2-3. Fasten off.

Vertical Stripe
Row 1 (Right Side): With right side facing, join A with a slip st in first st of Row 1, working along side edge, sc in edge of same row and each row across – 31 sc.
Rows 2-3: Repeat Rows 2-3 of pattern st. Fasten off.

Wide Section
With right side facing, join B or C with a slip st in first st of Row 3 of Vertical Stripe, ch 25.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 22 ch, (last ch counts as a slip st), slip st in same sc on Vertical Stripe as join – 23 sc.
Row 2: Work Row 2 of pattern st.
Row 3: Work Row 3 of pattern st to last sc, skip next sc of Vertical Stripe, slip st in next sc of Vertical Stripe.

Rows 4-7: Repeat Rows 2-3, joining Wide Section to Vertical Stripe on every right side row. Fasten off.
Row 8 (Right Side): With right side facing, join A with a slip st in first st of last row, ch 1, sc in each sc across, slip st in next sc of Vertical Stripe.
Rows 9-10: Repeat Rows 2-3 of pattern st, joining to Vertical Stripe at end of Row 10. Fasten off.
Row 11 (Right Side): With right side facing, join B or C with a slip st in first st, ch 1, sc in each sc across, slip st in next sc of Vertical Stripe.
Rows 12-31: Repeat Rows 2-3, joining to Vertical Stripe at end of every right side row. Fasten off.

Border
Round 1 (Right Side): With right side facing, join A with a slip st in any corner, ch 1, [sc 32 sts evenly spaced along edge to next corner, ch 2, turn to work along next side edge] 4 times, slip st in first sc to join – 32 sc along each side edge and 4 ch-2 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *[ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next sc] across to last sc before ch-2 space, ch 1, skip next sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc – 18 sc and 17 ch-1 spaces on each side.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc and ch-1 space around, working (sc, ch 2, sc) in each corner ch-2 space – 37 sc on each side.

Following photo, arrange 20 Blocks in 5 rows of 4 Blocks each. Alternate placement of B and C Blocks, keeping Narrow Section on left side on one row and on right side on following row to alternate direction of Blocks.

Blocks of first row will be joined along one side starting at lower right hand corner and working from right to left. Once first row of Blocks have been joined, remaining rows of Blocks will be joined above previous row along one or two sides until all Blocks have been joined together.

First Row
First Block
Round 4 (Right Side): With right side facing, join D in top right corner ch-2 space with a slip st, *[ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] to last sc before corner ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next sc, (slip st, ch 4, slip st) in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * around, slip st in first slip st to join – 19 ch-2 spaces on each side. Fasten off.

Second-Fourth Blocks
One Side Join
Round 4 (Right Side): With right side facing, join D in top right hand corner ch-2 space with a slip st, *[ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] to last sc before corner ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next sc, (slip st, ch 4, slip st) in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * once more, [ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] to last sc before corner ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in corner ch-4 space, ch 2, drop loop from hook and pull through corresponding ch-4 space of previous Block, ch 2, slip st in ch-4 space of working Block, [ch 1, drop loop from hook and pull through corresponding ch-2 space of previous Block, ch 1, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] across to last sc before corner ch-2 space, ch 1, drop loop from hook and pull through corresponding ch-2 space of previous Block, ch 1, skip next sc, slip st in corner ch-4 space, ch 2, drop loop from hook and pull through corresponding ch-4 space of previous Block, ch 2, slip st in ch-4 space of working Block, slip st in first slip st to join. Fasten off.

Second Row
Fifth Block
One Side Join
Round 4 (Right Side): With right side facing, join D in lower right hand corner ch-2 space with a slip st, *[ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] to last sc before corner ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next sc, (slip st, ch 4, slip st) in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * once more, [ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] to last sc before corner ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in corner ch-4 space, ch 2, drop loop from hook and pull through corresponding joined corner space of previous Block, ch 2, slip st in ch-4 space of working Block, [ch 1, drop loop from hook and pull through corresponding ch-2 space of previous Block, ch 1, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] across to last sc before corner ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in corner ch-4 space, ch 2, drop loop from hook and pull through corresponding ch-4 space of previous Block, ch 2, slip st in ch-4 space of working Block, slip st in first slip st to join. Fasten off.

Sixth-Eighth Blocks
Two Side Join
Round 4 (Right Side): With right side facing, join D in top right hand corner ch-2 space with a slip st, [ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] to last sc before corner ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next sc, (slip st, ch 4, slip st) in corner ch-2 space, [ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] to last sc before corner ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next sc, *slip st in corner ch-4 space, ch 2, drop loop from hook and pull through corresponding joined corner space of previous Block, ch 2, slip st in ch-4 space of working Block, [ch 1, drop loop from hook and pull through corresponding ch-2 space of previous Block, ch 1, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] across to last sc before corner ch-2 space, ch 1, drop loop from hook and pull through corresponding ch-2 space of previous Block, ch 1, skip next sc; repeat from * once more, slip st in corner ch-4 space, ch 2, drop loop from hook and pull through corresponding ch-4 space of previous Block, ch 2, slip st in ch-4 space of working Block, slip st in first slip st to join. Fasten off.

Third-Fifth Rows
Work as for Second Row.

Outer Border
Note: Corner spaces on each side of joining seam count as ch-2 spaces.
Round 1 (Right Side): With right side facing, join D in any ch-2 space with a slip st, [ch 2, slip st in next ch-2 space] around, working (ch 2, slip st, ch 2, slip st) in each corner ch-4 space, slip st in first slip st.
Round 2: [Ch 2, slip st in next ch-2 space] around, working (ch 2, slip st, ch 3, slip st) in each corner ch-2 space, slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.
