instructions:
Horizontal Stripes: With A, ch 54.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 53 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in first sc, skip next sc, * 2 dc in next sc, skip next sc; repeat from * to last sc; dc in last sc; turn – 53 sts.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in first dc, * skip next 2 dc, 2 dc in space between skipped dc and next dc; repeat from * to last st; dc in top of ch-3; turn.
Repeat Row 3 for pattern, changing colors every 5 rows: 2 more rows A, then [5 rows each B, C, D, E, A] 3 times.
Last Row: With A, ch 1, sc in first dc, sc in each dc across and in top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Vertical Stripes-Row 1: With right side facing, join E in corner to work across long edge; ch 1, sc in same space, work [ch 1, sc] 80 times evenly across to next corner; turn – 161 sts.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in first sc, [dc in next ch-1 space, 2 dc in next ch-1 space] 40 times, dc in last sc; turn – 123 sts.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in first dc, skip next dc, * 2 dc in space between skipped dc and next dc, skip next dc, dc in next dc, skip next dc; repeat from * to last st; dc in top of ch-3; turn.
Row 4: Ch 3, dc in first dc, * dc in next dc, skip next dc, 2 dc in space between skipped dc and next dc, skip next dc; repeat from * to last st; dc in top of ch-3; turn.
Repeat rows 3 and 4 for pattern changing color every 5 rows: 1 more row E, then 5 rows each D, C, B, and A. Fasten off.
Repeat Vertical Stripes on the opposite side.
BORDER: With right side facing, join D in any corner; ch 3, * dc evenly across to next corner **, 3 dc in corner; repeat from * around, end at **; 2 dc in same st as ch-3; join in top of ch-3. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

instructions:
BLANKET
Square (Make 49) 
Ch 3, slip st in first st to form a ring.

Round 2: Ch 3, [slip st in front loop of next dc, ch 3] around, slip st in back loop in top of beginning ch of Round 1 – 12 loops. 
Round 3: Ch 3, 2 dc in same space on Round 1, 3 dc in back loop of next dc on Round 1, ch 3, skip next st, *[3 dc in back loop of next dc] twice, ch 3, skip next st; repeat from * around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 4 ch-3 spaces.
Round 4: Slip st in next dc, ch 3, dc in next 3 dc, skip next dc, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in ch-3 space, *skip next dc, dc in next 4 dc, skip next dc, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in ch-3 space; repeat from * around; slip st in back loop of beginning ch.
Round 5: Ch 3, *dc in back loop of each dc to ch-3 space, dc in back loop of next ch, (dc, ch 1, dc) in back loop of next ch, dc in back loop of next ch; repeat from * to last ch-3 space, dc in back loop of next 3 dc, slip st in top of beginning ch.

Round 1: With right side facing, join yarn in any st, ch 1, sc in each st around, working 3 sc in each Blanket corner ch-1 space, slip st in first sc.

Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ O’Go™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Fired Clay (42008) 3 O’Gos
Size U.S. M/13 (9 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 6.5 hdc and 4.5 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Notes:
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet. 
• Pull tie to remove and start crocheting!
• For this pattern, colors can be easily separated by gently pulling apart and cutting at the color transition. Each color is ready to use. Follow color guide shown in Materials section for each O’Go (Contrast A, B, C, D, E and F). You may find it helpful to place each color section in its own resealable (zip lock) bag and label each bag – A, B, C, D, E, F.

CROCHET  I  SKILL LEVEL: EASY

Blanket is worked from top right corner to bottom left corner in 9 Sections
• To join new colors work to last 3 loops on hook of previous color. Yoh with new color and proceed.
• When working rows where hdc is worked in sp between prev sts, do not work hdc in sp between last hdc and turning ch 2 at end of row.
• Ch 2 at beg of row counts as hdc throughout.

SECTION 1
With B, ch 19.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook (counts as 2 sts). 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 18 sts.
2nd to 6th rows: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in sp between first 2 hdc. *1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). (Do not work hdc in sp between last hdc and turning ch 2 at end of row). Turn. 18 sts.
Break B at end of 6th row. Join C.

SECTION 2
1st row: (RS). With C, ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between first 2 hdc. *1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 4 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). (Do not work hdc in sp between last hdc and turning ch 2). Working along side of Section 1, work 9 hdc evenly along side edge. Turn. 30 sts.
2nd row: Ch 2. Working in horizontal bar created below st in prev row (see diagram), 1 hdc in each of first 9 hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc) 3 times. 1 hdc in each of last 16 hdc. 1 hdc in top of turning ch 2. Turn. 33 hdc
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between first 2 hdc. (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 18 times. (2 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 3 times. (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 9 times. 1 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). Turn. 36 hdc.
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between first 2 hdc. (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 10 times. (2 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 3 times. (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 20 times. 1 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). Turn. 39 hdc.
5th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between first 2 hdc. (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 21 times. (2 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 3 times. (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 12 times. 1 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). Turn. 42 hdc.
6th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between first 2 hdc. (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 13 times. (2 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 3 times. (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 23 times. 1 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). Break C. Join A. Turn. 45 hdc.

SECTION 3
1st row: (RS). With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between first 2 hdc. (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 24 times. (2 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 3 times. (PM on 4th st of last 6 hdc worked around corner). (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 15 times. 1 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). Turn. 48 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. Working in horizontal bar created below st in prev row (see diagram), 1 hdc in each hdc to marked hdc. 2 hdc in marked hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. (PM on sp between last 4 hdc worked). 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row, ending with 1 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). Turn. 50 hdc.
3rd to 6th rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between first 2 hdc. *1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc.  Rep from * to sp before marked sp. 2 hdc in this sp. 2 hdc in marked sp. (PM on sp between last 2 hdc worked). 2 hdc in next sp. **1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc. Rep from ** to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). Turn. 62 hdc at end of 6th row. Break A. Join D.

SECTION 4
1st row: (RS). With D, ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between first 2 hdc. *1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc. Rep from * to sp before marked sp. 2 hdc in this sp. 2 hdc in marked sp. 2 hdc in next sp. (PM on 4th st of last 6 hdc worked around corner). **1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc. Rep from ** to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. Working in horizontal bar created below st in prev row (see diagram), 1 hdc in each hdc to marked hdc. 2 hdc in marked hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. (PM on sp between last 4 hdc worked). 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. 1 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). Turn.
3rd to 6th rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between first 2 hdc. *1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc. Rep from * to sp before marked sp. 2 hdc in this sp. 2 hdc in marked sp. (PM on sp between last 2 hdc worked). 2 hdc in next sp. **1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc. Rep from ** to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc (top of ch 2). Turn. Break D. Join F.

SECTION 5
With F, work as for Section 4. Break F. Join E.
SECTION 6
With E, work as for Section 4. Break E. Join B.
SECTION 7
With B, work as for Section 4. Break B. Join C.
SECTION 8
With C, work as for Section 4. Break C. Join A.
SECTION 9
With A, work as for Section 4. Break A. Join D.
SECTION 10
With D, work as for Section 4. Fasten off.

Edging: 1st row: (RS). Join D with sl st in bottom right corner. Ch 1. Work sc evenly up side edge of Blanket Work 3 sc in corner. Work sc evenly across top edge of Blanket. Do not turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each to end of row. Fasten off.

Note: Worked over foundation chain (ch) multiple of 2 ch + 2. 
Ch 36.

1 single crochet (sc) in 4th ch from hook (counts as 1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc). 
*Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Repeat (Rep) from * to end of ch. 
Turn. 35 sts (18 sc total).

Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn—23 sc.

Border
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in each st to 
end of row, ch 2; working across ends of rows 
of first side, sc in each row, ch 2; working 
across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in 
each foundation ch, ch 2; working across 
ends of rows on next side, sc in each row, ch 
2; join with slip st in first sc, turn—92 sc and 
4 ch-2 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in first ch-2 
space, sc in each sc to next ch-2 space, *(sc, 
ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space, sc in each sc to 
next ch-2 space; repeat from * twice; join with 
slip st in first sc; change to B, turn—100 sc 
and 4 ch-2 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in each sc to next ch-2 
space, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space] 4 
times; join with slip st in first sc—108 sc and 
4 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off and turn.
Round 4 (wrong side): With wrong side facing, 
join B with slip st in any ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, 
ch 2, sc) in same ch-2 space, *sc in each sc 
to next ch-2 space, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 
space; repeat from * twice; join with slip st in 
first sc—116 sc and 4 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off 
and turn.
Rounds 5-8: Repeat Round 4 four times with 
right side facing on odd numbered rows and 
wrong side facing on even numbered rows—
148 sc and 4 ch-2 spaces at end of Round 8.
Round 9 (right side): With right side facing, 
join B with slip st in any ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, 
ch 2, sc) in same ch-2 space, *sc in next 7 
sc; change to D, sc in next 23 sc; change to 
B, sc in next 7 sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 
space; repeat from * to 2 times, sc in next 7 
sc; change color to D, sc in next 23 sc; change 
color to B, sc in remaining sc; join with slip st 
in first sc—156 sc and 4 ch-2 spaces. Fasten 
off and turn.
Round 10 (wrong side): With right side facing, 
join B with slip st in any ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, 
ch 2, sc) in same ch-2 space, *sc in next 8 
sc; change to D, sc in next 23 sc; change to 
B, sc in next 8 sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 
space; repeat from * to 2 times, sc in next 8 
sc; change color to D, sc in next 23 sc; change 
color to B, sc in remaining sc; join with slip st 
in first sc, turn—164 sc and 4 ch-2 spaces. 
Round 11: Repeat Round 3—172 sc and 4 ch-2 
spaces. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
ASSEMBLY
Arrange squares in 4 rows of 3 squares each 
and whipstitch together. 
Outer Border
With right side facing, join B with slip st to 
ch-2 space at top right corner.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in 
first ch-2 space, sc in each sc and ch-2 space 
to next corner ch-2 space, *(sc, ch 2, sc) in 
next corner ch-2 space, sc in each sc and 
ch-2 space to next ch-2 space; repeat from * 
twice; join with slip st in first sc—630 sc and 
4 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off and turn.
Round 2 (wrong side): With wrong side of 
short end facing, join B with slip st in ch-2 
space at top right corner, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in 
same ch-2 space, *sc in next 11 sts; [change 
to D, sc in next 23 sts; change to B, sc in next 
22 sts] two times; change to D, sc in next 23 
sts; change to B, sc in next 11 sts, (sc, ch 
2, sc) in next ch-2 space; sc in next 11 sts; 
[change to D, sc in next 23 sts; change to B, 
sc in next 22 sts] three times; change to D, sc 
in next 23 sts; change to B, sc in next 11 sts, 
(sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space; repeat from * 
once; join with slip st in first sc—638 sc and 
4 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off and turn.
Round 3 (right side): With right side of short 
end facing, join B with slip st in ch-2 space 
at top right corner, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same 
ch-2 space, *sc in next 12 sts; [change to D, 
sc in next 23 sts; change to B, sc in next 22 
sts] two times; change to D, sc in next 23 sts; 
change to B, sc in next 12 sts, (sc, ch 2, sc) 
in next ch-2 space; sc in next 12 sts; [change 
to D, sc in next 23 sts; change to B, sc in next 
22 sts] three times; change to D, sc in next 
23 sts; change to B, sc in next 12 sts, (sc, ch 
2, sc) in next ch-2 space; repeat from * once; 
join with slip st in first sc—646 sc and 4 ch-2 
spaces. Fasten off and turn.
Round 4: With wrong side facing, join B with 
slip st in any ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) 
in same ch-2 space, sc in each sc, [(sc, ch 2, 
sc) in next ch-2 space, sc in each sc] 3 times; 
join with slip st in first sc—654 sc and 4 ch-2 
spaces. Fasten off and turn.
Rounds 5–9: Repeat Round 4 five times with 
right side facing on odd numbered rows and 
wrong side facing on even numbered rows—
694 sc and 4 ch-2 spaces at end of Round 9. 
Fasten off and turn.
Round 10: Join C with slip st to any st, ch 1, 
reverse sc in each sc and ch-2 space; join 
with slip st in first reverse sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in all ends. Block lightly, if necessary.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 2 skeins 0774 Light Raspberry A

instructions:
HEXAGON #1 (make 9)
Center Circle
With A, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 5 (counts as tr, ch 1), [tr in ring, ch 1] 11 times; join with slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch—12 tr and 12 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 2: With Right Side facing, draw up a loop of B in any ch-1 space, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in same ch-1 space, ch 1, *2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 dc and 12 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 3: With Right Side facing, draw up a loop of A in any ch-1 space, ch 3, dc in same ch-1 space, dc in next dc, ch 1, skip next dc, *2 dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next dc, ch 1, skip next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—36 dc and 12 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 4: With Right Side facing, draw up a loop of C in any ch-1 space, ch 3, dc in same ch-1 space, dc in next 2 dc, ch 1, skip next dc, *2 dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next 2 dc, ch 1, skip next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—48 dc and 12 ch-1 spaces (12 groups of 4 dc each, separated by ch-1 spaces). Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 7 single crochet (sc) and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm]. 8 stitches (sts) and 6 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Moss St Pattern (Pat), including sc and chain (ch) sts.
instructions:
Notes:
• Blanket is worked in 3 separate Panels and joined together in Finishing.
• All 3 Panels use Moss St Panel instructions with different Stripe Pat repeat (rep).
• Chain (ch) 1 at beginning (beg) of row does not count as st.
• To join new color, work to last 2 loops on hook of previous color. Yarn over hook (yoh) with new color, draw through remaining (rem) loops and proceed with new color.
• For Panels 1 and 2, break previous color at color changes. For Panel 3, follow Stripe Pat and carry previous color loosely up side of work where indicated.
MOSS ST PANEL (make 3)
With Color 1, ch 36 tightly. See diagram and Stripe Pat on page 2.
1st row: [Right Side (RS)]. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Turn. 35 sts.

2nd row:  [Wrong Side (WS)]. Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in first ch-1 space (sp). *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.

3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.

First 3 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.
Keeping continuity (cont) of Stripe Pat, rep 2nd and 3rd rows for Moss St Pat until all 90 rows of Stripe Pat are complete. Fasten off.

STRIPE PAT
Panel 1 Stripe Pat
Work 6 rows of Moss St Pat in each color in this order:
C (Color 1), B, A, F, A, E, A, D, A, C, A, B, F, A, E.
These 90 rows complete Panel 1 Stripe Pat.

Panel 2 Stripe Pat
Work 10 rows of Moss St Pat in each color in this order:
B (Color 1), A, F, A, E, A, D, A, C.
These 90 rows complete Panel 2 Stripe Pat.

Panel 3 Stripe Pat
Note: Carry colors up side of work when stripe colors are repeated. Work Moss St Pat in this order:
With C, work 6 rows. Break C. Join F.
With F, work 4 rows. Join C.
With C, work 2 rows. Join F.
With F, work 2 rows. Break F. Join C.
With C, work 2 rows. Break C. Join A.
With A, work 2 rows. Join F.
With F, work 2 rows. Break F. Join A.
With A, work 6 rows. Break A. Join F.
With F, work 4 rows. Join A.
With A, work 2 rows. Break A. Join F.
With F, work 2 rows. Break F. Join E.
With E, work 2 rows. Join B.
With B, work 2 rows. Join E.
With E, work 2 rows. Break E. Join B.
With B, work 6 rows. Break B. Join E.
With E, work 4 rows. Join B.
With B, work 2 rows. Break B. Join E.
With E, work 2 rows. Break E. Join D.
With D, work 2 rows. Join A.
With A, work 2 rows. Break A. Join D.
With D, work 6 rows. Break D. Join A.
With A, work 4 rows. Join D.
With D, work 2 rows. Join A.
With A, work 2 rows. Break A. Join D.
With D, work 2 rows. Break D. Join C.
**With C, work 2 rows. Join B.
With B, work 2 rows. Join C.**
Rep from ** to ** 3 times more. Do not join C at end of last row.
These 90 rows complete Panel 3 Stripe Pat.

FINISHING
Join Panels: Place RS of Panels 1 and 2 together (tog). Beg at bottom edge of Blanket, join A with slip stitch (sl st) through both thicknesses. Taking care to work sts loosely and evenly, work 1 row of sl st through both thicknesses to join Panels.
Rep to join remaining (rem) Panel, noting both joining rows beg at bottom edge of Blanket.

Outer Edging: (RS). Join A with sl st at top right corner of Blanket. Work 1 round (rnd) of sc evenly around outer edge, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Rep from ** to last block. 3 dc in same sp as last sl st. Turn.

Proceed as follows:
Next row: (RS). Skip first 3 dc. Join A with sl st to next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. 3 dc in same sp as sl st. *Skip next 3 dc. Sl st in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. 3 dc in same sp as last sl st. Rep from * to marker on ch-3 sp. Skip next 3 dc. Sl st to next marked ch-3 sp. Skip next 3 dc. Sl st to next ch-3. Ch 3. PM on last ch.  **3 dc in same sp as last sl st. Sl st to next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. First Motif (top left-hand corner motif)

Round 5: Slip st in next dc, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same dc, *ch 1, (sc, ch 4, sc, ch 6, sc, ch 4, sc) in next corner ch-3 space, [ch 1, skip next dc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next dc, ch 1, skip next dc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space] 3 times, ch 1, skip next dc**, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in first sc – 3 ch-6 spaces; 6 ch-4 spaces; 21 ch-2 spaces.
Second and Successive Triangle Motifs: Make and join 65 more motifs same as First Triangle Motif, joining each to previous motif while completing last round as follows. Make and join motifs in numerical order following Assembly Diagram for color section and placement. Join motifs at ch-6, ch-4 and ch-2 spaces but not at ch-1 spaces.
Rounds 1-4: Work same as First Motif.
On Strip 1 (motifs 2 -11), join from top to bottom on 1 side only from corner to corner as follows while completing Round 5: continuing in pattern st for Round 5, join ch-6 spaces as follows: ch 3, drop loop, draw loop under to over through corresponding ch-6 space on adjacent motif, ch 3. Join ch-4 spaces as follows: ch 2, drop loop, draw loop under to over through corresponding ch-4 space on adjacent motif, ch 2. Join ch-2 spaces as follows: ch 1, drop loop, draw loop under to over through corresponding ch-2 space on adjacent motif, ch 1.

Join next motif on 2 sides, joining corners to same motif on the left. Join next motif on 1 side and next motif on 2 sides working as follows where 3 ch-6 corners meet: ch 3, drop loop, draw loop under to over through opposite ch-3 space, ch 2, drop loop, draw loop under to over through opposite corner ch-3 space of next motif to the left, ch 3 and continue joining next side to the same triangle. Border
With right side facing, join F in ch-4 space to the left of top of strip 1.

Round 2: Slip st in next ch-2 space, ch 1, skipping over all sts and working in ch-2 and ch-1 spaces, work (sc, ch 3, sc, ch 1) in each ch-2 space around; at valleys on top and bottom edge, work: (sc, ch 3, sc) in first ch-1 space, skip next (dc, ch 1, dc, ch 1, dc), (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-1 space; at end of round, join with slip st in first sc. Round 7: Draw up loop of A in last ch-1 space of previous 
round, ch 1, sc in each ch-1 space to first corner ch-2 
space, [(sc, ch 2, sc) in corner ch-2 space, sc in next Puff 
, sc in each ch-1 space to next corner ch-2 space] 3 times, 
(sc, ch 2, sc) in last corner ch-2 space, sc in next Puff, sc 
in each ch-1 space to end of round; join with slip st in first 
sc—56 sc and 4 corner ch-2 spaces.
Rounds 8–11: Repeat Round 4 four times—88 sc and 4 
corner ch-2 spaces at the end of Round 11. Drop, but do 
not fasten off A.
Round 12: With C, repeat Round 6—96 Puffs and 4 
corner ch-2 spaces. Fasten off C.
Rounds 13–17: Repeat Rounds 7–11—136 sc and 4 
corner ch-2 spaces at the end of Round 17.
Rounds 18–29: Repeat Rounds 6–17.
Rounds 32–36: Repeat Rounds 6–12; do not fasten off C 
at end of Round 36. Fasten off A.
Round 37: With C, ch 1, sc in each ch-1 space around, 
working 3 sc in each corner ch-2 space; join with slip st in 
first sc. Fasten off C.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

pattern_name: Juicy Fruits and Whipped Crème Throw
materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 4 skeins 1303 Aran A
1 skein each of 1701 Hot Pink B
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: 2 shells = 4” (10cm) in pattern
instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com and www.crochettoday.com
©2013 Coats & Clark
Sweeten up your room with cheerful stripes! Or consider this easy pattern for a super gift throw. Just crochet it in colors that appeal to the recipient.
THROW
With B, ch 152.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, *skip next 2 ch, 5 dc in next ch, skip next 2 ch, sc in next ch; repeat from * across; change to A, turn—Twenty-five 5-dc groups and 26 sc.
Row 2: Ch 2, dc in first sc, ch 1, sc in center st of next 5-dc group, ch 1, *beg cross-st, ch 1, sc in center st of next 5-dc group, ch 1; repeat from across to last sc, 2 dc in last sc, turn—24 cross-sts and 25 sc.
Row 3: Ch 3, 2 dc in first dc, sc in next sc, *5 dc in ch-1 space of next cross-st, sc in next sc; repeat from * across to last 2 dc, skip next dc, 3 dc in top of beginning ch-2, change to C, turn—Twenty-four 5-dc groups, two 3-dc groups, and 25 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first dc, ch 1, skip next 2 dc, cross-st, ch 1, *sc in center st of next 5-dc group, ch 1, cross-st, ch 1; repeat from * across to last sc; change to D in last st of Row 4.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 5 dc in ch-1 space of next cross-st, *sc in next sc, 5 dc in ch-1 space of next cross-st; repeat from * across to last sc, sc in last sc; change to A, turn—Twenty-five 5-dc groups and 26 sc.
Rows 6 and 7: Repeats Row 2 and 3; change to D in last st of Row 7.
Repeat Rows 4-7 changing color in the following sequence: [2 rows each of D, A, B, A, C, A] 8 times, then 2 rows D. Fasten off.
Edging
With right side facing, join A with slip st in first sc to work across st of last row; ch 3, 6 dc in same st as join, *skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc, 6 dc in next sc; repeat from * to last sc, 7 dc in last sc; working down long side and in ends of rows, **sc in space between next 2 B rows, 6 dc in sc of next color row, skip next color row;** repeat from ** to Row 1, 7 dc in the base of the first sc of Row 1; working across opposite side of foundation chs of Row 1, ***sc in loop below next 5-dc group, 6 dc in loop below next sc; repeat from *** to last loop, 7 dc in last loop; working up 2nd long side and in ends of rows, repeat between ** and ** to last row; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.
Special Stitch
Beginning Cross-stitch (beg cross-st) = Dc in space after the sc and before the next 5-dc group one row below, ch 1, dc in space before the same sc and previous 5-dc group.
Cross-stitch (cross-st) = Dc in next ch-space after next sc two rows below, ch 1, dc in ch-space before same sc.
Notes
1. When instructed to work into a stitch or space "2 rows below", work into the row numbered 2 less than the current row. For example, if you are working Row 5, a stitch "2 rows below" is in Row 5 – 2 = Row 3.
2. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color.

Notes:
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull tie to remove.
• Colors can be easily separated by gently pulling apart and cutting at the color transition. Each color is ready to use.
• Designate each color A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H and I as indicated in shade palette.
• To join new color, work to last loops on hook of previous color. Yoh with new color, draw through rem loops and proceed with new color.
• Pattern is worked in multiple motifs that are joined together into 4 Panels during Assembly.
• Panels have sections worked off the sides before being seamed tog in Finishing.
• It may be helpful to place a removable st marker on RS of work to keep track of RS and WS.
• Gauge and Blocking are very important for this project. Please double check your gauge and dimensions for each Motif/Panel as you work to ensure all your pieces will fit tog in Finishing.
• If you achieve gauge, and your Motifs aren’t measuring up, please try going up or down a hook size as necessary to get the correct Motif size. With bulky yarns, going up or down a hook size won’t necessarily affect the number of stitches in your measured gauge, but it can make a tighter or looser fabric with a very similar gauge that can affect the overall size of your finished Motif.

3rd rnd: *Ch 4. 2 sc in next ch-4 sp. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Skip next sc. Rep from * 3 times more.
4th rnd: *Ch 4. 2 sc in next ch-4 sp. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Skip next sc. Rep from * 3 times more.
5th rnd: *Ch 4. 2 sc in next ch-4 sp. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Skip next sc. Rep from * 3 times more.
6th rnd: *Ch 4. 2 sc in next ch-4 sp. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Skip next sc. Rep from * 3 times more.
7th rnd: *Ch 5. 2 sc in next ch-4 sp. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Skip next sc. Rep from * 3 times more.
8th rnd: *Ch 5. 2 sc in next ch-5 sp. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Skip next sc. Rep from * 3 times more.

instructions:
Hexagon (Make 21 each with A and B; and 20 each with C and D).

2nd rnd: (Ch 3. Sl st in next sc) 12 times.

4th rnd: *(1 sc. 1 hdc. 1 dc. 1 tr. Ch 1. 1 tr. 1 dc. 1 hdc. 1 sc) all in next ch-5 sp. Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * 5 times more.
5th rnd: Ch 7. *(1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp between next 2 tr. Ch 3**. Working over sl st of 4th rnd, 1 tr in next ch-1 sp of 3rd rnd. Ch 3. Rep from * ending at **. Join with sl st in 4th ch of ch-7.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *3 sc in next ch-3 sp. 3 sc in next ch-2 sp. 3 sc in next ch-3 sp.** 1 sc in next tr. Rep from * ending at **. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

1st row: A, B, C, D, A, B, C
2nd row: B, C, D, A, B, C, D, A
3rd row: D, A, B, C, D, A, B
4th row: A, B, C, D, A, B, C, D
5th row: C, D, A, B, C, D, A
6th row: D, A, B, C, D, A, B, C
7th row: B, C, D, A, B, C, D

9th row: A, B, C, D, A, B, C
10th row: B, C, D, A, B, C, D, A
11th row: D, A, B, C, D, A, B

Following Assembly diagram, with RS facing each other, whip stitch Hexagons tog through back loops only into alternating rows of 7 and 8 hexagons. Then whip stitch strips tog in order, starting at top with 1st row and ending at bottom with 11th row.

With RS facing, join B with sl st to back loop of any sc. Ch 1. Working through back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around, having 3 sc in center sc of 3-sc groups at outer points and work sc2tog at inner points over last sc of one hexagon and first sc of next hexagon. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Note: Afghan is worked using Tapestry Crochet Techniques. To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Notes:

Sl st in next dc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 hdc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 tr in next dc. Ch 2. 2 tr in next dc. Rep from * twice more. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 hdc in next dc. 1 sc in next dc. Sl st in next dc. Ch 1. Next row: 1 sc in next dc. 1 hdc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 tr in next dc. Ch 2. 2 tr in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 hdc in next dc. 1 sc in next dc. Sl st in next dc. Ch 1. Set-Up: 1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc). *Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Turn. 223 sts (including sc and ch-1 sts).
Proceed in Moss St Pat as follows:
2nd row: Ch 2 (counts as 1 sc. Ch 1). Skip first sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last sc. Turn.
Rep 2nd row twice more, ending on a WS row. Join B. Break A.
With B, rep 2nd row for Moss St Pat for 6" [15 cm], ending on a WS row. Join C. Break B.
Note: When working Stripe Pat, do not cut yarn. Carry color not in use loosely up side of work.
With C, cont in Moss St Pat, AT SAME TIME, proceed in Stripe Pat until work from beg measures approx 52" [132 cm], ending with 4 rows of C. Join B. Break C.
With B, work in Moss St Pat for 6" [15 cm], ending on a WS row. Join A. Break B.
With A, work 4 rows in Moss St Pat.
Fasten off.

Tassels (make 18): Wrap C around a 7" [18 cm] piece of cardboard 30 times. Tie securely at one end. Cut across other end. Wrap C 6 times around tassel 1½" [4 cm] from tied end and fasten securely. Attach Tassel at each corner of Blanket. Attach 7 Tassels evenly spaced across short edges of Blanket.

instructions:
BASIC STRIP
1. Set loom to width indicated in pattern.
2. Wrap yarn around the back of loom, placing yarn end on left side of the loom and working yarn on right side.
3. Bring working yarn to front of loom, crossing over to left side of loom.
4. Bring yarn end to front of loom, crossing over to right side of loom. This should form an “X”.
5. Wrap yarn end around bottom of “X” to the back, around all yarns and then bring back to the front of loom.
6. Tie a knot around “X” using the yarn end and working yarn. Make sure knot is centered. Drop yarn end.
7. Holding working yarn, cross over to right side of loom, wrapping to the back.
8. Insert hook into left loop from the bottom, yoh and draw up a loop.
9. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
10. Keeping working loop on hook, /f_lip hook to back of loom (through the loom and over the top of work).
11. Hold working yarn in left hand and rotate loom, bringing right side to left side. Working yarn will now be wrapped around right side of loom, ready for the next stitch.

BLANKET
Set loom to 4" [10 cm] wide.
Make 20 Basic Strips of 160 loops.
Join Strips tog using Basic Join Technique.
Finish side edges as per Basic Instructions.
Add Fringe to top and bottom of Blanket.
Fringe
Cut 12" [30.5 cm] lengths of yarn. Taking 3 strands tog, knot into fringe evenly across top and bottom of Blanket. Make sure to loop fringe through both working loops along top edge so Blanket will not unravel. Trim ends evenly.
12. Insert hook in upper left loop. Yoh and draw up a loop.
13. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
14. Rep Steps 10-13 required number of times. Mark every 30 loops for easier counting.
15. To /f_inish Strip, break yarn, leaving a long tail and thread through remaining loop on hook.
16. Remove Strip from loom and roll Strip from the top to the bottom, until ready to use.

BASIC JOINING TECHNIQUE
Joining Strips 1 and 2 (starting with a left strip)
1. Lay 2 Strips side by side on a /f_lat surface and unroll slightly.
2. Working with Strip on the left, insert hook through /f_irst 4 loops on right side of Strip.
3. Working with Strip in the right, insert hook through /f_irst 4 loops on left side of Strip and draw through 4 loops on hook.
4. Insert hook through next 4 loops of left Strip and draw through 4 loops on hook.
5. Insert hook through next 4 loops of right Strip and draw through 4 loops on hook.
6. Unrolling Strips as needed, rep Steps 4 and 5 until end of Strip.
7. Using a piece of scrap yarn, secure end temporarily so Strip will not unravel.

Joining Strips 2 and 3 (starting with a right strip)
1. On a /f_lat surface, lay Strip 3 to the right of joined Strips 1 and 2. Unroll slightly.
2. Starting with the Strip on the right (Strip 3), insert hook in /f_irst 4 loops on left side of Strip.
3. Working with Strip on the left (joined Strips 1 and 2), insert hook through /f_irst 4 loops of right side of Strip and draw through 4 loops on hook.
4. Insert hook though next 4 loops on right Strip and draw through 4 loops on hook.
5. Insert hook through next 4 loops on left Strip and draw through 4 loops on hook.
6. Rep Steps 4 and 5 until end of Strip.
7. Using a piece of scrap yarn, secure end temporarily so Strip will not unravel.
Continue joining Strips as established, making sure to alternate starting with a left strip or right strip otherwise work will begin to slant.

FINISHING SIDE EDGES
1. Insert hook into /f_irst 8 loops of Strip.
2. Draw last 4 loops on hook through /f_irst 4 loops on hook.
3. Insert hook into next 4 loops of Strip and draw through 4 loops on hook.
4. Rep Step 3 until end of Strip.
5. Using a piece of scrap yarn, secure end temporarily so Strip will not unravel.
Rep on opposite side edge.

abbreviations: Arm-to-side scwj (single crochet whip stitch join) = Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back in first of 3 centered sts on side adjacent motif. 3 Fdc (foundation double crochet) = Yoh. Insert hook into the “chain” of the previous stitch and pull up a loop. Yoh and draw through one loop on hook (the “chain”). (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
FFdc (first foundation double crochet) = Yoh. Insert hook in next st and pull up a loop. Yoh and draw through one loop on hook (the “chain”). (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.

Side-to-arm scwj (single crochet whip stitch join) = Joining to each stitch of 3-stitch group on arm of adjacent motif. (Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back in indicated st in adjacent motif. Pick up loop on hook and pull through indicated st. 1 sc in next st of current rnd) 3 times.

abbreviations: Beginning Cluster = Yo, insert hook in st, yo and pull up a loop, yo and pull through 2 loops on hook, yo, insert hook in same st, yo and pull up a loop, yo and pull through 2 loops on hook, yo and pull through all 3 loops on hook.

instructions:
Make 30 blocks according to color sequence:
Square 1 (make 5): 1 round A, 1 round C, 2 rounds B, 2 rounds A
Square 2 (make 5): 1 round C, 1 round B, 2 rounds A, 2 rounds C
Square 3 (make 5): 1 round B, 1 round A, 2 rounds C, 2 rounds B
Square 4 (make 5): 1 round A, 1 round B, 2 rounds C, 2 rounds A
Square 5 (make 5): 1 round C, 1 round A, 2 rounds B, 2 rounds C
Square 6 (make 5): 1 round B, 1 round C, 2 rounds A, 2 rounds B

SQUARE
Ch 5, join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 5 (count s as tr, ch 1), (tr in ring, ch 1) 15 times; join with a slip st in fourth ch of starting ch 5 – 16 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join next color with slip st in any ch-1 space, ch 2, beginning cluster in same sp, ch 2, (cluster, ch 2) in each ch-1 space around; join with slip st in beginning cluster – 16 clusters. Fasten off.
Round 3: With right side facing, join next color with slip st in any ch-2 space, ch 3, 3 dc in same sp, *ch 1, sc in next ch-2 space, (ch 2, sc in next ch-2 space) twice, ch 1, (4 dc, ch 2, 4 dc) in next ch-2 space; repeat from * twice more, ch 1, sc in next ch-2 space, (ch 2, sc in next ch-2 space) twice, ch 1, 4 dc in same ch-2 space as first 4 dc of round, ch 1, sc in top of beginning ch 3.
Round 4: Ch 3, 3 dc in space formed by last ch 1 and sc, *skip next ch-1 space, (ch 1, 4 dc in next ch-2 space) twice, ch 1, skip next ch-1 space, (4 dc, ch 3, 4 dc) in next ch-2 corner space; repeat from * twice more, skip next ch-1 space, (ch 1, 4 dc in next ch-2 space) twice, ch 1, skip next ch-1 space, 4 dc in same sp as first 4 dc of round, ch 3, join with slip st to top of beginning ch 3. Fasten off.
Round 5: With right side facing, join next color with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in same space, *(4 dc in next ch-1 space) 3 times, (4 dc, ch 3, 4 dc) in corner ch-3 space; repeat from * twice more, (4 dc in next ch-1 space) 3 times, 4 dc in same ch-3 space as first 4 dc of round, ch 3; join with slip st tbl ONLY of top of beginning ch 3.
Round 6: Ch 1, working tbl ONLY , sc in same loop as joining and next 19 dc, 3 sc in corner ch-3 space, (working tbl ONLY , sc in next 20 dc, 3 sc in corner ch-3 space) 3 times, join with slip st to both loops of first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

ASSEMBLY
With right sides held together and working tbl ONLY , whipstitch squares together with matching colors of yarn into 6 rows of 5 squares each, following diagram for square placement. Whipstitch rows together to form afghan.

BORDER
Round 1: With right side facing and working tbl ONLY , join C with slip st tbl of center sc of any 3 sc corner, ch 3, 2 dc in same st, [dc in each sc and joining to center sc of next corner, 5 dc in corner sc] 3 times, dc in each sc to beginning of round, 2 dc in same st as first 3 dc, join with slip st to both loops of top of beginning ch-3 – 536 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, working in both loops of sts, dc in same st, [dc in each dc to center dc of next corner, 4 dc in corner dc] 3 times, dc in each dc to beginning of rnd, join with slip st to top of beginning ch-3 – 548 dc. Fasten off.
Round 3: With right side facing, join B with slip st tbl ONLY of any dc in round 2, working tbl ONLY , ch 1, sc in same st, and next 2 st, Picot, *sc in next 3 dc, Picot; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

instructions:
BASIC SQUARE (Make 27): With CA, ch 3; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc.
Rnd 2: Ch 1, [sc in sc, (slip st, ch 5, slip st) all in next sc] 4 times; join. Fasten off.
Rnd 3: Attach CB in any sc; ch 3, (2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) all in same sc, [ch 1, skip (slip st, ch-5, and slip st), (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) all in next sc] 3 times, ch 1; join with a slip st in top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Rnd 4: Attach CC in any ch-3 corner space; ch 3, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in same space, * dc in next 2 dc, ch 1, skip next dc, dc over the ch-5 and the ch-1 spaces together, skip next dc, dc in next 2 dc **, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join. Fasten off.
Rnd 5: Attach CB in the dc that was worked over the 2 spaces together; ch 1, [sc in dc, sc in ch-1 space, sc in next 4 dc, 5 sc in corner ch-3 space, sc in next 4 dc, sc in ch-1 space] 4 times; join. Fasten off.
Rnd 6: Attach CA in 3rd sc of corner 5-sc; ch 3, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in same sc, * [skip next sc, 2 dc in next sc] 7 times, skip next sc **, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in next (center corner) sc; repeat from * around, end at **; join. Fasten off.
Sew squares together in three strips of 9 squares.
SIDE PANEL (Worked on one side of 2 strips only):
With right side facing, attach CA at bottom right-hand corner of strip; ch 1, work 21 sc across each square changing to CC in last sc; turn – 189 sc.
Bobble Trim Row (Wrong Side): With CC, ch 4, skip first 2 sc, * MB in next sc, ch 1, skip next sc, dc in next sc **, ch 1, skip next sc; repeat from * across, end at ** and change to CA in last st; turn.
Next Row: With CA, ch 1, sc in each st and space across; turn – 189 sts.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in each sc across changing to CB in last sc; turn.
Work 37 rows sc with CB. Work 2 rows sc with CA.
Work Bobble Trim Row with CC. Work 2 rows sc with CB. Fasten off.
Work cross-stitch embroidery on both Side Panels following Chart. Sew last row of one panel to next strip of squares; repeat. Construction is now complete.
Outer Edging-Rnd 1: With right side facing, attach CA in any dc; ch 1, work sc around entire afghan, working 5 sc in corner ch-3 spaces; join with a slip st in first sc; drop yarn, change to CC; TURN.
Rnd 2: Ch 4, work as for Bobble Trim Row around, working the equivalent of 3 sts in each corner sc; join with a slip st in 3rd ch of ch-4; drop yarn; pick up CA; TURN.
Rnd 3: Ch 1, sc in each st and ch around and work 3 sc in corners; join. Fasten off CA.
Rnd 4-Picot Edging: With smaller hook, pick up CC in sc, * ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, skip next sc, slip st in next 2 sc; repeat from * around. Fasten off.
Trim Bobbles (Make 85): NOTE: Begin and end Trim Bobble with long ends to be used later to sew bobbles on.
With smaller hook and CC, ch 3; MB in 3rd ch from hook. Fasten off. Sew bobbles on places marked on Chart.
Optional Tassel Trim (Make 12): Wind CC around cardboard 25 times. Tie wraps at one edge of cardboard. Cut wraps at opposite edge of cardboard. Tie about 1" down from top. Trim.
Sew tassels on top and bottom edges of Bobble Trim Rows as shown. Sew one button over each tassel where tassel is sewn to afghan.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 5 skeins 718 Shocking Pink A
1 skein each of 706 Perfect Pink B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5.5mm [US I-9] and 5mm [US H-8] (for border Round 8 only)
abbreviations: A, B, and C = Color A, B, and C
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Throw measures 47 x 71” (119.5 x 180.5 cm). One square = 20 x 20” (51 x 51 cm).
gauge: CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge. Rounds 1 and 2 = 4” (10 cm).
instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com

Notes
1. Throw is made from six squares. Each square is worked in joined rounds.
2. Squares are joined together using a "join-as-you-go" technique.
3. To make a smaller throw, use a hook one or two sizes smaller.

FIRST SQUARE
With larger hook and A, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Sc in ring, [ch 10, sc in ring] 7 times; join with ch 3, dtr in first sc (the last ch-3 and dtr count as last ch-10 space)—8 sc and 8 ch-10 spaces. 
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc of beginning shell here and throughout), (dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in ch-10 space formed by the last ch-3 and dtr of previous round (first beginning shell made), *ch 1, Sm-Shell in next ch-10 space; repeat from * around, ch 1; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—8 Sm-Shells and 8 ch-1 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in next dc, beg-Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, ch 4, 3 dc in ch-2 space of next shell, *ch 4, Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 4, 3 dc in ch-2 space of next shell; repeat from * around, ch 4; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—4 Sm-Shells, 8 ch-4 spaces and 4 sets of 3-dc (for lower points of hearts).
Note: After working into the ch-space of a shell, skip the remaining stitches of the shell before working the next part of the instruction.
Round 4: Slip st in next dc, beg-Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, ch 4, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc, *ch 4, Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 4, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 4; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—4 Sm-Shells, 8 ch-4 spaces, and 4 sets of 5-dc (for hearts).
Round 5: Slip st in next dc, beg-Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, ch 4, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc] twice, 2 dc in next dc, *ch 4, Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 4, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next st] twice, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 4; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—4 Sm-Shells, 8 ch-4 spaces, and 4 sets of 8-dc (for hearts).
Round 6: Slip st in next dc, beg-Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, ch 5, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *ch 5, Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 5, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 5; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—4 Sm-Shells, 8 ch-5 spaces and 4 sets of 11-dc (for hearts).
Round 7: Slip st in next dc, beg-Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, ch 5, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *ch 5, Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 5, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 5; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—4 Sm-Shells, 8 ch-5 spaces and 4 sets of 14-dc (for hearts).
Round 8: Slip st in next dc, beg-Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, ch 5, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *ch 5, Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 5, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 5; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—4 Sm-Shells, 8 ch-5 spaces and 4 sets of 18-dc (for hearts).
Round 9: Slip st in next dc, beg-Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, ch 5, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 6 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 6 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *ch 5, Sm-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 5, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 6 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 6 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 5; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—4 Sm-Shells, 8 ch-5 spaces and 4 sets of 22-dc (for hearts).
Round 10: Slip st in next dc, beg-Inc-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, ch 4, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 20 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *ch 4, Inc-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 4, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 20 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 4; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—4 Inc-Shells, 8 ch-4 spaces and 4 sets of 24-dc (for hearts).
Round 11: Slip st in next 2 dc, beg-Lg-Shell in first ch-2 space of first shell, Lg-Shell in 2nd ch-2 space of same shell, ch 3, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 5 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 10 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 5 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *ch 3, Lg-Shell in first ch-2 space of next shell, Lg-Shell in 2nd ch-2 space of same shell, ch 3, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 5 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 10 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 5 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—8 Lg-Shells, 8 ch-3 spaces and 4 sets of 28-dc (for hearts).
Round 12: Slip st in next 2 dc, beg-Lg-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, ch 2, Lg-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 2, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 13 dc, ch 2, dc in next 13 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *ch 2, Lg-Shell in ch -2 space of next shell, ch 2, Lg-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 2, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 13 dc, ch 2, dc in next 13 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 2; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—8 Lg-Shells, 16 ch-2 spaces and 8 sets of 15-dc (for tops of hearts).
Round 13: Slip st in next 2 dc, beg-Lg-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, Lg-Shell in next ch-2 space between shells, Lg-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 2, dc in next 13 dc, ch 4, skip next 2 dc, sc in next ch-2 space, ch 4, skip next 2 dc, dc in next 13 dc, *ch 2, Lg-Shell in ch -2 space of next shell, Lg-Shell in next ch-2 space between shells, Lg-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 2, dc in next 13 dc, ch 4, skip next 2 dc, sc in next ch-2 space, ch 4, skip next 2 dc, dc in next 13 dc; repeat from * around, ch 2; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—12 Lg-Shells and 8 sets of 13-dc (for tops of hearts).
Round 14: Slip st in next 2 dc, beg-Lg-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, [ch 1, Lg-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell] twice, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc2tog (over next 2 dc), hdc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, tr in next dc, 3 tr in next dc, tr in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, hdc in next dc, sc2tog, [ch 4, sc in next ch-4 space] twice, ch 4, sc2tog (over next 2 dc), hdc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, tr in next dc, 3 tr in next dc, tr in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, hdc in next dc, sc2tog, ch 2 **, [Lg-shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 1] twice, Lg-shell in ch-2 space of next shell; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—12 Lg-Shells  and 8 sets of 13-sts (for tops of hearts).
Round 15: Slip st in next 2 dc, beg-Lg-Shell in ch-2 space of first shell, *ch 1, (tr, ch 4, tr) in next ch-1 space between shells, ch 1, Gt-shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 1, (tr, ch 4, tr) in next ch-1 space between shells, ch 1, Lg-Shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 2, skip next sc, tr in next hdc, ch 2, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 2, skip next tr, hdc in next tr, ch 2, skip next (center) tr, hdc in next tr, ch 2, skip next tr, dc in next dc, ch 2, skip next dc, tr in next hdc, [ch 2, dc in next ch-4 space] 3 times, ch 2, skip next sc, tr in next hdc, ch 2, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 2, skip next tr, hdc in next tr, ch 2, skip next (center) tr, hdc in next tr, ch 2, skip next tr, dc in next dc, ch 2, skip next dc, tr in next hdc, ch 2 **, Lg-shell in ch-2 space of next shell; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—8 Lg-Shells and 4 Gt-Shells.
Fasten off.

SECOND SQUARE
Make same as First Square through Round 14. One side of Second Square is now joined to one side of First Square while working Round 15.
Round 15: Work same as Round 15 of First Square to 2nd shell (center Lg-Shell at corner), then work across next edge, joining the ch-8, ch-4, and ch-2 spaces to the corresponding ch-spaces of the First Square, as follows:
Join One Side of Square to Previous Square: Ch 1, (4 tr, ch-8-join, 4 tr) in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 1, (tr, ch-4-join, tr) in next ch-1 space between shells, ch 1, (3 dc, ch-2-join, 3 dc) in ch-2 space of next shell, ch-2-join, skip next sc, tr in next hdc, ch-2-join, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch-2-join, skip next tr, hdc in next tr, ch-2-join, skip next (center) tr, hdc in next tr, ch-2-join, skip next tr, dc in next dc, ch-2-join, skip next dc, tr in next hdc, [ch-2-join, dc in next ch-4 space] 3 times, ch-2-join, skip next sc, tr in next hdc, ch-2-join, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch-2-join, skip next tr, hdc in next tr, ch-2-join, skip next (center) tr, hdc in next tr, ch-2-join, skip next tr, dc in next dc, ch-2-join, skip next dc, tr in next hdc, ch-2-join, (3 dc, ch-2-join, 3 dc) in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 1, (tr, ch-4-join, tr) in next ch-1 space between shells, ch 1, (4 tr, ch-8-join, 4 tr) in ch-2 space of next shell (center corner shell).
Complete Round 15 same as Round 15 of First Square, no longer joining ch-spaces.

THIRD-SIXTH SQUARE
Work same as Second Square, joining side edges to neighboring Squares as needed to form a rectangle with 3 rows of 2 Squares in each row. Note: When joining the ch-8 corners where four Squares meet, work as follows: 4 tr in ch-2 space of corner Lg-Shell, ch 4, working clockwise (counter-clockwise if left-handed) square-join to ch-8 corner space of next Square, ch 1, skip ch-8 corner space of next Square, square-join to ch-8 corner space of next Square, ch 4, 4 tr in ch-2 space of same corner Lg-Shell.
Do not fasten off after joining last Square.

BORDER
Round 1 (right side): Slip st in next 2 dc, (slip st, ch 1, sc) in ch-2 space of first shell, ch 2, dc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, sc in next ch-4 space, ch 2, dc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, skip next 2 tr, dc in next tr, ch 2, skip next tr, (dc, [ch 2, dc] 3 times) in corner ch-8 space, *ch 2, skip next tr, dc in next tr, ch 2, skip next 2 tr, dc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, sc in next ch-4 space, ch 2, dc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, sc in ch-2 space of next shell, [ch 2, dc in next ch-2 space] 16 times, ch 2, sc in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 2, dc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, sc in next ch-4 space, ch 2, dc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, skip next 2 tr, dc in next tr, ch 2, skip next tr **, (dc, ch 2, dc) in corner ch-space, ch 2, skip joining seam, (dc, ch 2, dc) in corner ch-space of next Square; repeat from * to next outer corner ch-8 space ending last repeat at **, (dc, [ch 2, dc] 3 times) in corner ch-8 space, repeat from * 2 more times (until all outer corner ch-8 spaces have been worked into), ch 2, skip next tr, dc in next tr, ch 2, skip next 2 tr, dc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, sc in next ch-4 space, ch 2, dc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, sc in ch-2 space of next shell, [ch 2, dc in next ch-2 space] 16 times, ch 2; join with slip st in first sc—294 ch-2 spaces (87 ch-2 spaces across each long edge, 58 ch-2 spaces across each short edge, and 1 ch-2 space at each of the 4 corners).
Fasten off.
Round 2 (right side): With right side facing and larger hook, draw up a loop of B in any ch-2 space on edge away from corner, ch 1, working in the ch-2 spaces only (skipping the sc and dc sts), work (sc, ch 2, sc) in each ch-2 space around, working (sc, ch 3, sc) in each of the 4 corner ch-2 spaces; join with slip st in first sc—290 ch-2 spaces and 4 corner ch-3 spaces.
Round 3 (wrong side): Slip st in next ch-2 space, ch 5 (counts as first dc, ch 2), turn, dc in next ch-2 space, working in the ch-spaces only, *ch 2, dc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * around, working (dc, [ch 2, dc] 3 times) in each corner ch-3 space; end with ch 2, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—306 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Rounds 4 and 5: With C, repeat Rounds 2 and 3—318 ch-2 spaces. Do not fasten off at the end of Rnd 5.
Round 6: With C, repeat Round 2—314 ch-2 spaces and 4 corner ch-3 spaces.
Fasten off.
Round 7 (right side): With right side facing and larger hook, draw up a loop of A in 7th ch-2 space following any corner ch-3 space, ch 1, sc in same ch-2 space, *Sm-Shell in next ch-2 space, sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * around, working Lg-Shell in each corner ch-3 space; end with join with slip st in first sc.
Do not fasten off.
Change to smaller hook.
Round 8: *Ch 2, (slip st, ch 2, slip st) in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 2, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around working (ch 2, skip next dc, slip st in next dc, ch 2, skip next dc, (slip st, ch 3, slip st) in corner ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next dc, slip st in next dc, ch 2, skip next dc) in sts of each Lg-Shell at corners; end with ch 2 and join with slip st to joining slip st of Round 7.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

gauge: 12 dc and 10 rows = 4 inches square
instructions:
Round 1: Start with a slip knot. Ch 4, join with a sl st in the first ch to form a ring. Ch 3 (counts as dc), 2 dc in the ring, ch 1, *3 dc in the ring, ch 1; repeat from * 3 more times. Join with a sl st to top of ch 3. 

Round 2: Sl st to the next ch-1 space. Ch 3, 2 dc in same ch-1 space, ch 1, *3 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1; repeat from * around. Join with a sl st to top of ch 3.

Round 3: Sl st to next ch-1 space. Ch 3, 2 dc in same ch-1 space, ch 1, *3 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1; repeat from * around. Join with a sl st to top of ch 3.

Continue until your square is the desired size, changing colors as desired. Finish off and weave in ends using yarn needle.

Size U.S. L/11 Susan Bates® Silvalume® (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Use separate sections of yarn for each area of color in the Chart. When joining colors, work to last 2 loops of first color. Pick up new color under previous color on WS to avoid a hole. Draw new color through 2 loops and proceed in new color, leaving previous color on WS.
• When working single color rows (5th to 8th, 13th to 16th, 65th to 68th and 73rd to 76th), break individual yarn sections and work with single section of A.
FRONT
Using separate yarn sections: 
*With MC, ch 3. *With A, ch 3. With MC, ch 4. With A, ch 3.* With MC, ch 38. Rep from * to * once more. With MC, ch 4. (65 ch total). Beg working Chart in sc (see page 2), reading RS rows from right to left and WS rows from left to right and noting that each square represents 1 sc as follows:
1st row: (RS). With appropriate color, 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 64 sc. 
2nd row: With appropriate color, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.

With B, ch 139.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. 1 sc in top of turning ch. Join A. Turn. 137 sc.
3rd row: With A, ch 3 (counts as dc). (2 dc in next sc) 3 times. (Miss next sc. 1 dc in next sc) 5 times. *Miss next sc. (2 dc in next sc) 6 times. (Miss next sc. 1 dc in next sc) 5 times. Rep from * to last 4 sc. Miss next sc. (2 dc in next sc) 3 times. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. 1 sc in top of turning ch. Join B. Turn.

Rep 3rd and 4th rows for Zig-Zag Pat in Stripes as follows:
**2 rows B. 2 rows A. 2 rows C. 2 rows A. 2 rows D. 2 rows A. 2 rows D. 2 rows A. 2 rows C. 2 rows A. 2 rows E. 2 rows A. 2 rows E. 2 rows A. 2 rows D. 2 rows A. 2 rows B. 2 rows A.**

Rep from ** to ** (36 rows) for Stripe Pat once more.
Work 2 rows B. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 8 skeins 661 Frosty Green.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
sFPdc: Yo, insert hook from front to back to front again, around the post of the next sc 2 rows below, yo and pull up a loop, [yo and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice.
FPdc: Yo, insert hook from front to back to front again, around post of indicated st, yo and pull up a loop, [yo and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice.
rsc: Working from left to right, insert hook into next st, yo, pull up loop, yo, draw through both loops on hook.
gauge: 17 sts and 20 rows in pattern = 6”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain gauge.
instructions:
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in next 22 sts.
Row 2: Sc in next 22 sts.
Row 3: [Sc in next sc, sFPdc] twice, sc in next 5 sc, [sFPdc] 4 times, sc in next 5 sc, [sFPdc, sc in next sc] twice.
Row 4: Repeat Row 2.
Row 5: [Sc in next sc, FPdc] twice, sc in next 4 sc, sFPdc, FPdc, sc in next 2 sc, FPdc, sFPdc, sc in next 4 sc, [FPdc, sc in next sc] twice.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2.
Row 7: [Sc in next sc, FPdc] twice, sc in next 3 sc, sFPdc, FPdc, sc in next 4 sc, FPdc, sFPdc, sc in next 3 sc, [FPdc, sc in next sc] twice.
Row 8: Repeat Row 2.
Row 9: [Sc in next sc, FPdc] twice, sc in next 2 sc, sFPdc, FPdc, sc in next 6 sc, FPdc, sFPdc, sc in next 2 sc, [FPdc, sc in next sc] twice.
Row 10: Repeat Row 2.
Row 11: [Sc in next sc, FPdc] twice, sc in next sc, sFPdc, FPdc, sc in next 2 sc, [sFPdc] 4 times, sc in next 2 sc, FPdc, sFPdc, sc in next sc, [FPdc, sc in next sc] twice.
Row 12: Repeat Row 2.
Row 13: [Sc in next sc, FPdc] twice, [sFPdc, FPdc, sc in next 2 sc] twice, FPdc, sFPdc, sc Leave sc behind each post stitch unworked.
Rows 14 and 24: Tr in next sc, sc in next sc, tr in next sc, sc in next 7 sc, tr in next sc, [sc in next sc, tr in next sc] 7 times, sc in next 7 sc, tr in next sc, sc in next sc, tr in next sc.
Row 15 and 25: Repeat Row 1.
Row 39: Repeat Row 1.
Row 40: [Tr in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times, sc in next 11 sc, [sc in next sc, tr in next sc] 6 times.
Continue in pattern established in Row 2, working [Diamond Pattern B Rows 1-40] 4 times, then Rows 1-38 once, ending with Chevron Pattern A Row 14 (Wrong Side Row); turn to work Edging on Right Side.
Edging
Round 1: Ch 1, 3 sc in first st for corner; sc in each st across top, 3 sc in corner, sc evenly down side (work approximately 4 sc per every 5 rows), 3 sc in corner, sc across lower edge, 3 sc in corner, sc evenly up next side; join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, rsc in each sc around entire afghan; join to first st. Fasten off.

Weave in all ends.

abbreviations: A, B, C = Colors A, B, C
gauge: Rounds 1–3 on motif = 3” diameter Full motif = 4.75” diameter between corners; 4.25” diameter between sides; 2.5” on side between corners. CHECK YOUR GAUGE, Use any size hook to obtain your gauge.
instructions:
Hexagon Motif (make 83 total: 20 with B and 21 each with C, D and E in Rounds 2-4)
With A, ch 5; join with sl st to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side) Work 12 sc in ring; join with sl st in first sc—12 sc.
Fasten off.
Round 2 With right side facing, join flower color (B, C, D, or E) with sl st in any sc, ch 4, (counts as first tr), 2 tr in same st as joining, ch 2, sk next st, [3 tr in next st, ch 2, sk next st] 5 times; join with sl st in top of beginning ch-4—18 tr and 6 ch-2 sps.
Round 3 Ch 1, (sl st, ch 1) in next tr, (sl st, ch 1) in each tr and ch around; join with sl st in joining sl st—30 sl sts and 30 ch-1 sps.
Fasten off.
Round 4 With right side facing, working behind Round 2 in skipped sts on Round 1, join flower color (B, C, D, or E) with sl st in any skipped st on Round 1, work beginning Cl, ch 3; *Cl in next skipped st on Round 1, ch 3; repeat from * 4 more times; join with sl st in top of beginning Cl—6 Cl and 6 ch-3 sps.
Fasten off.
Round 5 With right side facing, join A with sl st in any ch-3 sp on Round 4, ch 4 (counts as first tr), (2 tr, ch 3, 3 tr) in same ch-3 sp, sk next Cl; *(3 tr, ch 3, 3 tr) in next ch-3 sp, sk next Cl; repeat from * 4 more times; join with sl st in top of beginning ch-4—36 tr and 6 corner ch-3 sps.
Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
Randomly arrange motifs into 6 strips of 8 motifs and 5 strips of 7 motifs. With right side of motifs together and working through both thicknesses, join A with sl st in back loop of middle ch of corner ch-3 sp, sl st in back loop of each ch and tr across, ending with sl st in middle ch of next corner ch-3 sp. Fasten off. Repeat to join each motif together into strips. Arrange strips alternately with shorter strips between longer strips. With right side of strips together, join strips together in same manner, starting and stopping in middle ch of corner ch-3 sps on strips.
Edging
Round 1 With right side facing, join A with sc in any st, sc in each st, 5 sc in corner ch-3 sps, in corners where 2 hexagon motifs are joined, work (sc in corner ch-sp on first joined motif, sc2tog in middle ch in corner of both joined motifs, sc in corner ch-sp on 2nd joined motif).
Round 2 With right side facing, join D with sl st in any st, ch 1, (sl st, ch 1) in each st around; join with sl st in joining sl st. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in all ends.

THROW
With larger hook and A, ch 200. 
Row 1 (right side): Working in back bumps of ch sts, sc in 2nd ch from hook, [skip next ch, shell in next ch, skip next ch, sc in next ch] twice, *shell in next ch, sc in next ch, skip next ch, shell in next ch, skip next ch, sc in next ch, skip next ch, shell in next ch, skip next 2 ch, sc in next ch, skip next 2 ch, shell in next ch, skip next ch, sc in next ch, skip next ch, shell in next ch, skip next ch, sc in next ch; repeat from * across, ending last repeat at **, skip next ch, sc in last ch; turn.

Arrange squares into 6 horizontal strips of 5 squares each. Alternate squares A and squares B across, for 3 strips beginning and ending with square A, and 3 strips beginning and ending with square B, as shown in assembly diagram.

Join Squares in Horizontal Strips: Hold neighboring squares with Wrong Sides together and work from the Right Side. Match the dc sts and ch-1 spaces of the squares. 18th rnd: Ch 2. (With D, 2 dc. Ch 1. With B, ch 1. 2 dc) all in next st. [With B, 1 dc in each of next 44 sts. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all in next st] twice. 1 dc in each of next 44 sts. (With B, 2 dc. Top Hat
With black yarn, ch 10.
1st row: 1 dc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 8 dc.

4th row: Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of 8 sts across bottom of Hat. Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Join with sl st to last sc on base of Hat. Fasten off. 

Scarf
With green yarn, ch 19.
1st row: 1 dc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 18 dc. Fasten off. 
Join yarn to 11th dc of row just worked. 
Next row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. Turn, leaving rem sts unworked. Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. Fasten off. Add fringe to ends of Scarf as shown in photo. 

Carrot Nose
With orange yarn, ch 5.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in last ch. Fasten off. 

Snowman Head
**With C, beg using magic loop method. 
1st rnd: Ch 2. 10 dc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dc in each st around. Join. 20 dc.
3rd rnd: As 2nd rnd. 40 dc. 
4th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st. Rep from * around. 60 dc.**
Fasten off. 

Snowman Body 
Work from ** to ** as given for Snowman Head. 
Next rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st. Rep from * around. 90 dc.

With 2 strands of A held together, make an adjustable ring.

Round 5: With 1 strand of B and C held together, (ch 3, 2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, ch 1, [2 dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space, ch 1] 3 times, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, slip st in top of ch-3 and next 2 dc – 8 3-dc shells, 28 dc, 4 ch-2 spaces, 8 ch-1 spaces. Cut B.
Round 6: With 2 strands of C, slip st in corner ch-2 space, (ch 3, 2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, [ch 1, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next 7 dc, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space] 3 times, ch 1, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next 7 dc, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, change to 1 strand of A and 1 strand of C, slip st in top of ch-3 and next 2 dc – 8 3-dc shells, 44 dc, 4 ch-2 spaces, 8 ch-1 spaces.
Round 7: With 1 strand of A and C held together, (ch 3, 2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, ch 1, [2 dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next 11 dc, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space, ch 1] 3 times, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next 11 dc, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, slip st in top of ch-3 and next 2 dc – 8 3-dc shells, 60 dc, 4 ch-2 spaces, 8 ch-1 spaces. Round 8: With 2 strands of A, slip st in corner ch-2 space, (ch 3, 2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, ch 1, [2 dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next 15 dc, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space, ch 1] 3 times, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next 15 dc, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, slip st in top of ch-3 – 8 3-dc shells, 76 dc, 4 ch-2 spaces, 8 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
Lay Motifs in three rows with 3 Motifs in each row. Hold Motifs with wrong sides together. Using 1 strand of A and working through back loops only of each st, slip st or sew all Motifs together.

Round 1 (right side): Join 2 strands of C in any corner ch-2 space with a slip st, (ch 3, 2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, [dc in each st or space across to next corner, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in ch-2 space] 3 times, dc in each st or space across to beginning ch-3, slip st in top of beginning ch-3. instructions:
Notes:
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook of previous color. Yoh with new color, draw through loops, and proceed with new color.
• Carry yarn when not in use loosely up side of work unless otherwise stated.
• Each skipped sc has ch sp worked above it for 2 rows (i.e. if you skip 1 sc, you will ch-2 above it). This establishes 'gap' where Mosaic dc will later be worked.
• Mosaic dc always replaces sc directly behind it on working row.
• WS of your work maintains alternating 2-row striped pat as you work in front of ch sps each time you work Mosaic dc – do not work around ch-sps. The ch-sps are positioned behind Mosaic dc.

Stripe Pat
With A work 4 rows. Break A. Join B. 
With B, work 6 rows. Break B. Join A. 
Rep last 10 rows twice more.
These 30 rows form Stripe Pat.

BLANKET
With A, ch 116 (multiple of 10 ch + 6).
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 115 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
First 2 rows of Stripe Pat are complete. 
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep 2nd row until all 30 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.
31st to 34th rows:  With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Break A. Join C. Turn.
Proceed in Mosaic Pat as follows (see chart on page 3):
35th to 38th rows: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Join A. Turn.
39th row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *(Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Turn.
40th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *(Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
41st row: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Mosaic dc in next st 3 rows below (38th row). Skip next ch-2. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Mosaic dc. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. Mosaic dc. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Turn.
42nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. *Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
43rd row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *Mosaic dc in next st 3 rows below (40th row). Skip next ch-2. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. Mosaic dc. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
44th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sts. *Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from* to end of row. Turn.
45th row: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Mosaic dc in next st 3 rows below (42nd row). Skip next ch-2. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. Mosaic dc. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
46th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
47th row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *Mosaic dc in next st 3 rows below (44th row). Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. Mosaic dc. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in next sc. Mosaic dc. Skip next ch-2. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Mosaic dc. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
48th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sts. *Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
49th row: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *Ch 2. Skip next sc. Mosaic dc in next st 3 rows below (46th row). Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Mosaic dc. Skip next ch-2. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. turn.
50th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
51st row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Ch 2. Skip next sc. Mosaic dc in next st 3 rows below (48th row). Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Mosaic dc. Skip next ch-2. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
52nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in in each of first 3 sc. *(Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts) twice. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn. Break A.
53rd row: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *[Mosaic dc in next st 3 rows below (50th row). Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc] twice. Mosaic dc. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
54th to 56th rows:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Join A. Break C.
Rep 1st to 56th rows once, then rep 1st to 34th rows once. Fasten off.
Edging rnd: (RS). Join A with sl st to any corner of Blanket. Ch 1. Work sc evenly around Blanket, working around yarn carried loosely up side of work to enclose it and working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

instructions: BLANKET First Square With B, ch 4, join into a ring with a slip st in first ch. Round 1 (wrong side): Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc—8 sc. Round 8: Ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in first sc, ** *ch 1, skip next 2 sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc*; repeat from * to * across to next corner, ch 1, skip next sc (sc, ch 4, sc) in corner ch-2 space, ch 1, skip next sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc; repeat from ** around; repeat from * to * to beginning of round; join with a slip st in first sc. Round 8: Ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in first sc, *ch 1, skip next 2 sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc*; repeat from * to * across to next corner, ch 1, skip next sc (sc, ch 4, sc) in corner ch-2 space, ch 1, skip next sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc; repeat from * to * across to next corner, ch 1, **(sc, ch-4 join in corner ch-4 space of previous Square, sc) in next ch-3 space, [ch 1, skip next sc, (sc, ch-2 join in corresponding ch-2 space on previous Square, sc) in next sc] across to next corner, ch 1, skip next sc; repeat from ** to ** once, (sc, ch-4 join in corner ch-4 space of previous Square, sc) in next ch-3 space, ch 1, skip next sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc; repeat from * to * to beginning of round; join with a slip st in first sc. Round 2: With right side facing, join E in first sc to the left of any corner lg shell, ch 1, sc in same sc, ** *ch 2, (sc, ch 2, sc) in center dc of next shell, ch 2, sc in next sc*; repeat from * to * across to next corner, ch 2, skip next 2 dc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in each of next 3 dc, ch 2, skip next 2 dc, sc in next sc; repeat from ** around; repeat from * to * across to beginning; join with a slip st in first sc. abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.

instructions:
Ch 120.
See Diagram on page 2.
1st row:  1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
*Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in next ch. 
Rep from * to end of chain. Turn.

2nd row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. *1 sc  in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next st. 
Rep from * to last 2 sts, 1 sc in each of last ch-1 sp and sc. Turn.  
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. Ch 1. 
Skip next st. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp.  
Ch 1. Skip next st. Rep from * to last st. 1 sc in last st. Turn.

These 2 rows form Moss St Pat.
4th to 7th rows:  As 2nd and 3rd rows.
8th row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. *Puff st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last st. 1 sc in last st. Turn.  
9th row: As 3rd row.
10th row: As 8th row.
11th row: As 3rd row.
12th row: As 8th row.
13th row: As 3rd row.
14th to 19th rows: As 2nd and 3rd rows.
20th row: As 8th row. 
21st row: As 3rd row.
Rep 2nd to 21st rows 5 times more, 
ending final rep on 19th row. Do 
not fasten off.  Do not turn. 

Border
1st rnd: Ch 1. *Working along side of Blanket, work in Moss St pat to next corner. 3 sc in corner. Work in Moss St pat across width of Blanket. 3 sc in corner.  Rep from * once more. Join with sl st to first st.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. Work 1 dc in each st and ch-1 sp around, working 3 dc in each corner.  Join with sl st to first st. 
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next st. 1 dcbp around next st. Rep from* around, working 3 sts around corner sts.

Notes:
• When you work corners, you will maintain cont of (1 dcfp. 1 dcbp) st pat while working 3 sts around corner sts. You will work either (1 dcfp. 1 dcbp. 1 dcfp) or (1 dcbp. 1 dcfp. 1 dcbp) around corner sts to keep cont.
• You should work all dcfp from prev rnd as dcfp, and work all dcbp from prev rnd as dcbp.
4th and 5th rnds: As 3rd rnd.
Fasten off and weave in ends.

instructions:
Notes:
• Blanket is made in 7 Panels and seamed tog in Finishing.

PANEL A (make 4)
With A, ch 16.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook (counts as 2 hdc). 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 15 sts.
2nd row: (WS). Ch 2. *Work 1 hdc into horizontal bar created below next st in previous row (bar is below loops normally worked on WS – see diagram). Rep from * to last st. 1 hdc in last st (top of ch 2). Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdcbl in next st. 1 hdcbl in each st to last st. 1 hdc in last st (top of ch 2). Turn.
4th to 10th rows: Rep 2nd and 3rd rows 3 times more, then rep 2nd row once more. Join B. Break A. Turn.
11th row: (RS). With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.
12th row: (WS). Ch 2. *1 dcbp around next st. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
13th row: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
14th to 20th rows: Rep 12th and 13th rows 3 times more, then rep 12th row once more. Join A. Break B. Turn.
21st row: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.
22nd to 30th rows: Rep 2nd to 10th rows.
Rep 11th to 30th rows 3 times more. Fasten oﬀ.
PANEL B (make 3)
With B, ch 16.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook (counts as 2 hdc). 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 15 sts.
2nd to 10th rows: As 12th to 20th rows of Panel A.
11th row: (RS). With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.
12th to 20th rows: As 2nd to 10th rows of Panel A. Join B. Break A.
21st row: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.
22nd to 30th rows: As 12th to 20th rows of Panel A.
Rep 11th to 30th rows 3 times more. Fasten oﬀ.
FINISHING
Seaming: With B, sew Panels tog as shown in Assembly Diagram, aligning edges of alternating colors in a grid pattern.

Round 3: Join E in any corner space, ch 2, dc in same space, *[ch 1, 2 dc in next ch-space] twice, ch 1, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc ) in corner space; repeat from * around, end 2 dc in first corner space, ch 2, slip st in top of beginning ch to join.

Round 1: Working in back loops only, join A in 2nd ch of any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, sc in same loop, [sc in each sc across to next corner, working sc2tog in corner ch-spaces of adjoining Squares and working (sc, ch 2, sc) in each corner space of Throw] around to first corner space, sc, ch 2, slip st to first st to join.

Weave in ends.
