gauge: Crochet Version: 12 dc and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm]; Knit Version: 17 sts and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of rnds counts as dc.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first dc.
Crochet Version
With B, ch 5. Join with sl st to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 2 dc in ring. Ch 3. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Sl st in each of next 2 dc and ch-3 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in same sp as sl st. Ch 1. *(3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) all in next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * around. Join. Fasten off.
3rd rnd: Join C with sl st in any corner ch-3 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in same sp as sl st. Ch 1. *3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) all in next corner ch-3 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * around. Join.
4th rnd: Sl st in each of next 2 dc and ch-3 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in same sp as sl st. Ch 1. *3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * to next corner ch-3 sp. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) all in next corner ch-3 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * around, ending at **. Join.
With C, rep 4th rnd twice more. Fasten off.
***Next rnd: Cont as established, with A work 6 rnds. With B work 4 rnds. With C work 4 rnds. Rep from *** once more. 36 rnds in total. Fasten off.
Knit Version
STRIPS 1 and 4
With A, cast on 33 sts. 1st row: (RS). Knit. 2nd row: P1. * K1. P1. Rep from * to end of row. Rep last 2 rows for pat 22 times more. 46 rows in total. With B, rep last 2 rows 23 times more. With C, rep last 2 rows 23 times more. With A, rep last 2 rows 23 times more. With B, rep last 2 rows 23 times more. Cast off.
STRIPS 2 and 5
Work in pat as given for Strip 1 in the following sequence: B, C, A, B, C.
STRIP 3
Work in pat as given for Strip 1 in the following sequence: C, A, B, C, A.
FINISHING
Arrange strips 1 to 5 with cast-on edges at lower edge and sew together.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein 313 Aran A
2 skeins each 400 Grey Heather B and 319 Cherry Red C
abbreviations: A, B, C, D = color A, B, C, D
*or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: Square = 8” x 8”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Square (Make 36)
Row 1 (Right Side): With larger hook and C, ch 6, dc in 4th, 5th, and 6th ch from hook; turn – 1 motif completed.
Row 2: Ch 6, dc in 4th, 5th, and 6th ch from hook, slip st in top of ch-3 of Row 1, ch 3, 3 dc over same ch-3 of Row 1; turn – 2 motifs completed.
Row 3: Ch 6, dc in 4th, 5th, and 6th ch from hook, [slip st in top of next ch-3, ch 3, 3 dc over same ch-3] twice; turn – 3 motifs.
Row 4: Repeat Row 3 working sts in brackets 3 times – 4 motifs.
Row 5: Repeat Row 3 working sts in brackets 4 times; – 5 motifs. Cut yarn.
Row 6: Join B in last dc made. Repeat Row 3 working sts in brackets 5 times – 6 motifs. Cut yarn.
Row 7: Join D in last dc made. Repeat Row 3 working sts in brackets 6 times – 7 motifs. Cut yarn.
Row 8: Join A in last dc made. Repeat Row 3 working sts in brackets 7 times – 8 motifs. Cut yarn.
Row 9: Join D in last dc made. Repeat Row 3 working sts in brackets 8 times – 9 motifs. Cut yarn.
Begin Decrease Rows
Row 10: At side edge skip last 3 dc made, join A in top of last ch-3; [ch 3, 3 dc over ch-3, slip st in top of next ch-3] 8 times; turn – 8 motifs. Cut yarn.
Row 11: With D repeat Row 10 working sts in brackets 7 times – 7 motifs. Cut yarn.
Row 12: With B repeat Row 10 working sts in brackets 6 times – 6 motifs. Cut yarn.
Row 13: With C repeat Row 10 working sts in brackets 5 times – 5 motifs. Do NOT cut yarn.
Row 14: Slip st in 3 dc and in top of ch-3, [ch 3, 3 dc over same ch-3, slip st in top of next ch-3] 4 times; turn – 4 motifs.
Row 15: Repeat Row 14 working sts in brackets 3 times – 3 motifs.
Row 16: Repeat Row 14 working sts in brackets twice – 2 motifs.
Row 17: Repeat Row 14 working sts in brackets once – 1 motif. Fasten off.
Large Blocks (Make 9)
Using 4 Squares per Large Block, arrange Squares with C triangle of each Square at center. Take care that all Squares are positioned so that stripes match at sides. Using yarn ends, sew squares together between motifs on wrong side of work.
Sew Large Blocks together into a 3 Block x 3 Block unit.
Border
Round 1: With right side facing and larger hook, join B in corner; ch 1, ** (sc, ch 2, sc) in corner, * ch 2, sc between next 2 motifs; repeat from * to corner; ch 2; repeat from ** around; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Slip st in ch-2 corner space, (ch 3, 2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, * 3 dc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * to next corner**, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join in top of ch-3. Cut yarn.
Round 3: Join D in any ch-2 corner space; ch 1, ** (sc, ch 2, sc) in corner, ch 2, * skip 3 dc, sc between next two 3-dc groups, ch 2; repeat from * to corner; repeat from ** around; join.
Round 4: Repeat Round 2.
Round 5: Slip st to corner and repeat Round 3.
Round 6: Slip st to corner and repeat Round 2.
Round 7: Slip st to corner and repeat Round 3.
Round 8: Change to smaller hook; slip st in corner, (ch 3, 2 dc, picot, 3 dc, picot) in corner, * (3 dc, picot) in next ch-2 space; repeat from * to corner; [3 dc, picot] twice in corner; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

1 skein each 321 Gold A, 256 Carrot B, 672 Spring Green C, and 512 Turqua D
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C

gauge: 13 dc = 4” [10 cm]; 7 rows = 4” [10 cm] in double crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With A, ch 5, slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 4 (counts as tr here and throughout), tr in ring, [ch 2, 2 tr in ring] seven times, ch 2, slip st in top of beginning ch-4 to join – 8 2-tr groups and 8 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join B with a slip st in the first tr in any 2-tr group, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 2 dc in next tr, *ch 2, skip ch-2 space, dc in the next tr, 2 dc in next tr; repeat from * 6 times more, ch 2, skip last ch-2 space, slip st in top of the beginning ch-3 to join – 24 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next dc, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next dc; repeat from * 6 times more, ch 2, skip last ch-2 space, slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 40 dc. Fasten off.
Round 4: With right side facing, join C with a slip st in first dc of any 5-dc group, ch 3, dc in next dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next 2 dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc; repeat from * 6 times more, ch 2, skip last ch-2 space, slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 56 dc.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc, tr in next 2 dc, ch 2 for corner space, skip next ch-2 space, tr in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 4 dc, ch 2, *dc in next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc, tr in next 2 dc, ch 2 for corner space, tr in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 4 dc, ch 2; repeat from * 2 more times, slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.
Round 6: With right side facing, join D with a slip st in any corner ch-2 space, ch 3, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same space (corner made) *dc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts, sc in next 4 sts, ch 2, skip ch-2 space, sc in next 4 sts, hdc in next 3 sts, dc in next st**, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next corner ch-2 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 4 ch-3 corner spaces with 20 sts and a ch-2 space on each side.
Round 7: Ch 3, dc in next st, *(2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next corner ch-3 space, dc in next 10 sts, ch 2, skip ch-2 space, dc in next 10 sts; repeat from * 2 more times, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next corner ch-3 space, dc in next 10 sts, ch 2, skip ch-2 space, dc in next 8 sts, slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Round 8: Ch 3, dc in next 3 sts, *(2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next corner ch-3 space, dc in next 12 sts, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next 12 sts; repeat from * 2 more times, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next corner ch-3 space, dc in next 12 sts, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next 8 sts, slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.
Round 9: With right side facing you, join E with a slip st in any ch-3 space, ch 3, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same space, *dc in each dc to ch-2 space, ch 2, skip ch-2 space, dc in each dc to next corner ch-3 space, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in corner ch-3 space; repeat from * to last corner ch-3 space, dc in each dc to ch-2 space, ch 2, skip ch-2 space, dc in each dc to beginning ch-3, slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Rounds 10-12: Ch 3, dc in each dc to next corner ch-3 space, *(2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in corner ch-3 space, dc in each dc to ch-2 space, ch 2, skip ch-2 space, dc in each dc to next corner ch-3 space; repeat from * to beginning ch-3, slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.
Round 13: With A, repeat Round 9.
Rounds 14-15: With B, repeat Rounds 9-10.
Rounds 16-17: With C, repeat Rounds 9-10.
Rounds 18-20: With D, repeat Rounds 9-10.
Round 21: With E, repeat Round 9.
Rounds 22-24: With E, repeat Round 10.
Round 25: With A, repeat Round 9.
Rounds 26-27: With B, repeat Rounds 9-10.
Rounds 28-29: With C, repeat Rounds 9-10.
Round 30: With D, repeat Round 9.
Rounds 31-32: With D, repeat Round 10.
Round 33: With E, repeat Round 9.
Rounds 34-36: With E, repeat Round 10.
Fasten off
BORDER
Round 1: With right side facing, join E with a slip st in any side dc, ch 1, sc in same st, *sc in each st to corner ch-3 space, work 3 sc in corner ch-3 space; repeat from * to last side, sc in each st to first sc, slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join A with a slip st in any sc, ch 1, sc in same st, *sc in each st to center sc of corner 3-sc, work 3 sc in center sc; repeat from * to last side, sc in each st to first sc, slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 3: With B, repeat Round 2.
Round 4: With C, repeat Round 2.
Round 5: With D, repeat Round 2.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver Ombre™: 4 skeins 3987 Cocoa
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Throw measures about 45 x 58" [114.5 x 147.5 cm]
gauge: In pattern, (sc, 5 dc, sc, 5 dc, sc) = 4" [10 cm]; 8 rows = 4" [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
THROW
ch 188.
Row 1: Work 2 dc in 4th ch from hook (3 skipped ch count as first dc), *skip next 3 ch, sc in next ch, skip next 3 ch, 5 dc in next ch; repeat from * to last 8 ch, skip next 3 ch, sc in next ch, skip next 3 ch, 3 dc in last ch—Twenty-two 5-dc groups, 23 sc, and a 3-dc group at beginning and end of row.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first dc, ch 3, dec, *ch 3, sc in next dc, ch 3, dec; repeat from * to beginning ch-3, ch 3, sc in top of beginning ch-3—23 dec, 24 sc, and 46 ch-3 spaces.
Row 3: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), turn, 2 dc in first sc, skip next ch-3 space, sc in top of next dec, *skip next ch-3 space, 5 dc in next sc, skip next ch-3 space, sc in top of next dec; repeat from * to last ch-3 space, skip last ch-3 space, 3 dc in last sc.
Rows 4-109: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 fifty-three times.
Row 110: Repeat Row 2.
Do not fasten off.
Border
Working in ends of rows down side of throw, adjusting stitches as needed to keep work flat; ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in end of Row 110, [2 dc in end of next row, dc in end of next row] to last row, 2 dc in end of last row; working along opposite side of foundation ch, 3 dc in first ch, [2 dc in next ch-3 space, dc in ch opposite next sc, 2 dc in next ch-3 space, dc in ch opposite next 5-dc group] 22 times, 2 dc in next ch-3 space, dc in ch opposite next sc, 2 dc in next ch-3 space, 3 dc in last ch; working in ends of rows along next side of throw, 2 dc in end of first row, [dc in end of next row, 2 dc in end of next row] to last row, 2 dc in end of last row; working across Row 110, 3 dc in first sc (same sc as last dc worked), [2 dc in next ch-3 space, dc in next dec, 2 dc in next ch-3 space, dc in next sc] 22 times, 2 dc in next ch-3 space, dc in next dec, 2 dc in next ch-3 space, 3 dc in last st; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

pattern_name: Square A for Bright Eyes Baby Blanket
materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 1 skein each 1101 Eggshell A, 1701 Hot Pink B, 1201 Daffodil C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: Rounds 1–5 of square = 5” (12.5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SQUARE A (make 13)
With A, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), 15 dc in ring; join with slip st to top of beginning ch—16 dc. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join B with sc in any dc, *ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next dc, ch 3, skip next dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * around omitting last sc; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc, 4 ch-1 spaces, and 4 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 3: With right side facing, join C with dc in first ch-1 space, dc in same space, *ch 1, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-3 space, ch 1, 2 dc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * around omitting last 2 dc; join with slip st in first dc—twelve 2-dc groups, 8 ch-1 spaces, and 4 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 4: With right side facing, join B with sc in last ch-1 space, ch 2, sc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, *3 sc in next ch-2 space (corner made), [ch 2, sc in next ch-1 space] twice, ch 2; repeat from * around ending with 3 sc in last ch-2 space, ch 2; join with slip st in first sc—20 sc and 12 ch-spaces. Fasten off.
Round 5: With right side facing, join A with d.c. in any ch-2 space, d.c. in same space, d.c. evenly around working d.c. in each sc, 3 d.c. in center st of each corner (corner made), and 2 d.c. in each ch-2 space; join with slip st in first d.c.—52 d.c. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein 324 Bright Yellow A
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc
( ) = work all directions in parentheses in the indicated stitch or space
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Throw measures 41” x 41” (104 cm x 104 cm)
gauge: Daisy Motif measures 6" (15 cm) square. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
DAISY MOTIF (Make 36)
With A, ch 4, join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 3 (counts as first ddc now and throughout), work 11 dc into ring; slip st in top of ch-3 to join—12 dc. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join B in any dc, ch 3, dc in the same dc, * 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around; slip st in top of ch-3 to join—24 dc (12 pairs). Fasten off.
Note: For Round 3, work into the spaces between sts, NOT into the sts.
Round 3: Join C in the space between any pair of dc, (ch 3, dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in the same space, * [ch 1, skip 2 dc, 2 dc in next space] twice, ch 1, skip 2 dc,** (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in next space; repeat from * twice, then from * to ** once; slip st in top of ch-3 to join—32 dc and 16 ch-1 spaces.
Round 4: Slip st in the next dc and ch-1 space, (ch 3, 2 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in same ch-1 space, * [skip 2 dc, 3 dc in next ch-1 space] 3 times, skip 2 dc,** (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in ch-1 corner space; repeat from * twice, then from * to ** once; slip st in top of ch-3 to join—60 dc and 4 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 5: Join B in any ch-1 corner space, ch 1 (does not count as a st now and throughout), * 3 hdc in ch-1 space, hdc in next 15 dc; repeat from * around; slip st in first hdc to join—72 hdc. Fasten off.
Round 6: Join C in the second hdc of Round 5 (the corner st), ch 1, * 3 hdc in the corner st, hdc in next 17 hdc; repeat from * around; slip st in first hdc to join—80 hdc. Fasten off and weave in ends.
Joining Motifs
Note: Seams are worked by holding 2 Motifs with Wrong Sides together and inserting the hook through the stitches of both Motifs, then drawing up a loop and completing the new stitch. (It may be helpful to use stitch holders to connect the unworked sides and edges of the Motifs so the strips of Motifs will hold together until all Seams are completed.)
Horizontal Seam (Make 5): Match both upper right corner hdc; join A in corner; ch 1, * sc in corner hdc and next 20 hdc, ending in upper left corner—21 sc. Without breaking yarn, continue joining pairs of Motifs until there is a strip of 2 rows of 6 Motifs each. Fasten off. Add the next Motif by matching a loose Motif to the Motif at the top right of the strip of 12 Motifs (Wrong sides together). Work a Horizontal Seam across these 2 Motifs. Continue working, joining Motifs across the top of the strip of 12 Motifs. When the third horizontal row is completed, there will be a strip of 18 Motifs. Continue joining Motifs in the same way until you have 6 strips of 6 Motifs each. Fasten off.
Vertical Seam (Make 5): Turn partially joined Blanket and work the unjoined Motifs in the same way as the Horizontal Seams, crocheting over the tops of the Horizontal Seams. Fasten off and weave in ends.
BORDER
Round 1 (Right Side): Join A in any corner hdc, ch 1, *3 hdc in the corner st; hdc in each hdc across the side up to the corner, working into the side of the sc from the Seam instead of in the hdc from Round 6 as needed—123 hdc. Repeat from * 3 times; slip st in first hdc to join—492 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in the same hdc, 2 dc in each hdc around; slip st in top of ch-3 to join—984 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; slip st in top of ch-3 to join. Fasten off.
Round 4: With slip knot on hook, join B in the space between any pair of dc, surface slip st around the post of each dc from Round 3 (see Special Stitch above); slip st in first st to join. Fasten off and weave in ends.

Contrast A Birch (10986) 3 balls or 650 yds/600 m

Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at back of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice - 1 dcbp made
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice - 1 dcfp made
FC2dcfp = (Front cross 2 dcfp - worked over next 2 sts). Skip next stitch. 1 dcfp around post of next stitch. Working in front of dcfp just made, 1 dcfp around post of skipped stitch

FC6trfp = (Front cross 6 trfp - worked over next 6 sts). Skip next 3 stitches. 1 trfp around post each of next 3 stitches. Working in front of 3 trfp just made, 1 trfp around post of each of 3 skipped stitches
Popcorn = 4 dc in indicated stitch. Drop loop from hook. Re-insert hook in first dc of 4-dc group. Draw dropped loop through stitch
Trfp = (Yoh) twice and draw up a loop around post of next st at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times - 1 trfp made
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:  
• Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc.
•  To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.
With A, ch 96. (Multiple of 28 ch + 12). See diagram on page 3.
1st row:  (WS). 1 dc 4th ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 94 dc. 
2nd row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 hdc in first dc. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 dc. FC2dcfp over next 2 dc. *1 dcbp around each of next 2 dc. FC2dcfp over next 2 dc. 1 dcbp around next dc. Popcorn in next dc. 1 dcbp around post of next dc. FC2dcfp over next 2 dc. 1 dcbp around post of each of next 2 dc. FC6trfp over next 6 dc. 1 dcbp around post of each of next 2 dc. FC2dcfp over next 2 dc. 1 dcbp around post of next dc. Popcorn in next dc. 1 dcbp around post of next dc. FC2dcfp over next 2 dc, 1 dcbp over next 2 dc. Rep from * twice more. FC2dcfp over next 2 dc. 1 dcbp over next 2 dc. 1 hdc in the top of turning ch. Turn. 94 sts.
**3rd row: Ch 1. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 sts. 1 dcbp around post of each of next 2 sts. *1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 sts. 1 dcbp around post of each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around post of next st. Ch 1. Skip next Popcorn. 1 dcfp around post of next st. 1 dcbp around post of each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 sts. 1 dcbp around post of each of next 6 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 sts. 1 dcbp around post of each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around post of next st. Ch 1. Skip next Popcorn. 1 dcfp around post of next st. 1 dcbp around post of each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. Rep from * twice more. 1 dcbp around post of each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 sts. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 94 sts (including ch-1 sps). 
4th row: Ch 1. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sts. FC2dcfp over next 2 sts. *1 dcbp around each of next 2 dc. FC2dcfp over next 2 dc. 1 dcbp around next dc. Popcorn in next ch-1 sp. 1 dcbp around post of next st. FC2dcfp over next 2 sts. 1 dcbp around post of each of next 2 sts. FC6trfp over next 6 sts. 1 dcbp around post of each of next 2 sts. FC2dcfp over next 2 sts. 1 dcbp around post of next st. Popcorn in next ch-1 sp. 1 dcbp around post of next st. FC2dcfp over next 2 dc, 1 dcbp over next 2 dc. Rep from * twice more. FC2dcfp over next 2 dc. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 dc. 1 hdc in the top of turning ch. Turn. 94 sts.
5th and 6th rows: As 3rd and 4th rows. Join B. Break A.
7th to 12 rows:  With B, rep 3rd and 4th rows 3 times more. Join C. Break B.
13th to 18th rows: With C, rep 3rd and 4th rows 3 times more. Join D. Break C.
19th to 24th rows: With D, rep 3rd and 4th rows 3 times more. Join A. Break D.
**Rep from ** to ** twice more. Do not break D at end of last rep. 
Next row: (WS). With D, ch 1. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Fasten off.

Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 11 sc and 13 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: Worked over a foundation chain of 10 + 9.
Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc. To change colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed with new color.
With MC, ch 79.
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each of next 5 ch. *1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 7 ch. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 6 dc. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Rep from * to last 7 sts. 1 dc in each of last 7 sts. Turn. Break MC. Join A.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. *1 dc in each of next 3 sts. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
4th row: As 3rd row. Break A. Join MC.
5th row: Ch 3. *1 dc in each of next 6 sts. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 7 sts. 1 dc in each of last 7 sts. Turn.

7th row: As 3rd row.
8th row: As 7th row. Break B. Join MC.

Rep 3rd to 10th rows until work from beg measures approx 32" [81.5 cm] ending on a WS row.
Border: 1st rnd: (RS) *With RS facing join MC with sl st to top right corner, 1 sc in each st to end of row. 3 sc in corner. Work 88 sc evenly along side of Blanket. 3 sc in corner. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st.
2nd rnd: Work 1 sc in each st around, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first st.
3rd rnd: As 2nd rnd. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Blanket Brights™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Contrast A Carrot Orange (12002) 4 balls or 818 yds/748 m

abbreviations: Hdc2(4)tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) 2 (4) times. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.

measurements: Approx 50" [127 cm] circumference x 60" [152.5 cm] long excluding Fins and Flame. To fit Child ages 4 to 8 years.
gauge: 7 hdc and 6 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: To join new color, work to last loops on hook of previous color. Yoh with new color, draw through rem loops and proceed with new color.

Rocket
Front and Back (make alike)
Note: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as hdc.
With C, ch 22.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. 20 hdc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Break C. Turn.
3rd row: With A, ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows 11 times more. 44 hdc.

Next 3 rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
Rep last 4 rows twice more. 50 hdc.
Cont even in hdc until work from beg measures approx 45" [114.5 cm], ending on a WS row. Break A.
Dec as follows: Next row: (RS). With C, ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn.
Rep last row 11 times more. 26 hdc.
Next row: (RS). Ch 2. (Hdc2tog) twice. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 4 hdc. (Hdc2tog) twice. Turn.
Next row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Hdc2tog.
Rep last 2 rows twice more. 8 hdc.
Next row: Ch 2. *Hdc2tog. Rep from * to end of row. 4 hdc. Turn.
Next row: Ch 2. Hdc4tog.
Fasten off.
Portholes (make 3 alike)
With D, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sc. Break D.
8th rnd: Join B with sl st to first sc. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 2 dc in next sc. *1 dc in each of next 3 sc. 2 dc in next sc. Rep from * around. 70 dc.
Fasten off.
Fins (make 2 alike)
With C, ch 2.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 3 sc in first sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. 4 sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th to 16th rows: As 3rd and 4th rows 6 times more. 10 sc at end of 16th row. Turn.
17th and 18th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
19th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. 11 sc. Turn.
20th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. 12 sc. Turn.
21st to 26th rows: As 19th and 20th rows twice more. 18 sc. Turn.
27th to 30th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
31st row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
32nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows to 12 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows until 2 sts rem.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
Flame (See diagram on page 3).
With A, ch 19.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 1 tr in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working across opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 1 tr in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of last 3 ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 tr in next tr. 3 tr in next tr. 1 tr in next tr. 1 dc in each of next 2 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. (1 sc. 1 dc. 1 sc) in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Turn. Break A. Join B.

pattern_name: Deck the Halls Crochet Christmas Blanket
materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® Jumbo™ (14 oz/396 g; 744 yds/681 m)
Size U.S. I/9 [5.5 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.  Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Approx 46" x 54" [117 x 137 cm], excluding fringe.
gauge: 12 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Chain (ch) 2 at beginning (beg) of row does not count as stitch (st).
• When changing color, work to last 2 loops on hook of last st. Draw new color through 2 loops, then proceed in new color.
• Carry yarn not in use up the side of work.
Stripe Pattern (Pat)
With A, work 2 rows.
With B, work 2 rows. These 4 rows form Stripe Pat. 
With A, ch 153. See diagram on page 2.
Set-up row: 1 single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 152 sc.
1st row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 dc in first sc. [Double crochet next 2 sts together (dc2tog)] 3 times. 3 dc in each of next 3 sc. *(Dc2tog) 6 times. 3 dc in each of next 3 sc. Repeat (rep) from * to last 7 sts. (Dc2tog) 3 times. 1 dc in last st. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 dc in first st. (Dc2tog) 3 times. 3 dc in each of next 3 sts. *(Dc2tog) 6 times. 3 dc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 7 sts. (Dc2tog) 3 times. 1 dc in last st. Turn.
First 2 rows of Stripe Pat are now in place. Keeping continuity (cont) of Stripe Pat, rep 2nd row until work from beg measures approx 54" [137 cm], ending after 2 rows of A. 
Next row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Fasten off.
Fringe:  Cut lengths of B 16" [40.5 cm] long. Taking 3 strands together (tog), fold in half and knot into fringe across Bottom and Top of Blanket.
Trim fringe evenly.

abbreviations: BPdc = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
FPdc = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.

instructions:
Note: Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc.
Ch 80.
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each st to end of chain.  Turn. 78 sts.
2nd row: Ch 3. *FPdc around each of next 4 sts. BPdc around each of next 4 sts. Rep from * to last st. 1 dc in top of turning ch 3. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. *BPdc around each next 4 sts. FPdc around each of next 4 sts. Rep from * to last st. 1 dc in top of turning ch 3. Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. *BPdc around each of next 4 sts. FPdc around each of next 4 dc. Rep from * to last st. 1 dc in top of turning ch 3. Turn.

Rep 2nd to 5th rows for Basketweave Pat until piece measures 35” [89 cm]. Do not fasten off.
Edging: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st across to last st. 3 hdc in last st (corner). (Work hdc evenly across side to corner. 3 hdc in next corner) 3 times. Work hdc evenly up last side, ending with 2 hdc in base of beginning ch 2. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 7 Skeins 946 Peruvian Print.
Crochet Hook: 10mm [US N-15] Crystalites® or Luxite® hook (requires hook without a wide thumb/finger grip).
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated;
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: Square = 4¼” x 4¼”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SQUARE A (Full Square beginning a diagonal row)-
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 21, pick up a loop in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 21 sts.
Row 1 Return: Yo, draw through first loop, [yo, draw through 2 loops] 8 times, yo, draw through 4 loops – center cluster made, [yo, draw through 2 loops] 9 times – 1 loop on hook.
Row 2: Skip first vertical bar, [TSS] 8 times, insert hook under center vertical bar of cluster and draw up a loop – mark this loop, [TSS] 8 times, TSS working under both vertical bars of final st – 19 sts.
Row 2 Return: Yo, draw through first loop, * yo, draw through 2 loops *; repeat from * to * until 2 loops remain on hook before marked loop, yo, draw through 4 loops; repeat from * to * to end – 1 loop on hook.
Row 3: Skip first vertical bar, * TSS under next vertical bar *; repeat from * to * up to cluster; TSS under marked st – move marker to this new loop; repeat from * to *, working under both vertical bars of final st – 2 fewer sts than previous row pick-up.
Row 3 Return: Repeat Row 2 Return.
Rows 4-9: Repeat Row 3 noting there will be 2 fewer sts on hook at the end of pick up portion of each row.
Row 10: TSS under marked st, TSS under both vertical bars of final st – 3 sts.
Row 10 Return: Yo, draw through all 3 loops – 1 loop on hook. DO NOT FASTEN OFF.
SQUARE B (Half Square used to create a straight edge at the end of a diagonal row)-Row 1 (Right Side): Working in ends of rows, pick up loop in each row of current square – 11 sts.
Row 1 Return: Yo, draw through 2 loops – left cluster made, * yo, draw through 2 loops; repeat from * across – 1 loop on hook.
Row 2: Skip first vertical bar, TSS to cluster; TSS under both vertical bars of final st of cluster – 1 fewer st than previous row pick-up.
Row 2 Return: Repeat Row 1 Return.
Rows 3-9: Repeat Row 2 noting there will be 1 fewer st on hook at the end of pick up portion of each row.
Row 10: TSS under both vertical bars of final st – 2 sts.
Row 10 Return: Yo, draw through both loops. FASTEN OFF.
SQUARE C (Subsequent Full Square)-Row 1 (Right Side): Working in ends of rows, skip final row of current square, pick up a loop in space between current square and adjacent square, working in ends of rows of adjacent square, beginning at Row 1, pick up loop in end of each row – 21 sts.
Row 1 Return-Row 10 Return: Work as for Square A.
SQUARE D (Half Square used to create straight edge at the beginning of a diagonal row)-Row 1 (Right Side): Place slip knot on hook; beginning in Row 1 working in ends of rows, pick up loop in each row of adjacent square – 11 sts.
Row 1 Return: Yo, draw through first loop, * yo, draw through 2 loops; repeat from * until 3 loops remain on hook; yo, draw through 3 loops – right cluster made and 1 loop on hook.
Row 2: Skip cluster, * TSS under next vertical bar; repeat from * across, working under both vertical bars of final st – 1 fewer st than previous row pick-up.
Row 2 Return: Repeat Row 1 return.
Rows 3-9: Repeat Row 2 noting there will be 1 fewer st on hook at the end of pick up portion of each row.
Row 10: TSS under both vertical bars of final st – 2 sts.
Row 10 Return: Yo, draw through both loops – 1 loop on hook. DO NOT FASTEN OFF.
FINISHING-Edging: Working in ends of rows, join yarn with sc in left edge of Row 10 of Square #161; sc in same place, * sc in each of next 8 rows, [draw up a loop in next row] twice, yo and draw through 3 loops, sc in next 8 rows, [2 sc in next row] twice; repeat from * 6 more times; sc in next 8 rows, 2 sc in next row; sc in next 90 rows, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts **, [2 sc in next st] twice; repeat from * to ** working in sts rather than rows on bottom edge; 2 sc in next row; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 13 skeins 0940 Plum Pudding A and 3 skeins 0312 Black B
abbreviations: [ ] = Work directions inside brackets as many times as indicated.
gauge: 13 sc + 15 rows = 4”/10cm. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the specified gauge.
instructions:
AFGHAN
Exterior Panel (make 11)
Starting at center edge with A, ch 13.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each rem ch across – 12 sc. Ch 1, turn.
Rows 2–4: Sc in each st across. Ch 1, turn.
Row 5 Work 2 sc in first st, sc in each st across to last st, 2 sc in last st – 14 sc. Ch 1, turn.
Rows 6–95: Following Exterior Panel Chart for color placement, repeat Rows 2–5 twenty-two times more, then repeat Rows 2 and 3 once more – 58 sc at end of Rows 93–95. Place marker in first and last st on Row 95. Fasten off B. Do not fasten off A.
First Scallop
Row 96 (wrong side): Sc2tog, sc in next 25 sts – 26 sc. Ch 1, turn, leaving rem sts unworked.
Row 97: Sc2tog, sc in each st across to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 24 sc. Ch 1, turn.
Rows 98–103: Repeat Row 2 six times more – 12 sc at end of row 103. At end of Row 103, do not ch 1.
Row 104: Sl st in first st, ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st across to last 3 sts, sc2tog – 8 sc. Ch 1, turn, leaving last st unworked.
Row 105: Repeat Row 104 – 4 sc. At end of row, do not ch 1.
Fasten off.
Second Scallop
Row 96 (wrong side): With wrong side facing, sk next 4 unworked sts on Row 95, join A with sl st in next st, ch 1, sc in same st as joining, sc in each rem st across to last 2 sts; sc2tog – 26 sc. Ch 1, turn.
Rows 97–105: Work same as Rows 97–105 on First Scallop.
Exterior Panel Edging
Note: When working sts with B on Round 1, carry A along edge of panel and work B sts over strand of A, changing back to A in last st of B. Drop and cut B after short section of B has been worked.
Round 1: With right side facing and Row 1 at top, join A with sc in free lp of ch at right-hand corner of center edge of any exterior panel, matching yarn color with center of exterior panel and changing color as necessary, sc in free lp of each foundation ch along center edge, in edge of each row along both side edges and in each st on scallop edge around panel, working 2 sc in each corner of center edge and in each marked corner st on Row 95; join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join B with sl st in first sc, ch 1, sc in same st as joining, sc in each sc around, working 2 sc in each corner; join as before.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, sc in each sc around, working 2 sc in each corner; join. Fasten off.
Interior Panel (make 11)
Starting at center edge with A, ch 5.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each rem ch across – 4 sc. Ch 1, turn.
Rows 2–4: Sc in each st across. Ch 1, turn.
Row 5: Work 2 sc in first st, sc in each st across to last st, 2 sc in last st – 6 sc. Ch 1, turn.
Rows 6–14: Repeat Rows 2–5 two times more, then repeat Row 2 once more – 10 sc at end of Rows 13 and 14.
Interior Panel Edging
Round 1 (right side): Sc in each st and in edge of each row around panel, working 2 sc in each corner; join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
Rounds 2 and 3: Work same as Rounds 2 and 3 on exterior panel edging.
ASSEMBLY
Place two exterior panels with right sides tog. Working through both thicknesses, join B with sl st in back lp of first st at end of long panel edges, sl st in back lp of each st across long panel edge. Fasten off. Repeat on other exterior panels until all panels have been assembled, forming a large exterior ring. Assemble interior panels in same manner as exterior panels, forming an interior ring. Connect exterior and interior rings by placing each face down on a large surface with interior ring in center opening of exterior ring. Working through both thicknesses, join B with sl st in back lp of any st on outer edge of interior ring and inner edge of exterior ring, sl st in back lp of each st around until inner and outer rings are joined, easing to fit where necessary. Join with sl st in first sl st. Turn afghan over.
Inner Circle
Round 1: With right side facing, join B with sl st in bottom right-hand corner of any interior panel edge, ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in next 5 sc along bottom edge of panel; work 6 sc along bottom edge of each panel around – 66 sc. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join A with sl st in first sc, ch 1, starting in same st as joining, [sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 11 times – 55 sc. Join as before.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in each sc around. Join.
Round 4: Ch 1, starting in same st as joining, [sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 11 times – 44 sc. Join.
Round 5: Repeat Round 3.
Round 6: Ch 1, starting in same st as joining, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 11 times – 33 sc. Join.
Round 7: Ch 1, starting in same st as joining, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] 11 times – 22 sc. Join.
Round 8: Ch 1, starting in same st as joining, [sc2tog] 11 times – 11 sc. Join.
Round 9: Ch 1, starting in same st as joining, [sc2tog] 5 times; sc in next sc – 6 sc. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through sts to close hole.
FINISHING
Weave in all ends

materials: RED HEART® “Light & Lofty®”: 8 skeins 9646 Colorado Multi CA; 1 skein each 9380 Antique Blue CB and 9316 Puff CC.
abbreviations: *or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated;
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 13 sts = 4”; 12 rows = 8” in pat. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
AFGHAN: With CA, ch 66.
Row 1 (Right Side): With CA, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 65 sc.
Rows 2 and 4: With CA, ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: With CA ch 1, 2 sc, with CB from skein 1 sc, [with CA 11 sc, with CB 1 sc] 5 times, with CA 2 sc; turn. Cut CB.
Row 5: With CA ch 1, 4 sc, * with new CB bobbin 1 sc, with CA 7 sc, with CB 1 sc, with CA 1 sc, drop CB **, with CA 2 sc, with new CC bobbin 1 sc, with CA 7 sc, with CC 1 sc, with CA 1 sc, drop CC, with CA 2 sc; rep from * to last 3 sc, end at **; with CA 3 sc; turn.
Row 6: With CA ch 1, 4 sc, * 7 sc working over dropped CB strand, drop CB **, with CA 5 sc, 7 sc working over dropped CC strand, drop CC, with CA 5 sc; rep from * to last 6 sc, end at **; 6 sc; turn.
Rows 7 and 11: With CA ch 1, 6 sc, * with CB 1 sc, with CA 3 sc, with CB 1 sc, with CA 1 sc, drop CB **, with CA 6 sc, with CC 1 sc, with CA 3 sc, with CC 1 sc, with CA 1 sc, drop CC, with CA 6 sc; rep from * to last 5 sc, end at **; with CA 5 sc; turn.
Row 8: With CA ch 1, 6 sc, * 3 sc working over dropped CB strand, drop CB **, with CA 9 sc, 3 sc working over dropped CC strand, drop CC, with CA 9 sc; rep from * to last 8 sc, end at **; with CA 8 sc; turn.
Row 9: With CA ch 1, 8 sc, * with CB 1 sc, with CA 1 sc, drop CB **, with CA 10 sc, with CC 1 sc, with CA 1 sc, drop CC, with CA 10 sc; rep from * to last 7 sc, end at **; with CA 7 sc; turn.
Row 10: With CA ch 1, 8 sc, * 3 sc working over dropped CB strand, drop CB **, with CA 9 sc, 3 sc working over dropped CC strand, drop CC, with CA 9 sc; rep from * to last 6 sc, end at **; with CA 6 sc; turn.
Row 12: With CA ch 1, 6 sc, * 7 sc working over dropped CB strand, drop CB **, with CA 5 sc, 7 sc working over dropped CC strand, drop CC, with CA 5 sc; rep from * to last 4 sc, end at **; with CA 4 sc; turn.
Row 13: With CA ch 1, 4 sc, * with CB 1 sc, with CA 7 sc, with CB 1 sc, with CA 1 sc, drop CB **, with CA 2 sc, with CC 1 sc, with CA 7 sc, with CC 1 sc, with CA 1 sc, drop CC, with CA 2 sc; rep from * to last 3 sc, end at **; with CA 3 sc; turn. Cut CB and CC.
Rows 14-16: Rep Rows 2-4.
Rows 17-25: Rep Rows 5-13 EXCEPT change CB to CC and change CC to CB.
Rows 26-88: Rep Rows 2-25 twice, then rep Rows 2-16.
Row 89: Rep Row 2. Fasten off.
BORDER-Rnd 1: With right side facing, attach CC in corner, ch 1, sc evenly around afghan working 3 sc in each corner; join with a sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
Rnd 2: Attach CB in corner; ch 1, sc in each sc around working 3 sc in each corner; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Crushed Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 315 yds/288 m)
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 12 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Ch 142.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to end of ch. Turn. 141 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows until work from beg measures 53" [134.5 cm], ending on a 2nd row. Do not turn. Work 1 sc in corner. Work 157 sc down long edge of Blanket. Work 1 sc in corner. Work 1 sc in each st along bottom. Work 1 sc in corner. Work 157 up long edge of Blanket. Work 1 sc in corner. Work 1 sc in each st along top. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Border: With RS facing, join yarn with sl st 2 sts to left of top right corner st.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. *1 sc in next st. (1 sc. Ch 5. 1 sc) in next st. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Rep from * to next corner st. (1 sc. Ch 5. 1 sc) in corner st. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * around, omitting last 4 sts in final rep. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: **Ch 2. Dc2tog all in next sc. Ch 2. Sl st in next st. *(5 dc. Ch 3. 5 dc) in next ch-5 sp. Skip 3 sc. Sl st in next st. Ch 2. Dc2tog all in next st. Ch 2. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * to 2 sts before corner ch-5 sp. (5 dc. Ch 3. 5 dc) in corner ch-5 sp. Skip next 2 sc. Sl st in next st. Rep from ** around. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 2 skeins 1001 White B
RED HEART® Gumdrop®: 1 ball each 750 Grape A, 625 Apple C, 530 Blueberry D, 620 Cherry E, 501 Smoothie F, and 202 Lemon G
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Blanket measures 36½” wide x 35½” long (92.5 x 90 cm).
gauge: 2 pattern repeats = 3” (7.5 cm) (one pattern repeat consists of 5 double crochet and one single crochet); 8 rows = 3” (7.5 cm).
instructions:
With A, ch 130.
Row 1 (right side): Work 2 dc in 4th ch from hook (beginning ch count as first dc), skip next 2 ch, sc in next ch, *skip next 2 ch, 5 dc in next ch, skip next 2 ch, sc in next ch; repeat from * across to last 3 ch, skip next 2 ch, 3 dc in last ch; turn—106 dc and 21 sc. Fasten off.
Row 2: With wrong side facing, join B with sc in first dc, *ch 1, skip next 2 dc, skip next sc, dc in space between skipped sc and next dc, ch 2, working in front of dc just made, dc in space between 2nd skipped dc and skipped sc, ch 1, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * across working last sc in top of beginning ch, turn—42 dc, 22 sc, 42 ch-1 spaces, and 21 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Row 3: With right side facing, join C with sc in first sc, 5 dc in first ch-2 space, (ch 1, 5 dc) in each ch-2 space across, sc in last sc, turn—105 dc, 2 sc, and 21 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Row 4: With wrong side facing, join B with dc in first sc, dc in same st, ch 1, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc, *ch 1, skip next sc 2 rows below, dc in next ch-1 space 2 rows below, ch 2, working in front of dc just made, dc in ch-1 space before skipped sc 2 rows below, ch 1, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * across to last 3 sts, ch 1, skip last 2 dc, 2 dc in last sc, turn—44 dc, 21 sc, 21 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Row 5: With right side facing, join D with dc in first dc, 2 dc in same st, (ch 1, 5 dc) in each ch-2 space across, ch 1, 3 dc in last dc, turn—106 dc and 21 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Row 6: With wrong side facing, join B with sc in first dc, *ch 1, skip next sc 2 rows below, dc in ch-1 space after skipped sc 2 rows below, ch 2, working in front of dc just made, dc in ch-1 space before skipped sc 2 rows below, ch 1, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * across, turn—42 dc, 22 sc, and 21 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Rows 7–82: Working all even-numbered rows with B, repeat Rows 3–6 nineteen times, changing color in odd-numbered rows in the following color sequence: Work 1 row with E, 1 row with F, [1 row with G, 1 row with A, 1 row with C, 1 row with D, 1 row with E, 1 row with F] 6 times.
Row 83: With G, repeat Row 3.
Row 84: With B, repeat Row 4. Do not fasten off.
Border
Round 1: With right side facing, ch 1, hdc evenly spaced around, working 3 hdc in each corner st or space; join with slip st in first hdc—four 3-hdc groups.
Round 2: Ch 2, camel st in each st around, working 3 camel sts in center st of each 3-hdc group; join with slip st in first camel st—four 3-camel st groups.
Rounds 3–6: Ch 2, camel st in each st around, working 3 camel sts in center st of each 3-camel st group; join with slip st in first camel st.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART ® “Baby Econo®”: 2 skeins 1001 White A

abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: 14 sts and 10 rows = 4” in pattern.
instructions:
SPECIAL ABBREVIATION:
shell = work 5 dc in specified st
SWATCH PATTERN:
Ch 15.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across – 14 sc. Ch 3 (counts as dc on next row now and throughout), turn.
Row 2: Dc in next sc and in each remaining sc across – 14 dc. Ch 1, turn.
Row 3: Sk first dc; *dc in next dc, slip st in next dc; repeat from * across; dc in 3rd ch of turning ch-3 – 7 dc, 6 slip sts and 1 ch. Ch 3, turn.
Row 4: *Dc in next slip st, dc in next dc; repeat from * across; dc in turning ch-1 – 14 dc. Ch 1, turn.
Rows 5-10: Repeat rows 3 and 4 three times more. Swatch should measure 4” x 4”/ 10.2cm x 10.2cm. If necessary, adjust hook size to obtain correct gauge.
BLANKET:
Beginning at bottom edge; with A, ch 80.
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across – 79 sc. Ch 3 (counts as dc on next row now and throughout), turn.
Row 2 (right side): Dc in next sc and in each remaining sc across – 79 dc. Ch 1, turn.
Row 3: Sk first dc, dc in next dc; *slip st in next dc, dc in next dc; repeat from * across; slip st in 3rd ch of turning ch-3 – 39 dc and 40 slip sts. Ch 3, turn.
Row 4: Dc in next dc; *dc in next slip st, dc in next dc; repeat from * across; dc in turning ch-1 – 79 dc. Fasten off A. Turn.
Row 5: Join B with slip st in first dc, dc in next dc; *slip st in next dc, dc in next dc; repeat from * across; slip st in 3rd ch of turning ch-3 – 39 dc and 40 slip sts. Fasten off B. Turn.
Row 6: Join A with slip st in first slip st, ch 3 (counts as dc); *dc in next dc, dc in next slip st; repeat from * across – 79 dc. Fasten off A. Turn.
Row 7: Join C with slip st in first dc, dc in next dc; *slip st in next dc, dc in next dc; repeat from * across; slip st in 3rd ch of turning ch-3 – 39 dc and 40 slip sts. Fasten off B. Turn.
Rows 8: Join A with slip st in first slip st, ch 3 (counts as dc); *dc in next dc, dc in next slip st; repeat from * across – 79 dc. Ch 1, turn.
Row 9: Repeat Row 3.
Row 10: Dc in next dc; *dc in next slip st, dc in next dc; repeat from * across; dc in turning ch-1 – 79 dc. Ch 1, turn.
Rows 11 and 12: Repeat Rows 9 and 10 once. At end of Row 12, fasten off A. Turn.
Rows 13-36: Repeat rows 5-12 three times more.
Row 37: Repeat Row 7.
Row 38: Repeat Row 6.
Row 39: Repeat Row 5.
Rows 40-44: Repeat Rows 8-12.
Rows 45-60: Repeat Rows 37-44 two times more.
Rows 61-66: Repeat Rows 37-42 once.
Row 67: Sc in first dc and in each dc across, sc in 3rd ch of turning ch-3 – 79 sc. Ch 1, turn. Do not fasten off.
EDGING:
Round 1: Work 3 sc in first sc (corner made), sc in next 77 sc across top, 3 sc in last sc (corner made), sc in left edge of Rows 66-2, working 2 sc around post of each dc on even numbered rows and 1 sc in each slip st or ch on odd numbered rows, 3 sc in edge of row 1 (corner made), sc in free loop of next 77 chs across bottom, 3 sc in free loop of last ch (corner made), sc in right edge of rows 2-66, working 2 sc around turning ch-3 spaces of each even numbered row and 1 sc in each slip st on odd numbered rows – 362 sc. Join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off A.
Rnd 2: Join B with slip st in 2nd sc of 3 sc in any corner, ch 3 (counts as dc), 2 dc in same sc as joining; 3 dc in next sc; *2 dc in next sc and in each sc across to next corner**; 3 dc in each of 3 sc in corner; repeat from * 3 times more, ending final repeat at **; 3 dc in first sc of 3 sc in last corner – 736 dc. Join with slip st in first sc.
Rnd 3: Slip st in next dc, ch 1, sc in same dc;* sk next 2 dc, shell in next dc, sk next 2 sc, sc in next dc; repeat from * to next corner; sc in next dc; repeat from * around – 122 shells. Join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off B.
FINISHING:
Weave in all ends.

pattern_name: Corner to Corner Crochet School Bus Blanket
materials: Bernat® Blanket Brights™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Size U.S. K/6½ [6.5 mm] crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 8 hdc and 4 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: Ch 2 at beg of row counts as hdc. When working from chart, wind small balls of the colors to be used, one for each separate area of color in the design. Start new colors at appropriate points. To change color, work to last 3 loops on hook, yoh with new color. Pull through 3 loops on hook to complete st and proceed in new color. 

With A, ch 5. See Chart. 
1st row: (RS) 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. Turn. 1 block made. 
2nd row: Ch 5. 1 hdc in 3 rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch – beg block made. (Sl st. Ch 2. 3 hdc) in next ch-2 sp - block made. Turn. 2 blocks. 
3rd row: Beg block. (Block in next ch-2 sp) twice. Turn. 3 blocks. 
4th row: Beg block. (Block in next ch-2 sp) 3 times. Turn. 4 blocks. 
5th row: Beg block. (Block in next ch-2 sp) 4 times. Turn. 5 blocks. 
6th row: Beg block. (Block in next ch-2 sp) 5 times. Turn. 6 blocks. 
7th row: Beg block. (Block in next ch-2 sp) 6 times. Turn. 7 blocks. 
Keeping cont of color changes in Chart (each square on grid represents 1 block), cont in this manner, increasing 1 block each row until there are 38 blocks. 
Next row: Beg block. *Block in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * to last ch-2 sp. Sl st in last ch-2 sp. (Do not make a block.) Turn. 
Next row: Sl st in each of first 3 hdc. *Block in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last 2 rows 8 times more. 
Begin decreases: Next row: Sl st in each of first 3 hdc. *Block in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * to last ch-2 sp. Sl st in last ch-2 sp. (Do not make a block.) Turn. Keeping cont of Chart, rep last row until 1 block rem. Fasten off. 
FINISHING: With F, embroider words as shown in photo using chain stitch.

instructions:

With B, ch 1. 3 dc in same ch-2 sp. Rep from * to * once more. 3 dc in beg sp. Ch 1. Join with hdc to top of beg ch-3.

Ch 1) in each ch-1 sp to next corner.* 3 dc in next corner. Ch 2. Drop A. With B, ch 1. 3 dc in same corner. Rep from * to * once more. Ch 1. 3 dc in beg sp. Ch 1. Join with hdc to top of beg ch-3.

With A, ch 157.

materials: RED HEART® Soft™: 4 skeins each 9518 Teal A and 1882 Toast C; 3 skeins each 4601 Off White B and 4412 Grass Green D.
abbreviations: A, B, C, D = colors A, B, C, D;
*or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: 13 sts and 16 rows = 4” in pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
Mosaic Pattern (worked on multiple of 6 + 3 sts)
Foundation Row 1 (RS): With A, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn.
Foundation Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Change to B.
Row 1 (RS): Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, *ch 2, skip next sc, sc in next 5 sc; repeat from * across, ending row with sc in next sc, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sts, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next 5 sc; repeat from * across, ending with ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in last 2 sc, turn. Change to A.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, ch 2, skip next sc, *dc in next skipped sc three rows below, ch 2, skip next sc, sc in next 3 sc, ch 2, skip next sc. Repeat from * across, ending with sc in last sc, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next 3 sc, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next dc; repeat from * across, ending with ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in last sc, turn. Change to B.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first sc, working in front of 2 ch-2 spaces, dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below, *ch 2, skip next sc, dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below, sc in next 2 sc, ch 2, skip next sc, dc in next skipped sc three rows below; repeat from * across, ending with sc in last sc, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next 3 sts, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next dc; repeat from * across, ending with sc in last sc, turn. Change to A.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *ch 2, skip next sc, dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below, sc in next 2 sc, ch 2, skip next sc, dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below; repeat from * across, ending with ch 2, skip next sc, sc in last sc, turn.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next dc, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * across, ending with ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in last sc, turn. Change to B.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *dc in next skipped sc three rows below, sc in next 3 sc, dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below, skip next sc; repeat from * across, ending row with dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below, sc in last sc, turn.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next 5 sts; repeat from * across, ending with sc in last sc, turn. Change to A.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc, *dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below, sc in next 5 sc; repeat from * across, ending with dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below, sc in last 2 sc, turn.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. Change to C.
Rows 13-14: Repeat Row 12. After Row 14, change to D.
Rows 15-26: Repeat Rows 1-12, except use D instead of B and use C instead of A. After Row 26, change to A.
Rows 27 and 28: Repeat Row 12. After Row 28, change to B.
Repeat Rows 1-28 for pattern.
THROW
With A, ch 160.
Begin Mosaic Pattern, and work even until piece measures approx 55” from beginning, ending with Row 14 of pattern. Do not fasten off.
BORDER
Rnd 1 (RS): With RS facing and C, ch 1, sc evenly around, working 3 sc in each corner; join with slip st in first sc.
Rnd 2: Ch 1, working from left to right, reverse sc in each st around; join with slip st in first reverse sc.
Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Blanket Brights™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)

Note: To change colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of previous strand draw new color through.
Stripe Pat
With A, work 20 rows.

With A, ch 101.
1st row: (RS). 2 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 3 dc). 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. (Dc3tog) twice. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. *3 dc in each of next 2 ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. (Dc3tog) twice. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Rep from * to last ch. 3 dc in last ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. (Dc3tog) twice. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *3 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. (Dc3tog) twice. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * to last dc. 3 dc in last dc. Turn.

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ O’Go™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Size U.S. M/13 (9 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
5" [12.5 cm] piece of cardboard for tassels.
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
Sc2(3)togtbl = Draw up a loop in back loop only of each of next 2 (3) sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Approx 50 x 59" [127 x 150 cm], excluding tassels.
gauge: 7.5 sts and 6 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Notes:
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull tie to remove.
• For this pattern, colors can be easily separated by gently pulling apart and cutting at the color transition. Each color is ready to use.
• Follow color guide shown in Materials section for each O’Go (Contrast A, B, C, D, E and F). You may find it helpful to place each color section in its own resealable (zip lock) bag and label each bag – A, B, C, D, E, F.
• Blanket is made of 5 Panels, worked on the diagonal.
• Panels are reversible and will alternate to create final pattern when joined.
• To join new colors work to last loops on hook of previous color. Yoh with new color and proceed.

PANEL 1
With B, ch 2.
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 scbl in first sc. 1 scbl in next sc. 2 scbl in last sc. Turn. 5 sts.
3rd to 6th rows: Ch 1. 2 scbl in first sc. 1 scbl in each sc to last sc. 2 scbl in last sc. Join Contrast A. Break B. Turn. 13 sts.
7th to 12th rows: With A, as 3rd row. 25 sts. Join B at end of 12th row. Break A.
13th row: With B, ch 1. 2 scbl in first sc. 1 scbl in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2togtbl. PM on last st. Turn. 25 sts.
14th row: Ch 1. Sc2togtbl. 1 scbl in each sc to last sc. 2 scbl in last sc. 25 sts. Turn.
15th to 18th rows: Rep last 2 rows twice more. Join A at end of 18th row. Break B. Turn.
19th to 24th rows: With A, rep 13th to 18th rows. Join B at end of 24th row. Break A. Turn.
25th to 66th rows: Rep 13th to 24th rows 3 times more, then 13th to 18th rows once.

NOTES
1. Squares are worked in continuous rounds with RS facing throughout. Do not join and do not turn at the end of around. Place a marker to indicate the beginning of the round and move the marker up as work progresses.
2. To change color, sl st in next st and fasten off old color. Join new color in indicated st and work next round as instructed. When working next round, do not work into the sl st, instead work over the sl st and directly into the same st as the sl st.

SQUARE 1 (make 6)

Round 2: [Sc in next hdc, (sc, hdc, sc) in next hdc (corner made)] 4 times—16 sts.

KITTY SQUARE (make 9)

instructions:
This clever throw design is made of crochet granny squares that change colors halfway through each round so that they appear to be two triangles. Follow the diagram to create the modern twirling pattern.

Notes
1. Throw is made from 96 squares sewn together following assembly diagram.
2. Each square is worked in joined and turned rounds. The yarn color is changed halfway through each round so that square appears to be made from two triangles. When changing yarn color, do not fasten off old color. Drop old color and pick it up again when next needed. When old color is needed carefully bring it up to height of current row, yarn over and proceed with old color.
3. To assemble throw, squares are sewn into strips then the strips are sewn together.
4. Squares are sewn together using a special technique. The technique creates an invisible seam and allows the tension of seams to be easily adjusted.
5. A border is worked in rounds all the way around outside edge of assembled throw.

Special Techniques
Adjustable-ring = Wrap yarn into a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring. After the first round of stitches is worked, pull gently on tail to tighten ring.

Needle-join = Invisibly join the last stitch of a round to the beginning chain of the round, as follows:
1. Cut yarn, leaving 4" [10 cm] tail.
2. Yarn over with tail and draw tail through loop on hook to fasten off.
3. Thread the tail onto yarn needle and use it to draw the tail under the top two loops of the beginning chain, then back through the center of the last stitch made.

SQUARE (make 96)
Make 32 squares using B for the second color.
Make 28 squares using C for the second color.
Make 36 squares using D for the second color.
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (wrong side): With A, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 2 dc in ring, ch 2, 3 dc in ring, ch 1; drop A but do not fasten off; yarn over with second color and draw through loop on hook; with second color, ch 1, 3 dc in ring, ch 2, 3 dc in ring; pull gently on tail to tighten ring; join with hdc in top of beginning ch-3 (the joining hdc counts as a final ch-2 space)—12 dc and 4 ch-2 spaces (3 dc along each of 4 sides between ch-2 spaces).
Round 2 (right side): With second color, ch 3, turn, dc in final ch-2 space of Round 1 (the space formed by the joining hdc), dc in next 3 sts, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-2 space (corner made), dc in next 3 sts, 2 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 1; drop second color but do not fasten off; with A, yarn over and draw through loop on hook, ch 1, 2 dc in same ch-2 space (corner made), dc in next 3 sts, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-2 space, dc in next 3 sts, 2 dc in next ch-2 space (the same ch-2 space as first 2 dc of this Round); join with hdc in top of beginning ch-3—28 dc and 4 ch-2 spaces (7 dc along each of 4 sides between corner ch-2 spaces).
Round 3: With A, ch 3, turn, dc in final ch-2 space of previous round, dc in next 7 sts, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-2 space, dc in next 7 sts, 2 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 1; drop second color but do not fasten off; with second color, yarn over and draw through loop on hook, ch 1, 2 dc in same ch-2 space, dc in next 7 sts, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-2 space, dc in next 7 sts, 2 dc in next ch-2 space; join with hdc in top of beginning ch-3—44 dc and 4 ch-2 spaces (11 dc along each of 4 sides between corner ch-2 spaces).
Round 4: With second color, ch 3, turn, dc in final ch-2 space of previous round, dc in next 11 sts, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-2 space, dc in next 11 sts, 2 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 1; drop second color but do not fasten off; with A, yarn over and draw through loop on hook, ch 1, 2 dc in same ch-2 space, dc in next 11 sts, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-2 space, dc in next 11 sts, 2 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 1, Needle-join—60 dc and 4 ch-2 spaces (15 dc along each of 4 sides between corner ch-2 spaces). Note: Designer recommends using a needle-join to join the last round of each square. If preferred, join last round in same manner as previous rounds then fasten off.

FINISHING
Assembly
Notes:
1. When joining square edges of different colors, use yarn with the fewest separate colors (lowest letter indicator). For example, if one edge is color D and the other is color B, use B for sewing the edges together.
2. To sew invisible seams, you will pass the needle under the "cross bar" of stitches. The cross bar is located near the top of the stitch between the front and back loops. Spread the front and back loops, look down from the top of the stitch and you will see the cross bar. The cross bar runs horizontally just below the top loops. Insert the needle from the top of the stitch, between the front and back loops and then under the cross bar.
Arrange squares into 8 strips of 12 squares each following the assembly diagram. You will need to rotate each square so that the colored triangle is in the correct corner, according to assembly diagram.
Sew edges of squares in each strip together invisibly, as follows:
1. Hold two neighboring squares with right sides together.
2. Cut a 12" [30.5 cm] length of yarn of matching color. If the edges are different colors, see note #1 above.
3. Pass needle under cross bar of 2nd chain of corner ch-2 of first square.
4. Pass needle under cross bar of 2nd chain of corner ch-2 of second square.
5. Pass needle under cross bar of first stitch of first square.
6. Pass needle under cross bar of first stitch of second square.
7. Pass needle under cross bar of next stitch of first square.
8. Pass needle under cross bar of next stitch of second square.
9. Repeat steps 7 and 8 all the way across seam, ending after passing needle under cross bar of first chain of corner ch-2 of both squares.
10. Set yarn needle aside. Holding firmly to each end of sewing yarn, pull until the yarn is completely straight. Slide squares along the yarn seam to evenly distribute the stitches and smooth any puckering or stretching along the seam. Weave in ends.
Repeat this process until squares in all 8 strips have been sewn together.
Repeat this process to sew the strips together.

Border
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, join A with a slip st in first dc following any corner ch-2 space; ch 1, beginning in same st as join, sc in each st around, working (sc, ch 2, sc) in each corner ch-2 space; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join B with a slip st in first sc following any corner ch-2 space; ch 1, beginning in same st as join, sc in each st around, working (sc, ch 2, sc) in each corner ch-2 space; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 3: With A, repeat Round 2. Fasten off.
Round 4: With C, repeat Round 2. Fasten off.
Round 5: With A, repeat Round 2. Fasten off.
Round 6: With D, repeat Round 2. Fasten off.

Round 7: With right side facing, join A with slip st in first sc following any corner ch-2 space; ch 3 (counts as dc), beginning in next st, dc in each st around, working (dc, ch 2, dc) in each corner ch-2 space; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Do not fasten off.
Rounds 8 and 9: With A, ch 3, dc in each st around, working (dc, ch 2, dc) in each corner ch-2 space; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Fasten off.
Weave in any remaining ends.

Marquise Motif (make 84 as shown in Color Sequence)
With first color, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as first dc), 11 dc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—12 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as first hdc and ch 1), hdc in next st, [ch 1, hdc in next st] 10 times, ch 1; change to 2nd color; join with slip st in 2nd ch of beginning ch—12 hdc and 12 ch-1 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), dc in same st as join, working in front of first ch-1 space, dc in next st 2 rounds below, [2 dc in next st, working in front of next ch-1 space, d...
notes:
1. Throw is made of 84 marquise motifs worked in joined rounds with right side facing. Marquise motifs are joined into Strips which are arranged as shown in Assembly Diagram and joined together.
2. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Cut old color.
3. When instructed to work into a stitch or space “2 rounds below”, work into the round numbered 2 less than the current round. For example, if you are working Round 3, a stitch “2 rounds below” is in Round 3 – 2 = Round 1.
4. Beginning and ending tails of Strips are gathered into tassels.

materials: RED HEART® Comfort®: 1 ball each 3179 Sage A, 3167 Tan B, 3150 Grey C, and 3130 White D
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Throw measures 45” wide x 55” long (114.5 x 139.5 cm)
instructions:
THROW
With A, ch 114.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—113 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. 
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each st across; change to B, turn. 
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first st, *long-sc in next st 1 row below, long-sc in next st 2 rows below, long-sc in next st 3 rows below, long-sc in next st 4 rows below, long-sc in next st 3 rows below, long-sc in next st 2 rows below, long-sc in next st 1 row below, sc in next st; repeat from * across, turn.
Rows 7–9: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. 
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in each st across; change to C, turn. 
Rows 11–200: Repeat Rows 6–10 thirty-eight times, changing color in the following sequence: Work 5 rows with C, 5 rows with D, *5 rows with A, 5 rows with B, 5 rows with C, 5 rows with D; repeat from * 8 times; change to A at end of last row.
Row 201: Repeat Row 6. Do not turn.
Border
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, working in ends of rows of first side, *skip first row, sc in each row to last row, skip last row*; working in opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch (corner made), sc in each ch across to last ch, 3 sc in last ch (corner made); working in ends of rows of other side, repeat from * to *; working in last row, 3 sc in first st (corner made), sc in each st across to last st, 3 sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc—620 sc and four 3-sc corners. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join B with sc in center st of any 3-sc corner, 2 sc in same st, sc in each st around working 3 sc in center st of each 3-sc corner; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 3: With D, repeat Round 2.
Round 4: With C, repeat Round 2.
FINISHING 
Weave in all ends.

THROW
With A, ch 144.
Row 1 (right side): Dc in 4th ch from hook (3 skipped ch count as first dc), dc in next ch, *skip next 2 ch, dc in next ch, 3 dc in next ch, dc in next ch; repeat from * to last 4 ch, skip next 2 ch, dc in next ch, 2 dc in last ch—141 dc. 
Drop loop of A from hook and place it on the stitch marker.
Row 2 (right side): Do NOT turn piece, with right side still facing, join B with sc in top ch of beginning ch-3 of Row 1, sc in next st, *ch 3, skip next 2 sts, sc in next st, Fphdc around next st, sc in next st; repeat from * to last 4 sts, ch 3, skip next 2 sts, sc in next st, sc in last st and change to A—28 ch-3 spaces.
Drop, but do not cut, B.
Row 3 (wrong side): With A, ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), TURN, 5 dc in each ch-3 space across, dc in last st—142 dc.
Drop loop of A from hook and place it on the stitch marker.
Row 5 (right side): With A, ch 3, TURN, dc in first st, dc in next ch-1 space, 5 dc in each ch-3 space across, dc in last ch-1 space, 2 dc in last st—141 sts.
Drop loop of A from hook and place it on the stitch marker.
Row 6 (right side): Do NOT turn, with right side still facing, change to B, ch 1, sc in top ch of beginning ch-3, sc in next st, *ch 3, skip next 2 sts, sc in next st, Fphdc around next st, sc in next st; repeat from * to last 4 sts, ch 3, skip next 2 sts, sc in next st, sc in last st and change to A—28 ch-3 spaces.
Rows 7–122: Repeat Rows 3-6 twenty-nine times.
Rows 123–125: Repeat Rows 3–5.
Fasten off A and B.

Round 1 (right side): Do NOT turn, with right side still facing, join A with sc in top ch of beginning ch-3 of last row, sc in same ch (first corner made), work 137 sc evenly spaced across to last st, 2 sc in last st (corner made); work 157 sc evenly spaced along side edge; working across opposite side of foundation ch, 2 sc in first ch (corner made), work 137 sc evenly spaced across to last ch, 2 sc in last ch (corner made); work 157 sc evenly spaced along side edge; join with slip st in first sc—596 sc. 
Round 2: Ch 1, *sc in first sc of corner, ch 1, sc in 2nd sc of corner, sc in each st to next 2-sc corner; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—596 sc and 4 corner ch-1 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, (sc, ch 1, sc) in corner ch-1 space, *sc in each sc to next corner ch-1 space, (sc, ch 1, sc) in corner ch-1 space; repeat from * 2 more times, sc in each sc to end of round; join with slip st in first sc—604 sc and 4 corner ch-1 spaces.
Fasten off.

Fasten off.

4th rnd: Ch 1. *3 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 2. 3 sc in next ch-3 sp. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.

5th rnd: Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch 3). *2 sc in next ch-2 sp. Ch 3. Skip next 3 sc. 1 dc in next sc (between two petals). Ch 3. Rep from * around, ending with "Ch 3. Skip next 3 sc." Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 6.
Proceed in Jacob’s Ladder pat as follows:
6th rnd: Ch 1. 4 sc in next ch-3 sp. Skip next 2 sc. 4 sc in next ch-3 sp. *(2 sc. 1 hdc. 1 dc) in next ch-3 sp. 2 dc in next sc. Ch 10. Sl st in first ch to form loop. 2 dc in next sc – corner made. Skip next ch-10 sp. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around, ending with "Ch 10." Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Break B.

Create Jacob’s Ladder by chaining loops as follows:
Pick up ch-10 loop from 7th rnd and pull through ch-10 loop of 6th rnd.
Pick up ch-10 loop from 8th rnd and pull through ch-10 loop of 7th rnd.
Pick up ch-10 loop from 9th rnd and pull through ch-10 loop of 8th rnd.

Joining 2 Motifs

2nd rnd: Sl st in next sc (center sc of corner). Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc) in same st as last sl st. *(Ch 3. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 8 times. 1 sc in next sc.* (Ch 1. 2nd rnd: Sl st in next sc (center sc of corner). Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc) in same st as last sl st. *(Ch 3. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 8 times. 1 sc in next sc.* (Ch 1. Sl st to ch-3 sp of first adjoining motif. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 8 times. 1 sc in next sc. (Ch 1. Sl st to ch-3 sp of second adjoining motif. Ch 1. Loop-st RS = Wrap yarn around thumb 3 times and hold at front of work, insert hook into indicated stitch and between yarn wraps and your thumb, remove your thumb from wraps and draw wraps through stitch (leaving part of each wrap on RS of fabric to form loops). Proceed in Texture Pat as follows: 
1st row: (RS). With A, ch 1. 1 scbl in each of first 7 sts. (2 scbl in next st. 1 scbl in each of next 4 sts) 20 times. 1 scbl in each of last 5 sts. Turn. 135 sc.

1st row: (RS). With B, ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
3rd and 4th rows: As 1st and 2nd rows. 
**5th row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. *With C, Loop-st RS in each of next 5 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 
6th row: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. *With C, Loop-st WS in each of next 5 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 
7th and 8th rows: As 5th and 6th rows. Break C. 
9th and 10th rows: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

12th row: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 10 sc. *With C, Loop-st WS in each of next 5 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * to last 5 sc. 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Turn. 
13th and 14th rows: As 11th and 12th rows. 
15th and 16th rows: As 9th and 10th rows. Turn. 
17th to 22nd rows: Rep 5th to 10th rows once more. 
23rd to 26th rows: As 1st and 2nd rows twice more. Join A. Break B. PM at end of last row. 

Proceed in Honeycomb Pat as follows: 
1st row: (RS). With A, ch 1. 1 scbl in each of first 8 sts. (2 scbl in next st. 1 scbl in each of next 5 sts) 20 times. 1 scbl in each of last 7 sts. Turn. 155 sts. 

2nd row: Ch 2. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each of first 5 sts. *Sl st in each of next 5 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 
3rd and 4th rows: Working in back loops only, sl st in each of first 5 sts. *1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. Sl st in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 
5th row: As 2nd row. 
Rep 2nd to 5th rows for pat until work from last marked row measures approx 10" [25.5 cm], ending on a RS row. Join B. Break A. 

Proceed in Bobble St Pat as follows: 
1st row: (RS). With B, ch 1. 1 scbl in each of first 8 sts. (Scbl2tog. 1 scbl in each of next 5 sts) 20 times. 1 scbl in each of last 7 sts. Turn. 135 sts. 
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Join C. Turn. 
4th row: (WS). With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 5 sc. *With C, bobble in next st. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * to last st. 1 hdc in last st. Break C. Turn.

Proceed in Stripe Pat as follows: 
1st row: (WS). With A, ch 3. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
2nd row: With B, ch 3. 1 dc in sp between first and next dc. *1 dc in st between next 2 dc. Rep from * to last 2 dc. Skip sp between last 2 dc. 1 dc in last dc. Turn. 
Rep last row changing colors every row as follows: C, A, B until work from beg measures 60" [152.5 cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off.
