abbreviations: Dc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
Dc join = Yoh and pull up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Insert hook in adjacent stitch on Motif Panel. Yoh and pull through stitch on Motif panel and 2 loops on hook
2(3-4) dc-cl = [2 (3-4) Double Crochet Cluster]. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 2 (3-4) times in same stitch. Yoh and draw through all 3 (4-5) loops on hook.
Picot = Ch 6. Sl st in 5th ch from hook. Ch 1
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
Shell = [(2 dc-cl. Ch 2) twice. 2 dc-cl] in indicated space or stitch
V-st = (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in indicated stitch
gauge: 12 dc and 6 rows = 8" [20.5 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Ch 2 at beg of row counts as hdc.
• Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc.
• Ch 4 at beg of row counts as dc and ch-1 sp.
• Ch 5 at beg of row counts as dc and ch-2 sp.
• Ch 6 at beg of row counts as dc and ch-3 sp.
• Throw is constructed of 3 motif panels with a striped section between each motif panel. The striped section joins to the end panels on the last row. Each motif panel is made of 6 motifs. See Assembly Layout for assistance.

THROW
SOLID COLOR MOTIF (Make 3 in A, 3 in B and 3 in C) 
See Chart on page 6.
Ch 5. Join with sl st to form ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 5. (1 dc in ring. Ch 2) 7 times. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-5. 8 dc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 3 (does not count as a dc). 3 dc-cl in same sp as sl st. *Ch 5. Skip ch-2 sp. 4 dc-cl in next dc. Rep from * around. Ch 5. Join with sl st to first st. 
3rd rnd: Slip st in next ch-sp. Ch 1. *(3 sc. Ch 2. 3 sc) in ch-5 sp. Ch 1. Skip next dc-cl. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 ch-2 sps and 8 ch-1 sps.
4th rnd: Sl st in each sc to next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in ch-2 sp. *Ch 4. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 4. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Ch 4. (1 tr. Picot. 1 tr) in next ch-1 sp. Ch 4. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * around ending at **. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 ch-4 sps. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 4 sc in each of next 3 ch-4 sps. *4 sc in corner ch-sp (formed by picot). PM in second sc. 4 sc in each of next 4 ch-4 sps. Rep from * around ending at **. 4 sc in last ch-4 sp. Join with sl st to first sc. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc across to marker. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 

MULTI COLOR MOTIF
See Chart on page 6.
Make 3 of each of the following motifs, for a total of 9 motifs. Work as given for Solid Color Motif changing colors in following order: 
Motif ABC: Rounds 1-2 Color A, Round 3 Color B, Rounds 4-6 Color C.
Motif BCA: Rounds 1-2 Color B, Round 3 Color C, Rounds 4-6 Color A.
Motif CAB: Rounds 1-2 Color C, Round 3 Color A, Rounds 4-6 Color B.

MOTIF PANEL (Make 3 panels). 
With RS facing, whip stitch motifs tog to form a panel. Place motifs in following order: CAB, A, ABC, B, BCA, C. 

STRIPED SECTION
See Chart on page 5.
1st row: (RS). Working on a long edge of middle motif panel, join C on right side in corner with slip st. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same st. 1 dc in each sc across. Join A. Fasten off C. Turn. 133 dc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. *Ch 6. Skip 5 dc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * across. Turn. 22 ch-6 sps.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (1 sc. 1 hdc. 5 dc. 1 hdc. 1 sc) in each ch-6 sp across. 1 sc in last sc. Join C. Fasten off A. Turn.
4th row: Ch 5. Skip first (2 sc. 1 hdc. 2 dc). *1 sc in next dc. Ch 5. Skip next 8 sts. Rep from * to last 5 sts. Ch 2. 1 dc in last sc. Turn.
5th row: Ch 3. 2 dc in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in next sc. *5 dc in next ch-5 sp. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * across to tch. 2 dc in tch-sp. 1 dc in 3rd ch of tch. Join B. Fasten off C. Turn. 133 dc. 
6th row: Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 2. 4 dc) in first dc. *Skip next 3 dc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 4 dc) in next dc (small shell made). Rep from * across to last 4 sts. 1 sc in top of tch. Turn. 33 small shells. 
7th row: Ch 2. *Skip next dc. Dc2tog. Skip next dc. Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * across. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 2. 4 dc) in first sc. *Skip next (Ch-3 sp, Dc2tog). (1 sc. Ch 2. 4 dc) in next sc. Rep from * across. 1 sc in top of tch. Turn.
9th row: Ch 2. *Skip next dc. Dc2tog. Skip next dc. Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * across. Fasten off. Do not turn.
With RS facing, join A with sl st to top of tch of 9th row.
10th row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in Dc2tog. 2 sc in next ch-3 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * across. Turn. 133 sc.
11th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 3. Skip next 2 sc. 4 dc-cl in next sc. Ch 3. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * across. Turn. 22 dc-cl.
12th row: Ch 5. 1 sc in first dc-cl. *Ch 2. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 2. 1 sc in next dc-cl. Rep from * across. Ch 2. 1 dc in last sc. Turn.
13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. *2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next sc **. 2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * across ending at **. 2 sc in tch-sp. 1 sc in 3rd ch of tch. Join C. Fasten off A. Turn. 133 sts. 
14th row: Ch 1. 1 sc first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Skip next 3 sc. *Shell in next sc. Skip next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Skip next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. Shell in next sc. Skip next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join B. Fasten off C. Turn. 16 shells.
15th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. *Ch 3. Skip next (dc-cl, ch-2 sp). 1 sc in next dc-cl. Ch 3. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 dc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
16th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. (2 dc-cl. Ch 2. 2 dc-cl) in next dc. *1 sc in next sc. Shell in next dc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc (2 dc-cl. Ch 2. 2 dc-cl) in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in top of tch. Join A. Fasten off B. Turn.
17th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 dc. 1 sc in dc-cl. *Ch 3. Skip next (ch-2 sp, dc-cl). 1 dc in next sc. Ch 3. Skip next (dc-cl, ch-2 sp). 1 sc in next dc-cl. Rep from * across. 1 sc in next dc. 1 sc in top of tch. Turn.
18th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Shell in next dc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * across. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join C. Fasten off A. Turn.
19th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. *Ch 3. Skip next (dc-cl, ch-2 sp). 1 sc in next dc-cl. Ch 3. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 dc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
20th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 3 dc in next ch-3 sp. *1 dc in next sc. 3 dc in ch-3 sp. 1 dc in next dc. 3 dc in ch-3 sp. Rep from * to last 3 dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in top of tch. Turn. 133 dc.
21st row: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. Skip next dc. *V-st in next dc. Skip 2 dc. Rep from * to last 4 dc. V-st in next dc. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in top of tch. Turn.
22nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc and ch-1 sp across. 1 dc in top of tch. Join B. Fasten off C. Turn. 133 dc.
23rd row: Ch 5. Skip first 3 dc. *1 dc in next 2 dc. Ch 2. Skip 2 dc. Rep from * across. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in top of tch. Join A. Fasten off B. Turn.
24th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. 1 sc in next dc. *Working over chain, 1 dc in 2 skipped sts from 23rd row. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * across to tch ending at **. 1 sc in 3rd ch of tch. Join B. Fasten off A. Turn. 133 sts.
25th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 3. Skip next 2 sts. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc) in next sc. Rep from * to last 4 sts. Ch 3. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
26th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 2. Skip next ch-3 sp. (1 sc. Ch 3. 2 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. Ch 2. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
27th row: Ch 6. *1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. Rep from * across. 1 dc in last sc. Join C. Fasten off B. Turn.
28th row: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in next sc. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 hdc in next sc. Rep from * to last tch. 3 hdc in tch-sp. 1 hdc in 3rd ch of tch. Turn. 133 hdc.
29th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc across. Turn.
30th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in back loop only of each hdc across. Join A. Fasten off C. Turn.
31st row: Ch 3. *1 dc in next hdc. 1 dc around post of dc just made. Skip next hdc. Rep from * across. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in top of tch. Turn.
32nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc across. 1 dc in top of tch. Turn.
33rd row: Ch 3. *1 dc in next dc. 1 dc around post of dc just made. Skip next dc. Rep from * across. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in top of tch. Join B. Fasten off A. Turn.
34th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc across. 1 dc in top of tch. Fasten off B. Do not turn.
With RS facing, Join C with sl st to top of tch on 34th row.
35th row: Ch 1. Sl st loosely in each dc across. Fasten off C. Do not turn.
Note: Next row joins the edge motif panel to the striped section. Motif panel has 133 sts along the long edge to match the 133 sts in the striped section. Motif Panel has 22 sts along the first 5 motifs and 23 sts along the last motif’s edge).
Join B with sl st in top of tch of 34th row.
36th row: Ch 3. 1 dc join in each st on 34th row (behind sl st of 35th row) joining Motif Panel as you work. Fasten off B.
Rep 1st to 36th rows on opposite side of the middle motif panel.

BORDER
1st rnd: Join A with slip st to corner on edge Motif Panel. *1 sc in each sc across Motif Panel to corner. 2 sc in each of next corner 2 sc. 1 sc in each sc across motif panel. 1 sc evenly along edge of Striped Section. 1 sc in each sc across Motif Panel to corner. 2 sc in each of next corner 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to corner. 2 sc in each of next corner 2 sc. Rep from *around. Join with sl st to first sc. Join B. Fasten off A.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. *1 dc in each sc to corner. 2 dc in each of next corner 2 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of tch. Join A. Fasten off B.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to corner. 2 sc in each of next corner 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off A.

instructions:

instructions:
BLANKET
With larger hook and color A, ch 218.
Row 1:  3 dc in 5th ch from hook, sk 2 ch, 3 dc in next ch, sk 2 ch, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch, [sk 2 ch, 3 dc in next ch] twice, *sk 5 ch, [3 dc in next ch, sk 2 ch] twice, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch, [sk 2 ch, 3 dc in next ch] twice*, repeat from * to * 10 more times, sk 2 ch, dc in last ch. Fasten off yarn. Turn.
Row 2:  Attach color B, ch 4, [3 dc between dc groups] twice, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in ch-3 space, *[3 dc between dc groups] twice, skip next 2 dc groups, [3 dc between dc groups] twice, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in ch-3 space, [3 dc between dc groups] twice; repeat from * to * to end of row, dc in top of ch in previous row. Fasten off yarn. Turn.
Repeat Row 2 for 4 rows in the following color sequence: A, C, D, C
Repeat Row 2 in following color sequence until there are 13 color repeats (78 rows total): A, B, A, C, D, C
Repeat Row 2 for 3 more rows in following color sequence. (81 rows total): A, B, A
Fasten yarn off.  Do not turn.

Edging
Row 1:
Side 1:   Attach color A in last st made, 3 sc in same st, *2 sc over side of dc, sc in top of dc, 2 sc over 4 ch, sc in top of dc*, 2 sc over dc, sc in dc, repeat from * to * to last dc, 2 sc over last ch, 3 sc in 3rd ch.

Side 1 : Attach color D in 2nd st of 3 sc of previous row, sc in each sc to next corner, 3 sc in middle st of 3 sc of previous row,
Side 2:  *Sc in next 8 sts, [sc dec over next 2 sts] twice, sc in next 8 sts, 3 sc in next st*; repeat from * to * to next corner, 3 sc in middle st of 3 sc of previous row,

Repeat Row 2 for 5 more rows using the following color sequence. C, B, B, A, A.

abbreviations: Dtr = (Yoh) 3 times and draw up a loop in indicated stitch. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 4 times.

Tss = One row of Tunisian simple stitch is worked in two steps as follows: 1) Forward Pass (right to left): Skip first vertical thread. *Insert hook into front loop only of next vertical thread. Yoh and draw up a st. Rep from * to last vertical thread. Insert hook into both front and back loops of last vertical thread. Yoh and draw up a st.
gauge: 16 Tss and 13 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Tunisian simple stitch (Tss) using Tunisian crochet hook.
instructions:
Notes:
• Blanket is worked in Tunisian crochet. Each row consists of a pick-up portion where loops remain on hook and a return portion where loops are worked off.
• Right side is facing throughout.
• Blanket is worked in 8 segments. The first segment is worked independently in its entirety. The 2nd through 7th segments are worked joining the left edge of the new segment to the right edge of the previous segment as you work the final st in the forward pass of each row.
• The final segment is worked joining the right edge to the left edge of Segment 1 at the conclusion of the return pass and the left edge to the right edge of Segment 7 as you work the final st in the forward pass.
• Edging is worked in traditional crochet around piece after all pieces have been joined. The stitch works a dtr followed by a sc. The sc will force the dtr to crunch up to appear as a little bobble. If needed, push the crunched dtr to the right side.
BLANKET
Segment 1
1st row: Forward pass:  ( Right to left). With afghan hook, ch 49 loosely, working in back bump of each ch, pick up a loop in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, leaving all loops on hook – 49 sts.

Return Pass:  ( Left to right after working Forward pass of each row). Yoh, draw through 1 loop on hook, *yoh, draw through 2 loops on hook; repeat from * until 1 loop remains on hook.

2nd row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). Work Forward Pass of Tss in each st until 1 st remains, Tss under both strands of final st – 49 sts.
2nd row Return pass:  ( Left to right after working Forward pass of each row). *Yoh, draw through 2 loops on hook; repeat from * until 1 loop remains on hook.

3rd row:  Tss2tog, Tss in each st until 3 sts remain, Tss2tog, Tss under both strands of final st – 47 sts.
3rd row Return pass:  Repeat Return Pass.

4th row:  Tss in each st until 1 st remains, Tss under both strands of final st – 47 sts.
4th row Return pass:  Repeat Return Pass.

5th row:  Tss2tog, Tss in each st until 3 sts remain, Tss2tog, Tss under both strands of final st – 45 sts.
5th row Return pass:  Repeat Return Pass.

6th row:  Tss in each st until 1 st remains, Tss under both strands of final st – 45 sts.
6th row Return pass:  Repeat Return Pass.

7th - 46th rows: Repeat 5th - 6th rows, noting there will be 2 fewer sts on hook at the end of each odd numbered pick-up row – 5 sts remain on last row worked.

47th row: Tss3tog, Tss under both strands of final st – 3 sts.
47th row Return pass:  Repeat Return Pass.

48th row:  Tss, Tss under both strands of final st – 3 sts.
48th row:  Yoh, draw through 3 loops.
Bind Off: Slip st in final st. Fasten off.

Segments 2 to 7
1st row (RS):  With afghan hook, ch 49 loosely, working in back bump of each ch, pick up a loop in 2nd ch from hook and each remaining ch across, leaving all loops on hook, to join to previous segment, insert hook from right side to wrong side of right-hand edge of corresponding row of previous segment, yoh and draw through edge st and first loop on hook – 49 sts.

1st row Return pass: *Yoh, draw through 2 loops on hook; repeat from * until 1 loop remains on hook.
2nd row:  Tss in each st, join to previous segment as for Row 1 – 49 sts.
2nd row Return pass:  Repeat Return Pass.

3rd row: Tss2tog, Tss in each st until 3 sts remain, Tss2tog, Tss in final st, join to previous segment – 47 sts.
3rd row Return pass:  Repeat Return Pass.

4th row:  Tss in each st until 1 st remains, Tss under both strands of final st – 47 sts. 
4th row Return pass:  Repeat Return Pass.

5th row: Tss2tog, Tss in each st until 3 sts remain, Tss2tog, Tss in final st, join to previous segment – 45 sts.
5th row Return pass:  Repeat Return Pass.

6th row:  Tss in each st, join to previous segment – 45 sts.
6th row Return pass:  Repeat Return Pass.

7th - 46th rows:  Repeat 5th-6th rows, noting there will be 2 fewer sts on hook at the end of each odd numbered pick-up row – 5 sts remain on last row worked.

47th row:  Tss3tog, Tss in final st, join to previous segment – 3 sts.
47th row Return pass:  Repeat Return Pass.

48th row:  Tss across, join to previous segment – 3 sts.
48th row Return pass: Yoh, draw through 3 loops.
Bind Off: Slip st in final st. Fasten off.

Final Segment 8
1st row (Right Side): With afghan hook, ch 49 loosely; remove loop from hook, insert hook from back to front in end of left edge of 1st row of Segment 1, place loop back on hook and draw through, working in back bump of each ch, pick up a loop in 2nd ch from hook and each remaining ch across, leaving all loops on hook, to join to previous segment, insert hook from right side to wrong side of right-hand edge of corresponding row of previous segment, yoh and draw through edge st and first loop on hook – 49 sts.

1st row Return pass:  *Yoh, draw through 2 loops on hook; repeat from * until 1 loop remains on hook; remove loop from hook, insert hook from back to front in end of next row on Segment 1, place loop back on hook and draw through.

2nd row:  Tss in each st, join to previous segment as for 1st row – 49 sts.
2nd row Return pass: Repeat 1st row Return pass, including joining to next row on Segment 1.

3rd row: Tss2tog, Tss in each st until 3 sts remain, Tss2tog, Tss in final st, join to previous segment – 47 sts.
3rd row Return pass:  Repeat 1st row Return Pass.

4th row:  Tss in each st until 1 st remains, Tss under both strands of final st – 47 sts.
4th row Return pass:  Repeat 1st row Return Pass.

5th row: Tss2tog, Tss in each st until 3 remain, Tss2tog, Tss in final st, join to previous segment – 45 sts.
5th row Return pass:  Repeat 1st row Return Pass.

6th row:  Tss in each st, join to previous segment as for 1st row – 45 sts.
6th row Return pass:  Repeat 1st row Return Pass.

7th - 46th rows:  Rep 5th - 6th rows, noting there will be 2 fewer sts on hook at the end of each odd numbered pick-up row – 5 sts remain on last row worked.

47th row:  Tss3tog, Tss in final st, join to previous segment – 3 sts.
47th row Return pass: Repeat 1st row Return Pass.

48th row:  Tss across, join to previous segment – 3 sts.
48th row Return pass: Yoh, draw through 3 loops.
Bind Off: Slip st in final st. Fasten off leaving long tail.

FINISHING
Using yarn needle and begining tails from foundation ch, join foundation ch from each segment to the foundation ch of the segment to the left and weave in ends. To close small hole at center, weave long tail through final slip sts of each segment and gather to close hole.

Edging
1st rnd: With right side facing and U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook, working along opposite edge of foundation ch, join yarn with sc in first ch of any Segment, dtr in next st, [sc in next st, dtr in next st] 23 times across Segment, *[sc in next st, dtr in next st] 24 times across next Segment, repeat from * across each remaining Segment, join with a slip st in first sc – 192 sc and 192 dtr.

2nd rnd: [Dtr in each sc, sc in each dtr] around, slip st in first st.
3rd rnd: [Sc in each dtr, dtr in each sc] around, slip st in first st.
4th rnd: Sc in each st around, slip st in first st. Fasten off.

instructions:

With A, ch 8.

instructions:
AFGHAN
Square (make 408: 54 each of Squares 1, 2, 3, and 4 and 48 each of Squares 5, 6, 7, and 8):
With first color, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as first dc here and throughout), 11 dc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—12 dc. Fasten off. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Join 2nd color with slip st in any dc, ch 2, dc in same st, 2 dc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 dc. Fasten off.
Round 3: Join 3rd color with sc in any st, sc in same st, skip next 2 sts, (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in next st, skip next 2 sts, *2 sc in next st, skip next 2 sts, (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in next st, skip next 2 sts; repeat from * twice; join with slip st in first sc—24 dc, 8 sc, and 4 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
With right sides facing, arrange 68 squares as shown in the assembly diagram. Repeat sequence 5 more times.

Pillow cover measures 22” wide by 15” long (56 x 38 cm) without pillow insert.
Special Techniques
Adjustable-ring method = Wrap yarn in a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail firmly between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring, working over both strands (the tail and the ring). After the first round of stitches is worked, pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Invisible join = After last stitch in round is made, cut yarn leaving a 6” (15 cm) tail. Pull tail completely through last stitch. Thread the tail onto yarn needle and weave the end under the top 2 loops of the first stitch of the round and then back down into the center of the top of the last stitch of the round. 
Join with sc = Place a slip knot on hook, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through both loops on hook.
Color Sequences
Square 1: A, D, C
Square 2: B, C, D
Square 3: C, A, B
Square 4: D, B, A
Square 5: A, D, B
Square 6: B, C, A
Square 7: C, A, D
Square 8: D, B, C

JOINING SQUARES
Horizontal Join
Row 1: Hold first squares of Rows 1 and 2 with wrong sides together; working through both thicknesses, join C with sc in first ch-1 space; *working in inside loops (back loop of lower square and front loop of upper square), sc in each st across to last ch-1 space, sc in last ch-1 space**, sc in ch-1 space of next pair of squares; repeat from * across joining each pair of squares from Rows 1 and 2 and ending at **—240 sc in each row. Fasten off.
Rows 3–23: Holding squares of next row to squares of last row joined, work horizontal join same as Row 1. 
Vertical Join
With right side facing, turn afghan so unjoined rows are facing you. Work same as Rows 1–16 of horizontal join—170 sc in each row.
FINISHING AFGHAN
Border
Notes On outer edge of first round, you will work again into same ch-1 spaces as joining rows. In Rounds 2 and 3, two 3-dc groups together count as a corner.
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, join C with sc in ch-1 space of first square at top corner, 2 sc in same space, sc in each st and ch-1 space around working 3 sc in each unworked ch-1 space of each corner square (corner made); join with slip st in first sc—168 sc across each short edge between outer ch-1 spaces, 238 sc across each long edge between outer ch-1 spaces and 3 sc in each outer ch-1 space. Place stitch markers on 2nd and 3rd sts of each 3-sc group at top right and bottom left corners and on first and 2nd sts of each 3-sc group at top left and bottom right corners. 
Round 2: Ch 2, 2 dc in same st as join, dc in each st around working 3 dc in each marked st (corner made); join with slip st in top of beginning ch—172 dc across each short edge and 242 dc across each long edge. Fasten off. Place stitch marker on 3rd st of first 3-dc group and first st of 2nd 3-dc group at each corner. 
Round 3: With right side facing, join D with slip st in any unmarked st, ch 2, dc in each st around working 3 dc in each marked st (corner made); join with slip st in top of beginning ch—176 dc across each short edge and 246 dc across each long edge. Fasten off. Place stitch marker on 3rd st of first 3-dc group and first st of 2nd 3-dc group at each corner. 
Round 4: With right side facing, join B with slip st in any unmarked st, ch 2, dc in each st around working 3 dc in each marked st; invisible join in top of beginning ch. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

PILLOW COVER
Square (make 30: 4 of Square 1, 6 of Square 3, 8 of Square 5, and 12 of Square 8)
Work same as afghan squares.
ASSEMBLY
With right sides facing, arrange 15 squares as shown in the assembly diagram for first side of cover. Repeat sequence for 2nd side. Join horizontal and vertical rows same as afghan assembly—50 sc across each horizontal row and 30 sc across each vertical row.

FINISHING PILLOW
Border
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of afghan border on each pillow cover side—54 sc across each long edge and 34 sc across each short edge.
Round 3 (joining round): With wrong sides of pillow cover sides held together and working through both thicknesses, join D with slip st in any unmarked st, ch 2, dc in each st around 3 sides working 3 dc in each of next 6 marked sts (corners made), insert pillow, dc in each remaining st to last marked, 3 dc in each of last 2 marked sts; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—58 dc across each long edge and 38 dc across each short edge. Fasten off. Place stitch marker on 3rd st of first 3-dc group and first st of 2nd 3-dc group at each corner. 
Round 4: Work same as Round 4 of afghan border.
Weave in ends.

instructions:
Notes:
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull tie to remove.
• For this pattern, colors can be easily separated by gently pulling apart and cutting at the color transition. Each color is ready to use. Follow color guide shown in Materials section for each O’Go (Contrast A, B, C, D, E and F). You may find it helpful to place each color section in its own resealable (zip lock) bag and label each bag – A, B, C, D, E, F.

• Blanket is worked diagonally from corner to corner.
• When working from chart, use separated colors from O’Gos for each separate area of color in the design.
• Start new colors at appropriate points.
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook, yoh with new color. Pull through 2 loops on hook to complete st and proceed in new color.

BLANKET
See Chart on page 3.
With A, ch 6.

3rd row: Beg block. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 3 blocks.
Keeping cont of color changes in Chart (each square on grid represents 1 block), rep last row until 33rd row of chart is complete. 33 blocks.
Keeping cont of Chart, proceed as follows to work sides even:
34th row: Beg block. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. Sl st in last ch-3 sp. ( Do not make a block). 33 blocks. Turn.

35th row: Sl st in each of first 3 dc. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 33 blocks.
Keeping cont of Chart, proceed as follows to dec corner:
41st row: Sl st in each of first 3 dc. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. Sl st in last ch-3 sp. ( Do not make a block). 32 blocks. Turn.

1st rnd: Ch 3. *Sl st between next 2 blocks. Ch 3. Rep from * around working (Sl st. Ch 3. Sl st) in each corner. Join with sl st in first sl st. Turn.
2nd rnd: Sl st in next ch-3 sp. Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 2 hdc in same sp as last sl st. *3 hdc in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * around, working (3 hdc. Ch 1. 3 hdc) in corner ch-3 sp. Join with sl st to top of ch-2. Fasten off.

pattern_name: FROM THE MIDDLE CROCHET BOBBLE THROW

5" [12.5 cm] wide piece of cardboard for tassels.
abbreviations: Bobble = (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 5 times all in same stitch. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Dc3tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch. Yoh a draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Hdc3tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 3 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 60" [152.5 cm] diameter from peak to peak, excluding tassels.
gauge: 11 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc. 
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc. 
• To change colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed with new color.

Stripe Pat
With A, work 4 rnds.
With B, work 4 rnds.
These 8 rnds form Stripe Pat.

Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring. See diagram on page 3.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 13 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 14 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. 2 dc in each dc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 28 dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. 4 dc in same sp as last sl st. *Dc3tog. 5 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Dc3tog. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 
4th rnd: Sl st in next dc. Ch 2. 3 hdc in same dc as sl st. *Bobble in next st. 3 hdc in next dc. Hdc3tog. 3 hdc in next dc. Rep from * around, ending last rep at **. Join with sl st to first hdc. 
5th rnd: Sl st in next st. Ch 3. *3 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st. 3 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st. Dc3tog. 1 dc in next st. Rep from * around, ending last rep at **. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
6th rnd: Sl st in next st. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same st as sl st. *(Bobble in next st. 3 hdc in next st) twice. Bobble in next st. 1 hdc in next st. Hdc3tog. 1 hdc in next st. Rep from * around, ending last rep at **. Join with sl st to first hdc. 
7th rnd: Sl st in next st. Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. *3 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st. 3 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Dc3tog. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around, ending last rep at **. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 
8th rnd: Sl st in next st. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same st as sl st. *Bobble in next st. 1 hdc in next st. (Bobble in next st. 3 hdc in next st) twice. (Bobble in next st. 1 hdc in next st) twice. Hdc3tog. 1 hdc in next st. Rep from * around, ending last rep at **. 
9th rnd: Sl st in next st. Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 4 sts. 3 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st. PM in dc. 3 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 5 sts. Dc3tog. PM in dc3tog. *1 dc in each of next 5 sts. 3 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st. PM in dc. 3 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 5 sts. Dc3tog. PM in dc3tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 
10th rnd: Sl st in next st. *1 hdc in next st. Bobble in next st.* Rep from * to * until 1 st before next marked st. 3 hdc in next st. Bobble in next st. PM in Bobble. 3 hdc in next st. **Bobble in next st. 1 hdc in next st. Rep from ** to 1 st before next marked st. Hdc3tog. PM in hdc3tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
11th rnd: Sl st in next st. Ch 3. *1 dc in each st to 1 st before marked st. 3 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st. PM in dc. 3 dc in next st. 1 dc in each st until 1 st before next marked st. Dc3tog. PM in dc3tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 
Rep 10th and 11th rnds, keeping cont of Stripe Pat, until work from center to outer point measures approx 30" [76 cm]. Fasten off.

Tassels (make 7)
Cut a piece of cardboard 5" [12.5 cm] wide. Wind B around cardboard 40 times. Break yarn leaving a long end and thread end through needle. Slip needle through all loops and tie tightly. Remove cardboard and wind yarn tightly around loops 1" [2.5 cm] below fold. Fasten securely. Cut through rem loops and trim ends evenly. Sew one Tassel to each "peak" along the edge of Blanket as pictured.

instructions: Make a slip knot and place it on your hook. Slip knot Make a loop with yarn and fold it on itself to make a pretzel shape. Then draw through to make slip knot. Chain (Ch) 101. Chain *Yarn over hook (Yoh), draw through loop – 1 chain made. Repeat (rep) from* 100 times more – 101 chains made. 1st row: (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in 5th ch from hook (counts as dc. Skip 2 ch). *Skip next 2 ch. (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch. Repeat (Rep) from * to last 3 ch. Skip next 2 ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. See diagram. Yoh and insert hook into 5th ch from hook. Yoh and draw through first 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through remaining (rem) loops on hook – 1 dc made. Ch 1, then rep above steps in same st – (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) made. 2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). *(1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch-1 space (sp). Rep from * to end of row. 1 dc in last dc. Turn. instructions:
The instructions are written for Child size. If changes are necessary for Adult size the instructions will be written thus ( ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to both sizes. Note: Ch 2 at beg of rows counts as hdc. To join new color, work to last loops on hook of previous color. Yoh with new color, draw through rem loops and proceed with new color.

Bottom Crust
With A, ch 3.
**1st row: (RS). 2 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Turn. 3 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in next hdc.  1 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 4 hdc.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
4th row (inc row): Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 6 hdc.
Rep last 2 rows, inc 2 hdc every other row to 22 (32) hdc.
Next 2 rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Next row (inc row): Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
Rep last 3 rows, inc 2 hdc every 3rd row to 48 (72) hdc.** Place marker at end of row.
Next row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from marked row measures approx 13" [33 cm]. 
Fasten off.

Cheese
With B, ch 3.
Work from ** to ** as given for Bottom Crust.
Break B. Join C.
With C, proceed as follows:
1st row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. (Hdc2tog) twice. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. (Hdc2tog) twice. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row twice more.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 sc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * to last 10 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 dc in each of next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 sc in each of last 2 hdc. Break C. Join A. Turn. Place marker on last row.
With A, proceed as follows:
Next row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from marked row measures approx 20" [51 cm]. Fasten off, leaving a long end.
Fold top edge of crust to meet marked row on RS. Using long end, sew top edge to marked row. Sew side seams of Crust.
Holding WS tog, join A with sl st to top right corner at Crust. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc to join pieces, changing to B where Cheese begins and working 5 sc in tip of slice. Fasten off.

Toppings:
Pepperoni (make 6 for Child, 12 for Adult)
With C, ch 4.
1st rnd: 11 dc in 4th ch from hook. Join with sl st to top of ch 3 (counts as dc). 12 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first dc. *1 sc in next dc. 2 sc in next dc. Rep from * to last dc. 1 sc in last dc. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc. Fasten off.

Mushroom (make 6 for Child, 12 for Adult)
With D, ch 5. 
1st row: 8 tr in 4 th ch from hook. Ch 4. Sl st in same sp as tr just worked.
Stem: Ch 5. 1 hdc in 3 rd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Sl st in same sp as previous tr worked.  Working in rem loops of ch, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 hdc in last ch. Join with sl st to top of first hdc. Fasten off.
Sew Toppings to Cheese as shown.

BLANKET

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 space (sp). *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.

First 3 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows for Sc/Ch-1 Pat until work from beg measures 60" [152.5 cm], ending on a Wrong Side (WS) row. Do not fasten off.

1st rnd:  (RS). With current color, ch 1. Work in sc evenly around outer edge of Blanket, having 3 sc in each corner. Join with slip stitch (sl st) to first sc.

instructions:
THROW
Center Square
With A, ch 4; slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), work 11 dc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—12 dc.
Round 2: Ch 1, puff in same ch as join, *ch 1, puff in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 1; join with slip st in first puff—12 puffs and 12 ch-1 spaces.
Round 3: (Slip st, ch 3, dc) in first ch-1 sp, dc in next puff, [dc in next ch-1 sp, dc in next puff] twice, *(2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp (corner made), dc in next puff, [dc in next ch-1 sp, dc in next puff] twice; repeat from * around, 2 dc in first ch-1 space again; join with ch 1, hdc in top of beginning ch-3 (joining ch 1, hdc count as a corner ch-3 space)—36 dc and 4 corner ch-3 spaces (9 dc along each of 4 sides between corner ch-3 spaces).
Round 4: Ch 1, puff in first ch-3 space (formed by the joining hdc), [ch 2, skip next dc, puff in next dc] 4 times, *ch 2, skip next dc, (puff, ch 3, puff) in next corner ch-3 space, [ch 2, skip next dc, puff in next dc] 4 times; repeat from * around, ch 2, skip last dc, puff in first ch-3 space again; join with ch 1, hdc in first puff—24 puffs, 20 ch-2 spaces, and 4 corner ch-3 spaces (6 puffs and 5 ch-2 spaces along each of 4 sides between corner ch-3 spaces).
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in first ch-3 space, [dc in next puff, 2 dc in next ch-2 space] twice, dc in next puff, dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next puff, [2 dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next puff] twice, *(2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next corner ch-3 space, [dc in next puff, 2 dc in next ch-2 space] twice, dc in next puff, dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next puff, [2 dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next puff] twice; repeat from * around, 2 dc in first ch-3 space again ch 1, hdc in top of beginning ch-3—76 dc and 4 corner ch-3 spaces (19 dc along each of 4 sides between corner ch-3 spaces).
Round 6: Ch 1, puff in first ch-3 space (formed by the joining hdc), [ch 1, skip next dc, puff in next dc] 9 times, *ch 1, skip next dc, (puff, ch 3, puff) in next corner ch-3 space, [ch 1, skip next dc, puff in next dc] 9 times; repeat from * around, ch 1, skip last dc, puff in first ch-3 space again, ch 3; join with slip st in first puff—44 puffs, 40 ch-1 spaces, and 4 corner ch-3 spaces (11 puffs and 10 ch-1 spaces along each of 4 sides between corner ch-3 spaces).
Round 7: Ch 1, beginning in same puff as join, sc in each puff and ch-1 space around, working 3 sc in each corner ch-3 space; join with slip st in first sc—96 sc (23 sc along each of 4 sides between center sc of 3-sc corners). Fasten off A.
Round 8 (right side): With right side facing, join B with a slip st in center sc of any corner 3-sc, ch 4, dc in same sc (beginning ch-4 and following dc count as first V-st here and throughout), ch 1, V-st in same sc (corner made), [skip next 2 sc, V-st in next sc] 7 times, skip next 2 sc, *(V-st, ch 1, V-st) in next sc (center sc of corner 3-sc), [skip next 2 sc, V-st in next sc] 7 times, skip next 2 sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—36 V-sts and 4 corner ch-1 spaces (9 V-sts along each of 4 sides between corner ch-1 spaces).
Round 9: (Slip st, ch 4, dc) in first ch-space, (V-st, ch 1, V-st) in corner ch-1 space, *V-st in ch-1 space of each V-st to next corner ch-1 space, (V-st, ch 1, V-st) in corner ch-1 space; repeat from * 2 more times, V-st in ch-1 space of each V-st to end of round; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—44 V-sts and 4 corner ch-1 spaces (11 V-sts along each of 4 sides between corner ch-1 spaces).
Rounds 10–12: (Slip st, ch 4, dc) in first ch-space, V-st in ch-1 space of each V-st around, working (V-st, ch 1, V-st) in each corner ch-1 space; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—68 V-sts and 4 corner ch-1 spaces (17 V-sts along each of 4 sides between corner ch-1 spaces) in Round 12. Fasten off B.
Round 13 (right side): With right side facing, join C with a slip st in any corner ch-1 space, ch 2 (counts as hdc), (2 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in same corner ch-1 space, *sc in ch-1 space of next V-st, [3 dc in ch-1 space of next V-st, sc in ch-1 space of next V-st] 8 times **, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-1 space; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2—Thirty-two 3-dc groups, 36 sc, eight 3-hdc groups, and 4 corner ch-2 spaces (eight 3-dc groups, 9 sc, and two 3-hdc groups along each of 4 sides between corner ch-2 spaces).
Round 14: (Slip st, ch 1, sc) in next hdc, skip next hdc, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space, *skip next hdc, sc in next hdc, skip next hdc, [3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st] 9 times, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * 2 more times, skip next hdc, sc in next hdc, skip next hdc, [3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st] 8 times, 3 dc in next sc; join with slip st in first sc—Thirty-six 3-dc groups, 40 sc, eight 3-hdc groups, and 4 corner ch-2 spaces (nine 3-dc groups, 10 sc, and two 3-hdc groups along each of 4 sides between corner ch-2 spaces).
Round 15: Ch 3, 2 dc in same st as join, skip next hdc, sc in next hdc, skip next hdc, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space, *skip next hdc, sc in next hdc, skip next hdc, [3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next sc, skip next st] 10 times, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * 2 more times, skip next hdc, sc in next hdc, skip next hdc, [3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st] 9 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—Forty 3-dc groups, 44 sc, eight 3-hdc groups, and 4 corner ch-2 spaces (ten 3-dc groups, 11 sc, and two 3-hdc groups along each of 4 sides between corner ch-2 spaces).
Round 16: (Slip st, ch 1, sc) in next st, skip next st, 3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space, *skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st, [3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next sc, skip next st] 11 times, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * 2 more times, skip next st, [sc in next st, skip next st, 3 dc in next sc, skip next st] 10 times; join with slip st in first sc—Forty-four 3-dc groups, 48 sc, eight 3-hdc groups, and 4 corner ch-2 spaces (eleven 3-dc groups, 12 sc, and two 3-hdc groups along each of 4 sides between corner ch-2 spaces).
Round 17: Ch 3, 2 dc in same st as join, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st, 3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space, *skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st, [3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st] 12 times, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * 2 more times, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st, [3 d in next sc, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st] 10 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—Forty-eight 3-dc groups, 52 sc, eight 3-hdc groups, and 4 corner ch-2 spaces (twelve 3-dc groups, 13 sc, and two 3-hdc groups along each of 4 sides between corner ch-2 spaces).
Round 18: (Slip st, ch 1, sc) in next st, skip next st, [3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st] twice, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space, *skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st, [3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st] 13 times, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * 2 more times, skip next st, [sc in next st, skip next st, 3 dc in next sc, skip next st] 11 times; join with slip st in first sc—Fifty-two 3-dc groups, 56 sc, eight 3-hdc groups, and 4 corner ch-2 spaces (thirteen 3-dc groups, 14 sc, and two 3-hdc groups along each of 4 sides between corner ch-2 spaces).
Round 19: Ch 3, 2 dc in same st as join, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st, [3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st] twice, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space, *skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st, [3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next sc, skip next st] 14 times, (3 hdc, ch 2, 3 hdc) in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * 2 more times, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st, [3 dc in next sc, skip next st, sc in next st, skip next st] 11 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—Fifty-six 3-dc groups, 60 sc, eight 3-hdc groups, and 4 corner ch-2 spaces (fourteen 3-dc groups, 15 sc, and two 3-hdc groups along each of 4 sides between corner ch-2 spaces). Fasten off C.
Round 20 (right side): With right side facing, join D with a slip st in any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, 3 sc in same corner ch-2 space, *sc in next st, [skip next st, sc in next 3 sts] 15 times, skip next st, sc in next st **, 3 sc in corner ch-2 space; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in first sc—200 sc (49 sc along each of 4 sides between center sc of 3-sc corners).
Round 21: (Slip st, beg-Cl, ch 3, Cl) in next sc (center sc of 3-sc corner), *[ch 1, skip next sc, Cl in next sc] 24 times, ch 1, skip next sc **, (Cl, ch 3, Cl) in center sc (corner made); repeat from * ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in beg-Cl—104 Cl, 100 ch-1 spaces, and 4 corner ch-3 spaces (26 Cl and 25 ch-1 spaces along each of 4 sides between corner ch-3 spaces).
Rounds 22–25: (Slip st, beg-Cl, ch 3, Cl) in first corner ch-3 space, *ch 1, skip next Cl, [Cl in next ch-1 space, ch 1, skip next Cl] to next corner ch-3 space, ch 1, skip next Cl **, (Cl, ch 3, Cl) in corner ch-3 space; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in beg-Cl—120 Cl, 116 ch-1 spaces, and 4 corner ch-3 spaces (30 Cl and 29 ch-1 spaces along each of 4 sides between corner ch-3 spaces in Round 25. Fasten off D.
Round 26 (right side): With right side facing, join A with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 1, 3 sc in same corner ch-3 space, sc in each Cl and ch-1 space around, working 3 sc in each corner ch-3 space; join with slip st in first sc—248 sc (61 sc along each of 4 sides between center sc of 3-sc corners).
Round 27: (Slip st, ch 3, 2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next sc (center sc of 3-sc corner), *skip next 3 sc, 3 dc in next sc, [skip next 2 sc, 3 dc in next sc] 18 times, skip next 3 sc **, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next sc (center sc of 3-sc corner); repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st to top of beginning ch-3—Eighty-four 3-dc groups and 4 corner ch-3 spaces (twenty-one 3-dc groups along each of 4 sides between corner ch-3 spaces).
Rounds 28–32: Slip st in each st to first corner ch-3 space, (slip st, ch 3, 2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in corner ch-3 space, 3 dc in each space between 3-dc groups around, working (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in each corner ch-3 space; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—One hundred and four 3-dc groups and 4 corner ch-3 spaces (twenty-six 3-dc groups along each of 4 sides between corner ch-3 spaces) in Round 32.
Fasten off A.
Side Triangles
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, join C with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 1, 3 sc in same corner ch-3 space, sc in next 39 dc, skip next dc, sc in next 38 dc, 3 sc in next corner ch-3 space—83 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 2, turn, skip first st, dc in next st (beginning ch-2 and following dc count as dc2tog here and throughout), sc in next st, *dc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * to last 2 sts, dc2tog—75 sts in Row 5.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, *dc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * across.
Rows 7–10: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, dc in next st, *sc in next st, dc in next st; repeat from * to last 2 sts, sc2tog—67 sts in Row 10.
Row 11: Ch 3 (counts as dc), *sc in next st, dc in next st; repeat from * across.
Rows 12–16: Repeat Rows 2–6—59 sts in Rows 15 and 16.
Rows 17–44: Repeat Row 7 for 28 more times—3 sts in Row 44.
Row 45: Ch 1, turn, sc3tog—1 st. Fasten off C. 
Repeat Rows 1–45 along each of the remaining 3 sides of the center square.
Outer Square
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, join B with a slip st in the 1 sc at the tip (Row 45) of any side triangle, ch 1, *3 sc in sc at tip, work 55 sc evenly spaced along side of same triangle to corner ch-3 space of center square, sc in ch-3 space of center square, work 55 sc evenly spaced along side of next triangle to 1 sc at tip; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—456 sc (113 sc along each of 4 sides between center sc of 3-sc corners).
Round 2: Slip st in next sc (center sc of 3-sc corner), ch 4 (counts as tr), 2 tr in same sc, tr in each sc around, working 3 tr in center sc of each 3-sc corner; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-4—464 tr (115 tr along each of 4 sides between center tr of 3-tr corners).
Round 3: (Slip st, ch 1, 3 sc) in next tr (center tr of 3-tr corner), sc in each tr around, working 3 sc in center tr of each 3-tr corner; join with slip st in first sc—472 sc (117 sc along each of 4 sides between center sc of 3-sc corners).
Rounds 4–7: Repeat Rounds 2 and 3 twice—504 sc (125 sc along each of 4 sides between center sc of 3-sc corners).
Round 8: Repeat Round 2—512 tr (127 tr along each of 4 sides between center tr of 3-tr corners).
Round 9: (Slip st, ch 1, 3 sc) in next tr (center tr of 3-tr corner), *sc in next 63 tr, skip next tr, sc in next 63 tr **, 3 sc in center tr of corner 3-tr; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in first sc—516 sc (128 sc along each of 4 sides between center sc of 3-sc corners).
Round 10: Slip st in next sc (center sc of 3-sc corner), ch 5 (counts as hdc, ch 3), hdc in same sc, *[ch 2, skip next 2 sc, hdc in next sc] 42 times, ch 2, skip next 2 sc **, (hdc, ch 3, hdc) in center sc of corner 3-sc; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in 2nd ch of beginning ch-5—176 hdc, 172 ch-2 spaces, and 4 corner ch-3 spaces (44 hdc and 43 ch-2 spaces along each of 4 sides between corner ch-3 spaces). Fasten off B.
Round 11 (right side): With right side facing, join D with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 1, (sc, hdc, 3 dc, hdc, sc) in same ch-3 space, (sc, hdc, dc, hdc, sc) in each ch-2 space around working (sc, hdc, 3 dc, hdc, sc) in each corner ch-3 space; join with slip st in first sc.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook

gauge: 16 dc and 7 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Note:Carry color not in use loosely
across top of previous row and work
color in use over it. To change color,
work to last 2 loops on hook. Draw
loop in next color through 2 loops on
hook to complete st and proceed in
next color.
Strip A(make 3)
With MC, ch 29.
1st row:(RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from
hook. 1 dc in next ch. *With A, 1 dc in
each of next 3 ch. With MC, 1 dc in
each of next 3 ch. Rep from * across,
joining A at end of last dc. 27 dc. T urn.
2nd row:With A, ch 3 (counts as dc).
Miss first dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc.
*With MC, 1 dc in each of next 3 dc.
With A, 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep
from * across, joining MC at end of
last dc. T urn.
3rd row:With MC, ch 3 (counts as
dc). Miss first dc. 1 dc in each of next
2 dc. *With A, 1 dc in each of next
3 dc. With MC, 1 dc in each of next
3 dc. Rep from * across, joining A at
end of last dc. T urn.
4th to 10th rows:Rep 2nd and 3rd
rows 3 times more, then 2nd row once.
**11th to 20th rows:With MC, ch 3
(counts as dc). Miss first dc. 1 dc in
each dc across. T urn.
21st row:As 3rd row.
22nd to 29th rows:Rep 2nd and 3rd
rows 4 times.
30th row:As 2nd row.**
Rep from ** to ** twice more. Fasten
off.
Strip B(make 2)
With MC, ch 29.
1st row:(RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from
hook. 1 dc in each ch across. 27 dc.
T urn.
2nd to 10th rows:Ch 3 (counts as
dc). Miss first dc. 1 dc in each dc
across. T urn.
***11th row:With MC, ch 3 (counts
as dc). Miss first dc. 1 dc in each of
next 2 dc. *With A, 1 dc in each of
next 3 dc. With MC, 1 dc in each of
next 3 dc. Rep from * across, joining
A at end of last dc. T urn.
12th row:With A, ch 3 (counts as dc).
Miss first dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc.
*With MC, 1 dc in each of next 3 dc.
With A, 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep
from * across, joining MC at end of
last dc. T urn.
13th to 20th rows:Rep 11th and
12th rows 4 times more.
21st to 30th rows:With MC, ch 3
(counts as dc). Miss first dc. 1 dc in
each dc across. T urn.***
Rep from *** to *** twice more.
Fasten off.
Sew strips tog in the following
sequence: A, B, A, B, A.
Edging: 1st rnd:With RS of work
facing, join MC with sl st in top right
corner. Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp as last sl
st. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around,
having 3 sc in each corner. Join A with
sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:With A, ch 4 (counts as 1 dc
and ch 1). *Miss next sc. 1 dc in next
sc. Ch 1. Rep from * around, working
[(1 dc. Ch 1) twice. 1 dc] in each
corner sc. Join MC with sl st to 3rd ch
of ch 4. Break A.
3rd rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last
sl st. *1 hdc in next missed sc from 1st
rnd (working around ch-1 sp of 2nd
rnd). 1 sc in next dc. Rep from *
around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 12 sts = 4" (10 cm); 8 rows = 4" (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BLANKET Center
With A, ch 88.
Row 1 (right side):
Forward Pass: Working in back bars, insert hook in 2nd ch from hook, yarn over and pull up a loop, [insert hook in next ch, yarn over and pull up a loop] across; leaving all loops on hook, drop A—88 loops.
Return Pass: With B, working from left to right, yarn over and draw through first loop on hook, [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] across—88 Tss. 
Row 2: 
Forward Pass: [Skip next st, Tss in next st, Tss in skipped st] across, working Tss in last st; leaving all loops on hook, drop B.
Return Pass: With A, repeat Row 1 Return Pass.
Row 3: 
Forward Pass: Tss in next st, [skip next st, Tss in next st, Tss in skipped st] across to last 2 sts, Tss in next st, Tss in last st; leaving all loops on hook, drop A. 
Return Pass: Repeat Row 1 Return Pass—88 Tss.
Rows 4–59: Repeat last 2 rows 28 times. 
Row 60: Repeat Row 2.
Bind Off Row: Skip first st, [inserting hook as for Tss, sc in next st, inserting hook as for Tss, sc in skipped st*, skip next st] across to last 2 sts, ending last repeat at *, inserting hook as for Tss, sc in last 2 sts. Cut B.
Edging
First Side Edge: With A and working in ends of rows, skip Bind Off Row, sc in each row across—60 sc. Fasten off. 
Second Side Edge: With right side facing and working in ends of rows, join A with sc in end of Row 1, sc in each row across, slip st in end of Bind Off Row—60 sc.
BORDER
Top Border
Row 1: 
Forward Pass: With right side of Bind Off Row facing, insert hook in first st, pull up a loop with C, [insert hook in next st, yarn over and pull up a loop] across; leave all loops on hook—87 loops.
Return Pass: Working from left to right, yarn over and draw through first loop on hook, [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] across—87 Tss.
Row 2: 
Forward Pass: Insert hook in first horizontal bar, yarn over and pull up a loop, Tps in each st to last st, insert hook in last horizontal bar, yarn over and pull up a loop, Tss in last st; leave all loops on hook—89 loops.
Return Pass: Repeat Row 1 Return Pass.
Rows 3–5: Repeat Row 2—95 sts.
Bind Off Row: Slip st in horizontal bar of first st, inserting hook as for Tss, slip st in each vertical bar across, slip st in last horizontal bar, inserting hook as for Tss, slip st in last st. Fasten off.
Lower Border
With right side of first row of blanket facing and working Row 1 in opposite side of foundation ch, repeat Top Border.
Side Border (work twice)
Row 1: 
Forward Pass: With right side of side edge facing, insert hook in end of Row 1 of Lower Border, pull up a loop with C, insert hook in same st as last st worked in Row 1 of Lower Border, yarn over and pull up a loop, insert hook in first st of 2nd Side Edging, yarn over and pull up a loop, [insert hook in next st, yarn over and pull up a loop] across to Top Border, insert hook in same st as first st worked in Row 1 of Top Border, yarn over and pull up a loop, insert hook in end of Row 1 of Top Border, yarn over and pull up a loop; leave all loops on hook—64 loops.
Return Pass: Repeat Row 1 Return Pass of center—64 Tss.
Row 2: 
Forward Pass: Remove loop from hook, insert hook in end of next row of Lower Border, pick up loop and pull up to right side, working in previous row, Tps in first st, insert hook in next horizontal bar, yarn over and pull up a loop, Tps in each st across to last st, insert hook in next horizontal bar, yarn over and pull up a loop, Tps in last st, insert hook in end of next row of Top Border, yarn over and pull up a loop; leave all loops on hook—68 sts.
Return Pass: Repeat Row 1 Return Pass of center—68 sts.
Rows 3–5: Repeat Row 2—80 sts.
Bind Off Row: Remove loop from hook, insert hook in last bind off st of Lower Border, pick up loop and pull up to right side; working as for Tss, slip st in each Tss across. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Block to finished measurements.

instructions:
Pumpkin Face Throw
If you’re decorating for Halloween, make sure you have this crochet throw to complete your décor! The funny pumpkin faces are combined with the “BOO!” center square to give everyone happy memories of this fun season.

THROW
Pumpkin Square (make 5)
With B, ch 4, join with slip st in first ch.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as first dc throughout), 11 dc in ring, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—12 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, *[(2 dc, 1 tr) in next dc, (1 tr, 2 dc) in next dc] (corner), dc in next dc, repeat from * twice, (2 dc, 1 tr) in next dc, (1 tr, 2 dc) in next dc, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, *corner in next 2 tr, dc in next 5 dc, repeat from * twice, corner, dc in next 2 dc, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in next 4 dc, *corner in next 2 tr, dc in next 9 dc, repeat from * twice, corner in next 2 tr, dc in next 4 dc, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in each dc across to corner tr, *corner in next 2 tr, dc in each dc across to corner tr, repeat from * twice, corner in next 2 tr, dc in each remaining dc across, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Rounds 6–9: Repeat Round 5. Fasten off at end of last round.
Round 10: Join A in same st as last round join, repeat round 5. Fasten off.
Stripes Squares (make 4)
Rounds 1 & 2: With B, repeat rounds 1 and 2 of Pumpkin Square. Fasten off at end of last round.
Rounds 3–5: Join E in same st as last round join, repeat rounds 3–5 of Pumpkin Square. Fasten off at end of last round.
Rounds 6 & 7: Join D in same st as last round join, repeat round 5 of Pumpkin Square. Fasten off at end of last round.

Pumpkin Face #1
Eye (make 2)
Round 1: With A, ch 2, 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around—18 sc. Leaving long end, fasten off.

Nose
With A, ch 2.
Rounds 1 & 2: Repeat rounds 1 & 2 of Eyes—12 sc. Leaving long end, fasten off.

Mouth
With A, ch 12, join with slip st in first ch.
Round 1: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc), 23 hdc in ring, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2. Leaving long end, fasten off.

Eyebrow (make 2)
With A, ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, 2 sc in each of next 2 chs, sc in last 2 chs. Leaving long end, fasten off.

Pumpkin Face #2
Eye (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Round 2: [3 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 3 times—12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in next sc, [3 sc in next sc, sc next 3 sc] twice, 3 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc, join with slip st in first sc. Leaving long end, fasten off.

Pumpkin Face #3
Eye (make 2)
With A, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, tr in last st, ch 1, turn.
Row 2: Sc in next 5 sts, 3 sc in tip, working on opposite side of starting ch, sc in next 5 chs, ch 1, turn.
Row 3: Sc in next 6 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in remaining 6 sc. Leaving long end, fasten off.

Mouth
With A, ch 25.
Row 1: Dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in next 2 chs, [3 dc in next ch, dc in next ch, dc3tog, dc in next ch] 3 times, dc in last ch. Leaving long end, fasten off.

Pumpkin Face #4
Eye (make 2)
With A, ch 6.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 chs, 3 sc in last ch, working on opposite side of ch, work sc in next 3 chs, 2 sc in last ch—12 sc.
Round 2: 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next 2 sc—18 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around—24 sc. Leaving long end, fasten off.

Nose
With A, ch 4, join with slip st in first ch.
Row 1: Ch 3, 9 dc in ring, ch 1, turn—10 dc.
Row 2: 2 sc in next dc, sc in next 8 dc, 2 sc in last dc. Leaving long end, fasten off.

Mouth
With A, ch 21.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 chs, hdc in next 3 chs, dc in next 8 chs, hdc in next 3 chs, sc in remaining 3 chs. Leaving long end, fasten off.

BOO! (letters for center square)
Letter B
With A, ch 13.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, ch 9, turn.
Row 2: Skip next 5 sc, sc in next sc, ch 9, skip next 5 sc, sc in last sc, ch 1, turn.
Row 3: Sc in next sc, sc in next 9 chs, slip st in next sc, sc in next 9 chs, slip st in top of last st. Leaving long end, fasten off.

Letter O (make 2)
With A, ch 25, join with slip st in first ch.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in same ch as joining and each remaining ch around, join with slip st in first sc. Leaving long end, fasten off.

! (Top)
With A, ch 14.
Row 1: Hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in next 7 chs, sc in last 4 chs. Leaving long end, fasten off.

! (Bottom)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join with slip st in first sc. Leaving long end, fasten off.

ASSEMBLY
Using long ends, sew Faces to Squares as shown in diagram.
Sew Squares together through back loops only of Round 10 of Squares.

Border
Round 1: Join C with slip st in any dc on outside edge of throw, ch 3, dc in each st around, working 5 dc between 2 outside corner tr, join with slip st in first st. Fasten off and weave in ends.
Round 2: Join A with sc in any dc on Round 1, *skip next dc, 5 dc in next dc, skip next dc, sc in next dc, repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off and weave in ends.

Dtrfp Cluster = *(Yoh) 3 times and draw up a loop around post of marked stitch 2 rows below. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times. Repeat from * twice more around same marked st. Yoh and draw through all 4 loops on hook. Note: Always skip stitch directly behind Dtrfp Cluster on working row.

Ch 123 (multiple of 15 ch + 18).

Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – counts as beg dc2tog. (1 dc in next ch. 2 dc in next ch) twice. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch (PM on each of last 2 dc worked). (2 dc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch) twice. *Dc5tog over next 5 ch. (1 dc in next ch. 2 dc in next ch) twice. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch (PM on each of last 2 dc worked). (2 dc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch) twice. Rep from * to last 3 ch. Dc3tog over last 3 ch. Turn.
Set-up row 2: Ch 3. Skip first st. Beg dc2tog over next 2 sts. (1 dc in next st. 2 dc in next st) twice. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. *Dc5tog over next 5 sts. (1 dc in next st. 2 dc in next st) twice. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Dc3tog over last 3 sts. Turn.
Proceed in pat as follows:
1st row: (RS). Ch 3. Skip first st. Beg dc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 dc in next st. 2 dc in next st. Dtrfp Cluster around post of next marked st 2 rows below. Skip next st on working row (behind Dtrfp Cluster). Working behind Dtrfp Cluster, 2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts (PM on each of last 2 dc worked). 2 dc in next st. Dtrfp Cluster around post of next marked st 2 rows below. Skip next st on working row (behind Dtrfp Cluster). 2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st. *Dc5tog over next 5 sts. 1 dc in next st. 2 dc in next st. Dtrfp Cluster around post of next marked st 2 rows below. Skip next st on working row (behind Dtrfp Cluster). 2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts (PM on each of last 2 dc worked). Working behind Dtrfp Cluster, 2 dc in next st. Dtrfp Cluster around post of next marked st 2 rows below. Skip next st on working row (behind Dtrfp Cluster). 2 dc in next st.1 dc in next st. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Dc3tog over last 3 sts. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. Skip first st. Beg dc2tog over next 2 sts. (1 dc in next st. 2 dc in next st) twice. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. *Dc5tog over next 5 sts. (1 dc in next st. 2 dc in next st) twice. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Dc3tog over last 3 sts. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows for pat until work from beg measures approx 62" [157.5 cm], ending on a 1st row. Fasten off.
Tassels (make 18): Wind yarn around a piece of cardboard 5½" [14 cm] wide 20 times. Tie through loops securely at one end. Cut loops on opposite end. Wrap yarn 3 times around Tassel 1" [2.5 cm] down from tied end. Fasten securely. Trim ends evenly. Sew 1 Tassel centered at each point, along top and bottom edges of Afghan having 1 Tassel in each corner.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 3 skeins 330 Linen A
abbreviations: A, B, etc. = Color A, Color B, etc.
* = Repeat directions following * as many times as indicated
[ ] = Repeat directions inside brackets as many times as indicated
gauge: 13 sc and 15 sc rows = 4”. 13 dc and 4.5 dc rows = 4”.
instructions:
How to Make a gauge Swatch
With any color, ch 14.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each rem ch across—13 sc.
Rows 2-15: Ch 1, turn; sc in each sc across. Swatch should measure approx 4” square. Adjust hook size if necessary to obtain correct gauge.
NOTES
1. When working with multiple color sections across a row, do not carry colors under sts. Instead, make bobbins (small, separate balls of yarn) for each color section, and join them as needed.
2. To change colors, work last st of old color until 2 loops remaining on hook, yo with new color and draw through both loops on hook. Drop old color to wrong side of work to be picked up again on next row.
3. Fasten off any colors not being used on next row.
THROW
With A, ch 138. 
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—137 sc (Row 1 of chart complete). 
Rows 2-64: Work in sc and dc following chart. Work all even-numbered rows from A to B, then work from C to B once, then work from C to D, turn. Work all odd-numbered rows from D to C, then work from B to C, then work from B to A, turn.
Rows 65-172: Repeat Rows 11-64 twice.
Rows 173-182: Repeat Rows 11-20. 
Row 183: With A, ch 1, turn; sc in each st across. 
Rows 184-192: Repeat Rows 2-10. At end of Row 192, fasten off. 
Finishing
Weave in all ends.

abbreviations: Mosaic Dc = Working in front of chain spaces, work 1 dc in skipped sc 3 rows below
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions: Notes: • Each skipped sc has ch-2 worked above it for 2 rows. Rnd 3: Ch 3, dc in ch-2 sp; ch 1, with wrong sides together sc in ch-3 sp on first motif, ch 1, dc in same ch-2 sp on 2nd motif, dc in next 2 dc; sc in next ch-1 sp, skip next dc on motif in progress – join made; dc in next 3 dc, join, 3 dc in ch-4 sp, ch 2, sc in ch-5 sp on first motif, ch 2, 3 dc in same ch-4 sp on 2nd motif; complete same as first motif – 1 side joined.

instructions:

Paint eyes on face with green, let dry, then paint center of eye with black. Paint nose with black, let dry, then paint whiskers with glow. Paint mouth with red. Sew Bat faces on Throw according to diagram.

Round 2: Ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook – picot, skip join, skip next sc, slip st in next 3 sc, work picot, skip next sc, slip st in each st around. Fasten off.

Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.

Fasten off. There are a total of 11 color blocks in each strip.
Strips 2, 4, 6, 8 (Make 4): With A, ch 16.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 15 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.

Sew strips together following assembly diagram. Weave in ends.

Rounds 2 and 3 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, sc in each sc around and work 3 sc in center corner sc; join to first sc. TURN at end of Round 3.
Round 4: *Ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, skip next sc, slip st in next 2 sc; repeat from * around. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® "Soft Yarn™": 2 Balls 4601 Off White A

instructions:
AFGHAN: Work 35 Motifs—9 Motifs each with C, D and E and 8 Motifs with F. Instructions are for C Motif. Changes for D, E and F are in parentheses).

MOTIF: With B ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rnd 1(RS): Ch 1, work 8 sc into ring; join with a slip st in first sc; fasten off.

Rnd 2: Join A with a dc in any st; pc in same st, ch 3, * pc in next sc, ch 3; repeat from * 6 times; join with a slip st in first pc; fasten off – 8 pc.

Rnd 3: Join C (D, E, F) in any ch-3 sp, ch 5, 3 dc in same space, * 3 dc in next ch-3 sp, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next sp—corner made, repeat from * twice, 3 dc in next ch-3 space, 2 dc in beginning ch-2 sp, join with a slip st in third ch of beginning ch-5 – 9 dc on each side.

Rnd 4: Slip st in ch-2 space, ch 5, (dc, ch 1, dc) in same space, ch 1, sk next dc, [dc in next dc, ch 1, sk next dc] 4 times, * (dc, ch 1, dc, ch 2, dc, ch 1, dc) in next ch-2 space, ch 1, sk next dc, [dc in next dc, ch 1, sk next dc] 4 times; repeat from * around, dc, ch 1 in beginning ch-2 space, join with a slip st in third ch of beginning ch-5.

Rnd 5: Slip st in ch-2 space, ch 3, (dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in same space, 2 dc in each ch-1 space to corner ch-2 space, * (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in corner ch-2 space, 2 dc in each ch-1 space across to corner, repeat from * around, join with a slip st in third ch of beginning ch-3; fasten off – 18 dc on each side.

Rnd 6: Join A in any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, * (sc, ch 2, sc) in ch-2 space, sc in each of next 5 dc, * dtr in middle dc of 3-dc group in Row 3, sk next dc on Row 5, sc in each of next 2 dc on Row 5, (tr, ch 1, tr) into same middle dc of 3-dc group in Row 3, sk next 2 dc on Row 5, sc in each of next 2 dc on Row 5, dtr into same middle dc of 3-dc group in Row 3, sk next dc on Row 5, sc in each of next 5 dc on Row 5; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in first sc.

Rnd 7: Slip st in ch-2 space, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same ch-2 space, * [sk 3 sc, 3 dc in next sc, sk 2 sc, 3 dc in dtr, sk 2 sc and tr, 3 dc in ch-1 space between 2 tr, sk 2 sc, 3 dc in dtr, sk 2 sc, 3 dc in next sc, sk 3 sc **, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in ch-2 space] 3 times; repeat from * to ** one more time, join with a slip st in third ch of beginning ch-3; fasten off.

Rnd 8: Join B with a slip st in any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, * (sc, ch 2, sc) in ch-2 space, ch 1, sk next dc, sc in next dc, ch 1, sk next dc, [sc in space between 3-dc groups, ch 1, sk next dc, sc in next sc, ch 1, sk next dc] 6 times; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in first sc; fasten off.

ASSEMBLY: Motifs are joined using B on WS, using Assembly Diagram as guide. Vertical Seams: Using B, begin at lower right edge of afghan chart, with RS of Motifs to be joined facing, join yarn with a slip st through both Motifs in corner ch-2 space, ch 1, sc in same space, * [ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space of both Motifs] 14 times, ch 1, sc in ch-2 space, ch 1, do not fasten off, holding next 2 Motifs with RS facing, sc in corner ch-2 space, repeat from * across all Motifs in row; fasten off. Continue to join all Motifs in vertical rows as shown in diagram.

Horizontal Seams: Join horizontal seams in same manner.

BORDER: Rnd 1: Join B with a slip st in ch-2 space of any corner, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in ch-2 corner space, ch 1, [sc in next ch-1 space, ch 1] 12 times, * sc in ch-2 space, ch 1, sc in ch-2 space of next Motif, ch 1, [sc in next ch-1 space, ch 1] 12 times **; repeat from * to ** to corner ch-2 space, (sc, ch 2, sc) in ch-2 corner space; repeat around, join with a slip st in first sc; fasten off.

Rnd 2: Join A in any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, * (sc, ch 3, sc) in ch-2 space, ch 3, [sc in next ch-1 space, ch 3] across to next ch-2 space, repeat from * across to next corner ch-2 space, repeat around, join with a slip st in first sc, slip st in ch-2 sp.

Rnd 3: Ch 1, * (sc, ch 2, sc) in corner ch-2 space, ch 1, [sc in ch-3 space, ch 1] across to next corner ch-2 space, repeat from * around, join with a slip st in first sc.

Rnd 4: Slip st in ch-2 space, ch 1, sc in next sc, ch 3, * sc in corner ch-2 space, ch 3, [sc in sc, ch 3] across to corner ch-2 space, repeat from * around, join with a slip st in first sc; fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 3 skeins 0380 Windsor Blue A
abbreviations: A,B,C,D = Color A, B, C, D

gauge: Motif 9” x 12”. Central hexagon = 2.5” across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain gauge.
instructions:
Rnd 1 - Central Hexagon
Ch 4, slip st in fourth ch from hook to form a ring.
Rnd 1: (ch 1 optional) 6 scs in ring, slip st in first sc. (6 scs)
Rnd 2: Ch 3, (counts as first dc) 2 dcs in same sc, (ch 3, 3 dcs in next sc) 5 times. Ch 3. Slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off. (18 dcs, 6 ch-3 spaces)

Rnd 2 - Two Side Petals
First petal: Ch 4, place tail of chains from front to back in any ch-3 corner on hexagon. Slip st in fourth ch from hook to form a ring. Ch 1, (optional ch 1) 6 scs in ring, slip st in first sc to join the rnd. Ch 2, slip st in the next ch-3 corner to the right on hexagon. (1st dc made.) 2 dcs in same sc on petal. Ch 3. 3 dcs in next sc, ch 3. 2 dcs in next sc, begin 1 more dc in same sc, but before you yarn over the second time, insert hook in ch-3 corner to the left on hexagon, yo, and pull through all 3 loops on hook. (modified dc). Fasten off. (9 dcs and 2 ch-3 spaces)

Second petal: Ch 4, place tail of chains from front to back in ch-3 corner on hexagon that is directly across from center of first petal. Slip st in first ch to form a ring. (ch 1, optional). 6 scs in ring, slip st in first sc to join the rnd. Ch 2, slip st in the next ch-3 corner to the right on hexagon. (1st dc made.)  2 dcs in same sc on petal. Ch 3. 3 dcs in next sc, ch 3. 2 dcs in next sc, begin 1 more dc in same sc, but before you yarn over the second time, insert hook in ch-3 corner to the left on hexagon, yo, and pull through all 3 loops on hook. Fasten off. (9 dcs and 2 ch-3 spaces)

Rnd 3 - Small Oval Border
Join with sc in right corner ch-3 space of either petal.  3 scs in same space, sc in next 3 dcs, 4 scs in ch-3 corner space, sc in next 3 dcs, 2 scs in ch-3 space of hexagon.  Sc in next 3 dcs on hexagon, 2 scs in ch-3 space on hexagon. On petal, sc in next 3 dcs, 4 scs in ch-3 space.  Sc in next 3 dcs, 4 scs in ch-3 space, sc in next 3 dcs.  2 scs in ch-3 space on hexagon. Sc in next 3 dcs on hexagon, 2 scs in ch-3 space on hexagon. Sc in next 3 dcs on petal. Slip st in first sc. Fasten off.  (48 scs) 

Rnd 4
Join with sc in 4th sc of a corner.  (ch 3, skip 1 sc, sc in next sc) 23 times. Ch 3. Slip st in first sc. Fasten off. (24 ch-3 loops)

Rnd 5
Join with sc in any ch-3 loop, (ch 3, sc in next loop) 23 times. Ch 3, slip st in first sc. Fasten off. (24 ch-3 loops) 

Rnd 6 - Petal Row
First petal: Ch 4. Place tail from front to back through the middle ch-3 loop of a short side. Slip st to form a ring.  6 Scs in ring. Slip st in first sc to join rnd. Ch 2, slip st in ch-3 loop immediately to the right. (1st dc made).  2 dcs in same sc on petal. Ch 2. 3 dcs in next sc on petal, ch 2. 2 dcs in next sc on petal. Begin last dc in same sc, but before you yarn over the second time, insert hook in ch-3 loop immediately to the left. Pull through all 3 loops on hook. Fasten off. (9 dcs and 2 ch-2 spaces)

Second-twelfth petals: Follow instructions for the first petal with these placements: place the second and following petals in the next unused ch-3 loop to the left. Anchor it with slip st to the right in the ch-3 loop to the right where the previous petal fastened off. Anchor each petal to the left with the modified dc in the next ch-3 loop immediately to the left.

Rnd 7 - Petal Border
Join D with sc in any ch-2 right corner of any petal.  2 scs in same space. (*Sc in next 3 dcs, 3 scs in ch-2 space, sc in next 2 dcs, in last dc and 1st dc of next petal, sc dec, sc in next 2 dcs,*  3 scs in ch-2 space.) 11 times. Repeat from * to * 1 time. Slip st in first sc. Fasten off. (168 sts)

Rnd 8
Join A with sc in the third sc of a sc-3 right corner of a petal. Sc in next 4 scs, (*ch 2, skip 2 scs, work 1st half of a dc dec in next sc, skip 3 scs, work second half of the dc dec in next sc, ch 2*. Skip 2 scs, sc in next 5 scs) 11 times. Repeat from * to * 1 time. Slip st in first sc. Fasten off. (120 sts)

Rnd 9 - Corner Super Petals
Ch 4, in a corner of the motif, place tail from front to back around both posts of blue dc dec on the previous round.  Slip st to form a ring. (Ch 1, optional). 6 scs in ring.  Slip st in first sc to join rnd. Ch 3, anchor with slip st to the right in the 5th sc to the right. 2 tr in same sc on petal, ch 2. 3 tr in next sc, ch 2. 2 tr in next sc. The final anchoring tr is worked as follows: yo twice, insert hook into same sc on petal, (yo and pull thru 2 loops) twice. Insert hook in 5th sc to the left, yo, pull through remaining loops. Fasten off. (9 trs and 2 ch-2 spaces)
Skip two dc decs (on the blue A rnd), and place the second petal around the next dc dec.

Rnd 10
Join D with sc in right ch-2 corner space of any super petal. Sc in same space, *sc in next tr, 3 scs in next (middle) tr, sc in next tr, 2 scs in ch-2 space, sc in next 3 trs. With Wrong sides facing each other, and D, join with sc, and sc in inside loops only of every st, matching corresponding sts on each motif. Make 6 rows of 6 motifs each alternate Motifs A and B throughout.

FPdc around first unused tr to the left of the corner.  Repeat in pattern  Repeat from * to * for each corner. Slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4. Fasten off. (360 FPdcs)

At corner *2 scs in slip st, 2 scs in each of next 4 sts, 3 scs in middle sc of sc-3 corner, 2 scs in each of next 5 sts.* Repeat in pattern for all four sides. Slip st in first st. Fasten off. With right side facing, join A in a ch-2 space to the left of any joining seam.

Row 2: Ch 1, dec, sc to last 2 sc, dec; turn – 12 sc.
Row 3: Repeat Row 2 – 10 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 5: Repeat Row 2 – 8 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, dec, sc in last 3 sc; turn – 7 sc.

Row 3: Ch 1, skip first sc, dec, sc to last 3 sc, dec; turn – 27 sc.
Rows 4 and 5: Repeat Row 3 – 23 sc at end of Row 4 and 19 sc at end of Row 5.
Rows 6-11: Ch 1, dec, sc to last 2 sc; dec; turn – 7 sc at end of Row 11.
Row 12: Ch 1, dec, skip next sc, shell in next sc, skip next sc, dec. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

Assembly
Arrange Squares 1 and 2 following diagram, noting the direction of the fans.
After the first square, all others are joined while working the Square Edging.

Square Edging
With right side facing, join A in center dc of bottom or top corner shell or in dc at beginning or end of Top Corner Row 1; ch 4, slip st in same dc, * ch 2, work [slip st, ch 2] 12 times evenly spaced to next corner **; (slip st, ch 4, slip st) all in next corner; repeat from * around, end at **. Fasten off. There will be 13 ch-2 spaces between each corner ch-4 space.

To Join Squares
Join on 1 or 2 sides as necessary in ch-4 spaces and ch-2 spaces while working Square Edging.
To join a ch-2 space = ch 1, drop loop from hook, insert hook from right side into corresponding space and into dropped loop, draw loop through, ch 1.

Increases are made by working into the top of the indicated stitch and then by working around the post of the same stitch. 3. Rounds 1–6 of blanket are the owl’s body. Owl’s body parts, branches, leaves, and flowers are worked separately and sewn to blanket. Leave long tails for sewing when fastening off. 4. When sewing pieces to blanket, insert the needle horizontally through the top of the stitches on the right side of the blanket so your stitching doesn’t show on the wrong side.
