materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 4 skeins 931 Seagrass A, 2 skeins 668 Honeydew B, 5 skeins 320 Cornmeal C.
abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: Blocks measure 8” x 8”. First 7 rounds = 5” across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
THROW
Floral Block (Make 30)
With A, ch 5; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, [sc in ring, ch 3] 8 times; do NOT join.
Round 2: [(Sc, 3 dc, sc) all in next ch-3 space] 8 times; do not join – 8 petals made.
Round 3: Working behind petals of previous round, sc in first sc of Round 1, ch 4, [sc in next sc of Round 1, ch 4] 7 times; do not join.
Round 4: [(Sc, dc, 3 tr, dc, sc) all in next ch-4 space] 8 times; join with a slip st to first sc – 8 petals made. Fasten off.
Round 5: Working behind petals of previous round, join B in first sc of Round 3; ch 1, sc in first sc of Round 3, ch 5, [sc in next sc of Round 3, ch 5] 7 times; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 6: * (Sc, dc, 2 tr, ch 3, 2 tr, dc, sc) all in next ch-5 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-5 space, ch 3 **; repeat from * around, end at **; join in first sc – 4 corner shells made. Fasten off.
Round 7: Join C in ch-3 space of any corner shell; ch 3 (counts as first dc), (3 dc, ch 2, 4 dc) all in corner ch-3 space, * skip next 3 sts, 2 tr in next sc, 2 tr in next ch-3 space, skip next sc, 2 tr in next ch-3 space, 2 tr in next sc, skip next 3 sts **, (4 dc, ch 2, 4 dc) all in next corner ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join with a slip st in top of ch-3.
Rounds 8 and 9: Ch 3, dc in each st around and work (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in each corner ch-2 space; join in top of ch-3 – 24 dc between ch-2 spaces at end of Round 9. Fasten off at end of Round 9.
Round 10: Join B around the post of 2nd dc after the corner space 2 rounds below (Round 8); ch 1, sc around post of same dc, working in Round 8 around, * [ch 5, skip next dc, sc around post of next dc] 9 times, ch 5, skip ch-2 space, skip next dc **, sc around post of next dc; repeat from * around, end at **; join in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 11: Join A in corner ch-5 space of Round 10 AND corner ch-2 space of Round 9 together; ch 1, * working through both corner ch-5 space of Round 10 and corner ch-2 space of Round 9, (sc, ch 2, sc) in corner space, sc in next 3 dc of Round 9, [ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next ch-5 space of Round 10 and next dc of Round 9 together] 9 times, sc in next 3 dc; repeat from * around; join in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 12: Join C in any sc; ch 1, sc in each st and ch-1 space around and work (sc, ch 2, sc) all in each corner ch-2 space; join in first sc – 28 sc between corner ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Assembly
With C, slip st Blocks together 5 wide x 6 long, using back loop of each corresponding st of Round 12, making sure that each junction of four blocks and all other corners are evenly spaced so design will not be distorted.
Border
Join C in first sc after corner ch-2 space on a short side.
Round 1: Ch 3, dc in each sc around and work 2 dc in each joining seam and 5 dc in each corner ch-2 space; join in top of ch-3.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in each dc around and work 5 dc in 3rd dc of each corner 5-dc group; join.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in next 25 dc, skip next 3 dc, 9 tr in next dc, * skip next 3 dc, dc in next 23 dc, skip next 3 dc, 9 tr in next dc *; repeat from * to * twice more; ** skip next 3 dc, dc in next 26 dc, skip next 3 dc, 9 tr in next dc, skip next 3 dc, dc in next 27dc, skip next 3 dc, 9 tr in next dc; repeat from * to * 4 times; skip next 3 dc, dc in next 26 dc, skip next 3 dc, 9 tr in next dc, skip next 3 dc **, dc in next 27 dc, skip next 3 dc, 9 tr in next dc; repeat from * to * 3 times; repeat from ** to **; dc in next dc; join.
Round 4: Slip st in next 2 dc, ch 3, dc in next 21 dc, * skip next 2 dc, 2 dc in next tr, dc in next 3 tr, 3 dc in next tr, dc in next 3 tr, 2 dc in next tr, skip next 2 dc, dc in next 19 dc *; repeat from * to * 3 times more; dc in next 3 dc, ** skip next 2 dc, 2 dc in next tr, dc in next 3 tr, 3 dc in next tr, dc in next 3 tr, 2 dc in next tr, skip next 2 dc, dc in next 23 dc; repeat from * to * 5 times; dc in next 3 dc, skip next 2 dc, 2 dc in next tr, dc in next 3 tr, 3 dc in next tr, dc in next 3 tr, 2 dc in next tr, skip next 2 dc **, dc in next 23 dc; repeat from * to * 4 times; dc in next 3 dc; repeat from ** to **; dc in next dc; join.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join. Fasten off. 
Round 6: Join B around post of beginning ch-3 of Round 4 in upper right hand corner; ch 1, sc around post of same dc, * ch 5, skip next dc of Round 4, sc around post of next dc of Round 4; repeat from * around; join in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 7: Join A in first dc to the left of beginning ch-3 of Round 5; ch 1, sc in ch-5 space of Round 6 AND in same st as joining together, * ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next ch-5 space of Round 6 and next dc of Round 5 together; repeat from * around; ch 1; join.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in first sc, * sc in next ch-1 space, ch 3, slip st in last sc made **, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, end at **; join. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Blanket Stripes™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Main Color (MC) Foggy Shores (76021) 6 balls or 1300 yds/1184 m
Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Contrast A Dark Gray (10044) 2 balls or 300 yds/273 m
Size U.S. M/13 (9 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 8 sts and 6.5 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Note: Blanket is worked in 5 Panels using 4 shades of striping yarn (MC). Vertical surface slip st rows are worked after Panels are complete.

PANEL 1
With MC, beg with complete stripe of shade shown on diagram on page 2 (Color 1), ch 20.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. (Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in next ch) 4 times. Ch 1. Skip next ch and place marker on skipped ch. (1 sc in next ch. Ch 1. Skip next ch) 4 times. 1 sc in last ch. Turn. 19 sts.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.

3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.

Rep 2nd and 3rd rows for pat. Work a further 7 rows in pat (10 rows in total). Break Color 1. Join Color 2 at beg of complete stripe. 
With Color 2, work 10 rows in pat. Break Color 2. Join Color 3 at beg of complete stripe.
With Color 3, work 10 rows in pat. Break Color 3. Join Color 4 at beg of complete stripe.
With Color 4, work 10 rows in pat. Break Color 4. Join Color 1 at beg of complete stripe.
With Color 1, work 10 rows in pat. Break Color 1. Join Color 2 at beg of complete stripe.
With Color 2, work 10 rows in pat. Break Color 2. Join Color 3 at beg of complete stripe.
With Color 3, work 10 rows in pat. Break Color 3. Join Color 4 at beg of complete stripe.
With Color 4, work 10 rows in pat. Break Color 4. Join Color 1 at beg of complete stripe.
With Color 1, work 10 rows in pat. Break Color 1. Join Color 2 at beg of complete stripe.
With Color 2, work 10 rows in pat. Fasten off.

PANELS 2 to 5
Following shade changes shown on diagram, work as for Panel 1.

Vertical Surface Slip Stitch: (RS). Beg in marked ch at lower edge of each Panel, join 2 strands of A with sl st in marked ch. Keeping yarn at back (WS) of work, sl st into each ch-1 sp in alternate rows above joining sp to create a straight vertical chain of surface sl sts to top edge. Fasten off.

Note: Take care to sl st loosely to avoid pulling in work. 

Panel Edging: Work Panel Edging along sides of Panels 1 to 5 as indicated on diagram (outer edging of Panel 1 and Panel 5 will be completed after Panels are joined).
With RS facing, join A with sl st at lower or top corner of Panel. Work 1 row of sc evenly down side edge. Fasten off.

Note: Take care to work same number of sc along each side edge for neat joining.

Join Panels: Place WS of Panels 1 and 2 tog. Beg at top edge of Blanket, join A with sl st through both corresponding sc from Panel Edging. Taking care to work sts loosely to avoid pulling in Panels, work 1 row of slip st through both thicknesses to join Panels.

Rep to join rem Panels, noting all joining rows beg at top edge of Blanket to insure the joining rows are all worked in the same direction.

Outer Edging: 1st rnd: (RS). Join A with sl st at top right corner of Blanket. Work 1 rnd of sc around outer edge, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. Taking care to work sts loosely, work 1 slip st in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat ® Super Value (Solids: 197 g/7 oz) (389 m / 426 yds)
2 balls each of: Contrast A: (# 077 97 Damson)
O R O mbres (251 m / 275 yds) / Twists (280 m / 307 yds): 142 g/5 oz
3 balls each of: A, B, C, D, E and F.
Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 14 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
With A, ch 59.
1st rnd: (RS). 2 dc in 3rd ch from hook. (Ch 1. Miss next 3 ch. 3 dc in next ch) 13 times. Ch 1. Miss next 3 ch. [(3 dc. Ch 3) twice. 3 dc] in last ch. Working along other side of ch, (Ch 1. Miss next 3 ch. 3 dc in next ch) 13 times. Ch 1. Miss next 3 ch. (3 dc. Ch 3) twice in last ch. Join B with sl st to top of ch 3.
2nd rnd: With B, sl st in each of first 2 sts. Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 2 dc in same ch-1 sp as last sl st. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) 13 times. (Ch 1. 3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc in next ch-3 sp) twice. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) 14 times. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in each of next 2 ch-3 sps. Ch 1. Join C with sl st to top of ch 3.
3rd rnd: With C, sl st in each of first 2 sts. Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 2 dc in same ch-1 sp as last sl st. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) 14 times. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) 15 times. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Join D with sl st to top of ch 3.
Continue rnds as before, working (Ch 1. 3 dc) in ch-1 sps and (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in ch-3 corner sps, changing color every rnd in following sequence: D, E, F, A, B, C, D until blanket measures approx 60 ins [152.5 cm] wide. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Freesia™ (7.9 oz/225 g ; 309 yds/282 m)
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next indicated stitch or space. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 10 sc and 11 rows = 4" (10 cm).
instructions:
Stripe Pat
With A, work 3 rows.
With B, work 1 row.
With C, work 2 rows.
With B, work 1 row.
These 7 rows form Stripe Pat.
BLANKET
With A, ch 138 (multiple of 17 ch + 2). See diagram on page 2.
Foundation row: (WS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. (Dc2tog over next 2 ch) twice. Ch 1. (1 dc in next ch. Ch 1) 5 times. *(Dc2tog over next 2 ch) 6 times. Ch 1. (1 dc in next ch. Ch 1) 5 times. Rep from * to last 6 ch. (Dc2tog over next 2 ch) 3 times. Turn.

Proceed in pat as follows:
1st row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). Skip first st. 1 dc into next st. (Dc2tog over next st and ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. (1 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1) twice. *(Dc2tog over next ch-1 sp and next st) twice. (Dc2tog over next 2 sts) twice. (Dc2tog over next st and next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. (1 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1) twice. Rep from * to last 2 ch-1 sps. (Dc2tog over next ch-1 sp and next st) twice. Dc2tog over next 2 sts. Turn. Leave last ch-3 unworked.
Rep last row for pat. First 2 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, cont in pat until 59 rows in total of Stripe Pat have been worked, ending with 3 rows of Contrast A.
Fasten off.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver Ombre™ (10 oz/283 g; 482 yds/440 m) Sweet Treat (4975) 6 balls
Size U.S. I/9 [5.5 mm] crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Dc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
gauge: 12 dc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Ch 3 counts as dc at beg of rnd.
HEXAGON  (make 17) See diagram on page 4.
Ch 5. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 5 (counts as 1 tr. Ch 1). (1 tr in ring. Ch 1) 11 times. Join with sl st to 4th ch of ch-5.
2nd rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 1 dc in ch-1 sp. Ch 1. *2 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. 24 dc and 12 ch-1 sps.

3rd rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Skip next dc. *2 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Skip next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in top of ch-3. 36 dc and 12 ch-1 sps.

4th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 1 dc in ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 1. Skip next dc. *2 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 2. Skip next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. 48 dc and 12 ch-1 sps. [12 groups of 4 dc each, separated by ch-1 sps]

5th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 1 dc in ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Ch 1. Skip next dc. *2 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Ch 1. Skip next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in top of ch-3.

6th to 8th rnds: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 1 dc in ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each dc to 1 dc before next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next dc. *2 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each dc to 1 dc before ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. 96 dc (12 groups of 8 dc each and 12 ch-1 sps at end of 8th rnd.)

9th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 8 dc. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 8 dc. *(1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch-1 sp (Hexagon Point made). 1 dc in each of next 8 dc. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 8 dc. Rep from * around. 1 dc in first ch-1 sp of rnd. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. (Last Hexagon Point made). 108 dc (6 groups of 18 dc each and 6 ch-1 sps).

10th rnd:  Sl st to next ch-1 sp. Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each of next 8 dc. Hdc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 8 dc. (1 hdc. Ch 1. 1 hdc) in next ch-1 sp. 1 hdc in each of next 8 dc. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 8 dc. Rep from * around. 1 hdc in same ch-1 sp as beg ch-2. Ch 1. Join with sl st to top of ch-2. 114 hdc (6 groups of 19 hdc each and 6 ch-1 sps).

11th rnd:  Sl st to next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 1 dc in each of 19 hdc. *(1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 19 sc. Rep from * around. 1 dc in same ch-1 sp as beg ch-3. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.

HALF HEXAGON  (make 2) See diagram on page 5.
Ch 5. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st row: (RS). Ch 5 (counts as 1 tr. Ch 1). (1 tr in ring. Ch 1) 5 times. 1 tr in ring. 7 tr and 6 ch-1 sps. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. (2 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) 5 times. 2 dc in last ch-1 sp. 1 dc in 4th ch of ch-5. 14 dc and 5 ch-1 sps. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. [ (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch-1 sp – Hexagon Point made. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc] twice. 1 dc in last dc. Turn. 21 dc and 2 ch-1 sps.
4th row: Ch 3. 2 dc in next dc. [1 dc in each dc to next ch-1 sp. (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch-1 sp] twice. 1 dc in each st to last 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in last dc. Turn.
5th to 7th rows: Ch 3. 2 dc in next d. [1 dc in each dc to next ch-1 sp. (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch-1 sp] twice. 1 dc in each dc to last 2 sts. 2 dc in next st. 1 dc in last st. Turn. 45 dc and 2 ch-1 sps.

8th row:  Ch 2. 2 hdc in next dc. [1 hdc in each st to next ch-1 sp. (1 hdc. Ch 1. 1 hdc) in ch-1 sp] twice. 1 hdc in each st to last 2 sts. 2 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in last st. Turn. 51 hdc and 2 ch-1 sps.

9th row:  Ch 3. 2 dc in next hdc. [1 dc in each hdc to next ch-1 sp. (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch-1 sp] twice. 1 dc in each hdc to last 2 sts. 2 dc in next hdc. 1 dc in last hdc. Turn. 57 dc and 2 ch-1 sps.

10th row: Ch 4 (counts as tr). 2 tr in next dc. [1 tr in each dc to next ch-1 sp. (1 tr. Ch 1. 1 tr) in next ch-1 sp] twice. 1 tr in each dc to last 2 sts. 2 tr in next st. 1 tr in last st. Turn. 63 dc and 2 ch-1 sps.

Fasten off.
FINISHING
With RS facing, arrange Hexagons and Half Hexagons as shown in Assembly Diagram and sew tog.

Border
1st rnd: (RS). Draw up a loop in any outer corner ch-1 sp. Ch 3. Work rnd of dc evenly around entire outer edge of Blanket, as follows:
1. Work 1 dc in each dc.
2. Work dc evenly spaced across edge of Half Hexagons.
3. At each inner corner (where 2 hexagons meet), work to 1 dc before first ch-1 sp, work dc2tog over dc and ch-1 sp. Skip seam, work dc2tog over next ch-1 sp and dc.
4. Work (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in each outer corner ch-1 sp.
5. At end of rnd, work dc in same ch-1 sp as first st. Ch 1. Join with sl st in top of beg ch. Fasten off.

2nd rnd: (RS). Draw up a loop in any outer corner ch-1 sp. Ch 2. Work hdc around as follows:
1. Work 1 hdc in each dc.
2. At each inner corner, work to 1 st before first corner dc2tog. (Hdc2tog) twice. Turn.
3. Work (1 hdc. Ch 1. 1 hdc) in each outer corner ch-1 sp.
4. At end of rnd, work hdc in same ch-1 sp as sl st. Ch 1. Join with sl st in top of beg ch.

3rd rnd: Ch 2. Work same as 2nd rnd, working in dc instead of hdc.
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 reverse sc in each st around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Classic Crochet Size 10 (400 yds; 365.76 m) Main Color (MC) Natural (0226) 1 ball
Aunt Lydia’s® Metallic Crochet Size 10 (100 yds; 91.4 m) Contrast A White/Silver (0015) 1 ball
Susan Bates® Steelite® crochet hook U.S. 7-8 (1.5-1.6 mm) or size needed to obtain gauge.
Beads or black floss for eyes.
Small amount of poly fiberfill to stuff.
abbreviations: Picot = Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
gauge: 38 sc x 40 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
TIP from designer: 
Use the trick quilters use to bury their knots when hand quilting. Make a knot close to the surface of the work and pull the knot into the interior and out the other side. Trim thread close to exit point.
Notes:  
• Nose, head and body are worked in one piece.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
Beg at Nose, with A, make Magic Loop.
1st rnd: 6 sc in magic loop. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc. Fasten off A.
3rd rnd: Join MC with sl st to back loop of any sc. Ch 1. 1 scbl in same sp as sl st and each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. 16 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. 20 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. 24 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. 30 sc.
9th to 19th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 30 sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join. 24 sts.
Stuff Body.
21st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Join. 18 sts. 
22nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Join. 12 sts. 
Finish stuffing. 
23rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 6 sts. Fasten off, leaving an end 12-18" [30.5–45.5 cm] long. Thread end through front loops of rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely. 
TAIL
With MC, ch 9. 
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. 8 sc. 
Fasten off.
EARS (Make 2)
With MC, ch 5. 
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn. 3 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 2 sts.
4th row: Ch 2. Skip first sc. 1 hdc in next sc. Fasten off. 
Sew Ears to head as shown in picture. 
LEGS (make 4)
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.

2nd rnd: Join MC with sl st to back loop of any sc. Ch 2. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in same sp as sl st and each sc around. Join. 8 hdc. 
Fasten off, leaving an end 12-18" [30.5–45.5 cm] long for sewing Legs to Body.   
Stuff Legs.
WINGS (make 2)
With A, ch 6, leaving a long end. 
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 5 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. Skip next sc. 5 dc in next sc. Skip next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 9 sts.   
3rd row: Picot. Skip first sc. *Sl st in next sc. Picot. Skip next st. Rep from * to last sc. Sl st in last sc. Fasten off. 
TIPS from designer: 
• Remove the metallic wrap from the Tail to make threading the needle and sewing easier.
FINISHING 
Sew Tail as shown in picture. 
Sew Legs as shown in picture.
Sew Wings to Back as shown in picture.
Sew on 2 black beads for eyes as shown in picture. 
Optional: With black embroidery floss embroider eyes using French Knot.

materials: Red Heart® With Love® Solids (7 oz/198 g; 370 yds/338 m)
Size U.S. F/5 (3.75 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Sc-blo = Single crochet in back loop only.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 9" [23 cm] tall, in seated position. Approx 15" [38 cm] tall, including legs.
gauge: 18 sc and 18 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Head, body, arms, and legs are worked in continuous rounds (spiral), with right side always facing. Claws are worked directly onto the ends of arms and legs. Eye patches begin in continuous rounds and end with a row.
• Arms are attached to body while a neck round of body is worked.
• Eye patches are attached to head using safety eyes before head is complete, while head is still relatively flat, for ease in access. Do not use safety eyes if making for child under 2 years of age.

EYE PATCHES (make 2)
With C, make an adjustable ring.
1st rnd (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
2nd rnd: Work 2 hdc in each st around—12 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 5, hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, slip st in next hdc of 2nd rnd. Fasten off.

ARMS (make 2)
Beginning at top (shoulder) with A, leaving a 16" [40.5 cm] tail, ch 14; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1, sc in same ch as joining slip st and in each remaining ch around; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—14 sc.
Place a marker in last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
2nd to 29th rnds: Sc in each st around, stuffing piece as work progresses.
30th rnd: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 2 sts—11 sc.
31st rnd: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts] twice, sc2tog, sc in last st—8 sc.
Finish stuffing piece. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Fold last round flat and sew opening closed.

Close top opening: Fold foundation round flat and sew opening closed, leaving long tail of yarn.

LEGS (make 2)
Beginning at top (hip) with A, leaving a 14" [35.5 cm] tail, ch 16; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1, sc in same ch as joining slip st and in each remaining ch around; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—16 sc.
Place a marker in last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
2nd to 32nd rnds: Sc in each st around, stuffing piece as work progresses.
33rd rnd: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 4 times—12 sc.
34th rnd: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 4 times—8 sc.
Finish stuffing piece. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Fold last round and sew opening closed. Close top opening: Fold foundation round flat and sew opening closed, leaving long tail of yarn.

HEAD
Beginning at nose and working towards back of head, with C, ch 7.
Nose
1st rnd (RS): Working in back bumps of foundation ch, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 5 ch; working along opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 6 ch; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining slip st and in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts, place a marker in the center sc of the 5 sc just made, 2 sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc—14 sc. Fasten off.
Face
3rd rnd: With right side facing, working in back loops only, join B with slip st in marked sc of 2nd rnd, remove marker, ch 1, sc in same sc and in each remaining sc around; join with slip st in first sc—14 sc.

4th rnd: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 7 times; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—21 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
5th rnd: [Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 7 times—28 sc.
6th rnd: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 7 times—35 sc.
7th rnd: [Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 7 times—42 sc.
8th rnd: [Sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st] 7 times—49 sc.
9th rnd: [Sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st] 7 times—56 sc.
10th and 11th rnds: Sc in each st around.
12th rnd: Sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc of this round. Fasten off.
13th rnd: With right side facing, working in back loops only, join A with slip st in first sc of 12th rnd (same sc as joining slip st), ch 1, sc in same sc and in each remaining sc around; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—56 sc.

Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Do not fasten off.

Attach Eyes
Use a length of contrasting color scrap yarn to mark face for eye patch placement as follows: Thread scrap yarn onto yarn needle. Imagine a straight line across face that lies straight across widest part of nose. Insert needle from back, onto the line and about 3 rounds in from edge of face (face is B-colored part), bring yarn straight across widest part of nose and then insert needle from front about 3 rounds in from opposite edge of face.

Attach a safety eye and eye patch on one side of face as follows: Insert a safety eye into the middle of the circular portion of one eye patch then between 9th and 10th rnds of the face and on the scrap yarn line. Do not attach washer. Repeat to position second eye and eye patch on opposite side of face. Check for even placement. Make certain that the narrow portion (Row 3) of each eye patch faces downwards and outwards from the eye and that both eye patches are at about the same angle. Snap the safety eye washers into place. Do not sew the eye patches in place, they will be sewn to face later.
Tips: Pinning the eye patches using straight pins may be helpful in assuring that the patch locations and angles match. If double layer of crochet fabric is too thick to snap the washer in place, try putting the washer on upside down with the small raised ring on top of the washer facing in towards the post.

Back of Head
14th to 18th rnd: Sc in each st around.
19th rnd: [Sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog] 7 times—49 sc.
20th and 21st rnds: Sc in each st around.
22nd rnd: [Sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog] 7 times—42 sc.
23rd rnd: Sc in each st around.
24th rnd: [Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] 7 times—35 sc.
25th rnd: Sc in each st around.
26th rnd: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 7 times—28 sc.
Stuff piece firmly.
27th rnd: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 7 times—21 sc.
28th rnd: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 7 times—14 sc.
Finish stuffing piece. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread ending tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Securely weave in and trim end.

BODY
Beginning at bottom of body with A, make an adjustable ring.
1st rnd (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
2nd rnd: Work 2 sc in each st around—12 sc.
3rd rnd: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
4th rnd: [Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—24 sc.
5th rnd: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—30 sc.
6th rnd: [Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—36 sc.
7th rnd: [Sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—42 sc.
8th rnd: [Sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—48 sc.
9th rnd: [Sc in next 7 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—54 sc.
10th rnd: [Sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—60 sc.
11th rnd: [Sc in next 9 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—66 sc.
12th to 14th rnds: Sc in each st around.
Note: Some stitches of next round are worked only into back loops. Later, the tops of the legs are sewn to the unused front loops.
15th rnd: Sc-blo in next 8 sts, sc in next 6 sts, sc-blo in next 8 sts, sc in each remaining st around.
16th to 21st rnds: Sc in each st around.
22nd rnd: [Sc in next 9 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—60 sc.
23rd rnd: [Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] 10 times—50 sc.
24th to 30th rnds: Sc in each st around.
31st rnd: [Sc in next 8 sts, sc2tog] 5 times—45 sc.
32nd rnd: [Sc in next 7 sts, sc2tog] 5 times—40 sc.
33rd rnd: [Sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog] 5 times—35 sc.

Neck
34th rnd: [Sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog] 5 times—30 sc.

Mark Stitches for Arm Placement
Use a length of contrasting color scrap yarn to mark for arm placement as follows: Hold one end of scrap yarn immediately before the first unworked front loop of 15th rnd. Stretch the scrap yarn upwards in a straight line to 34th rnd and place a marker in the 34th rnd stitch at the straight line. Moving towards the back, skip the next 5 stitches of 34th rnd and place a marker in the next stitch. The two markers just placed indicate the beginning and ending stitches where one arm will be attached. Repeat this process to mark stitches for the other arm, beginning by holding one end of scrap yarn immediately following the last unworked front loop of 15th rnd.

35th rnd: *Sc in each st to next arm marker, hold top of arm against 34th rnd with sts matching the marked sts and the sts between the markers; working through both layers, sc in next 7 sts; repeat from * once more, sc in each st to end of round—30 sc. Remove arm markers.

36th to 38th rnds: Sc in each st around.
Stuff piece firmly.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing head to body.

Claws
Working into stitches of last round of leg and over the sewing stitches used to close end of leg. Skip first st, join B with slip st in next st, *ch 6, slip st in back bump of 2nd ch from hook and in back bump of next 4 ch, slip st in same st of leg and in next st of leg; repeat from * twice more (3 claws made).
Fasten off. Weave in and trim ends. Repeat to work claws on second leg and both arms.

FINISHING
Pin eye patches to face. Sew patches securely in place, using small whip stitches.
With three strands of black embroidery floss embroider a running stitch or outline stitch upward curving mouth on face. Embroider mouth over six single crochet stitches, evenly spaced about three rounds down from the bottom of the nose and following the curvature of the single crochet stitches.
Sew head to neck. Sew legs to free front loops from 15th rnd of body. Match the top edge of the leg with the eight unworked front loops.

31st rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc.
32nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
33rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sc.
Stuﬀ Neck and Body /f_i rmly.
34th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 8 sc.
Fasten oﬀ leaving long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts.
Arms (make 2 alike): With Color 3, ch 6. Join with sl st to /f_i rst ch making sure not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 6 sc.
2nd to 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Break Color 3. Join with Color 1.
9th rnd: With Color 1, ch 1. Working in front loops only, *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 9 sc.
10th and 11th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten oﬀ leaving long end. Stuﬀ end of Arms (hands) only. Draw end tightly through rem sts.
Sew Arms to Body as shown in photo.
Legs (make 2 alike):  With Color 3, ch 6. Join with sl st to /f_i rst ch making sure not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 6 sc.
2nd to 8th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Break Color 3. Join with Color 1.
10th rnd: With Color 1, ch 1. Working in front loops only, 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
12th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 6 sc.
Fasten oﬀ leaving long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts. Do not stuﬀ Legs.
Sew Legs to Body as shown in photo.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 334 Buff A, 316 Soft White B, 718 Shocking Pink C, 847 Blue Tones D, 312 Black E, 365 Coffee F, 972 Pink Camo G.
Yarn needle, stuffing, assorted small beads (for earrings and bracelet), heavy-duty sewing thread, button (for pocketbook), red crayon (to shade cheeks).
abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G = Color A, B, C, D, E, F, and G
() = work directions in parentheses into same st
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: 20 sts = 4”; 16 rows = 4” in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEAD AND BODY
Beginning at top of head, with A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Rounds 8–15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: [Sc2tog] 15 times—15 sts.
Rounds 17–19: Sc in each sc around.
Round 20: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 7 times, sc in last sc—22 sc.
Round 21: [Sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 2 times; change to B in last sc—24 sc.
Undershirt
Rounds 22–27: With B, sc in each sc around; change to A in last sc of Round 27.
Waist
Rounds 28 and 29: With A, sc in each sc around; change to B in last sc of Round 29.
Begin Knickers
Rounds 30–35: With B, sc in each sc around. Do not fasten off. Stuff body firmly.
Joining Row: Flatten lower edging, matching stitches. Working through both thicknesses, sc across to close lower edge. Fasten off B.

HAIR
Long Strip (make 7)
Row 1: With F, *ch 23, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and each remaining ch across; repeat from * 9 more times. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Sew first strip, centered on back of head, across Round 13 (each side should end at hairline). [Sew next strip, centered on back of head, across next row above previous strip] 6 times.
Medium Strip (make 3)
Row 1: With F, *ch 23, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and each remaining ch across; repeat from * 7 more times. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Sew first strip, centered on back of head, across next row above last long strip. [Sew next strip, centered on back of head, across next row above previous strip] 2 times.
Small Strip (make 3)
Row 1: With F, *ch 23, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and each remaining ch across; repeat from * 5 more times. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Sew first strip, centered on back of head, across next row above last medium strip. [Sew next strip, centered on back of head, across next row above previous strip] 2 times. Note: The last strip should be at center top of head.

EAR (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Sew ears in place. 
Earrings (make 2): Thread three beads onto heavy-duty sewing thread and sew to ear. Repeat for 2nd earring.

LEG (make 2)
Beginning at foot, with E, ch 6.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch—12 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 3 sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc—18 sc.
Round 3: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around; change to A in last sc.
Round 4: With A, sc in next 6 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 6 sc—15 sc.
Round 5: Sc in next 3 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 6 sc—12 sc.
Round 6: Sc in next 3 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 3 sc—9 sc.
Rounds 7 and 8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: Work 2 sc in first sc, sc in each remaining sc around—10 sc.
Rounds 10–27: Sc in each sc around, stuffing leg as you go; change to B in last sc.
Round 28: With B, sc in each sc around.

ARM (make 2)
Beginning at top of arm, with A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Rounds 3–19: Sc in each sc, stuffing arm as you go.
Round 20: [Sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 3 sc—6 sc.
Round 21: Work 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in last 3 sc—9 sc.
Rounds 22–24: Sc in each sc around.
Round 25: [Sc2tog] 4 times, sc in last sc—5 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff arm. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull gently to close opening. Draw a strand of A through arm at elbow and pull to form elbow dimple. Sew arms to sides of body. With B, embroider a strap over each shoulder, from top front of undershirt to top back of undershirt.

JEANS (make 2)
Beginning at waist, with D, ch 14.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—13 sc.
Rows 2–6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 6 sc, turn—14 sc.
First Leg
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first 7 sc, turn; leave remaining sts unworked (for 2nd leg)—7 sc.
Rows 9–24: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off.
Second Leg
Row 8: Join D with sc in first unworked sc following Row 8 of first leg, sc in remaining 6 unworked sc, turn—7 sc.
Rows 9–24: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off. Sew side seams and inner leg seams.

APRON
Beginning at neck edge, with G, ch 16.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in each remaining ch across, turn—30 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times, turn—36 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in each of next 6 sc, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in each of next 6 sc, sc in last 6 sc, turn—48 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in next 6 sc, ch 3, skip next 12 sc (for underarm), sc in next 12 sc, ch 3, skip next 12 sc (for underarm), sc in last 6 sc, turn—24 sc and 2 ch-3 spaces.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc and ch across, turn—30 sc.
Rows 6–11: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 12: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1 here and throughout), skip first sc, dc in next sc, *ch 1, dc in next sc; repeat from * across, turn—30 dc and 29 ch-1 spaces.
Row 13: Ch 1, sc in each dc and ch across, turn—59 sc.
Row 14: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1 here and throughout), skip first 2 sc, dc in next sc, *ch 1, skip next sc, dc in next sc; repeat from * across, turn—30 dc and 29 ch-1 spaces.
Row 15: Ch 1, sc in each dc and ch across, turn—59 sc.
Rows 16–18: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 19–22: Repeat Rows 14 and 15 twice.
Fasten off.
Neck ties
With G, ch 35 (for first tie), join with slip st in top corner of apron, slip st in each ch across opposite side of apron foundation ch, ch 35 (for 2nd tie). Fasten off.
Waist ties
Join G with slip st on one side of apron at waist (Row 11), ch 35. Fasten off. Repeat on other side of waist.

FLOWER/HAT
With D, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Working in front loops only, (slip st, ch 1, sc) in first st (petal made), *ch 1, (slip st, ch 1, sc) in next st; repeat from * around—6 petals.
Round 3: Ch 2, working behind petals into free back loops of Round 1, (slip st, ch 2, dc) in first sc, *ch 2, (slip st, ch 2, dc) in next sc; repeat from * around; slip st in first sc again.
Fasten off. Sew flower/hat to top of head.

BAG
With C, ch 12.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 9 ch, 3 sc in last ch, working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 9 ch, 2 sc in last ch—24 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in each of next 3 sc, sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in each of last 2 sc—30 sc.
Rounds 3–11: Sc in each sc around.
Round 12: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 13: Sc in next 3 sc, ch 35 (for strap), skip next 10 sc, slip st in next 2 sc, TURN; leave remaining sts unworked.
Strap: Ch 1, sc in each of the 35 ch, slip st in next sc; leave remaining sts unworked. Fasten off.
Flower
With C, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, work 12 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Working in front loops only, ch 1, 2 sc in same st as join, 2 sc in each remaining sc around; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 3: Ch 3, working behind sts of Round 2 and into free back loops of Round 1, dc in same st as join, 2 dc in each remaining st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off. Sew flower to front of bag.

FINISHING
Weave in ends. Place clothing and accessories on doll.
Embroider Face
With F, embroider satin stitch eyes and couched stitch eyebrows. With A, embroider satin stitch nose, With C, embroider a couched stitch smile. With red crayon, gently rub color onto face for cheeks.

materials: 1 skein each 311 White A, 312 Black B, and 373 Petal Pink C for Moo-Cow Puppet
1 skein each 313 Aran, 400 Grey Heather, and 373 Petal Pink for Kitty Puppet
1 skein of 373 Petal Pink for Piglet Puppet
Small amounts of black, white, and pink felt
Small amounts of black, grey heather felt for Kitty Puppet
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 16 sts= 4”; 17 rnds = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
MOO-COW PUPPET
NOSE: With C, ch 9.
Rnd 1: 2 Sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in each of next 7 ch; working along opposite side of ch, sc in next 8 sts – 24 sc. Do not join – see Note above.
Rnds 2-7: Work even in sc, changing to A in last sc on Rnd 7. Cut C.
Rnd 8: Work even in sc with A.
Rnd 9: [Sc in next sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 8 times – 16 sc.
Puppet-Rnd 10: [2 Sc in next sc] 4 times, changing to B in last sc, cut A, with B [2 sc in next sc] 4 times working over B beginning yarn tail and changing to A in last sc, drop B, with A [2 sc in next sc] 8 times working over A beginning yarn tail – 32 sc.
Rnd 11: With A [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice, working over the A tail left on previous rnd and changing to B in last sc by loosely drawing B across the B area, cut A, with B [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice working over the B strand and changing to A in last sc, drop B, with A [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times working over A beginning yarn tail – 40 sc.
Continue to add and drop colors and work over ends as on last rnd.
Rnds 12-25: With A sc in next 10 sc, with B sc in next 10 sc, with A sc in next 20 sc.
Rnd 26: With A sc in next 11 sc, with B sc in next 8 sc, with A sc in next 21 sc.
Rnd 27: With A sc in next 12 sc, with B sc in next 6 sc, with A sc in next 22 sc.
Rnd 28: With A sc in next 13 sc, with B sc in next 4 sc, with A sc in next 23 sc.
Rnd 29: With A sc in next 14 sc, with B sc in next 2 sc, with A sc in next 24 sc. Cut B.
Rnd 30: Work even with A; sc in next 8 sc; place new marker; remove old marker.
Thumb Opening-Rnd 31: Sc in next 22 sc, ch 12, skip next 12 sc, sc in next 6 sc.
Rnd 32: Sc in next 22 sc, sc in next 12 ch, sc in next 6 sc – 40 sc.
Rnds 33-46: Work even.
Tail-Rnd 47: Sc in next 11 sc, ch 9, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 7 ch, sc in same sc on Puppet, sc in next 28 sc; slip st in next sc. Fasten off.
THUMB: With A ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rnd 1: 8 Sc in ring.
Rnd 2: [2 Sc in next sc] 8 times – 16 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 24 sc.
Rnds 4-14: Work even.
Slip st in next sc. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing.
EAR (Make 2): With B ch 4; join to form a ring.
Rnd 1: 5 Sc in ring.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc – 6 sc.
Rnd 3: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc – 7 sc.
Rnd 4: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc – 8 sc.
Rnd 5: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 7 sc – 9 sc.
Rnd 6: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 8 sc – 10 sc.
Rnd 7: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 9 sc – 11 sc.
Rnd 8: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 10 sc – 12 sc.
Rnd 9: Work even.
Slip st in next sc. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing.
FINISHING: Sew thumb into opening matching stitch for stitch. With thumb centered and lying flat on underside of Puppet, fold nose towards top of Puppet and tack in place as pictured. Pinch sides of nose to form nostril indentations and tack in place. Cut four 5” pieces of B and knot into end of tail; trim. Slip st base of ear together. Cut eyes, nostrils, ear linings and horns from felt and glue in place, pinching center area of horns together as pictured. Sew base of ears in place near top of B area on Puppet. Weave in ends. Make liner and insert into Puppet.
KITTY PUPPET
NOSE/MUZZLE: With C, ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rnd 1: 8 Sc in ring, changing to A in last sc. Cut C.
Rnd 2: With A, [2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 16 sc.
Rnd 3: [2 Sc in next sc] 16 times – 32 sc.
Rnds 4-6: Work even in sc.
Rnd 7: [Sc in next 2 sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 8 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 8: [Sc in next sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 8 times –16 sc.
PUPPET-Rnd 9: [2 Sc in next sc] 16 times – 32 sc.
Rnd 10: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 40 sc.
Rnds 11-12: Work even, changing to B in last sc of Rnd 12. Drop A.
Rnd 13: With B work 1 rnd even, changing to A in last sc by picking up dropped strand. Drop B.
Rnds 14-31: Repeat Rnds 11-13 6 more times.
Rnd 32: With A, work 1 rnd even.
Thumb Opening-Rnd 33: With A ch 12, skip next 12 sc, sc in next 28 sc, changing to B in last sc.
Rnd 34: With B, sc in next 12 ch, sc in next 28 sc, change to A in last sc.
Rnds 35-48: Repeat Rnds 11-13 4 more times, then repeat Rnds 11 and 12 once more. Cut A.
Tail-Rnd 49: With B, sc in next 30 sc, ch 11, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, tr in next 6 ch, sc in same sc on Puppet, sc in next 10 sc; slip st in next sc. Fasten off.
THUMB: With A, ch 4; join.
Rnd 1: 8 Sc in ring.
Rnd 2: [2 Sc in next sc] 8 times – 16 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 24 sc.
Rnds 4-14: Work even. 
Slip st in next sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
EAR (Make 2): With A, ch 4; join.
Rnd 1: 5 Sc in ring.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc – 6 sc.
Rnd 3: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc – 7 sc.
Rnd 4: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc – 8 sc.
Rnd 5: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 7 sc – 9 sc.
Rnd 6: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 8 sc – 10 sc.
Rnd 7: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 9 sc – 11 sc.
Rnd 8: 2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 10 sc – 12 sc.
Slip st in next sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
PUPPET FINISHING: Sew thumb into opening, matching stitch for stitch. With thumb centered and lying flat on underside of Puppet, fold Nose/Muzzle towards top of Puppet as pictured and tack in place to front of face; fold lower part of muzzle to form mouth indentation; tack in place. Cut eyes, tongue, and mouth from felt and glue in place as pictured. With D, stitch whiskers on both sides of nose. Slip st base of ear together. Sew ears in place. Weave in ends. Make liner.
PIGLET PUPPET
SNOUT: Ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rnd 1: 8 Sc in ring.
Rnd 2: [2 Sc in next sc] 8 times – 16 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 4: Work even in sc.
Rnd 5: Working tbl ONLY, sc in next 24 sc.
Rnd 6: Working in both loops, [sc in next sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 8 times – 16 sc.
Rnd 7: Repeat Rnd 4.
Rnd 8: [Sc in next sc, skip next sc] 8 times – 8 sc.
Rnd 9-10: Repeat Rnd 4.
PUPPET-Rnd 11: [2 Sc in next sc] 8 times – 16 sc.
Rnd 12: [2 Sc in next sc] 16 times – 32 sc.
Rnd 13: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 40 sc.
Rnds 14-34: Work even.
Thumb Opening-Rnd 35: Ch 12, skip next 12 sc, sc in next 28 sc.
Rnd 36: Sc in next 12 ch, sc in next 28 sc – 40 sc.
Rnds 37-50: Work even.
Tail-Rnd 51: Sc in next 29 sc, ch 5, 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, [3 sc in next ch] 3 times, sc in same sc on Puppet, sc in next 10 sc; slip st in next sc. Fasten off.
THUMB: Ch 4; join.
Rnd 1: 8 Sc in ring.
Rnd 2: [2 Sc in next sc] 8 times – 16 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 24 sc.
Rnds 4-14: Work even.
Slip st in next sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
EAR (Make 2): Ch 4; join.
Rnd 1: 5 Sc in ring.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in first sc, sc in next 4 sc – 6 sc.
Rnd 3: 2 Sc in first sc, sc in next 5 sc – 7 sc.
Rnd 4: 2 Sc in first sc, sc in next 6 sc – 8 sc.
Rnd 5: 2 Sc in first sc, sc in next 7 sc – 9 sc.
Rnd 6: 2 Sc in first sc, sc in next 8 sc – 10 sc.
Rnd 7: 2 Sc in first sc, sc in next 9 sc – 11 sc.
Rnd 8: 2 Sc in first sc, sc in next 10 sc – 12 sc.
Rnd 9: Work even.
Slip st in next sc. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing.
PUPPET FINISHING: Sew thumb into opening matching stitch for stitch. With thumb centered and lying flat on underside of Puppet, fold Snout towards top of Puppet as pictured and tack in place in front of face. Cut facial features from felt and glue in place. Slip st base of ear together. Sew base of ears in place; fold tips forward and tack in place. Weave in ends. Make liner.
LINER (FOR ALL PUPPETS)
With A, ch 4; join.
Rnd 1: 12 Sc in ring.
Rnd 2: [2 Sc in next sc] 12 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 12 times – 36 sc.
Rnds 4-22: Work even.
Thumb Opening-Rnd 23: Ch 10, skip next 10 sc, sc in next 26 sc.
Rnd 24: Sc in next 10 ch, sc in next 26 sc – 36 sc.
Rnds 25-35: Work even.
Slip st in next sc. Fasten off.
THUMB: Ch 4; join.
Rnd 1: 8 Sc in ring.
Rnd 2: [2 Sc in next sc] 8 times – 16 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times – 20 sc.
Rnds 4-12: Work even.
Slip st in next sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
LINER FINISHING: Sew into thumb opening, matching stitch for stitch. Weave in ends. Insert into Puppet.

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Classic™ Crochet Thread size 10 (White: 400 yds/365.8 m; Colors: 350 yds/320 m)
Size U.S. 7 (1.5 mm) Susan Bates® Steelite® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Optional: You can also use black Floss for the eyes
abbreviations: Hdcbl = Half double crochet through back loop only
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in front loops ONLY in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
Scfl = Single crochet in front loop only
measurements: Approx 1¾" x 1" x 4" [4.5 x 2.5 x 10 cm]
gauge: 36 sc and 40 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Designer Tip: Use the trick quilters use to bury their knots when hand quilting. Make a knot close to the surface of the work and pull the knot into the interior and out the other side. Trim thread close to the exit point.
Designer Tip:  Do not fully tighten the Magic Loop until after working Rnd 2. It will make it easier to get your hook into the stitches.
Notes:  
• The Elephant is worked from the tip of the nose to the back end.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first sc.
With MC, make Magic Loop.
Video here. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in Magic loop. Join. 6 sc. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 scfl in each sc around. Join. 
3rd to 5th rnds: As 2nd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 9 sc.
7th and 8th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each 1 sc around. Join. 
Coil and stuff beg tail into trunk. 
9th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 2 sc in each of next 6 sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join. 18 sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. 2 sc in each of next 6 sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join. 24 sc. 
Lightly stuff trunk with fiberfill.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next 1 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next 1 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc. 
14th to 25th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each 1 sc around. Join. 
26th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
27th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
28th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
29th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
Stuff Elephant firmly
30th rnd:  Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join. 6 sts. Fasten off, leaving a 12" [30.5 cm] tail.  
Tail
Use the tail at the bottom center back to make the elephant’s tail.  
With MC, ch 8. 
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Fasten off. Trim approx ¼" [6 mm] from the end.
Legs (Make 4) 
With MC, make Magic Loop.
1st rnd:  Ch 1. 8 sc in Magic Loop. Join. 8 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdcbl in each sc around. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long end to sew Legs to the Body. 
Ears (Make 2) 
With MC, ch 5. 
1st row:  1 sc in the 2nd ch from the hook and each ch to the end of chain. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc to end of row. Ch 1. Turn. 8 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. 1 hdc in the next sc. (1 dc. 1 tr) in the next sc. (1 tr. 1 dc) in the next sc. 1 hdc in the next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn. 10 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. 2 sc in each of next 2 tr. 1 sc in each of last 4 sts. Turn. 12 sts.

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Contrast A Whipped Cream (10867) 1 ball
Size U.S. L/11 [8 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
10" [25.5 cm] diameter round microbead pillow or fiberfill stuffing.
measurements: Approx 10" [25.5 cm] in diameter (excluding comb and fins).
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rnds = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: All Body rnds are worked in a continuous spiral. Do not ch 1 unless directed, and do not join any rnds with a sl st unless directed. Move a stitch marker along first st of each rnd as you work to keep track of your progress.

Bottom Half of Body
See Diagram on page 3.
With A, beg using magic loop method, demonstrated here: https://www.yarnspirations.com/video-y-crochet-magic-loop.html
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 hdc in ring. 10 sts.
2nd rnd: 2 hdc in each hdc around. 20 hdc.
3rd rnd: *1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. 30 hdc.
4th rnd: *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Rep from * around. 40 hdc.
5th rnd: *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. 50 hdc.
6th rnd: *1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * around. 60 hdc.
7th rnd: 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * until 4 hdc rem. 1 hdc in each of last 4 hdc. 66 hdc.
8th rnd: *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 10 hdc. Rep from * around. 72 hdc.
9th rnd: 1 hdc in next 8 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 17 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * until 9 hdc rem. 1 hdc in each of last 9 hdc. 76 hdc.
10th and 11th rnds: 1 hdc in each hdc around.
12th rnd: 1 hdc in each of next 17 hdc. 2 dc in next hdc. 3 tr in next hdc. 2 dc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 35 hdc. 2 dc in next hdc. 3 tr in next hdc. 2 dc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 18 hdc. 84 sts.
13th rnd: 1 sc in next hdc. Sl st in next hdc. Break yarn. Weave in ends and set piece aside.

Top Half of Body
See Diagram on page 4.
1st to 11th rnds: Rep from 1st to 11th rnds as for Bottom Half of Body.
12th and 13th rnds: 1 hdc in each hdc around.
14th rnd: 1 hdc in each of next 17 hdc. 2 dc in next hdc. 3 tr in next hdc. 2 dc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 35 hdc. 2 dc in next hdc. 3 tr in next hdc. 2 dc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 18 hdc. 84 sts.
15th rnd: 1 sc in next hdc. Sl st in next hdc. Break yarn leaving a long tail for sewing. Weave in first end at magic loop. Set piece aside.

Tail
With A, beg using magic loop method.
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in ring. 1 hdc in ring. 3 dc in ring. Turn. 5 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of first 3 sts. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Break yarn leaving a long tail for sewing. 8 sts. Set piece aside.

Comb
With B, ch 6.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. (3 dc in next ch. 1 sc in next ch) twice. Turn. 9 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Break yarn leaving a long tail for sewing. Set piece aside.

Beak
With C, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in ring. 6 hdc in ring. 7 sts.
2nd rnd: 2 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 14 hdc.
Break yarn leaving a long tail for sewing. Set piece aside.

Feet (make 2)
With C, ch 10.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 6 ch. (Turn. Loosely sl st in each of first 3 sts. Ch 5. Skip first ch. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 sl sts. 1 sl st in next ch) twice. Break yarn leaving a long tail for sewing. Set pieces aside.

Assembly
Sew Comb to center top of Top Half of Body. Be sure to position it perpendicularly to "Wings" on sides as shown in photo.
Add Safety Eyes to Top Half of Body, on opposite side of long tail.
Sew Feet to Bottom Half of Body, leaving toes loose. Be sure to position facing away from 13th rnd. Flip one over so they are mirrored.
Sew Tail to Bottom Half of Body, at end of 2nd row of tail. Be sure to position behind Feet, centered between Wings. Sew around 11th/12th rnd of Body.
Use long tail on Top Half of Body to whipstitch Top and Bottom tog JUST OVER HALFWAY around. Be sure to align Wings, and face Eyes and Feet in same direction. Stop just a few sts past second safety eye.
Sew Beak to front, between Eyes, overlapping seam. Push Beak out a bit while sewing to create a "beaky shape."
Insert pillow ball or fill with fiberfill. Finish using long tail on Top Half of Body to whip stitch Top and Bottom tog.

Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 2 sc, turn—5 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 2 sc, turn—6 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 2 sc, turn—7 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 3 sc, turn—8 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 3 sc, turn—9 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 4 sc, turn—10 sc.
Rows 11–13: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, sc2tog, sc in last 4 sc, turn—9 sc.
Row 15: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in last 4 sc, turn—8 sc.
Row 16: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in last 3 sc, turn—7 sc.

With right sides held together and referring to photo for color sequence, back stitch Sections together through ends of rows, working close to edges. materials: RED HEART® Super Saver® – 1 skein each 3620 Glowworm, 0324 Bright Yellow, and 3934 of Dayglow or colors your choice
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook – 5.5 mm [US I-9]
measurements: One monster measures about 5½" [14 cm] tall and 3" [7.5 cm] in diameter.
gauge: 15 hdc = about 4" [10 cm]; 12 rounds = about 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Pattern Notes
1. Monster is made from two pieces: Body and base.
2. Base is crocheted to bottom of Body and piece is stuffed just before completing seam.
3. Work each monster using yarn color of your choice.
4. Monster face is made from pieces of felt.

MONSTER
Body (make 1 for each monster) 
With color of your choice, make an adjustable ring, as follows:
Wrap yarn into a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail between middle finger and thumb. 
Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop.

Round 1: Chain 2 (counts as first hdc), work 8 half double crochet (hdc) stitches in the ring; pull gently on tail to tighten ring; join with slip st in top of beginning chain-2 – you will have 9 hdc in this round (counting the beginning chain-2 as one hdc).
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), hdc in same st as joining slip st, 2 hdc in each of next 8 hdc; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2 – 18 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining slip st, hdc in next st, [2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st] 8 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2 – 27 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining slip st, hdc in each of next 2 sts, [2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts] 8 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2 – 36 hdc.
Round 5: Ch 2, skip same st as joining slip st, hdc in each remaining st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2. Repeat Round 5 until the piece measures about 5½" [14 cm] tall.
Fasten off.

Base (make 1 for each monster)
Make an adjustable ring and work Rounds 1–4 of monster body.
Do not fasten off.

FINISHING
Hold the base and lower edge of body together with stitches matching.
Joining Round: With yarn still attached to base, ch 1; working through both thicknesses, sc in each st around, stuff the piece before completing the round, then join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off and weave in yarn tails.
Using photograph and your imagination as guides, cut out facial features from felt. With craft glue, glue features to monster. Hint: A quarter makes a great guide for cutting out the whites of eyes.

With contrast color and RS facing, crochet sides tog to form a cube, leaving one side open for stuffing. Stuff Block into cube shape. Crochet opening closed.

With B, ch 14. With MC, ch 15. With D, ch 17. 
1st row: (RS). With D, 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 14 ch. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 15 ch. With B, 1 sc in each of next 15 ch. Ch 1. Turn. 45 sc.

With C, ch 10. With MC, ch 11. With D, ch 13.

Rep last row 10 times more. Fasten off.
Work from ** to ** as given for Small Graphic Blocks.
With MC and RS facing, crochet sides tog to form a cube, leaving one side open for stuffing. Stuff Block into a cube shape. Crochet opening closed. 
LARGE FLOWER BLOCKS
With MC, ch 16. With A, ch 17. With B, ch 18. 
1st row: (RS). With B, 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 16 ch. With A, 1 sc in each of next 17 ch. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 17 ch. Ch 1. Turn. 51 sc. 
1st row of Chart III is completed.

Next row: (RS). Miss first 17 sc. Join C with sl st to next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 21st row of Chart III across next 16 sts. 
Cont in Chart III to end of chart. Fasten off. 
With contrast color and RS facing, crochet sides tog to form a cube, leaving one side open for stuffing. Stuff Block into cube shape. Crochet opening closed. 
SMALL FLOWER BLOCKS
Work as given for Small Stripey Blocks, substituting B for C, A for D and C for B.

instructions:
Notes: 
• Stuffie is made in several pieces that are sewn or crocheted together. 
• Rnds are worked in a spiral. Do not ch 1 at beg of rnd or join any rnds with a sl st unless specifically directed in the pattern.
• PM on first st of rnd as you work to keep track of your progress.
Mushroom Top:
With MC, beg using magic loop method demonstrated here. 
**1st rnd: (RS)  Ch 1. 1 sc in ring. 9 hdc in ring. 10 sts.

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ O’Go™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)

abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 10 sc and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Pattern starts with circle for Ball Top. Each Panel is then worked in rows beg with 2 sts from Ball Top. Panels are then sewn tog with mattress st. Ball Bottom is closed off with circle to close gap at bottom of Panels.

Ball Top: With C, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Do not join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
Do not fasten off.
Proceed in rows as follows:
First Panel:
**1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Turn. 2 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 3 sc. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 4 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn. 5 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn. 6 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn. 7 sc.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Turn. 8 sc.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Turn. 9 sc.
9th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Turn. 10 sc. 
10th to 12th rows:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Turn. 9 sc. 
14th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Turn. 8 sc. 
15th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Turn. 7 sc. 
16th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Turn. 6 sc.
17th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn. 5 sc. 
18th row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn. 4 sc.
19th row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 3 sc.
20th row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 2 sc. Fasten off.**
Second Panel: With RS facing, join B with sl st to next sc of Ball Top.
Work from ** to ** as given for First Panel.
Third Panel: With C, work as given for Second Panel.
Fourth Panel:  With A, work as given for Second Panel.
Fifth Panel: With C, work as given for Second Panel.
Sixth Panel:  Join A with sl st to next sc of Ball Top.
Work from ** to ** as given for First Panel working in Stripe Pat:
With A, work 2 rows.
With B, work 2 rows.
These 4 rows form Stripe Pat.
FINISHING 
With RS facing and using coordinating worsted weight yarn, join Panels using mattress st. 
Before joining last 2 Panels, stuff firmly (See Diagram on page 3).
MATTRESS ST
Ball Bottom: 
With RS facing, join C with sl st to bottom of a Panel.
1st rnd:  Ch 1. Work sc evenly around, working 2 sc into bottom of each Panel. Do not join. 12 sc.
2nd rnd:  *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc. 
Fasten off, leaving long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.

instructions:
TOP
With A, ch 35.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each remaining ch; turn—34 sc.
Row 2 (Right Side): Ch 1, sc in each sc; turn.
Rows 3-10: Repeat Row 2.

Left Back
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc; leave remaining sc unworked; turn—6 sc.
Rows 12-17: Repeat Row 11; fasten off.

Right Back
Referring to photo for placement, attach A to first sc of Row 11; repeat Rows 11-17 of Left Back.

Front
Row 11: Referring to photo for placement, attach A to 6th unworked st of Row 10; ch 1, sc in same attached st and next 11 sc; turn—12 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc in first 12 sc; turn.

Left Front
Row 13: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc; turn—6 sc.
Row 14: Ch 1, skip first sc; sc in remaining 5 sc; turn—5 sc.
Row 15: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc; turn—5 sc.
Row 16: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in remaining 4 sc; turn—4 sc.
Row 17: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc; turn—4 sc.
Row 18: Ch 1, skip first sc; sc in remaining 3 sc; turn—3 sc.
Row 19: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc; fasten off, leaving long tail for finishing—3 sc.

Right Front
Row 13: Referring to photo for placement, attach A to first sc of Row 12 of Front; repeat Rows 13-19 of Left Front.

WRIST FLOWER (Make 2 each with B, C and D)
Ch 4; join with slip st to form ring.
Row 1: *Ch 4, slip st in ring; repeat from * 4 more times; fasten off, leaving long tail for finishing—5 ch-4 loops.

HEADBAND FLOWER (Make 5 each with B, C and D)
Ch 4; join with slip st to form ring.
Row 1: *Ch 2 (counts as first dc), dc in ring, ch 2, slip st in ring; repeat from * 4 more times; fasten off, leaving long tail for finishing—5 Petals.

LEI FLOWER (Make 17 each with B, C and D)
Repeat Headband Flower. Instead of leaving long tail for finishing, weave in ends.

LEI LACE
With A, and leaving long tails at beginning and end of work, ch 50; fasten off.

WRIST BAND
With A, ch 12.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and remaining chs; fasten off, leaving long tail for finishing—11 sc.

HEADBAND
With A, ch 38.
Row 1: Dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as first 2 dc) and remaining chs; fasten off, leaving long tail for finishing—36 dc.

FINISHING
Outfit: Referring to photo for placement, use long tails of Front pieces to sew Left Front and Right Front pieces to the first 3 sts nearest to the armholes of both sides of the Back; weave in ends. Sew snaps to edges of Back. 
Skirt Fringe: With E, cut 136 - 14" (35.5 cm) strands for fringe. Holding 4 strands together, fold in half. Referring to photo for placement, attach each group to the back of each st of the foundation ch—34 - 7" (18 cm) fringes made.
Wrist Flowers: Using a long tail, sew one pony bead to middle of a Flower; using same long tail, sew Flower to Wrist Band. Repeat for each Flower; weave in all ends.
Headband: Using a long tail, sew one pony bead to middle of a Flower; using same long tail, sew Flower to Headband. Repeat for each Flower; weave in all ends.
Lei: String all Lei Flowers on Lei Lace; tie Lace ends together.
