2nd rnd:  Join B with sl st in sp between any 2 dc. Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc). 3 dc in same sp as last sl st. *Skip next 2 dc. 4 dc in next sp between 2-dc. Rep from * to last 2 dc. Join with sl st to top of first ch-3. 20 dc (5 clusters of 4-dc).
3rd rnd:  Sl st in each of next 2 sps (ending in sp at center of 4-dc cluster from 2nd rnd). Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc). 6 dc in same sp as last sl st. *Skip next 4 dc. 7 dc in next sp (center of 4-dc cluster from 2nd rnd). Rep from * to last 2 dc. Join with sl st to top of first ch-3. 35 dc (5 clusters of 7-dc). Fasten off.

4th rnd: Join C with sl st in first dc (top of ch-3). Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 scbl in each of next 6 dc. Working around 2nd and 3rd rnds, 1 hdc in next sp 3 rnds below (1st rnd). *1 scbl in each of next 7 dc. Working around 2nd and 3rd rnds, 1 hdc in next sp 3 rnds below. Rep from * to last sp. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sts.
Note: Hdc in rnds below will cause Motif to cup. Push dc clusters to RS to form slightly raised “petals" of flowers.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next sc. *1 sc in each of next 7 sts. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next sc. Rep from * to last 4 sts. 1 sc in each of last 4 sts. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Flat Sl St Joining:  With A and RS facing, sl st Motifs tog to form 2 halves of ball as shown in Assembly Diagram, working through back loops only and keeping yarn to WS to create Flat Sl St ch detail (see diagram). With A and Flat Sl St Joining method established, join 2 halves of Ball tog, inserting stuffing at halfway point. Fasten off.
Note: Keep working yarn to WS of work so only flat sl st chain is visible on RS.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Size U.S. G/6 [4 mm] crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 3" [7.5 cm] tall x 3" [7.5 cm] diameter.
gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Toy is worked in a spiral. Do not join rnds. There are no ch worked at beg of rnd unless otherwise indicated; simply work directly into the next st (noting marker to indicate end of rnd will move up each rnd). BIRD With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. PM on last st.
2nd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 15 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 20 sc.
4th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 25 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
7th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
8th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 35 sc.
9th to 12th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
13th rnd: *With A, 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. With A, 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd.
14th rnd: *With A, 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. With A, 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd.
15th rnd: As 14th rnd.
16th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
17th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 25 sc.
18th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 20 sc.
Stuff toy, and install safety eyes, placing eyes in approx 8th rnd of work, with 5 sts between eyes.
19th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 15 sc.
20th rnd: *1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 10 sc.
21st rnd: *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 5 sc. Fasten off. Draw end tightly through rem sts and secure tightly.
BEAK With B, ch 3.
1st row: 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sl st in next ch. Fasten off.
Sew Beak to Bird as shown in photo.
WINGS (make 2) With B, ch 10.
1st row: 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sl st in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 9 sts.
2nd and alt rows: Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each st to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each of next 7 sts. Turn.
5th row: Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each of next 5 sts. Turn.
7th row: Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each of next 3 sts. Turn.
8th row: As 2nd row. Fasten off. Sew one Wing to each side of Bird as shown in photo.

materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi Textures™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 242 yds/221 m) Hedgehog (9375) 1 ball makes 2
Sizes U.S. B/1 crochet hook for smooth yarn
U.S. J/10 (6 mm) crochet hook for fur yarn or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook and smooth yarn.
instructions:
Version 1 and 2: Brown fur is Color 1. Beige is Color 2. Red is Color 3. Purple is Color 4. Note: Do not join at end of rnd. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). Move marker up as each rnd is completed.
HEDGEHOG (make 2 alike)
Head
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: *1 sc in next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
6th to 12th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Inset eyes between rnds 6 and 7, with 3 sc between eyes.
13th rnd: *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 12 sts.

14th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Stuff head.
Snout
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 9 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 12 sc.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 15 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Stuff Snout and sew in place.
With Color 1, using French Knot, embroider Nose. Using Straight st, embroider mouth as shown in picture. See Diagrams on page 3.

Front of Body
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 6.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 3 ch. 3 sc in last sc. Do not turn. Work in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in last ch. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd. 12 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. 18 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
5th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc. Fasten off.
Back of Body
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 6.
1st to 4th rnds: As 1st to 4th rnds of Front of Body. 30 sc.
5th to 7th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leave a long end for sewing. Sew front of Body to back of Body, easing to fit and stuff before closing.
Back of Head
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 2.
1st to 3rd rnd: As 1st to 3rd rnds of Head. 18 sc.
4th to 6th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Sew over back of Head and sew Head to top of Body.
Ear (make 2) 
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 2.
1st row: 6 hdc in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off and sew in place.
Leg  (make 4) 
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: 7 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd to 6th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Stuff Legs lightly and sew in place.

Clothes
Note: Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc. 
Cape
With smaller hook and Color 4, ch 19.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 18 sc.
2nd row:  Ch 3. 1 dc in first sc. 2 dc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 36 dc. 
3rd to 6th rows: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn. 
Edging: Ch 1. Work in sc around Cape, having 3 sc in corners. 
Ties
With smaller hook and Color 4, ch 28. 
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. 1 sc in each of next 18 sc across neck edge of Cape. Ch 28. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Fasten off.

Stocking Cap
Note: Do not break color not in use. Carry color not in use up side of work. 
With smaller hook and Color 4, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd to 4th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Change to Color 3 at end of 4th rnd. Do not break Color 4.
5th to 6th rnds:  With Color 3, 1 sc in each sc around. Change to Color 4 at end of 6th rnd.
7th rnd: With Color 4, 1 sc in each sc around.
8th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 8 sc.
9th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
10th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 10 sc. Change to Color 3.
11th rnd: With Color 3, 1 sc in each sc around.
12th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 12 sc. Change to color 4.
13th rnd: With Color 4, 1 sc in each sc around.
14th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 
15th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
16th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc. Change to Color 3.
17th rnd: With Color 3, 1 sc in each sc around.
18th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 21 sc. Change to Color 4.
19th rnd: With Color 4, 1 sc in each sc around.
20th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
21st rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
22nd rnd: *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc. Change to Color 3.
23rd rnd:  *With Color 3, 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
24th to 27th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Sew Cap in place.
Tassel 
Hanger:  With smaller hook and Color 3, ch 6. 
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Attach to tip of hat. 
Tassels:  Wrap Color 3 around a 7” [18 cm] piece of cardboard 10 times. Tie securely at one end. Cut across other end. Wrap yarn 6 times around tassel ½” [1 cm] from tied end, and fasten securely. Trim tassel to desired length. Attach to hanger.

Scarf
With smaller hook and Color 3, ch 50.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 49 hdc.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Fasten off.

Hat
With smaller hook and Color 3, ch 10. 
Ribbing: 1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. 9 sc.
2nd to 27th rows: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Do not fasten off. 
Top of Hat:  1st row:  Ch 1. Work 27 sc spaced evenly across side edge of Ribbing. Turn. 27 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * to end  of row. Turn. 20sts.
4th row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 16 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 12 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * to end of row. 8 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. 
Thread yarn through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely. Sew back seam.

pattern_name: Brother and Sister Bears to Crochet
materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi Prints™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 242 yds/221 m) Teddy Bear (9833) 1 ball makes 2
Sizes B/1 (2.25 mm) crochet hook for smooth yarn, U.S. J/10 (6 mm) crochet hook for fur yarn or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Approx 7½" [19 cm] from top of ear to bottom of foot.
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook and smooth yarn.
instructions:
Instructions
Boy Version 1: Beige Fur is Color 1. Royal blue is Color 2. Light blue is Color 3. Tan is Color 4.
Girl Version 2: The same numbers apply.
Notes:
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed, keeping color change to WS of work.
• Do not join at end of rnd. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). Move marker up as each rnd is completed.

BOY VERSION 1
Outer Eye (Make 2).
With smaller hook and Color 4, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long end.

Head
With larger hook and Color 1, beg at top of head, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd:  *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th to 9th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around.
10th rnd:  (Sc2tog) 9 times. 9 sts. Stuff head. Set aside.
Following manufacturer's instructions, attach safety eye through center of outer eye. Snap in place. Sew Outer Eye in place to Head pushing plastic point into head. With Color 4, using Satin st, embroider nose and a Straight st embroider underneath.

Leg (make 2) 
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 9 sc.
3rd to 8th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off at end of last row. Stuff leg.

Body
With smaller hook and Color 3, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd:  *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
5th to 8th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Join Color 2 at end of last rnd.
9th to 11th rnds:  With Color 2, 1 sc in each sc around. Join Color 3 at end of last rnd.
12th to 13th rnds:  With Color 3, 1 sc in each sc around. Join Color 2 at end of last rnd.
14th to 16th rnds:  With Color 2, 1 sc in each sc around. Join Color 3 at end of last rnd.
17th to 19th rnds:  With Color 3, 1 sc in each sc around. Do not fasten off.
Stuff Body. Sew Head to top of Body, pushing neck down so it is sewn at 5th rnd of Body.
Centering Head, fold bottom of Body flat. Working through both thicknesses, work 12 sc across bottom of Body. Fasten off.
Flatten bottom of leg. With Color 1 sew legs in place across 12 sc of Body.

Ear (make 2) 
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 4.
1st row: 9 dc in 4th ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew in place to Head.

Arm (make 2). 
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd to 12th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving long end of yarn. Stuff Arms.

Hand (make 2) 
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving long end of yarn. Stuff lightly and sew in place at end of Arm.

Turtle neck
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 10.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 9 sc.
2nd to 30th rows:  Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Fasten off at end of last row, leaving long end to sew center back seam. Sew turtle neck around neck.

Bottom edge of sweater:  With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 6.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 5 sc.
2nd to 32nd rows: Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Fasten off at end of last row, leaving long end. Sew in place around 17th rnd of Body. Sew back seam.

GIRL VERSION 2
Head 
With larger hook and Color 4 beg at top of head, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. (24 sc).
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. (30 sc).
7th to 12th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around.
13th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
14th rnd:  1 sc in each sc around. Insert eyes 5 sc apart between rnds 6 and 7.
15th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
16th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 12 sts. Fasten off. Stuff head.

Ear (make 2) 
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 2.
1st row: 6 sc in 2nd ch from Hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten off. Sew in place.

Snout
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Sew in place and embroider same as for Boy’s Version.

Leg (make 2) 
With smaller hook and Color 4, ch 2 (bottom of leg).
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd to 16th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving long end of yarn. Stuff Legs.

Arm 
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. 10 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Join color 3 at end of 4th rnd.
5th to 13th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving long end of yarn. Stuff Arms. Flatten top of arm and sew in place.

Girl Body:  Follow directions for Boy’s Version Body with following color changes: 
1st to 14th rnds: Color 3.
15th to 19th rnds: Color 2. Finish same as Boy’s Version.

Collar
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 18.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain each. Turn. 17 sc.
2nd row: *Sl st in next sc. 3 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. Sl st in last sc. Fasten off. Sew Collar around neck.

Flower
With smaller hook and Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: [(Sl st. Ch 2) 4 times. Sl st] in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off. Pull beg strand to tighten and sew in place.

Skirt: (worked side to side) 
Notes: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as st.
Do not break color not in use. Carry color not in use up side of work.

With smaller hook and Color 3, ch 10.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Turn.
2nd row:  Ch 2. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join Color 2. Turn.
3rd row:  With Color 2, ch 1. Working in back loops only,  1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Turn.
4th row:  Ch 2. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in each of first 3 dc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Turn.
5th row: With Color 3, as 3rd row.
6th row: With Color 3, as 4th row.
7th to 28th rows:  Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep 3rd to 6th rows. Fasten off Color 3.
With Color 2, work in sc along waist, covering carry alongs. Sew center back seam. Put on bear. Sew to 11th rnd of Body.

materials: Bernat® Super Value™ (7 oz/197 g; 440 yds/402 m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume™ crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Pair of safety eyes 12 mm in diameter.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Rnds are joined with a sl st to first sc.
Snout:
With B, beg using magic loop method, demonstrated here. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 dc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd to 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each around. Join
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

Nose
With D, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 12 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
3rd to 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
Fasten off, leaving long tail. Sew Nose onto Snout as shown in photo, stuffing as you seam.

Main Body and Head:
With A, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Join. 40 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sc.
7th to 24th rnds: As 5th rnd.
25th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Rep from * around. 45 sts.
26th and alt rnds: As 5th rnd.
27th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.
29th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Join. 35 sts.
31st rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
33rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. 25 sts.
35th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 50 sts.
37th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. Join. 55 sts.
38th to 47th rnds: As 5th rnd.
48th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 44 sts.
49th rnd: As 5th rnd.
50th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Join. 33 sts.
51st rnd: As 5th rnd.
52nd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 22 sts.
53rd rnd: As 5th rnd.
Stuff Body and Head. Add safety eyes as shown in photo, approx 8 rnds below final rnd. Sew Snout on Head as shown in photo, stuffing as you seam.
54th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through rem sts and pull tight to close.

Arms and Legs (make 4)
With C, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Break C. Join A.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Join. 16 sts.
8th rnd: As 6th rnd.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Join. 12 sts.
Rep 6th rnd 10 times more (or until Arms and Legs measure desired length.)
Fasten off, leaving long tail. Stuff with polyfill. Fold last rnd of Arms in half and sew flat. Sew Arms along 33rd rnd of Body as shown in photo. Fold last rnd of Arms in half and sew flat. Sew Back Legs to sides of Body to make support for sitting position - see picture.

Antlers (make 2)
With C, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join.
2nd to 10th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
Fasten off, and stuff with polyfill.

Antler Branches (make 2)
With C, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join.
2nd to 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
Fasten off, and stuff with polyfill. Sew to Antlers as shown in photo.

Ears
With A, ch 5.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 2 sc in last st. Turn. 6 sts.
4th to 5th rows: As 2nd row.
6th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sts.
7th row: As 2nd row.
8th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts.
9th rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around Ear. Join. Fasten off.
Sew Ears to Head as shown in photo.
Optional: Make a pompom tail.

materials: small amount of red yarn or embroidery floss (for mouth)
two 20” (51cm) lengths of floral stem wire (for pose-able leprechaun – optional)
RED HEART® Super Saver: 1 skein each 368 Paddy Green A, 312 Black B, 321 Gold C, 672 Spring Green D, 512 Turqua E, 256 Carrot F, 316 Soft White G, 313 Aran H
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Leprechaun measures 14” (35.5 cm) tall, including hat
gauge: 13 sts = 4” (10 cm); 14 rows/rounds = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SHOES (make 2)
Beginning at bottom of shoe, with B, ch 8.
Round 1 (right side): Work 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 5 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 5 ch; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in same st as join, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 5 sc; join with slip st in first sc—20 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Top of Shoe
Identify 9 sts at center of one end of shoe (for toe end). Top of shoe is worked back and forth in rows.
Row 5 (right side): With right side facing, draw up a loop in the first of the 9 toe sts, ch 1, insert hook in same st, yarn over and pull up a loop, [insert hook in next st, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 4 loops on hook, [sc3tog] twice, slip st in next st, turn; leave remaining sts unworked.
Row 6: Skip the slip st, sc3tog, slip st in end of Row 5, turn.


Ankle
Round 7 (right side): Ch 1, work 14 sc evenly spaced all the way around top opening of shoe; join with slip st in first sc—14 sc.
Round 8: Slip st in each st around.
Fasten off. With C, embroider a straight stitch square on the front of each shoe for buckle. Use a small amount of B to stuff the toe of each shoe and set aside.

LEGS (make 2)
Beginning at bottom of leg with G, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Rounds 3–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; change to D; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; change to G; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 8 and 9: Repeat Rounds 6 and 7. Fasten off D.
Round 10: With G, ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 11: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; change to A; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off G.
Begin Knickers
Round 12: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Rounds 13 and 14: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 15: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 4 times; join with slip st in first sc—20 sc.
Rounds 16–18: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off first leg. Make 2nd leg but do not fasten off.
Join Legs
Round 1 (joining round): Beginning on 2nd leg, ch 1, sc in same st as join, sc in next st; beginning in any st on top of first leg, sc in next 16 sc of first leg, leave last 4 sc unworked and leave corresponding 4 sc of 2nd leg unworked, sc in remaining 14 sc of 2nd leg; join with slip st in first sc—32 sc. Working from wrong side, sew the matching unworked stitches between the legs together. Decide which side of the joined legs you would like to be the front. Place a small amount of stuffing in the bottom of each leg. Place one shoe on bottom of each leg taking care to place the toes facing forwards and sew in place. Place a marker in center back of top of each leg.
Round 2: Ch 1, [sc in each sc to 1 st before next marker, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc] twice, sc in each sc to end of round; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc. Remove markers.
Rounds 3 and 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

HEAD
Beginning at top of head with H, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: Sc in next sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 5 times, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 3 sc—36 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—42 sc.
Rounds 8–12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: Sc in next 21 sc, popcorn in next sc (for nose), sc in last 20 sc.
Rounds 14–16: Sc in each sc around.
Attach safety eyes about two rows above nose and spaced as desired.
Round 17: [Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 18: Sc in next sc, [sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc] 5 times, sc2tog, sc in last 3 sc—30 sc.
Round 19: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 20: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 21: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Rounds 22–24: Sc in each sc around.
Slip st in next st. Fasten off. Stuff head. With yarn needle and F, embroider straight stitches across top of head for hair. Begin by sewing a long straight stitch from one side of top front of head to back center of head to define the part. Then embroider straight sts across the head from the part to the sides of the head. Keep working stitches between the part and sides of head, gradually working towards the back of the head. Keep the stitches very close together, even allowing them to overlap from time to time. Vary the length of the stitches to approximate the look of real hair. Work longer stitches over the top of the head and shorter stitches near the lower edges of the sides to add texture and make shaping the lower edges of the hair easier. Embroider shorter straight stitches near the front of the part for a cowlick and on either side of the front of the face for sideburns.

Notes: It is important to stuff the head before embroidering the hair to prevent the head from puckering as the stitches are worked. Pay attention to the tension of the stitches as you want them to be tight enough to sit smoothly on the head, but not so tight that they deform the head. Stuffing may stick to the needle as you embroider. Take care not to pull the stuffing all the way through to the outside.

EARS (make 2)
With H, ch 4.
Row 1: Working in back bars, slip st in first ch from hook sc in next ch, dc in next ch, slip st in last ch. Fasten off. Arrange ears on either side of head, behind the sideburns (spread some of the straight sts apart slightly for ear placement) and even with the nose. Sew ears in place.
With a small amount of red yarn or embroidery floss, embroider a straight stitch “V” for mouth.

HAT
Beginning at top of hat with A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Note: Work first stitch of each round in same stitch as join.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 6: Sc in next sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 5 times, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 3 sc; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc.
Round 7: Sc in next sc, [sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc] 5 times, sc2tog, sc in last 3 sc; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 8: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Rounds 9–11: Sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Brim
Round 12: Ch 1, working in back loops only, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—32 sc.
Round 13: Ch 1, working in both loops, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—40 sc.
Round 14: Slip st in each st around. Fasten off.

Hat Band
With B, ch 2.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—1 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in the sc.
Repeat Row 2 until piece is long enough to go around hat above brim. Fasten off, leaving a tail for sewing. Sew ends of hat band together and slip over top of hat and down to just above brim. With C embroider a straight st square on hat band for buckle.

JACKET
Beginning at lower edge with A, ch 33.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—32 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 18 sc, sc2tog, sc in last 5 sc, turn—30 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first 13 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last 13 sc, turn—28 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 14 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 6 sc, turn—30 sc. Do not fasten off.
First Front 
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc, turn; leave remaining sts unworked for back and second front—6 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off.
Back
Row 1: Skip 1 unworked st following first front (for underarm), join A with sc in next unworked st, sc in next 15 unworked sc, turn; leave remaining sts unworked for second front—16 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off.
Second Front
Row 1: Skip 1 unworked st following back (for underarm), join A with sc in next unworked st, sc in last 5 unworked sc, turn—6 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off. Fold fronts over back and sew shoulder seams.

Collar
Row 1: Join A with sc in edge of one front just before shoulder seam, work 13 more sc evenly spaced across back neck edge working last of these sc in edge of other front just following shoulder seam, turn—14 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in last sc—16 sc. Fasten off.

Sleeves (work 2)
Round 1: Join A with sc in skipped sc at underarm, work 11 more sc evenly spaced around armhole; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Rounds 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, sc2tog, sc in last 5 sc; join with slip st in first sc—11 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, sc2tog, sc in last 4 sc; join with slip st in first sc—10 sc.
Rounds 8 and 9: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off. Repeat for second sleeve.

Cuffs (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, turn—3 sc.
Rows 3–16: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 17: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, turn—2 sc.
Row 18: Ch 1, sc2tog—1 sc.
Fasten off. Repeat for second cuff. Wrap one cuff around end of each sleeve. With sewing needle and thread, sew a tiny yellow button through the shaped ends of the cuff. With yarn needle and yarn, sew outer edge of cuff to outer edge of sleeve. Repeat for second cuff.

VEST
Notes: Vest is worked from side to side. Color is changed every row (except Row 6). Colors are joined and rows worked with right side facing at all times.
Beginning at one side of vest with C, ch 11.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—10 sc. Fasten off.
Row 2: With right side facing, join D with sc in first sc, sc in same sc (increase made), sc in each remaining sc across—11 sc. Fasten off.
Row 3: With right side facing, join C with sc in first sc, sc in same sc (increase made), sc in each remaining sc across—12 sc. Fasten off.
Row 4: With right side facing and slip knot of D on hook, draw up a loop in first sc, draw up a loop in next sc, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook (decrease made), sc in each remaining sc across—11 sc. Fasten off.
Row 5: With C, repeat Row 4—10 sc. Fasten off.
Row 6: With right side facing and working in back loops only, join C with sc in first sc, sc in each remaining sc across. Fasten off.
Rows 7–10: Repeat Rows 2–5.
Fasten off. With sewing needle and thread, sew 4 tiny green buttons evenly spaced across Row 6. Turn jacket inside out and sew edges of vest to inside of fronts of jacket. Sew edges of vest about ½” (1.5cm) in from front edges of jacket. After sewing vest in place, turn jacket right side out again.

HANDS (make 2)
With H, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Rounds 2–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, 2 sc in same sc as join, sc in next sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] twice; join with slip st in first sc—9 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in first 8 sc, popcorn (for thumb); join with slip st in first sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, sc in same sc as join, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] twice; join with slip st in first sc—7 sc.
Round 10: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff hand. Weave tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Secure end and weave in. Repeat for second hand. Insert one hand in end of each sleeve, taking care to place thumb upwards, and sew in place.

BOWTIE
With E, ch 2.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—1 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in the sc, turn—2 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in next 2 sc, turn—4 sc.
Rows 4–6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice, turn—2 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc2tog, turn—1 sc.
Rows 9 and 10: Ch 1, sc in the sc, turn.
Rows 11–18: Repeat Rows 2–9.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew ends of tie together and weave in ends. Flatten piece centering the narrow section.

Band
With E, ch 2.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—1 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in the sc, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Wrap band around narrow center of tie and sew ends of band together. Weave in ends.

POT ‘O GOLD
Beginning at bottom of pot with B, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: Sc in next sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 5 times, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 3 sc—36 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—42 sc.
Round 8: Sc in next 2 sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] 5 times, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 4 sc—48 sc.
Round 9: [Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—54 sc.
Round 10: Sc in next 3 sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 8 sc] 5 times, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 5 sc—60 sc.
Round 11: [Sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—66 sc.
Rounds 12–21: Sc in each sc around.
Round 22: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 11 times—55 sc.
Round 23: Sc in first sc, [sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc] 10 times, sc2tog, sc in last 2 sc—44 sc.
Rounds 24 and 25: Sc in each sc around.
Round 26: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 11 times—55 sc.
Round 27: Sc in first sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 10 times, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 3 sc—66 sc.
Rounds 28 and 29: Sc in each sc around.
Round 30: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 22 times—44 sc.
Slip st in next st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Curl top edge to the right side (outside) of pot. With tail sew curled edge in place. Stuff pot.

COINS (make 24 or as many as desired)
With C, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: TURN, slip st in each st around. Fasten off.
Arrange coins, overlapping edges, into a circle a bit larger than the top opening of the pot. Sew coins together then sew edges of circle of coins to top edge of pot, allowing some coins to overlap with the edge and adding more stuffing as you sew to make the coins bulge upwards out of the pot.

FINISHING
When assembling leprechaun, add stuffing as you sew to ensure that leprechaun is well-padded. Do not stuff so firmly that stuffing shows through stitches.

Pose-able Leprechaun (optional)
Bend up the ends of each piece of floral stem wire about ½–1” (1.5–2.5cm). Wrap the bent ends with duct tape to secure and cover any sharp edges. Fold one piece of wire in half. Twist the top (fold) of the piece (this end will be inserted into the neck later). Insert one end of bent piece into each leg. Stuff the legs firmly, distributing the stuffing evenly around the wire. Twist the center of the second length of wire around the first length about 2” (5 cm) from the top (Hint: Hold jacket in place over legs to see where sleeves line up before twisting second length around first length). Wrap twist with duct tape to secure second length of wire to first. Insert one end of second length into each sleeve. Stuff sleeves firmly, distributing the stuffing evenly around the wire. Sew the jacket to the top of the legs. Sew under the lower edge of the jacket (about 3 rows up from lower edge) and sew to legs about 3 rows from top edge of legs. Stuff the body of the jacket firmly. Use your finger to make a hole in the stuffing of the neck. Insert the twisted end of the first length of wire into the opening and insert neck into top of jacket. Take care to keep collar on the outside. Sew neck into opening at top of jacket, sewing through second row of neck. Add more stuffing as you sew, distributing it evenly around the wire and ensuring that the neck is sturdy. Sew bowtie to front of neck. Stuff hat and sew to top of head.

Leprechaun Assembly (if not pose-able)
Stuff legs firmly. Stuff sleeves and jacket firmly. Sew the jacket to the top of the legs. Sew under the lower edge of the jacket (about 3 rows up from lower edge) and sew to legs about 3 rows from top edge of legs. Sew neck into opening at top of jacket, sewing through second row of neck. Add more stuffing as you go to ensure that the neck is sturdy (Hint: Insert a short length of wire or dowel to increase the sturdiness of the neck). Sew bowtie to front of neck. Stuff hat and sew to top of head.

Weave in any remaining ends.

materials: Bernat® Maker Minis™ Kit includes 10 balls (1.7 oz/50 g each; 17.65 oz/500 g total), (61 yds/56 m; 610 yds/560 m)
Small amount of Yellow for embroidery
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.

Rocketship: Fiberfil stuffing. Hot glue gun with glue sticks. Wooden dowel 1⁄4" [.5 cm] diameter (to support rocket booster frames). 2 small pom-poms 1⁄3" [8 mm] diameter (for alien headphones). 1 toothpick. 2 small black beads 1⁄8" [3 mm] (for alien eyes). One half of a clear fillable plastic ornament 2" [5 cm] diameter (for porthole dome).
Alien: 2 post and washer animal noses (for eyes) 1⁄2” [13 mm]. Fiberfil stuffing. Wooden dowel 1⁄4” [.5 cm] diameter (for rigid insert for top knot/hair). Hot glue gun with glue sticks.
abbreviations: Cross Sc = Single Crochet Cross Stitch.

Joined tr = Insert hook into top horizontal bar of tr just worked and draw up a loop. Insert hook into second horizontal bar of same tr and draw up a loop. Insert hook into next ch and draw up a loop. 4 loops on hook. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times. – Joined tr made.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
Tr (Treble crochet) = (Yoh) twice. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times
measurements: Rocketship: Approx 12" [30.5 cm] long, excluding flames. Alien: Approx 11" [12.5 cm] tall, excluding top knot hair.
gauge: 14 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
ROCKETSHIP
Notes:
1. Booster Rockets and Booster Rocket frames are worked separately and sewn tog. Frames are cylindrical pieces that hold Booster Rockets on Spaceship and are fitted with a small length of wooden dowel to provide rigidity.
2. The clear spaceship dome (porthole), is created from half of a fillable clear plastic ornament. It is connected to Spaceship with crochet edging that is glued around the bottom edge of the dome using strong craft glue. Space features are glued to a toothpick, then inserted and glued in place on Spaceship.
3. To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed, keeping color change to WS of work.
4. This project includes some optional multi-crafting techniques for finishing and embellishing. Make certain to read through entire pattern before beg.

Beg at nose cone with B, ch 2.
See Diagram on page 4.

1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 5 sc. PM on first st. Do not join at end of rnds, unless otherwise stated. Work in spiral in continuous rnds. Move marker up at beg of each rnd.

2nd rnd: 2 cross sc in each of next 5 sc. 10 sc.

3rd rnd: (1 cross sc in next sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 5 times. 15 sc.

4th rnd: 1 cross sc in each sc around.

5th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 3 times. 18 sc.

6th rnd: 1 cross sc in each sc around.

7th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 3 times. 21 sc.

8th rnd: 1 cross sc in each sc around.

9th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 7 times. 28 sc.

10th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 7 times. 35 sc.

11th rnd: 1 cross sc in each sc around. Sl st in first sc of rnd. Fasten off.

Work in joined rnds as follows:

12th rnd: Working in back loops only, join A with sl st in first sc. Ch 1. 1 cross sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 35 sc.

13th rnd: Ch 1. (1 cross sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 7 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sc. Fasten off.

14th rnd: Working in back loops only, join C with sl st in first sc. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.

15th rnd: Ch 1. (1 cross sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 7 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 49 sc.

Work in continuous rnds (spiral):

16th rnd: 1 cross sc in each sc around. PM on first st. Do not join. 49 sc.

17th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 7 times. 56 sc.

18th to 32nd rnds: 1 cross sc in each sc around. Sl st in first sc of rnd. Fasten off.

33th rnd: Working in back loops only, join A with sl st in first sc. Ch 1. 1 cross sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.

34th to 36th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Do not join. Fasten off at end of last rnd.

37th rnd: Working in back loops only, join D with sl st in first sc. Ch 1. 1 cross sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.

38th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog) 7 times. 49 sts. PM on first st. Do not join. Work in continuous rnds (spiral).

39th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog) 7 times. 42 sts.

40th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 19 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 40 sts.

41st rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 10 times. 30 sts.

Stuff piece firmly and cont stuffing piece as work progresses.

42nd rnd: 1 cross sc in each st around.

43rd rnd: (1 cross sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 10 times. 20 sts.

44th to 46th rnds: 1 cross sc in each st around. Fasten off.

47th rnd: Working in back loops only, join A with sc in any st of rnd 46. 1 cross sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.

48th and 49th rnds: Ch 1. 1 cross sc in each sc around.

50th rnd: Working in back loops only, (1 cross sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 5 times. 15 sts.

51st rnd: Working in back loops only, (1 cross sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog) 3 times. 12 sts.

Sl st in first st of rnd. Fasten off. Finish stuffing Rocketship.

BOOSTER ROCKETS (make 3).
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 6 sc. PM on first st. Do not join at end of rnds. Work in spiral in continuous rnds.

2nd rnd: (1 cross sc in next sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 3 times. 9 sc.

3rd rnd: 1 cross sc in each sc around.

4th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 3 times. 12 sc.

5th and 6th rnds: 1 cross sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc at end of 6th rnd. Fasten off.

7th rnd: Join B with sl st to back loop of first sc. Working in back loops only, 1 cross sc in each sc around. PM on first st. Do not join at end of rnds. Work in spiral in continuous rnds.

Begin stuffing lightly and cont stuffing as work progresses. 

Working in both loops:

8th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 10 sts.

9th rnd: 1 cross sc in each st around.

10th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 8 sts. 

Sl st in first sc of rnd. Fasten off. 

Finish stuffing rocket, leaving room for inserting a flame into the end.

BOOSTER ROCKET FRAMES  (make 3).
Casing
With D, ch 2, leaving a long end for sewing.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd to 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 cross sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.

Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Insert piece of wooden dowel into Casing and trim even with edge of piece to make Frame. Sew one Frame to each Booster Rocket. Sew Frames right below edge of last A-colored rnd of Rocket. Sew around Frame to secure.

Flames (make 3 – 1 per rocket).
Wrap A around 2 fingers 5 times. Slip loops off fingers. Tie D securely at one end. Cut across other end. Using photo as reference, glue one Small Flame to opening of each Booster Rocket. 

PLASTIC DOME EDGING
With D, ch 34 (or number of chains needed to fit snuggly around circumference of dome). Join with sl st to first ch to form a circle.

1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 cross sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 34 sc.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 cross sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

3rd rnd: Working along opposite side of foundation ch, join A with sc in any ch. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off, leaving long end for sewing.

Attach Edging to Dome: Carefully break off the hanging tab on the edge of half dome. To keep table clean and prevent dome from sticking to table, work on piece of waxed paper. Run a bead of hot glue around edge of dome. Place glued dome flat on waxed paper. Slip edging down over dome with B-colored side up, pushing it down until A-colored edge is lying flat on the waxed paper. 

Note: A-colored edge will be sewn to Rocketship. Set aside to dry.

ALIEN
Head: With E, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 6 sc. PM on first st. Do not join. Work in spiral in continuous rnds.

2nd and 3rd rnds: 1 cross sc in each sc around. 
4th rnd: (Sc2tog) 3 times. Fasten off. Use ends as stuffing. Cut toothpick in half. Glue Head to flat (cut) tip of toothpick. 

Glue 2 beads to upper front of head to form eyes. Glue two small pompoms to upper sides of Head (as if wearing head phones).

FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide to placement of features and pieces.
Attach Rockets to Rocketship: Using yarn ends, and with A-end facing up towards the nose of the Rocketship, sew Booster Rockets, evenly spaced around first D-colored rnd of Rocketship approx 14 sc apart. Insert and glue alien toothpick into upper side of Rocketship evenly spaced between 2 Booster Rockets. Place dome over alien and pin edging to Rocketship.  
With long end of A, sew dome to Rocketship. 

SPACE ALIEN
Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed, keeping color change to WS of work.

LEGS/BODY
First Leg
Beg at bottom of leg with A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from ring. Do not join. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). 6 sc.
PM in last sc worked to for end of rnd. Move marker up as each rnd is completed.
2nd rnd: 2 cross sc in each of next 6 sts. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: (1 cross sc in next sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 6 times. 18 sc.
4th to 8th rnds: 1 cross sc in each sc around. Fasten off. Stuff leg.

Second Leg
Work as given for First leg. Do not fasten off.
Cont to stuff leg and body as work progresses.

Join Legs: Remove end of rnd markers for both legs.
9th rnd: Hold first leg and second leg tog and working through both thicknesses, 1 cross sc in next sc to join legs. 1 cross sc in each of next 17 sc of Second leg then 1 cross sc in each of 17 sc of First leg. 34 sc.

PM in last sc worked and move marker up as each rnd is completed.

Body
10th rnd: (2 cross sc in next st. 1 cross sc in each of next 16 sts) twice. 36 sc.
11th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 6 times. 42 sc.
12th rnd: 1 cross sc in each sc around. Join B with sl st to back loop of next sc. Do not fasten off A. 

13th rnd: With B, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 cross scbl in same sp as sl st. 1 cross scbl in each sc around. Do not join. Work in continuous rnds.
14th to 16th rnds: Working in both loops,  1 cross sc in each sc around.

17th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 36 sts.

18th rnd: 1 cross scbl in each st around.

19th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 30 sts. Join A with sl st to back loop of next sc. Fasten off B.

20th rnd: Working in back loops only,  with A, 1 cross scbl in each st around. 

21st rnd: Working in both loops,  (1 cross sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 24 sts.

22nd to 24th rnds: 1 cross sc in each st around.

25th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 18 sts.

Neck
26th and 27th rnds: 1 cross sc in each st around.

Finish stuffing piece. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Leave neck open.

HEAD
See diagrams on page 11.

Beg at lower end of head with A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 6 sc. Do not join. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). PM in last sc worked to for end of rnd. Move marker up as each rnd is completed.

2nd rnd: 2 cross sc in each of next 6 sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: (1 cross sc in next st. 2 cross sc in next st) 6 times. 18 sc.
4th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 6 times. 24 sc.
5th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 6 times. 30 sc.
6th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 6 times. 36 sc.
7th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 6 times. 42 sc.
8th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 cross sc in next sc) 6 times. 48 sc.
9th and 10th rnds: 1 cross sc in each sc around. Join C with sl st to back loop of next sc. Fasten off B.
11th rnd: Working in back loops only,  with C, 1 sc in each st around. Do not join. Work in continuous rnds.

12th rnd: Working in both loops,  (1 cross sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 42 sts.

13th to 15th rnds: 1 cross sc in each st around. 

16th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 36 sts.

Attach post and washer noses (for eyes) between 8th and 9th rnds, approx 6 - 7 sts apart. Play with the angle of the eyes to determine the best position before snapping on washers.

Stuff as work progresses.

17th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 30 sts.

18th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 24 sts.

19th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 18 sts.

20th rnd: (1 cross sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 12 sts.

21st rnd: (1 cross sc in next st. Sc2tog) 4 times. 8 sts.

22nd to 25th rnds: 1 cross sc in each st around. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. 

Cut length of wooden dowel approx 1" [2.5 cm]. Insert dowel in top portion of Head. Thread yarn through sts of last rnd. Pull tightly to close hole around dowel. Fasten securely.

TOPKNOT
Wrap C around 2 fingers 6 times. Tie securely at one end. Cut across other end. Wrap yarn twice around tassel ¼" [.5 cm] from tied end, and fasten securely. Attach Tassel securely to top of Head. 

ARMS  (make 2).
Beg at top of arm with A, ch 8. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: 1 sc in each ch around. Do not join. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). 8 sc.
PM in last sc worked for end of rnd. Move marker up as each rnd is completed.
2nd to 4th rnds: 1 cross sc in each sc around. Join C at end of 4th rnd.
5th to 10th rnds: With C, 1 cross sc in each sc around.

Hand: 11th rnd:  2 cross sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
12th rnd: 1 cross sc in each sc around.
13th rnd: (1 cross sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. 12 sts.

Stuff arm lightly. 

Next row: (Closing row). Hold top edges tog and working through both thicknesses, 6 sl st across top edge to close. 6 sl sts. Do not fasten off.

Fingers
1st row: Ch 5. Turn. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 3 ch (first finger made). Working in sts of Closing row, sl st in each of first 3 sl sts. Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 3 ch (second finger made). Sl st in same st of Closing row and each of next 2 sts. Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 3 ch (third finger made). Sl st in same st and last st of Closing row.

Fasten off.

BELT
With D, ch 35, leaving a long end for sewing. 1st row: Working in back bumps only, draw up a loop in 2nd, 3rd, 4th chains from hook. Yoh and draw up a loop through 2 loops on hook) 4 times – beg joined tr made.

Working in back bumps only, 1 joined tr in each ch to end of chain. 40 tr. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.

FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide to placement, sew the pieces tog.

Sew Arms to sides of Body at 25th rnd approx 6 or 7 sts apart.

Sew Head to top of neck. 

Wrap Belt around torso approx 15 rnds down from neck. Sew short edges tog then tack belt around the entire body.

With Yellow embroider Star in middle of belt for buckle (or use button).

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 3933 Dove A, 334 Buff B, and 312 Black C.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Toy measures about 6.5” (16.5 cm) long by 11.5” (29 cm) tall from hoof to tip of ear.
gauge: 14 sc = 4” [10 cm]; 10 rounds sc = 2” [5 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Head
Beginning at the muzzle, with B, ch 4.
Round 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in each of the next 2 chs. Rotate work so the bottom of the foundation ch is on top. Working in the opposite side of the ch, 2 sc in each of the next 3 chs; place marker in first sc—12 sc.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in each of the next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 3 sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Rounds 5-6: Sc in each sc around; fasten off. Join A to Round 6 at center of chin with a slip st and continue (see Special Technique).
Rounds 7-9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: [Sc2tog in next sc, sc in each of the next 3 sc] 6 times—24 sts.
Rounds 11-16: Sc in each st around.
Stuff Head firmly and continue stuffing as you close.
Round 17: [Sc2tog in next st, sc in each of the next 2 sts] 6 times—18 sts.
Rounds 18-19: Sc in each st around.
Round 20: [Sc2tog in next st, sc in next st] 6 times—12 sts.
Round 21: [Sc2tog in next st] 6 times—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving 15” (38 cm) end for sewing. With yarn needle, weave end of yarn in and out of sts of Round 21 and draw end closed. Fasten off, leaving remaining end for sewing.
Neck
With A, ch 20. Being careful not to twist chain, slip st into beginning chain to form ring.
Round 1: Sc in each ch around—20 sc.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Rounds 3-4: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving 12” (30.5 cm) end for sewing.
Body
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc] 6 times—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in each of the next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 3 sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Rounds 6-17: Sc in each sc around.
Stuff Body firmly and continue stuffing as you close.
Special Stitch
sc2tog = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Special Technique
Join new yarn with a slip st = Make a slip knot and place on hook. Insert hook into the indicated stitch or space, yarn over, and draw hook through both the stitch or space and the slip knot (1 loop on hook).

Notes
1. Work in continuous rounds (spiral) with Right side facing. Do not join or turn unless directed. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
2. Work through both loops of each stitch unless otherwise directed.
3. Stuff Body parts firmly but gently. Overstuffing will cause stitches to stretch and fiberfill will show through stitching.

Leg (make 4)
With C, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc] 6 times—12 sc.
Round 3: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around.
Round 4: Working in both loops of each sc, sc in each sc around. Fasten off.
Join A to Round 4 with a slip st.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Rounds 6-12: Repeat Round 5. Fasten off, leaving 12” (30.5 cm) end for sewing. Stuff Leg firmly.
Ear (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Rounds 3-4: Repeat Round 2.
Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Rounds 6-8: Repeat Round 2.
Round 9: [2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 2 sc] 3 times—12 sc.
Rounds 10-12: Repeat Round 2.
Round 13: [2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 3 sc] 3 times—15 sc.
Rounds 14-16: Repeat Round 2.
Round 17: [2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 4 sc] 3 times—18 sc.
Rounds 18-22: Repeat Round 2. Fasten off, leaving 20” (50.8 cm) end for sewing. Do not stuff. Flatten Ear and sew last round closed using whip stitches. Fold Ear in half lengthwise. Sew bottom of Ear together to preserve fold. Fasten off, leaving remaining end for sewing Ears to Head.
Tail
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc.
Round 2: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around.
Rounds 3-7: Working in both loops of each sc, sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving 8” (20 cm) end for sewing. Do not stuff.
Tail Hair
Join C with a slip st in any front loop of Round 2 of Tail. [Ch 5, slip st in each of the next 4 chs, slip st in next front loop of Tail] 6 times—6 Tail Hairs. Fasten off, hiding ends inside Tail.

ASSEMBLY
Use photograph as a guide for sewing pieces together. Sew neck to top of body, preserving round shape. Stuff lightly. Sew head to neck, stuffing neck as needed to provide firm foundation. Sew Legs to bottom of body so donkey is well-balanced and can stand. Place front legs behind Round 6, about 5 sts apart, and place back legs about 8 rounds behind the front legs. Sew tail to Donkey’s backside. Flatten bottom of ear, creating a triangle. Sew to top of head. Repeat for other ear, leaving 3 to 4 sts between ears.

Mane
Using a long scrap of yarn and a long running stitch, hand baste a straight line down the back of the head and neck between the back of one ear and the neck/body joining. Make a second line from the back of the other ear, parallel to the first line. These will act as a guide while creating the mane. Mane is worked freehand between the lines. Join C with a slip st at the base of the neck, between the lines. *Ch 5, slip st in each of the next 4 chs, slip st to body (mane hair made). Repeat from * 3 to 4 times between the basted lines to create the base of the mane. Continue working back and forth between the lines, up the neck and back of the head, covering the neck with mane hairs. When you reach the ears, work several mane hairs between the ears for the forelock. Fasten off, hiding ends. Remove basting stitches.

FINISHING
Use photograph as a guide for placement of facial features.
Eyes
Working over one or two stitches for each eye, embroider with satin stitches on the round that is midway between the ears and the muzzle, about 12 sts apart. Pull yarn tightly between eyes to indent slightly.
Nose
Satin stitch nostrils on muzzle.

instructions:

30th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc) 6 times. 72 sts.
31st rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc) 6 times. 66 sts.
32nd rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc) 6 times. 60 sts.
33rd rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc) 6 times. 54 sts.
34th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc) 6 times. 48 sts.
35th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc) 6 times. 42 sts.
36th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) 6 times. 36 sts.
37th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc) 6 times. 30 sts.

1st rnd: 1 scbl in each sc around. 18 sts.
2nd rnd:  (2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 6 times. 24 sts.
3rd rnd: (2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 6 times. 30 sts.
4th rnd: (2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc) 6 times. 36 sts.
5th rnd: (2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) 6 times. 42 sts.
6th rnd: (2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc) 6 times. 48 sts.
7th rnd: (2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc) 6 times. 54 sts.
8th rnd: (2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc) 6 times. 60 sts.
9th to 23rd rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. 60 sts.
24th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc) 6 times. 54 sts.
25th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc) 6 times. 48 sts.
26th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc) 6 times. 42 sts.
27th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) 6 times. 36 sts.

Finish stuffing.
29th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 6 times. 24 sts.
30th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 6 times. 18 sts.
31st rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 6 times. 12 sts.
32nd rnd: (Sc2tog) 6 times 6 sts. Fasten off.
LEGS (Make 2)
See Diagram on page 6. Make Magic ring. Work from ** to ** as given for Head. 36 sc.
7th rnd: 1 scbl in each sc around.
8th and 9th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
10th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc) 6 times. 30 sts.
11th and 12th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
13th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 6 times. 24 sts.
14th and 15th rnds: As 11th rnd.
16th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 6 times. 18 sts.
Stuff bottom of Legs only.
17th to 22nd rnds: 1 sc in each st around. 18 sts.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. Fold sides tog and stitch closed. Sew Legs to Body between 26th and 27th rnds.
ARMS (Make 2)
Make Magic ring. See Diagram on page 6. Work from ** to *** as given for Head. 24 sts.
5th and 6th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
7th rnd:  (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 6 times. 18 sts.
8th and 9th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
10th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 6 times. 12 sts.
Stuff bottom of arms only.
11th to 16th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc at end of last rnd.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. Fold sides tog and sew closed. Sew Arms to Body between 9th and 10th rnds.
TAIL
Make Magic ring. See Diagram on page 7. Work from ** to *** as given for Head. 24 sts.

7th rnd:  (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 6 times. 18 sts.
8th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 6 times. 12 sts.
9th and 10th rnds: 1 sc in each st around. Stuff lightly.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Fold sides tog and sew closed. Sew Tail to Body between 24th and 25th rnds. Bend upwards and sew middle of Tail to Body for better shape.

7th rnd: (2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) 6 times. 42 sc.
8th and 9th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around.
10th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) 6 times. 36 sts.

pattern_name: Crochet Ollie the Owl Toy Trio
materials: Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Contrast A Terracotta Rose (10880) 1 ball or 220 yds/201 m
Contrast B Gold (10970) 1 ball or 220 yds/201 m
Contrast C Aquatic (10801) 1 ball or 220 yds/201 m
Size U.S. K/10.5 (6.5 mm) Susan Bates® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Pair of 5/8" (15 mm) safety eyes for each Owl
abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 (3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 12" [30.5 cm] tall by 8" [20.5 cm] wide.
gauge: 8 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Version 1: C as Color 1, B as Color 2, and A as Color 3.
Version 2: A as Color 1, C as Color 2, and B as Color 3.
Version 3: B as Color 1, A as Color 2, and C as Color 3.

Notes:
• Rnds are joined with a sl st to first sc.
• To join new color, work to last loops on hook of first color. Yoh with new color, draw through loops and proceed with new color.

Head and Body
With Color 1, beg using magic loop method, demonstrated here.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 20 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.
6th to 12th rnds: As 4th rnd.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
14th rnd: As 4th rnd.
15th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sts.
Note: Before starting Head, stuff Body with polyfill.
16th rnd: As 4th rnd. Break Color 1. Join Color 2.
17th rnd: With Color 2, ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 40 sts. 
18th to 23rd rnds: As 4th rnd.
24th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
25th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.

Eyes (make 2)
With Color 1, beg using magic loop.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 20 sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Add safety eyes to center of each Eye as shown in photo.

Beak
With Color 3, ch 4.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Turn. 3 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Turn. 1 st.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

Wings
With Color 2, beg using magic loop method. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 4 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st) twice. Join. 6 sts. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts) twice. Join. 8 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts) twice. Join. 10 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts) twice. Join. 12 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts) twice. Join. 14 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts) twice. Join. 16 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts) twice. Join. 18 sts.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
10th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts) 3 times. 15 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

Feet (make 2)
With Color 3, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 12 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Fold each foot in half and stitch together. Define webbed “toes” by making stitches as illustrated in diagram below.

FINISHING
Stitch Eyes to Head as shown in photo, noting that eyes should touch at the center. Stitch on Beak, with Beak slightly overlapping eyes. Stuff Head with polyfil. Sew top of Head shut with yarn needle by pinching the top edges together. Stitch Wings onto either side of Owl where Body and Neck meet. Stitch Feet to base of Owl Body.

pattern_name: Crochet Santa and Mrs Claus Dolls
materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/71 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Santa Claus Main Color (MC) Black (00002) 1 ball or 44 yds/40 m
Contrast A White (00001) 1 ball or 44 yds/40 m
Contrast B Red (00095) 2 balls or 220 yds/200 m
Contrast C Jute (00082) 1 ball or 44 yds/40 m
Contrast D Mod Green (01223) 1 ball or 5.5 yds/5 m
Contrast E Yellow (00010) 1 ball or 5.5 yds/5 m
Mrs. Claus Main Color (MC) Black (00002) 1 ball or 33 yds/30 m
Contrast A White (00001) 1 ball or 110 yds/100 m
Contrast B Red (00095) 2 balls or 220 yds/200 m
Contrast C Jute (00082) 1 ball or 44 yds/40 m
Contrast D Mod Green (01223) 1 ball or 22 yds/20 m
Size U.S. F/5 [3.75 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Blush for cheeks (optional for Mrs. Claus)
abbreviations: Beg Cluster = Ch 2. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice in next st. Yoh and draw through loops on hook.
Cluster = (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times in next st. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Dc2(3)tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 2 (3) times. Yoh and draw through all 3 (4) loops on hook
Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Scbl = Single crochet through back loop only
Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 (3) sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Santa Claus: Approx 14" [35.5 cm] tall. Mrs. Claus: Approx 13" [33 cm] tall (without top bun)/approx. 15" [38 cm] tall with top bun.
gauge: 20 sc and 21 rnds = 4" [10 cm] before stuffing.
instructions:
Note
• Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as st.
• Key for all Diagrams
SANTA CLAUS
FOOT/LEG  (make 2 alike)
(See Diagram 1).
With MC, ch 7.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working on opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 15 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 dc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 21 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sts. (1 hdc in next dc. 2 dc in next st) 3 times. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sts. (1 sc in next st. 2 sc in next st) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 27 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. (1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. 2 hdc in next st) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. (1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 2 sc in next st) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 33 sts.
5th to 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
(See Diagram 2).
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Dc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 4 sts. Dc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts. Join with sl st to first sc. 29 sts.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. (Hdc2tog) 6 times. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts. Join with sl st to first sc. 23 sts.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. (Sc2tog) 5 times. 1 sc in each of next 11 sts. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
11th and 12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Stuff firmly. Fasten off.
Join A with sl st to first sc.
13th and 14th rnds: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Join B with sl st to first sc.
15th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Do not join. Work in continuous rnds.
16th and 22nd rnds: 1 sc in each st around. Fasten off.

BODY
(See Diagrams 3 and 4).
Hold Legs with toes facing in same direction and mark inner sc on both Legs. Stuff firmly as you work.
1st rnd: Join B with sl st in inner sc of first Leg. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. Ch 1. 1 sc in inner sc of second Leg. 1 sc in each of next 17 sts around same Leg. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 17 sts around first Leg. Do not join with sl st to first sc. PM for beg of rnd. 37 sc.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in rem loop of next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. (1 sc in next st. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in next sc. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. 44 sc.
3rd rnd: 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. 46 sc.
4th to 6th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
7th rnd: Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc around. 45 sts.
8th rnd: 1 sc in each st around. 
9th to 11th rnds: Rep 7th and 8th rnds once more, then 7th rnd once. 43 sc.
12th rnd: 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 21 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 41 sts. 
13th rnd: Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st around. 40 sts.
14th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
15th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
16th and 17th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
18th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sts.
19th and 20th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
21st rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 28 sts.
22nd rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
23rd rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts. 
24th and 25th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
26th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 20 sts.
27th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 16 sts. Fasten off. 
28th rnd: Join A with sl st to first sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Fasten off.

HEAD STABILIZER
See Diagram 5.
29th rnd: Join C with sl st to first sc. Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sts.
30th rnd: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
31st and 32nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Stuff firmly.
33rd rnd: (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sts.

HEAD
See Diagram 6.
1st rnd: With RS facing, holding piece with Legs toward you and working in free loops of sc of 30th rnd of Head Stabilizer, join C with sl st at back center sc. Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. 30 sts. PM for beg of rnd.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
5th to 14th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Attach safety eyes between 11th and 12th rnds 4 sc apart.
Stuff firmly as you work.
15th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
16th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 30 sts.
17th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
18th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
19th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 12 sts.
20th rnd: (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sts. 
Fasten off.

NOSE
See Diagram 7.
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. 3 sc. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing.
Stuff lightly.
Using photo as a guide for placement, sew Nose on Head.

ARMS (make 2 alike)
See Diagram 8.
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. 4 sc. PM for beg of rnd.
Stuff firmly as you work, leaving last 4 rnds unstuffed.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 8 sc.
3rd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 10 sc.
5th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
6th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 8 sts. 
Fasten off. 
7th rnd: Join A with sl st to first sc. 1 sc in each st around. Fasten off. 
Join B with sl st to first sc. 
8th to 21st rnds: With B, 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing.
Sew Arms on Body.

BEARD
See Diagram 9.
Beard Layer 1 (make 2 alike)
With A, ch 21.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. (Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. (1 dc. Ch 1. Sl st) in next ch. *(Sl st. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. (1 dc. Ch 1. Sl st) in next ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing.

BEARD LAYER 2 (make 2 alike)
With A, ch 23.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. (Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. (1 dc. Ch 1. Sl st) in next ch. *(Sl st. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. (1 dc. Ch 1.
