Sl st) in next ch. Rep from * to last 2 ch. (Sl st. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch. (1 dc. Ch 1. Sl st) in last ch. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing.

HAT
See Diagrams 10 and 11.
With B, ch 4, join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: 6 sc in ring. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. 6 sc. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 8 sc. 
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 10 sc.
4th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 12 sc.
5th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 14 sc.
6th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 16 sc.
7th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
8th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 20 sc.
9th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * around. 22 sc.
10th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
11th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 26 sc.
12th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * around. 28 sc.
13th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
14th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sc.
15th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Rep from * around. 34 sc.
16th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
17th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 17 sc. Rep from * around. 38 sc.
18th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 18 sc. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
19th to 26th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off.

BRIM
With WS facing, join A with sl st to first sc.
27th rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
28th and 29th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Flip Brim up on RS. 
Pin Hat to Head approx 2 rnds above the Eyes.
Arrange Layers of Beard alternately and sew ends to middle of face.
Sew Mustache under nose.

HOLLY (make 2 alike)
See Diagram 12.
With D, ch 7.
1st rnd: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. (Sl st in next ch. Ch 2. Sl st in next ch) twice. (Sl st. Ch 3. Sl st) in last ch. Working on opposite side of ch, (Sl st in next ch. Ch 2. Sl st in next ch) twice. Sl st in last ch. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off. 

BERRY
See Diagram 13.
With C, ch 4. Join with sl st to first sc to form a ring.
1st rnd: Beg Cluster in ring. Ch 1. (3-dc cluster in ring. Ch 1) twice. Join with sl st to first cluster. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing.

SANTA’S PANTS
See Diagram 14.
Note: Pants worked from waist down.
Belt: With MC, ch 48. Join in rnd with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sl st in each ch around. Join with sl st to back loop of first sl st. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each sl st around. Join with sl st to back loop of first sl st.
Rep last rnd 4 times more. Fasten off at end of last rnd, leaving a long end. 
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first sc.
Pants: 1st rnd: Join B with sl st to back loop of first sl st. Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sl st around. Join. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep last rnd 6 times more. 
Shape crotch and legs: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 24 sc. Ch 2. Skip next 24 sc. Join. 24 sc and ch-2 sp. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 24 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Join. 26 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep last rnd 3 times more. Fasten off at end of last rnd.
With RS facing, join B with sl st to rem loop of 2nd ch of ch-2. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st and each st to 1st ch of ch-2. 1 sc in rem loop of ch-2. Join. 26 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep last rnd 4 times more. Fasten off at end of last rnd.
Fur: Join A with sl st to back loop of first sc. 
1st rnd: Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each sc around. Join with sl st to back loop of first sl st.
2nd rnd: Working in back loops only, *1 tr in next sl st. 1 sl st in next sl st, pushing tr-post to front of work. Rep from * to last sl st. 1 tr in last sl st. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.

SANTA’S JACKET
See Diagram 15.
Note: Jacket is worked from neck down in one piece.
With B, ch 11. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *(1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in each of next 2 ch.* 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. Rep from * to * once more. 1 sc in last ch. Turn. 14 sc and 4 ch-2 sps.
2nd row: Ch 1. [1 sc in each sc to next ch-2 sp. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next ch-2 sp] 4 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 4 times more, ending on a WS row. 54 sc and 4 ch-2 sps.
1st–2nd rows: Rep from * to * for Left Front.
4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. (2 sc inc’d). 11 sc.
5th to 8th rows: As 4th row 4 times. 19 sc.
9th row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in first sc *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 dc in next sc). Rep from * to last sc. 1 dc in last sc. Turn. 21 sts. 
10th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first dc. 1 sc in each of next 19 sts (dc and ch-1 sps). 2 sc in last dc. Turn. 23 sc.
11th row: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch-1). *(1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc). Rep from * to last sc. 1 dc in last sc. Turn.
12th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc and ch-1 sp to end of row. Turn.
13th and 14th row: As 11th and 12th rows once more. Fasten off.
Vest assembly: Sew shoulder seams using whip stitch. PM on sides of fronts and back 1" [2.5 cm] down from shoulder seams for armholes. Sew side seams to markers.
Trim: With RS facing, join A with sl st to left front bottom corner. Ch 1. Work in sc up left front edge, across back neck and down right front edge. Do not work across bottom of Vest. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Split MC into separate strands and using 1 strand, embroider eyebrows and mouth with Straight Stitch. (See Diagram).
Pompom: Wind A around 2 fingers approx 50 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to a smooth round shape. Sew pompom to tip of Hat.

MRS. CLAUS
FOOT/LEG  (make 2 alike)
See Diagram 18.
With MC, ch 7.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working on opposite side of ch. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 15 sc.
Note: Stuff firmly as you work.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 dc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 21 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sc. (1 hdc in next dc. 2 hdc in next dc) 3 times. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sc. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 27 sc.
4th and 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (Dc2tog) 7 times. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
Fasten off.
8th rnd: Join A with sl st to first sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
9th and 10th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *Working in front loops only, sl st in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.
12th rnd: Join C with sl st to first sc. Ch 1. Working in back loops only of 10th rnd, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sl st.
13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sl st around. Do not join, work in continuous rnds.
14th to 17th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off at end of last rnd.
18th rnd: Join C with sl st to first sc. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
19th to 20th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
21st rnd: *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 20 sc.
22nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off.

BODY
See Diagram 19.
Hold Legs with toes facing in same direction and mark inner sc on both Legs. 
Note: Stuff firmly as you work.
1st rnd: With RS facing, join B with sc in inner sc of first Leg. Ch 1. 1 sc in inner sc of second Leg. 1 sc in each of next 19 sc around same Leg. 1 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 19 sc around first Leg. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. PM for beg of rnd. 41 sc.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in rem loop of joining ch. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 24 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. 44 sc.
3rd to 6th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
7th rnd: 1 sc in each of first 10 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 20 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 10 sc. 42 sts.
8th to 14th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
15th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
16th and 17th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
18th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sts.
19th and 20th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
21st rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 28 sts.
22nd rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
23rd rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts. 
24th and 25th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
26th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 20 sts.
27th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 16 sts. Fasten off. Join A.
28th rnd: With A, 1 sc in each st around. Fasten off. 

HEAD STABILIZER
See Diagram 20.
29th rnd: Join C with sl st to first sc. Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sts.
30th rnd: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
31st and 32nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Stuff firmly.
33rd rnd: (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sts.

HEAD
See Diagram 21.
1st rnd: With RS facing, and working in free loops of sc of Rnd 30 of Head Stabilizer, join C with sl st at back center. Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. 30 sts. PM for beg of rnd.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
5th to 14th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Attach safety eyes between 11th and 12th rnds approx 4 sc apart.
Stuff firmly as you work.
15th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
16th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 30 sts.
17th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
18th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
19th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 12 sts.
20th rnd: (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sts.
Fasten off.

HAIR BASE
See Diagram 22.
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. 6 sc. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
7th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
8th to 15th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
16th rnd: Sl st in next sc. (Ch 3. 1 tr) in same sp as last sl st. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each st to last 5 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. (1 tr. Ch 3) in last sc. Join with sl st in first sl st. Fasten off.

BUN
See Diagram 23.
With A, ch 2.
1st to 4th rnds: Rep 1st to 4th rnds of Hair Base.
5th and 6th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
7th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
8th rnd: *1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 12 sts. Fasten off. 
Stuff firmly.

HAIR TIE
With D, ch 15.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing.

BERRY
With B, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Beg Cluster. Ch 2. (3-dc cluster. Ch 2) twice in ring. Join with sl st to first cluster. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing. 

PIN Hair Base to Head. Sew in place. Sew Bun on Head. Sew Hair Tie around Bun and then sew Berry over seam.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft™ (Solids: 6 oz/170.1 g; 315 yds/288 m; Heathers: 5 oz/141.7 g; 250 yds/228 m)
Bernat® Pipsqueak™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 101 yds/92 m)
Sizes U.S. E/4 (3.5 mm) and U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge
Pair of 8 mm Safety Eyes or 2 buttons for Eyes
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of the next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: Caron® Simply Soft™: 17 sc and 18 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook. Bernat® Pipsqueak™: 9 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Body
With A and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 72 sc. Place marker on last rnd.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 5" [12.5 cm].
Beg dec rnds: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sts.
2nd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sts.
7th to 10th rnds: As 2nd to 5th rnds.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sts.
12th to 15th rnds: As 2nd to 5th rnds.
16th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sts.
17th to 20th rnds: As 2nd to 5th rnds.
21st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sts.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Stuff Body.
Head
Nose: With B and smaller hook, ch 4.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in next ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Join D at end of last rnd.
5th rnd: With D, Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 21 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Break D, join A with sl st to first sc.
8th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 35 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sc.
11th rnd: As 9th rnd.
Cont as established, inc 7 sc evenly spaced across every other rnd until there are 63 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 5 times more.
Beg dec rnds: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 49 sts
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sts.
6th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 35 sts.
8th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
Stuff Head.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sts.
10th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 21 sts.
12th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 7 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end through rem loops and pull tightly. Fasten securely.
Sew Head to top of Body.
Eye Patches (make 2)
With B and smaller hook, ch 9.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 8 sc.
2nd row: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each sc to last sc. 2 hdc in last sc. Turn. 9 hdc.
3rd row: Ch 2 (counts as hdc) 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Break B. Join D. Turn. 10 hdc.
4th row: With D, ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Do not turn. Work 4 hdc evenly along side edge. Fasten off. Attach Safety Eyes or buttons to Eye Patches as shown in picture.
Sew Eye Patches to front of Head as shown in picture.
Ears (make 2 with A for Outer Ear and 2 with B for Inner Ear).
Note: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as hdc.
With smaller hook, ch 10.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 8 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn. 6 sts.
4th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn. 4 sts.
5th row: Ch 2. (Hdc2tog) twice. 2 sts.
6th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. Fasten off.
Holding WS of Outer and Inner Ears tog, with smaller hook, join D with sl st to bottom right corner. Working through both thicknesses, ch 1. Work 1 row of sc evenly to top of Ear. Work 3 sc in tip of Ear. Work 1 row of sc evenly along left side edge. Fasten off.
Sew Ears to top of Head.
With B, embroider mouth.
Arms (make 2)
With B and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Rep last rnd 9 times more. Break B, join A.
Next rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until Arm measures approx 6" [15 cm] from beg. Fasten off.
Stuff Arms lightly. Attach Arms to either side of Body.
Legs (make 2)
With B and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 9 times more. Break B, join A.
Next rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sts.
Next 10 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
Next 10 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.
Stuff Legs lightly. Attach Legs to bottom of Body.
Tail
With 2 strands of B held tog and larger hook, ch 20. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each ch around. Join with sl st to top of ch-2. 20 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to top of ch-2.
3rd rnd: As 2nd rnd, join D with sl st to top of ch-2.
**4th and 5th rnds: With D, as 2nd rnd, join 2 strands of B at end of 5th rnd.
6th to 8th rnds: With B, as 2nd rnd. Join D with sl st to top of ch 2 at end of 8th rnd.**
Rep from ** to ** once more. Break B, join D.
Next rnd: With D, ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to top of ch-2.
Next rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch-2. 16 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in next hdc. Hdc2tog. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch-2. 12 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). *Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Join with sl st to top of ch-2. 8 sts.
Next rnd: (Hdc2tog) 4 times. 4 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end.
Draw end through rem loops and draw up tightly. Fasten securely.
Attach Tail to back of Body at center back.
Bandana
With C and larger hook, ch 2.
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 7 sc.
Rep last row 3 times more. 13 sc at end of last row.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 15 sc.
Rep last 2 rows to 21 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Ch 7. Turn.
Next row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 5 ch. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Ch 7. Turn.
Next row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. Ch 1. Skip next ch (buttonhole). 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Sl st in next sc. Fasten off.
Sew on button to correspond with buttonhole.

pattern_name: Squeeze a Peach Crochet Stress Ball
materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Contrast A Tea Rose (00042) 1 ball or 34 yds/31 m
Contrast B Sage Green (00084) 1 ball or 6.5 yds/6 m
Size U.S H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Join each rnd with sl st to first st.
PEACH
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Join. 3 sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 6 sc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 11 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of last 12 sc. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 11 sc. Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in each of last 12 sc. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 11 sc. 1 sc in skipped sc 3 rows below. 1 sc in each of last 12 sc. Join.
Rep 6th to 8th rnds once more.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
Attach safety eyes following manufacturer’s directions. Stuff Peach firmly.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.
Optional: Use a small brush and apply blush to top of Peach.
LEAF (make 2):
With B, ch 6.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in last ch. Fasten off.
Sew Leaves onto Peach as shown in photo.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 1 skein 1001 White A and small amounts of 1401 Pewter B and 1704 Bubblegum C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Colors A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 14 sc = 4" [10 cm]; 18 sc rows = 4” [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
LAMB
Body (make 2)
With A, ch 7.
Row 1: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in each ch across, turn – 12 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice, turn – 19 sc.
Rows 3–17: Ch 1 (counts as first sc), (hdc, dc) in first st, skip 2 sts, *(sc, hdc, dc) in next st, skip 2 sts; repeat from * across, skip last st, sc in top of turning ch, turn – 6 (sc, hdc, dc) groups, 1 sc.
Row 18: Ch 1, sc in first st, (sc2tog) across – 9 sc.
Fasten off.

Head (make 2)
With A, ch 7.
Row 1: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in each ch across, turn – 12 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice, turn – 19 sc.
Rows 3–12: Ch 1 (counts as first sc), (hdc, dc) in first st, skip 2 sts, *(sc, hdc, dc) in next st, skip 2 sts; repeat from * across, skip last st, sc in top of turning ch, turn – 6 (sc, hdc, dc) groups, 1 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, sc in first st, (sc2tog) across – 9 sc.
Fasten off.

Ear (make 2)
With A, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 5 ch, work 3 sc in last ch; working down opposite side of ch, sc in next 6 sts, turn – 15 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in next sc, hdc in next 5 sc, 3 hdc in next sc, hdc in next 5 sc, sc in last 2 sc, turn – 13 hdc, 4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across – 17 sc. 
Fasten off.

Arm (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, place st marker to mark beginning of round – 6 sc.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 15 sc.
Rounds 4 -19: Sc in each sc around. 
Fasten off. 

Leg (make 2)
With A, ch 2. 
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, place st marker to mark beginning of round – 6 sc.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 18 sc.
Rounds 4–22: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off.

Snout
With B, ch 2. 
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, place st marker to mark beginning of round – 6 sc.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.

FINISHING
Sew side and bottom seams of Body, leaving neck open. Stuff. Sew Head pieces together, leaving neck open. Place Head over Body neck opening and push down slightly. Sew firmly in place. Fold long edges of Ear and sew together. Sew Ear in place on Head. Repeat for second Ear. Stuff Arms. Holding Round 19 flat, sew edge together. Sew in place on Body. Repeat for second Arm. Stuff Legs. Holding Round 22 flat, sew edge together. Sew in place on Body. Repeat for second Leg. With yarn needle and C, embroider satin sts for nose and straight sts for mouth. Sew snout in place. With B, embroider satin sts for eyes.
Optional: Cut a 16" (40.6 cm) length of ribbon. Tie around neck. Trim ribbon. With yarn needle, weave in all loose ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 319 Cherry Red A, 324 Bright Yellow B, 316 Soft White C, 312 Black D, 400 Grey Heather E, 505 Aruba Sea F, 672 Spring Green G, 254 Pumpkin H, and 886 Blue I
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Car measures 2¾” wide x 4½” long (7 x 11.5 cm). Plane measures 8” long x 8” wide (20.5 x 20.5 cm), across wings. Truck measures 2¾” wide x 7” long (7 x 18 cm).
gauge: 15 sts = 4” (10 cm) in pattern; 16 rows/rounds = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CAR
Body 
Beginning at front of car, with A, ch 8.
Round 1: Work 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 5 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 5 ch; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first 3 sc, sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in remaining sc; join with slip st in first sc—22 sc.
Rounds 3–16: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 17: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, sc2tog 3 times, sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog 3 times, sc in last 2 sc; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc.
Round 18: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, sc3tog, sc in next 5 sc, sc3tog, sc in last 2 sc; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. Stuff lightly and, holding edges together, sew last round closed.
Roof 
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Rounds 5 and 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. Stuff lightly, then sew roof over Rounds 8–15 of body.
Front and Rear Window (make 2)
With C, ch 7.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. With D, embroider straight st eyes over 3rd st from each edge of Row 1 of front window. Sew front window over Rounds 5 and 6 of front side of roof. Sew rear window over Rounds 5 and 6 of back side of roof.
Side Window (make 2)
With C, ch 2.
Row 1 (right side): Work 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. Sew side windows over Rounds 5 and 6 of each side of roof.
Bumper (make 2)
With E, ch 15.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across—14 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. 
Headlight (make 2)
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—5 sc. Fasten off leaving long tail for sewing. 
Tire Half (make 8)
With E, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc; change to D—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc¬—12 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail on 4 tire halves for sewing. 
To form tire, *holding wrong sides together, whipstitch two tire halves around outer edges; repeat from * 3 times. 
ASSEMBLY
Sew bumpers over lower front and back of body, ensuring that each bumper is centered and wrapped slightly around each side. Using photograph as a guide, with D, backstitch curved mouth on front bumper.
Sew headlights above ends of front bumper. Allow half of each tire to hang below body and sew in place on lower sides between edges of bumpers.
FINISHING CAR
Weave in ends.
PLANE
Nose and Body 
Note: Insert stuffing every few rounds.
Beginning at nose, with F, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Rounds 5 and 6: Repeat Round 3; change to G at end of Round 6.
Round 7: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times, sc in remaining sc; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 9: Repeat Round 3. 
Round 10: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Rounds 11–19: Repeat Round 3 nine times.
Round 20: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 21–26: Repeat Round 3 six times.
Round 27: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Rounds 28–31: Repeat Round 3 four times.
Round 32: Ch 1, sc2tog around; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. 
Round 33: Repeat Round 3. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave end through last sts and pull tightly to close tail end of body. On underside of nose, with D, embroider curved smile with backstitches between Rounds 3 and 4.
Front Wing (make 2) 
Beginning at outer tip of wing, with H, ch 8.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. 
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in remaining sc, turn—9 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. 
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc to center st of 3-sc group, 3 sc in center st, sc in remaining sc, turn—11 sc. 
Rows 6–13: Repeat Rows 4 and 5 four times—19 sc.
Row 14: Repeat Row 4. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. Fold wing in half lengthwise and whipstitch outer edges together. 
Rear Wing (make 3) 
Beginning at outer tip of wing, with H, ch 6.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. 
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in remaining sc, turn—7 sc.
Row 4: Repeat Row 2.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in remaining sc, turn—9 sc.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. Fold wing in half lengthwise and whipstitch outer edges together. 
Windshield
With C, ch 7.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc—12 sc. Fasten off leaving long tail. With D, embroider straight st eyes 1 stitch apart from center of Row 1 of windshield. Sew windshield over Rounds 7 and 8 of body. 
Front Tire Half (make 4)
With E, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc; change to D—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail on 2 tire halves for sewing. Holding wrong sides together, whipstitch two tire halves around outer edges; repeat for 2nd tire.
Rear Tire Half (make 2) 
With D, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. Fasten off leaving long tail on 1 tire half for sewing. Holding wrong sides together, whipstitch tire halves around outer edges. 
ASSEMBLY
Using photograph as a guide for placement, sew front wings on sides of body over Rounds 14–20 and 2 rear wings over Rounds 30–33. Sew remaining wing over top of body over Rounds 30–33. Sew front tires to underside of body slightly forward of front wings; sew rear tire to underside of body centered between rear wings.
FINISHING PLANE
Weave in ends.
TRUCK
Cab Body
With I, ch 34.
Row 1 (right side): Dc in 4th ch from hook (beginning ch-3 counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in each ch across, turn—32 dc.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in first 3 dc, [bpdc around next dc, dc in next 7 dc] three times, bpdc around next dc, dc in next 3 dc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in first 2 dc, [fpdc around next dc, dc in next 7 dc] three times, fpdc around next dc, dc in last 4 dc, turn.
Rows 4 and 5: Repeat Rows 2 and 3.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
Cab Top and Bottom (make 2)  
With I, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in first sc, sc in next st, *(sc, ch 2, sc) in first sc, sc in next st; repeat from * 3 times; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc and 4 ch-2 sps.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *(sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space, sc in next 3 sc; repeat from * twice, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space, sc in last 2 sc; join with slip st in first sc—20 sc and 4 ch-2 sps.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, *(sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space, sc in next 5 sc; repeat from * twice, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space, sc in last 3 sc; join with slip st in first sc—28 sc and 4 ch-2 sps. Fasten off leaving long tail for sewing.
Front Bumper
With E, ch 15.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across—14 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. 
Grill
With E, ch 5.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—4 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. 
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
Headlight (make 2)
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
Front Windshield
With C, ch 7.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. With D, embroider straight st eyes 1 stitch apart from center of Row 1 of front windshield. 
Side Window (make 2)
With C, ch 5.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—4 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
Trailer Box Top And Bottom (make 2)
With E, ch 19.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—18 sc.
Rows 2–8: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. 
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
Trailer Box Side (make 2)
With E, ch 19.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn—18 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc; change to B, turn.
Rows 3 and 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc; change to A at end of Row 4, turn.
Rows 5 and 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc; change to E at end of Row 6, turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in each sc. Fasten off.
Trailer Back End
With E, work same as cab top.
Tire Half (make 12) 
With E, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; change to D; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next st, *sc in next sc, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail on six of the tire halves. *Holding wrong sides together, whipstitch two tire halves around outer edges; repeat from * 5 times.
ASSEMBLY
Cab
With right side of cab body facing, gently fold cab body so post sts form outer corners; working across ends of rows, sew edges together to form back of cab body. Sew cab top and bottom to body and stuff body before closing edges. Center the bumper over lower front of cab body, wrapping slightly and evenly around each side and sew in place. Using photograph as a guide, with D, embroider curved smile with backstitches on bumper. Center grill over bumper and sew in place. Sew headlights on each side of grill. Align Row 1 of front windshield over Row 5 of cab body front and sew piece in place. Align Row 1 of each side windshield over Row 5 of cab body sides and sew in place. 
Trailer
Sew trailer box top to top edges of box sides and box bottom to bottom edges. Sew back end to back of trailer box. Stuff trailer box, then whipstitch to back of cab body. Using photograph as a guide, sew tires to lower sides of truck, allowing half of each tire to hang below cab body and trailer box.
FINISHING TRUCK
Weave in ends.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 2.25 mm [US B-1]
regular sized drinking straw (for leg armatures)
Optional: Pins, knee high stocking and plastic pellets for weighted stuffing.
abbreviations: A, B, C, and D = Color A, Color B, Color C, and Color D
() = work directions in parentheses into same st
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Llama measures about 5" [12.5 cm] tall and 4" [10 cm] wide (at widest).
gauge: 32 sts = about 4" [10 cm]; 28 rounds = about 4" [10 cm] in single crochet (sc). EXACT GAUGE IS NOT CRITICAL TO THIS PROJECT.
instructions:
BODY
With A or B, make an adjustable ring. 
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; 
do not join, work in continuous rounds 
(spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to 
indicate end of round. Move marker up 
as each round is completed.

Begin Fleece Rounds
Notes
1. Stitches in every other round of this
section are worked in back loops only.
This leaves free loops on the surface
of the body.
2. Fleece is worked later and attached
to the free loops.
Round 2: Working in back loops only, 
work 2 sc in each of next 6 sts—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 
times—18 sc.
Round 4: Working in back loops only, 
[sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each st around.
Make Neck Opening
Round 6: Working in back loops only, sc 
in next 18 sts, ch 6, skip last 6 sts (for 
neck opening)—18 sc and 1 ch-6 space.
Round 7: Sc in next 18 sts, sc in next 6 
ch—24 sc.
Round 8: Working in back loops only, sc 
in each st around.
Round 9: Sc in each st around.
Round 10: Repeat Round 8.
Round 11: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 
times—18 sc.
Round 12: Working in back loops only, 
[sc in next st, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Round 13: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sc.
Tail: Ch 6, sc in 2nd ch from hook and 
next 4 ch.
Fasten off leaving a long yarn tail. 
Thread tail through stitches of Round 
13 and pull to close opening and anchor 
tail. Weave in and trim tail.
Stuff body with fiberfill, or insert pellet 
filled knee high, through neck opening.

HEAD/NECK
With same yarn color as used for body, 
make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; 
do not join, work in continuous rounds 
(spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to 
indicate end of round. Move marker up 
as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each of next 6 
sts—12 sc.
Rounds 3 and 4: Sc in each st around. 
Round 5: Work 2 sc in each of next 12 
sts—24 sc.
Rounds 6–8: Sc in each st around. 
Begin Fleece Rounds
Round 9: Working in back loops only, sc 
in next 18 sts, ch 6, skip last 6 sts (for 
neck opening)—18 sc and 1 ch-6 space. 
Round 10: Sc in next 18 sts, sc in next 6 
ch—24 sc.
Round 11: Working in back loops only, sc 
in each st around.
Round 12: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 
times—18 sc.
Attach safety eyes between Rounds 
7 and 8, about 10 or 11 stitches apart. 
Place both eyes an equal distance from 
the edges of neck opening just made 
so they will sit correctly when neck is 
added.
Begin stuffing head and continue 
stuffing as work progresses. Do not use 
weighted stuffing in head.
Round 13: Working in back loops only, 
[sc2tog] 9 times—9 sc.
Fasten off. Weave in and trim ends.
Neck
Join yarn with slip stitch in any st of 
neck opening. In the next round, stitches 
are worked into each stitch (including 
the chains of the ch-6) around the neck 
opening.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, in 
each st around, and in left and right side 
edges of opening—14 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to 
indicate end of round. Move marker up 
as each round is completed.
Round 2: Working in back loops only, sc 
in each st around
Round 3: Sc in each st around.
Round 4: Repeat Round 2.
Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing 
neck to neck opening of body. 

LEGS (make 4)
With same yarn color as used for body, 
make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; 
do not join, work in continuous rounds 
(spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to 
indicate end of round. Move marker up 
as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–6: Sc in each st around. 
Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing 
leg to body. If needed, thread beginning 
yarn tail through stitches at beginning 
of piece and pull to close opening. 
Weave in and trim beginning tail only. 
Insert drinking straw into leg and cut to 
size. 

EARS (make 2)
With same yarn color as used for body, 
ch 12.
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, sc 
in each bump across.
Fasten off leaving a long tail. Fold the 
strip in half. With the tail, sew together 
the edges that make up the opposite 
side of the foundation chain. Do not 
trim the tail. It can be used later to sew 
ear to head.

FLEECE
Finish stuffing the head and neck firmly. 
Fleece Round: Join matching yarn with 
slip st in any free loop of head Round 9, 
ch 5, slip st in same st, slip st in next st, 
*(slip st, ch 5, slip st) in next st, slip st in 
next st; repeat from * around. Fasten off 
and weave in ends.
Repeat Fleece Round around Rounds 11 
and 13 of head, Rounds 2 and 4 of neck, 
and Rounds 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12 of body.

BLANKET
With C, leaving a long beginning tail for 
fringe, ch 15.
Row 1: With C, Sc in 2nd ch from hook 
and in each remaining ch across and 
change to D in last st—14 sc.
Row 2: With D, ch 1, turn, sc in each st 
across and change to B in last st.
Row 3: With B, ch 1, turn, sc in each st 
across and change to A in last st.
Row 4: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in each st 
across and change to B in last st.
Row 5: With B, ch 1, turn, sc in each st 
across and change to D in last st.
Row 6: With D, ch 1, turn, sc in each st 
across and change to C in last st.
Row 7: With C, ch 1, turn, sc in each st 
across.
Fasten off C, leaving a long tail for 
fringe.
Hold all fringes along one side of 
blanket together and tie an overhand 
knot about ½" [1.5 cm] from edge of 
blanket. Trim ends even, about ½" [1.5 
cm] from knot. Repeat on other side of 
blanket.

FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide to 
placement, use yarn tails or yarn scraps 
to sew the following pieces together.
1. Sew head/neck to body neck opening,
positioning the head facing forwards
relative to the chest (or position to
the side, if desired). Take care to sew
all the way around the neck opening
using a secure whipstitch.
2. Sew ears to top of head between the
first and second fleece rounds on
head, about 2 or 3 stitches apart.
3. Sew legs to bottom portion of body,
between fleece rounds. Position back
legs about ½" [1.5 cm] from front legs.
Place back legs very close together
(so they touch), place the front legs
very close together. To check for
balance, pin or baste legs in place
first then sew securely in place.
With embroidery needle and 2 strands 
of black embroidery floss, embroider 
a "Y" shape for nose. Embroider the "Y" 
beginning in tip of muzzle and about 3 
rows high. Weave the floss back through 
head and knot securely then bury yarn 
in head, trimming excess as needed.

Halter
Noseband: With C, ch 14; join with slip 
st in first ch to form a ring. Note: This 
part of the halter is placed around the 
llama's muzzle.
Head Strap: Ch 21. Note: This part of the 
halter forms the strap that fits around 
the llama's head. 
Try halter on for size and adjust as 
needed. Join the end of the head strap 
with a slip st in the opposite side of the 
noseband circle.
Fasten off, knotting the yarn end 
securely. Place halter on llama.

Tassels (make 3 – 1 each with B, C, D)
1. Cut 2 lengths of C, about 3" [7.5 cm]
long for ties.
2. Cut 3 strands of tassel color yarn,
about 2" [5 cm] long.
3. Hold the 3 strands together and fold
in half.
4. Thread one of the 3" [7.5 cm] ties
through the fold then tie into a knot
for top of tassel.
5. Tie remaining 3" [7.5 cm] tie around
the top of the tassel, about ⅛" [3
mm] below top of tassel, for tassel
neck. Trim ends even. Place a small
dot of glue on knot to secure.
Repeat this process to make all 3 
tassels. Using photograph as a guide 
to placement and using yarn tails or 
yarn scraps, tie two of the tassels to 
the halter, where noseband and head 
strap meet. Tie third tassel to one of the 
llama's ears.
Place blanket on back of llama and tack 
in place using same yarn color as used 
for body. 
Weave in and trim any remaining ends.

materials: Caron International's Simply Soft (100% acrylic; 6 oz/170 g, 315 yds/288 m): 1 oz (A), 1 oz (C)
Caron International's Simply Soft Brites (100% Acrylic): 1 oz (B)
One size US G-6 (4mm) crochet hook, or size to obtain gauge.
Safety eyes (not recommended for small children)
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
SNAKE
Head
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join and do not turn—6 sc.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 4–6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—24 sc. Change to B in last st.
Rounds 8–10: Sc in each sc around. Change to C in last st of Round 10.
Round 11: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 12–18: Sc in each st around. Change to B in last st of Round 18.
Do not fasten off.
Body
If using safety eyes, insert them in Round 10 with 5 stitches between them.
You will not be able to add safety eyes after snake is completed.
Rounds 1–3: With B, sc in each sc around—18 sc. Change to A in last st of Round 3.
Rounds 4–11: Sc in each sc around. Change to B in last st of Round 11.
Rounds 12–14: Sc in each sc around. Change to C in last st of Round 14.
Rounds 15–22: Sc in each sc around. Change to B in last st of Round 22.
Repeat Rounds 19–40 eight more times. Do not fasten off.
Shape Tail
Rounds 1–3: With B, sc in each sc around—18 sc. Change to A in last st of Round 3.
Round 4: Sc in each st around.
Round 5: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sts.
Round 6 and 7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sts.
Work a sl st in the next st. Fasten off leaving a long tail. Use the long tail to sew opening closed.

TONGUE
With C, ch 8.
Row 1: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, ch 3, sl st in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, hdc in next 5 ch of beginning ch-8.
Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
Sew tongue to front of head. Using yarn needle, weave in all ends. If desired, embroider eyes onto face.

materials: RED HEART® Soft Baby Steps®: 1 ball each 9401 Elephant A, 9600 White B, and 9200 Baby Yellow C
Small amount of black yarn (for face)
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Bear measures 12” (30.5 cm) tall, without crown.
gauge: 10 sc = 2” (5 cm) in pattern; CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Beginning at top of head, with A, ch 6.
Round 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch—12 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in last 2 sc—18 sc.
Round 3: Work 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in last 2 sc—24 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 8: Sc in each sc.
Round 9: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—42 sc.
Round 10: Sc in each sc.
Round 11: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—48 sc.
Rounds 12–16: Sc in each sc.
Round 17: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc. Stuff leg with fiberfill.
Round 18: [Sc2tog] 9 times—9 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Second Leg
Round 1 (right side): With wrong side of unworked sts of body facing, join A with sc in front loop of first unworked st after first leg, working in front loops only, sc in each remaining st, turn; working in unworked loops of first 6 sts, sc in each loop—12 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–18: Work same as Rounds 2–18 of first leg.
Arm (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—15 sc.
Rounds 4–17: Sc in each sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Stuff arm with fiberfill. Flatten last round; holding edges together, sew through both thicknesses to close arm.
Ear (make 2) 
Work same as arm through Round 6—15 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 3 times—12 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Do not stuff. Flatten last round; holding edges together, sew through both thicknesses to close ear.
Snout 
With B, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Crown
With C, ch 26.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—25 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 6, *slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, tr in next ch, skip next 3 sc, slip st in next sc, ch 6; repeat from * 4 times, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, tr in next ch, skip next 3 sc, slip st in last sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew first 2 rows together to form circle.
FINISHING
Stuff snout lightly with fiberfill. Using photograph as a guide for all pieces, sew snout to front of head, ears to sides of head, and arms to sides of body. Place crown off-center between ears and sew to top of head.
With black yarn and satin stitches, embroider eyes and nose; embroider mouth with straight stitches under nose.
Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Baby Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Contrast A Misty Jungle Green (04801) 1 ball or 160 yds/146 m
Contrast B Lemon Lime (04223) 1 ball or 85 yds/77 m
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Susan Bates® split-lock stitch count markers.
2 yds [1.8 m] of Bernat® Super Value™ in Black (07421) for embroidery.
Pair of black safety eyes 14 mm diameter.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stiches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Approx 18" [45.5 cm] tall x 15" [38 cm] diameter (measured across Large Florette).
gauge: 8 sc and 9 rows = 4" (10 cm).
instructions:
LARGE FLORETTE 
Notes:  
• Join all rnds with sl st to first sc.
• Push tr sts to RS of work to create bobbles
Beg at top of Large Florette, with A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 8 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc. 1 tr) in each sc around. Join.16 sts. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *(1 sc. 1 tr) in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc. Rep from * around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
8th rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 48 sts.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc. [(1 sc. 1 tr) in next sc] 4 times. 1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 72 sts.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *(1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc) twice. [(1 sc. 1 tr) in next sc] 4 times. (1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc) twice. Rep from * around. Join. 96 sts.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc. Rep from * around. Join.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sts. (Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 72 sts.
15th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc. Rep from * around. Join.
16th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. (Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sts.
17th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc. Rep from * around. Join.
18th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sts.  Fasten off.
SMALL FLORETTE
Notes:  
• Join all rnds with sl st to first sc.
• Push tr sts to RS of work to create bobbles.
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 8 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc. 1 tr) in each sc around. Join. 16 sts. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc. Rep from * around. Join.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc. Rep from * around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc. Fasten off.
STEM
Note: Stem is worked in a continuous spiral.  Do not join at end of rnds. Place marker on first stitch of rnd and move marker each rnd to keep place.
With B, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
4th rnd: *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sc.
5th rnd: *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around.
7th rnd: Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around.
8th to 11th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
12th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
13th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
14th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sts.
15th and 16th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
17th rnd (Branch opening): 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. Ch 6. Skip next 6 sc. 1 sc in next sc and each sc to end of rnd. 32 sts (including ch-6).
18th rnd: 1 sc in each sc and ch to end of rnd. 32 sts.
19th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
20th and 21st rnds: 1 sc in each sc and ch to end of rnd.
22nd rnd:  1 sc in each sc around. Sl st in first sc of next rnd.  Fasten off.
BRANCH
Note:  Branch is worked in a continuous spiral.  Do not join at end of rnds. Place marker on first stitch of rnd and move marker each rnd to keep place.
Join B with sl st to first skipped st from 17th rnd of Stem.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Working across opposite side of ch-6, 1 sc in each of next 6 ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
2nd to 4th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Sl st in first sc of next rnd. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Attach safety eyes to Stem as shown in photo. Stuff Large and Small Florettes, Stem and Branch. Sew last rnd of Stem and last rnd of Large Florette tog. Sew last rnd of Branch and last rnd of Small Florette tog. With black yarn, embroider mouth using straight st as seen in photo.

materials: Bernat® Baby Blanket Calico™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Contrast A Mossy Path (04930) 2 balls or 352 yds/322 m
Contrast B Leafy Greens (04928) 1 ball or 60 yds/55 m
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 8 sc and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
•  Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
•  Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as stitch.
Bottom of Pillow
With A, ch 31.
See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working in opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join. 62 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 28 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 28 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 68 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 28 sc. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 28 sc. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. Join. 74 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 28 sc. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 28 sc. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. Join. 80 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep 5th rnd until work from beg measures 13" [33 cm].
Cont for Top of Pillow:
See diagram.
1st rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 28 sc. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. Rep from * once more. Join. 74 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 28 sc. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. Rep from * once more. Join. 68 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 28 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. Rep from * once more. Join. 62 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 25 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 25 sc. (Sc2tog) twice. Join. 56 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Stuff Body.
Note: Safety eyes cannot be moved once they are properly attached, so it’s best to make sure you like eye placement using stitch markers before inserting them.
Following manufacturer’s instructions, attach Safety Eyes at markers.
With long yarn end, sew top edge tog.
Stomach
With B, ch 3.
See diagram.
1st row: (WS). 5 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Turn. 5 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 10 hdc.
3rd row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 15 hdc.
4th row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 20 hdc.
5th row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 25 hdc.
6th row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to end of row. Do not turn. 30 hdc.
Next row: Cont along flat edge, ch 2. Work 20 hdc evenly across edge. Turn.
Next 6 rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off.
Sew Stomach to Body as shown in photo.
Arms and Legs (make 4 alike)
With A, ch 2.
See diagram.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep 2nd rnd until work from beg measures 9" [23 cm]. Fasten off leaving a long end to sew to Body. Sew Arms and Legs to Body as shown in photo.
Eyelids (make 2)
With A, ch 3.
See diagram.
1st row: 5 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Fasten off.
Sew Eyelids over safety eyes as shown in photo.

materials: RED HEART® Soft Baby Steps: 1 ball each: 9200 Baby Yellow A and 9505 Aqua B
RED HEART® Boutique® Sashay Mini™: 1 ball 2682 Breezy C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Clothes designed for 18” (45.5 cm) doll. Tee Shirt measures: 8½” (21.5 cm) wide x 7” (18 cm) long. Skirt measures: 9” (23 cm) wide x 6” (15 cm) long. Purse measures: 3” (8 cm) wide x 3” (8 cm) high.
gauge: 16 sts = 4” (10 cm); 20 rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc; turn—52 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 11 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 13 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 11 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc; turn—56 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 14 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 7 sc; turn—60 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in next 8 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 13 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 15 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 13 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 7 sc; turn—64 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in next 8 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 14 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 16 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 14 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 8 sc; turn—68 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 15 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 17 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 15 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 8 sc; turn—72 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 16 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 18 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 16 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 9 sc; turn—76 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 17 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 19 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 17 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 9 sc; turn—80 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 18 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 20 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 18 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 10 sc; turn—84 sc.
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in next 11 sc, skip 20 sc, sc in next 22 sc, skip 20 sc, sc in next 11 sc; turn—44 sc.
Rows 15-26: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. At the end of Row 26, do not turn.
Buttonhole Placket
Row 1: Rotate work so that side of Row 26 is on top; ch 1, work one sc in the side of each Row; turn—26 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in next 2 sc, ch 1, skip 1 sc, [sc in next 4 sc, ch 1, skip 1 sc] 4 times, sc in next 3 sc; turn—26 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc and ch-1 space across—26 sc. Fasten off and weave in ends.
Assembly
Using white sewing thread, sew Buttons onto Tee Shirt, centering one Button under each Buttonhole.
SKIRT
With B, ch 41.
Row 1 (Right side): Skipping first ½” (12.7 mm) of elastic, hold elastic above foundation ch and loosely sc over elastic, working in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; leave last ½” (12.7 mm) of elastic unworked—40 sc. Place loop on stitch holder. With sewing thread, tack ends of elastic in place; trim excess elastic. Place loop back on hook; turn.
Rows 2-3: Ch 1, sc across; turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in next 3 sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 7 sc] 4 times, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc; turn—45 sc.
Rows 5-6: Ch 1, sc across; turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in next 4 sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 8 sc] 4 times, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc; turn—50 sc.
Rows 8-9: Ch 1, sc across; turn.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in next 4 sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 9 sc] 4 times, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc; turn—55 sc.
Row 11 (Attach Ruffle): Ch 1, place C on top of work so cut end is on the right and ball is on the left. Leaving a 2” end to sew to wrong side later, insert hook through a large mesh hole in C and then through the first sc from Row 10, sc together using B; *skip one hole in C and insert hook into the next hole in C and then through the next sc from Row 10, sc together using B; repeat from * across—55 sc. Cut C, leaving a 2” end. Do not fasten off B.
Rows 12-13: With B, ch 1, sc across; turn.
Row 14 (Attach Ruffle): Ch 1, place C behind work so cut end is on the right and ball is on the left. Leaving a 2” (5.1 cm) end to sew to wrong side later, insert hook through first sc from Row 13 and then through a large mesh hole in C, sc together using B; *insert hook into the next sc from Row 13, then skip one hole in C and insert hook into the next hole in C, sc together using B; repeat from * across—55 sc. Cut C, leaving a 2” end. Do not fasten off B.
Rows 15-16: Repeat Rows 12 and 13.
Row 17: Repeat Row 11.
Rows 18-19: Repeat Rows 12 and 13. Fasten off, leaving long end for sewing.
Assembly
Using B, sew side edges together, matching Rows of sc; fasten off and weave in ends. Using thread, sew matching ends of C together and tack to inside of Skirt.
PURSE
With B, ch 21.
Row 1 (Wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 18 ch, 3 sc in last ch; turn to work in opposite side of foundation ch; sc in next 19 ch; turn—41 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in next 20 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 20 sc; turn—43 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in next 21 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 21 sc; turn—45 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in next 22 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 22 sc; turn—47 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in next 23 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 23 sc, change color to A in last sc; turn—49 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in next 24 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 24 sc; turn—51 sc.
Finishing
For Strap, ch 51, slip st in first sc of Row 6 to join. Fasten off, leaving long end for sewing. Using photograph as a guide, fold Purse into thirds and sew sides closed using A. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Soft: One ball each: 4420 Guacamole A, 9440 Light Grey Heather B, 2515 Turquoise C, 4600 White D, 4614 Black E.
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5.5 mm [US I-9], 4.0mm [US G-6]
Three 5⁄8” (15.9 mm) buttons, sewing thread to match buttons, sewing needle, yarn needle, fiberfill stuffing, stitch markers
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Clothes designed for 18” (45.5 cm) doll. Coat measures: 7” (18 cm) wide x 9½” (24 cm) long. Ear Flap Hat measures: 12” (30.5 cm) in diameter. Wristers measure: 2” (5 cm) long. Boots measure: 4” (10 cm) high. Dog measures: 8” (20.5 cm) high x 12” (51 cm) long.
gauge: With 5.5 mm [US I-9] hook, 12 sc = 4” (10 cm); 15 rows sc = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com 
©2014 Coats & Clark
RedHeart.com
Walking the Dog for Dolls
Crochet the perfect puppy for your doll, and 
then crochet the warm coat and accessories 
to take him on a cool morning or evening 
walk. Pattern includes Coat, Ear Flap Hat, 
Wristers and Boots.

Right Front
Row 20 (Right side): Ch 1, sc 
in next 8 sc; turn—8 sc.
Rows 21-25: Ch 1 sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 26: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in 
next 6 sc; turn—7 sc.
Row 27: Ch 1, sc in next 5 sc, 
sc2tog; turn—6 sc.
Row 28: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in 
next 4 sc; turn—5 sc.
Row 29: Ch 1, sc in next 3 sc, 
sc2tog; turn—4 sc.
Rows 30-32: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; 
turn. At end of Row 32, fasten off, leaving 
a long tail for seaming later to Back.

Left Front
Using 5.5 mm [US I-9] hook, join 
A to beginning of Row 19.
Rows 20-32: Repeat Rows 
21-32 of Right Front.

Back
Skip first 2 sc of unworked middle 
section of Coat. Using 5.5 mm [US I-9] 
hook, join A to next sc of Row 19.
Row 20: Ch 1, sc in next 18 sc, leave 
last two sc unworked; turn—18 sc.
Rows 21-29: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; 
turn. At end of Row 29, fasten off.

Assembly
Using long tails, sew Left Front to first 
4 sc of Back and sew Right Front to 
last 4 sc of Back. Weave in all ends.

Special Stitches
sc2tog = [draw up a loop in next 
st] twice, yarn over and draw 
through all 3 loops on hook.
sc3tog = [draw up a loop in next 
st] 3 times, yarn over and draw 
through all 4 loops on hook.

Notes
1. Unless otherwise noted, always work under
both loops of the stitch in the row below.
2. For sections worked in rounds, place
marker for beginning of round and move
marker up as each round is completed.
3. To change color, work last stitch of old
color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new
color and draw through all loops on hook to
complete stitch. Proceed with new color.

COAT
Using 5.5 mm [US I-9] hook with A, ch 39.
Row 1 (Wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from 
hook and each ch across; turn—38 sc.
Rows 2-19: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.

COLLAR
Using 4.0 mm [US G-6] hook with A, join 
yarn to Right side of Row 26 of Right Front.
Row 1: Ch 1, work 1 sc in the side of each 
Row of Rows 26-32 of Right Front, work 10 
sc across Back, work 1 sc in the side of each 
Row of Rows 32-26 of Left Front; turn—24 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in 
next sc, sc in next 20 sc, 2 sc in next 
sc, sc in last sc; turn—26 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next 
sc, sc in next 10 sc, [2 sc in next sc] 
twice, sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next 
sc, sc in last sc; turn—30 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in 
next sc, sc in next 26 sc, 2 sc in next 
sc, sc in last sc; turn—32 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next 
sc, sc in next 13 sc, [2 sc in next sc] 
twice, sc in next 13 sc, 2 sc in next 
sc, sc in last sc; turn—36 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. 
Fasten off; weave in ends.

Left Placket
Using 5.5 mm [US I-9] hook with A, join yarn 
to Wrong side of Row 1 on left edge of Coat.
Row 1: Ch 1, work 1 sc in the side of each 
Row of Rows 1-25 of Coat; turn—25 sc.
Rows 2-4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. 
At end of Row 4, fasten off; weave in ends.

Right Placket
Using 5.5 mm [US I-9] hook with A, join yarn 
to Wrong side of Row 25 on right edge of Coat.
Row 1: Ch 1, work 1 sc in the side of each 
Row of Rows 25-1 of Coat; turn—25 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 3 (Buttonholes): Ch 1, sc in next 2 sc, 
ch 2, skip 1 sc, sc in next 9 sc, ch 2, skip 
1 sc, sc in next 9 sc, ch 2, skip 1 sc, sc in 
next 2 sc; turn—22 sc, three ch-2 spaces.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc and ch-2 
space across—25 sc. Fasten off; weave 
in ends. Using thread, sew Buttons to 
Left Placket, making sure they line up 
with Buttonholes in Right Placket.

Arm (Make 2)
Using 5.5 mm [US I-9] hook with A, 
join yarn to 2nd unworked sc of armpit 
on Right side of Row 19 of Coat.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in same sc; work 
23 sc evenly around sides of armhole; 
sc in last unworked sc of armpit; slip 
st in first sc to join; turn—25 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc 
in next 19 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc; slip 
st in first sc to join; turn—23 sc.
Rounds 4-5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc 
in next 17 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc; slip 
st in first sc to join; turn—21 sc.
Rounds 7-8: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn.
Round 9: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc 
in next 15 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc; slip 
st in first sc to join; turn—19 sc.
Rounds 10-15: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn. At end of 
Round 15, fasten off; weave in ends.

WRISTERS (Make 2)
Using 5.5 mm [US I-9] hook with B, ch 12; 
slip st in top of beginning chain to join.
Round 1 (Wrong side): Ch 1, sc in 2nd ch 
from hook and each ch across; turn—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in next 5 sc, ch 2, skip 
2 sc, sc in next 5 sc; slip st in first sc to 
join; turn—10 sc, one ch-2 space.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in 
next ch-2 space, sc in next 5 sc; slip 
st in first sc to join; turn—12 sc.
Rounds 4-6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn. At end of 
Round 6, fasten off; weave in ends.

BOOTS (Make 2)
Using 5.5 mm [US I-9] hook with E, ch 6.
Round 1 (Right side): Work 3 sc in 2nd 
ch from hook, sc in next 3 ch, 3 sc in 
last ch; rotate work so opposite side of 
foundation chain is on top, sc in last 3 ch; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in next 3 sc, [2 sc in next 
sc] 3 times, sc in next 3 sc, [2 sc in next sc] 3 
times; slip st in first sc to join; turn—18 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 
3 times, sc in next 3 sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in 
next sc] 3 times, sc in next 3 sc; slip st in first 
sc to join; turn—24 sc. Change color to B.
Round 4: With B, ch 1, sc in front loops only 
around; slip st in first sc to join; turn—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, working in both loops, 
sc in next 13 sc, [sc2tog in next sc] 
3 times, sc in next 5 sc; slip st in 
first sc to join; turn—21 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in next 3 sc, [sc2 tog 
in next sc] 3 times, sc in next 12 sc; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn—18 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in next 11 sc, [sc2tog 
in next sc] 3 times, sc in last sc; slip 
st to first sc to join; turn—15 sc.
Rounds 8-17: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn. At end of 
Round 17, fasten off; weave in ends.

EAR FLAP HAT
Using 5.5 mm [US I-9] hook with C, ch 2.
Round 1 (Right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch 
from hook; slip st to first sc to join; turn—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc] 6 times; 
slip st to first sc to join; turn—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 
6 times; slip st in first sc to join; turn—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 
2 sc in next sc] 6 times; slip st in 
first sc to join; turn—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, 
2 sc in next sc] 6 times; slip st in 
first sc to join; turn—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, 
2 sc in next sc] 6 times; slip st in 
first sc to join; turn—36 sc.
Rounds 7-14: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn. At end of 
Round 14, fasten off; weave in ends.

Right Ear Flap
With Right side facing, skip first 5 sc 
of Round 14 of Ear Flap Hat. Using 5.5 
mm [US I-9] hook, join C in next sc.
Row 1 (Right side): Ch 1, sc in same 
sc and next 7 sc; turn—8 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in 
next 6 sc; turn—7 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in 
next 5 sc; turn—6 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in 
next 4 sc; turn—5 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in 
next 3 sc; turn—4 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in 
next 2 sc; turn—3 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next sc; turn—2 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc2tog. Fasten 
off; weave in ends.

Left Ear Flap
With Right side facing, skip next 10 sc 
of Round 14 of Ear Flap Hat. Using 5.5 
mm [US I-9] hook, join C in next sc.
Rows 1-8: Repeat Rows 1-8 of Right Ear Flap.

Hat Border
With Right side facing and using 5.5 
mm [US I-9] hook, join A to first sc 
of Round 14 of Ear Flap Hat.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in next 5 sc, work 1 sc in 
the side of each Row of Rows 1-8 of Right 
Ear Flap, ch 15, slip st in 2nd ch from hook 
and next 13 chs, work 1 sc the side of each 
Row of Rows 8-1 of Right Ear Flap, sc in next 
10 sc, work 1 sc in the side of each Row of 
Rows 1-8 of Left Ear Flap, ch 15, slip st in 
2nd ch from hook and next 13 chs, work 1 
sc the side of each Row of Rows 8-1 of Left 
Ear Flap, sc in last 5 sc; slip st in first sc to 
join—52 sc. Fasten off; weave in ends.

DOG
Gauge is not critical for this item. Work tightly 
so stuffing does not show through stitches. 
Body
Using 4.0 mm [US G-6] hook with B, ch 2.
Round 1 (Wrong side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch 
from hook; slip st in first sc to join; turn—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc] 6 times; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 
6 times; slip st in first sc to join; turn—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 
2 sc in next sc] 6 times; slip st in 
first sc to join; turn—24 sc.
Rounds 5-21: Ch 1, sc in each sc 
around; slip st in first sc to join; turn.
Round 22: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 
times; slip st in first sc to join; turn—18 sc.
Round 23: Ch 1, [sc, sc2tog] 6 times; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn—12 sc.
