Round 24: Ch 1, sc2tog 6 times; slip st in first 
sc to join—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long 
tail for sewing. Sew closed; weave in ends.

Legs (Make 4)
Using 4.0 mm [US G-6] hook with D, ch 2.
Round 1 (Wrong side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch 
from hook; slip st in first sc to join; turn—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc] 6 times; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; slip st 
in first sc to join; turn. Change color to B.
Rounds 4-10: Ch 1, sc in each sc 
around; slip st in first sc to join; turn.
Round 11 (Hips): Ch 1, sc in first 
6 sc; do not join; turn—6 sc.
Round 12: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 
2 sc, sc2tog; turn—4 sc.
Round 13: Ch 1, [sc2tog] in next 2 sc—2 sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Stuff 
Legs lightly; sew all 4 Legs to Body, referring 
to photo for placement. Weave in all ends.

Head
Using 4.0 mm [US G-6] hook with B, ch 2.
Round 1 (Right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch 
from hook; slip st in first sc to join; turn—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc] 6 times; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 
6 times; slip st in first sc to join; turn—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 
2 sc in next sc] 6 times; slip st in 
first sc to join; turn—24 sc.
Rounds 5-8: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn.
Round 9: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 
times; slip st in first sc to join; turn—18 sc.
Round 10: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 
times; slip st in first sc to join; turn—12 sc.
Rounds 11-12: Ch 1, sc in each sc 
around; slip st in first sc to join; turn.
Round 13: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc] 6 times; 
slip st in first sc to join—24 sc. Fasten 
off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Stuff 
lightly; sew Head to Body, referring to 
photo for placement. Weave in ends.

Snout
Using 4.0 mm [US G-6] hook with D, ch 6.
Round 1 (Right side): Work 3 sc in 2nd 
ch from hook, sc in next 3 ch, 3 sc in 
last ch; rotate work so opposite side of 
foundation chain is on top, sc in last 3 ch; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in next 3 sc, [2 dc 
in next sc] 3 times, sc in next 3 sc, 
[2 dc in next sc] 3 times; slip st in 
first sc to join; turn—12 dc, 6 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, dc in next 6 sts, sc in next 
3 sts, dc in next 6 sts, sc in last 3 sts; slip 
st in first dc to join; turn—12 dc, 6 sc.
Rounds 4-5: Ch 1, sc in each st around; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc; 
do not join; turn—4 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, 
sc in last sc; turn—3 sc.
Rounds 8-10: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Round 11: Ch 1, sc3tog—1 st. Fasten 
off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Stuff 
lightly; sew Snout to Head, referring to 
photo for placement. Weave in ends.

Nose
Using 4.0 mm [US G-6] hook with E, ch 2.
Round 1 (Right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch 
from hook; slip st in first sc to join; turn—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; slip 
st in first sc to join. Fasten off, leaving 
a long tail for sewing. Stuff lightly. 
Referring to photo, sew Nose to Snout 
and embroider Mouth. Weave in ends.

Eyes (Make 2)
Using 4.0 mm [US G-6] hook with E, ch 2.
Round 1 (Right side): Ch 1, work 4 sc 
in 2nd ch from hook; slip st in first sc to 
join—4 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for 
sewing. Referring to photo for placement, 
embroider a French knot in the center of 
each Eye using D, and sew Eyes to Head.

Ears (Make 2)
Using 4.0 mm [US G-6] hook with B, ch 8.
Round 1 (Wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch 
from hook, sc in next 5 ch, 3 sc in last 
ch; rotate work so opposite side of 
foundation chain is on top, sc in last 6 ch; 
slip st in first sc to join; turn—15 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc, 3 dc in 
each of next 3 sc, sc in next 6 sc—12 
sc, 9 dc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for 
sewing. Sew Ears to Head, referring to 
photo for placement. Weave in ends.

Tail
Using 4.0 mm [US G-6] hook with D, ch 2.
Round 1 (Right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch 
from hook; slip st in first sc to join; turn—6 sc.
Rounds 2-6: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; slip 
st in first sc to join; turn. Change color to B.
Round 7: With B, ch 1, sc in each sc 
around; slip st in first sc to join; turn.
Rounds 8-13: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; 
slip st in first sc to join. Fasten off, leaving 
a long tail for sewing. Referring to photo for 
placement, sew Tail to Body. Weave in ends.

Collar
Using 4.0 mm [US G-6] hook with C, ch 21.
Row 1 (Right side): Ch 1, sc in 2nd 
ch from hook and each sc across; 
turn—20 sc. Change color to A.
Row 2: With A, ch 1, sc in each sc 
across; turn. Change color to C.
Row 3: With C, ch 1, sc in each sc 
across; fasten off, leaving a long tail 
for sewing. Place Collar around Neck; 
sew sides together. Weave in ends.

Leash
Using 4.0 mm [US G-6] hook with 
E, join yarn to Collar; ch 50.
Row 1: Slip st in 11th ch from hook 
and remaining 39 chs—10 ch, 40 slip 
sts. Fasten off; weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m) Sleepy Contrast A Buff (0334) 1 ball or 62 yds/56.5 m
Contrast B Aruba Sea (0505) 1 ball or 40 yds/36.5 m
Contrast C Soft White (0316) 1 ball or 6 yds/5.5 m
Sneezy Contrast A Buff (0334) 1 ball or 62 yds/56.5 m
Contrast B Gold (0321) 1 ball or 40 yds/36.5 m
Contrast C Soft White (0316) 1 ball or 6 yds/5.5 m
Size U.S. G/6 [4 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge. Susan Bates® stitch markers. Polyfil stuffing. Susan Bates® yarn needle.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rnds = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
BODY
See Diagrams on page 3.
With A, make a magic loop.
1st rnd: (RS). 6 sc in magic loop.
Do not join, work in continuous rnds. PM for beg of rnd. Move marker up as work progresses.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
7th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 42 sc.
8th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.
9th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 54 sc.
10th to 14th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
15th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sts.
16th and 17th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
18th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 42 sts.
19th rnd: As 16th rnd.
20th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
21st rnd: As 16th rnd.
22nd rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 30 sts.
23rd rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
Fasten off.
Stuff Body.

HAT
With B, make a magic loop.
See Diagrams on page 4.
1st rnd: (RS). 4 sc in magic loop. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. PM for beg of rnd. Move marker up as work progresses.
2nd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 6 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 8 sc.
4th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 10 sc.
6th rnd: As 4th rnd.
7th rnd: 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. (1 sc inc’d). 11 sc.
8th to 14th rnds: As 7th rnd. 18 sc.
15th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 20 sc.
16th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * around. 22 sc.
17th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
18th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 26 sc.
19th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * around. 28 sc.
20th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
21st rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
22nd rnd: As 4th rnd.
23rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 42 sc.
24th rnd: As 4th rnd.
25th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.
26th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 54 sc.
27th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 60 sc.
Fasten off. Stuff Hat.

NOSE
See Diagram on page 3.
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. PM for beg of rnd. Move marker up as work progresses.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 8 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: (Sc2tog) 4 times. 4 sts.
Fasten off. Stuff Nose.

BEARD
Cut one 6" [15 cm] length of C and tie end in a knot to form a circle.
Cut 20 x 5" [12.5 cm] lengths of C and add as fringe to the circle at opposite end of knot.

FINISHING
Pin Hat onto Body to find placement for Nose. Stitch Nose in position.
Pull Beard ‘ring’ under Nose and stitch knot in place to hold Beard in position under Nose.
Trim Beard as desired.
Sew Hat to Body over top of Nose.

materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi™ (3.5 oz /100 g; 239 yds/219 m) Cactus (9627) 1 ball
Size U.S. B/1 [2.25 mm] Susan Bates® crochet hook or sizes needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbl = Double crochet through back loop only
Hdcbl = Half double crochet through back loop only
Scbl = Single crochet through back loop only
Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) sc. Yoh and draw through all 3(4) loops on hook
gauge: 24 dc and 18 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
•  Before beg, separate different color sections of yarn as follows: Pop center color out by pushing gently on center of ball so that it comes out intact. Find point where the color changes and cut yarn. Rep this process for rem yarn colors by pushing rings of color out of the larger ring and cutting. Wind each color into a separate ball to prevent tangling. You may find that one color appears both in the center and on outside of the ball, wind tog or separately.
•  Each cactus is made from 5 pieces: Body, 2 arms and 2 legs.
•  Clothing is made separately and placed on completed cactus.

BODY
Notes:
• Body is worked from side to side in rows.
• All body stitches are worked into back loops only to form ridges.
• When body rows are complete, stitches are worked along one side edge, dec to gather the edge for top of cactus.
With A or B, ch 22.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 21 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each of first 7 sc. 1 hdcbl in each of next 7 sc. 1 dcbl in each of next 6 sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3 (does not count as a st). 1 scbl in first sc. 1 dcbl in each of next 6 dc. 1 hdcbl in each of next 7 hdc. 1 sc in each of last 7 sc. Turn.
4th to 17th rows: As 2nd and 3rd rows 7 times more.
18th row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each of first 7 sts. 1 hdcbl in each of next 7 sts. 1 dcbl in each of next 6 sts. 1 scbl in last st.
Gather Top of Head: Do not turn. Working in ends of rows along side edge, (sc2tog over ends of next rows) 9 times. 9 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long yarn tail. Weave tail through rem loops. Pull to gather top of Head. Sew side edges of first and last rows tog. Stuff body. Sew lower edges tog for bottom of cactus.
Facial features: With C embroider eyes using French knot as shown in picture. Embroider mouth using straight stitch as shown in picture.

ARMS (make 2 for each cactus)
Note: Arms worked from side to side in rows.
With same color as for Body, ch 10.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 9 sc.
2nd to 9th rows: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Weave tail through ends of rows along one side edge. Pull to gather for hand end of arm. Sew edges of first and last rows tog. Stuff arm. Bend arm in middle and sew a few stitches to maintain the bend and make hand end point upwards.

LEGS (make 2 for each cactus)
Beg at bottom of foot, with C, ch 13.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 12 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each of first 3 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 scbl in each of last 3 sc. Turn. 9 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each of first 3 sts. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of last 3 sts. Turn. 7 sts.
4th to 7th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Fold piece in half and sew side and lower edges tog. Stuff piece.

OVERALLS (make for cactus done with B)
Notes:
• Overalls are worked side to side - worked all the way across front then across back.
• At center of front and back, sts are left unworked to form crotch.
With A, ch 11.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd to 10th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Crotch: 11th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 7 sc.
12th row: Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Turn. 10 sc.
13th to 30th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
31st and 32nd rows: As 11th and 12th rows.
33rd to 40th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

Waistband
1st row: Do not turn at end of last row. Working in ends of rows along long side edge (waist edge), work sc evenly spaced to end of row. Join C. Fasten off A, leaving long end.
2nd and 3rd rows: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off, leaving a long yarn tail for sewing. Sew side edges tog for side seam. Sew inseam and crotch seam.

Strap (make 2)
With A, ch 15.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. 14 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew ends of each Strap to front of waistband approx 1"  [2.5 cm] from side edges. Sew Straps to back.
With C, embroider a French knot button on front at end of each strap.

DRESS (make with A)
Notes:
• Dress is made from 3 pieces: Front, back and tie.
• Tie is attached to top of front edge. Ends of tie are crossed at back of dress and sewn to top of back edge.
Front
With D, ch 13.
Bib: 1st row:  1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 12 sc.
2nd to 7th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Skirt: 8th row: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout). 1 dc in first sc. 2 dc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 24 dc.
9th and 10th rows: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Back
With D, ch 13.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 12 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row.
Skirt: 3rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first sc. 2 dc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 24 dc. 
4th and 5th rows: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew side seams.
Tie
With D, ch 40. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain (first strap made). Do not turn or fasten off.
Attach tie to dress: With dress front facing, working along opposite side of front foundation ch, 1 sc in each ch to end of row. Ch 40. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Fasten off and weave in ends. Cross straps at back of dress and thread each end through a space between stitches at top of back, 2 sts from center back. Tie the ends into a bow.

FLOWER
With D, ch 4.
1st rnd: Work 11 dc in the 4th ch from hook. Join with sl st in top of beg ch. Turn. 12 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as a st). 3 hdc in next dc. (Sl st in next dc. 3 hdc in next dc) 5 times. Sl st in same st as joining slip st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide to placement, Sew arms to side of cactus. Sew legs to underside of cactus. For A-cactus, sew flower to top of side of head. Put dress or overalls on cactus. Weave in and trim any rem ends.

materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi Prints™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 2242 yds/221 m)
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
2 black safety eyes 1/4" [6 mm] for each toy.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Approx 4" [10 cm] tall, excluding comb and legs.
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Version 1: White as Color 1, Yellow as Color 2, and Red as Color 3. 
Version 2: Prints as Color 1, Yellow as Color 2, and Red as Color 3. 
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.

Body
With Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
6th and 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
9th and 10th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
12th and 13th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
15th to 21st rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sts.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
24th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
25th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
Secure safety eyes to Body as shown in photo. Stuff Body firmly.
26th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
27th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join. 6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.

Beak
With Color 2, ch 6, leaving a long end for sewing. Join with sl st to first ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 3 times. Join. 3 sts.
Fasten off. Draw end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.
Sew Beak to Body as shown in photo.

Comb (top of head): With Color 3, ch 6.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from the hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in next ch of foundation ch. Rep from * 3 times more.
Fasten off, leaving long end for sewing. Sew Comb to top of Body as shown in photo.

Wattle
With Color 3, ch 11. 
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 3 sc in last ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Sew Wattle around Beak as shown in photo.

Wings (make 2)
With Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. (1 sc in next sc. 2 dc in next sc) 3 times. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. Join. 18 sts.
Fasten off, leaving long end for sewing. Sew Wings to sides of Body as shown in photo.

Tail
With Color 1, ch 24, leaving a long end for sewing. Join.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 24 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
5th to 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * around. Join.
Fasten off, leaving long end for sewing. Sew end of Tail closed at 7th rnd. Stuff Tail firmly. Sew tail to Body as shown in photo.

Legs (make 2)
With Color 2, ch 14.
1st row: 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 2 ch. *Ch 4. 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sl st in each of next 2 ch. Rep from * once more. 1 sc in next ch of foundation chain and each ch to end of chain.
Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Sew Legs to bottom of Body as shown in photo.

materials: Bernat® Baby Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 492 yds/450 m)
Size U.S. E/4 (3.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 16 sc and 18 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Front and Back  (make 2 alike)
With B, ch 21.
1st row:  (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 20 sc.
2nd row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until piece measures 3½" [9 cm], ending on a WS row. Do not fasten off.
Next row:  (RS). Ch 2 (counts as hdc). *Dcfp around next sc. Dcbp around next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 hdc in last sc. Turn.
Next row:  Ch 2 (counts as hdc). *Dcfp around next st. Dcbp around next st. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdc in top of ch 2. Break B, join A.
Head: 1st row:  With A, ch 1. Working in back loops only , 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
2nd to 6th rows:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Shape Head: Next row:  Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 18 sts.
Rep last row, dec 2 sts every row to 8 sts. Fasten off.
Arms (make 2)
**With A, ch 2.
1st rnd:  8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.  16 sc.
3rd to 5th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.**
6th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Break A, join B with sl st to first st. 12 sts.
7th rnd:  With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
8th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 6 times more, stuffing very lightly (to maintain floppiness of limbs) as you work. Fasten off at end of last rnd.
Legs  (make 2)
Work from ** to ** as given for Arms.
6th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 12 sts.
7th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 7 times more, stuffing very lightly as you work. Fasten off at end of last rnd.
Ears (make 2)
With A, ch 10. Join with sl st to first ch.
1st rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sc.
5th to 13th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
14th rnd:  Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) twice. 12 sts.
15th rnd:  Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving long end. Thread end through rem sts and draw up tightly. Fasten securely.
FINISHING
Mark position of Eyes on Front piece. Insert Safety Eyes following manufacturer’s instructions. With pink embroidery floss, embroider nose and mouth using satin stitch.  
Satin Stitch
With WS of Front and Back tog, sew edges tog, leaving opening for stuffing. Stuff Body. Sew rem edge closed.
Attach Arms and Legs.
Sew Ears to top of Head.

instructions:
Note: Do not join at end of rnds. Work in spiral in continuous rnds. Move marker onto first st at beg of each rnd.

2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
6th and 8th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Join B at end of 8th rnd.
9th and 10th rnds: With B, 1 sc in each sc around.
11th and 12th rnds: With A, 1 sc in each sc around.
13th and 14th: With B, 1 sc in each sc around.

21st rnd: (Sc2tog) 6 times.

Wings (make 2)
With C, ch 6.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working in opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. Turn.
2nd row: Sl st in each of first 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 hdc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sl st in each of last 2 sc. Fasten off.

Antennae

With crochet hook, draw Antennae through Body above eyes as shown in photo. Tie knots in Antennae as close to Body as possible to secure.

materials: Bernat® Blanket ™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/210 m)
Size U.S. K/10½ [6.5 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 15" [38 cm] tall by 11" [28 cm] wide
gauge: 8 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: All rnds are joined with a sl st to first st unless otherwise indicated.
Beak
Note: Beak is not stuffed with polyfill
With B, ch 7.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 2 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Working into opposite side of chain, 1 sc in each ch to last ch. Join.14 sc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
Fasten off, leaving long tail to stitch Beak onto Head of Duck.
Body/Head
With A, beg using magic loop method, demonstrated here: https://www.yarnspirations.com/ca-en/video-y-crochet-magic-loop.html
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sc.
7th to 14th rnds: As 5th rnd.
15th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
16th rnd: As 5th rnd.
17th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
18th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sts.
19th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 40 sc.
20th rnd: As 5th rnd.
21st rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in first st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sc.
22nd to 29th rnds: As 5th rnd.
Note: Attach safety eyes between rnds 27 and 28 approx 10 sts apart.
Stitch Beak to Head between rnds 26 and 27 centred between safety eyes.
30th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sts.
31st rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sts.
32nd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sts.
33rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sts.
Note: Stuff with polyfill before proceeding to following decrease rnds.
34th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Join. 30 sts.
35th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sts.
36th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around until closed. Join. Fasten off.
Wings (make 2)
Note: Wings are not stuffed with polyfill.
With A, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 9 sc in ring. Join. 9 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 15 sc.
6th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
8th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 9 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Sew to either side of Duck where head and body meet as shown in photo.
Feet (make 2)
With B, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. 3 dc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 3 dc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 3 dc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 7 sts. Join. 26 sts.
4th rnd: Working in back loops only, work 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Skip next dc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Skip next dc. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 23 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. (Sc2tog) to end of rnd. Join. 12 sts.
7th rnd: As 5th rnd.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff Feet with polyfill and sew to bottom of Duck approx 5 rnds from bottom and 15 sts apart.
Tail
With A, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in first st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 9 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 12 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 15 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 18 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in each of first 3 sts. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 21 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of first 4 sts. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 25 sc.
9th rnd: As 7th rnd.
Sew to back of Duck as shown in photo.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 2.25 mm [US B-1]
Black embroidery floss and embroidery needle for mouth
Scrap of pink felt for cheeks
Regular size drinking straw for leg armature
Optional: Knee high stocking and plastic pellets for weighted stuffing
abbreviations: A, B, C, and D = Color A, Color B, Color C, and Color D
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Mermaid measures about 5½" [14 cm] tall not including tail, and 7½" [19 cm] tall including tail.
gauge: 32 sts = about 4" [10 cm]; 28 rounds = about 4" [10 cm] in single crochet (sc). EXACT GAUGE IS NOT CRITICAL TO THIS PROJECT. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BODY
Beginning at top of body with A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each of next 6 sts and change to your choice of yarn color B or C for bikini in last st —12 sc. Fasten off A.

Bikini
Round 3: With bikini color, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 4–6: With bikini color, sc in each st around and change to A in last st. Fasten off bikini color.
Rounds 7–11: With A, sc in each st around and change to bikini color in last st. Fasten off A.
Rounds 12–14: With bikini color, sc in each st around.
Stuff body with stuffing or with optional knee high filled with plastic pellets. Complete piece with bikini color only. Round 15: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Round 16: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Secure tail and weave to inside of body.

ARMS AND LEGS (make 4)
Note: Arms and legs are "stuffed" with drinking straw cut to size. Do not stuff with fiber.
With A, make an adjustable ring. Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–11: Sc in each st around. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing limb to body. Insert straw into limb and cut straw even with top opening of limb.

HEAD
Beginning at top of head with A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each of next 6 sts—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—36 sc.
Rounds 7–12: Sc in each st around.
Round 13: [Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 14: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc. Attach safety eyes between Rounds 8 and 9, about 8 sts apart.
Round 15: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Begin stuffing head and continue to stuff until piece is complete.
Round 16: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing head to body.

WIG BASE
With your choice of yarn color B or D, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 8 hdc in ring; join with slip st in first hdc—8 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 1 (does not count as a stitch), 2 hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first hdc—16 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st] 8 times; join with slip st in first hdc—24 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st] 8 times; join with slip st in first hdc—32 hdc.
Round 5: Ch 1, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first hdc.
Rounds 6 and 7: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing wig base to head. Note: Hair instructions are found at the end of the pattern. Hair is added very last.

TAIL
Beginning at waist with C, ch 20; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Work 2 sc in same ch as joining slip st, sc in next 9 ch, 2 sc in next ch, sc in next 9 ch; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—22 sc. Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–8: Sc in each st around. Round 9: [Sc2tog, sc in next 9 sts] twice—20 sc.
Round 10: Sc in each st around.
Round 11: [Sc2tog, sc in next 8 sts] twice—18 sc.
Round 12: Sc in each st around.
Round 13: [Sc2tog, sc in next 7 sts] twice—16 sc.
Round 14: Sc in each st around.
Round 15: [Sc2tog, sc in next 6 sts] twice—14 sc.
Rounds 16 and 17: Sc in each st around.
Round 18: [Sc2tog, sc in next 5 sts] twice—12 sc.
Round 19: Sc in each st around.
Round 20: Work 2 sc in each st around—24 sc.
Round 21: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—30 sc.
Fasten off C.

Fins
Flatten piece, with decrease lines at sides. Inserting through both layers, place a marker in the middle stitch on the top and bottom layers so that there are 14 stitches on each side of the marked middle stitches.
First Fin
Working through both layers, join C with slip st in the marked middle sts.
Round 1: Sc in next 14 sts; leave sts on other side of marker unworked for second fin; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—14 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each st around.
Round 4: [Sc2tog, sc in next 5 sts] twice—12 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 4 times—8 sc.
Round 6: [Sc2tog] 4 times—4 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Weave in and trim ends.

Second Fin
Working through both layers, join C with slip st in the marked middle sts so that you are ready to work over the 14 unworked sts. Repeat Rounds 1–6 of first fin.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Weave in and trim ends.

Waistband
Round 1: With right side facing and working along opposite side of foundation chain at waist, draw up a loop of B in any ch, ch 1, hdc in same ch and in each ch around; join with slip st in first hdc—20 hdc.
If a two-color waistband is desired, fasten off B and draw up a loop of C in any hdc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off. Weave in and trim ends.

TUTU
Beginning at waist edge with B, ch 19.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—18 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, 2 sc in each st across—36 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, *sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * across—54 sc.
Rows 4 and 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. With long yarn tail, sew edges together for back seam, leaving about ⅛" [3mm] unsewn at top waist edge. Weave in and trim ends.

Sash
With right side facing, join B with slip st in one top corner of waist edge, ch 22. Fasten off and weave in and trim ends. Join B with slip st in second top corner of waist edge, ch 22. Fasten off and weave in and trim ends.

SKIRT
Beginning at waist edge with C, ch 19.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—18 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, [hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st] 6 times—24 hdc.
Rows 3–5: Ch 1, turn, hdc in each st across and change to B in last st of last row.
Fasten off C, leaving a long tail for sewing edges together.
Row 6: With B, turn, *ch 3, slip st in next st; repeat from * across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Using the long tail, sew the first and last ch-3 loops together. Weave in and trim end. With long C-colored tail from Row 5, whip stitch side edges together for back seam. Weave in and trim ends.

Sash
With B, ch 25, hold skirt with foundation ch at top, sc in each ch along opposite side of foundation ch, ch 25. Fasten off and weave in and trim ends.

FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide to placement, use yarn tails or yarn scraps to sew the following pieces together.
1. Sew head to body, taking care to position face frontwards.
2. Sew arms to upper sides of body at Rounds 3 and 4.
3. Sew legs to lower portion of body.
Bangs: Before sewing wig base to head, embroider bangs as follows: With yarn same color as wig base, begin embroidering bangs about 2 rows above the eyes and make long stitches that will be partially hidden under the wig base. Vary the length of the bang stitches for a tousled look. Place wig base on head, overlapping bangs by a fraction of an inch. Pin in place, for best results, and sew base to head. Weave and trim ends.
Smile: With embroidery needle and 2 strands of black embroidery floss, embroider a smile at Round 13 of head, in the middle of the face, about 3 stitches wide.
Cheeks: Cut small circles from pink felt. Referring to photo for placement, glue cheeks to face directly under and to the sides of the eyes.
Hair Version 1 (side buns)
With B, leaving a long beginning tail, ch 21.
Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 hdc in next ch, *hdc in next ch, 2 hdc in next ch; repeat from * across—30 hdc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Roll the piece in spiral (jelly roll) fashion. With one yarn tail, sew layers to one another to retain the shape. With the other yarn tail, sew bun to side of head, about level with the eyes. Repeat to make and attach second bun.

Hair Version 2 (long curls)
First Round of Curls: Join D with slip st in any st of last round of wig base; ch 21, slip st in each ch of ch-21 just made, slip st in same st as joining slip st (first curl made), *skip next st, slip st in next st, ch 21, slip st in each ch of ch-21 just made, slip st in same st of wig base as very first slip st of this curl (next curl made); repeat from * around last round of wig base. Fasten off, weave in and trim ends.
Next Round of Curls: Working around Round 4 of wig base (or any round desired), repeat first round of curls.
Notes: There is no need to fill entire wig base with curls as it will become too heavy and may make the head sag. To hide base and style the hair, pull a few lengths of the Round 4 curls to the back of head and tie loosely in back. Slip stitch lengths will curl naturally.
Weave in and trim any remaining ends. Dress mermaid in outfit of your choice.

materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi Prints™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 239 yds/219 m) Giraffe (9321) 1 ball makes 2
Size B/1 (2.25 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume™ crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
4 black safety eyes ¼" [6 mm]. Stitch marker. Fiber/filling. Susan Bates® Steel Yarn Needle. Susan Bates® Split-Lock Stitch Count Markers.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Approx 9" [23 cm] from top of ear to bottom of foot.
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook and smooth yarn.
instructions:
Version 1: Yellow as Color 1. Brown as Color 2. White as Color 3.
Version 2: Multi as Color 1. Brown as Color 2. White as Color 3.
Notes:
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed, keeping color change to WS of work.
• Do not join at end of rnd. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). Move marker up as each rnd is completed.

VERSION 1 
Body
Beg at bottom of body, with Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. (12 sc).
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. (18 sc).
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around (24 sc).
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
6th to 14th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
15th rnd: 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. (Sc2tog) 6 times. 1 sc in each of last 9 sc. 24 sts.
16th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
17th rnd: 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog) 6 times. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. 18 sts.
18th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
19th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. 15 sts. Stuff body.
20th to 30th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
31st rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. (20 sc).
32nd to 37th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Stuff as you go.
38th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. (15 sts).
39th rnd: (Sc2tog) 7 times. 1 sc in last sc. (8 sts). Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Thread yarn through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely, leaving a long end.
Ear (make 2)
With Color 1, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 5 dc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc last ch. Turn. 11 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. 2 sc in each of next 3 sts. 1 sc in each of last 4 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Sew Ears in place.
Horn (make 2)
With Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Sew Horn in place.
Snout
With Color 3, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. (9 sc).
3rd to 5th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Sew Snout in place stuffing as you sew. When Snout is sewn in place, embroider mouth and nostrils with Color 2, little straight sts. With Color 2 embroider satin st Eyes above Snout.
Leg (make 4)
With Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. (10 sc).
3rd rnd: Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join Color 1.
4th to 12th rnds: With Color 1, 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Stuff leg and sew in place.
Spot (make 5)
With Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Sew Legs in place.
Tail
With Color 2, ch 8. 
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Sew tail in place.
Cut 3 lengths of Color 3 7" [18 cm] long. Draw through end of tail. Fold in half. Tie 6 ends tightly together. Trim and brush.
VERSION 2
With Color 1, work as given for Version 1. For Snout - use Color 3.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)

gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Body and Head (all Versions make alike).
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join C 
with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: With C, ch 1. 2 sc in each sc 
around. Join B with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc 
around. Join C with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc 
around. Join B with sl st to first sc.
5th and 6th rnds: As 3rd and 4th rnds.
Stuff Body.
7th rnd: With B, ch 1. *Draw up a loop in 
each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 
3 loops on hook - Sc2tog made. Rep from 
* around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 5 sts. 
Break B and C.
8th rnd: With A, ch 1. 2 sc in each st 
around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next 
sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 15 sc.
10th and 11th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc 
around. Join with sl st to first sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. 
Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first 
sc. 10 sts.
Stuff Head.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * 
around. Join with sl st to first sc. 5 sts. 
Fasten off. Draw yarn through rem sts and 
fasten securely.
Wacky
Hair: Wind C around 4 fingers 6 times. 
Remove from fingers and tie tightly in 
center. Sew to top of Head. Cut loops 
unevenly.
Sew 2 beads to Head for eyes. Embroider 
mouth with straight stitch as seen in 
picture. Sew key-ring to top of Head.
Stingy
Wings (make 2).
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc. 1 hdc. 5 dc. 1 hdc. 2 sc) 
in ring. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Fasten off.
Sew Wings to back of Body as seen in 
picture.
Antennae: Cut length of A 4" [10 cm] 
long. Thread through top of Head and 
knot each end.
Sew 2 beads to Head for eyes. Embroider 
mouth with straight stitch as seen in 
picture. Sew key-ring to top of Head.
Punky
Mohawk: Cut 8 lengths of B 4" [10 cm] 
long. Draw each length of yarn through 
Head in a line from top of Head to base of 
Head at back. Knot through each length 
of yarn close to Head to form Mohawk. 
Trim evenly.
Sew 2 beads to Head for eyes. Embroider 
mouth and eyebrows with straight stitch 
as seen in picture. Sew key-ring to top of 
Head.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Size U.S. H/5 [8 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of worsted weight yarn in dark brown for Nose and Mouth.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 9" [23 cm] tall x 5" [12.5 cm] wide, including Legs.
gauge: 13 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:  
• All rnds are joined with sl st to first sc.  
• Where instructions indicate to leave a long tail when fastening off, this tail is to be used in seaming.

Snout
With A, beg using magic loop method demonstrated here. ( See diagram on page 3)
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.  
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.  
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. With dark brown yarn, stitch on Mouth as shown in photo. Loop yarn between 2 sts approx 10 times to make Nose.  
Body/Head
Note: Body and Head are worked in one piece from the bottom up.  
With B, beg using magic loop method. ( See diagram on page 3)
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
4th to 10th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.  
11th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
12th rnd: As 4th rnd.
13th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
14th rnd: As 4th rnd. 
15th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 12 sts.
16th rnd: As 4th rnd. 
17th rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 24 sc.
18th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
19th to 26th rnds: As 4th rnd.
27th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
28th rnd: As 4th rnd.
29th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
Before proceeding to complete Head, stitch Snout to Face between 20th and 24th rnds. Add safety eyes between 24th and 25th rnds, approx 6 sts apart and centered over Snout. Beg stuffing with polyfill. Cont stuffing with polyfill while working rest of Head.
30th rnd: As 4th rnd.
31st rnd: As 13th rnd. 18 sts.
32nd rnd: As 15th rnd. 12 sts.
33rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. 
Ears (make 2)
With B, beg using magic loop method. ( See diagram on page 3)
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in next st. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc. 
3rd and 4th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 8 sts.
Do not stuff. Stitch Ears to Head as shown in photo, approx 4 rnds down from top. 
Mane
With C, join yarn to top of head, on left side of magic loop. ( See diagram on page 3)
1st rnd:  Ch 8. Sl st in same sp as join. *(Sl st. Ch 8. Sl st) all in corresponding st of next rnd of Head. Rep from * around, working in a circle from top of head, behind ears, and down under chin and back to top.
2nd rnd: Sl st in next st, working behind 1st rnd. Ch 10. Sl st in same st. *(Sl st. Ch 10. Sl st) all in corresponding st of next rnd of Head. Rep from * around, working in a circle behind 1st rnd. Join with sl st to base of first chain worked. 
Fasten off. 
Feet (make 2)
With B, beg using magic loop method. ( See diagram on page 3)
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sts.
6th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Stuff Feet with polyfill. Attach Feet to each side at bottom of Body. Note that Feet should stick out sideways to give Lion support to sit up.

Arms (make 2)
With B, beg using magic loop method. ( See diagram on page 3)
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 15 sc.
3rd to 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
8th to 9th rnds: As 3rd rnd. 
10th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 9 sc.
11th to 15th rnds: As 3rd rnd. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff Arms with polyfill. Stitch to Lion at Neck so Arms hang down in Front of Feet as shown in photo. 
Tail
With C, beg using magic loop method. ( See diagram shown right)
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join. 
2nd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
6th rnd:  *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 6 sc.
7th to 12th rnds: As 2nd rnd. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stitch tail to Body at center back.

materials: Lily Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Size U.S H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first sc. Turn at end of each rnd, alternating RS and WS throughout.
BODY
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: (RS). 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. Turn. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn. 12 sc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 18 sc.
4th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 24 sc.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 30 sc.
6th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 36 sc.
7th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 42 sc.
8th to 11th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
12th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 19 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each sc of last 19 sc. Join. Turn. 46 sc.
13th to 30th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
31st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 19 sc. (Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of last 19 sc. Join. Turn. 36 sc.
32nd to 34th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
Stuff Body.
Tail: 35th rnd:  Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to last 6 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. Join. Turn.
36th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
37th to 42nd rnds:  Rep last 2 rnds 3 times more.
43rd to 46th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn. 
47th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join. Turn. 20 sc.
48th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join. Turn. 24 sc.
49th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join. Turn. 28 sc.
50th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join. Turn. 32 sc.
51st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 7 sc. Join. Turn. 36 sc.
52nd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Skip last 18 sts. Join. Turn. 20 sc.
**53rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
54th rnd:  Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join. Turn. 18 sc.
55th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
56th rnd:  Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join. Turn. 16 sc.
57th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog 3 times. Join. Turn. 10 sc.
Stuff Tail.
58th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 5 times. Join. 5 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts.
Next rnd:  With WS facing, join A to last skipped st in 52nd rnd. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Join. Turn. 20 sc.
Rep from ** to **.
Tusk: With A, ch 8. Join with sl st to first ch, making sure not to twist ch.
Note: Do not turn at end of rnds while working Tusk.
1st rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 8 sc.
2nd to 8th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
9th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) twice. Join. 6 sc.
10th to 15th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts.
Flippers: With MC, ch 4.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of row. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sts.
3rd to 6th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Do not fasten off. Do not turn.
Flipper Edging:  Ch 1. Work sc evenly around sides and ch edge. Fasten off.
Assembly: Sew Tusk and Flippers onto Body as shown in picture.
With B, embroider Eyes with satin stitch as shown in picture.

materials: RED HEART® Soft Yarn: 1 ball 9522 Leaf for Hat; 1 ball each 9779 Berry A and 9522 Leaf B for Bag.
RED HEART® Heart & Sole® with Aloe: 1 ball 3960 Spring Stripe.
Yarn needle, sewing needle and thread; three ½” flower shaped buttons for Hat; 2 stitch markers, one shank button for Bag.
Yarn needle, sewing needle and thread, three ½” flower shaped buttons in assorted colors.
abbreviations: V-st = (dc, ch 1, dc) in same space.
sc2tog = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Hat circumference: 13”. Bag: 4½” wide x 4” high. Vest Chest Measurement: 11½”. Vest Length: 6”.
gauge: With larger hook and Soft Yarn: 6 V-sts = 4”; 8 rounds = 4” for Hat. 14 sts = 4”; 12 rows = 4” in pattern for Bag. With smaller hook and Heart and Sole Yarn 17 sts = 4”; 16 rows = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hooks to obtain the gauges.
instructions:
LACY LEAf HAT
Special Abbreviation
V-st = (dc, ch 1, dc) in same space.
Ch 3; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1 throughout), [dc in ring, ch 1] 7 times; join with a slip st in 3rd ch of ch-4 – 8 ch-1 spaces.
Round 2: Slip st in next ch-1 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 3, sc) in same space and in each ch-1 space around; join with a slip st in first sc – 8 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in next ch-3 space, ch 4, V-st in same space, [(dc, ch 1, V-st) in next ch-3 space] 7 times; join in 3rd ch of ch-4 – 16 ch-1 spaces.
Round 4: Repeat Round 2 – 16 ch-3 spaces.
Round 5: Slip st in next ch-3 space, ch 4, dc in same space, [V-st in next ch-3 space] 15 times; join in 3rd ch of ch-4 – 16 V-sts.
Round 6: Repeat Round 2.
Round 7: Slip st in next ch-3 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-3 space and in each ch-3 space around; join.
Round 8: Slip st in next ch-3 space, ch 1, 2 sc in same space and in each ch-3 space around; join – 32 sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Brim-Round 10: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, hdc in next sc, 2 hdc in next sc, dc in next sc, 2 dc in next 2 sc, dcc in next sc, 2 hdc in next sc, hdc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc; TURN leaving remaining sts unworked.
Brim Edging
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, 2 dc in next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With sewing needle and thread, sew buttons to front of brim following photo as guide. Weave in ends.
VERY BERRY BAG
Row 1 (Right Side): With A, ch 24; sc in 2nd ch from hook, [hdc in next ch, sc in next ch] 11 times; turn – 23 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc throughout), working in front loops only, hdc in first st, [sc in next st, hdc in next st] 11 times; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in first st, [hdc in next st, sc in next st] 11 times; turn.
Rows 4-9: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 three more times. Fasten off after Row 9.
Border
Round 1: With right side facing, join B with sc in first st on last row of bag; work 2 more sc in same st, sc in next 11 sts, mark last st made, sc in next 10 sts, 3 sc in last st; working over post of st at row ends, work 9 sc to next corner; working in remaining loops of beginning ch, 3 sc in first st, sc in next 11 sts, mark last st made, sc in next 10 sts, 3 sc in last st; working over post of st at row ends, work 9 sc to next corner; join in first sc. Fasten off.
Assembly
Row 1: With wrong sides together, fold bag in half at markers, join A with a slip st in first marked st at fold; working through both thicknesses at same time, [ch 1, slip st in next sc] 12 times; for strap [ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook] 16 times; taking care not to twist strap, working in st on opposite side of bag border and through both thicknesses at the same time, slip st in center sc of 3-sc group, [ch 1, slip st in next sc] to 2nd marker. Fasten off. Remove stitch markers.
Flap
Row 1 (Right Side): Join B with a slip st in center of side seam behind strap; working in back loops only in sc across top of bag, sc in next 2 sc, hdc in next 2 sc, dc in next sc, 3 dc in next sc, dc in next sc, hdc in next 2 sc, sc in next 2 sc, slip st in center of second side seam; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, working in front loops only, sc in first 2 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, dc in next 3 sts, 3 dc in next st, dc in next 3 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, sc in last 2 sts, slip st in center of side seam; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, working in both loops, sc in first 2 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, dc in next 4 sts, for buttonhole (dc, ch 1, dc) in next st, dc in next 4 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, sc in next 2 sts, slip st in center of side seam. Fasten off.
Flap Trim
Row 1: With right side facing, join A with a slip st in center of side seam, [ch 1, slip st in next st] 9 times, slip st in ch-1 space, [ch 1, slip st in next st] 9 times, ch 1, slip st in center of side seam. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With sewing needle and matching thread, sew button to front of bag lined up with buttonhole. Weave in ends.
SPRING STRIPES VEST
Special Abbreviations
V-st = (dc, ch 3, dc) in same st or space.
sc2tog = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Row 1 (Right Side): Beginning at lower edge, ch 49; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 48 sc.
Rows 2-6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sc; sc2tog; turn – 46 sc.
Rows 8 and 9: Repeat Row 2.
Row 10: Repeat Row 7 – 44 sc.
Rows 11-14: Repeat Row 2.
Divide for Left front
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in first 10 sc; TURN leaving remaining sts unworked.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across; turn – 9 sc.
Rows 4-6: Repeat Row 2.
Rows 7-14: Repeat Rows 3-6 twice more – 7 sc. Fasten off.
Back
Row 1: With right side facing, skip next 2 sc of last long row, join yarn with sc in next sc, sc in next 19 sc; TURN – 20 sc.
Rows 2-14: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
Right front
Row 1: With right side facing, skip next 2 sc of last long row, join yarn with sc in next sc, sc in next 9 sc; turn – 10 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, sc2tog; turn – 9 sc.
Rows 4-6: Repeat Row 2.
Rows 7-14: Repeat Rows 3-6 twice more – 7 sc. Fasten off.
Lower Border
Row 1: With right side facing, working in remaining loops of beginning ch, join yarn with sc in first st, * V-st in next st, skip next st, sc in next st **, skip next st; repeat from * across, end at **; turn – 12 V-sts.
Row 2: Ch 6 (counts as dc, ch 3), dc in first sc, [sc in ch-3 space of next V-st, V-st in next sc] 12 times; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, slip st in ch-3 space of first V-st, ch 1, sc in same space, [V-st in next sc, sc in ch-3 space of next V-st] 12 times; do not turn but pivot to work Front Edging.
Front Edging and Button Loops
With right side still facing, ch 1, working over post of st at row ends, sc in first row, 2 sc in next row, sc in next row; for button loops [(sc, ch 3, sc) in next row, sc in next 2 rows] 3 times; sc in each row to back neck, sc in each st across back, working in row ends of opposite side, sc in each row to last 2 rows on Lower Border, 2 sc in next row, sc in last row. Fasten off.
Armhole Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join yarn with sc in first skipped sc at underarm, sc in next sc, working over post of st at row ends, sc in each row around armhole opening; join with a slip st in first sc – 30 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, skip next 2 sc, V-st in next sc, skip next 2 sc, [sc in next sc, skip next 2 sc, V-st in next sc, skip next 2 sc] 4 times; join in first sc.
Round 3: Ch 6 (counts as dc, ch 3), dc in same sc, sc in ch-3 space of next V-st, [V-st in next sc, sc in ch-3 space of next V-st] 4 times; join in 3rd ch of ch-6. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With sewing needle and matching thread, attach buttons to left front aligned with button loops. Weave in ends.
