The Royal Family
Have fun creating your own crochet version of the Royal Family! We’ve included the Prince, Princess, Royal Baby and an elegant Pram so that they can enjoy a family stroll around the palace.

Additional Supplies

Special Stitch
sc2tog = [Draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

Embroidery Stitches
Running Stitch = Draw the needle and yarn in and out of the fabric in a line, creating a dash pattern.
Back Stitch = Draw needle and yarn through fabric from back side to front side (starting point), draw needle and thread through from front side to back side about ½” (1.5cm) to the right, *draw needle and thread through from back side to front side about ½” (1.5cm) to the left of starting point of previous stitch (starting point of next stitch), draw needle and thread through from front side to back side at starting point of previous stitch; repeat from * to create a solid line of stitches.
French Knot = Draw needle and yarn through fabric from back side to front side, hold yarn close to where it exits the fabric and wind it 3 or 4 times around the needle. Holding yarn down firmly, re-insert the needle close to the yarn’s original exit point and draw the needle through leaving a knot on the surface.

Outer Shell Sides (make 2)
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Row 1: Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work back and forth in rows, turn—6 sc.
Note: Always skip the ch-1 at the beginning of a row. Work the first stitch into the first sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 3 times, turn—9 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 3 times, turn—12 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 3 times, turn—15 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 3 times, turn—18 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 3 times, turn—21 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] 3 times, turn—24 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Outer Shell Center
With A, ch 11.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—10 sc.
Rows 2–24: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Inner Lining Sides (make 2)
With C, make an adjustable ring.
Rows 1–6: Work same as Rows 1–6 of Outer Shell Sides—21 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Inner Lining Center
With C, ch 9.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—8 sc.
Rows 2–24: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Hood
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Rows 1–7: Work same as Rows 1–7 of Outer Shell Sides—24 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, [sc2tog, sc in next 6 sc] 3 times, turn—21 sc.
Rows 9–12: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Wheel (make 4)
With B, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—5 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–26: Sc in each sc around, firmly stuffing wheel every 5 rounds.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Axles and Handle (make 5)
With D, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—5 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–16: Sc in each sc around, lightly stuffing 3 pieces every 5 rounds (for Axles and Handlebar), leave the other 2 pieces unstuffed (for sides of Handle).
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Assembly
1. Sew long curved edge of one Outer Shell Side to one long edge of Outer Shell Center. Sew long curved edge of other Outer Shell Side to opposite long edge of Outer Shell Center. Sew Inner Shell Lining Sides to Inner Shell Lining Center in same manner.
2. Nest the Inner Lining inside the Outer Shell. Working through both thicknesses, join A with sc in top edge, sc evenly around top edge to join pieces together; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
3. Sew open end of each Wheel to first round to form a tire (donut) shape. Sew two Wheels to each side of Pram. The top of each Wheel should sit about 2 rows below top edge of Pram.
4. Position one Axle so that its ends line up in the center of the front two Wheels. Sew the Axle to the underside of the Pram. Repeat to position and attach the rear Axle. With D, sew 'spokes' between the inside edge of each Wheel and the end of the Axle (see diagram #1: spoke diagram).
5. With last row of Hood forming edge of front opening of Hood, sew lower edge of Hood to back half of Pram.
6. Flatten the two Handle sides and place them parallel to each other. Place the Handlebar across one end of the Handle sides and sew in place. Roll the Handle sides completely around the Handlebar until the first seams are reached. Sew a few more stitches to secure (see diagram #2: handle diagram). Sew remaining ends of Handle sides to the front of the Pram.
7. Using the Pram Crown template, cut two crown patches from yellow felt. With sewing needle and yellow thread, sew one crown to each side of Hood using a running stitch.

PRINCE
Head and Body
Beginning at top of Head with I, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 3 times—12 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Rounds 6–11: Sc in each sc around.
Round 12: [Sc2tog, sc in next sc] 8 times—16 sc.
Round 13: Sc in each sc around.
Round 14: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 4 times—12 sc.
Change to E to begin body.
Round 15: Working in back loops only, [sc2tog, sc in next sc] 4 times—8 sts.
Round 16: Sc in each sc around.
Round 17: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 4 times—12 sc.
Round 18: Working in front loops only, 2 sc in each sc around—24 sc.
Round 19 (shape shoulders): Sc in next 8 sc, dc in next 4 sc, sc in next 8 sc, dc in next 4 sc.
Rounds 20–23: Sc in each st around.
Round 24: [Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc] 4 times—20 sc.
Round 25: Sc in each sc around.
Round 26: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 5 times—15 sc.
Rounds 27–29: Sc in each sc around.
Round 30: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 5 times—20 sc.
Rounds 31–36: Sc in each sc around.
Round 37: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 4 times—24 sc.
Round 38: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Arm (make 2)
Beginning at Hand with I, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Rounds 3–5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: [Sc2tog, sc in next sc] 3 times—6 sc.
Change E to begin sleeve.
Round 7: Working in front loops only, 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Rounds 8–12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Rounds 14–16: Sc in each sc around.
Stuff sleeve only.
Round 17: [Sc2tog, sc in next sc] 3 times—6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Shoe (make 2)
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 3 times—12 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 3 times—15 sc.
Rounds 5–11: Sc in each sc around.
Round 12: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc] 3 times—12 sc.
Stuff lightly.
Round 13: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Weave in end securely.

Jacket Detail
With A, ch 21.
Row 1 (belt): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—20 sc.
Change to E.
Row 2: Working in front loops only, sc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 3–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Ear (make 2)
With I, make an adjustable ring.
Row 1: Work 5 sc in ring; do not join, work back and forth in rows, turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Nose
With I, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Assembly
1. Attach safety eyes: Determine center front of Head by identifying the shoulders (double crochet stitches of Round 19 of Body). Attach eyes to center front of Head between Rounds 8 and 9 with 4 or 5 stitches between them. You may also use felt circles or embroider French Knots with A instead of using safety eyes.
2. Sew Nose between eyes.
3. Stuff Head and upper Body. With yarn needle and E, beginning at lower edge of Body, sew a running stitch or back stitch line through both thicknesses up the center of the piece to separate the legs, sewing up to Round 31. Stuff each pant leg, leaving the lower edges open (see diagram #3: pant diagram).
4. Sew the edges of the A-colored portion (belt) of the Jacket Detail together, leaving the E-colored section free. Slip Jacket Detail over the legs and sew belt around waist with the free edges of the E-colored section facing the front.
5. With Round 13 of Shoes in the back, sew the lower open edges of the legs to the tops of the Shoes.
6. Flatten and sew the open Arm edges shut and sew each Arm to the double crochet stitches (shoulders) of Round 19 of Body.
7. Coat Details: With yarn needle and A, sew a back stitch line up the center front of the Jacket beginning at the belt and ending at the chin. With yarn needle and B, embroider 3 or 4 French Knots evenly spaced close to the A-colored line for buttons.
8. With right side facing front, sew Ears to sides of Head. With yarn needle and G, embroider lazy daisy stitch above each eye for eyebrows. With yarn needle and A, sew a straight stitch mouth below the Nose.
9. Hair: Cut 60–70 strands of G, each about 4” (10cm) long. Attach strands to Head as if attaching fringe (see Special Techniques). After all strands are attached, use yarn needle to separate the plys. Trim hair to desired length.
10. Using The Prince Sash template, cut a sash from light blue felt. Fold the sash over the shoulder so the ends overlap at the opposite hip. With sewing needle and light blue thread, sew the overlapped ends to the hip to secure.

PRINCESS
Head and Body
Beginning at top of Head with I, make an adjustable ring.
Rounds 1–17: Work same as Rounds 1–17 of Head and Body for Prince, do not change color before Round 15, work all rounds with I—12 sc at the end of Round 17.
Round 18: Work 2 sc in each of next 6 sc; change to F to begin neckline, 2 sc in each of last 6 sc—24 sc.
Round 19: With F, sc in next 2 sc; change to I, sc in next 8 sc; change to F, sc in last 14 sc.
Round 20: With F, sc in next 4 sc; change to I, sc in next 4 sc; change to F, sc in last 16 sc.
Continue with F only for body.
Rounds 21–23: Sc in each sc around.
Round 24: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 25: Sc in each sc around.
Round 26: [Sc2tog, sc in next sc] 6 times—12 sc.
Rounds 27–29: Sc in each sc around.
Round 30: Work 2 sc in each sc around—24 sc.
Round 31: Sc in each sc around.
Change to I.
Round 32: [Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc] 4 times—20 sc.
Rounds 33–38: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Arm (make 2)
Beginning at Hand with I, make an adjustable ring.
Rounds 1–6: Work same as Rounds 1–6 of Arm for Prince—6 sc.
Change F to begin sleeve.
Rounds 7–17: Work same as Rounds 7–17 of Arm for Prince—6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Shoe (make 2)
Make same as Shoes for Prince.

Tops of Feet (make 2)
With I, make an adjustable ring.
Row 1: Work 8 sc in ring; do not join, work back and forth in rows, turn—8 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Dress Collar
With F, ch 22.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—21 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Hat
With F, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 3 times—12 sc.
Round 4: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Skirt
With F, ch 18.
Round 1: Sc in first ch to form a ring, sc in each remaining ch around; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—18 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 3 times—21 sc.
Rounds 7–13: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Ear (make 2)
With I, make an adjustable ring.
Row 1: Work 5 sc in ring; do not join, work back and forth in rows, turn—5 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Nose
With I, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Assembly
1. Attach safety eyes: Determine center front of Head by identifying the front neckline. Attach eyes to center front of Head between Rounds 8 and 9 with 4 or 5 stitches between them. You may also use felt circles or embroider French Knots with A instead of using safety eyes.
2. Sew Nose between eyes.
3. Stuff Head and upper Body. With yarn needle and I, beginning at lower edge of Body, sew a running stitch or back stitch line through both thicknesses up the center of the piece to separate the legs, sewing up to Round 31. Stuff each leg, leaving the lower edges open (see diagram #4: pant diagram).
4. Flatten and sew the open Arm edges shut and sew each Arm to the shoulders at Round 19 of Body.
5. Sew the Dress Collar over the neckline taking care to join the ends at the back of the neck. Slip the skirt over the legs and sew to waist. Roll/fold up the skirt hem and sew a few stitches around the skirt to secure the hem in place.
6. Sew Tops of Feet to the front edges of each leg opening. With Round 13 of Shoes in the back, sew the lower open edges of the legs and Tops of Feet to the tops of the Shoes.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft™ (Solids: 6 oz/170.1 g; 315 yds/288 m; Heathers: 5 oz/141.7 g; 250 yds/228 m)
Bernat® Pipsqueak™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 101 yds/92 m)
Sizes U.S. E/4 (3.5 mm) and U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) crochet hooks or sizes needed to obtain gauge.
Pair of 10 mm Safety Eyes or 2 buttons for Eyes.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: Caron® Simply Soft™: 17 sc and 18 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook. Bernat® Pipsqueak™: 9 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Body
With A and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 72 sc. Place marker on last rnd.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 5" [12.5 cm].
Beg dec rnds: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sts.
2nd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sts.
7th to 10th rnds: As 2nd to 5th rnds.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sts.
12th to 15th rnds: As 2nd to 5th rnds.
16th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sts.
17th to 20th rnds: As 2nd to 5th rnds.
21st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sts.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Stuff Body.
Head
Nose: With B and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join A with sl st to first sc.
5th and 6th rnds: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
10th rnd: As 8th rnd.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc.
12th rnd: As 8th rnd.
Cont as established, inc 8 sc evenly spaced across every other rnd to 64 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 7 times more.
Beg dec rnds: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sts
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sts.
6th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 35 sts.
8th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
Stuff Head.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sts.
10th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 21 sts.
12th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 7 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end through rem loops and pull tightly. Fasten securely.
Sew Head to top of Body.
Fuzzy Beard
With D and larger hook, ch 5.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 8 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. 12 sc.
4th row: As 3rd row. 18 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. 24 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. 30 sc.
7th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 4 sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. 36 sc.
Cont as established, inc 6 sc evenly spaced on each of next 4 rows. 60 sc at end of 11th row. Fasten off.
Curve Beard around bottom of Nose, and up sides of Face to create Beard shape as shown in picture. Attach Safety Eyes or buttons to part of Beard that curves upwards. Sew in position. With B, embroider mouth.
Outer Ear (make 2)
With smaller hook and A, ch 11.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd to 7th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 8 sts.
9th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 6 sts.
10th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sts.
11th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts.
12th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
Inner Ear (make 2)
With smaller hook and D, ch 9.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 8 sc.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 6 sts.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sts.
6th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts.
7th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
Holding WS of Outer and Inner Ears tog, with larger hook and 2 strands of A held tog, join with sl st to bottom right corner. Working through both thicknesses, Ch 1. Work 1 row of sc evenly to tip of Ear. Work 3 sc in tip of Ear. Work 1 row of sc evenly along left side edge. Fasten off.
Sew Ears to top of Head.
Arms (make 2)
With smaller hook and B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around.
Rep last rnd 9 times more. Break B, join A.
Next rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until Arm measures approx 6" [15 cm] from beg. Fasten off.
Stuff Arms lightly. Sew Arms to either side of Body.
Legs (make 2)
With smaller hook and B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 9 times more. Break B, join A.
Next rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sts.
Next 10 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
Next 10 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.
Stuff Legs lightly.
Sew Legs to bottom of Body.
Tail
With 2 strands of A held tog and larger hook, ch 20. Join with sl st to first ch.
1st rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each ch around. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. 20 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 2.
Rep last rnd until Tail from beg measures approx 4” [10 cm]. Break A. Join 1 strand of D.
Next rnd: With D, ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 2.
Next rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. 16 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in next hdc. Hdc2tog. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. 12 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). *Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. 8 sts.
Next rnd: (Hdc2tog) 4 times. 4 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end.
Draw end tightly through rem loops. Fasten securely.
Necktie
With C and smaller hook, ch 6.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 5 sc.
2nd to 7th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 7 sc.
9th row: As 8th row. 9 sc.
10th to 14th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
15th, 16th and 17th rows: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts rem.
18th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Fasten off.
Tie ‘Knot’
With C and smaller hook, ch 7.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 6 sc.
2nd to 13th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off. Sew last row and foundation row tog. Place Tie into loop of Tie ‘knot’ and sew in position.
Attach Tie to front of Body as shown in picture.

instructions:

head

4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.

next rnd: Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sts.
next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
Stuff Head.
next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 8 sts. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.

Body
With MC and smaller hook, ch 30. Join in ring with sl st into first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 2" [5 cm].
next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 4" [10 cm].
next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd twice more. Fasten off.

arms (make 2).
glove: With A and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 tr in next sc (thumb). 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures 3" [7.5 cm].
next rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in first sc. Ch 2. (1 sc. Ch 2) in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
next rnd: Join MC with sl st to rem back loop of any st of previous rnd. Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures 4" [10 cm]. Fasten off. Stuff Arms lightly.
Legs (make 2).
Shoe: With B and smaller hook, ch 5.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join MC with sl st to first sc. Place marker at end of rnd. 21 sts.
6th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 17 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until Leg from top of Shoe measures 5" [12.5 cm]. Fasten off.

hair fringe
Cut a piece of tape 13" [33 cm] long and secure onto a flat surface with sticky side up. Cut lengths of D 14" [35.5 cm] long and lay them across tape so strip of tape is in center of yarn. Holding tissue paper over top of yarn and using sewing machine, run a line of stitching along length of tape. Remove tape when hair is secure. Remove tissue paper after stitching. Pin fringe to outside of head. Using backstitch and D, sew hair into place along sewn line. Fold hair up and secure at top of Head tightly.
CLothing

5th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 18 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Do not turn. Join with sl st to first sc. 22 sc.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.

4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
6th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
7th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Place marker on last st. 72 sc.
8th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 5½" [14 cm]. Join A. Break B.
next rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 2. (1 sc. Ch 2) in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Sew button to back of Dress to correspond to button loop.
Snowflake (make 1).
With A and smaller hook, ch 3. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 1 dc in ring. Ch 2. *(Yoh and draw up a loop in ring. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – dc2tog made. Ch 2. Rep from * 4 times more. Join with sl st to first dc.
2nd rnd: Sl st to first ch-2 sp. (Ch 3. 1 dc) in same ch-2 sp. Ch 2. 1 sc in next st. Ch 2. *(2 dc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2. 1 sc in next st. Ch 2. Rep from * 4 times more. 2 dc in first ch-2 sp. 1 dc in top of ch-3.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook – picot made. 1 sc. Ch 4. Sl st in 4th ch from hook. 1 sc. Picot) along side of previous dc. Ch 3. Miss next 2 dc and ch-2 sp. Sl st in next sc. Ch 3. Miss next 2 dc and ch-2 sp. *(1 sc. Picot. 1 sc. Ch 4. Sl st in 4th ch from hook. 1 sc. Picot) in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. Miss next 2 dc and ch-2 sp. Sl st in next sc. Ch 3. Miss next 2 dc and ch-2 sp. Rep from * 4 times more. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Sew Snowflake to front of Dress as shown in picture.
Cape
note: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as hdc.
With C and larger hook, ch 8.

2nd row: Ch 2. (1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 2 hdc in next sc) twice. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. 10 hdc.
3rd row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 12 hdc.
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Turn. 14 hdc.
5th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Turn. 16 hdc.
6th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc across. Turn.
7th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Turn. 18 hdc.
8th row: As 6th row.
9th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Turn. 20 hdc.
10th and 11th rows: As 6th row.
12th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Turn. 22 hdc.
13th and 14th rows: As 6th row.
15th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. Turn. 24 hdc.
16th and 17th rows: As 6th row. Fasten off at end of 17th row.
Sew 6" [15 cm] lengths of C to each top corner of Cape for ties.

With A and smaller hook, ch 41. Join in ring with sl st into first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 16 ch. turn. Leave rem ch unworked.
2nd row: Miss first 2 sc. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Miss next 2 sc. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. Sl st in next sc. Turn.
3rd row: 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. (1 sc. Picot. 1 sc. Ch 4. Sl st in 4th ch from hook. 1 sc. Picot) in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Place st marker on last st. Miss next 2 sc. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. Sl st in next sc. Fasten off.
4th row: With RS facing, join A with sl st at marker. Ch 1. Miss first sc. *1 sc in each of next 2 dc. (1 sc. Picot. 1 sc. Ch 4. Sl st in 4th ch from hook. 1 sc. Picot) in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * once more. Sl st in next sc. Fasten off.
Finishing
Sew small beads in random pattern to Dress Front, Cape and Crown as shown in picture.

materials: Bernat® Baby Blanket Frosting™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Very Berry (61016) 1 ball or 218 yds/193 m
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
5 yds [4.5 m] of black worsted weight yarn for embroidery
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Bear is worked in continuous spiral. Do not join at end of rnds.
• Work in spiral in continuous rnds, moving marker onto first st for beg of each rnd.
FIRST LEG
**Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 7 sc in ring. Do not join.
Proceed working in spiral as follows:
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 14 sc. PM on first sc to mark beg of rnd.
3rd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
Rep last rnd, working in continuous spiral, moving marker onto first st at beg of each rnd until Leg measures 7" [18 cm].**
Fasten off.
SECOND LEG
Work from ** to ** as given for First Leg. Do not fasten off at end of Second Leg.
Join Legs: 1st rnd: 2 sc in next sc of Second Leg (PM on first sc). 2 sc in first sc of First Leg to join. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc of First Leg. 2 sc in last sc of First Leg. 2 sc in next sc of Second Leg. 1 sc in each of rem 12 sc of Second Leg. 32 sc. Do not join rnd.
BODY
1st rnd: *2 sc in next sc (PM on first sc). 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc. Do not join. Work in spiral in continuous rnds.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
Rep last rnd, working in spiral, until Body measures approx 6" [15 cm] from Leg join, stuffing lightly as you work.
1st rnd: (Dec rnd). *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 30 sts.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
3rd rnd: (Dec rnd). *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: (Dec rnd). *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 20 sts.
6th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
Fasten off.
HEAD
Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Do not join at end of rnds. Work in spiral in continuous rnds. PM on first sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
4th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sc.
6th rnd: As 4th rnd.
7th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
8th to 14th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
15th rnd: (Dec rnd). *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sts.
16th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
17th rnd: (Dec rnd). *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
18th rnd: As 16th rnd.
19th rnd: (Dec rnd). *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 16 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail to sew Head to Body.
Stuff Head.
EARS (Make 2)
Ch 2.
1st rnd: 7 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join at end of rnds. Work in spiral in continuous rnds. PM on first sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 14 sc.
3rd rnd: (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc) twice. 16 sc.
4th and 5th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Fasten off at end of last rnd, leaving a long tail for seaming.
Fold Ear in half and sew bottom edge closed using long tail.
ARMS (Make 2)
Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in ring. Do not join at end of rnds. Work in spiral in continuous rnds. PM on first sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures approx 6" [15 cm].
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for seaming.
Stuff half the Arms lightly, leaving the top unstuffed.
Using long tail, attach Arms at top of Neck opening using Whipstitch, centering Arms with sides of Body.
FINISHING
Attach Head to Body using whipstitch, adding extra stuffing into neck to better stabilize Head.
Pin Ears into position at top of Head, with top of Ear aligned with 2nd rnd of Head.
Attach Ears to head, curving them slightly.
WHIPSTITCH
With Black worsted weight yarn, embroider Eyes and Nose using Satin Stitch. Embroider Mouth using Straight stitch as shown in photo.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 360 Café Latte A, 334 Buff B, 319 Cherry Red C, 312 Black D
floral stem wire (optional – to stabilize neck and for pose-able tail)
abbreviations: A, B, C, and D = Color A, B, C, and D
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 16 sts = 4” (10 cm); 16 rounds = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com and www.crochettoday.com
©2012 Coats & Clark
Love Monkey
Show your love to sweethearts of all ages with a lovingly crocheted monkey! What a sweet gift that will make them smile for years!
Round 18: [Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 19: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 20: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 21: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 22: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing head to body.
FACE
Beginning at top of body, with B, ch 2.
Rounds 1–4: Work same as Rounds 1–4 of head—24 sc.
Round 5: Skip next 2 sc, 9 dc in next sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 3 sc, skip next 2 sc, 9 dc in next sc, skip next 2 sc, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice, sc in next 3 sc—34 sts.
Round 6: 2 sc in next sc, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times, sc in last sc—43 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing face to head. Attach eyes at base of 9-dc groups on Round 5. With D and using photograph as a guide, embroider a straight stitch mouth and nose. Sew face to head, sewing around outer edges of face. Stuff head.
EARS (make 2)
Inner Ear
With B, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join, work back and forth in rows, turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc across, turn—10 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times, turn—15 sc. Fasten off.
Outer Ear
With A, work same as inner ear through Row 3—15 sc. Do not fasten off.
Row 4: Ch 1, hold one inner ear and one outer ear together with stitches of last rows matching; working through both thicknesses, sc in each sc across, do not turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, reverse sc in each sc across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing ear to head. Using photograph as a guide for placement, sew one ear to each side of head.
BODY
Beginning at bottom of body, with A, ch 2.
Rounds 1–6: Work same as Rounds 1–6 of head—36 sc.
Rounds 7–14: Sc in each sc around.
Begin stuffing body. Continue to stuff as work progresses.
Rounds 15–18: Work same as Rounds 19–22 of head—12 sc.
Fasten off and weave in ends.
TUMMY HEART
With C, ch 2.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—1 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 3 sc in the sc, turn—3 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—5 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—7 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—9 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 8: Skip first 2 sc, 6 dc in next sc, skip next sc, slip st in next sc, skip next sc, 6 dc in next sc, skip last 2 sc, sl st in beginning ch-1—13 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing heart to tummy. Sew heart to front of body. Stuff body. For additional stability, cut a 10” (25.5 cm) length of floral stem wire and fold it in half. Insert wire into center of body, allowing about 2” (5 cm) to extend from top. Place head on top of body, inserting remainder of wire into center of neck. Sew head to top of body.
ARMS AND LEGS (make a total of 4 pieces – 2 for arms and 2 for legs)
Beginning at tip of tail, with A, ch 2.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of head—12 sc. No marker is needed for beginning of round.
Rounds 3–10: Sc in each sc around.
Round 11: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] twice—10 sc.
Round 12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] twice—8 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing limb to body. Stuff limbs lightly and sew to body.
TAIL
With A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join. Work in continuous rounds (spirals). No marker is needed for beginning of round.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Repeat Round 2 working until tail measures about 15” (38 cm) from beginning or desired length. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing tail to body. Stuff tail lightly and sew to back of body. Note: If a pose-able tail is desired, do not stuff tail. Wrap stuffing around wire, taking special care to wrap around tip of wire, and insert wrapped wire into tail. Leave about 2” (5 cm) of unwrapped wire extending out of open end of tail. Insert the 2” (5 cm) end into body before sewing tail in place.
FINISHING
Weave in any remaining ends.

instructions:

with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from 
*around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * 
around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.**
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 10 times more.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw

Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around.

Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with

Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st.

1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 2" [5 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around.

Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 4" [10 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep
from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.

Arms (make 2).
With MC and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 tr in next sc (thumb). 1 sc 
in each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 8 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures 4" [10 cm]. Fasten off. 
Stuff Arms lightly.
Legs (make 2).
***With MC and smaller hook, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in 
last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in 
each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of 
next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of 
next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join
with sl st to first sc.***
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each 
sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. Place marker at end of rnd. 
21 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each 
sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 17 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each 
sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until leg from marker at top of Shoe measures 
5" [12.5 cm]. Fasten off.
hair
With D and smaller hook, ch 2. 
Work from ** to ** as given for Head.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 30 sc. turn.
Next row: *Ch 25. 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 2 hdc in each ch to end 
chain. Miss next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten 
off.
tie ribbon into bows at each side of hair.
Shoes (make 2).
With A and larger hook, work from *** to *** as given for legs. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 1 hdc in next sc. [(Yoh and 
draw up a loop in next st. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 
twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – dc2tog made]
3 times. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 10 sc. Join with sl st to 
first sc. Fasten off.
thread ribbon through center back stitch at top edge of shoe. tie 
ribbon around ankle.
FINIShING
Stuff legs. Sew top of legs closed using whip st. Sew to bottom of 
Body. Attach Arms to sides of Body.
With red and black embroidery floss, embroider mouth and 
eyelashes using straight stitch. Attach beads to Head for Eyes. Sew 
Head to Body.
Dress
With A and larger hook, ch 24. Join with sl st to first ch taking care 
not to twist ch.
Bodice: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first 
sc. 24 sc.
2nd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to 
first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. (1 hdc. 1 dc. 1 hdc) in next

8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next sc. 1 hdc in next hdc. 3 dc in next

turn.
2nd to 4th rows: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each dc

Fasten off.

third heart: Join B, with sl st to next ch of foundation ch. Work as

Fourth heart: Join C, with sl st to next ch of foundation ch. Work as

heart

materials: Bernat® Satin (100 g/3.5 oz; 149 m/163 yds)
Size 3.75 mm (U.S. F or 5) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
gauge: 18 sc and 22 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Stripe Pat
With A, work 4 rnds.
With B, work 4 rnds.
These 8 rnds form Stripe Pat.

BODY
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join B with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
First 4 rnds of Stripe Pat are complete. Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, work as established, inc 8 sc every rnd until there are 96 sc. Place marker on last rnd.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 4 ins [10 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog made. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 88 sts.
Next 4 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last 5 rnds until there are 64 sc.
Work even in rnds until work from marked rnd measures approx 5½ ins [14 cm], ending with 4 rnds of A, and joining MC at end of last rnd.
Place marker at end of last rnd.
With MC, work even in rnds until work from last marker measures 3 ins [7.5 cm].
Shape head: Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Stuff Body. Sew top edge closed.

Eyes (make 2).
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join C with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: With C, ch 1. *4 dc in next sc. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Miss next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dc. Fasten off.

Eyelids (make 2).
With C, ch 10.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 9 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sc. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. Turn.
Rep last row twice more. 3 sc. Fasten off at end of last row.

Beak
With B, ch 2.
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc.

Round 12: *3 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around, change to B in last st—24 sts.

Round 14: Sc in each st around, change to B in last st—24 sts.
Round 15: *2 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around, change to A in last st—18 sts.
Round 16: *Sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around, change to B in last st, stuff head firmly—12 sts.
Round 17: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around—6 sts. Fasten off, weaving tail through opening and pulling tightly to close. Set aside.
BODY
With A, ch 14, join with slip st.
Round 1-2: Working in stripe pattern throughout, sc in each st around—14 sts.
Round 3: *6 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * 2 times—16 sts.
Round 4: *7 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * 2 times—18 sts.
Round 5: Sc in each st around—18 sts.
Round 6: *2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—24 sts.
Round 7-11: Sc in each st around—24 sts.
Round 12: *2 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around—18 sts.
Round 13: Sc in each st around—18 sts.
Round 14: Divide sts for legs; sc in 4 sts, skip 10 sts, sc in last 4 sts, first leg opening made—8 sc worked. Stuff torso.
Round 15-20: Leaving skipped sts unworked, sc in each of the 8 leg sts around, join C in last st of Round 20, fasten off A and B—8 sts. Stuff legs as rounds are completed.
Round 21: 2 sc in each st around—16 sts.
Round 22: Sc in each st around.
Round 23: *Sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around, end sc—11 sts. Continue to stuff leg.
Round 24: *3 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * twice, end sc—9 sts.
Round 25: *Sc, sc2tog; repeat from * 3 times—6 sts. Fasten off, weaving tail through hole and pulling tightly to close. Trim excess yarn.
Round 26: Begin 2nd leg; Skip 1 st from leg just made (these sts will be sewn closed after making 2nd leg), join yarn to next st, ch 1, sc in st and in next 7 sts around—8 sts.
Round 27: Repeat Rounds 14-25 for 2nd leg. Fasten off as for first leg. Sew opening closed. Weave in ends.
ARMS (make 2)
With A, Ch 6, join with slip st.
Round 1-7: Working in stripe pattern, sc in each st around, adding C in last st of last round, fasten off A and B—6 sts.
Round 8: 2 sc in each sc around—12 sts.
Round 9: Sc in each st around.
Round 10: *Sc, sc2tog; repeat from * 4 times—8 sts. Stuff arm.
Round 11: *2 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * 2 times—6 sc. Fasten off, weaving tail through hole and pulling tightly to close.
MANE
With A ch 14, fasten off. Cut several 4” (10cm) lengths of yarn in A and B. Hold one strand of each together, fold in half. Insert hook through chain, pull strands through to make a loop, pull ends through loop to secure. Repeat until mane is full. Sew to back of head and neck, trim.
TAIL
Ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. Fasten off. Make fringe in end of tail as for mane. Sew in place, trim.

Sew head to body at neck opening and join arms at shoulders. With C, embroider eyes as shown, using a French Knot. Fluff mane.

instructions:

Head
**With smaller hook and MC, ch 2.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.

Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
Stuff Head.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 8 sts. Join with sl st to first st. Stuff rem of Head. Fasten off.
Body
With smaller hook and MC, ch 30. Join with sl st to first ch taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 2 ins [5 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 4 ins [10 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd twice more. Fasten off.
Sew bottom edge of Body closed. Stuff Body.
Arms (make 2).
With smaller hook and MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 tr in next sc (thumb). 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.

Foot: **With smaller hook and MC, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.**
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Place marker at end of rnd.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 21 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 17 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.

Sandal (make 2)
With A, work from ** to ** as given for Foot. Fasten off.
Front Strap: 1st row: Join A with sl st to back loop of 4th sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in back loop of each of next 2 sc. Turn.

Hair fringe
Cut a piece of tape 11 ins [28 cm] long and secure onto a flat surface with sticky side up. Cut lengths of D 19 ins [48 cm] long and lay them across tape so strip of tape is in center of yarn. Holding tissue paper over top of yarn and using sewing machine, run a line of stitching along length of tape. Remove tape when hair is secure. Remove tissue paper after stitching.
Pin fringe to center of head. Using backstitch and D, sew hair into place along sewn line. Secure Hair into place with ribbon as shown.

With larger hook and A, ch 24. Join with sl st to first ch taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 5 times more. Join C at end of last rnd. Break A.
Next rnd: With C, ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in same sp as last sl st. *1 hdc in next sc. 2 hdc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join B with sl st to top of ch 2. 36 hdc.
Next rnd: With B, ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join C with sl st to first hdc.
Next rnd: With C, ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join B with sl st to first hdc.
Rep last 2 rnds twice more.
Next rnd: With B, ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join C with sl st to first hdc.
Next rnd: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sl st. Ch 3. 1 dc) in first sc. *Miss next sc. (Sl st. Ch 3. 1 dc) in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to same sp as first sl st. Fasten off.
Straps (make 2).
With A, ch 10. Fasten off.
Put Dress on Doll and mark position for Straps. Sew Straps to Dress.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein 319 Cherry A, 2 skeins 312 Black B.
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions given in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 8 sts = 2.5”, 14 rows = 4” CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
GAME
Strip 1 (make 4)
With A ch 9.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, and in each ch across; turn – 8 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
Repeat Row 2 until there are 8 rows, change to B repeat row 2 with B until there are 8 rows, change to A, change colors every 8 rows until there are 8 blocks.
Strip 2 (make 4)
With B ch 9.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, and in each ch across; turn – 8 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
Repeat Row 2 until there are 8 rows, change to A repeat row 2 with A until there are 8 rows, change to B, change colors every 8 rows until there are 8 blocks.
Sew strips together alternately, sc in each st and row end around working 3 sc in each corner.
BACK
With B, ch 65. Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across.
Row 2: ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Repeat row 2 until there are 32 rows.
Next Row: ch 1, sc in first 16 sts, ch 32, skip next 32 sts, sc in last 16 sts; turn.
Next Row: ch 1, sc in first 16 sts, sc in each of next 32 ch, sc in last 16 sts; turn.
Repeat row 2 for 30 more rows. Sc in each st and row end around working 3 sc in each corner for same number of sts as board.
FINISHING
Holding front and back pieces with wrong sides together, and working through all 4 loops, sc in each st around working 3 sc in each corner for two rnds.
CHECKERS (make 12 with A and 12 with B)
Ch 4, work 13 dc in 1st ch, join with a slip st to top of beginning ch-4, Fasten off. Weave in ends.

Top of Body
1st rnd: *Sc2togtbl. 1 scbl in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 72 sts.
2nd rnd: Working in both loops, 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * to last 5 sc. 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. 66 sts.
3rd rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. Rep from * around. 60 sts.
4th rnd: 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * to last 4 sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. 54 sts.
5th rnd: *Sc2togtbl. 1 scbl in each of next 7 sts. Rep from * around. 48 sts.
6th rnd: Working in both loops, 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * to last 3 sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. 42 sts.
7th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
8th rnd: 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. 30 sts.
9th rnd: *Sc2togtbl. 1 scbl in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
10th rnd: Working in both loops, 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. 18 sts.
11th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 12 sts.
Following manufacturer’s instructions, attach safety eyes to side of Body 1½" [4 cm] apart, 5 rounds down from first rnd at Top of Body (as shown).
Stuff Body firmly.
12th rnd: *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten off. Weaving in end.
LEAF (make 20)
Ch 26. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring, being careful not to twist chain. PM for beg of rnd. Move marker up on rnds as work progresses. See diagrams on page 5.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each ch around. Do not join. 26 sc.
Cont working in a spiral as follows:
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
3rd rnd: 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. 2 sc in last sc. 30 sc.
4th to 8th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
9th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 26 sc.
10th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 22 sc.
11th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 18 sc.
12th to 14th rnds: Cont in this manner, dec 4 sc each rnd for next 3 rnds (as established). 6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving long end. Draw end tightly through rem 6 sts at tip and fasten off. Weave in end.
ASSEMBLY
Outer 6-Leaf Ring
Stuff 6 Leaves loosely. Fold foundation chains of 6 leaves in half, having beg of row at join of foundation ch of each Leaf.
Joining 6 Leaves in rnd: (RS). Join yarn with sl st to rem loop foundation ch at join of first Leaf. Ch 1. * Working through both thicknesses, work 13 sc in rem loops of foundation ch across bottom edge to “seam" Leaf closed. Rep from * across bottom edge of rem 5 Leaves. Join in rnd with sl st to first sc, being careful not to twist Leaves.
2nd rnd: Join Outer 6-Leaf ring to Body: Align Outer 6-Leaf Ring sts and rem front loops of 1st rnd of top of last round of Body, aligning space between Leaves over eyes (as shown in photo). Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Inner 6-Leaf Ring
Stuff 6 Leaves loosely. Fold foundation chains of 6 Leaves in half, having beg of row at join of foundation ch of each Leaf.
Joining 6 Leaves in rnd: (RS). Join yarn with sl st to rem loop foundation ch at join of first Leaf. Ch 1. *Work through both thicknesses of rem loops of foundation ch as follows: Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog (Total 9 sts). Rep from * across bottom edge of rem 5 Leaves. Join in rnd with sl st to first st, being careful not to twist Leaves.
2nd rnd: Join Inner 6-Leaf Ring to Body: Align Inner 6-Leaf Ring sts and rem front loops of 4th rnd of Top of Body so that Leaves are offset between Leaves of Outer Ring. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
5-Leaf Ring
Stuff 5 Leaves loosely. Fold foundation chains of 5 Leaves in half, having beg of row at join of foundation ch of each Leaf.
Joining 5 Leaves in rnd: (RS). Join yarn with sl st to rem loop foundation ch at join of first Leaf. Ch 1. * Working through both thicknesses of rem loops of foundation ch as follows: [(Sc2tog) 3 times. Sc3tog. (Sc2tog) twice] (Total 6 sts). Rep from * across bottom edge of rem 4 Leaves. Join in rnd with sl st to first sc, being careful not to twist Leaves.
Join 5-Leaf Ring to Body: Align 5-Leaf Ring sts and rem front loops of 8th rnd of Top of Body so that Leaves are offset between Leaves of Inner Ring. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Top 3-Leaves
Joining 3 Leaves in rnd: Work from ** to ** as for 1st rnd of 5-Leaf Ring, noting, there are 3 Leaves only. Fasten off.
Sew Top 3-Leaves ring to Top of Body in center of 5-Leaf Ring, adjusting and shaping as necessary to fit, as shown in photo.
Embroidery: With pink yarn, embroider blush lines below each eye using Satin St (as shown).

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ O’Go™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Milk and Honey (42005) 1 O’Go or approx 68 yds/62 m per shade

Approx 3 yds/2.5 m of black worsted weight yarn to embroider eyes.
Approx 15 yds/14 m of pink worsted weight yarn for Cherry.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 8 sc and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Notes:
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull tie to remove.
CROCHET ICE CREAM TOY
ICE CREAM TOY
Top Scoop: With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
8th to 15th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
16th rnd: Working in front loops only, *Sl st in next sc. 3 hdc in next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * around. Join.
17th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only of 15th rnd, *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Break B. Join C. 36 sc.
Bottom Scoop: 18th rnd: With C, ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
19th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
20th to 27th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
28th rnd: Working in front loops only, *Sl st in next sc. 3 hdc in next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * around. Join.
29th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only of 27th rnd, *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Break C. Join A. 36 sc.
Embroidery: With black yarn, embroider eyes using Satin St on Scoops as shown in photo.
With pink yarn, embroider blush lines below each eye using straight st, as shown in photo.
Cone: 30th rnd: With A, ch 1. Working in front loops only, *1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Rep from * around. Join.
31st rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only of 29th rnd, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
32nd and 33rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
34th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
35th and 36th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Stuff Scoops and Cone firmly.
37th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
38th and 39th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
40th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
41st and 42nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
43rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
44th and 45th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Finish stuffing Cone firmly.
46th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 6 sc.
47th and 48th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving long end. Drawn end tightly through rem sts.
Cherry: With smaller hook and pink yarn, ch 6.
1st rnd: Working into horizontal "bump" at back of ch, sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each of next 3 ch – Cherry Stem made. Working into front loop only, 6 sc in last ch. Hold Cherry Stem to front of work. Join last sc to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join. 30 sc.
6th to 8th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off, leaving long end.
Stuff Cherry firmly. Using long end, sew Cherry onto Top Scoop, as shown in photo.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 2.25 mm [US B-1]
Optional: Plastic pellets for weighted stuffing and thin pouch to hold pellets
abbreviations: A, B, C, and D = Color A, Color B, Color C, and Color D
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 26 sts = about 4" [10 cm]; 22 rounds = about 4" [10 cm] in single crochet (sc). EXACT GAUGE IS NOT CRITICAL TO THIS PROJECT. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BODY/HEAD
Beginning at bottom of body, with A or B, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each of next 6 sts—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 6 times—36 sc.
Rounds 7–10: Sc in each st around. 
Round 11: [Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts] 6 times—30 sc.
Rounds 12–14: Sc in each st around. 
Round 15: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 16: Sc in each st around.
Round 17: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts] 6 times—18 sc.
Before stuffing piece, if using weighted pellets, fill thin cloth pouch with weighted pellets and place pouch in bottom of piece. Then stuff piece, packing stuffing on top of pouch.
Round 18: [Sc2tog, sc in next st] 6 times—12 sc.
Rounds 19–22: Sc in each st around. 
Begin Head
Round 23: Work 2 sc in each st around—24 sc.
Rounds 24–26: Sc in each st around. 
Round 27: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 28: Sc in each st around.
Attach safety eyes between Rounds 25 and 26, about 4 stitches apart.
Round 29: [Sc2tog, sc in next st] 6 times—12 sc.
If needed, add a little more stuffing to piece.
Round 30: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sc. 
Fasten off leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Weave in and trim ends.
BEAK
With D, make an adjustable ring. 
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each of next 2 sts, sc in next 4 sts and change to C in last st—8 sc.
Rounds 3 and 4: With C, sc in each st around.
Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing beak to head.
LEGS (make 2 for each flamingo)
With C, leaving a long beginning tail for sewing leg to body, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] twice—8 sc.
Rounds 3–14: Sc in each st around.
Foot
Flatten the top of the tube, matching stitches in back and front of last round to make a double layer with 4 stitches in each layer. Work now proceeds back and forth in rows.
Row 15: Working through both thicknesses, skip the first st, sc in next 3 sts.
Row 16: Ch 1, turn, working in front loops only, 2 sc in first st, sc in next st, 2 sc in last st—5 sc. 
Row 17: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in last st—7 sc.
Row 18: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, hdc in next st, dc in next 3 sts, hdc in next st, sc in last st.
Fasten off. Weave in and trim the ending tail. Do not cut the beginning tail, it can be used later to sew leg to body.
WINGS (make 2 for each flamingo)
With same yarn color as used for body, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each of next 6 sts—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4 (wing tips): Slip st in next st, ch 4, slip st in next st, ch 6, slip st in next st, ch 8, slip st in next st, ch 6, slip st in next st, ch 4, slip st in next st; leave remaining sts unworked.
Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing wing to body. 
FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide to placement, use yarn tails or yarn scraps to sew the following pieces together.
1. Sew beak to head between eyes, positioning so that the beak curves downwards.
2. Sew legs to bottom of body, positioning the feet to face forwards with the small ridge at ankle on the front side.
3. Sew wings to sides of body, with about 10 stitches on front belly between the wings Point the wing tips toward the back and sew around the outside of Round 3 leaving wing tips unsewn.
Weave in and trim any remaining ends.

materials: Yarn needle, stitch marker, Polyester fiberfill, two 6mm black buttons for eyes/or safety eyes, sewing needle and thread.
abbreviations: [] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 18 sts = 4” (10 cm); 22 rounds = 4” (10 cm) in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Body
Work 6 sc in adjustable ring. Do not join but work in continuous rounds. Place marker in first st of round and move it up as your work progresses.
Round 1: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 2: [Inc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 3: [Inc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 4: [Inc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 5: [Inc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times – 36 sc.
Rounds 6-15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: [Dec] 18 times – 18 sc.
Round 17: Sc in each sc around.
Rounds 18: [Sc in next sc, dec] 6 times – 12 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff firmly.
Head and Trunk
Work 6 sc in Adjustable ring.
Rounds 1-10: Work same as for body – 36 sc.
Round 11: [Sc in next 4 sc, dec] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 12: [Sc in next 3 sc, dec] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 13: [Sc in next 2 sc, dec] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 14: [Sc in next sc, dec] 6 times – 12 sc. Add stuffing.
Round 15: [Sc in next 2 sc, dec] 3 times – 9 sc. Start stuffing as you go.
Rounds 16-29: Sc in each sc around.
Round 30: [Sc in next sc, dec] 3 times – 6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through remaining sc and pull tight.
Feet (Make 4)
Work 6 sc in Adjustable ring. Work in continuous rounds as before.
Round 1: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Rounds 2-7: Sc in each sc around. Add stuffing firmly.
Round 8: [Dec] 6 times – 6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through remaining sc and pull tight.
Ears (Make 2)
Row 1: Leaving a long tail before beginning, ch 5; 2 hdc in 3rd ch from hook, hdc in next 2 ch; turn.
Row 2: Ch 2, 2 hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 3 hdc; turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, 2 hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 4 hdc; turn.
Row 4: Ch 2, 2 hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc, sc in next hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc. Fasten off.
Finishing
Sew feet, ears and head to body as pictured. Sew eyes in place. Weave in ends.

3” (7.5 cm) piece of cardboard (to make tassel for tail)
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B

gauge: 7 sts = 2” (5 cm); 8 rows = 2” (5 cm), in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com
