These huggable, agreeable little elephants 
are ready to go anywhere a kid goes. 
Whether having an imaginary safari or going to grandma’s house, they are the 
perfect companions. Plus since they are crocheted with Super Saver, they 
machine wash and dry with little fuss.
Row 82: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, [sc2tog] 3 
times, sc in last 4 sc, turn—11 sc.
Rows 83–89: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Row 90: Ch 1, working in back loops only, 
[sc2tog] 5 times, sc in last sc—6 sc. 
Fasten off.
Ear (make 2) 
Beginning at inside edge of ear, ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch 
across, turn—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc, turn—12 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, [sc 
in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times, turn—
18 sc.
Rows 5–7: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Rows 8–13: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 
2 sc, sc2tog, turn—6 sc.
Fasten off.
Tail 
Leaving a long tail for sewing, ch 16.
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in 
each ch across. Fasten off.
Tassel
Wrap yarn around 3” (7.5 cm) piece of 
cardboard 20 times. Thread an 8” (20.5 cm) 
length of yarn under top of wraps and tie 
tightly in a knot close to the wraps; leave tails 
for sewing to tail. Cut other end so you have 
twenty 6” (15 cm) strands. Pull strands down 
with knot at center top. Wrap a 12” (30.5 cm) 
length of yarn 3 times around the tassel, about 
½” (12.7 mm) below the top knot, and tie 
tightly. Draw ends down through tassel neck 
to inside of tassel. Brush ends of strands to 
fluff and trim evenly. Sew to end of tail.
Notes
Body, head, and trunk are made as one piece 
worked back and forth in rows. Ears and tail 
are worked separately and sewn to elephant 
after body, head, and trunk are sewn and 
stuffed.
Special Stitch 
sc2tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over 
and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw 
through all 3 loops on hook.
ELEPHANT (make 1 with A and 1 with 
B)
Body, Head, and Trunk
Beginning at bottom of body, ch 42.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook 
and in each ch across, turn—41 sc. Place 
marker on 21st st.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 18 sc, 
2 sc in each of next 3 sc, sc in next 18 sc, 2 
sc in last sc, turn—46 sc.
Rows 3–22: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Row 23: Ch 1, slip st in first 7 sc, sc in next 32 
sc, leave remaining sc unworked, turn—
32 sc.
Rows 24–34: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Rows 35 and 36: Ch 11, sc in 2nd ch from 
hook and in next 9 ch, sc in each sc, turn—
52 sc.
Rows 37–56: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Row 57: Ch 1, slip st in first 10 sc, sc in next 
32 sc, leave remaining sc unworked, turn—
32 sc.
Rows 58–67: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Rows 68 and 69: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc to last 2 sc, 
sc2tog, turn—28 sc.
Row 70: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 14 times, turn—14 sc.
Rows 71–81: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.
Shape and stuff elephant as follows: 
Arms 
With right side facing and working across 
ends of rows, weave yarn through edges of 
Rows 35–57 (for right arm) and Rows 36–57 
(for left arm), pull tightly to close, secure 
but do not cut yarn. Working through both 
thicknesses of 10 stitches, sew seam of each 
arm. Secure yarn and stuff arms.
Legs 
Working in same manner as arms, weave yarn 
through edges Rows 2–22 on each side, then 
sew through 7 stitches to form seam. Secure 
yarn and stuff legs.
Trunk and Head 
With right side facing, weave yarn through 
Row 90, pull tightly to close, secure but do not 
cut yarn. Working across ends of rows and 
through both thicknesses, continue sewing 
through all rows until this seam meets arms, 
stuffing tightly as you go.
Body
Beginning from marked stitch, sew half 
of remaining stitches at bottom of body to 
unsewn ends of rows between legs and 
arms. Stuff and shape bottom to ensure that 
elephant will sit. Sew remaining half of bottom 
stitches to second side of body, stuffing and 
adjusting shape as you go. Sew tail to bottom 
back of body.
Using photograph as a guide, sew inside edge 
of ears to back of head and sew eyes midway 
between ears and trunk.
Weave in remaining ends.

materials: RED HEART® With Love™: 1 skein each 1302 Caramel A
two ½” diameter black shank style buttons
optional plastic pellets and 1 knee-high stocking
optional dental floss for attaching eyes
abbreviations: Dec (decrease) = draw up a loop in next 2 sc, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 18 sts = 4”; 20 rows = 4” in sc with larger hook. Gauge is not important with this project as long as tightly crocheted stitches are achieved to prevent stuffing showing through.
instructions:
LEGS (Make 4)
Round 1: With A (B) and larger hook, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook working over yarn tail – 6 sc. Pull yarn tail to close hole.
Round 2: [Inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, inc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Rounds 4-6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc in next sc, dec] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 8: [Dec, sc in next 4 sc] twice – 10 sc. Stuff paw firmly.
Round 9: [Dec, sc in next 3 sc] twice – 8 sc.
Rounds 10-18: If making light colored puppy change to C, otherwise continue with A. Sc in each sc around. Stuff leg very lightly as rounds are completed.
Next Step: Hold the layers flat to close the top. Ch 1, sc through both layers in each sc across – 4 sc. Fasten off.

BODY
Begin at bottom.
Rounds 1-3: With A (C) and larger hook, repeat Rounds 1-3 same as for Legs – 18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, inc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sc, inc] 6 times – 36 sc.
Round 7-Attach 2 Legs: Sc in 27 sc, then holding first leg flush with edge, sc through all layers in next 4 sc, sc in next sc of body, attach 2nd leg sc through all layers in next 4 sts – 36 sc.
Rounds 8-12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: [Sc in next 4 sc, dec] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 14: [Sc in next 3 sc, dec] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: [Sc in next 2 sc, dec] 6 times – 18 sc. Stuff firmly beginning with optional plastic pellet packet first. Continue stuffing as rounds are made.
Round 17-Attach 2 Legs: Sc in next 4 sc, holding first leg flush with edge, sc through all layers in next 4 sc, sc in next 5 sc of body, attach 2nd leg sc through all layers in next 4 sc, sc in last sc of body – 18 sc.
Round 18: Sc in each sc around. Do not stuff remaining rounds.
Round 19: [Sc in next sc, dec] 6 times – 12 sc.
Rounds 20-21: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off leaving yarn tail for attaching head.

HEAD
Begin at muzzle.
Rounds 1-6: With A (C) and larger hook, work same as Body Rounds 1-6 – 36 sc.
Rounds 7-9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: [Sc in next 4 sc, dec] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 11: Sc in each sc around.
Round 12: [Sc in next 3 sc, dec] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rounds 13-16: Sc in each sc around.
Round 17: [Sc in next 2 sc, dec] 6 times – 18 sc. Stuff head firmly.
Round 18: [Sc in next sc, dec] 6 times – 12 sc. Continue stuffing as rounds are completed.
Round 19: [Sc in next sc, dec] 4 times – 8 sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

Ears (Make 2)
Begin at base of ear.
Round 1: With A (B) and larger hook, leaving a 6” yarn tail before slip knot, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 6 sc.
Rounds 2-7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: [Sc in next sc, dec] twice – 4 sc. Thread yarn needle with yarn end and weave yarn through last round of sts to close hole. Weave in end from needle but leave long tail from beginning round for attaching ears to head. Do not stuff.

Tail
With A (B) and larger hook, ch 7; working in back bumps of beginning ch, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 6 sc. Fasten off leaving yarn end for sewing tail to body.

Heart Shaped Nose Patch/Eye Appliqué
Row 1: With smaller hook and E (D), ch 2; 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, 3 sc in next sc, [2 sc in next sc] twice; do not turn – 11 sc.
Row 3: Working across row ends at the top of the heart shape, 2 sc in first row end, slip st between rows, 2 sc in next row end, slip st to next st. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

FINISHING
The head is designed with the smaller end as the crown of the head and the larger end as the muzzle. Using yarn tail from neck of body sew head to neck securely.
Pin heart shaped nose to muzzle end. Using matching sewing thread and needle, attach securely by sewing. Likewise, pin heart appliqués to head or chest as desired and attach using sewing thread.
Using photo as a guide, sew on button eyes using strong sewing thread or dental floss.
Attach ears and tail using yarn ends. 
Embroider paw detail using E: beginning at the left hand edge of the paw, insert needle about ½” from tip of paw, bringing it straight through to the other side and pulling tightly to shape. Insert needle back into paw and out about ¼” from the first paw detail. Repeat one more time for a total of 3 paw details. Knot, weave in ends. Repeat for other 3 paws.

materials: Caron International's Simply Soft (100% Acrylic): 4 oz (A), 4 oz (B) Shown in: #9702 Off White (A) and
Caron International's NaturallyCaron.com Country (75% Microdenier Acrylic/25% Merino Wool; 3 oz/85g, 185yds/169m skein): 4 1/2 oz (B) Shown in: #0016 Charcoal (B)
measurements: Toy measures approximately 9 1/2"/24cm tall x 9 1/2"/24cm long
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
SPECIAL STITCHES:
double-loop-st: Wrap yarn around index finger twice and hold behind work, insert hook into indicated stitch and between the yarn wraps and your finger, remove your finger from wraps and draw wraps through stitch (leaving part of each wrap on other side of fabric to form loops), yarn over and draw through all loops on hook. Note: Loops form on side of fabric that is facing away from you.
double-loop-st2tog: [Wrap yarn around index finger twice, insert hook into next stitch and between the yarn wraps and your finger, remove your finger from the wraps and wraps through stitch (leaving part of each wrap on other side of fabric to form loops)] twice, yarn over and draw through all loops on hook.
sc2tog: Single crochet 2 together – Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop, (2 loops on hook), insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

NOTES:
1. Stuff sheep as work progresses, unless otherwise instructed.
2. Pieces are worked in continuous rounds; do not join and do not turn at end of rounds. Place a marker to indicate beginning of round and move marker up as work progresses.
3. Work tightly so stuffing won't show between stitches.

BODY:
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: Work 2 double-loop-sts in each st around—12 sts.
Round 3: [Double-loop-st in next st, 2 double-loop-sts in next st] 6 times—18 sts.
Round 4: [Double-loop-st in next 2 sts, 2 double-loop-sts in next st] 6 times—24 sts.
Round 5: [Double-loop-st in next 3 sts, 2 double-loop-sts in next st] 6 times—30 sts.
Round 6: [Double-loop-st in next 4 sts, 2 double-loop-sts in next st] 6 times—36 sts.
Round 7: [Double-loop-st in next 5 sts, 2 double-loop-sts in next st] 6 times—42 sts.
Round 8: [Double-loop-st in next 6 sts, 2 double-loop-sts in next st] 6 times—48 sts.
Rounds 9–25: Double-loop-st in each st around.
Round 26: [Double-loop-st in next 6 sts, double-loop-st2tog] 6 times—42 sts.
Round 27: [Double-loop-st in next 5 sts, double-loop-st2tog] 6 times—36 sts.
Round 28: [Double-loop-st in next 4 sts, double-loop-st2tog] 6 times—30 sts.
Round 29: [Double-loop-st in next 3 sts, double-loop-st2tog] 6 times—24 sts.
Round 30: [Double-loop-st in next 2 sts, double-loop-st2tog] 6 times—18 sts.
Round 31: [Double-loop-st in next st, double-loop-st2tog] 6 times—12 sts.
Round 32: [double-loop-st2tog] 6 times—6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Complete stuffing body. Use tail to sew opening closed.

HEAD:
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—36 sc.
Rounds 7 and 8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—42 sc.
Rounds 10–19: Sc in each sc around.
Round 20: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times—48 sc.
Round 21: [Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—54 sc.
Round 22: Sc in each sc around.
Round 23: [Sc in next 7 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—48 sts.
Round 24: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times—42 sts.
Round 25: [Sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—36 sts.
Round 26: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—30 sts.
Round 27: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sts.
Round 28: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sts.
Round 29: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sts.
Round 30: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sts.
Round 31: [Sk next st, sl st in next st] 3 times—3 sts.
Fasten off.

FLEECE ON TOP OF HEAD:
With A, ch 2.
Rounds 1–5: Work Rounds 1–5 of body—30 sc.
Round 6: [Double-loop-st in next 4 sc, 2 double-loop-sts in next st] 4 times; in the following, work double-loop st, but wrap yarn around two fingers instead of one (for longer loops), [double-loop-st in next 4 sc, 2 double-loop-sts in next sc] twice—36 sts. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

LEG (make 4):
With B, ch 2.
Rounds 1–6: Work Rounds 1–6 of head—36 sc.
Round 7: Working in front loops only, sc in each sc around.
Rounds 8 and 9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: [Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 5 sc] 3 times—33 sts.
Round 11: [Sc in next 9 sts, sc2tog] 3 times—30 sts.
Round 12: [Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts] 3 times—27 sts.
Round 13: [Sc in next 7 sts, sc2tog] 3 times—24 sts.
Round 14: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts] 3 times—21 sts.
Rounds 15–24: Sc in each st around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

EAR (make 2):
Note: Do not stuff ears.
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—12 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—15 sc.
Round 6–12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 3 times—12 sts.
Round 14: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 3 times—9 sts.
Round 15: Flatten piece and work through both thicknesses, sc evenly across to seam.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

TAIL:
With A, ch 2.
Rounds 1–3: Work Rounds 1–3 of body—18 sts.
Rounds 4–6: Double-loop-st in each st around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING:
Sew legs to lower side of body. Stack black buttons on top of white buttons and sew to head. Sew hair to top of head, placing longer loops in front for bangs. Sew ears to top of head. Sew head to front of body. Sew tail to back of sheep, near top of body. Using yarn needle, weave in all ends.

instructions:
NOTES:
Bunny is worked in continuous rnds. Do not join and do not turn at end of rnds. PM for beg of rnd. Move marker as each rnd is worked.

Ch 2.

6 sc.

12 sc.

4th rnd: (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 6 times. 24 sc.

12th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc). 66 sc.

Work 1st to 6th rnds as given for Body. 36 sts.
7th and 8th rnds:  1 sc in each st around.
9th rnd: 1 sc in each of next 17 sts. 2 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 17 sts. 38 sts.
10th rnd: 1 sc in each of next 14 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 14 sts. 40 sts.
11th rnd: 1 sc in each of next 19 sts. 2 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 19 sts. 42 sts.
12th rnd: 1 sc in each of next 18 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 18 sts. 44 sts.

27th to 31st rnds:  Cont in same manner, dec 6 sc every rnd. 6 sts. 
Fasten off at end of last rnd, leaving long end.
Thread end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.

ARMS 
Rep 1st to 4th rnds as given for Body. 24 sts.
5th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
6th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 7 sts. 2 sc in next st) 3 times. 27 sts.
7th to 11th rnds:  1 sc in each st around.
12th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Sc2tog) 3 times. 24 sts.
13th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts) 3 times. 21 sts.
14th and 15th rnds: Cont in same manner, dec 3 sc every rnd. 15 sts.
16th to 39th rnds:  1 sc in each st around. Fasten off at end of last rnd.

LEGS 
Rep 1st to 4th rnds as given for Body. 24 sts.
5th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 7 sts. 2 sc in next st) 3 times. 27 sts.
6th to 12th rnds:  1 sc in each st around.
Heel shaping: Proceed in rows as follows:
1st row: 1 hdc in each of next 8 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 8 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 9 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. Hdc2tog over side edge of row and next unworked st of 12th rnd. Turn. 10 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Hdc2tog over side edge of row and next unworked st of 12th rnd. Turn. 11 sts.
5th and 6th rows: As 3rd and 4th rows. 13 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts. Hdc2tog over side edge of row and next unworked st of 12th rnd. Work across sts of 12th rnd as follows: Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Sc2tog. Sc2tog over last st and side edge of beg of rnd. Do not turn. 25 sts.
8th rnd: 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 9 sts. 1 sc in each of next 14 sts.
9th rnd: 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 7 sts. 1 sc in each of next 15 sts.
10th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog) 5 times. 20 sts.
11th to 54th rnds:  1 sc in each st around. Fasten off at end of last rnd.

EARS 
Rep 1st and 2nd rnds as given for Body. 12 sts.
3rd rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
4th rnd:  (1 sc in next st. 2 sc in next st) 6 times. 18 sts.
5th to 8th rnds:  Cont in same manner, inc 6 sc every following alt rnd. 30 sts.
9th to 22nd rnds:  1 sc in each st around. 
23rd rnd: (1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts) 3 times. 27 sts.
24th to 27th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
28th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Sc2tog) 3 times. 24 sts.
29th to 43rd rnds:  Cont in same manner, dec 3 sc every following 5th rnd. 15 sts.
44th to 52nd rnds: 1 sc in each st around. Fasten off at end of last rnd.

TAIL
Ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
6 sc.
2nd rnd: Lp st in each st around.
3rd rnd: 2 lp st in each st around. 
12 sts.
4th rnd: (Lp st in next st. 2 lp st in next st) 6 times. 18 sts. Fasten off.
Turn work inside out. 

FINISHING
Sew head to top of body. 
Sew ears to top of head. 
Sew arms to sides of body. Sew legs to bottom of body along 11th rnd.
Sew tail to back of body.

3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
With A, rep last rnd once. 
With MC, rep last rnd twice. 
Rep last 3 rnds 3 times more.
With MC, rep last rnd until work from joining rnd measures 9 ins [23 cm]. 
Stuff body. 
Shape shoulders: Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Miss next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last 2 rnds once more. 27 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Miss next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Stuff remainder of Body. 
HEAD 
Muzzle: With A, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.  
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.  
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.

12th rnd: As 7th rnd. 
13th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 54 sc.

With A, rep last rnd once.  
With MC, rep last rnd until work from beg measures 16 ins [40.5 cm].

Next 2 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Miss next sc. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc. Fasten off.
Sew Arms to body. 
TAIL
Note: Stuff Tail as you work.
With 2 strands of A, ch 2.

3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.  
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd 5 times more. Join 2 strands of MC at end of last rnd. 
With MC, rep last rnd twice. 
With A, rep last rnd once. 
Rep last 3 rnds once more.
With MC, rep last rnd until work from beg measures 18 ins [45.5 cm]. 
Shape top: Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Miss next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc. 
Next 2 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Miss next sc. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc. Fasten off. 
Sew Tail to body. 
EARS (make 2). 
With 2 strands of A, ch 2.

abbreviations: Hdc bobble = (Yoh and draw up a loop) 3 times all in next stitch. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook. Ch 1 tightly to close bobble.

instructions:
Notes:
• Stuff pieces lightly. Do not over stuff.
• When fastening off at end of a rnd, you may wish to finish with an invisible join, as follows: Cut yarn, leaving a long tail. Pull up on last loop on hook until tail is drawn all the way through last stitch. Thread tail onto yarn needle. Insert yarn needle under both strands of 2nd st of round, then insert needle down through last stitch. This creates a loop that looks like the top of a stitch. Weave in the remaining tail.

LEGS (make 2).
Beg at Boot, with F, make a magic ring. 
1st rnd: (RS). Work (3 sc. 2 hdc. 3 sc) in ring. Join with sl st in first sc. 8 sts. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 2 hdc in each of next 2 hdc (toe). 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 10 sts.

Hold both Legs tog, with toes facing in same direction. Sew tops of Legs tog, sewing through 2 sts at inside of each Leg and leaving 8 sts on each Leg unsewn. Stuff Legs. 

Lower Tunic 
With C, ch 24. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist ch. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. 24 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. PM for beg of rnd. Move marker up as work progresses. 
2nd rnd: (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. 20 sts. 
3rd rnd: 1 sc in next sc. Place Tunic around top of Legs, beg at back of Legs. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each of 8 unsewn sts of first Leg. Working in Tunic only, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each of 8 unsewn sts of 2nd Leg. Working in tunic only, 1 sc in last sc. 20 sc. Fasten off. 

Belt rnd: With RS facing, join E with sc at center back of Tunic. 1 sc in each remaining sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 20 sc. Fasten off. 

Upper Tunic 
1st rnd: With RS facing, join C with sl st at center back of Belt. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each sc around. 20 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. PM for beg of rnd. Move marker up as work progresses. 
2nd and 3rd rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. 
4th rnd: 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. 16 sts. 
5th rnd: (Sc2tog) 8 times. 8 sts. Stuff Tunic. Fasten off, leaving a long yarn tail for sewing Tunic to Head. 
With D, embroider a straight stitch square on center front of Belt for buckle (see photo and Diagram on page 4). 

ARMS (make 2) 
Beg at hand, with A, make a magic ring. 
1st rnd: (RS). Work 8 sc in ring. 8 sts. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. PM for beg of rnd. Move marker up as work progresses. 
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 
3rd rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 6 sts. Fasten off A. 
Sleeve: 4th rnd: With RS facing, join C for Grumpy or D for Happy with sl st in first sc of 3rd rnd. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 6 sc.
5th to 8th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Do not stuff Arm. 
9th rnd: (Sc2tog) 3 times. 3 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long yarn tail for sewing Arm to Tunic.

HEAD
Beg at top of Head, with A, make a magic ring. 
1st rnd: (RS). Work 6 sc in ring. 6 sts. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. PM for beg of rnd. Move marker up as work progresses. 
2nd rnd: Work 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc. 
3rd rnd: (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 18 sc. 
4th and 5th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. 
6th rnd: 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Hdc bobble in next sc (nose). 1 sc in each of last 8 sc. 
7th rnd: 1 sc in each st around. 
Attach safety eyes, between 5th and 6th rnds, on either side of nose. 
Note: Push posts of safety eyes between strands of st, not in sp between sts, to avoid allowing safety eye to sink back into Head. 
8th rnd: (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 12 sts. 
9th rnd: (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. 8 sts. 
10th rnd: 1 sc in each st around. Fasten off. Stuff Head. 

CAP
Beg at top of Cap, with B for Grumpy or D for Happy, make a magic ring. 
1st rnd: (RS). 4 sc in ring. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. PM for beg of rnd. Move marker up as work progresses. 
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 
3rd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 8 sc. 
4th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 
5th rnd: (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 4 times. 12 sc. 
6th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 
7th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 4 times. 16 sc. 
8th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 
9th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 4 times. 20 sc. 
10th and 11th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. 
Fasten off. 

BEARD
1st row: With G, (Ch 3. Turn chain on its side and working into back ‘bump’, sl st in 2nd ch from hook and next ch) 3 times. (Ch 4. Turn chain on its side and working into back ‘bump’, sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 2 ch) 4 times. (Ch 5. Turn chain on its side and working into back ‘bump’, sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 3 ch) 3 times. (Ch 4. Turn chain on its side and working into back ‘bump’, sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 2 ch) 4 times. (Ch 3. Turn chain on its side and working into back ‘bump’, sl st in 2nd ch from hook and next ch) 3 times. 17 beard ‘chain pieces’ in total.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing Beard to face.

FINISHING
Sew Arms to sides of body, near top of Tunic. Sew Head to top of Tunic. Arrange Beard around chin and sides of face and sew in place. Place Cap on Head and sew in place. With E, embroider face details with straight stitches as shown in photo.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 0312 Black A, 0319 Cherry Red B, 0886 Blue C, 0321 Gold D, 0334 Buff E, 0313 Aran F, 0358 Lavender G, 0512 Turqua H, 0672 Spring Green I.
Yarn needle, stitch marker, fiberfill, one pair 6mm safety eyes.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Each gnome measures 8” tall including cap.
gauge: 14 sts = 4”; 15 rows = 4” in single crochet.
instructions:
PAPA
Legs (make 2)
Beginning at shoe, with A, make an adjustable ring. 
Round 1 (Right Side): Work (3 sc, 2 hdc, 3 sc) in ring; join 
with slip st in first sc—8 sts. 
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, 2 hdc in each of next 2 hdc 
(for toe), sc in last 3 sc; join with slip st in first sc—10 sts. 
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in 
first sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, [sc2tog] 2 times, sc in last 
3 sc; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc. Fasten off.

Round 5: With Right Side facing, join B with sc in first sc 
of Round 4, sc in each remaining sc around; do not join, 
work in continuous rounds. Place marker for beginning of 
round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 6 and 7: Sc in each sc around. 
Round 8: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 2 times—10 sc. 
Fasten off. Hold both legs together, with toes facing in the 
same direction. Sew tops of legs together, sewing through 
2 stitches at inside of each leg and leaving 8 stitches on 
each leg unsewn. Stuff legs.
Lower Tunic
With C, ch 24; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in 
first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, sc in each ch around; do not 
join, work in continuous rounds—24 sc. Place marker for 
beginning of round. Move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 4 times—20 sc.
Round 3: Sc in next sc; place tunic around top of 
legs, beginning at back of legs, working through both 
thicknesses, sc in 8 unsewn sts of first leg; working in tunic 
sts only, sc in next 2 sc; working through both thicknesses, 
sc in 8 unsewn sts of 2nd leg; working in last tunic st only, 
sc in last sc—20 sc. Fasten off.
Belt
Round 1: Join A with sc at center back of tunic, sc in each 
remaining sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Upper Tunic
Round 1: Join C with sc at center back of belt, sc in each 
sc around; do not join, work in continuous rounds. Place 
marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as work 
progresses.
Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: Sc in next 4 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next 6 sc, 
[sc2tog] twice, sc in next 2 sc—16 sc.
Round 5: [Sc2tog] 8 times—8 sc. Stuff tunic. Fasten 
off, leaving a long tail for sewing tunic to head. With D, 
embroider a straight stitch square on center, front of belt 
for buckle.
Arms (make 2)
Beginning at hand, with E, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Work 8 sc in ring; do not join, work 
in continuous rounds—8 sc. Place marker for beginning of 
round. Move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Round 3: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 2 times—6 sc. Fasten off.
Sleeve
Round 4: Join C with sc in first sc of round 3, sc in next 5 sc.
Rounds 5–8: Sc in each sc around. Do not stuff arm.
Round 9: [Sc2tog] 3 times—3 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing arm to tunic.
Head
With E, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work 
in continuous rounds—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of 
round. Move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 4 and 5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: Sc in next 9 sc, 3-hdc popcorn in next sc (for 
nose), sc in last 8 sc.
Round 7: Sc in each sc around.
Attach safety eyes, between Rounds 5 and 6, on either 
side of nose. Note: Push posts of safety eyes between 
strands of a stitch, not in space between stitches, to avoid 
allowing the eye to sink back into the head.
Round 8: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Round 9: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 4 times—8 sc.
Round 10: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off. Stuff head.
Cap 
With B, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Work 4 sc in ring; do not join, work 
in continuous rounds—4 sc. Place marker for beginning of 
round. Move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Round 3: Work 2 sc in each sc around—8 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times—12 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times—16 sc.
Round 8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times—20 sc.
Rounds 10 and 11: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.
Hair and Beard
Row 1: With F, [ch 3, working  in back bars, slip st in 2nd 
ch from hook and in next ch] 4 times, [ch 4, working  in 
back bars, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch] 4 
times, [ch 5, working  in back bars, slip st in 2nd ch from 
hook and in next 3 ch] 2 times, [ch 4, working  in back 
bars, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch] 4 times, 
[ch 3, working  in back bars, slip st in 2nd ch from hook 
and in next ch] 4 times. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for 
sewing hair and beard to cap and face. 
Front Curl (optional)
With F, ch 5, working in back bars, slip st in 3rd ch from 
hook and in next 2 ch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for 
sewing curl to underside of cap.

Mustache
With F, [ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch] 
2 times. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing mustache 
to face.
FINISHING
Sew arms to sides of body, near top of tunic. Sew head to 
top of tunic. Sew front curl to underside of center front of 
cap. Sew ends of hair and beard piece together to form a 
ring. Sew piece to underside of cap edge, placing seam 
centered at back of cap, and sewing for about ½” on each 
side of seam (to about where ears would be). Place cap 
on head and sew in place. Arrange beard around chin and 
sides of face and sew in place. Sew mustache beneath 
nose. Weave in all ends.

BOY
Legs (make 2)
Work same as papa’s legs through Round 7, using A for 
shoe and D for legs. Work one more round, as follows, 
before finishing leg.
Round 8: Sc in each sc around.  
Round 9: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 2 times—10 sc. 
Fasten off. Hold both legs together, with toes facing in the 
same direction. Sew tops of legs together, sewing through 
2 stitches at inside of each leg and leaving 8 stitches on 
each leg unsewn. Stuff legs.
Lower Tunic
With I, ch 20; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in 
first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around; join with slip st in 
first sc. Fasten off.
Belt
Round 1: Place tunic around top of legs, join A with sc in 
first sc of belt, beginning at back of legs, working through 
both thicknesses, sc in 8 unsewn sts of first leg, sc in next 
2 sc of belt only, working through both thicknesses, sc in 8 
unsewn sts of 2nd leg, sc in last sc of belt; join with slip st 
in first sc—20 sc.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. 
Fasten off.
Upper Tunic
With I, work same as papa’s upper tunic.
Arms (make 2)
Work same as papa’s arm, using E for hand, and I for 
sleeve.
Head
Work same as papa’s head.
Cap 
With C, work same as papa’s cap.
Hair
Row 1: With A, [ch 3, working in back bars, slip st in 2nd 
ch from hook and in next ch] 18 times. Fasten off, leaving 
a long tail for sewing hair to cap. Sew last stitch to first 
stitch. Sew hair to underside of cap edge.
FINISHING
Sew arms to sides of body, near top of tunic. Sew head 
to top of tunic. Sew cap to top of head. With B, embroider 
straight stitch mouth below nose.

GIRL
Legs (make 2)
Work same as boy’s legs, using G for shoe and E for leg.
Skirt
With I, ch 48; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in 
first ch.
Round 1 (ruffle): Taking care not to twist ch, sc in first ch., 
sc in next ch, skip next 2 ch, [sc in next 2 ch, skip next 2 
ch] 11 times; do not join, work in continuous rounds—24 
sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up 
as work progresses.
Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 10 sc, sc2tog, 
sc in next 5 sc—22 sc.
Round 5: Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 9 sc, sc2tog, 
sc in next 4 sc—20 sc. Fasten off.
Waistband
Round 1: Place skirt around top of legs, join H with sc in 
first sc of waistband, beginning at back of legs, working 
through both thicknesses, sc in 8 unsewn sts of first leg, 
sc in next 2 sc of waistband only, working through both 
thicknesses, sc in 8 unsewn sts of 2nd leg, sc in last sc of 
waistband; join with slip st in first sc—20 sc. Fasten off.
Blouse
With G, work same as papa’s upper tunic.
Arms (make 2)
Work same as papa’s arm, using E for hand and G for 
sleeve.

Head
Work same as papa’s head.

Cap
Work same as papa’s cap.

Hair
With D, [ch 10, 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 3 sc in each of 
next 4 ch, sc in next 4 ch] 5 times, [ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch 
from hook and next ch] 5 times (for bangs), [ch 10, 3 sc in 
2nd ch from hook, 3 sc in each of next 4 ch, sc in next 4 
ch] 5 times. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing hair to 
cap. Sew last stitch to first stitch. Sew hair to underside of cap edge, centering bangs at front of cap.
Finishing
Sew arms to sides of body, near top of blouse. Sew 
head to top of blouse. Sew cap to top of head. With B, 
embroider straight stitch mouth below nose.

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Classic™ Crochet Thread size 10 (350 yds/320 m)
Aunt Lydia’s® Classic™ Crochet Thread size 3 (150 yds/137 m)
Size U.S. C/2 (2.75 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in front loops ONLY in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Micro Bear: Approx 2½" x 1¾" x ¾" [6 x 4.5 x 2 cm]; Mini Bear: 3¼" x 2¼" [8.5 x 5.5 cm]
gauge: 36 sc and 40 rows = 4" [10 cm] with U.S. 7 (1.5 mm) crochet hook and Aunt Lydia’s® Classic 10 Crochet Thread; 26 sc and 28 rows = 4" [10 cm] with U.S. C/2 (2.75 mm) crochet hook and Aunt Lydia’s® Classic 3 Crochet Thread
instructions: Note: The instructions are written for both Versions. Designer Tip: Use the trick quilters use to bury their knots when hand quilting. Make a knot close to the surface of the work and pull the knot into the interior and out the other side. Trim thread close to the exit point. Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st. HEAD Make Magic loop. Video here. 1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in magic loop. Join. PM for beg of rnd. 6 sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc. 3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 18 sc. 4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. 24 sc. 5th to 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join. 18 sts. 9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join. 12 sts. Stuff Head. 10th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 6 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. LEGS (make 2) Make Magic loop. 1st rnd: Ch 1. 4 sc in magic loop. Join. PM for beg of rnd. 4 sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 8 sc. 3rd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off at end of last rnd, leaving a long end of First Leg. Do not fasten off at end of Second Leg. Stuff legs. BODY Cont working around legs as follows: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc of Second Leg. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc of First Leg. Join. PM for beg of rnd. 16 sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join. 12 sts. 4th and 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. 6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next st. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long end. 9 sts. Stuff Body. ARMS (make 2) Make Magic loop. 1st rnd: Ch 1. 4 sc in magic loop. Join. PM for beg of rnd. 4 sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. 6 sc. 3rd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off at end of last rnd, leaving a long end. EARS (make 2) Make Magic loop. 1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in magic loop. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Using a needle with the tail from the center, pull through the SC at the edge opposite of fasten off tail. SNOUT Make Magic loop. 1st rnd: Ch 1. 12 sc in magic loop. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Sew snout to head using the picture as a guide, make a knot close to the surface and pull to the inside of the head. Embroider nose with black floss. Sew on bead eyes and ears using the picture as a guide for placement. SCARF for Mini Bear Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color. Stripe pat B – 2 rows. A – 2 rows. These 4 rows form Stripe pat. Scarf With B, ch 9. 1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 8 sc. 2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. First 2 rows of Stripe pat are complete. Cont in Stripe pat, rep last row until work from beg measures approx 4" [10 cm], ending with 2 rows of B. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 334 Buff A, 365 Coffee B, and 316 Soft White C.
Stuffing, split-ring stitch marker, yarn needle.
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Chocolate Pie & Ice Cream is 8”. Pie is 4½” from point to back of crust. Ice Cream long.
gauge: 13 sc = 4”; 16 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CHOCOLATE PIE
Crust
With A, ch 2.
Row 1: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook; turn – 3 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in 1st st, sc to last st, 2 sc in last st; turn – 5 sts.
Rows 4-15: Repeat Rows 2-3 – 17 sts at end of Row 15.
Row 16: Repeat Row 2.
Row 17: Ch 1, working in back loops ONLY, sc in each st across; turn.
Rows 18-21: Repeat Row 2.
Row 22: Ch 1, (sc, dc, sc) all in 1st st; * slip st in next st, (sc, dc, sc) all in next st; repeat from * across. Fasten off.
Chocolate
With B, work same as Crust through Row 16.
Row 17: Ch 1, sc in each st across; DO NOT TURN; work 16 sc evenly along edge, 1 sc in tip, 16 sc evenly along other edge; turn – 50 sts.
Row 18: Ch 1, working in front loops ONLY, sc in 1st 33 sts; TURN.
Row 19: Working in these 33 sts only, ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
Rows 20-21: Repeat Row 19. Fasten off.
Join: Hold Chocolate in place on Crust and attach A in top back left corner of Crust. Ch 1, work through both Chocolate and Crust, sc evenly down side, across bottom edge, and up other side. Fasten off. Stuff pie and with A, sew opening closed.
Whipped Cream
With C, ch 30.
Row 1: 3 dc in 3rd ch from hook and in next 14 ch, 3 tr in remaining ch across. Fasten off.
Curl Whipped Cream according to photo and sew to top of Pie.

ICE CREAM CONE
Cone
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Round 2: * Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 8 sts.
Round 3: * Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 10 sts.
Round 4: * Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 12 sts.
Round 5: * Sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 14 sts.
Round 6: * Sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 16 sts.
Round 7: * Sc in next 7 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 8: * Sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 20 sts.
Round 9: * Sc in next 9 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 22 sts.
Round 10: Sc in each st around.
Round 11: * Sc in next 10 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 12: Repeat Round 10.
Round 13: * Sc in next 11 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 26 sts.
Round 14: Repeat Round 10.
Round 15: * Sc in next 12 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 28 sts.
Round 16: Repeat Round 10.
Round 17: * Sc in next 13 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 18: Repeat Round 10. Fasten off.
Ice Cream
With C, ch 2.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook; turn – 1 st.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in st; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in st; turn – 2 sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in 1st st, 2 sc in next st; turn – 3 sts.
Row 6: Repeat Row 4.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in 1st st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st; turn – 4 sts.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in 1st st, 2 sc in next st, sc in remaining sts; turn – 5 sts.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in 1st 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in remaining sts; join with a slip st to first sc to form ring, begin working in rounds – 6 sts.
Round 10: * 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 12 sts.
Round 11: * Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 12: * Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 13: Sc in each st around.
Round 14: * Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 15: * Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Round 16: Repeat Round 13.
Round 17: * Sc2tog; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 18: Repeat Round 13.
Round 19: * 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Rounds 20-23: Repeat Round 13.
Round 24: * Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 30 sts. Fasten off.
Join: Stuff Cone and Ice Cream. With A, sew together. Sew Rows 1-9 of Ice Cream together lengthwise, curl down and sew in place.
Cuff
With A, ch 5.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 4 sts.
Rows 2-28: Ch 1, working in back loops ONLY, sc in each st across; turn.
Fasten off. Sew in place around top of Cone.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 530 Orchid A, 722 Pretty ‘n Pink B, and 3862 Jade C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 12 sts = 4" (10 cm); 8 rows of bodice = 2" (5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions: OUTFIT Bodice With A, ch 34. Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—33 sc. Rows 2–7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first 14 sc, skip next 2 sc, 5 dc in next sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in last 14 sc; change to B, turn—28 sc and 5 dc. Row 9: Ch 1, sc in each st across to next dc, sc in next 2 dc, 3 sc in next dc, sc in each remaining st—32 sc and one 3-sc group. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. Strap With B, ch 35, sc in center st of 3-sc group, ch 35. Fasten off. Body Row 1 (right side): With right side of bodice facing and working in opposite side of foundation row, join C with sc in first ch, sc in next 3 ch, *2 sc in next ch, sc in next 7 ch; repeat from * twice, 2 sc in next ch, sc in last 4 ch, turn—37 sc. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *skip next 2 sc, 5 dc in next sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * across, turn—7 sc and 30 dc. Row 3: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), 2 dc in first sc, skip first 2 dc, sc in next dc, *skip next 2 dc, 5 dc in next sc, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * across, skip last 2 dc, 3 dc in last sc, turn—6 sc and 31 dc. Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first dc, skip next 2 dc, 5 dc in next sc, *skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc, skip next 2 dc, 5 dc in next sc; repeat from * across, skip last 2 dc, sc in top of beginning ch, turn—7 sc and 30 dc. Row 5: Repeat Row 3. Rows 6–19: Repeat last 2 rows 7 times. Row 20: Ch 1, sc in first 7 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next 15 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next 6 dc, sc in top of beginning ch, turn—33 sc. Row 21: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next 13 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last 6 sc, turn—29 sc. Row 22: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next 11 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last 5 sc, turn—25 sc. Row 23: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next 9 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last 4 sc, turn—21 sc. Row 24: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next 7 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last 3 sc, turn—17 sc. Row 25: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next 5 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last 2 sc, turn—13 sc. Row 26: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next 3 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last sc, turn—9 sc. Row 27: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next sc, [sc2tog] twice, turn—5 sc. Row 28: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next sc, sc2tog, turn—3 sc. Row 29: Ch 1, sc3tog—1 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. First Fin With B, leaving a long beginning tail, ch 17. Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—16 sc. Row 2: Ch 3, dc in each sc across, turn. Row 3: Ch 3, dc in next 7 dc; leave remaining dc unworked, turn—8 dc. Row 4: Ch 3, dc2tog, dc in next 4 dc, dc in top of beginning ch, turn—7 dc. Row 5: Ch 3, dc in next 3 sts, dc2tog, dc in top of beginning ch, turn—6 dc. Row 6: Ch 3, dc2tog, dc in next 2 dc, dc in top of beginning ch, turn—5 dc. Row 7: Ch 3, dc in next dc, dc2tog, dc in top of beginning ch, turn—4 dc. Row 8: Ch 3, dc2tog, dc in top of beginning ch, turn—3 dc. Row 9: Ch 3, dc2tog, working 2nd 'leg' in top of beginning ch, turn—2 dc. Fasten off. 2nd Fin Row 1: With wrong side of first fin facing, join B with slip st in top of beginning ch of Row 2, ch 3, dc in unworked 7 dc, turn—8 dc. Rows 2–7: Repeat Rows 4–9 of first fin. Crown With B, ch 33; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around; join with slip st in first sc—33 sc. Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, picot, *ch 3, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc, picot; repeat from * around, ch 3; join in first sc—11 picots. Fasten off. FINISHING With end tails, sew matching edges of bodice and body together. Flatten lower section of body. Referring to photograph as a guide, with beginning tail, sew Row 1 of first fin to flattened edge of body. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”-Princess: 1 Skein each 381 Light Blue A, 313 Aran B, 321 Gold C, 324 Bright Yellow D; Frog: 1 skein 368 Paddy Green A, 12” of 256 Carrot B.
Split-lock stitch marker; yarn needle; stuffing;
Princess: 2 small blue buttons for eyes; small amount red and black pearl cotton; red crayon for cheeks;
abbreviations: dec (decrease) = draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Princess measures 6” tall. Frog measures 6½” high from top of eyes to bottom of body.
gauge: 16 sc = 4”; 20 rnds = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
PRINCESS
HEAD AND BODY: Begin at top of head with B, ch 2. Rnd 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc. Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc. Rnd 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 24 sc. Rnd 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 30 sc. Rnds 6-12: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 13: [Dec] 15 times – 15 sc. Neck-Rnd 14: [Sc in next 3 sc, dec] 3 times – 12 sc. Body-Rnd 15: [Inc] 12 times – 24 sc. Cut B. Stuff head. Rnds 16-24: With A, sc in each sc around. Stuff body. Rnd 25: [Dec] 12 times – 12 sc.
Rnd 26: [Dec] 6 times – 6 sc. Fasten off. Finish stuffing. Weave yarn tail through remaining 6 sc, draw up firmly to gather; fasten securely.
ARM (Make 2): With B, ch 2. Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook. Rnd 2: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] twice – 8 sc. Rnds 3-6: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off. Stuff lightly. Sew opening flat and sew in place.
HAIR: With D, ch 2. Rnds 1-3: Repeat Rnds 1-3 of Head – 18 sc. Rnd 4: Working in front lps only, slip st in first sc, * ch 10, 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across **, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around, end at **; join. Fasten off. Sew Rnds 1-3 to center top of head.
CROWN: With C, ch 13. Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 12 sc. Row 2: [Ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times; bring beginning of this row around and join with a slip st to first sc. Fasten off. Sew to top center of hair.
EARS: With B, ch 2. Row 1: 3 Sc in 2nd ch from hook; turn. Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in last sc. Fasten off. Sew ears in place.
Sew on button eyes with black pearl cotton. Embroider smile with red pearl cotton. Color cheeks with crayon.
SKIRT: With A, ch 25. Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 24 sc. Row 2: Ch 3, dc in first sc, 2 dc in each sc across; turn – 48 sts. Row 3: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in each dc across and in top of ch-3; turn. Row 4: Ch 1, [sc in dc, skip next dc, 5 dc in next dc, skip next dc] 12 times. Fasten off. Sew to waist; sew back seam.
LEG (Make 2): With B, ch 2. Rnds 1 and 2: Repeat Rnds 1 and 2 of Head – 12 sc. Rnd 3: Sc in each sc around. Rnd 4: Sc in first sc, [dec] 3 times, sc in last 5 sc – 9 sc. Rnds 5-7: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off. Stuff. Sew in place.
FROG
HEAD AND BODY-Rnds 1-26: Work same as Princess Rnds 1-26 all with A.
EYE (Make 2): With A, ch 2. Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook. Rnd 2: [Sc in next sc, inc] 3 times – 9 sc.
Rnd 3: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off. Insert wiggle eye. Sew in place at top of head as pictured.
ARM (Make 2)-Rnds 1-3: Work same as Princess Rnds 1-3 with A. Row 4: Hold work flat and work 4 sc across through both thicknesses; turn – 4 sc. “Fingers”-Row 5: Ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, skip first sc on Row 4, slip st in next sc, [ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, slip st in next sc on Row 4] twice. Fasten off. Sew in place.
LEG (Make 2)-Rnds 1-3: Work same as Princess Rnds 1-3. Rnds 4 and 5: Sc in each sc around. Stuff. Row 6: Hold work flat and work 6 sc across through both thicknesses; turn – 6 sc. “Toes”-Row 7: Ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, skip first sc on Row 6, slip st in next sc, [ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] twice. Fasten off. Sew in place.
With B, stitch mouth as pictured. Weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 239 yds/219 m) Sweet Treats (9755) 1 ball makes 2 Ice Cream Cone and Cake Slice
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Popcorn = Work 4 dc into same stitch. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back into first dc of 4 dc group. Pull dropped loop through st. Ch 1 to secure popcorn
Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Ice Cream Cone: Approx 6½" [16.5 cm] tall. Cake Slice: Approx 3½" [9 cm] tall.
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Ice Cream Cone and Cake Slice:
Yellow as Color 1, Blue as Color 2, Beige as Color 3, Pink as Color 4.
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
ICE CREAM CONE
Ice Cream Scoop 1: Beg at top, with Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
8th to 15th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
16th rnd: Working in front loops only, *sl st in next sc. 3 hdc in next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * around. Join.
17th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only of 15th rnd, *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Break Color 1. Join Color 2. 36 sc.
Ice Cream Scoop 2: 18th rnd:
With B, ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
19th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
20th to 27th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
28th rnd: Working in front loops only, *sl st in next sc. 3 hdc in next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * around. Join.
29th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only of 27th rnd, *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Break Color 2. Join Color 3. 36 sc.
Secure safety eyes onto Scoops as shown in photo.
Using Color 4, embroider blush below eyes as shown in photo.
Ice Cream Cone: 30th rnd: With Color 3, ch 1. Working in front loops only, *1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Rep from * around. Join.
31st rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only of 29th rnd, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
32nd and 33rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
34th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
35th and 36th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Stuff Scoops and Cone firmly.
37th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
38th and 39th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
40th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
41st and 42nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
43rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
44th and 45th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Finish stuffing Cone firmly.
46th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 6 sc.
47th and 48th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off, leaving long end. Draw end tightly through remaining sts.
Cherry: With Color 4, ch 4. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join, leaving remaining ch-2 as Stem of Cherry. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off, leaving long end.
Stuff Cherry firmly. Using long end, sew Cherry onto Scoop 1 as shown in photo.
CAKE SLICE
Cake Icing: With Color 4, ch 3.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in last ch. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 4 sc.
3rd and 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn.
Rep 3rd to 5th rows until 26 rows from beg have been worked. 20 sc.
27th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
28th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
29th to 43rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
44th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
45th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
46th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 18 sc.
47th and 48th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of rows. Turn.
Rep 46th to 48th rows until 2 sts remain, ending on a 46th row. 
Fasten off.
Top Edge Frosting: 1st row:
Join Color 2 with sl st to 1st front loop of 27th row. Working in front loops only, *Popcorn in next st. Sl st in next st. Rep from * to last st. (Popcorn. Sl st) in last st. Fasten off.
Bottom Edge Frosting: 1st row:
Join Color 1 with sl st to 1st front loop of 43rd row. Ch 1. Working in front loops only, *1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. 
Fasten off.
Cake Layers 
Stripe Pat:
With Color 3, 4 rows.
With Color 1, 2 rows.
With Color 3, 4 rows.
With Color 2, 2 rows.
With Color 3, 4 rows.
These 16 rows complete Stripe Pat.
With Color 3, ch 51.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 50 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
First 2 rows of Stripe Pat are complete. 
Rep 2nd row until all 16 rows of Stripe Pat have been worked.
Fasten off.
Attach safety eyes and embroider cheeks on Cake Layers as shown in photo.
Joining Cake Layers and Cake Icing: Referring to diagram, pin Cake Layers and Cake Icing together to help with joining.
1st rnd: Working through both thicknesses, join Color 4 with sl st anywhere along meeting edges of Cake Layers and Cake Icing. Ch 2. Work hdc evenly around all edges. Stuff Cake firmly 2” [5 cm] before completing joining edge. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.
Icing Dollop
Stripe Pat:
With Color 1, 2 rows.
With Color 2, 2 rows.
These 4 rows complete Stripe Pat.
With Color 1, ch 11.
1st row: Sc2tog over 2nd and 3rd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 2 sc in last ch. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc.1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join Color 2. Turn.
3rd row:  With Color 2, ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join Color 1. Turn.
4 rows of Stripe Pat complete. 
Keeping the continuity of Stripe Pat, rep 3rd and 4th rows until 12 rows in total are complete. 
Fasten off leaving long tail.
Using Color 1, sew ends together to create Tube. Gather top edge of Tube. Pull tight and secure. Do not break Color 1. Using same tail, gather bottom edge of Tube. Pull tight and secure.
Sew Icing Dollop to top of Cake as shown in picture.

materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi Textures™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 242 yds/221 m) Fox (9201) 1 ball makes 2
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
1 black safety nose 1/3" [8 mm] and 2 black safety eyes ¼" [6 mm] for each toy.
abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) sc. Yoh and draw through all 3(4) loops on hook
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Version 1: Orange as Color 1, Brown as Color 2, White Texture as Color 3. 
Version 2: White as Color 1, Brown as Color 2, White Texture as Color 3. 
Notes:
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.
 
Ears (make 2).
Front Ear:**With Color 1, ch 8.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 7 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 5 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Fasten off.**
Back Ear: Rep from ** to ** as given for Front Ear.
Inner Ear: With Color 3, ch 5, leaving a long end for sewing.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Turn. 
4th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off. Sew Inner Ear to RS of Front Ear.
With WS of Front and Back Ears tog and working through both thicknesses, join Color 1 with sl st to bottom right corner of Ear.
1st row: With Color 1, work 6 sc evenly up side of Ear. Join Color  2. Do not break Color 1. With Color 2, 4 sc in top corner of Ear. Break Color 2. With Color 1, 6 sc evenly down side of ear.
Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Facial Fur
With Color 3, ch 12.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 11 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Sc2tog. 9 sts. 
Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Chest Fur
With Color 3, ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 7 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 5 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Fasten off, leaving long end for sewing.
Head and Body
With Color 1, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
7th to 11th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sts.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc. 
15th to 25th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Do not fasten off.
Sew Facial Fur and Chest Fur to Body and Head as shown in picture. Attach safety eyes and nose as shown in picture. Sew Ears onto Head as shown in picture.
Stuff Head and Body firmly.
Divide for legs: Join separate length of Color 1 with sl st to first  sc. Ch 4. Skip next 16 sc. Join with sl st to next sc. Fasten off.
Left Leg
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 16 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. Join. 20 sc.
***2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Break Color 1. Join Color 2. 15 sts.
3rd rnd: With Color 2, ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 10 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 5 times. Join. 5 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Stuff leg firmly. Draw end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.***
Right Leg
Join Color 1 with sl st to last sc of 25th rnd of Body. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc into opposite side of each of next 4 ch. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Join. 20 sc.
Rep from *** to *** as given for Left Leg. 
Arms (make 2)
With Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with Color 1. Break Color 2. 
3rd rnd: With Color 1, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep 3rd rnd 4 times more.
Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Stuff arms firmly.
Sew Arms to Body as shown in picture.
Tail
With Color 3, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with Color 1. Break Color 3.
4th rnd: With Color 1, ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th to 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
10th and 11th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around.
Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Stuff Tail firmly.
Sew Tail to Body as shown in picture.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver: 1 skein each of 512 Turqua A, 316 Soft White B, 706 Perfect Pink C and 312 Black D
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Large Pony measures 9” (22 7/8 cm) tall, Small Pony measures 5 ½” (14 cm) tall
gauge: Gauge is not important for this project.
instructions:
Mouth
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join.
Rounds 2–3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join.
Round 6: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times, sc in last sc, join.
Rounds 7–8: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join.
Round 9: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around, join.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing in place.
Ears (Make 2)
With A, ch 4
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, do not join. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing in place.
Legs (Make 4)
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join.
Rounds 2–8: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join. Fasten off.
Rounds 9–12: With A, ch 1, sc in each sc around, join. 
Round 13: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Round 14: Ch 1, [sc in each of next 2, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Row 15: Now working in rows, ch 1, sc in first sc and in next 7 sc, turn.
Row 16: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing in place.
LARGE PONY 
Body
With A, ch 2. 
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around, join.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Rounds 5–18: Ch 1, sc in each st around, join.
Round 19: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] around, join.
Round 20: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] around, join.
Round 21: Ch 1, [sc2tog] around, join. Fasten off, and sew closed.
Neck
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around, join.
Rounds 3–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join.
Round 6: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Rounds 7–12: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing in place.
FINISHING
Body Assembly
Referring to photo for placement, using long tails, sew Neck to Body, Mouth to Neck, Ears to Head and Legs to Body.  
Neck Fringe
With B, cut (34) 6-inch (15 ¼ cm) pieces of yarn for neck fringe. Attach two rows of single layer fringe, placing them side by side starting at bottom of back of neck, then attaching fringe upwards to ears. Fold strand in half. Insert hook through stitch, and draw folded end of strands through to form loop. Thread ends of strand through loop, and pull ends to tighten. Trim fringe lightly, if needed.
Tail fringe
With B, cut (12) 11-inch (28 cm) pieces of yarn for tail fringe. Attach one fringe using all 12 pieces of yarn. Fold strands in half. Insert hook through stitch, and draw folded end of strands through to form loop. Thread ends of strands through loop, and pull ends to tighten. Trim fringe lightly, if needed.
Eyes
With D, embroider eyes, using photo as placement. 
SMALL PONY
Body
With C, ch 2. 
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around, join.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Rounds 4–15: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join.
Round 16: Ch 1 [sc in each of next 2 sc, sc2tog] around, join.
Round 17: Ch 1, [sc2tog] around, join. Fasten off, and sew closed.
Neck
With C, ch 2.
Round 1: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around, join.
Rounds 3–4: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Rounds 6–8: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing in place.
Mouth
With C, ch 2.
Round 1: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join.
Round 7: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around, join.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing in place.
Ears (Make 2)
With C, ch 4
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 2 chs, do not join. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing in place.
Legs (Make 4)
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join.
Rounds 2–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join. Fasten off.
Rounds 6–7: With C, ch 1, sc in each sc around, join. 
Round 8: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Round 9: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around, join.
Row 15: Now working in rows, ch 1, sc in first sc, sc in next 6 sc, turn.
Row 16: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog, turn.
Row 17: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing in place.
FINISHING
Referring to photo for placement, using long tails, sew Neck to Body, Mouth to Neck, Ears to Head and Legs to Body.
Neck fringe
With B, cut (20) 5-inch (12 ¾ cm) pieces of yarn for neck fringe. Attach two rows of single layer fringe, placing them side by side starting at bottom of back of neck, then attaching fringe upwards to ears. Fold strand in half. Insert hook through stitch, and draw folded end of strands through to form loop. Thread ends of strand through loop, and pull ends to tighten. Trim fringe lightly, if needed.
Tail fringe
With B, cut nine 7-inch (1.8 cm) pieces of yarn for tail fringe. Attach one fringe using all 9 pieces of yarn. Fold strands in half. Insert hook through stitch, and draw folded end of strands through to form loop. Thread ends of strands through loop, and pull ends to tighten. Trim fringe lightly, if needed.
Eyes
With D, embroider eyes, using photo as placement.

materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi Textures™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 242 yds/221 m) Alien/Rocketship (9278) 1 ball
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.

Rocketship: Stitch marker. Fiberfil stuffing. Yarn needle. Strong craft glue or cement. Drinking straw (to support rocket booster frames). 1 medium pompom ¾" [19 mm] diameter (for alien head). 3 small pompoms 1/3" [8 mm] diameter (2 for alien headphones and 1 for nosecone embellishment). 1 toothpick. 2 small black beads 1/8" [3 mm] (for alien eyes)
Optional: One half of a clear fillable plastic ornament 2" [5 cm] diameter (for porthole dome)
Alien: 2 post and washer animal noses (for eyes) ½" [13 mm]. Stitch marker. Fiberfil stuffing. Yarn needle. Small length of plastic drinking straw (rigid insert for top knot/hair).
Optional: Knee high stockings and weighted stuffing (such as aquarium gravel, plastic pellets or rice), small red glitter foam star and craft glue (for belt buckle)
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Rocketship: Approx 6½" [16.5 cm] long. Alien: Approx 5" [12.5 cm] tall.
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Rocketship: Green is A. Yellow is B. Blue is C. Fuzzy Pink is D. Alien: Green is A. Yellow is B. Fuzzy Pink is C. Blue is not used in this design.
Notes
• Booster Rockets and Booster Rocket frames are worked separately and sewn tog. Frames are cylindrical pieces that hold Booster Rockets on Rocketship and are fitted with a small length of plastic drinking straw to provide rigidity.
• The clear spaceship dome (porthole), is created from half of a fillable clear plastic ornament. It is connected to Spaceship with crochet edging that is glued around the bottom edge of the dome using strong craft glue or cement. Space alien and nose cone feature are glued to a toothpick, then inserted and glued in place on Rocketship.
• Before beg, separate different color sections of the yarn as follows: Pop center color out by pushing gently on the center of ball so that it comes out intact. Find point where color changes and cut yarn. Rep this process for rem yarn colors by carefully pushing rings of color out of larger ring and cutting. Roll each color into a ball to prevent tangling.
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed, keeping color change to WS of work.
• This project includes some optional multi-crafting techniques for finishing and embellishing. Make certain to read through entire pattern before beg.
• Designs may not be suitable for babies and very young children as the fuzzy hair yarn and post and washer eyes could come off and pose a choking hazard.

ROCKETSHIP
Beg at nosecone with B, make an adjustable ring as follows: Wrap yarn into a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work sts of first rnd in the ring. After the first rnd of sts is worked, pull gently on tail to tighten ring.
1st rnd: 5 sc in ring. Do not join. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). 5 sc. PM in last sc worked to indicate end of rnd. Move marker up as each rnd is completed.
2nd rnd: Work 2 sc in each of next 5 sc. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 5 times. 15 sc.
4th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
5th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 18 sc.
6th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
7th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 21 sc.
8th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
9th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 7 times. 28 sc.
10th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 7 times. 35 sc.
11th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Sl st in next st. Fasten off.
Work in joined rnds as follows:
12th rnd: Working in back loops only, join A with sc in any sc of 11th rnd. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st in first sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 7 times. Join with sl st in first sc. 42 sc. Fasten off.
14th rnd: Working in back loops only, join C with sc in any st of 13th rnd. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st in first sc.
15th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 7 times. Join with sl st in first sc. 49 sc.
Work in continuous rnds (spiral):
16th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Do not join. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). 49 sc. PM in the last sc worked to indicate end of rnd. Move marker up as each rnd is completed.
17th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 7 times. 56 sc.
18th to 37th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
38th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog) 7 times. 49 sts.
39th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog) 7 times. 42 sts.
40th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 19 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 40 sts.
41st rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 10 times. 30 sts.
Stuff piece firmly and cont stuffing piece as work progresses.
42nd rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
43rd rnd: (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 10 times. 20 sts.
44th to 46th rnds: 1 sc in each st around. Fasten off.
47th rnd: Working in back loops only, join A with sc in any st of rnd 46. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st in first sc.
48th rnd: 1 sc in each st around. Fasten off.
Work in joined rnds as follows:
49th rnd: Working in back loops only, join B with sc in any st. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st in first sc.
50th rnd: Working in back loops only, (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 5 times. Do not join. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). 15 sts.
51st rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog) 3 times. 12 sts.
Sl st in next st. Fasten off. Finish stuffing Rocketship, leaving room for inserting a flame into the end.

BOOSTER ROCKETS (make 3)
With A, make an adjustable ring as given for Rocketship.
1st rnd:  6 sc in ring. Do not join. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). 6 sc. PM in last sc worked to indicate end of rnd. Move marker up as each rnd is completed.
2nd rnd: (1 sc in next st. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join C. 9 sc.
3rd rnd:  With C, 1 sc in each sc around.
4th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join B. 12 sc.
5th to 7th rnds:  With B, 1 sc in each sc around.
Begin stuffing lightly and cont stuffing as work progresses. 
8th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 10 sts.
9th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
10th rnd:  (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 8 sts. Fasten off. 
Finish stuffing rocket, leaving room for inserting a flame into the end.

BOOSTER ROCKET FRAMES (make 3)
With C, ch 2, leaving a long end for sewing.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc. 6 sc.
2nd to 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Insert piece of plastic drinking straw into frame and trim even with edge of piece. Sew one frame to each Booster Rocket. Sew Frame right below edge of last C-colored rnd of Rocket. Sew around frame to secure. 

PLASTIC DOME (PORTHOLE) EDGING 
With B, ch 39 (or number of chains needed to fit snuggly around circumference of dome). Join with sl st in first ch to form a circle.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st in first sc. 39 sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
3rd rnd:  Working along opposite side of foundation ch, join A with sc in any ch. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
Attach Edging to Dome: Carefully break off the hanging tab on the edge of half dome. To keep table clean and prevent dome from sticking to table, work on piece of waxed paper. Sew short ends of edging tog to form a circle. Run a bead of strong craft glue around edge of dome. Place glued dome flat on waxed paper. Slip edging down over dome with B-colored side up, pushing it down until A-colored edge is lying flat on the surface. 
Note: A-colored edge will be sewn to Spaceship. Set aside to dry.

POMPOM ALIEN
Cut toothpick in half (save second half for nosecone embellishment). Glue medium-sized pompom to flat (cut) tip of toothpick and allow glue to dry. Glue 2 beads to upper front of pompom head to form eyes. Glue two small pompoms to upper sides of pompom head (as if wearing headphones) and allow glue to dry for several hours.

POMPOM NOSECONE
