instructions:
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * 5 times—24 sc.
Rounds 5–8: Sc in each st around. Insert post of safety eye in any st between Rounds 5 and 6 and attach washer to secure. Repeat for 2nd safety eye, leaving 1 or 2 stitches between posts so that washers, when locked in place, touch each other but do not overlap. 
Rounds 9–14: Sc in each st around. Stuff body firmly and continue to stuff as you work.
Round 15: *Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * 5 times—18 sc. Place marker on this round for placement of feet.
Round 16: *Sc2tog, sc in next st; repeat from * 5 times—12 sc.
Round 17: *Sc2tog; repeat from * 5 times—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving an 8” (20.5 cm) tail for sewing. Weave ending tail through stitches and pull gently until closed. Fasten off and weave in ends.
Foot (make 2)
With C, ch 4.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in next 2 ch (first toe made), *ch 4, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in next 2 ch (next toe made); working in opposite side of foundation ch, slip st in first ch of first toe (to form heel); repeat from * once. Fasten off.
Beak
With C, ch 2.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—1 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 3 sc in sc. Fasten off, leaving an 8” (20.5 cm) tail for sewing.
Wing (make 2)
Beginning at wing tip, with B, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in remaining st, turn—3 sc.
Rows 3–11: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in remaining sts, turn—12 sc.
Fold wing in half lengthwise into a triangle, matching row ends, and continue working through both thicknesses to close wing. 
Row 12: Working across ends of rows, 3 hdc in first row, slip st in next row, *3 hdc in next row, slip st in next row; repeat from * across to wing tip. Fasten off, leaving a 15” (38 cm) tail for sewing.
FINISHING
Optional: Make crocheted or felt circles for eyes instead of plastic animal eyes and sew firmly into center of eye circles with a small bit of stuffing inserted to give dimension.
Where eye circles meet at center of head, sew together with tail from one circle.
Sew wider end of beak between eyes. 
Flatten bottom of owl so it sits. Sew heel of each foot to marked round of body, aligning directly under each eye.
Thread tail of each wing to last row at wider end. Using photograph as a guide, sew wings to sides of body. Secure tightly. 
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 Skein 256 Carrot A, small amount 312 Black B.
Split-lock stitch marker; yarn needle, stuffing, 2 small round black buttons (9mm).
abbreviations: dec (decrease) = draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Lobster measures 5½” tall; Mermaid measures 6¼” tall.
gauge: 16 sc = 4”; 20 rnds = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
LITTLE LOBSTER INSTRUCTIONS
HEAD AND BODY: Begin at top of head with A, ch 2.
Rnd 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc. 
Rnd 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6times – 30 sc. 
Rnds 6-12: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 13: [Dec] 15 times – 15 sc.
Neck-Rnd 14: [Sc in next 3 sc, dec] 3 times – 12 sc. 
Body-Rnd 15: [Inc] 12 times – 24 sc.
Rnds 16-19: Sc in each sc around. Stuff head.
Rnds 20-24: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 25: [Dec] 12 times – 12 sc.
Rnd 26: [Dec] 6 times – 6 sc. Fasten off.
Finish stuffing. Weave yarn tail through remaining 6 sc, draw up firmly to gather; fasten securely.
CLAW (Make 4): With A, ch 2.
Row 1: 5 Sc in 2nd ch from hook; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, [inc] 5 times – 10 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, [inc] 10 times – 20 sc. Fasten off.
Fold piece in half. Sew through both thicknesses of Row 3 together through back loops. Stuff lightly, sew opening closed. Sew 2 claws together at bottom for each arm.
ARM (Make 2): With A, ch 2.
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] twice – 8 sc.
Rnds 3 and 4: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.
Stuff lightly. Sew Rnd 4 in place on body. Sew a pair of claws to top of Rnd 1.
LEGS (Make 8): With A, ch 6; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. Fasten off.
Sew 4 on each side under arms.
FEELERS (Make 2): With A, ch 13; slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. Fasten off.
Sew to top of head.
TAIL: With A, ch 18; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around – 18 sc.
Rnds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 4: [Sc in next 4 sc, dec] 3 times – 15 sc.
Rnd 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, dec] 3 times – 12 sc.
Rnd 6: [Sc in next 2 sc, dec] 3 times – 9 sc.
Rnd 7: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 8: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] 3 times – 12 sc.
Rnd 9: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] 4 times – 16 sc.
Rnds 10 and 11: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 12: [Sc in next 7 sc, inc] twice – 18 sc.
Rnd 13: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] 6 times – 24 sc. Fasten off.
Flatten Rnd 13 and sew together through both thicknesses. Sew through both thicknesses at Rnd 7 so stuffing won’t go beyond this point. Stuff Rnds 1-6. Sew tail in place.
Sew eyes in place. With B, embroider smile.

BABY MERMAID INSTRUCTIONS
HEAD AND BODY: Begin at top of head with A, ch 2.
Rnd 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc. 
Rnd 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6times – 30 sc. 
Rnds 6-12: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 13: [Dec] 15 times – 15 sc.
Neck-Rnd 14: [Sc in next 3 sc, dec] 3 times – 12 sc. 
Body-Rnd 15: [Inc] 12 times – 24 sc.
Rnds 16-19: Sc in each sc around. Cut A. Stuff head.
Rnds 20-24: With B, sc in each sc around.
Rnd 25: [Dec] 12 times – 12 sc.
Rnd 26: [Dec] 6 times – 6 sc. Fasten off.
Finish stuffing. Weave yarn tail through remaining 6 sc, draw up firmly to gather; fasten securely.
TAIL: With B, ch 18; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around – 18 sc.
Rnds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 4: [Dec] 9 times – 9 sc.
Rnd 5: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 6: [Inc] 9 times – 18 sc.
Fin-Rnd 7: [Slip st in first sc, sc in next sc, hdc in next sc, 2 hdc in each of next 3 sc, hdc in next sc, sc in next sc, slip st in next sc] twice. Fasten off. 
Sew fin seam. Stuff tail and sew in place on left side of body.
ARM (Make 2): With A, ch 2.
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] twice – 8 sc.
Rnds 3-6: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off. 
Stuff lightly. Sew opening flat and sew in place.
FLOWER (Make 2): With D, ch 2.
Rnd 1: [Sc, ch 1] 6 times all in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st to first sc. Fasten off.
Sew in place.
EARS: With A, ch 2.
Row 1: 3 Sc in 2nd ch from hook; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in last sc. Fasten off.
Sew ears in place.
HAIR: With C, [ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 3 ch] 5 times. Fasten off.
Gather slip st section together and sew to top of head. Tie bow around hair with ribbon.
Sew green buttons in place for eyes. With red pearl cotton embroider smile. Color cheeks lightly with crayon.

materials: Lily® Sugar'n Cream® (2.5 oz /70.9 oz; 120 yds/109 m)
Main Color (MC) Soft Violet (00093), Wine (00015), Mod Green (01223), Hot Pink (01740), Hot orange (01628) 1 ball or 65 m/72 yds
Contrast A White (00001) 1 ball or 30 m/35 yds
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dtr = (Yoh) 4 times. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 5 times - Double treble crochet made.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4” [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Shell is worked in a spiral. Do not join new color at end of each rnd, rather, leave loop of color just worked ‘live’ & pick it up again when instructed.
Front 
With MC, ch 5. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. (3 sc. 3 hdc. 3 dc) in ring. Drop MC. Join A with sl st in ring. 2 sc in ring. 11 sts (9 sts MC, 2 sts A).
2nd rnd: With A, working in front loops only, sl st in each of next 9 sts made with MC. Drop A. Pick up MC. Working in back loops only, 2 dc in each of first 2 sc made with A. 2 dc in each of next 9 sts made with MC. Drop MC.
3rd rnd: Pick up A. Working in front loops only, sl st in each of next 22 sts made with MC. Drop A. Pick up MC. Working in back loops only, 2 tr in each of next 22 sts made with MC. Drop MC.
4th rnd: Pick up A. Working in front loops only, sl st in each of next 44 sts made with MC. Drop A. Pick up MC. Working in back loops only, 2 dtr in each of next 10 sts made with MC. Fasten off MC.
5th rnd: Pick up A. Working in front loops only, sl st in each of next 22 sts made with MC. Fasten off A.
Back
With MC, ch 5. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. (3 sc. 3 hdc. 3 dc) in ring. Drop MC. Join A with sl st in ring. 2 sc in ring. 11 sts (9 sts MC, 2 sts A).
2nd rnd: With A, working in back loops only and inserting hook from back to front, sl st in each of next 9 sts made with MC. Drop A. Pick up MC. Working in front loops only, 2 dc in each of first 2 sc made with A. 2 dc in each of next 9 sts made with MC. Drop MC.
3rd rnd: Pick up A. Working in front loops only, sl st in each of next 22 sts made with MC. Drop A. Pick up MC. Working in back loops only, 2 tr in each of next 22 sts made with MC. Drop MC.
4th rnd: Pick up A. Working in front loops only, sl st in each of next 44 sts made with MC. Drop A. Pick up MC. Working in back loops only, 2 dtr in each of next 10 sts made with MC. Fasten off MC, leaving a long end.
5th rnd: Pick up A. Working in front loops only, sl st in each of next 22 sts made with MC. Fasten off A.
With rem length of MC sew Front and back tog leaving an opening to insert stuffing. Stuff lightly. Sew opening closed.

materials: lily® sugar ‘n cream® (70.9 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds) (00002 Black)
note: 2 balls will make 1 large and 5 small spiders
Size 3.75 mm (U.S. F or 5) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: small: Approx 5” [12.5 cm] long; large: Approx 8½” [21.5 cm] long.
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rows = 4” [10 cm].
instructions:
small spider
Body: **With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.**
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
6th to 10th rnds: As 4th rnd.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - sc2tog made. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
12th rnd: As 4th rnd.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sts.
Stuff Body.
neck: 14th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sts.
Head: 15th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
16th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
17th to 19th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
Stuff Head.
21st rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc. Fasten off.
legs (make 2 sets).
With A, ch 24. *Turn chain up-side down. Sl st in 2nd bump from hook and each bump, created by chain to end of chain.* Ch 28. Rep from * to * once more. Ch 30. Rep from * to * once. Ch 26. Rep from * to * once.
FinisHing
Insert wire into Legs. Sew 2 sets of Legs to bottom of Spider. Shape Legs. Sew 1 bead to top of back for decoration. Glue googly eyes in position.

large spider
Body: Work from ** to ** as given for Small Spider.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
7th rnd: As 5th rnd.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sc.
10th to 14th rnds: As 5th rnd.
15th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sts.
16th and 17th rnds: As 5th rnd.
18th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sts.
19th and 20th rnds: As 5th rnd.
21st rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
22nd and 23rd rnds: As 5th rnd.
24th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
25th and 26th rnds: As 5th rnd.
27th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sts.
28th and 29th rnds: As 5th rnd.
Stuff Body.
Head: 30th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
31st rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
32nd to 35th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
36th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sts.
Stuff Head.
37th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 10 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sts.
38th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 5 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 5 sts. Fasten off.
legs (make 2 sets).
With A, ch 30. *Turn chain up-side down. Sl st in 2nd bump from hook and each bump, created by chain to end of chain.* Ch 32. Rep from * to * once more. Ch 34. Rep from * to * once more. Ch 32. Rep from * to * once more.
FinisHing
Insert wire into Legs. Sew 2 sets of Legs to bottom of Spider. Shape legs. Sew beads to top of back for decoration. Glue googly eyes in position.

materials: Simply Soft Party (85 g/3 oz; 150 m/164 yds)
One size US G-8 (5.5mm) crochet hook (for Wand, ties and last row of top of Tiara); and US H-8 (5mm) (for body of Tiara), or sizes to obtain gauge.
For Tiara: Safety pins or small stitch holder, 3 iridescent beads (ensure hole in beads is large enough for yarn needle to pass through), yarn needle.

For Wand: One dowel—12"/30.5cm long, low-temperature hot glue gun, glue sticks, iridescent beads (any number, size and color of beads may be used. One 1/2"/1cm diameter bead is recommended for bottom of wand stem; ensure hole in beads is large enough for yarn needle to pass through), yarn needle.
abbreviations: Picot = Ch 3, sl st in top of sc just made.
measurements: Finished measurements: Tiara measures approximately 6"/15cm wide by 1/2"/9cm tall (at center). Star on wand measures approximately 4"/10cm across (from tip to tip).
gauge: N/A
instructions:
TIES
With smaller hook and 1 strand of yarn coming from outside of ball, make an adjustable ring. Tie #1: [Ch 7, sc in ring] 5 times (flower made), ch 125. Place final lp on a safety pin. Do not fasten off. Tie #2: With 1 strand of yarn coming from inside of ball, work same as Tie #1, do not place final lp on holder. Join ends of ties: Place final lp of Tie #1 and Tie #2 together on larger hook. 
TIARA
With larger hook, holding 2 strands of yarn together (the 2 strands coming from the 2 ties). Headband: Ch 8, dc in 8th ch from hook (first box made), [turn, ch 5, sk next 2 ch of previous box, dc in next ch] 7 times—8 boxes. Top of Tiara (RS): Do not turn, working across long side of headband, ch 1, sk first box, 7 dc in next box, sc in next box, 3 dc in next box, 3 tr in next dc, 3 dc in next box, sc in next box, 7 dc in next box, sc in last box, turn. Remove one lp from hook, place lp on a safety pin. Keep the other lp on hook. Next Row (WS): With larger hook and 1 strand of yarn, working in front loops only (to create ridge on RS), ch 1, sl st in first sc, *sc in next dc, hdc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc, tr in next dc, ch 5, sl st in last tr made (picot made), 2 dc in next dc, hdc in next dc, sc in next dc*; ch 1, sl st in next sc, ch 1; sc in next dc, hdc in next dc, dc in next 2 sts, (2 tr, picot, 2 tr) in next tr, dc in next 2 sts, hdc in next dc, sc in next dc, ch 1, sl st in next sc; rep from * to * once more; sl st in next ch-1 sp; working across short, side edge of headband, sl st in next 3 ch. Do not fasten off. 
TIES AND LOWER EDGING
Tie #3: Change to smaller hook, ch 129, sl st in 4th ch from hook to create a ring at end of ch, [ch 7, sc in ring] 5 times. Fasten off. Lower Edging: With RS of tiara facing, place lp on safety pin back onto larger hook. Working across short side edge of headband, sl st in next 3 ch, move Ties #1 and #2 out of the way; ch 1, [work 3 sc in next box, picot] 7 times, 3 sc in next box. Do not fasten off. Tie #4: Work same as Tie #3. 
FINISHING
Beads (optional) should not be used on tiaras for young children. Cut a 10"/25.5cm length of yarn and split the length into 2 strands, each strand should be thin enough to sew the beads to the tiara. Sew one bead to RS of each point of tiara (optional).

WAND
Stitches Used: Chain (ch), half double crochet (hdc), single crochet (sc), slip stitch (sl st)
Special Technique: Adjustable-ring method
Wrap yarn into a ring, ensuring that tail falls behind working yarn. Between finger and thumb, grip ring and tail firmly. Insert hook through center of ring, yo (with working yarn) and draw up a lp. Yo and draw through lp on hook (first ch made). Work sts of first rnd into ring. After first rnd of sts is worked, pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring. 
Notes: Beads are optional and should not be used on wands for young children. Star is crocheted with size G-6 (4mm) hook to create a dense fabric. To make sturdy star, take care to work with a tight tension. 
STEM
Thread yarn into yarn needle. Take needle through a 1/2"/1cm diameter bead. Draw yarn end through about 2"/5cm and glue end along side of one end of dowel. Glue bead to end of dowel. Wrap yarn around dowel, placing each wrap against previous wrap and glue in place as you wrap, until dowel is completely covered. Cut the end of the yarn and glue end to top of dowel. 
STAR (make 2)
Center Circle
Leaving a long beginning tail (for sewing beads to star), make an adjustable ring. 
Rnd 1: Work 10 sc in ring; do not join and do not turn—10 sc.
Rnd 2: Working in back loops only, 2 sc in each sc around—20 sc.
First Point—Row 1: Ch 1, working in back loops only, hdc in next 4 sc, turn. Row 2: Ch 2, sk first hdc, hdc in next 3 hdc, turn. Row 3: Ch 2, sk first hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc, turn. Row 4: Ch 2, sk first hdc, hdc in next hdc, turn. Row 5: Ch 1, sl st in first hdc, sl st evenly down side of point to top of Row 1. 
Second Point—Row 1: Working in back loops only, hdc in next 4 sc of center circle. Rows 2–5: Rep Rows 2–5 of first point.
Third and Fourth Points—Work same as Second Point.
Fifth Point—Row 1: Working in back loops only, hdc in next 4 sc of center circle; sl st in top of beginning ch of Row 1 of first point, turn. Rows 2–4: Rep Rows 2–4 of first point. Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sl st in first hdc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing two stars together around outer edges. 
FINISHING
Embellish Stars: Arrange beads on RS of star, as desired, and sew in place. Assemble Wand: Place top of dowel (end without bead) on WS of one star and glue to secure. Place second star on top of first star, matching the edges, and glue to dowel. Thread yarn tail into yarn needle and whipstitch the edges of the stars together. Weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Size U.S. H/5 [8 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of worsted weight yarn in charcoal for Nose and Mouth.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 9" [23 cm] tall x 5" [12.5 cm] wide, including Legs.
gauge: 13 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:  
• All rnds are joined with sl st to first sc. 
• Where instructions indicate to leave a long tail when fastening off, this tail is to be used in seaming. 

Snout
With A, beg using magic loop method demonstrated here. ( See diagram on page 3)
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join. 
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. 
With charcoal yarn, stitch on Mouth as shown in photo. Loop yarn between 2 sts approx 10 times to make Nose. 

Body/Head
Note: Body and Head are worked in one piece from the bottom up. 
With B, beg using magic loop method. ( See diagram on page 3)
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
4th to 10th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
11th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
12th rnd: As 4th rnd.
13th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
14th rnd: As 4th rnd. 
15th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 12 sts.
16th rnd: As 4th rnd. 
17th rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 24 sc.
18th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
19th to 26th rnds: As 4th rnd.
27th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
28th rnd: As 4th rnd.
29th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
Before proceeding to complete Head, stitch Snout to Face between 20th and 24th rnds. Add safety eyes between 24th and 25th rnds, approx 6 sts apart and centered over Snout. Beg stuffing with polyfill. Cont stuffing with polyfill while working rest of Head.
30th rnd: As 4th rnd.
31st rnd: As 13th rnd. 18 sts.
32nd rnd: As 15th rnd. 12 sts.
33rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. 

Ears  (make 2) ( See diagram on page 3)
With B, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc. 
3rd and 4th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 8 sts.
Do not stuff. Stitch Ears to Head as shown in photo, approx 4 rnds down from top. 

Feet (make 2) ( See diagram on page 3)
With B, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sts.
6th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 8 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Stuff Feet with polyfill.  Attach Feet to each side at bottom of Body. 
Note that Feet should stick out sideways to give Bear support to sit up.

Arms (make 2) ( See diagram on page 3)
With B, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 15 sc.
3rd to 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
8th to 9th rnds: As 3rd rnd.

Tail ( See diagram shown right)
With B, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 15 sc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 10 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 5 sc.

Stuff with polyfill and stitch to center back of Body.

materials: lily® sugar’n cream® (70.9 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds)
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rows = 4” [10 cm] with smaller hook. 15 sc and 16 rows = 4” [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Doll
First leg
note: Stuff Legs as you work.

sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of 
next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st 
to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 
4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join 
with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (Draw up a 
loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog 
made) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 21 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each of 
next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 17 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each of 
next 6 sc. Join B with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
stocking: 8th rnd: With B, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each 
st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with 
sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until Stocking from top of shoe measures 2½” [6 cm]. Fasten 
off. Stuff Shoe.
Breeches cuff: With A, ch 14 loosely. Join with sl st to first ch. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. Do not 
break A.
attach Breeches cuff to stocking: 1st rnd: Align Breeches Cuff over 
Stocking, having Cuff on outside of Stocking. With A, ch 1. Working 
through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first 
sc. 14 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until Leg from top of Shoe measures 6” [15 cm]. Fasten off. 
Stuff Leg.
second leg 
Work as given for First Leg. Do not fasten off.
Cont as follows for Body:
Body
Breeches: 1st rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc of Second Leg. 
1 sc in 14 sc of First Leg. 1 sc in each of last 7 sc of Second Leg. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 28 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 4 times more, joining mc at end of last rnd.
Body: next rnd: With mc, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in first 
sc. (1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last  
6 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
next 5 rnds: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join 
with sl st to first sc.
next rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join with sl st 
to first sc. 28 sts.
next 3 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
next rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join with sl st 
to first sc. 24 sts.
next 3 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
next rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join with sl st 
to first sc. 20 sc. Fasten off.
head 
With smaller hook and mc, ch 2.
**1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * 
around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * 
around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.**
6th to 16th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
17th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sts. 
18th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
Stuff Head.
19th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
20th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 
8 sts. Fasten off.
arms (make 2).
With smaller hook and mc, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 tr in next sc (thumb). 1 sc in 
each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 8 sts.
7th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures 4½” [11.5 cm]. Fasten off.
Stuff Arms lightly.
Finishing 
Attach Arms to sides of Body. Sew Head to Body. Sew beads to front of 
Head for eyes. With red embroidery floss, embroider mouth.
hair 
With smaller hook and C, ch 2.
Work from ** to ** as given for Head.
next 4 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 26 sc. turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
next 2 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 26 sc. Turn.
next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
Rep last row 4 times more. 16 sts at end of last row. Fasten off.
Sew Hair to Head.
clothing
top 
Front and Back (make 2 alike).
With larger hook and A, ch 18.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 
17 sc.
2nd to 5th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 
Turn. 16 sts.
7th and 8th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
9th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 14 sts.
10th and 11th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
12th row: As 9th row. 12 sts.
13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
14th row: As 9th row. 10 sts.
15th row: Sl st in each of next 2 sts. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc 
in each of next 7 sc. turn. Leave rem sc unworked. 8 sts.
16th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 6 sts.
17th and 18th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
shape neck: 19th row: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 2 hdc in first sc. 1 sc in next 
sc. Sl st in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 3 hdc in last sc. Fasten off.
sleeve (make 2).
With larger hook and A, ch 12.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 
11 sc.
2nd to 8th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
9th row: Sl st in first 2 sc. Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. 
turn. Leave rem st unworked. 7 sts.
10th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 5 sts.
11th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
12th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.
13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Leave rem st unworked. Fasten 
off.
collar (make 2 alike).
Beg at neckline with larger hook and B, ch 8.
1st row: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. (1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in next 
ch) twice. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 2 hdc in first sc. 1 hdc in each of next 
2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 3 hdc in last sc. 
Turn. 14 sts.
3rd row: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in first hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc 
in each of next 2 hdc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sl st in each of next 2 sts. 
1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in each of 
next 2 hdc. Fasten off.
Finishing
Sew Top side seams. Put Top on doll. Sew shoulder seams. Put Sleeves 
on Arms and mark placement on Top. Sew Sleeves to Top. Sew Collar at 
neckline as shown in picture.
hat
With smaller hook and A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join 
with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 
11 sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 26 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of 
next 12 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join with sl st to first 
sc. 28 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc) twice. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of 
next 14 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Join with sl st to first 
sc. 32 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc) twice. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 34 sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of 
next 16 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 36 sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 17 sc) twice. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 38 sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of 
next 18 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 40 sc.
14th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 19 sc) twice. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 42 sc.
15th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each 
of next 20 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 44 sc.
16th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 21 sc) twice. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 46 sc.
17th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each 
of next 22 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 48 sc.
18th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc 
in next sc) 8 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sc.
19th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (2 sc in 
next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc) 7 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of 
next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 8 times. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 72 sc.
21st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of 
next 8 sc) 7 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st 
to first sc. 80 sc. Fasten off.
Belt
With larger hook and A, ch 24. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring, 
taking care not to twist chain.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc. 
Fasten off.
large buckle (make 2).
With smaller hook and d, ch 4. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. (3 sc. Ch 1) 4 times into ring. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Fasten off.
small buckle (make 2).
With smaller hook and d, ch 2. 
1st rnd: (1 sc. Ch 1) 4 times in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first 
sc. Fasten off.
Finishing
Sew 1 Large Buckle to center of both Belt and Hat as shown in picture. 
Sew 1 Small Buckle to top of each Shoe as shown in picture.

materials: Bernat® Baby Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Contrast A Adobe (04923) 1 ball or 130 yds/119 m
Contrast B Driftwood Dreams (04924) 1 ball or 155 yds/142 yds
Size U.S. K/10½ [6.5 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
2 yards [1.8 m] of black worsted weight yarn for embroidery
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Approx 8" [20.5 cm] wide x 10" [25.5 cm] tall.
gauge: 8 sc and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Mushroom Cap
Notes: 
• Mushroom Cap is worked as a spiral to ruffled section. Place marker on first st of rnd and move marker each rnd to keep place. 
• Ch 1(2) at beg of rnd does not count as st.
With A, beg using magic loop method demonstrated here. See diagram on page 3.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. 
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc. 
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc. 
4th rnd: Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Note: Unworked back loops from this rnd will be used to attach Body to Cap. 
5th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 32 sc. 
6th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 

Mushroom Body
Note: All rnds of Body are joined with sl st to first st. 
With B, ch 24. Join in rnd with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist chain. See diagram on page 3.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 24 sc.
2nd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 hdc in each st around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 30 hdc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 36 hdc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *2 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 42 hdc.
10th to 13th rnds: As 6th rnd.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 36 hdc.
15th rnd: Ch 1. *Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 30 hdc.
16th rnd: Ch 2. Working in front loops only, 3 dc in each hdc around. Join. 90 dc. Fasten off.
Fold Body in half with seam at back of work. Sew base of Body closed, using unworked back loops from 16th rnd. 

Mushroom Cap Spots (make 2.)
With B, beg using magic loop method. See diagram on page 3.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 5 sc in ring. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail to sew to Cap.
Sew Spots to Cap as shown in photo. 

Cheeks (make 2)
With A, beg using magic loop method. See diagram on page 3.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 hdc in ring. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail to sew to Body.
Sew Cheeks to Body as shown in photo.

Embroider eyes as shown in photo using satin stitch and black  worsted weight yarn.
SATIN STITCH
Using backstitch and black worsted weight yarn, embroider Mouth as shown in photo.

materials: Lily Sugar’n Cream(70.9 g/ 2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds) (01130 Warm Brown) 1 ball
Size 3.5 mm (U.S. E or 4) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of black embroidery floss for nose.
Small piece of white felt for teeth.
gauge: 16 sc and 20 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
BODY
**With A, ch 2. 
1st rnd:8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd:Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd:Ch 1.  Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
6th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 6 times more.
Note: Stuff Body, then cont stuffing Head as you work shaping.
Head shaping: 1st rnd:Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
2nd to 4th rnds:Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
5th rnd:Ch 1. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
6th to 8th rnds:As 2nd to 4th rnds.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc.
Fasten off leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts.
EARS (make 2)
Ch 2. 
1st rnd:6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
LEGS (make 4)
With A, ch 2.
**1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd to 4th rnds:Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off at end of last rnd.
TAIL
Work as given for Legs.
FINISHING
Attach Ears to top of Head.  Stuff Legs and Tail lightly and attach to Body. Sew beads to front of Head for Eyes. With black embroidery floss, embroider nose and mouth. Glue on white felt for teeth.

materials: Lily® Sugar'n Cream® (2.5 oz /70.9 oz; 120 yds/109 m)
Contrast A Country Yellow (01612) 1 ball or 220 yds/205 m
Contrast B Country Green (01222) 2 balls or 130 yds/120 m
Contrast C Black (00002) 1 ball or 18 yds/15 m
Contrast D White (00001) 1 ball or 18 yds/15 m
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Dc2(3)tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Scbp = Insert hook from back to front to back around post of sc. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4” [10 cm].
instructions:
TOP SHELL
Hexagons (make 7)
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 5 times. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (Ch 2. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 5 times. Ch 2. Join with sl st to first sc. Break A.
5th rnd: Join B with sl st to any ch-2 sp. Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp. (1 sc in each sc to next ch-2 sp. 3 sc in next ch-2 sp) 5 times. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Join Hexagons as shown in Diagram as follows:
Place RS of Hexagons tog. Working into back loops only through both thicknesses, join B with sl st through corresponding corner sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc to next corner. Rep from * as needed to join Hexagons.
Edging: (RS). Working into back loops only, join B with sl st in marked sc as shown on diagram. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. *1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in next sc. Dc3tog over next sc, joining sp and next sc of next Hexagon. 1 dc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc.** 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * 4 times more, then rep from * to ** once. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

BELLY
With A, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working in opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
Note: Work all following rows into back loops only.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 3 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc.* 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to * once more. Join with sl st to first sc. 26 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc.* 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * to * once more. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 34 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc.* 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * to * once more. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc.* 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. Rep from * to * once more. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 50 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. *(3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) twice. 3 sc in next sc.* 1 sc in each of next 20 sc. Rep from * to * once more. 1 sc in each of last 8 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 62 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 68 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Rep from * to last 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 74 sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 11 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 80 sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * to last 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 7 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 86 sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 13 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 92 sc.
14th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. Rep from * to last 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 8 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 98 sc. Fasten off.

HEAD
**With B, ch 18. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first ch. *Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to last ch. Ch 1. Skip last ch. Join A with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
2nd rnd: With A, sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last sc. Ch 1. Skip last sc. Join B with sl st to first sc.**
3rd rnd: With B, sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * once more. (Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. Skip last sc. Join A with sl st to first sc. 22 sts. Break B.
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending with 1 sc in last ch-1 sp. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc) twice. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
7th and 8th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. (2 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in each of last 11 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 26 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 11 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sc. Fasten off.
Top of Head: 1st row: (RS). Skip first 5 sc. Join A with sl st to next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in each of next 8 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Turn. Place marker on next unworked st and leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sl st in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Hdc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 8 sts. Hdc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sl st in next st. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Skip first sl st. Sl st in next sc. 1 sc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. Dc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 4 sts. Dc2tog. 1 hdc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Sl st in next st. Fasten off.
Lower Mouth: 1st row: (RS). Join A with sl st to marked sc. 1 sc in next sc (beside marked sc). 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sl st in last sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. Skip first sl st. Sl st in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Sl st in next sc. Fasten off.
Inner Mouth: 1st rnd: (RS). Working in back loops only, join C with sl st in corner of Lower Mouth. Ch 1. Work 10 sc across Lower Mouth, then work 14 sc across Top of Head. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog over same sc as last sl st and next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 hdc in next sc. Hdc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 4 sc. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in next sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off leaving a long end. Push end to inside of Head.
Turn Head inside out. Using end, join sides on Inner Mouth with 1 row of sl st. Fasten off. Turn Head right-side out. Stuff Head.
Eyes (make 2)
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
With C, embroider pupil with straight st. 
Tail
Work from ** to ** as given for Head.
3rd rnd: With B, as 2nd rnd.
4th to 7th rnds: As 2nd and 3rd rnds twice more.
8th rnd: With A, sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. Sc2tog over next 2 ch-1 sps. (Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Rep from * once more. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip last sc. Join B with sl st to first sc. 14 sts. Break A.
9th rnd: With B, as 2nd rnd. 
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending with 1 sc in last ch-1 sp. Join with sl st to first sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sts.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sts.
14th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sts.
15th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 4 sts. Fasten off leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts. Stuff Tail.
Flipper Legs (make 4)
Work from ** to ** as given for Head.
3rd rnd: With B, as 2nd rnd. Break B.
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending with 1 sc in last ch-1 sp. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th and 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
8th to 13th rnds: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts. Fasten off at end of 13th rnd leaving a long end.
Turn Leg inside out. Using end, fold Leg flat and join sides on with 1 row of sl st. Fasten off. Turn Leg right-side out. Stuff Leg.
FINISHING
Sew Eyes in position. Sew Belly to Top Shell with an overlap of approx ½" [1 cm] around Shell edge and leaving an opening to insert stuffing. Stuff and sew opening closed. Sew Flipper Legs, Head and Tail in position.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Contrast A Gold (0321) 1 ball or 129 yds/118 m
Contrast B Light Periwinkle (0347) 1 ball or 83 yds/76 m
Contrast C Aran (0313) 1 ball or 37 yds/34 m
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Two 1/2" [1.5 cm] safety eyes and safety nose
abbreviations: Hdcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Hdcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 (3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
gauge: 12 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc.

HEAD
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.

5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sc.
10th to 20th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
21st rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 19 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * once more. Join. 40 sc.
Fasten off, leaving long end for sewing.
Stuff Head firmly.

EARS (make 2 alike)
Inner Ear: With C, ch 4.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of last 2 ch. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc.
3rd to 5th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sc.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog.
Fasten off.
Outer Ear: With B, ch 4.
Rep from 1st row to 8th row as given for Inner Ear.
Hold Inner Ear and Outer Ear tog with WS facing each other. Join A with sl st to bottom right corner of Ear. Working through both thicknesses, work sc evenly around Ear, leaving bottom edge unworked.
Sew Ears to Head as shown in photo.

ANTLERS (make 2 alike)
With C, ch 6. Join with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 6 sc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Ch 3. Skip each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc or ch around. Join. 6 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through remaining stitches.
Join C with sl st to first skipped stitch of 3rd rnd. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Ch 3. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc or ch around. Join. 6 sc.
Next 3 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through remaining stitches.
Stuff Antlers firmly and sew to Head as shown in photo.

FOREHEAD SECTION
With A, ch 8.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from the hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 6 hdc.
2nd to 4th rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn. 4 hdc.
6th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
7th row: Ch 2. (Hdc2tog) twice. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
With C, embroider spots on Forehead Section.
Sew Forehead Section to Head as shown in photo.
Attach safety nose.
Attach safety eyes.
With A, make a stitch to cinch eyes closer together as shown in photo.

BODY
With B, ch 40. Join with sl st to first ch, making sure not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each ch around. Join. 40 hdc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. *1 hdcfp around next hdc. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. Rep from * around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each st around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 19 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * once more. Join. 42 sc.
6th to 9th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 dc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sc.
14th to 20th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
21st rnd: Ch 2. Working in front loops only, 1 hdc in each sc around. Join.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 hdcfp around next hdc. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. Fasten off.
With A, join with sl st to first st of 20th rnd.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 60 sc.
Next 3 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through remaining stitches.
Stuff Body firmly.
With yarn end from Head, sew Head to Body through back loops only of 3rd rnd.

TAIL
Inner Tail: With C, ch 4.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of last 2 ch. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc.
3rd to 5th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sc.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Fasten off.
Outer Tail: With B, ch 4.
Rep from 1st row to 8th row as given for Inner Tail.
Hold Inner Tail and Outer Tail tog. Join A with sl st to bottom right corner of Tail. Working through both thicknesses, work sc evenly around Tail, leaving bottom edge unworked.
Sew Tail to back side of Body as shown in photo.

ARMS (make 2 alike)
With B, ch 12. Join with sl st to first ch, making sure not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 12 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep 2nd rnd until work from beg measures 31/2" [9 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 2. Working in front loops only, 1 hdc in each sc around. Join.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 hdcfp around next hdc. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. Fasten off.
Join A with sl st to 1st st of 3rd last rnd.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Next 2 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join last rnd with C. Break A.
Next 3 rnds: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through remaining stitches.
Stuff Arms firmly.
Sew Arms to Body as shown in photo.

materials: Bernat® Baby Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Contrast A  Lemon Lime (04223) 1 ball or 169 yds/154 m
Contrast B  Mountain Mist (04826) 1 ball or 114 yds/104 m
Contrast C  White (04005) 1 ball or 29 yds/27 m

Piece of cardboard cut into 10" [25.5 cm] diameter circle.
