gauge: 9 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Do not join at end of rnds. Work rnds in continuous spiral, placing marker at first st and moving marker each subsequent rnd.
Back Piece
**With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 32 sc.
5th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.**
7th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 56 sc.
8th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 64 sc.
9th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 72 sc.
10th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 80 sc. Do not fasten off. Turn.
From this point on, work back and forth in rows:
See diagram on page 3.
Back Piece Frill: 1st row:  (WS). Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. [(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc] 5 times. 2 sc in next sc. 62 sc and 11 ch-1 sps. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
***2nd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. Rep from * 10 more times. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. *1 sc in each st to next ch-1 sp. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each st to next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. Rep from * 4 more times. 1 sc in each st to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn.
4th and 5th rows: As 2nd and 3rd rows.
6th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first sc (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. *(2 dc. Ch 1. 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 dc in last dc.
Fasten off.***
Head
With A, work from ** to ** as given for Back Piece. 
Cont with A, proceed as follows:
7th to 10th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. 48 sc.
11th rnd: 1 sc in each of first 24 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around.  56 sc.
12th rnd: 1 sc in each of first 24 sc. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 64 sc. 
13th rnd: 1 sc in each of first 24 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 72 sc. 
14th rnd: 1 sc in each of first 24 sc. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 80 sc.
15th to 18th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
19th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Sl st in each of first 2 sc of prev rnd.
Do not fasten off. Turn.
From this point on, work back and forth in rows:
Head Frill: 1st row:  (WS). Ch 1. Working in back loops only, work as 1st row of Back Piece Frill.
With A, work from *** to *** as given for Back Piece Frill.
Large Horns  (make 2).
With C, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 
9 sc. 
4th and 5th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
6th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 12 sc. 
7th and 8th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
9th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 15 sc. 
10th and 11th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
12th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Sl st in each of first 2 sc of prev rnd.
Fasten off.
Small Horn  (make 1).
With C, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 
9 sc. 
4th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 12 sc. 
4th to 6th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
7th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Sl st in each of next 2 sc. 
Fasten off. 
Eyes  (make 2).
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: (2 sc. 1 hdc. 2 dc. 1 hdc) in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Assembly  (See Diagram)
Place Head and Back piece tog with WS facing each other and Frills aligned. Join B with sl st in same sp as marked st of Head Frill. 
Join Back Piece and Head Frills: With Head facing and keeping yarn at back of work, sl st into each st at base of Frills through both thicknesses to join (working into same sps as first row of Frill). Do not fasten off. 
Insert cardboard circle, placing flush with Back Piece. Stuff Head. 
Cont with B and working through both thicknesses throughout, proceed as follows:
Join rem Head: Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each of next 20 sc (sts between ends of Frill to close bottom of Head). Work 6 sc evenly up side of Frill to corner. 3 sc in corner. Working along last row of Frills, 1 sc in each sc to next ch-1 sp. Sl st in next ch 1 sp. (Sl st in ch-1 sp 1 row below) 5 times. (Sl st in ch-1 sp 1 row above) 5 times. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each sc to next ch-1 sp. 3 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each sc to next ch-1 sp. Sl st in next ch 1 sp. (Sl st in ch-1 sp 1 row below) 5 times. (Sl st in ch-1 sp 1 row above) 5 times. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Rep from * 4 more times. 1 sc in each sc to last st of Frill. 3 sc in last st of Frill. Work 6 sc evenly down side of Frill. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
 
FINISHING
Sew Small and Large Horns and Eyes to Head as seen in photo. With B, embroider mouth with Chain st as seen in photo.

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Dried Flowers (10981) 1 ball or 129 yds/140 m
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of black worsted weight yarn for embroidery.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes: 
• Do not join in rounds (rnds). 
Work in spiral. Move marker for beginning (beg) of rnd as work progresses.
• When Body is complete, turn work inside out. WS of work is facing you.
Ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 single crochet (sc) in 2nd chain (ch) from hook. Place marker (PM) in first sc for beg of rnd. 6 sc in rnd. Do not join. Work in spiral (see note).
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each of next 6 sc. Replace marker to first sc. 12 sc in rnd.
3rd rnd: 1 sc in first sc. Move marker. 2 sc in next sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Repeat (rep) from * around. 18 sc in rnd.
Continue (cont) working in spiral rnds, moving marker to indicate first sc as follows:
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
7th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 42 sc.
8th to 12th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
13th rnd: 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops - single crochet 2 together (sc2tog) made. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
14th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
15th to 17th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
18th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from* around. 24 sts.
19th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
20th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
21st and 22nd rnds: 1 sc in each st around. Fasten off, leaving long tail for seaming.
Turn work inside out, so WS of work becomes RS.
With black worsted weight yarn, embroider eyes at 20th rnd, using Satin Stitch. Locate position for nose 1 rnd below and embroider using Satin Stitch. Embroider whiskers using Straight Stitch as shown in photo.
Paws (make 2).
Ch 5, leaving a long tail for sewing.
1st row: [Right side (RS).] 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 3 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. Fasten off and weave in last end.
Using yarn needle, with WS down, sew 1st row of each Paw into 14th rnd of Body, on same side as eyes as shown in photo, using Whip Stitch.
Tail
Ch 4, leaving long tail for sewing.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd to 8th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
9th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. Turn.
10th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off and weave in last end.
Sew 1st row of Tail into 7th rnd of Body, centered on opposite side from face and Paws, using Whip Stitch.
FINISHING
Add stuffing. Fold top of Body flat and sew top of head seam using Whip Stitch, being sure to center eyes and nose.

materials: Lily® Sugar'n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m) Purple Grapes Main Color (MC) Black Currant (01318) 1 ball or 60 m/66 yds
Contrast A Warm Brown (01130) 1 ball or 6 m/7 yds
Green Grapes Main Color (MC) Hot Green (01712) 1 ball or 60 m/66 yds
Contrast A Warm Brown (01130) 1 ball or 6 m/7 yds
Size 3.5 mm (U.S. E or 4) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 9½" (24 cm) long x 1¾" (4.5 cm) diameter.
gauge: 16 sc and 18 rows = 4" (10 cm).
instructions:
GRAPES (make 15).
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Draw up loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw loop through all loops on hook – sc2tog made) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Lightly stuff Grape. Thread end through rem sts and draw tightly.
STEM (make 1).
With A, ch 16.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 9 ch. Ch 7. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 11 ch. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Grapes to Stem as shown in picture.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 0334 Buff A, 0706 Perfect Pink B, 0512 Turqua C, 0321 Gold D, 0312 Black E, 0311 White F, 0310 Cherry Red G
abbreviations: [] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Each gnome measures 7” (18 cm) tall, seated.
gauge:
CROCHET GAUGE: 14 sts = 4” (10 cm); 15 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
KNIT GAUGE: 16 sts = 4” (10 cm); 24 rows = 4” (10 cm) in Stockinette st (knit on Right Side, purl on Wrong Side). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size needles to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
GNOELLA
Head
Beginning at top of head, with A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Rounds 5–7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: Sc in next 5 sc, 3-hdc popcorn (for ear), sc in next 5 sc, 3-hdc popcorn (for nose), sc in next 5 sc, 3-hdc popcorn (for ear), sc in last 6 sc. 
Round 9 and 10: Sc in each sc around.
Round 11: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 12: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc. Do not fasten off.
Embroider Face: With E, embroider 2 French Knots on either side of nose. Cut a length of E and separate the plies. Using a single ply of E, embroider 3 eyelashes at the corner of each eye. With G, embroider a straight st mouth below the nose.
Round 13: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 3 times—9 sc.
Stuff head.
Body
Round 14: Work 2 sc in each sc around—18 sc.
Round 15: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Rounds 16–21: Sc in each sc around.
Special Crochet Stitches
3-hdc popcorn = 3 hdc in indicated stitch, remove hook from loop, insert hook from front to back in first hdc of 3-hdc group, place dropped loop back on hook and draw through.
sc2tog = [Draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Special Knit Stitches
Inc 1 to 5 = Work 5 stitches into one stitch – Knit into front of next st without removing from needle, then knit into back, front, back, and front again of same st.
M1 = Make 1 (Increase) – Lift strand between needles to left-hand needle and knit strand through the back loop, twisting it to prevent a hole.
Special Crochet Technique
Adjustable Ring = Holding the yarn a few inches from the end, wrap around your finger. Do not remove wrap from finger, insert hook into the wrap and draw up a loop of working yarn. Chain one to secure the loop, and remove ring from finger. Work stitches of first round in the ring. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Notes
1. Colors A, B, D, E, F, and G are needed for Gnoella. A, C, D, E, and G are needed for Gnoah. 
2. Gnoella is crocheted, and Gnoah is knit. Only small amounts of each color are needed. Many gnomes can be made from 1 skein of each color.
3. Head and body are made in one piece. Then arms and legs are worked separately and sewn to body. Bonnet, cap, diaper, and hair are worked separately and attached to finished gnome.
4. Stuff pieces lightly. Do not over stuff.
Round 22: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Stuff body.
Round 23: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Round 24: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through remaining stitches and pull to gather. Securely weave in end.
Legs (make 2)
Beginning at foot, with A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Work 8 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds—8 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Round 3: [Sc2tog, sc in next sc] 2 times, sc2tog—5 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 2 times, sc in last sc—7 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around, TURN.
Note: Work now proceeds back and forth in rows, leaving one stitch unworked at the end of each row. This creates a bend in the leg.
Row 7 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc, turn; leave last sc unworked—6 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, turn; leave last sc unworked—5 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, turn; leave last sc unworked—4 sc.
Notes: Work now resumes in the round. Work into every stitch as instructed, including the stitches that were left unworked when working the leg bend. To help the leg bend and reduce gaps between stitches, a sc2tog is worked when each of the unworked stitches is worked into. Each sc2tog is worked by drawing up a loop in the edge of a row and in the unworked stitch.
Round 10 (Right Side): Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc; do not turn, working down side edge, [insert hook in edge of row and draw up a loop, insert hook in next unworked st in row below and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook] 2 times, working up opposite side edge, insert hook in edge of row and draw up a loop, insert hook in next unworked st in row above and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook—7 sts.
Round 11: Insert hook in edge of Round 10 and draw up a loop, insert hook in first st of Round 10 and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook, sc in next 6 sc.
Slip st in next st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing leg to body.
Arms (make 2)
Beginning at hand, work same as leg through Round 5—7 sc.
Rounds 6–9: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing arm to body.
Diaper
With B, ch 21.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—20 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, skip first sc, slip st in next sc, sc2tog, sc in each sc across to last 4 sc, sc2tog, turn; leave last 2 sts unworked—14 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—12 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 2 times, sc2tog, sc in last sc, turn—9 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog, turn—7 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog, turn—5 sc.
Rows 9–14: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Round 15 (Right Side): Ch 1, slip st in each st across, do not turn, slip st evenly around entire outside edge; join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.
Bonnet
Beginning at top of bonnet, with B, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Work 4 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds—4 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 2 times—6 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 2 times—8 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times—12 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times—16 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times—20 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times—24 sc.
Rounds 8 and 9: Sc in each sc around; TURN at the end of Round 9.
Back of Bonnet
Row 10 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 12 sc, sc2tog, turn—14 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 10 sc, sc2tog, turn—12 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 8 sc, sc2tog, turn—10 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog, turn—8 sc.
Row 14: Sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off.
Lace Trim (Right Side): With Right Side facing and leaving a long tail (for bonnet tie), join F with slip st in end of Row 14 to work across front edge of bonnet; *ch 3, sc in front edge; repeat from * working evenly spaced across front edge; slip st in opposite end of Row 14. Fasten off, leaving a long tail (for bonnet tie).
Front Curl
With D, ch 5.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, [ch 2, slip st in next ch] 2 times, slip st in last ch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing curl to head.
Finishing (Gnoella)
Using photograph as a guide, stuff arms and legs and sew to body. Legs can be sewn to body in a sitting or standing position, as desired.
Fold diaper, bringing Row 14 up to Row 1 and folding edges of Row 1 over ends of Row 14. With F, sew a cross stitch at each end of Row 1 to hold top of sides of diaper together. Place diaper on gnome.
Place bonnet on gnome’s head. With bonnet in place, determine location for front curl. Remove bonnet and sew front curl to head. Replace bonnet and tie a bow at chin. If desired, bonnet can be sewn to head with a few stitches. Weave in all ends.

GNOAH
Head and Body
Beginning at top of head, with A, cast on 8 sts.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Purl.
Row 2: K1, [M1, k1] 7 times—15 sts.
Row 3: Purl.
Row 4: K1, [M1, k2] 7 times—22 sts.
Row 5: Purl.
Row 6: K2, [M1, k3] 6 times, M1, k2—29 sts.
Rows 7–11: Work in St st (knit on Right Side, purl on Wrong Side) for 5 rows.
Row 12: K7, increase 1 to 5 (for ear), k6, increase 1 to 5 (for nose), k6, increase 1 to 5 (for ear), k7—41 sts.
Row 13: P7, p5tog, p6, p5tog, p6, p5tog, p7—29 sts.
Row 14: Knit.
Row 15: Purl.
Row 16: [K2, k2tog] 7 times, k1—22 sts.
Row 17: Purl.
Row 18: [K1, k2tog] 7 times, k1—15 sts.
Row 19: Purl.
Row 20: [K1, k2tog] 5 times—10 sts.
Embroider Face: With E, embroider 2 French Knots on either side of nose. With G, embroider a straight st mouth below the nose.
Body
Row 21: Purl.
Row 22: [K1, M1] 9 times, k1—19 sts.
Row 23: Purl.
Row 24: [K2, M1] 9 times, k1—28 sts.
Row 25: Purl.
Row 26: K14, M1, k14—29 sts.
Rows 27–37: Work in St st for 11 rows.
Row 38: [K2, k2tog] 7 times, k1—22 sts.
Row 39: Purl.
Row 40: [K1, k2tog] 7 times, k1—15 sts.
Row 41: Purl.
Row 42: [K2tog] 7 times, k1—8 sts.
Cut yarn, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through sts of last row and pull to gather. Use remaining tail to sew back seam. Stuff head and body before completing seam.
Arms (make 2)
Beginning at hand, leaving a long beginning tail, with A, cast on 5 sts.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Purl.
Row 2: [K1, M1] 4 times, k1—9 sts.
Rows 3–5: Work in St st for 3 rows.
Row 6: [K1, k2tog] 3 times—6 sts.
Row 7: Purl.
Row 8: [K2, M1] 2 times, k2—8 sts.
Row 9: Purl.
Row 10: K3, M1, k2, M1, k3—10 sts.
Rows 11–16: Work in St st for 6 rows.
Bind off. Cut yarn leaving a long tail. Weave beginning tail through cast-on sts and pull to gather. Securely weave in beginning tail. Use ending tail to sew side seam.
Legs (make 2)
Beginning at foot, work same as arm through Row 10—10 sts.
Row 11: Purl.
Note: Work now proceeds in short rows, leaving one stitch unworked at the end of each row. This creates a bend in the leg.
Row 12: K9, turn; leave last st unworked.
Row 13: P8, turn.
Row 14: K7, turn.
Row 15: P6, turn.
Row 16: Knit to end of row—10 sts.
Rows 17–20: Work in St st for 4 rows.
Bind off. Cut yarn leaving a long tail. Weave beginning tail through cast-on sts and pull to gather. Securely weave in beginning tail. Use ending tail to sew side seam.
Diaper
With C, cast on 24.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Purl.
Row 2: Knit.
Row 3: Purl.
Row 4: Bind off 2 sts, k2tog, knit to end of row—21 sts.
Row 5: Bind off 2 sts, p2tog, purl to end of row—18 sts.
Row 6: [K2tog] 2 times, knit to last 4 sts, [k2tog] 2 times—14 sts.
Row 7: Purl.
Row 8: K2tog, k4, k2tog, k4, k2tog—11 sts.
Row 9: Purl.
Row 10: K2tog, knit to last 2 sts, k2tog—9 sts.
Row 11: Purl.
Row 12: K2tog, knit to last 2 sts, k2tog—7 sts.
Rows 13–21: Work in St st for 9 rows.
Row 22: K1, M1, knit to last st, M1, k1—9 sts.
Row 23: Purl.
Row 24: Knit.
Bind off.
Cap
Beginning at tip of cap, leaving a long beginning tail, with A, cast on 4 sts.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Purl.
Row 2: [K1, M1] 3 times, k1—7 sts.
Row 3: Purl.
Row 4: [K2, M1] 3 times, k1—10 sts.
Row 5: Purl.
Row 6: [K3, M1] 3 times, k1—13 sts.
Row 7: Purl.
Row 8: [K2, M1] 6 times, k1—19 sts.
Row 9: Purl.
Row 10: [K3, M1] 6 times, k1—25 sts.
Row 11: Purl.
Row 12: [K4, M1] 6 times, k1—31 sts.
Rows 13–18: Work in St st for 6 rows.
Bind off.
Front Curl
With E, cast on 10 sts. Work no rows, bind off immediately. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave the tail through the bound-off edge and pull to form a curve. Secure end, but do not trim tail. Use tail later to sew curl to head.
Bind off.
Belt
With E, cast on 40 sts. Work no rows, bind off immediately.
Finishing (Gnoah)
Using photograph as a guide, stuff arms and legs and sew to body. Legs can be sewn to body in a sitting or standing position, as desired.
Fold diaper, bringing bind-off edge up to cast-on edge and folding edges of cast-on edge over ends of bind-off edge. With C, sew a cross stitch at each end of cast-on edge to hold top of sides of diaper together. Place diaper on gnome. Wrap belt around top of diaper, allowing ends to overlap at front. With E, sew belt to diaper. With D, embroider straight st belt buckle on belt.
Place cap on gnome’s head. With cap in place, determine location for front curl. Remove cap and sew front curl to head. Replace cap and sew to head. Weave in all ends.

pattern_name: LILY FUN IN THE SUN DOLL WITH DRESS
materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream Solids (70 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds) Main Color (MC) (01004 Soft Ecru) 1 ball
Lily Sugar’n Cream Ombres (56.7 g/2 oz; 86 m/95 yds) Contrast B (51445 Lava Lamp) 1 ball
Doll: Size 3.5 mm (U.S. E or 4) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of red and black embroidery floss.
Dress: Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: Doll: 16 sc and 20 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]. Dress: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
DOLL
Head: **With MC and smaller hook, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd 10 times more.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sts. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts. 
Stuff Head.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Stuff rem of Head. Join with sl st to first st. 8 sts. Fasten off. 
Body: 
With MC and smaller hook, ch 30. Join with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 2 ins [5 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts,
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 4 ins [10 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd twice more. Fasten off.
Sew bottom edge of Body closed. 
Stuff Body. 
Arms (make 2).
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 tr in next sc (thumb). 1 sc in each of last 5 sc.
Join with sl st to first sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures 4 ins [10 cm]. Fasten off.
Stuff arms lightly.
Legs (make 2).
Shoe: With A and smaller hook, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch.
Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc.
Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc.
Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc.
(Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join MC with sl st to first sc. Place marker at end of rnd. 21 sts.
6th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 6 sc.
(Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc.
Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 17 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc.
(Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd until Leg from top of Shoe measures 5 ins [12.5 cm]. Fasten off.
Shoe strap: Join A with sl st to 6th sc of marked rnd. Ch 5. Join with sl st to 13th sc of marked rnd. Fasten off.
Stuff Legs.

Flower (make 2): With B and smaller hook, ch 6. 
1st row: Sl st in 6th ch from hook. *Ch 6. Sl st in same sp as last sl st. Rep from * 3 times more. Fasten off. 

FINISHING
Sew top of Legs closed. Sew to bottom of Body. Attach Arms to sides of Body. With MC, make Belly Button using French Knot.
Hair fringe
Cut a piece of tape 11 ins [28 cm] long and secure onto a flat surface with sticky side up. Cut lengths of A 14 ins [35.5 cm] long and lay them across tape so strip of tape is in center of yarn.  Holding tissue paper over top of yarn and using sewing machine, run a line of stitching along length of tape. Remove tape when hair is secure. Remove tissue paper after stitching
Pin fringe to outside of head. Using backstitch and A, sew hair into place along sewn line.
Fold hair up and secure at top of Head tightly. Attach Flower to ponytail as shown in picture. 
With red embroidery floss, embroider mouth. With black embroidery floss, embroider eyelashes using straight stitch. Attach beads to Head for eyes. Sew Head to body.

DRESS
Note: Dress is worked from top down.
With B and larger hook, ch 24. Join with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd 5 times more.
Next rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *2 dc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dc. 48 dc. 
Next rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first dc.
Next rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dc. 96 dc. 
Next 2 rnds: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first dc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in back loop of same sp as last sl st. *Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook– picot made. Ch 1. Miss next 2 sts. Sl st in next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.
Straps:(make 2). With B and larger hook, ch 7. Fasten off.
Try dress on. Attach each strap at top edge.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Size U.S. H/8 [5 mm] crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Approx 13" [33 cm] wide x 18" [45.5 cm] tall.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: All rnds are joined with a sl st to first st.
HEAD
With C, beg using magic loop method (demonstrated here).
**1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sc. **
7th to 10th rnds: As 4th rnd. Break C. Join A.
11th rnd: With A, as 4th rnd.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.
13th to 15th rnds: As 4th rnd.
Note: Add safety eyes in space between 13th and 14th rnds. Space eyes 8" [20.5 cm] apart as shown in photo. Start stuffing Head with polyfill at this stage.
16th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
17th to 21st rnds: As 4th rnd.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sts.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 10 sts.
24th rnd: As 23rd rnd. 5 sts. Fasten off.
BODY
With A, beg using magic loop method.
Work from ** to ** as given for Head.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sc.
9th to 13th rnds: As 7th rnd.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sts.
15th to 18th rnds: As 7th rnd.
19th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.
20th to 26th rnds: As 7th rnd.
27th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
Note: Start stuffing Body with polyfill at this stage.
28th and 29th rnds: As 7th rnd.
30th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sts.
31st rnd: As 7th rnd.
32nd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 10 sts.
33rd rnd: As 32nd rnd. 5 sts. Fasten off.
Sew Head to Body, angling Head slightly down as shown in photo.
ARMS AND LEGS (make 4)
With D, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 12 sc in ring. Join. 12 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
3rd to 8th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Break D. Join A.
9th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 15 sts.
11th rnd: As 9th rnd.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join. 12 sts.
13th to 22nd rnds: As 9th rnd.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff with polyfill.
Stitch Arms to neck as shown in photo, spaced approx 5 sts apart.
Stitch Legs to bottom of Body as shown in photo, approx 7 rnds from base and spaced approx 15 sts apart.
 OUTER EARS
Note: Make one Outer Ear in A and one in B.
Beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off.
INNER EARS (make 2)
With C, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off.
Line up edges of Inner and Outer Ears. Sew Inner Ear to Outer Ear. Stitch to Head as shown in Photo.
SPOTS (make 3)
With B, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc arund. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 2 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 hdc in next sc. 2 dc in next sc. 2 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 hdc in next sc. 2 dc in next sc. 2 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in last st Join. 30 sts.
Fasten off.
Stitch Spots to Body, placed as shown in photo. With B, embroider nostrils on snout with straight stitches as shown in photo.
HORNS (make 2)
With D, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in ring. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 9 sc.
3rd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
Fasten off.
Stitch Horns to top of Head as shown in photo.
TAIL
Cut 6 strands of A and 3 strands of B, approx 15" [38 cm] long.
With all 9 strands held tog, wrap around st at center back of Body. Fold in half and divide into 3 groups of 6 strands. Braid tog as shown in diagram. Tie a knot and trim ends evenly.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 886 Blue A, 316 Soft White B, 321 Gold C, and 885 Delft D
6” x 8½” (15 x 21.5 cm) piece of flexible cardboard
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Menorah measures 10” wide x 10” tall (25.5 x 25.5 cm), not including candles. Center candle (“shamash”) measures 4” (10 cm) tall. Regular candles measure 3” (7.5 cm) tall.
gauge: 12 sts = 4” (10 cm); 15 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet.
instructions:
Base and Main Shaft
With A, form an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1 (right side): Work 5 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—5 sc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc—10 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, *sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—15 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, *2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—20 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—25 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, *2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, *sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—35 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, *2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—40 sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, *sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—45 sc.
Round 10: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 11: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 12: Ch 1, working in back loops only, *sc in next 7 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—40 sc.
Round 13: Ch 1, *sc2tog, sc in next 6 sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—35 sc.
Round 14: Ch 1, *sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 15: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 16: Ch 1, *sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—25 sc.
Round 17: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 18: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—20 sc.
Round 19: Ch 1, *sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc.
Rounds 20–33: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 34 (form branch slots): Ch 1, sc in next 2 sc, ch 4, skip next 4 sc (branch slot made), sc in next 4 sc, ch 4, skip next 4 sc, sc in last 2 sc; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc and 2 ch-4 spaces (branch slots).
Round 35: Ch 1, sc in each sc and ch around; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 36–41: Repeat Rounds 34 and 35 three more times.
Rounds 42–45: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing.

Branches (make 8)
Branch #1
With right side facing and larger hook, working in free loops of first ch-4 space (branch slot) made in Round 34, join A with slip st in first ch.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in same ch, sc in next 3 ch, sc in 4 skipped sc of previous round; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc.
Rounds 2–26: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Branch #2
On same side of main shaft as previously made branch, join A with slip st to branch slot in Round 36 of main shaft; repeat Rounds 1–20 of branch #1. Fasten off.
Branch #3
On same side of main shaft as previously made branch, join A with slip st to branch slot in Round 38 of main shaft; repeat Rounds 1–14 of branch #1. Fasten off.
Branch #4
On same side of main shaft as previously made branch, join A with slip st to branch slot in Round 40 of main shaft; repeat Rounds 1–8 of branch #1. Fasten off.
Repeat branches #1–#4 along opposite side of main shaft.

Horizontal Bar
With A, ch 15.
Round 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; join with slip st in first sc—14 sc.
Rounds 2–40: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

Cups (make 9)
With A, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1 (right side): Work 4 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—4 sc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc.
Rounds 3 and 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

Candles (make 9: 8 regular and 1 shamash (center candle))
With B, form an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 5 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—5 sc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Rounds 2–9: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Notes: For shamash only, repeat last round 3 more times. For all candles, proceed in rows. 
Next Row: Skip first 2 sc, sc in next sc, skip next sc, slip st in last sc, turn.
Next Row: Skip slip st, slip st in next sc. Fasten off. 

Flame
Row 1: Join C with slip st in slip st of last row, ch 3, (slip st, sc) in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in next ch. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Base and Main Shaft 
Roll the cardboard piece, overlapping edges to create a tube that fits inside main shaft. Tape edges and place tube into shaft. Pour polyester pellets around and inside tube to fill the base and stabilize the tube. Firmly stuff polyester fiberfill inside tube and branches.
Horizontal Bar, Branches, and Cups 
Flatten tube with join centered on underside. Working through both thicknesses, join A with slip st at beginning of one open end, slip st across ends of rounds to close opening. Fasten off. Repeat on other end.
Center bar, with join on underside, over top of main shaft and sew in place. Beginning with each branch #4, gently bend branches up and sew ends to underside of horizontal bar. Sew cups along top of horizontal bar, centering one cup above each branch. Insert candles in cups, placing shamash in center cup.

Embroidery (optional)
Using photograph as a guide, with yarn needle and D, backstitch around base and cups to decorate.
Weave in all ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Stripes™”: 1 ball 942 Cancun Stripe MC or 944 Breezy Stripe MC.
RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 311 White A and 312 Black B.
Yarn needle, polyester stuffing, two black 1/8” (5mm) buttons, sewing needle, black thread, plastic pellets (optional).
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 16 sts = 4”; 16 rnds = 4” in sc with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the specified gauge.
instructions:
PONY
Body-Rnd 1: With larger hook and MC, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Rnd 3: [2 Sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Rnd 4: [2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 5: [2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Rnds 6 and 7: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 8: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rnds 9-14: Repeat Rnd 6.
Rnd 15: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Rnd 16: [Sc2tog, sc in next sc] 6 times – 12 sc. Stuff firmly with polyester filler (and plastic pellets, as desired).
Rnd 17: [Sc2tog] 6 times – 6 sc. Fasten off. Weave yarn tail through last 6 sc, draw up firmly; fasten securely. Weave in ends.
Head-Rnds 1-4: Work same as Body Rnds 1-4.
Rnd 5: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 6: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Rnd 7: Repeat Rnd 5.
Rnd 8: [2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 9: [2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Rnd 10: [2 Sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times – 36 sc.
Rnd 11: Repeat Rnd 5.
Rnd 12: [Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Rnd 13: Repeat Rnd 5.
Rnd 14: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 15: Repeat Rnd 5.
Rnd 16: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Rnd 17: [Sc2tog, sc in next sc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Stuff head firmly with polyester.
Rnd 18: [Sc2tog] 6 times – 6 sc. Fasten off. Weave yarn tail through last 6 sc, draw up firmly; fasten securely. Weave in ends.

AMIGURUMI PONIES | CROCHET
CROCHET  I  SKILL LEVEL: INTERMEDIATE

Legs (Make 4)-Rnd 1: With larger hook and MC, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st in first sc.
Rnd 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join –12 sc.
Rnd 3: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each sc around; join.
Rnds 4 and 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Rnd 6: Ch 1, [sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc] twice, sc2tog; join – 9 sc.
Rnds 7-11: Repeat Rnd 4. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing. Stuff legs.

Eyes (Make 2)-Rnds 1 and 2: With smaller hook and A, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc] twice, sc2tog – 9 sc.
Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing. Stuff lightly. Weave yarn tail through last 9 sc, draw up firmly; fasten securely.

Eyelids (Make 2)-Row 1: With smaller hook and MC, ch 13; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 12 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, hdc in next 3 sc, slip st in next 2 sc, hdc in next 3 sc, sc in last 2 sc. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing.

Ears (Make 2)-Rnd 1: With smaller hook and MC, ch 2; 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 3: 2 Sc in each sc around – 8 sc.
Rnd 4: Repeat Rnd 2.
Rnd 5: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] twice – 6 sc.
Rnd 6: [Skip first sc, sc in next sc] 3 times – 3 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Tail: With smaller hook and MC, ch 5. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing. Cut three 4” strands of yarn. Fold strands in half forming a loop; insert the crochet hook into the end of the chain and draw the loop through, then draw the yarn ends through the loop and tighten. Pull plies apart to fluff and trim to about 1”.

Finishing
Sew all 4 legs to each other at the top of the legs, using the un-trimmed yarn ends. Tack the legs as needed to keep them from flailing out.
Attach the 4 joined legs by sewing securely to the bottom of the body, positioning them more towards the back to offset the weight of the head. Attach tail at the very back of the body. 
Pin head to body as pictured. Attach by sewing with yarn tail. Sew on eyes. Sew buttons to eyeball with needle and black thread. Pin eyelid on with the curved edge over the top of the eyes; sew in place, tacking down in a few places in the middle of the 2 eyes.
Using B and sharp yarn needle, embroider the mouth using an outline or running st. Make the nostrils using a French knot st. Outline eyelids with B using a running or outline st. Weave in ends.
Mane: Cut ten 4” strands of yarn. Fold 2 strands in half forming a loop; insert the crochet hook into a loop on the back of the head and draw the loop through, then draw the yarn ends through the loop and tighten. Repeat with remaining cut strands. Pull plies apart to fluff and trim to about 1”.

materials: 6-strand embroidery floss in blue, red, yellow, and black
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Little Red Riding Hood and Wolf measure 6" (15 cm) tall. Grandmother measures 7" (18 cm) tall.
gauge: 4 sc = 1" (2.5 cm); 4 rows = 1" (2.5 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
LITTLE RED RIDING HOOD
Head
Beginning at center of face, with A, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—18 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; changing to B—24 sc.
Round 5: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: *Sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around—21 sc.
Round 8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: *Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around—18 sc.
Round 10: *Sc in next sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around—12 sc. Stuff head with fiberfill. Place marker on last st of Round 4 for center of neck.
Round 11: [Sc2tog] around—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through sts and pull gently to close. 
Hair 
Row 1: Working in back loops, join C with slip st in 3rd sc at right of marked st on Round 4, leave marker in place, *ch 2, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around; leave last 3 sc before marked st unworked. Fasten off.
Body
Beginning at bottom of feet, with D, ch 6.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working in opposite side of foundation ch, skip first ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch—12 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in last 2 sc—18 sc.
Rounds 3–13: Sc in each sc around.
Round 14: *Sc in next sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around—12 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Stuff body with fiberfill.
Arm (make 2) 
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around; change to D.
Rounds 3–7: Sc in each sc around. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Skirt
With E, ch 19.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—18 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in first sc, 2 dc in each remaining sc across, turn—36 dc.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in each dc across. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Apron 
With F, ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc across, turn—12 sc.
Rows 3 and 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off. 
Cape 
With B, ch 25.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—24 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, [sc2tog] across, turn—12 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, 3 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across to last st, 3 sc in last sc; working down first side, sc in end of each row; working in opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in each ch across to last ch, 3 sc in last ch; working up other side, sc in end of each row; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING 
LITTLE RED RIDING HOOD 
Head
With blue embroidery floss, embroider 
French knot eyes; embroider smile 
with red embroidery floss and couched 
stitching. Color cheeks with red crayon. 
Legs
Flatten body slightly. With strand of 
D, back stitch through center sts of 
Rounds 1–5. 
Body 
With end tail of body, sew head in place 
on Round 14. 
Sew arms in place.
Clothing 
Place skirt around waist of doll and, 
working in ends of rows, sew back seam. 
With yellow embroidery floss, 
embroider 5 French knots evenly 
spaced between Rows 3 and 4 of apron. 
Sew apron over skirt.
Sew cape around neck.
Weave in ends. 
GRANDMOTHER
Head
Work same as Little Red Riding Hood 
head, changing to G at end of Round 4.
Hat Ruffle
Row 1: Working in back loops, join G 
with slip st in 3rd sc at right of marked 
st on Round 4, leave marker in place, *3 
sc in next sc, slip st in next sc; repeat 
from * around; leave last 3 sc before 
marked st unworked. Fasten off. 
Body
With G, work same as Little Red Riding 
Hood body. 
Arm (make 2) 
Work same as Little Red Riding Hood 
arm, changing to G at end of Round 2. 
Nightgown
With H, work Rows 1 and 2 same as Little 
Red Riding Hood skirt. 
Rows 3–5: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, 
turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING GRANDMOTHER
Head
Embroider facial features and color 
cheeks same as Little Red Riding Hood. 
With black embroidery floss, back stitch 
around eyes to make eyeglasses.
Join F with slip st in any sc at top of 
head, 3 loop sts in same sc. Fasten off. 
Braid 
Cut 7 strands of F each measuring 
14" (35.5 cm). Tie 1 strand tightly around 
center of remaining 6 strands. Tie center 
strand to side of head under ruffle. Fold 
over gathered strands and braid 12 
strands of yarn to desired length. Secure 
with another short strand of F and trim 
all strands. 
Legs
With G, shape same as Little Red 
Riding Hood.
Body
Sew head and arms to body.
Sew nightgown around body in same 
manner as Little Red Riding Hood skirt.
Weave in ends.
WOLF
Head
Beginning at tip of nose, with I, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning 
of round and move up as each round is 
completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc 
around—12 sc.
Rounds 3 and 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next 6 
sc, sc in remaining 3 sc—18 sc.
Round 6: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next 
sc; repeat from * around—24 sc.
Rounds 7–10: Sc in each sc around.
Round 11: *Sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog; 
repeat from * around—21 sc.
Round 12: *Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog; 
repeat from * around—18 sc.
Round 13: *Sc in next sc, sc2tog; repeat 
from * around—12 sc. Stuff head  
with fiberfill.
Round 14: [Sc2tog] around—6 sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail 
through sts and pull gently to close. 
Ear (make 2) 
With I, ch 4. 
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc 
in next ch, (2 hdc, ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch 
from hook, 2 hdc) in last ch; working in 
opposite side of foundation ch, skip first 
ch, hdc in next ch, sc in last ch.  
Fasten off. 
Body
With I, work same as Little Red Riding 
Hood body. 
Arm (make 2)
With I, work same as Little Red Riding 
Hood arm, do not change color at end 
of Round 2.
Tummy
With F, ch 5.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and 
in next 2 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working in 
opposite side of foundation ch, skip first 
ch, sc in next 2 ch, 2 sc in last ch—10 sc. 
Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 
2 sc, 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 
sc in last 2 sc; join with slip st in first sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Tail
With I, ch 7. 
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc 
in next ch, hdc in next 4 ch. Fasten off, 
leaving a long tail for sewing. 
FINISHING WOLF
Head
With black embroidery floss, embroider 
satin stitch eyes and nose and 3 straight 
stitches for mouth.
Sew ears to top of head.
Legs
With I, shape same as Little Red 
Riding Hood.
Body
Sew head and arms to body.
Position tummy on front of body and 
sew in place. Sew tail to back of body.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each of 313 Aran A, 373 Petal Pink B, 579 Pale Plum C, 310 Monet D, 360 Café E, 320 Cornmeal F, 530 Orchid G, small amount each of 885 Delft Blue H, 718 Shocking Pink I (to embroider face)
small pearl beads (for earrings and necklace)
abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, and I = Color A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, and I
() = work directions in parentheses into same st
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: 20 sts = 4”; 16 rows = 4” in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEAD AND BODY
Beginning at top of head, with A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Rounds 8–15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: [Sc2tog] 15 times—15 sts.
Rounds 17–19: Sc in each sc around.
Round 20: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 7 times, sc in last sc—22 sc.
Round 21: [Sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 2 times; change to B in last sc—24 sc.
Undershirt
Rounds 22–27: With B, sc in each sc around; change to A in last sc of Round 27.
A classic girl, Lucy prefers conservative outfits and loves home décor. She’s a natural giver who spearheads charity stitching groups. Crochet her from head to toe including undergarments and shoes and then dress her in a top, cardie sweater and skirt. She likes to complete her outfit by accessorizing with pearl necklace and earrings.
Waist
Rounds 28 and 29: With A, sc in each sc around; change to B in last sc of Round 29.
Begin Knickers
Rounds 30–35: With B, sc in each sc around. Do not fasten off. Stuff body firmly.
Joining Row: Flatten lower edging, matching stitches. Working through both thicknesses, sc across to close lower edge. Fasten off B.
ARM (make 2)
Beginning at top of arm, with A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Rounds 3–19: Sc in each sc, stuffing arm as you go.
Round 20: [Sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 3 sc—6 sc.
Round 21: Work 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in last 3 sc—9 sc.
Rounds 22–24: Sc in each sc around.
Round 25: [Sc2tog] 4 times, sc in last sc—5 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff arm. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull gently to close opening. Draw a strand of A through arm at elbow and pull to form elbow dimple. Sew arms to sides of body. With B, embroider a strap over each shoulder, from top front of undershirt to top back of undershirt.
EAR (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Sew ears in place. 
Earrings
With heavy-duty sewing thread, sew one pearl bead on each ear.
HAIR
Ponytail
Wrap F around 8” piece of heavy cardboard 120 times. Cut one end of wraps. *Hold two strands together and fold in half, forming a loop at folded end. Insert hook around a stitch on head of doll at hairline. Place loop of folded strands on hook and draw through. Thread ends of strands through loop and pull to tighten; repeat from * around hairline, then continue to repeat from * to fill in over back of head. Draw hair neatly to middle of back of head to form a ponytail. Secure ponytail with elastic band. 
Bangs
Wrap F around 2” piece of heavy cardboard 20 times. Cut one end of wraps. Attach strands across forehead hairline in same manner as ponytail strands.
Trim ends of ponytail and bangs to even.
Bow
With C, ch 80. Fasten off. Tie bow around ponytail.
LEG (make 2)
Beginning at foot, with E, ch 6.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch—12 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 3 sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc—18 sc.
Round 3: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around.
Round 4: Sc in next 6 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 6 sc—15 sc.
Round 5: Sc in next 3 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 6 sc—12 sc.
Round 6: Sc in next 3 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 3 sc—9 sc.
Rounds 7 and 8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: Work 2 sc in first sc, sc in each remaining sc around—10 sc.
Rounds 10–15: Sc in each sc around, stuffing leg as you go; change to A in last sc.
Rounds 16–27: With A, sc in each sc around; change to B in last sc of Round 27.
Round 28: With B, sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Seam Toe
Flatten last row, matching stitches and ensuring that toe faces forward, sewing through both thicknesses, sew across.
Top of Boots (make 1 for each leg)
With E, ch 12, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across. Fasten off. Sew around top of boot.
Sew legs to bottom of body.
SKIRT 
With D, ch 17. Note: Skirt is worked side to side.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 4 ch, hdc in next 5 ch, dc in last 6 ch, turn—16 sts.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), dc in next 5 dc, hdc in next 5 hdc, sc in last 5 sc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, hdc in next 5 hdc, dc in last 6 dc, turn.
Rows 4–27: Repeat last 2 rows 12 times.
Row 28: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), dc in next 5 dc, hdc in next 5 hdc, sc in next 3 sc, ch 1, skip next sc, sc in last sc (buttonhole made).
Fasten off. Sew back seam from lower edge to first sc (leave top part unsewn). Sew button, opposite buttonhole. 
TOP
Beginning at lower edge, with C, ch 31.
Row 1: Work sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each remaining ch across, turn—30 sc.
Rows 2–7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, ch 10 (for first strap), skip next 6 sc, sc in next 10 sc, ch 10 (for 2nd strap), skip next 6 sc, sc in last 4 sc, turn—18 sc and 2 ch-10 spaces.
Row 9: Ch 1, slip st in first 4 sc, sc in next 10 ch, slip st in next 10 sc, sc in next 10 ch, slip st in last 4 sc—30 sc and 8 slip sts. Fasten off. 
SWEATER
With G, ch 35.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—34 sc.
Rows 2–10: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Right Front
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc; leave remaining sts unworked (for armholes, back and left front), turn—6 sc.
Rows 12–17: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off.
Back
Row 11: Skip next 5 unworked sc following right front, join G with sc in next sc, sc in next 11 sc; leave remaining sts unworked (for armhole and left front)—12 sc.
Rows 12–17: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off.
Left Front
Row 11: Skip next 5 unworked sc following back, join G with sc in next sc, sc in each remaining sc across—6 sc.
Rows 12–17: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off.
Shoulder Seam 
Fold fronts over back. Beginning at side edge, sew two stitches together across each top edge for shoulder seams. Fold back unsewn front portions for collar.
Sleeve
Row 1: Join G with sc in center unworked sc at one underarm, work 20 more sc evenly spaced around armhole; do not join; turn—21 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 7 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 8 sc, sc2tog, turn—18 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 8 sc, sc2tog, sc in last 8 sc, turn—17 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first 7 sc, sc2tog, sc in last 8 sc, turn—16 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first 7 sc, sc2tog, sc in last 7 sc, turn—15 sc.
Rows 9 and 10: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 11: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 3 times, turn—12 sc.
Rows 12–16: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Sew sleeve seam. Repeat for 2nd sleeve.
POCKETBOOK
With E, ch 6.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch, working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch—12 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 3 sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of last 2 sc—18 sc.
Round 3: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Rounds 5–9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: Sc in next 4 sc, ch 10 (for first handle), skip next 4 sc, sc in next 4 sc, ch 10 (for 2nd handle), skip next 4 sc, sc in last 4 sc—16 sc and 2 ch-10 spaces.
Round 11: Sc in each sc and ch around.
Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Place clothing and accessories on doll.
Embroider Face
With H, embroider satin stitch eyes. With E, embroider couched stitch eyebrows. With A, embroider satin stitch nose, With I, embroider a couched stitch smile. With red crayon, gently rub color onto face for cheeks.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 792 Sandy
Print A, 774 Light Raspberry B, 312 Black C, 885 Delft Blue D.
abbreviations: A, B, C, D = Color A, B, C, D
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: 14 sts = 4” 16 rows = 4” in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Head (stuff as you go)
Beginning at nose, with A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join – 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc; join – 6 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times; join – 9 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc; join – 18 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join – 24 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [sc in 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join – 30 sc.
Rounds 7-11: Ch 1, sc in each sc; join.
Round 8: Ch 1, [sc in 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times; join – 24 sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times; join – 18 sc.
Round 10: Ch 1, [sc, sc2tog] 6 times; join – 12 sc.
Round 11: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 6 times; join – 6 sc.
Fasten off. With yarn needle and tail, sew closed.

Body (stuff as you go)
With A, ch 2
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join – 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [2 sc] repeat around; join – 12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in sc, 2 sc in next sc] repeat around; join – 18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] repeat around; join – 24 sc.
Rounds 5-16: Ch 1, sc in each sc; join.
Round 17: Ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, sc2tog] repeat around; join – 18 sc.
Round 18: Ch 1, [sc in sc, sc2tog] repeat around; join – 12 sc.
Round 19: Ch 1, [sc2tog] repeat around; join – 6 sc.
Fasten off with long tail. With yarn needle and tail, sew closed.

Ear (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join – 6 sc.
Round 2: [(Sc, ch 1, dc, ch 1, sc) in next sc, sc in sc] three times; join – 18 sts (including chains).
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing to head.

Right leg (make 2)
With A, ch 5.
Round 1: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 2 ch, 3 sc in last ch, sc in next 2 ch of foundation chains; join – 10 sc.

Left Leg (make 2)
Rounds 1-9: Same as right leg.
Row 10 (switch to rows): Slip stitch in next 2 sc, turn, ch 1, sc in 5 sc, turn – 5 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in sc, sc2tog, do not turn – 3 sc.
Row 12: 2 sc in each slip st, 2 sc in each sc, 2 sc in side of each row, join – 22 sc.
Fasten off leaving long tail for sewing to body.

Tail
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join – 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [sc in sc, 2 sc in sc] 3 times; join – 9 sc.
Rounds 3-21: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Fasten off, do not stuff, with yarn needle, sew closed leaving long tail to sew to body.

Bow
With D, ch 50, fasten off.

FINISHING
Using photo for placement, with yarn needle and tail, sew head to body. Sew ears between rounds 10 and 11 of head. Stuff legs and sew in place. Sew tail between rounds 16 and 17 of body. With D, whipstitch eyes around rounds 5 and 6 of head. With B, whipstitch nose around upper edge of first two rounds of head. With C, whipstitch mouth to match photo. Tie bow around neck.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (5 oz/141 g; 236 yds/215 m) Wildflower (3955)  1 ball or 23.5 yds/21.5 m for Hat and 21 yds/19.5 m for Dress
Red Heart® Super Saver® Stripes™ (5 oz/141 g; 236 yds/215 m) Retro Stripe (4971) 1 ball or 23.5 yds/21.5 m for Hat and 21 yds/19.5 m for Dress
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbl = Double crochet in back loop only
Hdcbl = Half double crochet in back loop only
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4” [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Join with sl st to first sc at end of rnds.
DRESS
Skirt
**Ch 20. Join with sl st to form a ring. See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 20 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 25 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.**
4th rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). Working in back loops only,  2 hdcbl in first sc. 3 hdcbl in each sc around. Join with sl st to top of ch-2 (first hdc).
Fasten off.
Front Bib
Turn work upside down. With RS facing, join yarn with sc to rem loop of 5th ch of foundation ch.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. Turn. 5 sc (including joining sc).
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Ch 6. Do not fasten off. Pull loop to make it larger so it will not unravel.
Break yarn leaving a 4” [10 cm] tail.
Back
With RS facing, skip next 5 ch of foundation chain.
Join yarn with sc to rem loop of next foundation ch.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. Turn. 5 sc (including joining sc).
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Ch 6. Join with sl st to first sc of last row of Front Bib. 
Fasten off.
Insert hook back into loop of ch 6 of Front Bib. Join with sl st to first sc of last row of Back.
Fasten off.
HAT 
Work from ** to ** as given for Dress.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). Working in back loops only,  2 dcbl in first sc. 3 dcbl in each sc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3 (first dc).
Fasten off.
