Hold first bottom half on top of 2nd bottom half, place 3" (7.5 cm) disk between halves. 
Round 6: Working through both thicknesses, repeat Round 6 of hat—36 sc.
Rounds 7 and 8: Repeat Rounds 7 and 8 of hat—48 sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Crust Edge
Place pie filling between pie tin and crust. Stuff with fiberfill between filling and tin as work progresses. 
Round 1: Working through all 3 thicknesses, join D with sc in any st, (ch 5, sc) in each st around, ch 5; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off.
CAKE
Disk Cover (make 4)
With B, ch 2.
Rounds 1–6: Work same as Rounds 1–6 of hat—36 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sts, 2 sc in next st, *sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; change to G; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Sides
Place 4" (10 cm) disk between 2 disk covers 
Round 1: Working through both thicknesses, join G with sc in any st, Cl in same st, (sc, cl) in each st around; change to C; join with slip st in first sc, turn—42 sc and 42 Cls.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; change to B; join with slip st in first sc —42 sc. 
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. 
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in each st around; change to C; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 5–7: Repeats Rounds 2–4.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in each st around; change to G; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, (sc, cl) in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Bottom of Cake
Stuff cake with fiberfill, then place last disk between remaining disk covers. 
Position covers on lower edge of sides. With G and working through all 3 thicknesses, whipstitch in each st around. Fasten off.
Candle
With G, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook—5 sc. Do not join until instructed. 
Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–5: Sc in each sc around.
Rounds 6: Sc in each sc around; join with slip st in next st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Flame
With C, ch 2.
Row 1: (Sc, ch 1, dc, ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, ch 1, sc) in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. 
Sew flame to Round 1 of candle. 
Sew candle to center of cake.
POT HOLDER (make 2)
With G, ch 15.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—14 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 7 sts, Cl in next st, sc in last 6 sts, turn—13 sc and 1 Cl. 
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first 7 sts, skip next st, sc in last 6 sts, turn—13 sc.
Rows 7 and 8: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in first st, [sc2tog] 6 times—7 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Fold pot holder lengthwise and working through ends of rows and in sts last row, whipstitch edges together.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 Skein each 722 Pretty ‘n Pink A and 579 Pale Plum B.
two ¼” black buttons for eyes.
abbreviations: A, B, etc. = color A, B, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 16 sts = 4”; 20 rnds = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEAD AND BODY: Begin at top of Head with A, ch 2.
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, inc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Rnd 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, inc] 6 times – 30.
Rnds 6-12: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 13: [Dec] 15 times – 15 sc.
Neck-Rnd 14: [Sc in next 3 sc, dec] 3 times changing to B in last sc – 12 sc.
Body-Rnd 15: With B, [inc] 12 times – 24 sc. Stuff head.
Rnds 16-19: With B, sc in each sc around changing to A in last sc of Rnd 19.
Rnd 20: With A, sc in back loops only of each sc around.
Rnds 21-24: Sc in each sc around. Stuff body.
Rnd 25: [Dec] 12 times – 12 sc.
Rnd 26: [Dec] 6 times – 6 sc. Fasten off.
Finish stuffing. Weave yarn tail through remaining 6 sc, draw up firmly to gather together; fasten securely.
SKIRT: Join B in any back loop left unworked on Rnd 20; ch 2, 2 hdc in same loop as joining, 3 hdc in each loop around; join with a slip st in top of ch-2. Fasten off.
SNOUT: With A, ch 2.
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Rnd 3: Sc in back loops only of each sc around.
Rnd 4: Slip st in each sc around. Fasten off.
Stuff lightly and sew in place. Sew eyes in place above snout.
ARM (Make 2): With A, ch 2.
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: [Sc in next sc, inc] 3 times – 9 sc.
Rnds 3-6: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.
LEG (Make 2): With A, ch 2.
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Rnds 3-5: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 6: [Sc in next 2 sc, dec] 3 times – 9 sc. Fasten off.
Stuff lightly and sew in place.
TAIL: With A, ch 6; 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. Fasten off.
Sew in place.
EAR (Make 2): With A, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 5 sc.
Rows 2 and 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, dec, sc in next sc, dec; turn – 3 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, draw up a loop in each of next 3 sc, yarn over and draw through all 4 loops on hook; turn – 1 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in sc, slip st in center st of Row 2 for ear fold. Fasten off.
Sew in place as pictured.

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Contrast A Dark Gray (10044) 2 balls or 304 yds/278 m
Contrast B Pink Dust (10956) 1 ball or 30 yds/27 m
Size U.S. K/10½ [6.5 mm] Susan Bates®Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Optional: 1 yd of nylon wire for whiskers
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 22½" [57 cm] long x 10" [25.5 cm] wide.
gauge: 8 sc and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Do not join at ends of rnds unless otherwise stated. Cont working in spiral, placing marker on first st of rnd for easier counting.
To ensure tight, neat stitches, this project is worked using a “yarn under” single crochet. The yarn under single crochet was worked for this project as follows: insert hook into next stitch. With the hook placed over the yarn (a “yarn under”), draw up a loop.

Head and Body
See diagram on page 4.
With B, beg using magic loop method demonstrated here .
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in magic loop.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. 9 sc. Break B. Join A.
4th rnd: With A, *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 12 sc.
5th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
6th rnd: As 4th rnd. 24 sc.
7th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
8th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
9th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
10th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 42 sc.
11th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.
12th to 15th rnds: As 9th rnd.
Note: Place safety eyes between 11th and 12th rnds, spaced 4" [10 cm] apart as shown in photo.
16th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 42 sc.
17th rnd: As 9th rnd.
18th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * around. 39 sc.
19th rnd: As 9th rnd.
20th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
21st and 22nd rnds: As 9th rnd.
23rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 42 sc.
Note: Stuff Head and Body as you work.
24th rnd: As 9th rnd.
25th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.
26th rnd: As 9th rnd.
27th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 54 sc.
28th rnd: As 9th rnd.
29th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 60 sc.
30th rnd: As 9th rnd.
31st rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 66 sc.
32nd to 41st rnds: As 9th rnd.
42nd rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. 60 sc.
43rd rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog, 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 54 sc.
44th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Rep from * around. 48 sts.
45th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog, 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 42 sc.
46th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
47th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
48th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
49th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
50th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 12 sc.
51st rnd: *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread through rem sts and cinch tightly.

Tail
See diagram on page 5.
With B, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 7 sc in ring.
2nd to 15th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
16th rnd: Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. 6 sc.
17th to 22nd rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
23rd rnd: As 16th rnd. 5 sc.
24th to 30th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
31st rnd: As 16th rnd. 4 sc.
32nd to 41st rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
42nd rnd: As 16th rnd. 3 sc.
43rd and 44th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
45th row: Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 2 sc.
46th to 48th rows: 1 sc in each sc. Turn.
49th row: Sc2tog. Fasten off.
Sew Tail to back of Rat as shown in photo.

Feet (make 4)
See diagram on page 5.
With B, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 7 sc in ring.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Break C. Join B.
3rd rnd: With B, 1 sc in each sc around.
4th rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 14 sc.
5th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 21 sc. Fasten off.
Sew Feet to Body as shown in photo, stuffing lightly as you work.

Nose
See diagram on page 5.
With B, ch 2.
1st row: 5 hdc in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off.
Seam Nose to Head as shown in photo.

Inner Ears (make 2)
See diagram on page 5.
With B, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 7 dc in ring. Join with sl st to first dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dc in each dc around. 14 dc. Fasten off.

Outer Ears (make 2)
See diagram on page 5.
With A, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 7 dc in ring. Join with sl st to first dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first dc. 14 dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dc. 21 dc. Fasten off.

Assemble Ears
Place Inner Ear on top of Outer Ear with WS facing tog and sew Inner Ear around circumference of 2nd rnd of Outer Ear. Sew Ears to sides of Head as shown in photo.

Optional Whiskers
Cut four 9" [23 cm] lengths of nylon wire. Using yarn needle, loop two lengths of nylon around sts on either side of nose. Knot into place. Trim to desired lengths.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 0319 Cherry Red A, 0886 Blue B, 0312 Black C, 0334 Buff D, 0321 Gold E and 0313 Aran F.
Yarn needle, stitch marker, fiberfill, pins, one pair 18-20mm safety eyes.
abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E, F = Color A, B, C, D, E, F
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 14 sts = 4”; 15 rows = 4” in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BODY
Legs (Make 1) Beginning at bottom of legs, with A, ch 70; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch around, do not turn, work in continuous rounds—70 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. Round 2: Sc in each sc around. Repeat Round 2 until piece measures 5” from beginning. Slip st in next st. Fasten off.
Tunic
Beginning at bottom of tunic, with B, ch 80; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch around, do not turn, work in continuous rounds—80 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: [Sc in next 14 sc, sc2tog] 5 times—75 sc. Rounds 5 and 6: Sc in each sc around. Round 7: [Sc in next 13 sc, sc2tog] 5 times—70 sc. Do not fasten off.
Join Legs and Tunic
Place legs inside tunic, matching sts. Round 1: Working in both loops of tunic and front loop of legs, sc in each sc around. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around. Slip st in next st. Round 4: [Sc in next 12 sc, sc2tog] 5 times—65 sc. Slip st in next st. Fasten off.
Belt
Round 1: With Right Side facing, join C with sc in any sc, sc in each remaining sc around. Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around. Slip st in next st. Fasten off.
Top of Tunic
Round 1: With Right Side facing, join B with sc in any sc, sc in each remaining sc around. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around. Round 4: [Sc in next 11 sc, sc2tog] 5 times—60 sc. Rounds 5–7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: [Sc in next 8 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—54 sc. Rounds 9–11: Sc in each sc around. Round 12: [Sc in next 7 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—48 sc. Round 13: Sc in each sc around. Round 14: [Sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—42 sc. Round 15: Sc in each sc around. Round 16: [Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—36 sc. Round 17: Sc in each sc around. Round 18: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc. Round 19: Sc in each sc around. Round 20: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc. Round 21: Sc in each sc around. Slip st in next st. Fasten off.
Arms (Make 2)
Hand
With D, make an adjustable ring. Round 1 (Right Side): Work 8 sc in ring. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—16 sc. Round 3: Sc in each sc around. Round 4: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times—20 sc. Round 5: Sc in each sc around. Round 6: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 5 times—15 sc. Round 7: Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in next sc, popcorn in next sc (for thumb), sc in next sc, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog—12 sc. Rounds 8 and 9: Sc in each sc around. Slip st in next st. Fasten off.
Arm
Round 1: With Right Side facing, join B with sc in any sc, sc in each remaining sc around. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. Round 2: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—15 sc. Rounds 3–5: Sc in each sc around. Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—18 sc. Rounds 7–9: Sc in each sc around. Round 10: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—21 sc. Rounds 11–16: Sc in each sc around.
Shape Shoulder
Note: The shoulder is worked back and forth in rows, creating a tall triangle on top of the arm. One or two stitches are left unworked at the end of each row. When the shoulder triangle is complete, a round of sc is worked all the way around the edges of the triangle causing the top of the shoulder to curve slightly. Place a marker in last round worked, directly above thumb. Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in each sc to 1 sc before marker, turn. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in next 19 sc, turn; leave last 2 sc unworked—19 sc. Row 3: Sc in each sc to last sc, turn; leave last st unworked—18 sc. Rows 4–16: Repeat Row 3—5 sc. Round 17: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; working in the sts left unworked in previous row, sc in every sc all the way around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Head
Beginning at top of head, with D, make an adjustable ring. Round 1 (Right Side): Work 8 sc in ring. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—16 sc. Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times—24 sc. Round 4: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc. Round 5: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—36 sc. Round 6: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—42 sc. Round 7: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—48 sc. Rounds 8–13: Sc in each sc around. Round 14: Sc in first 24 sc, popcorn in next sc (for nose), sc in next 23 sc. Rounds 15–18: Sc in each sc around. Round 19: [Sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—42 sc. Round 20: [Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—36 sc. Round 21: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc. Round 22: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc. Rounds 23–25: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.
Shoes (Make 2)
Beginning at back of shoe, with C, ch 28; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch around, do not turn, work in continuous rounds—28 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. Rounds 2–6: Sc in each sc around. Round 7: Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 5 sc—24 sc. Round 8: Sc in each sc around. Round 9: Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc—20 sc. Round 10: Sc in each sc around. Round 11: Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 3 times, sc in next 3 sc—16 sc. Round 12: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog, sc in next sc, sc2tog] twice, sc in next 2 sc—12 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round. Pull tail gently, but firmly, to close opening. Secure end.
Belt Buckle
With E, ch 16; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1: Ch 1, 3 sc in same ch as join, sc in next 3 ch, [3 sc in next ch, sc in next 3 sc] 3 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc. Fasten off.
Cap
Beginning at top of cap, with A, make an adjustable ring. Round 1 (Right Side): Work 5 sc in ring. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—10 sc. Round 3: Sc in each sc around. Round 4: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—15 sc. Round 5: Sc in each sc around. Round 6: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—20 sc. Round 7: Sc in each sc around. Round 8: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—25 sc. Round 9: Sc in each sc around. Round 10: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—30 sc. Round 11: Sc in each sc around. Round 12: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—35 sc. Round 13: Sc in each sc around. Round 14: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—40 sc. Round 15: Sc in each sc around. Round 16: [Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—45 sc. Round 17: Sc in each sc around. Round 18: [Sc in next 8 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—50 sc. Rounds 19–25: Sc in each sc around. Round 26: Slip st in each sc around. Fasten off.
Front Curl
With F, ch 3. Row 1 (Wrong Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across—2 sc. Row 2: Turn, ch 5, 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 hdc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in last ch, skip next sc of Row 1, slip st in next sc. Fasten off.
Mustache
With F, make an adjustable ring. Round 1 (Right Side): Work 5 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc. Round 2: Ch 7, 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 3 sc in next ch, 2 hdc in next ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in last ch, skip next sc of Round 1, slip st in next sc, ch 12, begin in 2nd ch from hook, [sc3tog] twice, hdc2tog, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in last ch, skip next sc of Round 1, slip st in next sc. Fasten off.
Eyebrows (Make 2)
With F, ch 4. Row 1 (Right Side): Working in back bumps, slip st in first ch from hook, [ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in next ch of foundation ch] 3 times. Fasten off.
Beard and Hair
With F, ch 51. Round 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; join with slip st in first sc—50 sc. Round 2: [Ch 7, 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 3 sc in next ch, 2 hdc in next ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in last ch, skip next sc of Round 1, slip st in next sc] 12 times; (center of beard), [ch 12, begin in 2nd ch from hook, [sc3tog] twice, hdc2tog, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in last ch, skip next sc of Round 1, slip st in next sc] 13 times. Fasten off.
Buttons (Make 3)
With C, make an adjustable ring. Round 1 (Right Side): Work 8 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With C, sew a 3” line of back stitches from center lower edge of body upwards, to separate legs. With A, sew bottom 12 sts of each shoe to back edge of a leg. Stuff shoes. Gently curve remaining portion of each lower leg edge around sides and top of shoe and sew in place. With B, sew buttons evenly spaced up center of tunic, placing 2 buttons above belt and one below. With C, embroider a back stitch line, slightly to the left of the buttons, from lower edge to top edge of tunic. With E, sew belt buckle to center of belt. Stuff body. Stuff arms. With B, sew arms to sides of body. Arrange mustache and beard and hair on face. Place beard and hair around head and mustache beneath nose. Pin center of beard (where curls change direction) on chin directly below nose. Pin back of hair low on back of head, to allow for later placement of cap. Pin mustache above center of beard allowing space (for mouth). With F, sew mustache and beard and hair in place. Attach safety eyes above nose. With F, sew one eyebrow above each eye. Place cap on head, then pin front curl under front edge of cap. Remove cap. With F, sew front curl in place. Sew cap to head or leave unsewn, as desired. Stuff head. With B, sew head to top of body. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Blanket Brights™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Contrast A Pixie Pink (12008) 1 ball or 25 yds/23 m
Contrast B Bright Lime (12041) 1 ball or 25 yds/23 m
Contrast C Busy Blue (12005) 1 ball or 25 yds/23 m
Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Contrast D Vintage White (10006) 1 ball or 55 yds/50 m
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) Susan Bates® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
1/4" [6 mm] pair of safety eyes for each Turtle
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
gauge: 9 sc and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Rnds are worked continuously without joining unless otherwise instructed. Cont working in spiral, moving marker onto first st of each rnd for easier counting.
TURTLE
(make 1 each with A, B and C as Color 1).
Shell
See diagram on page 2.
With Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. PM. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
4th and 5th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
6th rnd: Working in front loops only, *1 hdc in each of next 3 sc. 2 hdc in next sc. Rep from * to last 5 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sc. (1 hdc. 1 sc) in last sc. Join with sl st to first hdc.
7th rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to rem loop of first sc of 5th rnd. Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around.
8th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 16 sts.
9th rnd: (Sc2tog) 8 times.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Stuff Shell.
Secure yarn tail through rem sts and pull closed.
With D, whip stitch around 7th rnd of shell and embroider spots on top of Shell as shown in photo.
Flippers (make 4)
With D, ch 5.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working in opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of last 3 ch. Fasten off.
Sew Flippers to underside of Shell at color change rnd as shown in photo.
Head
With Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. PM. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Attach pair of safety eyes as shown in photo.
5th rnd: (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sc.
6th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Stuff Head.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Sew Head to underside of Shell at color change rnd. Secure Head under rnd of hdc as well.
Attach key ring as shown in photo.

materials: RED HEART® “Soft Yarn®”: 1 ball each of 4601 Off White A, 4422 Tangerine B, 9528 Lilac C, 6768 Pink D, and 2515 Turquoise E.
Crochet Hook: 3.75mm [US F-5] and 3.25mm [US D-3] (for tooth necklace only)
small amounts of black and red pearl cotton (for facial features)
abbreviations: A, B, C, D, and E = Color a, B, C, D, and e
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: 19 sts = 4”; 20 rows = 4” in single crochet using larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
TOOTH NECKLACE
With smaller hook and D, ch 5.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 2 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 2 ch, 2 sc in last ch—10 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–5: Sc in each sc around.
Handle: Ch 45, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, slip st in 4 sc across top of tooth pocket, slip st into 45th ch. FaSTen OFF.
FRONT OF DOLL
Head
With larger hook and A, ch 10.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—9 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc across, turn—18 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, turn—21 sc.
Rows 5–15: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 16: Ch 1, [sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 3 times, turn—18 sc.
Row 17: Ch 1, *sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—9 sc.
Row 18: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; change to E in last sc, turn.
Body
Row 19: With E, ch 1, 2 sc in each sc across, turn—18 sc.
Row 20: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 21: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * across, turn—24 sc.
Start a new tradition—instead of leaving a child’s tooth under the pillow, put it in this tooth fairy’s little pouch. It makes the tooth fairy’s job so much easier.

TOOTH FAIRY DOLL | CROCHET
CROCHET  I  SKILL LEVEL: EASY
RHC0334-022512M  | LAST UPDATED: AUGUST 2019 TOOTH FAIRY DOLL | CROCHET    2 of 3
Row 22: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 23: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * across, turn—30 sc.
Rows 24–41: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 42: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—24 sc.
Row 43: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—18 sc. Fasten off.
BACK OF DOLL
Work same as front of doll, using A for head (Rows 1–18) and E for body (Rows 19–43).
Sew front to back, stuffing before sewing closed.
Headband
With E, ch 41.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—40 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, working in front loops only, slip st in each sc across (for front edge of headband). Fasten off.
Ponytail Curls (Make 11)
With B, ch 12.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—22 sc. Fasten off.
Curls for Bangs (Make 3)
With B, ch 7.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—12 sc. Fasten off. 
Sew bangs, grouped together, on center front of head. 
Wrap headband around head, covering sewn ends of 
bangs, and sew in place. Sew ponytail curls, grouped together, on top of head.
Flower (for Headband)
With D, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Work 12 sc in ring—12 sc. Do not join.
Round 2: Working in front loops only, (slip st, ch 1, hdc) in first sc, hdc in next sc, *ch 1, (slip st, ch 1, hdc) in next sc, hdc in next sc; repeat from * around—6 petals.
Round 3: Gently push petals forward and work in the unworked back loops of Round 1; (slip st, ch 1, dc) in back loop of first sc, dc in next back loop, *ch 1, (slip st, ch 1, dc) in next back loop, dc in next back loop; repeat from * around, slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.
Sew flower onto headband, at side of head.
Skirt Ruffle
With C, ch 60.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—59 sc.
Row 2 (Right Side): Ch 4 (counts as tr), working in front loops only, 2 tr in first sc, 3 tr in each remaining ch across—177 tr. Fasten off.
Skirt
With Right Side of skirt ruffle facing, join D with slip st in first unworked back loop of Row 1.
Row 1: Ch 4 (counts as tr), 2 tr in same back loop as join, working in remaining unworked back loops of skirt ruffle Row 1, 3 tr in each back loop across, turn—177 tr.
Rows 2–4: Ch 3, dc in each st across, turn.
Fasten off.
Leg (Make 2)
Beginning at foot, with A, ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 4 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 4 ch, 2 sc in last ch, turn—14 sc.
Rows 2–8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn; change to E in last sc of Row 8.
Rows 9 and 10: With E, sc in each sc across, turn; change to D in last sc of Row 10.
Rows 11 and 12: With D, sc in each sc across, turn; change to E in last sc of Row 12.
Rows 13–28: Repeat Rows 9–12 four times.
Rows 29 and 30: Repeat Rows 9 and 10.
Fasten off. Sew side edges together to form tube. Stuff leg as you sew.
Toes
Join A with slip st to inner side (seamed side) of front of foot.
Row 1: Ch 1, 2 hdc in same space as join (big toe), work [slip st, ch 1, 2 sc (for toe)] 4 times evenly spaced across bottom of foot. Fasten off.
Sew top of legs closed and sew to bottom of body, placing leg seams to inside of leg.
Arm (Make 2)
Beginning at hand, with A, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, *sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * across, turn—9 sc.
Rows 3–17: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn; change to E in last sc of Row 17.
Row 18: With E, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 19: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc across, turn—18 sc.
Row 20 (Ruffle): Ch 1, *Slip st in next sc, ch 2, skip next sc; repeat from * across. Fasten off. Sew side edges together to form tube. Stuff arm as you sew. Fold Row 20 ruffle to outside of arm and sew arms to side of body.
Top Wing (Make 2)
With A, ch 10.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next 3 ch, dc in next 3 ch, 6 dc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, dc in next 3 ch, hdc in next 3 ch, sc in next 2 ch, turn—22 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 9 sts, 2 sc in each of next 4 sts, sc in last 9 sts, turn—26 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 11 sc, 2 hdc in next 4 sc, sc in last 11 sc, turn—30 sts. Fasten off A.
Row 4: With Right Side facing, join C with slip st in back loop of first st of Row 3, working in back loops only, *ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in next sc; repeat from * across to last sc, slip st in last sc. Fasten off.
Bottom Wing (Make 2)
Work same as top wing through Row 2. Fasten off A.
Row 3: Work Row 4 of top wing. Fasten off.
Sew wings in place on back of doll. Sew bottom wings first, then sew the top wings overlapping the bottom wings slightly.
Ear (Make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn.
Row 2 (Right Side): Ch 1, slip st in each sc across. Fasten off. Sew one pearl on each ear. Sew one ear to each side of head, in front of headband.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.
Embroider Face
With small amount of black pearl cotton, embroider French Knot eyes and straight stitch eyebrows. With small amount of red pearl cotton, embroider back stitch mouth. With red crayon, gently rub color onto face for cheeks. Place tooth necklace around neck.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 360 Café Latte A, 722 Pretty in Pink B, 373 Petal Pink C, 520 Minty D, 324 Bright Yellow E, and 312 Black F
Note: Only small amounts of E and F are needed
abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E, and F = Color A, B, C, D, E, and F
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
*= repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 12 sts = 3"; 14 rows = 3" in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEAD
Beginning at nose with A, ch 2. 
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. 
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 4–7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: Sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in each of next 6 sc, sc in last 9 sc—30 sc.
Rounds 11 and 12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—36 sc.
Rounds 14 and 15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 17: Sc in each sc around.
Round 18: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 19: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 20: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Stuff head.
Round 21: Sc in each sc around.
Round 22: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through the stitches of last round and pull to gather. Weave in end securely.
Facial Features: With F, embroider satin stitch eyes and nose, and straight stitch mouth.

EAR (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of head—12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 4 times—8 sc.
Fasten off. Do not stuff ear. Flatten and sew ears to head.

BODY
Beginning at top with A, ch 6; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 2 sc in each ch around—12 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. 
Round 2: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; change to B in last st—36 sc.
Rounds 8-18: With B, sc in each sc around.
Begin stuffing body and continue to stuff until piece is complete.
Divide for Legs

First Leg
Round 19: With B, sc in next 18 sc, place a marker in the next st; leave the marked st and all remaining sts unworked—18 sc. Work in continuous rounds over the 18 sc just worked only, forming a circle for the first leg. 
Round 20: Sc in each sc around.
Round 21: Sc in each sc around; change to A in last st.
Rounds 22–30: With A, sc in each sc around.
Shape foot
Round 31: Work 2 sc in each of the first 3 sc, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in each of last 3 sc—24 sc.
Rounds 32–35: Sc in each sc around. 
Round 36: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Stuff leg.
Round 37: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through the stitches of last round and pull to gather. Weave in end securely.

Second Leg
With right side facing, join B with sc in marked st following first leg.
Round 19: Sc in each remaining unworked st following first leg.
Round 20: Sc in each sc around. 
Round 21: Sc in each sc around; change to A in last st.
Rounds 22–30: With A, sc in each sc around.
Shape foot
Round 31: Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in each of next 6 sc, sc in last 7 sc—24 sc.
Rounds 32–37: Work same as Rounds 32–37 of first leg—12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through the stitches of last round and pull to gather. Weave in end securely. 
Sew head to top of body.

ARM (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of head—12 sc.
Rounds 3–5: Sc in each sc around. 
Round 6: [Sc2tog] twice, sc in remaining 8 sc—10 sc.
Rounds 7–16: Sc in each sc around. 
Fasten off. Stuff arms and sew to body.

CROWN
With E, ch 32.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 9 ch, *slip st in next ch; ch 4, working in ch-4 just made, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch; working in foundation ch, skip next 2 ch, slip st in next ch; ch 5, working in ch-5 just made, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch; working in foundation ch, skip next 3 ch, slip st in next ch; ch 4, working in ch-4 just made, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch; working in foundation ch, skip next 2 ch, sc in each remaining ch across. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Sew ends of crown together and place crown on head in front of ears. 
If desired, sew crown permanently in place.

TOP RUFFLE
With D, ch 25.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—24 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 2, (dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in first sc, *skip next sc, slip st in next sc, ch 2, (dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next sc; repeat from * to last 2 sc, skip next sc, slip st in last sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Sew ruffle around neck of bear.

FLOWER
With C, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals).
Round 2: Working in back loops only, slip st in first sc, *ch 2, hdc in 2nd ch from hook (petal made), slip st in next sc; repeat from * around—6 petals. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Sew flower in place at center of top ruffle.

SKIRT
Beginning at waist, with C, ch 37.
Row 1 (right side): Dc in 4th ch from hook (3 skipped ch count as first dc), 2 dc in each remaining ch across, turn—68 dc. 
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), working in front loops only, dc in each dc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, working in back loops only, dc in each dc across, turn.
Rows 4 and 5: Repeat Rows 2 and 3. 
Row 6: Ch 3, working in front loops only, dc in each dc across and change to D in last st, turn.
Row 7: With D, ch 4 (counts as first tr), tr in first dc, *ch 1, 2 tr in next dc; repeat from * across working last 2 tr in top of beginning ch-3, turn.
Row 8: Ch 3, dc in each tr and ch-1 space across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Pink Scallops: Hold skirt with lower edge (Row 8) at top and with right side facing you. Working in the unworked loops of Row 5, join C with sc in first unworked loop, *skip next 2 loops, 7 tr in next loop, skip next 2 loops, sc in next loop; repeat from * across. Fasten off. 
Green Frill: Hold skirt with waist (Row 1) at top and with right side facing you. Working in the unworked loops of Row 4, join D with slip st in first unworked loop, *dc in next loop, slip st in next loop; repeat from * across. Fasten off. 
Waistband: Hold skirt with waist (Row 1) at top and right side facing you. With B, ch 25 (for first tie), working in opposite side of foundation ch at top of skirt, sc in first 2 ch, sc2tog, *sc in next 3 ch, sc2tog; repeat from * across, ch 25 (for 2nd tie). Fasten off.
Sew lower half of side edges of skirt together for back seam, leaving top half of side edges unsewn so that skirt is removable. Use the ties to tie skirt around waist of bear. Alternately, the skirt can be permanently sewn to waist.

FINISHING
Weave in any remaining ends.

materials: Bernat® Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 315 yds/288 m) Main Color (MC) Terracotta Rose (32017) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 [5 mm] crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
9mm safety eyes. Black safety nose. Stuffing. Tapestry needle.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
gauge: 12 sc and 12 rows = 4” [10 cm].
instructions:
Body
With MC, begin using magic loop method, demonstrated here. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in magic loop. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last st. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
5th – 11th rnds: As 3rd rnd.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 25 sc.
13th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc.
15th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
16th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 15 sc.
17th – 19th rnds: As 3rd rnd. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff, leaving top open.

Snout
With A, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in next ch. Working into opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Add safety nose, as pictured.

Head
With MC, begin using magic loop. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in magic loop. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first st. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last st. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last st. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last st. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th – 13th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st. around. Join with sl st to first sc.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
15th rnd: As 6th rnd.
16th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
17th rnd: As 6th rnd. 
18th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
19th rnd: As 6th rnd. Sew on snout, stuffing lightly as you work. Attach safety eyes. 
20th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
21st rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.

Arms (make 2)
With MC, begin using magic loop. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in magic loop. Work in continuous rnds without joining with sl st, and omitting starting ch at beg of rnd.
2nd – 7th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
8th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. 
9th – 14th rnds: As 2nd – 7th rnds.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff.

Ears (make 2)
With MC, begin using magic loop. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 5 sc in magic loop. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in next sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 15 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Sew ears to head.

Feet (make 2)
With A, begin using magic loop. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in magic loop. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dc in each of first 2 sts. 2 hdc in next st. 2 sc in each of next 2 sts. 2 hdc in last st. Join with sl st to first dc. 12 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last st. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc. Break A. Join MC.
4th – 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
8th – 9th rnds: As 4th and 5th rnds.
Fasten off. Stuff and sew to bottom of Body as pictured.

Tail
With MC, begin using magic loop.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in magic loop. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff and sew to back of Body as pictured.

Easy Heart Pattern
With A, ch 7.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 6 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: As 2nd row.
4th - 6th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Turn.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Do not turn.
Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around entire perimeter of heart, working (Sc. Ch 1. Sc) into bottom stitch, where slip knot is located. Join with sl st to first sc of 7th row. Fasten off. Sew to Body as pictured.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Bread (make 2)
With MC, ch 16.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. Turn. 15 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to 
end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until piece from beg 
measures 3½” [9 cm], ending on a 
WS row.
Next row: (RS). *Skip next 3 sc.  
7 dc in next sc.** Skip next 3 sc.  
Sl st in next sc. Rep from * to ** 
once more. Skip next 2 sc. Sl st in 
last sc. Do not turn.
Edging: 1st rnd: Ch 1. Work 1 rnd 
of sc evenly around Bread, having 
3 sc in each bottom corner. Join A 
with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: With A, ch 1. Work 1 sc 
in each sc around, having 3 sc in 
each corner. Join with sl st to first 
sc. Fasten off.

Lettuce
With B, ch 4. Join with sl st to form 
ring.
1st rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as 
hdc). 8 hdc in ring. Join with sl st 
to first hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as 
hdc). 2 hdc in each hdc around. 
Join with sl st to first hdc. 16 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as 
hdc). *1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in 
next hdc. Rep from * around. Join 
with sl st to first hdc. 24 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as 
hdc). *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc.  
2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 
around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 
32 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in 
first hdc. *2 dc in next hdc. 1 dc in 
next hdc. Rep from * around. Join 
with sl st to top of ch 3. 48 dc.
6th rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc 
in first dc. 3 dc in each dc around. 
Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten 
off. 144 dc.

Tomato
With C, ch 4. Join with sl st to form 
ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc 
in ring. (Ch 3. 3 dc) 3 times in ring.  
Ch 3. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
2nd rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc 
in first dc. 2 dc in each of next 2 dc.  
(Ch 3. 2 dc in each of next 3 dc) 3 times. 
Ch 3. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 
6 dc. 3 sc in next ch-3 sp) 4 times. 
Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 

Cheese
With D, ch 17.
1st row: (RS) 1 dc in 4th ch from 
hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each 
ch to end of ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc).  
1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 2. Skip 
next 2 dc. 1 dc in each dc to end of 
row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc 
in each dc to ch-2 sp. 2 dc in ch-2 
sp. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. 
Turn.
4th row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc 
in each of next 8 dc. Ch 2. Skip 
next 2 dc. 1 dc in each dc to end of 
row. Turn.
5th row: As 3rd row.
6th row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc 
in each of next 3 dc. Ch 2. Skip 
next 2 dc. 1 dc in each dc to end of 
row. Turn.
8th row: As 3rd row. Do not turn. 
Edging: Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc 
evenly around outer edge of 
Cheese, having 3 sc in each corner. 
Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: lily® sugar’n cream® (70.9 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds)
Sizes 3.5 mm (U.S. E or 4) and 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hooks
Small amount of red embroidery floss for mouth
Small amount of black embroidery floss for eyelashes
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook. 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Doll
head
With MC and smaller hook, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from 
* around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from 
* around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd 10 times more.
next rnd: Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw 
through all loops on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 
Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sts. 
next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * 
around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
Stuff Head.
next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 8 sts. Join with sl st 
to first st. Fasten off.
Stuff Head. 
Body
With MC and smaller hook, ch 30. Join in ring with sl st into first 
ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
30 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 2" [5 cm]. 
next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * 
around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 4" [10 cm]. 
next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * 
around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd twice more. Fasten off.
Sew bottom edge of Body closed. Stuff Body. 
arms (make 2).
With MC and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
10 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 tr in next sc (thumb). 
1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 8 sts. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures 4” [10 cm]. Fasten off.
Stuff Arms lightly.
legs (make 2).
shoe: With A and smaller hook, ch 5. 
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc 
in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc 
in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each 
of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 16 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each 
of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 24 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 
(Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join MC with sl st 
to first sc. Place marker at end of rnd. 21 sts. 
6th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of 
next 6 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 17 sts. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 
(Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 14 sts. 
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd until Leg from top of Shoe measures 5" [12.5 cm]. 
Fasten off.
shoe strap: Join A with sl st to 6th sc of marked rnd. Ch 5. Join 
with sl st to 13th sc of marked rnd. Fasten off. Stuff Legs.
Finishing
Sew top of Legs closed using whip st. Sew Arms and Leg to 
Body. Attach Head to top of Body. With black embroidery floss, 
embroider eyelashes on Head. Sew beads for eyes to Head. With 
red embroidery floss, embroider mouth.
hair fringe
Cut a piece of tape 6" [15 cm] long and secure onto a flat surface 
with sticky side up. Cut lengths of C 19" [48 cm] long and lay 
them across tape so strip of tape is in center of yarn. Holding 
tissue paper over top of yarn and using sewing machine, run a 
line of stitching along length of tape. Remove tape when hair is 
secure. Remove tissue paper after stitching. Pin fringe to center 
of head. Using backstitch and C, sew hair into place along sewn 
line. Braid Hair and secure at side of Head.
clothing
Dress
With larger hook and A, ch 22.
1st row: 1 sc in 5th ch from hook (button loop). 1 sc in each of 
next 17 ch. Turn. 18 sc.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 18 sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc each of next 16 sc. 2 sc in last 
sc. Turn. 20 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc each of next 18 sc. 2 sc in last 
sc. Do not turn. Join with sl st to first sc. 22 sc.
Beg working rnds: 1st rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 2 sc 
in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
6th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
7th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in each sc around. 
Join with sl st to first sc. Place marker on last st. 72 sc.
8th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
Rep last rnd until work measures 4½" [11.5 cm] from marked rnd. 
Fasten off.
sleeves (make 2).
With larger hook and A, ch 10. Join with sl st to first ch to form 
ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
10 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 15 sc.
5th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 12 sts.
7th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
8th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 9 sts.
9th to 13th rnds: As 2nd rnd. Fasten off after last rnd.
Put Dress on Doll. Put Sleeves on Arms and mark placement 
on Dress. Sew Sleeves to Dress. Sew button to back of Dress to 
correspond with button loop.
apron
With larger hook and B, ch 101.
1st row: (Waistband/Ties). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each 
ch across. Fasten off. 100 sc.
2nd row: (Apron). Join B with sl st to 46th sc from end. Ch 1. 2 sc 
in same sp as last sl st. 2 sc in each of next 9 sc. turn. Leave rem 
sts unworked.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn. 20 sc.
Rep last row until Apron measures 3½" [9 cm] from beg. Fasten 
off.
Tie Apron at Doll’s waist. Wrap remaining Ties over Doll’s 
shoulders from back to front. Tuck ends of Ties into Waistband 
as pictured.
Buckle (make 2).
With smaller hook and D, ch 2. 
1st rnd: (1 sc. Ch 1) 4 times in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st 
to first sc. Fasten off.
Sew one Buckle to side of each Shoe as shown in picture.
Bonnet
With larger hook and B, ch 31.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. Turn. 
30 sc.
2nd to 11th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
12th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. (Sc2tog) 5 times. 1 sc 
in each of next 10 sc. Turn. 25 sts.
13th row: As 2nd row.
14th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. (Draw up a loop in each 
of next 3 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - sc3tog 
made) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Do not turn. Join with sl 
st to first sc. 19 sts.
Beg working in rnds: 1st rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 
6 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 15 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of 
next 6 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 13 sts. Fasten off.
Sew opening at back of Bonnet closed.
Fold Bonnet brim back approx 1½" [4 cm]. Attach 7" [18 cm] 
piece of ribbon to each side at fold as shown in picture.

pattern_name: I WANT TO BELIEVE CROCHET UFO STUFFIE
materials: Bernat® Baby Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Contrast A Black Bear (04828) 1 ball or 96 yds/88 m
Contrast B Misty Jungle Green (04801) 1 ball or 44 yds/41 m
Contrast C Lovely Blue (04793) 1 ball or 15 yds/14 m
Bernat® Baby Blanket Sparkle™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Contrast D Moonlight Sparkle (71001) 1 ball or 15 yds/14 m
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Popcorn = Work 3 hdc into next stitch. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back into first hdc of 3 hdc group. Pull dropped loop through st. Ch 1 to secure popcorn.
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Join each rnd with sl st to first st.
• When working 2 colors in same rnd, carry color not in use loosely on WS of work.

BOTTOM
With A, ch 2.
**1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
7th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.**





8th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
9th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sc.
10th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sc.
11th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 66 sc.
12th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 72 sc.
13th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 11 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 78 sc.
14th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 84 sc.
Fasten off.
TOP
With B, ch 2.
Rep from ** to ** as given for Bottom.
8th to 14th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. 42 sc. 
Break B and join C at end of 14th rnd.
15th rnd: With C, working in front loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.
16th rnd: Join A with sl st to first sc of 14th rnd. Working in back loops only, *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
17th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sc.
18th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sc.
19th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. With D, Popcorn in next sc. With A, 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 66 sts.
20th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 10 sts. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 72 sc.
21st rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 11 sc. (1 sc. With D, Popcorn) all in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 78 sts.
22nd rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 2 sc in next Popcorn. Rep from * around. Join. 84 sc.
Fasten off.

Assembly: With Top and Bottom held WS tog, join C with sl st.
Joining rnd:  Ch 1. Working in back loops only and through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.

ANTENNA
With D, ch 5.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Popcorn in last ch.
Fasten off.

Sew Antenna to top of UFO as shown in photo.
With A and using Back St, embroider mouth onto UFO as shown in photo.
With A and B and using Satin St, embroider eyes onto UFO as shown in photo.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g ; 120 yds/109 m) Main Color (MC) Soft Ecru (01004) 1 ball
Lily Sugar’n Cream Denims (2.5 oz/70.9 g ; 120 yds/109 m) Contrast D Indigo (01114) 1 ball
Size U.S. E or 4 (3.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of red embroidery floss for mouth.
Small amount of black embroidery floss for shirt buttons.
Small amount of Contrast E (00084 Sage Green) for Flower stems.
gauge: 16 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
First Leg
Note: Stuff Legs as you work.
**Shoe: With A, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first s c. 1 s c in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first s c. 1 s c in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Y oh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog made) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. 21 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 17 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join MC with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
8th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off. Stuff Shoe.
Pant Cuff: With D, ch 21. Join with sl st to first ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Do not break D.
Attach Pant Cuff to Leg: 1st rnd: Align Pant Cuff over Leg, having Cuff on outside of Leg. With D, ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until Leg from top of Shoe measures 6" [15 cm]. Fasten off. Stuff Leg.
Second Leg
Work as given for First Leg. Do not fasten off. Cont as follows for Body:
BODY
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc of Second Leg. 1 sc in 14 sc of First Leg. 1 sc in each of last 7 sc of Second Leg. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join B with sl st to first sc.
8th rnd: With B, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures 4½" [11.5 cm]. Fasten off. Stuff Arms lightly.
HAIR
With A, work from ** to ** as given for Head.
Work 3 rnds even.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 26 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
Next 2 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 26 sc. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
Rep last row 4 times more. 16 sts at end of last row. Fasten off.
Sew Hair to Head. With A, embroider ‘bangs’.
BOW TIE
With C, ch 5.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Turn. 1 st.
4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. Turn. 2 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. 4 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew Bow Tie to front of Body as shown in picture.
FINISHING
Attach Arms to sides of Body. Sew beads to front of Head for eyes. With red embroidery floss, embroider mouth. With black embroidery floss, embroider shirt buttons using bullion st.
FLOWERS (make 3).
Stem: With E, ch 9. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each ch to end of ch. Fasten off.
Flower: With C, *Ch 6. Sl st in 6th ch from hook. Rep from * 4 times more. Fasten off. Attach Flower to Stem.
Tie Flowers into a bouquet and attach to hand as shown in picture.
ABBREVIATIONS: www.yarnspirations.com
Rep last rnd 4 times more, joining A at end of last rnd.
Belt: Next rnd: With A, ch 2 (does not count as hdc). 1 hdc in each sc around. Join B with sl st to first hdc.
Shirt: Next rnd: With B, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in first hdc. *1 sc in each of next 6 hdc. 2 sc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 6 hdc. 1 sc in each of last 6 hdc. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 4 times more.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sts.
Next 3 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
Next 3 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc. Fasten off.
HEAD
**With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.**
Rep last rnd 10 times more.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
Stuff Head.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 8 sts. Fasten off.
ARMS (make 2).
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 tr in next sc (thumb). 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.

materials: Anchor® Embroidery Floss™ (9 yds/8 m) 1211 or 1207 2 skeins or 18 yds/16 m for each color
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) Susan Bates® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
measurements: Approx 2" [5 cm] long x 1½" [4 cm] around.
gauge: 28 sc and 28 rows = 4"[10cm].
instructions:
Note: Legwarmers are worked sideways. 
Ch 20 loosely. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 19 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row 10 times more. 
Joining row: Fold Legwarmer lengthwise and sl st foundation chain and last row tog. Fasten off.

pattern_name: I Want a Hippopotamus for Christmas
materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein in each of 512 Turqua A, 316 Soft White B, 319 Cherry Red C, and 706 Perfect Pink D
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 3.5mm [US E-4], 3.75mm [US F-5], and 4mm [US G-6]
Susan Bates® split lock stitch markers
Susan Bates® Easy Pom Pon Maker, 1¾" (4.5 cm) diameter
Yarn needle, tapestry needle, 1 pair 8mm post-and-washer safety eyes, plush stuffing, flexible drinking straw for candy cane insert
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: 22 sc = 4" (10 cm); 20 sc rows = 4" (10 cm) using F hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size needles to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
NOTES
1. This huggable hippo with removable hat is made of individual parts that are worked in the round and then sewn together.
2. Mark first stitch of first round for each piece, then move marker up as rounds are completed.
3. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color.
4. Only a small scrap of color D will be used. Any scrap of a similarly colored yarn would work just as well.

SPECIAL TECHNIQUE 
Magic ring: Wrap yarn around your left middle finger twice, leaving a 6" (15 cm) tail. Insert hook under both strands, and pull up a loop. Ch 1, and begin working directly into center of ring. This ring can be tightened later by pulling on the yarn tail.

SPECIAL STITCH
St2tog = Stitch 2 together: This is similar to a sc2tog (single crochet 2 together), but with a small difference that makes it nearly invisible. Insert hook through front loop of 1st st, then 2nd st to be decreased without performing a yarn-over in between, then yarn over and pull up a loop through both front-loops. Yarn over and draw remaining 2 loops on hook.

ARMS (make 2)
With B, create a magic ring.
Round 1: With size F hook, ch 1, 6 sc in ring, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2:  Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc – 12 sc.
Fasten off.
Join A with slip st in back loop of any sc.
From this point, work in unjoined rounds as follows:
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in back loop of same sc and of each sc around.
Rounds 4-9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: [Sc in each of next 4 sc, st2tog over next 2 sc] twice – 10 sc.
Rounds 11-16: Sc in each sc around.
Stuff bottom ⅔ of Arm.
Hold top of Arm closed and seam by working sc in each of next 5 sc and going through both layers of fabric.
Fasten off.

BODY
With A, create a magic ring, and work in unjoined rounds as follows:
Round 1: With size F hook, ch 1, 6 sc in ring.
Round 2:  2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3:  * Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 4:  * Sc in each of next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 5:  * Sc in each of next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 6:  * Sc in each of next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Round 7:  * Sc in each of next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 42 sts.
Rounds 8-18:  Sc in each sc around.
Round 19:  * Sc in each of next 5 sc, st2tog over next 2 sc; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Round 20:  Sc in each sc around.
Round 21:  * Sc in each of next 4 sc, st2tog over next 2 sc; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 22:  Sc in each sc around.
Round 23:  * Sc in each of next 3 sc, st2tog over next 2 sc; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 24 (arm joining round): Holding first Arm against topmost round, join by working sc in each of next 5 sc and going through both layers of fabric, sc in each of next 8 sc on Body, join second Arm same as first Arm, sc in each of last 6 sc on Body.
Round 25:  Sc in each sc around.
Round 26:  * Sc in each of next 2 sc, st2tog over next 2 sc; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 27:  Sc in each sc around.
Round 28: Sc in each of next 2 sts, hdc in the next 9 sts, sc in each of last 7 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing head to neck. Stuff piece firmly and set aside.

HEAD
Note: Head is worked from the snout upwards.
Using A and size F hook, ch 4.
Round 1: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each of next 2 ch, rotate piece 180 degrees, working in unused loops at opposite side of foundation ch work 2 sc in each of next 3 ch, join with slip st in first sc – 12 sc.
From this point, work in unjoined rounds as follows:
Round 2: * Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 3: * Sc in each of next 2 sc, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 4: * Sc in each of next 3 sc, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 5: * Sc in each of next 4 sc, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Round 6-10: Sc in each sc around.
Round 11: * Sc in each of next 4 sc, st2tog over next 2 sc; repeat from * around – 30 sc.
Round 12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: * Sc in each of next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 36 sc.
Round 14: * 2 sc in next st, sc in each of next 17 sc; repeat from * once more – 38 sts.
Round 15-19: Sc in each sc around.
Round 20: * St2tog over next 2 sc, sc in each of next 17 sc; repeat from * once more – 36 sc.
Round 21: * Sc in each of next 4 sc, st2tog over next 2 sc; repeat from * around – 30 sc.
Place eyes on or near Round 15, spaced about 7 sts apart, making certain they are parallel to the straight snout seam created by Round 1. Stuff piece firmly. Continue stuffing as further rounds are completed.
Round 22: * Sc in each of next 3 sts, st2tog over next 2 sc; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 23: * Sc in each of next 2 sts, st2tog over next 2 sc; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Rounds 24 and 25:  * Sc in next sc, st2tog over next 2 sc; repeat from * around – 8 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Finish stuffing top of piece. Weave yarn tail through sts of final round and pull tight to close hole.

EARS (make 2)
With A, create a magic ring, and work in unjoined rounds as follows:
Round 1: With size F hook, ch 1, 6 sc in ring.
Round 2:  2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing to head.

LEGS (make 2)
With B, create a magic ring.
Round 1: With size F hook, 6 sc in ring, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: * Sc in each of next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 15 sc.
Fasten off B.
Join A with slip st in back loop of any sc. From this point, work in unjoined rounds as follows:
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in back loop of same sc and of each sc around.
Round 5-7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: St2tog over next 2 sc, sc in each of next 13 sc – 14 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: St2tog over next 2 sc, sc in each of next 12 sc – 13 sc.
Round 11-18: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing to body. Stuff piece firmly and set aside.

HAT
Band
Using B and size G hook, ch 4.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end – 3 sc.
Row 2-28:  Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc across.
Hold short edges of Band together and seam by working slip st in back loop of each of next 3 sc and going through both layers of fabric. Do not fasten off.
Crown
Round 1: Working in edge sts of Band, ch 1, sc in same st and in each of next 27 edge sts, join with slip st in first sc – 28 sc.
Fasten off.
Join C with slip st in back loop of any sc.
Round 2 (ear hole round): Ch 1, sc in back loop of same sc, [sc in back loop of each of next 6 sc, ch 3, skip 3 sc] twice, sc in back loop of each of last 9 sts, join with slip st in first sc.
From this point, work in unjoined rounds as follows:
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same sc and in each st around including ch sts – 28 sc.
Round 4: * St2tog over next 2 sc, sc in each of next 5 sc; repeat from * around – 24 sc.
Round 5: * St2tog over next 2 sc, sc in each of next 4 sc; repeat from * around – 20 sc.
Round 6: * St2tog over next 2 sc, sc in each of next 3 sc; repeat from * around – 16 sc.
Round 7: * St2tog over next 2 sc, sc in each of next 6 sc; repeat from * once more – 14 sc.
Round 8: * St2tog over next 2 sc, sc in each of next 12 sc – 13 sts.
Rounds 9-17: * St2tog over next 2 sc, sc in each sc to end – 4 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave yarn tail through sts of final round and pull tight to close hole.
Pompom
With B, make a pompom and sew to tip of Hat.

HEART
With C and size E hook, ch 2.
Round 1: Skip 1 ch, working over yarn tail, work (2 dc, 2 hdc, 1 dc, 2 hdc, 2 dc, slip st) in 2nd ch from hook.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing to Body.
Pull beginning yarn tail tight to close hole.

CANDY CANE
With B, create a magic ring, and work in unjoined rounds as follows:
Round 1:  With size F hook, ch 1, 6 sc in ring.
Round 2:  Sc in each sc around.
[Change to C and work 2 rounds evenly in sc, change to B and work 2 rounds evenly in sc] twice.
Change to C.
Next 2 rounds: Sc in each of next 2 sc, hdc in each of next next 2 sc, sc in each of last 2 sc.
Change to B.
Work 6 more rounds evenly in sc, keeping with striping pattern (2 rounds per color).
Fasten off, leaving a long tail of B.
Cut length of straw so that the bendable portion fits inside the bend created by hdc sts. Insert straw and trim excess. Weave yarn tail through sts of final round and pull tight to close hole.

FINISHING
Using yarn end from neck area of body, (round 28) and a tapestry needle, begin sewing at the back of the head on the underside at Round 13. Note: May need to adjust head due to the elongated shape of head. Knot securely and fasten off, trimming yarn end.
Sew Legs to bottom of Body with their tops just touching, making certain that the color change jogs face backwards.
Sew heart to upper midsection of Body.
Sew Candy Cane to end of Arm using yarn scrap.
With D and yarn needle, embroider an X for each nostril, spaced about 7 sts apart.
Fold Ears in half and sew to Head 6 rounds back from eyes, spaced about 10 sts apart.
Place Hat on Head fitting ears through the ear holes. Do not sew Hat to Head.
Weave in all loose ends, working them to inside of Hippo.

materials: Simply Soft (170 g/6. oz;288 m/315 yds) B White (9701) 1

Simply Soft Paints (113 g/4. oz;190 m/208 yds) MC Oceana (0006) 2
