instructions:
Note: Do not join at end of rnds. Work in spiral in continuous rnds. Move marker onto first st at beg of each rnd.

CHICKEN
Body
With A, ch 2. See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. PM on first st. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
7th and 8th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
9th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
10th and 11th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
12th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 24 sc.

13th and 14th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
15th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
16th and 17th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Stuff Body firmly and attach safety eyes.
18th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 12 sc.
19th and 20th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
21st rnd: (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving long end. Draw end through rem sts.

Comb
With B, ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. *Sl st in next ch. Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Sl st in same ch at last sl st. Rep from * twice more.
Fasten off. Sew Comb to top of head.

Wings and Tail (make 3 alike)
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. PM on first st. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in next sc. *(1 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc) all in next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * once more. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc) all in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc.
Fasten off. Sew Wings and Tail to Body as shown in photo.

Legs (make 2)
With C, ch 7.
1st row: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Fasten off. Sew Legs to Body as shown in photo.

With C, embroider Beak with satin stitch as shown in photo.

abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 16 sc and 18 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook.
instructions:
HEAD
With MC and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd 10 times more.
Next rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 32 sts.
Approx = Approximate(ly)
Beg = Beginning
Ch = Chain(s)
Dc = Double crochet
Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Rem = Remain(ing)
Rep = Repeat
Rnd(s) = Round(s)
RS = Right side
Sc = Single crochet
Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Sl st = Slip stitch
St(s) = Stitch(es)
Tr = Treble crochet
Y oh = Yarn over hook
EASTER LILY CROCHET DOLL
Next rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 16 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.
BODY
With MC, ch 30. Join with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 2" [5 cm].
Next rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
Next rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 4" [10 cm].
Next rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
Next rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd twice more. Fasten off.
Sew bottom edge of Body closed. Stuff Body.
ARMS (make 2).
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 tr in next sc (thumb). 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sts.
7th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures 4" [10 cm]. Fasten off. Stuff Arms lightly.
LEGS (make 2).
Shoe: With A, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd:  Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join MC with sl st to first sc. Place marker at end of rnd. 21 sts.
6th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. 17 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
8th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until Leg from marked rnd measures 5" [12.5 cm]. Fasten off.
Shoe strap:  Join A with sl st to 6th sc of marked rnd. Ch 5. Join with sl st to 13th sc of marked rnd. Fasten off.
BUNNY HAT
With A and larger hook, ch 34.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 33 sc.
2nd to 8th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
9th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) twice. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 30 sts.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
11th row:  Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * to end of row. 20 sts.
12th row: As 10th row.
13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. (Sc2tog) 6 times. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Turn. 14 sts.
14th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Sew back of Hat closed.
Hat Neckband: 1st row: With RS of Hat facing, join A with sl st to bottom corner of Hat. Ch 1. Work 32 sc evenly along bottom straight edge of Hat. Ch 5. Sl st in last sc worked (button loop made). Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. 36 sc. Fasten off. Sew button to correspond to button loop.
EARS (make 2)
With A and smaller hook, ch 4.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc.
3rd to 10th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
11th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.
12th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
13th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Do not fasten off. Ch 1. Working around outside edge of Ear, work 1 rnd sc, having 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Attach Ears to top of Bunny Hat as shown in picture.
DRESS
Note: Ch 2 does not count as hdc at beg of rnd or row.
With A and larger hook, ch 27. Join with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 27 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. 2 dc in each sc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 54 dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
4th to 6th rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as last sl st. Hdc2tog. *1 hdc in next st. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 36 sts.
8th and 9th rnds:  Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
10th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as last sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Hdc2tog. *1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 30 sts. 
Next row:  Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as last sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join B with sl st to first hdc. 24 sts.
11th rnd:  With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Rep last rnd twice more.
Beg working in rows:
1st to 3rd rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 24 hdc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Ch 4. Join with sl st to last hdc (button loop made). Fasten off. Sew button to correspond to button loop.
BELLY
With MC and larger hook, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 3 hdc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in next ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sts.
2nd rnd:  Ch 2. 2 hdc in first sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. 2 dc in each of next 3 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. 2 hdc in each of last 2 sts. Join with sl st to first hdc. 16 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sts. 2 dc in each of next 4 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sts. 2 hdc in each of last 3 sts. Join with sl st to first hdc. 24 sts. Fasten off. Sew Belly to front of Dress as shown in picture.
BASKET
With B and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd:  Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. Working through both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd twice more.
Handle: Ch 7. Miss next 8 sc. Join with sl st to next sc. Turn. Sl st in each ch to end of ch. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
EGGS (make 2)
With smaller hook and small amount of contrast yarn, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:  (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc.
3rd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Stuff Egg lightly.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 4 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 4 sts. Fasten off leaving a long end. Thread end through rem loops and draw up securely.
FINISHING
Hair fringe:  Cut a piece of tape 5" [12.5 cm] long and secure onto a flat surface with sticky side up. Cut lengths of B 11" [28 cm] long and lay them across tape so strip of tape is in center of yarn. Holding tissue paper over top of yarn and using sewing machine, run a line of stitching along length of tape. Remove tape and tissue paper when hair is secure. Pin fringe to center of head. Using backstitch and B, sew hair into place along sewn line. Rep previous steps with 2" [5 cm] piece of tape and 20" [51 cm] lengths of yarn. Pin to front of hair-line to create bangs.
Sew Head to Body. Sew top of Legs closed using whip st. Sew to bottom of Body as shown in picture. Attach Arms to sides of Body. With black embroidery floss, embroider eyelashes. Sew beads to front of Head for eyes. With red embroidery floss, embroider mouth.

instructions:
Notes: 
• Join with sl st to first sc at end of each rnd.
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook. Draw loop of next color through 2 loops on hook to complete stitch and proceed in next color.
• When working rounds with color changes, carry color not in use loosely along top of previous round, towards WS of work and work stitches over yarn to prevent stranding.

HEAD
See diagram on page 5.
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 10 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
5th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
7th to 10th rnds: As 3rd rnd.

CHEEKS
See diagram on page 5.
Note: When working following rnds, carry color not in use loosely along top of previous rnd, towards WS of work and work sts over yarn to prevent stranding.
1st rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. With B, (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 9 times. 2 sc in next sc. With A, 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 50 sc.
2nd rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 29 sc. With A, 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join.
3rd rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. With B, sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 25 sc. Sc2tog. With A, 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 48 sts.
4th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. With B, sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 21 sc. Sc2tog. With A, 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 46 sts.
5th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts. With B, (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) twice. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) twice. Sc2tog. With A, 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 40 sts.
6th rnd: With A, ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Sc2tog. With B, sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog. With A, sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join. 32 sts.
7th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
Fasten off leaving a long end to sew Head to Body during Finishing.

EARS (make 2)
Outer Ear
See diagram on page 5.
With A, ch 10. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts) twice. Join. 8 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts) twice. Join. 6 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Join. 4 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Join. Fasten off.

Inner Ear
See diagram on page 5. 
With B, ch 5.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog.
Fasten off, leaving long tail.
Using long tail, sew Inner Ear to one side of Outer Ear.

BODY
See diagram on page 6.
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 10 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 50 hdc.
7th and 8th rnds: As 5th rnd.
9th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 18 sc. With A, 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. Join.
10th and 11th rnds: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 20 sc. With A, 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Join.
12th rnd: With A, ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. With B, sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. Sc2tog. With A, 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Sc2tog. Join. 46 sts.
13th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 14 sts. With B, 1 sc in each of next 18 sts. With A, 1 sc in each of next 14 sts. Join.
14th rnd: With A, ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) twice. With B, sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. With A, (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog) twice. Join. 38 sts.
15th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. With B, 1 sc in each of next 14 sts. With A, 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. Join.
16th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. With B, sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Sc2tog. With A, 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Join. 36 sts.
17th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. With B, 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. With A, 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. Join.
18th rnd: With A, ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. With B, sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog. With A, 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Sc2tog. Join. 32 sts.
19th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 11 sts. With B, 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. With A, 1 sc in each of next 11 sts. Join. Break B.
20th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off.
Stuff Body.

TAIL
See diagram on page 6.
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd to 9th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
10th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc) twice. Join. 18 sts.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
12th to 15th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
16th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc) twice. Join. 16 sts.
17th to 26th rnds: As 11th rnd.
Fasten off at end of last rnd, leaving a long tail to sew to Body during Finishing.
Stuff just end of Tail (approx 3" [7.5 cm]) lightly.
Sew Tail closed along last rnd.

ARMS (make 2)
See diagram on page 6.
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd to 12th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off at end of last rnd, leaving a long tail.
Stuff Arm very lightly.
Sew Arm closed along last rnd.

FINISHING
Notes:
• Safety eyes cannot be moved once they are properly attached. It’s best to make sure you’re happy with eye placement using stitch markers before inserting them.
• Eyes on sample are positioned along 1st row of Cheeks, approx 9 sc in from each side, with approx 6 sc between eyes.
Mark eye placement with stitch markers. Following manufacturer’s instructions, attach Safety Eyes at markers.
Stuff Head, placing slightly more stuffing in Cheeks.
With black worsted weight yarn, embroider nose and mouth as shown in photo.
Making sure front of Head is centered to front of Body, attach by sewing last rnd of Head to Body through front loops of 19th rnd.
Pin Ears into place at top of Head and sew into place.
Sew Arms to either side of Body, approx 1" [2.5 cm] from Belly, with top of Arm at Neck.
Pin Tail into place at center back. Sew into place along bottom and sides to neck allowing stuffed portion of Tail to be free and floppy, and sewing through just the bottom layer of Tail.

STRAWBERRY
See diagram on page 4.
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 8 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
8th rnd: As 6th rnd.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
Fasten off.
With B, embroider ‘seeds’ using straight st around sides of Strawberry.

STRAWBERRY TOP
With D, ch 2.
1st rnd: 9 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 18 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *(Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. Skip next sc. Sl st in next sc) – Leaf made. Rep from * around, ending with sl st in same sc as beg ch 3. Fasten off.

Stem
With D, ch 5.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Fasten off, leaving a tail approx 5" [12.5 cm] long.
Thread tail end through center of Top and secure on WS.
Stuff Strawberry. Sew Top to Strawberry, aligning sts of 3rd rnd of Top to last rnd of Strawberry.
Attach Strawberry to ‘hands’ at front as shown in photo, bringing yarn through just bottom layer of Arms and through sides of Strawberry.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Sizes U.S. G/6 (4 mm) and U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 2½" [6 cm] in diameter x 3½" [9 cm] tall.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Each Cupcake uses 3 different shades. Choose any combination from the shades listed.
Beg at base of Cupcake, with smaller hook and Color 1, ch 2. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd:  Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th to 8th rnds:  Ch 3 (does not count as st). (1 dcfp around next st. 1 dcbp around next st) 12 times. Join with sl st to top of 1st dcfp.
9th rnd:  Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sl st in each st around. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.
10th rnd:  Join Color 2 with sl st to any rem back loop of 8th rnd. Ch 1. Working in back loops only, *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join color 3 with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
11th rnd:  With Color 3, ch 1. Working in both loops, *2 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to last st. 2 sc in last st. Do not join. 30 sts.
12th rnd:  Working in back loops only, *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Do not join. 24 sts. Stuff Cupcake.
13th rnd:  Working in back loops only, *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Do not join. 18 sts.
14th rnd:  Working in back loops only, *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Do not join. 12 sts.
15th to 17th rnds:  Working in back loops only, *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Do not join. 3 sts at end of 17th rnd.
Fasten off.
Icing Edging
1st rnd:  With larger hook, join Color 3 with sl st to first rem front loop of 12th rnd. Working in front loops only, sl st in each sc around, working in a spiral continuously to top of Cupcake.
Fasten off.
Optional: Sew beads to Icing for 'sprinkles'.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream (Solids 2.5 oz/70.9 g; Ombres 2 oz/56.7 g)
2 balls Main Color (MC) and small amount of Contrast A
Size 5 mm (U.S. H/8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Ribbon 14 ins [35.5 cm] long, ¼ ins [1 cm] wide
measurements: Duck toy measures approximately 10 inches long.
gauge: 18 sc and 20 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]
instructions:
(Make 2 pieces alike). With MC, ch 11.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Rep last row 3 times more.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Rep last row 6 times more.

Tail: Next row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog made. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. Fasten off.

Head
With WS of work facing, join MC with ss to first st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 3 sc in first st. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each sc to last st. 2 sc in last st. 10 sc. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Ch 2. Turn.
Next row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last 2 rows twice more.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. Sc3tog over next 3 sts. Fasten off.

Joining Back and Front: Place Back and Front tog. Join MC with ss to first ch of foundation ch, working through both thicknesses. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as first ss. 1 sc in each sp around, working 3 sc in top of Tail and point of nose. Stuff lightly before closing up duck. Join with ss to first sc.
Fasten off. With A, embroider eye as illustrated. Tie ribbon around neck.

materials: RED HEART® Amigurumi™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 239 yds/219 m) - 1 ball makes 2 toys
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Version 1: Blue as Color 1, Pink as Color 2, Purple as Color 3.
Version 2: Orange as Color 1, Purple as Color 2, Pink as Color 3.
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
Body: With Color 1, ch 5.
1st rnd: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 5 sc in last ch. Working into opposite side of foundation chain, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Join. 14 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 3 sc in last sc. Join. 18 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 22 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 26 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join. 34 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join. 38 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 18 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join. 42 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 20 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 7 sc. Join. 46 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 22 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 8 sc. Join. 50 sc.
11th to 22nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 45 sts.
24th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.
25th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sts.
26th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sts.
Do not fasten off.
Arms: 1st rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Ch 25. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 23 ch. Sl st in next st of last rnd of Body. Turn. Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 21 sc of Arm. Sl st in each of last 3 sc. Turn. Ch 1. Skip first sl st. 1 sl st in each of next 5 sts. 1 sc in each of next 18 sc. Do not turn. Sl st in next st of last rnd of Body. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * 7 times more. Join.
Fasten off.
Secure safety eyes as shown in picture. Stuff body firmly with stuffing.
Underbody: 1st rnd: With Color 2, ch 2. 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc.
Suction Cups: 5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Ch 25. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 23 ch. Sl st in next sc of last rnd of Underbody. Turn. Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc of Suction Cups. Ch 2. 1 sc in next sc) 10 times. 1 sc in next sc. Sl st in each of last 3 sc. Turn. Ch 1. Skip first sl st. 1 sl st in each of next 4 sts. Skip next ch-2. 1 sl st in next sc. (1 sc in next sc. Skip next ch-2. 1 sc in next sc) 9 times. Do not turn. Sl st in next st of last rnd of Underbody. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * 7 times more. Join.
Assembly: With WS of Arms and Underbody Suction Cups held together, join Color 3 with sl st in any st. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, sc evenly around all Arms of Octopus, having 6 sc in each tip of the Arms. Join.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 3.5 mm [US E-4]
abbreviations: A, B, C, and D = Color A, Color B, Color C, and Color D
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 21 sts = about 4" [10 cm]; 25 rounds = about 4" [10 cm] in single crochet (sc). EXACT GAUGE IS NOT CRITICAL TO THIS PROJECT. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BODY/HEAD
With first color in chosen colorway, ch 3; slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 8 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—8 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 4 times—12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 3 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st—16 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 4 times—20 sc.
Round 5: Sc in next 2 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 3 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts—24 sc.
Round 6: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 4 times—28 sc.
Round 7: Sc in next 3 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts] 3 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts—32 sc.
Round 8: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts] 4 times—36 sc.
Round 9: Sc in next 4 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts] 3 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts—40 sc.
Round 10: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts] 4 times—44 sc.
Round 11: Sc in next 5 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts] 3 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts—48 sc.
Round 12: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 11 sts] 4 times—52 sc.
Round 13: Sc in next 6 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 12 sts] 3 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts—56 sc.
Round 14: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 13 sts] 4 times—60 sc.
Rounds 15–21: Sc in each st around.
Round 22: Sc in next 4 sts, [sc2tog, sc in next 8 sts] 5 times, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts—54 sc.
Round 23: [Sc2tog, sc in next 7 sts] 6 times—48 sc.
Round 24: Sc in next 3 sts, [sc2tog, sc in next 6 sts] 5 times, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts—42 sc.
Round 25: [Sc2tog, sc in next 5 sts] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 26: Sc in next 2 sts, [sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts] 5 times, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts—30 sc.
Round 27: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 28: Sc in next st, [sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts] 5 times, sc2tog, sc in next st—18 sc.
Stuff body.
Round 29: [Sc2tog] 9 times—9 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Secure tail and weave to inside of body.

BEAK
With second color in chosen colorway, ch 3; slip st in first ch to form a ring. 
Round 1: Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 3 times; join with slip st in first sc—9 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] twice, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Rounds 4–6: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Stuff lightly.

TAIL
With second color in chosen colorway, ch 3.
Row 1: Work 3 dc in 3rd ch from hook. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, [ch 7, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 5 ch, sc in next st] twice, ch 7, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 5 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

HEAD FEATHERS
Work with second color in chosen colorway.
Row 1: [Ch 11, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 9 ch] 3 times.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

EYES (make 2 for each bird)
With A, ch 3; slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. 
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with sl st in first sc—12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Pupil: With D, embroider a pupil in center of eye.

EYEBROW
With D, ch 5.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

BELLY
With D, ch 3; slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. 
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 5 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

WINGS/FEET (make 4 for each bird – 2 for wings and 2 for feet)
With A, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in each st across—6 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 
Row 5: Ch 2, turn, dc in first st, [ch 2, slip st in next st, ch 2, dc in next st] twice, ch 2, slip st in last st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide to placement, use yarn tails or yarn scraps to sew the following pieces together.
1. Sew head feathers to top of head.
2. Sew eyes to front of head.
3. Sew eyebrow above eyes.
4. Sew beak below eyes.
5. Sew belly below beak.
6. Sew tail to lower back of body.
7. Sew wings to sides of body.
8. Sew feet to bottom of body.
Weave in and trim any remaining ends.

materials: Bernat® Baby Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 492 yds/450 m) Main Color (MC) Potpourri (86029) 1 ball
Size U.S. D/3 (3.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.

Small amount of black worsted weight yarn for embroidery.
abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 10" x [25.5 cm] tall x 9" [23 cm] diameter, excluding limbs.
gauge: 18 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:

• To change colors, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed.
BODY
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook, placing marker on /f_i rst st for beg of rnd. Do not join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
4th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sc.
5th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.
7th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 56 sc.
8th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 64 sc.
9th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 72 sc.
10th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
11th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 80 sc.
12th rnd: *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * around. 88 sc.
13th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
14th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 96 sc.
15th rnd: *2 sc in /f_i rst sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 104 sc.
16th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
17th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 112 sc.
18th rnd: *2 sc in /f_i rst sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * around. 120 sc.
19th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Place 2nd marker at end of rnd – do not move 2nd marker each rnd.
Rep last rnd until work from 2nd marker measures 4" [10 cm].
Shape top as follows:
1st rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * around. 112 sc.
2nd to 4th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * around. 104 sc.
6th to 8th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
9th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 96 sc.
10th and 11th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
12th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Rep from * around. 88 sc.
13th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
14th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * around. 80 sc.
15th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
16th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 72 sc.
17th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
18th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 64 sc.
19th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
20th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 56 sc.
21st rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
22nd rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.
23rd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
24th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
Insert safety eyes. Stuff Body and Head.
25th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
26th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sc.
27th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
28th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 16 sc.
29th rnd: *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 8 sc. Fasten oﬀ leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts and fasten securely.
EARS (make 4).
With MC, ch 10.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. 9 sc. Turn.
2nd and alt rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. 7 sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. 5 sc. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. 3 sc. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Fasten oﬀ .
Join Ears: Hold 2 Ears tog with WS facing each other. Join MC with sl st through both thicknesses to bottom right corner of Ears.
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 8 sc evenly up right side of Ear to corner. 3 sc in corner. Work 8 sc evenly down left side of Ear. Fasten oﬀ .
SNOUT
With MC, ch 5. Working in spiral as given for Body, proceed as follows:
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working across opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in /f_i rst sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: 1 sc in /f_i rst sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 22 sc.
4th rnd: Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around.
5th to 7th rnds: Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten oﬀ .
Stuﬀ Snout lightly.
HOOVES (make 4)
With A, ch 2.
Working in spiral as for Body, proceed as follows:
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Place marker on last st for beg of rnd. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
3rd rnds: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
4th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around.
6th and 7th rnds: Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around.
8th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
9th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
10th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Break A. 16 sc.
Join MC with sl st to back loop only of any sc.
11th rnd: With MC, and working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around.
12th to 15th rnds: Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten oﬀ .
Stuﬀ Hoof lightly.
Create cloven hoof: Thread yarn needle with length of A. Draw yarn through center of hoof base (middle of 1st rnd) and up to top of 10th rnd (at color change). Cinch tightly to form cloven hoof. Secure ends. Repeat for each Hoof.
TAIL
With MC, ch 14.
1st row: 2 dc in 4th ch from hook. 3 dc in each ch to end of chain. Fasten oﬀ .
FINISHING
Sew Ears, Snout, Hooves and Tail to Body as seen in photo. With MC, create nostrils by making 2 tight stitches in Snout, and tacking them to Body. With black worsted weight yarn, embroider eyebrows and mouth using Stem Stitch.

instructions:
(Make 2 pieces alike). Ch 11.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. Rep last row 3 times more, ending with 18 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row 6 times more.

Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. Fasten off.
Head: With WS of work facing, join yarn with sl st to first st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn. 7 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 3 sc in first st. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn. 8 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each sc to last st. 2 sc in last st. 10 sc. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Ch 2. Turn.
Next row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last 2 rows twice more. 13 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. Sc3tog over next 3 sts. Fasten off.
Joining Back and Front: Place Back and Front tog. Join yarn with sl st to first ch of foundation ch, working through both thicknesses. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each sp around, stuffing lightly as you work 3 sc in top of Tail and point of nose. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E, and F = Color A, B, C, D, E, and F

gauge: 20 sts = 4” (10 cm); 16 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet
instructions:
Waist
Rounds 28 and 29: With A, sc in each sc around; change to B in last sc of Round 29.
Begin Knickers
Rounds 30–35: With B, sc in each sc around. Do not fasten off. Stuff body firmly.
Joining Row: Flatten lower edging, matching stitches. Working through both thicknesses, sc across to close lower edge. Fasten off B.
ARM (make 2)
Beginning at top of arm, with A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Rounds 3–19: Sc in each sc, stuffing arm as you go.
Round 20: [Sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 3 sc—6 sc.
Round 21: Work 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in last 3 sc—9 sc.
Rounds 22–24: Sc in each sc around.
Round 25: [Sc2tog] 4 times, sc in last sc—5 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff arm. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull gently to close opening. Draw a strand of A through arm at elbow and pull to form elbow dimple. Sew arms to sides of body.
LEG (make 2)
Beginning at foot, with C, ch 6.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch—12 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 3 sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc—18 sc.
Round 3: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around; change to A in last sc.
Round 4: With A, sc in next 6 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 6 sc—15 sc.
Round 5: Sc in next 3 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 6 sc—12 sc.
Round 6: Sc in next 3 sc, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 3 sc—9 sc.
Rounds 7 and 8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: Work 2 sc in first sc, sc in each remaining sc around—10 sc.
Rounds 10–27: Sc in each sc around, stuffing leg as you go; change to B in last sc.
Round 28: With B, sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew legs to bottom of body.
HAIR
With C, ch 34.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—33 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, [sc in next 9 sc, sc2tog] 3 times, turn—30 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, [sc in next 8 sc, sc2tog] 3 times, turn—27 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 7 sc, sc2tog] 3 times, turn—24 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] 3 times, turn—21 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, [sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 3 times, turn—18 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 3 times, turn—15 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 3 times, turn—12 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 3 times, turn—9 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] 3 times, turn—6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through last 6 sts and pull to gather. Use remainder of tail to sew side edges together for back seam. Sew hair to head.
Braid: With C, [ch 42, hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across] 3 times. Fasten off. Braid the 3 strips together. Cut a length of D and tie around end of braid to secure, then wrap the length of D around end of braid for about 1” (2.5 cm), thread end of length to inside of wraps to secure. Sew braid to hair.
FLOWER
(make 3 – 1 with B and 2 with F)
Ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—6 sc.
Row 2: (Slip st, ch 1, 2 hdc) in first sc (first petal made), *ch 1, (slip st ch 1, 2 hdc) in next sc; repeat from * across—6 petals.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. With tail, sew side of first petal to side of last petal, then thread remainder of tail through bases of petals and pull to gather. Sew flower to top of hair.
EAR (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Sew ears in place. 
DRESS
Beginning at top, with B, ch 25.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—24 sc.
Rows 2–9: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 10: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), working in back loops only, 2 dc in first sc, 3 dc in each remaining sc across, turn—72 dc.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn.
Row 12: Ch 3, working in back loops only, dc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 13–22: Repeat last 2 rows 5 times.
Row 23: Repeat Row 11.
Row 24: Slip st in next sc, skip next sc, 3 hdc in next sc, *skip next sc, slip st in next sc, skip next sc, 3 hdc in next sc; repeat from * across to last sc, slip st in last sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing back seam (but, do not sew back seam until instructed).
Skirt Ruffle
Row 1: With right side facing, hold dress upside down, join E with slip st in first unworked front loop of Row 11, ch 3, dc in same st as joining, dc in next front loop, *2 dc in next front loop, dc in next front loop; repeat from * across, turn.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
With D, work another ruffle in unworked front loops of Row 15.
With E, work another ruffle in unworked front loops of Row 19.
Sew side edges of dress together for back seam. With tails, sew edges of ruffles together.
Collar Ruffle
With B, ch 37.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—36 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in first sc, 2 dc in each remaining sc across, turn—72 dc.
Row 3: *Ch 1, slip st in next dc; repeat from * across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. 
Note: You may find it easier to place the dress on the doll before attaching the collar ruffle.
With tail, sew short edges together for back seam of collar. Pin collar evenly to top of dress, matching back seams and center fronts. Sew center 6 stitches of collar ruffle to center 6 stitches of top of dress on the front and the back, leave remaining portion of collar ruffle unsewn for armholes.
WAIST TIE
With F, ch 50.
Row 1: Hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, do not fasten off; hold tie at left side of waist of dress to work in unworked front loops of Row 9, hdc in each unworked loop of Row; ch 50, hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across. Fasten off. Tie ends of waist tie into a large bow.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Sew rings to ears for earrings. 
Necklace: String about 12” (30.5 cm) of beads onto strong sewing thread and tie ends of thread together securely. Place on doll and sew a few stitches at back of neck to secure.
Place clothing and accessories on doll.
Embroider Face
With C, embroider satin stitch eyes and couched stitch eyebrows. With A, embroider satin stitch nose, With D, embroider a couched stitch smile. With red crayon, gently rub color onto face for cheeks.

materials: Bernat® Softee® Chunky™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 108 yds/99 m) Main Color (MC) White (28005) 1 ball
Size U.S. K/10½ [6.5 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 20" [51 cm] tall x 10" [25.5 cm] wide.
gauge: 12 sc and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes :
• You can make both the Polar Bear and the Brown Bear using these 6 skeins of Bernat Softee Chunky.
• Head and body are worked top down.
• All rnds beg in first st of rnd.
• Rnds are joined with sl st to first st of rnd unless otherwise indicated.

Snout
With B, beg using magic loop method, demonstrated here.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for attaching.
With a long strand of E and tapestry needle, loop yarn approx 6 times around 3 stitches at top of the snout as demonstrated in video. Tie knot on WS of work to secure.

Ears (make 2)
With MC for Polar Bear or C for Brown Bear, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join. 10 sc.
2nd to 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 10 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 8 sts.
Fasten off leaving a long tail for attaching.

Head/Body
With MC for Polar Bear or C for Brown Bear, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: (RS) Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
6th to 10th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 36 sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. 30 sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
15th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
Attach snout to head between rnds 8 and 13.
Using E, stitch eyes above either side of the top of the snout as demonstrated in video.
EYES: Stitch on a smiling eye as shown for Polar Bear or use your tapestry needle to weave the yarn around the two stitches between rounds 8 and 9 about 4 times, as shown for Brown Bear.
Stitch ears onto either side of head, 3 rounds down from top.
Stuff Head lightly with polyfill.
16th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 8 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for seaming.
Pinch opening of Head closed. Working into 15th rnd, stitch front and back together with the tail and a tapestry needle so the polyfill stays in the head.

Join A for Polar Bear or D for Brown Bear to any st of 16th rnd.
17th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
18th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 32 sc.
19th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 32 sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
21st and 22nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 40 sc.
23rd rnd: *Ch 2. Skip next 10 sts. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sc and 2 ch-2 sps. Do not work into skipped sts or chain - these are the armholes.
24th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 40 sc.
25th to 28th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 40 sc.
29th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc.
30th to 32nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 32 sc.
33rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
34th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 24 sc. Fasten off A or D. Join MC for Polar Bear or C for Brown Bear.
35th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 24 sc.

Divide for Legs: 36th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Skip next 12 sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join. 12 sc.
Note: Leave skipped stitches unworked.

First Leg
1st to 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 9 sc.
9th to 11th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 9 sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 6 sc.
13th to 19th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 6 sc.
Fasten off MC or C. Join B.
20th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
Paw: 21st and 22nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 9 sts.
24th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 6 sts.
Fasten off leaving a long tail. Weave tail tightly through remaining stitches to close Paw.

Second Leg
Join MC for Polar Bear or C for Brown Bear to any skipped sc along the edge of the 36th rnd.
Repeat 1st to 24th rnd of First Leg. Fasten off leaving a long tail. Weave tail tightly through remaining stitches to close Paw.
Knot Legs just above Paws.

Arms
Join A for Polar Bear or D for Brown Bear to any skipped sc along the edge of the 23rd rnd.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc and ch around. Join. 12 sc.
Repeat 1st to 19th rnds of First Leg. Fasten off A or D. Join B.
Repeat 20th to 24th rnds of First Leg.
Fasten off leaving a long tail. Weave tail tightly through remaining stitches to close Paw. Knot arm right before the Paw. Repeat for second Arm.

materials: Lily ® Sugar’n Cream (70.9 g/2 .5 oz; 109 m /120 yds)
Size 3.5 mm (U.S. E or 4) and 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hooks
Small amount of red embroidery floss for mouth
Small amount of black embroidery floss for eyelashes
Small pearl beads for necklace and bracelet
Length of 1 inch [2.5 cm] wide grosgrain ribbon
gauge: 16 sc and 20 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Head
**With MC and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd 10 times more.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2 tog made. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
32 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2 tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
24 sts.
Stuff Head.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2 tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
16 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2 tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.

Body
With MC and smaller hook, ch 30. Join with sl st to first ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc.
30 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 2 ins [5 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2 tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
24 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 4 ins [10 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2 tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
18 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd twice more. Fasten off.
Sew bottom edge of Body closed. Stuff Body.

Arms (make 2).
With MC and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
10 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 tr in next sc (thumb). 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2 tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc.
8 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures 4 ins [10 cm]. Fasten off.
Stuff arms lightly.

Legs (make 2).
**Foot: With MC and smaller hook, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc.
10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
24 sc.**
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (Sc2 tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc.
21 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2 tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2 tog over last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
17 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (Sc2 tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc.
14 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until Leg measures 5 ins [12.5 cm]. Fasten off.
Stuff Legs.

Finishing
Sew top of Legs closed using whip st. Sew to bottom of Body as shown in picture. Attach Arms to sides of Body. With black embroidery floss, embroider eyelashes. Sew beads to front of Head for eyes. With red embroidery floss, embroider mouth. Make string of small beads 7 ins [18 cm] long for necklace and tie around neck. Make string of small beads 3 ins [7.5 cm] long for bracelet and tie around wrist.

Hair fringe
Cut a piece of tape 11 ins [28 cm] long and secure onto a flat surface with sticky side up. Cut lengths of B 14 ins [35.5 cm] long and lay them across tape so strip of tape is in center of yarn. Holding tissue paper over top of yarn and using sewing machine, run a line of stitching along length of tape. Remove tape when hair is secure. Remove tissue paper after stitching. Pin fringe to outside of head. Using backstitch and B, sew hair into place along sewn line. Fold hair up and secure at top of Head tightly.

Dress
With A and larger hook, ch 34. Join with sl st to first ch, being careful not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc.
34 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd 3 times more.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2 tog. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Sc2 tog. 1 sc in each of last 15 sc. Join with sl st to first st. 32 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd 3 times more.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2 tog. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. Sc2 tog. 1 sc in each of last 14 sc. Join with sl st to first st. 30 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd once more.
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2 tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2 tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.

Bodice
Beg working in rows.
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 18 sts. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
Rep last row twice more.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Ch 5. Sl st in same sp as last sc. (button loop made). Fasten off.
Sew Button to back to correspond with button loop.
Tie Ribbon around waist.

Shoes (make 2).
With B and larger hook, work from ** to ** as given for Foot. Fasten off.
Front Strap: 1st row: Join B with sl st to back loop of 4th sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in back loop of each of next 2 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Turn.
Rep last row 9 times more. Fasten off. Sew cast off edge to opposite side of Shoe.
Back Strap: With B, ch 10. Fasten off. Sew Back Strap to Front Strap as shown in photo.

materials: RED HEART® Shimmer®: 1 ball each 1012 Black A and 1929 Red B
RED HEART® Buttercup®: 1 ball 4270 White C
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 3.75mm [US F-5], 4mm [US G-6], and 6.5mm [K-10.5]
1 yd (1 m) ½” (12.7 mm) wide white satin ribbon
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Clothes designed for 18” (45.5 cm) doll. Dress measures 12” circumference around bodice x 11” long (30.5 x 28 cm). Shrug measures: 15” across sleeves x 7” long (38 x 18 cm). Shoe measures: 3½” (9 cm) long. Purse measures: 2½” long by 3” wide (6.5 x 7.5 cm), closed and not including strap.
gauge: 15 sts = 4” (10 cm); 16 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet with medium hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
DRESS
Note: Work all sections of dress with medium hook.
Bodice
Working from lower edge up, with A, ch 44; join with slip st in first ch. 
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in each ch around; join with slip st in first sc, turn—44 sc.
Rounds 2–8: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc, turn.
Right Back
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in first 10 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—10 sc.
Row 10–15: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. 
Right Back Shoulder
Row 16: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—5 sc.
Row 17–20: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. 
Fasten off.
Front
Row 9 (right side): With right side facing, skip next 2 sc of Row 8, join A with sc in next st, sc in each remaining sc, turn—20 sc.
Rows 10–13: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. 
Left Front Shoulder 
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—5 sc.
Rows 15–20: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. 
Fasten off.
Right Front Shoulder
Row 14: With wrong side facing, skip next 10 sc of Row 8, join A with sc in next st, sc in remaining 4 sc, turn—5 sc.
Rows 15–20: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. 
Fasten off.
Left Back Shoulder
Row 9: With right side facing, skip next 2 sc of Row 8, join A with sc in next st, sc in each remaining sc, turn—10 sc.
Rows 10–15: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. 
Fasten off.
Row 16: With wrong side facing, skip next 5 sc of Row 15, join A with sc in next st, sc in each remaining sc, turn—5 sc.
Notes
1. Doll set consists of dress, shrug, shoes, and purse.
2. Top of dress is made in rows and joined rounds; skirt is worked in joined rounds.
3. Shrug begins in continuous rounds to form first sleeve, body is worked in turned rows, and then second sleeve is worked in continuous rounds. You may find it helpful to place a stitch marker for beginning of round and move it up as each round is completed.
Neck Edging
Row 1: With right side of left back facing, join A with sc in first sc of Row 15, ch 6, slip st in 5th ch from hook (button loop made); working in each remaining st and across ends of rows, sc 44 sts evenly around. Fasten off.
Armhole Edging (work 2)
Round 1: With right side of bodice facing, join A with sc in any sc in Row 8; working in each remaining st and across ends of rows, sc 28 sts evenly around. Fasten off.
Skirt
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing and working across opposite side of foundation ch of bodice, join B with sc in first ch, sc in each remaining ch; join with slip st in first sc, turn—44 sc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in first sc, 2 dc in each sc around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch, turn—88 dc.
Rounds 3–12: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 13: Ch 1, (sc, ch 4) in each dc across; join with slip st in first sc—88 sc and 88 ch-4 spaces. Fasten off.
SHRUG
Note: Sleeves are worked in continuous rounds and body is worked back and forth in rows.
First Sleeve
With largest hook and C, ch 14; join with slip st in first ch. 
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in each ch around—14 sc. Do not join or turn. Optional: Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Repeat Round 2 until piece measures 3½” (9 cm), turn.
Body
Next Row (right side): Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Repeat last row until piece measures 10” (25.5 cm) from beginning edge.
Second Sleeve
Next Round: With same side as first sleeve facing, sc in each sc around. Do not join or turn. Optional: Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Repeat last round until piece measures 13½” (34.5 cm) from beginning edge. Fasten off.
Edging
Round 1: With right side facing of body facing, join C with sc in end of first row, sc in same row, working 2 sc in each st or in end of each row, sc 62 sts around body and sleeve edges; join with slip st in first sc, turn—64 sc. 
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. 
PURSE
With medium hook and A, ch 21. 
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 18 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working on opposite side of foundation ch, skip first ch, sc in next 19 ch, turn—41 sc. Do not join. 
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 20 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 20 sc, turn—43 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 21 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 21 sc, turn—45 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 22 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 22 sc, turn—47 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 23 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 23 sc, turn—49 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first 24 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 24 sc—51 sc. Do not turn.
Last Row (strap): Ch 51, slip st in first sc of last row; Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Bring bottom edge with strap to 13th st from beginning edge and sew side edges together.
SHOES (make 2)
With smallest hook and A, ch 9.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 6 ch; working on opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in next 6 ch; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc. Optional: Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in same st as join, 2 sc in next 2 sc, sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in last 6 sc; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, 2 sc in next sc, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice, sc in next 6 sc, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, sc in next 6 sc; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Rounds 4 and 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in first 16 sc, [sc2tog] 4 times, sc in remaining 6 sc; join with slip st in first sc—26 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in first 14 sc, [sc2tog] 4 times, sc in remaining 4 sc; join with slip st in first sc—22 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in first 13 sc, ch 6 (shoe strap made), skip next 7 sc, sc in last 2 sc; join with slip st in first sc—22 sc and 1 strap). Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew button near top edge of right back with sewing thread. 
Tie ribbon around waist and trim ends as desired.
Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Baby Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Contrast A  Green (04922) 2 balls or 282 yds /257 m
Contrast B  Bubblegum (04916) 1 ball or 220 yds /201 m
Contrast A  Melon (04917) 2 balls or 282 yds /257 m
Contrast B  Baby Teal (04734) 1 ball or 220 yds /201 m
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small pieces of white and black felt.
Hot glue gun and glue sticks.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Approx 22" [56 cm] tall x 18" [45.5 cm] wide.
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st. 
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.
Body
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.

abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and insert hook from back to front around post of next stitch. Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Dcfp = Yoh and insert hook from front to back around post of next stitch. Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Scbp = Insert hook from back to front around post of next stitch and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 4¾" [12 cm] wide x 8" [20.5 cm] long.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: When joining colors, work to last loops on hook of first color.
Draw new color through last loops and proceed.
• Push picot sts to RS.
FISH (make 2)
With A, ch 4.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc. Turn.
2nd to 6th rows: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 13 sc at end of 6th row, ending last row with join MC. Break A.
7th row: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Skip next sc. (2 dc. Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook – picot made. 2 dc) in next sc.
Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * twice more. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sts. Ch 1. Skip next picot. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. (Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 1. Skip next picot. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc) twice. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
9th row: [Ch 6. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook (counts as 1 dc and picot). 1 dc] in first sc. *Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Skip next 2 sc. (2 dc. Picot. 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * once more. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Skip next 2 sc. (1 dc. Picot. 1 dc) in last sc. Turn.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. Ch 1. Skip next picot. 1 sc in next dc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. *1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 1. Skip next picot. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * once more. 1 sc in next dc. Ch 1. Skip next picot. 1 sc in top of ch 3. Turn.
11th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Skip next sc. *(2 dc. Picot. 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Skip next 2 sc. Rep from * once more. (2 dc. Picot. 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Turn.
12th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. *1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 1. Skip next picot. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * twice more. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
13th row: Sl st to first ch-1 sp. [Ch 6. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook (counts as 1 dc and picot). 1 dc] in same sp as sl st. *Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Skip next 2 sc. (2 dc. Picot. 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * once more. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Skip next 2 sc. (1 dc. Picot. 1 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Turn. Leave rem st unworked.
14th row: As 10th row.
15th row: Sl st to first ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. Skip next sc. *(2 dc. Picot. 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Skip next 2 sc. Rep from * once more. (2 dc. Picot. 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp. PM on 3rd dc. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Fasten off.
16th row: With WS facing, join MC with sl st at marker. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. (Ch 1. Skip next picot. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc) twice. Ch 1. Skip next picot. 1 sc in next dc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
17th row: Sl st to first ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Skip next 2 sc. (2 dc. Picot. 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Skip next 2 dc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * once more. Turn. Leave rem st unworked.
18th row: Sl st in each of first 3 dc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Ch 1. Skip next picot. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 1. Skip next picot. 1 sc in next dc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
19th row: Sl st to first ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. Skip next 2 sc. (2 dc. Picot. 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Turn. Leave rem st unworked.
20th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sts. Ch 1. Skip next picot. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Join A. Break MC. Turn.
21st row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each st across. Turn. 7 sc.
22nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). (Dcbp. 2 dc in next sc) twice. Dcbp. 1 dc in last sc. Turn.
23rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc (counts as 2 dc). (Dcfp. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc) twice. Dcfp. 2 dc in last dc. Turn.
24th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 dc. (Picot. Scbp. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc) 3 times. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With B embroider eyes using a French Knot.
With WS tog, sew around edges leaving a large enough opening to stuff. Lightly stuff. Sew rem opening closed.

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Contrast A Orange Leaf (10907) 2 balls or 285 yds/260 m
