abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 9 sc and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm] with Bernat® Blanket™ and larger hook.
instructions:
Note: Join with sl st to first sc at end of each rnd.
FIRST FOOT
With A and larger hook, ch 6.
See diagram on page 4. 
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 3 sc in last 
ch. Working into rem loops of ch, 
1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 2 sc in sp 
where first sc made. Join. 12 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as 
sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc 
in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of 
next 3 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. 
Join. 18 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as 
sl st. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of 
next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each 
of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc 
in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc 
in each of last 3 sc. Join. 22 sc. 
4th and 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each 
sc around. Join.
6th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp 
as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 
(Sc2tog) 6 times. 1 sc in each of last 
6 sc. Join. 16 sts.
7th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp 
as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 
(Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of last 
7 sc. Join. 14 sts.
8th and 9th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each 
st around. Join. Place marker on 
10th sc of last rnd.
Fasten off.
SECOND FOOT
See diagram on page 4.
Work as given for First Foot, but do 
not fasten off at end of last rnd, and 
do not place marker.
JOIN FEET: Next rnd: Ch 1. Work 
1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each 
of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Ch 2. 
Work 2 sc in marked sc of First Foot. 
1 sc in each of next 12 sc of First 
Foot. 2 sc in last sc of First Foot. 
1 sc in each ch of ch 2. 2 sc in next 
unworked sc of Second Foot. 1 sc 
in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 34 sc. 
Fasten off.
 
BODY
Join A with sl st to rem loop of 2nd 
ch worked in ch 2 at back of Feet.
See diagrams on pages 4 and 5.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as 
sl st. 1 sc in each sc around, ending 
with last sc worked into rem loop of 
ch 2. Join. 36 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 
5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 
around. Join. 42 sc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc 
around. Join. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 
6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 
around. Join. 48 sc.
5th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 
7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 
around. Join. 54 sc.
7th and 8th rnds: As 3rd rnd.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 
26 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc 
in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 56 sc.
10th and 11th rnds: As 3rd rnd. 
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 
27 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc 
in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 58 sc.
13th to 16th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in 
each sc around. Join.
17th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 
27 sc. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each sc 
to end of rnd. Join. 56 sts.
18th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st 
around. Join.
19th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 
26 sc. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each sc 
to end of rnd. Join. 54 sts.
20th rnd: As 18th rnd.
21st rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each 
of next 10 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each 
of next 11 sc. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc 
in each of next 11 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc 
in each of next 10 sc. Sc2tog. Join. 
48 sts.
22nd rnd: As 18th rnd.
Do not fasten off. Set Body aside 
and make Arms.
ARMS (Make 2)
With A and larger hook, ch 2.
See diagrams on pages 5 and 6. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Join.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc 
around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in 
each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc 
in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 18 sc.
4th to 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each 
sc around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each 
of next 7 sc) twice. Join 16 sts.
9th and 10th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in 
each st around. Join.
11th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each 
of next 6 sc) twice. Join. 14 sts.
12th to 14th rnds: As 9th rnd. 
Stuff Arm very lightly. 
Close top of Arm: Next row:  
Fold top of Arm to align sts. Ch 1. 
Working through both thicknesses, 
1 sc in each sc to close top. 7 sc. 
Fasten off. 
JOIN ARMS TO BODY
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 
9 sc of Body. Align top row of Arm 
against next 7 sc of Body. Working 
through both thicknesses,  1 sc in 
each of next 7 sc. 1 sc in each 
of next 16 sc of Body. Align top 
row of second Arm against next 
7 sc of Body. Working through both 
thicknesses, 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 
1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Join. 48 sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st 
around. Join.
Stuff Feet and Body.
HEAD
See diagram on page 6.
1st rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each 
of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 
Join. 42 sts.
2nd and 3rd rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in 
each st around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each 
of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 
Join. 36 sts.
5th and 6th rnds: As 2nd and 3rd 
rnds.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each 
of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 
30 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. 
Join.
Stuff Head as you work.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each 
of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 
24 sts.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each 
of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 
18 sts.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next 
sc. Rep from * around. Join 12 sts. 
Finish stuffing.
Fasten off, leaving a length of yarn 
to sew top of Head. 
EARS (Make 2)
With A and larger hook, ch 2. 
See diagram on page 6.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc 
in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 
12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. 
Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join. 
6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a length of yarn 
to sew Ears to Head.
 
MUZZLE
With A and larger hook, ch 20. Join.
See diagram on page 6. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. 
Join. 20 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 
4 sc. (Sc2tog) 6 times. 1 sc in each of 
last 4 sc. Join. 14 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. 
Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 
2 sc. (Sc2tog) 5 times. 1 sc in each of 
last 2 sc. Join. 9 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc3tog) 3 times. Join 
2 strands of B held tog. Break A.
Bobble Nose:  Holding 2 strands 
of B tog, ch 3. (Yoh and draw up a 
loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops 
on hook) 4 times all in 3rd ch from 
hook. Yoh and draw through 5 loops 
on hook. Ch 1 – Bobble Nose made. 
Fasten off, leaving approx 6" [15 cm] 
length. Thread end through yarn 
needle and pull through top of 2nd 
Sc2tog of last Muzzle rnd to form 
Nose. Secure on WS.
HAT
Top:  With smaller hook and 
2 strands of B held tog, ch 2.
See diagram on page 6.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc 
around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc 
in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 
24 sc.
Side: 4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back 
loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. 
Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 
(Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc) 
twice. 22 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. 
Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops 
only, *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 
Rep from * around. Join. 33 sc. 
8th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 
*2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 
2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 44 sc. 
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Note: Safety eyes cannot be moved 
once they are properly attached, so 
it’s best to make sure you’re happy 
with eye placement using stitch 
markers before inserting them.
Stuff Muzzle lightly. Position Muzzle 
at front of Head and pin in place. 
Mark eye placement with stitch 
markers. Following manufacturer’s 
instructions, attach Safety Eyes at 
markers.  
Sew Muzzle in position.
EARS: Run yarn through last rnd of 
Ear and cinch to create curved Ear 
shape. 
Sew Ears to either side of Head as 
shown in photo.
Sew his little Hat into position and 
send him off to work!

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver™ (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m) Café Latte (0360) 1 ball
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.

abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm], working in rnds.
instructions:
Bear Body (make 2 pieces alike)  
Beg at base, ch 6. 
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
1 sc in each ch to end of chain. 
Turn. 5 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. 
Turn. 7 sc. 
3rd to 12th rows: Rep last row 10 times more. 27 sc. 
13th to 32nd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
33rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 3 sts Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 25 sts. 
34th to 40th rows: Rep last row 8 times more. 9 sts rem. Fasten off at end of first piece. Do not fasten off at end of second piece. 
 
Join Pieces: With RS tog, working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc along sides and bottom of Body, leaving top (last row of each piece) unworked. Fasten off. Fold work inside out for RS. Stuff Body, having seams at front and back. 
 
Bear Head (make 2 pieces alike) 
Ch 11. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. 10 sc. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 11 sts. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. 
Turn. 13 sc. 
4th to 11th rows: Rep last 2 rows 4 times more. 25 sc at end of last row. 
12th to 14th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. PM at end of last row (nose). 
15th row: Sl st in each of first 7 sts. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc to end of row. 19 sc. 
16th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 17 sc. 
17th to 21st rows: Rep last row 5 times more. 7 sts rem. Fasten off. 
 
Head Gusset 
Ch 2. 
1st row: (RS). 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 3 sc. Turn. 
2nd to 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Turn. 
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 3 sc in next sc. PM on center sc of 3-sc group. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc. 
6th to 8th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
9th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to marked sc. 3 sc in marked sc. PM to center sc of 3-sc group. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 7 sc. 
10th to 21st rows: Rep last 4 rows 3 times more. 13 sc at end of last row. 
22nd to 28th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
29th row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 11 sc. 
30th and 31st rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
32nd to 40th rows: Rep last 3 rows 3 times more. 5 sts rem. 
41st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Turn. 
Rep last row until work measures length to fit from marker of Head to beg of foundation ch. Fasten off at end of last row. 
 
Join Gusset to Head: Align foundation ch of Gusset with markers of Head pieces. 
With RS tog, working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc along one side of Gusset and one side of Head from marker to foundation ch of Head and Gusset, leaving bottom of Head unworked. Fasten off. 
Rep for joining second piece of Head to Gusset. Turn work inside out for RS. Stuff Head. 
 
Legs (make 2) 
Note: Join all rnds of Legs with sl st to first sc. 
Ch 6. 
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working in rem loops along foundation ch . 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join. 12 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join. 18 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) twice. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) twice. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. 30 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. 36 sc. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc) twice. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. 42 sc. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) twice. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. 48 sc.  
 
Sides: 8th to 12th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.  
 
Shape Instep: 13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. (Sc2tog) 7 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 41 sts. 
14th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. (Sc2tog) 4 times. Sc3tog. (Sc2tog) 4 times.1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 31 sts. 
15th to 24th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 31 sc. 
 
Shape top of Leg: 1st rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 28 sts. 
2nd and alt rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join. 24 sts. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join. 20 sts. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join. 16 sts. 
Stuff Legs, leaving space of last 2 rnds unstuffed. 
9th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join. 12 sts. 
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Fold top flat. Sew top seam with long end. 
Place Legs at each side of Body, having Body seams at front and back. 
Thread yarn through Legs and Body 4 times to secure in place (see Diagram). Tie ends of yarn. 
 
Arms (make 2) 
Note: Join all rnds of Arms with sl st to first sc. 
Ch 2. 
1st rnd: 7 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 7 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 14 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 21 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 28 sc. 
5th to 12th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts. 
14th to 16th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. 
17th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sts. 
18th to 20th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. 
21st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sts. 
22nd to 29th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. 
Stuff Arms, leaving space of last 2 rnds unstuffed. 
Fasten off leaving a long end. Fold top flat. Sew top seam with long end. 
 
Sew Arms at each side of Body (see photo). 
 
Ears 
Note: Join all rnds of Ears with sl st to first sc. 
Ch 24. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring, taking care to not twist chain. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 24 sc. 
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. Sc2tog. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 6 sts. Fasten off. 
Fold Ear flat. Sew top seam. 
Sew Ears to Head as shown in picture. 
With black yarn, embroider eyes and nose using Satin stitch as shown in picture.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 2.75 mm [US C-2]
four 20 mm safety eyes (two for each bee)
Optional: Knee high stocking and plastic pellets for weighted stuffing
abbreviations: A, B, C, and D = Color A, Color B, Color C, and Color D
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 28 sts = about 4" [10 cm]; 32 rounds = about 4" [10 cm] in single crochet (sc). EXACT GAUGE IS NOT CRITICAL TO THIS PROJECT. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEAD/BODY
Note: Before beginning, choose a colorway and refer to colorway lists to determine when to change yarn color.
Colorway #1: Work Rounds 1-11 with A, Rounds 12-14 with B, Rounds 15-20 with A, and Rounds 21-31 with B.
Colorway #2: Work Rounds 1-11 with B, Rounds 12-15 with A, Rounds 16-18 with B, Rounds 19-27 with A, and Rounds 28-31 with B.
Beginning at top of head, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each of next 6 sts—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—36 sc.
Rounds 7–24: Sc in each st around. Using photograph as a guide to placement, attach safety eyes between Rnds 8 and 9 on opposite sides of head.
Round 25: [Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 26: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Begin filling body with stuffing or a combination of optional knee high filled with plastic pellets, and stuffing. Continue stuffing as work progresses.
Round 27: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 28: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Rounds 29 and 30: Sc in each st around.
Round 31: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving an 18" [45.5 cm] tail. Weave tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Do not weave in or trim yarn tail.
Stinger: Using attached long yarn tail as working yarn, insert hook through end of bee and draw up a loop of the yarn tail, ch 4, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, slip st into end of bee. Fasten off.
WINGS (make 2 for each bee)
Use C for colorway #1 bee and use D for colorway #2 bee.
Ch 2.
Rounds 1–4: Work same as Rounds 1–4 of head and body—24 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each st around.
Round 6: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—30 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing wing to body.
LEGS (make 6 for each bee)
With B, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 3rd ch from hook and in next 3 ch.
Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing leg to body.
FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide to placement, sew the following pieces together.
1. Sew wings to top of bee.
2. Sew legs to underside of bee, sewing 3 legs along each side.
Weave in and trim any remaining ends.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Contrast A Overcast (01042) 2 balls or 149 yds/136.5 m

abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
• Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc.
Head and Body:
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
8th to 11th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 10 sc. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 11 times. 1 sc in each of last 10 sc. Join. 53 sc.
13th to 16th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
17th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 10 sc. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 11 times. 1 sc in each of last 10 sc. Join. 42 sc.
18th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
19th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
21st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Break A. Join with B.
Stuff Head Firmly.
22nd rnd: With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
24th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
25th to 28th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
29th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Break B. Join with A.
30th rnd: With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
31st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
32nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sc.
33rd to 37th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
38th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
39th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
40th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc. Do not fasten off.
Separate for Legs:
Right Leg: Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. Ch 3. Skip next 21 sc. 1 sc in each of last 18 sc. Join. 24 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join.
**Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around.
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off leaving a long end.
Draw end tightly through rem sts.**
Left Leg: Join A with sl st to first skipped sc of 42nd rnd.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sc as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 20 sc. Ch 3. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 21 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Join.
Rep from ** to ** as given for Right Leg.
Shirt Edge
Join B with sl st to first sc of front loops of 28th rnd. 
1st rnd: Ch 2. Working in front loops only, *1 hdc in each of next 6 sc. 2 hdc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join.
Fasten off.
Ears (make 2)
Inside Ear: With C, ch 5.
***1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 6 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 3rd row until work from beg measures 4" [10 cm].
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice.
Fasten off.***
Outside Ear: With A, ch 5.
Rep from *** to *** for Inside Ear.
Ear Assembly
With WS of Inside Ear and Outside Ear tog, join A with sl st through both thicknesses to bottom right corner of foundation row. 
Next row: Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses and in back loops only, 1 sc evenly around sides of Ears, leaving foundation rows unworked. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Sew each Ear to Head as shown in photo.
Arms (make 2)
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 4 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep 2nd rnd until work from beg measures 1½" [4 cm].
Fasten off leaving a long end.
Draw end tightly through rem sts.
Sew Arms to Body as shown in photo.
Sleeves (make 2)
With B, ch 2.
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 6 sc.
3rd and 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off.
Sew Sleeves over Arms to Body as shown in photo.
Collar
With B, ch 25.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 2 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 2. Sl st in same ch as last dc. Sl st in next ch. Ch 2. 1 dc in same ch as last sl st. 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. (2 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch) twice.
Fasten off, leaving long end for sewing.
Sew Collar around neck with 2 dc points in front as shown in photo.
Tail
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th to 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
Stuff Tail firmly.
8th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join.
Fasten off, leaving a long end.
Draw end tightly through rem sts.
Sew Tail to Body at back as shown in photo.
Pencil
With D, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with C. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: With C, ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Break C. Join with D. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: With D, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep 4th rnd until work from beg measures 5" [12.5 cm]. Join C.
Next row: With C, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 9 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Next row: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Break C. Join with D. 6 sc.
Next row: With D, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Next row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 3 times. Join.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts.
Nose 
With length of China Rose Med Dk embroidery floss, embroider nose using satin stitch as shown in photo.
Eyes
With length of A, cinch eyes tog as shown in photo to create indents. With length of Black embroidery floss, embroider eyes using satin stitch as shown in photo.

4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sc.
8th rnd: As 6th rnd.
9th rnd:  Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 70 sc.
10th rnd: As 6th rnd.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 80 sc.
12th to 33rd rnds: As 6th rnd.
34th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 70 sc.
35th rnd: As 6th rnd.
36th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 60 sc.
37th rnd: As 6th rnd.
38th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 50 sc.
39th rnd: As 6th rnd.

With C, ch 6.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.

9th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 70 sc.
10th rnd: As 6th rnd.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 80 sc.

43rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.

45th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sc.
