Pompom
Wind A around 4 fingers approx 40 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to smooth round shape. Attach pompom to Hat as shown in photo.
Scarf
With B, ch 5.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next 3 ch. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until Scarf measures 42" [106.5 cm]. Fasten off. Cut lengths of yarn 6" [15 cm] long. Taking 2 strands tog, knot into fringe evenly across both ends of Scarf. Trim fringe evenly. Wrap Scarf around Snowman’s neck.

materials: RED HEART® Boutique Fur™: 3 balls 9100 Polar A, 1 ball 9012 Slate B
RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 312 Black C, 706 Perfect Pink D, and 316 Soft White E
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 16mm [US Q] and 4mm [US G-6]
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Puppy measures about 13” [33 cm] long (from end of nose to tip of tail).
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
BODY
Beginning at front end of body, with larger hook and A, ch 4.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in each of next 2 ch—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 3 times—9 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 3 times—12 sc.
Rows 6 and 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 8: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 3 times—9 sc.
Fasten off.
Finishing Body: Fold last row (Row 8) in half. With E, beginning at fold, sew halves of Row 8 together for back end of body, then sew side edges of piece together for bottom seam, stuffing as you go. Weave E through base of stitches of first row, pull tight to gather. Weave in end securely.

HEAD
With larger hook and A, ch 4.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in each of next 2 ch—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 3 times—9 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, [sc2tog] 4 times, sc in last st—5 sc.
Fasten off.
Finishing Head: Weave E through stitches of last row (Row 5) and pull to gather, then sew side edges of piece together, stuffing as you go. Weave E through base of stitches of first row, pull tight to gather. Weave in end securely.

LEGS (make 4)
With larger hook and A, ch 5.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch—4 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Fasten off.
Finishing Leg: Fold last row (Row 3) in half. With E, beginning at fold, sew halves of Row 3 together, then sew side edges of piece together for inside seam, stuffing as you go, then sew opening at end closed. Weave in end securely.

TAIL
With larger hook and A, ch 4.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch—3 sc.
Fasten off.

EAR (make 2)
With larger hook and B, ch 4.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch—3 sc.
Fasten off.

SPOT
With larger hook and B, ch 3.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next ch—2 sc.
Fasten off.

SNOUT
Beginning at tip of snout, with smaller hook and E, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. Note: If desired, place a marker in last stitch worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around—12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each st around.
Round 4: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each st around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Stuff and sew in place on front of head.

NOSE
With smaller hook and C, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. Note: If desired, place a marker in last stitch worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around—12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each st around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Weave tail through stitches of last round and pull to gather slightly (leaving a small opening). Stuff nose lightly. Sew in place on tip of snout. With C, using photograph as a guide, embroider straight stitches for mouth, below nose.

TONGUE
With smaller hook and D, ch 2. 
Row 1: Work 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook—3 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew tongue to snout at embroidered mouth.

EYE (make 2)
With smaller hook and C, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around; slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail onto yarn needle and weave tail in and out of outer edge, pull to gather. Sew eyes to front of head above snout. To help eyes show up, trim a little of the fur around eyes, if desired.

FINISHING 
Assembly: Refer to photograph for placement of all pieces. With E, sew head to top of front end of body, sewing around head a couple of times and making sure that you sew through the stitches (not just the outer layer of fur). Sew front legs forward as if puppy is lying down, sewing firmly in place. Sew back legs along side the front legs, sewing firmly in place. Sew tail to back end of body. With yarn needle and C, sew ears to top of head. Sew spot to one side of body. Weave in any remaining ends.

materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 239 yds/219m)
1 ball of yarn will make 2 Puppies.
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Pair of ¼" [6 mm] safety eyes.
Black embroidery floss for nose and mouth.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Note: Before start, separate the different color sections of the yarn as follows: Push the rings of color out from center. Find the point where the color changes and cut the yarn. Rep this process for the rem yarn colors. Wind each color into a separate ball. To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed, keeping color change to WS of work. Do not join at the end of rnd, work in continuous rnds. PM at end of rnd. Move marker up as each rnd is completed.
Version 1
MUZZLE 
**With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. 5 sc. PM at end of rnd. 
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each of next 5 sc. 10 sc. 
3rd rnd:  (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 5 times. 15 sc. 
4th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 5 times. 20 sc. 
5th and 6th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around.** Join with sl st in first sc at end of last rnd. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. 
With black floss, using Straight stitch, embroider nose and mouth onto muzzle as shown in picture. 
EARS (make 2)
With B, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. 5 sc. PM at end of rnd. 
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 
3rd rnd:  2 sc in each of next 5 sc. 10 sc. 
4th and 5th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. 
6th rnd:  (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 5 times. 15 sc. 
7th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 
Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. 
HEAD
Beg at top of head, with B, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. 6 sc. PM at end of rnd. 
2nd rnd:  Work 2 sc in each of next 6 sc. 12 sc. 
3rd rnd:  (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 18 sc. 
4th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 24 sc. 
5th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 30 sc. 
6th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 36 sc. 
7th to 11th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Break B at end of last rnd. Join A. 
12th to 17th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. 
18th rnd:  (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 30 sts. 
19th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. 
20th rnd:  (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 24 sts. 
21st rnd: 1 sc in each st around. 
Following manufacturer's instructions, attach safety eyes between 14th and 15th rnds, approx 10 sts apart. 
Lightly stuff muzzle and sew in place between eyes. 
Stuff head. 
22nd rnd:  (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 18 sts. 
23rd rnd: (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 12 sts. 
24th rnd: (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sts. 
Finish stuffing Head. 
Fasten off, leaving a long end. 
Thread end through all sts of last rnd. Pull tightly. Fasten securely. 
BODY
Stripe Pat
With D – 2 rnds
With C – 2 rnds
These 4 rnds form Stripe Pat.
Beg at bottom of body, with D, ch 2.
Proceed in Stripe Pat as follows:
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook Do not join. 6 sc. PM at end of rnd. 
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each of next 6 sc. 12 sc. 
3rd rnd:  (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 18 sc. 
4th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 24 sc. 
5th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 30 sc. 
6th to 12th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. 
13th rnd:  (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 24 sts. 
14th rnd: 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing body to head. 
FRONT LEGS (make 2)
First Leg: With B, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. 8 sc. PM at end of rnd. 
Next 9 rnds:  1 sc in each sc around, stuffing leg as you work. 
Join with sl st in first sc at end of last rnd. Fasten off, leaving a long end. 
Sew open end of leg closed. 
Second Leg:  Work as given for First Leg, working 4 rnds with A, then 5 rnds with B. 
BACK LEGS (make 2)
With B, ch 2. 
1st rnd:  10 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not  join. 10 sc. PM at end of rnd. 
Next 9 rnds:  1 sc in each sc around, stuffing leg as you work. 
Join with sl st in first sc at end of last rnd. Fasten off, leaving a long end. 
TINY TAIL
With B, ch 2. 
1st rnd:  6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not  join. 10 sc. PM at end of rnd 
2nd and 3rd rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. 
Join with sl st in first sc at end of last rnd. Fasten off, leaving a long end. 
FINISHING
Referring to picture as a guide to placement, sew Ears to Head. 
Stuff Body and sew to Head. 
Sew Front Legs to upper front of Body. 
Sew Back Legs to lower front of Body. 
Sew Tail to center rear of Body. 
Version 2
MUZZLE: Work from ** to ** as given for Version 1. Turn at end of 6th rnd.
Forehead Stripe
Note: Work back and forth in rows.
7th row: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
8th to 15th rows:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Turn.
Fasten off at end of last row, leaving a long end for sewing.
With black floss, embroider nose and mouth onto muzzle as shown in picture. 
EARS and HEAD:  With C, work as given for Version 1, omitting color changes.
BODY: With D, work as given for Version 1, omitting color changes.
FRONT LEGS:  With A, work as given for Version 1, omitting color changes.
BACK LEGS and TINY TAIL:  With C, work as given for Version 1.
FINISHING: Work as given for Version 1.

materials: Bernat® Baby Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 492 yds/450 m) Main Color (MC) Bunny Brown (86028) 1 ball or 420 yds/385 m
Contrast A Restful Rose (86002) 1 ball or 82 yds/75 m
Size U.S. D/3 (3.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Small amount of Black worsted weight yarn for embroidery
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 10" x [25.5 cm] long x 9" [23 cm] diameter, excluding feet and ears.
gauge: 18 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Stufﬁe is worked in a continuous spiral. Do not join at end of rnds.
• Place marker on first stitch of rnd and move marker each rnd to keep place.

BODY
Beg at head, with MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook, placing marker on first st for beg of rnd. Do not join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
4th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sc.
5th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.

7th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 56 sc.
8th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 64 sc.
9th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 72 sc.
10th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
11th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 80 sc.
12th rnd: *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * around. 88 sc.
13th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
14th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 96 sc.
15th rnd: *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 104 sc.
16th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
17th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 112 sc.
18th rnd: *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * around. 120 sc.
19th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
Place 2nd marker at end of rnd – do not move 2nd marker each rnd. Rep last rnd until work from 2nd marker measures 4" [10 cm]. Cont as follows:
1st rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * around. 112 sc.
2nd to 4th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * around. 104 sts.
6th to 8th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
9th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 96 sts.
10th and 11th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
12th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Rep from * around. 88 sts.
13th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
14th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * around. 80 sts.
15th rnd: 1 st in each st around.
16th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 72 sts.
17th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
18th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 64 sts.
19th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
20th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 56 sts.
21st rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
22nd rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sts.
23rd rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
24th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 40 sts.
Stuff Body.
25th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
26th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sts.
27th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
28th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 16 sts.
29th rnd: *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 8 sts. Fasten off leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts and fasten securely.

FEET (make 4)
With MC, ch 5. Working in spiral as for Body, proceed as follows:
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Place marker on last st for beg of rnd. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working across opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Do not join. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 3 sc in last sc. 14 sc.
3rd to 10th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Fasten off. Stuff Feet lightly.

OUTER EAR (make 2)
With MC, ch 5.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 6 sc.
3rd and 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 8 sc.
6th and 7th rows: As 3rd and 4th rows.
8th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 10 sc.
9th to 20th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
21st row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 8 sts.
22nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 6 sts.
23rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sts.
24th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Fasten off.

INNER EAR (make 2)
With A, work as given for Outer Ear. Join Ears: Holding one Inner Ear and one Outer Ear tog with WS facing each other, join MC with sl st to bottom right corner of Ear. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work sc evenly up right side of Ear, having 3 sc in tip of Ear, then down left side. Fasten off.

TAIL
With MC, ch 2. Working in spiral as for Body, proceed as follows:
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around 18 sc.
4th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around 24 sc.
5th to 9th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
10th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around 18 sc.
11th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around 12 sc.
Stuff Tail lightly.
12th rnd: *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 6 sc.
Fasten off. Draw end through rem sts and fasten securely.

FINISHING
Sew Ears, Feet and Tail to Body as seen in photo. Sew Ears tog 1" [2.5 cm] up from bottom. With black yarn, embroider eyes using satin stitch and eyebrows using straight stitch. With black yarn, make 3 stitches around bottom of each foot to create claws. With A, embroider mouth and nose using straight stitch.

materials: RED HEART® Anne Geddes Baby™: 1 ball 936 Rocking Horse
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 4mm [US G-6] and 5mm [US H-8]
Three ½” (12mm) buttons, sewing thread, sewing needle, yarn needle, stitch markers
abbreviations: ( ) = work all directions in parentheses in the indicated stitch or space
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Nightgown fits: 18” (45.5 cm) tall doll. Nightgown from shoulder to bottom edge measures: 12.5” (32 cm). Bed Sock foot length measures: 3” (7.5 cm). Headband measures: 21.5” (54.5 cm) long.
gauge: 17 sc and 20 rows sc = 4” (10 cm) with smaller hook; first 8 rows of Yoke in pattern = 2.5” (6.5 cm) long with smaller hook; 4 shells of (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) and 8 rows of shells = 4” (10 cm) with smaller hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
NIGHTGOWN
Yoke
With smaller hook, ch 41.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn—40 sc.
Row 2 (Wrong Side): Ch 2 (counts as beginning hdc now and throughout), hdc in front loop only of each sc across; turn—40 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 2, 2 hdc in back loop only of next hdc, *hdc in back loop only of next hdc, 2 hdc in back loop only of next hdc; repeat from * across, working last 2 hdc in top of beginning ch-2; turn—60 hdc.
Row 4: Ch 2, hdc in front loop only of each hdc across, working last 2 hdc in top of beginning ch-2; turn.
Rows 5-6: Repeat Rows 3-4—90 hdc.
Row 7: Ch 2, hdc in back loop only of next hdc, 2 hdc in back loop only of next hdc, *hdc in back loop only of each of next 2 hdc, 2 hdc in back loop only of next hdc; repeat from * across, working last 2 hdc in top of beginning ch-2; turn—120 hdc.
Row 8: Repeat Row 4.
Body
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1 (does not count as a st), 18 sc in back loops only, ch 4, skip 26 hdc for Sleeve, 32 sc in back loops only, ch 4, skip 26 hdc for next Sleeve, 18 sc in back loops only, working last sc in top of ch-2; join with slip st in beginning sc—76 sts.
Round 2: Change to larger hook; (ch 3, 1 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in first sc, skip 3 sc, *(2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in next sc, skip 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3, being careful not to twist—19 shells.
Rounds 3-16: Slip st in next st and ch-1 space, (ch 3, 1 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in same space, (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in ch-1 space of each shell around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—19 shells.
Round 17: Slip st in next st and ch-1 space, (ch 3, 2 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in same space, (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in ch-1 space of each shell around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—19 large shells.
Rounds 18-19: Slip st in next 2 sts and ch-1 space, (ch 3, 2 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in same space, (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in ch-1 space of each shell around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—19 large shells. At end of Round 19, fasten off and weave in ends.
Sleeves
Sleeves (Make 2)
Round 1 (Right Side): With smaller hook, attach yarn with slip st in chain space at center of underarm, (ch 3, 1 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in same space; continue working over 26 skipped hdc as follows: (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in first skipped hdc, [skip 3 hdc, (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in next hdc] 6 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—8 shells.
Rounds 2-3: Slip st in next st and ch-1 space, (ch 3, 1 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in same space, (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in ch-1 space of each shell around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—8 shells. At end of Round 3, fasten off and weave in ends.
Work second Sleeve in same manner.
Back Yoke Edging
Note: Work 12 sc evenly across each edge by working 3 sc in each pair of hdc row ends. Do not leave extra spaces between stitches and ch-3 loops.
With Right Side of the back of the Yoke facing, use smaller hook to attach yarn with slip st in row end of hdc at top right corner; ch 1, 12 sc across right edge. Rotate Yoke to work across left edge; work 12 sc and 3 ch-3 loops evenly across left edge as follows: 2 sc, ch 3, 4 sc, ch 3, 4 sc, ch 3, 2 sc, ending at top left corner. Fasten off and weave in ends. Sew Buttons on Edging under loops.
Gown Flower Tie
With smaller hook, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring; *[slip st, ch 2, 1 dc, ch 2] 5 times in ring; join with slip st in beginning slip st**; work a 30” (76 cm) long chain, join with slip st in 4th ch from hook to form a ring; repeat from * to **. Fasten off and weave in ends. Weave Tie through first round of shell pattern on Body.
BED SOCKS
BED SOCKS (Make 2)
Note: Toe and Sock Top are worked in continuous rounds without joining or turning. Place a stitch marker in the last st of each round and move up as rounds are completed.
Toe
With smaller hook, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1 (does not count as a st now and throughout), 10 sc in ring; do not join, place marker—10 sc.
Round 2: *[2 sc in back loop only of next sc, 1 sc in back loop only of next sc] twice**, 2 sc in back loop only of next 2 sc; repeat from * to **; move marker—16 sc.
Rounds 3-7: Work sc in back loop only of each sc around, moving marker at end of each Round—16 sc.
Heel
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, sc in back loop only of each of next 10 sc; turn—10 sc.
Rows 2-3: Ch 1, sc in each sc; turn—10 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, 3 sc, sc2tog twice, 3 sc; turn—8 sts.
Row 5: Ch 1, 8 sc; turn—8 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, 2 sc, sc2tog twice, 2 sc; turn—6 sts.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc, sc2tog twice, sc; turn—4 sts.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc2tog twice; turn—2 sts.
Sock Top
Round 1: Ch 1, 2 sc, work 7 sc evenly across sc row ends of Heel side, at front work sc in back loop only of each of next 6 sc, work 7 sc evenly across sc row ends of other Heel side; do not join, place marker—22 sc.
Rounds 2-9: Sc in back loop only of each sc around, moving marker at end of each sc around. At end of Round 9, fasten off and weave in ends.
HEADBAND
HEADBAND
Work same as Gown Flower Tie, making the chain 18” (45.5 cm) long instead of 30” (76 cm) long.

materials: Patons® Classic Wool DK Superwash™ (1.75 oz/50 g; 125 yds/114 m)
Contrast C Medium Grey Heather (12044) 1 ball
Size U.S. C/2 (3 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Large eyed blunt tip tapestry needle.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Sc2(3)(7)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3)(7) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
gauge: 21 sc and 22 rows = 4” [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: When joining colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed.
Legs (make 2)
Beg at Sole of Shoe: With A, ch 6.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc . 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 2 hdc in each of next 6 sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 38 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 13 sts. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 15 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Join B with sl st to first sc. 34 sc.
6th rnd: With B, ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join A with sl st to first sc.
7th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Shape Toe: 1st row: Join A with sl st to back loop of 9th sc of last rnd. Ch 1. Working in back loops, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (Sc2tog) 5 times. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc7tog. Fasten off.
Shoe: 1st rnd: Join B with sl st in back loop of first st of 6th rnd. Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Work 7 sc across edge of Toe. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 27 sc.
Head
Nose: With E, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 9 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 15 sc.
5th and 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Break E, join C at end of 6th rnd.
7th rnd: With C, ch 1. Working in back loops only, (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 5 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc.
8th rnd: Working in both loops, Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
9th to 11th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. join with sl st to first sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 50 sc.
15th rnd: As 13th rnd.
16th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 60 sc.
17th to 24th rnds: As 13th rnd.
25th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 50 sts.
26th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
27th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 40 sts.
28th rnd: As 26th rnd.
Stuff Head.
29th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 30 sts.
30th rnd: As 26th rnd.
31st rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 20 sts.
Stuff Head and attach safety eyes in 9th rnd of Head, spaced as shown in photo.
32nd rnd: As 26th rnd.
33rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 10 sts.
34th rnd: As 33rd rnd. 5 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Complete stuffing Head. Draw end through rem sts and secure tightly.
Outer Ear (make 2).
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1 *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Inner Ear: (make 2) With D, work from ** to ** as given for Outer Ear. Fasten off.
With WS tog, sew Inner Ear to center of Outer Ear.
Arms (make 2).
With C, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd to 8th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
9th rnd: Ch 1. (sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc) twice. Join with sl st to first st. 14 sts.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures 4½” [11.5 cm]. Fasten off.
Stuff Arm.
Sleeve 
With A, ch 18.  Join with sl st to first ch to form ring, taking care not to twist chain.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc) twice. Join B with sl st to first st. 16 sts.
3rd rnd: With B, ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts) twice. Join with sl st to first st. 14 sts.
Join Sleeve to Arm: 1st rnd: Align Sleeve over Arm, having Sleeve on outside of Arm. With D, ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each sc around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
2nd and 3rd rnds: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join B with sl st to first sc at end of 3rd rnd.
4th and 5th rnds: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off at end of 5th rnd.
Sew top of Arm closed.
Attach Arms at either side of Body.
Sew Head to top of Body.
Vest
Lower Section: With B, ch 5.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until piece measures 9½” [24 cm], ending on a WS row. Do not turn at end of last row.
Top Section: 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. Working across long side edge, work 48 sc evenly across to Lower Section. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc).  1 hdc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 10 hdc. (Hdc2tog) twice. 1 hdc in each of next 20 hdc. (Hdc2tog) twice. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 44 sts.
5th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row 4 times more.
Divide for armholes: Right Front: 1st row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 10 sts.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Turn. 9 sts.
4th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 8 sts.
5th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Turn. 6 sts.
6th row: As 5th row. 4 sts.
7th row: Ch 2. (Hdc2tog) twice. Fasten off.
Back: With RS facing, skip next 4 hdc. Join B with sl st to next hdc. 
1st row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog (over same st as last sl st and next st). 1 hdc in each of next 10 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st across. Turn. 12 sts.
3rd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn. 10 sts.
4th row: As 2nd row.
5th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn. 8 sts.
6th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn. 6 sts.
7th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn. 4 sts. Fasten off.
Left Front: With RS facing, skip next 4 hdc. Join B with sl st to next hdc.
1st row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 10 sts.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 9 sts.
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Turn. 8 sts.
5th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Turn. 6 sts.
6th row: As 5th row. 4 sts.
7th row: Ch 2. (Hdc2tog) twice. Fasten off.
Sew shoulder seams.
Finishing
Sew Ears to Head as shown in picture. 
With B, embroider mouth using straight stitch. With A, embroider shoelaces using straight stitch.

materials: RED HEART® Baby Hugs™ Light: 1 ball each 3825 Bluie A and 3303 Shell B
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Dino measures 11½" (29 cm) across, 8" (20.3 cm) tall.
gauge: 17 sc = 4" (10 cm); 18 sc rows = 4" (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
BODY (make 2)
With A, ch 52. 
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 51 sc. 
Row 2 (wrong side): Slip st in next 2 sc, sc in each st across, turn – 2 slip sts, 49 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in next 44 sts, slip st in next st, turn – 44 sc, 1 slip st.
Row 4: Slip st in next 3 sts, sc in each st across, turn – 3 slip sts, 42 sc.
Row 5: Slip st in next 6 sts, dc in next st, slip st in next 2 sts, dc in next st, slip st in next 2 sts, sc in next 28 sts, sl st in next st, turn – 11 slip sts, 2 dc, 28 sc. 
Row 6: Slip st in next st, sc in next 26 sts, slip st in next st, turn – 2 slip sts, 26 sc.
Row 7: Sc in next 26 sts, turn – 26 sc. 
Row 8: Slip st in next st, sc to last st, slip st in last st, turn – 2 slip sts, 24 sc.
Row 9: Skip 1st slip st, sc in each st across, skip last slip st, turn – 24 sc. 
Repeat Rows 8-9 until 8 sts remain. 
Cut yarn.
BODY BORDER
With right side of Body facing, attach A with a slip st to the corner edge of Row 5 of Body, to the left of the dc eyes. 
Working along the Back Spine:
Round 1: Ch 1, sc evenly around the outside of the piece to the beginning of Row 5, slip stitching into the dc sts for the eyes.
Cut yarn, leaving a 65" (165 cm) yarn tail on one Body piece for seaming.
LEGS (make 4)
With A, ch 17. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 16 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Cut yarn, leaving a long tail for seaming.
FINISHING
Face
With right side facing and with yarn needle and B, embroider eyes in small U shapes onto the dc sts of Row 5. 
Embroider the teeth in a zig-zag line along the lower half of the mouth.
Assemble Body
Thread the 65” (165 cm) tail from the second Body piece. Place Body pieces together with right sides facing and the embroidered piece on top. Whip st the two pieces together, working up over the eyes and around the piece, leaving a small gap at the bottom. Turn the piece right-side out; stuff and stitch to close the gap.
Legs
Fold Leg in half lengthwise. With yarn needle and A, seam both sides to make tall, skinny rectangles. Sew to Body. 
Repeat for remaining Legs.
Back Spine
With right side of Body facing, attach A to Body about 1" (2.5 cm) from the head. 
Working along the top edge of Body:
Row 1: Slip st in next st, sc in next 4 sts, *ch 5, tr cluster, ch 3, slip st in top of tr cluster, ch 5, slip st in bottom of tr cluster, sc in next 4 sts; repeat from * until 7 tr clusters are completed total, slip st in next 3 sts.
Cut yarn.
With yarn needle, weave in all loose ends.

materials: Bernat® Baby Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 492 yds/450 m) Misty Gray (86016) 1 ball or 492 yds/450 m
Size U.S. D/3 (3.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of Black worsted weight yarn for embroidery.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 10" x [25.5 cm] tall x 9" [23 cm] diameter, excluding feet and ears.
gauge: 18 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Stuffie is worked in a continuous spiral. Do not join at end of rnds. Place marker on first stitch of rnd and move marker each rnd to keep place.

BODY
Ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook, placing marker on first st for beg of rnd. Do not join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
4th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sc.
5th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.
7th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 56 sc.
8th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 64 sc.

9th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 72 sc.
10th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
11th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 80 sc.
12th rnd: *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * around. 88 sc.
13th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
14th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 96 sc.
15th rnd: *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 104 sc.
16th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
17th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 112 sc.
18th rnd: *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * around. 120 sc.
19th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
Place 2nd marker at end of rnd – do not move 2nd marker each rnd. Rep last rnd until work from 2nd marker measures 4" [10 cm].

Shape top: 1st rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * around. 112 sts.
2nd to 4th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
5th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * around. 104 sts.
6th to 8th rnds:  1 sc in each st around.
9th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 96 sts.
10th and 11th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
12th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Rep from * around. 88 sts.
13th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
14th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * around. 80 sts.
15th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
16th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 72 sts.
17th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
18th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 64 sts.
19th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
20th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 56 sts.
21st rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
22nd rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sts.
23rd rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
24th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 40 sts.

Stuff Body and Head.
25th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
26th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sts.
27th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
28th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 16 sts.
29th rnd: *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 8 sts. Fasten off leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts and fasten securely.

EARS (make 4)
Ch 11.
1st row: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 2 sc in last ch. 12 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. 14 sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th to 8th rows: As 3rd and 4th rows twice more. 18 sc.
9th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. 19 sc. Turn.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row.
11th and 12th rows: As 9th and 10th rows once more. 20 sc. Turn.
13th to 16th rows: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 12 sc at end of last row.
Place marker on last st to mark top of Ear.
Fasten off.

Join Left Ear: Place 2 Ears together with top markers aligned at left side. Join yarn with sl st to bottom right corner. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc up right side of Ear, across last row and down left side of Ear. Fasten off leaving a long end.

Join Right Ear: Place 2 Ears together with top markers aligned at right side. Join yarn with sl st to bottom right corner. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc up right side of Ear, across last row and down left side of Ear. Fasten off leaving a long end.

TRUNK
Ch 2.
Working in spiral as for Body, proceed as follows:
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around.
4th to 7th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
8th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 20 sc.
9th to 16 rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
17th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
18th to 25th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
26th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 28 sc.
27th and 28th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Fasten off. Stuff Trunk lightly.

FEET (Make 4).
Ch 2.
Working in spiral as for Body, proceed as follows:
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Place marker on last st for beg of rnd. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
4th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around.
6th and 7th rnds: Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around.
8th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
9th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
10th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 16 sts.
11th rnd: Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each st around.
12th to 15th rnds: Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around.
Fasten off. Stuff Feet lightly.

TAIL
Ch 2.
Working in spiral as for Body, proceed as follows:
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 4 sc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
4th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 6 sc.
5th and 6th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
7th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 8 sc.
8th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
9th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 10 sc.
10th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
11th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 12 sc.
12th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
Fasten off. Stuff Tail lightly.

FINISHING
Fold down top of Right Ear ½" [1 cm] at foundation chain and sew to Body as seen in picture. Rep for Left Ear. Sew Trunk, Feet and Tail to Body as seen in photo. Bend Trunk to desired shape and tack in place with MC. With black worsted weight yarn, embroider eyes using Satin Stitch. With black worsted weight yarn, embroider eyebrows and mouth using Stem Stitch.

materials: Lily® Sugar ’n Cream (Solids: 70.9 g/2.5 oz/109 m/120 yds)
1 ball each of: Lt Blue (MC); Yellow (A); White (B); Beige (D).
Small amounts of Black (C) and Green (E) for embroidery.
Size 3.5 mm (U.S. E or 4) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 16 sc and 20 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
BODY
With MC, ch 2.
**1st rnd:7 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc.
2nd rnd:Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 14 sc.
3rd rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in next sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 21 sc.
4th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 28 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 35 sc.
6th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join A with sl st in first sc. 42 sc.
7th rnd:With A, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * to last 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 49 sc.**
8th and 9th rnds:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join MC with sl st in first sc at end of 9th rnd. 
10th and 11th rnds:With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
12th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook - Sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * to last 6 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join A with sl st in first sc. 42 sts.
13th to 15th rnds:With A, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each st around. Join MC with sl st in first sc at end of 15th rnd. 
16th rnd:With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
17th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last 5 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 35 sts.
18th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each st around. Join A with sl st in first sc.
19th to 21st rnds: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join MC with sl st in first sc at end of 21st rnd.
22nd rnd:With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 4 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 28 sts.
23rd and 24th rnds:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each st around. Join A with sl st in first sc at end of 24th rnd. 
25th and 26th rnds:With A, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
HEAD
With B only, work from ** to ** as given for Body.  
8th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
9th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * to last 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 56 sc.
10th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
11th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * to last 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 63 sc.
12th to 17th rnds:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
18th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * to last 8 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 56 sts.
19th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each st around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
20th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * to last 4 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 49 sts.
21st rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Sc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * to last 6 sts. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Join with sl st in first sc. 42 sts.
22nd rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. *Sc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 sc in last st. Join with sl st in first sc. 35 sts.
23rd rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Sc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 4 sts. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Join with sl st in first sc. 28 sts.
24th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in next st. *Sc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Join with sl st in first sc. 21 sts. Fasten off. 
Arm (make 2). With B, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc.  
2nd rnd:Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
Rep last rnd twice more, joining MC at end of last rnd. 
With MC, rep last rnd 12 times more.
Fasten off. 
Leg (make 2). With B, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc.  
2nd rnd:Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
Rep last rnd twice more, joining MC at end of last rnd. 
With MC, rep last rnd 11 times more.
Fasten off. 
Ear (make 2). With B, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc.  
2nd rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
3rd rnd:Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 12 sc.
4th rnd:As 2nd rnd. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 18 sc. 
6th rnd:As 2nd rnd. Fasten off. 
Tail: With B, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc.  
2nd and 3rd rnds:Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join MC with sl st in first sc at end of 3rd rnd. 
4th to 6th rnds:With MC, as 2nd rnd. Join A with sl st in first st at end of 6th rnd. 
7th to 9th rnds:With A, as 2nd rnd.  
Rep last 6 rnds 3 times more, then 4th to 6th rnds once more. Fasten off.
Cheeks: With B, ch 2. 
1st row: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. T urn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc.  T urn. 4 sc. 
3rd row:Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. T urn. 6 sc. 
4th row:Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row.  T urn. 
5th row:Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc.
T urn. 4 sts. 
6th row:Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. 
Rep 2nd to 6th rows once more. Fasten off. 
Nose: With C, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Stuff Body, Head, Arms, Legs and sew tog as illustrated. Sew Cheeks in position, placing stuffing as you sew. Sew on Nose. With C and E, embroider eyes and mouth. Cut 3 strands of C, 7 ins [18 cm] long and thread through Cheeks for whiskers. Insert pipe cleaner into Tail, shape it and sew at bottom back of Body. 
MOUSE
Body: With D, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc.  
2nd rnd:Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 16 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 3 times. Join with sl st in first sc. 13 sts.
6th and 7th rnds:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
8th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. Join with sl st in first sc. 10 sts.
9th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each st around. Join with sl st in first sc.
10th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1sc in each of next 2 sc. Working in front loops only: 3 dc in next sc. Sl st in next sc. 3 dc in next sc. Working through both loops, 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st in first sc.
11th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Working in back loops of 9th rnd only: 1 hdc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each sc of 10th rnd to end of rnd. Join with sl st in first sc.
12th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join with sl st in first sc. 7 sc.
13th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc.
14th rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (Sc2tog over next 2 sc) 3 times. Join with sl st in first sc. 4 sc. Fasten off. 
Tail: With D, ch 30. Fasten off. Sew to Mouse.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 373 Petal Pink A, 316 Soft White B, and 312 Black C.
RED HEART® “Pomp-a-Doodle™”: 1 ball 9785 Cotton Candy Pink D.

Yarn needle, stitch marker, black embroidery floss, polyester filler, strong hand-sewing thread and needle, buttons* or plastic safety eyes*; Optional ribbon: plastic pellets and knee-high hose for making pellet packet.
abbreviations: dec (decrease) = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Poodle measures 13” tall x 12” from nose to end (excluding tail).
gauge: 20 sc = 4”; 16 rounds = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
POODLE
Head (Begin at nose)
Work in continuous rounds without joining. Mark beginning of round. Move marker up each round.
Round 1: With C and smaller hook, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Round 2: [Inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Rounds 3 and 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: Dec, sc in next 9 sc, slip st in next sc – 11 sts. Fasten off. Stuff with black yarn remnants to prevent stuffing show-through.
Round 6: Join B in any st; ch 1, [inc, sc in next sc] 5 times, inc – 17 sc.
Round 7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: Inc, sc in next 8 sc, inc, sc in next 7 sc – 19 sc.
Round 9: Inc, sc in next 9 sc, inc, sc in next 8 sc – 21 sc.
Round 10: Inc, sc in next 10 sc, inc, sc in next 9 sc – 23 sc.
Round 11: Inc, sc in next 11 sc, inc, sc in next 10 sc – 25 sc.
Round 12: [Inc, sc in next 4 sc] 5 times – 30 sc.
Round 13: [Inc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times – 36 sc.
Round 14: Sc in each sc around.
Round 15: [Inc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times – 42 sc.
Round 16: [Inc, sc in next 6 sc] 6 times – 48 sc.
Round 17: [Inc, sc in next 7 sc] 6 times – 54 sc.
Rounds 18-23: Sc in each sc around.
Round 24: [Inc, sc in next 8 sc] 6 times – 60 sc.
Round 25: Sc in each sc around.
Round 26: [Dec, sc in next 4 sc] 10 times – 50 sc.
Round 27: [Dec, sc in next 3 sc] 10 times – 40 sc.
Round 28: [Dec, sc in next 2 sc] 10 times – 30 sc. Stuff head firmly, continuing as rounds are worked.
Round 29: [Dec, sc in next sc] 10 times – 20 sc.
Round 30: Sc in each sc around. Finish stuffing head.
Round 31: [Dec] 10 times – 10 sc.
Round 32: [Dec] 5 times – 5 sc. Fasten off, weaving yarn tail through sc to close hole.

Body (Beginning at rear end)
Round 1: Using A and smaller hook, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Round 2: [Inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Inc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 4: [Inc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 5: [Inc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 6: [Inc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times – 36 sc.
Round 7: [Inc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times – 42 sc.
Round 8: [Inc, sc in next 6 sc] 6 times – 48 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: [Inc, sc in next 7 sc] 6 times – 54 sc.
Round 11: [Inc, sc in next 8 sc] 6 times – 60 sc.
Rounds 12 and 13: Sc in each sc around.
Round 14-Back Leg Openings: Sc in next 3 sc, ch 8, skip 10 sc, sc in next 2 sc, ch 8, skip 10 sc, sc in next 35 sc – 56 sts.
Rounds 15-23: Sc in each ch and sc around – 56 sc.
Round 24-Front Leg Openings: Sc in next 3 sc, ch 8, skip 10 sc, sc in next 2 sc, ch 8, skip 10 sc, sc in next 31 sc – 52 sts.
Round 25: Inc, sc in next 23 sts, inc, sc in next 27 sc – 54 sc.
Rounds 26: Inc, sc in next 24 sts, inc, sc in next 28 sts – 56 sc.
Round 27: Sc in each sc around.
Round 28-Neck Opening: Sc in next 39 sc, ch 10, skip 10 sc, sc in next 7 sc – 56 sts.
Round 29: Sc in each ch and sc around – 56 sc.
Stuff poodle body as rounds are worked.
Round 30: [Sc in next 6 sc, dec] 7 times – 49 sc.
Round 31: Sc in next sc, [dec, sc in next 4 sc] 8 times – 41 sc.
Round 32: Sc in next sc, [dec] 20 times – 21 sc.
Continue to stuff body.
Round 33: Sc in next sc, [dec] 10 times – 11 sc.
Round 34: Sc in next sc, [dec] 5 times – 6 sc.
Round 35: [Dec] 3 times – 3 sc. Fasten off, weaving yarn tail through sc to close hole.

Legs (Make 4)
Round 1: Join B to any st in leg opening; ch 1, sc in each ch and sc around inc 3 sts evenly spaced – 21 sc.
Rounds 2-14: Sc in each sc around, changing to A in the last st of the last round. Fasten off B.
Round 15: With A, slip st loosely at base of each sc around (this will be the foundation for applying leg pouf).
Round 16: Sc in each sc of Round 14 around – 21 sc.
Stuff upper section of leg. If using plastic pellets to add weight to poodle, place about ¼ cup in the toe of a knee-high stocking, cut and tightly knot. Stuff this into bottom-most parts needing extra weight, finish stuffing with polyester filler.
Round 17: Sc in next sc, [inc, sc in next 4 sc] 4 times – 25 sc.
Round 18: Sc in each sc around.
Round 19: [Inc, sc in next 4 sc] 5 times – 30 sc.
Round 20: [Inc, sc in next 5 sc] 5 times – 35 sc.
Round 21: [Dec, sc in next 5 sc] 5 times – 30 sc.
Round 22: [Dec] 15 times – 15 sc.
Finish stuffing.
Round 23: [Dec] 7 times, sc in next sc – 8 sc.
Round 24: [Dec] 4 times – 4 sc.
Fasten off leaving long tail for sewing. Repeat for other legs.
Pomp-a-Doodle™ yarn is worked in the thread between the pompons. Do not pull pompons through stitches. See Red Heart video tutorial at http://www.redheart.com/ for more information on working with Pomp-a-Doodle™.

Leg Pouf
Round 1: Join D in any slip st of Round 15; sc in each slip st around leg.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.

Neck
Round 1: Attach A to any sc in neck opening; ch 1, sc in each ch and sc around inc 6 sts evenly spaced – 26 sc.
Rounds 2-7: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off leaving yarn tail for attaching head.

Ribbed Sweater Collar
Row 1: Ch 7; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 6 sc.
Rows 2-21: Ch 1, sc in back loops only in each sc across; turn. Fasten off leaving long tail for attaching to neck.
Edging: Join D in end of any row of collar; slip st evenly across row ends (about 12 pompoms). Fasten off.

Tail
With smaller hook and A, ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; do not join; work in continuous rounds.
Rounds 2-12: Work even in sc. Fasten off A in last sc.
Round 13: Join D in any sc; slip st (1 pompom per slip st) in each sc around.
Round 14: * 2 Slip sts in next slip st, slip st in next slip st; repeat from * around.
Round 15: Slip st in every other st around. Fasten off.

Ears (Make 2)
With smaller hook and B, ch 12; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around; do not join – 12 sc.
Rounds 2-6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Inc, sc in next 5 sc] twice – 14 sc.
Rounds 8 and 9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: [Inc, sc in next 6 sc] twice – 16 sc.
Round 11: Sc in each sc around.
Round 12: [Inc, sc in next 7 sc] twice – 18 sc.
Round 13: [Inc, sc in next 8 sc] twice – 20 sc.
Round 14: Sc in each sc around.
Round 15: [Inc, sc in next 9 sc] twice – 22 sc.
Rounds 16 and 17: Sc in each sc around.
Round 18: [Dec, sc in next sc] 7 times, sc in next sc – 15 sc.
Round 19: [Dec, sc in next sc] 5 times – 10 sc.
Round 20: [Dec] 5 times – 5 sc. Fasten off, using long tail to close hole.

Ear Pouf
Round 1: Starting at the tip of the ear at Round 18, slip st D into stitches around the ear tip. 
Round 2: Slip st in each slip st around. Fill in bare spots with D as needed. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew head, tail, and sweater collar to body as in photo, using long yarn tails. Make certain parts are securely attached. Sew ears to head leaving approximately 4” diameter circle free between ears at top of head.
Locate eye placement. Using black embroidery thread, sew 3 lines for eyelashes as shown. Attach buttons securely, overlapping the eyelashes a little OR embroider eyes if toy is to be used for children under 2 years of age.

Head Pouf
Add after ears have been attached and head has been sewn to neck. 
Round 1: Beginning at the crown of the head where the ears are attached, with larger hook and B, loosely work 25 slip sts into the sts of the Head in a circle about 4” diameter. This circle should be placed directly on top of the head, evenly spaced in conjunction with the ears. 
Round 2: With D and larger hook, sc in each st around.
Round 3: Inc, [sc in next sc, inc] 12 times – 38 sc.
Round 4: Sc in next 2 sc, [dec, sc in next 2 sc] 9 times – 29 sc.
Round 5: [Dec, sc in next 3 sc] 5 times, dec, sc in last 2 sc – 23 sc.
Round 6: Sc in next sc, [dec] 11 times – 12 sc.
Round 7: [Dec] 6 times – 6 sc.
Round 8: [Dec] 3 times – 3 sc. Fasten off.

Ribbon is attached by weaving the tip of the ribbon between a few D sts, pulling through with even lengths and tying into a bow. Tighten and trim ends.

Blushed Cheeks
Use dark powder blush and extra large makeup brush or stencil brush. Load makeup onto brush as if to apply to face, tapping off excess. Locate cheek area on Head and apply using a tamping or pouncing motion. To do this, hold the brush straight and perpendicular to the poodles’ face. Tap the brush end onto the desired location; do not use a brushing or sweeping motion. Apply blush in layered stages until desired effect is achieved.

materials: Lily® Sugar ‘n Cream (70 g/2.5 oz; 109 m / 120 yds)
Size 3.5 mm (U.S. E or 4) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of red embroidery floss for mouth.
gauge: 16 sc and 20 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Head
** With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc at end of 3rd rnd.**
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 7 times more. Do not break A.
Next rnd: With B, working in front loops only, ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in same sp as last sl st. Sl st in next sc. *3 dc in next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Break B.
Next rnd: With A, working in unused loops of rnd before last, ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – Sc2tog made. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
Stuff Head.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 8 sc.
Fasten off leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts.

Beard
With B, ch 16.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 15 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in first sc. *Sl st in next sc. 3 dc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew Beard to Head as shown in photo.

Hat
*** With MC, work from *** to *** as given for Head.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.*****
5th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *(1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sc.
8th to 10th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 35 sc. Fasten off.
Stuff Hat. Attach Hat to top of Head.

Body
With MC, work from *** to *** as given for Hat.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 6 times more.
Top shaping: 1st rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
2nd and alt rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
Stuff Body.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sts.
Fasten off leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts.

Arms (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd once more, joining MC at end of rnd.
With MC, work 8 rnds even. Fasten off.

Boots (make 2)
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Attach Head to Body. Stuff Arms lightly. Stuff Boots. Attach Arms and Boots to Body as shown in picture. Attach beads for eyes. With red embroidery floss, embroider mouth.

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Contrast A Dark Teal (10825) 1 ball or 132 yds/121 m
Contrast B Misty Green (10878) 1 ball or 26 yds/24 m
Contrast C Vintage White (10006) 1 ball or 9 yds/8.5 m
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
2 black safety eyes 1" [2.5 cm]. Stuffing. Yarn needle.
abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
Body
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th to 11th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
13th and 14th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
15th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
16th to 22th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sts.
24th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
25th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
26th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
Secure safety eyes to Body as shown in photo. Stuff Body firmly.
27th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
28th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join. 6 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.
Nose
With A, ch 4.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working into opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in next ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join. 8 sc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off at end of 3rd row. Stuff Nose. Sew to Body as shown in picture.
Embroider Nostrils with straight stitch as shown in picture. See page 3.
Ears (make 2)
With B, ch 3, leaving a long end for sewing.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. 4 sc.
3rd row: Ch 2. Sl st in each of rst 2 sc. Ch 2. Sl st in each of next 2 sc. Ch 2. Sl st in same sp as last sl st. Fasten off. Sew Ears to Body as shown in photo.
Horns (make 2)
With C, ch 4, leaving a long end for sewing. Join with sl st to first ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 4 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Join. 2 sts. Fasten off. Draw end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.
Stuff Horns firmly. Sew Horns to Body as shown in photo.
Arms (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 4 sc.
2nd to 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off at end of last rnd, leaving a long end for sewing.
Sew Arms to Body as shown in photo.
Belly
With B, ch 4.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 3 sc in next ch. Working into opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in next ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join. 8 sc.

Ch 2.

4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. (1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Turn. 34 sts rem.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts) 4 times. Turn. 30 sts rem.
6th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Turn. 26 sts rem.
7th row: As 3rd row.
8th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 21 sts rem.
9th row: As 3rd row.
10th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in next st. Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 16 sts rem.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 356 Amethyst A, 722 Pretty ’n Pink B, 254 Pumpkin C and 312 Black D.

instructions:
Now dolls can go to the party in their own colorful witch costume. This crocheted ensemble coordinates with the Little Witch Hat & Shawl for girls, LW3821.
Rows 16–26: Ch 3, dc in each dc across; turn.
Row 27: Ch 1, sc in each dc across; turn.
Points
Row 28: Ch 1, starting in first st, *sc in each of next 6 sc, ch 1, turn, sc2tog over first 2 sts, sc in each of next 2 sc, sc2tog over first 2 sts, ch 1, turn, sc in each of next 4 sc, ch 1, turn, [sc2tog over first 2 sts] twice, ch 1, turn, sc2tog over first 2 sts, working in row-end sts, work 3 sc evenly spaced across side edge of point; repeat from * across – 9 points. Fasten off, leaving a long sewing length.
ASSEMBLY
Sew back seam to 1” (2.5 cm) below waist. Sew Peplum seam. Evenly space 3 buttons on top left side of Back and sew in place with sewing needle and thread. Use spaces between sts on right Back for button holes.
HAT
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join – 6 sc. Work in a spiral, marking beginning of each round and moving marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 9 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: *Sc in each of next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 12 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 18 sc.
Rounds 7–8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: *Sc in each of next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 24 sc.
Rounds 10–11: Sc in each sc around.
Round 12: *Sc in each of next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 30 sc.
Rounds 13–14: Sc in each sc around.
Dress fits: 18” (45.5 cm) doll
Special Abbreviations
Single crochet 2 together (sc2tog): [Insert hook in next st, yarn over, draw up a loop] twice, yarn over, draw through 3 loops on hook.
DRESS
Bodice
Starting at neck edge with A, ch 25.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 24 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in first sc, 2 dc in each sc across; turn – 48 dc.
Row 3: Ch 3, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next st, 2 dc next st; repeat from * across; turn – 72 dc.
Rows 4–6: Ch 3, dc in each dc across; turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first 9 dc, skip next 18 dc, sc in next 18 dc, skip next 18 dc, sc in last 9 dc; turn – 36 sc.
Rows 8–10: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Peplum
Row 11: Ch 3, working in back loops of sts, dc in very first sc, 2 dc in each st across; turn – 72 dc.
Row 12: Ch 1, starting in first st, *sc in next 2 dc, 2 sc in next dc; repeat from * across; turn – 96 sc.
Row 13: Ch 3, dc in each sc across; turn.
Row 14: *Ch 4, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, dc in next ch, skip next 2 dc in row 13, slip st in next dc; repeat from * across – 32 points. Fasten off.
Skirt
Row 15: With right side facing, working in remaining loops of sts in Row 10, join A with a slip st in front loop of first st, ch 3, dc in same st as joining, 2 dc in each st across; turn – 72 dc.
5 rows dc = 3” (7.5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.

Designed by Michele Wilcox
What you will need:
RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 356 Amethyst A, 722 Pretty ’n Pink B, 254 Pumpkin C and 312 Black D.

Round 15: *Sc in each of next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 36 sc.
Rounds 16–18: Sc in each sc around.
Round 19: *Sc in each of next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 42 sc.
Rounds 20 & 21: Sc in each sc around.
Round 22: *Sc in each of next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 48 sc. Fasten off B, join A.
Rounds 23–25: With A, sc in each sc around. Fasten off A, join B with slip st in front loop of first sc.
Round 26: With B, ch 3, working in front loops of sts, dc in first st, 2 dc in each st around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 96 dc.
Round 27: Ch 1, sc in each dc around; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
CAPE
Starting at neck edge with C, ch 78.
Row 1: Dc in 6th ch from hook, (beginning ch-5 counts as ch 1, dc, ch 1), *skip next 2 ch, 5 dc in next ch, skip next 2 ch, dc in next ch, ch 1, skip next ch, dc in next ch, rep from * across; turn – 9 shells.
Row 2: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), skip next ch-1 space, dc in next dc, *skip next 2 dc, 5 dc in next dc, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc, ch 1, skip next ch-1 space, dc in next dc; repeat from * across, ending with last dc in top of turning ch; turn. Fasten off C, join B.
Rows 3–10: Repeat Row 2, working in the following color sequence: *2 rows B, 2 rows C; repeat from * once. Fasten off C, join A.
Row 11: With A, repeat Row 2, do not turn. Do not fasten off.
Edging
Round 1: Working in row-end sts on side edge of Cape, sc evenly across to next corner, working across opposite side of foundation ch of neck, sc in each ch across, ch 1, turn, *sc2tog over next 2 sc; repeat from * across neck edge to next corner, turn, ch 40 (for tie), slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in each ch across, sc in each st across neck edge to next corner, ch 40 (for tie), slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in each ch across, working in row-end sts on other side edge, sc evenly across to next corner; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 of last row of cape. Fasten off.
PUMPKIN BAG
Starting at bottom edge with C, ch 12.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each of next 9 ch, 3 sc in last ch, working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in each of next 9 ch, 2 sc in last ch; do not join – 24 sc. Work in a spiral, marking beginning of each round, moving marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: 2 sc in next sc, sc in each of next 9 sc, 2 sc in each of next 3 sc, sc in each of next 9 sc, 2 sc in each of last 2 sc – 30 sc.
Rounds 3–12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: *Sc in each of next 3 sc, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 14: Sc in each of next 6 sc, ch 24 (for strap), skip next 6 sts, sc in each of next 6 sc, ch 24 (for strap), skip next 6 sts; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off C. With D and yarn needle, following photo, embroider 2 vertical satin st eyes, horizontal satin st nose and back st mouth.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Boutique Chic™: 1 ball 1901 Pimento Red.
Strong matching sewing thread and needle
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 6 stitches = 4” (10 cm); 5 rounds = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet.
instructions:
Give the loves of your life this funny crocheted monster for Valentine’s day or any time you feel like spreading your warm feelings! It won’t take long to create this stuffed charmer.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 7 times—28 sc.
Rounds 5–9: Sc in each sc around.
Decide where you want the front to be. Select an area with the least number of pompoms. Remove the beginning of round marker. Using photograph as a guide, determine nose placement and tie reserved pompom in place. Hide the knot inside the monster. Attach safety eyes to face on either side of pompom nose.
Dividing Round (divide for legs): Sc in each sc to the center of the front, ch 4 (for between legs), skip next 14 sc (for second leg), sc in next 14 sc (for first leg), place marker in first and last sc of the 14 sc just made. You are now ready to work in rounds over the ch-4 and the 14 sc just worked. Replace the beginning of round marker. Do not move the Dividing Round markers until instructed to remove them. They will be used when working the second leg.
First Leg
Round 1: Sc in one loop of each ch of the ch-4, sc in next 14 sc—18 sc.
Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: Working in back loops only, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Slip st in next st and fasten off leaving a long tail. Stuff body and first leg. Weave tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Weave in end.
Second Leg
Note: Sc2togs are worked at the beginning and end of the dividing ch-4 to reduce gapping.
Round 1: Join yarn with sc in first skipped sc of divide, sc in next 13 sc, insert hook in same st as marked sc of Dividing Round and draw up a loop (2 loops on hook); working in free loops of the ch-4, insert hook in first ch and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook, sc in next 2 ch, insert hook in next ch and draw up a loop, insert hook in same st as next marked sc of Dividing Round and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through 3 loops on hook; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—18 sc. Remove Dividing Round markers. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: Working in back loops only, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Slip st in next st and fasten off leaving a long tail. Stuff leg. Weave tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Weave in end.
ARMS (make 2)
Make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 9 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—9 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around.
Rounds 3 and 4: Sc in each sc around.
Slip st in next stitch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Stuff arms lightly and sew to monster. Use the long tail for sewing or use strong, matching sewing thread if preferred.
FINISHING
Weave in any remaining ends.
