materials: RED HEART® Super Saver: 1 skein each 3620 Glowworm A, 0254 Pumpkin B, 0324 Bright Yellow C, 0316 Soft White D and 0312 Black E
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Crab measures 4.5” (11 cm) long x 3.5” (9 cm) tall
gauge: 14 sc = 4” [10 cm]; 20 rows sc = 4” [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions: Rounds 7-10: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, change color in pattern at end of each Round. Fasten off C. Round 11: Working in front loops only, ch 1, hdc in each sc around. Slip st in first hdc to join—36 hdc. Round 12: Slip st in each hdc around—36 slip sts. Fasten off and weave in ends. Underside Underside is worked in continuous Rounds without joining or turning. With A, ch 2. Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Round 2: [2 sc in next sc] 6 times—12 sc. Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc. Round 4: [Sc in each of the next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc. Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 3 sc] 6 times—30 sc. Round 6: 2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc, [ch 7, turn, slip st in second ch from hook and next 5 chs, slip st in front loop of next sc (Leg formed)] 3 times, [sc in each of the next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 3 times, [ch 7, turn, slip st in second ch from hook and next 5 chs, slip st in front loop of next sc] 3 times, sc in each of the next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 3 sc —30 sc and 6 Legs. Do not fasten off. Attaching Shell to Underside Underside and Shell will be attached by slip stitching together through back loops of last Round of Underside and back loops of Round 11 of Shell. Align Shell and Underside with wrong sides together. *Insert hook through next back loop of Underside and next back loop of Shell, draw loop through both back loops and loop on hook (slip st made). Repeat from * around Shell, working through the back loop of each sc and the last st of each Leg on the Underside, stuffing as you close. Stuff firmly but do not overstuff or stretch stitches (this helps prevent stuffing showing through work). Fasten off and weave in ends. Front Claws (Make 2) With A, ch 2. Round 1 (Right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Round 2: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 3 times—9 sc. Round 3: Working in current st, [wrap yarn over hook, insert hook into st and pull up a loop] 3 times, yarn over and pull loop through all 7 loops on hook (Thumb made). Sc in each of the next 8 sc—1 Thumb and 8 sc. Round 4: Sc2tog 4 times, sc in last st—5 sc. Stuff lightly. Rounds 5-8: Sc in each st around. Continue stuffing lightly as work progresses. At the end of Round 8, fasten off, leaving 8” tail for sewing. Eyes Eye Whites (Right side): With D, *ch 6, turn, 3 hdc in 2nd ch from hook, 3 hdc in next ch, slip st in next ch, 3 hdc in each of the next 2 chs. Fasten off, leaving 8 “ tail for sewing. Eyelids: With A, work same as Eye Whites; do not fasten off. Ch 1 turn; matching wrong sides of Eye Whites and Eyelids, sc two pieces together working 1 sc in each of the next 6 matching hdc’s, slip st in the next matching slip sts, work 1 sc in each of the next 6 matching hdc’s. Fasten off, leaving 12” tail for sewing. Eyebrow With E, *ch 4 loosely, turn, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in the next 2 chs. Repeat from *, ending in middle of Eyebrow. Fasten off, leaving 8” tail for sewing. Assembly Using photograph as a guide, sew Front Claws to Underside in front of each set of Legs with Thumbs pointing inward. Lightly stuff Eyes and position on top of Shell, centered between Claws. Sew to Shell, matching colors. With E, add a French knot in the center of each Eye White for a Pupil. Attach center of Eyebrow between Eyes with 2 for 3 stitches. Embroider a sassy V-smile. Weave and hide any remaining ends.

Stuff Shoe. 
Leg: 1st rnd: With B, working in back loops only, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join C with sl st to first sc. 
Cont even, working 2 rnds C, 2 rnds B, until Leg from top of Shoe measures 4 ins [10 cm]. Fasten off. 
Stuff Leg. 
Shoe edging: With smaller hook, join A with sl st to rem loop of top of Shoe. *Ch 3. 1 sc in 3rd ch from hook. Sl st in same sp as last sl st - picot made. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first picot. Fasten off. 
Finishing 
Sew top of Legs closed using whip st. Attach Jingle Bell to tip of Shoe. Sew Legs to bottom of Body. Sew Arms to sides of Body. With black embroidery floss, embroider eyelashes on Head. Sew Beads to Head. With red embroidery floss, embroider mouth. 
Hair fringe 
Cut a piece of tape 5 ins [12.5 cm] long and secure onto a flat surface with sticky side up. Cut lengths of D 11 ins [28 cm] long and lay them across tape so strip of tape is in center of yarn. Holding tissue paper over top of yarn and using sewing machine, run a line of stitching along length of tape. Remove tape when hair is secure. Remove tissue paper after stitching. Pin fringe to top of head. Using backstitch and D, sew hair into place along sewn line, being sure to get all lengths secured in sts. Trim evenly. 
Hat 
Note: Ch 2 does not count as hdc. 
With larger hook and A, ch 36. Join with sl st to first ch, being careful not to twist ch. 
1st rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each ch around. Join B with sl st to first hdc. 
2nd rnd: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join A with sl st to first hdc. 
3rd rnd: With A, as 2nd rnd. Join B. 
4th rnd: With B, ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – hdc2 tog made. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first hdc. 30 hdc. 
5th rnd: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each st around. Join B with sl st to first hdc. 
6th rnd: With B, ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Hdc2 tog. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first hdc. 24 sts. 
7th rnd: As 5th rnd. 
8th rnd: With B, ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Hdc2 tog. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first hdc. 18 sts. 
9th rnd: As 5th rnd. 
10th rnd: With B, ch 2. *1 hdc in next hdc. Hdc2 tog. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first hdc. 12 sts. 
11th rnd: As 5th rnd. 
12th rnd: With B, ch 2, *Hdc2 tog. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first st. 6 sts. 
13th rnd: As 5th rnd. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread end through rem loops. Pull tightly and fasten securely. 
Sew Jingle Bell to top of Hat. 
Attach Hat to Head, sewing through all thicknesses. 
Dress 
Note: Ch 2 does not count as hdc. 
With larger hook and B, ch 40. Join with sl st to first ch, being careful not to twist ch. 
1st rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 40 hdc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Hdc2 tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 32 sts. 
4th and 5th rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 
6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Hdc2 tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 24 sts. 
7th and 8th rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 
Beg working in rows: 1st row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 24 hdc. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc across. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 5. Sl st in first hdc. (button loop made). Ch 2. 1 hdc in same st as last sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc across. Fasten off. 
Edging: Join C with sl st to any rem loop of foundation ch at bottom of dress. *Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Miss next 2 ch. Sl st in next ch. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to same sp as first sl st. Fasten off. 
Straps (make 2) 
With larger hook and B, ch 9. 
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 8 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn. 
Rep last row once more. Fasten off. 
Belt 
With larger hook and C, ch 24. Join with sl st to first ch, being careful not to twist ch. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Put Dress on doll, mark position for Straps. Sew Straps to Dress. Sew Belt to Dress as shown in picture. Sew button to back of Dress to correspond to button loop.

materials: RED HEART® “Sport”: 1 Skein each No. 904 Jockey Red MC, No. 230 Yellow CA, No. 687 Paddy Green CB, No. 254 Pumpkin CC, and No. 1 White CD [2 1/2 oz (70 g), 240 yd (219 m)].
Yarn needle, small amount stuffing material.
abbreviations: CA, CB, etc = color A, B, etc
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Pail is approximately 9” high and 11” across. Fish are approximately 6” long and 3” high.
gauge: 15 sts = 4”; 7 rows = 4” in dc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
FISH
(Make 2 pieces each CA, CB, CC, and CD): Ch 10.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 9 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1; [draw up a lp in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 lps on hook – sc dec made; sc in next 5 sc, sc dec over last 2 sc; turn – 7 sc.
Rows 3 and 4: Ch 1, sc dec over first 2 sc, sc to last 2 sc; sc dec; turn – 3 sc at end of Row 4.
Row 5: Ch 2, hdc in first sc, 3 hdc in next sc, hdc in last sc; turn – 5 hdc.
Row 6: Ch 2, hdc in first 2 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc, hdc in last 2 hdc; turn – 7 hdc.
Row 7: Ch 2, working in back lps only, hdc in first 3 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc, hdc in last 3 hdc; turn – 9 hdc.
Row 8: Ch 2, working in front lps only, hdc in first 4 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc, hdc in last 4 hdc; turn – 11 hdc.
Row 9: Ch 2, working in back lps only, hdc in first 5 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc, hdc in last 5 hdc; turn – 13 hdc.
Row 10: Ch 2, working in front lps only, hdc in first 6 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc, hdc in last 6 hdc; turn – 15 hdc.
Row 11: Ch 2, working in back lps only, skip first hdc; [yo and draw up a lp in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 5 lps on hook – hdc dec made; hdc in next 4 hdc, 3 dc in next hdc, hdc in next 4 hdc, skip next hdc, hdc dec over last 2 hdc – 13 sts; turn.
Row 12: Ch 2, working in front lps only, skip first hdc, hdc dec, hdc in next 3 sts, 3 dc in next dc, hdc in next 3 sts, skip next hdc, hdc dec; turn – 11 sts.
Row 13: Ch 2, working in back lps only, skip first hdc, hdc dec, hdc in next 2 sts, 3 dc in next dc, hdc in next 2 sts, skip next hdc, hdc dec; turn – 9 sts.
Row 14: Ch 2, working in front lps only, skip first hdc, hdc dec, hdc in next st, 3 dc in next dc, hdc in next st, skip next hdc, hdc dec; turn – 7 sts.
Row 15: Ch 1, working in back lps only, skip first st, sc dec, 3 sc in next dc, skip next st, sc dec; turn – 5 sts.
Row 16: Ch 1, skip first st, sl st in next sc, 3 sc in next sc, skip next st, sl st in last sc. Fasten off.
With wrong sides tog, sew 2 matching pieces tog, stuffing lightly before closing seam.
FISHING PAIL
With MC, ch 4; join with a sl st to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 3, 15 dc in ring; join with a sl st in top of ch-3 – 16 sts.
Rnd 2: Working in back lps only, ch 3, dc in same st as joining, [2 dc in next dc] 15 times; join – 32 sts.
Rnd 3: Working in back lps only, ch 3, dc in same st as joining, dc in next st, [2 dc in next st, dc in next st] 15 times; join – 48 sts.
Rnd 4: Working in back lps only, ch 3, dc in same st, dc in next 2 dc, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc] 15 times; join – 64 sts.
Rnd 5: Working in back lps only, ch 3, dc in each dc around; join.
Rnd 6: Ch 3, dc in each dc around inc 4 sts evenly spaced; join – 68 sts. Fasten off.
Rnd 7: With wrong side facing, attach CA in any st; ch 1, sc in each st around; join in first sc; TURN.
Rnd 8: Working in back lps only, ch 2, skip first sc, hdc in each sc around; join in top of ch-2; TURN.
Rnd 9: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join; TURN. Fasten off.
Rnds 10 and 11: With right side facing, join MC in any sc and rep Rnd 6 – 76 sts at end of Rnd 11. Fasten off.
Rnds 12-14: With CB, rep Rnds 7-9.
Rnds 15 and 16: With MC, rep Rnd 6 – 84 sts at end of Rnd 16. Fasten off
Rnds 17-19: With CC, rep Rnds 7-9.
Rnds 20 and 21: With MC, rep Rnd 6 – 92 sts at end of Rnd 21. TURN at end of Rnd 21; do not fasten off.
Rnds 22 and 23: Working in back lps only, ch 1, sc in each st around; join to first sc; TURN. Fasten off.
Handle
With MC, ch 56.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across changing to CA in last sc; turn – 55 sc.
Row 2: With CA, ch 1, working back lps only, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: Rep Row 2 changing to MC in last sc.
Rows 4 and 5: With MC, rep Rows 2 and 3. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew each end of the handle to opposite sides of the pail. With CA and wrong side facing, sl st loosely in front lps across handle and top of pail. Rep for other side of handle and pail. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Fashion Crochet Thread size 3: 1 ball each 6 Scarlet A, 325 Tangerine B and 423 Maize C
Susan Bates® Crochet hook: Size 3.5 mm [E-4] crochet hook
11 oz [315g] of polyester pellets for three juggling balls
split ring stitch marker or small safety pin
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: Gauge is not important for this project.
instructions:
With A (C), make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring, do not join, mark last st made with the safety pin; tighten ring.
Round 2: [2 sc in next st] 6 times—12 sts.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times—18 sts.
Round 4: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 6 times—24 sts.
Round 5: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times—30 sts.
Round 6: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 6 times—36 sts.
Round 7: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 6 times, changing to B (A)—42 sts.
Round 8: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts] 6 times—48 sts.
Rounds 9 and 10: Sc in each st around.
Round 11: Sc in each st around, changing to C (B).
Rounds 12–14: Repeat Round 9.
Round 15: Sc in each st around, changing to B (A).
Rounds 16–18: Repeat Round 9.
Round 19: [Sc2tog, sc in next 6 sts] 6 times, changing to A (C)—42 sts.
Round 20: [Sc2tog, sc in next 5 sts] 6 times—36 sts.
Round 21: [Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts] 6 times—30 sts.
Round 22: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times—24 sts.
Round 23: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts] 6 times—18 sts. Stuff ball with pellets to desired fullness.
Round 24: [Sc2tog, sc in next st] 6 times—12 sts.
Round 25: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sts. Fasten off leaving a long tail.
FINISHING
Add more pellets if desired. Thread tail in tapestry needle and weave through remaining sts. Pull tight to gather, fasten off securely. Weave in tail.
POLKA DOT JUGGLING BALL
Work as for Striped Ball, using A for background and B and C for polka dots. Each polka dot is worked over 3 rounds. On the first and 3rd rounds, the polka dot is 2 sts wide, on the 2nd round it’s 3 sts wide. Position polka dots as desired, taking care not to place them too close together for best results.

materials: Contrast C 41554 In Motion Twists 1 ball
Size 3.5 mm (U.S. E or 4) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Small amount of red embroidery floss for mouth
Small amount of black embroidery floss for eyelashes
measurements: Doll: Approx 13 ins [33 cm] tall; Dress: Approx 4 ¼ ins [11 cm] long.
gauge: Doll: 16 sc and 20 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]; Dress: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Head: With MC, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd 10 times more.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sts. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
Stuff Head.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog over next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. Stuff rem of Head. Fasten off. 
Body: With MC, ch 30. Join with sl st to first ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 2 ins [5 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 4 ins [10 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd twice more. Fasten off.
Sew bottom edge of Body closed. Stuff Body. 
Arms (make 2).
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 tr in next sc (thumb). 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until Arm from beg measures 4 ins [10 cm]. Fasten off. Stuff Arms lightly.
Legs (make 2).
Shoe: With A, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn.
Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (Sc2tog over next 2 sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join MC with sl st to first sc. Place marker at end of rnd. 21 sts.
6th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog over next 2 sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 17 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (Sc2tog over next 2 sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd until Leg from marker at top of Shoe measures 5 ins [12.5 cm]. Fasten off.
Shoe strap: Join A with sl st to 6th sc of marked rnd. Ch 5. Join with sl st to 13th sc of marked rnd. Fasten off.
FINISHING 
Stuff Legs. Sew top of Legs closed using whip st. Sew to bottom of Body. Attach Arms to sides of Body.
Hair: Cut a piece of tape 11 ins [28 cm] long and secure onto a flat surface with sticky side up. Cut A, 14 ins [35.5 cm] long and lay them across tape so strip of tape is in center of yarn. Holding tissue paper over top of yarn and using sewing machine, run a line of stitching along length of tape. Remove tape when hair is secure. Remove tissue paper after stitching. Pin hair to outside of head. Using backstitch and A, sew hair into place along sewn line. Fold hair up and secure at top of Head tightly. With red and black embroidery floss, embroider mouth and eyelash using straight stitches. Sew head to body.
Dress 
Note: Dress is worked from top down.
With B, ch 30. Join with sl st to first ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in next ch. Miss next 2 ch. 1 sc in next ch. 3 sc in next ch. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sc in next ch. Miss next 2 ch. 1 sc in last ch. 1 sc in first ch (where first 2 sc worked). Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Working in back loops only, ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 3 sc in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sc in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in last sc. 1 sc in first sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 
3rd rnd: Working in back loops only, ch 1. 3 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 5 sc in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sc in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. 2 sc in first sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 
4th to 7th rnds: Working in back loops only, ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 3 sc in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. 1 sc in first sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 
8th rnd: Working in back loops only, ch 1. 3 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 5 sc in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. 2 sc in first sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 
9th and 10th rnds: Working in back loops only, ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 3 sc in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. 1 sc in first sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Break B. Join C.
11th rnd: Working in front loops only, with C, ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 3 sc in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. 1 sc in first sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.  
12th rnd: Join C with sl st to back loop of first sc of 11th rnd. Working in back loops only, ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same sp as sl st. *2 dc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.
Straps: (make 2). With 2 strands of B, ch 8. Fasten off. 
Try dress on Doll. Attach each strap at points of top edge. 
Flower: (make 1 with C, make 2 with B). 
Ch 2. 
1st rnd: 7 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: *Working in back loops only, ch 3. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * around, ending with ch 3. Join with sl st to first st. (7 petals). Fasten off.
Sew C Flower on Dress and B Flowers at ponytail.

materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi Prints™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 242 yds/221 m) Snail (9652) 1 ball makes 2 Snails
Size B/1 (2.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Approx 6½" [16.5 cm] from top of head to tip of tail.
gauge: 24 sc and 28 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed, keeping color change to WS of work.
• Do not join at end of rnd. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). Move marker up as each rnd is completed.
Boy Version 1:  Green is Color 1, Yellow is Color 2, Purple is Color 3.
Girl Version 2:  Purple is Color 1, Yellow is Color 2, Multi is Color 3.

BOY VERSION 1 
Outer Eye (Make 2).
With Color 3, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.

Head and Body
With Color 1, ch 2 (top of head).
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.

2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. 
12 sc.
3rd rnd:  *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
5th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
7th to 12th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. 
Place Outer Eye against head between 6th and 8th rnds, 3 sc apart. Following manufacturer’s instructions, attach safety eye through center of outer eye and through head. Snap in place inside head.
13th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 20 sts.
14th rnd: *1 sc in each st around. 
Stuff head.
15th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 15 sts.
16th to 44th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
Stuff Head lightly as you go.
45th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 12 sts.
46th to 49th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
50th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 10 sts.
51st to 57th rnds: 1 sc in each st around. 
Finish stuffing. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Draw end through rem sts. Pull tightly. 
Fasten securely. 
Cut long piece of pink from the multi yarn. Using Satin st, embroider Nose. Using Back st, embroider Smile. For Diagrams see page 3.

Antenna (make 2). 
With Color 1, ch 6. 
1st row:  Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. 
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Sew in place.

Shell
With Color 2, ch 2.
1st row: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. 
Turn. 9 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 12 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row.
7th row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 16 sc.
8th to 10th rows:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
11th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. (Sc2tog) 4 times. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Turn. 16 sc.
12th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
13th to 48th rows:  As 11th and 12th rows 18 times more, stuffing lightly as you go. Fasten off. 
Beg with 1st row, roll up Shell tightly and sew tog as you roll. 
Sew Shell to Body with open end of Shell covering 26th to 29th rnds of Body. 

Hat 
With Color 3, ch 2 (top of hat).
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Do not join at end of rnd. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd:  2 sc in each sc around. 
12 sc.
3rd rnd:  *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th to 8th rnds:  1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to front loop of first sc.
9th rnd:  Ch 2 ( does not count as st). Working in front loops only, 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 2 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Sew Hat in place.

Bow Tie
With Color 3, ch 5.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Contrast A Light Gray (0341) 1 ball or 80 yds/73.5 m
Contrast B Real Teal (0656) 1 ball or 40 yds/37 m
Contrast C Gold (0321) 1 ball or 27.5 yds/25 m
Contrast D Petal Pink (0373) 1 ball or 60 yds/55 m
Size U.S. 7 (4.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
• Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc.
Head and Body
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
8th to 11th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 10 sc. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 11 times. 1 sc in each of last 10 sc. Join. 53 sc.
13th to 16th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
17th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 10 sc. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 11 times. 1 sc in each of last 10 sc. Join. 42 sc.
18th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
19th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
21st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Break A. Join B.
Attach safety eyes (see photo for placement) and stuff Head firmly.
22nd rnd: With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
24th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
25th to 28th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
29th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Break B. Join with A.
30th rnd: With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
31st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
32nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sc.
33rd to 37th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
38th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
39th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
40th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc. Do not fasten off.
Separate for Legs:
Right Leg: Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. Ch 3. Skip next 21 sc. 1 sc in each of last 18 sc. Join. 24 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join.
***Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Break A. Join with D.
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off leaving a long end.
Draw end tightly through rem sts.***
Left Leg: Join A with sl st to first skipped sc of 42nd rnd.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sc as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 20 sc. Ch 3. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 21 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Join.
Rep from *** to ***.
Skirt: Join B with sl st to first sc of front loops of 28th rnd.
1st rnd: Ch 2. Working in front loops only, 1 hdc in same sc as sl st. 1 hdc in next sc. *2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 hdc in last sc. Join.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Break B. Join C.
5th rnd: With C, ch 1. *1 sc in next hdc. 2 dc in next hdc. 1 sc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. Fasten off.
Ears (make 2 alike)
Inside Ear: With D, ch 2.
**1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. Do not join. 20 sc.
Fasten off.**
Outside Ear: With A, ch 2.
Rep from ** to ** for Outside Ear.
Ear Assembly:
With WS of Inside Ear and Outside Ear tog, join with sl st through both thicknesses to first sc of 4th row. Next row: Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses and in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row.
Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing.
Sew each Ear to Head as shown in photo.
Arms (make 2 alike)
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 4 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep 2nd rnd until work from beg measures 1½" [4 cm]. Break A. Join with D.
Next rnd: With D, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off leaving a long end.
Draw end tightly through rem sts.
Sew Arms to Body as shown in photo.
Sleeves (make 2 alike):
With B, ch 2.
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 6 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Break B. Join C.
4th row: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 2. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row.
Fasten off.
Sew Sleeves over Arms to Body as shown in photo.
Collar
With C, ch 25.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 2 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 2. Sl st in same ch as last dc. Sl st in next ch. Ch 2. 1 dc in same ch as last sl st. 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. (2 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch) twice.
Fasten off leaving long end for sewing.
Sew Collar around neck with 2 dc points in front as shown in photo.
Tail
With D, ch 13.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 12 sc.
Fasten off.
Sew Tail to back of Body under Skirt.
Nose:
With length of D, embroider nose using satin stitch as shown in photo.
SATIN STITCH
Finishing Eyes
With length of A, cinch eyes tog as shown in photo, which helps create slightly pointy nose.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 13 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: All rnds are joined with a sl st to first st.
Body
Beg using magic loop method, demonstrated here. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 30 sc.
5th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 40 sc.
7th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 50 sc.
9th to 12th rnds: As 3rd rnd.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
14th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
15th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
16th to 18th rnds: As 3rd rnd.
19th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 27 sc.
20th and 21st rnds: As 3rd rnd.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
23rd rnd: As 3rd rnd.
24th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 21 sc.
25th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
26th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
27th to 30th rnds: As 3rd rnd.
Fasten off. Stuff with polyfill, leaving end open.
Snout
Beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sc.
5th rnd: As 3rd rnd. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Add safety nose as shown in photo. Stuff before stitching to Head.
Ears (make 2)
Beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 5 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 15 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 10 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. 
Head
Beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
7th to 11th rnds: As 5th rnd.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 32 sc. 
13th rnd: As 5th rnd. 
14th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 24 sc.
15th rnd: As 5th rnd.
Note: Now is a good time to stitch Snout to Head, and stuff Head.
16th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of rnd. 16 sc.
17th rnd: As 5th rnd.
18th to 20th rnds: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 2 sc. 
Fasten off.
Sew Ears to Head as shown in photo.  Stuff Snout and sew to Head as shown in photo, with top of Snout placed below 4th rnd of Head.
Attach safety eyes to 4th round of head, just above Snout and spaced approx 4 sts apart. Sew Head to Body as shown in photo.
Arms (make 2)
Beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in  back loops only, 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 12 sc.
7th and 8th rnds: As 5th rnd.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of rnd. 8 sc.
10th rnd:  As 5th rnd. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff with polyfill.
Feet (make 2)
Beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 18 sc
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. Working in  back loops only, 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join.
6th and 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 18 sc.
9th to 11th rnds: As 6th and 7th rnds.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 12 sc. 
13th and 14th rnds: As 6th and 7th rnds.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff with polyfill.
Sew Arms and Feet to Body as shown in photo.
Tail
Beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join. 12 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join. 8 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff with polyfill and sew to Body as shown in photo.
Scarf
With B, ch 5.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row.  Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 10” [25.5 cm]. Fasten off. Cut lengths of B 4” [10 cm] long.
Knot into fringe across ends of Scarf. Trim fringe evenly.

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Baby Shower™ (170 yds/155 m)
Bunny Version - Contrast A Yellow (7330) 1 ball
Bunny Version - Contrast B White (0100) 1 ball
Bear Version - Contrast A Dark Dogwood (8820) 1 ball
Bear Version - Contrast B Natural (8010) 1 ball
Size U.S. D/3 (3.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Pink embroidery floss (for Bunny Teether only)
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Bunny: Approx 7" [18 cm] tall, including ring. Bear: Approx 5" [12.5 cm], including ring. Both characters: Head approx 2" [5 cm] diameter.
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes
• Each Teether is made from 8 pieces: Head, Nose, 2 Ears, 2 Eyes, Ring Cover, and Ruff.
• Head, Nose, Ring Cover, and Ruff are worked the same for both Teethers.
• Separate instructions are provided for Bunny Nose, Ears and Eyes and for Bear Nose, Ears, and Eyes.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first sc/st.

HEAD
With A, make an adjustable ring: Wrap yarn into a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring. After the first round of stitches is worked, pull gently on tail to tighten ring.

1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join with sl st in first sc. 8 sc.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.

3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.

4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc.

5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.

6th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.

7th to 12th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.

13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sts.

14th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog, *1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.

15th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first st. 12 sts.

Fasten off, leaving a 12-18" [30.5-45.5 cm] long tail. Stuff head firmly. Thread long tail through rem sts and pull to close opening. Secure end but do not cut tail, it will be used later to sew Head to covered ring.

BUNNY NOSE
With A, make an adjustable ring as given for Head.
1st to 4th: As 1st to 4th rnds of Head. 32 sc at end of last rnd.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. With yarn tail, sew Nose to Head adding a very small amount of polyfill to Nose as you sew.

BUNNY EARS (make 2)
With A, ch 6, leaving a long tail for sewing Ear to Head.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 5 sc.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Turn. 7 sc.

3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

4th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of first 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in last st. Turn. 9 sc.

5th row: As 3rd row.

6th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 2 sc in next st) twice. 1 sc in last st. Turn. 11 sc.

7th to 9th rows: As 3rd row.

10th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of first 3 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in last st. Turn. 9 sts.

11th and alt rows: As 3rd row.

12th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in first 2 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in last st. Turn. 7 sts.

14th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in first st. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in last st. Turn. 5 sts.

16th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.

17th row: As 3rd row.

Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Using photograph as a guide, sew Ears to Head.

BUNNY EYES (make 2)
Cut two ¾" [19 mm] circles from black felt. Using photograph as a guide, applique Eyes to Head. With white embroidery floss, embroider outline stitch along lower edge of each Eye. With white embroidery floss, embroider a French knot on each Eye as highlight.

BEAR NOSE
With A, make an adjustable ring, as given for Head.
1st to 3rd rnds: As 1st to 3rd rnds of Head. 24 sc at end of last rnd.

4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.

Fasten off, leaving a long tail. With yarn tail, sew Nose to Head adding a very small amount of polyfill to Nose as you sew.

BEAR EARS (make 2)
With A, make an adjustable ring, as given for Head.
Row 1: 4 sc in ring. Turn. 4 sc.

Row 2: Ch 2 (does not count as st). 2 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 8 hdc.

Row 3: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Using photograph as a guide, sew Ears to Head.

BEAR EYES (make 2)
Cut two ½" [13 mm] circles from black felt. Using photograph as a guide, applique Eyes to Head. With white embroidery floss, embroider outline stitch along lower edge of each Eye. With white embroidery floss, embroider a French knot on each Eye as highlight.

RING COVER
With B, ch 23.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 21 hdc.

2nd to 5th rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.

Joining row: Wrap cover over ring and bring first and last row tog with sts matching. Working through both thicknesses, slip st in each st across to attach cover to ring.

Fasten off and weave in end.

RUFF
With B, ch 16.
1st row: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 30 sc.

2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 60 sc.

Fasten off at end of last row, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
With yarn tail still attached to Head, sew Head to center of Ring Cover. Place Ruff around base of Head, where it is joined to Ring Cover. With yarn tail still attached to Ruff, sew short ends of Ruff together. Weave in ends.
