PIGEON
BODY
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
9th and 10th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc. PM in last st for Leg placement. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. PM in last st for Leg placement. 1 sc in each of last 36 sc. Join.
13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sc.
15th to 17th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
18th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 30 sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Sc2tog. * PM for Tail placement. Sc2tog. Rep from * to * once. Join. 56 sc.
19th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 30 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Join. 50 sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join
21st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 39 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of last 8 sc. Join. 48 sc.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 27 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) 3 times. Join. 45 sc.
24th to 26th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
27th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
28th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. PM in last st for Wing placement. 1 sc in each of next 20 sc. PM in last st for Wing placement. 1 sc in each of last 14 sc. Join.
29th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * once more. Join. 32 sc.
Stuff Body firmly. Cont stuffing as rem rnds are worked.
30th and 31st rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
32nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 27 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Join. 30 sc.
33rd and 34th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Break MC. Change to A.
35th to 37th rnds: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
38th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc. Change to B, 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Change to A, 1 sc in each of last 8 sc. Join.
39th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. Change to B, 1 sc in each of next 17 sc. Change to A, 1 sc in each of last 7 sc. Join.
40th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. Change to B, 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Change to A, 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Join. Break A. Change to B. 27 sc.
41st rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
42nd rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 8 sc. Rejoin MC, 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Change to B, 1 sc in each of last 8 sc. Join.
43rd rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. Change to MC, 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Change to B. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join.
44th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Change to MC, 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc) twice. Change to B, Sc2tog. Join. Break B. Cont with MC. 24 sc.
45th rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
46th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
47th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
48th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join. 6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving long yarn end. Using long yarn end, weave through top of final sts and pull tightly to close.
TAIL
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Join. 6 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) twice. Join. 8 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join and change to MC. 18 sc.
9th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Change to C.
10th rnd: With C, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Break C. Change to MC.
11th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 21 sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
14th and 15th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
16th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
17th and 18th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
19th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join. 36 sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 18 sc. PM in last st for Tail placement. 1 sc in each of last 18 sc. Join.
Fasten off, leaving a long yarn end. Stuff Tail firmly. Align marker on Tail with designated marker on Body. Keeping markers aligned and using long yarn end, sew last rnd of Tail evenly around last rnd to Body, working over approx 10 rnds below marker.
LEFT WING
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 8 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 10 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Break MC. Change to B. 15 sc.
5th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join. 19 sc. Break B. Join A.
7th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 9 sc. Rejoin MC. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Join.
9th rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Change to A, 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Break A. Change to MC. With MC, 1 sc in each of last 12 sc. Join.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 14 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join. 21 sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. 21 sc. Join.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
13th rnd: Rep 11th rnd.
14th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
15th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 14 sc. Join. 20 sc.
16th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join.
17th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Change to C. Do not carry or break MC.
18th rnd: With C, rep 16th rnd. Change to MC. Do not carry or break C.
19th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Break MC. Change to C.
21st rnd: With C, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join.
Stuff Left Wing firmly. Cont stuffing as rem rnds are worked.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 10 sc.

RIGHT WING
Work from ** to ** as given for Left Wing.
8th rnd: Pick up MC. With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 10 sc. Change to A. With A, 1 sc in each of last 9 sc. Change to MC. Join.
9th rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 12 sc. Change to A, 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Break A. Change to MC. With MC, 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 14 sc. Join. 21 sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join. 21 sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
13th rnd: Rep 11th rnd.
14th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
15th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 14 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join. 20 sc.
16th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join.
17th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Change to C. Do not carry or break MC.
18th rnd: With C, rep 16th rnd. Change to MC. Do not carry or break C.
19th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Break MC. Change to C.
21st rnd: With C, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join.
Stuff Right Wing firmly. Cont stuffing as rem rnds are worked.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 10 sc.
24th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 8 sc.
25th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 4 times. Join. 4 sc
Fasten off, leaving long yarn end. Using long yarn end, weave through final sts and pull tight to close. Weave in ends.
Wing Assembly
With length of MC, whipstitch first rnd of each Wing at designated markers of 28th rnd of Body. Wings should be oriented so rnd join is facing Body, and A sts in 9th, 10th and 11th rnds of Wings are at top, as shown in photo.
THIGHS (make 2 alike)
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 9 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 15 sc.
5th and 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 21 sc.
9th and 10th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off at end of 10th rnd, leaving long yarn end.
LEGS (make 2 alike)
With C, ch 6. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 6 sc.
2nd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. (Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times – Toes made. 1 sc in last sc. Join.
Fasten off, leaving long yarn end.
FEET (make 2 alike)
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: (RS). 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd row: (Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Sl st in next sc) 3 times. Fasten off, leave rem sts unworked.
Leg Assembly
Align Feet with last rnd of Legs, with WS tog. Using long yarn end, sew Feet to last rnd of Legs, keeping Toes aligned.
Stuff Leg firmly.
With length of C, sew 1st rnd of Legs evenly around 1st rnd of Thighs.
Stuff Thigh firmly.
Align top of each Thigh, so Toes point upwards, with designated markers in 11th rnd of Body. Using long yarn end sew last rnd of Thighs evenly around last rnd to Body, working over approx 6 rnds below markers.
BEAK
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Fasten off at end of 3rd rnd, leaving long yarn end.
Stuff Beak firmly.
Using long yarn end, sew Beak evenly around final sts of Body, working over 40th to 42nd rnds on side opposite to Tail, as shown in photo.
With small amount of white worsted weight yarn, satin stitch over bridge of Beak, as shown.
EYES (make 2 alike)
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join and fasten off, leaving long yarn end.
With small amount of white worsted weight yarn, satin stitch triangle highlights onto eyes, as shown.
Using long yarn end and working evenly around tops of sts, sew Eyes to Body over 41st to 43rd rnds, equally spaced on either side of Beak, as shown.

pattern_name: Crochet Dipped Donuts and Donut Holes
materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi Prints™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 242 yds/221 m) Donut (9337) 1 ball makes 2 Donuts and 4 Donut Holes
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
2 black safety eyes 1/4" [6 mm] for each toy.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Donut: Approx 4" [10 cm] diameter. Donut Hole: Approx 1¼" [3 cm] diameter.
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Dipped Donut
Version 1: Brown as Color 1, Pink as Color 2.
Version 2: Beige as Color 1, Rainbow Print as Color 2.
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to 1st st.
Donut
With Color 1, ch 12. Join with sl st to 1st ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 12 sc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 66 sc.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 72 sc.
15th to 20th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
21st rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 66 sts.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sts.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sts.
24th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sts.
25th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sts.
26th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sts.
27th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
28th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
29th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
30th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts. Fasten off leaving long end. Use end for sewing.
Making sure RS of Donut is facing out (RS facing in inside hole of Donut), begin sewing beg ch and 30th rnd tog, stuffing Donut firmly at same time.
Donut Icing
With Color 2, ch 18. Join with sl st to 1st ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep from ** to ** as given for Donut.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 72 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc of last rnd of Icing. Ch 2. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Ch 6. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join.
Fasten off leaving long end.
Secure safety eyes to icing as shown in photo. Sew Icing to Donut beg with center hole of donut followed by outside drips of Icing.
Donut Holes (make 1 in each shade)
Ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th to 9th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.
Secure safety eyes as shown in photo. Stuff Donut Hole firmly.
12th rnd: Ch 1. ((Sc2tog) 6 times. Join. 6 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts.

materials: 1 skein each of 360 Café Latte A, 506 Pool B, 324 Bright Yellow C, 3620 Glowworm D, and 312 Black E
Note: Only a small amounts of D and E are needed.
Yarn needle, stitch marker, stuffing, ½" [13 mm] button for cape (optional)
abbreviations: A, B, C, D, and E = Color A, B, C, D, and E
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 12 sts = 3"; 14 rows = 3" in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEAD
Beginning at nose with A, ch 2. 
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. 
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 4–7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: Sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in each of next 6 sc, sc in last 9 sc—30 sc.
Rounds 11 and 12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—36 sc.
Rounds 14 and 15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 17: Sc in each sc around.
Round 18: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 19: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 20: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Stuff head.
Round 21: Sc in each sc around.
Round 22: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through the stitches of last round and pull to gather. Weave in end securely.
Facial Features: With E, embroider satin stitch eyes and nose, and straight stitch mouth.
RHC0334-016803M | LAST UPDATED: AUGUST 1, 2019
CROCHET  
SKILL LEVEL
EASY
SHOP KIT
SUPER HERO BEAR SET | CROCHET    1 of 3

EAR (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of head—12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 4 times—8 sc.
Fasten off. Do not stuff ear. Flatten and sew ears to head.
BODY
Beginning at top with C, ch 6; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 2 sc in each ch around—12 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. 
Round 2: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around. 
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—36 sc.
Rounds 8-18: Sc in each sc around.
Begin stuffing body and continue to stuff until piece is complete.
Divide for Legs
First Leg
Round 19: Sc in next 18 sc, place a marker in the next st; leave the marked st and all remaining sts unworked—18 sc. Work in continuous rounds over the 18 sc just made only, forming a circle for the first leg. 
Rounds 20–23: Sc in each sc around.
Round 24: Sc in each sc around; change to B in last st.
Boot
Rounds 25–30: With B, sc in each sc around.
Round 31: Work 2 sc in each of first 3 sc, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in each of last 3 sc—24 sc.
Rounds 32–35: Sc in each sc around.
Round 36: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Stuff leg.
Round 37: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through the stitches of last round and pull to gather. Weave in end securely.
Second Leg
With right side facing, join A with sc in marked st following first leg.
Round 19: Sc in each remaining unworked st following first leg.
Rounds 20–23: Sc in each sc around.
Round 24: Sc in each sc around; change to B in last st.
Boot
Rounds 25–37: Work same as Rounds 25–37 of first leg.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through the stitches of last round and pull to gather. Weave in end securely. 
Sew head to top of body.
ARM (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of head—12 sc.
Rounds 3–5: Sc in each sc around. 
Round 6: [Sc2tog] twice, sc in remaining 8 sc—10 sc.
Rounds 7–16: Sc in each sc around. 
Fasten off. Stuff arms and sew to body.
SLEEVE (make 2)
With C, ch 15.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—14 sc. 
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Slip sleeve around upper part of arm and sew in place.
BOOT TOP (make 2)
Beginning at top of boot with B, ch 21. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—20 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Place boot top around top of boot and sew in place.
CAPE
Collar
With B, ch 21.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—20 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * across, turn—25 sc. 
Row 3: Ch 1, *sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * across, turn—30 sc. 
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. 
Fasten off.
Body of Cape
Row 1 (right side): Turn collar upside down to work in chains along opposite side of foundation ch, join B with slip st in first ch, ch 6, sc in same ch as last slip st (button loop made), sc in each remaining ch across, turn—20 sc and one ch-6 button loop.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in first sc, 2 dc in each remaining sc across, turn—40 dc. 
Rows 3–12: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
Fasten off. Sew button just below collar, opposite button loop. Button cape around neck.
STAR
With D, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook—5 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. 
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—10 sc.
Round 3: *Slip st in next sc, ch 4, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, dc in next ch (point made), skip next sc of Round 2; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first slip st—5 points.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew star to center back of cape.
BELT
With D, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—5 sc. 
Rows 2–38: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew belt around bear's waist.
Belt Buckle
With B, ch 6.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working along opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch—12 sc. 
Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 3 sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of last 2 sc—18 sc. 
Round 3: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
With C, embroider a chain stitch "S" on buckle. Sew buckle to center of belt.
FINISHING
Weave in any remaining ends.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 2.25 mm [US B-1]
Optional: Pins, knee high stocking and plastic pellets for weighted stuffing.
abbreviations: A, B, C, and D = Color A, Color B, Color C, and Color D
() = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Dinosaur measures about 4¼" [11 cm] tall and 4" [10 cm] wide (at widest).
gauge: 32 sts = about 4" [10 cm]; 28 rounds = about 4" [10 cm] in single crochet (sc). EXACT GAUGE IS NOT CRITICAL TO THIS PROJECT. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SPOTTED DINOSAUR BODY
Beginning at bottom of body with A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each of next 6 sts—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—36 sc.
Make Opening for Tail
Round 7: 2 sc in next st, ch 8, skip next 8 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] twice, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] twice—34 sts and 1 ch-8 space.
Round 8: Sc in each st and ch around—42 sc.
Rounds 9–11: Sc in each st around.
Round 12: [Sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 13: Sc in each st around.
Round 14: [Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc. 
Round 15: Sc in each st around.
Begin stuffing piece with fiberfill or place optional knee high, filled with plastic pellets, into piece. Continue stuffing piece as work progresses.
Round 16: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc. 
Round 17: Sc in each st around.
Round 18: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc. 
Round 19: Sc in each st around.
Round 20: [Sc in next 7 sts, sc2tog] twice—16 sc. 
Round 21: [Sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog] twice—14 sc.
Rounds 22 and 23: Sc in each st around.
Finish stuffing piece.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing head to neck. If needed, thread beginning yarn tail through stitches at bottom of piece and pull to close opening. Secure and weave in beginning tail only.
STRIPED DINOSAUR BODY
Beginning at bottom of body with B, make an adjustable ring.
Rounds 1–8: Work same as Rounds 1–8 of spotted dinosaur body—42 sc. 
Begin Striped Section
Remove end of round marker. 
Reposition End of Round: Sc in next 4 sts. Slip stitch in next sc and change yarn color to C (as you work the slip stitch). Note: The yarn color changes are made at the end of rounds. Repositioning the end of round to the center of the back/tail will allow the color changes to be hidden beneath the back spikes that are added later. 
Round 9: With C, ch 1, sc in same st as slip st and in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc.
Note: Work first sc of all following stripe rounds in same stitch as joining slip stitch.
Round 10: With C, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc and change to B.
Round 11: With B, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. 
Round 12: With B, ch 1, [sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc and change to C—36 sc.
Round 13: With C, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. 
Round 14: With C, [sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc and change to B—30 sc. 
Round 15: With B, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. 
Begin stuffing piece with fiberfill or place optional knee high, filled with plastic pellets, into piece. Continue stuffing piece as work progresses. 
Round 16: With B, [sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc and change to C—24 sc. 
Round 17: With C, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. 
Round 18: With C, [sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc and change to B—18 sc. 
Cut C. Work remaining rounds with B only.
Round 19: Sc in each st around; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). 
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 20: [Sc in next 7 sts, sc2tog] twice—16 sc. 
Round 21: [Sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog] twice—14 sc.
Rounds 22 and 23: Sc in each st around. 
Finish stuffing piece.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing head to neck. If needed, thread beginning yarn tail through stitches at bottom of piece and pull to close opening. Secure and weave in beginning tail only.
TAIL
Note: If making spotted dinosaur, use yarn color A. If making striped dinosaur, use yarn color B.
Join yarn with slip stitch in any st of the tail opening. In the next round, stitches are worked into each stitch (including the chains of the ch-8) around the tail opening.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in next 15 sts—16 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each st around 
Round 4: [Sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog] twice—14 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog] twice—12 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] twice—10 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] twice—8 sc.
Round 8: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] twice—6 sc.
Fasten off leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. Weave in and trim ends.
HEAD
Note: If making spotted dinosaur, use yarn color A. If making striped dinosaur, use yarn color B.
Make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each of next 6 sts—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 4–7: Sc in each st around. 
Round 8: [Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 9: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—30 sc.
Rounds 10 and 11: Sc in each st around. 
Round 12: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 13: [Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 14: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Round 15: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 4 times—8 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread ending tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening. If needed, thread beginning yarn tail through stitches at beginning of piece and pull to close opening. Weave in and trim tails.
LEGS (make 4 for each dinosaur)
Note: If making spotted dinosaur, use yarn color A. If making striped dinosaur, use yarn color B.
Make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Place a marker in the last sc worked to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each of next 6 sts—12 sc.
Rounds 3 and 4: Sc in each st around. 
Stuff leg. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing leg to body. If needed, thread beginning yarn tail through stitches at beginning of piece and pull to close opening. Weave in and trim beginning tail only.
SPOTS (make 3 for spotted dinosaur)
With D, make an adjustable ring. 
Round 1: Work 12 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing spot to body. If needed, thread beginning yarn tail through stitches at beginning of piece and pull to close opening. Weave in and trim beginning tail only.
SPIKES
Note: If making spotted dinosaur, use yarn color D. If making striped dinosaur, use yarn color C.
Leaving a long beginning tail for sewing spikes to body, ch 36.
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across—35 slip sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, (3 hdc, slip st) in next st, slip st in next st, [skip next st, (slip st, 3 hdc, slip st) in next st, slip st in next st] 10 times, skip next st, slip st in last st.
Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing spikes to body.
FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide to placement, use yarn tails or yarn scraps to sew the following pieces together.
1. Sew head to body, positioning face slightly to the side.
2. Sew legs to bottom-most portion of body. Position the back two legs directly in front of the tail and the front legs directly in front of the back legs.
Note: To get proper balance and make the dinosaur sit upright, it may be helpful to pin legs before sewing in place.
3. Sew spikes along back of body, beginning at top of head. Place the first spike about level with the middle of the eyes and follow the contour of the back of head, neck, back, and tail. End by sewing last slip st of spikes about even with tip of tail.
Note: It may be helpful to pin spikes to body before sewing in place.
4. Sew spots to spotted dinosaur body. Position spots randomly.
With embroidery needle and 2 strands of black embroidery floss, embroider a running stitch smile on face of dinosaur, about 3 rows below last round of muzzle end of head. Weave the floss back through head and knot securely then bury yarn in head, trimming excess as needed.
Weave in and trim any remaining ends.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 2 balls 5142 Cherry Red A
RED HEART Boutique® Sassy Fabric™: 1 hank 9947 Red Leopard B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
( ) = work all directions in parentheses in the indicated stitch or space
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Dress fits 18” (45.5 cm) tall doll. Dress from Neck to bottom edge measures 15” (38 cm). Skirt circumference measures 30” (76 cm).
gauge: 17 hdc = 4” (10 cm); Rows GAUGE. Use any size to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
DRESS
Yoke
With A, ch 34.
Row 1 (Right Side): Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and next ch, [2 hdc in next ch, hdc in next 2 ch] 10 times, 2 hdc in last ch; turn—44 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each hdc across; turn—44 sc.
Row 3: Ch 2, dc in next 3 sc, 2 dc in next sc, [dc in next 4 sc, 2 dc in next sc] 7 times, dc in last 4 sc; turn—52 dc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each dc across, working last sc in top of ch-2; turn—52 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, [hdc in next 7 sc, 2 hdc in next sc] 6 times, hdc in last 4 sc; turn—58 hdc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in each hdc across; turn—58 sc.
Shape Armholes
Row 7: Ch 2, dc in next 8 sc, ch 7, skip next 11 sc, dc in next 18 sc, ch 7, skip next 11 sc, dc in last 9 sc; turn—36 dc, 2 ch-7 spaces.
Bodice
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in each dc and ch across, working last sc in top of ch-2; turn—50 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, hdc in each sc across; turn—50 hdc.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in each hdc across; turn—50 sc.
Row 11: Ch 2, dc in next sc and each sc across; turn—50 dc.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc in each dc across, working last sc in top of ch-2; turn—50 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, [hdc in next 5 sc, 2 hdc in next sc] 8 times, hdc in last 2 sc; turn—58 hdc.
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in each hdc across; turn—58 sc.
Row 15 (Right Side): Ch 2, dc in same first sc, [dc in next 5 sc, 2 dc in next sc] 9 times, d...last round; join with slip st in top of ch-2; turn—99 dc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in each hdc around; join with slip st in first sc; turn—99 sc.
Round 8: Ch 2, dc in each sc around; join with slip st in top of ch-2; turn—99 dc.
Rounds 9-15: Repeat Rounds 5-8 consecutively; repeat Rounds 5-7 consecutively.
Round 16: Ch 2, dc in next 9 sc, 2 dc in next sc [dc in next 10 sc, 2 dc in next sc] 8 times; join with slip st in top of ch-2; turn—108 dc.
Round 17: Ch 1, sc in each dc around; join with slip st in first sc; turn—108 sc.
Round 18: Ch 1, hdc in each sc around; join with slip st in first hdc; turn—108 hdc.
Round 19: Ch 1, sc in each hdc around; join with slip st in first sc; turn—108 sc.
Round 20: Ch 2, dc in each sc around; join with slip st in top of ch-2; turn—108 dc.
Round 21: Repeat Round 17.
Round 22: Ch 1, [hdc in next 8 sc, 2 hdc in next sc] around; join with slip st in first hdc; turn—120 hdc.
Round 23: Ch 1, sc in each hdc around; join with slip st in first sc; turn—120 sc.
Round 24: Ch 2, dc in each sc around; join with slip st in top of ch-2; turn—120 dc. Fasten off A.
Back Overlap
With Right Side facing, join A in top right corner of opening; ch 2, working down side of opening, dc evenly across this side only; fasten off.
RUFFLES
Note: Ruffles are worked into the spaces between the vertical posts of stitches with the Right Side of the Dress facing, holding the Yoke at the top, and with the Right Side of B facing.
Neck Ruffle
Leave a 3” (7.5 cm) tail on B; insert hook in next hole on B and between sts of top left corner of Row 1 of the Yoke; holding a new strand of A underneath, pull loop of A through both layers to top, [insert hook in next loop of B and through next space between sts of Row 1, pull loop of A through all layers] across; fasten off A. Cut B, leaving a 3” (7.5 cm) tail.
Skirt Ruffles (Make 4)
With stitch markers, mark Round 22, Round 18, Round 14, and Round 10 of the Skirt.
Leave a 3” (7.5 cm) tail on B, insert hook in next hole on B and between sts of Round 22; holding a new strand of A underneath, pull loop of A through both layers to top, [insert hook in next loop of B, skip 2 sts of Round 22, insert hook through next space between sts of Round 22, pull loop of A loosely through all layers] across; fasten off A. Cut B, leaving a 3” (7.5 cm) tail.
Repeat on marked rounds, working from the bottom up.
FINISHING 
Roll under each end of B and tack down with needle and thread. Weave in all ends of A. Evenly space 3 buttons under Overlap on left side of opening, using spaces between stitches of Overlap as buttonholes; sew buttons in place. Block, stretching skirt lengthwise.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® “Classic Crochet”, Size 10: 1 Ball each 493 French Rose A, 422 Golden Yellow B, 12 Black C, 495 Wood Violet D, 119 Violet E, 431 Pumpkin F.
AUNT LYDIA’S® “Metallic Crochet”, Size 10: 1 Ball of 1P White/Pearl G.
Split-ring stitch marker; stuffing, yarn needle; 4 silver beads; sewing needle and thread; 3 alphabet beads: B, U, and G.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: 20 sc = 4”; 24 rounds = 4” with two strands held together. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
LOVE BUG
With A, ch 12.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 9 ch, 3 sc in last ch; turn to work along opposite side of beginning ch, sc in next 9 ch, 2 sc in next ch – 24 sts.
Round 2: * Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 3: * Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Round 4: Sc in each st around.
Rounds 5-10: Repeat Round 4.
Round 11: * Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 48 sts.
Round 12: Repeat Round 4.
Round 13: * Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 60 sts.
Rounds 14-20: Repeat Round 4.
Round 21: * Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 48 sts.
Round 22: * Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 36 sts. Add stuffing.
Round 23: * Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 24: Sc2tog around – 12 sts. Fasten off. Sew seam parallel to beginning ch.
Fender (Make 4)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 6 sts.
Round 2: 2 sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Round 3: * Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 4: * Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Rounds 5-6: Sc in each st around.
Round 7: Slip st in each st around. Fasten off.
This darling little bugger will delight all ages. Make this little car as shown then make a few more in other colors for added fun. Crochet thread isn’t just for doilies!
FINISHING
Sew Wheel Flowers to center of each Wheel. Sew 1 silver bead in the center of each flower, pulling thread tightly to indent. Sew each Wheel under a Fender, and sew each Fender to Car as pictured.
With C, embroider a pupil in the center of each Headlight/Eye. Stuff Eye lightly and sew into place onto Car. Embroider mouth and nose as pictured.
Sew Tail Lights into place at back of car. Sew Large Flower in place at top of car, and Small Flowers randomly over roof of car as pictured.
Sew alphabet beads spelling “BUG” in a row on back of Car for license plate. Weave in ends.
Wheel (Make 4)
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 6 sts.
Round 2: 2 sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Round 3: * Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 18 sts. Change to C in last st. Fasten off B.
Round 4: With C, * sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Rounds 5-6: Sc in each st around.
Round 7: Sc2tog around – 12 sts.
Round 8: Repeat Round 7 – 6 sts. Fasten off. Add stuffing. Draw remaining sts together.
Wheel Flower (Make 4)
With D, ch 2.
Round 1: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 8 sts.
Round 2: * Slip st in next st, ch 1; repeat from * around. Fasten off.
Headlight/Eye (Make 2)
With G, work same as for Fender through Round 3 – 18 sts.
Round 4: Working in back loops only, sc in each st around.
Round 5: * Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 12 sts. Fasten off.
Petal-Round 6: Working in the front loops from Round 3 only, join E in any st, ch 1, sc in same st as joining, * 3 hdc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around. Fasten off.
Tail Lights (Make 2)
With F, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st. Fasten off.
Large Flower
With D, ch 5; join.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as 1st dc), 11 dc in ring; join – 12 sts. Fasten off D.
Round 2: Working in front loops only, join A in any st, ch 2, * slip st in next st, ch 2; repeat from * around. Fasten off A.
Round 3: Working in back loops of Round 1 only, join B in any st, ch 3, * slip st in next st, ch 3; repeat from * around. Fasten off B.
Small Flowers
With D, ch 2.
Round 1: 7 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 7 sts.
Round 2: * (Slip st, ch 3, slip st) all in next st; repeat from * around. Fasten off.
Make 1 more Small Flower with D, 2 with B, 1 with G, 1 with E, and 1 with F.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 360 Café Latte A, 312 Black B, 512 Turqua C, 385 Royal D, 254 Pumpkin E, 324 Bright Yellow F, and 319 Cherry Red G.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: 12 sts = 3”; 14 rows = 3” in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BEAR
Head
Beginning at nose with A, ch 2.
Round 1 (Right Side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 4–7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: Sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in each of next 6 sc, sc in last 9 sc—30 sc.
Rounds 11 and 12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—36 sc.
Rounds 14 and 15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 17: Sc in each sc around.
Round 18: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 19: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 20: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Stuff head.
Round 21: Sc in each sc around.
Round 22: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through the stitches of last round and pull to gather. Weave in end securely.
Facial Features
With B, embroider satin stitch eyes and nose, and straight stitch mouth.

Ear (Make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of head—12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 4 times—8 sc.
Fasten off. Do not stuff ear. Flatten and sew ears to head.

Headband
With C, ch 31.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn—30 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off. Sew headband around head, in front of ears.

Bow
With C, ch 2.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of head; change to D in last st of Round 2—12 sc.
Round 3: With D, sc in each sc around; change to C in last st.
Round 4: With C, sc in each sc around; change to D in last st.
Round 5: With D, [skip next sc, slip st in next sc] 6 times—6 slip sts.
Round 6: With D, sc in each slip st around; change to C in last sc—6 sc.
Round 7: With C, 2 sc in each sc around; change to D in last sc—12 sc.
Rounds 8 and 9: Repeat Rounds 3 and 4; do NOT change to D in last st of Round 9.
Round 10: With C, [sc2tog] 6 times—6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through the stitches of last round and pull to gather. Weave in end securely.

Body
Beginning at top with A, ch 6; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, 2 sc in each ch around—12 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; change to C in last st—36 sc.

Bathing Suit
Round 8: With C, sc in each sc around; change to D in last st.
Round 9: With D, sc in each sc around; change to C in last st.
Rounds 10–17: Repeat last 2 rounds 4 more times.
Round 18: With C, sc in each sc around; change to D in last st. Stuff body and bathing suit.

Divide for Legs
First Leg
Round 19: With D, sc in next 18 sc; change to A in last sc, place a marker in the next st; leave the marked st and all remaining sts unworked—18 sc. Work in continuous rounds over the remaining 18 sc only, forming a circle for the first leg. 
Rounds 20–30: Sc in each sc around.

Shape Foot
Round 31: Work 2 sc in each of first 3 sc, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in each of last 3 sc—24 sc.
Rounds 32–35: Sc in each sc around.
Round 36: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Stuff leg.
Round 37: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through the stitches of last round and pull to gather. Weave in end securely.

Second Leg
With Right Side facing, join D with sc in marked st following first leg.
Round 19: Sc in each remaining unworked st following first leg; change to A in last st.
Rounds 20–30: Sc in each sc around.

Shape Foot
Round 31: Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in each of next 6 sc, sc in last 7 sc—24 sc.
Rounds 32–37: Work same as Rounds 32–37 of first leg—12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through the stitches of last round and pull to gather. Weave in end securely.

Sew head to top of body.

Tie (for bathing suit top)
With C, ch 35, slip st in center top of bathing suit, ch 35. Fasten off and weave in ends. Tie both ends together behind neck.

Skirt
With D, ch 36; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around; change to C in last sc—36 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. Carry color not in use up inside of work until next needed.
Round 2: With C, *sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; change to D in last sc—54 sc.
Round 3: With D, sc in each sc around; change to C in last st.
Round 4: With C, sc in each sc around; change to D in last st. Fasten off C.
Round 5: With D, *slip st in next sc, ch 3, skip next sc; repeat from * around. Fasten off. Wrap skirt around waist and sew beginning edge to waist.

Arm (Make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of head—12 sc.
Rounds 3–5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: [Sc2tog] twice, sc in remaining 8 sc—10 sc.
Rounds 7–16: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off. Stuff arms and sew to body.

DUCKY INNER TUBE
With F, ch 42; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around—42 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—48 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—54 sc.
Rounds 4–6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc in next 7 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—48 sc.
Round 8: [Sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—42 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Use tail to sew beginning edge to Round 9, stuffing piece as you go.

Ducky Head
With F, ch 2.
Rounds 1–4: Work same as Rounds 1–4 of bear head—18 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Rounds 6 and 7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around—12 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off.

Beak
With E, ch 2.
Round 1: Work same as Round 1 of bear head—6 sc.
Round 2: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice—8 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff very lightly. Use tail to sew beak to ducky head.

Facial Features
With B, embroider French knot eyes to ducky head. Sew ducky head to inner tube.

PAIL
With G, ch 2.
Rounds 1–3: Work same as Rounds 1–3 of head—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—27 sc.
Round 8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: [Sc in next 8 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—30 sc.
Round 10: Sc in each sc around.
Round 11: [Sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—33 sc.
Round 12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: Slip st in each sc around.

Handle
Ch 18, skip next 16 slip sts, slip st in next slip st, turn, skip the slip st just made, slip st in each of next 18 ch. Fasten off.

GOLD FISH
With E, ch 2.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of head—12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 5–12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around—9 sc.
Stuff piece lightly.
Round 14: [Sc2tog] 4 times, sc in last sc—5 sc.
Row 15: Flatten last round, working through both thicknesses, work 3 sc evenly spaced across, turn—3 sc.
Row 16: Ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch (fin made), skip next sc of Row 15, slip st in next sc, ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch (fin made), slip st in last sc of Row 15, turn.

Edging
Ch 1, sc around edges of tail, working 3 sc in each tip and working a slip st in the slip st at center of tail (between fins). Fasten off.

Top Fin
With E, ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, *ch 1, sc in next ch; repeat from * across. Fasten off. Sew fin to back of gold fish.

Side Fin (Make 2)
With E, ch 4, hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, slip st in last ch. Fasten off. Sew one side fin to each side of gold fish.

Bottom Fin
With E, ch 7, hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, slip st in next ch, hdc in next 2 ch, slip st in last ch. Fold fin in half and sew center to bottom of gold fish.

Facial Features
With B, embroider French knot eyes and straight st smile.

FINISHING
Weave in any remaining ends. Place accessories on bear.

Notes
• Motifs using Granny Square™ All in One™ begin with Color 1 (shortest color rep) from center of pull-skein, leaving a 4” [10 cm] tail to weave in.
• Each color aligns with 1 rnd in the Motif with 5 colors in total. If too much color is left at end of rnd, pull back some sts and slightly loosen gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change. • When Motif is complete, cut yarn where Color 5 (longest color rep) ends, leaving a tail for weaving in. Begin next Motif with Color 1 and repeat 5 rnds for each Motif.

• Ch 6 at beg of rnds counts as dc and ch-3 sp.

3rd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
4th and 5th rnds: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.

abbreviations: dc3tog = [Yarn over, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] 3 times, yarn over, draw through all 4 loops on hook.
picot = Ch 3, slip st in 3rd ch from hook.
V-st (V-stitch) = (Dc, ch 1, dc) in indicated space.

2-dc Cl (2 double crochet Cl) = Yarn over, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook (2 loops remain on hook); yarn over, insert hook in same stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops, yarn over, draw through all 3 loops on hook.

3-dc Cl (3 double crochet Cl) = Yarn over, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook (2 loops remain on hook); [yarn over, insert hook in same stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] 2 times, yarn over, draw through all 4 loops on hook.

2-sc Cl (2 single crochet Cl) = Insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, yarn over, insert hook in same stitch, yarn over, pull up loop, yarn over, draw through all 4 loops on hook.

Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first 3-dc Cl, ch 5, sc in next ch-3 space, *ch 5, sc in next 3-dc Cl, ch 5, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ch 2, dc in first sc (ch 2, dc counts as last ch-5 space)—12 sc and 12 ch-5 spaces. Round 3: Ch 1, sc in last ch-5 space, (ch 6, sc) in each remaining ch-5 space, ch 3, dc in first sc (ch 3, dc counts as last ch-6 space—12 sc and 12 ch-6 spaces. Round 4: Ch 1, sc in last ch-6 space (ch 7, sc) in each remaining ch-6 space, ch 7; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc and 12 ch-7 spaces. Fasten off. Motif 2 (make 2) With A, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1: Work same as Round 1 of Motif 1; change to B. Rounds 2–4: Work same as Rounds 2–4 of Motif 1. Motif 3 (make 2) With B, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 3: (Beg 2-dc Cl, ch 3, 2-dc Cl) in first dch, (ch 3, dc) in next dc, *[ch 3, 2-dc Cl] 2 times in next dc, (ch 3, dc) in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 3; join with slip st in beg 2-dc Cl—twelve 2-dc Cls, 6 dc, and 18 ch-3 spaces. Round 4: Slip st in next dc and first ch-3 space, (beg 3-dc Cl, picot, 3-dc Cl) in same ch-3 space, ch 3, (3-dc Cl, picot, 3-dc Cl) in next dc, *ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, (3-dc Cl, picot, 3-dc Cl) in next ch-3 space, ch 3, (3-dc Cl, picot, 3-dc Cl) in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 3; join with slip st in beg 3-dc Cl—twenty-four 3-dc Cls, 12 picots, and 12 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off. Motif 4 (make 2) With B, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1: Work same as Round 1 of Motif 3. Round 2: Work same as Round 2 of Motif 3; change to A. Round 2: Ch 3, dc in first dc, *ch 3, skip next dc, 2 dc next dc; repeat from * around, ch 3, skip last dc; join with slip st in top of beg ch— 24 dc and 12 ch-3 spaces. Round 3: Slip st in next dc and first ch-3 space, ch 3, 4 dc in same ch-3 space, (ch 1, 5 dc) in each remaining ch-3 space, ch 1; join with slip st in top of beg ch—60 dc and 12 ch-1 spaces. Round 4: (Slip st, ch 1, sc) in last ch-1 space, (ch 6, sc) in each remaining ch-1 space, ch 6; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc and 12 ch-6 spaces. Fasten off. Round 5: Join B with slip st in any ch-6 space, (beg 3-dc Cl, ch 3, 3-dc Cl) in same ch-6 space, [ch 3, 3-dc Cl] 2 times in each remaining ch-6 space, ch 3; join with slip st in beg 3-dc Cl— 24 3-dc Cls and 24 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off. Continued... Round 6: Join C with slip st in any ch-3 space, ch 1, sc in same ch-3 space, (ch 5, sc) in each remaining ch-3 space, ch 5; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc and 24 ch-5 spaces. Round 7: (Slip st, ch 3, 3 dc, 2 tr, picot, 2 tr, 4 dc) in first ch-5 space (first shell made), sc in next ch-5 space, [(ch 5, sc) in next ch-5 space] 2 times, *(4 dc, 2 tr, picot, 2 tr, 4 dc) in next ch-5 space (shell made), sc in next ch-5 space, [(ch 5, sc) in next ch-5 space] 2 times; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beg ch—6 shells, 18 sc, and 12 ch-5 spaces. Fasten off. Motif 6 (make 1 each with A and C) Ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1: Ch 6 (counts as first dc and ch-3 space), dc in ring, [ch 3, dc in ring] 6 times, ch 3; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beg ch—8 dc and 8 ch-3 spaces. Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, (ch 6, sc) in each dc, ch 6; join with slip st in first sc—8 dc and 8 ch-6 spaces. Round 3: Slip st in first ch-6 space, ch 3 (counts as first dc), (2 dc, ch 5, 3 dc) in same ch-6 space, (3 dc, ch 5, 3 dc) in each remaining ch-6 space; join with slip st in top of beg ch-3—48 dc and 8 ch-5 spaces. Round 4: Beg dc3tog, ch 5, 3 dc in first ch-5 space, ch 5, dc3tog, *dc3tog, ch 5, 3 dc in next ch-5 space, ch 5, dc3tog; repeat from * around; join with slip st in beg dc3tog—40 dc and 16 ch-5 spaces. Round 5: (Slip st, ch 1, sc, picot, sc) in first ch-5 space, ch 3, dc3tog, ch 3, (sc, picot, sc) in next ch-5 sp, *ch 3, (sc, picot, sc) in next ch-5 space, ch 3, dc3tog, ch 3, (sc, picot, sc, ch 3) in next ch-5 space; repeat from * around, ch 3; join with slip st in first sc—8 dc, 32 sc, and 24 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off. Motif 7 (make 2) With C, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1: Ch 1, sc in ring, *ch 4, sc in ring; repeat from * 4 times, ch 1, dc in first sc (ch 1, dc count as last ch-4 sp)—6 sc and 6 ch-4 spaces. Round 2: Beg V-st in last ch-4 space, (ch 4, V-st) in each remaining ch-4 space, ch 4; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beg V-st—6 V-sts and 6 ch-4 spaces. Round 4: Ch 1, 2-sc Cl in same st as join, (ch 1, sc) in next 3 dc, ch 1, 2-sc Cl in next dc, *ch 3, 2-sc Cl in next dc, (ch 1, sc) in next 3 dc, ch 1, 2-sc Cl in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 3; change to B; join with slip st in first 2-sc Cl—twelve 2-sc Cls, 18 sc, 6 ch-3 spaces, and 24 ch-1 spaces. Round 5: Ch 1, sc in first ch-1 space, (ch 3, sc) in next 3 ch-1 spaces, *ch 4, sc in next ch-1 space, (ch 3, sc) in next 3 ch-1 spaces; repeat from * around, ch 4; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc, 18 ch-3 spaces, and 6 ch-4 spaces. Round 6: Ch 1, sc in first ch-3 space, (ch 3, sc) in next 2 ch-3 spaces, *ch 8, sc in next ch-3 space, (ch 3, sc) in next 2 ch-3 spaces; repeat from * around, ch 8; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc, 12 ch-3 spaces, and 6 ch-8 spaces. Round 7: Ch 1, sc in first ch-3 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, (3 dc, [picot, 3 dc] 2 times) in same ch-8 space, *(ch 3, sc) in next 2 ch-3 spaces, ch 3, (3 dc, [picot, 3 dc] 2 times) in next ch-8 space; repeat from * around, ch 3; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc, 54 dc, and 18 ch-3 spaces. 9th rnd: Ch 3 (does not count as st). *Working from back to front behind last rnd, 1 sc in ch-4 sp of 7th rnd between center 2 tr. Ch 5. Rep from * 4 times more. Miss first ch 3. Join with sl st to next sc. Fasten off.

Dancin’ Skeleton 
Appliqué
Crochet a skeleton appliqué and sew it  
onto a t-shirt. It’s a spooky, groovy idea for 
the Halloween season or for Day of the  
Dead events!
Row 18: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 19: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 15 
sts, sc2tog – 16 sts.
Row 20: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 21: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 13 
sts, sc2tog – 14 sts.
Row 22: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 23: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 11 
sts, sc2tog – 12 sts.
Row 24: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 9 
sts, sc2tog – 10 sts.
Row 25: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 7 
sts, sc2tog – 8 sts.
Row 26: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 5 
sts, sc2tog – 6 sts. Do Not Fasten Off.
Edging: Ch 1, sc evenly spaced around entire 
Head, slip st in first sc to join. 
Fasten off. 
BODY
Body is worked along foundation ch to make 
spine, from top to bottom on first side and 
from bottom back to top along opposite side to 
form hips, ribs and shoulders.
Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 27 for 
Spine. 
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 5 
ch to form neck, ch 12, slip st in 2nd ch from 
hook and next 11 ch for shoulder, slip st in 
next ch of foundation ch, slip st in next 4 ch, 
[ch 10, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 9 
ch, slip st in next ch of foundation ch, slip st 
in next 2 ch] 3 times for 3 ribs, ch 7, slip 
st in 2nd ch from hook and next 6 ch for rib, slip 
st in next ch of foundation ch, slip st in next 4 
ch, ch 12, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 
11 ch for hip, slip st in next ch of foundation 
ch, turn work to work along opposite edge of 
foundation ch, ch 12, slip st in 2nd ch from 
hook and next 11 ch for second hip, slip st in 
same ch of foundation ch, slip st in next 4 ch, 
ch 7, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 6 
ch for rib, slip st in next ch of foundation ch, 
[slip st in next 2 ch  ch 10, slip st in 2nd ch 
from hook and next 9 ch, slip st in next ch of 
foundation ch] 3 times for 3 ribs, slip st in next 
4 ch, ch 12, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and 
next 11 ch for shoulder, slip st in next ch of 
foundation ch, slip st in remaining chs to first 
st. Fasten off.
ARMS (Make 2)
Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 21. 
Row 1: Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd 
ch from hook and each ch across – 20 sts. 
Row 2: Ch 1, do not turn, sc 4 sts in last ch.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st – 4 sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 3 
sts – 3 sts.
Row 5: Slip st in row end next to last st just 
made, ch 3, turn, slip st in 2nd ch from hook 
and next ch to form first finger, [slip st in next 
st, ch 4, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 
ch] 3 times to form 3 fingers, slip st in row 
end next to last st just made, ch 3, turn, slip st 
in 2nd ch from hook and next ch, to form last 
finger. 
Fasten off. 
LEGS (Make 2)
Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 21. 
Row 1: Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd 
ch from hook and each ch across – 20 sts. 
RIGHT FOOT 
Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 7. 
Row 1: Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd 
ch from hook and each ch across – 6 sts. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in 
next st, turn to work along opposite edge of 
foundation ch, sc in next 4 sts – 10 sts.
Round 3: Working in continuous rounds, 2 sc 
in first st, sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next 2 sts, 
sc in next 5 sts, slip st in next st.
Row 4: [Ch 3, slip st in same space and in 
next space] 4 times for 4 toes, ch 4, slip st in 
same place and in next st for big toe. 
Fasten off. 
LEFT FOOT 
Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 7. 
Row 1: Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd 
ch from hook and each ch across – 6 sts. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 5 st, 2 sc in 
next st, turn to work along opposite edge of 
foundation ch, sc in next 4 sts – 10 sts.
Round 3: Working in continuous rounds, 2 sc 
in first st, sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next 2 sts, 
sc in next 5 sts, slip st in next st.
Row 4: Ch 4, slip st in same place and in next 
st for big toe, [ch 3, slip st in same space and 
in next space] 4 times for 4 toes. 
Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Following photo and using 1 strand of B, 
embroider mouth on Head with straight 
stitches. Sew on buttons for eyes. Embroider 
eye brows above eyes. 
For best results, lay tee-shirt flat and insert 
a piece of cardboard inside and smooth the 
shirt front. Referring to the photo, pin Skeleton 
pieces to upper middle portion of shirt. 
Arrange limbs as desired. Carefully hand-
stitch pieces using matching thread, being 
careful not to pull the thread too tightly in 
order to prevent puckering.

1st row: (Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch) twice. Sl st in first ch. Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Join with sl st in original sl st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Z
Ch 16.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Skip next ch. 1 sc in each of next 5 ch. Skip next ch. 1 sc in each of rem 4 ch.

instructions:
Flower Motif (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd:6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc. Fasten off.
First Petal: 1st row:Join B with sl st to front loop only of any sc. *Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in front loop only of next sc. 4 sc for petal. Turn.
Next 3 rows:Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc of petal. Turn.
Next row:Ch 1. (Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made) twice. Fasten off.*
Second Petal: **Rejoin B with sl st to front loop of next unworked sc of 2nd rnd. Rep from * to * once.**
Third to Sixth Petals: Rep from ** to ** 4 times more. 6 petals.
Glue Flower Motifs to flip flops.

instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com and www.crochettoday.com

A to Z in Crochet
Use these crocheted alphabet letters to personalize or send a message on your creations. Each letter is two inches tall and can be sewn or applied with fabric glue.

A
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch for center bar, sc in next 3 ch of ch-8, turn, ch 4, slip st in tip of center bar, ch 5, turn, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 3 ch, sc in slip st, sc in last 4 ch, slip st in first st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

B
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 5, turn, skip 3 sc, sc in next sc, ch 6, skip next 2 sc, slip st in last sc.
Row 3: Turn, skip slip st, sc in next 6 ch, slip st in sc, sc in last 5 ch, slip st in edge of Row 1.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

C
Ch 13.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Shape into a “C” while sewing in place.

D
Ch 17.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 6 ch, 3 sc in next ch, sc in next 7 ch, 2 sc in last ch, slip st in first st to join.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

E
Ch 8.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, [ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, sc in next 3 ch of ch-8] twice, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, slip st in side of last sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

F
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, sc in next 3 ch of ch-8, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, slip st in last ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

G
Ch 15.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, slip st in same space as slip st, sc in remaining 13 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Shape into a “G” while sewing in place.

H
Left Side
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch for center bar, sc in next 3 ch of ch-8.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Right Side
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch across – 7 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Sew Sides together along center bar.

I
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 7 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

J
Ch 10.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, sc in side of last sc along ch-10, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, slip st in same sc alongside.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Shape into a “J” while sewing in place.

K
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 3 ch, slip st in last sc along ch-8, ch 4, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 2 ch, slip st in same sc alongside, sc in remaining ch of ch-8.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

L
Ch 12.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, skip next ch, sc in last 7 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

M
Ch 21.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 9 ch, ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 3 ch, sc in remaining 10 ch of ch-21.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Shape into a “M” while sewing in place.

N
Ch 25.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 6 ch, skip next ch, sc in ch in next 8 ch, skip 1 ch, sc in each remaining ch across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Shape into a “N” while sewing in place.

O
Ch 17, slip st in first ch to join.
Round 1: Sc in each ch around, slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

P
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 5, turn, skip first 3 sc, slip st in next sc, leave remaining sts unworked.
Row 3: Turn, sc in each ch of ch-5, slip st in last ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Q
Ch 17, slip st in first ch to join.
Round 1: Ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, sc in each ch around, slip st in first ch, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

R
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 5, turn, skip 3 sc, sc next sc for center sc, ch 5, turn, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 3 ch, slip st in center sc, sc in 4 ch of first ch-5 space, slip st in edge of Row 1.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

S
Ch 17.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 16 sc.
Shape into a “S” while sewing in place.

T
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, sc in side of last sc along ch-8, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, slip st in same sc alongside.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

U
Ch 17.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 16 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Shape into a “U” while sewing in place.

V
Ch 18.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 7 ch, skip next ch, sc in remaining 8 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Shape into a “V” while sewing in place.

W
Work as for M, reversing direction while sewing in place.

X
Make 2
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 7 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Shape pieces into a “X”, crossing in center, while sewing in place.

Y
Row 1: [Ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch] twice, slip st in first ch, ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, slip st in same slip st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Z
Ch 16.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, skip next ch, sc in next 5 ch, skip next ch, sc in remaining 4 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Shape into a “Z” while sewing in place.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 (3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Smiley Face:  Approx 4" [10 cm] diameter. Granny Square:  Approx 4½" [11.5 cm] square. Checkered Square:  Approx 5" [12.5 cm] square. Mushroom: Approx 4½" [11.5 cm] tall x 4" [10 cm] wide.
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Join rnds with sl st to first st.
SMILEY FACE 
(See diagram on page 4).
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st. 
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 2. 12 hdc in ring. Join. 
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 24 hdc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 2. *2 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 36 hdc.
4th rnd:  Ch 2. *1 hdc in next st. 2 hdc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. Rep from * around. 48 hdc. Break A. Join B.
5th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc around. Join. Fasten off.
Eyes (make 2)
With B, ch 4.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. Sl st in next ch. Fasten off. 
Surface Slip Stitch Smile
With RS facing, join B with sl st to any stitch in the 4th rnd of Smiley Face. Working along top of 4th rnd, work surface slip stitch as follows: *Insert hook into next st and draw up a loop through loop on hook. Rep from * until you have worked across the tops of 24 stitches in 4th rnd. Fasten off. 
Sew Eyes to Smiley Face as shown in photo.
GRANNY SQUARE 
(See diagram on page 4).
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6 (counts as 1 dc. Ch 3). (3 dc in ring. Ch 3) 3 times. 2 dc in ring. Join. Fasten off. 12 dc and 4 ch-3 sps. 
2nd rnd:  Join B in any ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from *twice. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join. Fasten off. 
3rd rnd: Join C in any ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join. Fasten off. 
4th rnd: Join D in any ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-2 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp across to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice. (Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp across to first ch-3 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join. Fasten off. 
5th rnd: Join E to any ch-3 sp. Ch 1. 4 sc in same ch-3 sp. Work 1 sc in each sc and ch-1 sp, and 4 sc in each ch-3 sp. Join. Fasten off. 
CHECKERED SQUARE 
Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.
With A, ch 22.
1st row: (RS). With A, 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. (With B, 1 hdc in each of next 4 ch. With A, 1 hdc in each of next 4 ch) twice. Turn. 20 hdc.
2nd row:  With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 4 hdc. *With B, 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. With A, 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 
3rd and 4th rows:  With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 4 hdc. *With A, 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. With B, 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 
5th and 6th rows: As 2nd row.
Rep 3rd to 6th rows until work from beg measures approx 5" [12.5 cm], ending after a 4th or 6th row. Fasten off.

With RS facing, join A with sl st to any corner. Work 3 sc in same sp as sl st. Work in sc evenly around, working 3 sc in each corner. Join. Fasten off. 
MUSHROOM
(See diagrams on page 4).
Mushroom Cap 
With A, ch 16.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 15 sc.
2nd row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. 13 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
4th to 7th rows: As 2nd row. 5 sc. 
8th row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 3 sts.
9th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Fasten off. 
Join B.
1st rnd: With B, ch 1. Work evenly in sc around entire Cap, working 3 sc in each corner sp. Join. Fasten off. 
Mushroom Stem
With B, ch 6.
1st row:  1 sc in 2nd chain from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 5 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) twice. 7 sc.
4th row: As 2nd row.
5th row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) twice. 5 sts.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. Sc3tog. 1 sc in last st. Turn. 3 sts.
7th row: As 2nd row.
8th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Fasten off. 
Join A.
1st rnd:  With A, ch 1. Work in sc evenly around entire Stem, working 3 sc in each corner. Join. Fasten off. 
Mushroom Spots
Small Spot (make 2)
With B, beg using magic loop method demonstrated here. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sl st in ring. Join. Fasten off. 
Large Spot (make 1)
With B, make magic loop. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sl st in ring. Join. 
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. Sl st in each sl st around. Join. Fasten off. 
Sew Spots to Mushroom Cap as shown in photo. Align Mushroom Cap and Stem and sew in place as shown in photo.

materials: Coordinated sewing thread and needle to sew on T-shirts as desired
measurements: Ladybug measures 2” across with ½” for head
gauge: Not needed for this project
instructions:
Ladybug
Body With A, chain 4.

Round 1: Work 7 double crochet in the 4th chain from hook (skipped chains count as first double crochet), change to B in last double crochet, with B, 2 double crochet in same chain, change to A in last double crochet – 10 double crochet. Join with a slip stitch in first skipped chain.
Round 2: With A, chain 2 (counts as half double crochet), half double crochet in same stitch as joining, 2 half double crochet in each of next 7 stitches, changing to B in last half double crochet, with B, 2 half double crochet in each of next 2 stitches, changing to A in last half double crochet – 20 half double crochets. Join with a slip stitch in 2nd chain of beginning chain-2.

Round 3: With A, chain 2, half double crochet in same chain as joining, half double crochet in next stitch, (2 half double crochet in next stitch, half double crochet in next stitch) 7 times, change to B in last half double crochet; with B, (2 double crochet in next double crochet, double crochet in next double crochet) twice, changing to A in last double crochet – 24 half double crochet and 6 double crochet. Join with a slip stitch in 2nd chain of beginning chain-2. Fasten off, leaving an 8” tail of B.

Black line on back
Working on back side of body with yarn needle, weave black end to center of body. Insert crochet hook from right side into center and pull up black loop. With black section at bottom, insert hook back into body in red section directly above black section about ¼” away and pull up another loop, pulling loop through loop on hook (surface chain made). Work about 3 more surface chains across in a straight line up to edge of body, splitting red section in half as shown in photo – 4 or 5 surface chains. Fasten off.

Head
With B, chain 3.
Round 1: Work 6 double crochet in 3rd chain from hook. Fasten off. Sew flat edge of head (beginning chs and last double crochet) to top of body above surface chains as shown in photo.

Antennae
With B, chain 8. Fasten off, leaving long ends. Weave antennae through top of head. Weave long tails back through antennae chain and sew into back of head to conceal.

Finishing
Weave in all ends. Sew 2 buttons on each side of line on red body section with sewing needle and thread. Pin ladybug to shirt as desired and stitch in place.

FLOWER
With either C or E (center of flower), chain 2.
Round 1: (right side) Work 10 single crochet in 2nd chain from hook – 10 single crochet. Join with slip stitch to first single crochet. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join D with slip stitch in any single crochet, double crochet in same stitch as joining (double crochet, slip stitch) in next stitch; *(slip stitch, double crochet) in next stitch, (double crochet, slip stitch) in next stitch; repeat from * 3 times more – 5 petals made. Join with slip stitch to first slip stitch. Fasten off.

Finishing
Weave in ends. Pin flower(s) to shirt as desired and stitch in place.

materials: RED HEART® "Luster Sheen™": 1 Skein each 0517 Turquoise (A) 0915 Cherry Red (B), 0227 Buttercup (C), 0001 White (D), 0518 Light Mulberry (E)
Two 3/16”/.5cm black buttons – one for each bird
Coordinated sewing thread and needle to sew on T-shirts as desired
