gauge: Not needed for this project.
instructions:
Bird
Note The head, body and wing are worked separately and sewn together with yarn tails. The tail and beak are worked directly onto the bird.

Body  With A, chain 7.

Round 1: (right side) Slip stitch in 2nd chain from hook, single crochet in next chain, half double crochet in next chain, double crochet in next chain, triple crochet in next chain, 4 double crochet in last chain; working in opposite side of chains, triple crochet in next chain, double crochet in next chain, half double crochet in next chain, single crochet in next chain, slip stitch in last chain – 14 stitches (including slip stitches). Join with a slip stitch in first slipped stitch.
Round 2: Chain 3 (counts as first double crochet), double crochet in same slip stitch as joining, 2 double crochet in each of next 13 stitches – 28 double crochet. Join with slip stitch in 3rd chain of beginning chain-3. Fasten off.

Head
With A, chain 3.
Round 1: (right side) Work 9 double crochet in 3rd chain from hook. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.

Beak
With right side of head facing and C, insert hook in 5th double crochet on head (for left-facing bird) or in 3rd double crochet on head (for right-facing bird) and draw up a loop, chain 1, double crochet in next double crochet. Fasten off. Using end of yarn from head, sew flat part of head (beginning chains and last double crochet) to rounded part of body (10th-12th double crochet on Round 2 of body for left facing bird and 17th-19th double crochet on Round 2 of body for right-facing bird.

Wing
With B, chain 7.

Round 1: Work same as Round 1 of body. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.

Tail  
Row 1: With right side of body facing, join B with slip stitch in first double crochet on Round 2 of body (for left-facing bird) or in next to last double crochet on Round 2 (for right-facing bird), chain 3 (counts as double crochet), double crochet in same stitch as joining, 2 double crochet in next stitch – 4 double crochet. Chain 3 (counts as double crochet on next row), turn.
Row 2: Double crochet in next 3 stitches – 4 double crochet. Chain 1, turn.
Row 3: Work (half double crochet, slip stitch) in first double crochet, (half double crochet, slip stitch) in each of next 2 double crochet, (half double crochet, slip stitch) in 3rd chain of turning chain 3 – 4 half double crochet and 4 slip stitches. Fasten off.

Finishing
Weave in all ends. Sew wing to body. Sew button to head for eye. Pin assembled bird(s) to shirt as shown in photo or as desired and stitch in place.

FLOWER  
With either C or E, (center of flower), chain 2.
Round 1: (right side) Work 10 single crochet in 2nd chain from hook – 10 single crochet. Join with slip stitch to first single crochet. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join D with slip stitch in any single crochet, double crochet in same stitch as joining (double crochet, slip stitch) in next stitch; *(slip stitch, double crochet) in next stitch, (double crochet, slip stitch) in next stitch; repeat from * 3 times more – 5 petals made. Join with slip stitch to first slip stitch. Fasten off.

Finishing
Weave in ends. Pin flower(s) to shirt as desired and stitch in place.

Row 4: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] twice, sc in next 20 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] twice – 32 sts.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] twice, sc in next 24 sts, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] twice – 36 sts.

Row 19: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next st, sc2tog] twice, sc in next 24 sts, [sc2tog, sc in next st] twice – 32 sts.

Row 21: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next st, sc2tog] twice, sc in next 20 sts, [sc2tog, sc in next st] twice – 28 sts.

Row 32: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next st, sc2tog] twice, sc in next 16 sts, [sc2tog, sc in next st] twice – 24 sts.
Row 33: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.

FINISHING
Following photo, sew Nose in center of Head. Sew buttons on Head for eyes. With 2 strands of C held together, embroider mouth with straight stitches from tip of Nose. materials: Red Heart® All in One™ Granny Square™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 417 yds/381 m)
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: Motif = Approx 6" [15 cm] square.
instructions:
Visit this link for additional info about Red Heart All in One Granny Square: here.
Notes:
• Motifs using Granny Square All in One begin with Color 1 (shortest color rep) from center of pull-skein, leaving a 4" [10 cm] tail to weave in.
• Each color aligns with 1 round (rnd) in the Motif with 5 colors in total. If too much color is left at end of rnd, pull back some stitches (sts) and slightly loosen gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change. If too little color is left, pull back some sts and slightly tighten gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change.
• When Motif is complete, cut yarn where Color 5 (longest color rep) ends, leaving a tail for weaving in. Begin next Motif with Color 1 and repeat 5 rnds for each Motif.
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
• Ch 6 at beg of rnds counts as dc and ch-3 sp.
• Join all rnds with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-6 unless otherwise indicated.
Granny Square All in One Motifs (make 2)
With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring. See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
4th and 5th rnds: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.

instructions:

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Classic Crochet Thread™, Size 10 (Solids: 350 yds; Shaded colors: 300 yds)
Size U.S. 7 (1.65 mm) steel crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
instructions:
Notes
• Each corsage can be made from 1 or more cabbage roses. 2 leaves are attached to each rose.
• Each rose is made from a long strip of crochet that is rolled into a spiral and secured into a rose shape.
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.

Cabbage Rose
With A, leaving a long end, ch 29 loosely.
1st row: (RS). Working in back bumps of foundation ch, (1 tr. Ch 1. 1 tr) in 4th ch from hook. *Ch 1. (1 tr. Ch 1. 1 tr) in next ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Turn. 52 tr and 51 ch-1 sps.
2nd row: Ch 3. (1 tr. Ch 1. 1 tr) in first ch-1 sp. *Ch 1. (1 tr. Ch 1. 1 tr) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 102 tr and 101 ch-1 sps.
3rd row: Ch 1. *3 sc in next ch-1 sp. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. 3 tr in each of next 2 ch-1 sps. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp. 3 sc in last ch-1 sp. 303 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end.

Finishing
Thread yarn back and forth through ends of rows to first ch of foundation row. Coil work at foundation ch into Cabbage Rose. Secure coiled foundation ch with sewing needle and thread. Fasten securely.

LEAF (make 2)
With C, ch 22.
1st row: (WS). Working in back bumps of foundation ch, 1 dc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 20 dc. Do not break C.
2nd row: With B, ch 3. Working in back loops only, 1 tr in each of first 12 sts. 1 dc in each of next 6 sts. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 2 sc in each of 2 skipped ch of 1st row. Do not turn. Working across opposite rem loops of foundation ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 dc in each of next 6 ch. 1 tr in last 12 ch. Turn. 44 sts.
3rd row: Ch 3. Working through both loops, 1 tr in each of first 12 sts. 1 dc in each of next 6 sts. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. 2 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. 1 dc in each of next 6 sts. 1 tr in each of last 12 sts. Turn. 46 sts. Fasten off B.
4th row: With C, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 22 sts. 2 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of last 22 sts. 1 sc in top of beg ch-3. Do not turn. Working in ends of rows along side edge, Ch 1. 1 sc around posts of tr at end of next 2 rows. 1 sc in end of foundation ch. 1 sc around post of dc at end of next row. 1 sc around post of tr at end of next 2 rows. 1 sc around post of st of next row. Fasten off.

Center Vein
Note: Center vein is worked in surface slip st using B.
Holding long end of B at back of leaf, insert hook in sp between first 2 dc of 1st row. Yoh and pull up a loop. *Skip next 2 dc (elongating loop of B so that it spans the 2 dc). Insert hook in next sp before next dc sts. Yoh and pull up a loop. Rep from * to last sp. Yoh and draw up a loop. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew leaves to back of rose. Use safety pin to pin one or more roses into place on a dress or glove to use as a corsage or use bobby pin to place in hair. Allow leaf tips to curl for more realistic look.

instructions:
FLOWER
See diagram on page 2.
Shown in photos as follows:
With H as Color 1 and E as Color 2.
With L as Color 1 and I as Color 2.
With D as Color 1 and A as Color 2.
With J as Color 1 and C as Color 2.
With F as Color 1 and K as Color 2.

With Color 1, beg using magic loop method demonstrated here.

See diagram on page 2.
Shown in photos in B, F, J, L, and E.
Ch 6.

materials: Thread, Size 10: 1 ball each 422 Golden Yellow A and 401 Orchid Pink B

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc.

gauge: Rounds 1-3 = 1" [2.5 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Beginning at center, with A, ch 2.
Round 1 (Right Side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook (do not join)—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of Round and move marker up as each Round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc. Fasten off.
Round 4: With B, work in back loops only for this Round. Join with a sc in back loop of first sc of Round 3 (see Special Stitch), sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, *sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: *Ch 3, skip 1 sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first loop—12 ch-3 loops.
Round 6: Ch 1, [sc, hdc, dc, hdc, sc] in each ch-3 loop around; join with slip st in first sc—12 petals. Fasten off and weave in ends.
Round 7: Join B with a sc in any unworked front loop of Round 3; [ch 1, 2 dc in next front loop, ch 1, sc in next front loop] 7 times, ch 1, 2 dc in last front loop, ch 1; join with slip st in first sc—9 petals. Fasten off, leaving end for sewing.

gauge: Rounds 1–3 of 7-Petal Flower = 1¾” (4.5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
FLORAL DECORATION 
Motif 1: 7-Petal Flower (make 7) 
With A, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 4 (counts as first dc, ch 1), dc in ring, [ch 1, dc in ring] 5 times, ch 1; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beg ch—7 dc and 7 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join B with slip st in any ch-1 space, ch 3 (counts as first dc), 2 dc in same space, (ch 1, 3 dc) in each ch-1 space, ch 1; join with slip st in top of beg ch—21 dc and 7 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off. 
Round 3: Join C with sc in any ch-1 space, (hdc, dc) in next dc, 2 tr in next dc, (dc, hdc) in next dc, [sc in next ch-1 space, (hdc, dc) in next dc, 2 tr in next dc, (dc, hdc) in next d] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—7 sc, 14 hdc, 14 dc, and 14 tr. Fasten off.
Motif 2: 5-Petal Flower (make 3) 
With C, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Beg 3-dc Cl in ring, [ch 3, 3-dc Cl in ring] 4 times, ch 3; join with slip st in beg Cl—5 Cls and 5 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off. 
Round 2: Join D with slip st in any ch-3 space, 5 sc in same space, (ch 1, 5 sc) in each ch-3 space, ch 1; join with slip st in first sc—25 sc and 5 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 3: Join B with slip st in first sc, ch 3, 2 tr in next 3 sc, ch 3, slip st in next sc (petal made), [ch 1, slip st in next sc, ch 3, 2 tr in next 3 sc, ch 3, slip st in next sc (petal made)] 4 times, ch 1; join with slip st in first sc—5 petals. Fasten off.
Motif 3: Large 3-Color Flower (make 3) 
With A, ch 12.
Row 1 (right side): Dc in 6th ch from hook (beginning ch count as first ch-5 space) and in next ch, tr in next 3 ch, dc in next ch, (dc, ch 5, slip st) in last dc—4 dc, 3 tr, and 2 ch-5 spaces. Do not turn.
Round 2: Working in opposite side of foundation ch, ch 1, sc in first ch (same ch as last slip st made), 2 sc in next ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in next ch, sc in next ch, 7 sc in first ch-5 space, sc in first dc, 2 sc in next dc, sc in next 3 tr, 2 sc in next dc, sc in next dc, 7 sc in last ch-5 space; change to C; join with slip st in first sc—32 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [ch 4, skip next 3 sc, sc in next sc] 3 times, ch 5, skip next 3 sc, sc in next sc, [ch 7, skip next 3 sc, sc in next sc] twice, ch 5, skip next 3 sc, sc in next sc, ch 4, skip last 3 sc; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc, 4 ch-4 spaces, 2 ch-5 spaces, and 2 ch-7 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 1, (sc, hdc, 4 dc, hdc, sc) in first 3 ch-4 spaces, (sc, hdc, 5 dc, hdc, sc) in next ch-5 space, (sc, hdc, 7 dc, hdc, sc) in each ch-7 space, (sc, hdc, 3 dc, place marker on last dc made, 2 dc, hdc, sc) in next ch-5 space, (sc, hdc, 4 dc, hdc, sc) in last ch-4 space; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc, 16 hdc, and 40 dc. Fasten off. 
Row 5 (wrong side): With wrong side facing, join D with sc in marked st, [ch 10, skip next 9 sts, sc in next dc] 3 times, turn—4 sc and 3 ch-10 spaces.
Row 6 (right side): Ch 1, (sc, hdc, 4 dc, 4 tr, 4 dc, hdc, sc) in each ch-10 space; join with slip st in last sc. Fasten off. 
Motif 4: Pink Flower Petal (make 9) 
With D, ch 14.
Row 1 (right side): Tr in 7th ch from hook and in next 2 ch (beginning ch count as ch-6 space), dc in next 3 ch, sc in next ch, slip st in last ch—8 sts and 1 ch-6 space. 
Round 2: With right side facing and working in opposite side of foundation ch, ch 1, slip st in first ch, sc in next 7 ch, (picot, [2 dc, picot] 4 times) in ch-6 space, sc in next 8 sts; join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.
Motif 5: 3-Petal Flower (make 3 each with A & D and 1 with B)
Ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in ring, [ch 3, sc in ring] twice, ch 3; join with slip st in first sc—3 sc and 3 ch-3 spaces.
Round 2: (Slip st, ch 4, 3-tr Cl, picot, ch 4, slip st, ch 1) in each ch-3 space; join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off. 
Motif 6: Long-stemmed Flower (make 3) 
With E, ch 75. 
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across to last ch, ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), 5 dc in last ch (stem made), turn—73 sc and 6 dc.
Row 2: Ch 3, 2 dc in next 4 dc, 2 dc in top of beginning ch—11 dc. Fasten off. 
Row 3 (right side): With right side facing, join A with slip st in first dc, [ch 6, slip st in next dc] 10 times—10 ch-6 spaces. Fasten off.
Row 4: With right side facing, join D with slip st in first ch-6 space, (slip st, ch 4, tr, picot, tr, ch 4, slip st) in each ch-6 space. Fasten off. 
Motif 7: Large Leaf (make 6) 
With F, ch 19, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 2 ch, tr in next 8 ch, dc in next 2 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working in opposite side of foundation ch, skip first ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 2 ch, tr in next 8 ch, dc in next 2 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, sc in last ch; join with slip st in first ch. 
Fasten off. 
Motif 8: Large 2-Color Leaf (make 6) 
With F, ch 19, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 2 ch, tr in next 8 ch, dc in next 2 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, 2 sc in last ch; change to E, sc in same ch; working in opposite side of foundation ch, skip first ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 2 ch, tr in next 8 ch, dc in next 2 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, sc in last ch; join with slip st in first ch. Fasten off. 
Motif 9: Small 2-Color Leaf (make 4) 
With F, ch 12, slip st in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch count as ch-2 space), sc in next 2 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 4 ch, hdc in next ch (hdc; change to E, hdc) in last ch; working in opposite side of foundation ch, skip first ch, dc in next 4 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, sc in next 2 ch, slip st in ch-2 space. 
Fasten off.
Motif 10: Small Leaf (make 12)  
With G, repeat Motif 9, do not change color.
Motif 11: 2 Leaves with Stem (make 4) 
With E, ch 20, *slip st in 3rd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, sc in next ch, slip st in next ch (leaf made)*; ch 8, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 6 ch (top stem made); ch 8, repeat from * to *; slip st in last 12 ch (bottom stem made). 
Fasten off.
Motif 12: Picoted Leaf 
With E, ch 23.
Round 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 sc, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 3 ch, tr in next 5 ch, dtr in next 6 ch, tr in next ch, dc in next ch, 3 hdc in last ch; working in opposite side of foundation ch, skip first ch, dc in next 2 ch, tr in next ch, dtr in next 6 ch, tr in next 5 ch, dc in next 3 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, sc in next 3 ch; ch 6, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 4 ch (stem made); join with slip st in first sc. 
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first 8 sts, [picot, dc in next 3 sts] 11 times, sc in next 4 sts, slip st in each sc of stem. Fasten off.
Motif 13: 3-Point Leaf (make 3) 
With F, ch 9, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 7 ch (stem made), [ch 20, dc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch across; join with slip st in last sc of stem] twice. Fasten off.
Motif 14: 4-Point Leaf
With F, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in last ch (stem made); *ch 23, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 2 ch, dtr in next 3 ch, dc in next 2 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in last 12 ch, slip st in 2nd sc of stem (leaf made)*; [ch 15, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across] twice (2nd and 3rd leaves made); repeat from * to *. Fasten off.
Motif 15: Small Stem
With E, ch 11, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 9 ch. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Block pieces to finished measurements, if desired.
Referring to photographs, sew all pieces in place on back of jacket and sleeves.

instructions:
LARGE FLOWER (make 2)
Ch 8. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in ring. (Ch 6. 3 dc in ring) 5 times. Ch 6. 1 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch-3.
2nd rnd: Sl st in next dc and next ch-6 loop. *Ch 1. (1 sc. 1 hdc. 7 dc. 1 hdc. 1 sc) in ch-6 loop. Ch 1. Miss next dc. Sl st in next dc. Rep from * 5 times more. Fasten off.
SMALL FLOWER (make 3)
Ch 6. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in ring. (Ch 4. 3 sc in ring) 5 times. Ch 4. 1 sc in ring. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Sl st in next sc and next ch-4 loop. *(1 sc. 1 hdc. 4 dc. 1 hdc. 1 sc) in ch-4 loop. Miss next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * 5 times more. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Flowers to skirt as shown in picture.

instructions: Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 9.  Row 1: Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 8 sts.  Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st – 10 sts. Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st – 12 sts. Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Row 6: Ch 1, turn, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st – 14 sts. Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Row 8: Ch 1, turn, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st – 16 sts. Row 9: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Row 10: Ch 1, turn, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 12 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st – 18 sts. Row 11: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Row 12: Ch 1, turn, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 14 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st – 20 sts. Rows 13-16: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Row 17: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 17 sts, sc2tog – 18 sts. Row 18: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Row 19: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 15 sts, sc2tog – 16 sts. Row 20: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Row 21: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 13 sts, sc2tog – 14 sts. Row 22: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Row 23: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 11 sts, sc2tog – 12 sts. Row 24: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 9 sts, sc2tog – 10 sts. Row 25: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 7 sts, sc2tog – 8 sts. Row 26: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog – 6 sts.  Do Not Fasten Off. Edging: Ch 1, sc evenly spaced around entire Head, slip st in first sc to join. Fasten off.  Body is worked along foundation ch to make spine, from top to bottom on first side and from bottom back to top along opposite side to form hips, ribs and shoulders. Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 27 for Spine. Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 5 ch to form neck, ch 12, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 11 ch for shoulder, slip st in next ch of foundation ch, slip st in next 4 ch, [ch 10, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 9 ch, slip st in next ch of foundation ch, slip st in next 2 ch] 3 times for 3 ribs, ch 7, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 6 ch for rib, slip st in next ch of foundation ch, slip st in next 4 ch, ch 12, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 11 ch for hip, slip st in next ch of foundation ch, turn work to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, ch 12, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 11 ch for second hip, slip st in same ch of foundation ch, slip st in next 4 ch, ch 7, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 6 ch for rib, slip st in next ch of foundation ch, [slip st in next 2 ch  ch 10, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 9 ch, slip st in next ch of foundation ch] 3 times for 3 ribs, slip st in next 4 ch, ch 12, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 11 ch for shoulder, slip st in next ch of foundation ch, slip st in remaining chs to first st. Fasten off.  ARMS (Make 2) Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 21. Row 1: Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 20 sts. Row 2: Ch 1, do not turn, sc 4 sts in  last ch. Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st – 4 sts. Row 4: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 3 sts – 3 sts. Row 5: Slip st in row end next to last st just made, ch 3, turn, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next ch to form first finger, [slip st in next st, ch 4, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next ch] 3 times to form 3 fingers, slip st in row end next to last st just made, ch 3, turn, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next ch, to form last finger.  Fasten off.  LEGS (Make 2) Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 21. Row 1: Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 20 sts. RIGHT FOOT Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 7. Row 1: Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 6 sts. Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, sc in next 4 sts – 10 sts. Round 3: Working in continuous rounds, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next 2 sts, sc in next 5 sts, slip st in  next st. Row 4: [Ch 3, slip st in same space and in next space] 4 times for 4 toes, ch 4, slip st in same place and in next st for big toe.  Fasten off.  LEFT FOOT Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 7. Row 1: Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 6 sts. Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 5 st, 2 sc in next st, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, sc in next 4 sts – 10 sts. Round 3: Working in continuous rounds, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next 2 sts, sc in next 5 sts, slip st in  next st. Row 4: Ch 4, slip st in same place and in next st for big toe, [ch 3, slip st in same space and in next space] 4 times for 4 toes.  Fasten off.  FINISHING Following photo and using 1 strand of B, embroider mouth on Head with straight stitches. Sew on buttons for eyes. Embroider eye brows above eyes. For best results, lay tee-shirt flat and insert a piece of cardboard inside and smooth the shirt front. Referring to the photo, pin Skeleton pieces to upper middle portion of shirt. Arrange limbs as desired. Carefully hand-stitch pieces using matching thread, being careful not to pull the thread too tightly in order to prevent puckering.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball 494 Victory Red.

abbreviations: Shell = (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in next space.
Beg-Shell (Beginning Shell) = ch 3, (dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in same ch-space.
Picot = ch 3, slip st in side and top loops of last st.
3-dc-cluster = [yo and draw up a loop, yo and draw through 2 loops] 3 times all in same st, yo and draw through all 4 loops on hook.
gauge: 28 sts = 4” in dc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Snowflake 1:
Ch 8; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 4, dc in ring, [dc, ch 1, dc] 13 times in ring; join with a slip st in 3rd ch of ch-4.
Round 2: [Slip st in next ch-1 space, ch 15, slip st in same space] 14 times – 14 loops. Fasten off.
Round 3: Attach thread in any ch-15 loop; * [ch 5, slip st in next ch-15 loop] 14 times.
Round 4: [Ch 5, (5 sc, ch 5, 5 sc) all in next ch-5 space] 14 times; join in first ch.
Round 5: Slip st in next ch of first ch-5 space, ch 1, [sc in ch-5 space, ch 3, shell in next ch-5 space, ch 3] 14 times; join in first sc.
Round 6: Slip st to ch-1 space of first shell, beg shell in ch-1 space, [ch 7, shell in next ch-1 space] 13 times, ch 7; join in top of ch-3.
Round 7: Slip st to ch-1 space of first shell, beg shell in ch-1 space, * ch 3, sc in next ch-7 space, ch 3 **, shell in next ch-1 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join.
Round 8: Slip st to ch-1 space, ch 7, slip st in 3rd ch from hook, ([tr, picot] twice, tr) in first ch-1 space, * ch 3, sc in next sc, picot, ch 3 **, ([tr, picot] 3 times, tr) all in next ch-1-space; repeat from * around, end at **; join in 4th ch of ch-7. Fasten off.

Snowflake 2:
Ch 10; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3, 20 dc in ring; join with a slip st in top of ch-3 – 21 sts.
Round 2: Ch 6, [tr in next dc, ch 2] 20 times; join in 4th ch of ch-6.
Round 3: Ch 7, [tr in next tr, ch 3] 20 times; join in 4th ch of ch-7.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, [ch 7, sc in next tr] 20 times, ch 7; join in first sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [(4 sc, ch 3, 4 sc) in next ch-7 space] 21 times; join in first sc.
Round 6: Slip st to ch-3 space, ch 12, slip st in 9th ch from hook (ch-9 loop made), ch 10, slip st in 7th ch from hook, [ch 7, slip st in last slip st] twice, sc in last 3 ch of ch-10, ch 9, slip st in same slip st that closed first ch-9 loop, sc in last 3 ch of ch-12, ch 5, slip st in next ch-3 space of Round 5, * ch 7, slip st in last ch-9 space, ch 4, slip st in 4th ch of ch-7 (ch-9 loops joined), ch 10, slip st in 7th ch from hook, [ch 7, slip st in last slip st] twice, sc in last 3 ch of ch-10 **, ch 9, slip st in same slip st that closed previous joined ch-9 loop, sc in last 3 ch of ch-7, ch 5, slip st in next ch-3 space of Round 5; repeat from * around, end at **; ch 4, slip st in first ch-9 loop, ch 4, slip st in same slip st that closed previous ch-9 loop, sc in last 3 ch of ch-7, ch 5; join. Fasten off.

Snowflake 3:
Ch 10; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 24 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 4, tr in next sc, ch 7, [skip next 2 sc, tr in next 2 sc, ch 7] 5 times; join with a slip st in top of ch-4.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, sc in next tr, * (5 sc, ch 3, 5 sc) all in next ch-7 space **, sc in next 2 tr; repeat from * around, end at **; join in first sc.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in next sc, ch 11, [skip next 10 sc, dc in next 2 sc, ch 11] 5 times; join in top of ch-3.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, sc in next dc, * (7 sc, ch 3, 7 sc) all in next ch-11 space **, sc in next 2 dc; repeat from * around, end at **; join.
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in next sc, ch 15, [skip next 14 sc, dc in next 2 sc, ch 15] 5 times; join; TURN, slip st in last ch-15 made; TURN.
Round 7: [Ch 7, (9 sc, ch 7, 9 sc) all in next ch-15 space] 6 times.
Round 8: Slip st in next ch-7 space, ch 3, 4 dc in same ch-7 space, * ch 7, (3-dc-cluster, [ch 5, 3-dc-cluster] twice, ch 3, slip st) all in 4th ch from hook, sc in next 3 ch, 5 dc in same ch-7 space **, ch 5, 5 dc in next ch-7 space; repeat from * around, end at **; ch 3, dc in top of ch-3 to join and form last space.
Round 9: [Ch 9, slip st in next ch-5 space] 36 times working last slip st in joining dc.
Round 10: Ch 1, [(5 sc, ch 3, 5 sc) all in next ch-9 space] 3 times, * (5 sc, ch 1, slip st in last ch-3 space made, ch 1, 5 sc) in next ch-9 space, [(5 sc, ch 3, 5 sc) all in next ch-9 space] twice; repeat from * to last ch-9 space working sts in brackets once on last repeat; (5 sc, ch 1, slip st in first ch-3 space, ch 1, 5 sc) all in last ch-9 space; join in first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Block snowflakes and apply as desired.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein 368 Paddy Green
Safety pin, sewing needle and matching thread, yarn needle
abbreviations: ( ) = work directions in parenthesis the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Clover measures 2" [5 cm] at widest point.
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
Ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 2: *Ch 3, (tr, 2 dc, tr) in next sc, ch 3, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around, ch 8, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 6 ch, slip st in first ch of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in ends. Using needle and matching thread, sew safety pin to back of Clover.

materials: STITCH NATION by Debbie Stoller™ Full o’ Sheep™: 1 ball each 2605 Honeycomb A, 2640 Thyme B and 2350 Hazelnut C.
Crochet Hook 5 mm [US H-8] and 8 mm [US L-11].
Sharp yarn needle, 1½” bar pin, fiberfill stuffing, straight pins.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Flower measures 8” in diameter before felting, 5 ½” after felting.
gauge: Gauge is not important, but the stitches need to be loose to felt the yarn successfully.
instructions:
Note: Join rounds with a slip stitch.

SPECIAL ABBREVIATIONS
3-ch-picot = Ch 3, insert hook in front loop (horizontal bar) of the dc just made and in the left strand (vertical bar) of the same st, yo and pull through all three loops.

SUNFLOWER
Petals
Round 1:  With A, ch 2, 6 sc in second ch from the hook; join to first sc – 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc; join to first sc – 12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc] 6 times; join to first sc – 18 sc.
Round 4: (First row of petals), working in the front loops only of the previous round, slip st into first sc, [ch 5, working in the back hump of the chain, sc in second ch from the hook and the next 3 ch, slip st in next sc] 17 times; ch 5, working in the back hump of the chain, sc in second ch from the hook and the next 3 ch, slip st into back loop of first sc – 18 petals.
Round 5: Working behind the petals and in the back loops only of round 3, ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times; join to first sc – 24 sc.
Round 6: (Second row of petals) working into both loops of round 5, [ch 6, sc in the back hump of the second ch from the hook and the next 4 ch, slip st in next sc] 23 times; ch 6, sc in the back hump of the second ch from the hook and the next 4 ch; join to first petal – 24 petals.
Fasten off.  Weave in ends.

Sunflower Center
Round 1:  With C, ch 2, 6 sc in second ch from the hook; join to first sc – 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc; join to first sc – 12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join to first sc – 12 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Fasten off.  Weave in ends.

Leaves (Make 2)
Round 1:  With B, ch 4, 8 dc into first chain; do not join, turn.
Round 2: Ch 2, hdc in first dc, hdc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc; (3 dc, 3-ch-picot, 2 dc) in next dc; dc in next 2 dc, hdc in next dc, hdc in top of turning ch, ch 2, slip st into top of starting ch.
Fasten off.  Weave in ends.

Backing
Round 1:  With C, ch 2, 6 sc in second ch from the hook; join to first sc – 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc; join to first sc – 12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times; join to first sc – 18 sc.
Round 4:  Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times; join to first sc – 24 sc.
Fasten off.  Weave in ends.

Felting
Before assembling the flower, put the pieces into pillowcases and tie closed. Place them in a washing machine with hot water and a small amount of detergent. Check during the wash cycle regularly until desired amount of felting is achieved. Rinse soap and squeeze out excess water. To shape Sunflower, make a small aluminum ball and flatten one side. Place in the middle of the sunflower and pin or tie the petals around the ball and let dry. Block remaining pieces into desired shapes and let dry.

ASSEMBLY
With C, sew the sunflower center into the middle of the flower leaving a small opening; stuff center with fiber fill; finish sewing in place. arrange leaves on back of flower; pin into place and stitch to the sunflower with B. Place backing on the sunflower over the leaves; pin and stitch into place with C. Sew bar pin onto back.

materials: Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: 15 ins [38 cm] as per final measurement of Apron Skirt; 9 ins [23 cm] for Bib.
gauge: 13 hdc and 8 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions: Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook. Draw loop of next color through 2 loops on hook to complete st and proceed. Ch 2 does not count as hdc. Stripe Pattern Work 5 rows with MC. Work 1 row with C. Work 2 rows with MC. Work 2 rows with A. Work 2 rows with MC. Work 1 row with C. Work 5 rows with MC. These 18 rows form Stripe Pat. Apron Skirt: With MC, ch 87. 1st row: (WS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. 85 hdc. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in 1st hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc through back loop only. *1 hdc in next hdc through front loop only. 1 hdc in next hdc through back loop only. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn. Rep last row until work from beg measures 15 ins [38 cm]. Next row: Ch 2. Working through both loops, 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Fasten off. Pleats: With RS of apron facing, place marker along top edge 6 ins [15 cm] from either side. Fold 1 inch [2.5 cm] pleat and pin in position. Ties and Waistband: 1st row: With A, ch 42. With RS facing, join with sl st to upper left corner of Apron. Working through all thicknesses of pleats, work 1 sc in each st across top of Apron to end of row. Ch 43. Turn. 2nd row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 41 ch. 1 sc in each sc across. 1 sc in each of next 42 ch. Turn. 3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Rep last row once more. Fasten off. With RS of work facing, join B with sl st to any corner of Tie. Work one rnd of sc around Tie and outer edge of Apron, having 3 sc in each outside corner and sc2tog in inner corners as follows: (Draw up a loop in next st) twice. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook - sc2tog made. Join with sl st to first sc. Next rnd: Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Pocket: With MC, ch 41. 1st row: (WS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. 39 hdc. Turn. 1st row of Stripe Pat is completed. Keeping cont of Stripe pat, proceed as follows: 1st row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in 1st hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc through back loop only. *1 hdc in next hdc through front loop only. 1 hdc in next hdc through back loop only. instructions:
Legs

Directions are for size Child’s 4-6. Changes for size Child’s 8/10 are in parentheses.

Note
Gingerbread Man Panels are crocheted first.  Apron is then crocheted on either side of joined panels.
APRON
Gingerbread Man Panels (Make 3)
Head
With A, ch 3, join with slip st to form ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 3, (counts as dc), 11 dc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning-ch; do not turn – 12 dc.
Neck
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in same st, 3 sc in next st, sc in next st; do not turn – 5 sc.
Arms
Row 1: Ch 4, turn; 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 2 chs; with Right Side facing, slip st in next 5 sts (across neck), ch 4, turn; 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 2 chs; do not turn – 10 sc, 5 slip st.
Body
Row 1: With Right Side facing, working into sts from Row 1 Neck and over slip sts from Row 1 Arms, sc in next 5 sts; turn – 5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in last st; turn – 7 sc.
Rows 3 - 4: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each st across; do not turn.

GAUGE: 9 sc and 13 rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain gauge.

What you will need:

All Sizes
Row 1: With Right Side facing, join C with sc in ch-1 sp at bottom right corner, [sc in next 15 sts, sc in next ch-1 sp, dc in center of joining, sc in next ch-1 sp] twice, sc in next 15 sts, sc in next ch-1 sp; turn – 53 sts.
Size 4-6 Only
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across.
Fasten off.
Size 8-10 Only
Rows 2-8: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. Fasten off.
Apron Front
All Sizes
Row 1: With Right Side facing, join C with sc in ch-1 sp at bottom right corner, [sc in next 11 sts, sc in next ch-1 sp, dc in center of joining, sc in next ch-1 sp] twice, sc in next 11 sts, sc in next ch-1 sp; turn – 41 sts.
Rows 2-3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st across to last 2 sts, sc2tog; turn – 37 sc.
Sizes 4-6 Only
Rows 4-6: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st across to last 2 sts, sc2tog; turn – 31 sc.
Size 8-10 Only
Rows 4-6: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
All Sizes
Rows 7-28: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Rows 29 – 33: Repeat Row 2 – 21 (27) sc.
Fasten off.
Edging
Round 1: With Right Side facing, join B with sc in first st of last row on Front, 2 sc in same st, sc in next 19 (25) sts, 3 sc in last st; pivot to work in row ends along first long side, sc in each row end to Gingerbread Man Panel; sc in ch-1 sp, sc in next 17 sts, sc in next ch-1 sp; sc in each row end of Bottom section to corner; working across last row of Bottom, 3 sc in first st, sc in each st across to last st, 3 sc in last st; pivot to work along second long side, sc in each row end of Bottom to Gingerbread Man Panel; sc in next ch-1 sp, sc in next 17 sts, sc in next ch-1 sp; sc in each row end along side; join with slip st in beginning sc – 188 (206) sc.
Fasten off.
Round 2: With Right Side facing, join D with slip st in center st of top right corner, sc in next 23 (29) sts, slip st in next st, working around outer edge of apron, *shell in next st, slip st in next st; repeat from * around, ending with slip st in beginning slip st – 82 shells.
Fasten off.
Neck Tie
Row 1: With Right Side facing, join B with slip st in top right corner, ch 76, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end; slip st in same sp as joining – 75 sc.
Fasten off. Repeat in opposite corner for second tie.
Waist Ties
Repeat as for Neck Ties, beginning by joining at side approximately 8” (20 cm) down from top edge. Repeat on opposite side for second Waist Tie.
Tie Edging
Join D with slip st in same st as beginning-slip st for first neck tie, loosely slip st in each st, slip st over end post of last st; working across opposite side of tie, slip st in bottom loops of beginning ch, slip st in same st as joining.
Fasten off. Repeat for remaining waist and neck ties.
FINISHING
Weave in all ends.
With yarn needle and B, embroider a French knot for each eye and nose on each Gingerbread Man face.
With D, wrap a 6” (15 cm) strand around each Gingerbread Man neck, pull to shape neck and knot tightly; tie in small bow, trim ends.

materials: Bernat® Handicrafter® Cotton (1.75 oz/50 g; 80 yds/73 m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Child size: Approx 17" x 20" [43 x 51 cm]. Adult size: Approx 221/2" x 23" [57 x 58.5 cm].
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
The instructions are written for smaller size. If changes are necessary for larger size the instructions will be written thus ( ). When only one number is given, it applies to both sizes.
Note: To change color, work to last loops on hook at end of row. With new color, draw through loops on hook, then proceed in new color.

Apron
With MC, ch 56 (74).
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook (counts as 1 hdc). 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 54 (72) hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Join A. Turn.
3rd and 4th rows: With A, as 2nd row, joining MC at end of last row.
5th and 6th rows: With MC, as 2nd row, joining A at end of last row.
Rep 3rd to 6th rows for Stripe Pat until work from beg measures 12 (15)" [30.5 (38) cm], ending with a WS row.
Next row: With appropriate color, ch 2. (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - Hdc2tog made. 1 hdc in each st to last 3 sts. Hdc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 hdc in last st. Turn. Place markers at each end of row. Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row until 24 (28) sts rem.
Cont even in Stripe Pat until work from beg measures approx 19 (22)" [48 (56) cm], ending on a 6th row of Stripe Pat. Fasten off.

Pocket
With MC, ch 56 (74).
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook (counts as 1 hdc). 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 54 (72) hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 5½ (7½)" [14 (19) cm], ending with a WS row. Fasten off.

Vertical Dividers: Place vertical markers along 19th (25th) hdc in from each side edge. With RS facing, join 2 strands of A with sl st at foundation edge of marker and work a vertical chain up length of Pocket to top edge. Fasten off. Rep along other marker.

Bottom edging: 1st row: With RS facing, join A with sl st in bottom corner of lower edge. Ch 1. Work 54 (72) sc evenly across. Fasten off.
2nd row: With RS facing, join MC with sl st in first sc of last row. Ch 1. Work 1 sc in each sc across. Fasten off.

Top edging: Work as for Bottom edging across top edge.

Pin Pocket in position to RS of Apron, having bottom edge of Pocket 2 (3)" [5 (7.5) cm] above lower edge of Apron.

Apron Edging: 1st rnd: With RS facing, join A with sl st to bottom right corner of Apron. Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp as sl st. Work 53 (71) sc along bottom edge, 3 sc in corner, 38 (49) sc up side edge (working through both Apron and Pocket edges), 22 (32) sc up armhole edge, 3 sc in corner, 23 (27) sc across top edge, 3 sc in corner, 22 (32) sc down armhole edge, 38 (49) sc down side edge (working through both Apron and Pocket edges). Join with sl st in first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 1 sc in each sc around, having 3 sc in each corner sc. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.

Neck Strap
With A, ch 58 (63).
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 57 (62) sc.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Fasten off at end of 3rd row.

Waist Ties (make 2).
With A, ch 85 (101).
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew Pocket vertical dividers through both thicknesses to form 3 pockets. Sew Neck Strap and Waist Ties in position.

abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

instructions:
With MC, ch 11.

2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
4th to 7th rows: As 2nd and 3rd rows twice. 16 sc.
8th row: As 3rd row.
9th row: Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of first 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook - sc2tog made. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. Turn.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 385 Royal A, 316 Soft White B, and 319 Cherry Red C
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5.5mm [US I-9] and 3.75mm [US F-5] (for stars only)
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Apron measures about 29” (73.5 cm) long, not including top ties, and is designed to fit most adults.
gauge: 12 sts = 4” (10 cm); 6 rows = 4” (10 cm) in double crochet (dc) using larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Skirt
With larger hook and C, ch 45.
Row 1 (right side): Dc in 4th ch from hook (3 skipped ch count as first dc) and in each remaining ch across, turn—43 dc.
Row 2: Ch 1 (counts as first slip st), skip first dc, *dc in next st, slip st in next st; repeat from * across working last slip st in top of beginning ch; change to B in last slip st, turn—22 slip sts and 21 dc.
Row 3: With B, ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), skip first slip st, dc in each remaining st across working last dc in beginning ch-1, turn—43 dc.
Row 4: With B, repeat Row 2; change to C in last st.
Row 5: With C, repeat Row 3.
Row 6: With C, repeat Row 2; change to B in last st.
Rows 7–50: Repeat Rows 3–6 eleven more times. Do not turn at the end of the last row. Fasten off B. Do not fasten off C.

Top of Skirt
Row 1: With C, working alongside edge of skirt, sc in the end of each row across, turn—50 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—40 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—30 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in next 18 sts, [sc2tog] 3 times, turn—24 sc. Fasten off C.

Waist Tie
Row 1 (right side): With larger hook and A, ch 80, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across; with right side facing, sc in each of the 24 sts of last row of top of skirt, ch 80, turn.
Row 2: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 78 ch, sc in each remaining ch across, turn—182 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. Fasten off A.

Bib
With right side facing and larger hook, join B with slip st in 80th st of waist tie.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 3, dc in next 11 sts, 2 dc in next st, dc in next 11 sts, turn; leave remaining sts unworked—25 dc.
Row 2: Ch 1 (counts as first slip st), skip first dc, *dc in next st, slip st in next st; repeat from * across working last slip st in top of beginning ch; change to C in last slip st, turn—13 slip sts and 12 dc.
Row 3: With C, ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), skip first slip st, dc in each remaining st across working last dc in beginning ch-1, turn—43 dc.
Row 4: With C, repeat Row 2; change to B in last st.
Row 5: With B, repeat Row 3.
Row 6: With B, repeat Row 2; change to C in last st.
Rows 7–10: Repeat Rows 3–6; change to A at the end of Row 10. Fasten off B and C.
Row 11: With A, ch 1, sc in each st across working last sc in beginning ch-1, turn.
Rows 12–19: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 20: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 3 times, sc in next 13 sts, [sc2tog] 3 times—19 sc. Fasten off A.

Bib Border and Top Tie on First Side
Row 1 (right side): With right side of bib facing and larger hook, join A with sc in edge of Row 1 of bib to work in ends of rows along one side edge of bib, work 23 more sc evenly spaced alongside edge, ch 61, turn—24 sc and 61 ch.
Row 2: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch and sc across, turn—84 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off A. Sew lower edge of this section to top edge of waist tie.

Bib Border and Top Tie on Second Side
Row 1 (right side): With larger hook and A, ch 60; with right side of bib facing, work sc in edge of last row of bib to work in ends of rows along remaining side edge of bib, work 23 more sc evenly spaced alongside edge, turn—24 sc and 60 ch.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc and ch across—84 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off A. Sew lower edge of this section to top edge of waist tie.

Skirt Border
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing and larger hook, join A with sc in edge of skirt just below waist tie to work alongside edge of skirt, sc evenly spaced down around skirt to just below waist tie on other side, working 3 sc in each lower corner, turn.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc in each st to center sc of first 3-sc corner, 3 dc in center sc, 3 dc in each st to center sc of next 3-sc corner, 3 dc in center sc, hdc in each remaining sc to waist, turn.

Apron Border
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing and larger hook, join B with slip st in lower edge of waist tie near last row of skirt border, ch 2, hdc in each st of last row of skirt border; slip st evenly around edges of end of waist tie; hdc evenly up side of bib to first top tie; slip st evenly around edges of top tie; hdc evenly across top of bib; slip st evenly around edges of other top tie; hdc evenly down side of bib; slip st around edges of other end of waist tie; join with slip st in first hdc.
Row 2: *Sc in next st, 3 hdc in next st; repeat from * around skirt border. Fasten off B.

HEART POCKET
With larger hook and A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. Place marker in last stitch made, to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: Work 3 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts, 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts, 2 dc in each of next 3 sts, 2 hdc in next st, sc in next 2 sts, slip st in next st, sc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, 2 dc in each of next 3 sts, 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts, sc in next 6 sts—44 sts.
Round 7: Sc in next st, 3 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts, hdc in next st, 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts, dc in next 4 sts, 2 dc in each of next 2 sts, 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts, sc in next st, skip next st, slip st in next st, skip next st, sc in next st, 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts, 2 dc in each of next 2 sts, dc in next 4 sts, 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts, hdc in next st, sc in next 7 sts, slip st in next st.
Fasten off.

STARS (make 4)
With smaller hook and B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). Place marker in last stitch made, to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around—10 sc.
Round 3: *Slip st in next st, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch (point made), skip next st; repeat from * 4 more times; join with slip st in first slip st—5 points.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
Sew one star to front of heart pocket. Sew three remaining stars evenly spaced across top A-colored section of bib. Using photograph as a guide, sew heart pocket to skirt of apron. Weave in ends.

Note: In following rows use a separate ball of yarn for each section of color.
Row 12 (11)–16 (16): With A, ch 3, (dc, ch 2, sc) in first ch-2 space, d-box in next 6 (9) ch-2 spaces; change to B, d-box in next 4 (5) ch-2 spaces; change to A, d-box in last 7 (10) ch-2 spaces, turn; change to C in last st of last row.
Row 17: With C, ch 3, (dc, ch 2, sc) in first ch-2 space, d-box in next 6 (9) ch-2 spaces; change to D, d-box in next 4 (5) ch-2 spaces; change to C, d-box in last 7 (10) ch-2 spaces, turn.
Rows 18–20: With C, ch 3, (dc, ch 2, sc) in first ch-2 space, d-box in next 6 (9) ch-2 spaces; change to D, d-box in next ch-2 space; change to C, d-box in next 2 (3) ch-2 spaces; change to D, d-box in next ch-2 space; change to C, d-box in last 7 (10) ch-2 spaces, turn.
Row 21: Repeat Row 17; change to A in last st.
Rows 22–29 (33): With A, ch 3, (dc, ch 2, sc) in first ch-2 space, d-box in next 6 (9) ch-2 spaces; change to B, d-box in next 4 (5) ch-2 spaces; change to A, d-box in last 7 (10) ch-2 spaces, turn.
Place a stitch marker at beginning and end of last row, for placement of waist ties.
Shape Sides
Row 30 (34) (decrease): With A, slip st in each ch of first ch-2 space, slip st in next 2 dc, ch 3, (dc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space, d-box in next 5 (8) ch-2 spaces, place a marker in last ch-2 space made; change to B, d-box in next 4 (5) ch-2 spaces, place a marker in last ch-2 space made; change to A, d-box in each ch-2 space across to last ch-2 space, 2-dc Cl in last ch-2 space, turn—16 (23) d-boxes.
Note: The markers added in Row 30 (34) indicate where the color change should occur. Move markers up to last ch-space of each color section, as each row is completed. Use of stitch markers in this manner is optional. If you can 'read' your stitches, you may choose not to use markers.
Row 31 (35)–36 (46): With A, ch 3, (dc, ch 2, sc) in first ch-2 space, d-box in each ch-2 space to first marker; change to B, d-box in each ch-2 space to next marker; change to A, d-box in each ch-2 space across to last ch-2 space, 2-dc Cl in last ch-2 space, turn—10 (11) d-boxes.
Bib
Rows 37 (47)–46 (52): With A, ch 3, (dc, ch 2, sc) in first ch-2 space, d-box in next 2 ch-2 spaces; change to B, d-box in next 4 (5) ch-2 spaces; change to A, d-box in last 3 ch-2 spaces, turn.
Remove the color change markers.
First Neck Tie
Row 1: With A, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in first ch-2 space, dc in next dc, turn.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until tie measures about 9” (23cm). Fasten off. 
Second Neck Tie
Row 1: Draw up a loop of A in opposite top corner of apron, ch 3, dc in next dc, dc in next ch-2 space, turn.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until tie measures about 9” (23cm). Fasten off. 
WAIST TIES
Row 1: Draw up a loop of A in edge of apron where marked to work down side of apron, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), work 2 dc evenly spaced in edge of apron, turn—3 dc.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until tie measures about 15” (38 cm). Fasten off. Repeat on other side edge for 2nd tie.
FINISHING
Edging
Draw up a loop of A in edge of apron at beginning of an A-colored section, sc evenly spaced all the way around the outer edge of the apron, changing color to match each section; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

Row 16: Repeat row 9 – 30 sc.
Row 17: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.

Row 22: Repeat row 16 –24 sc.
Rows 23–27: Repeat Row 9 –14 sc. Fasten off.

2nd rnd: (Tears rnd). Ch 1. Work 5 dc down post of first dc of previous rnd. Ch 1. Work 5 dc up post of 2nd dc of previous rnd – beg scale st made. Miss next 5 dc. *Work 5 dc down post of next dc of previous rnd. Ch 1. Work 5 dc up post of next dc of previous rnd – scale st made. Miss next 5 dc. Rep from * 11 times more. Join with sl st to ch 1.
3rd rnd: (Base rnd). Sl st to 3rd dc of next missed 5-dc group of previous rnd. Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc between 2 dc of scale st. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc.** 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * 11 times more; then rep from * to ** once more. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
4th rnd: (Tears rnd). Ch 1. Beg scale st. Miss next 5 dc. *Scale st. Miss next 5 dc. Rep from * 11 times more. Join with sl st to ch 1.
Rep 3rd and 4th rnds for pat until work from beg measures approx 8" [20.5 cm]. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc of last base rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 84 sc. Fasten off. 
Bag Edging: With smaller hook, join A with sl st to any sc.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp as last sl st. Miss next 2 sc. *3 sc in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Sl st in next sc. Ch 1. *3 sc in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until edging measures 2" [5 cm]. Fasten off.
HANDLES (make 2). With larger hook and 2 strands of A, ch 4.
1st rnd: Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 ch (4 loops on hook). 
2nd rnd: Drop all loops from hook. Pick up last loop worked (4th loop). Working from right to left, insert hook in 1st loop (this will cause a circle to form). Yoh and draw through loop. Insert hook into 2nd loop. Yoh and draw through loop. Insert hook into 3rd loop. (4 loops on hook).
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 18" [45.5 cm] long. Break yarn, leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts and fasten securely.
FLOWER (See Diagram II on page 3). With larger hook and B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in first sc. (1 hdc. 2 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. *1 sc in next sc. (1 hdc. 2 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. Rep from * once more. Do not join with sl st. 3 petals.
3rd rnd: Do not ch 1. Working in rem back loops of 1st rnd, 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in first sc. (1 hdc. 2 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. *1 sc in next sc. (1 hdc. 2 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. Do not join with sl st. 6 petals.
5th rnd: Do not ch 1. Working in rem back loops of 3rd rnd, 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 5 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in first sc. (1 hdc. 2 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. *1 sc in next sc. (1 hdc. 2 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. Rep from * 7 times more. Do not join with sl st. 9 petals.
7th rnd: Do not ch 1. Working in rem back loops of 5th rnd, 2 sc first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 5 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in first sc. (1 hdc. 2 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. *1 sc in next sc. (1 hdc. 2 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. Rep from * 10 times more. Do not join with sl st. 12 petals.
9th rnd: Do not ch 1. Working in rem back loops of 7th rnd, 2 sc first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 5 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in first sc. (1 hdc. 2 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. *1 sc in next sc. (1 hdc. 2 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. Rep from * 13 times more. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 15 petals.
FINISHING
Join bottom edge: With larger hook, join MC with sl st at bottom edge. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sl st across bottom edge to join. Fasten off.
Sew Handles and Flower to top of Bag as shown in picture.

materials: Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
Awl tool 4 mm diameter for holes.
measurements: Approx 14 ins [35.5 cm] wide x 16 ins [40.5 cm] high.
gauge: Granny Square Motif = 3½ ins [9 cm] square. 16 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions: Granny Square (make 12) With MC, ch 4. Join with sl st to form ring. 1st rnd:Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in ring. (Ch 1. 3 dc ) 3 times in ring. Ch 1. Sl st to top of ch-3. 2nd rnd:Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch-1 sp). [(3 dc. Ch 1) twice in next ch 1 sp] 3 times. (3 dc. Ch 1. 2 dc) in last ch-1 sp. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 3rd rnd:Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. *(3 dc. Ch 1) twice in next ch-1 sp. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * twice more. (3 dc. Ch 1) twice in last ch-1 sp. Sl st in top of ch-3. Fasten off. Piece A(make 1 each with A, B and C) Ch 46. 1st row:1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 45 sc. Turn. 2nd row:Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row until work from beg measures 12 ins [30.5 cm]. Fasten off. Piece B With B, ch 30. 1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 29 sc. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row until work from beg measures 15 ins [38 cm]. Fasten off. Handle/Gusset With B, ch 10. 1st row:1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 9 sc. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row until work from beg measures 95 ins [241.5 cm]. Fasten off. FINISHING Felt Pieces A, B and Handle/Gusset. Felted Piece A should measure approx 8 x 8 ins [20.5 x 20.5 cm]. Felted Piece B should measure approx 5½ x 11 ins [14 x 28 cm]. Felted Handle/Gusset should measure approx 1¾ x 72 ins [4 x 183 cm]. Cut four 3½ ins [9 cm] squares from each Piece A (12 squares in total). With an awl tool, make 4 corner holes ¼ inch [.5 cm] in from both edges. Make 3 more holes evenly spaced between corner holes along each side of square. With RS of work facing, join MC with sl st to any corner hole. Ch 1. *(2 sc. Ch 1. 2 sc) in corner hole. (3 sc in next hole) 3 times. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Cut four Triangle Motifs 4½ ins [11.5 cm] wide x 5 ins [12.5 cm] high from Piece B. With an awl tool, make corner hole ¼ inch [.5 cm] in from both edges at right angle. Make 1 hole at each point ½ inch [1 cm] below both edges. Make 6 holes along the shortest (bottom) side of Triangle Motif evenly spaced between corner holes. Make 10 holes evenly spaced between corner holes along the longest side of Triangle Motif. Make 8 holes evenly spaced between corner holes along last side of Triangle Motif. Right Triangle Motif: With RS of work facing, join MC with sl st to bottom right corner hole. Ch 1. (2 sc. Ch 1. 2 sc) in corner hole. (3 sc in next hole up side of Triangle Motif) 8 times. (2 sc. Ch 2. 2 sc) in next point hole. (3 sc in next hole down longest side of Triangle Motif) 10 times. (2 sc. Ch 2. 2 sc) in next point hole. (3 sc in each hole along bottom side of Triangle Motif) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Left Triangle Motif: With RS of work facing, join MC with sl st to bottom left corner hole of Triangle Motif. Ch 1. (2 sc. Ch 1. 2 sc) in corner hole. (3 sc in next hole along bottom side of Triangle Motif) 6 times. (2 sc. Ch 2. 2 sc) in next point hole. (3 sc in next hole up longest side of Triangle Motif) 10 times. (2 sc. Ch 2. 2 sc) in next point hole. (3 sc in next hole down side of Triangle Motif) 8 times. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Trim Handle/Gusset to measure 70 ins [177.5 cm] long. With an awl tool, make 4 corner holes ¼ inch [.5 cm] below both edges. Make 2 holes evenly spaced between corner holes along short sides of Handle. Make rem holes ½ inch [1 cm] apart along long sides of Handle/Gusset, ¼ ins [.5 cm] below edge. With RS of work facing, join MC with sl st to any corner hole. Ch 1. *(2 sc. Ch 1. 2 sc) in corner hole. Work 3 sc in each hole along sides, having (2 sc. Ch 1. 2 sc) in corner holes. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. With RS of work facing and MC sew all squares and triangle motifs for Front and Back, as shown on Diagram I. Sew short sides of Handle/Gusset tog to form a ring, taking care not to twist gusset. Pin Handle/Gusset to Front, with gusset seam at center bottom of bag. Starting at top of Triangle Motif, with RS of work facing and MC, sew Handle/Gusset and Front tog. Rep for Back. HOW TO FELT INSTRUCTIONS FELTING • Put pieces in top-loading washing machine. Put in a pair of jeans or large towel (in non-interfering color) for extra agitation. Using low water level, run a Hot/Cold cycle for 15 min. • Add 2 tablespoons of baking soda for a small load. After one cycle, check for size. Repeat as necessary. • Run through the rinse and dry spin cycle. • Lay felted piece on a dry towel, away from direct heat or sunlight. • Shape piece to correct measurements. • Allow to dry thoroughly. Do not use a clothes dryer. • If an edge ripples, baste a thread through the edge and gather in. Remove the thread after felted item is dry. • When piece is dry, use tailor's chalk to mark cutting (trimming) lines. AFTERCARE • You have spent a lot of time and care completing these items through their knitting/crocheting and felting stages. A little thought to aftercare will ensure that you will have these beautiful felted items for many years to come. • After you have subjected your item to the felting process, you may think that it has gone through the most vigorous and tortured wash that yarn could ever endure. Now you assume that you can throw that felted item into the hot wash cycle along with your sheets. Do not do it! Treat your newly felted item with caution and care in order to avoid further shrinkage or distortion. • Felted handmade items can always be improved with brushing. • Even a slight pressing will give a smoother appearance to felted fabric. Always press lightly using a steam iron and a damp cloth. Never press down on the fabric but hold the iron just above the fabric.

materials: 12” Two-Slider Zipper (Coats & Clark Art.F.53), yarn needle, sewing needle and matching thread.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Bag measures 16” wide x 21” tall, including strap.
gauge: 14 sc = 4”; 10 rows = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BAG (Front and Back Alike)
Ch 27.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, [2 sc in next ch, sc in next 2 ch] 8 times – 34 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first sc, sc across to last sc, 2 sc in last sc – 36 sc.
Rows 4-13: Repeat Rows 2-3 for 5 more times – 46 sc.
Rows 14-16: Repeat Row 2.
Row 17: Repeat Row 3 – 48 sc.
Repeat Rows 14-17 twice more – 52 sc.
Work even piece measures 10” from beginning, end with a wrong side row.
Shape Top
Left Side
Row 1: Ch 1, turn, sc in first 18 sc, slip st in next sc. Leave remaining sts unworked.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, skip slip st and next sc, slip st in next sc, sc across – 16 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc to last sc, slip st in last sc – 15 sc.
Rows 4-7: Repeat Rows 2-3 twice more – 9 sc.
Rows 8-10: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off.
Right Side
Row 1: With right side facing, skip center 14 sc, join yarn with slip st in next sc, sc in each sc to end – 18 sc. Work as for Left Side, reversing shaping.
FINISHING
Sew Front and Back together along bottom and side edges.
Strap
Row 1: With right side facing, join yarn in first sc on last row of one Top edge, ch 1, work 18 sc across both sides of Top edge.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc across to last 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc – 16 sc.
Rows 3-5: Repeat Row 2 – 10 sc.
Work even until Strap measures 18” from Top edge, end with a right side row.
Increase Row: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc across to last 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc – 12 sc. Repeat Increase Row 3 more times – 18 sc.
Last Row: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Sew end of Strap to last row of opposite Top edge. Fold long edge of Strap in half to wrong side and sew closed.
Top Opening
Sew Top edge of Front and Back together for 2” from each Strap on either side for opening for zipper.
Zipper Edge Round
With right side facing, join yarn at zipper opening, ch 1, sc evenly around, slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.
Sew zipper into zipper opening.

materials: RED HEART® Vera™: 2 balls each 2360 Caffé A, and 2312 Nero B
abbreviations: A and B = Color A and Color B
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Bag measures about 11” [28 cm] wide at base, 20½” [52 cm] wide at top edge, and 11” [28 cm] tall (not including handles).
gauge: 13 sc = 4” [10 cm]; 16 rows = 4” [10 cm] in single crochet (sc). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Base
With A, ch 36.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across—35 sc.
Rows 2–25: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off.

Front
Row 1: Join B with sc at beginning of one long edge of base, work 34 more sc evenly spaced along edge—35 sc.
Rows 2–7: With B, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. Change to A in last sc of last row.
Rows 8–14: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. Change to B in last sc of last row.
Rows 15–21: With B, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. Change to A in last sc of last row.
Rows 22–35: Repeat Rows 8–21.
Rows 36–42: Repeat Rows 8–14.
Fasten off.

Back
Beginning along remaining long edge, work back the same as front.

Side
Row 1: Join B with sc at beginning of one short edge of base, work 20 more sc evenly spaced along edge—21 sc.
Row 2 (increase row): With B, ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across—22 sc.
Rows 3 and 4: With B, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 5 (increase row): Repeat Row 2—23 sc.
Rows 6 and 7: With B, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. Change to A in last sc of last row.
Row 8: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 9 (increase row): With A, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc to last sc, 2 sc in last sc—24 sc.
Rows 10 and 11: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 12 (increase row): Repeat Row 9—25 sc.
Rows 13 and 14: With A, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. Change to B in last sc of last row.
Row 15: With B, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 16 (increase row): Repeat Row 2—26 sc.
Rows 17 and 18: With B, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 19 (increase row): Repeat Row 2—27 sc.
Rows 20 and 21: With B, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. Change to A in last sc of last row.
Rows 22–35: Repeat Rows 8–21—29 sc.
Rows 36–42: Repeat Rows 8–14—31 sc.
Fasten off. Repeat along remaining short edge for second side.

STRAPS (make 2)
With B, ch 11.
Row 1: Sc in 3rd ch from hook, [ch 1, skip next ch, sc in next ch] 4 times—5 sc, 4 ch-1 spaces, and 1 beginning ch-space.
Row 2: Ch 2, turn, skip first sc, sc in next ch-1 space, [ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space] 3 times, ch 1, skip last sc, sc in beginning ch-space.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures about 19” [48.5 cm] from beginning.
Fasten off. Repeat for second strap.

FINISHING
Sew edges of front, back, and sides together using yarn matching the stripes. Sew ends of one strap to inside of top edge of front and one strap to inside of top edge of back, sewing each end about 2” [5 cm] from seam. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Maker™ Splash™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 305 yds/279 m) Cherry Swirl (35005) 2 balls or 507 yds/463 m
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 12 hdc and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as st.
• Ch 3 at beg of rnds counts as dc.
• Ch 4 at beg of rnds counts as tr.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st, unless otherwise stated.
Base: Ch 3.
1st rnd: 7 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join. 7 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 14 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. 21 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 2 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. 28 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 3 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. 35 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 4 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. 42 hdc.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 5 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. 49 hdc.
8th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 6 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. 56 hdc.
9th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 7 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. 63 hdc.
10th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 8 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. 70 hdc.
11th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 9 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. 77 hdc.

Sides: 12th rnd: (Set-up rnd). Ch 3. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in each hdc around. Join.
13th rnd: (Scale rnd). Ch 4. 4 dc down post of first dc of previous rnd. Ch 1. (4 dc. 1 tr) up post of 2nd dc of previous rnd – beg scale st made. Skip next 5 dc. *(1 tr. 4 dc) down post of next dc of previous rnd. Ch 1. (4 dc. 1 tr) up post of next dc of previous rnd - scale st made. Skip next 5 dc. Rep from * 10 times more. Join. 11 scale sts.
14th rnd: Sl st to 3rd dc of last skipped 5-dc group of previous rnd. Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc between 2 dc of scale st. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc.** 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * 9 times more, then rep from * to ** once more. Join.
15th rnd: Beg scale st. Skip next 5 dc. *Scale st. Skip next 5 dc. Rep from * around. Join.
16th to 29th rnds: Rep last 2 rnds 7 times more. 
30th rnd: Sl st to 3rd dc of last skipped 5-dc group of previous rnd. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each dc around. Join. 77 hdc
31st and 32nd rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 
33rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 2 hdc. *Ch 1. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Ch 1. Skip next hdc.** 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * 9 times more, then from * to ** once. 1 hdc in each of last 2 hdc. Turn. 55 hdc and 22 ch-1 sps.
34th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 2 hdc. *1 hdc in next ch-1 sp. 1 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next ch-1 sp.** 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * 9 times more, then from * to ** once. 1 hdc in each of last 2 hdc. Turn. 77 hdc.
35th rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each hdc around. Join and fasten off.

DRAWSTRING
Ch 91.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Fasten off.
Tie a knot 1" [2.5 cm] up from each end of Drawstring.
STRAP
Ch 6.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 5 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until strap measures approx 30" [76 cm] or desired length, ending on WS. Do not fasten off.
Border: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 3 sc in last sc. Working down side edge of strap, 1 sc in side of each row to next corner. Working in opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 3 sc in next ch. Working up side edge of strap, 1 sc in side edge of each row to first corner. 2 sc in same sp as first sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: 1 skein Red Heart® Super Saver® 315 Artist Print.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: 17 sts = 5” (13 cm); 14 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Ch 18
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—17 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 8” (20 cm) from beginning, ending with a wrong side row. Place a marker at each end of the last row worked.
Flap
Continue working in sc 1½” (4cm) more, ending with a wrong side row. Next row (right side): Ch 3 (counts as dc) skip first sc, dc in each remaining sc to end, turn—17 dc.
Next row: Ch 1, sc in each dc across. Fasten off.
