materials: RED HEART® "Super Saver®": 1 Skein each 528 Medium Purple A and 315 Artist Print B.
One pair 6” diameter round bamboo handles; ¾” button; yarn needle.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Bag is 17” wide x 9½” tall without handles.
gauge: 12 sc = 4”; 14 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
PURSE
With A, ch 59.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 58 sts.
Rows 2-59: Ch 1, sc in the back loop of each sc across; turn.
Row 60: Ch 1, sc in each st across. Do not turn.
Handle Flap
Rotate Bag 90 degrees to work along side edge.
Row 1: Ch 1, sc 31 sts evenly along short edge; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc2tog across, sc in last st; turn – 16 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc to last 2 sts, sc2tog; turn – 14 sts.
Rows 4-7: Ch 1, sc across; turn.
Fasten off, leaving a 12” tail.
With Right Side facing, join A at right corner of other short edge. Repeat Handle Flap directions.
Flower
With B, ch 5; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1), [dc in ring, ch 1] 5 times; join in 3rd ch of ch-4 – 6 dc.
Round 2: Ch 1, * (sc, 3 dc, sc) all in next ch-1 space; repeat from * around – 6 petals.
Round 3: Holding petals forward, * slip st in next dc from Round 1, ch 3; join.
Round 4: Ch 1, * (sc, hdc, 3 dc, hdc, sc) all in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around; join.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, holding petals forward, * ch 4, sc between next 2 petals; repeat from * around; ch 4; join.
Round 6: Ch 1, * (sc, hdc, 5 dc, hdc, sc) all in next ch-4 space; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Wrap Handle Flap over bamboo handle so that Row 7 of Flap meets Row 1. Sew securely. Repeat for 2nd handle.
Fold bag in half with right sides together. Working through both layers, join A 3” below handles, ch 1, sc down side edge. Fasten off. Repeat for 2nd side.
Gusset: With right sides together, fold bottom corner perpendicular to side seam to create a triangle at lower corner. With yarn needle, sew a seam approximately 2” across, perpendicular to side seam. Repeat for other corner.
Turn bag right side out. Sew flower to bag. Sew button in center of flower. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Eco-Cotton™ Blend: 2 skeins each 1370 Candy Marl A, 1645 Moss B, 1340 Almond C, 1890 Denim F
1 skein each 1001 Snow E and 1373 Linen Marl D
abbreviations: A, B, etc= color A, B, etc
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: Rounds 1-3 = 3½” of Small Square holding 2 strands of yarn together. Rounds 1-10 = 9½” of Large Square holding 2 strands of yarn together. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the specified gauge.
instructions:
SMALL SQUARES
SQUARE I (Make 3)
Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 4, slip st to first ch to join.
Round 1 (RS): Ch 3 (counts as dc), work 2 dc in ring, ch 2, [3 dc, ch 2] 3 times, slip st to first sc to join. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join B in any ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same space, *ch 1, Fpdc around center dc of next 3-dc cluster, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space; repeat from * around, end ch 1, Fpdc around center dc of last 3-dc cluster, ch 1, slip st to first sc to join. Fasten off.
Round 3: Join F in any ch-2 space, ch 1, sc in same space, *ch 1, (3-dc cluster, ch 2, 3-dc cluster) in next Fpdc, ch 1, sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * around; end ch 1, (3-dc cluster, ch 2, 3-dc cluster) in next Fpdc, ch 1, slip st to first sc to join. Fasten off.
SQUARE II (Make 2)
Work as for Square I, using D as first color, E as second color and C as third color.
SQUARE III (Make 2)
Work as for Square I, using F as first color, A as second color and B as third color.
JOINING SMALL SQUARES
Arrange Squares together into Strip in the following order: I, II, I, III, II, I, III.
Round 4 of First Square: Join A in center dc of 3-dc cluster to left of any corner ch-2 space on any Square, ch 1, [sc, ch 2, sc] in same dc and in each ch-1 space and center dc of 3-dc clusters around, working (sc, ch 4, sc) in each corner ch-2 space, slip st to first sc to join – 6 ch-spaces on each side. Fasten off.
Joining Round 4 of Next Square: Join A in center dc of 3-dc cluster to left of any corner ch-2 space on next Square, work as for First Square to corner ch-2 space of last side, sc in corner of working Square, ch 2, slip st in corner ch-4 space of previous Square, ch 2, sc in corner of working Square, *sc in next st of working Square, ch 1, slip st to next ch-2 space of previous Square, ch 1, sc in same st of working Square; repeat from * to last corner, sc in corner of working Square, ch 2, slip st in corner ch-4 space of previous Square, ch 2, sc in corner of working Square, slip st to first st to join. Fasten off.
Repeat Joining Round 4 to join 7 Squares into a Loop – 42 ch-spaces around.
LARGE SQUARES
(Make 1 in first color combination for LARGE SQUARE IV; make 2 in second color combination in parenthesis for LARGE SQUARES V and VI)
Holding 2 strands of E (F) together, ch 4, slip st to first ch to join.
Round 1 (RS): Ch 3 (counts as dc), work 2 dc in ring, ch 2, [3 dc, ch 2] 7 times, slip st to first sc to join. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join D (A) in any ch-2 space, ch 1, [2 sc, ch 2, 2 sc] in each ch-2 space around, slip st to first sc to join. Fasten off.
Round 3: Join F (B) in any ch-2 space, ch 3 (counts as dc), work 2 dc in same space for corner, *ch 1, (3-dc cluster, ch 2, 3-dc cluster) in next ch-2 space, ch 1, 3-dc cluster in next ch-2 space; repeat from * around, end ch 1, (3-dc cluster, ch 2, 3-dc cluster) in next ch-2 space, ch 1, slip st to top of beginning ch to join. Fasten off.
Round 4: Join A (E) in any ch-2 space, *ch 1, sc in ch-2 space, ch 1, 3-dc cluster in next ch-1 space, ch 1, (2 dc, tr, ch 2, tr, 2 dc) in center dc of next 3-dc cluster, ch 1, 3-dc cluster in next ch-1 space; repeat from * around, ch 1, slip st to first sc to join. Fasten off.
Round 5: Join B (D) in ch-1 space to left of any corner ch-2 space, *ch 1, sc in ch-1 space, *[ch 1, sc in center dc of next 3-dc cluster, ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space], ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space, repeat between [], ch 1, sc in center dc of next 3-dc cluster, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in corner ch-2 space, ch 1, sc in center dc of next 3-dc cluster; repeat from * around, end ch 1, slip st to first sc to join, turn. Fasten off.
Round 6 (WS): Sc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, *skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space, ch 1; repeat from * around, working (sc, ch 2, sc, ch 1) in corner ch-2 space, end ch 1, slip st to first sc to join, turn. Fasten off.
Round 7 (RS): Join C (A) in any ch-1 space and repeat Round 6 – 12 sc on each side. Do not turn. Fasten off.
Round 8: Join E (C) in 2nd ch-1 space to left of any corner ch-2 space, ch 3 (counts as dc), 2 dc in same space, *ch 1, (skip next sc, ch-1 space and next sc), 3-dc cluster in next ch-1 space; repeat from * around working (3-dc cluster, ch 2, 3-dc cluster) in each corner ch-2 space, ch 1, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 7 3-dc cluster each side. Fasten off.
Round 9: Join F (B) in ch-1 space to left of any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, *sc in ch-1 space space, ch 1, sc in center dc of next 3-dc cluster, ch 1; repeat from * around, working (sc, ch 2, sc, ch 1) in corner ch-2 space, ch 1, slip st to first sc to join.
Round 10: Ch 1, sc in each sc and ch-1 space around working (sc, ch 2, sc) in each corner ch-2 space, slip st to first sc to join – 31 sc each side. Fasten off.
JOINING LARGE SQUARES
Square IV
Mark center st on center front Small Square on small square Loop. Count 7 ch-spaces to right and left of center st. Arrange Large Square IV so center of square is lined up with marked st on Loop.
Joining Round 11: Join A in 2nd sc to left of any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same sc, skip 2 sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc, *[skip next sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc, skip 2 sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc] across to last sc before corner ch-2 space, skip next sc, (sc, ch 4, sc) in corner ch-2 space; repeat * once more, work between [] to last st before next corner ch-2 space, skip last sc, sc in ch-2 space, ch 2, slip st in corresponding st where marked on Loop, ch 2, sc in corner ch-2 space, [skip next sc, (sc in next sc, ch 1, slip st in corresponding st on Loop, sc in same sc), skip 2 sc, (sc in next sc, ch 1, slip st in corresponding st on Loop, sc in same sc)] across to last sc before last corner, skip last sc, sc in ch-2 space, ch 2, slip st in corresponding st where marked on Loop, ch 2, sc in corner ch-2 space, slip st to first sc to join – 14 spaces across each side; 12 ch-2 spaces and 2 ch-4 spaces. Fasten off.
Squares V and VI
Joining Round 11: Join A in 2nd sc to left of any corner ch-2 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in same sc, skip 2 sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc, *[skip next sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc, skip 2 sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc] across to last sc before corner ch-2 space, skip next sc, (sc, ch 4, sc) in corner ch-2 space, work between [] to last st before next corner ch-2 space, *skip last sc, sc in ch-2 space, ch 2, slip st in corresponding st where marked on Loop, ch 2, sc in corner ch-2 space, [skip next sc, (sc in next sc, ch 1, slip st in corresponding st on Loop, sc in same sc), skip 2 sc, (sc in next sc, ch 1, slip st in corresponding st on Loop, sc in same sc)] across to last sc before last corner; repeat from * skip last sc, sc in ch-2 space, ch 2, slip st in corresponding st where marked on Loop, ch 2, sc in corner ch-2 space, slip st to first sc to join – 14 spaces across each side; 12 ch-2 spaces and 2 ch-4 spaces. Fasten off.
Edge
Round 1: With right side facing and holding 2 strands of yarn together, join A in any ch-2 space along Top Edge of Large Squares, ch 1, [sc, ch 2, sc] in each ch-2 space around top edge of Large Squares, slip st to first sc to join. Fasten off.
BOTTOM
Holding 2 strands of A together, ch 4, slip st to first ch to join.
Round 1: Ch 1, work 8 sc in ring, slip st in first sc to join. Mark beginning of round.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around – 16 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] around – 24 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] around – 32 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] around – 40 sc.
Round 6: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] around – 48 sc.
Round 7: Sc in each sc around, slip st to first sc – 48 sc. Fasten off.
Round 8: Join F in first sc, sc in each sc around – 48 sc.
Round 9: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] around – 60 sc.
Round 10: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] around – 70 sc.
Round 11: Sc in each sc around.
Round 12: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] around – 80 sc.
Round 13: Sc in each sc around.
Round 14: Sc in each sc around, inc 2 sts evenly – 82 sts.
Round 15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: Sc in each sc around, inc 2 sts evenly – 84 sts.
Round 17: Sc in each sc around, slip st to first sc to join. Fasten off.
Joining Round 18: Join A in any sc, ch 1, sc in same st, ch 1, slip st in corresponding st on along opposite long edge of Loop, sc in same sc, *skip next sc, (sc in next sc, ch 1, slip st in corresponding st on Loop, sc in same sc); repeat from * to join Bottom with Top, slip st to first st to join.
TOP EDGE
Mark center st at center front.
Round 1: With right side facing and holding 2 strands of yarn together, join C to ch-2 space at marked center, ch 4 (counts as dc and ch-1 space), *dc in next ch-2 space, ch 2, dc in next ch-2 space, ch 1; repeat from * around slip st to 3rd ch of beginning ch. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join D in first ch-1 space, ch 1, sc in same space, *work 5 dc in next ch-2 space for shell, sc in ch-1 space; repeat from * around, slip st to first sc. Fasten off.
Round 3: Join E in first sc, ch 1, sc in same st, *ch 2, (sc, ch 2, sc) in center dc of shell, ch 2, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st to first sc to join. Fasten off.
Round 4: Join F in first ch-2 space, ch 3, *(sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space, ch 2, slip st in next sc, ch 2; repeat from * around, slip st in first ch. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Tie
With C, leaving a 6” tail, ch 2, sc in second ch from hook, [ch 1, sc in previous sc] 129 times or to desired length. Fasten off, leaving 6” tails.
Beginning and ending at center front, weave tie through ch-spaces of Round 1 of Top Edge. Pull to tighten and tie ends in a bow. Cut 8 lengths, each 12”. Fold lengths in half and tie 4 lengths along with tails to each end of Tie. Trim ends evenly.
Strap
With C, ch 4, leaving 7” tails.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 chs, turn.
Rows 2-6: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn – 3 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn – 4 sc.
Rows 8-68: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Row 69: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc, turn – 3 sc.
Rows 70-75: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. Fasten off, leaving 7” tails.
Fold Strap in half and loop around 3-dc cluster at back of Bottom edge. Using tails, sew opposite ends to corresponding place at Top Edge.

materials: Patons® Hempster™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 190 yds/174 m)
Size U.S. E/4 (3.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 8½" [21.5 cm] diameter x 11" [28 cm] tall.
gauge: 18 sc and 22 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
• Ch 3 at beg of rnds counts as dc.
• In Patterned Section, 2 dc are used to create a faux “seam”. Beg ch-3 (counts as dc) and last dc make up one “seam,” and 2 dc placed in middle of rnd create the second.
Base: With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 56 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 64 sc.
9th to 17th rnds: Cont in this manner, working 8 inc evenly spaced around for 9 more rnds. 136 sc at end of 17th rnd.
18th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 144 sc. PM at end of last rnd.
Main Section: Next rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 35 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 148 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 3" [7.5 cm].
Patterned Section: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 73 sc. PM. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. *Skip next sc. 1 dc in each of next 3 sc. Working in front of rnd, 1 dc in previously skipped sc – X-st made**. Rep from * to marker. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * to ** to last sc. 1 dc in last sc. Join. 36 X-sts and 4 dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. *1 sc in sp between last st and next st. Skip next dc. 1 sc in each of next 3 dc.** Rep from * to marker. 1 sc in each of next 6 dc. Rep from * to ** to last dc. 1 sc in last dc. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 74 sc. PM. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join.
5th rnd: Skip first sc. Sl st into next sc. Ch 3. *Skip next sc. 1 dc in each of next 3 sc. Working in front of rnd, 1 dc in previously skipped sc – X-st made**. Rep from * to marker. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to ** to end of rnd. 1 dc in first skipped sc. Join. 36 X-sts and 4 dc.
Last 3 rnds form Pat.
Cont in pat until Patterned Section measures approx 6" [15 cm], ending on a 4th rnd.
Note: Sl sts at beg of 5th rnds are important to keep Pat lined up.
Top: Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep last rnd until work from end of Patterned Section measures 2" [5 cm]. Fasten off.
Drawstring (Strap)
Instructions are written for Drawstring. If changes are necessary for Strap, the instructions will be written thus (). When only 1 number is given, it applies to both projects.
With A, ch 118 (261).
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of row. Turn. 117 (260) sc.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fold in half lengthwise and working through both thicknesses to join 3rd row to foundation row, work 1 sc in each st to end of row. Fasten off.
Drawstring Stopper:
With A, ch 13. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 1¼" [3 cm]. Fasten off.
Press Drawstring Stopper tube flat, and with A, sew through both thicknesses along middle to form two channels.
FINISHING
Drawstring: Pleat Bag as shown below and thread Drawstring through sps formed by crossed dc.
Thread each end of Drawstring through channel of Drawstring Stopper. Sew ends of Drawstring tog to form continuous loop.
Strap: Thread each end through sp between 2 dc at faux seam and secure in place with Bowline Knot as shown below.

materials: Bernat® Suede-ish™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 179 yds/164 m) Honeycomb (91008) 3 balls
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 16" [40.5 cm] wide x 17½" [44.5 cm] high.
gauge: 15 dc and 6 rows= 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as st. 
• All rows begin in first dc.
Front and Back (make 2 pieces alike)
See diagram on page 3.
Ch 61. 
1st row: 1 dc in 3rd ch from hook. 
1 dc in each ch to end of chain. 
Turn. 59 dc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. *Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 4 sts. a dc in each of last 4 dc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each dc and ch-1 sp to last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 5 dc. Turn. 
5th row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 5 sts. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each dc to last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 5 dc. Turn.  
6th row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. *Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to 4 sts before next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 5 dc. Turn.
7th row: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in each ch-1 sp and dc to second-last ch-1 sp. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc) twice. Turn.
8th row: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in each dc to next ch-1 sp. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc) twice. Turn.
9th row: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. *Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next st. Rep from * to 5 sts before next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc) twice. Turn.
10th row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc) twice. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 23 dc/ch-1 sps. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc) 3 times. Turn.
11th to 16th rows: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp) 3 times. 1 dc in each dc to next ch-1 sp. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc) 3 times. Turn.
17th row: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp) 3 times. (1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Skip next dc) 11 times. 1 dc in next dc. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc) 3 times. Turn. 
18th row: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in each dc/ch-1 sp to second-last ch-1 sp. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc) twice. Turn.
19th row: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in each dc to next ch-1 sp. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc) twice. Turn.
20th row: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp) twice. (1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Skip next dc) 17 times. 1 dc in next dc. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc) twice. Turn.
21st row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each dc and ch-1 sp to last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 5 dc. Turn.
22nd row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each dc to last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 5 dc. Turn.
23rd row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next st. *Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 5 dc. Turn.
24th row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each dc and ch-1 sp to end of row. Turn.
25th and 26th rows: Ch 2. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn. 
Fasten off.
Straps (make 2)
Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
1 sc in each chain to end of chain. 
Turn. 7 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 24" [61 cm].
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Place Front on top of Back with WS facing. Join yarn with sl st to upper left corner. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc down side, across bottom and up opposite side of Tote, working 3 sc in each bottom corner. Fasten off. Place Straps on RS, with each end approx 3" [7.5 cm] from side edges of Tote as shown in photo, placing 1 strap on Front and other on Back. Work 1 rnd of reverse sc around top of Tote, joining Straps as you work. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver: 2 skeins of 365 Coffee A; 1 skein each of 3945 Blue Suede B, 321 Gold C, and 376 Burgundy D.
1 yd (.9 m) of fabric for lining
Sewing needle and matching sewing thread
abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E = color A, B, C, D, E
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Finished Size: 22” (56 cm) wide x 19” (48.5 cm) deep, excluding straps.
gauge: First 3 rounds = 3¼” (8.5 cm) across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook needed to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
BAG
Square
With A, ch 4; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc – 8 sc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 2 dc in first sc, *(2 dc, tr, 2 dc) in next sc, 3 dc in next sc; repeat from * twice, (2 dc, tr, 2 dc) in next sc; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 32 sts.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in each of next 4 dc, *(2 dc, tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in each of next 7 sts; repeat from * twice, (2 dc, tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 2 dc, change to B by drawing through when joining with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 48 sts. Fasten off A.
Round 4: With B, ch 3, *dc in each dc across to corner tr, (2 dc, tr, 2 dc) in next tr; repeat from * 3 times, dc in each dc to beginning; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 64 sts.
Rounds 5-25: Repeat Round 4, working in the following color sequence: 1 more round B; 2 rounds A; 2 rounds C; 2 rounds A; 2 rounds D; 2 rounds A; 2 rounds B; 2 rounds A; 2 rounds C; 2 rounds A; 2 rounds D – 400 sts at end of last round. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
Lining
Measure across the center of the Square (sample was 27½” (70 cm) across). Cut a square of fabric that is 1” (2.5 cm) wider than the width of the Square. Second Side Flap
Repeat First Side Trim across opposite side of Square.

Round 2: Ch 1, *sc in next 13 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc, turn – 84 sts.
Round 3: Ch 1, *sc in next 12 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc, turn – 78 sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, *sc in next 11 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc, turn – 72 sts.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, *sc in next 11 sts, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc, turn – 78 sts.
Round 7: Ch 1, *sc in next 12 sts, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc, turn – 84 sts.
Round 8: Ch 1, *sc in next 13 sts, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc, turn – 90 sts. Fasten off, leaving a very long sewing length.
Fold the Strap in half toward wrong side of Bag, and with sewing length, sew top of last round to base of first round. Note: Sample used a lacing stitch worked under the two loops of both edges.
Repeat Handle on other side of Bag.
Curlicues (Make 2 each with B, C and D)
Ch 25.
Row 1: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each of the next 19 ch, slip st in each of last four ch sts. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Assemble Tassel
Round 1: Place a slip loop of A on hook, *insert hook through 2 loops of the last slip st of one of the Curliques, bend the end of the Curlique, skip next slip st and insert hook through both loops of the next slip st, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook; repeat from * in each Curlique and any order; join with a slip st in first sc – 6 sc.
Rounds 2-3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc – 3 sc.
Joining Row: Ch 6, slip st to the outside center of one of the handle sides of the bag, turn, slip st in each ch back to the tassel. Fasten off.
Closure Loop: With A, join with a slip st to center of inside handle opposite the handle where the tassel is attached, ch 20, join with slip st at base of ch-20 loop, slip st in each ch around. Fasten off.

Rep from * 14 times more. Break A.
With B, work 64 rows in Moss St Pattern.
These 186 rows complete Color Placement.

TOTE
With A, chain (ch) 62, leaving 10" [25.5 cm] tail for sewing seams later in Finishing.
Foundation row: (Right Side - RS). 1 single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook. *Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Repeat (Rep) from * to end of chain. Turn. 61 stitches (sts) (including sc and ch sts).
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in first ch-1 space (sp). *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
First 3 rows of Color Placement are complete.
Rep last 2 rows for Moss St Pattern (Pat) and continue (cont) following Color Placement until 186 rows of Color Placement are complete. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Fold along diagonals indicated in Folding Diagram, matching A to A and B to B.
Sew edges of Bag together (tog) where indicated in Seaming Diagram.
Handle
Sew left handle point to right handle point using foundation row yarn end, leaving no gap between two points.
Handle Cover
With B, ch 16. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 15 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Cover measures 3" [7.5 cm] ending on a Wrong Side (WS) row. Do not fasten off. 
Fold Handle Cover in half lengthwise with WS facing, sandwiching Handle. Working through both thicknesses, join last row to 1st row, working 1 sc in each st to end of row. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Softee® Cotton™ (4.2 oz/120 g; 254 yds/232 m)
Sizes U.S. G/6 (4 mm) and U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
4" [10 cm] piece of cardboard for tassels.
abbreviations: Mosaic Dc = Working in front of chain spaces, work 1 dc in skipped sc 3 rows below
Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
measurements: Approx 9" [23 cm] diameter x 12" [30.5 cm] tall.
gauge: 16 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook.
instructions:
Notes:
• Join all rnds with sl st to first sc. 
• When working dc in rows 3 rows below, work in front of ch-2 spaces, not around. 
• Each skipped sc has ch-1 worked above it for 2 rows. 
This establishes the ‘gap’ where Mosaic Dc will later be worked
• Mosaic Dc always replaces sc directly behind it on working row
• WS of your work maintains alternating 2-row striped pattern because you are working in front of chain spaces each time you work Mosaic Dc - you are never working around chain-spaces. 
The chain-spaces are positioned behind Mosaic Dc.

Beg at base with smaller hook and A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc. 
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc. 
Cont in this manner, inc 8 sc evenly around next 8 rnds (as established). 112 sc.
Next rnd (bottom “seam”): (RS). Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc around. Join. Turn.
From this point on, rnds are joined and then turned to create a straight seam.
Next rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join B. Turn.
Proceed in Mosaic Diamond Pat as follows:
(See diagram on page 4).
Set-up rnd 1: (RS). With B ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
Set-up rnd 2:  (WS). With B ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. Join A. Turn.
1st rnd: (RS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join.
2nd rnd: (WS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join B. Turn.
3rd rnd: (RS). With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. (Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. Ch 2. Skip next sc) 3 times. Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
4th rnd: (WS). With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sts (Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join A. Turn.
5th rnd: (RS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. (Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. Ch 2. Skip next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
6th rnd: (WS). With A, ch 1. *(1 sc in next st. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp) 6 times. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join B. Turn.
7th rnd: (RS). With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. Ch 2. Skip next sc) 5 times. Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
8th rnd: (WS). With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. (Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc) 5 times. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join A. Turn.
9th rnd: (RS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. (Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. Ch 2. Skip next sc) 5 times. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
10th rnd: (WS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next st) 6 times. Rep from * around. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join B. Turn. 
11th rnd: (RS). With B, ch 1. *1 sc in next 2 sc. (Mosaic dc in skipped sc 3 rows below. Ch 2. Skip next sc) 5 times. Mosaic dc in skipped sc 3 rows below. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
12th rnd: (WS). With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. (Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc) 5 times. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join A. Turn.
13th rnd: (RS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 dc in skipped sc 3 rows below) 5 times. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
14th rnd: (WS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. (Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc) 5 times. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join B. Turn.
15th rnd: (RS). With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. 1 sc in next sc. (Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. Ch 2. Skip next sc) 3 times. (Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
16th rnd: (WS). With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sts. (Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join A. Turn.
17th rnd: (RS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. (Ch 2. Skip next sc. Mosaic dc in skipped sc 3 rows below) 3 times. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join.
18th rnd: (WS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc) 3 times. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join B. Turn.
19th rnd: (RS). With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (1 sc in next sc. Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below) twice. Ch 2. Skip next sc. (Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. 1 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
20th rnd: (WS). With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Rep from * around. Join A. Turn.
21st rnd: (RS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. Mosaic dc in skipped sc 3 rows below. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
22nd rnd: (WS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join B. Turn.
23rd rnd: (RS). With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Join. Turn.
24th rnd: (WS). With B, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Rep from * around. Join A. Turn.
Rep 1st to 24th rnds once more. 
Break B. 
Next rnd: (RS). With A, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Mosaic dc in next skipped sc 3 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
Next rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Turn.
Rep last rnd twice more (alternating RS and WS as established). 
Next rnd (eyelet rnd): (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Ch 2. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc) 7 times. Ch 2. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join. Turn.
Next rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc) 7 times. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join. Turn.
Next rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn. 
Rep last rnd twice more (alternating RS and WS as established). 
Fasten off.

Drawstring 
With 2 strands of A held tog and smaller hook, ch 120.
1st row: Working in bottom loops of chain only, sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each ch to end of chain. Fasten off. 
Insert Drawstring from front-to-back into the 4th eyelet at the top of Bag. Weave drawstring in and out through all eyelets finishing with ends protruding from 4th and 5th eyelets (this should be opposite of center back seam).

Tassels (make 2)
Wrap A around 4" [10 cm] piece of cardboard 40 times. Tie securely at one end. Cut across other end. Wrap yarn 6 times around tassel ½" [1 cm] from tied end and fasten securely. Attach 1 Tassel to each end of Drawstring.

Straps (make 2)
With 2 strands of A held tog and larger hook, ch 6.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 5 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Strap measures 20" [51 cm] ending on a RS row. Do not turn.
Edging:  Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around all edges of Strap, having 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Hold 2 Straps tog with short ends aligned and WS facing. Sew ends of Straps with WS facing to top of RS of Bag, aligning short ends with the last row of Mosaic Diamond pat and centering at the center back seam (see Diagram). Two straps will overlap each other with WS of Straps showing. Flip Strap over so RS is facing and sew rem short edges of Straps to bottom of Bag at bottom “seam" rnd, 3" [7.5 cm] to each side of center back seam.

materials: Lily Sugar ’n Cream Ombres (56.7 g/2 oz) Main Color (MC) (Pink): 2 balls
Lily Sugar ’n Cream (70.9 g/2.5 oz) Contrast A (Green): 1 ball
Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 14 sts and 15 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] in bobble st pat.
instructions:
FRONT and BACK (make 2 alike)
With MC, ch 28.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 27 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 tr in next sc (pushing tr to RS of work). 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows 8 times more. Fasten off.
Gusset
With MC, ch 4.
1st row: (WS). 2 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 3 dc). Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first sc. 1 dc in next sc. 2 dc in last sc. Turn.
4th row: As 2nd row.
5th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first sc. 1 dc in each of next 3 sc. 2 dc in last sc. Turn. 7 dc.
6th row: As 2nd row.
7th row: Ch 3. Miss first sc. 1 dc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
8th to 11th rows: Rep 6th and 7th rows twice.
12th row: (RS-Fold row). Ch 1. Working in back loop only, 1 sc in each dc across. Turn.
13th row: As 7th row.
14th to 29th rows: Rep 6th and 7th rows 8 times.
30th row: As 12th row.
31st row: As 7th row.
32nd to 35th rows: Rep 6th and 7th rows twice.
36th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. Turn.
37th row: Ch 3. Miss first sc. (Yoh and draw up a loop in next sc. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – dc2tog made. 1 dc in next sc. Dc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 dc in last sc. Turn.
38th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st across. Turn.
39th row: Ch 3. Miss first sc. (Yoh and draw up a loop in next sc. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – dc3tog made. 1 dc in last sc.
40th row: As 38th row.
41st row: Ch 3. Miss first sc. Dc2tog over last 2 sc. Do not fasten off. Cont as follows to join:
Pin sides of Front and Back to sides of Gusset to fold rows, then bottom of Front and Back to rows of Gusset between fold rows. 
With RS of Front or Back facing and working through both thicknesses, work 19 sc down 1 side, 3 sc in corner, 25 sc across bottom, 3 sc in corner and 19 sc up other side.
Next row: Working from left to right instead of from right to left, as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc across.
Fasten off.
Tab: Ch 12. Turn chain sideways. Sl st in center ‘bump’ at back of 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in next bump and each bump to end of ch. Fasten off.
Sew in position at top of Bag as shown. Sew zipper in position.
ROSE (make 2)
With MC, ch 16.
1st row: (RS). 2 dc in 4th ch from hook. 3 dc in each ch to end of ch. Fasten off.
Coil rose to form rosebud and sew to Front of Bag as shown in picture.
LEAF (make 4)
With A, ch 8.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in last ch. Fasten off.
Sew 1 Leaf to each side of Rose as shown in picture.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft™ (6 oz/170 g; 315 yds/288 m)
Contrast A Cobalt (39784) 1 ball or 288 yds/264 m
Contrast B Chartreuse (39771) 1 ball or 299 yds/273 m
Size U.S. 7 [4.5 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
measurements: Approx 12" x 12" x 3" [30.5 x 30.5 x 7.5 cm], excluding Strap.
gauge: 16 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Chart Pat.
instructions:
Note: When working from chart and joining new color, work to last 2 loops on hook of last st. Draw new color through 2 loops, then proceed in new color. 
BAG BASE 
With A, ch 13. 
Work Chart on page 2, noting each square of chart is equal to 1 sc and reading RS rows from right to left and WS rows from left to right. Carry color not in use across top of entire previous row and work sts around it. This will ensure even gauge as all sts will be worked around an extra strand of yarn held across top of previous row. Carry both colors up side of work. 
1st row: (1st row of Chart - RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 12 sc. 
2nd row: (2nd row of Chart - WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until 6th row of chart is complete. 
Rep last 6 rows of Chart Pat until Bag Base measures approx 12" [30.5 cm], ending on 3rd row or 6th row. Fasten off. 

STRAP & SIDES 
With A, ch 13. 
Work Chart as noted for Bag Base. 
1st row: (1st row of Chart - RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 12 sc. 
2nd row: (2nd row of Chart – WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until 6th row of chart is complete. 
Rep last 6 rows of Chart Pat until Strap measures approx 12" [30.5 cm], ending on 3rd row or 6th row of chart. PM on each end of last row. Cont in Chart Pat, until Strap measures approx 36" [91.5 cm], ending on 3rd row or 6th row of chart. PM on each end of last row. Cont in Chart Pat until Strap measures approx 48" [122 cm], ending with 3rd row or 6th row of chart. Fasten off. 

FRONT & BACK PANELS 
With A, ch 49. 
Work Chart as noted for Bag Base. 
1st row: (1st row of Chart - RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 48 sc. 
2nd row: (2nd row of Chart – WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until 6th row of chart is complete. 
Rep last 6 rows of Chart Pat until work from beg measures approx 12" [30.5 cm], ending on 3rd row or 6th row of chart. 
Next row: With B only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off. 

FINISHING 
Join Bag Base to Front & Back Panels: 
With RS of Base facing, place lower edge of Front Panel behind long edge of Base with WS of work tog, aligning corner of Base with corner of Front Panel. 
1st row: Join B with sl st. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work sc evenly across edge. Fasten off. 
Rep to join Base to Back Panel. 
Join Strap & Sides to Bag Base: 
With RS of Base facing, place beg edge of Strap & Sides behind short edge of Base with WS of work tog, aligning corner of Bottom with corner of Strap. 
1st row: Join B with sl st. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work sc evenly across edge. Fasten off. 
Rep to join opposite end of Strap & Sides to Base. 
Join Strap & Sides to Front & Back Panels: 
Align top corners of Front and Back Panels to rows marked with st markers on Strap & Sides. Pin pieces tog if desired. Beg at bottom right corner of Panel, join B with sl st. 
1st row: Beg at bottom right corner of Front Panel, join B with sl st. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work sc evenly up edge of Front Panel, across single edge of Strap, and down opposite edge of Front Panel. Fasten off. 
Rep for other side.

materials: Caron® x Pantone™ Bamboo™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 180 yds/165 m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 11" [28 cm] wide x 6" [15 cm] long.
gauge: 14 sts and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Notes: 
• Before working with Caron® x Pantone™ Bamboo™ multi-shade yarn braid, separate each color link and wind into 5 separate balls.
• Each color link will be referenced by its Pantone # (see ball band)
• Due to finite amount of yarn in each shade, pattern gauge must be matched to ensure successful results.
• To join new color, work to last loops on hook of first color. Yoh with new color, draw through loops and proceed with new color.
• Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as hdc
With Color 1, ch 46. 
1st row:  1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to last ch. 5 hdc in last ch. Do not turn. Work in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 hdc in each ch to end of row. Turn. 91 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 hdc. 2 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 96 hdc.
3rd row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first hdc. *1 tr in next hdc. 1 sc in next hdc. Rep from * 20 times more. **1 tr in next hdc. (1 sc. 1 tr) all in next hdc. 1 sc in next hdc. (1 tr. 1 sc) all in next hdc. Rep from ** once more. 1 tr in next hdc. (1 sc. 1 tr) all in next hdc. ***1 sc in next hdc. 1 tr in next hdc. Rep from *** to last hdc. 1 sc in last hdc. Turn. 101 sts.
4th row:  Ch 2. 1 hdc in first sc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 sts. (1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. 2 hdc in next st) 5 times. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 106 hdc.
5th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 hdc. (1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc) 5 times. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 111 hdc.
6th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 hdc. (1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc) 5 times. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 116 hdc.
7th row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first hdc. *1 tr in next hdc. 1 sc in next hdc. Rep from * 20 times more. **(1 tr in next hdc. 1 sc in next hdc) twice. 1 tr in next hdc. (1 sc. 1 tr) all in next hdc. (1 sc in next hdc. 1 tr in next hdc) twice. 1 sc in next hdc. (1 tr. 1 sc) all in next hdc. Rep from ** once more. (1 tr in next hdc. 1 sc in next hdc) twice. 1 tr in next hdc. (1 sc. 1 tr) all in next hdc. ***1 sc in next hdc. 1 tr in next hdc. Rep from *** to last hdc. 1 sc in last hdc. Turn. 121 sts.
8th row:  Ch 2. 1 hdc in first sc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 sts. (1 hdc in each of next 6 sts. 2 hdc in next st) 5 times. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 126 hdc.
9th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 hdc. (1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc) 5 times. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 131 hdc.
10th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 136 hdc.
11th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first hdc. *1 tr in next hdc. 1 sc in next hdc. Rep from * 20 times more. **(1 tr in next hdc. 1 sc in next hdc) 4 times. 1 tr in next hdc. (1 sc. 1 tr) all in next hdc. (1 sc in next hdc. 1 tr in next hdc) 4 times. 1 sc in next hdc. (1 tr. 1 sc) all in next hdc. Rep from ** once more. (1 tr in next hdc. 1 sc in next hdc) 4 times. 1 tr in next hdc. (1 sc. 1 tr) all in next hdc. ***1 sc in next hdc. 1 tr in next hdc. Rep from *** to last hdc. 1 sc in last hdc. Turn. 141 sts.
12th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first sc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 sts. (1 hdc in each of next 10 sts. 2 hdc in next st) 5 times. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Join Color 2. Turn. 146 hdc.
13th row:  With Color 2, ch 2. 1 hdc in first sc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 sts. *1 hdc in each of next 11 sts. 2 hdc in next st. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 151 hdc.
14th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first sc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 sts. (1 hdc in each of next 12 sts. 2 hdc in next st) 5 times. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 156 hdc.
15th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first sc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 sts. (1 hdc in each of next 13 sts. 2 hdc in next st) 5 times. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Join Color 1. Turn. 161 hdc.
16th row:  With Color 1, ch 2. 1 hdc in first sc. 1 hdc in each of next 42 sts. PM. (1 hdc in each of next 14 sts. 2 hdc in next st) 5 times. PM. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. 166 hdc.
Fasten off.
Assembly
Fold Clutch in half to st markers.
Join Color 2 with sl st to bottom left corner of Bag. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, sc evenly across edge to st marker. 1 sc in each of next 40 hdc. Ch 4 for Button Loop. 1 sc in each of next 40 hdc. Work sc evenly across rem edge.
Fasten off.
Sew on button as shown in picture.
Tassel: Cut a piece of cardboard 4" [10 cm] wide. Wind Color 1 around cardboard 30 times. Break yarn leaving a long end and thread end through needle. Slip needle through all loops and tie tightly. Remove cardboard and wind yarn tightly around loops ¾" [2 cm] below fold. Fasten securely. Cut through rem loops and trim ends evenly. Sew Tassel to top right corner of Clutch as seen in picture.

materials: Bernat® Maker Home Dec™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 317 yds/290 m) Main Color (MC) Woodberry  (11001) 2 balls
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Popcorn = 4 dc in next stitch. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back into top of first dc of 4-dc group and pull dropped loop through.
measurements: Approx 15" [38 cm] wide x 14" [35.5 cm] tall, excluding handles.
gauge: 11 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
With MC, ch 42.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to last ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working across opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 84 sc. PM on first sc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each sc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 3 (does not count as st). 1 dc in next sc. 1 dc in same sp where sl st was made – beg X-st made. *Skip next sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 dc in skipped sc – X-st made. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to beg X-st. Sl st to next dc. 42 X-sts.
Note: Second sl st at end of X-st rnds are important to keep lined up on side of Bag.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
8th rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). 1 hdc in first sc. *Popcorn in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around, ending with: Popcorn in next sc. 1 hdc in last sc. Join with sl st to top of first hdc. 28 popcorns.
9th and 10th rnds: As 5th and 6th rnds.
11th rnd: As 5th rnd.
12th rnd: As 4th rnd.
Rep 5th to 12th rnds to form pat twice more. Break MC at end of last rnd. Join A.
Next 6 rnds: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Sl st in each st around. Fasten off.
FINISHING
To place grommets: Lay Bag flat. PM for grommets 4" [10 cm] in from each side to position grommet. Following manufacturer’s instructions, apply grommets (grommets will be squeezed between sc sts).
Handles (make 2)
For each Handle make 6 chain lengths as follows: Ch 110. Fasten off, leaving 10" [25.5 cm] tails on both ends.
Divide 6 chain lengths into 3 groups (2 chain lengths each). Braid 3 groups into Handle. Secure ends tightly. Slip into grommets and tie a knot. Adjust lengths as needed. Add beads to ends. Knot and trim as shown in picture.

pattern_name: IN THE BAG GRANNY CROCHET TOTE
materials: Red Heart® All in One™ Granny Square™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 417 yds/381 m) - Moody Cherry (2019) - 1 ball (13 Granny Squares)
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
10 yds/9.5 m of black worsted yarn for joining Motifs may be required
measurements: Approx 16" [40.5 cm] wide x 16" [40.5 cm] deep, excluding Strap.
gauge: Motif = Approx 6" [15 cm] square.
instructions:
MOTIF
Make 13.
With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
4th and 5th rnds: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. **(3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
Fasten off.
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as double crochet (dc).
• Ch 6 at beg of rnds counts as dc and ch-3 sp.
• Join all rnds with slip stitch (sl st) to 3rd ch of ch-6 unless otherwise indicated.
STRAPS (make 2)
Note: To work Straps, use yarn as ‘self-striping’ yarn allowing colors to change as they appear.
Ch 68 (using any section of color, saving black sections for joining Motifs).
1st row: 1 single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 67 sc.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off.
Sew Straps in position as shown in photo.
ASSEMBLY
Notes:
• Join Motifs tog using just black sections of yarn.
• Extra length of black worsted yarn may be required for joining.
Join Motifs: Hold WS of 2 Motifs tog with sts aligned. Join black section of yarn with sl st in ch-2 corners of aligned Motifs at top right. With WS tog, following diagrams, join Motifs tog, matching lettered sides and working in whipstitch through back loops only through both thicknessess. Fasten off.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (70.9 g/2.5 oz.; 109 m/120 yds)
Size U.S. F/5 (3.75 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 17" [43 cm] wide x 14½" [37 cm] high, excluding handles.
gauge: 15 hdc and 12 rnds = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
•  When joining colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed.
•  Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
•  Join with sl st to first st at end of each rnd.
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 6 times. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 6 times. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc) 6 times. Join. 36 sc.
Cont as established, inc 6 sc each rnd until there are 126 sc. Join B at end of last rnd.
Proceed as follows:
1st rnd: With B, ch 2. Working into back loop only, 1 hdc in each sc around, inc 4 sts evenly around. Join. 130 hdc.
2nd to 9th rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between each hdc around. Join A at end of 9th rnd.
10th rnd: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between each hdc around. Join C.
11th to 19th rnds: With C, ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between each hdc around. Join A at end of 19th rnd.
20th rnd: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between each hdc around. Join D.
21st to 29th rnds: With D, ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between each hdc around. Join A at end of 29th rnd.
30th rnd: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between each hdc around. Join E.
31st to 39th rnds: With E, ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between each hdc around. Join A at end of 39th rnd.
40th rnd: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in sp between each hdc around. Join.
41st rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each hdc around. Join. Fasten off.
Straps (make 2)
With A, ch 111.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn.
2nd to 5th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fold Handle in half lengthwise and working through both thicknesses to join 5th row to foundation row, work 1 sc in each st to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew straps in position as shown in photo.

abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Tote measures 12½” [32 cm] long x 27½” [70 cm] circumference.
gauge: 7 sc = 4” [10 cm]; 8 rows = 4” [10 cm] in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in first ch. Place marker in first st for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Working in continuous rounds, 2 sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Round 3: *2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 4: *2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 5: *2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 6: *2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Round 7: *2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around – 42 sts.
Round 8: *2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts; repeat from * around – 48 sts.
Rounds 9-20: Sc in each st around.
Shape Handles
Round 21: Sc in first 7 sts, ch 14, skip next 10 sts, sc in next 14 sts, ch 14, skip next 10 sts, sc in last 7 sts – 56 sts.
Round 22: Work sc in each st and ch around – 56 sc.
Round 23: Sc in each st around.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Classic™”: 1 Skein 246 Sea Coral B.
Bamboo purse handles, stitch markers, yarn needle.
RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 Skein each 505 Aruba Sea A and 305 Aspen Print C.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
gauge: 13 hdc = 4”; 11 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BAG
Front
Top Panel
With A, ch 13.
Row 1: Dc in 3rd ch from hook and each ch across.
Rows 2-17: Ch 2, turn, Fpdc in each st across, hdc in top of beginning ch – 11 sts.
Rows 18-34: Change to B, repeat Row 2. Fasten off.
Center Panel
With C, ch 20.
Row 1: Dc in 3rd ch from hook and each ch across.
Rows 2-28: Ch 2, turn, Fpdc in each st across, hdc in top of beginning ch – 18 sts.
Rows 29-34: Change to A, repeat Row 2. Fasten off.
Bottom Panel
With B, ch 13.
Row 1: Dc in 3rd ch from hook and each ch across Rows 2-17: Ch 2, turn, Fpdc in each st across, hdc in top of beginning ch – 11 sts.
Rows 18-34: Change to A, repeat Row 2. Fasten off.
Back
With A, ch 37.
Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across.
Rows 2-28: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), turn, hdc in each hdc across, turn – 36 hdc. Fasten off.
Bottom Gusset
With C, ch 37.
Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across.
Rows 2-4: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), turn, hdc in each hdc across, turn – 36 hdc. Fasten off.
Side Gusset (Make 2)
With C, ch 35.
Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across.
Rows 2-4: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), turn, hdc in each hdc across, turn – 34 hdc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew one long edge of Top Panel to one long edge of Center Panel. Sew opposite long edge of Center Panel to one long edge of Bottom Panel. With wrong sides together and using 2 strands of B held together and overhand stitch, sew one long edge of Bottom Gusset to first row of Back. Sew one long edge of each Side Gusset to side edges of Back. Sew short edges of Gussets together. Sew opposite long edges of Gusset to Front. Leave top edge unsewn.
Handle Tabs
Mark top edge of Front and Back for placement of 4 purse handle rings. Row 1: With right side facing, join B at right edge of where marked for purse handle rings, ch 1, hdc in next 3 sts. Rows 2-5: Ch 1, turn, hdc in each hdc across – 4 hdc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Pull Tab through purse handle ring and sew opposite end to wrong side to secure purse handles along top edge of Purse. Weave in ends.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (70.9 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds) Contrast A Yellow (00010) 3 balls or  330 m/363 yds
Contrast B Black (00002) 1 ball or 30 m/33 yds
Contrast C White (00001) 1 ball or 20 m/22 yds
Contrast D Tangerine (01699) 1 ball or 20 m/22 yds
Sizes U.S. G/6 (4 mm) and U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge
Coats & Clark™ 20" [51 cm] long Polyester All-Purpose Zipper in Black (002) or Coats & Clark™ Yarn Zip 22" [56 cm] long
Dual Duty XP® All-Purpose Thread in Black (900)
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Hdc4tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) 4 times. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Approx 10" [25.5 cm] wide x 14" [35.5 cm] high x 3" [7.5 cm] deep
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook.
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 for turning ch does not count as hdc.
Front and Back (make 2 pieces alike)
With A and smaller hook, ch 35.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 33 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows for pat until work from beg measures 9" [23 cm], ending with a RS row.

Shape top: 1st row:  (WS). Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Sc2tog. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: As 1st row.
4th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each st to last 2 sc. Hdc2tog. Turn.
5th to 8th rows:  Rep last 2 rows twice more.
9th row:  As 1st row. 17 sts rem. Fasten off.

Base and Gusset
With A and smaller hook, ch 12.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 10 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows for pat until work from beg measures 9" [23 cm], ending with a WS row. Place marker at end of last row.

Divide for zipper opening: 
Next row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
Cont in pat on 5 sts until opening from marker measures 20" [51 cm], ending with a WS row. Fasten off.
With RS facing, rejoin A with sl st to unworked sts. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as last sl st. 1 hdc in each of last 4 sts. Turn.
Cont in pat on 5 sts until opening measures 20" [51 cm], ending with a WS row. Do not fasten off.
Join sides: Next row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 5 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sc from first side. 10 hdc. Turn. Place marker on last st.
Cont in pat until work from marker measures 9" [23 cm], ending with a WS row. Fasten off. Sew last row and foundation row tog (center of bottom base).

Wings (make 2)
With C and smaller hook, ch 8. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring. 
1st rnd:  Ch 2. 1 hdc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 
8 hdc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. (1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc) 3 times. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 12 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc) 5 times. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 18 hdc.
4th rnd:  Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. (1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc) 8 times. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 27 hdc.
Fold work flat.

Joining row:  Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 13 sc evenly across. Turn.
Next row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 3. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten off.

Antennae (make 2)
With B and smaller hook, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring. 
1st rnd:  Ch 2. 1 hdc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 
4 hdc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 
8 hdc. 
4th rnd:  Ch 2. (Hdc4tog) twice. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread end onto yarn needle and draw tightly through rem 2 sts.

Pocket
With A and smaller hook, ch 33.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 31 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc to end of row. Join B. Turn. 
3rd row: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc to end of row. Join A. Turn. 
5th row:  With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Sc2tog. Join B. 
Turn.
7th row: As 3rd row.
8th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Sc2tog. Join A. 
Turn. 
9th row:  With A, ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each sc to last 2 sc. Hdc2tog. Turn.
10th row: As 6th row.
11th row: With B, ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each sc to last 2 sc. Hdc2tog. Turn.
12th and 13th rows:  As 8th and 9th rows.
14th row: As 6th row. Fasten off. 15 sts rem.

Pocket edging:  (RS). Join B with sl st at lower right corner. Ch 1. Work sc evenly around outer edge of Pocket to opposite corner. Fasten off. Leave edge of foundation row unworked.

Hanging loop
With D and smaller hook, ch 22.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 21 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row once more. Fasten off.

Straps (make 2)
With 2 strands of D and larger hook, ch 7.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 4 ch. Turn. 5 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Strap measures 16" [40.5 cm], ending with a WS row. Fasten off.

Eyes (make 2)
With B and smaller hook, ch 3.
1st rnd: 8 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off, leaving a long end.

FINISHING
Sew Eyes to Front as shown in photo. Embroider mouth with B, using chain stitch as shown in photo. Sew Pocket to Front leaving top edge open.
Pin Gusset and Base to outer edges of Front and Back, having Base seam at center of bottom edge.
Joining rnd:  With smaller hook and, RS of Front facing and working through both thicknesses, join A with sl st at center of bottom edge. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around to join Gusset and Base to Front. Join D with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: With D, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Rep these 2 rnds to join outer edge of Back, Gusset and Base.
Sew Wings and Antennae to outer edge of Front (behind joining rnds) as shown in photo.
Sew zipper in position along Gusset opening. Attach Hanging Loop as shown in picture. Sew Straps in position.

instructions:
Note:  Join each rnd with sl st to first st.

instructions:
Base: With 2 strands of A, ch 2. 1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.

5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sc as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sc as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
7th to 15th rnds: Cont in this manner, inc 6 sc evenly around each rnd. 90 sc.

17th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, *2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 21 sc. Rep from * around to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 94 sc.
Place marker at end of last rnd.
Main Section: Next rnd: Ch 2 (does not counts as hdc). 1 hdc in same sp as last sl st. 1 hdc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first hdc.

Make handles: Next rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 6 times. *Ch 18. Skip next 18 sps between 2 hdc.* (1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc) 29 times. Rep from * to * once more. **1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc. Rep from ** around, ending with 1 hdc in sp between last hdc and first hdc of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc.

Work 18 hdc in next ch-18 sp. *1 hdc in sp between next 2 hdc. Rep from * around, ending with 1 hdc in sp between last hdc and first hdc of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc. 94 hdc.

materials: RED HEART® Boutique™ “Big & Lite™”: 3 balls each 9402 Pewter A and 9529 Dark Teal B.
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated

measurements: Bag measures 15” wide x 8” high without straps.
gauge: 10 sts = 4”; 7 rows = 4” in dc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BAG
Front
With A, ch 40.
Row 1 (Right Side): Dc in 4th ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 38 sts.
Rows 2-12: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in next dc and in each dc across, dc in top of ch-3; turn.
Row 13: Ch 1, hdc in each dc across and in top of dc; turn 
Row 14: Ch 1, hdc in each hdc across. Fasten off.
Back
With B repeat Rows 1-14 same as Front.
Bottom Gusset
With B, ch 45.
Row 1 (Right Side): Hdc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in each ch across; turn – 44 hdc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, hdc in each hdc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 3.
Side Gusset (Make 2)
With A, ch 25.
Row 1 (Right Side): Hdc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in each ch across; turn – 24 hdc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, hdc in each hdc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 3.
Assembly
Sew long edges of Bottom Gusset to lower edges of Front and Back. Sew short edge of Side Gussets to short edges of Bottom Gusset. Sew long sides of Side Gussets to Front and Back.
Front Loops
First Tier
** Row 1: Keeping yarn and hook on top of fabric throughout, with right side of Front facing, join B around first dc of Row 4; ch 1, sc around same dc and around each dc across; turn.
Row 2: * Ch 15, slip st in next sc; repeat from * across. Fasten off.
2nd Tier: Repeat from ** with A on Row 8.
3rd Tier: Repeat from ** with B on Row 12.
Right Side Strap
Row 1: With right side facing, join B in top of right Side Gusset; ch 3, work 4 dc across; turn.
Row 2: Ch 4, skip first dc, tr in each dc across and in top of ch-3; turn.
Rows 3-17: Ch 4, skip first tr, tr in each tr across and in top of ch-4; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 17.

Work same as Right Side Strap on left Side Gusset with A. Sew ends of straps together. Weave in all ends.

materials: Caron® Cotton Varied Stripes Cakes™ (8 oz/227 g; 481 yds/440 m) Gladiolus (42013) 2 balls or 877 yds/802 m
Caron® Cotton Cakes™ (8 oz/227 g; 481 yds/440 m) Candy Cookie (11006) 2 balls or 877 yds/802 m

measurements: Bag: Approx 10" [25.5 cm] diameter x 12" [30.5 cm] high, excluding strap. Strap: Approx 2" [5 cm] wide x 66" [167.5 cm] long.
gauge: 15.5 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm]. 15.5 sc and 30 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Ridge St Pat.
instructions:
BAG
Note: Do not join at ends of rnds unless otherwise stated. Cont working in spiral placing marker on first st of rnd for easier counting.
BASE
Ch 2.
1st rnd: 10 sc in 2nd ch from hook. PM on first st.
2nd rnd: Loosely sl st in each sc around.
3rd rnd: 2 sc in each sl st around. 20 sc.
4th rnd: Working over sc from prev rnd, 2 sc in each sl st 2 rnds below (rnd 2) around.
5th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
6th rnd: *1 sc in next sl st. 2 sc in next sl st. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
7th rnd: *Working over sc from prev rnd and into sl sts 2 rnds below (5th rnd), 1 sc in next sl st. 2 sc in next sl st. Rep from * around.
8th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
9th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sl sts. 2 sc in next sl st. Rep from * around. 40 sc.
10th rnd: *Working over sc from prev rnd and into sl sts 2 rnds below (8th rnd), 1 sc in each of next 2 sl sts. 2 sc in next sl st. Rep from * around.
11th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
12th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sl sts. 2 sc in next sl st. Rep from * around. 50 sc.
13th rnd: *Working over sc from prev rnd, and into sl sts 2 rnds below (8th rnd), 1 sc in each of next 3 sl sts. 2 sc in next sl st. Rep from * around.
14th to 34th rnds: Cont working Ridge St Pat as established, working 1 rnd of sl sts, 1 rnd evenly inc 10 sc around, and 1 rnd working over sc from prev rnd. 120 sc at end of 34th rnd.
35th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
36th rnd: 1 sc in each sl st around.
37th rnd: Working over sc from prev rnd and into sl sts 2 rnds below (35th rnd), 1 sc in each sl st around. PM at end of last rnd.
SIDE OF BAG
Rep Base 35th to 37th rnds until work from marker measures approx 10" [25.5 cm], ending on a 37th rnd.
Next rnd (strap hole rnd): Loosely sl st in each of first 28 sc. Ch 4. Skip next 4 sc. Sl st in each of next 56 sc. Ch 4. Skip next 4 sc. Sl st in each of last 28 sc.
Next rnd: 1 sc in each sl st and ch around. 120 sc.
Next rnd: Working over sc from prev rnd and into sl sts or ch 2 rnds below, 1 sc in each st around.
Cont with Side as follows:
Rep Base 35th to 37th rnds until work from marker measures approx 12" [30.5 cm], ending on a 37th rnd.
Sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
STRAP
Loosely ch 257.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 256 sc.
2nd to 9th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
10th row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Do not turn. Cont working around Strap as follows: Edging rnd: (RS). Ch 1. Sl st evenly around 4 sides of Strap. Join with sl st to first ch. Fasten off.
Attach Strap: Insert ends of Strap and knot through ch‐4 sps in Sides to secure in place, adjusting to desired length and leaving ends hanging loosely (as shown in photo).

materials: Bernat® Super Value™ (7 oz/197 g; 426 yds/389 m) Main Color (MC) Yellow (07445) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 8" [20.5 cm] in diameter, excluding petals.
gauge: 13 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Front and Back (make alike). 
With MC, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc. 
Cont in same manner, inc 8 sts every rnd to 88 sc. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Gusset
With MC, ch 7. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each sc to end of ch. 6 sc. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until work from beg measures 22" [56 cm], ending with a WS row. Fasten off. 
Pin Gusset to Front and Back, having top opening approx 4" [10 cm] wide. 
To join Back and Gusset: Join MC with sl st to beg of Gusset. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses (where appropriate), work 1 rnd of sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
To join Front and Gusset: Working along opposite side of Gusset, join A with sl st to beg of Gusset. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses (where appropriate), work 1 rnd of sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Do not fasten off. Cont as follows for Petals:
First Petal: 1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 11 sc.
**2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. 14 sc. Turn. 
3rd to 6th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each sc to last 3 sts. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 
Rep last row 3 times more. 6 sts.
Next row: (RS). Skip first 2 sts. 6 dc in next sc. Skip next 2 sts. Sl st in last sc. Fasten off.** 
Second to Eighth Petals: With RS of work facing, join A with sl st to next skipped sc of joining rnd. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 11 sc. 
Work from ** to ** as given for First Petal. 
Eyes (make 2). 
With A, ch 2. 
1st row: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc across. 8 sc. 
Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten off. 
Shoulder Straps (make 2). 
With MC, ch 49. 
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook and each ch to end of ch. 47 sts. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row twice more. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Sew Straps to Back of Bag. Sew Eyes in position. With A, embroider eyelashes and mouth with stem st as shown in picture.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/71 g; 120 yds/109 m) Main Color (MC) Robin’s Egg (01215) 1 ball
Size U.S. 7 (4.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Designed to fit most 17 to 24 oz metal water bottles, approx 8" [20.5 cm] tall excluding handle.

instructions:
1st rnd (RS):  With MC, make a magic loop. Video here. Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). [Dc in ring. Ch 1] 7 times. Join with a sl st in third ch. 8 dc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 5 (counts as tr and ch 1). Tr in next ch sp. Ch 1. [Tr in next st. Ch 1. Tr in next ch sp. Ch 1] 7 times. Join with sl st in 4th ch. 16 tr.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each ch sp around. Join with sl st in first sc. 32 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Sc in each st around. Join.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. [Sc in next 8 sts. Ch 7. Skip 7 sts. Sc in next st] twice. Join. 18 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. [Sc in next 8 sts. Sc in next ch sp. Ch 5. Sc in same ch sp. Sc in next st] twice. Join. 22 sc.
7th rnd:  Ch 1. [Sc in next 9 sts. Sc in next ch sp. Ch 3. Sc in same ch sp. Sc in next 2 sts] twice. Join. 26 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 8 (counts as tch and ch 7). Skip 7 sts. [Sc in next 3 sts. Sc in next ch sp. Ch 1. Sc in same ch sp. Sc in next 3 sts]. Ch 7. Skip 7 sts. Rep from [ to ]. Join with sl st in second ch. 16 sc.
9th rnd:  Ch 1. [Sc in next ch sp. Ch 5. Sc in same ch sp. Sc in next 4 sts. Sc in next ch sp. Sc in next 4 sts] twice. Join. 22 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. [Sc in next st. Sc in next ch sp. Ch 3. Sc in same ch sp. Sc in next 10 sts] twice. Join. 26 sc.

Rep 2nd row until Handle measures approx 48" [122 cm], or to desired length.

materials: Lily® sugar’n cream® (solids: 70.9 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds; stripes: 56.7 g/2 oz; 86 m/95 yds)
main color (mc) Hot Green (01712) 250 m/275 yds or 2 balls

contrast B Yellow (00010) 40 m/45 yds or 1 ball
