abbreviations: Kernel St = Insert hook in last stitch worked. Yoh and draw up a loop. Insert hook in next stitch. Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 11" [28 cm] wide x 14" [35.5 cm] tall x 9" [23 cm] deep.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Beg with Base, Backpack is worked in sections built directly from previous sections. Body is worked in continuous rounds. Pocket, Flap and Straps are worked separately, then sewn on. 
BACKPACK
Base: With A, ch 23 loosely.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Kernel St across to end of ch. Turn. 22 sts.
2nd to 26th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. Kernel St across to end of row. Turn.
Break A. Join B.
Body: 1st rnd: With B, ch 1. *Work 20 sc evenly across last row. Work 3 sc in corner. Work 33 sc evenly across side edge. Work 3 sc in corner. Rep from * once more. Join with sl st to first sc. 118 sc. PM at beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Do not join.
3rd to 9th rnds: Working in continuous rnds, 1 sc in each sc around. Do not join.
10th to 29th rnds: 1 hdc in each st around. Do not join.
30th rnd: 1 sc in each hdc around. Do not join.
31st rnd: 1 sc in each of first 8 sc. *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Do not join. 107 sts.
32nd rnd: 1 sc in each of first 8 sc. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Do not join. 96 sc.
33rd rnd: *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Do not join. 84 sc.
34th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Do not join. 72 sc.
35th and 36th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to last sc.
Fasten off.
Top Flap: 1st row: Working in back loops only, join C with sl st in first sc of last rnd of Body. Ch 1. 1 sc in same st as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 26 sts. Turn. 27 sc.
2nd to 19th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
20th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 23 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 25 sc.
21st row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Ch 3. Skip each of next 3 sc for Buttonhole. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 23 sts.
22nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 21 sc.
23rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 17 sc. Sc2tog. 19 sc.
Fasten off.
Top Flap Edging: Join C with sl st to top left corner. Work sc evenly around edge of Top Flap to opposite corner. Fasten off.
Pocket: With D, ch 28.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 27 sc.
2nd to 5th rows: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 35 sc at end of 5th row.
6th to 21st rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off.
Pocket Flap: With D, ch 28.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 27 sc.
2nd to 13th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
14th to 17th rows: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. 19 sc rem at end of 17th row.
Pocket Flap Edging: Join D with sl st to top left corner. Work sc evenly around edge of Top Flap, leaving foundation ch edge unworked. Fasten off.
Pocket Assembly:
Sew first row of Pocket to first round of Body, lining up placement under Top Flap. Sew sides of Pocket in position. Sew first row of Pocket Flap to Backpack 2 rows above Pocket to allow Flap to fold over.
Ties
Left Tie: **Join A with sl st 2 rows below first st of Top Flap. Ch 75. Fasten off. Weave in and out of sts to center front of Body.**
Right Tie: Rep from ** to ** sts.
Pull Ties to gather top edge of Body. Sew button on Body to correspond with buttonhole on Flap.
Straps (make 2 alike): With E, ch 66.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 65 sc.
2nd row: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc). 1 hdc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew one end of each Strap on opposite corners of Top Flap. Sew opposite ends on corresponding corners of Base. Using length of Black embroidery floss and back stitch, embroider monogram of choice.

materials: 4 balls RED HEART® Sashay Sequins™ 1948 Mediterranean
1 ball RED HEART® Sashay Sequins™ 1101 Champagne
Susan Bates® Luxite® Bulky Crochet Hook: 16 mm [Q]
1 pair 6 x 5" (15 x 12.5 cm) bamboo purse handles
Stiff cardboard 6” (15 cm) long to make tassel
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Tote measures 9½ x 13" (24 x 33 cm) not including the handles.
gauge: 6 sc = 4" (10 cm); 7 sc rounds = 4" (10 cm) CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
TOTE
Ch 29.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in second ch from hook and in each ch to end – 28 sc. Slip st in first sc of the row to join into a round.
Next round: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc.
Repeat this round until piece measures 8½" (21.5 cm) in length.
Begin Mesh
Next 4 rounds:
Round 1: * Ch 2, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, join with slip st in second of 2 beginning ch.
Round 2: Ch 1, * sc in next space, ch 2; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 3: * Ch 2, sc in next space; repeat from * around, join with slip st in second of 2 beginning ch.
Round 4: Repeat Round 2.
Attach Handles
Next round: Ch 2, sc in next space, ch 2, remove hook being careful to not unravel last loop, insert ch-2 just made into one ring of one purse handle, replace hook in last loop, sc in next space, [ch 2, sc in next space] 3 times, ch 2, remove hook, insert ch-2 into other ring of same purse handle, replace hook, sc in next space, [ch 2, sc in next space] twice, ch 2, remove hook, insert ch-2 into one ring of second tote handle, replace hook, sc in next space, [ch 2, sc in next space] 3 times, ch 2, remove hook, insert ch-2 into other ring of second tote handle, replace hook, sc in next space, ch 2, sc in next space, join with slip st in second of 2 beginning ch. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Flatten tote and sew bottom edge closed.
Weave in all loose ends.
Tassel
1. Cut a 15” (38 cm) length of yarn and lay across top of cardboard; this will be used to tie top of tassel.
2. Wrap yarn around cardboard 13 times.
3. Using the 15” (38 cm) tie, knot top of tassel tightly. Cut tassel at opposite end.
4. Cut a 24” (61 cm) long length of yarn for wrapping neck of tassel. Wrap around tassel 3 times and knot ends together. Allow ends to become part of tassel.
5. Use ties at top of tassel to tie onto purse handle. Trim lower ends of tassel evenly.

materials: Red Heart® With Love Chunky™ (5 oz/141 g; 171 yds/156 m) Taupe (1970) 3 balls
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Two 6" [15 cm] inside diameter round wooden handles (measure the diameter across the opening inside the handles)
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at back of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Puff = (Yoh and draw up a loop) 3 times in indicated st. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 13" x 14" [33 x 35.5 cm], not including handle
gauge: 10 sc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes:
Tote is worked in 2 pieces: Body and base.
Body is worked back and forth in rows. Side edges are seamed to form back seam of tote. Base is worked separately in rounds and crocheted to bottom edges of body. Knotted fringe is attached around top of assembled tote.

BODY
Ch 70.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—69 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sts, *puff in next st, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * to last st, sc in last st, turn—16 puffs.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across. Turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, puff in next st, *sc in next 3 sts, puff in next st; repeat from * to last 2 sts, sc in last 2 sts, turn—17 puffs.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each st across. Turn.
Rows 6-17: Repeat Rows 2-5 for 3 more times.
Rows 18-33: Ch 1, sc in each st across. Turn.
Row 34: Ch 1, sc in first 34 sts, sc2tog, sc in remaining 33 sts, turn—68 sc.
Row 35 (tassel ridge): Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in back loop only of each st across. Turn.
Row 36: Ch 3, *Dcfp around next st, Dcbp around next st; repeat from * to last st, Dcfp around last st.
Fasten off.
Sew side edges of body together for back seam, forming tube shape.
Lower Edge: Working along opposite side of foundation ch, join yarn with sc in any ch, sc in each remaining ch around; join with slip st in first sc—69 sc.
Fasten off.

HANDLE WRAPS
First Wrap
With right side facing, join yarn with slip st in 25th dc of last row of body.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 3, [Dcfp around next st, Dcbp around next st] 9 times, Dcfp around next st; turn, leave remaining sts unworked—20 sts.
Rows 2-4: Ch 3, *Dcfp around next st, Dcbp around next st; repeat from * to last st, Dcfp around last st. Turn.
Fasten off.

Second Wrap
With right side facing, skip first 14 unworked sts of last row of body following Row 1 of first wrap, join yarn with slip st in next st.
Rows 1-4: Work same as Rows 1-4 of first wrap.
Fasten off.

BASE
Note: Place a marker in last sc made to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. Work in continuous rounds. (spiral)
Ch 12.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 9 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working along opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 9 ch, 2 sc in last ch; —24 sc.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in first st, sc in next 9 sts, 2 sc in each of next 3 sts, sc in next 9 sts, 2 sc in each of last 2 sts—30 sc.
Round 3: Sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 3 times, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] twice—36 sc.
Round 4: Sc in first 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 3 times, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] twice—42 sc.
Round 5: Sc in first 3 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 3 times, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] twice—48 sc.
Round 6: Sc in first 4 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 3 times, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] twice—54 sc.
Round 7: Sc in first 5 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st] 3 times, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st] twice—60 sc.
Round 8: Sc in first 6 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st] 3 times, sc in next 9 sts, [sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st] twice—66 sc.
Round 9: [Sc in next 21 sts, 2 sc in next st] 3 times—69 sc.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
With right sides facing, hold outer edge of base and lower edge of body together with stitches matching. Pin base in place. Working through both loops of both thicknesses, join yarn with sc in any st, sc in each remaining st all the way around to join the base to the body; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

Attach Handles
Hold one round handle on inside of first wrap. Fold wrap over to cover handle and pin in place. Carefully sew last row of wrap to first row of wrap. Repeat to attach second handle.

Knotted Fringe
Fringe base: Turn tote upside down. Working in loops that were left unworked when making Row 35, join yarn with sc in 3rd loop from center back seam, *ch 4, skip next 3 loops, sc in next loop; repeat from * around to last 3 loops, ch 4, skip last 3 loops; join with slip st in first sc—17 ch-4 spaces.
Fasten off. Turn tote upright.

Attach fringe: Wrap yarn 51 times around 10" [25.5 cm] piece of heavy cardboard. Cut wraps at one end of cardboard only, making 51 strands about 20" [51 cm] long. Holding 3 strands together, fold strands in half. Insert crochet hook from right side through one of the ch-4 spaces of the fringe base. Place fold on hook and draw fold through, forming a loop. Thread ends of strands through loop and pull to tighten (one fringe attached). Repeat to attach fringe in every ch-4 space of fringe base.

Knot fringe: Divide each fringe into 2 groups of 3 strands. Holding 3 strands from one fringe and 3 strands from the neighboring fringe together, tie a loose overhand knot. Repeat tying 3 strands of a fringe and 3 strands of its neighboring fringe together all the way around the tote. Trim ends of fringes evenly.

Weave in ends.
Fringe: Cut yarn 10 to 14 ins [25.5 to 35.5 cm] long. Taking 2 or 3 strands together for each fringe knot into fringe across cast on and cast off edges. Trim fringe evenly.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball each 5142 Cherry Red A and 4601 Off White B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5mm [H-8 US] and 5.5mm [I-9 US]
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Gift bag measures 6” long x 5½” wide (15 x 14 cm), not including handles
gauge: 4 sts = 1” (2.5 cm); 5 rows = 1” (2.5 cm) in single crochet with larger hook.
instructions:
Here’s My Heart Gift Bag
This bag is perfect for the little miss to carry or to use as a gift bag for girls of any age! Crochet it in any color your heart desires and trim with a sweet white edging.
Row 16: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts, skip next 2 sts, dc in next st, 2 dc in next st, 3 dc in next st, 2 dc in next st, dc in next st, next skip 2 sts, sc in last 3 sts, turn—9 dc and 6 sc.
Row 17: Skip first 3 sts, [2 dc next st, dc next st] twice, 3 dc in next st, [dc next st, 2 dc next st] twice, skip next 2 sts, slip st in last st—15 dc. Fasten off.
Second Lobe
With right side facing and larger hook, join A with slip st in ch-2 space.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in ch-2 space, sc in next 4 sts, skip next 2 sts, 5 dc in next st, skip 2 sts, sc in last 5 sts, turn—5 dc and 10 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Repeat Rows 16 and 17 of first lobe. Do not fasten off.
Edging
Round 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 2 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts, sc in last st of Row 16 of second lobe, ch 1, slip st in marked ch-2 space, ch 1, sc in first st of Row 16 of first lobe, sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 3 times; *sc in ends of next 16 rows,* (sc, ch 2, sc) in beginning ring; repeat from * to * once; join with slip st in first st—74 sc and 1 ch-2 sp. Fasten off.
Lace Heart
Mitered Square
Work same as Rows 1–10 of large heart—20 sc and 1 ch-2 sp. Place marker in ch-2 space of Row 10.
First Lobe
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts, skip next 2 sts, 5 dc in next st, skip 2 sts, sc in last 2 sts, sc in ch-2 space, turn—5 dc and 6 sc.
Row 12: Skip first 3 sts, 2 dc in next 2 sts, 3 dc in next st, 2 dc in next 2 sts, skip 2 sts, slip st in next st—11 dc and 1 slip st. Fasten off.
Second Lobe
With right side facing and larger hook, join A with slip st in ch-2 space.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in ch-2 space, sc in next 2 sts, skip next 2 sts, 5 dc in next st, skip 2 sts, sc in last 3 sts, turn—5 dc and 6 sc.
Row 2: Repeat Row 12 from first lobe of lace heart—11 dc.
Edging
With right side facing, join B with slip st in marked ch-2 space.
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in first st of Row 11 of second lobe, *[2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 3 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st;* sc in ends of next 11 rows, (sc, ch 2, sc) in beginning ring, sc in ends of next 11 rows, sc in next st; repeat from * to * once, 2 sc in next st, sc in last st of Row 11 of first lobe, turn—56 sc and 1 ch-2 sp.
Row 2: Ch 3, sc in next st, *[ch 3, skip next st, sc in next st] 13 times, ch 3,* skip ch-2 sp, sc in next st; repeat from * to * once, slip st in last st, turn—28 sc and 28 ch-3 sps.
Row 3: Ch 1, slip st in first ch-3 space, [ch 3, skip next sc, sc in next ch-3 space] 14 times, ch 3, sc in same ch-3 space as just worked, [ch 3, skip next sc, sc in next ch-3 space] 13 times, ch 3, slip st in last ch-3 space—28 sc and 29 ch-3 sps. Fasten off.
Side Gusset
With larger hook and A, ch 52.
Row 1 (right side): Working in back bars, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—51 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in each st, ch 2; working in spaces between rows, sc 4 sts evenly across to Row 1, ch 2; working in opposite side of Row 1, sc in each ch, ch 2; working in spaces between rows, sc 4 sts evenly across to Row 5; join with slip st in first sc—110 sc and 4 ch-2 sps. Fasten off. Place markers on center sts of each long edge.
Handles (make 2)
With smaller hook and B, leaving an 8” (20.5 cm) tail, ch 41.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch, turn—40 slip sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, slip st in each st. Fasten off, leaving 8” (20.5 cm) tail.
FINISHING
With right side facing, place lace heart on top of right side of large heart. With B, sew through both lower edges, leaving 18 stitches open across top to create pocket. With wrong sides together, align one marked stitch on gusset with point of large heart. With A and overcast stitching, sew through both edges to create a raised seam on right side of bag. Repeat to attach 2nd heart to gusset. Using photograph as a guide for placement, sew ends of handles to wrong side of large hearts. Weave in ends.

pattern_name: Going to Grandma’s Pocket on Hanger
materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 0358 Lavender CA and 373 Petal Pink CB.

instructions:
Organizer:  With CA, ch 45.
Row 1:  Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each rem ch across, turn, ch 1.  (44 sts)
Rows 2 – 6:  Sc in each sc across, end CA, turn, join CB, ch 1.
Row 7: Sc in each sc, turn, ch 1.
Row 8:  Sc in each sc across, end CB, turn, join CA, ch 1.
Row 9:  Sc in each sc across, turn, ch 1.
Rows 10-86:  Repeat rows 2 – 9, maintaining 6 rows CA, 2 rows CB color pat. End CA, turn, join CB, ch 1.
Row 87 (Button Hole row):  Sc in first 8 sc, ch 1, sk 1, [sc in next 8 sc, ch 1, sk 1] 3 times, sc in 8 sc, turn, ch 1.
Row 88 & 89: With CB, sc in each st across.
Row 90: With CB, [sc in next sc, sk 1 sc, 3 dc in next sc, sk 1 sc] 5 times, sc in next sc, dc and tr in next sc, tr and dc in next sc, sc next sc, [sk 1 sc, 3 dc in next sc, sk 1, sc in next sc] 5 times. Fasten off.
With RS together, fold row 1 up to row 80 and sew side seams. Open out organizer, and fold flap forward. Matching button holes, sew buttons in place on row 7.
Flower (make 3): With CB, ch 6, join to first ch with a slip st to form ring.  [Ch 1, 2 dc in ring, ch 1, slip st in ring] 5 times, end off.  Sew in place on front of bag.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® O’Go™ (Solids: 7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m; Prints: 5 oz/141 g; 236 yds/215 m) Main Color (MC) Black (7120) 1 O’Go
Contrast A, B, C, D, E Rainbow (7192) 1 O’Go
Contrast F, G, H, I, J Jeweltone (7195) 1 O’Go
Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m) Main Color (MC) Black (0312) 1 ball
Size U.S. I/9 [5.5 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Susan Bates® split-lock stitch count markers.
abbreviations: Sc3tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 3 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Scfl = Single crochet in front loop only
measurements: Approx 17" [41 cm] wide x 12" [30.5 cm] tall x 3½" [9 cm] deep, excluding handles
gauge: 12 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Chart Pat.
instructions:
Notes:
Version I only:
• To begin working with O’Go, locate the end of the yarn.
• Carefully cut plastic tie where ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull to remove tie. 
• Colors can be easily separated by gently pulling apart and cutting at the color transition. Each color is ready to use. Follow color guide shown in Materials section for O’Go (Contrast A to J). You may find it helpful to place each color section in its own resealable (zip lock) bag and label each bag A to J.
• Each color is ready to use.
Version I & II:
• Carry color not in use loosely across top of work and work sts around yarn not in use.
• Bag is worked in rounds which are joined, then turned. RS and WS will alternate.
BASE
With MC, ch 39.
1st rnd: (WS). 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working across opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn. 78 sc.
2nd rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc first sc. 3 sc in next sc, PM on center st (corner). 1 sc in each of next 36 sc. 3 sc in next sc, PM on center st (corner). 1 sc in next sc. 3 sc in next sc, PM on center st (corner). 1 sc in each of next 36 sc. 3 sc in next sc, PM on center st (corner). Join with sl st to first sc. Turn. 86 sc.
3rd to 6th rnds:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to corner. 3 sc in corner st, replacing marker on center st. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn. 118 sts at end of 6th rnd. Remove markers.
7th rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 2 scfl in first sc. 1 scfl in each of next 58 sc. 2 scfl in next sc. 1 scfl in each sc to end of rnd. Join F with sl to first sc. Turn. 120 sc.
MAIN BODY
Proceed in Chart as follows:
See Chart on page 3.
1st rnd: (RS). With F, ch 1. *With F, 1 sc in next 5 sc. With D, 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
2nd rnd: (WS). With D, ch 1. *With D, 1 sc in next 5 sc. With F, 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
First 2 rows of Chart are complete. Cont in sc as established working in Chart pat until row 37 of Chart is complete, noting 60-st rep will be worked twice, reading RS rnds from right to left and WS rnds from left to right and turning to alt RS and WS of work as established.
Fasten off all shades but MC.
Top Edge and Handles:
1st and 2nd rnds: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
3rd rnd (Handle placement):  (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 18 sc. Ch 72 (Handle). Skip next 24 sc. 1 sc in each of next 36 sc. Ch 72 (Handle). Skip next 24 sc. 1 sc in each of last 18 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
4th rnd: (WS). Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 17 sc. Sc3tog-over next sc and next 2 ch and PM on this st. 1 sc in each of next 68 ch. Sc3tog-over next 2 ch and next sc and PM on this st. 1 sc in each of next 17 sc. Rep from * once more. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn. 208 sc.
5th to 11th rnds: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to 1 st before marker. Sc3tog, replacing marker on this st.  Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn. Do not turn at end of 11th rnd.
12th rnd (edging):  (RS). Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left, as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.
REVERSE SC
Interior Handle Edging: With RS facing, join MC with sl st to last skipped st of 3rd rnd where Handle meets top of Main Body.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left, as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc to corner. Working into opposite side of ch from 3rd rnd, work 1 reverse sc in each ch to corner. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.
Rep Interior Handle Edging on opposite side of Bag.

materials: Lily® Sugar'n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 oz; 120 yds/109 m) Main Color (MC) Indigo (01114) 585 yds/530 m or 5 balls
Size 5 mm (U.S. H/8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Bobble Cluster = [(Yoh and draw up a loop) 3 times. Yoh and draw through 6 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook – bobble made. Ch 2. Bobble] all in next st.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
measurements: Approx 27" [68.5 cm] around x 19" [48 cm] high, excluding handles.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
BAG
(See Charts VI and VII on pages 36 and 37). 
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
Ch 4. Join with sl st in first ch to form ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 7 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 8 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 dcfp around first dc. 1 dc in sp between last dc and next dc. (1 dcfp around next dc. 1 dc in sp between last dc and next dc) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 16 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 dcfp around first d cfp. Ch 2. 1 sc in next dc. Ch 2. (1 dcfp around next dcfp. Ch 2. 1 sc in next dc. Ch 2) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 2 dcfp around first d cfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next sc. Ch 1. (2 dcfp around next dcfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next sc. Ch 1) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
5th rnd: Ch 2. 2 dcfp around each of first 2 dcfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. (2 dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
6th rnd: Ch 2. 2 dcfp around first dcfp. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. (2 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 2 dcfp around first dcfp. 1 dcfp around each of next 4 dcfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. (2 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dcfp around each of next 4 dcfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
8th rnd: Ch 2. 1 dcfp around each of first 3 dcfp. Ch 2. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 2. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 2. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 2. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
9th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 2. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 2. Miss next ch-2 sp, sc, ch-2 sp) 8 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
10th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next sc. Ch 1. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Miss next ch-2 sp) 8 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
11th to 13th rnds: Ch 2. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp) 8 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
14th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 2. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 2) 8 times. Join with sl st to first st.
15th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 2. Miss next ch-2 sp, sc, ch-2 sp. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 2. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2) 8 times. Join with sl st to first st.
16th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Miss next ch-2 sp. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next sc. Ch 1) 8 times. Join with sl st to first st.
17th to 19th rnds: Ch 2. (1 dcfp around each of next 6 dcfp. Ch 1. Bobble Cluster in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1) 8 times. Join with sl st to first st.
20th to 31st rnds: As 8th to 19th rnds.
32nd to 37th rnds: As 8th to 13th rnds.
38th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 2. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp) 8 times. Join with sl st to first st.
39th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Ch 2. Miss next ch 2, sc, ch 2. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp) 8 times. Join with sl st to first st.
40th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Miss next ch-2 sp. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp) 8 times. Join with sl st to first st.
41st and 42nd rnds: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dcfp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 48 dcfp.
Fasten off.
Strap (make 2)
With 2 strands held tog, ch 84. 
1st rnd: 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. Optional: Working into rem loops along opposite side of ch, work 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Ch 1. Do not fasten off.
Fold Strap in half lengthwise with RS facing each other (WS of last rnd will show). Join Strap by working 1 sl st through tops of corresponding dc and foundation ch to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew Straps to Bag as shown in picture.

materials: RED HEART® “Eco-Ways Bamboo Wool™”: 4 balls 3920 Cayenne
abbreviations: PS (Picot Shell) = [Ch 10, slip st in last sc] 3 times
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Bag measures 14.5” x 10” before felting. Bag may measure 10” wide, 7” high after felting.
gauge: 14 sc = 4”; 14 rounds = 4” in sc. Gauge is unimportant for this piece.
instructions:
PURSE
BACK & FLAP
Round 1: Ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 6 sc.
Round 2: [2 Sc in next sc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 3: [2 Sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 4: * Sc in next 2 sc, (sc, PS, sc) all in next sc, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice; repeat from * once more – 24 sc.
Round 5: Working behind PS, slip st in first ch-loop, skip 1 sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, slip st in third ch-loop, skip 1 sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc, slip st in ch-loop, skip 1 sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, slip st in ch-loop, skip 1 sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc – 30 sts.
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times – 36 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 42 sc.
Round 8: Sc in next 4 sc, slip st in remaining ch-loop, skip 1 sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc, (sc, PS, sc) all in next sc, sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, slip st in remaining ch-loop, skip 1 sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc, PS, sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc – 48 sts.
Round 9: Sc in next 7 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts, slip st in ch-loop, skip 1 st, sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, slip st in ch-loop, skip 1 st, sc in next 6 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts] twice, slip st in ch-loop, sc in next 4 sts, slip st in ch-loop, skip 1 st, sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st – 54 sts.
Round 10: [Sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times – 60 sc.
Round 11: [Sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 66 sc.
Round 12: Sc in next 10 sc, PS, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sc, slip st in ch-loop, skip 1 sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 10 sc, PS, 2 sc in next sc] twice, sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc, slip st in ch-loop, skip 1 sc, sc in next 9 sc, PS, 2 sc in next sc – 72 sts.

Rnd 1:  2 Dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in next 35 ch, 5 dc in last ch, working on opposite side of beginning ch, dc in next 35 sts, 2 dc in same ch as first 2 dc; join to top of ch-3 – 80 sts.
Rnd 2:  Ch 3, * [2 dc in next dc] twice, dc in next 35 dc, [2 dc in next dc] twice **, dc in next dc; repeat from * around, end at **; join – 88 sts.
Rnd 3:  Ch 3, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 37 dc, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc] 4 times, dc in next 36 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc; join – 96 dc.
Rnd 4: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc; yo and insert hook from the front to the back to the front around the post of next st, yo and draw lp through, [yo and draw through 2 lps] twice – front post dc (fpdc) made; dc in next 41 dc, fpdc, dc in next 5 dc, fpdc, dc in next 41 dc, fpdc, dc in last 2 dc; join.
Rnd 5 and 6:  Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, fpdc, dc in next 41 dc, fpdc, dc in next 5 dc, fpdc, dc in next 41 dc, fpdc, dc in last 2 dc; join.
Rnd 7:  Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, * fpdc, dc in next dc, [ch 1, skip next st or sp, dc in next dc] 20 times, fpdc **, dc in next 5 dc; repeat from * to last 2 dc, end at **; dc in last 2 dc; join.
Rnds 8 and 9:  Repeat Rnd 7.
Rnd 10:  Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, * fpdc, dc in next dc; [yo and draw up a lp to height of current row} 3 times all in next ch-1 sp, yo and through all 7 lps on hook – puff st made; [ch 1, skip next dc, puff st] 19 times, dc in next dc, fpdc **, dc in next 5 dc; repeat from * to last 2 dc, end at **; dc in last 2 dc; join.
Rnd 11: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, * fpdc, dc in next dc, [ch 1, skip puff st, dc in sp] 19 times, ch 1, skip puff st, dc in next dc, fpdc **, dc in next 5 dc; repeat from * to last 2 dc, end at **; dc in last 2 dc; join.
Rnds 12 and 13: Repeat Rnd 7.
Rnd 14: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, * fpdc, [dc in next dc, dc in next sp] 20 times, dc in next dc, fpdc **, dc in next 5 dc; repeat from * to last 2 dc, end at **, dc in last 2 dc; join.
Rnds 15-19: Repeat Rnd 5.
Rnds 20-27: Repeat Rnds 7-14 once more. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
Strap
With right side facing, skip last 3 sts made, attach thread in next dc to the right.
Row 1:  Ch 2, fpdc, dc in next 5 sts, fpdc, dc in next dc; turn.
Row 2: Ch 2; yo and insert hook from the back to the front to the back around the post of next st, yo and draw lp through, [yo and draw through 2 lps] twice - of next st, yo and draw lp through, [yo and draw through 2 lps] twice.

materials: Patons Classic Merino Wool (100 g/3.5 oz)
1 ball each of 00238 (Paprika) as A, 00202 (Aran) as B and 00205 (Deep Olive) as C.
Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
measurements: Approx 14 ins [36 cm] square before felting. Approx 12 ins [30.5 cm] square after felting.
gauge: 15 sc and 17 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Ch 5 counts as dc and ch 2.
FRONT and BACK (Make alike)
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd:Ch 5. (3 dc in ring. Ch 2) 3 times. 2 dc in ring. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 5. Fasten off.
2nd rnd:Join B with sl st to any ch-2 sp. Ch 5. 3 dc in same sp as last sl st. [Ch 1. Miss next 3 dc. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-2sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 5. Fasten off.
3rd rnd: Join C with sl st to any ch-2 sp. Ch 5. 3 dc in same sp as last sl st. [Ch 1. Miss next 3 dc. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Miss next 3 dc. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-2 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 5. Fasten off.
4th rnd:Join A with sl st to any ch-2 sp. Ch 5. 3 dc in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Miss next 3 dc. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. Miss next 3 dc.** (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-2 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 5. Fasten off. (Four 3-dc groups on each side of square, including corner groups).
Rep last rnd, having 1 more 3-dc group on each side of square on every following rnd to twelve 3-dc groups on each side of square, changing colors in following sequence: B, C, A, C, B, A, C, A.
FINISHING: With WS of Front and Back tog, join B with sl st to any ch-2 sp. Ch 1. *Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each dc and ch-1 sp to next ch-2 sp. 2 sc in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * twice more, having 1 sc in last ch-2 sp. Fasten off.
Felt Bag following “How to Felt” instructions. Shape bag to measurements and dry flat.
Cut lining fabric to size of Bag. Sew side seams. Sew lining to inside of top edge of Bag. Center handles on top edge of Bag and sew in position.
… a part of your life.
P.O. Box 40 Listowel ON  N4W 3H3
Important to know before felting
• Record all the measurements and changes before and after felting. You will be able to adjust the method to produce proper results.
• Always test a sample. Different colored yarns may felt differently.
• Colorfastness can be affected by very hot water.
• Any knitting that has been properly felted becomes very dense and matted.
How To Felt
• Using low water level, run a Hot/Cold cycle for 5 to 15 min. Add a pair of old jeans for agitation.
• Add 2 tablespoons of baking soda for a small load. After one cycle, check for size. Repeat if necessary.
• Run through the rinse and dry spin cycle.
• Do not use a clothes dryer.
• Shape piece to correct measurements.
• Lay felted piece onto a dry towel, away from direct heat or sunlight.
• If an edge ripples, baste a thread through the edge and gather in. Remove the thread after the felting is dry.

materials: COATS® Crème De La Crème®: 3 balls of 350 Dark Linen A
1 ball each of 625 Brite Green C, 1 White D, and 856 Navy E
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4 mm [US G-6]
abbreviations: A, B, C, etc. = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
measurements: Purse measures about 9 x 11” [23 x 28 cm], not including strap.
gauge: 15 sts = 4” [10 cm]; 16 rows = 4” [10 cm] in single crochet (sc). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
FRONT
Beginning at lower edge with A, ch 42.
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—41 sc.
Rows 2–36: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Top Edging (right side): Ch 1, do not turn, reverse sc in each st across. Fasten off.
Side and Lower Edging (right side): With right side facing, join D with slip st in end of top edging to work down a side edge, sc in end of each row down side edge, 3 sc in corner; working in opposite side of foundation ch, sc in each ch across lower edge, 3 sc in corner, sc in end of each row up other side edge; join with slip st in edge of top edging. Fasten off.
BACK WITH FLAP
Back
Work same as Front through Row 36.
Row 37: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Flap
Rows 38–56: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Round 57: Ch 1, turn, 3 sc in first st (corner made), sc in each st to last st, 3 sc in last st (corner made), sc in end of each row down side edge, 3 sc in corner; working in opposite side of foundation ch, sc in each ch across lower edge, 3 sc in corner, sc in end of each row up other side edge; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
STRAP AND SIDES
Sides
With B, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—7 sc.
Rows 2–108: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Strap
Row 109: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog—5 sc.
Row 110: Ch 1, turn, sc in first 2 sts, sc2tog, sc in last st—4 sc.
Rows 111–272: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 273: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, sc in last 2 sts—5 sc.
Row 274: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in last st—7 sc.
Edging
Work sc evenly spaced around entire outer edge of piece, working 3 sc in each corner; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
CROSS-STITCH EMBROIDERY
Embroider cross-stitch paisley pattern on right side of Front, following Front chart.
Embroider cross-stitch paisley pattern on right side of Flap, following Flap chart.
Notes: Flap is top part of Back piece, Rows 38–57. The Flap is folded down over the front. This means that Row 57 is at the bottom of the Flap Chart and Row 38 is at the top.
FINISHING
Attach Front to Strap and Sides: With wrong sides of pieces together (right sides facing out), carefully pin one edge of Rows 1–108 of Strap and Sides piece to side and lower edges of Front, leaving remaining rows of Strap and Sides piece free for Strap. Working through both thicknesses, join D with slip st in top right corner of Front (if you are left-handed, join in top left corner of Front), ch 1, reverse sc in each st down side edge, across lower edge, and up 2nd side edge; slip st in end of top edging of Front. Fasten off.
Attach Back to Strap and Sides: With wrong sides of pieces together (right sides facing out), carefully pin free edge of Rows 1–108 of Strap and Sides piece to side and lower edges of Rows 1–37 of Back and Flap piece. Working through both thicknesses, join D with slip st in top right corner of Back (Row 37) (if you are left-handed, join in top left corner of Back), ch 1, reverse sc in each st down side edge, across lower edge, and up 2nd side edge to other top corner of Back; working through single thickness of flap, reverse sc in each st around flap edges; join with slip st in beginning ch-1. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

materials: Lily® sugar’n cream® (70.9 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds) Tangerine (01699) 3 balls (250 m/275 yds)
Size U.S F/5 (3.75 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Purchased handle approx 22" [56 cm] long with metal rings.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at back of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice - 1 dcbp made.
measurements: Approx 13" [33 cm] wide x 10" [25.5 cm] high (excluding handle).
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Front and Back (make 2 pieces alike). (See Chart I on page 2). Ch 27.
1st row: (RS). Working in horizontal ‘bump’ at back of each ch, sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 26 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each of next 22 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
3rd and alt rows: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each st to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each of next 18 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
6th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each of next 14 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
8th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each of next 10 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
10th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each of next 10 sts. Sl st in each of next 4 missed sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
12th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each of next 14 sts. Sl st in each of next 4 missed sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
14th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each of next 18 sts. Sl st in each of next 4 missed sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
16th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each of next 22 sts. Sl st in each of next 4 missed sts. Turn. 26 sts.
17th row: As 3rd row.
Rep 2nd to 17th rows 7 times more, then rep 2nd to 16th rows once. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread end onto tapestry needle and draw tightly through narrow row ends at center. Fasten securely.
Edging: (See Chart II). 
1st row: (RS). Join yarn with sl st at outer edge. Ch 1. Work 73 sc along outer edge to opposite corner. Fasten off.
2nd row: (RS). Inserting hook from back to front, work sl st around post of 1st sc of last row. Ch 2 (counts as st). Dcbp around post of each sc to end of row. Fasten off.
Join Front and Back: Place RS of Front and Back tog and pin edging sts tog. Working through both thicknesses and in back loop only of each st across, join yarn with sl st in first dcbp. Sl st in each dcbp to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew handle rings in position at each side of Bag as shown in picture.

materials: Red Heart® All in One™ Granny Square™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 417 yds/381 m)
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Dual Duty XP® All Purpose thread in desired shade, shown in Bright Deep Purple (9238).
All purpose or denim sewing machine needle suited to weight of tote bag, or hand-sewing needle.
Optional: Temporary or permanent fabric adhesive, washable glue stick, heavy-duty sewing pins or sewing clips.
Scrap fabric to cover designs printed on tote.
measurements: Small Motif = Approx 8" x 8¾" [20.5 cm x 22 cm]. Large Motif = Approx 8" x 11" [20.5 cm x 28 cm].
gauge: 12 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• As Tote surface will be visible 
underneath granny squares, you 
may wish to cover Tote sections 
with fabric first. See Finishing for 
instructions. 
• To determine final size of Motif(s) 
needed for your Tote, measure 
area(s) on your Tote you wish to 
cover with granny squares. 
Instructions for Motifs as shown 
are given below, but you can 
adjust the number of rounds and 
rows worked to suit your Tote. 

With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to 
first ch to form ring. 
See diagram on page 4.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 
3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join. 
Color 1 complete.
2nd rnd: Color 2 begins. Sl st in next 
ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. 
*Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 
sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc 
in first ch-3 sp. Join. Color 2 
complete.
3rd rnd: Color 3 begins. Sl st in next 
ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. 
*Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 
(3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep 
from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last 
ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. 
Join. Color 3 complete.
4th rnd: Color 4 begins. Sl st in next 
ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. 
*(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next 
ch-3 sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in 
next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, 
then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first 
ch-3 sp. Join. Color 4 complete.
5th rnd: As 4th rnd, with Color 5.
6th rnd: As 4th rnd, using yarn as 
self-striping yarn.
Small Motif only:
7th rnd: Sl st in next ch-3 sp. 
Ch 2 (does not count as st). 2 hdc 
in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 hdc in next 
ch-1 sp. Ch 1) to next ch-3 sp. 2 hdc 
in ch-3 sp. Sl st in same ch-3 sp. 
Working in back loops only, sl st in 
each dc and each ch-1 (working 
into ch and not sp) to next ch-3 sp. 
Sl st in next ch-3 sp.** 2 hdc in ch-3 
sp. Rep from * to ** once. Fasten off. 
Large Motif only:
Note: Next rnd worked along 3 
sides only.
7th rnd: Sl st in next ch-3 sp. Ch 2. 
2 hdc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 hdc 
in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) to next ch-3 
sp.** (3 hdc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 
sp. Ch 1. (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) 
to next ch-3 sp. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 hdc) in 
next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to ** once. 
2 hdc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 2. Sl st in 
same ch-3 sp. Fasten off.
Proceed as follows in rows:
1st row: (RS). Join with sl st to top 
right ch-3 corner sp. Ch 3 (counts as 
dc). 1 dc in same ch-3 sp. (Ch 1. 3 dc 
in next ch-1 sp) to next ch-3 sp. 
Ch 1. 2 dc in ch-3 sp. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. 
(Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) to end of 
row. 1 dc in last dc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in 
same dc. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) 
to end of row. Ch 1. 2 dc in last dc. 
Turn.
4th row: As 2nd row. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Optional: If needed, to cover areas 
of Tote where Motifs will be placed, 
cut fabric approx 1" [2.5 cm] wider 
and 1" [2.5 cm] taller than area to 
be covered. 
Press ½" [1.25 cm] under to WS of 
fabric along all edges. Spray WS of fabric in a well-
ventilated area with temporary 
fabric adhesive following product 
instructions, or apply washable 
glue stick to all edges. Place WS of 
fabric on RS of Tote.
Attach Motifs: Carefully spray WS 
of Motif in a well-ventilated area 
with temporary fabric adhesive 
following product instructions 
being careful not to over-saturate 
Motifs. Place WS of Motif to RS of 
Tote. Alternatively, secure to Tote 
with heavy-duty sewing pins or 
clips.
Using a sewing machine or a hand-
sewing needle and matching 
thread, sew into place. 
Tip: Use a longer stitch length and 
a 90/14 or 100/16 machine needle 
for heavier canvas totes. 
Rep finishing steps for additional 
Motifs as needed.

materials: ECO-WAYS™ 'Bamboo Wool®': 8 skeins 3340 Rust A, 1 skein each 3525 Peacock B, 3650 Dill C and 3920 Cayenne D.
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Before Felting: 18½” wide x 15¾” high. After Felting: 11” wide x 11½” high.
gauge: 16 sts = 4”; 3 rows = 2¾” in cluster stitch before felting. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Cluster Stitch (multiple of 3 sts +1)
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1 (counts as first sc), (hdc, dc) in next sc,* skip 2 sc, (sc, hdc, dc) in next sc; repeat from * across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, (hdc, dc) in next st, *skip 2 sts, (sc, hdc, dc) in next sc; repeat from * to last 2 sts, skip 2, sc in top of turning ch.
Repeat Row 3 for Cluster stitch.

BACK
With A, ch 62.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn.
Beginning with Row 2, work in Cluster st until 38 rows have been worked.
Row 39: Sc in each st across – 61 sc.
Do not turn, place marker for beginning of round.
Round 1: Turn to work along side edge, work 52 sc along side edge, 3 sc in corner, 58 sc along opposite edge of beginning ch, 3 sc in corner, 52 sc along side edge, 3 sc in corner, work 58 sc along last edge, 3 sc in corner, slip st to first sc to join.
Round 2: Working in front loops only, sc in each sc around, working 3 sc in each corner sc, slip st to first sc to join.
Round 3: Working in both loops, slip st in each sc around, turn.
Last Row: Ch 1, sc in same st as slip st, working in back loops of Round 2 only, working 3 sc in each corner sc, sc in each st around 3 sides, leaving last side unworked for top edge. Fasten off.

FRONT
Work same as Back through Last Row. Do not fasten off, turn.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in sc, working 3 sc in each corner sc, along 3 sides, turn.
Repeat last row 4 more times. Fasten off.

FINISHING
With right sides together, sew through both loops of last row to join Front and Back.

Handle (make 2)
With A, ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn.
Rows 2 – 76: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Do not fasten off.
Turn to work along side edge, sc evenly around all sides of Handle, working 3 sc in each corner, slip st to first sc to join. Fasten off.

Flower (make 4)
With D, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: (Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc) around – 18 sc.
Round 4: (Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc) around – 24 sc.
Fasten off.
Round 5: Join B with a sc in front loop of first sc, working in front loops only, sc in each st around, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 6: Ch 1, 3 sc in same sc as slip st, *slip st in next sc, ch 1, 3 sc in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st in last sc to join – 12 petals.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in first unworked back loop of Round 5,*ch 2, (dc, tr) in next back loop, (tr, dc) in next back loop, ch 2, sc in next back loop; repeat from * around – 8 petals.
Fasten off.
Sew one end of each Handle along top edge of Front and Back of Bag.

Leaf (make 8)
With C, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next ch, hdc next 2 chs, dc next 2 chs, 6 dc in last ch, turn to work along opposite side of beginning ch, dc next 2 ch, hdc next 2 ch, sc last 2 ch, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc next 2 sts, hdc next 2 sts, dc next 2 sts, (2 dc next st) 6 times, dc next 2 sts, hdc next 2 sts, sc last 2 sts, slip st in first sc of Row 2.
Fasten off.
Arrange and sew Flowers and Leaves in place on Front of Bag. Weave in ends.

Felting
Machine-wash or hand-felt until stitch definition is minimal, using after felting measurements as a guide. Stretch and shape. Allow to air dry.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 672 Spring Green A, 528 Medium Purple B and 312 Black C.
abbreviations: V-Stitch = (Tr, ch 2, tr) all in same st.

Surface slip stitch = Make a slip knot but do not place it on hook. Hold slip knot on wrong side of fabric. Insert hook into fabric from right side to wrong side; place slip knot on hook and pull yarn to right side, leaving knot on wrong side. Insert hook from right side to wrong side thru any desired st or space, yo and draw a loop to right side. To end a line of surface slip sts, pull up a loop on the right side of fabric; remove hook from loop. Insert hook from wrong side to right side and into dropped loop; pull loop to wrong side. Cut yarn tail; place tail thru loop and pull taut.

Rev V-st (reverse V-st) = *Yo twice, insert hook into next st, yarn over and draw up a loop, (yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice**; skip 2 sts, repeat from * to ** once more, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Bag measures 12” x 12.5” x 5.5” deep at base.
gauge: 13 sts = 4”; 16 rounds = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Base
With A, ch 18.
Round 1: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each of next 15 chs, 3 sc in next ch, turn; working down the underside of the foundation chs, sc in each of next 15 chs, join with slip st in top of beginning sc—36 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, *2 sc in each of next 3 sts, sc in each of next 15 sts; repeat from * 1 more time; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, *(sc in next st, 2 sc in next st) 3 times, sc in each of next 15 sts; repeat from * 1 more time; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, *(sc in each of next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st) 3 times, sc in each of next 15 sts; repeat from * 1 more time; join with slip st in first sc—54 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, *(sc in each of next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st) 3 times, sc in each of next 15 sts; repeat from * 1 more time; join with slip st in first sc—60 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, *(sc in each of next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st) 3 times, sc in each of next 15 sts; repeat from * 1 more time; join with slip st in first sc—66 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, *(sc in each of next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st) 3 times, sc in each of next 15 sts; repeat from * 1 more time; join with slip st in first sc—72 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, *(sc in each of next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st) 3 times, sc in each of next 15 sts; repeat from * 1 more time; join with slip st in first sc—78 sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, *(sc in each of next 7 sts, 2 sc in next st) 3 times, sc in each of next 15 sts; repeat from * 1 more time; join with slip st in first sc—84 sc.
Round 10: Ch 1, *(sc in each of next 8 sts, 2 sc in next st) 3 times, sc in each of next 15 sts; repeat from * 1 more time; join with slip st in first sc—90 sc. Fasten off.
Sides
Round 1 background: Join B with sc in back loop only where previously fastened off, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Drop B.
Round 1 overlay: All sts on this round are worked in Round 10 of the Base. Join C with slip st in front unused loop of first st of Round 10 of Base, ch 4, skip 2 sts, tr in front loop only of next st (counts as Rev V-st), ch 4; *skip 1 st, Rev V-st, ch 4; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-4—18 ch-4 spaces, 18 Rev V-sts. Drop C.
Rounds 2-3 background: With B, sc in both loops of each st around; join with slip st in first sc—90 sc.
Round 4 background: With B, ch 1, sc in each of next 2 sts; *sc in back loop only of tr2tog of overlay round and into both loops of next background st, sc in each of next 4 sts of background round; repeat from * around, ending last repeat sc in each of last 2 sts of background round; join with slip st in first sc—90 sc. Drop B.
Round 4 overlay: All sts on this round are worked in sts of the previous overlay round. With C, ch 6 (counts as tr and ch 2), tr in front loop of same st, skip ch-4 space, ch 1, *V-stitch in front loop only, ch 1, skip ch-4 space; repeat from * 16 more times; join with slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-6—18 V-sts. Drop C.
Rounds 5-7 background: With B, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—90 sc.
Round 8 background: With B, ch 1, sc in back loop of first tr of overlay round and into first st in of background round, sc in next 2 sts of background round, sc in back loop only of next tr on overlay round and into both loops of next st of background round, sc in next st of background round, sc in back loop of next tr of overlay round and into next st of background round, sc in next 2 sts of background round; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with slip st in first sc. Drop B.
Round 8 overlay: All sts on this round are worked in sts of the previous overlay round. Ch 4, skip 2 ch, tr in front loop only of next st (counts as Rev V-st), ch 4; *skip 1 st, Rev V-st, ch 4; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-4. Drop C.
Round 9 background: With B, sc in both loops of each background st around; join with slip st in first sc—90 sc.
Repeat rounds 2-9 (background and overlay) 4 more times, then work rounds 2-8 once more, ending with Round 8 background—48 background rounds and 12 overlay rounds.
Straps (make 2)
Lay bag flat. There should be 9 “V’s” across side of bag. In the last overlay round, place marker for strap in the first leg of the 2nd V and in the first leg of the 8th V.
Round 1 (right side): Join C with sc in front loop only of the first marked V, sc in each of next 2 chs, sc in last tr—4 sc.
Round 2 (wrong side): Ch 1, turn; working through both loops on round 1 and corresponding stitches of last background round of bag, sc in each of next 4 sts—4 sc.
Rounds 3-64: Ch 1, turn; sc in each of next 4 sts.
Round 65 (right side): Ch 1, turn; working through both loops of round 64 and corresponding sts of last background round of bag at next marker, sc in each of next 4 sts—4 sc.
Round 66: Ch 1, turn; working in last overlay round, sc in tr, sc in each of next 2 ch, sc in next tr—4 sc. Fasten off.
Strap Edging
Round 1: With C and right side facing, place one sc in side of each of 66 rounds. Fasten off.
Repeat for opposite side of same strap and both side edges of opposite strap.
SPIDER
Body
With C, ch 4, slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with A in first sc —6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each of next 6 sc; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, *sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * 5 more times; join with slip st in first sc —18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, *sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—28 sc. Fasten off.
With C, surface slip st around body between Rounds 4 and 5. Fasten off.
Head
With A, ch 4, slip st to form ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st; join with slip st in first sc —12 sc. Fasten off.
With A and yarn needle, sew body and head onto bag.
Legs
With hook and A, surface slip st 4 legs on each side of body.
Weave in ends.

instructions:

With A, ch 38.

Row 3: Ssc in each st across to next 3-ssc group, 2 ssc in next st, ssc in next st, 2 ssc in next st, ssc in each st across to last 3 ssc group, 2 ssc in next st, ssc in next st, 2 ssc in next st, sl st in next st. Row 4: With right side facing, join yarn with sl st in st with marker, ch 1, ssc in each st around to last st, hdc in last st, do not join, work in a spiral. Place marker in last hdc.
Row 5-8: Ssc in each st around, moving marker up each round.
Move Marker back one st.
Row 9: With A, ssc in each of next 11 sts, change to B, *with B, ssc in each of next 11 sts, change to A**, with A, ssc in each of next 11 sts, change to B; repeat * around, ending last repeat at **—4 sections of 11 A sts; 4 sections of 11 B sts. First row of Chart complete.
Rows 10-30: Work in ssc following Chart for color changes. Work following Chart from A to B; repeat from A to B around.

With yarn needle and yarn, sew handles to bag making sure the handles are centered on the front and back of bag.

5 sc.

Row 5: Repeat Row 3—7 sc.
Rows 6-7: Repeat Row 4—11 sc.
Rows 8-31: Repeat Rows 5-7—43 sc. 
Rows 32-33: Repeat Row 3—43 sc. 
Row 34: Repeat Row 4—45 sc.
Rows 35-36: Repeat Row 3—45 sc. 
Row 37: Repeat Row 4—47 sc.
Rows 38-45: Repeat Row 3—47 sc.
Top Right Curve
Row 46: Ch 1, sc in first 23 sc; turn—23 
sc.
Row 47: Ch 1, sc2tog (see Special 
Stitches), sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog; 
turn—21 sts.
Row 48: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; 
turn—21 sc.
Row 49: Repeat Row 47—19 sts.
Row 50: Repeat Row 48—19 sc.
Rows 51-55: Repeat Row 47—9 sts. 
Fasten off.
Top Left Curve
Row 46 (Right Side): Go back to Row 
45; skip next sc on Row 45 and join with 
sc in next sc (see Special Techniques). 
Sc across remaining sc of Row 45; 
turn—23 sc.
Rows 47-55: Repeat Rows 47-55 of Top 
Right Curve; at end of last row, do not 
fasten off; turn.
Edge
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1; working 1 
sc in each sc or in the side of each row, 
sc in first 64 sts, 3 sc in back of ch at

of 3-sc group just made, sc in remaining

around, moving marker to st at center of

Gusset
Count 46 sts before and after marked st, 
place markers in both sts.
Round 1 (Right Side): Join with sc in 
marked st on left edge of Side; sc in

on right edge of Side; turn—93 sc.

Handle (make 2)
Ch 55.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each 
ch across; turn—54 sc.
Row 2: Slip st in front loop of each sc 
across; turn—54 sts.

Tassel
1. Wrap yarn around cardboard 20
times; cut one end.
2. Tie a long piece of yarn around center
of strands and pull strands down
away from knot.
3. Wrap a long piece of yarn around
piece about ¾" (2 cm) down from top.
Wrap strand tightly around, going
downward until wrapping is about 1"
(2.5 cm) long, knot ends together and
pull to the inside.
4. Trim lower ends of Tassel evenly.
5. Make a chain 15 chs long; fasten off.

With Right Sides together, sew front 
and back Sides of Heart together by 
sewing through both loops of sts on 
last rounds of Gussets; turn Right Side

Tassel.

Pompom (make 1)
1. Print out template provided with pattern for each disc (make 2 discs). Glue to cardboard. Allow to dry, then cut out along solid and dashed lines.
2. Cut a piece of yarn approx 8" [20.5 cm] long, place between 2 discs around the center cut out and hold discs together.

6. Pull the discs from the yarn. Fluff and trim Pompom into smooth round shape.
7. Attach Pompom to zipper pull as shown in picture.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 13½ [34 cm] wide x 16" [40 cm] long x 10" [25 cm] deep.
gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
Base of Back Pack is made first in continuous rounds with right side facing throughout. Body is worked in continuous rounds around Base. Straps are made separately, back and forth in rows, and sewn to finished Back Pack. 
Special Technique
Adjustable loop ring: Holding yarn a few inches from end, wrap around your finger. Do not remove wrap from finger, insert hook into wrap and draw up a loop of working yarn. Chain one to secure loop and remove ring from finger. Work stitches of first round in ring. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.

BACK PACK
Base
Round 1 (RS): Beginning with an adjustable loop ring, work 6 sc in ring – 6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 6: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times – 36 sc.
Round 7: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times – 42 sc.
Round 8: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] 6 times – 48 sc.
Round 9: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 7 sc] 6 times – 54 sc.
Round 10: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 8 sc] 6 times – 60 sc.
Round 11: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 9 sc] 6 times – 66 sc.
Round 12: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 10 sc] 6 times – 72 sc.
Round 13: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 11 sc] 6 times – 78 sc.
Round 14: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 12 sc] 6 times – 84 sc.
Round 15: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 13 sc] 6 times – 90 sc.
Round 16: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 14 sc] 6 times – 96 sc.
Round 17: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 15 sc] 6 times – 102 sc.
Round 18: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 16 sc] 6 times – 108 sc.
Round 19: Slip st in each sc around.

Body
Rounds 20-30: Sc in each sc around.
Round 31: Hdc in each sc around.
Rounds 32-37: Hdc in each hdc around.
Decrease Round 38: [Hdc2tog, hdc in next 16 hdc] 6 times – 102 hdc.
Rounds 39-53: Hdc in each hdc around.
Decrease Round 54: [Hdc2tog, hdc in next 15 hdc] 6 times – 96 hdc.
Rounds 55-57: Hdc in each hdc around.
Round 58: Sc in each hdc around.
Rounds 59-60: Sc in each sc around.
Round 61: [Ch 2, skip next 2 sc for straps, sc in next 46 sc] 2 times. 
Round 62-64: Sc in each st around – 96 sc. Fasten off.

Straps (Make 2)
Ch 120.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch across, turn – 119 sc.
Rows 2-4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Holding both straps together, layering one strap on top of the other, thread one end of both straps from outside in through one of the ch-2 opening at top of bag. Sew end of straps down on the inside of the bag. Making sure straps do not twist, keeping straps together, thread opposite ends over top of bag from the inside out through the other ch-2 opening.
Flatten bag, folding the base up making it easier to see the slip stitch edge at base.
Pull up so that the ends of both straps are even with the bottom of bag, separate straps and position ends approximately 13" [33 cm] apart. Line up bottom of strap with the slip stitch edge and sew in place. Sew sides of beginning ends of straps together, approximately 2" [5 cm]. Sew across strap at 2" [5 cm] mark.
Weave in ends.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (Ombres: 2 oz/56.7 g; 102 yds/93 m) Poppy Ombre (02528) 6 balls or 600 yds/546 m
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) Susan Bates® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Popcorn = Work 5 dc into same stitch or space. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back into first dc of 5 dc group. Pull dropped loop through st. Ch 1 to secure popcorn.
measurements: Approx 20" [51 cm] deep x 20" [51 cm] wide, excluding handles.
gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
MOTIFS  (make 13)
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
• Join all rnds with sl st to top of ch 3.
Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring. See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 3 dc in ring. Ch 1. (4 dc in ring. Ch 1) 3 times. Join.
2nd rnd: Sl st in each of next 3 dc and next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. (3 dc. Ch 1. 4 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *(4 dc. Ch 1. 4 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * twice more. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in each of next 3 dc and next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. (1 dc. Popcorn. 2 dc) in same sp as last sl st. Skip next dc. *1 dc in each dc to next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each dc to 1 dc before next ch-1 sp. Skip next dc. (2 dc. Popcorn. 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * twice more. 1 dc in each dc to next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each dc to 1 dc before first ch-1 sp. Join.

4th rnd: Sl st in next dc and next popcorn. Ch 3. (1 dc. Popcorn. 2 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *Skip 1 dc. 1 dc in each dc to 1 dc before next popcorn. Skip next dc. (2 dc. Popcorn. 2 dc) in top of popcorn. Rep from * twice more. Skip 1 dc. 1 dc in each dc to 1 dc before next popcorn. Join.
Rep 4th rnd until Motif measures 7" [18 cm] square. Fasten off.

Straps
Ch 75.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 74 sc.
2nd to 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off at end of last row.

FINISHING
Pin all pieces to measurements. Cover with a damp cloth leaving cloth to dry. With WS tog, following diagrams, join Motifs tog, matching lettered sides and working in sc through back loops only. Edging: With RS facing, join yarn with sl st to any corner st. 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around, working 3 sc in corners. Join with sl to to top of first sc. Fasten off. Sew Straps in position as shown in photo.

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Main Color (MC) Sand (10014) 2 balls or 257 yds/235 m
Bernat® Blanket Small Ball™ (5.3 oz/150 g; 108 yds/98 m) Contrast A Taupe (00029) 1 ball or 18 yds/16 m
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 10" [25.5 cm] diameter x 4½" [11.5 cm] deep, excluding straps.
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
FRONT
See diagram on page 2.
**With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 56 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 64 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 72 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 80 sc.**
PM in 27th and 54th sts for Ear placement, and in 80th st of last rnd for Assembly and Border.
Fasten off, leaving long yarn tail.
BACK
Work from ** to ** as given for Front. Do not fasten off at end of 10th rnd.
PM in 7th, 35th, 46th and 73rd sts of last rnd for Strap placement.
Cont as follows:
11th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
12th to 14th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
15th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 30 sc. Ch 20. Skip next 20 sc. 1 sc in each of last 30 sc. Join. 60 sc and 1 ch-20 sp.
16th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 30 sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 ch. Ch 8. Sl st in first ch of ch-8 (Toggle loop made). 1 sc in each of next 10 ch. 1 sc in each of last 30 sc. Join. 80 sc.
17th to 19th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
PM in last st for Assembly.
Fasten off.
STRAPS (Make 2)
With MC, and leaving long yarn tail, ch 6.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 5 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until Strap measures approx 16" [40.5 cm]. Fasten off, leaving long yarn tail.
EARS (Make 2)
With MC, ch 2.
1st row: (RS). 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc across. Turn. 8 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 12 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten off, leaving long yarn tail. 16 sc.
Align both Ears, RS up, centered over designated markers on Front. Using long yarn tail, and working into front loops only of Front, sew Ears to Front, as shown.
NOSE
With A, ch 2.
1st row: (RS). 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. 3 sc in next sc. Working around sts at ends of rows, 1 sc in each of next 2 rows. Working in rem loop of foundation ch, 3 sc in next ch. Working around sts at ends of rows, 1 sc in each of next 3 rows. 2 sc in same sp as first sc. Join.
Fasten off, leaving long yarn tail.
With RS facing and using long yarn tail, sew Nose to Front as shown.
With A, embroider eyes and mouth to Front, as shown.
FINISHING
Align assembly markers on Backpack Front and Back with WS tog. Using long yarn tail from Front, working through back loops only of Front, sew Front and Back tog. Do not remove marker on Front.
Using long yarn tails at beg of Straps, sew both Straps evenly across 10 rem loops between 35th and 46th markers of Back.
Using long yarn tails at ends of Straps, sew each Strap at 7th and 73rd markers of Back, working in rem loops over marked sts and 2 sts on either side.
With A, sew Toggle to Back, aligned with Toggle Loop and on opposite side of ch-20 sp, as shown.
Border: Join A with sl st at marker in rem loop of Front.
1st rnd: *Loosely sl st in each rem loop of Front to next Ear. Working in front loops only, loosely sl st in each of next 16 sc of Ear. Rep from * once more. Loosely sl st in each rem loop of Front. Fasten off.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Contrast A Hot Orange (01628) 2 balls or 230 yds/210 m
Contrast B Ecru (00004) 3 balls or 350 yds/320 m
Contrast C Black (00002) 1 ball or 17 yds/16 m
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 13" [33 cm] wide x 16" [40.5 cm] long, excluding handles.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
BAG
With A, ch 49.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 98 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 46 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 104 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). 1 hdc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
Rep last rnd until Bag measures 8" [20.5 cm]. Break A, join B.
With B, cont even in rnds until Bag measures 16" [40.5 cm]. Fasten off.

HANDLES (make 2)
With B, ch 105.
1st row:  1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 104 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Handle measures 2" [5 cm] wide. Fasten off.

EARS (make 2)
With A, ch 12. 
1st row:  1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 11 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 9 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 7 sts.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 5 sts.
6th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.
7th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog.
Fasten off, leaving a long end.

EYES (make 2)
Outer Eye
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc. Fasten off.
Pupil (make 2)
With C, ch 2.
Work from 1st rnd to 3rd rnd as given for Outer Eye. Fasten off.
Highlight Pupil with straight stitch using B as shown in photo. Sew Pupil to Outer Eye. 

NOSE
With C, ch 4.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of last 2 ch. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Do not turn. Edging:  Ch 1. Working around Nose, work 1 rnd of sc, having 1 sc in each side, and 2 sc in each ‘corner’ of Nose to make a triangle. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end.

FINISHING
Sew Handles to Bag as shown in picture. Sew Ears to front of Bag at top edge of Cat’s head. Sew Eyes and Nose to front of Bag. Embroider snout and whiskers with C using outline stitch.

pattern_name: THE "MONSTER ATE MY HOMEWORK" TOTE BAG
materials: Lily® sugar’n cream® (70.9 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds)
contrast A Hot Green (01712) 105 m/116 yds or 1 ball
contrast B Grape (00071) 250 m/276 yds or 3 balls

contrast D White (00001) 38 m/42 yds or 1 ball

instructions:
bag (make 2 pieces alike)
note: Ch 2 for turning ch does not count as hdc.
With A, ch 47.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 45 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 2" [5 cm]. Join B.
With B, rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 10" [25.5 cm]. Join A.
With A, rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 12" [30.5 cm]. Fasten off.
mouth Pocket
With C, ch 18.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 17 sc.
2nd to 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: (Folding row). Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
6th to 8th rows: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Place marker at end of last row.
9th row: Ch 1. Fold work along 5th row. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each sc and rem loop of foundation ch to end of row. Turn. (first pencil pocket made).
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from marked row measures 5½" [14 cm], ending on a WS row.
next row: (RS). Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Place marker at end of row.
next 3 rows: Ch 1. Working through both loops, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
next row: (RS). (Folding row). Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
next 3 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Fasten off at end of last row.
Fold work along last Folding row worked. Thread yarn through needle and sew edge to rem loops of marked row (second pencil pocket made).
Teeth (make 2)
With D, ch 26.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 25 sc.
First Tooth: *1st row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. Sc2tog. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off.*
second Tooth: **Join D with sl st to next unworked sc. Work from * to * as given for First Tooth.**
Third to Fifth Teeth: Rep from ** to ** 3 times more. 5 teeth made.
Sew Teeth to Mouth Pocket as shown in picture, taking care not to sew side pencil pockets closed.
eyes
With D, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc. Fasten off.
handles (make 2)
With B, ch 69.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 67 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 4 times more.
Fold work in half lengthwise. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each hdc and rem loop of foundation ch to end of row. Fasten off.
Finishing
With WS of Bag pieces tog, join A with sl st to top left corner. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 rnd of sc evenly around side edges and bottom, having 3 sc in each bottom corner. Fasten off.
