materials: Coats® “Crème De La Crème™”: 2 balls 1 White A, 1 ball 205 Golden Yellow B.
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: Round 1 = 2½” across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the specified gauge.
instructions:
SQUARE (Make 8)
With B, ch 6, slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1: (Ch 3, 2 dc in ring, turn, ch 3, dc in next 2 sts, dc in top of turning ch, turn – beginning petal made), holding petal to front, [(work 3 dc in ring, turn, ch 3, dc in next 3 sts, turn – petal made)] 7 times, slip st to top of beginning ch – 8 petals.
Fasten off.
Round 2: Join A in any space between petals, (ch 3, 2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, ch 2, sc in next space between petals, ch 2, [(3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next space, ch 2, sc in next space, ch 2] 3 more times, slip st to top of beginning ch.
Round 3: Slip st to ch-2 corner space, *(3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in corner ch-space, [ch 1, 3 dc in next space] twice, ch 1; repeat from * 3 more times, slip st to first dc to join.
Round 4: Slip st to corner ch-space, *(3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in corner ch-space, [ch 1, 3 dc in next space] 3 times, ch 1; repeat from * 3 more times, slip st to first st to join.
Round 5: Slip st to corner ch-space, *(3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in corner ch-space, [ch 1, 3 dc in next space] 4 times, ch 1; repeat from * 3 more times, slip st to first st to join.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew 4 Squares together to make a Larger Square for Front. In same manner, sew remaining 4 Squares together for Back.
EDGING
Round 1: Join A in any corner space of Front, *(3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in corner space, [ch 1, 3 dc in next space] 5 times, [2 dc in next corner space] twice, [ch 1, 3 dc in next space] 5 times, ch 1; repeat from * around; slip st to first dc to join.
Round 2: Slip st to corner space, *(3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in corner space, [ch 1, 3 dc in next space] to next corner; repeat from * around, slip st to first dc to join.
Fasten off.
Joining: With wrong sides of Front and Back pieces together, join A in any corner space, working through both layers, sc pieces together along 3 sides.
Fasten off.
Top Edge
Round 1: Join A in any st, sc in each st around, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 2: [Ch 5, skip next st, slip st in next st] around, slip st to first st to join.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

pattern_name: BERNAT HANDICRAFTER COTTON TWISTS CROCHET BAG

instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as st. 
FRONT and BACK (make alike).
Ch 40.

Next 6 rows:Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 52 hdc at end of last row.
Next row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row for 10 ins [25.5 cm], ending with a WS row. 
**Shape strap: Next row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 17 hdc. (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - Hdc2tog made. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 18 sts.
Next row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.

With WS of work facing, join yarn with sl st to first st.
Work from ** to ** as given above, noting RS becomes WS.

With WS of Front and Back tog, sew bottom and side seams to top of Straps. 
Decorative Flap: Ch 17. 
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. 15 hdc.

materials: RED HEART® Reflective™: 3 balls 8251 Neon Orange B, 1 ball each 8671 Neon Green A and 8012 Black C
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5.5mm [US I-9] and 6mm [US J-10]
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Bag measures 10” wide x 12” high (25.5 x 30.5 cm), not including handles.
gauge: 14 sts = 4” (10 cm); 15 rounds = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet with larger hook. Gauge is not critical for this project but tension should be tight.
instructions:
Round 2: Sc in each st around; change to B; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 3: Sc in each st around; change to A; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Sc in each st around; change to B; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 5 and 6: Repeat Rounds 3 and 4. Cut A at the end of Round 6.
Rounds 7–32: Sc in each st around.
Round 33: Sc in each st around; change to A; join with slip st in first sc. Do not cut B.
Rounds 34 and 35: Repeat Rounds 2 and 3.
Round 36: Repeat Round 2.
Rounds 37 and 38: Repeat Round 3 twice.
Round 39: Repeat Round 2. Cut A.
Round 40: Repeat Round 3. Fasten off.
Handles
Lay bag flat and place stitch marker on stitch at left edge of last round.
Round 41: Join A with sc in marked st, sc in next 9 sts, ch 14, skip next 13 sts, sc in next 19 sts, ch 14, skip next 13 sts, sc in next 9 sts; change to B; join with slip st in first sc—38 sc and 2 ch-13 spaces.
Round 42: Sc in each sc to first ch-14 space, 30 sc in first ch-14 space, sc in each sc to next ch-14 space, 30 sc in next ch-14 space, sc in each remaining sc; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 43: Join B with slip st in any st, slip st in each st around; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off.

abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E = color A, B, C, D, E
st st = Stockinette st (k on right side rows, p on wrong side rows)
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Finished bag measures 12½” tall x 18” wide.
gauge: 18 sts = 4”; 22 rows = 4” in St st unfelted.
instructions:
PURSE
Front
With A, cast on 90 sts. 
Begin with a k row, work 4 rows even in St st.
Begin Color Pattern
Begin with Row 1, work color pattern from chart until Row 92 has been completed.
With A, work 4 rows in St st. Bind off.
Back
With A, cast on 90 sts.
Begin with a k row, work even in St st until piece measures same as front. Bind off.
sides and Bottom of Purse
With A, cast on 25 sts.
Begin with a k row, work even in St st until piece fits down one side edge, across bottom edge and up opposite side edge of back piece. Bind off.
FINIsHING
Embroidery
Stem Stitch vines and make French knots following chart for placement. Weave in yarn ends.
Crochet Handles and Trim
Holding 4 strands of B together, crochet 3 chains, each 6’ long.
seam and Prepare for Felting
Pin bottom and sides to front and back pieces, leaving top 2” on each side unattached (will be trimmed after felting). With A, sew in place.
FELTING
Place chains in a mesh laundry bag or a pillow case. Set a washer to hot, heavy-duty cycle, and low water. Add the purse and bag with chains. Run one wash (agitation only) cycle, removing pieces several times during process to check progress. Two or more cycles may be needed before satisfied results are achieved. Remove pieces when measurements are correct, pieces are stiff to the touch, and the stitch definition is nearly invisible. Rinse in cool water to stop the felting process. Flatten out chains so they are uniform in size and length. Shape the purse by squaring off the bottom and sides. If possible, dry the purse on a form that is the correct proportion, like a cardboard box. This will help ensure the purse maintains its crisp edges. Dry pieces thoroughly away from heat. Trim excess (if necessary) from side pieces left unattached when seaming. Fold pieces in half toward inside of purse at top edge to form a pleat, whip stitch together. Whip stitch front and back pieces together from top edge of purse to pleat.
With B, whip stitch length of chain around sides and bottom of front and back of purse beginning at top edge working down side, across bottom and up opposite side to top edge.
With C, embroider blanket stitch across top edges of front and back of purse. With crochet hook, make 1 sc in first blanket st, * ch 3, 1 sc in same ch as last sc, 1 sc in next blanket st; repeat from * across.
Attach Handles
* Holding 3 strands of chain together, each approximately 30” long, thread one end through first D-Ring 1½”. Wrap an 8” length of B around chains and ends to secure and close pocket. Repeat for second D-Ring. Attach these 2 D-Rings to purse front. Repeat for purse back.
Optional Interfacing
For Interfacing, whip stitch each 17” x 10½” piece of plastic canvas (front and back) to 17” x 3” piece (bottom) to make purse form. Insert form into purse. Tack pieces into place, being sure bottom fits correctly and securely before tacking in place.
Optional Lining
Fold fabric in half lengthwise. Stitch ½” side seams from the top down on each side. Turn top raw edge over ½” and press. Insert lining into purse, folding bottom side edges into a triangle to form flat bottom. Tack top of triangle to side seam on each side. 
Insert magnetic closures following manufacturer’s instructions to center top edges of lining. Sew around top edges to attach lining to purse.

(Popcorn in next dc. Ch 1) twice. Popcorn in next dc. Rep from * twice more. Ch 5. Join with sl st to top of beg popcorn.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Beg popcorn in same sp as sl st. Ch 1. Popcorn in next ch-1 sp. *Ch 3. 3 dc in center ch of next ch-5 sp. Ch 3.** Popcorn in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Popcorn in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st to top of beg popcorn.
4th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Beg popcorn in same sp as sl st. *Ch 4. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 3. 3 dc in next dc. Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 4.** Popcorn in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to **. Join with sl st to top of beg popcorn.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *4 sc in next ch-4 sp. 1 sc in next dc. 3 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 5. Miss next 3 dc. 3 sc in next ch-3 sp. 1 sc in next dc. 4 sc in next ch-4 sp.** 1 sc in next popcorn. Rep from * 3 times more, ending last rep at **. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). *1 dc in each of next 8 sc. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-5 sp. 1 dc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * 3 times more, omitting 1 dc at end of last rep. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.

Join 2 Motifs: Place RS of Motifs tog. Working through both thicknesses, join yarn with sl st through corresponding corner ch-3 sps. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Working through back loops only, sl st in each sc to next corner ch-3 sp. 1 sc in last corner ch-3 sp. Fasten off.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 8. Miss next 5 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *(4 sc. Ch 3. Sl st in last sc worked – picot made. 4 sc) in next ch-8 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten off.
Top Edging: With smaller hook, ch 11. 1st row: 1 dc in 9th ch from hook. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 8. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Turn. Rep 2nd row 62 times more. Do not turn at end of last row.
Next row: (RS). Working down side of previous rows, ch 3. *(4 sc. Picot. 4 sc) in next ch-8 sp. Rep from * across. Fasten off.
Join to Bag: Next row: With RS facing and working into opposite side of edging, join yarn with sl st in first ‘unworked’ ch-8 sp. Ch 1. (4 sc. Ch 1. Sl st to corner ch-3 sp of Motif at side seam of top edge. Ch 1. Sl st in last sc worked. 4 sc) in same ch-8 sp as last sl st. *[(4 sc. Ch 1. Miss next 5 sc of Motif. Sl st in next sc of Motif. Ch 1. Sl st in last sc worked. 4 sc) in next ch-8 sp] 3 times.** (4 sc. Ch 1. Miss next 5 sc of Motif. Sl st in next corner ch-3 sp of Motif. Ch 1. Sl st in last sc worked. 4 sc) in next ch-8 sp. Rep from * around, ending last rep at **. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Sew edging tog at side seam.
Straps (make 2): With 2 strands of yarn held tog and larger hook, ch 130. 1st rnd: 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Working into rem loops along opposite side of ch, work 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Ch 1. Do not fasten off. Fold Strap in half lengthwise with RS facing each other (WS of last rnd will show). Join Strap by working 1 sc through tops of corresponding dc and foundation ch to end of row. Fasten off. Sew ends of Straps in position 3" [7.5 cm] from side edges as shown in photo.

abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook

instructions:
Notes:
Panels with Handles are worked back and forth in rows, then sewn together.
Beginning chain-1 is intentionally omitted in Rows 2–6 of Handle so edges will curve evenly.
Outer Pocket is made separately and sewn to Front.
TOTE
Panel (make 2)
Ch 39.
Row 1 (right side): Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch across to last ch, 2 sc in last ch, turn—40 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st across to last st, 2 sc in last st, turn—48 sc.
Rows 6–36: Ch 1, skip first st, 2 sc in next st, *skip next st, 2 sc in next st; rep from * across, turn.
Fasten off.
Handle
Row 1: With right side facing, skip first 12 sts, join yarn with slip st in next st, ch 1, sc2tog in same st as join and in next st, sc in next 20 sts, sc2tog; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—22 sc.
Rows 2–6: Sc2tog in first 2 sts, sc in each st across to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—12 sc.
Rows 7–36: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Fasten off.
Pocket
Ch 16.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—15 sc.
Rows 2–19: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY & FINISHING
With wrong sides of Panels held together, sew sides and bottom together.
Sew top edges of Handles together.
Trim (work twice)
Round 1: With right side of Tote facing, join yarn with sc at seam; working in unworked sts of Row 36 of Panel and in ends of rows of Handle, sc evenly spaced around opening; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Pocket Trim
Row 1: With right side facing and working in ends of rows, join yarn with sc in Row 19, sc in each row to Row 1, 3 sc in Row 1; working in opposite side of foundation ch, skip first ch, sc in each ch across to last ch, skip last ch; working in ends of rows of other side, 3 sc in Row 1, sc in each row across; leave remaining sts of Row 19 unworked. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Referring to photo as a guide for placement, sew Pocket to front Panel.
Weave in ends.

instructions:
USING THIS GUIDE
Click on the underlined words throughout the pattern to access our library of helpful tools.

NOTES
• Motifs begin with Color 1 (shortest color rep) from center of pull-skein, leaving a 4" [10 cm] tail to weave in.
• Each color aligns with 1 round (rnd) in the Motif with 5 colors in total. If too much color is left at end of rnd, pull back some stitches (sts) and slightly loosen gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change. If too little color is left, pull back some sts and slightly tighten gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change.
• When Motif is complete, cut yarn where Color 5 (longest color rep) ends, leaving a tail for weaving in.
• Begin next Motif with Color 1 and repeat 5 rnds for each Motif.
• Granny Square how to: https://www.yarnspirations.com/pages/how-to-granny-square-guide

MOTIF
Make 4.
With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring. See diagram.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
4th and 5th rnds: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
Fasten off.
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as double crochet (dc).
• Ch 6 at beg of rnds counts as dc and ch-3 sp.
• Join all rnds with slip stitch (sl st) to 3rd ch of ch-6 unless otherwise indicated.

ASSEMBLY
Join Motifs: Hold WS of 2 Motifs tog with sts aligned. Join white yarn with sl st in ch-2 corners of aligned Motifs at top right. Ch 1. Working in back loops only, work 1 sc in each dc through both thicknessess. Fasten off. 
Join Motifs as shown in diagram:
Top edging: 1st rnd: (RS). Join yarn (any section of color) with sl st to top edge of Bag at right corner. Ch 1. Work 1 single crochet (sc) in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Using sewing thread and needle, sew in zipper along top edge opening.
STRAP
With any color section of yarn, ch 109.
1st rnd: 2 dc in 4th ch from hook. *Skip next 2 ch. 3 dc in next ch. Rep from * to last 3 ch. Skip next 2 ch. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in last ch. Working along opposite side of ch, work 3 dc in each ch-2 sp (working around foundation ch), to last ch. 3 dc in first ch of rnd (same ch as first 2 dc). Ch 2. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as joining sl st. 1 sc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Sew Strap to Bag along top edge at either end as shown.
We love seeing your makes! Share your photos using #YARNSPO and tag us @yarnspirations on Instagram or find us on Facebook.
Notes: 
• Join Motifs tog using just white sections of yarn.
• To work edging and Strap, use yarn as ‘self-striping’ yarn, allowing colors to change as they appear.

gauge:
Large Motif = 3½ ins [9 cm]
12 dc and 6 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] with smaller crochet hook.
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 does not counts as hdc.

SCARF
First Large Motif
With smaller hook and A, ch 4. Join in a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 12 sc in ring. Join B with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: With B, ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 1 dc in next sc. *2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join C with sl st to top of ch 3. 18 dc.
3rd rnd: With C, ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. *2 hdc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off. 36 hdc.

Second Large Motif (joining 2 Large motifs)
Work 1st and 2nd rnds as given for First Large Motif.
3rd rnd: With C, ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 2 hdc in each of next 8 dc. Join with sl st to any hdc of First Large Motif – Joint I made. 2 hdc in each dc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off. 36 hdc.
First set of 2 Large Motifs complete. Make 11 more sets.

**Medium Motif (joining to 4 Large Motifs).
With MC, ch 4. Join in a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). 1 dc in ring. Ch 1. *Join with sl st in 6th hdc of First Large Motif before Joint I – Joint II made. (1 dc. Ch 1) twice in ring. Miss 5 hdc after Joint I on Second Large Motif. Join with sl st to next hdc of Second Large Motif – Joint III made*. (1 dc. Ch 1) 4 times in ring. Rep from * to * on second set of Large Motifs. (1 dc. Ch 1) 3 times in ring. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch 4. Fasten off. 12 dc.
First Small Motif (Joining to 2 Large and Medium Motifs)
With A, ch 4. Join in a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in ring. Join with sl st to 4th hdc before Joint II of second set of Large Motifs - Joint IV made. 3 dc in ring. Miss (dc, ch 1, dc, ch 1) of Medium Motif from Joint II. Join with sl st to next dc of Medium Motif - Joint V made. 3 dc in ring. Miss 3 dc of Large Motif from Joint III. Join with sl st to Large Motif - Joint VI made. 3 dc in ring. Join with sl st to first dc. Fasten off. 12 dc.
Rep for Second Small Motif, joined to opposite side of Medium Motif. **
Rep from ** to ** until all 12 sets of Large Motifs have been joined.

Border: With RS of Scarf facing miss 3 dc of First Large Motif from Small Motif Join, join MC with sl st to 4th hdc of First Large Motif. Working into back loops only, ch 3 (counts as dc). **1 hdc in next hdc. (1 sc in next hdc. Ch 1. Miss next hdc) twice. 1 sc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. 1 dc in next hdc. Ch 2 (corner). 1 dc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. (1 sc in next hdc. Ch 1. Miss next hdc) twice. 1 sc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. 1 dc in next hdc. Ch 2. ** Miss 4 hdc from Joint I of 2nd Large Motif. 1 dc in 5th hdc of 2nd Large Motif. Rep from ** to ** once more. ***Miss 2 dc from Joint of Small Motif. 1 tr in each of next 3 dc of Small Motif. Ch 2. Miss next 3 hdc of Large Motif from Joint. 

HAT
Motif I
**With smaller hook and A, ch 4. Join in a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 12 sc in ring. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join B with sl st to any sc. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in next sc. *(2 dc in next sc) twice. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 20 dc. Fasten off.**
3rd rnd: Join C with sl st to any dc. Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 3 dc. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 3. (1 dc in next dc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 dc. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 3) 3 times. 1 dc in next dc. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.

Motifs II to V (make 4)
Work from ** to ** as given for Motif I.
3rd rnd: Join C with sl st to any dc. Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 3 dc. 1 dc in next dc. (Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 dc. 1 dc in next dc) twice. Ch 1. Join with sl st to corner of previous motif. Ch 1. 1 dc in next dc. 1 hdc in next dc. Miss next dc and hdc of previous motif. Join with sl st to 2nd hdc of joining motif. 1 hdc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. 1 dc in next dc. Miss next hdc and dc of joining motif.  Join with sl st to corner of previous motif. Ch 1. 1 dc in next dc. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.

Motif VI
Work from ** to ** as given for Motif I.
3rd rnd: Join C with sl st to any dc. Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in next dc. *Ch 1. Join with sl st to corner of previous motif. Ch 1. 1 dc in next dc. 1 hdc in next dc. Miss next dc and hdc in previous motif. Join with sl st to 2nd hdc of previous motif. 1 hdc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Miss next hdc and dc of previous motif. Join with sl st to corner of previous motif.* Ch 1. 1 dc in next dc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to *, joining to Motif I instead of previous motif. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.
These 6 motifs form crown of hat.

Top of Hat
Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw loop in next color through 2 loops on hook to complete st and proceed in next color.
1st rnd: (RS). Join MC with sl st to sp between motifs. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as last sl st. Work 8 hdc across first motif. *1 hdc in sp between motifs. 8 hdc across next motif. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 54 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join A with sl st to first hdc. Break MC.
3rd rnd: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 8 hdc. Miss next hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. Miss next hdc. Rep from * around. Join B with sl st to first hdc. 48 hdc. Break A.
4th rnd: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 7 hdc. Miss next hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. Miss next hdc. Rep from * around. Join C with sl st to first hdc. 42 hdc. Break B.
5th rnd: With C, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 6 hdc. Miss next hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. Miss next hdc. Rep from * around. Join MC with sl st to first hdc. 36 hdc. Break C.
6th rnd: With MC, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 5 hdc. Miss next hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Miss next hdc. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first hdc. 30 hdc.
7th rnd: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 2 hdc. Miss next hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Miss next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 20 hdc.
8th rnd: Ch 2. Yoh and draw up a loop in each of first 4 hdc. Yoh and draw through all 4 loops on hook. (draw up a loop in each of next 4 hdc. Yoh and draw through all 5 loops on hook) 4 times. Fasten off.

Edging: 1st rnd: Join MC with sl st between any 2 motifs at lower edge. Ch 1. Work 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Work 8 sc across motif and 1 sc in sp between motifs. Rep from * around Hat. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Work 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

BAG (make 2 pieces alike)
Stripe Pattern
Work 1 row with MC.
Work 1 row with A.
Work 1 row with B.
Work 1 row with C.
These 4 rows form Stripe Pat.
With smaller hook and MC, ch 31.
Foundation row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. *Ch 1. Miss next ch. 1 dc in each of next 4 ch. Rep from * to end of ch. Join A in last dc. Ch 3. Turn. 30 sts.
1st row: With A, miss first dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *Ch 1. Miss next ch 1 sp. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. Rep from * to end of row. Join B in last dc. Ch 3. Turn. Last row forms pat.
2nd row of Stripe pat is complete.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat (beg with 3rd row), work a further 10 rows in pat, ending with RS facing for next row. Place markers at each end of last row.
Shape top: 13th row: With MC, miss first dc. (Yoh and draw up a loop in next dc. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook– d2tog made. Pat to last 3 sts. dc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 dc in last dc. Join A, ch 3. Turn.
14th row: With A, miss first dc. dc2tog over next 2 dc. Pat to last 3 dc. dc2tog over next 2 dc. 1 dc in last dc. Join B, ch 3. Turn.
15th row: Miss first dc. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Miss next ch 1 sp. dc2tog over next 2 dc. Pat to last 5 sts. dc2tog over next 2 dc. Ch 1. Miss next ch 1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Join C, ch 3. Turn.
16th row: Miss first dc. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Miss next ch 1 sp. dc2tog over next 2 dc. Pat to last 5 sts. dc2tog over next 2 dc. Ch 1. Miss next ch 1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Join MC, ch 3. Turn.
17th row: Miss first dc. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Miss next ch 1 sp. dc2tog over next 2 dc. Pat to last 5 sts. dc2tog over next 2 dc. Ch 1. Miss next ch 1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Join A, ch 3. Turn.
18th, 19th, 20th and 21st rows: Miss first dc. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Miss next ch 1 sp. 1 dc in next dc. Pat to last 4 sts. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Miss next ch 1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Ch 3. Turn. Omit turning ch at end of last row. Fasten off.

Handles: With larger hook and 3 strands of MC, work 1 rnd of sc around each ring. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Fold last 2 rows of Bag to inside and sew over Handles to form casing. With MC, sew Bag tog, beg and ending at markers.
Fringe: Cut lengths of A, B and C, 9 ins [23 cm] long. Taking 2 strands each of A, B and C tog, knot into fringe across lower edge of Bag in each corner, then at every point where ch 1 sp occurs in pat. Trim fringe evenly.

instructions:
1st row:  1 single crochet (sc) in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 27 sc.

Gauge Swatch Pattern (Pat)
With A make a Slip Knot: Make a loop with yarn and fold it on itself to make a pretzel shape. Then pull through to make slip knot.
With A, chain (ch) 28.

Chain:
Yarn over hook (Yoh) and draw up a loop – 1 chain made.
Repeat (rep) last step 27 times more – 28 chains made.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Repeat (rep) 2nd row until work from beginning (beg) measures 6" [15 cm].
Fasten off.
Measure your completed Gauge Swatch to determine if 18 single crochet (sc) across = 4" [10 cm] and 23 rows high = 4" [10 cm]. If you have fewer than 18 sc across, your crochet is loose and you will need to change to a smaller hook to achieve correct gauge. If you have more than 18 sc across, your crochet is tight and you will need to change to a larger hook to achieve correct gauge.

Notes:
• Stitches (sts) are worked into back loops only throughout.
• Worked over foundation chain (ch) multiple of 14 ch +2.
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.

TOTE Stripe Pattern (Pat)
With A, work 4 rows. Join B. Break A.
With B, work 4 rows. Join C. Break B.
With C, work 4 rows. Join A. Break C.
These 12 rows form Stripe Pat. See diagram on page 6.

1st row: [Right Side (RS)]. 2 single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook.
With A make a slip knot and loosely chain (ch) 72.
*1 sc in each of next 6 ch. Skip 1 ch. 1 sc in each of next 6 ch. 3 sc in next ch.
Repeat (rep) from * to end of chain, ending last rep with 2 sc in last ch. Turn. 76 sc.

2nd row: Ch 1. Working into back loops only of each st, 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 3 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row, ending last rep with 2 sc in last sc. Turn.

Keeping continuity (cont) of Stripe Pat, rep 2nd row until work measures approx 20" [51 cm] long measured from valley to valley, ending on any 4th row of Stripe Pat. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

NOTE: Changing Colors (first change happens after 4th row)
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.

Peaked Edge Handle:
Attach handle by wrapping 5 peaks around handle and fastening securely in place on inside of Bag.
FINISHING Aligning first and last row so that peaks are even, sew side seams together (tog), using whipstitch, from bottom fold up to bottom line of valleys approx 1" [2.5 cm] from top edge.
Valley Edge Handle:
Attach handle by wrapping 4 central peaks around handle and fastening securely in place on inside of Bag.
Wrap two half edge peaks to inside and fasten securely inside Bag.

instructions:
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.
• Work into horizontal bumps at back of foundation chain for 1st row.

BOTTOM OF PURSE
First Wedge: With A and Tunisian hook, ch 24.
1st row: Forward pass: (Right to left). Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each rem ch to end of chain, leaving all loops on hook. 24 sts on hook. PM on last st. Do not turn.

Return pass:  (Left to right after working Forward pass of each row). Yoh and draw through last loop only (for edge st). *Yoh and draw through 2 loops. Rep from * until 1 loop rem on hook. Do not turn.

**2nd row: Forward pass: (Right to left). *1Tss in next st. Rep from * to last 2 sts before marker. PM on last st. Leave rem sts unworked. Return pass. 
Rep last row, working 2 sts less on every Forward pass row until there are 2 sts rem. Join B. 
Next row: Forward pass: (Right to left). With B, *1Tss in next st. Rep from * to end of row. 24 sts. Return pass.** 

Second Wedge: With B, work from ** to ** as given for First Wedge, joining C at end of last row.
Third Wedge: With C, work from ** to ** as given for First Wedge, joining A at end of last row.
Changing colors in the following sequence: A, B, C, work 9 more Wedges. Fasten off. 

Joining row:  With RS tog and crochet hook, join C with sl st to first st at outer edge. Working through both thicknesses, work in sc across foundation row and last row of Bottom. Fasten off. 
To close center of Bottom: Thread C through side edges of each row. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.

SIDE OF PURSE
With A and Tunisian hook, ch 60.
1st row: Forward pass: (Right to left). Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each rem ch to end of chain, leaving all loops on hook. 60 sts on hook. Do not turn.

Return pass: (Left to right after working Forward pass of each row). Yoh and draw through last loop only (for edge st). *Yoh and draw through 2 loops. Rep from * until 1 loop rem on hook. Do not turn.

2nd row: Forward pass: (Right to left). *1Tss in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Return pass. 
Rep last row 8 times more.

***Next row: Forward pass: (Drawstring hole row). 1Tss in each of first 5 sts. Sl st in each of next 3 sts. *1Tss in each st to end of row. Return pass, working ch 3 over 3 sl sts.
Next row: Forward pass: 1Tss in each of first 5 sts. Draw up a loop in each of next 3 ch. *1Tss in each st to end of row. Return pass.*** 
Join B.
With B, rep 2nd row 10 times more. 
Work from *** to ***. Join C.
With C, rep 2nd row 10 times more. 
Work from *** to ***. Join A.
Changing colors in the following sequence: A, B, C, work 9 more stripes, noting position of Drawstring holes. Fasten off.
Join Side to Bottom: With WS tog and U.S. G/6 (4 mm) hook, matching colors of Side and Bottom, join C with sl st to any st. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 rnd of sc around Side and Bottom. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Drawstring: With C and Tunisian hook, ch 150.
1st row: Forward pass: (Right to left). Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each rem ch to end of chain, leaving all loops on hook. 150 sts on hook. Do not turn.

Return pass: (Left to right after working Forward pass of each row). Yoh and draw through last loop only (for edge st). *Yoh and draw through 2 loops. Rep from * until 1 loop rem on hook. Fasten off.

Thread Drawstring through eyelets, meeting ends at front of Purse. Pull ends slightly to gather top of Purse and tie tog. 

Handle: With C and Tunisian hook, ch 90. 
Work in Tss as given for Drawstring, changing colors as follows: (2 rows with C. 2 rows with A. 2 rows with B) twice. Fasten off.
With WS tog, fold Handle lengthwise. With U.S. G/6 (4 mm) hook, join C with sl st to first st. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc across foundation row and last row of Handle. Fasten off.
Sew Handle at WS 5 sts down from top edge at each side of Purse as shown.

instructions:
Notes: 
• To use Coats & Clark™ Yarn Zip, a foundation of chain stitches will be worked directly into the zipper.
• Body of Pouch is then worked directly into these chains on zipper.
• After 2nd rnd, Pouch is worked in continuous rnds. Do not join at end of rnds.

Setting Up Stitches on Coats & Clark™ Yarn Zip
Prepare zipper:
Using a pen or pencil, make small dots along right side of zipper ¼" [0.6 cm] up from bottom zipper stop and 8" [20.5 cm] up from this bottom mark. Make small markings every ¼" [0.6 cm] between these 2 points along right side of loose-weave channel on zipper tape. There should be 33 dots spaced evenly along side of zipper. 
Repeat on left side of zipper.

Begin working into zipper:
With smaller hook, insert hook into top of zipper at bottom mark ¼" [0.6 cm] up from zipper stop. Holding yarn behind zipper, draw up a loop. Insert hook at next ¼" [0.6 cm] marking and draw up a loop (2 loops on hook). Draw this loop through first loop, being sure to not pull too tightly. 
Continue in this manner, inserting hook at each ¼" [0.6 cm] marking, pulling up a loop and drawing it through loop on hook. Once top of zipper is reached, you should have 32 chain sts along right side of zipper.
Pull zipper head down below top marking. Working across top of zipper, insert hook into top marking on left side, drawing up a slightly longer loop to span across top of zipper.
Work down left side of zipper as on opposite side to bottom marking. Make 1 last chain st across bottom of zipper, into same space as first chain. Pull loop from top of zipper to WS and fasten off. Cut yarn leaving approx 4" [10 cm] tail.

POUCH
1st rnd: With larger hook, join yarn with sl st to first ch st on right side. Ch 1. Working through right ‘leg’ of chain only, work 1 sc in each ch st to top of zipper (32 sc). Work 1 sc in ch across top of zipper. Work 1 sc in each of 32 ch down left side of zipper. Work 1 sc in ch across bottom of zipper. Join with sl st to first sc. 66 sc.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 28 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * once more. Do not join. Place marker on last st. 62 sts.

3rd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Rep last rnd, moving end of rnd marker up at end of each rnd, until work from edge of zipper measures 5" [12.5 cm].

FINISHING
Sl st in next sc to complete final rnd. Fasten off, leaving a long yarn end to seam bottom of Pouch. Lay Pouch flat, aligning sts of last rnd. Using yarn tail, sew bottom of Pouch closed. Weave in ends.

Body

Shoulder Strap

Waist & Cross-body Straps
Long Strap: **Ch 5, leaving a long end.

Ring Tabs (make 2)

FINISHING
Sew in zipper using thread and sewing needle. Fold Pouch in half, having half of Pouch as a flap.
Insert one end of Long Strap into rectangular ring. Fold 1" [2.5 cm] to cover rectangular ring. Sew folded end to Strap.
Insert opposite end of Long Strap into 2 rectangular rings held together. Fold 1" [2.5 cm] to cover both rectangular rings for buckles. Sew folded end to Strap.

Insert Ring Tab into single rectangular ring at one end of Strap. Fold Ring Tab in half and sew both ends to one side of Pouch at top flap fold. Rep for other side. Fasten by inserting end of Long Strap through both rings of Short Strap, pulling to fit, then over and between the 2 rings.

SMALL ESSENTIALS POUCH

materials: RED HEART® Gumdrop®: 2 balls of 620 Cherry A

abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E, F = color A, B, C, D, E, F
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified

instructions:
We show this easy-to-crochet purse in two equally stunning versions. The first is just two colors, while the second uses four bright colors set off by a dark navy.
Round 5: With right side facing, join next color with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in same ch-3 space, *[3 dc between next two 3-dc groups] 3 times**, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next corner ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
ASSEMBLY
Bag #1 With right sides of Squares facing, using A, whipstitch squares into 3 strips of 6 squares each. Whipstitch strips together in like manner.
Bag #2 Arrange squares randomly. With right sides of Squares facing, using F, whipstitch Squares into 3 strips of 6 squares each. Whipstitch strips together in like manner.
Measure for Optional Lining
Measure assembled Squares before sewing side seams. It should measure approximately 13” x 26” (33 x 66 cm). Add 1” (2.5 cm) in both directions for seams. Should be approximately 14” x 27” (35.5 x 68.5 cm). Cut lining fabric to this size.
Sew Side Seams
Fold crocheted piece in half crosswise, with right sides together. Fold is at bottom of bag. Whipstitch lower 2 squares together on both sides of bag. Leave 1 pair of squares on both sides un-joined. If adding optional lining, leave bag inside-out. Otherwise, turn bag right-side out. 
LINING (optional)
Press ½” (13 mm) seam allowance to wrong side on top and bottom of lining fabric so that piece now measures 14” x 26” (35.5 x 66 cm). Fold piece in half with right sides together, and press bottom fold. Piece now measures 14” x 13” (35.5 x 33 cm). Sew ½” (13 mm) side seam starting 4” (10 cm) below top edge and sewing to bottom fold; repeat on other side of lining. Press seams open. Turn lining right side out. Place inside-out bag into inside-out lining. Sew lining to bag with sewing needle and thread along top edge (leaving tops of sts in Round 5 open to attach handle); continue sewing 4” (10 cm) down side, 4” (10 cm) up other side, along top of other side of bag, 4” (10 cm) down side and 4” (10 cm) up other side. When sewing, make sure you sew only partially through stitches so that thread does not show on outside of bag. Turn bag right side out, so lining is inside.
JOIN HANDLE
With right side facing, join Round 5 color with a slip st in in top right-hand corner ch-3 space on either side of bag, ch 1, sc in same space, working loosely (or stitches will not slide over bumps on handles), and holding top of one handle behind top edge of bag, insert hook between next two 3-dc groups and through handle, yarn over, draw through handle and 3-dc group, yarn over and draw through both loops on hook (sc made), working over handle, work 2 more sc in same space, [working over handle, work 3 sc between next two 3-dc groups] 3 times, *[working over handle, sc in next corner ch-3 space] twice, [working over handle, work 3 sc between next two 3-dc groups] 4 times; repeat from * once, sc in last corner ch-3 space. Fasten off. Repeat for other side and other handle. Weave in ends.

instructions:

Notes:

2nd rnd: Sl st in each of next 3 dc and next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. (3 dc. Ch 1. 4 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *(4 dc. Ch 1. 4 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * twice more. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in each of next 3 dc and next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. (1 dc. Popcorn. 2 dc) in same sp as last sl st. Skip next dc. *1 dc in each dc to next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each dc to 1 dc before next ch-1 sp. Skip next dc. (2 dc. Popcorn. 2 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * twice more. 1 dc in each dc to next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each dc to 1 dc before first ch-1 sp. Join.

Ch 75.

instructions:
BACKPACK
Base
Ch 23 loosely.

Body
Round 1: Ch 1, turn, sc 20 sts evenly spaced across last row, work 3 sc in corner, turn to work along side edge, sc 33 sts evenly spaced along side edge, 3 sc in corner, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, sc 20 sts evenly spaced across, 3 sc in corner, turn to work along opposite side edge, sc 33 sts evenly spaced along side edge, 3 sc in corner, slip st in first st to join – 118 sts.
Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each st around.
Rounds 3-9: Working in continuous rounds, sc in each st around.
Rounds 10-30: Hdc in each st around.
Round 31: Sc in each st around.
Round 32: Sc in next 8 sts, *sc in next 8 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 107 sts.
Round 33: Sc in next 8 sts, *sc in next 7 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 96 sts.
Round 34: *Sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 84 sts.
Round 35: *Sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 72 sts.
Rounds 36-37: Sc in each st around, slip st in first st of last round to join. Fasten off.
Top Flap
Row 1: Working in back loops only, join yarn in first st of last row with a slip st, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 26 sts – 27 sts.
Rows 2-19: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 27 sts.
Row 20: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 23 sts, sc2tog – 25 sts.
Row 21: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 9 sts, ch 3, skip 3 sts for buttonhole, sc in next 9 sts, sc2tog – 23 sts.
Row 22: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 8 sc, sc in each ch of ch-3 space, sc in next 8 sc, sc2tog – 21 sts.
Row 23: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 17 sts, sc2tog – 19 sts.
Fasten off.
Trim
Join yarn in top left corner with a slip st, working in the ends of rows, sc evenly spaced down edge, sc in each st along bottom edge, sc evenly spaced along opposite side edge. Fasten off.
POCKET FLAP
Ch 28.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 27 sts.
Rows 2-13: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 14: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 25 sts.
Row 15: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 23 sts.
Row 16: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 21 sts.
Row 17: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 19 sts. Fasten off.
Trim
Join yarn in top left corner with a slip st, working in ends of rows, sc evenly spaced down edge, sc in each st along bottom edge, sc evenly spaced along opposite side edge. Fasten off.
POCKET
Ch 28.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 27 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st – 29 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st – 31 sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st – 33 sts.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st – 35 sts.

FINISHING
Pocket Assembly
Sew first row of Pocket to first round of Body, lining up placement under Top Flap. Sew sides to front of Body. Sew first row of Pocket Flap to Body 2 rows above Pocket so Flap folds over.

Left Tie
Join yarn with a slip st 2 rows below first st of Top Flap, ch 75. Fasten off. Weave in and out of sts to center of front of Body.

Ch 66.

Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Fasten off.

Optional: For stability across top edges of Tote, cut 2 pieces of plastic canvas as shown in Diagram, taking care to leave smooth edges and trimming as needed to fit.
With right sides facing up, center Row 1 of Pocket on Row 5 of one Panel. Pin in place and sew around 3 sides with end tail.
With right sides held together, seam side and bottom edges of Panels together.
Fold Facing to wrong side, insert stabilizers with strap openings aligned, and sew last row of Facing to wrong side of Panels.
Turn right side out.
Weave in ends.
Insert straps through openings and adjust to desired length.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 512 Turqua A, 316 Soft White B, and 672 Spring Green C
3 Sheets Plastic Canvas Clear No: 33900-1: 10.5” x 13.5” [27 cm x 34 cm]
3 Sheets Rainbow Classic felt: 9” x 12” [23 cm x 30.5 cm]
abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Tote measures 28” [71 cm] around x 9” [23 cm] high
gauge: 13 sts = 4” [10 cm]; 10 rows = 3” [8 cm] in hdc pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Edging Round: Join C in same st as joining; ch 1, insert hook in last st worked and draw through a loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook, * insert hook in next st to the right and draw through a loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook; repeat from * around. Fasten off.
Handle (Make 2)
With A, ch 110.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd from hook and in each ch across; turn – 109 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
Handle Edging Round: Join C in first sc of Row 2; ch 1, 3 sc in first sc, sc in each sc to last sc; 3 sc in last sc, working on opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in each ch to last ch; 3 sc in last ch; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.
Fold bag flat. Sew ends of handles to bag 3½” [9 cm] from sides of bag.
Cut a vertical 4½” [11 cm] wide strip from one plastic canvas sheet and one felt sheet. Using the measurement or tracing of the bottom of the bag after Round 7, cut the plastic canvas to that measurement and cut the felt ½” [1.3 cm] larger all the way around. Pin together and sew the felt to the canvas, covering the cut edges with the excess felt. Place in bottom of bag felt side down. Secure with thread around the bottom of the bag.
With remaining canvas, arrange the sheets to make a circle that fits into bag, overlapping canvas edges by ½” [1.3 cm]. Trim excess from circle and at top of bag. Sew overlapped edges together.
TOTE
Bottom of tote
With C, ch 21.
Round 1: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 18 ch, 3 sc in last ch, working on opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 18 ch; do NOT join but work in continuous rounds – 42 sc. Place marker in first st and move up each round.
Round 2: * [Inc] 3 times, sc in next 18 sc; repeat from * once more – 48 sc.
Round 3: * [Inc] 6 times, sc in next 18 sc; repeat from * once more – 60 sc.
Round 4: Sc in next 2 sc, [inc] 6 times, sc in next 23 sc, [inc] 6 times, sc in next 23 sc – 72 sc.
Round 5: Sc in next 4 sc, [inc] 9 times, sc in next 25 sc, [inc] 9 times, sc in the next 25 sc – 90 sc.
Rounds 6 and 7: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off at end of Round 7. Measure or trace bottom of bag for lining.
Body of Bag
Round 8: With right side facing, join A in back loop of next sc; ch 2 (counts as hdc), hdc in back loop of next sc and each sc around; join with a slip st in top of ch-2 – 90 hdc.
Round 9: Ch 2, hdc between ch-2 of row below and next hdc, * hdc between next 2 hdc; repeat from * to last hdc; do NOT place hdc between last hdc and the ch-2 of row below; join – 90 hdc.
Repeat Round 9 for hdc pattern in the following color sequence: 2 more rounds A, [1 round C, 4 rounds B, 1 round C, 4 rounds A] twice.
With remaining felt, arrange the sheets to cover the outside of the canvas circle, overlapping edges and allowing an extra ½” [1.3 cm] at top and bottom. Trim excess. Sew to canvas circle, covering the cut edges with the excess felt. Place in bag with the felt side next to the bag so that the canvas will not show through. Secure with thread around the bottom of the bag.
Cut lining cloth 10” x 29” [25 cm x 74 cm] for bag and 4½” x 11” [44 x 28 cm] for bag bottom. Check for fit inside the bag, then remove, adjust if necessary and sew side and bottom seams with ½” [1.3 cm] seams. Insert finished lining into bag and sew to bag closely below the bag edging; tack to canvas around bottom.

materials: Bernat® Maker Fashion™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 126 yds/115 m)
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of the next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 11 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
INSTRUCTIONS
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first sc.
With A, ch 31.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working across opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join. 62 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 28 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 28 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 68 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 31 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 31 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 74 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 34 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 34 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 80 sc. PM at end of rnd. Beg working in spirals (do not join at end of rnd).
5th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 4" [10 cm].
Next rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 18 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 76 sc.
Next 3 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Rep last 4 rnds twice more, having 1 st less between decs on each dec rnd. 68 sts. Fasten off.
Fringe: Cut strands of B 20" [51 cm] long. Fold in half and knot into fringe around top edge of Bag, working around posts of sts of last rnd. Trim fringe evenly. Thread 1 bead onto each strand of fringe, knotting end to secure.
Edging rnd: (RS). Join 2 strands of A with sl st to last row at top of Bag. Sl st in each st around. Fasten off.
Handle: With 2 strands of A held tog, ch 56. Sl st in back “bump” of 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Fasten off. Sew to Bag as shown in picture.

pattern_name: LILY® SUGAR’N CREAM SHOPPING TOTE BAG
materials: Size 6.5 mm (U.S. K or 10 ½) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension
gauge: 11 hdc and 7 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] with 2 strands of yarn.
instructions:
Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook. Draw loop of next color through 2 loops on hook to complete st and proceed. Ch 2 does not count as hdc.

Stripe Pat
Work 1 row with A.
Work 1 row with MC.
Work 1 row with C.
Work 1 row with MC.
Work 1 row with B.
Rep last 5 rows twice more.
These 15 rows form Stripe Pat.

Front and Back (make alike)
With 2 strands of MC, ch 38.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 37 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 3 times more. Join A at end of last row.
Next row: (RS). With 2 strands of A, ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in next st through back loop only. *1 hdc in next st through front loop only. 1 hdc in next st through back loop only. Rep from * to last st. 1 hdc in last st. Turn.
1st row of Stripe Pat is complete.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row until 15 rows of Stripe Pat are complete. Join MC at end of last row.
Next row: (WS). With 2 strands of MC, ch 1. 1 sc in first hdc. 1 sc in next hdc in back loop only. *1 sc in next hdc in front loop only. 1 sc in next hdc in back loop only. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 sc in last hdc. Place marker at each end of row.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 4 times more. Fasten off.

Edging: With RS of Front facing, join 2 strands of MC with sl st to bottom right corner. Ch 1. Work 27 sc up right side of Front. Fasten off.
With RS of Front facing, join MC with sl st to top left corner. Ch 1. Work 27 sc down left side of Front. Rep for Back.

Gusset
With 2 strands of MC, ch 3.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn.
Rep last row 6 times more.
Next row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. 4 sc.
Next 7 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 6 sc.
Next row: 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Ch 1. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 30 ins [76 cm], ending with RS facing for next row.
Next row: Ch 1. Draw up loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook- sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. Turn. 4 sc.
Next 7 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sc.
Next 6 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off.

Handles (make 2)
With 2 strands of MC, ch 51.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 50 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 7 times more. Fasten off.
Fold handle lengthwise and sew closed.

FINISHING
Pin Front and Gusset tog between markers, WS facing. Join 2 strands of MC with sl st at left marker and working through both thicknesses proceed in sc down left side of Bag, across bottom and up right side to opposite marker. Do not turn.
Next row: Working from left to right instead of right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off.
Rep for Back.
With RS of work facing, join 2 strands of MC with sl st to marked st. Ch 1. Work 1 row of reverse sc around upper edge of Bag. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Sew Handles to inside of Bag 2½ ins [6 cm] in from side edges as shown in picture.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver™ Super Craft Kit
Kit includes 12 balls (50 g/1.7 oz each; 600 g/21 oz total), yardage (85 m/93 yds each; 1020 m/1116 yds total).
Main Color (MC) Pale Yellow 1 ball or 85 yds/77 m

Printed or solid color cotton lining fabric 45" [114.5 cm] wide x ½ yd  [45 cm].
Coats® Dual Duty XP® All-Purpose Thread in matching color.
measurements: Approx 15¾" x 17" [38 x 43 cm] excluding handles.
gauge: 13 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm]. 1 Motif = Approx 3" [7.5 cm] diameter.
instructions:
Notes: • Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st. • Join Motifs as you work.
First Motif
***With larger hook and MC, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring. See diagram on page 5.
1st rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as st). 12 hdc in ring. Join with sl st to top of first hdc, skipping beg ch 2. Fasten off. 12 hdc.
With RS facing join Color 1 to back loop (working through back loop and horizontal bar at WS of work) with sl st to any hdc.***
2nd rnd: *Ch 9. Sl st in same sp as last sl st.** Sl st in back loop (working through back loop and horizontal bar at WS of work) of next hdc. Rep from * around ending at **. Join with sl st to same sp as first sl st. Fasten off. 12 ch-9 petals.

Second Motif (join 1 side)
Work from *** to *** as given for First Motif. 2nd rnd: Ch 4. Sl st to 5th ch of any ch-9 loop of adjoining Motif. Ch 4. Sl st in same sp as last sl st. Sl st in back loop (working through back loop and horizontal bar at WS of work) of next hdc. Ch 4. Sl st to 5th ch of next ch-9 loop of adjoining Motif. Ch 4. Sl st in same sp as last sl st. Sl st in back loop (working through back loop and horizontal bar at WS of work) of next hdc *Ch 9. Sl st in same sp as last sl st.** Sl st in back loop (working through back loop and horizontal bar at WS of work) of next hdc. Rep from * around ending at **. Join with sl st to same sp as first sl st. Fasten off. 12 ch-9 petals.

Next Motif (join 2 sides)
Work from *** to *** as given for First Motif.
2nd rnd: Ch 4. Sl st to 5th ch of second ch-9 loop of first (right) adjoining motif before existing join. Ch 4. Sl st in same sp as last sl st. Sl st in back loop (working through back loop and horizontal bar at WS of work) of next hdc. Ch 4. Sl st to 5th ch of next ch-9 loop of the same adjoining Motif. Ch 4. Sl st in same sp as last sl st. Sl st in back loop (working through back loop and horizontal bar at WS of work) of next hdc. Ch 4. Sl st to 5th ch of first ch-9 loop of second (left) adjoining Motif after existing join. Ch 4. Sl st in same sp as last sl st. Sl st in back loop (working through back loop and horizontal bar at WS of work) of next hdc. Ch 4. Sl st to 5th ch of next ch-9 loop of the same adjoining Motif. Ch 4. Sl st in same sp as last sl st. Sl sl st in back loop (working through back loop and horizontal bar at WS of work) of next hdc. *Ch 9. Sl st in same sp as last sl st.** Sl st in back loop (working through back loop and horizontal bar at WS of work) of next hdc. Rep from * around ending at **. Join with sl st to same sp as first sl st. Fasten off. 12 ch-9 petals.

Following Assembly Diagram use Color 1 as shown in diagram and join Motifs as you work into Bag.
Top Border: 1st rnd: With RS facing and smaller hook, join I with sl st to 5th ch of first far-right free ch-9 loop of any Motif. Ch 5 (counts as dc and ch-2). *(Ch 2. 1 sc in 5th ch of next ch-9 loop) twice. (Ch 2. 1 dc in 5th ch of next ch-9 loop) twice. Rep from * around, ending with: Ch  2. 1 dc in 5th ch of next ch-9 loop. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-5.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st and 2 sc in each ch-2 sp around. 120 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd and 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left, as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each ch-1 sp around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Handles: (make 2). With smaller hook and I, ch 90. See diagram on page 5.
1st row: Sl st in 41st ch from hook and each of next 29 ch. Turn. Leve rem 20 ch unworked.
2nd to 6th rows: Ch 40. Sl st in first sl st and each of next 29 sl sts. Turn.
7th row: Ch 40. Sl st in first sl st and each of next 29 sl sts. Ch 20. Fasten off.
Fold Bag flat. PM 2" [5 cm] in from side edges along top edge of Bag. Arrange ch-40 loops of Handles beg at markers and placing loops towards center. Sew loops to WS under last rnd of reverse sc as shown in picture.

LINING
Using fabric, cut 1 rectangle 18" x 35" [45.5 x 89 cm].
Note: Seam allowances are ½" [1.25 cm].
Top edges of fabric bottom: Fold one side edge ¼" [.75 cm] to WS of fabric and press. Fold over again ¼" [.75 cm] to WS and press. Pin into place.
Sew seam by hand 1/8" [0.30 cm] from folded edge or with sewing machine set to longest stitch length, sew 1/8" [0.30 cm] from folded edge, taking out pins as you sew.
Note: Be sure to keep fabric flat as this row of stitches will later be sewn to crochet Bag.
Sew Side Seams
Note: Sides are sewn using a French seam to enclose raw side edge.
Fold piece in half with wrong sides together and right side facing, matching shorter side edges with folded edges at top. Pin into place.
Sew seams by hand or machine ¼" [75 mm] from each side edge.
Press seam, with seam allowance to one side.
Turn piece so right sides are together, and wrong side is facing. Press fabric in half, making sure seam is at very edge.
Pin into place.
Sew seams by hand or machine ¼" [75 mm] from each side edge, encasing raw edges of first seam within seam allowance.
Turn piece so WS is facing. Insert lining into Bag and hand sew top edge of lining to 2nd row of sc of Bag edging, using whipstitch over edge.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Sizes U.S. H/8 (5 mm) and U.S. J/10 (6 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
Pair of 5" [12.5 cm] diameter plastic ring purse handles.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 12" [30.5 cm] wide x 14" [35.5 cm] long, excluding handles.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook.
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as hdc.
FRONT and BACK (make alike)
With A and smaller hook, ch 43.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 41 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. Work 1 hdc in horizontal bar created below st in previous row (bar is below loops normally worked on WS-see diagram) in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 6 times more.
Proceed as follows:
1st row: (RS). Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in next hdc. *Ch 1. Skip next hdc. 1 dc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * to last 3 hdc. Ch 1. Skip next hdc. 1 dc in each of next 2 hdc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next ch-1 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp and 2 dc. Ch 1. 2 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in next dc. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 4 dc. Ch 1. Skip next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows for pat until piece measures 9" [23 cm] from beg, ending on a WS row.
Top Shaping: Right Half:
1st row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 17 sts. Hdc2tog. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 18 sts.
2nd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. Work 1 hdc in horizontal bar created below st in previous row (bar is below loops normally worked on WS-see diagram) in each st to end of row. Turn. 17 sts.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in horizontal bar created below st in previous row in each st to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Turn. 16 sts.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows twice more, then 2nd row once. Fasten off. 11 sts rem at end of last row.
Top Shaping: Left Half:
1st row: (RS). Skip next 3 unworked sts. Join A with sl st to next st. Ch 2. Beg in same sp as join, Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 18 sts.
2nd row: Ch 2. Work 1 hdc in horizontal bar created below st in previous row (bar is below loops normally worked on WS-see diagram) in each st to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Turn. 17 sts.
3rd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in horizontal bar created below st in previous row in each st to end of row. Turn. 16 sts.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows twice more, then 2nd row once. Fasten off. 11 sts rem at end of last row.
Top edging: (RS). Join A with sl st to top of right half shaping. Ch 1. Work 16 sc evenly down right half shaping. Work 1 sc in each of 3 skipped sts. Work 16 sc evenly up left half shaping. Fasten off. 35 sc.
HANDLES
Holding 2 strands of B tog, and larger hook, join yarn with sl st to purchased ring. Ch 1. Work 73 sc around ring. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
With smaller hook, join single strand of A with sl st to any sc. Ch 1. Work 1 sc in each of next 35 sc. Fasten off.
Attach Handles: Hold WS of Handle and side of Bag tog, lining up rows of sc. With smaller hook, join A with sl st to first sc. Working through back loop of Handle and front loop of Bag edging only, join Handle and Bag tog by working sl st in each of 35 sc to end of row. Fasten off.
Join Front and Back
With WS of Bag pieces tog and smaller hook, join A with sl st at top right corner. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc evenly down right side edge, along bottom and up left side edge. Fasten off.
TASSEL
Wrap B around an 8" [20.5 cm] piece of cardboard 30 times. Break yarn leaving a long end and thread end through needle. Slip needle through all loops and tie tightly. Remove cardboard and wind yarn tightly around loops 1" [2.5 cm] below fold. Fasten securely. Cut through rem loops and trim ends evenly. Attach Tassel to Bag Handle as shown in picture.

materials: Lily® sugar’n cream® (70.9 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds)
contrast A Hot Blue (01742) 2 balls 215 m/235 yds

instructions:
stripe Pat: Work 1 row of each color: A, B, C. These 3 rows form Stripe Pat.
note: Do not break color at end of row. Carry color not in use loosely up side of work.

2nd row: With B, ch 2. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp - counts as beg dc2tog. *Yoh and draw up a loop in same ch-1 sp as last st. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw up a loop in next ch-1 sp. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook - dc2tog made. Ch 1. Rep from * to last sc. Dc2tog over last worked ch-1 sp and last sc. Join C. Turn.

4th row: With A, ch 3 (counts as dc). Dc2tog over first st and next ch-1 sp. *Ch 1. Miss next sc. Dc2tog over last worked ch-1 sp and next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last sc. Dc2tog over last worked ch-1 sp and last sc. 1 dc in last sc. Join B. Turn.
5th row: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in first st. *Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 sc in last st. Join C. Turn. 2nd to 5th rows form Zig-Zag pat.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last 4 rows until work from beg measures approx 6" [15 cm], ending on a 5th row. Fasten off.
second section: 1st row: (WS). With appropriate color, ch 25. With WS facing, pat across 25 sts of First Section. Ch 26. Join next color. Turn.
2nd row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Miss next ch. Rep from * to last ch. 1 sc in last ch. **Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from ** to last st of First Section. Ch 1. Miss last st. ***1 sc in next ch. Ch 1. Miss next ch. Rep from *** to last ch. 1 sc in last ch. Join next color. Turn. 75 sts.
Beg with 4th row of Zig-Zag pat, work for next 6" [15 cm], ending on a 5th row.
Third section: 1st row: (WS). Pat across 75 sts of Second Section. Ch 51. Join next color. Turn.
2nd row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Miss next ch. Rep from * to last ch. 1 sc in last ch. **Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from ** to last ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last st. Join next color. Turn.
Beg with 4th row of Zig-Zag pat, work for next 6" [15 cm], ending on a 4th row.

Sew corresponding sides. (See Assembly Diagram).
Opening edging: 1st rnd: With RS facing, join A with sl st to any outer corner. Ch 1. Work 18 sc along each side, having 3 sc in outer corners and sc2tog in inner corners. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: As 1st rnd. Fasten off.
straps: (Make 2).
With A, ch 80.
1st rnd: 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. Working into rem loops along opposite side of ch, work 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. Ch 1. Do not fasten off.
Fold Strap in half with RS facing each other (WS of last rnd will show). Join Strap by working 1 sl st lengthwise through tops of corresponding dc and foundation ch to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew Straps to WS at outer corners (see picture).

materials: RED HEART® “Heart & Sole® with Aloe”: 1 ball 3960 Spring Stripe or 3966 Toasted Almond.
Split lock stitch marker; yarn needle.
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 14 sts = 2”; 16 rounds = 2” in sc rounds. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
POUCH
Round 1: Ch 2, 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; DO NOT JOIN but work in continuous rounds. Mark end of round. Move marker up each round.
Round 2: [Inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Inc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 4: [Inc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 5: [Inc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 6: [Inc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times – 36.
Round 7: [Inc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times – 42.
Rounds 8-20: Sc in each sc around. At the end of Round 20, join with a slip st in next sc.
Round 21: Ch 4 (counts as a dc and ch-1), skip next sc, * dcb in next sc, ch 1, skip next sc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in 3rd ch of ch-3.
Round 22: Ch 1, 2 sc in each ch-1 space around; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Make 1 or 2 twisted cords starting with a 3-yard length of yarn for each. Bring the cut ends together and tie a knot close to the ends forming a large loop. Secure the knotted end to a stable surface or have a friend hold the end. Slip a pencil into the loop and hold the yarn just below the loop and the pencil. Holding the yarn taut, twirl the pencil, thereby twisting the yarn, until the entire length is tightly twisted and begins to twist back upon itself. Bring the loop end and the knotted end together. Tie with an overhand knot. Trim the ends. Smooth out the kinks so that the cord lies flat and is evenly twisted along its length.
Weave each cord through the ch-1 spaces of Round 21 (in opposite directions if using 2). Knot ends of cord together; trim ends.

instructions: Base: Ch 43. 1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Do not turn. Working into other side of ch, work 1 sc in each rem loop of ch. Miss last 3 sc. 1 dc in first sc. 2nd rnd:*Ch 5. 1 sc in next ch-5 loop. Rep from * around, ending with ch 2. 1 dc in last dc of previous rnd. Rep last rnd until work from base when folded flat measures 12 ins [30.5 cm]. Next rnd:Sl st in next ch 5 loop. Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp. *1 sc in next sc. 3 sc in next ch-5 loop. Rep from * around, ending with 1 sc in last dc. Join with sl st to first sc. 84 sc. Next rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sc as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn. 4th row: Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. 8 sts. Ch 1. Turn. 5th row: 1 sc in each st across. Ch 1. Turn. materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 2 Skeins 0319 Cherry Red A and 1 skein 0311 White B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 16 sts = 4”; 16 rows = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
To Change Color In Sc: With present color draw up a loop in st before change then complete the sc with the next color. Carry color not in use loosely across top of row and work over it as you go.
SPECIAL PATTERN STITCHES
DOTS (Worked over a multiple of 4 sts + 3 sts):
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, 1 sc A, 1 sc B, * 3 sc A, 1 sc B; repeat from * to last st; 1 sc A; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across with A; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, 3 sc A, * 1 sc B, 3 sc A; repeat from * across; turn.
Row 4: Repeat Row 2.
Repeat Rows 1-4 for Dots pattern.
CHECKS (Worked over a multiple of 6 sts + 3 sts):
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, 3 sc A, * 3 sc B, 3 sc A; repeat from * across.
Rows 2 and 3: Repeat Row 1.
Rows 4, 5 and 6: Ch 1, 3 sc B, * 3 sc A, 3 sc B; repeat from * across.
Repeat Rows 1-6 for Checks pattern.
BASE-Row 1: With A, ch 16; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 15 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across.
Rows 3-47: Work Rows 1-4 of Dots pattern 11 times, then work 1 more A row. Fasten off.
With wrong side facing, join A and slip st in each st and row around base. Fasten off.
BACK: With wrong side facing, join A and work 47 sc along one long edge of Base. Work Rows 1-4 of Dots pattern 9 times, then repeat Dots pattern Row 1 again. Fasten off.
FRONT: Work same as for Back across remaining long edge of Base.
SIDES (Make 2): With wrong side facing join A and work 15 sc along side edge of Base. Work 37 sc rows even with A. Fasten off.
Sew back and front to sides.
LARGE POCKET: With A, ch 46.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 2 ch, * 3 sc B, 3 sc A; repeat from * across; turn – 45 sts.
Rows 2-24: Repeat Checks pattern Rows 2-6, then Rows 1-6 three times. ** Fasten off.
Edging-Rnd 1: With right side facing, join A in any st, leaving chain row free, and slip st around; join with a slip st in back loop of first slip st.
Rnd 2: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each slip st around; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Sew pocket to Back through sc rnd on 3 sides.
BOTTLE POCKET: With A, ch 22. Work same as Large Pocket over 21 sts to **.
Row 25: With A, ch 1, [sc in sc; draw up a loop in next 2 sc, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook] 7 times – 14 sts. Fasten off.
Edging: Work same as for Large Pocket. Sew to Side through sc row on 3 sides.
FLAP-Row 1: With right side of Back facing, skip 13 sc, join A in next sc; ch 1, sc in same sc and next 2 sc,[3 sc B, 3 sc A] 3 times; turn – 21 sts.
Rows 2-19: Repeat Checks pattern Rows 2-6, then Rows 1-6 twice, then Row 1 once more.
Shape Flap: Keeping continuity of pattern, decrease 1 st at each end of next 2 rows – 17 sts. Fasten off.
Bag and Flap Edging: With right side facing, join A in first sc to the left of the flap; ch 1, sc evenly around bag to flap, work 1 sc in each row down side of flap, 7 sc across end of flap, ch 3 for button loop, skip next 3 sc, 7 sc across end of flap, 1 sc in each row sc up side of flap to first sc; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Flap Edging-Row 1: With right side facing, join A in first sc at right edge of flap; ch 1, sc in each sc along flap, working 3 sc in ch-3 space; do not turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, working left to right, sc in each sc around flap for reverse sc. Fasten off.
Sew button in center of front about 4” from top edge.
STRAP (Make 2): With a double strand of A, skip first 5 sc on top edge of bag, join in next sc; ch 1, sc in same sc and in next 2 sc; turn – 3 sc. Work 75 rows of sc. Fasten off, leaving a long sewing strand. Leaving last 5 sc of top edge free, sew end of strap to opposite edge of same side of bag.
LITTLE POCKET: With A, ch 16. Work same as Large Pocket over 15 sts to **. Fasten off. Fold in half and sew side seams. Join A at seam; ch 1, sc around top edge; join with a slip st in first sc; ch 20, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 7 ch; hold chain next to top edge of bag front 6 sts from strap and slip st together the next 3 ch and next 3 sc of bag front, then slip st in remaining ch; slip st in first slip st. Fasten off. The little pocket will hold a cell phone and can be used on inside or outside of bag.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 0365 Coffee CA and 0885 Delft Blue (knit) OR 0774 Light Raspberry (crochet) CB.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Bags measure approximately 12” wide x 10” deep.
gauge: 3 repeats = 5¼”; 14 rows = 5” in pat. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BAG: With CA, ch 58. 
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, * 3 sc in next ch, sc in next 2 ch **, sc-dec over next 3 ch, sc in next 2 ch; rep from * to last 2 ch, end at **; sc in last 2 ch; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, dec over first 2 sc, sc in next 3 sc, * 3 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc **, sc-dec over next 3 sts, sc in next 2 sc; rep from * to last 3 sc, end at **; sc in next sc, dec over last 2 sc changing to CB; turn.
Rep Row 2 for pat, working next 2 rows with CB, then next 2 rows with CA and repeat until there are a total of 54 rows (27 stripes) – about 20” from beg. Last stripe will be CA. Fasten off.
Decrease for FLAP: Skip first 2 sts, attach CB in next st; dec over this and next sc, sc in next sc, * 3 sc in next sc **, sc in next 2 sc, sc-dec over next 3 sts, sc in next 2 sc; rep from * to last 5 sts, end at **; sc in next sc, dec over last 2 sc; turn leaving last 2 sts unworked.
Work in pat as now established until there are 16 rows (8 stripes) from decrease. Last stripe will be CA. Work 2 more rows as established with CA. Fasten off.
FINISHING: Work same as Knit Bag from ** to **.
Flap Edging: With right side facing, join CA and work 2 rows sc evenly across row ends (side edge) of flap. Fasten off. Repeat on opposite edge.
Strap: With CB, ch 151.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 150 sc. Fasten off.
Row 2: With right side facing, attach CA in first sc; ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
Row 4: With right side facing, attach CA in first ch of beginning ch edge; ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
Row 5: Rep Row 3. Fasten off.
Place ends of strap over side seams and sew in place.

instructions:
BODY
With MC, ch 135.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Ch 5. Skip next 6 ch. Sl st in next ch. *Ch 6. Skip next 6 ch. Sl st in next ch. Rep from * to last 7 ch. Ch 5. Skip next 6 ch. 1 sc in last ch. Turn.

Take care not to twist ch. 1 sc in each of next 52 sc. Ch 88 (strap). Skip next 24 sc. Take care not to twist ch. 1 sc in each of last 26 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 26 sc. 1 sc in each of next 88 ch. 1 sc in each of next 52 sc. 1 sc in each of next 88 ch. 1 sc in each of last 26 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 280 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last row until Strap measures 1" [2.5 cm]. Fasten off.

instructions:
MOTIF (Make 4)
Notes: 
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts dc. 
• Ch 6 at beg of rnds counts as dc and ch-3 sp. 
• Join all rnds with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-6 unless otherwise indicated.
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring. See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join B in any ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join. Fasten off.
3rd rnd: Join A in any ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join. Fasten off.
4th rnd: Join C in any ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join. Fasten off.
5th rnd: With D, as 4th rnd. Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
Join Motifs as shown in Assembly diagram. 
Join Motifs: Hold WS of 2 Motifs tog with sts aligned. Join D with sl st in ch-3 corners of aligned Motifs at top right. Ch 1. Working in back loops only, work 1 sc in each dcs through both thicknessess. Fasten off.
Top edging: 1st rnd: (RS). Join E with sl st to top edge of Bag at right corner. Ch 1. Work sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Strap
With F, ch 109.

Break F.
2nd rnd: With E, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as joining sl st. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
With E, sew Strap to Bag along top edge at either end as shown.
FINISHING 
Using sewing thread and needle, sew in zipper along top edge opening.

materials: 1 pair bamboo round handles, 6” in diameter

instructions:
PURSE
Side (Make 2)

Row 5: Ch 3, dc in each sc across, turn.

instructions:

Note: Ch 1 at beg of row does not count as st.
With MC, ch 33.

Sides
Notes: Join all rnds with sl st to first st. Ch 1 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
Beg working around Base in joined rnds as follows:
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 hdc in each st across (total of 32 hdc). Working around edge sts of rows, work 28 hdc evenly along first side edge. Working in unused loops of foundation ch, 1 hdc in each rem ch across foundation edge (total of 32 hdc). Working around edge sts of rows, work 28 hdc evenly along second side edge. Join with sl st to first hdc. 120 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 splhdc in each st around. Join.

Beg working from Chart as follows:
Notes:

1st to 23rd rnds: Work rnds 1 to 23 of Chart, noting each square represents 1 splhdc, reading all rnds from right to left and noting 12-st rep will be worked 10 times. Break A.
