materials: RED HEART® Celebration™: 1 ball each 9840 Blue/Silver A, 9740 Pink/Silver B, and 9240 Lime/Silver C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Basket measures 7” tall x 8” diameter across bottom (18 x 20.5 cm)
gauge: Rounds 1–4 = 3½” (9 cm) in pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With 3 strands of A held together, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around—16 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—32 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—40 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 10 times; join with slip st in first sc—60 sc.
Rounds 9–13: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
With 3 strands of B held together, draw up a loop in 31st sc of Round 13.
Round 14: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 15: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *skip next sc, sm shell in next sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * to last 3 st, skip next sc, sm shell in next sc, skip last sc; join with slip st in first sc—15 sm shells and 15 sc.
Round 16: Ch 3 (counts as first dc of first sm shell), 2 dc in same sc as joining (first sm shell made), *sc in 2nd dc of next sm shell, sm shell in next sc; repeat from * to last sm shell, sc in 2nd dc of last sm shell; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Round 17: Slip st in next dc, ch 1, sc in same dc, *sm shell in next sc, sc in 2nd dc of next sm shell; repeat from * to last sc, sm shell in last sc; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 18: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), *hdc in next dc, sc in next dc, hdc in next dc, dc in next sc; repeat from * to last sm shell, hdc in next dc, sc in next dc, hdc in next dc; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—15 dc, 30 hdc, and 15 sc.
Round 19: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—60 sc. Fasten off.
With 3 strands of C held together, draw up a loop in 31st sc of Round 19.
Round 20: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 21: Repeat Round 20; join with slip st in first sc. Drop 2 strands of C to wrong side. Note: Work next round loosely with one strand of C.
Round 22: Bell sc (see Special Stitches) in first sc, sc in next 5 sc, *bell sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc; repeat from * around; pick up 2 strands of C and join with slip st in first sc—10 bells added.
Round 23: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 24: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *skip next 2 sc, lg shell in next sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * to last 5 sc, skip next 2 sc, lg shell in next sc, skip next 2 sc; join with slip st in first sc—10 lg shells and 10 sc.
Round 25: *Ch 3, (slip st, ch 3, slip st) in 3rd dc of lg shell, ch 3, slip st in next sc; repeat from * to last lg shell, ch 3, (slip st, ch 3, slip st) in 3rd dc of lg shell, ch 3; join with slip st in first ch of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Ora™: 15 balls 5341 Pietra A, and 9 balls 5360 Caramello B.
measurements: Large basket measures about 10” [25.5 cm] wide, 15½” [39.5 cm] long, and 12” [30.5 cm] tall. Small basket measures about 7” [18 cm] wide, 11½” [29 cm] long, and 9” [23 cm] tall.
gauge: 7 sts = about 4” [10 cm]; 9 rows = about 4¼” [11 cm] in single crochet (sc). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
LARGE BASKET
BASE
With A, ch 28.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—27 sc.
Rows 2–21: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off.
LONG SIDE (make 2)
With A, ch 28.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—27 sc.
Rows 2–21: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Make Opening for Handle
Row 22: Ch 1, turn, sc in first 9 sc, ch 9, skip next 9 sc, sc in last 9 sc—18 sc and 1 ch-9.
Row 23: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc and ch across—27 sc.
Rows 24 and 25: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off. Repeat for second long side.
SHORT SIDE (make 2)
With A, ch 19.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—18 sc.
Rows 2–25: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off.
SMALL BASKET
BASE
With B, ch 21.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—20 sc.
Rows 2–15: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off.
LONG SIDE (make 2)
With A, ch 21.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—20 sc.
Rows 2–15: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Make Opening for Handle
Row 16: Ch 1, turn, sc in first 7 sc, ch 6, skip next 6 sc, sc in last 7 sc—14 sc and 1 ch-6.
Row 17: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc and ch across—20 sc.
Rows 18 and 19: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off. Repeat for second long side.
SHORT SIDE (make 2)
With A, ch 14.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—13 sc.
Rows 2–19: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Attach long sides to base: Hold base and one long side together, with stitches along edge matching. Working from right side (outside of basket) and through both thicknesses, join yarn with a slip st in beginning corner, slip st in each st across to opposite corner. Fasten off. Repeat to attach second long side to remaining long side of base.
Attach short sides to base: Hold base and one short side together, with stitch along edge matching. Working from right side and through both thicknesses, join yarn with a slip st in beginning corner, slip st evenly spaced across to opposite corner. Fasten off. Repeat to attach second short side to remaining short side of base.
Join basket corners: Working from right side and through both thicknesses, join yarn with a slip st at beginning of any basket corner edge, working through both thicknesses, slip st evenly spaced along edge. Fasten off. Repeat to join remaining three basket corners.
Weave in ends.

10th to 14th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
15th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog made. (1 sc in each of next 16 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 51 sc.
16th to 20th rnds: As 10th rnd.
21st rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sts.
22nd to 24th rnds: As 10th rnd.
25th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. (1 sc in each of next 14 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 45 sc.
26th to 28th rnds: As 10th rnd.
29th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sts.
30th to 32nd rnds: As 10th rnd.
33rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. (1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 39 sc. Ch 7 (for hanging loop). Join with sl st to first ch. Fasten off.

LARGE FLOWER (make 1)
With larger hook and A, ch 3. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 7 sc into ring. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 10. 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 3 sc in each of next 8 ch. *1 sc in next sc. Ch 10. 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 3 sc in each of next 8 ch. Rep from * 5 times more. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 7 petals.

SMALL FLOWER (See Chart 2)
With larger hook and B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 7. 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 3 sc in each of next 5 ch. *1 sc in next sc. Ch 7. 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 3 sc in each of next 5 ch. Rep from * 3 times more. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 5 petals.

LEAF (make 4)
With larger hook and C, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. (2 hdc. Ch 2. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 2 hdc) in last ch. Working into opposite side of ch, work 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off leaving a long tail for stitching.

FINISHING
Fold top edge approx 2½" [6 cm] to RS. Layer Small Flower on top of Large Flower and sew on button to center through all layers. Sew Flower to Basket front as shown in picture. Sew Leaves randomly around Flowers as shown in picture.

instructions:
USING THIS GUIDE
Click on the underlined words throughout the pattern to access our library of helpful tools.
INSTRUCTIONS
MAKE THIS
Slip Knot : Make a loop with yarn and fold it on itself to make a pretzel shape. Then pull through to make slip knot.
Chain : Yarn over hook (Yoh) and draw up a loop - 1 chain made.
Single Crochet : Insert hook in indicated stitch. Yarn over hook (Yoh) and draw through loop – 2 loops on hook. Yarn over hook (Yoh) and draw through both loops on hook – 1 single crochet made.

Small Basket
(See Diagram on page 7).
Base: Chain (ch) 2.
1st rnd: 8 single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook. Join with Slip Stitch to first sc. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next sc - Corner made. 1 sc in next sc. Repeat (rep) from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next sc for corner. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 space (sp). 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Place Marker (PM) at end of rnd. 44 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.

Large Basket
(See Diagram on page 9).
Base: Rep 1st to 6th rnds as for Small Basket. Do not place marker at end of 6th rnd.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 52 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 60 sc and and 4 ch-1 sps.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 8 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next corner ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Place Marker (PM) at end of rnd. 68 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.
Sides: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 9 sc. *Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 17 sc. Rep from * twice more. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 68 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 9" [23 cm]. Fasten off. Fold top 3" [7.5 cm] to RS as seen in picture.

instructions:
Notes: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st throughout. Join all rnds with sl st in first st. Beg at bottom, ch 5. Join with sl st to form a ring.  
1st rnd: Ch 2. 8 hdc in ring. Join. 8 hdc.

Proceed in Lace Pat as follows: 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Miss next 3 sc.  
(3 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in next sc – shell made. Miss next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending with 1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Miss last sc. Join.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver Chunky™: 3 skeins 0334 Buff A; 1 skein each 0400 Grey Heather B and 0776 Dark Orchid C.

gauge: 10 sc = 4" (10 cm); 10 sc rows = 4" (10 cm) with two strands held together. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size needles to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With two strands of A held together, make an adjustable ring as follows: Wrap yarn around your finger with the yarn tail to the left and under the working yarn. Insert hook through the circle from front to back. Using the working yarn, yarn over and pull up a loop.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc 6 in ring. Join with a slip stitch to first sc; tighten beginning yarn tail to close ring – 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st to first sc – 12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, *sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, *sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 36 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, *sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 42 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, *sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 48 sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, *sc in next 7 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 54 sc.
Round 10: Ch 1, *sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 60 sc.
Round 11: Ch 1, *sc in next 9 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 66 sc.
Round 12: Ch 1, *sc in next 10 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 72 sc.
Round 13: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st around; join with slip st to first sc.
Rounds 14-16: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st to first sc.
Round 17: Ch 1, *sc in next 11 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 78 sc.
Rounds 18–20: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st to first sc.
Round 21: Ch 1, *sc in next 12 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 84 sc.
Rounds 22–24: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st to first sc.
Round 25: Ch 1, *sc in next 13 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 90 sc.
Round 26: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st to first sc.
Cut A.
With two strands of B held together:
Round 27: Ch 1, hdc in each st around; join with a slip st to first hdc.
With two strands of C held together:
Round 28: Ch 1, *sc in next 13 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 84 sc.
Round 29: Ch 3, cluster st in first st, ch 1, *skip 1 st, cluster st in next st; repeat from * to last st, skip last st, join with slip st to first cluster.
Round 30: Ch 1, *[2 sc in next cluster st] six times, sc in top of next cluster st; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 78 sc.
Cut C.
With two strands of B held together:
Round 31: Ch 1, hdc in each st around; join with a slip st to first hdc.
Cut B.
With two strands of A held together:
Round 32: Ch 1, *sc in next 11 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 72 sc.
Round 33: Ch 1, *sc in next 10 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * to end of round, join with slip st to first sc – 66 sc.
Fasten off.
Handles (Make 2)
With two strands of A held together and leaving an 8" (20.3 cm) tail for seaming, ch 20.
Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 19 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 1, hdc in each st across.
Fasten off, leaving an 8" (20.3 cm) tail for seaming.
FINISHING
With yarn needle, seam each Handle end to the inside of the basket along Round 32, leaving 5 sc between each Handle's edge.
Weave in all loose ends.

4th rnd: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 32 hdc.

6th rnd: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 40 hdc.

2nd rnd: With MC, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 31 hdc. With A, 1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. With MC, 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc.
3rd rnd: With MC, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 30 hdc. With A, 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. With MC, 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc.
4th rnd: With MC, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 29 hdc. With A, 1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. With MC, 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join A with sl st to first hdc. Break MC.
5th and 6th rnds: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 20 hdc. Do not break A. With MC, 1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. Do not break MC. With A, 1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. Do not break A. With MC, 1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. With A, 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 2 skeins each 319 Cherry Red A and 312 Black C; 1 skein each of 316 Soft White B and 321 Gold D
Plastic 1-bushel basket, 16¾” (42 cm) in diameter, 12¾” (32 cm) tall
abbreviations: A, B, C, D = Color A, B, C, D
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Basket Measurements: 16¾” (42 cm) in diameter; 12¾” (32 cm) tall.
gauge: 14 sc = 4" (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
NOTES
1. Basket cover and liner are worked from bottom to top.  Popcorn trim is worked up from upper edge of basket cover and then sewn to top of basket liner after basket is inserted.
2. Basket cover and liner are worked in continuous rounds.  Place a detachable marker at beginning of rounds to mark beginning and end of rounds and move up as work progresses.
3. Basket is for decoration only. If photographing a baby, never leave unattended.
SPECIAL STITCHES: 
popcorn = 3 dc in same st, drop loop from hook, insert hook from front to back in first dc, draw dropped loop through st on hook.
BASKET COVER
Beginning at bottom, with A, make an adjustable ring. 
Round 1: Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). Pull gently on tail to tighten ring. Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. 
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc. 
Round 3: *2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around—18 sc. 
Round 4: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * around—24 sc. 
Round 5: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * around—36 sc. 
Round 7: *Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—42 sc. 
Round 8: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc; repeat from * around—48 sc. 
Round 9: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc; repeat from * around—54 sc. 
Round 10: *Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * around—60 sc.
Round 11: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc; repeat from * around—66 sc. 
Round 12: *Sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—72 sc. 
Round 13: *Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc; repeat from * around—78 sc. 
Round 14: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 10 sc; repeat from * around—84 sc. 
Round 15: *Sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc; repeat from * around—90 sc. 
Round 16: *Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 7 sc; repeat from * around—96 sc. 
Round 17: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 14 sc; repeat from * around—102 sc.
Round 18: *Sc in next 16 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—108 sc.
At this point the circle should be close to the diameter of the base of basket – if not then work one or two more rounds in sc.
Round 19: Working in the back loops only, sc in each sc around.
Work even in rounds of sc for 1” (2.5 cm) from base of Round 19.
Next round (increase): *2 sc in next st, sc in each of next 17 sts; repeat from * around—114 sc.
**Work even in rounds of sc for 1” (2.5 cm) from base of last round.
Next round (increase): Work in sc, increasing 6 evenly around—120 sts.**
Repeat from ** to ** 7 times—162 sc at end of last round. Work even in rounds of sc until piece measures about 2” (5 cm) less than height of basket, complete last st with B. Fasten off A.
Popcorn Trim
Round 1 With B, sc in each st around—162 sc.
Round 2:  *Popcorn in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around—81 popcorns.
Round 3: Sc in each of next 161 sts, ending in the popcorn of previous round.
Rounds 4–13: Repeat last 2 rounds 6 times. 
Round 14: Sc in each st around, join with a slip st in next st. Fasten off B.
Liner
With C, work same as Basket Cover through Round 18.  
Round 19: Working in the front loops only, sc in each sc around. 
Work the same as Basket Cover, excluding Popcorn Trim, do not change to B. Fasten off C.
Buckle
Starting at side, with D, ch 13.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—12 sc.
Rows 2–3: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each of first 3 sc, ch 6, skip next 6 sts, sc in each of last 3 sc, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each of first 3 sc, 6 sc in next ch-6 sp, sc in each of last 3 sc, turn—12 sc.
Rows 6–9:  Repeat Rows 2-5.
Rows 10–11:  Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. 
Edging: With Right Side facing, slip st evenly around outer edge of Buckle. 
Fasten off.
Belt
With C, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until Belt measures all the way around center of basket, slightly stretched. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Slip basket into basket cover with popcorn trim coming over top of rim of basket. Slip liner into basket and neatly sew top edge of liner to last round of popcorn trim. 
Insert one end of belt through belt buckle and sew to other end of belt. 
Tack join behind the belt buckle. Belt can be tacked to basket if necessary.

3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 56 sc. 
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 64 sc. 
9th to 13th rnds: Cont in this manner, inc 8 sc evenly around (as established). 104 sc at end of 13th rnd. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Place marker at end of rnd. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep last rnd twice more, joining B at end of last rnd.
With B, rep last rnd 5 times, joining C at end of last rnd.
With C, rep last rnd 5 times, joining D at end of last rnd.
With D, rep last rnd 5 times, joining E at end of last rnd.
With E, rep last rnd twice.
Next rnd (Handle openings): Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 21 sc. 
Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 
1 sc in each of next 42 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc and ch-1 sp around. Join. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.
Handles: With 2 strands of E held tog, ch 26. 
Thread chain through first ch-1 sp of Handle opening rnd and back out through second ch-1 sp of same rnd. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring, being careful not to twist. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around, rotating chain through Handle opening for ease of working. Join. Fasten off. 
Rep for second Handle.

materials: Bernat® Beyond® (4.2 oz/120 g; 80 yds/73 m)
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Approx 8" [20.5 cm] tall (sitting) and 8" [20.5 cm] wide.
gauge: 10 sc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Basket
With C, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
7th to 17th rnds: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
18th rnd: Sl st in each sc around (to give Basket a more defined edge). Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Koala
Nose 
With A, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working on opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off, leaving long end.
Head 
With MC, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th to 9th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 24 sts.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 16 sts.
13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Sew on Nose. Attach safety eyes, following manufacturer’s instructions. Stuff firmly.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 12 sts.
15th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off, leaving a long end.
Stuff rem of Head. Weave yarn through front loops of last rnd. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.
Ear (make 2)
With MC, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 15 sc.
4th to 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Inner Ear (make 2) 
With B, ch 3. 
1st row: (RS). 6 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Do not join. Fasten off. 
Lay Ear flat. Sew Inner Ear to Ear as shown in picture. 
Sew Ears onto Head between 5th and 9th rnds of Head.
Body
With MC, ch 6. 
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Working on opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in first ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
4th to 7th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sts.
9th to 12th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sts.
14th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Stuff Body firmly.
15th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 5 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end.
Weave yarn through front loops of last rnd. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.
Legs (make 2) 
With MC, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog.  1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 9 sts. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Join with sl st to first st.  7 sts. 
7th to 14th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long end. 
Stuff Legs lightly.
Arms (make 2)
With MC, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.  
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Do not join. 
Cont in rnds as follows:
2nd to 7th rnds: 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Do not join.
8th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. 8 sts. 
9th to 14th rnds: 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Do not join. Fasten off at end of last rnd, leaving a long end.
Do not stuff Arms.
Sew Body to Basket (make sure bottom lays flat along side Basket). 
Tip: Sew Body over seam of Basket to hide seam!
Sew Head to top of Body and rim of Basket (make sure Head is secure and not floppy).
Sew on Arms and Legs to Body, then to Basket.

materials: Bernat® Plush™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 146 yds/133 m)

instructions:
Notes: 
• When changing colors, work hdc to last 3 loops on hook. Draw new color through last 3 loops and proceed in new color, keeping color change to WS of work.
• Carry color not in use along top of last row and work new sts around carried color.
• Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc.
• Join with sl st to first hdc at end of each rnd.
Base
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring. See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). 10 hdc in ring. Join. 10 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 20 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join. 30 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 2 hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 2 hdc. Join. 40 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 3 hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 3 hdc. Join. 50 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 4 hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 4 hdc. Join. 60 hdc.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 5 hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 5 hdc. Join. 70 hdc.
9th rnd: As 7th rnd.
10th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 6 hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 6 hdc. Join. 80 hdc.
11th rnd: As 7th rnd. Join B with sl st to first hdc.
Sides
Proceed in Checker Pat as follows:
1st to 3rd rnds: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. *With A, 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. With B, 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Rep from * to last 5 hdc. With A, 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Join B with sl st to first hdc at end of 1st and 2nd rnds. Join A with sl st to first hdc at end of 3rd rnd.
4th to 6th rnds: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. *With B, 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. With B, 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Rep from * to last 5 hdc. With B, 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Join A with sl st to first hdc at end of 4th and 5th rnds. Join B with sl st to first hdc at end of 6th rnd.
These 6 rnds form Checker Pat.
Rep 6 rnds of Checker Pat once more, then 1st to 3rd rnds once more.
Break B.
Top Edge
With A only, ch 1. Working from left to right instead of right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 ball 301 Mirage for Tall Keeper; 1 ball each 334 Buff A and 301 Mirage B for Short Keeper.
Yarn needle, stitch marker, 2-3 oatmeal containers, glue.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Tall Keeper is 10” tall. Short Keeper is 5” tall.
gauge: 25 sc = 8”; 16 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Notes: Keepers are crocheted in a spiral fashion in continuous rounds. Mark beginning of round. To change colors, work last step of previous st with new color. To prevent colors pooling on variegated yarn, divide yarn into 2 balls. Alternate working with each ball every round, carrying ball not in use loosely along wrong side of work.
Special Abbreviations
sc2tog = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
TALL KEEPER
Bottom Piece
Round 1: Ch 2, 6 sc in the 2nd ch from hook – 6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 6: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 6 times – 36 sc.
Round 7: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 6 times – 42 sc.
Round 8: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts] 6 times – 48 sc.
Round 9: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts] 6 times – 54 sc.
Round 10: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts] 6 times – 60 sc, slip in first sc to join.
Sides
Round 11: Working in back loops only, sc in each st around, slip st in first st to join – 60 sc.
Rounds 12-13: Working in continuous rounds, sc in each sc around – 60 sc.
Round 14: [Sc2tog, sc in next 8 sts] 6 times – 54 sc.
Repeat Round 12 on 54 sc until Sides measure 9½” from Round 11.
Top Edging
Working in back loops only, slip st in each st around for 3 rounds.
Fasten off.
Lid
Round 1: Ch 2, 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in first sc to join – 6 sc.
Round 2: Working in back loops only, sc in each st around, slip st in first st to join – 6 sc.
Work in continuous rounds until Stem measures 2” from beginning.
Repeat Rounds 2-13 as for Bottom Piece – 60 sc.
Repeat Round 12 on 60 sc until piece measures ½” from Round 11.
Repeat Top Edging as for Bottom Piece.
Fasten off.
SHORT KEEPER
With A, work Rounds 1-14 of Bottom Piece same as for Tall Keeper.
Repeating Round 12, work stripes with 2 rounds of B as desired until Sides measures 4½” from Round 11.
Work Top Edging as for Tall Keeper with A.
Work Lid as for Tall Keeper with A, adding 2 rounds of B for stripe.

abbreviations: A, B, C, etc. = Color A, Color B, Color C etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Small basket measures about 8” [20.5 cm] tall and 30” [76 cm] circumference. Medium basket measures about 10” [25.5 cm] and 36” [91.5 cm] circumference. Large basket measures about 12” [30.5 cm] and 42” [106.5 cm] circumference.
gauge: 8 sts = 4” [10 cm]; 9½ rows = 4” [10 cm] in single crochet with 3 strands of yarn held together. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.

Base

Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.

Round 4: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—54 sc.
Round 10: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—60 sc.

Round 11: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—66 sc.
Round 12: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—72 sc.
Large Basket Only:
Round 11: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—66 sc.
Round 12: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—72 sc.
Round 13: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 11 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—78 sc.
Round 14: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 12 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—84 sc.

Sides
All Baskets:
Next Round (right side): Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—60 (72, 84) sc. 
Next 3 Rounds: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off A.
Next Round (right side): With right side facing and 3 strands of B held together, join yarn with sc in same st as joining, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Next 1 (2, 3) Rounds: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off B.
With 3 strands of C held together, repeat last 2 (3, 4) rounds. Fasten off C.
With 3 strands of D held together, repeat last 2 (3, 4) rounds. Fasten off D.
With 3 strands of E held together, repeat last 2 (3, 4) rounds. Fasten off E.
With 3 strands of F held together, repeat last 2 (3, 4) rounds. Fasten off F.
Next Round: With right side facing and 3 strands of G held together, join yarn with sc in same st as joining, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Next Round: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.

Handles
Next Round: Continue with G, ch 1, sc in first 10 (12, 14) sts, ch 10 (12, 14), skip next 10 (12, 14) sts, sc in next 20 (24, 28) sts, ch 10 (12, 14) sts, skip next 10 (12, 14) sts, sc in last 10 (12, 14) sts; join with slip st in first sc—40 (48, 56) sc and 2 ch-10 (12, 14) spaces.
Next Round: Ch 1, [sc in each st to next ch-space, 10 (12, 14) sc in ch-space] twice, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Last Round: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

7th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 8 times. Join with sl st to first sc. turn. 56 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc) 7 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. turn. 64 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 8 times. Join with sl st to first sc. turn. 72 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc) 7 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. turn. 80 sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 8 times. Join with sl st to first sc. turn. 88 sc.

next 2 rnds: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.

Sizes U.S. G/6 (4 mm) and U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Twisted sc = Insert hook in next stitch. Bring hook over yarn instead of yarn over hook and pull up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 9½" [24 cm] diameter x 7" [18 cm] tall, excluding antlers and nose
gauge: 16 sc and 18 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook and 1 strand of yarn. 10½ twisted sc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger crochet hook and 2 strands of yarn.
instructions:
BASKET
Notes:
• Basket is worked with 2 strands of yarn. 
• Antlers, Nose and Eyes are worked with 1 strand of yarn. 
• Join each rnd with sl st to first sc. 
With 2 strands of A and larger hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 8 sc.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join. 32 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join. 40 sc. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join. 48 sc. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Join. 56 sc. 
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join. 64 sc. 
9th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Join. 72 sc. 
10th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Join 2 strands of MC. 80 sc. Break A. 
11th rnd: With 2 strands of MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join. PM at end of rnd. 
12th rnd: Ch 1. *1 twisted sc in each sc around. Join. Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 7” [18 cm]. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working from right to left instead of left to right as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.

REINDEER ANTLERS (make 2). 
With A and smaller hook, ch 14. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. 
**2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
Rep last rnd 10 times more. 
Shape Side Antler: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. 
Rep last rnd until there are 24 sc. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. Ch 2. Skip next 12 sc. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join. 14 sc. 
Next 6 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
Shape top of Side Antler: Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 10 sts. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 5 times. Join. 5 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread yarn through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely. 
Main Antler: Join A with sl st to rem loops of ch-2. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in rem loops of ch-2. 1 sc in each skipped sc around. Join. 14 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. ** 
Rep from ** to ** once more. 
Rep last rnd 5 times more. 
Shape top of Main Antler: Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 10 sts. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 5 times. Join. 5 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread yarn through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely. 
Following diagram on page 3, sew Reindeer Antlers to inside of Basket.

EARS (make 2)
With MC and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join. 9 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join. 12 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join. 15 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join. 18 sc. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join. 21 sc. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join. 24 sc. 
8th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join. 27 sc. 
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. PM at end of last rnd. 
Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 3” [7.5 cm]. Next rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 9 times. Join. 18 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. 
Do not stuff.

NOSE
With B and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th to 8th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread yarn through sts of last rnd. Pull slightly. Stuff lightly and sew Nose in position.

EYES
With D, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in next sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc. Fasten off D.
4th rnd: (RS). Join C with sl st to back loop of any sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Fasten off. 
Using satin stitch, with C, embroider White Dot on each eye (see diagram). Sew Eyes in position.

instructions:
BASKET
Notes:

Base Note: Do not join at ends of rnds unless otherwise stated. Cont working in spiral placing marker on first st of each subsequent rnd for easier counting.
Wth B, ch 2.

Cont working in spiral as follows:
2nd rnd: 2 splsc in each sc around. 12 sts.
3rd rnd: *2 splsc in next st. 1 splsc in next st. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
4th rnd: *1 splsc in next st. 2 splsc in next st. 1 splsc in next st. Rep from * around. 24 sts.

7th rnd: *2 splsc in next st. 1 splsc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * around. 42 sts.
8th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 3 sts. 2 splsc in next st. 1 splsc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. 48 sts.
9th rnd: *2 splsc in next st. 1 splsc in each of next 7 sts. Rep from * around. 54 sts.
10th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 4 sts. 2 splsc in next st. 1 splsc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. 60 sts.
11th rnd: *2 splsc in next st. 1 splsc in each of next 9 sts. Rep from * around. 66 sts.
12th rnd: 1 splsc in each st around.
13th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 5 sts. 2 splsc in next st. 1 splsc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * around. 72 sts.
14th rnd: 1 splsc in each st around. With F, join with sl st to first st. Break B.
Do not fasten off.
Cont with Sides as follows:
Side Note: Rnds are joined with sl st to first st.
1st rnd: With F, ch 1. 1 hdcbl in each st around. Join. 72 sts.
2nd to 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 splhdc in each st around. Join. 72 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 splhdc in each st around. Join with A.

Proceed with Intarsia Pat as follows:
Notes:
• Turn after each rnd, working odd rnds with RS facing and even rnds with WS facing.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 4 skeins 1970 Taupe A

Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 6.5mm [US K-10½] and 8mm [US L-11]
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Basket measures 12" in diameter x 14" tall (30.5 cm x 35.5 cm) with open top.

instructions:
Bottom 
With larger hook and 4 strands of A held together, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 10 hdc in ring; join with slip st in first hdc—10 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first hdc—20 hdc.

Round 4: Ch 1, hdc in first 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, *hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first hdc—40 hdc.
Round 5: Ch 1, 2 hdc in first st, hdc in next 3 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first hdc—50 hdc.
Round 6: Ch 1, hdc in first 2 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 4 sts; repeat from * around to last 2 sts, hdc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in first hdc—60 hdc.
Round 7: Ch 1, 2 hdc in first st, hdc in next 5 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first hdc—70 hdc.
Round 8: Ch 1, hdc in first 3 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 6 sts; repeat from * around to last 3 sts, hdc in last 3 sts; join with slip st in first hdc—80 hdc.
Round 9: Ch 1, 2 hdc in first st, hdc in next 7 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 7 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first hdc—90 hdc.
Round 10: Ch 1, working back loops only, dc in each st around; join with slip st in first dc—90 dc.
Side
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each dc around; join with slip st in first sc—90 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, dc in first st, Fptr around next dc 2 rounds below, *dc in next st, Fptr around next dc 2 rounds below; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—45 dc and 45 tr.
Round 3: Repeat Round 1.
Round 4: Ch 1, Fptr around first dc 2 rounds below, dc in next st, *Fptr around next dc 2 rounds below, dc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc.
Rounds 5–12: Repeat Rounds 1–4 twice or until Side measures 7" (18 cm); change color to 2 strands of B. Cut all strands of A.
Top
Round 1: With smaller hook, ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—90 sc.

Repeat Round 3 until Top measures 6" (15 cm)

Fasten off.
Drawstring
With smaller hook and 2 strands of B held together, work as many ch as necessary for a 44-inch drawstring. Fasten off.

Weave drawstring through ch-1 spaces of Eyelet Round. Knot ends together to secure. Weave in ends.

Round 4: Ch 3, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—48 dc.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—60 dc.
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—72 dc.
Round 7: Ch 1, working in front loops only, sc in same st as join and in each dc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, working in back loops only of Round 6, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 9: Ch 3, dc in each sc around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 10: Ch3, Bpdc around next 2 dc, Fpdc around next 3 dc, *Bpdc around next 3 dc, Fpdc around next 3 dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 11: Ch 3 , Fpdc around next 2 dc, Bpdc around next 3 dc, *Fpdc around next 3 dc, Bpdc around next 3 dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Rounds 12–23: Repeat Rounds 10 and 11 six times.
Round 24: Repeat Round 10.
Round 25: Ch 1, sc in same st as join and in each dc around; join with slip st in first sc. Do not fasten off.
Handles (make 2)
Row 1: *Ch 12, skip next 5 sc, taking care not to twist ch, slip st in next sc, ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in next sc, turn, skip first 2 ch, dc in next 12 ch, skip next sc, slip st in next sc. Fasten off. Skip next 28 sc; join A with slip st in next sc; repeat from * once.
OWL FACE
Outer Eye (Make 2) 
With B, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of container.
Round 3: Ch 3, Fpdc around same st as join, *dc in next dc, Fpdc around same dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—48 sts. Fasten off.
Inner Eye Ruffle (Make 2)
With B, ch 8; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 18 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 2: *3 sc in next sc, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Eyeball (make 2) 
With C, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving tail for sewing.
Beak 
With C, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker on last st and move up as each round is complete.
Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—9 sc.
Round 5: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—12 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—15 sc.
Round 8: Sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew eyeball to center of inner eye ruffle; sew inner eye ruffle to outer eye. Using photograph as a guide, center eyes between handles, 2 to 3 rows below top edge, and sew in place. With wider edge at top, center beak between eyes and sew in place. Weave in ends.

gauge: 7 sts = 4" (10 cm); 6 rows = 4" (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:

Note: The sts making up this base should be relatively tight and stiff. This allows the base of the basket to have structure and not bend too much when carrying yarn. If your sts are too loose, you can make the sts tighter by either using more tension or switching to a smaller hook.
Round 1: Ch 5 (does not count as a st here and throughout), slip st to first ch to form a ring; 8 sc in ring; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 8 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, 2 sc in each of the following sts; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 17 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 25 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first st, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 8 times; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 33 sc.

Round 7: Ch 1, sc in first st, [sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 10 times; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 51 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in first st, [sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 12 times, sc in next 2 sts; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 63 sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, sc in first st, [sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 15 times, sc in next 2 sts; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 78 sc.
Round 10: Ch 1, sc in first st, [sc in next 10 sts, 2 sc in next st] 7 times, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 85 sc.
Do not break yarn.
BASKET WALLS
Round 11: Ch 3, dc in the back loop of each st; slip st to top of beginning ch to join.
Round 12: Ch 3, *BS1, 2 dc in space between last st and next st, BS2, 4 dc, puff st, 4 dc; repeat from * around; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 5 BS1, 5 BS2, 5 puff st, 50 dc.

Round 14: Ch 3, *BS1, 2 dc in space between last st and next st, BS2, 3 dc, puff st, dc, puff st, 3 dc; repeat from * around; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 5 BS1, 5 BS2, 45 dc, 10 puff sts.
Round 15: Ch 3, *[FPEdc] 4 times, skip 2 sts, [FPEdc] 4 times, 3 dc, dc in puff st, dc, dc in puff st, 3 dc; repeat from * around; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 40 FPEdc, 45 dc.
Rounds 16-19: Repeat Rounds 12-15.
Round 20: Ch 1, sc in each st; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 85 sc.
Round 21: Ch 1, 5 sc, ch 14, skip 10 sts, 31 sc, ch 14, skip 10 sts, sc in each remaining st around; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 65 sc, 28 ch.
Round 22: Ch 1, 5 sc, sc in each ch, 31 sc, sc in each ch, sc in each remaining st around; slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 85 sc.
Round 23: Ch 1, sc in each st around; slip st to top of beginning ch to join.

With yarn needle, weave in any loose ends.

abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.

instructions:
Notes:
• When joining new color while working lining, work to last 2 loops on hook of last st. Draw new color through 2 loops, then proceed in new color.
• Carry color not in use loosely across top of previous row and work sts around it to prevent stranding.
BASKET SIDES (make 4)
With A, ch 37.
1st row:(RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 35 dc.
2nd row: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). *Dcfp around each of next 3 dc. Rep from * to last 4 dc. Dcfp around each of next 3 dc. 1 hdc in last dc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). *Dcbp around each of next 3 sts. Dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 4 sts. Dcbp around each of next 3 sts. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
4th row: As 3rd row.
5th row: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). *Dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Dcbp around each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 4 sts. Dcfp around each of next 3 dc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
Rep 2nd to 5th rows for pat twice more. Fasten off.
BASKET BASE
With A, ch 37.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 36 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until piece measures approx 9” [23 cm]. Fasten off.
LINING SIDES (make 4)
With B, ch 37.
1st row: (RS). With B, 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. *With A, 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. With B, 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. Turn. 36 sc.
First row of Chart is now complete.
Cont in Chart, working 1st to 8th rows twice, then 1st to 4th rows once (20 rows total). Fasten off.
LINING BASE
Work from ** to ** as given for Lining Sides.
Cont in Chart, working 1st to 8th rows 4 times, then 1st to 4th rows once (36 rows total). Fasten off.
FINISHING
Join Basket Sides: With WS tog, join A with sl st to bottom right corner. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc evenly to top edge to join sides. Fasten off.
Rep for rem 3 sides.
Join Basket Base to Sides: Place lower edge of Sides behind Base with WS of work tog, aligning corners of Base with side seams. Join A with sl st to any corner.
1st rnd: Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 rnd of sc evenly around all 4 sides of Base, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Join Lining Sides: With RS tog, join B with sl st to bottom right corner. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc evenly to top edge to join sides. Fasten off. Rep for rem 3 sides.
Join Lining Base to Lining Sides: Place lower edge of Lining Sides behind Lining Base with RS of work tog, aligning corner of Base with side seams. Join B with sl st to any corner.
1st rnd: Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 rnd of sc evenly around all 4 sides of Lining Base, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Join Basket to Lining: Place Lining inside Basket, making sure all corners are aligned properly and top edges are even.
1st rnd: With RS of Lining facing you, join A with sl st to any sc. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 rnd of sc evenly around top edge to join Basket and Lining. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Turn work so RS of Basket is facing you. Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 rnd of reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

instructions:
Notes:

With B, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.

With B, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.

Using long ends on Handles, sl st to top edge of 2 Plain Motifs, beg at first dc after ch-3 sp. Fasten off and weave in ends.

With A, ch 6. See crochet diagram on page 2 and Blanket Chart on page 3. Each square of chart represents 1 block. 
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each of last 2 ch. Turn. 1 block made. 
2nd row: Ch 6. 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch – beg block made.  (Sl st. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp – block made. Turn. 2 blocks. 
3rd row: Beg block. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 3 blocks. 
Keeping cont of color changes in Chart on page 3 (each square on grid represents 1 block), rep last row until 60th row of chart is complete. 60 blocks. 
Keeping cont of Chart, proceed as follows to work sides even: 
61st row: Sl st in each of first 3 dc. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 
62nd row:  Beg block. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. Sl st in last ch-3 sp. (Do not make a block.) Turn. 
63rd to 72nd rows:  Rep last 2 rows 5 times more.
Keeping cont of Chart, proceed as follows to dec corner: 
73rd row: (RS). Sl st in each of first 3 dc. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. Sl st in last ch-3 sp. (Do not make a block). Turn. 
Keeping cont of Chart, rep last row until 1 block rem. 
Fasten off.
Edging: 
1st rnd:  (RS). Join A with sl st to any corner. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 
Work dc evenly around, working 5 dc in each corner. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
2nd rnd:  Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc around, working 5 dc in each corner dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver Chunky™: 4 skeins 400 Grey Heather A, 1 skein 341 Light Grey B, and small amounts of 373 Petal Pink C, and 312 Black D
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 6.5mm [US K-10½] and 8mm [US L-11]

[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Basket measures about 10" [25.5 cm] high, 12" [30.5 cm] wide and 36" [91.5 cm] circumference.
gauge: 9 sc = about 4" [10 cm]; 10 rows = about 4" [10 cm] with larger hook and 2 strands of yarn held together. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BASKET BASE
With larger hook and 2 strands of A held together, ch 3; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc.
Place a marker in last sc of Round 1 to mark end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around, do not join with slip st in first sc, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 7: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 6 times—42 sc.
Round 8: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts] 6 times—48 sc.
Round 9: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts] 6 times—54 sc.
Round 10: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts] 6 times—60 sc.
Round 11: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts] 6 times—66 sc.
Round 12: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts] 6 times—72 sc.
Round 13: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 11 sts] 6 times—78 sc.
Fasten off. Base should measure about 12" [30.5 cm] across.

BASKET SIDES
With larger hook and 2 strands of A held together, ch 24.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—23 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Repeat last row until piece measures about 36" [91.5 cm] from beginning (or length needed to reach comfortably all the way around outer edge of basket base).
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew short edges of basket sides together to form a tube. Sew one edge of tube to basket base.

Ears (make 2)
Place the side seam at the back of the basket and find the center of the top edge. One ear will be worked on each side of the center of top edge of basket.
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, larger hook, and 2 strands of A held together, join yarn with an sc to top edge of basket, about 2" [5 cm] past center top, work 6 more sc along top edge of basket—7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each st across—6 sc.
Rows 3–6: Repeat Row 2 for 4 more times—2 sc in Row 6.
Fasten off. Repeat to work 2nd ear, beginning the ear about 5½-6" [14-15 cm] before the first ear so that the finished ears are about 4" [10 cm] apart.

Inner Ear (make 2)
With smaller hook and one strand of B, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each remaining ch across—7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each st across—6 sc.
Rows 3–6: Repeat Row 2 for 4 more times—2 sc in Row 6.
Fasten off.

Nose
With smaller hook and one strand of C, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each remaining ch across—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each st across—4 sc.
Rows 3 and 4: Repeat Row 2 twice—2 sc in Row 4.
Fasten off.

Sew one inner ear to front of each ear. Sew nose to front of basket, centered between ears and 2-3" [5-7.5 cm] below top edge.

Facial features: Use photograph as a guide. With 2 strands of D, embroider straight stitch eyes and mouth.
With 2 strands of B, embroider straight stitch whiskers.
Weave in ends.

materials: 1 skein each 3955 Wildflower A and 358 Lavender B
1 ball 226 Natural of AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4 mm [US G-6]
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 6 mm [US J-10]
Susan Bates® split lock stitch markers
Two 10½ x 13½" (26.5 x 34.5 cm) sheets of 7-count plastic canvas
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Box Measures 9¼ x 9¼ x 3½" (23.5 x 23.5 x 9 cm)
gauge: 17 sts (including ch sts) = 4" (10 cm); 16 rows = 4" (10 cm) in Moss Stitch using smaller hook.
instructions:
MOSS STITCH
Ch an even number of sts.
Row 1: Skip 3 ch, sc in next ch, * ch 1, skip 1 foundation ch, sc in next ch; repeat from * to end, turn.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Repeat Row 3 only for Moss st.
INSIDE BOTTOM
With A and smaller hook, ch through 1 full color sequence, with the last loop on hook being the first loop of a new color just after a color change in the yarn.
Row 1 (right side): Sk 3 ch, sc in the 4th ch from the hook, * ch 1, sc around the foundation ch (instead of going into a ch st); repeat from * until 1 full color sequence has been completed. Count the number of sc made in each individual color in the colorway and note it down, then unravel one st repeat (sc, ch 1). Leave remaining ch sts unworked, turn.
Row 2 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Note: As you work this row and all remaining rows, you MUST get the correct number of sc in each color in order to maintain the planned color pooling. Change hook sizes, or actual st used, to get the correct color in place. If you use the same number of sts per color that you counted on Row 1, it will work out.
Row 3 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Note: The color of the sts on this row will shift to the left or right by 1 st from the previous right side row depending on the colorway and if you are right or left handed. It doesn’t matter which direction the stitch shifts as long as it is offset by 1.
Row 4 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Repeat rows 3 & 4 until 1 full color sequence has been worked at each side edge, ending after a Row 3.
Fasten off.
SIDES OF BOX
With A and smaller hook, ch through 4 full color sequences, with the last loop on hook being the first loop of a new color just after a color change in the yarn.
Row 1 (right side): Sk 3 ch, sc in the 4th ch from the hook, * ch 1, sc around the foundation ch (instead of going into a ch st); repeat from * until 4 full color sequences have been completed. Make certain that the number of sc made in each individual color in the colorway is the same as in Inside Bottom. Unravel one st repeat (sc, ch 1). Leave remaining ch sts unworked, turn.
Work in planned pooling Moss st same as Inside Bottom until piece measures 7" (18 cm), ending after a right side row. Fasten off.
OUTSIDE BOTTOM
With B and larger hook, ch 25.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end, turn – 24 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc to end, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures same as Inside Bottom, ending after a right side row.
Fasten off.
PLASTIC CANVAS FRAME
Cut plastic canvas pieces as follows: One square wider than Inside Bottom piece by one plastic-grid on all sides (C), two rectangles wider than Inside Bottom by one plastic-grid x 3.25" (8cm) high (D), and two rectangles equal to side edge of Inside Bottom x 3.25" (8cm) high (E).
Using cotton crochet thread, whip st short edges of D rectangles to short edges of E rectangles to join sides of frame, being sure to pull the cotton tight after each st. Align D rectangles so they are on outside of seam, as shown in frame diagram.
Use markers to hold corners of C to corners where the sides meet.
Using cotton crochet thread, whip st around edges of C, securing it to the sides by pulling the cotton tight after each st.
FINISHING
Squish or stretch the sts on foundation ch of Inside Bottom piece to match the width of the rest of the piece. You can slide the sts around along the foundation ch, as with an adjustable ring. Unravel unused foundation ch sts and weave in yarn tail to secure foundation. Work foundation of Sides of Box piece the same.
With right sides facing together, pin top edge of Sides of Box piece to Inside Bottom piece. With B, whip st short edges of Sides together and continue sewing around perimeter of Inside Bottom. Pull the sts snug so they don’t show through on right side.
Place Inside Bottom into the plastic canvas frame with wrong side down, matching up each corner. Using yarn needle and B, pass needle from outside of plastic frame up through a corner. Make sure the corner is in place, and pass the needle from inside the box back through to the outside, catching one st to secure the corner. From outside the plastic frame, pull the two ends of B tightly and tie a knot. Cut off the ends of the yarn, leaving a short tail. Don’t worry about the tails, they will be covered by Outside Bottom piece. Secure remaining 3 corners and center of Inside Bottom the same.
Carefully fold the sides of the box down over the plastic frame, easing the piece around the corners to avoid tearing the yarn.
With right sides facing out, pin Outside Bottom to foundation edge of Sides. With B, whip st around Outside Bottom to join to Sides of Box.
Weave all loose ends to inside.

24th rnd: (RS). Ch 1. *With A, 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 11.5 mm [US P-16] (for basket) and 6 mm [US J-10] (for scarf and facial features)

[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Basket measures about 16" [40.5 cm] tall and 42" [106.5 cm] circumference.
gauge: 5 sts = about 3" [7.5 cm]; 5 rounds = about 3" [7.5 cm] in single crochet (sc). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size needle to obtain the gauge.
instructions: With smaller hook and 2 strands of C held together, ch 11. Row 1: Dc in 3rd ch from hook (2 skipped ch do not count as a st) and in each remaining ch across—9 dc. Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each dc across. Row 3: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), turn, dc in each st across. Rows 4–85: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 for 41 times. Row 86: Repeat Row 2. Fasten off. Before beginning basket, wind B and C into 4 separate, equal sized balls of yarn. With larger hook and 4 strands of A held together, ch 2. Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). Place a marker in last stitch made. Move marker up as each round is completed. Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around—12 sc. Round 3: Repeat Round 2—24 sc. Round 4: [Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—30 sc. Round 5: [Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—36 sc. Round 6: [Sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—42 sc. Round 7: [Sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—48 sc. Round 8: [Sc in next 7 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—54 sc. Round 9: [Sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—60 sc. Round 10: [Sc in next 9 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—66 sc. Round 11: [Sc in next 10 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times—72 sc. Scalloped Lower Edge: Working in front loops only of Round 11 sts, slip st in first st, *2 hdc in next st, skip next st **, slip st in next st; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **. Round 12: Working in back loops only of Round 11 sts, sc in each st around. Rounds 13–28: Sc in each st around; change to 4 strands of C held together in last st of Round 28. Rounds 29–32: With C, sc in each st around; change to 4 strands of B held together in last st of Round 32. Rounds 33–38: With B, sc in each st around. Round 39 (form handles): Sc in next 12 sts, ch 12, skip next 12 sts, sc in next 24 sts, ch 12, skip next 12 sts, sc in next 12 sts—48 sc and 2 ch-12 spaces. Round 40: Sc in next 12 sts, sc in next 12 ch, sc in next 24 sts, sc in next 12 ch, sc in next 12 sts; slip st in first sc of this round. Fasten off. With smaller hook and a single strand of C, ch 4. Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—3 sc. Rows 2–6: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, sc2tog—2 sc. Rows 8–12: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. Row 13: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog—1 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing carrot nose to basket. With smaller hook and a single strand of D, ch 2. Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). Place a marker in last stitch made. Move marker up as each round is completed. Round 2: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] twice, slip st in next st; leave last st unworked. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing eye to basket. Use photograph as a guide to feature placement. Nose: Sew carrot nose at an angle between Rounds 22 and 26. Eyes: Sew an eye on each side of top of carrot nose, about 2 stitches away from nose. Mouth: With yarn needle and 2 strands of D held together, embroider a chain stitch smile beneath the carrot nose. Scarf: The scarf is longer than needed to reach around the basket, the ends are supposed to overlap. Before beginning, decide where you want the overlapping ends of the scarf to be. Carefully pin scarf in place around basket just above scalloped lower edge. When happy with the scarf placement, sew the top and lower edges to the basket leaving the overlapping ends loose. After edges of scarf are sewn to basket, gather the 9 sts of the first overlapping row on each overlapped end to make it look like the scarf ends have been tied together. Weave in any remaining ends.

6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sc.

9th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 72 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Place marker at end of rnd.
11th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 6" [15 cm]. Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Rep from * around. Join 2 strands of B with sl st to first sc. 66 sc. Break A.
Next rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
Next rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.

First Petal: 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 2 sc in same st as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 13 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 4th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Sc2tog. 11 sc. 5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. 9 sc. 6th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in next sc. (Sc2tog) twice. 5 sc. Fasten off.

Second through Sixth Petals: With RS facing, join 2 strands of B with sl st to first unworked st of last rnd of Basket. Work 1st to 6th rows as given for First Petal.

instructions:
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
With 2 strands of A, ch 2.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.

4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.

materials: 1 skein of RED HEART® Sweet Home™ in 9785 Calypso
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 6 mm [US J-10]
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Basket measures 6 x 11" (15 x 28 cm) at base and 7" (18 cm) high.
gauge: 10 sc = 4" (10 cm); 8 sc rows = 4" (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BASE
Ch 16.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end, turn – 15 sc.
Rows 2-23: Ch 1, sc in each sc to end, turn. Do not fasten off.

SIDES
Begin working around Base in joined rounds as follows:
Round 1: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each of next 13 sc, 3 sc in next sc, working in edge sts of rows, skip first row, sc in each of next 22 rows, working in unused loops of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in each of next 13 ch, 3 sc in next ch, working in edge sts of rows, sc in each of next 22 rows, sc in same st as first sc of this round, join with slip st in first sc – 82 sc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as 1 hdc), working in the back loops only, dc in each of next 15 sc, hdc in next sc, dc in each of next 24 sc, hdc in next sc, dc in each of next 15 sc, hdc in next sc, dc in each of next 24 sc, join with slip st in 2nd ch of beginning ch-2.
Rounds 3-6: Ch 2 (counts as 1 hdc), dc in each of next 15 sts, hdc in next hdc, dc in each of next 24 dc, hdc in next hdc, dc in each of next 15 dc, hdc in next hdc, dc in each of next 24 dc, join with slip st in 2nd ch of beginning ch-2.
Round 7 (dec round): Slip st in each of next 2 sts, ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), dc in each of next 12 dc, dc3tog over next (dc, hdc, dc), dc in each of next 22 dc, dc3tog over next (dc, hdc, dc), dc in each of next 13 sts, dc3tog over next (dc, hdc, dc), dc in each of next 22 sts, dc3tog over next dc and 2 slip sts, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-3 – 74 sts.
Round 8: Ch 2 (does not count as a st), hdc in each st around, join with slip st in first hdc, turn.

BRIM
Round 9: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each hdc around, join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 10-12: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in all loose ends.

abbreviations: Popcorn = Work 6 dc into same stitch or space. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back into first dc of 6 dc group. Pull dropped loop through st. Ch 1 to secure popcorn.

instructions:
Notes: • All rnds are joined with sl st to first sc.

With A, ch 2.
