2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in next st. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sc.
10th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sc.
11th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 66 sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 72 sc.
13th rnd:  Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each st around. Join.
14th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Rep 14th rnd until Basket measures 3" [7.5 cm] deep.
Beg working Tulip Pat as follows:
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sts. Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd and 3rd ch from hook – picot made. *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Picot. Rep from * around. Join. Break A. Join B.
2nd rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). Skip first sc. *Popcorn in next sc. Ch 2. Skip next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Ch 2. Popcorn in next sc. Ch 1. Join to 3rd ch of ch-4. Break B. Join A.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in ch-1 sp. 1 sc in popcorn. *2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next popcorn. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last ch-1 sp. Join.
4th to 8th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
9th rnd: As 1st rnd. Break A. Join C.
10th rnd:  As 2nd rnd. Break C. Join A.
11th to 16th rnds: With A, as 3rd to 8th rnds.
Rep 1st to 12th rnds once more. Fasten off.

abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Basket measures 11” (28 cm) in diameter x 5½” (14 cm) tall.
gauge: 14 dc = 4” (10 cm); 6 rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size needles/hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
Bottom
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 14 dc in 3rd ch from hook, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 15 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in same st, 2 dc in each st around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 30 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in same st, dc in next st, *2 dc in next st, dc in next st; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 45 dc.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in same st, dc in each of next 2 sts, *2 dc in next st, dc in each of next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 60 dc.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in same st, dc in each of next 3 sts, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 75 dc.
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in same st, dc in each of next 4 sts, *2 dc in next st, dc in each of next 4 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 90 dc.
Round 7: Ch 3, dc in same st, dc in each of next 5 sts, *2 dc in next st, dc in each of next 5 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 105 dc.
Round 8: Ch 3, dc in same st, dc in each of next 6 sts, *2 dc in next st, dc in each of next 6 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 120 dc.
Rounds 9-11: Ch 1, working in back loop only, sc in each st around; join with a slip st in first sc – 120 sc.
Round 12: Ch 3, working in back loop only, dc in each of the next 2 sts, ch 3, skip next 3 sts, *dc in each of next 3 sts, ch 3, skip next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 60 dc; 20 ch-3 spaces.
Round 13: Ch 3, dc in each of next 2 sts, dc in each of next 3 ch sts, *dc in each of next 3 sts, dc in each of the next 3 ch sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 120 dc.
Round 14: Ch 3, dc in each of next 2 sts, ch 3, skip next 3 sts, *dc in each of the next 3 sts, ch 3, skip next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 60 dc; 20 ch-3 spaces.
Rounds 15–16: Repeat rounds 13–14.
Round 17: Ch 1, *working in back loop only, sc in each of the next 3 sts, sc in each of next 3 ch sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc – 120 sc.
Round 18: Ch 1, working in back loop only, sc in each st around; join with a slip st in first sc – 120 sc.
Round 19: Ch 1, working in back loop only, sc in each st around; join with a slip st in first sc – 120 sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.
LEATHER HANDLES
Cut leather scrap in 2 pieces, 1” (2.5 cm) wide x 6” (15 cm) long. Round the ends if desired. Poke a hole through each end of the leather pieces, about a ½” (1.3 cm) from each end. Put one stud or rivet through each hole and use them to attach the handles to opposite sides of basket.

materials: Bernat® Maker™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 317 yds/290 m)
Main Color (MC) Soft Peach (06006) - 1 ball or 180 yds/165 m
Contrast A Lichen (06014) - 1 ball or 95 yds/87 m
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Susan Bates® Split-Lock Stitch Count Marker
measurements: Small Basket: Approx 4½" [11.5 cm] diameter x 7" [18 cm] unfolded. Large Basket: Approx 6¾" [17 cm] diameter x 9" [23 cm] unfolded.
gauge: 10 single crochet (sc) and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
1st round (rnd): 8 single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook. Join with slip stitch (sl st) to first sc. 8 sc. Insert hook into second ch from hook under the two top loops (do not count loop on hook as a chain); yarn over hook and draw up a loop – 2 loops on hook.

SMALL BASKET
See Diagram on page 6.
Base: With Main Color (MC), make a slip knot and place it on the hook.
Slip Knot
Make a loop with yarn and fold it on itself to make a pretzel shape. Then draw through to make slip knot.
Chain (ch) 2.
Chain
Yarn over hook (yoh), pull through loop – 1 chain made.
Repeat (rep) last step once more – 2 chains made.
Yarn over hook (yoh) and draw through both loops on hook – 1 sc made.
Rep last step 7 times more - 8 sc made.

Slip Stitch
Insert hook into next st. Yoh and draw yarn through both work and loop on hook in one movement.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next sc for corner. 1 sc in next sc. Repeat (rep) from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next sc for corner. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc and 4 ch-1 spaces (sps).

3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 space (sp). 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.

4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.

5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.

6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Place Marker (PM) at end of rnd. 44 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.

Sides: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. *Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * twice more. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 44 sc.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 4" [10 cm]. Break MC. Join A with sl st to last st worked.
With A, rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 7" [18 cm]. Fasten off. Fold top 3" [7.5 cm] to Right Side (RS) as seen in picture.

Fasten off
To permanently fasten off yarn, cut yarn leaving a long tail. Pull end of yarn through loop on hook and pull gently to tighten.

STITCH KEY
= chain (ch)
= slip stitch (sl st)
= single crochet (sc)

LARGE BASKET
Base: Rep 1st to 6th rnds as for Small Basket. Do not place marker on 6th rnd.

7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 52 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.

8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next 6 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 60 sc and and 4 ch-1 sps.

9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 8 sc. *(1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Rep from * twice more. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next 7 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Place Marker (PM) at end of rnd. 68 sc and 4 ch-1 sps.

Sides: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 9 sc. *Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 17 sc. Rep from * twice more. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 68 sc.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 6" [15 cm]. Break MC. Join A with sl st to last st worked.
With A, rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 9" [23 cm]. Fasten off. Fold top 3" [7.5 cm] to RS as seen in picture.

instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: redheart.com
©2017 Coats & Clark Page 1 of 2
An organized home is a more relaxed home, and these baskets can help make it happen. They are easy to crochet and will hold all your favorite possessions right where you need them (like your yarn).
Directions are for size Small basket. Changes for Large baskets are in parentheses.

Notes
1. Each basket is worked in joined rounds, beginning at the center of the base.
2. Three strands are held together throughout.
3. To change yarn color, working joining slip st as follows: Insert hook in first sc, yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook. Proceed with new color. Cut old color, leaving a long tail to weave in later.

BASKET
Base
With 3 strands of A held together, ch 3; slip st in first ch to form a ring.

Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—54 sc.
Round 10: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—60 sc.

Large Basket Only:
Round 11: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—66 sc.
Round 12: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—72 sc.
Round 13: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 11 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—78 sc.
Round 14: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 12 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—84 sc.

Sides
All Baskets:
Next Round (right side): Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—60 (84) sc.
Next 5 (19) Rounds: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Change yarn color to B in joining slip st of last round.
Next Round (right side): With B, ch 1, sc in same st as joining, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Next 10 (6) Rounds: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.

Handles
Next Round: Ch 1, sc in first 10 (14) sts, ch 10 (14), skip next 10 (14) sts, sc in next 20 (28) sts, ch 10 (14) sts, skip next 10 (14) sts, sc in last 10 (14) sts; join with slip st in first sc—40 (56) sc and 2 ch-10 (14) spaces.
Next Round: Ch 1, [sc in each st to next ch-space, 10 (14) sc in ch-space] twice, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Last Round: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off B.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Maker Splash™ (8.8 oz /250 g; 305 yds/279 m)
Concrete (35001) or Blue Print (35011) or Teal Print (35010)
Sizes U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet through back loops only
gauge: 14.5 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
FIRST SECTION
Ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.  
2nd rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each of next 5 sc. Join 
with sl st to top of ch-3. 6 dc.
Start working in rows as follows:
1st row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
PM #1 at beg of row. 
Sl st in top of first dc of 2nd rnd to join. Turn. 2 sts (1 sc, 1 sl st).
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in first sl st. Working in back loop, sl st in 
last sc. Turn. 2 sts (1 sc, 1 sl st).
3rd row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl in 
next sc. Sl st in next dc of 2nd rnd to join. Turn. 3 sts 
(1 sl st, 1 sc, 1 sl st).
4th row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in first sl st. 1 scbl in next sc. Working in 
back loop, sl st in last sl st. Turn. 3 sts (2 sc, 1 sl st).
5th row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl in 
each of next 2 sc. Sl st in next dc of 2nd rnd to join. Turn. 4 sts 
(1 sl st, 2 sc, 1 sl st).
6th row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in first sl st. 1 scbl in each of next 2 sc. 
Working in back loop, sl st in last sl st. Turn. 4 sts (3 sc, 1 sl st).
7th row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl in 
each of next 3 sc. Sl st in same dc of 2nd rnd to join. Turn. 
5 sts (1 sl st, 3 sc, 1 sl st). 
PM #2 on last sl st.
SECOND SECTION
Note: Second Section will be worked over the same number 
of sts (5 sts) without increases after 8th row.
8th row: (WS- inc row). Ch 1. 1 scbl in first sl st. 1 scbl in each 
of next 3 sc. Working in back loop, sl st in last sl st. Turn. 5 sts 
(4 sc, 1 sl st).
9th row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl in 
each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st in next dc of 2nd rnd. Turn. 
10th and alt rows: (WS). Ch 1. Skip first sl st. 1 scbl in each of 
next 4 sc. Working in back loop, sl st in last sl st. Turn. 5 sts.
11th row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl in 
each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st in next dc of 2nd rnd. Turn.
13th row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl in 
each of next 4 sc. Sl st in same dc of 2nd rnd. Turn. 
15th row: As 11th row. 
PM #3 on last joining sl st. 
4 ridges total for Second Section.
THIRD  SECTION
Note: Third Section will be worked over the same number of 
sts (6 sts) without increases after 16th row. 
16th row: (WS – inc row). Ch 1. 1 scbl in first sl st. 1 scbl in each 
of next 4 sc. Working in back loop, sl st in last sl st. Turn. Total 
6 sts. (5 sc, 1 sl st). 
17th row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl in 
each of next 5 sc. Join with sl st to last dc of 2nd rnd.  Turn. 
18th and alt rows: (WS). Ch 1. Skip first sl st. 1 scbl in each of 
next 5 sc. Working in back loop, sl st in last sl st. Turn. 6 sts.
19th row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl in 
each of next 5 sc. Join with sl st in side of 1st row (where 
placed marker #1). Turn.
21st row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl in 
each of next 5 sc. Join with sl st in sp between next 2 ridges 
(side of 3rd row). Turn.
23rd row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl 
in each of next 5 sc. Join with sl st in same sp as last joining 
sl st. Turn.
25th row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl 
in each of next 5 sc. Join with sl st in sp between next 2 ridges 
(side of 5th row).
27th row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl 
in each of next 5 sc. Join with sl st in sp between next 2 ridges. 
Turn. 
PM #4 on last joining sl st. 6 ridges total for Third Section.
FOURTH  SECTION
Note: Fourth Section will be worked over the same number 
of sts (7 sts) without increases after first increase row 
(28th row of pat) of section.
28h row: (WS – inc row). Ch 1. 1 scbl in first sl st. 1 scbl in 
each sc to last sl st. Working in back loop, sl st in last sl st. 
Turn. 1 sc increased.
29th row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl 
in each sc to end of row. Join with sl st in same sp as last 
joining sl st. Turn.  
30th and alt rows: (WS). Ch 1. Skip first sl st. 1 scbl in each sc 
to last sl st. Working in back loop, sl st in last sl st. Turn. 
The same amount of sts as for 28th rnd.
31st row: Ch 1. Working in back loop, sl st in first sl st. 1 scbl in 
each sc to end of row. Join with sl st in sp between next 
2 ridges. Turn.
33rd row: As 31st row.
34th row: As 30th row.
Rep 29th to 33rd rows once. 6 ridges total for Fourth Section, 
ending on a RS row and PM on last joining sl st. 
Next Section
**Next row: (WS – inc row). As 28th row of Fourth Section. 
Cont in pat as established (alternating 2 ridges in next spot 
with 1 ridge in next spot), rep 29th to 34th rows**. Rep from ** to ** until: 
9 ridges complete for Fifth Section, working over 8 sts, ending 
on a RS row and PM on last joining sl st. 
12 ridges complete for Sixth Section, working over 9 sts, 
ending on a RS row and PM on last joining sl st. 
15 ridges complete for Seventh Section, working over 10 sts, 
ending on a RS row and PM on last joining sl st. 
18 ridges complete for Eighth Section, working over 11 sts, 
ending on a RS row and PM on last joining sl st. 
21 ridges complete for Ninth Section, working over 12 sts, 
ending on a RS row and PM on last joining sl st. 
24 ridges complete for Tenth Section, working over 13 sts, 
ending on a RS row and PM on last joining sl st.
12 ridges complete for Eleventh Section, working over 14 sts, 
ending on WS row. 
Do not fasten off at end of last row.
Hanging loop: Ch 2. Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. PM 
on loop just made. Ch 1. Yoh and draw up a loop through both 
loops on hook – first foundation sc made. *Draw up a loop in 
marked sp. PM on loop just made. Ch 1. Yoh and draw up a 
loop through both loops on hook. Rep from * 11 times more. 
Join with sc to sp where first sc made. Do not fasten off.
Top edging: 1st row: (WS). *Work 1 sc in each sp between next 
2 ridges. Rep from * to last 2 ridges, where last row of last 
section ends.
Note: Top edge will gather slightly to create 3-D shape. 
Do not fasten off.
Spiral Surface sl st: Cont working along joining (spiral) line, 
work surface sl st in each sp between next 2 ridges of sections 
on right side from joining (spiral) line, to end of joining (spiral) 
line (2nd rnd). Fasten off.
Note: Keep sts tight to create inner ridge of spiral.

1st rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as st). *Dcfp around next hdc. Dcbp around next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as st). *Dcbp around next dcfp. Dcfp around next dcbp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st.

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Baby Shower™ (170 yds/155 m)
Size U.S. D/3 (3.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: To fit infant 0-3 mos. Sole: Approx 3¼" [8.5 cm].

instructions:
Notes:
• Each bootie is made from a flat piece that is folded and seamed to form bootie.
• Surface slip stitch trim is worked around top opening of each bootie. 
BOOTIE (make 2)
With A, ch 19, leaving long end of yarn for sewing.
First Side
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. 18 sc. Turn.
2nd to 18th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Do not fasten off at end of last row.
Toe
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 9 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 9 sc.
2nd to 9th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Turn. Do not fasten off at end of last row.

Second Side
1st row: Ch 10. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 8 ch. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 18 sc.
2nd to 18th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Fasten off, leaving 18-20" [45.5-51 cm] end of yarn for sewing.
FINISHING
Fold Bootie in half. With beginning tail, sew heel seam. With ending tail, sew sole seam. Continue with ending tail, weave tail through ends of rows at toe and pull tightly to form toe and close opening. Weave in ends.
Surface Slip Stitch Trim
With B, work surface slip stitch trim around top opening of each bootie, as follows:
With RS facing, beg at heel end of bootie, hold yarn on WS. Leaving a long beg end of yarn, insert hook from RS to WS in top edge of bootie. Yoh and draw loop through fabric to RS (1 loop on hook). 
*Insert hook in next stitch along top edge of bootie. Yoh and draw loop through fabric and through loop on hook. Rep from * around top edge of bootie. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

instructions:
SOCK (Make 2)
With A, ch 18.
Row 1 (Right Side): Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 17 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc in blo of each st across; turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 1½”, ending with a Wrong Side row; do not turn on last row. Ch 13; turn.
Sock Top-Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, hdc in blo of last 17 hdc; turn – 29 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc in blo in 1st 17 sts, hdc through both loops to end; turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, hdc in 1st 12 sts, hdc in blo to end; turn.
Repeat Rows 2-3 until Sock Top measures 2” across, ending with Row 3.
Next Row: Ch 2, hdc in blo in 1st 17 sts; turn.
Repeat last row until Sock measures 5” across entire width, ending on a Right Side row.
Join Cuff: Fold cuff with Right Sides together, sc through outer loops of both sides. Do not fasten off.
Sock Edging: Ch 1, sc 11 evenly along bottom edge of Cuff, sc 12 along side of Sock Top (place marker in last st), sc 13 along front of Sock Top, sc 12 along side of Sock Top (place marker in first st), sc 12 along bottom edge of cuff; join to 1st sc. Fasten off.

SHOE (Make 2)
With B, ch 15.
Round 1: 2 Hdc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 12 ch, 5 hdc in last ch; turn to work in unused loops of beginning ch, hdc in next 12 ch, 2 hdc in 1st ch; join – 33 sts.
Round 2: Ch 2, 2 hdc in same st as join, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 12 sts, [2 hdc in next st] 5 times; hdc in next 12 sts, [2 hdc in next st] 2 times; join – 42 sts.
Round 3: Ch 2, 2 hdc in same st as join, [2 hdc in next st] 2 times; hdc in next 16 sts, [2 hdc in next st] 6 times; hdc in next 16 sts, 2 hdc in next st, 2 hdc in same st as join; join – 54 sts.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in same st as join, hdc in next 25 sts, [2 hdc in next st] 6 times; hdc in next 22 sts; join – 60 sts.
Shoe Side-Round 5: Ch 2, hdc in blo in each st around; join.
Rounds 6-7: Ch 2, hdc in 1st 26 sts, place marker, dc in next 15 sts, place marker, hdc in next 19 sts; join.
Fasten off.

STRAP (Make 2)
With B, ch 21.
Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
With Right Sides together, match markers of Sock and Shoe. With B, slip st through both loops of Sock and blo of Shoe in each st around. Fasten off. Turn Right Side out.
Join B in any unused loop of Shoe, ch 1, sc in same st and in each around; join to 1st st. Fasten off.
Attach Strap to sc edge of Shoe 1” from end of Sock. Tack down other side to other side of Shoe to mimic a Mary Jane shoe strap.
Weave in ends.

instructions:
The instructions are written for smaller size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written thus ( ). When only one number is given, it applies to both sizes. For ease in working, circle all numbers pertaining to your size.
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc throughout.
• Join rnds with sl st to top of ch 3 or first sc.
Motif (make 2)
Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 2 dc in ring. (Ch 2. 3 dc) 3 times in ring. Ch 2. Join.
2nd rnd: Sl st in each of next 2 dc and ch-2 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same sp as last sl st. [Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. Ch 1. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in each of next 2 dc and ch-2 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same sp. [Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Join. Fasten off.

2nd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 31 sc. 1 dc in each of next 27 (31) ch. Join. 58 (62) dc.

3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 (6) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 15 (17) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 (11) sc. Join. 48 (52) sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 (6) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 15 (17) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 (11) sc. Join. 44 (48) sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 (6) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 15 (17)sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 (11) sc. Join. 40 (44) sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 (6) sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 15 (17) sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 (9) sc. Join. 34 (38) sts. Fasten off. Sew bottom of sole.
Ankle: With RS facing, join yarn with sl st to right corner ch-2 sp of Motif. 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. Work 7 sc evenly across side of Motif. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Working in rem loops of ch, 1 sc in each of next 27 (31) ch. Join. 36 (40) sc.
2nd rnd: (Eyelet row). Ch 3. 1 dc in next sc. *Ch 2. Skip next 2 sc. 1 dc in each of next 1 (2) sc. Rep from * around, omitting last 1 (2) dc. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. *1 dc in next 1 (2) dc. 2 dc in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc around. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook - picot made. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. Fasten off.

instructions:

• Each loafer is worked from the sole upwards.

• Inset is crocheted to body of loafer.

LOAFER (make 2)
Sole
With A, ch 16.
1st rnd: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to last ch. 3 hdc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation chain, 1 hdc in each of next 11 ch. 1 hdc next ch (same ch as first hdc). Join with sl st to top of first hdc. 28 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. 2 hdc in each of next 3 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. 2 sc in last st. Join with sl st in first sc. 34 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 2 hdc in each of next 3 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. 1 dc in each of next 7 sts. 2 dc in each of next 5 sts. 1 dc in each of next 7 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. 2 hdc in last st. Join with sl st to top of first hdc. 44 sts. Fasten off. 
Note: Wider end of sole is for toe and narrower end of sole is for heel.

Sides
1st rnd: Join B with sl st to back loop of first st. Ch 1. Form welt st as follows: Insert hook in back loop of same sp as sl st then through horizontal loop on WS ¼-½" [6-13 mm] directly below. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. *Welt st in next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st first st. 44 sts.
PM in first and last of the 22 sts at center of toe end of loafer. 

2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to first marker. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. (Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. 1 hdc in each st to end of rnd. Join with sl st to top of first hdc. 40 sts. Fasten off.

TOE INSET
With A, ch 10.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in ch to end of chain. 8 hdc. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. Sl st in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sl st to end of row. Turn. 
4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in last st. Turn. 10 sc.
5th and 6th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
7th to 9th rows: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sts at end of last row.
Fasten off.

Attach Toe Inset
Note: 2nd row (slip st row) of Inset looks like “dashes” when RS is facing you.
Hold toe inset with RS facing up, with the 4 sts of the last row of inset matching the 4 decs at toe end of loafer. Align ends of 2nd row (slip st row) of inset with first and last sc of last rnd of loafer. Working through both thicknesses and beg in row below instep 2nd row, Yoh and draw A through both sts, leaving a long yarn tail to weave in later, *insert hook through end of next row of inset and then through next st of loafer, Yoh and draw through both sts and through loop on hook. Rep from * around edge of toe to just below other end of 2nd row of toe inset. Fasten off.

Trim and Strengthen Opening
PM on each side of 6 sts centered over heel end of loafer. 
1st row: With RS facing, join B with sl st in same st of loafer as last st of toe inset joining so that you are ready to work towards heel. 1 hdc in each st to first heel marker. (Hdc2tog) 3 times. 1 hdc in each st to toe inset. Sl st in same sp as last st of toe inset joining. Turn. 
2nd row: Working from inside the loafer, sl st firmly in each hdc to give upper edge of opening some strength. Fasten off.

BAND (make 2)
Note: Leave long tail at beg and end of strap for sewing band to loafer.
With B, ch 11.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 9 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sl st in each hdc to end of row.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
With RS of band facing up, place one band on toe inset of each loafer. Arrange slip stitch row of band at top and place it just below slip stitch row of inset. With long tails still attached to band, using photograph as a guide to placement, sew band to loafer. Sew a decorative button to one end of each band.
Weave in ends.

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Baby Shower™ (170 yds/155 m)
Size U.S. D/3 (3.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
2 snap closures for each pair of booties.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st) twice. Yoh and draw through all 5 loops on hook
measurements: To fit infant 0-3 mos. Sole: Approx 3¼" [8.5 cm].
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes:
• Each bootie is worked from sole upwards.
• Sole and sides of bootie are worked in joined rnds.
• Top of foot is worked back and forth in rows over toe end of bootie.
• Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.

BOOTIE (make 2)
Sole
With A, ch 16.
1st rnd: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to last ch. 3 hdc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 hdc in each of next 11 ch. 1 hdc in next ch (same sp as first hdc). Join with sl st to top of first hdc. 28 hdc.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in next hdc. 1 sc in each of next 6 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 2 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 1 sc in each of next 6 hdc. 2 sc in last st. Join with sl st in first sc. 34 sts.

3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 2 hdc in each of next 3 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. 1 dc in each of next 7 sts. 2 dc in each of next 5 sts. 1 dc in each of next 7 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. 2 hdc in last st. Join with sl st to top of first hdc. 44 sts. Fasten off.

Note: Wider end of sole is for toe and narrower end of sole is for heel.

Side
1st rnd: Join B with sl st to back loop of first st. Ch 1. Form welt st as follows: Insert hook in back loop of same sp as sl st then through horizontal loop on WS ¼-½" [6-13 mm] directly below. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. *Welt St in next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st first st. 44 sts.

2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st in top of first hdc. PM on stitch at center of toe.

3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to 2 sts before marked st. 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts. 1 hdc in marked st. Remove marker. 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts. 1 hdc in each st to end of rnd. Join with sl st to top of first hdc. 48 sts.

4th rnd: Ch 2. (Hdc2tog) twice. 1 hdc in each of next 12 sts. 1 sc in each of next 20 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 12 sts. Join with sl st to first hdc. 46 sts. Fasten off.

Top of Foot
Notes:
Version 1: Work top of foot with C.
Version 2: Work top of foot with B.
With RS facing, join yarn with sl st in last hdc before 20 sc at toe end of Bootie.

1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in next st. (Hdc2tog) 4 times. 1 hdc in next st. (Hdc2tog) 4 times. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. 1 sc in next st. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 14 sts.

Beg working in rnd: 
Next rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 3 sts. (Hdc2tog) twice. 1 hdc in next st. (Hdc2tog) twice. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. Cont working across heel section: Sl st in next st. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join with sl st in top of first hdc. Fasten off.

Slip Stitch Trim
Version 1: With RS facing, join C with sl st in top edge of bootie where Top of Foot meets Side (so that you are ready to work towards the heel). Sl st in each st along heel, ending at Top of Foot. Join B. With B, sl st in each st along edge of Top of Foot to end of rnd. Fasten off.

Version 2: With RS facing, join A with sl st at edge of Bootie. Sl st in each st around top edge of Bootie. Fasten off.

STRAP (make 1 for each Bootie)
With B, ch 18, leaving long end of yarn for sewing to Bootie.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 16 hdc. Fasten off.

Refer to photograph as a guide to placement and using long end of yarn, sew end of Strap to Bootie.
Note: The attached yarn tail is at different ends of each of the two straps. One strap is sewn on right edge of one bootie and the other strap is sewn on left edge of the second bootie, creating a left and a right bootie.

FINISHING
Sew top of a snap closure to underside of free end of each strap. Sew decorative button to topside of same end of strap. Sew bottom of snap closure to side of bootie, opposite top of snap at end of strap. Weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart® Baby Sheen™: 1 skein 0700 Pink.
2 Pink ½” (13 mm) buttons with shank, sewing needle and matching thread, Yarn needle.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Booties measure 4” (4½”) along length of foot.
gauge: 5 dc = 1”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain gauge.
instructions:
RIGHT BOOTIE
Ch 15 (17).
Round 1: 2 hdc in third ch from hook; hdc in each of next 11 (13) chs, 3 hdc in last ch; working on the opposite side of the same chs, hdc in each of next 11 (13) chs; sl st into the second ch – 28 (32) hdc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (count as hdc), hdc in same sp; 2 hdc in each of next 2 hdc, dc in each of next 11 (13) hdc, 2 hdc in each of next 3 hdc, dc in each of next 11 (13) hdc; sl st into the second ch – 34 (38) sts.
Round 3: Ch 2 (count as hdc), hdc in same sp; 2 hdc in each of next 5 hdc, dc in each of next 11 (13) dc, 2 hdc in each of next 6 hdc, dc in each of next 11 (13) dc; sl st into the second ch – 46 (50) sts.
Round 4: BPhdc in each st around. Do not join – 46 (50) hdc.
Rounds 5-6: Hdc in every hdc around.
Round 7: Hdc in each of the next 21 (23) hdc, 7 hdc2tog in next 14 hdc, hdc in each of the next 11 (13) hdc.
Round 8: Hdc in each of next 21 (23) hdc, 4 hdc2tog in next 8 hdc decreases, hdc in next 9 (11) hdc. Fasten off.
T-strap
Attach yarn to the center front st; ch 5.
Row 1: Sc in second ch from hook, sc in each of next 3 chs, slip st into the same st as the attachment – 4 sc.
Fasten off.
Strap
Row 1: Starting from the T-strap, skip next 7 (9) sts; attach yarn to next st, ch 2, hdc in next 19 (21) sts, ch 6; sc in the side of each of next 2 sts at the top of the T-strap, ch 12; turn – 40 (42) sts.
Row 2: Skip next 6 ch for buttonhole loop; sc in next 32 (34) sts. Fasten off.
LEFT BOOTIE
Work same as Right Bootie. Work Strap as follows:
Row 1: With wrong side facing and starting from the T-strap, skip next 7 (9) sts; attach yarn to next st, ch 2, hdc in next 19 (21) sts, ch 6, sc in the side of each of next 2 sts at the top of the T-strap, ch 12; turn – 40 (42) sts.
Row 2: Skip next 6 ch for buttonhole loop; sc in next 32 (34) sts. Fasten off.
Sew button at the edge of ankle of the bootie.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Baby Clouds™: 1 skein 9549 Orchid.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Booties fit most babies 6-12 months. Foot Length: 4”.
gauge: 9 sts = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the specified gauge.
instructions:
BOOTIES (make 2)
Ch 8.
Round 1: Work 2 dc in 3rd ch from hook, (beginning ch counts as first dc) dc in next 4 ch, 6 dc in last ch, turn to work along opposite side of beginning ch, dc in next 4 ch, 3 dc in last ch, slip st in top of beginning ch to join—20 dc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in back loops only in each st around, slip st in beginning ch to join.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in next 6 sts, [hdc2tog] 4 times, sc in next 6 sts, slip st in beginning ch to join¬—16 sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in next 6 sts, [hdc2tog] 2 times, sc in next 6 sts, slip st in beginning ch to join—14 sts.
Rounds 5-7: Ch 1, sc in each st around, slip st in beginning ch to join.
Round 8: Ch 1, slip st in each st around, slip st to beginning ch to join.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: Size 4 mm (U.S. G/6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 16 hdc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
note: turning ch 2 does not count as hdc.
Ch 29.
1st row: (rS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch across.
27 hdc. turn.
2nd to 5th rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc across. turn.
6th row: Sl st in each of first 6 hdc. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same st as last
sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 16 hdc. turn. Leave rem 5 hdc unworked.
7th to 11th rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc across. turn. 17 hdc.
Place marker at each end of 9th row. Do not turn at end of
11th row.
12th row: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to
left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each hdc across. Fasten off.
FInIshInG
Fold Bootie in half with rS facing each other. Join yarn with sl st
at marked row and work 1 row of sc through both thicknesses to
join seam down rem of cuff, around toe and across bottom of foot.
Fasten off. turn Bootie right side out. Fold down cuff.
tie: Make a chain 12" [30.5 cm] long. Weave through 7th row of
cuff.

materials: 1 ball each 2205 Little Lamb A and 2012 Black Sheep B
abbreviations: Dec (decrease) = draw up a loop in next 2 sts, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Bootie measures 4½” long x 2” at widest part. Directions are for size 9-12 months.
gauge: 20 sts = 4” in sc rounds. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Sole
With larger hook and A, ch 13.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 10 ch, 3 sc in last ch, sc in 10 ch on opposite side of beginning ch, 3 sc in last ch; join with a slip st in first sc – 27 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, inc in same sc as joining, * sc in next 10 sc, [inc] 3 times; repeat from * once more; join – 34 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, inc in same sc as joining, inc in next sc, sc in next 9 sc, hdc in next 2 sc, [inc] 5 times, hdc in next 2 sc, sc in next 9 sc, [inc] twice, sc in next 3 sc; join – 43 sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, inc in same sc as joining, [inc] twice, sc in next 11 sts, hdc in next 3 sts, [2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts] twice, sc in next 13 sts, [inc] twice, sc in next 3 sts; join – 50 sts.
Round 5: Ch 2, working in back loops only hdc in each st around; join in top of ch-2. Fasten off.
Bootie Upper
Round 1: Attach B in same st as joining; ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st around; join.
Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join. Fasten off.
Ankle
Row 1: Skip next 33 sc of last round, join B in next sc; ch 1, sc in same sc, hdc in next 28 sc, sc in next sc; turn – 30 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, dec, sc in next 7 sts, [dec] twice, sc in next 4 sts, [dec] twice, sc in next 7 sts, dec – 24 sts. Fasten off.
Toe Piece
Round 1: With larger hook and B, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from; join in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [inc] 6 times; join – 12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [inc, sc in next sc] 6 times; join – 18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [inc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times; join – 24 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in next 8 sc; TURN.
Row 6: Ch 2, hdc in first 7 sc, 2 hdc in last sc – 11 sts. Fasten off leaving long tail for sewing.
Finishing
Weave in ends. Sew ends of Rows 5 and 6 of Toe to ends of Rows 1 and 2 of Ankle; ease remaining sts of Toe to Bootie Upper. Embroider eye sockets onto skull head with A. Sew finished skull to upper portion of the toe area. Embroider crossbones by making 2 long running stitches. Tack stitches together at intersection with yarn. Add French Knots at each bone end.

materials: RED HEART® Baby TLC™: 1 ball 5942 Girlie Girl.
Two 9/16” (14 mm) size buttons, sewing needle and matching thread.
abbreviations: Single Crochet Decrease (sc2tog): (Insert hook into next st, yarn over, pull up a loop) twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
gauge: 4 dc= 1”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain gauge.
instructions:
RIGHT BOOTIE
Ch 11 (13).
Round 1: 3 sc in second ch from hook, sc in each of next 8 (10) chs, 3 sc in last ch; working on opposite side of beginning ch, sc in each of next 8 (10) chs, slip st into the first ch – 22 (26) sc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (count as hdc), hdc in same sp; 2 hdc in each of next 2 sc, dc in each of next 8 (10) sc, 2 hdc in each of next 3 sc, dc in each of next 8 (10) sc, slip st into the second ch – 28 (32) sts.
Round 3: Ch 2 (count as hdc), hdc in same sp; 2 hdc in each of next 5 hdc, dc in each of next 8 (10) dc, 2 hdc in each of next 6 hdc, dc in each of next 8 (10) dc, slip st into the second ch – 40 (44) sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in the back loop of every st around; slip st into the first ch – 40 (44) sc.
Rounds 5-6: Ch 1, sc in every sc around; do not join.
Round 7: Sc in each of next 18 (20) sts; sc2tog in next 14 sts, sc in each of next 8 (10) sc – 33 (37) sc.
Round 8: Sc in each of next 18 (20) sc; sc2tog in next 8 sts, sc in each of next 7 (9) sc – 29 (33) sc.
Fasten off.
T-strap
Join yarn to the center front st; ch 5.
Row 1: Sc in second ch from hook, sc in each of next 3 chs; slip st into the same st as the attachment.
Fasten off.
Strap
Row 1: Starting from the T-strap, skip next 5 (7) sts; join yarn to the next st, sc in next 18 (20) sts, ch 5, sc in the side of each of next 2 sts at the top of the T-strap, ch 10; turn.
Row 2: Skip next 5 ch for button loop, sc in next 32 (36) sts.
Fasten off.
LEFT BOOTIE
Work same as Right Bootie. Work strap as follows:
Row 1: Starting from the T-strap and working in opposite direction of Right Bootie Strap, skip next 5 (7) sts; join yarn to the next st, sc in next 18 (20) sts, ch 5, sc in the side of each of next 2 sts at the top of the T-strap, ch 10; turn.
Row 2: Skip next 5 ch for button loop, sc in next 32 (36) sts. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew button at the edge of ankle of the bootie. Weave in all ends. 
These cute booties are perfect for the baby. With a T-strap and a cute button, nothing is better for your lovely new baby.

materials: 1 ball each 941 Scooter A, and 100 Lily B
abbreviations: A and B = Color A, Color B
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: 16 sts = 4” (10 cm); 21 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet using larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BOOTIES (make 2)
Sole
With larger hook and A, ch 7 (9).  
Foundation Row: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across—6 (8) sc.  
Next 6 (7) Rows: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Next Row: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across to last sc, 2 sc in last sc—8 (10) sc.
Next 7 (10) Rows: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Sides
Round 1: Do not turn, work 14 (18) sc evenly spaced down side of sole; work 6 (8) sc across opposite side of foundation ch (this is the heel); work 14 (18) sc evenly spaced up other side of sole; sc in each st of last row; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—42 (54) sc. Place marker in last stitch made to indicate end of round. Move marker up as work progresses.  
Next 3 (4) Rounds: Working in front loops only, sc in each sc around.
Top of Foot
Notes: The top of foot is worked back and forth in rows across one end of the bootie. Take care to turn when instructed. When working the top of foot, do not ch 1 at beginning of rows.  
Row 1: Sc in next 1 (2) sc, slip st in next sc, TURN and leave remaining sts unworked; skip slip st, working in front loops only, sc in next 8 (10) sc; working in both loops, slip st in next 2 sc, TURN; leave remaining sts unworked.
Next 8 (12) Rows: Skip first 2 slip sts, working in front loops only, sc in next 8 (10) sc across top of foot; working in both loops, slip st in next 2 unworked sc on side of Bootie, turn.
Cuff
Rounds 1 and 2: Sc in each st all the way around top of Bootie, working twice around and ending at center back of Bootie. Fasten off.
Ribbing
With right side facing and smaller hook draw up a loop of B in last st of cuff (at center back).
Round 1 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), work 24 (28) more dc evenly spaced around top of cuff; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—25 (29) dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, *Fpdc around next st, Bpdc around next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Repeat Round 2 for a total of 10 rounds of ribbing or until cuff is desired length.
Last Round: Change to larger hook, repeat Round 2. Fasten off.
FINISHING BOOTIES
Weave in ends. Turn down cuff.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft (6 oz /170.1 g; 315 yds/288 m)
Size U.S. F/5 (3.75 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Bunting:  Make a total of 56 Triangles as follows:
Make 7 with Color 1 as A and Color 2 as B.
Make 7 with Color 1 as B and Color 2 as A.
Make 7 with Color 1 as C and Color 2 as D.
Make 7 with Color 1 as D and Color 2 as C.
Make 7 with Color 1 as E and Color 2 as F.
Make 7 with Color 1 as F and Color 2 as E.
Make 7 with Color 1 as G and Color 2 as H.
Make 7 with Color 1 as H and Color 2 as G.
Triangle Note: See chart on page 2. With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in ring. (Ch 3. 3 dc) twice in ring. Ch 3. Join with sl st to top of ch-3.
2nd rnd:  Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in last ch-3 sp of 1st rnd. Ch 1. *(3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc. Ch 1) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * once more. (3 dc. Ch 3.) in next ch-3 sp. With Color 2, join with sl st to top of ch-3.
3rd rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in last ch-3 sp of 2nd rnd. Ch 1. *3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. Ch 1.) in next ch-3 sp.  Rep from * once more. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3) in next ch-3 sp. Join with sl st to top of ch-3.
4th rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in last ch-3 sp of 3rd rnd. Ch 1. *(3 dc. Ch 1) in each ch-1 sp to next corner ch-3 sp. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc. Ch 1) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * once more. (3 dc. Ch 1) in each ch-1 sp to next corner ch-3 sp. (3 dc. Ch 3) in next ch-3 sp. Join with sl st to top of ch-3.
5th rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in last ch-3 sp of 4th rnd. Ch 1. *(3 dc. Ch 1) in each ch-1 sp to next corner ch-3 sp. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc. Ch 1) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * once more. (3 dc. Ch 1) in each ch-1 sp to next corner ch-3 sp. (3 dc. Ch 3) in next ch-3 sp. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Joining: 1st row: With I, ch 20 (tie). *Working along top edge of Triangles, 1 sc in each dc and ch-sp across. Rep from * across top of rem 55 Triangles. Ch 20 (tie). Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch and st to end of row. Fasten off.
Pompom: Wind Color 1 around 3 fingers 125 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to smooth round shade. Sew to Triangle point.

materials: RED HEART® Scrubby Sparkle™: 1 ball each 8506 Icepop A, 8260 Orange B, 8215 Lemon C and 8001 Marshmallow D
RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein 311 White E
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
FLOWER
(Make 10 each with A and B and 5 each with C and D)
Ch 4, sc in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), work 11 dc in ring – 12 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in same st, 2 dc in each st around, slip st in top of beginning ch 3 – 24 dc.
Round 3: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), hdc in same st, 2 hdc in each st around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 48 hdc.
Round 4: Sc in same st, hdc in next st, (dc, tr) in next st, (tr, dc) in next st, hdc in next st, sc in next st, *sc in next st, hdc in next st, (dc, tr) in next st, (tr, dc) in next st, hdc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc – 8 petals. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in loose ends. Arrange Flowers into 5 rows with 6 Flowers in each row, mixing and matching colors as desired. For each row, cut 2½ yds (m) of E. Tie a knot 3” [8 cm] from one end. *Starting at center of one petal of first Flower, thread E across wrong side of Flower to center of opposite petal, taking care E does not show on right side of Flower. Tie a knot at lower edge of first Flower to hold in place. Skip 3-4” [8-10 cm] along E and tie a knot. Repeat from * to thread all Flowers along length of E. Repeat to thread all Flowers along lengths of E to make 5 Garland lengths.
Hanger
With E, ch 24, slip st in first ch. Fasten off. Sew first ch to top of each first Flower. Weave in ends.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft™ (6 oz/170.1g; 315 yds/288 m) Main Color (MC) Pumpkin (39765) 1 ball
Size U.S. D/3 (3.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Leaf: Approx 21/2" [6 cm] x 5" [12.5 cm]. Garland: Approx 68" [172 cm] long.
gauge: 20 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Leaves (make 4 in each color).
Ch 17. See diagram on page 2. 
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.  
1 sc in each of next 3 ch.  1 hdc in each of next 4 ch. 1 dc in each of next 4 ch.  1 tr in each of next 3 ch.  7 tr in last ch. Working into opposite side of ch, 1 tr in each of next 3 ch.  1 dc in each of next 4 ch.  1 hdc in each of next 4 ch.   
1 sc in each of next 3 ch.  2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 
*1 sc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. 1 dc in next st. (3 tr. Ch 3. Sl st) in next st. Rep from * twice more. 
1 sc in each of next 2 sts. (1 hdc. 3 dc. 1 hdc) in next st.  1 sc in each of next 2 sts. **(Sl st. Ch 3. 3 tr) in next st.  1 dc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from ** twice more. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Do not fasten off. 
Stem: Sl st in next st. Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.  1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Join with sl st to first sc.  
Fasten off. 
Garland Assembly
With B, *ch 20. Join Leaf (MC) with sl st at top of Stem. Ch 20. Join Leaf (A) with sl st at top of Stem. Ch 20. Join Leaf (B) with sl st at top of Stem. Ch 20. Join Leaf (C) with sl st at top of Stem.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball each 4600 White A, 9925 Really Red B, 9251 Coral C, and 5142 Cherry Red D
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Each 5-heart string measures 25” (63.5 cm) long, not including hanging chain. Each heart measures 5” (12.5 cm) at widest x 4” long from center “V” to point.
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
HEART (make 15 as shown in Color Sequences)
Ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, (hdc, dc, hdc) in next sc, sc in next sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in next sc, (hdc, dc, hdc) in last sc; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc, 4 hdc, and 2 dc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, (hdc, dc) in next hdc, 2 dc in next dc, (dc, hdc) in next hdc, hdc in next sc, sc in next sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in next sc, hdc in next sc, (hdc, dc) in next hdc, 2 dc in next dc, (dc, hdc) in last hdc; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc, 6 hdc, and 8 dc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, 2 dc in next 4 sts, (dc, hdc) in next dc, hdc in next hdc, sc in next 3 sts, 3 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sts, hdc in next hdc, (hdc, dc) in next dc, 2 dc in last 4 sts; join with slip st in first sc—10 sc, 4 hdc, and 18 dc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, (hdc, dc, tr) in next dc, 2 tr in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next 3 dc, hdc in next 4 sts, sc in next 4 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc, hdc in next 4 sts, 2 dc in next 3 dc, 2 tr in next 3 dc, (tr, dc, hdc) in last st; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc, 10 hdc, 14 dc, and 14 tr.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, sc in next 2 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts; repeat from * twice, hdc in next 9 sts, sc in next 4 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc, hdc in next 9 sts, **hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st; repeat from ** twice, sc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in first sc—one 3-sc group, 13 sc, and 42 hdc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, sc in next 3 sts, *ch 3, skip next st, slip st in next st; repeat from * around to last 3 sts, ch 3, sc in last 3 sts; join with slip st in first sc—one 7-sc group and 26 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
Arrange hearts in 3 groups of 5 each or as desired. Heart to Heart Join: With right side of heart facing, join D with slip st in center st of 7-sc group of Round 7, ch 4; with wrong side of next heart facing, join with slip st in center st of 3-sc group of Round 6. Fasten off. Repeat to join 3 remaining hearts to previously joined hearts.
Hanging Chain: With right side of top heart facing, join D with slip st in center st of 7-sc group of Round 7, ch 30. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Repeat Heart to Heart Join and Hanging Chain twice to create 3 garlands.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

GARLAND
Notes:

With E, ch 27.

Wisteria (Make 5).
See Diagram on page 4.
With H, ch 4. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 7 sc into ring. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 10. 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 3 sc in each of next 8 ch. *1 sc in next sc. Ch 10. 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 3 sc in each of next 8 ch. Rep from * 5 times more. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Coil each “petal”.

Pansy.
See Diagram on page 4.
Make 4 with B as Color 1 and F as Color 2.
Make 6 with B as Color 1 and G as Color 2.
With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in ring. Ch 2) twice. (2 sc in ring. Ch 5) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to first ch-2 sp. Ch 2. (2 hdc. Picot. 2 hdc) all in same ch-2 sp. Skip next sc. Sl st in next sc. (2 hdc. Picot. 2 hdc) all in next ch-2 sp. *Skip next sc. Sl st in next sc. (1 hdc. 9 dc.1 hdc) all in next ch-5 sp. Rep from * twice more. Skip next sc. Sl st in next sc. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.

Carnation (Make 4).
See Diagram on page 5.
With C, ch 5, leaving a long tail to use for gathering center of flower closed. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc. 2 hdc. 2 dc. 3 tr) all in ring. Join with sl st in first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working behind 1st rnd, sl st in ring between first 2 sc. Ch 3. Sl st in ring between next 2 hdc. Ch 3. Sl st in ring between next 2 dc. Ch 3. Sl st in ring between next 2 tr. Ch 3. Sl st in ring after last tr. Ch 3. Join with sl st to first sl st. 5 ch-3 loops.
3rd rnd: *Ch 1. (5 dc. Sl st) in next ch-3 loop. Rep from * around. 5 petals.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working behind last rnd, 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 5. Sl st in sp between next 2 petals. Rep from * 3 times more. Ch 5. Join with sl st in first sc. 5 ch-5 loops.
5th rnd: *Ch 1. (2 dc. 4 tr. 2 dc. Sl st) in next ch-5 loop. Rep from * around. 5 petals.
6th rnd: Ch 1. Working behind last rnd, 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 7. Sl st in sp between next 2 petals. Rep from * 3 times more. Ch 7. 5 ch-7 loops.
7th rnd: *Ch 1. (3 dc. 5 tr. 3 dc. Sl st) in next ch-7 loop. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first ch 1. 5 petals.
Fasten off. Using long tail from beg and yarn needle, gather center tog tightly to close center of flower.

Daisy (Make 6).
See Diagram on page 5.
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 10 sc. Fasten off.
3rd rnd: Join D with sl st to first sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 7. 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Skip next sc of last rnd. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending with sl st in first sc. 5 petals.
Note: 5 petals from 3rd rnd will alternate with 5 petals from 4th rnd.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working behind last rnd, 1 sc in next skipped sc from 2nd rnd. *Ch 7. 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Skip next sc of 3rd rnd. 1 sc in next skipped sc from 2nd rnd. Rep from * around, ending with sl st in first sc. 5 petals. Fasten off.

Large Leaf (make 10).
See Diagram on page 5.
With A, ch 8.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 5 hdc in last ch. Do not turn. Working into opposite side in rem loops of foundation chain, 1 hdc in next ch, 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Small Leaf (make 10).
See Diagram on page 5.
With A, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. (2 hdc. Ch 2. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 2 hdc) in last ch. Do not turn. Hanging Strand
See Diagram on page 5.
With A, ch 278.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 9th ch from hook (skipped 8 ch counts as first hanging loop). 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Ch 8. Sl st in bottom of last hdc (second hanging loop made). Fasten off. 270 hdc and 2 ch-8 sps.

Optional – Corner Hanging Loops.
To hang Garland from a Mirror or Frame, measure across the top of your desired location. Fold Hanging Strand in half to find center. PM on either side of center to match measurement of desired location. Join A with sl st at marker. Ch 10. Sl st in same sp as last sl st. Fasten off and rep at 2nd marker.

With A and yarn needle, sew flower and leaf motifs to RS of Hanging strand as desired, leaving approx 1" [2.5 cm] of Hanging Strand visible at each end, not including Hanging Loops.

instructions:
3-Leaf Clover (Garland or Confetti: make 20 each in A and B)
Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: *Ch 3. 2 hdc in ring. Ch 3. 1 sl st in ring. Rep from * twice more. Ch 4. Turn. Skip 1st ch from hook. 1 sl st in each of next 3 ch. Sl st in ring. Fasten off.

abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E, F = Colors A, B, C, D, E, F
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Each bunny measures 7" (17.8 cm) tall x 5" (12.7 cm) at widest point. Bunting with 10 bunnies is approximately 4’2” (127 cm) measured flat.
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
Make an adjustable ring as follows: Wrap yarn around your finger with the yarn tail to the left and under the working yarn. Insert hook through the circle from front to back. Using the working yarn, yarn over and pull up a loop.

Round 1: 8 sc in loop, join to 1st sc with slip st; tighten beginning yarn tail to close ring, place marker to indicate beginning of round – 8 sc.  
Round 2: Ch 1, puff st in same st, ch 1, [puff st in next st, ch 1] 7 times; join last ch 1 to top of 1st puff st – 8 puff sts, 8 ch-1 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, *puff st in st, ch 1, puff st in ch-1 space, ch 1; repeat from * around, join with slip st to top of first puff st –16 puff sts, 16 ch-1 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same st, 2 sc in ch-1 space, *sc in next st, 2 sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * around, join with sl st to 1st sc – 48 sc.

Head: Begin working back and forth in rows:
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in same st and in next 8 sts – 9 sc.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), turn, hdc in same st as turning ch and in next 8 sts across – 10 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, fphdc around 1st st and each st across – 10 fphdc.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, skip 1st st, sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog – 7 sc.

First Ear:
Row 1: Ch 1, turn, skip 1st st, sc in next 2 sts – 2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in st, 2 sc in next st – 3 sc.
Rows 3-6: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, skip 1st st, 3 hdc in next st, slip st in last st. 
Fasten off.

Second Ear: Skip st next to inner edge st of 1st ear, attach yarn with slip st to next st.
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in same st and next st – 2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st – 3 sc.
Rows 3-6: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, skip 1st st, 3 hdc in next st, slip st in last st. 
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Edging: With Right Side facing, attach yarn with slip st to back loop of 1st st where Body and Head meet. Slip st in back loops of each Body st around, slip st in row ends and sts around the head and Ears; join last slip st to 1st slip st. 
Optional: For seamless join, cut yarn from skein but do not finish off. Thread yarn onto tapestry needle. Weave thread under the loops of the next st and back through the middle of the originating st, mimicking the teardrop shape of a st. Weave excess yarn along back of work to secure.

Pompom Tails: With F and a 1⅜" (35mm) pompom maker, (or fork; see below for details), make 1 pompom tail for each bunny. For consistency, ensure that the same number of wraps is used for each pompom. Using sharp scissors, carefully trim each pompom as needed, leaving 4-6" (10-15.25 cm) yarn ends from tie for attaching pompom to Bunny.
Using pompom tie ends, tie pompom on bottom portion of Body between Rounds 2 & 3. Knot securely and trim excess yarn from ties.

Fork Method: If pompom maker is unavailable, use a large two-tine meat serving fork to make pompoms as follows: Wrap the yarn snugly (not too tightly) around the entire fork for a total of 35 wraps. Cut yarn. Using a 10" (25.4 cm) piece of yarn, wrap yarn between the tines and around the middle of the wraps. Pull tightly to cinch and knot securely leaving 4-6" (10-15.25 cm) yarn ends from tie for attaching pompom to Bunny.

Assembly: With F, ch 20. Attach Bunny ear using slip st through the top most st of the 1st ear, ch 5, repeat ear attachment with slip st to 2nd ear, ch 10; repeat the process until all bunnies are attached, ch 20. There should be 10 chs between each Bunny and 5 chs between the ears of each Bunny. 

Hanging Loops (optional): Fold the 1st 10 chs of the ch 20 over to form a loop. With yarn needle and using yarn tail, sew to secure. Repeat for opposite end.  
With yarn needle, weave in all loose ends.

Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at back of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice - 1 dcbp made.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice - 1 dcfp made.
Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 (3) sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Each small star measures approx 5" [12.5 cm] across at widest. Each large star measures approx 7" [18 cm] across at widest.
gauge: 12 sc and 13 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes:
• Garland is made from 6 small stars, 6 large stars and a hanging cord. 
• The center of each star is worked in joined rounds. Each of six points is then worked back and forth in rows over a portion of the stitches in the last round of the center.
• Customize your garland by making as many small and large stars as desired using yarn colors of your choice.
• Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as a st.
CROCHET  I  SKILL LEVEL: EASY
MEDIUM
4

SMALL STARS (make 6 – 1 each with A, B, C, D, E, and F)
Center
Make an adjustable ring: Wrap yarn into a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring. After the first round of stitches is worked, pull gently on tail to tighten ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 2. 12 dc in ring. Join with sl st in first dc. 12 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. Dcfp around next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc. 12 sc and 6 Dcfp.
First Point: Work now proceeds back and forth in rows.
1st row: (RS). Sl st in next st. Ch 1. sc in next st. Dcfp around next st. 1 sc in next st. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked for rem points. 3 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. Dcbp around next st. 1 sc in next st. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Fasten off.
Next Point: 1st row: With RS facing, join yarn with sc in first unworked st of 2nd rnd: following previous point, Dcfp around next st. 1 sc in next st.
2nd and 3rd rows: As 2nd and 3rd rows of First Point. Fasten off. Rep Next Point until a total of 6 points have been made. Do not fasten off when last point is complete.
Border: With RS facing, ch 1. 1 sc evenly spaced around outer edge of Star, having (sc, ch 2, sl st in 2nd ch from hook, sc) at tip of each point. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
Hanging Loop: With A, leaving a 5" [12.5 cm] long end, ch 10. Sl st in first ch to form loop. Fasten off, leaving a 5" [12.5 cm] long end. Use ends to tie loop to tip of one point.

LARGE STARS (make 6 – 1 each with A, B, C, D, E, and F)
Center
Make an adjustable ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 2. 12 dc in ring. Join with sl st in first dc. 12 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. Dcfp around next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc. 12 sc and 6 Dcfp.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in each of next 2 sts. Dcfp around next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc. 24 sc and 6 Dcfp.
First Point: Work now proceeds back and forth in rows.
1st row: (RS). Sl st in each of next 2 sts. Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Dcfp around next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 5 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 2 sts. Dcbp around next st. 1 sc in next 2 sts. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 2 sts. Dcfp around next st. 1 sc in next 2 sts. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 2 sts. Dcbp around next st. 1 sc in next 2 sts. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Dcfp around next st. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. Dcbp around next st. 1 sc in next st. Turn.
7th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Fasten off.
Next Point: 1st row: With RS facing, join yarn with sc in first unworked st of 3rd rnd: following previous point, 1 sc in next st. Dcfp around next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts.
2nd to 7th rows: Work same as 1st to 7th rows of first point. Fasten off. Rep Next Point until a total of 6 points have been made. Do not fasten off when last point is complete.
Border: Work same as border for small star.
Hanging Loop: Work same as hanging loop for small star.

HANGING CORD
With A, work a chain approx 70" [178 cm] long. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and in each rem ch across. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Thread hanging cord through hanging loops of stars, arranging them in any order you prefer.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball each 275 Coral A, 450 Aqua B, 422 Golden Yellow C, 435 Silver D, 536 Passionista E, and 930 Monet F
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Half-circle motif measures 6" (15 cm) wide x 3½" (9 cm) deep; half-square motif measures 5¾" (14.5 cm) wide x 3" (7.5 cm) deep; banner measures 48" (122 cm) wide x 3¾" (9.5 cm) deep.
gauge: Rows 1-7 of half circle motif = 1¾" (4.5 cm) deep. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HALF CIRCLE MOTIF
(Make 1 in each A, B and C)
Ch 8, and join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 4 (counts as 1 dc and 1 ch), 12 dc in ring, ch 1, dc in ring, turn – 14 dc and 2 ch-1 spaces.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first dc, ch 1, * fpsc around next dc, ch 1, repeat from * 11 more times, sc in last dc, turn – 2 sc, 13 ch-1 spaces, 12 fpsc.
Row 3: Ch 4 (counts as 1 dc and 1 ch), * 3-dc cl in next fpsc, ch 3, repeat from * to last fpsc, 3-dc cl in last fpsc, ch 1, dc in last sc, turn –12 3-dc cl and 11 ch-3 spaces.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first dc, sc in first ch-1 space, * ch 5, sc in next ch-3 space, repeat from * to last ch-1 space, ch 5, sc in last ch-1 space, sc in last dc, turn – 12 ch-3 spaces.
Row 5: Ch 5 (counts as 1 dc and 2 ch), * sc in next ch-5 space, ch 5, repeat from * to last ch-5 space, sc in last ch-5 space, ch 2, dc in last sc, turn – 11 ch-5 spaces.
Row 6: Ch 5 (counts as 1 dc and 2 ch), sc in first ch-2 sp, * ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space, repeat from * to last ch-2 space, ch 5, sc in last ch-2 space, ch 2, dc in last dc, turn – 12 ch-5 spaces.
Row 7: Ch 5 (counts as 1 dc and 2 ch), * 3-dc cl in next ch-5 space, ch 5, repeat from * 10 more times, 3-dc cl in next ch-5 space, ch 2, dc in last dc, turn – 12 3-dc cl.
Row 8: Ch 5 (counts as 1 dc and 2 ch), 3-dc cl in first ch-2 space, (cl, ch 5, cl) in each ch-5 space to end, 3-dc cl in last ch-2 space, ch 2, dc in last dc, turn – 24 3-dc cl.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in first dc, sc in first ch-2 space, * ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space, repeat from * 10 more times, ch 5, sc in last ch-2 space, sc in last dc, turn – 12 ch-5 spaces.
Row 10: Ch 6, (counts as 1 dc and 3 ch), sc in first ch-5 space, * ch 6, sc in next ch-5 space, repeat from * to end, ch 3, dc in last sc, turn –11 ch-6 spaces.
Row 11: Ch 4 (counts as 1 dc and 1 ch), 3-dc cl in first ch-3 space, ch 2 * (3-dc cl, ch 3, 2-dc cl in first of 3 ch just made, 3-dc cl) in next ch-6 space, ch 2, repeat from * to last ch-3 space, 3-dc cl in last ch-3 space, ch 1, dc last dc, do not turn – 24 3-dc cl.
Top Edge
Rotate Motif 180 degrees, so that the edge sts of Rows 1-11 now form the top edge.
Row 1 (right side): Working in row edge sts, ch 1, [sc, ch 2] 18 times evenly along edge, then sc in corner – 19 sc and 18 ch-2 spaces.
Fasten off.

HALF SQUARE MOTIF
(Make 1 in each E and F, and 1 in both E and F as follows: work rows 1-4 with E, rows 5-6 with F, rows 7-8 with E, and rows 9-11 with F.)
Ch 8, and join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), 12 dc in ring, turn – 13 dc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, * ch 3, skip 2 dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * 3 times, turn – 5 sc, 4 ch-3 spaces.
Row 3: Ch 5 (counts as 1 dc and 2 ch here and throughout) * 3 dc in next ch-3 space, ch 3; repeat from * twice, 3 dc in next ch-3 space, ch 2, dc in last dc, turn – 4 3-dc groups.
Row 4: Ch 5, 3 dc in ch-2 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in corner ch-2 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 2, dc in last dc, turn – 4 3-dc groups, 2 sc.
Row 5: Ch 5, 3 dc in first ch-2 space, ch 2, * 3 dc in next ch-3 space, ch 2; repeat from * to corner ch-2 space, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in corner, ** ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-3 space; repeat from ** to last ch-2 space, ch 2, 3 dc in last ch-2 space, ch 2, dc in last dc, turn – 8 3-dc groups.
Row 6: Ch 5, 3 dc in first ch-2 space, ch 3, * sc in next ch-2 space, ch 3; repeat from * to corner ch-2 space (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in corner space, ** ch 3, sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from ** to last ch-2 space, ch 3, 3 dc in last ch-2 space, ch 2, dc in last dc, turn – 8 ch-3 spaces.
Row 7: Repeat Row 5 – 12 3-dc groups.
Row 8: Repeat Row 6 – 12 ch-3 spaces.
Row 9: Repeat Row 5 – 16 3-dc groups.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in first st, * sc in next ch-2 space, ch 1, picot, ch 1, repeat from * to corner ch-2 space (sc, ch 1, picot, ch 1, sc) in corner space, ** ch 1, picot, ch 1, sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from ** to end, sc in last dc, do not turn – 17 picots.
Top Edge
Rotate Motif 180 degrees, so that the edge sts of Rows 1-10 now form the top edge.
Row 1 (wrong side): Working in row edge sts, (sc, ch 2) 17 times evenly along edge, then sc in corner – 18 sc and 17 ch-2 spaces.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Joining Band
With right sides facing, arrange motifs as shown in photo or in desired order, and join across top edge as follows:
Row 1 (right side): With D, ch 10 and join with slip st in first ch to form ring, ch 1, 15 sc in ring, join with slip st in first of these 15 sc, ch 30, * 3 hdc in each ch-2 space along top motif, ch 3; repeat from * for each motif, ch 37 more (40 ch total), slip st in 10th ch from hook to from ring, ch 1, 15 sc in ring, join with slip st in first of these 15 sc, turn.
Row 2: (Slip st, ch 1) in each of next 30 ch, * slip st in next st, ch 1, skip next st, repeat from * to last 30 ch, (slip st, ch 1) in each of last 30 ch, slip st in next st.
Fasten off.
Weave in all loose ends.

Yarn needle, piece of cardboard or cell phone or device 5"-6" [12.5-15 cm] long to use to wrap Tassels.
abbreviations: A, B, etc. = Color A, Color B, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] work direction in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Garland measures 39" [104 cm] across Tassel span plus 4" [10 cm] Rope Chain added to both ends. Tassels measure between 5"-6" [12.5-15 cm] long.
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:

Wrap yarn around chosen object 15 times. Using 11" [28 cm] tie, knot top of Tassel tightly. Cut Tassel at opposite end.
