instructions:
FIRST RECTANGLE RAISED CHEVRON PIECE Ch 45 (77).
Row 1 (wrong side): Dc in the 3rd ch from hook (2 skipped sts do not count as a st), dc in each ch to the end, turn – 43 (75) dc.
Row 2: Ch 2, dc in each of first 3 sts, * dc in next st, skip next st, fpdc around next dc, dc in top of same dc just used, fpdc around same dc again, skip next st, dc in each of next 4 sts; repeat from * to end, turn – 5 (9) pattern repeats.
Row 3: Ch 2, dc in each of first 3 sts, * skip next st, bpdc around next fpdc, dc in top of same fpdc just used, dc in next st, dc in top of next fpdc, bpdc around same fpdc just used, skip next st, dc each of next 3 sts; repeat from * to end, turn.
Row 4: Ch 2, dc in each of first 2 sts, * skip next st, fpdc around next bpdc, dc in top of same bpdc just used, dc in each of next 3 dc, dc in top of next bpdc, fpdc around same bpdc just used, skip next st, dc in next st; repeat from * to last st, dc in last st, turn.
Row 5: Ch 2, dc in first st, skip next dc, bpdc around fpdc, dc in top of same fpdc just used, * dc in each of next 5 sts, dc in top of next fpdc, bpdc2tog over same fpdc just used and next fpdc skipping the center dc between the 2 fpdcs, dc in top of same fpdc just used, repeat from * to last 8 sts, dc in each of next 5 sts, dc in top of fpdc, bpdc around same fpdc just used, skip next st, dc in last st, turn.
Repeat rows 2 - 5 only until piece measures 26½ (35½)" (67.5 (90 cm) cm).
Last row: Ch 2, dc in each st to end. Fasten off.
SECOND RECTANGLE LOOPY STITCH PIECE Ch 49 (85).
Row 1 (setup row, wrong side): 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each of next 3 ch, [sc2tog over next 2 sts] twice, * sc in each of next 3 ch, 2 sc in each of next 2 ch, sc in each of next 3 ch, [sc2tog over next 2 sts] twice; repeat from * to last 4 ch, sc in each of next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch, turn – 48 (84) sts, 4 (7) repeats.
Row 2 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), dc in first st, dc in each of next 3 sts, [dc2tog over next 2 sts] twice, * dc in each of next 3 sts, 2 dc in next st, ch 10, 2 dc in next st, dc in each of next 3 sts, [dc2tog over next 2 sts] twice; repeat from * to last 4 sts, dc in each of next 3 sts, 2 dc in last st, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each of next 3 st, sc2tog over next 2 sts, ch 10, sc2tog over next 2 sts, * sc in each of next 3 sts, 2 sc in each of next 2 sts, sc in each of next 3 st, sc2tog over next 2 sts, ch 10, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * to last 4 sts, sc in each of next 3 sts, 2 sc in last st, turn.
Repeat rows 2 and 3 only until piece measures 26 (35)" (66 (89) cm), ending with a Row 3.
Next row (right side): Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), dc in first st, dc in each of next 3 sts, [dc2tog over next 2 sts] twice, * dc in each of next 3 sts, 2 dc in each of next 2 sts, dc in each of next 3 sts, [dc2tog over next 2 sts] twice; repeat from * to last 4 sts, dc in each of next 3 sts, 2 dc in last st, turn.
Do not fasten off.
Make sure all loops show on RS. Just push through the fabric if need be to get all of them on the RS.
Braid first column of loops by pulling one loop through the next working from top of piece downward. Use a marker to temporarily hold down final loop. Braid second column working from the bottom upward. Continue alternating directions in this manner, working each column of loops in the direction of the corresponding chevron “arrow”. So, braid upward for the chevron peaks, and downward for the chevron valleys.
Final row (wrong side): Ch 1, * sc in each of next 11 sts, tacking sc in next st; repeat from * to last 12 sts, sc in each of last 12 sts.
Fasten off.
Rotate piece 180 degrees. With right side facing, join yarn with a slip st at beginning of foundation row and work as follows:
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in each of next 5 sts, tacking sc in next st, * sc in each of next 11 sts, tacking sc in next st; repeat from * to last 6 sts, sc in each of last 6 sts.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
With right sides up, match edges as shown in seaming diagram; pin to hold. (Designer suggests using mini knit clips.) Seam edges together with whip st.
Designer Note: once the pieces are pinned in place, take a look and see if the poncho is the right size for you. You could even try it on at this point and see if you wish to make some additions to make the piece a little larger and more custom fit for you.
Add some extra length to the panels by working more rows (caution: adding too much length to the panels will make your neckline too big and the poncho will fall off your shoulders) as follows: Raised Chevron Piece: undo the last double crochet row of stitching you completed then join your yarn on the last repeat row of the Raised Chevron Panel and only work 1 more full row repeat. Then, work the double crochet row again and fasten off. Loopy st Piece: undo the final rows so that the loops are all free. Join your yarn to the last repeat row of the Loopy Chevron Panel and work as many 2 row repeats as necessary to match the new length of the Raised Chevron Panel. Then, rebraid where necessary, work the final rows again and fasten off.
And/or: after the seaming is complete, add a couple extra rounds of half double crochet (round 2 of the edging instructions) before doing the final round of the edging to get a little extra around the body. Make sure that you have the correct stitch multiple when indicated.
Bottom Edging
With right side facing, join yarn with a slip st in the first st to the left of a corner at bottom edge of Poncho.
Round 1: Ch 2 (does not count as a st here and throughout), * work in hdc evenly to corner, 3 hdc in corner st and mark center st of 3 hdc just made; repeat from * once more, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2. Be sure to end up with an even number of sts along each of the 2 edges, including corner sts.
Round 2: Ch 2, * hdc in each st to marked st, 3 hdc in marked st; repeat from * once more, hdc in last hdc, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2.
Round 3: Ch 1, * sc in next st, MD in next st; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Designer Note: If you decided to make your panels a bit longer, you may need to work a few extra sts on the first round of the neck edging. Try to add as few sts as possible without puckering the fabric or creating large gaps. Keep track of how many extra sts you added, then place that many markers at top edge, evenly spaced around the neck. Notes:
• Kaftan is worked in one piece from side to side, back and forth in rows. The fabric is very stretchy, so finished measurements may vary.
• The Kaftan does not begin with a traditional foundation chain. Instead, a series of ch-2 sps are created. The stitches of next row are worked into ch-2 sps.
• Neck opening is formed slightly off center. Kaftan is designed to wear "longer" section at back, but can be worn with longer section at front, back, or side as desired.
• Pattern stitch is reversible. There is no RS or WS.
1st row: [Ch 3. esc in 3rd ch from hook (the 2 skipped chains count as 1 ch-2 sp)] 56 times. Turn. 56 ch-2 sps.

Shape Neck
33rd row: Ch 4. Skip first ch-2 sp. esc in next esc. (Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. esc in next esc) 18 times. Ch 2. Skip next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next esc. (2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next esc) 8 times for neck edge. Ch 2. (Skip next ch-2 sp. esc in next esc) 26 times. Ch 2. esc in 2nd ch of turning ch. Turn. 20 ch-2 sps on one side of neck edge and 27 ch-2 sps on other side of neck edge and 25 sc across neck edge.

instructions:
FIRST RECTANGLE
RAISED CHEVRON PIECE
Ch 45 (77).
Row 1 (wrong side): Dc in the 3rd ch from hook (2 skipped sts do not count as a st), dc in each ch to the end, turn – 43 (75) dc.
Row 2: Ch 2, dc in each of first 3 sts, * dc in next st, skip next st, fpdc around next dc, dc in top of same dc just used, fpdc around same dc again, skip next st, dc in each of next 4 sts; repeat from * to end, turn – 5 (9) pattern repeats.
Row 3: Ch 2, dc in each of first 3 sts, * skip next st, bpdc around next fpdc, dc in top of same fpdc just used, dc in next st, dc in top of next fpdc, bpdc around same fpdc just used, skip next st, dc each of next 3 sts; repeat from * to end, turn.
Row 4: Ch 2, dc in each of first 2 sts, * skip next st, fpdc around next bpdc, dc in top of same bpdc just used, dc in each of next 3 dc, dc in top of next bpdc, fpdc around same bpdc just used, skip next st, dc in next st; repeat from * to last st, dc in last st, turn.
Row 5: Ch 2, dc in first st, skip next dc, bpdc around fpdc, dc in top of same fpdc just used, * dc in each of next 5 sts, dc in top of next fpdc, bpdc2tog over same fpdc just used and next fpdc skipping the center dc between the 2 fpdcs, dc in top of same fpdc just used, repeat from * to last 8 sts, dc in each of next 5 sts, dc in top of fpdc, bpdc around same fpdc just used, skip next st, dc in last st, turn.
Repeat rows 2 - 5 only until piece measures 26½ (35½)" (67.5 (90 cm) cm).
Last row: Ch 2, dc in each st to end. Fasten off.

SECOND RECTANGLE
LOOPY STITCH PIECE
Ch 49 (85).
Row 1 (setup row, wrong side): 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each of next 3 ch, [sc2tog over next 2 sts] twice, * sc in each of next 3 ch, 2 sc in each of next 2 ch, sc in each of next 3 ch, [sc2tog over next 2 sts] twice; repeat from * to last 4 ch, sc in each of next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch, turn – 48 (84) sts, 4 (7) repeats.
Row 2 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), dc in first st, dc in each of next 3 sts, [dc2tog over next 2 sts] twice * dc in each of next 3 sts, 2 dc in next st, ch 10, 2 dc in next st, dc in each of next 3 sts, [dc2tog over next 2 sts] twice; repeat from * to last 4 sts, dc in each of next 3 sts, 2 dc in last st, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each of next 3 st, sc2tog over next 2 sts, ch 10, sc2tog over next 2 sts, * sc in each of next 3 sts, 2 sc in each of next 2 sts, sc in each of next 3 st, sc2tog over next 2 sts, ch 10, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * to last 4 sts, sc in each of next 3 sts, 2 sc in last st, turn.
Repeat rows 2 and 3 only until piece measures 26 (35)" (66 (89) cm), ending with a Row 3.
Next row (right side): Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), dc in first st, dc in each of next 3 sts, [dc2tog over next 2 sts] twice * dc in each of next 3 sts, 2 dc in each of next 2 sts, dc in each of next 3 sts, [dc2tog over next 2 sts] twice; repeat from * to last 4 sts, dc in each of next 3 sts, 2 dc in last st, turn.
Do not fasten off.
Make sure all loops show on RS. Just push through the fabric if need be to get all of them on the RS.
Braid first column of loops by pulling one loop through the next working from top of piece downward. Use a marker to temporarily hold down final loop. Braid second column working from the bottom upward. Continue alternating directions in this manner, working each column of loops in the direction of the corresponding chevron “arrow”. So, braid upward for the chevron peaks, and downward for the chevron valleys.

Final row (wrong side): Ch 1, * sc in each of nest 11 sts, tacking sc in next st; repeat from * to last 12 sts, sc in each of last 12 sts.
Fasten off.
Rotate piece 180 degrees. With right side facing, join yarn with a slip st at beginning of foundation row and work as follows:
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in each of next 5 sts, tacking sc in next st, * sc in each of next 11 sts, tacking sc in next st; repeat from * to last 6 sts, sc in each of last 6 sts.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
With right sides up, match edges as shown in seaming diagram; pin to hold. (Designer suggests using mini knit clips.) Seam edges together with whip st. Designer Note: once the pieces are pinned in place, take a look and see if the poncho is the right size for you. You could even try it on at this point and see if you wish to make some additions to make the piece a little larger and more custom fit for you. 
Add some extra length to the panels by working more rows (caution: adding too much length to the panels will make your neckline too big and the poncho will fall off your shoulders) as follows: Raised Chevron Piece: undo the last double crochet row of stitching you completed then join your yarn on the last repeat row the Raised Chevron Panel and only work 1 more full row repeat. Then, work the double crochet row again and fasten off.  Loopy st Piece: undo the final rows so that the loops are all free. Join your yarn to the last repeat row of the Loopy Chevron Panel and work as many 2 row repeats as necessary to match the new length of the Raised Chevron Panel. Then, rebraid where necessary, work the final rows again and fasten off. 
And/or: after the seaming is complete, add a couple extra rounds of half double crochet (round 2 of the edging instructions) before doing the final round of the edging to get a little extra around the body. Make sure that you have the correct stitch multiple when indicated.

Bottom Edging
With right side facing, join yarn with a slip st in the first st to the left of a corner at bottom edge of Poncho.
Round 1: Ch 2 (does not count as a st here and throughout), * work in hdc evenly to corner, 3 hdc in corner st and mark center st of 3 hdc just made; repeat from * once more, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2. Be sure to end up with a multiple of 4 sts along each of the 2 edges, including corner sts. This will give you a multiple of 8 sts overall, which is necessary for the final (shell) round to work out properly.
Round 2: Ch 2, * hdc in each st to marked st, 5 hdc in marked st; repeat from * once more, hdc in last hdc, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2.
Round 3: Ch 1, * sc in next st, skip 3 sts, 9 tr in next st, skip 3 sts; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

Designer Note: If you decided to make your panels a bit longer, you may need to work a few extra sts on the first round of the neck edging. Try to add as few sts as possible without puckering the fabric or creating large gaps. Keep track of how many extra sts you added, then place that many markers at top edge, evenly spaced around the neck. On the second row, simply skip all the marked sts to get back to the correct number of sts needed.

1-Sided Joining
Round 4 (Joining Round): [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 2 times, 2 hdc in next st, picot, hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, (dc, picot, dc) in next st, dc in next 2 sts, 2 dc in next st, tr in next st, (tr, picot, tr) in next st, tr in next st, 2 dc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, (dc, picot, dc) in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st, joining picot, 2 hdc in next st, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 2 times – 48 sts.

Notes
1. Motifs are working in a continuous spiral. Do not join or turn unless otherwise indicated. Place a stitch marker in the first stitch and move up as work progresses.
2. Motifs are joined while working Rounds 4 and 5, using a join-as-you-go technique, following Assembly Diagram for placement.
Special Stitches
adjustable ring = Holding the yarn a few inches from the end, wrap around your finger. Do not remove wrap from finger, insert hook into the wrap and draw up a loop of working yarn. Chain one to secure the loop, and remove ring from finger. Work stitches of first round in the ring. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
picot = Ch 3, slip stitch in first ch, slip stitch in indicated stitch.
jointing picot = Ch 3, insert hook in first ch and in corresponding picot of previous Motif (see Assembly Diagram), yarn over and draw through all loops on hook, slip stitch in top of indicated stitch on current Motif.
2-Sided Joining
Round 4 (Joining Round): [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 2 times, 2 hdc in next st, joining picot, hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, (dc, picot, dc) in next st, dc in next 2 sts, 2 dc in next st, tr in next st, (tr, picot, tr) in next st, tr in next st, 2 dc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, (dc, picot, dc) in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st, joining picot, 2 hdc in next st, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 2 times – 48 sts.
Round 5 (Stem Joining Round): Ch 4, insert hook through 3 sc group of stems of all adjoining Motifs and work slip st, 3 sc in next ch, slip st in next 3 chs; join with slip st in next sc on Motif. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Block.

instructions:
Note: Join each rnd with sl st to first sc.
COASTERS
Center (Make 3 each with A and B.)  See diagram on page 2.
Ch 2.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 6 times more. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 6 times more. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 32 sc. Fasten off.
Outer (Work with B on A Centers and C on B Centers)
Join corresponding color with sl st to back loop of any sc.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 2 scbl in same sp as sl st. (1 scbl in each of next 3 sc. 2 scbl in next sc) 7 times. 1 scbl in each of last 3 sc. Join. 40 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 5. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and in each of next 3 ch - Stem made. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sl st in each of next 4 sc. *(2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc) twice. 2 hdc in next sc.** 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. (1 dc. Picot. 1 dc) all in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 2 hdc in next sc. Rep from * to ** once more. 1 sl st in each of last 4 sc. Join. Fasten off.
PLANT POT
With D, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 7 times. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 7 times. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 7 times. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join. PM at end of rnd. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc around. Join. 40 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep last rnd until work from marked row measures 3" [7.5 cm]. Fasten off. Fold top ½" [1.25 cm] to RS as seen in picture.

abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C

measurements: Finished measurements Snowflake Motif = 3 ½” (9 cm) in diameter
gauge: CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With desired color, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with a slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, ch 3, *sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, ch 3; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—6 ch-3 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in next st, skip next st, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-3 space, *skip st, sc in each of next 2 sts, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—6 ch-3 spaces.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in each of next 2 sts, (slip st, [ch 4, hdc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in each of next 2 ch, slip st in ch-3 space] twice in next ch-3 space, *skip next st, sc in each of next 3 sts, (slip st, [ch 4, hdc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in each of next 2 ch, slip st in ch-3 space] twice in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Repeat using colors A, B and C for desired number of Snowflake Motifs.
Snowflake Motif Finishing
Wet finished motif, flatten & straighten snowflake spokes, allow to dry. For extra flattening, cover damp motif with waxed paper and place heavy book on top until motif is dry.

pattern_name: How to Crochet Coasters for Beginners
materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Contrast A Soft Ecru (01004) 1 ball or 36 yds/33 m
Contrast B Hot Green (01712) 1 ball or 2 yds/1.5 m

Contrast D Sunshine (00073) 1 ball or 2 yds/1.5 m
Contrast E Tangerine (01699) 1 ball or 2 yds/1.5 m
Contrast B Tea Rose (00042) 1 ball or 2 yds/1.5 m
Contrast D Teal (01133) 1 ball or 2 yds/1.5 m
Contrast E Bright Navy (00009) 1 ball or 2 yds/1.5 m
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Chain (ch) 2 at beginning (beg) of rounds (rnds) does not count as half double crochet (hdc).
COASTER
Make 1 each with B, C, D, and E as Color 2.
With A, ch 3. 
1st rnd: 10 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join with slip stitch (sl st) to first hdc. 10 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 20 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Repeat (rep) from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join Color 2 with sl st to first hdc. 30 hdc.
4th rnd: With Color 2, ch 1. 1 single crochet (sc) in first hdc. 1 sc in next hdc. *2 sc in next hdc. 1 sc in each of next 2 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 sc in last hdc. Join A with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
5th rnd: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 ball 368 321 Gold or 376 Burgundy
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 12 sc = 4”; 15 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
COASTER
Ch 13.
Row 1: Sc in 4th ch from hook, [dc in next ch, sc in next ch] 4 times, dc in last ch.
Row 2: Ch 3, turn, [sc in next sc, dc in next dc] 4 times, sc in next sc, dc in top of beginning ch.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 3” from beginning.
Edging Round: Ch 3 (counts as hdc and ch 1), turn, [hdc in next dc, ch 1] 4 times across to last st, (hdc, ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, ch 1, hdc) all in last st, turn to work along side edge, [ch 1, hdc] 4 times evenly spaced along edge, ch 1, turn to work opposite foundation ch, (hdc, ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, ch 1, hdc) all in first st, ch 1, [hdc in next dc, ch 1] 4 times across to last st, (hdc, ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, ch 1, hdc) all in last st, turn to work along side edge, [ch 1, hdc] 4 times evenly spaced along edge, ch 1, (hdc, ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch from hook) in same space as beginning ch, ch 1, slip st to 2nd ch of beginning ch to join.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. For corner tassels, thread two strands of yarn into yarn needle. Insert into corner, thread all four ends through bead, knot ends close to bead. Trim ends.

5th rnd: ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.

materials: RED HEART® “Eco-Cotton™ Blend”: 2 balls Vanilla CA and 1 ball 1340 Almond CB for one set.
abbreviations: *or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions given in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Placemat measures 14” high x 19” wide. Coaster measures 5½” across.
gauge: Placemat Rnd 1 = 6” long x 1¼” wide. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
PLACEMAT
With CA ch 19. 
Rnd 1: 4 Dc in 4th ch from hook (ch-3 counts as dc), dc in next 14 ch, 5 dc in last ch, working on opposite side of beginning ch, dc in next 14 sts; join with a slip st to top of ch-3 – 38 sts.
Rnd 2: Ch 3, dc in same ch as joining, [2 dc in next dc] 4 times, dc in next 14 dc, [2 dc in next dc] 5 times, dc in next 14 dc; join – 48 sts.
Rnd 3: Ch 3, dc in same ch as joining, [2 dc in next dc] 9 times, dc in next 14 dc, [2 dc in next dc] 10 times, dc in next 14 dc; join – 68 dc.
Rnd 4: Ch 1, (sc, ch 4, sc) all in same ch as joining, skip next dc, * (sc, ch 4, sc) all in next dc, skip next dc; repeat from * around; join with a sl st to first sc.
Rnd 5: Slip st into space, ch 1, * (sc, ch 4, sc) all in space; repeat from * around; join.
Rnds 6 and 7: Rep Rnd 5.
Rnd 8: Sl st into sp, ch 1, 3 sc in space, * [ch 2, 3 sc in next space] 9 times, ch 2, [2 sc in next space] 7 times, ch 2 **, 3 sc in next space; repeat from * to **; join.
Rnd 9: Ch 3, skip first sc, dc in next 2 sc, * [3 dc in next sp, dc in next 3 sc] 9 times, 3 dc in next space, dc in next 14 sc, 3 dc in next space **, dc in next 3 sc; repeat from * to **; join.
Rnds 10 and 11: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join. Fasten off.
Rnd 12: Attach CB in same ch as joining. Ch 1, (sc, ch 4, sc) all in same ch, skip next dc, * (sc, ch 4, sc) all in next dc, skip next dc; repeat from * around; join to first sc.
Rnds 13-15: Rep Rnd 5. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
COASTER
Rnd 1: With CA ch 4, 11 dc in 4th ch from hook; join with a slip st to top of ch-3 – 12 sts. 
Rnd 2: Ch 3, dc in same ch as joining, [2 dc in next dc] 11 times; join – 24 sts.
Rnd 3: Ch 3, [2 dc in next dc] twice, * dc in next dc, [2 dc in next dc] twice; repeat from * around; join – 40 sts. 
Fasten off.
Rnd 4: Attach CB in same ch as joining. Ch 1, (sc, ch 4, sc) all in same ch, skip next dc, * (sc, ch 4, sc) all in next dc, skip next dc; rep from * around; join to first sc.
Rnd 5: Slip st into space, ch 1, * (sc, ch 4, sc) all in space; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: Size U.S. G/6 [4 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 18 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm] with 2 strands of yarn.
instructions:
Note: To join all rnds with sl st to first sc.
Coaster
Using 2 strands
1st rnd: 6 sc into a magic ring. Join (6 sc). Video here.
2nd rnd: 2 sc into each sc around. Join. (12 sc)
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc next sc) 6 times. Join. (18 sc)
4th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc next sc) 6 times. Join. (24 sc)
5th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc next sc) 6 times. Join. (30 sc)
6th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc next sc) 6 times. Join. (36 sc)
7th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc next sc) 6 times. Join. (42 sc)
8th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc next sc) 6 times. Join. (48 sc)
9th rnd: Ch 1. (Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc next sc) 6 times. Join. (54 sc)
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Ch 4. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left, as usual, skip 2 sc just made. Sl st in first sc of rnd. Ch 1. 6 dc in ch-4 sp - first Reverse Wave made. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Ch 4. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left, as usual, skip 2 sc just made and working behind First Reverse Wave, sl st in ch-4 sp of First Reverse Wave (after last dc). Ch 1. 6 dc in ch-4 sp - second Reverse Wave made. Rep from * 16 times more. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. (18 Reverse Waves).

materials: RED HEART® Gumdrop®: 1 ball of 620 Cherry A

Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4.25 mm [US G-6]
abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: Finished square = 4” x 4” (10 x 10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With first color, ch 4; slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 2 dc in ring, *ch 3, 3 dc in ring; repeat from * twice, ch 3; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 12 dc; 4 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 2: Slip st in next 2 dc and ch-3 space, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in same ch-3 space, *(3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * twice, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off if changing color.
Round 3: Slip st in next 2 dc and corner ch-3 space or join next color with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in same ch-3 space, *3 dc between next two 3-dc groups**, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next corner ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Round 4: Slip st in next 2 dc and ch-3 space, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in same ch-3 space, *[3 dc between next two 3-dc groups] twice**, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next corner ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Color Sequence
Coaster #1: Rounds 1-4: B.
Coaster #2: Rounds 1-2: A. Rounds 3-4: B.
Coaster #3: Rounds 1-2: A. Rounds 3-4: C.

pattern_name: Luck of the Irish Crochet Coasters
materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Contrast A Ecru (00004) 1 ball or 19.5 yds [17.5 m]
Contrast B Mod Green (01223) 1 ball or 13 yds [12 m]

gauge: 13 hdc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions: Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnds and rows does not count as hdc. Face With A, ch 3. 1st rnd: (RS) 10 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first hdc. 10 hdc. 2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc. 20 hdc. 3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 5 times more. 2 hdc in next hdc. Break A. Join B. With B, *1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * twice more. Join with sl st to first hdc. Turn. 30 hdc. Do not fasten off. Hat Note: Hat is worked in rows. 1st row: (WS). Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 9 hdc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 2nd row: Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. Sl st in each of next 2 sc. Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. Rep 3rd row once more. Fasten off. Beard 1st rnd: (RS). Join C with sl st to 1st unworked st of Face after Hat. *2 dc in next st. 1 sl st in next st. Rep from * 9 more times. Fasten off. FINISHING With D and E, embroider Eyes, Mouth, and Hat Details as shown in picture.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Baker’s Cotton: 1 ball each 700 Pink A, 621 Green B, 529 Turquoise C, 565 Purple D.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: One coaster measures about 4 x 4” (10 x 10cm) square.
gauge: Use finished measurements for gauge. GAUGE IS NOT CRITICAL FOR THIS PROJECT.
instructions:
COASTER
(make 4 – 1 each with A, B, C, and D)
Ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 5 (counts as dc, ch 2), dc in ring, [ch 2, dc in ring] 6 times, ch 2; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—8 dc and 8 ch-2 spaces.
Round 2: (Slip st, beg-V-st) in first ch-2 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-2 space, [ch 3, V-st in next ch-2 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-2 space] 3 times, ch 3; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—4 V-sts, 8 ch-3 spaces, and 4 sc.
Round 3: (Slip st, beg-V-st) in ch-2 space of beg-V-st, [ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space] twice, *ch 3, V-st in ch-2 space of next V-st, [ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space] twice; repeat from * 2 more times, ch 3; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—4 V-sts, 12 ch-3 spaces, and 8 sc.
Round 4: (Slip st, beg-corner) in ch-2 space of beg-V-st, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, shell in next ch-3 space, sc in next ch-3 space, *ch 3, corner in next ch-3 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * 2 more times, ch 3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—4 corners, 8 ch-3 spaces, 4 shells, and 8 sc.
Round 5: Slip st in next dc, (slip st, beg-shell) in ch-2 space of beg-corner, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, sc in 3rd dc of next shell, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, *ch 3, shell in ch-2 space of next corner, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, sc in 3rd dc of next shell, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * 2 more times, ch 3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—4 shells, 16 ch-3 spaces, and 12 sc.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Block into shape if needed.
Special Stitches
beg-V-st (beginning V-stitch) = Ch 5 (counts as dc, ch 2), dc in indicated space.
V-st (V-stitch) = (Dc, ch 2, dc) in indicated space.
beg-shell (beginning shell) = Ch 3 (counts as dc), 4 dc in indicated space.
shell = 5 dc in indicated space.
beg-corner (beginning corner) = Ch 3 (counts as dc), (dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in indicated space.
corner = (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in indicated space.
Note
Each coaster is worked in joined rounds with right side facing at all times. Do not turn at the end of rounds.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 376 Burgundy A and 316 Soft White B.
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 12 sts = 4”; 14 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
With A ch 66; join with a slip st to first ch taking care that ch is not twisted.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around; do not join but work in continuous rounds – 66 sc. Place marker in last st and move up each round.
Rounds 2-10: Sc in each sc around.
Round 11: [Sc in next 9 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 60 sc.
Rounds 12-16: Sc in each sc around.
Round 17: [Sc in next 8 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 54 sc.
Rounds 18-22: Sc in each sc around.
Round 23: [Sc in next 7 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 48 sc.
Rounds 24-28: Sc in each sc around.
Round 29: [Sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 42 sc.
Rounds 30-34: Sc in each sc around.
Round 35: [Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 36 sc.
Rounds 36-40: Sc in each sc around.
Round 41: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 30 sc.
Rounds 42-46: Sc in each sc around.
Round 47: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rounds 48-52: Sc in each sc around.
Round 53: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 18 sc. 
Rounds 54-56: Sc in each sc around; slip st in next sc. 
Fasten off.
Brim
Round 1: With wrong side facing, join B in any ch of beginning ch; ch 1, sc in each ch around; do not join but work in continuous rounds as before – 66 sc.
Use your crochet skills for a bit of holiday fun. Wearing this Santa hat and beard will make anyone feel like a jolly ol’ elf!
foundation row and in one loop only of the ch-15, [shell, skip 1 st] 16 times, shell in last st – 17 shells. Fasten off.
Row 15: Join yarn to work across the unused loops on the ch-15 only; [shell, skip 1 st] 7 times, shell in last st. Fasten off.
FiniSHinG
Try the hat on and pin beard to brim to get comfortable fit.  
With B and yarn needle, whipstitch beard in place to Row 1 of hat brim.
RED HEART® Super Saver®, Art. E300 available in solid color 7 oz (198 g), 364 yd (333 m); multicolor, heather and print 5 oz (141 g), 244 yd (223 m), flecks 5 oz (141g), 260 yds (238 m) skeins.
note: After Round one the brim will flip “up” and you’ll be working on the right side.
Rounds 2-9: Sc in back loop of each sc around. At end of Round 9, slip st in back loop of next sc; do NOT fasten off.
Round 10: Work Reverse Sc in each sc to marker. Remove marker.
note: Rounds 11-18 are worked in a spiral in the unused loops of Rounds 9-2 in descending order.
Rounds 11-18: Work Reverse Sc in each free loop (the remaining front loop) around. Fasten off.
Ball
Round 1: With B, make an adjustable ring, 6 sc in ring; do not join, place marker and move up each round – 6 sc.
Round 2: [2 sc in back loop of next sc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in back loop of each sc around.
Round 4: [Sc2tog in back loops] 6 times – 6 sc. Fasten off leaving long tail. Weave yarn through remaining sc, draw up firmly, and fasten securely.
Rounds 5-8: Join B with Reverse sc in last st of Round 4, working in a spiral toward the first st of Round 1, Reverse sc in each st or free loop around. Fasten off leaving long tail. Fold hat point in half to make it narrower; sew ball onto hat tip.
BEARD AnD MUSTACHE
Starting at Beard with B, ch 33.
Row 1 (Right Side): Working in ridge behind ch only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, 2 sc in next ch, [sc in next 8 ch, 2 sc in next ch] 3 times, sc in last 2 ch; turn – 36 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, working in front loops only, sc in first 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, [sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, sc in last 3 sc; turn – 40 sc.
Rows 3 and 5: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc across; turn.
Rows 4 and 6: Ch 1, sc in front loop of each sc across; turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, working in front loops only, * shell in next sc; repeat from * across; turn – 40 shells.
Now work in free loops of descending rows.
Row 8: Ch 1, working in the free loops of Row 6, shell in each free loop across; turn – 40 shells.
Row 9: Ch 1, working in the free loops of Row 5, [shell in next free loop, skip 1 loop] 19 times, shell in next free loop, sc in last free loop; turn – 20 shells.
Row 10: Repeat Row 9 except work in free loops of Row 4.
Row 11: Repeat Row 9 except work in free loops of Row 3.
Row 12: Repeat Row 9 except work in free loops of Row 2.
Mustache Row 13 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, working in the back loops only of the underside of the foundation ch, [shell, skip next ch] 5 times, ch 15, skip next 13 ch, [shell, skip next ch] 4 times, shell in last ch; turn.
Row 14: Ch 1, working in remaining loops of the same.

materials: 3 2-inch (5 cm) squares of felt in assorted colors
hot glue gun or fabric glue
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: 12 sts = 4" (10 cm); 15 rows = 4" (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Skull Top
With A, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 5 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc. 
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 5 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc. Do not fasten off. Continue in turned rows.
Bottom
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—8 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog, turn—6 sc.
Rows 4 and 5: Repeat Row 2. 
Do not fasten off. Continue in rounds.
Border
Round 1: Ch 1, working in ends of rows, sc in each row across first edge of bottom; working in unworked sts of Round 6, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 4 times, 2 sc in next st; working in ends of rows, sc in each row across other edge of bottom, ch 1, sc in each st of Row 5, ch 1; join with slip st in first sc—47 sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING 
Skull
Print template shown below. For each skull, cut forehead flower, nose, and 2 eyes from felt. Apply a small amount of glue on center back of each piece. Referring to photo as a guide, position pieces on skull and, with B and straight stitches, sew each piece in place. With B, embroider straight stitch teeth.
Weave in ends.
FLOWERS
Carnation (make 3: 1 each with C, D, and E)
Ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as first hdc), 9 hdc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—10 hdc. 
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc), 2 hdc in same st as join, 3 hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—30 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 4 (counts as hdc, ch 2), hdc in same st as join, [ch 2, hdc] twice in each st around, ch 2; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—60 hdc and 60 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Large Flower (make 2: 1 each with C and E) 
Round 1 (right side): Work same as Round 1 of Carnation.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as first dc), working in front loops only, dc in same st as join, 2 dc in next st, [(ch 2, slip st, ch 2, dc) in next st, 2 dc in next st] 4 times, ch 2; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—12 dc, 4 slip sts, 9 ch-2 spaces.
Round 3: Working in back loops only, slip st in same st as join, ch 2 (counts as first hdc), hdc in same st, 2 hdc in each st and ch around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—68 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 2, working in front loops only, dc in same st as join, 2 dc in next st, [(ch 2, slip st, ch 2, dc) in next st, 2 dc in next st] around, ch 2; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off.
Small Flower (make 3: 1 each with D, E, and F) 
Work same as Rounds 1–3 of Large Flower. Fasten off.
FINISHING FLOWERS
Weave in ends.
HAT
With B, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc. 
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc. 
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 5 times, sc in next st; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Rounds 5-10: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Brim
Round 11: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc. 
Round 12: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 5 times, sc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc.
Round 13: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 5 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc. 
Round 14: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st] 5 times, sc in last 3 sts; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING HAT
Referring to photograph as a guide, arrange flowers and skull on the hat as desired and glue in place.

pattern_name: It’s a Hoot Owl Hat & Cape
materials: RED HEART® 'Super Saver®': 1 skein each 334 Buff A
Crochet Hooks: 5.5mm [US I-9], 4mm [US G-6], and 3.75mm [US F-5]
abbreviations: A, B, C; etc. = color A, B, C; etc.
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Capelet = 18” wide at shoulder; Hat = 18” circumference x 7” high.
gauge: Hat: 16 sts = 4”; 12 rows = 4” in hdc with middle size hook. Capelet: 12 sts = 4” in hdc with largest hook.
instructions:
Capelet
Row 1: Beginning at neck edge, with A and largest hook, ch 31; working in the back bumps only sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 30 sc.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc in first 5 sc, [2 hdc in next sc, hdc in next sc] 10 times, hdc in last 5 sts; turn – 40 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 2, hdc in first 5 hdc, [hdc in next 9 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 3 times, hdc in last 5 hdc; turn – 43 hdc.
Row 4: Ch 2, hdc in first 5 hdc, [hdc in next 2 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 11 times, hdc in last 5 hdc; turn – 54 hdc.
Row 5: Ch 2, hdc in first 5 hdc, [hdc in next 10 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 4 times, hdc in last 5 hdc; turn – 58 hdc.
Row 6: Ch 2, hdc in first 5 hdc, [hdc in next 11 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 4 times, hdc in last 5 hdc; turn – 62 hdc.
Row 7: Ch 2, hdc in first 5 hdc, [hdc in next 12 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 4 times, hdc in last 5 hdc; turn – 66 hdc.
Row 8: Ch 2, hdc in first 5 hdc, [2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 6 hdc] 8 times, hdc in last 5 hdc; turn – 74 hdc.
Row 9: Ch 2, hdc in first 12 hdc, [2 dc in next hdc, dc in next hdc] 7 times, hdc in next 22 hdc, [2 dc in next hdc, dc in next hdc] 7 times, hdc in last 12 hdc; turn – 88 sts.
Row 10: Ch 2, hdc in first 12 hdc, dc in next 21 dc, hdc in next 22 hdc, dc in next 21 dc, hdc in last 12 hdc; turn.
Rows 11 and 12: Repeat Row 10.
Rows 13 and 14: Ch 2, hdc in each st across; turn.
Fasten off.
Capelet Feathers
With right side facing and largest hook, join A at upper left neck edge; ch 1, working across row ends: work 20 sc evenly spaced down left edge; working along the bottom edge: slip st in the first hdc, [ch 7, hdc in 3rd ch from hook and next 3 ch, slip st in the next ch, sc in the next 3 hdc of bottom edge] 29 times, ch 7, hdc in 3rd ch from hook and next 3 ch, slip st in the next ch; working across row ends: work 20 sc evenly spaced up right edge – 30 feathers. 
Fasten off.
Capelet Edging and Tie Straps
Left Tie and Edging
With largest hook and C, ch 39; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, sc in first sc of left side edging, [skip next sc, 5 dc in next sc, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] 5 times down left edge; slip st in first st of lower edge; work across feathers: * hdc in next 4 ch of ch-7, 2 hdc in next ch, 5 dc in ch-2 space at tip, 2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 4 sts of feather **, sc in next 3 sc between feathers; repeat from * across, end at **; slip st in last st; working up right side edge: sc in first sc, [skip next sc, 5 dc in next sc, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] 5 times; ch 39 for 2nd tie; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; slip st to top edge. Fasten off.
Hat
With middle size hook and A, ch 72; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring being careful that ch is not twisted. Work in continuous rounds without joining. Mark last st of each round and move marker up each round.
Rounds 1-3: Sc in each st around – 72 sc.
Rounds 4-20: Hdc in each st around.
Top Seam: Fold hat flat. Working in the front loop of the top layer and the back loop of the bottom layer, sc in each stitch across. Fasten off. 
Feather Tufts (Make 2)
With smallest hook and A, [ch 7, working in back bumps only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 5 ch] 3 times. Fasten off leaving yarn tail for sewing.
Tuft Edging
With right side facing and smallest hook, join C in first sc of first tuft, working around the tuft [sc in first 5 sts, 5 sc in next st, sc in 5 spaces along opposite side] 3 times. Fasten off leaving yarn tail for sewing.
Shape Feathers
With C yarn tail, thread yarn needle. Insert needle through the bottom left and right edges of all 3 feathers and pull tightly so that a fold is formed in the edge. Repeat until desired effect is achieved. Use remaining yarn to attach to corners of hat as pictured.
Beak
With smallest hook and D, ch 14; join with slip st to form a ring taking care that ch is not twisted. Work in continuous rounds same as for Hat.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around – 14 sc.
Round 2: [Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] twice – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] twice – 10 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] twice – 8 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] twice – 6 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] twice – 4 sc.
Fasten off leaving long yarn tail. Thread yarn tail in needle and weave through remaining sc to close opening. 
Round 8: Working on opposite side of starting ch, join D in any ch; ch 1, sc in same ch and in each ch around – 14 sc.
Round 9: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] twice, sc in next 2 sc, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] twice – 10 sc.
Round 10: [Sc2tog] 5 times – 5 sc.
Fasten off, weaving tail through sts to close hole, leaving yarn tail for attaching beak to face.
Eyes (Make 2)
Round 1: With smallest hook and F, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join.
Round 2: 2 Sc in each sc around; join with a slip st in next sc – 12 sc. Fasten off.
Round 3: With right side facing join B in back loop of any sc; working in back loops only, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join in first sc – 18 sc. Fasten off.
Round 4: Join E in back loop of any sc; working in back loops only, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 9 times; join – 27 sc.
Round 5: Ch 2, [hdc in next 2 sc, 2 hdc in next sc] 9 times; join – 36 hdc. Fasten off.
Round 6: Join F in front loop of any st; slip st in front loop of each st around; join. Fasten off. Place marker or scrap piece of yarn in last st completed. Set eye aside and repeat Rounds 1-6 for second eye.
Round 7: At marker, join B in remaining back loop of Round 5 to work behind sts of Round 6; ch 2, ** [hdc in next 5 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 6 times; join – 42 hdc.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in first 3 hdc, [hdc in next 3 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 4 times, sc in next 3 hdc **, ch 1; locate marked st of 2nd eye and repeat from ** to **.
Round 9: Continue around the bottom of both eyes: sc in each st to first sc of Round 8; join. Fasten off.
Round 10: Join C in back loop of same st as joining; * sc in next 2 sts, hdc in next 3 sts, dc in next 5 sts, [2 dc in next st] twice, dc in next 5 sts, hdc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st *, 2 sc in ch-1 space between the eyes; repeat between * and * for 2nd eye; slip st in each st around to beginning of Round 10; join. Fasten off.
Finishing
Center eye motif on hat as pictured; sew in place. With B, embroider one French Knot off center in each eye. Sew beak centered below the eyes as shown. Sew feather tufts to corners of hat. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Forever Fleece Finer™ (9.9 oz/280 g; 385 yds/352 m)

Main Color (MC) Petal (76010) 2 balls for sizes 12/18 mos and 2 balls for sizes 2/4 yrs

Sizes U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) and U.S. J/10 (6 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge
Hook and loop fastener dot for waistband
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Picot = Ch 3. Sl st in top of previous stitch.
Sc2tog = (Draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Trfp = (Treble front post) - (Yoh) twice and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times.
measurements:
Tail: To fit waist measurements:
12/18 mos 21" [53.5 cm]
2/4 yrs 23" [58.5 cm]
Finished measurements:
12/18 mos 3" x 20" [7.5 cm x 51 cm]
2/4 yrs 3"x 27" [7.5 cm x 68.5 cm]

12/18 mos 18½" [47 cm] circumference
2/4 years 19" [48 cm] circumference
gauge: Tail: 12 sc and 13 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook. Hat: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook.
instructions:
The instructions are written for smaller size. If changes are necessary for larger size the instructions will be written thus ( ). When only one number is given, it applies to both sizes.
HAT
Note: Hat is worked from side to side.
With smaller hook and MC, ch 37 (47) loosely.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 36 (46) sc.
**2nd row: Ch 1. Sl st in first sc. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked (sc and sl st). 
Rep last 2 rows 3 times more. 
Next row: As 2nd row. 
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. Working to end of row: (1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sl st) 5 times. Turn. 36 (46) sc.** 
Rep from ** to ** once more.
Shape face opening
Upper part:
1st row: (WS). Ch 1. Sl st first sc. 1 sc in each of next 17 (22) sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
***2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked (sc and sl st). 
3rd row: Ch 1. Sl st in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last 2 rows 2 (3) times more.***
Next row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. Working to end of row: (1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sl st) 4 (5) times. Turn. 18 (23) sc. 
Next row: Ch 1. Sl st in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep from *** to *** once more. 
Fasten off.
Lower part:
With WS facing, working across rem sts of Main Body. Skip next 4 (7) sc. Join yarn with sl st to next sc. 
1st row: (WS). Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 13 (15) sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 12 (14) sts. 
3rd row: As 1st row. 11 (13) sts. 
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row 7 (11) times more.
Next row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 12 (14) sts. 
Next row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Joining row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc of Lower Part. Ch  4 (7). Working across Upper Part: 1 sc in each sc to last sc. Working to end of row: (1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sl st) 4 (5) times. Turn. 36 (46) sc.
Rep from ** to ** as given above twice more. 
Fasten off. Sew back seam of Hat.
Spikes
With smaller hook and A, ch 35 (41).
First Spike: 1st row:  (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
**2nd row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (2 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 6 sc. 
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn.  4 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off.**
***Next Spike:  With RS facing, skip next 2 ch. Join A with sl st to next ch. 
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 
Work from ** to ** as given for First Spike.***
Rep from *** to *** to end of chain. 6 (7) Spikes. 
Join Spikes to Hat:  Using photo as reference, align foundation ch of Spikes along center of Hat. 
With A, work sl st through both thicknesses to attach Spikes to Hat. 
Fasten off.
TAIL
Notes:
• Move markers up as you work each row.
• Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as st.
With larger hook and MC, ch 4. 
1st row: (RS). 2 dc in 4th ch from hook. 3 dc. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 2 (does not count as st here and throughout). 1 hdc in first dc. Skip next dc. 1 hdc in last dc. Turn. 2 hdc.
3rd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout). 1 hdc in first hdc. 2 trfp around next dc 2 rows below. PM on each of last 2 sts. (1 hdc. 1 dc) in last hdc. Turn. 6 sts.
4th row: Ch 3. 1 hdc in first st. 2 hdc in next hdc. Skip marked 2 sts. 2 hdc in next hdc. (1 hdc. 1 dc) in last st. Turn. 8 sts. 
5th row: Ch 3. 1 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in next hdc. 1 trfp around each of next 2 trfp 2 rows below. PM on each of last 2 sts. Skip next 4 hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. (1 hdc. 1 dc) in last st. Turn. 8 sts. 
6th row: Ch 3. 1 hdc in first st. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Skip marked 2 sts. 1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. (1 hdc. 1 dc) in last st. Turn. 10 sts.
7th row: Ch 3. 1 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 1 trfp around each of next 2 trfp 2 rows below. PM on each of last 2 sts. Skip next 4 hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last dc. (1 hdc. 1 dc) in last st. Turn. 10 sts. 
8th row: Ch 3. 1 hdc in first st. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to marked 2 sts. PM on last st. Skip marked 2 sts. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 sts. 2 hdc in next hdc. (1 hdc. 1 dc) in last st. Turn. 
9th row: Ch 3. 1 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in each hdc to 2 hdc before marked st. 1 trfp around each of next 2 trfp 2 rows below. PM on each of last 2 sts. Skip next 4 hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last st. (1 hdc. 1 dc) in last st. Turn. 
Rep 8th and 9th rows, noting side incs, until width measures approx 8" [20.5 cm], ending on a 8th row. 
Next row: (RS). Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in each hdc to 2 hdc before marked st. 1 trfp around each of next 2 trfp 2 rows below. PM on each of last 2 sts. Skip next 4 hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last st. 2 hdc in last st. Turn. 
Next row:  Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in each hdc to marked 2 sts. PM on last st. Skip marked 2 sts. 1 hdc in each hdc to last st. 2 hdc in last st. Turn. 
Rep last 2 rows, until work along center Trfp line measures approx 25" [63.5 cm], ending on a WS row. 
Proceed as follows:
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. Sl st in first st. 1 sc in next st. 1 hdc in each hdc to 2 hdc before marked st. 1 trfp around each of next 2 trfp 2 rows below. PM on each of last 2 sts. Skip next 4 hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 sts. 1 sc in next st. Turn. Leave rem st unworked.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sl st in first st. 1 sc in next st. 1 hdc in each hdc to marked 2 sts. PM on last st. Skip marked 2 sts. 1 hdc in each st to last 2 sts. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. Leave rem st unworked.
Rep last 2 rows until there are no sts left to work. Fasten off.
Spikes (make 2 pieces alike)
With smaller hook and A, ch 3. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 2 sc in next ch (outer edge). 
Turn. 3 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. (inner edge). Turn. 4 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 
Turn. 5 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. 
Turn. 6 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 
Turn. 7 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. 
Turn. 8 sc.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 
Turn. 9 sc.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. 
Turn. 10 sc.
9th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
10th to 12th rows:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Turn.
13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. Turn.
Rep 2nd to 13th rows until work measures length to fit along Trfp line of Tail, ending on a 8th row. 
Fasten off.
Join 2 Spike Pieces tog:
Note: Join along outer edges only, leave inner edge unworked. 
Align 2 pieces with RS of 1st piece and WS of 2nd piece tog. With smaller hook, join A with sl st at foundation ch. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work in sc across outer edge (shaped spikes), having (2 sc. Picot. 1 sc) in top of each Spike. Fasten off at end of last Spike. 
Sew each side of Inner edge along corresponding Trfp sts of Tail.
Belt:  With MC and larger hook, ch 16. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 15 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until Belt measures 22 (27)" [ 56 (68.5) cm]. Fasten off. 
Fold Belt in half lengthwise. Join MC with sl st at fold. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work in sc across ends and length of Belt, working 3 sc in corners. Fasten off. 
With WS facing, align top of Tail with joining sc row at center of Belt. Join MC with sl st at right side of Tail. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work in sc to attach Tail to Belt. Fasten off. 
Try on Belt. Mark position of hook and loop fastener. Sew hook and loop fastener to ends of Belt.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®: 1 skein each 312 Black A
319 Cherry Red (for boy version) or 373 Petal Pink B (for girl version), and 0316 Soft White C
abbreviations: A, B, C etc. = color A, B, C etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Size: Child size 4-6. Finished measurements: Hat circumference measures 18” at base. Belt measures 4” x 54”.
gauge: Hat: 9 sc = 4”; after Round 5 = 3.5” across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge. Gauge not critical for eye patch and sash.
instructions:
HAT
Round 1: With larger hook and A, ch 2; 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 5 sc.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around – 10 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 15 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 20 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 25 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 30 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 35 sc.
Round 8: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 40 sc.
Rounds 9-20: Sc in each sc around.
Round 21: [Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 45 sc.
Round 22: [Sc in next 8 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 50 sc.
Round 23: [Sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 55 sc.
Round 24: [Sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 60 sc.
Round 25: [Sc in next 11 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 65 sc.
Round 26: [Sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 70 sc.
Round 27: [Sc in next 13 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 75 sc.
Round 28: [Sc in next 14 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 80 sc.
Round 29: [Sc in next 15 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 85 sc.
Round 30: [Sc in next 16 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 90 sc.
Round 31: [Sc in next 17 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 95 sc.
Round 32: [Sc in next 18 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 100 sc.
Round 33: [Sc in next 19 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 105 sc.
Round 34: [Sc in next 20 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times – 110 sc.
Round 35: [Sc in next 21 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times; join with slip st to first sc – 115 sc.
Joining Rounds
Rounds 36-37: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st to first sc
Fasten off A.
Round 38: Join B with slip st to last sc; ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st to first sc.
Round 39: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st to first sc.
Fasten off B.
Skull
Row 1: With smaller hook and C, ch 3; 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in last ch; turn – 3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in last sc; turn – 5 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 2 times; turn – 7 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn
Row 6: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 4 sc, skip 1 sc, sc in last sc; turn – 5 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 2 sc, skip 1 sc, sc in last sc; turn – 3 sc.
Fasten off, leaving 10” tail for seaming to hat.
Cross Bones (Make 2)
Row 1: With smaller hook and C, ch 2; 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st to first sc of 4 sc group; do not fasten off.
Row 2: Ch 11, 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st to first sc of 4 sc group.
Fasten off, leaving 10” tail for seaming to hat.
FINISHING
Hat
First Join: With yarn needle and strand of B, baste yarn to last st worked; skip 26 sc, sew next sc to basted st. Fasten off.
Second Join: With yarn needle and second strand of B, skip 10 sc from first join, baste yarn to next sc; skip 26 sc, sew next sc to basted st. Fasten off.
Third Join: With yarn needle and third strand of B, skip 10 sc from second join, baste yarn to next sc; skip 26 sc, sew next sc to basted st. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
Applique
With yarn needle and strand of C, place bones in an “X” configuration and seam to hat as shown. Layer skull over cross bones and seam to hat. With yarn needle and A, make skull face details as shown.
Weave in ends.
EYE PATCH
Row 1: With larger hook and A, ch 5; skip first ch, sc in next 4 chs; turn – 4 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in last sc; turn – 6 sc.
Rows 3-4: Ch 1, sc in each across; turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; at end of row, ch 30 (first tie made).
Fasten off.
To work second tie, join A with slip st to side of first sc of row 5; ch 30.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
BELT
Row 1: With larger hook and B, ch 11; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 10 sc.
Rows 2-3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 4: Ch 4 (counts as first tr), skip first sc, tr in each sc across; turn – 10 tr.
Rows 5-7: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
Repeat Rows 4-7 19 times.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
sc2tog = draw up a loop in next 2 sts, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Bead-picot = ch 1, slide bead up to hook, ch 1, enclosing bead, ch 1, insert hook under front loop and vertical bar of last sc, pull yarn through all loops.

gauge: 13 sts = 4” [10 cm]; 18 rows = 4¼” [11 cm] in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CROWN
Ch 72.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Sc in 2nd ch and each ch across; turn – 71 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 4: Slip st in 26 sc, ch 1, sc2tog in same and next sc, sc in next 18 sc, sc2tog; turn leaving remaining sts unworked – 20 sc.
Rows 5-12: Ch 1, sc2tog over first 2 sc, sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog over last 2 sc; turn – 4 sc at end of Row 12.

Row 14: Ch 1, sc2tog – 1 sc. Fasten off.
Edging
Place marker in tip of point; starting at marker, place a marker every 1½” [4 cm] along both sides of triangle and along top of band. String beads onto yarn with yarn needle. 
Row 1: With right side facing, join yarn with slip st to first slip st of Row 4, ch 1, * sc evenly to next marker, sc in marked st, bead-picot **; repeat from * to point of triangle, (2 sc, bead-picot, sc) all in point; repeat from * to end of band, end at **; sc to end of band. Fasten off.

abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C
measurements: Rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Turn your favorite dog into a Halloween monster with a bit of crochet magic! He may not scare anyone, but he will certainly earn his share of treats!
Size Small
Round 11: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 14 sc] 3 times – 48 sts.
Size Medium
Round 11: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sc] 6 times – 54 sts.
All Sizes
Rounds 12-14: Sc in each st around.
Neckband
Ch 11.
Row 1: Sc in second ch from hook and each ch across, skip next sc on hat edge, slip st in next sc on hat edge, ch 1; turn – 10 sc, 1 slip st.
Row 2: Skip slip st, sc in back loop of each sc across, ch 1; turn.
Row 3: Sc in back loop of each sc across, skip next sc on hat edge, slip st in next sc on hat edge, ch 1; turn. 
Rows 4-9: Repeat Row 2-3, 3 times.
Rows 10-27 (30): Repeat Row 2, 18 (21) times. (Rows are not attached to hat – face opening made).
Row 28 (31): Sc in back loop of each sc across, skip next 18 (20) sc on hat edge, slip st in next sc on hat edge, ch 1; turn.
Rows 29-38 (32-43) Repeat Rows 2-3, 10 (12) times.
Row 39 (44) (Joining Row) Working through both thicknesses, slip st in each st across Rows 1 and 38 (43) to join.
Fasten off.
Dog Spats
With A, ch 16.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; ch 1, turn – 15 sc.
Row 2: Sc in back loop of each sc across.
Rows 3-17 (21) Repeat Row 2, 15 (19) times.
Directions are for size Small. Changes for size Medium are in parentheses.
Notes
Hat is worked in a spiral. Do not join unless otherwise indicated.
Neckband is worked in rows and joined as you go to Hat on odd rows except where indicated.
Special Techniques
Adjustable ring method Holding the yarn a few inches from the end, wrap around your finger. Do not remove wrap from finger, insert hook into the wrap and draw up a loop of working yarn. Chain one to secure the loop, and remove ring from finger. Work stitches of first round in the ring. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Dog Hat
With A, make adjustable ring.
Round 1: 6 sc in ring; pull tight to close; place marker at beginning of round.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times – 18 sts.
Round 4: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 24 sts.
Round 5: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 30 sts.
Round 6: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times – 36 sts.
Round 7: Sc in each st around.
Round 8: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times – 42 sts.
Round 9: Sc in each st around.
Round 10: To create Earholes, ch 1, turn, sc in next 14 sc; ch 1, turn, sc in next 14 sc; ch 1, turn, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] twice, slip st down side of last 2 rows; slip st in next 7 sc, sc in next 14 sc; ch 1, turn, sc in next 14 sc; ch 1, turn, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] twice, ch 8, skip next 7 sc, sc in next 16 sc, ch 8, skip next 7 sc, sc in next 16 sc.
Row 18 (22) (Joining Row) Working through both thicknesses, slip st in each st across Rows 1 and 17 (21) to join.
Round 19 (23): Rotate to work around edge of cuff, ch 1, work 20 sc evenly around edge – 20 sts.
Note: Begin working back and forth as follows to create paw covers:
Row 20 (24): Work 3 sc in next st, skip next st, slip st in next st; turn.
Row 21 (25): Work 2 sc in each of next 3 sts, skip next st, slip st in next st; turn.
Row 22 (26): [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 3 times, skip next st, slip st in next st; turn.
Row 23 (27): [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 3 times, skip next st, slip st in next st; turn.
Round 24 (28): [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 3 times, sc in next 12 sc, place marker for beginning of round.
Round 25 (29): Sc in each st around.
Fasten off.
Claws (Make 3)
With C, make adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 4 sc in ring; pull tight to close; place marker at beginning of round – 4 sts.
Round 2: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] twice – 6 sts.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] twice – 8 sts.
Round 4: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] twice – 10 sts. Fasten off. Do not fasten off last claw.
Work 1 row of slip sts across open edge of claw, folding claw shut. Continue to work slip st across other 2 claws. Fasten off.
Eye Back (Make 2)
With A, make adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; pull tight to close; place marker at beginning of round – 6 sts.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Round 3: [Ch 8, skip next st, slip st in next st] 6 times – 6 ch-8 sps.
Round 4: 3 sc in each skipped st of Round 3 – 18 sts.
Round 5: [Ch 8, skip next st, slip st in next st] 9 times – 9 ch-8 spaces.
Round 6: [3 sc in next skipped st, 2 sc in next skipped st, 3 sc in next skipped st] 3 times – 24 sts.
Round 7: [Ch 8, skip next st, slip st in next st] 12 times – 12 ch-8 spaces.
Round 8: [3 sc in next skipped st, 2 sc in next skipped st] 6 times – 30 sts.
Fasten off.
Eye Front (Make 2)
With A, make adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; pull tight to close; place marker at beginning of round – 6 sts.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each around – 12 sts.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times – 18 sts.
Rounds 4-7: Repeat Rounds 5 - 8 of Eye Back.
Fasten off.
Eye Balls (Make 2)
With B, make adjustable ring.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; pull tight to close; place marker at beginning of round – 6 sts.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each around – 12 sts.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times – 18 sts. Slip st in next st. Fasten off.
With C, make adjustable ring.
Round 1: 6 sc in ring; pull tight to close; slip st in next st. Fasten off.
Horn (Make 2)
With D, make adjustable ring.
Round 1: 5 sc in ring; pull tight to close; place marker at beginning of round – 5 sc.
Rounds 2-3: 2 sc in next st, sc in each remaining st around – 7 sc. 
Round 3: Repeat Round 2, changing to E in last st – 8 sc.
Rounds 4-5: Repeat Round 2, changing to D in last st or Round 5 – 10 sc.
Rounds 6-8: Repeat Round 2, changing to E in last st of Round 9 – 13 sc.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Assembly: Stuff Horns with Fiberfill. Using photo as a guide, position Horns on sides of Hat and sew in place. Sew black parts of eyeballs to white parts. Sew white parts to Eye Fronts. Sew Eye Fronts to Eye Backs - 1/4 of the way around. Place left and right Eyes together on top of Horns. Complete sewing Fronts to Backs between Eyes and left to right at centers. Continue attaching Eyes to Hat around bases of Eyes. Attach Claws to Spats. Weave in all ends.

Rounds 14-15: Sc in each sc around.

Rounds 17-18: Sc in each sc around.
Round 19: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from *

Round 20: Sc in each sc around.
Round 21: *Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from *
