materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 624 Tea Leaf A, 235 Lemon B, 706 Perfect Pink C, and 724 Baby Pink D.
abbreviations: A, B, C, D = color A, B, C, D
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 6 sts = 1½”; 2 rounds = 1¼” in dc measured on base of hat. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Hat Base
Round 1: With B ch 5; join with a slip st to form a ring; ch 3, 11 dc in ring; join with a slip st in top of ch-3 – 12 sts.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in same st as joining, 2 dc in each dc around; join in top of ch-3 – 24 sts.
Round 3: Ch 3, 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc] 11 times; join – 36 sts.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc] 11 times; join – 48 sts.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc] 11 times; join – 60 sts. Fasten off.
Leaf (Make 2)
Row 1 (Right Side): With A ch 12; slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, (slip st, ch 2, 2 dc) all in next ch, dc in next 2 ch, hdc in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch, working on opposite side of ch, hdc in next 3 ch, dc in next 2 ch, 3 dc in next ch; turn.
Row 2: Ch 2, 2 dc in first dc, dc in next 4 sts, hdc in next 3 sts, sc in next st, 3 sc in next st, sc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts, dc in next 4 sts, (2 dc, hdc) in top of ch-2; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, skip first st, sc in next 11 sts, 3 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts, skip next st, slip st in last st. Fasten off.
Flower for Hat (Outside petals)
Row 1 (Right Side): With C ch 36; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 35 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, * (sc, ch 7, sc) all in next sc **, sc in next 3 sc, repeat from * to last 2 sc, end at **; sc in last 2 sc; turn – 9 petals.
Row 3: Ch 1, skip first 2 sc, * (2 dc, 10 tr, 2 dc) in next ch-7 loop **, skip next 2 sc, sc next sc, skip next 2 sc; repeat from * to last sc, end at **; slip st in last sc. Fasten off. Sew ends of rows together to form a circle.
Inside Petals
Row 1: With D ch 22; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 21 sc.
Row 2 (Right Side): Ch 1, working in back loops only across, * slip st in next sc, ch 1, (hdc, dc, tr) in next sc, (tr, dc, hdc) in next sc, ch 1; repeat from * across; slip st in same sc as last hdc; do NOT turn. Fasten off.
Row 3: With right side facing, join D in first front loop unworked on Row 2; working in front loops only across, ch 1, [(sc, hdc, dc) in next sc, (dc, hdc, sc) in next sc, slip st in next sc] 7 times. Fasten off. Sew ends of rows together to form a circle.
Vine (Make 3)
With A ch 25; 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. Fasten off.
Hat Finishing
Weave in ends. Sew leaves and vines in place to hat base and then assemble flower and sew in place.
Ties (Optional)
Attach A to a st on last round of Hat Base; ch 75; slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. Fasten off. Repeat tie on opposite side of base.
Collar
Row 1 (Right Side): With A ch 41; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 40 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in first sc, 2 dc in each sc across; turn – 80 sts.
Vines-Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 5 dc, [ch 15, 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 13 ch, sc in next 5 dc] 15 times working last sc in top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Collar Tie
With A ch 60, with right side facing, sc across remaining loops of beginning ch of collar, ch 60. Fasten off.
Small Flowers (Make 2 each in B, C and D)
Round 1: Ch 5; join with a slip st to form a ring; ch 3, 11 dc in ring; join with a slip st to front loop of ch-3 – 12 sts.
Round 2: Ch 1, working in front loops only, 3 hdc in same st as joining, slip st in next dc, [3 hdc in next dc, slip st in next dc] 5 times.
Round 3: Ch 1, working in back loops only, slip st in first st, 4 dc in next dc, [slip st in next dc, 4 dc in next dc] 5 times; slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.
Center Flower
Round 1: With B ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join but work in continuous rounds. Mark first st of round and move marker up each round.
Round 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 4: Working in front loops only, sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [(Sc, dc) in next sc] 18 times; slip st in first sc – 36 sts. Fasten off.
Round 6: Join C in first back loop on Round 4; ch 1, 2 sc in each back loop around – 36 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next sc, ch 1, skip next sc, 5 dc in next sc, ch 1, skip next sc] 9 times; join in first sc. Fasten off.
Stem (Make 2)
With A ch 31; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 4 ch, [ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, hdc in last ch, working on original ch again, sc in next 5 ch] 5 times. Fasten off.
Collar Finishing
Weave in ends. With wrong sides together sew 2 stems together so that there are matching leaves on each side as shown. Sew Center Flower to top of stem and then to center front collar. Sew 3 small flowers in 3 different colors to collar on each side of Center Flower, evenly spaced.

materials: 3 2-inch (5 cm) squares of felt in assorted colors
hot glue gun or fabric glue
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 12 sts = 4" (10 cm); 15 rows = 4" (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Skull
With A, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 5 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 5 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc. Do not fasten off. Continue in turned rows.
Bottom
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—8 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. 
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog, turn—6 sc.
Rows 4 and 5: Repeat Row 2. Do not fasten off. Continue in rounds.
Border
Round 1: Ch 1, working in ends of rows, sc in each row across first edge of bottom; working in unworked sts of Round 6, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 4 times, 2 sc in next st; working in ends of rows, sc in each row across other edge of bottom, ch 1, sc in each st of Row 5, ch 1; join with slip st in first sc—47 sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING SKULL
Print template shown below. For each skull, cut forehead flower, nose, and 2 eyes from felt. Apply a small amount of glue on center back of each piece. Referring to photo as a guide, position pieces on skull and, with B and straight stitches, sew each piece in place. With B, embroider straight stitch teeth.
Weave in ends.
FLOWERS
Carnation
With C, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as first hdc), 9 hdc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—10 hdc. 
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc), 2 hdc in same st as join, 3 hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—30 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 4 (counts as hdc, ch 2), hdc in same st as join, [ch 2, hdc] twice in each st around, ch 2; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—60 hdc and 60 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Large Flower
Round 1 (right side): With E, work same as Round 1 of Carnation.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as first dc), working in front loops only, dc in same st as join, 2 dc in next st, [(ch 2, slip st, ch 2, dc) in next st, 2 dc in next st] 4 times, ch 2; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—12 dc, 4 slip sts, 9 ch-2 spaces.
Round 3: Working in back loops only, slip st in same st as join, ch 2 (counts as first hdc), hdc in same st, 2 hdc in each st and ch around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—68 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 2, working in front loops only, dc in same st as join, 2 dc in next st, [(ch 2, slip st, ch 2, dc) in next st, 2 dc in next st] around, ch 2; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off.
Small Flower (make 2: 1 each with C and D)
Work same as Rounds 1–3 of Large Flower. Fasten off.
FINISHING FLOWERS
Weave in ends.
HAT
With B, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc. 
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc. 
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 5 times, sc in next st; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc. 
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, [sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 5 times, sc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 5 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc. 
Fasten off.
FINISHING HAT
Referring to photograph as a guide, arrange flowers and skull on the hat as desired and glue in place. Glue or sew elastic band to wrong side of hat.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball each Pumpkin 431, Black 12, Hot Pink 332
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Mask measures approx. 3 ¾” (9 ½ cm) long x 8” (20 ¼ cm) wide, excluding ties.
gauge: 23 sc = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain your gauge.
instructions:
Center Seam
Whipstitch 3 sts between markers together, remove markers. Continue with edging on left eye circle.

Edging and joining center circle
Round 1: Ch 6, dtr5tog, ch 6, skip next st, slip st in next st, [ch 4, skip 3 sts, slip st in next st] 5 times, ch 2, slip st in any ch-2 space on Center Circle, ch 2, skip next 3 sts on Eye Circle, slip st in next st on Eye Circle, ch 2, slip st in next ch-2 sp to the left on Center Circle, ch 2, skip next 3 sts on Eye Circle, slip st in next st on Eye Circle, ch 3, tr in Center Seam, skip next dc on Center Circle, slip st in next dc on Center Circle, ch 3, skip next 4 sts on next Eye Circle, slip st in next st, [ch 2, slip st in next ch-2 space on Center Circle, ch 2, skip next 3 sts on Eye Circle, slip st in next st] twice, [ch 4, skip next 3 sts on Eye Circle, slip st in next st] 5 times, ch 6, skip next st, dtr5tog, dtr in next st, ch 6, slip st in next st, [ch 5, skip next 3 sts, slip st in next st, picot, slip st in same st as last slip st made] 7 times, ch 5, skip next 3 sts, slip st in next st, 4 tr in Center Seam, skip next 2 sts, slip st in next st, [ch 5, skip next 3 sts, slip st in next st, picot, slip st in same st as last slip st made] 7 times, ch 5, slip st in last st, ch 6, join with slip st in top of dtr5tog.

Round 2: Ch 1, sc in dtr5tog, (ch 6, slip st, picot, slip st) in next ch-6 sp and each of next 4 ch-4 spaces, ch 6, slip st in next ch-5 space, [(slip st, picot, slip st, ch 6) in next unworked ch-2 space on Center Circle] 3 times, (slip st, picot, slip st) in next ch-2 space on Center Circle, slip st in next ch-5 space, [(ch 6, slip st, picot, slip st) in next ch-5 space] 4 times, (ch 6, slip st, picot, slip st) in next ch-6 space, ch 6, sc in dtr5tog, (ch 6, slip st, picot, slip st) in next ch-6 space and in each of next 7 ch-5 spaces, ch 6, slip st in next ch-5 space, [tr in next tr, ch 1] 3 times, tr in next tr, slip st in next ch-5 space, (ch 6, slip st, picot, slip st) in each of next 7 ch-5 spaces and in next ch-6 space, ch 6, join with slip st in beginning sc.

Row 3: (Ch 4, 6 tr) in sc, (ch 6, slip st, picot, slip st) in each of next 7 ch-6 spaces, ch 6, [(tr, picot) 5 times, tr] in next ch-6 space, (ch 6, slip st, picot, slip st) in each of next 7 ch-6 spaces, ch 6, (6 tr, ch 4, slip st) in next sc. Fasten off.

Tie
Make tie 48” (122 cm) long. With right side of Mask facing, wrap tie from front to back through first ch-6 space of last row, then pull tie from back to front through last ch-6 space at opposite side. Center strand goes behind head for wearing support. Pull ends of Tie from front to back around 6 tr and ch 4 at each end.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

Stiffen Mask
With wrong side of Mask facing, brush fabric stiffener onto Mask. Wrap Mask around the Styrofoam® head form. Form the Mask, pinning it in place with rustproof pins. Brush fabric stiffener onto right side of Mask and let dry completely.

materials: RED HEART® “SuperSaver™”: 1 skein each 971 Camouflage A and 406 Medium Thyme B
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: 12 sts = 4” using 5.5mm [US I-9] hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the specified gauge.
instructions:
LOWER BODY
With A and 5.5mm [US I-9] hook, ch 20 (38, 50).
Row 1 (RS): Dc in 4th ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 18 (36, 48) dc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 2 dc in first st, dc in each st to last st, 3 dc in last st, turn – 22 (40, 52) dc.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in each st across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 2 dc in first st, dc in each st to last st, 3 dc in last st, turn – 26 (44, 56) dc.
Row 5: Ch 3, dc in each st across, turn.
Row 6: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 2 dc in first st, dc in each st to last st, 3 dc in last st, turn – 30 (48, 60) dc.
Rows 7-10 (12, 14): Ch 3, dc in each st across, turn.
Row 11 (13, 15)-14 (18, 20): Ch 2, dc in next st (counts as dcto2tog), dc in each st to last 2 sts, dc2tog – 22 (36, 48) dc.
Rows 15 (19, 21)-16 (22, 28): Ch 3, dc in each st across. Do not fasten off.
Shape Neck
Using separate length of A, join yarn to first st of last row, ch 8 (9, 9) for Collar.
Fasten off.
Row 1: With right side facing, insert hook in last st of last row worked, ch 9 (10, 10) for Collar, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch, sc in next 22 (36, 48) dc, sc in next 8 (9, 9) ch, turn – 38 (54, 66) sts.
Rows 2-2 (4, 4): Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Shape Collar
Row 1: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st, turn – 40 (56, 68) sc.
Rows 2-6 (8, 8): Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each st to last sc, 2 sc in last sc – 50 (70, 82) sc.
Fasten off.
POCKET
With B and 5.5mm [US I-9] hook, ch 13 (15, 17).
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 12 (14, 16) sc.
Rows 2-12 (14, 16): Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Do not fasten off.
Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc evenly spaced around, working 3 sc in each corner, sc in first corner, slip st to first st to join. Fasten off.
Pocket Flap
With A and 5.5mm [US I-9] hook, ch 14 (16, 18).
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 13 (15, 15) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc3tog, sc in each st to last 3 sts, sc3tog – 9 (11, 11) sc.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Body Edging
Row 1: With right side facing, join B at upper Body next to neck with sc, work 31 (43, 49) sc along side to lower corner, work 3 sc in corner, work 15 (34, 46) sc along lower edge, work 3 sc in corner, work 32 (44, 50 ) sc along edge to upper neck. Fasten off.
Collar Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join B in first sc of Body Edging, sc in next 7 (8, 8) sc, work 3 sc in corner of Collar, working in edges of neck rows, work sc, ch 4 for button loop, slip st in last sc made, sc in next 1 (2, 2) sc along edge of collar, work 3 sc in corner of Collar, work 48 (68, 80) sc to next Collar corner, work 3 sc in corner, work 5 (7, 7) sc along edges of Collar, work 3 sc in corner, work 7 (8, 8) sc to last st of Body Edging, slip st to first st to join. Fasten off.
Flap Edging
Round 1: Working in opposite edge of beginning ch, join A in first ch with sc, sc again in same ch, sc in next 12 (14, 14) ch, work 3 sc in corner, work 3 sc along side edge, work 3 sc in corner, sc in next 3 (4, 4) sc, ch 4 for button loop, slip st in same st as last sc, sc in next 3 (4, 4) sc, sc in same st as beginning sc, slip st to first sc to join. Fasten off.
Sew Pocket Flap on top edge of Pocket. Sew Pocket to center of Body.
Sew buttons opposite button loops.
D-Ring Tab
Row 1: Place marker on left side 6 (7, 8½)” from bottom edge. Using 5.5mm [US I-9] hook, join A with sc in 3rd st above marker, sc in next 2 sts, turn.
Rows 2-4: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving an 8” tail.
Fold tab over both D rings and sew end to inside edge of Body.
Strap
Row 1: With right side facing, join A with sc in opposite D-Ring Tab, sc in next 2 sts, turn.
Work even in sc until Strap measures 11 (12, 12)” or desired length.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
CAP
Note: Work Size Small using 4mm [US G-6] hook, Size Medium using 5mm [US H-8] hook, and Size Large using 5.5mm [US I-9] hook.
Round 1: With A, ch 2, work 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around – 16 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 24 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 32 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 40 sc.
Round 6: Working in back loop only, sc in each sc around, sl st to first st to join.
Rounds 7-10: Ch 3 (counts as dc), working in both loops, dc in each st around, slip st to top of beginning ch. Fasten off.
Shape Bill
Row 1: With right side facing and working around bottom of Cap, join A in 16th sc after first st, sc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts, dc in next 2 sts, 3 dc in next st, dc in next 2 sts, hdc in next 3 sts, sc in next 2 sts, turn – 17 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 7 sts, 2 sc in each of next 3 sts, sc in last 7 sts, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, work in sc around outer edge of Cap and Bill, slip st to first st to join. Fasten off.
Ties (Make 2)
Join A at side of hat, ch 40. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

abbreviations: ( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st

measurements: Mask measures 16½” wide x 4½” long (42 x 11.5 cm)

instructions: Beginning at the top, ch 40. Row 3: Ch 3, dc in first st, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 15 sts, ch 10, skip next 5 sts, hdc in next 4 sts, ch 10, skip next 5 sts, dc in next 15 sts, 2 dc in next dc, 2 dc in top of beginning ch, turn—42 sts and 2 ch-10 spaces. abbreviations: Dsc2tog = Working vertically, draw up a loop in side of next sc. Draw up a loop in next unworked sc of previous round. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Usc2tog = Draw up a loop in next sc. Working vertically, draw up a loop in side of next sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.

HORNS
See diagram on page 3.
With B, beg using magic ring method, demonstrated here.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 7 sc in ring. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 21 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 5th row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
6th row: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Do not turn.
7th rnd: (WS). Ch 1. (Working vertically, draw up a loop in side of next sc. Draw up a loop in next unworked sc of previous rnd. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – Dsc2tog (downward sc2tog) made. PM on Dsc2tog. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. Draw up a loop in next sc. (Working vertically, draw up a loop in side of next sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – Usc2tog (upward sc2tog) made. Working into rem sts of 6th row, 1 sc in each st to marked st. Join with sl st to marked st. Turn. 17 sts.
8th row: (RS) Ch 1. Skip first st. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Turn.
9th row: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in next sc. Dsc2tog. PM on Dsc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Usc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to marked st. Join with sl st to marked st. Turn. 14 sts.
10th row: Ch 1. Skip first st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
11th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Dsc2tog. PM on Dsc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Usc2tog. 1 sc in each st to marked st. Join with sl st in marked st. Turn. 10 sts.
12th row: Ch 1. Skip first st. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Turn.
13th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 3 times. Dsc2tog. Sc2tog. Usc2tog. Join with sl st to first st. Turn. 6 sts.
14th and 15th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. 16th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st) twice. Fasten off.

With A, ch 14.

Create a wonderful wig for a child to wear at Halloween or when playing dress up. First a hat-like piece is crocheted and then fringe is added to create the “hair”.

Size Medium Only
Round 8: Ch 3, hdc in same space, *(ch 1, hdc in next space) 14 times, ch 1, hdc in next space, ch 1, hdc in same space; repeat from * around, join with sc to first hdc— 32 ch-1 spaces.

materials: 1 skein each 312 Black A, 254 Pumpkin B and 316 Soft White C
RED HEART® Super Saver®, Art. E300 available in solid color 7 oz (198 g), 364 yd (333 m); multi color, heather and print 5 oz (141 g), 244 yd (223 m), flecks 5 oz (141 g), 260 yd (238 m) skeins
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 4mm [G-6], 5.5mm [US I-9], 6.5mm [US K-10½]
abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Wristbands measure 5” [13 cm] long x 8” [20 cm] around. Hat circumference: 22” [56 cm]. Directions for Corset are for size small; changes for sizes medium and large are in parentheses.
gauge: Gauge: Hat: 11 sc = 4” [10 cm]; Rounds 1-5 = 3½” [9 cm] across with medium hook. Corset: 6 sts = 3” [8 cm]; 8 rows = 3” [8 cm].
instructions:
Hat Band/Tie
Row 23: With largest hook, ch 41, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, sc in front loops only of each sc across; turn—100 sc.
Row 24: Ch 41, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, sc in each sc across; turn—140 sc.
Rows 25-29: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 29.
Cross Bones (Make 2)
With smallest hook and C, ch 2; 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook; slip st in first sc of 4-sc group, ch 11, 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in next 9 ch. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
Skull
Row 1: With smallest hook and C, ch 3; 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in last ch; turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in last sc; turn—5 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] twice; turn—7 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 4 sc, skip 1 sc, sc in last sc; turn—5 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 2 sc, skip 1 sc, sc in last sc; turn—3 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
FINISHING
With yarn needle and strand of C, place bones in an “X” configuration and sew to hat as shown. Layer skull over cross bones and sew to hat. With yarn needle and A, embroider skull face details as shown. Weave in ends.
CORSET
First Side
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Begin at center front with larger hook and A, ch 31; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across changing to B in last sc; turn—30 sc. Fasten off A.
Work in back loops throughout.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: Repeat Row 2, changing to A; turn. Fasten off B.
Row 4 (Right Side): Work 6 Cross (see Special Stitches) across changing to B in last sc; turn. Fasten off A.
Row 5: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in each st to last 2 sts, skip next sc, sc in last st; turn—28 sc.
Row 6: Repeat Row 5 changing to A—26 sc. Fasten off B.
Row 7: Repeat Row 5 changing to B—24 sc. Fasten off A.
Row 8: Repeat Row 5—22 sc.
Row 9: Repeat Row 6—20 sc.
Row 10: Work 4 Cross across changing to B; turn. Fasten off A.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 12: Repeat Row 11 changing to A. Fasten off B.
Row 13: Repeat Row 11 changing to B. Fasten off A.
Row 14: Repeat Row 11.
Row 15: Repeat Row 12.
Row 16: Repeat Row 10.
Rows 17-35 (17-39, 17-43): Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 35 (39, 43).
Opposite Side
Row 1: With wrong side facing, join B to unused loops of beginning ch; ch 1, skip first ch, sc to last 2 ch, skip 1 ch, sc in last ch; turn—28 sc.
Repeat Rows 6-35 (6-39, 6-43) as for first side. Do not fasten off.
Trim
With right side facing, medium hook and B, [ch 4, skip 4 sc, slip st in next sc] 5 times; ch 1, sc in row ends evenly across top edge of corset; working in sc at side edge of corset, [ch 4, skip 4 sc, slip st in next sc] 5 times; ch 1, sc in row ends evenly across lower edge of corset. Fasten off.
Lacing
With largest hook and A, ch 200. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave lacing in ch-4 spaces of trim as you would lace a shoe. Weave in ends.
WRIST BANDS (Make 2)
First Side
Row 1 (Wrong Side): With largest hook and A, ch 16; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across changing to B in last sc; turn—15 sc. Fasten off A.
Work in back loops throughout.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: Repeat Row 2 changing to A; turn. Fasten off B.
Row 4 (Right Side): Work 3 Cross across changing to B; turn. Fasten off A.
Rows 5-13: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 13.
Opposite Side
Row 1: With wrong side facing, join B to unused loops of beginning ch; ch 1, sc in each ch across; turn—15 sc.
Rows 2-8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 8.
FINISHING
With wrong side facing, B and yarn needle, matching st for st, sew last rows of each side together. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Fashion Crochet, size 5: 2 balls 90G Gold/Gold
abbreviations: ( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Finished Sizes: 15 (17½, 20, 22½)” (38 [44.5, 51, 57] cm) in circumference, blocked. 4” (10 cm) tall (all sizes).
gauge: 28 sts = 4” (10 cm). Height of 6-row pattern repeat = 2¼” (5.5 cm) unblocked. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
CROWN
Ch 9.
Row 1 (wrong side): Dc in 4th ch from hook, ch 2, skip next ch, 3 dc in next ch, ch 2, skip next 2 ch, dc in last ch, turn.
Row 2 (right side): Ch 5 (counts as dc, ch 2 here and throughout), skip next ch-2 space, dc in next dc, ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 2, dc in each of last 2 dc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in next dc, ch 2, 3 dc in ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next dc, ch 2, skip next 2 ch, dc in 3rd ch of beginning ch-5, turn.
Row 4: Ch 5, skip next ch-2 space, [dc in next dc, ch 2] 3 times, 3 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 2, dc in each of last 2 dc, turn.
Row 5: Ch 3, dc in next dc, ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc, [ch 2, dc in next dc] 3 times, ch 2, skip next 2 ch, dc in 3rd ch of beginning ch-5, turn.
Row 6: Ch 5, skip next ch-2 space, [dc in next dc, ch 2] 5 times, 3 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 2, dc in each of last 2 dc, turn.

Row 7: Ch 3, dc in next dc, ch 2, 3 dc in next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc, turn, leaving remaining sts unworked.
Rows 8-36 (42, 48, 54): Repeat Rows 2-7 (4 [5, 6, 7] times; then repeat Rows 2-6 once. Fasten off.

Assembly
Sew last row to bottom of first row to form a tube. Weave in ends.

Top Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join yarn with a slip st in first row-end dc at the end of Row 1 (on point side of crown), ch 1, *(3 sc, picot) in each of first 5 row-end sts, [3 sc, picot] twice in next ch-5 space, (3 sc, picot) in each of next 5 ch-2 spaces, repeat from * around, join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

Bottom Edging
Attach thread around any dc on the bottom edge of the crown with right side facing.
Round 1: With right side facing, join yarn with a slip st in any row-end dc on straight edge of crown, ch 1, 3 sc in each row-end st around, join with a slip st in first sc – 108 (126, 144, 162) sc.
Round 2: Ch 5, skip next 2 sc, *dc in next sc, ch 2, skip next 2 sc; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-5 – 36 (42, 48, 54) ch-2 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, *2 sc in next ch-2 space, sc in next dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with a slip st in first sc.
Rounds 4-5: Repeat Rounds 2-3.
Rounds 6-7: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

Finishing
Weave in ends. Starch and block crown to the head circumference of the person who will wear the crown. Be sure to measure head at the position where you wish to place the crown.

Note
6-row repeat = Can be stretched from 2½-3” (6.5-7.5 cm). You may vary the size of the crown by how much you stretch out the points during blocking.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 2 skeins 254 Pumpkin A, 1 skein each 312 Black B and 512 Turqua C
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5mm [H-8 US] and 5.5mm [I-9 US]

Yarn needle, sewing needle, black sewing thread, straight pins, black netting measuring 18” x 8” (45.5 x 20.5 cm), 2½” (12.5 mm) buttons (for flowers), 1 package medium size beads (sample used Clubhouse Crafts Bright Bubble Bead Mix), 1 package sequins (sample used Mixed Sequins by Advantus Corp, 9 color pack), 1 package craft feathers (sample used Assorted Feathers by ZFP Company)
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Hat measures 7” (18 cm) diameter across top and 10” (25.5 cm) high.
gauge: 12 sts = 4” (10cm) in pattern; 12 rows = 4” (10cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions: Crown and Sides: With 2 strands of A held together and larger hook, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1: Work 8 sc into ring—8 sc. Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st—16 sc. Round 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times—24 sc. Round 4: [Sc in next 2 st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times—32 sc. Round 5: [Sc in next 3 st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times—40 sc. Round 6: Sc in each st. Round 7: [Sc in next 4 st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times—48 sc. Round 8: Sc in each st. Round 9: [Sc in next 5 st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times—56 sc. Round 10: [Sc in next 6 st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times—64 sc. Round 11: Sc in each st. Round 12: [Sc in next 7 st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times—72 sc. Rounds 13-16: Sc in each st. Round 17: [Sc in next 7 st, sc2tog] 8 times—64 sc. Rounds 18 and 19: Sc in each st. Brim: Round 33: [Sc in next 6 st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times—64 sc. Round 34: Sc in each st. Round 35: [Sc in next 7 st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times—72 sc. Round 36: Sc in each st. Round 37: [Sc in next 8 st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times—80 sc. Round 38: Sc in each st. Round 39: [Sc in next 9 st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times—88 sc. Round 40: Sc in each st. Fasten off. Hat Band: With larger hook and B, ch 9. Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in ch, turn—8 sc. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Repeat Row 2 until hat band fits around the base of the top hat. Fasten off, leaving tail for sewing. Flowers: Large Flower: With smaller hook and C, ch 25. Row 1: Work 3 dc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. Fasten off. Small Flower: With smaller hook and A, ch 17. Row 1: Work 3 dc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. Fasten off. Loosely roll each row around in a spiral to form flower. Sew a button and bead in the center of each flower through all layers to hold its shape. Special Stitch(es): sc2tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook. Finishing: Hat band: With black thread and sewing needle, sew three rows of sequins down the center of the hat band. With ending tail threaded through yarn needle and wrong sides held together, sew the hat band seam. Slip the hat band onto the hat; sew in place. Pin flowers and feathers in desired positions and sew onto the hat band. Sew beads around the flowers. Netting: With double thickness of black thread, baste across one long edge of the netting. Gently gather the netting by pulling the thread until it fits across the front of hat. Sew the netting under the hat band. Brim: Roll up the sides of the brim up and pull the front and the back of the brim down for a more stylish appearance. With A, tack brim in place if desired. Weave in all ends.

pattern_name: Radiant Defender Crochet Super Hero Mask
materials: Red Heart® Super Glow™ (1.8 oz/50 g; 50 yds/46 m) Glow Worm Green (2003) 1 ball or 50 yds/46 m
Size U.S. F/5 (3.75 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc3tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 3 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Mask measures approx 7½" [19 cm] across and 19" [48 cm] circumference including Band (will stretch to fit). Designed to fit Child 6 to 10 years.
gauge: 20 sc and 23 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
MASK
Eye Opening (make 2)
Ch 25. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring. See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1 (does not count as st). 42 hdc into ring. Join with sl st to first hdc. 42 hdc. Fasten off, leaving 6" [15 cm] tail on 2nd eye opening for sewing.
With WS of Eye Openings held tog and sewing through both thicknesses, whipstitch 3 sts together (first and 3rd sts sewn are “joined sts”).
Face
1st rnd: (RS). Join yarn with sl st in first joined st on left eye opening. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. 1 sc in each of next 39 hdc. 1 sc in next joined hdc of same Eye Opening. 1 sc in first joined hdc of 2nd Eye Opening. 1 sc in each of next 39 hdc. 1 sc in last joined hdc. Join with sl st in first sc. 82 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc). 1 hdc in each of next 17 sc. 2 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 2 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in each of last 17 sc. Join with sl st to first hdc (top of ch-2). 92 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 hdc in same st as join. 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 hdc in same st as join. 1 hdc in each of next 19 hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc) 4 times. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 27 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. (1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc) 4 times. 1 hdc in each of last 20 hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.
Band
With RS facing, PM at middle at each side of Mask.
1st row: Beg at first marker, count back 2 sts and join yarn with sl st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts, removing marker. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
Rep last row until Band measures 11½" [29 cm] or desired length to fit snuggly, ending with a WS row. Fasten off. Being careful not to twist Band, hold last row of Band to opposite side of Mask centered over st marker. Working through both thicknesses, whipstitch Band to secure in place. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 Skein each No. 0312 Black CA, No. 0932 Zebra CB and No. 0320 Cornmeal CC
abbreviations: CA, CB, etc = Color A, Color B, etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: To Fit Chest: 18 (23, 28)”. To Fit Neck: 16 (18, 20)”. To Fit Length: 10 (12, 16)”.
gauge: 12 sts = 4”; Rows 1-9 = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions: BODY: With CA, ch 50 (65, 74). Row 1 (Right Side): Dc in 3rd chain from hook, * skip next ch, 2 dc in next ch; rep from * to last 1 (0, 1) ch; dc in last 1 (0, 1) ch; turn – 48 (63, 72) sts. Row 2: With CB, ch 1, sc in first 2 dc; * [yo and draw up a lp, yo and draw through 2 lps] twice all in next dc, yo and draw through 3 lps on hook – dc cl made; sc in next 2 dc; rep from * to last dc; sc in last dc; turn. Row 3: With CC, ch 1, sc in each st across; turn. Row 4: With CC, ch 2, dc in first sc, * skip next sc, 2 dc in next sc; rep from * to last sc; dc in last sc; turn. Row 5: With CC, ch 1, sc in each dc across; turn. Row 6: With CA, ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Row 7: With CA, rep Row 4. Row 8: With CB, rep Row 2. Rows 9-18 (9-24, 9-30): Rep Rows 3-8 one (2, 3) more times, then rep Rows 3-6 once more. Fasten off. Row 19 (25, 31): With right side facing, skip first 6 (9, 12) sc, join CA in next sc; ch 2, dc in same sc, [skip next sc, 2 dc in next sc] 17 (22, 23) times, dc in next 1 (0, 1) sc; turn – 36 (45, 48) dc. Row 20 (26, 32): Ch 1, sc in each dc across. Fasten off. NECKBAND-Right Side-Row 1: With right side facing, join CC in first sc of last long row; ch 1, sc in 8 (10, 10) sc; turn. Rows 2-12 (2-12, 2-16): Work in sc, working 3 more rows with CC, then 4 rows CA, then 4 rows CC, then 0 (0, 4) rows CA. Buttonhole Row 13 (13, 17): Ch 1, sc in first sc, [ch 2, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 1 (2, 2) sc] twice, sc in last sc; turn. Row 14 (14, 18): Ch 1, sc in first sc, [2 sc in sp, sc in next 1 (2, 2) sc] twice, sc in last sc. Fasten off. Neckband-Left Side-Row 1: With right side facing, skip center 20 (25, 28) sc of last long row, join CC in next sc; ch 1, sc in last 8 (10, 10) sc; turn. Rows 2-12 (2-12, 2-16): Work in sc and work 3 more rows with CC, then 4 rows CA, then 4 rows CC, then 0 (0, 4) rows CA. Fasten off. Neck Edging: With right side facing, join CB to Right Neckband; ch 1, sc evenly around entire neck edge. Fasten off. Sew buttons to Left Neckband to correspond to buttonholes. Sew body seam. WINGS (Make 2): With CC, ch 4; join with a sl st to form a ring. Rnd 1: 6 Sc in ring; do not join but work in continuous rnds. Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc. Rnd 3: [Sc in sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc. Rnd 4: [Sc in 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; TURN – 24 sc. Shape Bottom of Wing-Row 5: Ch 1, skip first sc, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next st] 4 times, sc in next 3 sc; turn – 23 sc. Row 6: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in each sc to end; turn – 22 sc. Row 7: Ch 2, dc in first 4 sc, [2 dc in next sc, dc in next 5 sc] 3 times; turn – 25 sc. Size Small Only: Turn to work 12 sc evenly across bottom of wing. Fasten off. Medium and Large-Row 8: Ch 2, hdc in first 6 dc, 2 hdc in next dc, [hdc in next 2 dc, 2 hdc in next dc] 4 times, hdc in last 6 dc – 30 hdc. Turn to work (14, 14) sc evenly across bottom of wing. Fasten off. With wrong sides together, sew the bottoms of the 2 wings together. Weave a chenille stem through the sts of Row 7 or 8 on each wing. Trim and bend the tips of the chenille stems over at each end to secure in place. Sew the bottom edge of the wings to the center top of the sweater, 1” down from the neck edging. HEAD BAND: With CC, ch 11. Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd chain from hook, sc in each ch across; turn – 10 sc. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. (10 sts) Rows 3-12 (3-12, 3-16): Rep Row 2 working 2 more rows CC, then 4 rows CA, then 4 rows CC, then 0 (0, 4) rows CA. Fasten off. Head Band Ear Flaps-First Half-Row 1: With right side facing, join CA to either end of head band; ch 1, sc in first 4 sc; turn. Rows 2-10: Ch 1, sc to end; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 10. Ear Flaps-2nd Half-Row 1: With right side facing, skip next 2 sc on same end of headband, join CA in next sc; ch 1, sc in last 4 sc; turn. Rows 2-10: Ch 1, sc to end; turn. Join Flaps-Row 11: Ch 1, sc in next 4 sc, bring First Half around and sc in each of the 4 sc of First Half; turn – 8 sc. Row 12: Ch 1, sc to end. Row 13: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 5 sc, skip next sc, sc in last sc; turn – 6 sc. Row 14: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 3 sc, skip next sc, sc in last sc – 4 sc. Fasten off. Rep Rows 1-14 on the opposite side of head band. ANTENNA RINGS (Make 2): With CA, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a sl st in first sc. Fasten off. Sew antenna rings to the top of the head band. Weave folded chenille stems in each of the antenna rings, twist the chenille stems together and curl the tips. HEAD BAND TIE (Make 2): With CA and CB held together as one, ch 12. Fasten off. Sew to the end of each ear flap.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 512 Turqua A, 3955 Wildflower B, 316 Soft White C, and 312 Black D.
Yarn needle, polyester fiberfill, stitch marker.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Hood Height: 7½ (8½)" [19 (21.5) cm], not including Antennas. Hood Width: 13½ (15)" [34 (38) cm], not including Collar.
instructions:
Collar (Make 2)
Join B with slip st in first row. Work sts into row ends along front edge of Hood.
Row 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc throughout), dc in next 8 sts (10); ch 3, turn – 9 (11) sts.
Row 2: Dc in next 7 sts (9); ch 3, turn – 8 (10) sts.
Row 3: Dc in next 6 sts (8); ch 3, turn – 7 (9) sts.
Row 4: Dc in next 5 sts (7); ch 3, turn – 6 (8) sts.
Row 5: Dc in next 4 sts (6); ch 3, turn – 5 (7) sts.
Row 6: Dc in next 3 sts (5); ch 3, turn – 4 (6) sts.
Row 7: Dc in next 2 sts (4); ch 3, turn – 3 (5) sts.
Row 8: Dc in next st (3); ch 3, turn – 2 (4) sts.
Row 9: Dc in next st (2); ch 3, turn – 2 (3) sts.
Row 10: Dc in next st; ch 3, turn – 2 sts.
Rows 11-22 (25): Repeat Row 10, slip st after last st of last repeat. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Antenna (Make 2)
Note: Add stuffing as work progresses for best results.
With C, ch 2.
Round 1: 5 sc in first ch – 5 sts.
Round 2: 2 sc in each st around – 10 sts.
Round 3: *2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around – 15 sts.
Round 4: *2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around – 20 sts.
Round 5: *2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around – 25 sts.
Rounds 6-8: Sc in each st around.
Round 9: *Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 20 sts.
Round 10: *Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 15 sts.
Round 11: *Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around, changing to A in last st – 10 sts.
Fasten off C.
Rounds 12-21: With A, sc in each st around; join with a slip st to first sc after working last st of last repeat. Finish stuffing firmly. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Eye (Make 2)
With D, ch 2.
Round 1: 5 sc in first ch; join with a slip st to first sc – 5 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING
Using photo as a guide, sew Eyes to Antennas between Rounds 5 – 7. Sew Antennas to Hood approximately 6 (8) rows from top. Weave in ends.
Instructions are for Babies size 6-12 months. Changes for size 12-24 months, are in parentheses.
Notes
1. Ch-2 at the beginning of the row counts as a hdc throughout the pattern.
2. Unless otherwise indicated, do not join rounds; instead, place marker in first st of 2nd round and move up as work progresses.
3. When changing colors, work last st of old color until 2 loops are left on hook, drop old color, yarn over with new color and complete st. Fasten off old color.
Special Stitches
sc2tog = [Draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
hdc2tog = [Yarn over, draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 5 loops on hook.
HOOD
With A, ch 54 (62).
Row 1: Hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch across; ch 2, turn – 52 (60) sts.
Row 2: Hdc in each st across; ch 2, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 7½ (8½)" [19 (21.5) cm].
Next Row: Hdc in next 15 (19) sts, [hdc2tog] 10 times, hdc in next 16 (20) sts, slip st in next st – 32 (50) sts.
Do not fasten off. Fold Hood in half, with Right Sides facing; join top edges together by sc or sewing. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

MASK (all versions)

Side A Eye Piece
Row 1: Slip st in ch-2 space, ch 35, slip st in same space.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, 49 sc in ch-35 space, join with slip st in ch-2 space.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 9 sc, hdc in next 3 sc, dc in next 8 sc, [2 dc in next sc, dc in next sc] 4 times, 2 dc in next sc, dc in next 8 sc, hdc in next 3 sc, sc in next 9 sc, slip st in ch-2 space. Fasten off, weave in ends.

Join same color in next ch-2 space, follow instructions for side A, do not fasten off.

Row 3: Ch 1, turn, [2 sc in next ch-3 space, picot in last sc made, sc in same space] 4 times, join with slip st in 4th sc on eye piece. Do not fasten off, Do not turn.

Side A Eye Piece
Row 4: Sc in next sc, ch 2, skip next sc, dc in next sc, ch 1, dc in next sc, ch 1, skip next hdc, dc in next hdc, ch 1, skip next hdc, dc in next dc, [ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next dc] 2 times, dc in next dc, 2 cdc worked in next 4 dc, 10 cdc increases worked in next 10 dc, 3 cdc worked in next 6 dc, dc in next 2 dc, ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 1, skip next hdc, dc in next hdc, ch 1, skip next hdc, dc in next sc, [ch 1, skip next sc, dc in next sc] 3 times, ch 2, skip next sc, slip st in next sc, slip st in ch-2 space on ring.

Version 1
Flower (make 2)
With desired contrast color, ch 4, slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 sc in ring, join with slip st in front loop of first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, working in front loop only around, sc in same sc, ch 3, sc in same sc, ch 3, *sc in next sc, ch 3, sc in same sc, ch 3; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, weave in ends.

With desired contrast color, ch 10, holding last loop of each st on hook, 2 tr in 4th ch from hook, yo, draw through all loops on hook, ch 2, slip st in top of cluster just made, ch 4, slip st in the ch st at base of leaf, slip st in next 3 ch, ch 3, holding last loop of each st on hook 2 tr in same ch, yo, draw through all loops on hook, ch 4, slip st in same ch, slip st around base of leaf just made, slip st in next 2 ch. With desired contrast color, ch 5, 2 tr in 4th ch from hook, yo, draw through all loops on hook, ch 2, slip st in top of cluster just made, ch 4, slip st in the ch at base of leaf, slip st in next ch. Fasten off, weave in ends.

Flower (make 6)

Leaves (make 4)

Star Flower (make 2)

Using paint brush, apply fabric stiffener following manufacturer’s instructions. Pin to wig head to shape and allow to dry, making sure side pieces lay next to head.

Strap
Measure and cut elastic, allowing 1” (2.5 cm) on each end for hem. Hem each end. instructions:
SNOWFLAKE (Make 5: 1 with A and 4 with B)
With D, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 5 (counts as dc, ch 2), dc in ring, *ch 2, dc in ring; repeat from * 3 times, ch 2; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—6 dc and 6 ch-2 spaces.
Round 2: (Slip st, beg 3-dc Cl) in first ch-2 space, *picot, 3-dc Cl in next ch-2 space; repeat from * 4 times, picot; join with slip st to ch of beg 3-dc Cl. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Saturate snowflakes with white glue or fabric stiffener, stretch and block on sheet of aluminum foil. Allow to dry thoroughly before handling.
Wand 
Cut off the points from the star, leaving a pentagon-shaped piece. With hot glue, adhere a B-colored snowflake to each side. Securing ends with glue, wrap D around wand handle. Tie a long piece of C under wand tip and trim ends as desired.
Tiara 
Trim visor to half of its original width. Holding visor upside down, with hot glue, adhere an A-colored snowflake to the center and a B-colored snowflake on each side.
Special Stitches
Beg 3-dc Cl (beginning 3 double crochet cluster) = Ch 2, yarn over, insert hook in indicated stitch or space, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook (2 loops remain on hook); yarn over, insert hook in same stitch or space, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops, yarn over, draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Picot = Ch 7, slip st in 3rd ch from hook, ch 4.
3-dc Cl (3 double crochet cluster) = Yarn over, insert hook in indicated stitch or space, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook (2 loops remain on hook); [yarn over, insert hook in same stitch or space, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] 2 times, yarn over, draw through all 4 loops on hook.
Notes
1. Take care not to twist chains when making picots and the cluster stitch that follows.
2. Points of star on wand are cut off before adhering snowflakes on each side.
3. Foam visor is trimmed to narrower width and worn upside down.
4. An adult should always operate the hot glue gun.

3. Cape is worked in varying bands of 2 colors; be sure to work in correct color sequence for your size.
4. Lightsaber is worked in continuous rounds (spiral) with right side facing; do not join unless instructed. 
5. Although gauge is not critical for the lightsaber, stitching around the tube is intended to be close-fitting. If your tube has a larger diameter than the sample tube, add additional increase rounds until the tube fits into the first rows of lightsaber.
6. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Fasten off old color.
Continued...
Second Tab
Holding cape with first tab to your right, skip next 9 (10, 10, 11) stitches and join B with slip st in next st. 
Row 1: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining and in each remaining st, turn—8 (9, 10, 11) hdc.
Rows 2-6 (6, 8, 8): Ch 2, hdc in each st, turn. 
Do not fasten off at end of Row 6 (6, 8, 8).
Edging
Ch 36, slip st in each ch (neck tie made), sc in each st of last row of second tab; working across ends of rows, sc evenly down outer side of second tab and cape to Row 1; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in each ch; working across ends of rows, sc evenly up opposite side of cape and outer side of first tab to last row of first tab, sc in each st of last row; ch 36, slip st in each ch (neck tie made); working across ends of rows, sc evenly across inner side of first tab to last row of cape, sc in each unworked st of last row; working across ends of rows, sc evenly up inner side of second tab to last row; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off.
MASK
Eye Opening (make 2) 
With larger hook and B, ch 15; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. 
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1 (does not count as a st), work 25 hdc into ring; join with slip st to first hdc—25 hdc. Fasten off, leaving 6” (15 cm) tail on 2nd eye opening for sewing.
With wrong sides of eye openings held together and sewing through both thicknesses, whipstitch 3 sts together (the first and 3rd stitches sewn are “joined sts”).
Face
Round 1: With right side facing, join B with sc in first joined st on left eye opening (if you are right-handed; right eye opening if you are left-handed), sc in next 22 st, sc in next joined st of same eye opening, sc in first joined st of 2nd eye opening, sc in next 22 st, sc in last joined st; join with slip st in first st—48 sc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc), hdc in next 10 sts, 2 hdc in next st, place marker in first hdc made of 2 hdc, 2 hdc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts, sc in next 2 st, sc in next 9 sts, 2 sc in next st, 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts, place marker in last hdc made, hdc in last 11 sts; join with slip st to beginning ch-2; change to A. 
Note Move markers up in Round 3.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in each st; join with slip st to first st. Fasten off. 
Band
With right side facing, join A with sc at first marked hdc.
Row 1: Sc in next 3 hdc, turn—4 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Repeat last row until band measures 8 (10, 12, 12)” [20.5 (25.5, 30.5, 30.5) cm] or desired length, ending with a wrong side row. 
Do not fasten off. Being careful not to twist band, with wrong sides together, hold last row of band to opposite side of mask with first st of band at 2nd marked st; working through both thicknesses, join with slip st through 4 st of band. Fasten off.
CUFFS (make 2)
With larger hook and A, ch 7 (9, 11, 13). 
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch and each ch, turn—6 (8, 10, 12) sc. 
Rows 2-8 (8, 9, 9): Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st, turn.
Rows 9-20 (9-20, 10-22, 10-22): Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. 
Holding first and last rows with wrong sides together, slip st through back loops only of Row 1 and both loops of last row. Fasten off. 
STAR
Note If star is to be sewn to cape, leave long beginning and end tails.
With larger hook and A, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 5 sc in first ch; join with slip st to first st—5 sc. 
Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st; join with slip st to first st—20 sc at end of Round 3. 
Note Points of star are made from rows worked within Round 4.
Round 4: *Sc in next 4 st (first row made), turn; ch 1, sc2tog twice (2nd row made), turn; ch 1, sc2tog, do not turn; ch 1, working in ends of rows, slip st in each row, slip st in base of 4th st of first row; repeat from * 4 times; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
LIGHTSABER
Top
With smaller hook and A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in first ch—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st—12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—18 sc. 
Note At this point, rounds should be slightly larger than the end of your wrapping paper tube. If it is not, work an increase round.
Increase Round: *Sc in next 2 st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—24 sc.
If necessary, add additional increase rounds by working *sc into next 3 st, 4 st, 5 st…, 2 sc in next st; then repeating from * around.
Next Round: Sc in each st. 
Next Round: Working in back loops only, sc in each st. 
Next Round: Sc in each st.
Repeat last round until lightsaber is 5” (12.5 cm) shorter than length of tube; change to C.
Repeat last round until one round extends past end of tube; join with slip st in first st.
Fasten off.
Bottom
With smaller hook and C, ch 2.
Repeat Rounds 1-3 and any Increase Rounds necessary to match diameter of last round of top. 
Last Round: Sc in next 9 st, ch 10, sc in next 9 st; join with slip st in next st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
With right sides together, whipstitch bottom to top through 5 sc opposite ch-10 loop. Using photograph as a guide, sew button for closure on bottom approximately 1½” (4cm) from lower edge. Sew extra button above this for decoration. 
Band 
With smaller hook and B, ch 5.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each st across, turn—4 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st.
Repeat Row 2 until band is long enough to fit around tube snugly. 
With wrong sides held together, working through inner loop of first row and outer loop of last row, slip st in each st. Fasten off.
Slide band into place to cover color change. 
Whipstitch if desired. 
FINISHING
Cape 
Block cape lightly, if needed. Center star on B-colored band on cape; with beginning tail, backstitch center of star first, then sew points with end tail.

Row 1: With right side facing and smallest hook, join yarn at lower left corner to begin working along lower hem; ch 1, work 168 sc across; turn.

Left Front Trim and Tie

Repeat Rows 2-13 once more and then repeat Rows 2-12 once more.
First Opening For Horn-Next Row: ** Slip st across 10 sts, ch 5, skip next 5 sts, slip st across remaining sts; turn.
Next Row: Slip st to ch-5 space, slip st in each ch, slip st to last 2 sts; turn, leaving remaining sts unworked; turn—31 sts. **
Repeat Rows 3-13 as for first Short Row Wedge and then repeat Rows 2-12 once more.

Repeat Rows 3-13 as for first Short Row Wedge. Repeat Rows 2-13 once more and then repeat Rows 2-12 once more. Fasten off, leaving 10” tail for seaming.
Loosely baste the sides of rows at top of hat and cinch securely, seam hat.

Row 3: Skip 1 st, slip st across; turn—5 slip sts.

Row 6: Repeat Row 2—2 slip sts.
Row 7: Slip st across, slip st in each row and skipped slip st in Rows 2-6 below; turn—7 slip sts.
Row 8: Repeat Row 3—6 slip sts.
Rows 9-12: Repeat Rows 2 and 3—2 slip sts on final row.
Row 13: Repeat Row 7. Fasten off, leaving 10” tail for seaming.
Seam horn, then sew to Opening in hat. Repeat for opposite horn.

instructions:
Neckband
Row 1: Ch 14, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 12 ch, skip first sc of hat, slip st in next sc on hat; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, skip slip st, sc in back loops of 13 sc; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in back loops of 13 sc, skip next sc of hat, slip st in next sc on hat; turn.
Rows 4-15: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 six times.
Rows 16-40 (Not attached to hat): Ch 1, sc in back loops of 13 sc; turn.
Row 41: Repeat Row 3.
Rows 42-55: Repeat last 2 rows 7 times.
Row 56: Join to beginning ch by working a row of slip st through both thicknesses. Fasten off.
Eye Back (Make 2)
With MC, make ring.
Round 1: 6 sc in ring. Work in continuous rounds same as for Hat.
Round 2: [Inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Ch 8, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] 6 times.
On all even numbered rounds, hold ch-loops at front.
Round 4: [3 Sc in skipped sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 5: [Ch 8, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] 9 times.
Round 6: [3 Sc in skipped sc, 2 sc in next skipped sc, 3 sc in next skipped sc] 3 times – 24 sc.
Round 7: [Ch 8, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] 12 times.
Round 8: [3 Sc in skipped sc, 2 sc in next skipped sc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 9: [Ch 8, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] 15 times.
Round 10: [3 Sc in skipped sc, 2 sc in next skipped sc] 7 times, 3 sc in next skipped sc – 38 sc.
Round 11: [Ch 8, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] 19 times.
HAT
With MC, make ring.
Round 1: 6 Sc in ring. Do not join but work in continuous rounds. Place marker in first st and move up each round.
Round 2: [Inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Inc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 4: [Inc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 5: [Inc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 6: [Inc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times – 36 sc.
Round 7: [Inc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times – 42 sc.
Round 8: [Inc, sc in next 6 sc] 6 times – 48 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: [Inc, sc in next 7 sc] 6 times – 54 sc.
Round 11: Repeat Round 9.
Round 12: [Inc, sc in next 8 sc] 6 times – 60 sc.
Rounds 13-14: Repeat Round 9.
Round 15: [Inc, sc in next 9 sc] 6 times – 66 sc.
Rounds 16-24: Repeat Round 9. Continue with Neckband.

Round 12: [3 sc in skipped sc, 2 sc in next skipped sc] 9 times, 3 sc in next skipped sc – 48 sc. Fasten off.
Eye Front (Make 2)
Work same as for Hat through Round 4 – 24 sc.
Rounds 7-12: Work same as for Eye Back.
Eye Balls (Make 2)
With A, work same as Hat through Round 3 – 18 sc. Slip st in next sc. Fasten off.
Pupil
With B, make ring; 6 sc in ring; slip st in next sc. Fasten off.
Horns (Make 2)
With C, make ring.
Round 1: 5 Sc in ring. Work in continuous rounds as before.
Rounds 2 and 3: Inc, sc in each sc around – 7 sc at end of Round 3.
Rounds 4 and 5: With D, repeat last round twice – 9 sc.
Rounds 6-8: With C, repeat last round 3 times – 12 sc.
Rounds 9-18: Repeat Rounds 4-8 twice more – 22 sc. Fasten off.
SPATS (Make 2)
With MC, ch 12.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 11 sc.
Rows 2-33: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc across; turn.
Fold piece in half, lining up beginning and ending edges.
Work a row of slip st through both layers to join and form cuff into a tube.
Upper (Right Side): Ch 1, working around edge of cuff, sc in each row end around; join with a slip st in first sc – 33 sc.
Row 1: Ch 1, 3 sc in first sc, skip next sc, slip st in next sc; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, inc in next 3 sc, skip next sc, slip st in next sc; turn.
Row 3: [Inc, sc in next sc] 3 times, skip next sc, slip st in next sc; turn.
Row 4: [Inc, sc in next 2 sc] 3 times, skip next sc, slip st in next sc; turn.
Row 5: [Inc, sc in next 3 sc] 3 times, skip next sc, slip st in next sc; turn.
Row 6: [Inc, sc in next 4 sc] 3 times, skip next sc, slip st in next sc; turn.
Row 7: [Inc, sc in next 5 sc] 3 times, sc in next 20 sc; do not join but work in continuous rounds – 41 sc. Mark beginning of round.
Round 1: Sc in next 4 sc, [inc, sc in next 3 sc] 4 times, sc in each sc around – 45 sc.
Round 2: Sc in next 6 sc, inc, sc in next 3 sc, inc, sc in next 4 sc, inc, sc in next 3 sc, inc, sc in each sc around – 49 sc.
Round 3: Sc in next 8 sc, inc, sc in next 3 sc, inc, sc in next 5 sc, inc, sc in next 3 sc, inc, sc in each sc around; slip st in next sc – 53 sc. Fasten off.
Toe Claws
With C, make ring.
Round 1: 3 Sc in ring. Mark beginning of round.
Round 2: [Inc] 3 times – 6 sc.
Round 3: [Inc, sc in next sc] 3 times – 9 sc.
Round 4: [Inc, sc in next 2 sc] 3 times – 12 sc.
Round 5: [Inc, sc in next 3 sc] 3 times – 15 sc. Fasten off.
Make another 2 claws in same manner, EXCEPT do not fasten off last claw; fold claw to close the open edge and slip st through both layers across; continue to work slip st across other 2 claws in the same manner. Fasten off.
MITTENS (Make 2)
Row 1: With MC, ch 8; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn.
Rows 2-20: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc across; turn.
Fold piece in half, lining up beginning and ending edges.
Work a row of slip st through both layers to join and form cuff into a tube. Now work in row ends in continuous rounds as follows:
Round 1: [Inc, sc in next 4 rows] 4 times – 24 sc.
Rounds 2-4: Sc in each sc around.
Thumb Opening-Round 5: Ch 5, skip next 5 sc, sc in each sc around.
Round 6: Sc in next 5 ch, sc in each sc around.
Rounds 7-14: Sc in each sc around.
Round 15: [Dec, sc in next 4 sc] 4 times – 20 sc.
Round 16: [Dec, sc in next 3 sc] 4 times – 16 sc.
Round 17: [Dec, sc in next 2 sc] 4 times – 12 sc.
Round 18: [Dec, sc in next sc] 4 times – 8 sc.
Round 19: [Dec] 4 times – 4 sc. Fasten off leaving long yarn tail. Weave yarn through remaining sc and gather to close top. 
Thumb
Round 1: Attach yarn at right edge of thumb opening; work 5 sc across bottom edge of opening, sc in side of opening, 5 sc across top of opening, sc in side of opening – 12 sc.
Rounds 2-6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Dec, sc in next sc] 4 times – 8 sc.
Round 8: [Dec] 4 times – 4 sc. Fasten off leaving long yarn tail. Weave yarn through remaining sc and gather to close tip.
Claws
With C, make ring.
Round 1: 4 sc in ring. Mark beginning of round.
Round 2: [Inc, sc in next sc] twice – 6 sc.
Round 3: [Inc, sc in next 2 sc] twice – 8 sc.
Round 4: [Inc, sc in next 3 sc] twice – 10 sc.
Round 5: [Inc, sc in next 4 sc] twice – 12 sc. Fasten off.
Make another 2 claws in same manner, EXCEPT do not fasten off last claw; fold claw to close the open edge and slip st through both layers across; continue to work slip st across other 2 claws in the same manner. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Stuff Horns with fiberfill. Position Horns on sides of Hat and sew in place. Sew Pupils to Eyeballs. Sew Eyeballs to Eye Fronts. With wrong sides together, sew Eye Fronts to Eye Backs ¼ of the way around. Place left and right Eyes together between Horns. Complete sewing Fronts to Backs between Eyes and left to right at centers. Continue attaching Eyes to Hat around bases of Eyes. Attach claws to mittens and spats as shown.

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.

measurements: Cape measures 19 (19½, 20, 21)” [48.5 (49.5, 51, 53.5 cm] wide across lower edge x 11, 12, 14, 15½” [28 (30.5, 35.5, 39.5) cm] long, including tabs. Mask measures 16 (18, 20, 20)” [40.5 (45.5, 51, 51) cm] circumference.
gauge: 10 rows in hdc = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CAPE
With A, ch 56 (59, 61, 64).
Row 1: Hdc in 3rd ch from hook and each ch across, turn—55 (58, 60, 63) hdc.
Rows 2-4 (4, 8, 12): Ch 2, hdc in each st, turn.
Row 5 (5, 9, 13) (decrease row): Ch 2, hdc in first st, hdc2tog, hdc in each st to last 3 sts, hdc2tog, hdc in last st, turn—53, (56, 58, 61) hdc.
1. In the cape, beginning ch-2 does not count as a half double crochet. Do not work last stitch into beginning ch-2.
2. Eye openings and face of the mask and the star are worked in joined rounds with right side facing. Band of mask is worked in turned rows.
3. Star is made in your choice of color.
4. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Fasten off old color.

Size 2 only
Rows 6-19: Repeat Row 5—25 hdc.

Size 4 only
Row 6: Ch 2, hdc in each st, turn.
Row 7: Repeat Row 5—54 hdc.
Row 8: Ch 2, hdc in each st, turn.
Rows 9-21: Repeat Row 5—28 hdc.

Size 6 only
Row 10: Ch 2, hdc in each st, turn.
Rows 11-24: Repeat Row 9—30 hdc.

Size 8 only:
Row 14: Ch 2, hdc in each st, turn.
Rows 15-28: Repeat Row 13—33 hdc.

All sizes:
Row 20 (22, 25, 29): Ch 2, hdc in each st; change to B, turn.

First Tab
Row 1: Ch 2, hdc in first 8 (9, 10, 11) sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—8 (9, 10, 11) hdc.
Rows 2-6 (6, 8, 8): Ch 2, hdc in each st, turn. Fasten off B at end of Row 6 (6, 8, 8).

Second Tab
Holding cape with first tab to your right, skip next 9 (10, 10, 11) stitches and join B with slip st in next st.
Row 1: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining and in each remaining st, turn—8 (9, 10, 11) hdc.
Rows 2-6 (6, 8, 8): Ch 2, hdc in each st, turn. Do not fasten off at end of Row 6 (6, 8, 8).

Edging
Ch 36, slip st in each ch (neck tie made), sc in each st of last row of second tab; working across ends of rows, sc evenly down outer side of second tab and cape to Row 1; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in each ch; working across ends of rows, sc evenly up opposite side of cape and outer side of first tab to last row of first tab, sc in each st of last row; ch 36, slip st in each ch (neck tie made); working across ends of rows, sc evenly across inner side of first tab to last row of cape, sc in each unworked st of last row; working across ends of rows, sc evenly up inner side of second tab to last row; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off.

MASK
Eye Opening (make 2) With B, ch 15; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1 (does not count as a st), work 25 hdc into ring; join with slip st to first hdc—25 hdc. Fasten off, leaving 6” (15 cm) tail on 2nd eye opening for sewing.
With wrong sides of eye openings held together and sewing through both thicknesses, whipstitch 3 sts together (the first and 3rd stitches sewn are “joined sts”).
Face Round 1: With right side facing, join B with sc in first joined st on left eye opening (if you are right-handed; right eye opening if you are left-handed), sc in next 22 st, sc in next joined st of same eye opening, sc in first joined st of 2nd eye opening, sc in next 22 st, sc in last joined st; join with slip st in first st—48 sc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc), hdc in next 10 sts, 2 hdc in next st, place marker in first hdc made of 2 hdc, 2 hdc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts, sc in next 2 st, sc in next 9 sts, 2 sc in next st, 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts, place marker in last hdc made, hdc in last 11 sts; join with slip st to beginning ch-2; change to A. Note: Move markers up in Round 3.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in each st; join with slip st to first st. Fasten off. 
Band With right side facing, join A with sc at first marked hdc.
Row 1: Sc in next 3 hdc, turn—4 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Repeat last row until band measures 8 (10, 12, 12)” [20.5 (25.5, 30.5, 30.5) cm] or desired length, ending with a wrong side row. Do not fasten off. Being careful not to twist band, with wrong sides together, hold last row of band to opposite side of mask with first st of band at 2nd marked st; working through both thicknesses, join with slip st through 4 st of band. Fasten off.

CUFFS (make 2)
With C, ch 7 (9, 11, 13).
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch and each ch, turn—6 (8, 10, 12) sc.
Rows 2-8 (8, 9, 9): Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st, turn.
Rows 9-20 (9-20, 10-22, 10-22): Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. 
Hold first and last rows with wrong sides together, working through both thicknesses, slip st in each st. Fasten off. 

STAR
Notes: If star is to be sewn to cape, leave long beginning and end tails. If sewing to a t-shirt as shown, weave in all ends. With desired color, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in first ch; join with slip st to first st—5 sc. 
Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st; join with slip st to first st—20 sc at end of Round 3. 
Note: Points of star are made from rows worked within Round 4.
Round 4: *Sc in next 4 st (first row made), turn; ch 1, sc2tog twice (2nd row made), turn; ch 1, sc2tog, do not turn; ch 1, working in ends of rows, slip st in each row, slip st in base of 4th st of first row; repeat from * 4 times; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Block cape lightly, if needed. If star is sewn to cape, with beginning tail, backstitch center of star first, then sew points with end tail. Weave in all ends. If sewing to a t-shirt, pin down stars in desired location. Using matching thread sew star to t-shirt.

BOA Note: See Notes at beginning of pattern for how to work with C. With largest hook and C. Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch (opening in mesh) from hook, [skip next opening, sc in next opening] 5 times, turn—6 sts.

Sew beads and charms to front of top edge of bra between straps. Sew a bead to the tip of each shell of the waist shell trim. Sew beads evenly spaced around lower edge of crocheted skirt. Sew large sequins evenly spaced over the netted skirt. Weave in ends. Wear the finished mermaid costume over a leotard. instructions:

With A, ch 20 (38, 50).

Work 3 (2, 5) rows in dc.
Shape Upper Cape
Row 1: Ch 2, dc in next st (counts as dc2tog), dc to last 2 sts, dc2tog, turn – 32 (50, 62) dc.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in each st across, turn.
Repeat Rows 1-2 for 5 (6, 8) more times – 22 (38, 46) dc.
Fasten off.
EDGING
Round 1: With right side facing, join A with sc in lower bottom right corner, sc in same st, work 32 (45, 54) sc to upper corner, work 3 sc in corner, work 20 (36, 42) sc across upper edge, work 3 sc in corner, work 32 (45, 54) sc to first sc, sc in same st as first 2 sc, slip st in first st to join.
Fasten off.
Round 2: Join B with slip st in first st of previous round, ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in each st around; slip st to top of beginning ch.
Round 3: *[Dc, ch 1, dc] 3 times around post of next dc, turn work to left, [ch 1, dc] 3 times around post of next dc, turn work to left, ch 1; repeat from * around; slip st to first st to join.
Fasten off.
RIGHT TIE
Row 1: Join B with in 3rd (4th, 3rd) sc below neck corner on right side, sc in next 2 (3, 3) sts, turn – 3 (4, 4) sc. turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until Tie measures 8 (9, 10)”.
Fasten off.
LEFT TIE
Row 1: Join B in sc at upper neck edge on left side, sc in next 2 (3, 3) sts, turn – 3 (4, 4) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until Tie is same length as first Tie.
Fasten off.
VISOR
With B, ch 21.
Row 1 (RS): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 20 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across.
Fasten off.
Row 3: With right side facing, skip first 3 sc, working in back loops only, join with sc in next st, sc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts, 2 dc in next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, sc in next 2 sts, slip st in next st, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, skip slip st, skip next sc, working in both loops, sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next 2 sts, sc in next 6 sts skip next sc, slip st in next st, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, skip slip st, skip next sc, sc in next 14 sc, skip next sc, slip st in slip st from previous row.
Fasten off.
Flower (Make 2)
With C, ch 2, [ch 7, slip st in 2nd ch from hook] 11 times.
Fasten off.
Sew one Flower to Visor.
Ties
Join yarn in end of Row 1 of Visor, ch 30 for Tie. Repeat at other end of Row.
Fasten off.
PURSE
With B, ch 13 (15, 17).
Row 1: Dc in 4th ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 11 (13, 15) dc.
Rows 2-10 (12, 12): Ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in each dc across, turn. Do not fasten off.
Flap
Rows 1-3: Ch 2, dc in next dc (counts as dc2tog), dc in each st to last 2 sts, dc2tog, turn – 5 (7, 9) sts.
Do not fasten off. Mark center st.
Edging
Sc evenly around edge, working 2 sc in each lower corner, to 1 st before marked st, ch 7 to form loop, skip center st, sc around to first st, slip st to first st to join.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
With wrong side facing, fold up bottom of Purse to beginning of Flap. Sew sides together through top loops of each sc.
Purse Strap
Join B with slip st in side seam st, make a ch 14 (18, 24)” or desired length, join with a slip st to opposite side seam. Sew Flower to Front opposite loop.
Weave in ends.

instructions:
