instructions:
Ch 92. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first ch. 1 tr in next ch. *1 sc in next ch. 1 tr in next ch. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 4 (counts as tr). 1 sc in next tr. *1 tr in next sc. 1 sc in next tr. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 4.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first tr. 1 tr in next sc. *1 sc in next tr. 1 tr in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rnds until work from beg measures 8" [20.5 cm].
Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Boutique Unforgettable®: 1 ball 3945 Parrot
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 6 mm [US J-10]
measurements: Cowl measures 20½” (52 cm) circumference around neck, and 10” (25.5 cm) high.
gauge: 17 sts = 5” (12.5 cm); 13½ rows = 5” (12.5 cm) in half double crochet (hdc). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Cowl is worked back and forth in rows. Short edges are then crocheted together to form a circle. Edging is worked around both edges of circle.
COWL
Ch 35.
Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across— 34 hdc.
Row 2 (right side): Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, hdc in each st across.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, working in front loops only, hdc in each st across.
Repeat Rows 2 and 3 until you have worked a total of 70 rows. 
Seaming Row (wrong side): Turn, hold first and last rows with right sides together and stitches matching, working through both thicknesses, slip st in each st across to join piece into a circle. Do not fasten off.
Turn piece so that right side is facing out.
Edging (right side): Ch 1, work 2 sc in the end of every other row all the way around; join with slip st in first sc—70 sc. Fasten off.
With right side facing, draw up a loop of yarn in seam on opposite edge of cowl and repeat Edging.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart® Boutique Unforgettable®: 4 balls 3955 Winery (1 ball for hat and 3 balls for cowl)
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 6mm [US J-10]; 6.5mm [US K-10.5]
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Cowl measures 11” wide x 60” circumference (28 x 152.5 cm), including trim. Hat measures 20” (51 cm) circumference at brim.
gauge: 14 sts = 4” (10 cm); 8 rows = 4” (10 cm), in double crochet with smaller hook. 13 sts = 4” (10 cm); 7 rows = 4” (10 cm), in double crochet with larger hook.
instructions:
HAT
With smaller hook and leaving a 5” (12.5 cm) tail, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Note At end of each round, skip beginning chains and join with slip st in first dc.
Round 1: Ch 3 (does not count as first st here and throughout), 12 dc into ring; join with slip st in first dc—12 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, 2 dc in each dc around; join with slip st in first dc—24 dc.
Round 3 and all odd-numbered rounds: Ch 3, Bpdc in each dc around; join with slip st in first dc.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in first dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—36 dc.
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in first 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—48 dc.
Round 8: Ch 3, dc in first 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—60 dc.
Round 10: Ch 3, dc in first 14 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next 14 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—64 dc.
Round 12: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join with slip st in first dc.
Round 14: Ch 3, dc in first 15 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next 15 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—68 dc.
Rounds 15–17: Repeat Rounds 11–13.
Round 18: Ch 3, dc in first 16 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next 16 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—72 dc.
Round 20: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join with slip st in first dc.
Rounds 21–24: Repeat Rows 19 and 20 twice.

COWL
With larger hook, ch 41.
Row 1 (right side): Dc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch counts as first dc) and in each ch across, turn—39 dc.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as first dc here and throughout), Fpdc around next 12 dc, Bpdc around next 13 dc, Fpdc around last 13 dc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, dc in each dc across, turn.
Rows 4–21: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 nine times.
Row 22: Ch 2, Bpdc around next 12 dc, Fpdc around next 13 dc, Bpdc around last 13 dc, turn.
Row 23: Ch 2, dc in each dc across, turn.
Rows 24–41: Repeat Rows 22 and 23 nine times.
Rows 42–61: Repeat Rows 2-21.
Row 62: Repeat Row 3.
Row 63: Ch 2, Fpdc in each dc across, turn.
Rows 64 and 65: Repeat Row 3.
Row 66: Ch 2, Fpdc in each dc across, turn.
Rows 67–120: Repeat Rows 64–66 eighteen times.

Note Take care not to twist piece while joining first and last rows. Hold ends with wrong sides together.

Joining Row: Ch 2, working in opposite side of foundation ch, slip st in first ch of first row, *dc in next st of last row, slip st in next ch of first row; repeat from * across. Do not fasten off.

Edging
First side
Round 1 (right side): *Ch 4, skip next row, working across end of row, sc in next row; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first ch of beginning ch.
Round 2: *Ch 5, remove hook from loop, insert hook from front to back in next ch-4 space, pick up loop and pull through to right side; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first ch of beginning ch. Fasten off.

Second side
Join yarn with slip st in opposite end of joining row.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of first side.

FINISHING
Weave in ends. Block piece lightly.

materials: Bernat® Mega Bulky™(10.5 oz/300 g; 64 yds/58 m) Teal (88206) 1 ball
Size U.S. S (19 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: V-st = (1 hdc. Ch 1. 1 hdc) in indicated stitch.

2nd row: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). (V-st in ch-1 sp of next V-st) 3 times. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 28" [71 cm]. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball each of 9925 Really Red A, 4601 Off White B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4 mm [US G-6]

* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated

instructions:
COWL
With B, ch 120; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Carry another strand of B under the working strand, working in back bumps of beginning ch, sc in same ch as joining slip st and in each ch around; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—120 sc. Place a marker in last sc made. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Drop the carried strand of B and begin carrying a strand of A.
Note: In all following rounds, work sc stitches in the back loops only.
Round 2: *With B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next st; with B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next 7 sts; repeat from * around—12 pattern repeats.
Drop the strand of A and begin carrying a second strand of B.
Round 3: With B, sc in each st around.
Drop the carried strand of B and begin carrying a strand of A.
Round 4: Repeat Round 2.
Round 5: *With B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next st; with B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next 3 sts; with B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around.
Round 6: *With B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next st; with B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next 2 sts; with B, sc in next 3 sts; with A, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around.
Round 7: *[With B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next st] twice; with B, sc in next 5 sts; with A, sc in next st; repeat from * around.
Round 8: *With B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next st; with B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next 2 sts; with B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next st; with B, sc in next st; with A, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around.
Rounds 9 and 10: Repeat Rounds 2 and 3.
Rounds 11-21: Repeat Rounds 2-10.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

Weave in ends.

materials: Patons ® Lace Sequin (70 g/2.5 oz; 344 yds/314 m) 37707 (Ruby) 1 ball
Size 3.75 mm (U.S. For 5) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
abbreviations: D tr = (Yoh) 3 times and draw up a loop in next st. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 5 times.
measurements: Approx 12 ins [30.5 cm] wide x 28 ins [71 cm] around.
gauge: 17 sc and 23 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 120 sc.
2nd row: Ch 5 (counts as 1 dtr). 1 dtr in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd to 5th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd to 5th rows for pat until Cowl measures approx 12 ins [30.5 cm], ending on a 3rd row of pat. Fasten off.
Sew side edges tog.

measurements: Cowl is approximately 7½” (19cm) wide x 29” (74cm) circumference.
gauge: Gauge is not important for this project.
instructions:
Beginning chain: Use your fingers to make a slip knot and adjust loop so that two fingers will fit into it easily. Use your fingers to pull yarn strands from balls through the loop; 1 chain made. Repeat 6 more times so you have 7 chains (photo A).
Row 1: With last chain on your fingers, slip fingers into second chain from your hand and pull working yarn through; you now have two loops on your fingers. Then pull yarn through both loops; 1 single crochet (sc) made (photo B). Repeat in each of the remaining 5 chains to finish first row of 6 single crochets (photo C).
Row 2: Chain 1 and turn. Slip your fingers under the top strands of the first sc, pull working strand through (you now have 2 loops of yarn strands on your fingers). Pull working yarn through both loops; 1 sc made. Repeat in remaining 5 sc (photo D).
Repeat Row 2 until 28” (1m) long leaving enough length for joining.
Joining with Slip Stitches: Holding beginning chain under last row, slip fingers through both last stitch and chain st; pull a loop of yarn through. Leaving loop on your fingers, continue across to join the last row to the beginning chains. Cut tail about 10” (25 cm) long and pull through loop still on your fingers; pull tightly to secure.
FINISHING: Weave ends through existing stitches.

materials: Patons® Iced™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 85 yds/77 m) Graphite (97004) 4 balls
Size U.S. M/13 (9 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Popcorn = 4 dc in indicated stitch. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook in first of 4 dc and pull dropped loop through. Ch 1 tightly to close popcorn.
measurements: Approx 15” [38 cm] deep x 28" [71 cm] around at lower edge.
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4” [10 cm].
instructions:
Beg at lower edge, ch 48 loosely. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring, taking care to not twist chain.
1st rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each ch around. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. 48 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in next st. *Popcorn in next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Popcorn in next st. 1 dc in next st. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. 3 dc in same sp as last sl st. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook in top of ch 3 and pull dropped loop through. Ch 1 tightly to close popcorn – beg popcorn made. *1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Popcorn in next st. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 dc in each of last 3 sts. Join with sl st to top of beg popcorn.
4th to 11th rnds: Rep 2nd and 3rd rnds 4 times more.
12th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next st. *Popcorn in next st. Dc2tog. 1 dc in next st. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Popcorn in next st. 1 dc in next st. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 37 sts.
13th rnd: Beg popcorn. *1 dc in each of next 2 sts. Popcorn in next st. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Dc2tog. 1 dc in last st. Join with sl st to top of beg popcorn. 36 sts.
14th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next st. *Popcorn in next st. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to last st. Popcorn in last st. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
15th rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. 16th rnd: As 15th rnd. Fasten off.

materials: Caron® Cinnamon Swirl Cakes™ (8 oz/227 g; 407 yds/372 m) Maitai (33004) 1 cake
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 10" [25.5 cm] deep x 60" [152.5 cm] around.
gauge: 8 sts (3 dc, Ch 4, 1 tr) and 5 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Note: Ch 3 at beg of round counts as dc.
Ch 160. Join with st in first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist chain.
1st rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st in first sc. 160 sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 4. 1 tr) in same sp as sl st. Skip next 3 sc. *(3 dc. Ch 4. 1 tr) in next sc. Skip next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. 40 reps of (3 dc, ch 4, tr).
3rd rnd:  Sl st in each st to next ch-4 sp. Ch 8 (counts as tr and ch-4 sp). 3 dc in same sp as last sl st. (1 tr. Ch 4. 3 dc) in each ch-4 sp around. Join with sl st in 4th ch of beg ch-8.
4th rnd:  Sl st in each st to next ch-4 sp. (Ch 3. 2 dc. Ch 4. 1 tr) in same sp as last sl st *(3 dc. Ch 4. 1 tr) in each ch-4 sp around. Join with sl st in top of beg ch-3.
5th to 12th rnds: Rep 3rd and 4th rnds 4 times more.
Edging: 13th rnd: Sl st in each st to next ch-4 sp. Ch 4. 4 dc in same sp as last sl st. (Sl st. Ch 4. 4 dc) in each ch-4 sp around. Join with sl st in in first sl st. Fasten off.

materials: Caron® Chunky Cakes™ (9.8 oz/280 g; 297 yds/271 m) Cherries Jubilee (17001) 1 ball
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dc3tog = [Yo, insert hook in next stitch and draw up a loop. Yo and draw through 2 loops on hook] 3 times. Yo and draw through all 4 loops on hook
measurements: Approx 26" [66 cm] around x 12" [30.5 cm] deep.
gauge: 8 dc and 4 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Ch 31.
1st row: 3 dc in 5th ch from hook. *Skip next 2 ch. 3 dc in next ch. Rep from * to last 2 ch. Skip next ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 4 (counts as dc. Ch 1). *Dc3tog. Ch 1. Rep from * to beg ch. 1 dc in top of beg ch. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3 (counts as first dc). *Skip next ch 1 sp. 3 dc in next dc. Rep from * to beg ch. 1 dc in 3rd ch of ch 4. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows until work from beg measures approx 26" [66 cm], ending on a 2nd row.
Fasten off.
Sew ends tog, forming Cowl.
Edging: 1st rnd: With RS facing, join yarn with sl st to edge at seam. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 rnd of reverse sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.
Rep on opposite edge.

materials: RED HEART® Boutique Sashay Sequins™: 1 ball 1953 Twilight
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Cowl measures 9” (23 cm) wide x 50” (127 cm) long before joining and adding Ruffle
gauge: 15 sc = 4” (10 cm). In pattern, 10 rows = 4” (10 cm).
instructions:
COWL
Row 1: Work 31 Fsc (see Special Stitches).
Row 2 (Right side): Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in each of the next 30 sts; turn—31 dc.
Row 3: Ch 1 (does not count as a st), sc in each of the next 30 dc and top of beginning ch-3; turn—31 sc.
Row 4: Ch 3, dc in each of the next 4 sc, *Fptr (see Special Stitches) around next dc 2 rows below, BR (see Special Stitches) over next 3 dc 2 rows below, Fptr around next dc 2 rows below, dc in each of the next 3 sc; repeat from * twice, dc in each of the last 2 sc; turn—16 dc, 15 Fptr.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each of the next 30 sts and in the top of beginning ch-3; turn—31 sc.
Row 6: Ch 3, dc in each of the next 4 sc, *Fptr around next Fptr 2 rows below, BR over next 3 BR sts 2 rows below, Fptr around next dc 2 rows below, dc in each of the next 3 sc; repeat from * twice, dc in each of the last 2 sc; turn—16 dc, 15 Fptr.
Repeat Rows 5-6 until Cowl measures 50” (127 cm) long, ending on a Row 5. With Wrong side out, match sts on ends of first and last Rows and slip st ends together to join. Fasten off, weave in ends.
EDGING
Note: Open up the Sashay Sequins to smooth it out, and work into the top edge without the sequins. Start 4” (10 cm) from the end, and work into every other loop on the top edge to create the Ruffle.
Hold Sashay Sequins and Cowl with Right sides together. Insert hook where the Cowl is joined and through first loop of Sashay Sequins, draw loop up to join; *working evenly along first side of Cowl, insert hook into next st on Cowl and pull up another loop of Sashay Sequins and make a slip st; repeat from * around. Place a stitch marker in the last loop so it does not unravel. Fasten off.
Trim the Sashay Sequins, leaving a 4” (10 cm) end. Fold under raw edge of each end, use sewing needle and thread to tack down both ends of the Sashay Sequins at the joining point to secure them. Repeat for second side.

materials: 1 skein each 312 Black A and 722 Pretty ‘n Pink B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5.5mm [US I-9] and 6.5mm [US K-10½]
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: Rounds 1–4 = 2½" (6.5 cm) with smaller hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
COZY
With smaller hook and A, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, *sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, *sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in first st, *ch 7, skip next 3 sts, sc in next st; repeat from * 4 times, ch 3, dc in first sc (ch 3 and dc count as last ch-7 space here and throughout)—6 ch-7 spaces.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc around post of dc of last ch-7 space, *ch 7, sc in 4th ch of next ch-7 space; repeat from * 4 times, ch 3, dc in first sc—6 ch-7 spaces.
Rounds 7–10: Repeat Round 6.
Round 11: Ch 1, 3 sc around post of dc of last ch-7 space, 3 sc in 4th ch of each remaining ch-7 space; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 12: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
HAT Motif
With smaller hook and A, ch 2.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—1 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in sc, turn—2 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 4: Repeat Row 3.
Row 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st across, turn—4 sc.
Rows 6 and 7: Repeat Row 3.
Row 8: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in last st, turn—6 sc.
Row 9: Repeat Row 3.
Row 10: Ch 2 (counts as dc here and throughout this row), 4 dc in first st, sc in next 4 sts, (4 dc, ch 2, slip st) in last st—14 dc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Base
With larger hook and B, repeat Rows 1–10 of hat.
ASSEMBLY & FINISHING
Center motif on its base and with long tail of motif, sew together.
Slip cozy on bottle. Place motif on cozy and, with long tail of base, sew in place. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 944 Cherrycola A, 321 Gold B, and 316 Soft White C.
Yarn needle; two 12mm buttons for eyes; one ¾” wooden button.
abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 10 sts = 3”; 8 rows = 3½” in pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
WRAp
With A ch 14.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 13 sc.
Row 2 (Right Side): Ch 3, skip first st, dc in next st and each st across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, slip st in first dc, * dc in next dc, slip st in next dc; repeat from * across working last slip st in top of ch-3; turn.
Rows 4-23: Repeat Rows 2 and 3.
Row 24: Ch 3, skip first st, dc in next st and each st across, ch 10, slip st in last dc for button loop. Fasten off.
Beak
With B ch 6; dc in 3rd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, slip st in last ch. Fasten off.
Eye (Make 2)
With C ch 4; 11 dc in 3rd ch from hook; join with a slip st to top of ch-3. Fasten off. Sew button to center of eye.
FiNiSHiNG
Sew Beak and Eyes in place. Sew button to beginning edge to correspond to button loop. Sew first 3 sts of Row 24 to corresponding 3 sts of beginning ch. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Soft Baby Steps®: 1 ball each 9505 Aqua A and 9590 Lavender B
RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball each 4601 Off White C and 4614 Black D
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 6.0mm [US J-10], 5.0mm [US H-8], 3.5mm [US E-4], 2.75mm [US C-2]
abbreviations: A, B, C, D = Color A, Color B, Color C, Color D
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: 16 sc = 4” [10 cm]; 20 rows = 4” [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size needles/hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
Nose
With 2.75mm [C-2] hook and D, ch 3.
Row 1: Work (dc, hdc, sc, dc, sc, hdc, dc) all in 3rd ch from hook, ch 2, slip st into same st as last dc—8 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Spot
With 3.5mm [E-4] hook and B, ch 3.
Round 1: Work (6 hdc, 6 dc) In 3rd ch from hook; slip st in first st to join—12 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Eye (Make 2)
With 3.5mm [E-4] hook and C, ch 2.
Round 1: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook; slip st in first st to join—5 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Pupil (Make 2)
With 2.75mm [C-2] hook and D, ch 2.
Round 1: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook; slip st into same st as last sc —2 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Ear (Make 2)
Make one Ear with A and one with B. With 5.0mm [H-8] hook, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc, 2 sc] twice—8 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, 3 sc] twice—10 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around—10 sc.
Round 5: Sc2tog, 8 sc—9 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around—9 sc.
Round 7: Sc2tog, 7 sc—8 sc.
Round 8: Sc2tog, 6 sc—7 sc.
Round 9: Sc2tog, 5 sc—6 sc.
Round 10: Sc in each sc around—6 sc.
Round 11: Sc2tog; pinch the opening closed.

COZY
Head
With 6.0mm [J-10] hook and A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in second ch from hook—6 sc.
Round 2: [2 sc in sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc] twice—10 sc.
Round 3: Sc, 2 sc in next sc, 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc, 2 sc—12 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 5: Working in front loops only, [sc, 2 sc in next sc, 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice, sc, 2 sc in next sc—17 sc.
Round 6: Working in both loops, 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, [3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, 2 sc—21 sc.
Round 7: [6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—24 sc.
Round 8: 11 sc, 2 sc in next sc, 12 sc—25 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around—25 sc.
Round 10: 12 sc, sc2tog, 11 sc; ch 1, turn—24 sc.
Round 11: [6 sc, sc2tog] 3 times; ch 1, turn—21 sc.
Round 12: [3 sc, sc2tog] 4 times, sc; ch 1, turn—17 sc.
Round 13: [Sc, sc2tog] 5 times, 2 sc—12 sc.
Fasten off, weave in ends.

Finishing
Referring to photograph for placement, sew Nose to snout in center of Cozy. Embroider a mouth on snout below the Nose. Sew Pupils to Eyes. Sew one Eye to Spot, then sew Spot to Cozy above the snout. Sew other Eye above the snout. Sew Ears above Eyes. Weave in all ends.

materials: Patons® shetland Chunky (100 g/3.5 oz; 136 m/148 yds)
Version I Main Color (MC) (78024 Biscuit) 1 ball
Contrast B (78609 High Plains Variegated) 1 ball
Version II Main Color (MC) (78736 Oriental Orchid) 1 ball

gauge: 11 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Front 
note: Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc throughout.
Beg at bottom edge, with MC, ch 27. 
1st row: (RS). 5 dc in 6th ch from hook. (Miss next 5 ch. 5 dc in next ch) 
3 times. Miss next 2 ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. 2 dc in first dc. *Miss next 5 dc. Working behind row, 5 dc 
in 3rd ch of next missed ch-5 group from 2 rows below. Rep from * twice 
more. Miss next 5 dc. 3 dc last dc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. Miss next 2 dc. *Working behind row, 5 dc in center dc of 
next 5 dc group from 2 rows below.** Miss next 5 dc. Rep from * twice 
more, then rep from * to ** once more. Miss next 2 dc. 1 dc in last dc. 
Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. 2 dc in first dc. *Miss next 5 dc. Working in front of row 
through to back of work, 5 dc in center dc of next 5 dc group from 2 rows 
below. Rep from * twice more. Miss next 5 dc. 3 dc last dc. Turn.
5th row: Ch 3. Miss next 2 dc. *Working in front of row, 5 dc in center 
dc of next 5 dc group from 2 rows below.** Miss next 5 dc. Rep from * 
twice more, then rep from * to ** once more. Miss next 2 dc. 1 dc in last 
dc. Turn.
6th row: Ch 3. 2 dc in same sp. *Miss next 5 dc. Working behind row 
through to front of work, 5 dc in center dc of next 5 dc group from 2 rows 
below. Rep from * twice more. Miss next 5 dc. 3 dc last dc. Turn.
7th to 18th rows: Rep 3rd to 6th rows 3 times more.
19th row: Ch 3. *Working behind row, 3 dc in center dc of next 5 dc 
group from 2 rows below. Working in current row, 1 hdc in center of next 
5 dc group. Rep from * twice more. Miss next 2 dc. 1 dc in last dc. Fasten 
off.
edging: 1st row: (RS). Join B with sl st at bottom right corner. Ch 1. 
Work 27 sc up side of work. *(1 hdc. 1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc. 1 hdc) in corner st.* 
Work 8 sc evenly across top edge. Rep from * to * once more. Work 27 sc 
down side of work. Turn. 72 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 29 sts. (1 hdc. 1 dc. 1 hdc) in ch-1 sp. 
1 sc in each of next 12 sts. (1 hdc. 1 dc. 1 hdc) in ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of 
next 29 sts. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 30 sts. Place marker on 18th st. 3 sc 
in next dc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sts. 3 sc in next dc. 1 sc in each of next 
30 sts. Fasten off.
Back 
With B, work as Front, omitting all references to color changes.
eye Mask
With A, ch 13.
1st rnd: 5 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 6 dc). Miss next 2 ch. 1 sc in 
each of next 4 ch. Miss next 2 ch. 12 dc in last ch. Working into opposite 
side of ch, miss next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. 6 dc in next ch. Miss 
next 2 ch. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of next 3 dc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. 2 sc 
in each of next 6 dc. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. (Draw up a loop in each of 
next 3 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc3tog made) twice. 
1 sc in each of next 2 dc. 2 sc in each of next 3 dc. Join with sl st to first 
sc. Fasten off.
eyes (make 2).
With D, ch 2.
1st rnd: (4 sc. 2 hdc. 3 dc. 2 hdc) in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to 
first sc. Fasten off.
Beak
With C, ch 5.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 4 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. (Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through 
all loops on hook - sc2tog made) twice. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
FInIshInG
Sew eyes, Beak and buttons to eye Mask as shown. Sew eye Mask to 
Front as shown in picture.
top joining row: With WS of Back and Front pieces tog and Front facing, 
join B with sl st at marker. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sl st 
in each of next 43 sc. Fasten off. 
Sew Front and Back tog at bottom corners, leaving openings for spout 
and handle.
tassel: (make 2). 
Cut B, 4" [10 cm] long. Take 6 strands tog, fold in half and knot into 
fringe at each corner sc at top edge of Cozy. Trim fringe evenly.

Sizes 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) and 6 mm (U.S. J or 10) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain tension
abbreviations: Dcbp = yo and insert hook from back to front around post of dc 1 row below. yo and draw up a loop. yo and draw through 2 loops on hook. yo and draw through all loops on hook.
Dcfp = yo and insert hook from front to back around post of dc 1 row below. yo and draw up a loop. yo and draw through 2 loops on hook. yo and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 17 sc and 18 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook.
instructions:
Cupcake Liner (make 2 alike).
Note: Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc throughout.
With smaller hook and MC, ch 36. 
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each ch across. Turn. 34 dc.
2nd row: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around next st. 1 dcbp around next st) 16 times. 1 dc in last dc. Turn.
Rep 2nd row 10 times more. 
Fasten off.
Cupcake Top
With smaller hook and A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 5 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc) 5 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc) 5 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 54 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc) 5 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 60 sc. 
11th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 66 sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc) 5 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 72 sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 78 sc.
14th to 16th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Fasten off.
Icing
With larger hook and holding 2 strands of B tog, ch 71.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. Turn. 70 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc.
Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times.  (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Icing into spiral shape as pictured. Sew Icing to Cupcake Top. 
With WS of Cupcake Liner pieces tog, sew side edges tog at top 
corner and along last row only, leaving openings for spout and 
handle. Sew Cupcake Top to Liner as pictured. Sew beads in random 
pattern to Icing as shown in photo.
Pom-pom (make 1).
Wind C around 2 fingers approx 30 times. Remove from fingers and 
tie tightly in center. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to a smooth 
round shape. Attach to top of Icing spiral.

materials: 1 skein each 312 Black A and 3620 Glowworm B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5.5mm [US I-9] and 6.5mm [US K-10½]
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B

gauge: Rounds 1–4 = 2½" (6.5 cm) with smaller hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
COZY
With smaller hook and A, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.

Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, *sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, *sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in first st, *ch 7, skip next 3 sts, sc in next st; repeat from * 4 times, ch 3, dc in first sc (ch 3 and dc count as last ch-7 space here and throughout)—6 ch-7 spaces.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc around post of dc of last ch-7 space, *ch 7, sc in 4th ch of next ch-7 space; repeat from * 4 times, ch 3, dc in first sc—6 ch-7 spaces.
Rounds 7–10: Repeat Round 6.
Round 11: Ch 1, 3 sc around post of dc of last ch-7 space, 3 sc in 4th ch of each remaining ch-7 space; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 12: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

SPIDER
Motif Top Half
With smaller hook and A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc.
Round 2: Ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, **slip st in next st, [ch 6, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in remaining 4 ch] twice**, *slip st in next st, [ch 8, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in remaining 6 ch] twice*, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * to *; repeat from ** to **, slip st in next st, ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in bottom of beginning ch—2 pairs of short legs and 2 pairs of long legs. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing motif to base.

Motif Bottom Half
With smaller hook and A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts; leave remaining sts unworked—2 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing to top half.
With tail, sew each sc of Round 3 to each sc between pairs of long legs of top half.

Base
With larger hook and B, repeat top and bottom halves of motif.

ASSEMBLY & FINISHING
Center motif on its base and with long tail of motif top half, sew together. Slip cozy on bottle. Place motif on cozy and with long tail of base, sew in place. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Maker™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 317 yds/290 m)
Contrast A Cream (06003) 1 ball or 160 yds/146 m

instructions:
Note: Do not join at ends of rnds unless otherwise stated. Cont working in spiral placing marker on first st of rnd for easier counting.

See diagram on page 3.
With A, ch 2.

2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.

8th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.

1st rnd: 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Ch 8. Skip next 18 sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 1 sc in each of next 18 ch. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
6th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
7th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
8th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
9th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
10th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
11th rnd: *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 12 sc.

FACE
See diagram on page 4.
With B, ch 38. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring, making sure not to twist ch.

See diagram on page 4.
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. PM. 3 sc.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
3rd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 6 sc.
4th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving tail for sewing.
Sew Horns to head of Body as shown in photo.
Teeth (make 2)
See diagram on page 4.
With A, ch 3.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in last ch. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row.
Fasten off, leaving tail for sewing.
Sew Teeth to bottom of Mouth as shown in photo.

[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Cozy measures 9.5” (24 cm) wide by 4” (10 cm) tall and fits 12 oz. soda can.
gauge: With double strand yarn, 12 hdc = 4” [10 cm]; 11 rows hdc = 4” [10 cm]. With single strand yarn, 14 sc = 4” [10 cm]; 20 rows sc = 4” [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Football Can Cozy
Enjoy a soda (or other libation) served in this stylish cozy while you watch the game! Our football can cozy has personality plus, making it perfect for giving to enthusiastic football fans. Why not crochet a cozy or two while watching the game?

Rounds 6-13: Sc in each sc around.
Round 14: [Sc2tog, sc in each of the next 3 sc] 12 times — 48 sc.
Round 15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: [Sc2tog, sc in each of the next 2 sc] 12 times — 36 sc.
Round 17: Sc in each sc around.
Begin stuffing to create round ball shape. Stuff firmly to define shape but do not overstuff or stretch stitches (this helps prevent stuffing from showing through work). It may be helpful to place a soda can inside the Lining to hold its shape while working. Continue stuffing as you close.
Round 18: [Sc2tog, sc in the next sc] 12 times — 24 sc.
Round 19: Join Ball to Lining by single crocheting Ball Round 18 and open loops of Lining Round 5 together. Match and sc together each st and loop around, stuffing and shaping. Fasten off. Weave ends in.
Football End (Make 2)
End is worked in continuous rounds without joining or turning. Using one strand of A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook — 6 sc.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc] 6 times — 12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times — 18 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: [Sc in each of the next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times — 24 sc.
Round 7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: [2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 3 sc] 6 times — 30 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around.

Lining is worked holding two strands of yarn throughout. With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first st — 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join — 12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [2 hdc in next sc, hdc in next sc] 6 times; join — 18 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [Hdc in each of the next 2 hdc, 2 hdc in the next hdc] 6 times; join — 24 hdc.
Round 5: Ch 1, hdc in back loop only of each hdc around; join — 24 hdc.
Rounds 6-12: Ch 1, hdc in each hdc around; join — 24 hdc. Fasten off. Weave ends in.
Ball
Ball is worked in continuous rounds without joining or turning. Use a stitch holder to mark the beginning of each Round, moving up as work progresses. Using one strand of A, hold Liner with the top facing and join yarn in any back loop of Liner Round 12.
Round 1: [Sc in back loop of next st, 2 sc in back loop of next st] 12 times — 36 sc.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 2 sc] 12 times — 48 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [Sc in each of the next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 12 times — 60 sc.
Round 10: Sc in each of the next 2 sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 4 sc] 5 times, 2 sc in next sc, sc in each of the next 2 sc — 36 sc.
Round 11: Sc in each sc around to last sc; insert hook into last sc, yarn over and draw up loop (2 loops on hook), change to B, yarn over with B, draw through both loops to complete sc; continue with B.
Round 12: [2 sc, sc in each of the next 5 sc] 6 times — 42 sc.
Round 13: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off ends, leaving a 12” (30.5 cm) tail for sewing.
Finishing
Using photograph as a guide, stuff and sew the Football Ends to opposite sides of the Ball, creating a football shape.
For Mouth and Laces: With B, ch 8. Slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across — 7 slip sts. Fasten off, leaving 24” (60.9 cm) tail for sewing. Position Mouth about two-thirds of the way down on the Ball and sew on. Using the extra length of tail, satin stitch 4 Laces evenly across the Mouth.
For Eyes: using C and working over 2 or 3 sts, satin stitch the Eyes about 4 rounds above the Mouth and 3 stitches apart. Add Eyebrows. Fasten off, weave in ends.

instructions:
FRONT: With MC, ch 16.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 15 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Repeat Row 2 until 3” from beginning, end by working a wrong side row.
Divide for Neck Opening-First Side: Ch 1, sc in first 7 sc; turn. Work 1 row even on these 7 sc.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in 5 sc; draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc, draw through all 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made; turn – 6 sc. Work 1 row even.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in 4 sc, sc2tog; turn – 5 sc. Work 1 row even.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in 3 sc, sc2tog; turn – 4 sc. Work 1 row even. Fasten off.
Second Side: With right side facing, attach yarn in next sc of last long row; ch 1, sc in same sc and in each sc across; turn – 7 sc. Work 1 row even.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across; turn – 6 sc. Work 1 row even.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across; turn – 5 sc. Work 1 row even.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across; turn – 4 sc.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in 4 sc, ch 7, sc in 4 sc of first side; turn.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in 4 sc, sc in 7 ch, sc in 4 sc; turn – 15 sc.
BACK: Work even across 15 sc until back measures 5” from back neck edge or until back measures same as front to “shoulders”. Fasten off.
SLEEVES: With right side facing, attach yarn at side in the first row end of the neck division; ch 1, work 12 sc evenly across the same row end and the next 15 rows; turn – 12 sc. Work even in sc for 1 1/2”. Fasten off. Repeat on opposite side over same row ends for second sleeve.
ADD TEAM NUMBER: With right facing and CC, work chain stitch number(s) following appropriate chart onto front of jersey with embroidery chain stitch or using crochet hook (hold hook above fabric and yarn below fabric).
FINISHING: Sew side and sleeve seams. Tack the sleeve to the side seam as shown.
Lower Edging: With right side facing, attach MC or CC at a side seam; ch 3, dc evenly around; join with a sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Neck Edging: With right side facing, attach MC or CC at back neck; ch 1, sc evenly around neck opening; join with a sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same st as join and in next st, 2 sc in next st, *sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in same st as join, sc in next 3 sts, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.

Rounds 27–31: Repeat Rounds 9–13.
Handles

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

instructions:

With A, ch 25.

Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. 
Rounds 3 and 4: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts; change to B, sc in next 3 sts; change to A, *sc in next 3 sts; change to B, sc in next 3 sts; change to A; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts; change to B, sc in next 3 sts; change to A, [sc in next 3 sts; change to B, sc in next 3 sts; change to A] twice; sc in next 3 sts; change to B, sc in next 3 sts; change to C; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 6 and 7: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts; change to A, sc in next 3 sts; change to C, *sc in next 3 sts; change to A, sc in next 3 sts; change to C; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts; change to A, sc in next 3 sts; change to C, [sc in next 3 sts; change to A, sc in next 3 sts; change to C] twice, sc in next 3 sts; change to A, sc in next 3 sts; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 9–11: Repeat Round 3. 
Rounds 12–14: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 15: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, sc2tog, *sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 16: Ch 1, sc in first st, sc2tog, *sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 17: Ch 1, sc in first st, sc2tog, [sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] twice; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc. 
Note Continue in continuous (spiral) rounds, do not join at end of round until instructed. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 18–22: Ch 1, sc in each st around.

Weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart® Celebration™: 3 balls 9340 Aqua/Silver A
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Cake Cover measures 12” (30.4 cm) tall (including ruffle).
gauge: 7 sc = 2” (5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain gauge.
instructions:
Body
With A, ch 126. 
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, join with slip st in first sc—125 sc.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around—125 sc.
Rounds 3–22: Repeat Round 2—125 sc.
Round 23: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] around—100 sc.
Round 24: Repeat Round 2—100 sc.
Round 25: [Sc in next 8 sc, sc2tog] around—90 sc.
Round 26: Repeat Round 2—90 sc.
Round 27: Repeat Round 25—81 sc.
Rounds 28–43: Repeat Round 2, fasten off at end of last round—81 sc.
Flat Circle/Body Join
With right side facing, holding last rounds of 1 Flat Circle and Body together, working through both pieces, join C with slip st in any st, reverse sc in same st as join and in each remaining st around, fasten off—81 reverse sc.
Bottom Ruffles
With right side facing, join C with slip st in any loop on opposite side of foundation of Body.
Round 1: Ch 4, (tr, ch 1, tr) in same st as beginning ch-4, (tr, ch 1, tr) in each remaining st around, fasten off.
Center Rose (Make 1)
With B, leaving a 6” (15.2 cm) tail, ch 24.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—23 sc.
Row 2: [Ch 3, skip next sc, sc in next sc] across, turn—12 ch-3 spaces.
Row 3: Ch 3, (3 dc, ch 3, slip st) in first space (petal), [ch 3, (3 dc, ch 3, slip st) in next space] across, fasten off—12 petals.
CAKE COVER
Flat Circle (Make 2)
With A, ch 5, join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1: 6 sc in ring, place marker—6 sc.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around—18 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around—18 sc.
Round 5: 2 sc in each sc around—36 sc.
Round 6: Repeat Round 4—36 sc.
Round 7: Repeat Round 3—54 sc.
Round 8: Repeat Round 4—54 sc.
Round 9: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around—63 sc.
Round 10: Repeat Round 4—63 sc.
Round 11: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around—72 sc.
Round 12: Repeat Round 4—72 sc.
Round 13: [Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around—81 sc.
Round 14: Repeat Round 4, fasten off—81 sc.
Small Rose (Make 9)
With B, leaving a 6” (15.2 cm) tail, ch 16.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—15 sc.
Row 2: [Ch 3, skip next sc, sc in next sc] across, turn—8 ch-3 spaces.
Row 3: Ch 3, (3 dc, ch 3, slip st) in first space (petal), [ch 3, (3 dc, ch 3, slip st) in next space] across, fasten off—8 petals.
Leaf (Make 5)
With C, leaving 6” (15.2 cm) tail, ch 10.
Row 1: Dc in 3rd ch from hook and in next 2 chs, sc in next 2 chs, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch, working in remaining loops across, sc in next 2 chs, dc in next 3 chs. Fasten off.
Vine
With C, ch 3.
Row 1: Hdc in 3rd ch from hook, *hdc in side bar of first hdc, repeat from * until Vine is 45” (114.3 cm) long. Fasten off.
Assembly
1. Leaving 16 sc between each point, drape and sew Vine to Round 21 of Body. (5 points) Roll 1 Small Rose and stitch in shape using 6” (15.2 cm) tail. Use remainder of tail to stitch to each point where Vine is attached to Body.
2. Stitch 1 Leaf to center of assembled Flat Circle. Roll Center Rose and stitch in shape using 6” (15.2 cm) tail. Place Center Rose over stitched Leaf, and use remainder of tail to stitch to center of Flat Circle.
3. Leaving 15 sc between each Leaf, sew remaining Leaves to Rounds 10 and 11 of same Flat Circle. Roll remaining Small Roses and stitch in shape using 6” (15.2 cm) tails. Place 1 Small Rose over stitched each Leaf, and use remainder of tail to stitch to Flat Circle.
4. Turn Cake Cover inside out. Place remaining Flat Circle against wrong side of assembled Flat Circle. Sew remaining Flat Circle in place, stuffing as you go to create a rounded top. Fasten off and weave in all ends.

With 2.75mm [C-2] hook and B, ch 4.

sc2tog = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

Round 5: Sc in each sc around—17 sc.

Round 7: Working in both loops, [6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—24 sc.
Round 8: 11 sc, 2 sc in next sc, 12 sc—25 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around—25 sc.

Round 12: [3 sc, sc2tog] 4 times, sc; ch 1, turn—17 sc.
Round 13: [Sc, sc2tog] 5 times, 2 sc—12 sc. Fasten off, weave in ends.

With 2.75mm [C-2] hook and B, ch 3.
Row 1: Work (dc, hdc, sc, dc, sc, hdc, dc) all in 3rd ch from hook, ch 2, slip st into same st as last dc—8 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
6th and 7th rnds: As 4th rnd.
8th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc. Fasten off. Stuff Head.

With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
ANTLERS (make 2).
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
LEGS (make 4).
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join MC with sl st to first sc. Break A.
3rd to 8th rnds: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off after last rnd.
TAIL (make 1).
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd to 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off after last rnd.
FINISHING
Sew Antlers and Ears to Head as shown in picture. With A, embroider eyes using French knots. With red yarn, embroider nose using Satin stitch. Sew Head, Legs and Tail to Cozy as shown in picture.

instructions:
DAISY MOTIF
With MC, ch 5. Join with sl st to form a ring.
1st rnd:Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join  A with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 7. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 5 petals.
3rd rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in missed sc in last rnd. *Ch 7. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in next missed sc in last rnd. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 5 petals. Fasten off.
Note:5 petals from 2nd rnd should alternate with 5 petals from 3rd rnd.

TEA COZY
Notes: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook. Draw loop of next color through 2 loops on hook to complete st and proceed.
Ch 2 does not count as hdc.
Stripe Pattern
Work 2 rows with MC.
Work 2 rows with A.
Work 2 rows with MC.
Work 2 rows with B.
Work 2 rows with MC.
Work 2 rows with A.
Work 2 rows with MC.
These 14 rows form Stripe Pat.
Make 2 pieces alike.
With MC, ch 37.
1st row:(WS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 35 hdc.
2nd row:Ch 2. 1 hdc in 1st hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc through back loop only. *1 hdc in next hdc through front loop only. 1 hdc in next hdc through back loop only. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
First row of Stripe Pat is complete.
Keep cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row until 14 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.
Next row: (RS). With MC, ch 1. Working through both loops, 1 sc in first hdc. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 hdc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook - sc2tog made. Rep from * to end of row. 18 sts.
Next row:Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. *Sc2tog over next 2 sts. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. 10 sts.
Rep last row once more. 6 sts. Fasten off.
Edging: With RS of work facing, join MC with sl st to top left corner. Ch 1. Work 22 sc down left side of piece to foundation ch. Fasten off.
With RS of work facing, join MC with sl st to bottom right corner. Ch 1. Work 22 sc up right side of piece. Fasten off.
Place markers on side edges 2 ins [5 cm] from top and bottom.
With WS facing of both pieces, crochet both sides tog from top edge down to marker and from bottom edge up to marker, leaving openings for handle and spout.
With RS facing, join MC with sl st to bottom edge at side seam.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Sew Daisy Motif to top of Tea Cozy as shown in picture.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: Cozy 1: 1 skein each 313 Aran A and 385 Royal B
Cozy 2: 1 skein each 356 Amethyst A and 313 Aran B
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Cozy measures 9½” (24 cm) in circumference and 3¼” (8 cm) tall.
gauge: 12 sts = 4” (10 cm); 12 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
NOTES
Row gauge is not critical. When changing colors, do not cut yarn between rounds. Instead, pull up a large loop and place it in back of work. When starting a new round, tighten the loop before making the chain 1 to begin the round.

COZY
With A, ch 28. Join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Sc in each ch around.
Round 2: Ch 1 (does not count as st here and throughout), *(sc, ch 1, sc) in next st, skip 1 st; repeat from * to end, join with a slip st to first sc – 14 [sc, ch 1, sc] groups.
Round 3: Attach B with a slip st in middle of first (sc, ch 1, sc) group, leaving A’s loop hanging in back of work (see Note); ch 1, *(sc, ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 4: Pick up A’s loop and pull through first ch-1 space; ch 1, *(sc, ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 5: Pick up B’s loop and pull through first ch-1 space; ch 1, *(sc, ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, join with a slip st to first sc.
Repeat Rounds 4-5 until cozy measures 2¾" (7 cm), ending with Round 5.

Edging
Round 1: Pick up A’s loop and pull through first sc; *sc in next sc, skip ch-1 space, sc in next sc; repeat from * to end – 28 sc. Fasten off.

FINISHING
With yarn needle, weave in loose ends.

Main Color (MC) (00225 Dark Grey Mix) 1 ball

instructions:
Note: To join new color, work to last 2 loops on hook. Draw new color through last 2 loops then proceed in new color.

With MC and larger hook, ch 24. Join in ring with sl st into first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * once. Join with sl st to first sc. 26 sc.
5th and 6th rnds: As 2nd and 3rd rnds.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * once. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join A with sl st to first sc. Break MC.
9th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * once. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
11th and 12th rnds: As 2nd and 3rd rnds, joining B with sl st at end of 12th rnd. Break A.
13th rnd: With B, ch 1. *2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. Rep from * once. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
14th rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
MUZZLE
With A and smaller hook, ch 7.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working in opposite side of ch, work 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 14 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Reverse Sc.
EARS (make 2).
With MC and smaller hook, ch 15.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 13 ch. Turn. 14 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – Sc2tog made. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Turn. 7 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Draw up a loop in each of next 3 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – Sc3tog made. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew side ends of Ears together, creating a cupped shape. Sew Ears to Cozy as shown. Lightly stuff Muzzle and sew to Cozy as shown. With red yarn, work back stitch embroidery to form a curved line for mouth. With black yarn, stitch two X stitches above mouth as shown. Sew 2 buttons to Cozy to form eyes as shown.

With Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to any sc. *Ch 3. (Yoh and draw up a 
loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice in next st. Yoh and draw 
through all loops on hook – cluster made. Ch 3. Sl st in same sp as cluster. 
Rep from * around. Fasten off.
Flower 2 
(Make 2 with E as Color 1, C as Color 2 and A as Color 3. Make 2 with F as 
Color 1, B as Color 2 and D as Color 3).
With Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to any sc. Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. 
12 sc. Fasten off.
3rd rnd: Join Color 3 with sl st to any sc. *Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. Miss next sc. Sl st in next sc. 
Ch 6. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 
Miss next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to same 
sp as first sl st.
4th rnd: Sl st in each st of outer edge of Petals around. Fasten off.
Flower 3 (Make 2 with B as Color 1 and E as Color 2. Make 2 with A as 
Color 1 and F as Color 2).
With Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten 
off. 12 sc. 
3rd rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to any sc. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc) in each sc 
around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Finishing 
Felt Front, Back, and Flowers according to “How to Felt" instructions (see 
page 3). Cut out Front and Back pieces using template. With F, sew Back 
and Front tog with blanket st, leaving openings for spout and handle. 
With F, finish spout and handle openings with blanket st. Sew 6 Flowers 
to each side of Tea Cozy.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 885 Delft Blue A, 321 Gold B, and 312 Black C.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Hug fits 4” high mug with 3” top diameter and bottom diameter.
gauge: 4 rows = 1”; 4 sts = 1”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain gauge.
instructions:
HUG
Wrap
With A, ch 14.
Row 1: Sc in second ch from hook and each remaining ch across, ch 1; turn – 13 sc.
Rows 2 – 40: Sc in each sc across, ch 1; turn. At end of Row 40, ch 10; slip st in last sc of Row 40 (button loop made). Fasten off. Sew bottom 3 sts of beginning ch to bottom 3 sts of Row 40.
Sun
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in second ch from hook – 6 sc.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] – 18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] – 24 sc.
Round 5: *Slip st in next sc, ch 4, slip st in second ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, skip next 2 sc; repeat from * around. Fasten off.
Nose
With B, ch 3; work 4 hdc in third ch from hook. Fasten off.
Sunglasses (Make 2)
With C, ch 2; work 6 sc in second ch from hook; join. Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
Using photo as a guide, fold nose in half lengthwise and sew onto sun with B. Using floss, sew sunglasses onto sun; embroider sides and middle of glasses with straight sts; embroider couched stitch smile. Using B, sew sun onto wrap. Sew button onto back of wrap. Weave in ends. This nice gift idea will brighten the day with a smiling face and let someone know you care. Crochet one for yourself too. It will keep a morning cup of coffee or tea warm while you enjoy your morning.

materials: RED HEART® Anne Geddes Baby™: 1 ball each of 100 Lily A, 203 Daffodil B, 504 Robin C, 702 Rosie D and 591 Posy E for Version 1 OR  1 ball each of 100 Lily A, 504 Robin C and 801 Bluebell F for Version 2
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook:  4mm [US G-6], 3.5mm [US E-4] and 3.25 [US D-3]
Folding fabric storage cube, 11” [28 cm] tall x 10½” [26.5 cm] wide x 10½” [26.5 cm] deep
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: 11” [28 cm] high x 10½” [26.5 cm] wide x 10½” [26.5 cm] deep
gauge: 17 sc = 4” [10cm]; 19 rows = 4” [10cm] in single crochet using 4mm [US G-6] hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
COZY
Bottom Piece
With A and 4mm [US G-6] hook, ch 4, slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3, (counts as dc here and throughout), work 11 dc in ring, slip st in top of beginning ch to join – 12 dc. 
Round 2: Ch 3, *(2 dc, tr) in next dc, (tr, 2 dc) in next dc, dc in next dc; repeat from * twice more, (2 dc, tr) in dc, (tr, 2 dc) in next dc, slip st in top of beginning ch – 28 sts.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, *(2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 5 dc; repeat from * twice more, (2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 2 dc, slip st in top of beginning ch – 44 sts.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in next 4 dc, *(2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 9 dc; repeat from * twice more, (2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 4 dc, slip st in top of beginning ch – 60 sts.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in next 6 dc, *(2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 13 dc; repeat from * twice more, (2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 6 dc, slip st in top of beginning ch – 76 sts.
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in next 8 dc, *(2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 17 dc; repeat from * twice more, (2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 8 dc, slip st in top of beginning ch – 92 sts.
Round 7: Ch 3, dc in next 10 dc, *(2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 21 dc; repeat from * twice more, (2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 10 dc, slip st in top of beginning ch – 108 sts.
Round 8: Ch 3, dc in next 12 dc, *(2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 25 dc; repeat from * twice more, (2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 12 dc, slip st in top of beginning ch – 124 sts.
Round 9: Ch 3, dc in next 14 dc, *(2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 29 dc; repeat from * twice more, (2 dc, tr) in next tr, (tr, 2 dc) in next tr, dc in next 14 dc, slip st in top of beginning ch – 140 sts.
Fasten off.
Note
Make 1 each with A and B, C, D or E as contrasting color CC for Version 1 OR make 2 each with A and C and F as contrasting color CC for Version 2.
If desired, change to smaller hook on last rows for a tighter fit.
Side Panel
With A and 4mm [US G-6] hook, ch 40.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch – 39 sts.
Rows 2-3: Change to CC, ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Rows 4-5: Change to A, ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Rows 6-55: Continue to work in sc, alternating A and CC every 2 rows, end with 2 rows of CC. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Side Panel Edging
With right side facing and 4mm [US G-6] hook, join A at side edge of Side Panel, sc 50 sts evenly spaced along edge. Fasten off. 
Repeat along opposite side edge. Repeat Edging along each side edge of each Side Panel. 
With stripes running horizontally and foundation ch of each Side Panel along edges of Bottom piece, join A at one corner, working through both layers, sc lower edge of Side Panels and Bottom piece together. Fasten off. 
For Version 2, alternate C and F Side Panels. 
With right side facing and 4mm [US G-6] hook, join A at side edge of two Side Panels, working through both layers, sc side edges together, taking care to line up stripes. Fasten off. Repeat to join all sides.
Top Edging
Round 1: With 3.5mm [US E-4] hook, join A in any st along top edge, ch 1, sc in same st and in each st around, working 1 st in each side seam, slip st in first sc to join – 160 sts.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st and in each st around.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st and in next 7 sts, sc2tog, *sc in next 8 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * 15 times, slip st in first sc – 144 sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same st and in each st around, slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
Thread a length of elastic thread around top of Cozy to pull in. Cut and knot ends.
Sew a button in each corner and in center of each side along top edge of Cozy for Pennant Bunting.
PENNANT BUNTING 
Make 8 
With 3.5mm [US E-4] hook and A, ch 24. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 23 sts. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 
Decrease Row: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 21 sts.
Next Row: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 
Repeat last 2 rows until 3 sts remain. 
Last Row: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc2tog. 
Fasten off.
Edging Round: With 3.5mm [US E-4] hook, join A in first ch along opposite edge of foundation ch, ch 8, slip st in same st for button loop, sc in each ch across, ch 8, slip st in same st for button loop, turn to work along side edge, sc 20 sts evenly spaced along edge to last st, 3 sc in point, turn to work along opposite side edge, sc 20 sts evenly spaced along opposite side edge, slip st to first st. Fasten off. 
Bunny or Bear Head 
Make 8 Bunnies or Bears; 2 each in B, C, D and E 
With 3.25 [US D-3] hook, ch 4. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in next ch, sc in last ch – 4 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, 2 sc in next 2 sts, sc in last st – 6 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in last st – 8 sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in last st – 10 sts.
Rows 5-7: Sc in each st across.
Row 8: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 8 sts.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 2 sts, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last 2 sts – 6 sts.
Row 10: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog – 4 sts.
Edging Round: Sc evenly spaced around edges to first st, slip st in first sc. Fasten off. 
Bunny Ears
Make 2 for each Bunny
With same color and 3.25 [US D-3] hook, ch 5. 
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 2 ch, 5 hdc in last ch, turn to work opposite edge of foundation ch, sc in next 3 ch, slip st to first sc to join. 
Fasten off. 
Bear Ears
Make 2 for each Bear
With same color and 3.25 [US D-3] hook, ch 2.
Round 1: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in first sc. Fasten off. 
Muzzle
Make 8
With A and 3.25 [US D-3] hook, ch 4.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next ch, 3 sc in last ch, turn to work opposite edge of foundation ch, sc in next 2 ch, slip st to first sc to join. 
Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Using black embroidery thread and following photograph, work nose on Muzzle in satin st. Sew Muzzle to Bunny or Bear face. Embroider eyes on face. Sew Ears in place.  Sew a Bunny or Bear Head in center of each Pennant. Button each Pennant on Cozy.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 1 skein each 1601 Lettuce A and 1001 White B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Bottle hugger measures 11” (28 cm) in circumference x 13¼” (33.5 cm) tall x 2¾” (7 cm) in diameter across bottom.
gauge: Rounds 1–7 = 2¾” (7 cm); 19 sts = 5” (12.cm); 18 rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain gauge.
instructions:
BOTTLE HUGGER Body
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in same st as join and in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in same st as join, sc in next st, *2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same st as join and in next st, 2 sc in next st, *sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in same st as join, sc in next 3 sts, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in same st as join and in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st, *sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, 2 sc in same st as join, sc in next 5 sts, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in back loop only of each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 9: Ch 2 (does not count as a st here or throughout), dc in same st as join and in each st around; join with slip st in first dc—42 dc.
Rounds 10 and 11: Ch 2, Fpdc around first 3 sts, Bpdc around next 3 sts, *fpdc around next 3 sts, Bpdc around next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—21 Fpdc and 21 Bpdc.
Round 12: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc.
Round 13: Repeat Round 9.
Rounds 14 and 15: Ch 2, Bpdc around first 3 sts, Fpdc around next 3 sts, *bpdc about the next 3 sts, Fpdc around next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—21 Bpdc and 21 Fpdc.
Round 16: Repeat Round 12.
Round 17: Repeat Round 9.
Rounds 18 and 19: Ch 2, skip first st, dc in next 2 sts, Fptr around skipped st, Bpdc around next 3 sts, *skip next st, dc in next 2 sts, Fptr around skipped st, Bpdc around next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—4 dc, 21 Bpdc, and 7 Fptr.
Round 20: Repeat Round 12.
Round 21: Repeat Round 9.
Rounds 22 and 23: Ch 2, Bpdc around first 3 sts, skip next st, dc in next 2 sts, Fptr around skipped st, *bpdc around next 3 sts, skip next st, dc in next 2 sts, Fptr around skipped st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—14 dc, 21 Bpdc, and 7 Fptr.
Rounds 24–31: Repeat Rounds 16–23.
Round 32: Repeat Round 12.
Rounds 33–36: Repeat Rounds 9–12.
Round 37: Repeat Round 9.
Rounds 38 and 39: Repeat Rounds 14 and 15.
Rounds 40 and 41: Repeat Round 12.
Handles
Round 42: Ch 1, sc in same st as join and in next 5 sts, ch 12, skip next 10 sts, sc in next 11 sts, ch 12, skip next 10 sts, sc in last 5 sts; join with slip st in first sc—22 sc and 2 ch-12 spaces.
Round 43: Ch 1, sc in each st and ch around; join with slip st in first sc—46 sc.
Rounds 44 and 45: Repeat Round 12.
Fasten off.
Arm (make 2)
Ch 18; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2, dc in each ch around; join with slip st in first dc—18 dc.
Rounds 2 and 3: Repeat Rounds 10 and 11 of body—9 Fpdc and 9 Bpdc.
Round 4: Repeat Round 12 of body—18 sc.
Round 5: Repeat Round 9 of body—18 dc.
Rounds 6 and 7: Repeat Rounds 22 and 23 of body—6 dc, 9 Bpdc, and 3 Fptr.
Round 8: Repeat Round 12 of body. Fasten off.
Left Hand
Row 1 (right side): With right side of last round of first arm facing, join B with sc in 3rd st at right of seam, sc in next 5 sts, turn—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 4, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, sc in each st across, turn—9 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—6 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sts, sc2tog, turn—5 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts, sc2tog, turn—4 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—3 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first st, sc2tog—2 sc. Fasten off.
Right Hand
Row 1 (right side): With wrong side of last round of 2nd arm facing, join B with sc in 3rd st at right of seam, sc in next 5 sts, turn—6 sc.
Rows 2–8: Repeat Rows 2–8 of left hand.
ASSEMBLY
Flatten arms and arrange them with thumbs up. Referring to photograph as a guide, angle arms down slightly so that hands are positioned lower on body than ends of arms. Sew hands in place approximately 6” (15 cm) from bottom of body. Wrap arms around body and sew in place on back of body.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Team Spirit™: 1 skein in color of your choice will make several cozies.
abbreviations: [] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: 1½” fit 2½”-3” diameter cans; directions for large cans to fit diameter cans and bottles.
gauge: 14 sts = 4”; 10 rows = 4” in hdc/sc pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
COZY
Bottom
Round 1: Ch 5; join with a slip st in first ch to form ring; ch 1, 7 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc – 7 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join – 14 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join – 21 sc.
Size Large Can Only-Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times; join – 28 sc.
Both Sizes-Sides
Round 1: Working in back loops only, ch 2, hdc in next sc and in each sc around; join with a slip st in top of ch-2; TURN.
Now work in both loops.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in each hdc around; join; TURN.
Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in next sc and in each sc around; join; TURN.
Repeat Rounds 2 and 3 for height desired, ending on Round 2.
Choice of Edgings
Reverse Sc: With right side facing, working from left to right, sc in each st around; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
OR
Sc Edging: With right side facing, ch 1, sc in each st around; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
