materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Contrast A Carrot (0256) 1 ball or 128 yds/117 m
Size U.S. H/8 [5 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Susan Bates® split ring stitch markers
Small quantities [5 yds (4.5 m) each] of Black (0312) and White (0311)
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only of next stitch
measurements: Approx 9½" [24 cm] wide x 4" [10 cm] tall to fit 12 oz soda can.
gauge: 12 hdc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm] with two strands of yarn. 14 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm] with one strand of yarn.
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
• Lining is worked holding 2 strands of yarn tog throughout.
• Work loosely so that inside cup has a little stretch.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
• Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as st.
Lining
With A, ch 2.
See Diagram on page 3.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join.
6th to 12th rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. Fasten off.
Ball
Notes:
• Ball is worked in continuous rnds without joining or turning. Use a st marker to mark beg of each rnd, moving up as work progresses.
• Using 1 strand of A, hold Liner with top facing and join yarn with sl st to any back loop of 12th rnd of Lining.
See Diagram on page 3.
1st rnd: *Scbl in next st. 2 scbl in next st. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 60 sc.
6th to 13th rnds: As 2nd rnd.
14th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sts.
15th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
16th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
17th rnd: As 2nd rnd. Begin stuffing to create round ball shape. Stuff firmly to define shape but do not overstuff or stretch sts (this helps prevent stuffing from showing through work). It may be helpful to place a soda can inside the Lining to hold its shape while working. Cont stuffing as you close.
18th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
Joining rnd: Place Lining inside Ball and join 18th rnd of Ball to unworked loops from 5th rnd of Lining with 1 rnd of sc, working through both thicknesses. Fasten off.
Hoop and Net
See Diagram on page 3.
With Black, ch 8. Join with sl st to form ring. Fasten off, leaving 10" [25 cm] tail for sewing.
Join White with sl st to any ch on ring.
1st rnd: Ch 4. (Skip next ch. Sl st in next ch) 3 times. Ch 4. Join with sl st to first sl st of rnd. 4 ch-4 loops.
2nd rnd: Sl st in each of first 2 ch. (Ch 4. Sl st in next loop) 3 times. Ch 4. Join with sl st to first loop.
3rd rnd: (Ch 3. Sl st in next loop) 3 times. Ch 3. Join with sl st in first loop. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
FINISHING
Use photo as a guide for finishing. With scrap yarn, outline an oval on each side of the Ball using Running Stitch.
RUNNING STITCH
BACK STITCH
With Black, embroider the oval outline using Back Stitch. Bisect each oval lengthwise with another line of back stitches. Remove scrap yarn.
With Black, embroider eyes 1/3 of the way down face, approx 3 or 4 sts apart using Satin Stitch.
With Black embroider a V-smile and eyebrows using Back Stitch as shown in photo.
Position Hoop on left side of face. With Black sew back of Hoop to Ball. Fasten off. With White, sew back of Net to Ball. Fasten off and weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball 4422 Tangerine A, small amount 4614 Black B and 4601 Off White C for Jack-O-Lantern
RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball 9522 Leaf D, small amount 4614 Black B, 9925 Really Red E and 4601 Off White C for Frankenstein
RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball 4601 Off White C and small amount 4614 Black B for Ghostie
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
measurements: Cozy stretches to fit most sizes of coffee shop cups.
gauge: 24 sts = 5” (13 cm); 17 rows = 4” (10 cm) in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With D, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc around, slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew Nose to center front of Cozy.
Ear (Make 2)
With D, ch 4.
Row 1: Work 6 dc in 4th ch from hook.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. Sew one Ear to each side of Cozy.
Eye (Make 2)
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in first sc to join.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew Eyes to front of Cozy. With C, embroider a highlight in each eye.
Mouth
With E, ch 17.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Tack chain to Cozy in a crooked “W” shape for Mouth.
Hair
Cut 1” (3 cm) lengths of B and attach to center top of Cozy. Trim to ½” (2 cm) for Hair.
Cozy
With A for Jack-O-Lantern, D for Frankenstein or C for Ghostie, ch 13.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 12 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in back loop only of each sc across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 8” (20 cm) from beginning, end with a wrong side row. Do NOT fasten off.
Joining Row: With wrong side facing and short edges aligned and working through top of last row and remaining loop of foundation ch, ch 1, slip st in each st across.
Fasten off.
Finishing
Jack-O-Lantern
Eyes (Make 2)
With B, ch 4.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in last ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew Eyes to front of Cozy. With C, embroider a small highlight in each Eye.
Mouth
With B, ch 13.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in each of next 8 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in last sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Curve Mouth into a smile and sew in place.
Mouth
With B, ch 4.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, 3 sc in next ch, turn to work along opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next ch, 2 sc in next ch, slip st to first sc to join.
Fasten off, leaving a 12” (30 cm) end long tail for sewing. Sew Mouth to Cozy centered under Eyes.
Weave in ends.

pattern_name: CROCHET FLORAL CROSS STITCH TOTE BAG
materials: Caron® Colorama™ O’Go™ (6.4 oz/180 g; 228 yds/208 m) Main Color (MC) Sticky Rice (68024) 2 O’Gos
Contrast A, B, C, D and E: Baja (68013) 1 O’Go
Size U.S. J/10 (6 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 10 sc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull tie to remove.
• Colors can be easily separated by gently pulling apart and cutting at the color transition.
• Each color is ready to use.
Side Panels (make 2 alike)
With MC, ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 7 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until 44 rows in total are complete.
Fasten off.
Bottom
With MC, ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 7 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 17" [43 cm].
Fasten off.
Bag Front and Back Panels (make 2 alike)
With MC, ch 45.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 44 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until 44 rows in total are complete.
Fasten off.
Cross Stitch Embroidery
Noting chart placement is 1 row up from bottom and 1 st in from sides, cross stitch floral motif on Front of Tote. Each square of chart equals 1 single crochet stitch.
Join Panels:
Arrange Panels to form a box, having Side Panels opposite each other. With WS of 2 Panels tog, join MC with sl st to top left corner. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work sc evenly along side edge. Fasten off.
Rep for rem Panels.
Join Bottom to Panels:
With RS of Bottom facing, place lower edge of joined Panels behind Bottom with WS of work tog, aligning corner of Bottom with joining rows of Panels. Join MC with sl st.
1st rnd: Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work sc evenly around all 4 sides of Bottom. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Straps (worked lengthwise - make 2 alike)
With MC, ch 56.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 55 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until Strap measures 2" [5 cm].
Fasten off.
Sew Straps 1" [2.5 cm] down from top edge and 3" [7.5 cm] in from sides to WS of Bag.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Main Color (MC) Soft Ecru (01004) 3 balls or 300 yds/274.5 m
Contrast A Hot Green (01712) 1 ball or 5 yds/4.5 m
Contrast B Hot Pink (01740) 1 ball or 5 yds/4.5 m

Size U.S. E/4 (3.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 18 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Sides 
With MC, ch 28.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. Turn. 27 sc.
2nd row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to 
end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg 
measures 5" [12.5 cm], ending on 
a WS row. 
Next row:  (RS). (Fold line). Ch 1. 
Working in back loops only, 1 sc in 
each sc to end of row. Turn. 
***Next row:  Ch 1. Working in both 
loops, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. 
Turn. 
Rep last row until work from last 
fold line measures 10" [25.5 cm], 
ending on a WS row.***
Next row:  (RS). (Fold line). Ch 1. 
Working in back loops only, 1 sc in 
each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Next row:  Ch 1. Working in both 
loops, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. 
Turn.
Rep last row until work from last 
fold line measures 5" [12.5 cm], 
ending on a WS row. 
Rep from *** to *** once more. 
Next row:  (RS). (Joining row). 
Place foundation ch behind last 
row with WS of work tog. Ch 1. 
Working through both thicknesses, 
1 sc in each sc across. Fasten off. 
Base 
Ch 46.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. Turn. 45 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to 
end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until work from beg 
measures 5" [12.5 cm], ending with 
a WS row. Do not fasten off. 
Join Base to Sides:  Place lower 
edge of Sides behind Base with 
WS of work tog, aligning corners 
of Base with fold lines and joining 
row of Sides. 
Next rnd:  (RS). Ch 1. Working 
through both thicknesses,  work 1 
rnd of sc around all 4 sides of Base. 
Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Fold over sides of Basket to form 
a Brim as shown in photo. Placing 
chart slightly offset from center 
(see photo), cross stitch floral motif 
on Brim of Basket.

With MC, ch 22.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream (70 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds)
Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
With MC, ch 11.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 10 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn.
Rep last row 11 times more. 34 sts at end of last row.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 11 times more.
Next row: Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. Turn.
Rep last row 11 times more, joining B at end of last row. 10 sts rem.
Next row: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. *1 dc in sc 2 rows below. Miss next sc (behind dc). 1 hdc in next sc. Rep from * to last st. 1 hdc in last st. Turn.
Next row: Sl st in each of first 5 sts. Ch 8. 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 5 ch. Sl st in next st. Sl st in each st to end of row. Fasten off.
Eyes (make 2)
With A, ch 10.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 9 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows twice more, then 2nd row once. 3 sts rem.
Next row: Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of next 3 sc. Yoh and draw through all 4 loops on hook - sc3tog made. Fasten off.
Mouth
With A, ch 29.
1st row: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. (1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Miss next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Miss next ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 3 sc in next ch) twice. Miss next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Miss next ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Miss next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 3 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Miss next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn.
Rep last row once more. Fasten off.
Edging: Join MC with sl st to last row worked in MC on left side. Ch 1. Work sc evenly around sides and bottom edge. Join with sl st to last row worked in MC on right side. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew on Mouth and Eyes as shown in picture.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream(70.9 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds)
Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 16 sc and 20 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
With A, ch 8. Join with sl st to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). (3 dc. Ch 2) in ring.
[(4 dc. Ch 2) in ring] 7 times. Join with sl st to
top of ch-3. Break A.
2nd rnd: Join B with sl st to any ch-2 sp. Ch 3.
(2 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in same sp as last sl st. Ch 1.
*(3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. Rep
from * 6 times more. Join with sl st to top of
ch-3. Break B.
3rd rnd: Join A with sl st to any ch-1 sp. Ch 1.
1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 9 dc in next ch-3 sp.
(1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 9 dc in next ch-3 sp) 
7 times. Join with sl st to first sc. Break A.
4th rnd: Join B with sl st to 5th dc of any 9-dc
group. Ch 1. 1 sc in same dc. Ch 2. 1 dc in next
sc. Ch 2. 1 sc in 5th dc of next 9-dc group. Ch 2.
*(3 tr. Ch 3. 3 tr) in next sc (corner made). Ch 2.
1 sc in 5th dc of next 9-dc group. Ch 2. 1 dc in
next sc. Ch 2. 1 sc in 5th dc of next 9 dc group.
Ch 2. Rep from * twice more. (3 tr. Ch 3. 3 tr) in
next sc. Ch 2. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in
next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc. 2 sc in next 
ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 
1 hdc in each of next 3 tr. * (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in
next ch-3 corner sp. 1 hdc in each of next 3 tr.
2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next
ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc. 2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 
1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 hdc in
each of next 3 tr. Rep from * twice more. (3 dc.
Ch 2. 3 dc) in next corner ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in each
of next 3 tr. 2 sc in next ch-2 sp. Join with sl st
to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around, having 
3 sc in each corner sp. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.

materials: Lily Sugar n’ Cream® The Original™ (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Contrast A Soft Ecru (01004) 1 ball or 35 yds/32 m
Contrast B Warm Brown (01130) 1 ball or 6 yds/5.5 m
Contrast C Jute (00082) 1 ball or 10 yds/9 m
Contrast D Wine (00015) 1 ball or 10 yds/9 m
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
DISHCLOTH
Bread (Make 2 alike).
See Diagram on page 3.
With A, ch 24
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 23 sc.
2nd to 24th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
25th row: (RS). Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in first sc. 2 tr in next sc. 1 tr in each of next 3 sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Sl st in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 tr in each of next 3 sc. 2 tr in next sc. 3 dc in last sc. 29 sts.  Fasten off. 
Crust
See Diagram on page 3.
With RS facing, join B with sl st to top of last dc.

1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp as sl st. Working down side edge, 2 sc around post of last dc at end of row. 1 sc around post of sc at end of each row to next corner. 3 sc in corner. Working into opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each ch to next corner. 3 sc in corner. Working up side edge, 1 sc around post of sc at end of each row to last row. 2 sc around post of first dc at beg of last row. Working across top of last row, 3 sc in first dc. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Spread (Make 1 each in C and D).
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
See Diagram on page 3.
Ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * twice more. 3 sc in last sc. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next sc. *3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * twice more. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 24 sc.
4th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. *3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * twice more. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 32 sc.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. *3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * twice more. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join. 40 sc.
6th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. *3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * twice more. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join. 48 sc.
7th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. *3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * twice more. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join. 56 sc.
8th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 hdc in next sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 tr in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 tr in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc.** 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join. 64 sts. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Pin pieces to measurements. Cover with a damp cloth, leaving cloth to dry. 
With Bread RS up and last row at top, place Spread centered over Bread with RS up. Using C or D to correspond with Spread, and starting in bottom right corner, sew 3 edges to Bread, leaving bottom edge open. 
Rep with rem Bread and Spread.
Weave in ends.

instructions:

5th rnd: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from 
* around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 50 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from

7th rnd: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Rep from

materials: RED HEART® Scrubby Cotton™: 1 ball each 7230 Peachy A, 7105 Loofa B, and 7942 Blissful Print C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Scrubby measures 6" wide from point to point (15 cm)
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
Notes
1. Scrubby is worked in continuous (spiral) rounds, do not join until instructed.
2. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
SCRUBBY (make 1 each with A, B, and C)
Ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker in first st. 
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around—12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—18 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—24 sc. 
Round 5: *Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—30 sc. 
Round 6: *Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—36 sc. 
Round 7: *Sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—42 sc. 
Round 8: *Sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—48 sc. 
Round 9: *Sc in next 7 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—54 sc. 
Round 10: *Sc in next 8 sts, (sc, hdc, sc) in next st; repeat from * around—66 sts. 
Round 11: Sc in next 9 sts, 3 sc in next hdc, *sc in next 10 sts, 3 sc in next hdc; repeat from * around to last st; sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc—78 sc. 
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: Lily® sugar’n cream® (70.9 g/2.5 oz; 109 m/120 yds)
main color (mc) Yellow (00010) or Hot Orange (01628) or Robin’s Egg (01215) 1 ball or 40 m/44 yds
contrast a White (00001) 1 ball or 8 m/9 yds
Size 5 mm (U.S. H/8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Length of satin ribbon 1/8" [3 mm] wide
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
note: Ch 2 at beg of each rnd does not count as dc.
With MC, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 10 dc in ring. Join with sl st to first dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dc in each of next 10 dc. Join with sl st to first dc. 20 dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dc. 30 dc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dc. 42 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dc. 54 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first dc. 66 sts.
7th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in each of next 8 dc. 1 sc in next dc. 1 sc in next dc 4 rows below. Place marker on last sc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * around, omitting sc at end of last rep. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Thread satin ribbon through all marked sc. Pull tightly and tie in a bow.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream (Solids: 2.5 oz/70.9 g/109 m/120 yds)
Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
DISHCLOTH A
Motif (make 4). 
With A, ch 3.
1st rnd: (RS). 6 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join with sl st in back loop of first hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 4. [(Yoh) twice. Draw up a loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice] twice in same sp as last sl st. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – Beg Tr Cluster made. *Ch 5. [(Yoh) twice. Draw up a loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice] 3 times in back loop of next hdc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – Tr Cluster made. Rep from * 4 times more. Ch 5. Join with sl st to top of Beg Cluster. Break A. 
3rd rnd: Join MC with sl st to any ch-5 sp. Ch 2 (does not count as st). 6 hdc in same sp as sl st. *(3 hdc. Ch 2. 3 hdc) in next ch-5 sp. 6 hdc in next ch-5 sp. Ch 2.* 6 hdc in next ch-5 sp. Rep from * to * once more. Join with sl st in first hdc. 
4th rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as st). *1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. (1 hdc. Ch 2. 1 hdc) in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * 3 times more. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off. 
Sew 4 Motifs tog into a dishcloth. 
Edging: 1st rnd: Join A with sl st to any corner. Ch 1. 5 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in each of next 11 hdc. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Draw up a loop in same ch-2 sp. Draw up a loop in next ch-2 sp. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 11 hdc.** 5 sc in corner. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st in first sc. Break A. 
2nd rnd: Join B with sl st to any corner sc. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as sl st. *(Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 14 times. Ch 1. Miss next sc.** (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in corner sc. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st to first sc. Break B. 
3rd rnd: Join A with sl st to any corner ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as sl st. 
*(Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in missed sc 1 row below) 15 times. Ch 1. Miss next sc.** (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in corner ch-1 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st to first sc. 
4th rnd: Sl st in corner ch-1 sp. Ch 4. Beg Tr Cluster in same sp as last sl st. Ch 4. Sl st in same sp as Cluster. *(1 sc next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Cluster in next ch-1 sp. Ch 4. Sl st in same sp as Cluster. Rep from * around, working 3 Clusters in corner ch-1 sps and ending with: (1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first ch of ch-4. Fasten off. 
DISHCLOTH B
With MC, ch 58.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. Turn. 57 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 27 sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 3 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc3tog made. 1 sc in each of last 27 sc. Turn. 55 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 26 sc. Sc3tog over next 3 sts. 1 sc in each of last 26 sc. Turn. 53 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 25 sc. Sc3tog over next 3 sts. 1 sc in each of last 25 sc. Turn. 51 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 24 sc. Sc3tog over next 3 sts. 1 sc in each of last 24 sc. Join A. Turn. 49 sc.
6th row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 23 sc. Sc3tog over next 3 sts. 1 sc in each of last 23 sc. Turn. 47 sc.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 22 sc. Sc3tog over next 3 sts. 1 sc in each of last 22 sc. Join MC. Turn. 45 sc.
Cont in this manner, working sc3tog at center of each row, working in stripes as follows:
8th to 11th rows: With MC.
12th and 13th rows: With A.
14th to 28th rows: With MC. 3 sc rem.
Last row: Sc3tog over 3 sc. Fasten off.
Edging: 1st rnd: Join A with sl st to any corner. Ch 1. 5 sc in same sp as sl st. (Work 27 sc evenly across to next corner. 5 sc in next corner) 3 times. Work 27 sc evenly across last side. Join with sl st to first sc. Break A.
2nd rnd: Join B with sl st to any corner sc. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as sl st. *(Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 14 times. Ch 1. Miss next sc.** (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in corner sc. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st to first sc. Break B. 
3rd rnd: Join A with sl st to any corner ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as sl st. *(Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in missed sc 1 row below) 15 times. Ch 1. Miss next sc.** (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in corner ch-1 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® Super Size™ (Solids: 4 oz/113 g; 190 yds/174 m; Ombres & Prints: 3 oz/85 g; 143 yds/131 m)

instructions:

With A, beginning at bottom Edge, ch 13.

Row 2 (Right side): Ch 1 (does not count as a stitch), sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc; turn—14 sc. 
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in each of next 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 4 sc, sc in each of next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc; turn—20 sc.

Rows 10-19: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 20: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc in each sc across to last 3 sc, sc2tog; sc in last sc; turn—30 sc.
Rows 21-25: Repeat Row 20—20 sc.
Right Top
Row 26: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc in each of next 4 sc, sc2tog, sc in next sc; turn, leaving last 10 sts unworked—8 sc. 
Row 27: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each of next 4 sc, sc2tog; turn—6 sc.
Row 28: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each of next 2 sc, sc2tog; turn—4 sc. Fasten off.
Left Top
Referring to photo for placement, join A in first unworked sc at center of Row 25. 
Row 29: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc in each of next 4 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc; turn—8 sc.
Row 30: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each of next 4 sc, sc2tog; turn—6 sc.
Row 31: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each of next 2 sc, sc2tog; turn—4 sc. (Do not fasten off.)
EDGE
With Right Side facing, ch 1, sc around outside edge of pumpkin, working sts into sides of Rows as needed to keep work flat, and working a slip st in the bottom of the top center “V.”  Fasten off yarn and weave in ends.
STEM
With B, ch 5.
Row 1: Sc in second ch from hook and each ch across; turn—4 sc.
Rows 2-3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn—4 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each of next 2 sc, 2 sc in last sc; turn—6 sc. 
Rows 5-6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn—6 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in each of next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc—8 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Referring to photo for placement, sew stem to pumpkin.

With C, ch 5.
Row 1: Sc in second ch from hook and each ch across; turn—4 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn—4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog twice; turn—2 sts. 
Row 4: Ch 1, sc2tog—1 st.
Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Referring to photo for placement, sew eyes in place with Row 4 at the top of each.
NOSE
Make nose same as eye.
Referring to photo for placement, sew nose in place with Row 1 at the top.
MOUTH
With C, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in second ch from hook and each ch across; turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each of next 3 sc, 2 sc in last sc; turn—7 sc. 
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each of next 5 sc, 2 sc in last sc; turn—9 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Referring to photo for placement, sew Mouth in place.

Weave in ends.

instructions:
USING THIS GUIDE
Click on the underlined words throughout the pattern to access our library of helpful tools.
Version I:
With MC, make a slip knot and place it on the hook.
Slip knot
Make a loop with yarn and fold it on itself to make a pretzel shape. Then draw through to make slip knot.
Chain (ch) 26.
Chain
*Yarn over hook (Yoh), draw through loop – 1 chain made. Repeat (rep) from * 25 times more – 26 chains made.
1st row:  1 single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn.
Single crochet
Insert hook into 2nd ch from hook. Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through both loops on hook – 1 sc made.
Rep last steps in each ch to end of chain - 25 sc made. Turn.
Note:  There will be 25 sc in 1st row [1st skipped ch does not count as stitch (st)].
2nd row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Repeat (Rep) last row until work from beginning (beg) measures approx 8" [20.5 cm].
Fasten off
To fasten off the yarn, cut yarn leaving a long tail. Pull end through loop on hook and pull gently to tighten.
Weave in all yarn tails.
Version II: Work as given in Version I in Stripe Pattern (Pat) as follows:
Stripe Pat:
With A:  1 row
With B:  3 rows
With A:  5 rows
With C:  3 rows
With A:  4 rows
These 16 rows form Stripe Pat.

3rd rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc. Ch 1). *Popcorn in next hdc. Ch 1. 1 dc in next hdc. Ch 1. Rep from * to last hdc. Popcorn in next hdc. Ch 1. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-4.

materials: RED HEART® Scrubby™: 1 skein each 10 Coconut A, 620 Lime B, and 905 Cherry C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Colors A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: 14 dc = 4" (10 cm); 7 dc rows = 4" (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
DISHCLOTH
With A, ch 4; slip st to first ch to join ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 15 dc in ring, slip st to first dc to join – 16 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, 4 dc in same st, dc in next 3 dc, *5 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc; repeat from * twice, slip st to first dc to join – 32 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in next dc, 5 dc in next dc, *dc in next 7 dc, 5 dc in next dc; repeat from * twice, dc in last 5 dc, slip st to first dc to join – 48 dc.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in next 3 dc, 5 dc in next dc, *dc in next 11 dc, 5 dc in next dc; repeat from * twice, dc in last 7 sts, slip st to first dc to join – 64 dc.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in next 5 dc, 5 dc in next st, *dc in next 15 dc, 5 dc in next dc; repeat from * twice, dc in last 9 dc, slip st to first dc to join – 80 dc.
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in next 7 dc, 5 dc in next st, *dc in next 19 dc, 5 dc in next dc; repeat from * twice, dc in last 11 dc, slip st to first dc to join – 96 dc.
Fasten off. Break A, leaving a 6" (15.2 cm) tail.
Wreath
With B, make an adjustable ring as follows: Wrap yarn around your finger with the yarn tail to the left and under the working yarn. Insert hook through the circle from front to back. Using the working yarn, yarn over and pull up a loop.
Round 1: Ch 4 (counts as dc + ch 1), [dc, ch 1] in ring 19 times, slip st to first dc to join round; tighten beginning yarn tail to close ring – 20 dc, 20 ch-spaces.
Round 2: Ch 4 (counts as dc + ch 1), dc in next ch-space, (dc, ch 1, dc) in each ch-space around, slip st to first dc to join round – 40 dc, 20 ch-spaces.
Fasten off. Break B, leaving a 6" (15.2 cm) tail.
Bow
With C, make an adjustable ring.
Row 1: Ch 4 (counts as tr), 2 tr in ring, ch 4 (counts as tr), slip st in ring, ch 4 (counts as tr), 2 tr in ring, ch 4 (counts as tr), slip st in ring – 8 tr.
Tighten beginning yarn tail to close adjustable ring, forming Bow.
Fasten off. Break C, leaving a 6" (15.2 cm) tail.
FINISHING
With yarn needle, weave in Bow yarn ends. Sew Bow to Wreath using the wreath’s yarn tails (or an extra length of B), securing Bow on top center of Wreath (see photo for placement).
With an extra length of A, whipstitch Wreath to center of Dishcloth. Weave in all loose ends.

instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc.

2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 20 hdc.

4th rnd:  Ch 2. 1 dcfp around first st. *1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 dcfp in next st. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st to first st. 40 sts. 
5th rnd: Ch 2. 1 dcfp around first st. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 dcfp in next st. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st to first st. 50 sts.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m) Main Color (MC) Black Currant (01318) 1 ball or 43 yds [40 m]
Contrast A White (00001) 1 ball or 9 yds [8 m]
Contrast B Black (00002) 1 ball or 10 yds [9 m]
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops
gauge: 13 hdc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rows does not count as hdc.
HEAD
With MC, ch 3.
1st row: (RS). 5 hdc in 3rd ch from hook (skipped ch-2 does not count as st). Turn. 5 hdc.
2nd row: 2 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 10 hdc.
3rd row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in first hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 4 more times. Turn. 15 hdc.
4th row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 4 more times. Turn. 20 hdc.
5th row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 4 more times. Turn. 25 hdc.
6th row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 4 more times. Turn. 30 hdc.
7th row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 4 more times. Turn. 35 hdc.
8th row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 4 more times. Turn. 40 hdc.
9th row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 4 more times. Do not turn. Do not fasten off. 45 hdc.

BODY
Note: Body is worked by crocheting into the bottom of the semi-circle of the Head.
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. Work 23 sc evenly across bottom edge of Head. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from top of Head measures approx 7 ½" [19 cm], ending on a WS row. Do not fasten off.
Next row: (RS). 1 sl st in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. *Skip next sc. 4 dc in next sc. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sl st in last sc. Fasten off.

EYEBALL
With A, ch 4.
1st rnd: 11 dc in 4th ch from hook (skipped ch-3 counts as dc). Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 12 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. 2 dc in each of next 11 dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 24 dc. Fasten off.

PUPIL
With B, ch 4.
1st rnd: 11 dc in 4th ch from hook (skipped ch-3 counts as dc). Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 12 dc. Fasten off.

HORNS (make 2)
With B, ch 7.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. 6 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. 4 sc. Turn.
3rd and 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. 2 sc. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
7th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off.

MOUTH
With B, ch 15. Fasten off.

TEETH (make 2)
With A, ch 5.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew Horns, Eyeball, Pupil, Teeth, and Mouth to Head and Body as shown in picture.

materials: RED HEART® Scrubby™: 1 ball each 938 Almond A, 934 Candy B, 510 Glacier D, 10 Coconut C and 905 Cherry D

instructions:
CONE (make 2)
With A, ch 4.
Set-Up Row (Wrong Side): Dc in 4th ch from hook.
Row 1: Ch 3 (does not count as a dc here and throughout), turn, 3 dc in dc – 3 dc.
Row 2: Ch 3, turn, dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in last st – 4 dc.
Row 3: Ch 3, turn, dc in each dc to last dc, 2 dc to last dc – 5 dc.
Repeat Row 3 four more times – 9 dc.
Fasten off.

ICE CREAM
First Scoop
With B, ch 14.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, [skip next ch, Shell in next ch, skip next ch, sc in next ch] 3 times,
turn to work along opposite side of foundation ch, ch 1, *sc in sc, sc in skipped ch, sc in Shell, sc in skipped ch; repeat from * to last st, sc in last st.
Rows 2-3: Working along straight edge only, ch 2 (does not count as a hdc here and throughout), turn, 2 hdc in first st, hdc in each st to end – 15 hdc.
Fasten off.

Second Scoop
With C, ch 16.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, [skip next ch, Shell in next ch, skip next ch, sc in next ch] 3 times, sc in last ch, turn to work along opposite side of foundation ch, ch 1, sc in sc, *sc in next sc, sc in skipped ch, sc in Shell, sc in skipped ch; repeat from * to last 2 sts, sc in last 2 sts.
Rows 2-3: Working along straight edge only, ch 2, turn, hdc2tog, hdc in each st to end – 13 hdc.
Fasten off.

Third Scoop
With D, ch 16.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, [skip next ch, Shell in next ch, skip next ch, sc in next ch] 3 times, sc in last ch, turn to work along opposite side of foundation ch, ch 1, sc in sc, *sc in next sc, sc in skipped ch, sc in Shell, sc in skipped ch; repeat from * to last 2 sts, sc in last 2 sts.
Rows 2-6: Working along straight edge only, ch 2, turn, hdc2tog, hdc in each st to last 2 sts, hdc2tog – 3 hdc.
Fasten off.

CHERRY
With D, ch 4, slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, work 10 sc in ring. Fasten off.

STEM
With A, ch 10. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew Cone pieces together. Following photo and overlapping pieces along lower scalloped edges, sew three Scoops together. Sew Ice Cream along top edge of Cone. Sew Cherry in center of top edge of Third Scoop. Fold Stem in half and sew ends to top edge of Third Scoop. Weave in ends.

next st. 1 sc in each of last 4 sts. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 112 sts. 
13th rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right,

Ears (make 2)
With A, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in 
each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working 
into opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 
2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first 
sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl 
st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 3 sc in next sc.  
1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 3 sc in last sc. Join 
with sl st to first sc.14 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 
1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 3 sc in next sc.

4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st.

1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 hdc in each

Antlers (make 2)
With C, ch 9.
1st row: Working into horizontal ‘bump’ at 
back of ch, 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc 
in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in each of next 
4 ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sl st in each of first 5 sts. 
Ch 8. Working into horizontal ‘bump’ at 
back of ch, 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc 
in each of next 6 ch. 1 sc in each of next  
5 sl sts. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sl st in each of first 7 sts.  
Ch 8. Working into horizontal ‘bump’ at 
back of ch, 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc 
in each of next 6 ch. 1 sc in each of next  
7 sl sts. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. Sl st in each of first 5 sts.  
Ch 6. Working into horizontal ‘bump’ at 
back of ch, 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc 
in each of next 4 ch. 1 sc in each of next  
5 sl sts. Sl st in next sc. Fasten off.
Nose
With B, ch 4.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc 
in next ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working into 
opposite side of ch, 1 sc in next ch. 2 sc in 
last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last  
sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 3 sc in next sc.  
1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 3 sc in last sc. Join 
with sl st to first sc.12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last

sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Nose and Ears in position as shown in 
picture. Sew Antlers in position as shown

Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in same st as join, hdc in next 4 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 4 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch— 36 hdc.
Round 5: Ch 2, hdc in same st as join, hdc in next 5 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—42 hdc.
Round 6: Ch 2, hdc in same st as join, hdc in next 6 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 6 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—48 hdc. Fasten off.
Round 7: Join B with sc in any st, sc in same st, sc in next 7 sts, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—56 sc. Fasten off.

With C, ch 2.
Row 1 (right side): Work 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, sc in last st, turn—4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, *sc in first st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * once, turn—6 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, 2 sc in next 2 sts, sc in last 2 sts, turn—8 sc.

Row 7: Ch 1, skip first st, sc in next st, [sc2tog] 3 times—4 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Stem
With D, ch 6.

Referring to photograph as a guide, sew stem and leaf to top of apple. With D, embroider seeds ½" (1.5 cm) in length in center of apple, working 2 straight stitches in the same place for each seed. instructions:

Ch 35.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. *Scbp around next dc. Scfp around next dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each st to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. *Scfp around next dc. Scbp around next dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
5th row: As 3rd row.
Rep 2nd to 5th rows until work from beg measures 9" [23 cm]. Rep 2nd row once more. Do not fasten off. Cont as follows for edging:
Edging: (RS). Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around outer edge, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Subtle Bobble Version (B)
Ch 32.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 31 sc.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
4th and 5th rows: Rep 2nd and 3rd rows.
6th row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. *MB. 1 dc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
Rep 3rd to 6th rows until work from beg measures approx 8" [20.5 cm], ending on a 5th row. Do not fasten off. Cont as follows for edging:
Edging: (RS). Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around outer edge, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
“V” Cluster Version (C)
Ch 33. 
1st row: (RS). 2 dc in 5th ch from hook. *Miss next ch. 2 dc in next ch. Rep from * to last 2 ch. Miss next ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. 29 sts.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). *2 dc between next 2 dc cluster. Rep from * across, ending with 1 dc in top of ch 3. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 8" [20.5 cm], ending on a RS row. Do not fasten off. Cont as follows for edging:
Edging: Ch 4. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook. *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook-picot made. Rep from * around outer edge, working (Picot. 1 sc. Picot) in each corner. Join with sl st to base of ch 4. Fasten off.

() = work directions in parentheses into same st
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated

instructions:
SCRUBBY (make 2: 1 each with A & C and B & C)
First Pad
With first color, ch 2 loosely.
Round 1 (wrong side): (3 sc, 3 hdc, 3 sc, 3 hdc) in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc, turn—6 sc and 6 hdc.
Round 2 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), hdc in first hdc, 2 hdc in each of next 2 hdc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 hdc in each of next 3 hdc, sc in last 3 sc; join with slip st in top of beginning ch, turn—6 sc and 12 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc in next 2 sts, *2 dc in each of next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts, 2 dc in each of next 2 sts*, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * to * once; join with slip st in first sc, turn—6 sc and 20 dc.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in first dc, 2 hdc in next 9 sts, sc in next 3 sts, 2 hdc in next 10 sts, sc in last 3 sts; join with slip st in top of beginning ch, turn—6 sc and 40 hdc.
Fasten off.
Second Pad
Work same as first pad; at end of Round 4, change to C, do not turn or fasten off.
Joining Round (right side): Hold both pads with wrong sides together and sts matching, working through both thicknesses, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc, turn. Do not fasten off.
Hand Strap
Row 1: Ch 1, hdc in first 3 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—3 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 1, hdc in each st across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until strap fits snugly but comfortably across back of hand.
Last Row: Match sts in last row of strap to 3 sts of Joining Round on opposite side of pads (these Joining Round sts were worked into sc sts of Round 4 of pads); working through both thicknesses, slip st in the 3 sts. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

instructions:
SPECIAL STITCHES
Bpdc (back post double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from back side of work to front and to back again around the post of indicated stitch; yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), yarn over and draw through 2 loops (2 loops on hook), yarn over and draw through 2 loops (1 loop on hook). Skip the stitch "in front of" the Bpdc.
Fpdc (front post double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from front side of work to back and to front again around post of indicated stitch; yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), yarn over and draw through 2 loops (2 loops on hook), yarn over and draw through 2 loops (1 loop on hook).
sc2tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

NOTES
1. Scrubby is worked in joined rounds with right side facing at all times.
2. When instructed to work into a stitch "2 rounds below", work into the round numbered 2 less than the current row. For example, if you are working Round 14, a stitch "2 rounds below" is in Row 14 – 2 = Round 12.

SCRUBBY
Ch 17.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; taking care not to twist, join with slip st in first sc—16 sts.
Round 2: Ch 2 (does not count as a st here or throughout), hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first hdc.
Round 3: Ch 2, Fpdc around first st, Bpdc around next st, *Fpdc around next st, Bpdc around next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc.
Round 4: Ch 2, Bpdc around first st, Fpdc around next st, *Bpdc around next st, Fpdc around next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc.
Rounds 5-12: Repeat Rounds 3 and 4.
Round 13: (Ch 6, slip st) around post of each st around; join with slip st in first slip st.
Round 14: Ch 2, hdc in each slip st; join with slip st in first hdc.
Rounds 15–18: Repeat Rounds 13 and 14 twice.
Round 19: Repeat Round 13.
Round 20: Ch 1, sc in each slip st; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 21 and 22: Ch 1, [sc2tog] around; join with slip st in first sc—4 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
Weave tail through last round, pull tightly to close and secure. Sew first and last st of Round 1 together with beginning tail. Weave in ends. Slide open end over handle of large spoon or kitchen utensil.

Special Stitches
Cl (2 treble crochet cluster) = *[Yarn over] twice, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice; repeat from * once more, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Bpdc (back post double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from back side of work to front and to back again around the post of indicated stitch; yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice. Skip the stitch “in front of” the Bpdc.
Special Technique
Join with Bpdc (join with back post double crochet) = Place slip knot on hook, yarn over, insert hook from back side of work to front and to back again around the post of indicated stitch; yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice. Skip the stitch “in front of” the Bpdc.

Color Sequence for Ornament #2: Work 1 round each with C, A, C, B, A, and C.

Round 6: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next st, [2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st] 10 times, dc in next st, tr in next st, Cl in each of next 2 sts, tr in next st, dc in next st, [2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st] 10 times; join with slip st in 2nd ch of beginning ch—69 sts.

Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Scrubby™: 1 ball each 870 Royal A, 10 Coconut B, and 905 Cherry C

gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
SCRUBBY
Upper Body
With A, ch 14.
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—13 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st across to last sc, 2 sc in last st, turn—19 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Rows 6–9: Repeat Row 5; change to B at end of Row 9.
Rows 10–12: Repeat Row 5; change to C at end of Row 12.
Rows 13–16: Repeat Row 5.
Trunk
Row 17: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—3 sc.
Row 18: Repeat Row 5.
Row 19: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc2tog, turn.
Row 20: Ch 1, sc2tog, 3 sc in last st, turn—4 sc.
Row 21: Ch 1, 3 sc in first st, slip st in last 2 sts. Fasten off.
Lower Body 
Row 1 (wrong side): With wrong side of upper body facing, skip first st, join C with sc in next st, sc in each remaining st across, turn—15 sc. Do not fasten off.
Back leg
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in first 4 st, turn—4 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Fasten off.
Front leg 
Row 1: With right side of Row 1 of lower body facing, skip first 7 sts, join C with sc in next st, sc in last 3 sts, turn—4 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. 
Fasten off.
Edging 
With right side facing, join A with slip st in 7th st of Row 1 of upper body, ch 10, slip st in same st (hanging loop made), sc evenly around, working 3 sc in outer corners of legs and trunk; join with slip st in first slip st. 
Fasten off.

With B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook, do not join—5 sc.
Round 2: *Slip st in next sc, ch 2, sc in 2nd ch from hook; repeat from * 4 times, join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Weave in ends.
With sewing needle and white thread, sew stars in place on upper body.

Square (make 2)

Row 1: Ch 2 (does not count as stitch here and throughout), turn, hdc in first st, Fpdc, *Bpdc, Fpdc; repeat from * to last st, hdc in last st.
Row 2: Ch 2, turn, hdc in first st, Bpdc, *Fpdc, Bpdc; repeat from * to last st, hdc in last st. 
Repeat Rows 1-2 once more, then Row 1 once. Fasten off.
PIE 
With B, ch 22.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, [skip next ch, Shell in next ch, skip next ch, sc in next ch] 5 times, turn to work along opposite side of foundation ch, ch 1, *sc in next sc, sc in skipped ch, sc in Shell, sc in skipped ch; repeat from * to last st, sc in last st. 
Rows 2-3: Working along straight edge only, ch 2, turn, hdc in each st to end – 21 hdc. 
Row 4: Ch 2, turn, [hdc2tog] twice, hdc in each st to last 4 sts, [hdc2tog] twice – 17 hdc.
Row 5: Ch 2, turn, hdc2tog, *hdc in next st, hdc2tog; repeat from * to end – 11 hdc.
Row 6: Ch 2, turn, [hdc2tog] twice, hdc in next 2 sts, [hdc2tog] twice, hdc in last st – 7 hdc.
Row 7: Ch 2, turn, [hdc2tog] twice, hdc in next st, hdc2tog – 4 hdc. Fasten off. 
CREAM TOP
With C, ch 14.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, [skip next ch, Shell in next ch, skip next ch, sc in next ch] 3 times, turn to work along opposite side of foundation ch, ch 1,*sc in sc, sc in skipped ch, sc in Shell, sc in skipped ch; repeat from * to last st, sc in sc.
Row 2: Working along straight edge only, ch 2, turn, [hdc2tog] 3 times, hdc in next st, [hdc2tog] 3 times – 7 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 2, turn, [hdc2tog] twice, hdc in next st, hdc2tog – 4 hdc. Fasten off.  
CHERRY
With D, ch 4, slip st in first ch to form a ring. 
Round 1: Ch 1, work 10 sc in ring. Fasten off. 
STEM
With A, ch 10. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Sew lower scalloped edge of Pie along last row of Crust.
With scalloped edge as lower edge, sew Cream centered along top edge of Pie. Sew Cherry in center of top edge of Cream. Fold Stem in half and sew ends to top edge of Cream. 
Weave in ends.

Row 3: Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each st across – 21 sc.
Row 4: Ch 2 (does not count as a st), turn, hdc in each st across, changing to A in last st. 
Row 5: Ch 3 (does not count as a st), turn, working in back loops only, dc in each st across.
Repeat Rows 2-5 three more times.
Border 
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, turn to right side ready to work around edges, working over carried yarns to hide, sc evenly spaced around, working (sc, ch 1, sc) in each corner, slip st in first sc. 
Fasten off.
Round 2: Working through back loops only, join B in any sc with a slip st, slip st in each st around, working sc in each corner ch-1 space, slip st in first st. 
Fasten off.
FINISHIING
Weave in ends.

instructions:
With C, ch 32.

Row 2: Ch 1, turn, skip first sc, *sc in ch-1 space, ch 1, skip next sc; repeat from *, end sc in beginning ch-1.
Rows 3-29: Repeat Row 2. Do not fasten off.

instructions:
DISHCLOTH
With MC, ch 30. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 29 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 tr in next sc (push tr post to RS of work). 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.  
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. 1 tr in next sc (push tr post to RS of work). Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
Rep 2nd to 5th rows until work from beg measures 8 ins [20.5 cm], ending with 3rd or 5th row. Fasten off. 
Edging: 1st rnd: Join A with sl st to any corner. Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp as sl st. *Work 29 sc to next corner. 3 sc in corner. Rep from * twice more. Work 29 sc to next corner. Join with sl st in first sc. Break A. 
2nd rnd: Join C with sl st to any corner sc. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as sl st. *(Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 14 times. Ch 1. Miss next sc.** (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in corner sc. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st to first sc. Break C. 
3rd rnd: Join B with sl st to any corner ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as sl st. *(Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in missed sc 1 row below) 15 times. Ch 1. Miss next sc.** (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in corner ch-1 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st to first sc. 
4th rnd: Sl st in corner ch-1 sp. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 6 dc in same sp as last sl st. *Miss next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Miss next ch-1 sp and sc. 5 dc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, working 7 dc in corner ch-1 sp and ending with: miss next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Miss next ch-1 sp and sc. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off. 
Pot Holder
Front and Back: (make alike).
With C, ch 41. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch end of ch. 40 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
Rep 2nd row 39 times more. Fasten off.
Edging: 1st rnd: Working through both thicknesses and with Front facing, join B with sl st in bottom left corner. Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around outer edges to join pieces, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Pansy 
With D, ch 4. Join with sl st to form a ring. 
1st rnd:Ch 1. (2 sc in ring. Ch 2) twice. (2 sc in ring. Ch 5) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. Break D.
2nd rnd:Join Color 2 with sl st to first ch-2 sp. Ch 2. (2 hdc. Ch 3. 1 sl st in first ch – Picot made. 2 hdc) all in same ch-2 sp. Miss next sc. Sl st in next sc. (2 hdc. Picot. 2 hdc) all in next ch-2 sp. [Miss next sc. Sl st in next sc. (1 hdc. 9 dc. 1 hdc) all in next ch-5 sp] 3 times. Miss next sc. Sl st in next sc. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. Fasten off.
Leaf: (make 2). With E, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 5 dc in last ch. Working into opposite side of ch into rem loops, 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Make 2 Pansies: 1 With A and 1 with B. 
Sew 2 Pansies and 2 Leaves in corner of Pot Holder (see picture).

instructions:

1st rnd: Join yarn with sl st to top of ch-3 of Fourth Ring. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st (corner made). Ch 8. Miss next 9 dc. materials: RED HEART® Scrubby™: 1 ball each 905 Cherry A and 709 Bubblegum B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B

measurements: Scrubby measures 9” wide x 8½” long (23 x 21.5 cm).
gauge: Gauge is not critical with this project.
instructions:
SCRUBBY
With A, ch 4.
Row 1 (right side): Work 5 dc in 4th ch from hook (beginning ch count as first dc), turn—6 dc.
Rows 2–10: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in first dc (same as base of beginning ch-3), dc in each st across to beginning ch, 2 dc in top of beginning ch, turn—24 dc.
Row 11: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
First Lobe
Row 12: Ch 3, dc in next 11 dc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—12 dc.
Rows 13–15: Ch 3, dc2tog, dc in each st to last 3 sts, dc2tog, dc in top of beginning ch, turn—6 dc.
Fasten off.
2nd Lobe
Row 12 (wrong side): With wrong side facing, skip first unworked st, join A with slip st in next unworked st, ch 3, dc in each remaining st across, turn—12 dc.
Rows 13–15: Repeat Rounds 13–15 of first lobe. Do not fasten off at end of last round.
Edging
Round 1: Ch 1, working in ends of rows, sts, and opposite side of foundation ch, sc evenly spaced around, adding sc as needed to keep piece flat and working 3 sc in foundation ch (base of 6 dc of Row 1); join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join B with sc in center st of 3-sc group at bottom of piece, *ch 2, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, adding sc as need to keep piece flat; join with slip st in first sc. Do not turn.
Round 3: Ch 1, (sc, ch 3, sc) in each ch-2 space around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

Weave in ends.

Stripe Pat
With A, work 2 rows.

DISHCLOTH
With A, ch 26. See diagram on page 2.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *Skip next 2 ch. 5 dc in next ch. Skip next 2 ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in same sc as ch-3. *Skip next 2 dc. 1 sc in next dc. Skip next 2 dc. 5 dc in next sc. Rep from * to last 6 sts. Skip next 2 dc. 1 sc in next dc. Skip next 2 dc. 3 dc in last sc. Join B. Turn.

With A, ch 3.

Round 6: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, hdc2tog, hdc in next 2 hdc, 2 dc in next 6 hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc, hdc2tog; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—15 sc, 30 hdc, and 60 dc.

Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Scrubby Sparkle™: 1 ball each 8215 Lemon A, 8012 Licorice B, and 8001 Marshmallow C
measurements: Mitt measures 9" in circumference x 8" long (23 x 20.5 cm).
gauge: six 3-dc groups = 4" (10 cm); 16 rows = 4" (10 cm). Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
MITT
With A, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 hdc in ring; join with slip st in first hdc—12 hdc.
Round 2: Working in spaces between sts, 2 hdc in space between last and first st and in each remaining space around; join with slip st in first hdc—twelve 2-hdc groups.
Round 3: Working in spaces between 2-hdc groups, ch 1, 3 hdc in space beneath join and in each remaining space around; join with slip st in first hdc—twelve 3-hdc groups.
Round 4: Working in spaces between 3-hdc groups, ch 1, 3 hdc in space beneath join and in each remaining space around; join with slip st in first hdc.
Rounds 5–14: Repeat Round 4.
Fasten off. Place marker on Round 6 for placement of eyes.
Round 15: Join B with slip st in any space between 3-hdc groups, ch 1, 3 hdc in same space and in each space around; join with slip st in first hdc.
Round 16: Repeat Round 4. Fasten off.
Rounds 17 and 18: With A, repeat Rounds 15 and 16.
Rounds 19 and 20: Repeat Rounds 15 and 16.
Rounds 21 and 22: Repeat Rounds 17 and 18.
Rounds 23 and 24: Repeat Rounds 15 and 16.
Wing (make 2)
With C, ch 11.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 2 ch, hdc in next ch, 2 sc in last ch; working on opposite side of foundation ch, sc in first 3 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 2 ch, sc in last 3 ch. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Refer to photograph as a guide for placement of all pieces.
Eye (work twice)
Flatten mitt and determine front of piece. Leaving a 3" (7.5 cm) tail, join B with slip st in any space between 3-hdc groups of marked round, ch 1, bobble in same space. Fasten off, leaving a 3" (7.5 cm) tail.
Skip space and repeat for 2nd eye in next space.
Smile
With B, ch 13. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Curve smile under eyes where desired and sew in place.
Center wings on Round 13, 3 hdc apart. Sew in place and weave in remaining tails through each wing.
Insert hook in mitt and draw all tails to wrong side. Turn mitt inside out. Tie tails of each eye together with overhand knot.
Weave in all ends.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)

instructions:
Peach
Note: Ch 3 at beg of rnd or row counts as dc. With MC, ch 4. Join with sl st to form ring.

(2 tr in next sc. 1 tr in each of next 5 sc) twice. 2 tr in next sc. 1 tr in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Break MC. Do not turn. 26 sts.
Edging: Join A with sl st to 7th sc of 6th rnd. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. Working across side of Peach: (1 sc in each of next 6 sts. 2 sc in next st) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 5 sts. 1 sc in next sc of 6th rnd. Sl st in next sc. Fasten off.

1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 1 tr in each of next 5 ch. 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working across opposite side of ch, 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 1 tr in each of next 5 ch. 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Scrubby™: 1 ball each 10 Coconut A, 215 Bamboo B, 905 Cherry C, and 715 Primrose D

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Mitt measures 5½” (14 cm) across face x 8½” (21.5 cm) long, excluding hanging loop.
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
Ribbed Cuff
With A, ch 8.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—7 sc.
Rows 2–16: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Beard
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, working in ends of rows, sc in each row across, turn—16 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc, turn—18 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Repeat Row 3 until piece measures 3½” (9 cm) from bottom edge of ribbed cuff; change to B at end of last row.
Face
Repeat Row 3 until piece measures 4¾” (12 cm) from bottom edge of ribbed cuff; change to A at end of last row.
Repeat Row 3 three times; leaving a long beginning tail for sewing, change to C at end of last row.
Hat
Rows 1 and 2: Repeat Row 3 of beard.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—16 sc.
Row 4: Repeat Row 3 of beard.
Rows 5–12: Repeat last 2 rows 4 times—8 sc at end of Row 12.
Rows 13 and 14: Ch 1, [sc2tog] across, turn—2 sc at end of Row 14.
Fasten off.
BACK
Work same as front, omitting all color changes except C for hat.
Mustache
With A, ch 10. 
Row 1 (right side): Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, 3 dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, slip st in next ch, hdc in next ch, 3 dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, slip st in last ch. 
Fasten off.
Nose
With D, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Hanging Loop
With A, ch 10; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING
Refer to photograph as a guide for placement of facial features. 
With sewing needle and thread, sew mustache to center of face above beard and sew nose to head above mustache. 
With black yarn, embroider satin stitch eye on each side of nose on face.
Taking care to match colors and leaving bottom edge open for wearer’s hand, sew front and back together with A-colored across side edges of cuff, beard, and face and with C-colored tails across side edges of hat.
With end tail, sew hanging loop to top point of hat. 
Weave in ends.

Row 3: (Ch 3, 2 tr, ch 3, slip st) all in joining st for Petal, sc in next st, [(slip st, ch 3, 2 tr, ch 3, slip st) all in next st for Petal, sc in next st] 5 times, slip st in beginning joining st – 6 Petals. Fasten off.

Row 1: Ch 2, * dc in next 3 sts, ch1, skip next ch1sp, rep from * to last 3 sts, dc in last 3 sts, turn. Row 2: Ch 2, * dc in first st, ch1, skip next st, dc in next st, 1 long dc (insert hook in ch1sp 2 rows below), rep from * to last 3 sts, dc in next st, ch1, skip next st, dc in last st, turn. Row 3: Ch2, dc in first st, * ch1, skip next sp, dc in next 3 sts, rep from * to last 2 sts, ch1, skip next sp, dc in last st, turn. Row 4: Ch2, * dc in first st, 1 long dc over next sp, dc in next st, ch1, skip next st, rep from * to last 3 sts, dc in next st, 1 long dc over next sp, dc in last st, turn. Rep rows 1 - 4 until work measures 11 in., [28 cm] from beg. Fasten off. EDGING: Work 1 rnd sc evenly around entire outer edge, working 3 sc in each corner, sl st in first st. Next rnd: Ch 2, dc in each st, working 3 dc in each corner st, sl st in top of turning ch. Fasten off.

abbreviations: sc2tog: [Draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
dc2tog: [Yarn over, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] 2 times, yarn over, draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
Beginning at center, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 5 sc. Join to work in continuous rounds. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around – 10 sc.
Round 3: (Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc) around – 15 sc.
Round 4: (Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc) around – 20 sc.
Round 5: (Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc) around – 25 sc.
Round 6: (Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc) around – 30 sc.
Round 7: (Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc) around – 35 sc. Do not fasten off.
Shape First Leg
Row 1: Sc in next 7 sc, leave remaining sts unworked – 7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 3 sc, 2 dc in next sc, sc in last 3 sc – 8 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 3 sc, dc2tog, sc in last 3 sc – 7 sts.
Rows 4-5: Repeat Rows 2-3.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc next sc, 2 dc in next st, sc in next sc, sc2tog – 6 sts.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 2 sc, dc2tog, sc in next 2 sc – 5 sts.
Row 8: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, 2 dc in next st, sc2tog – 4 sts.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, sc in next sc, dc2tog, sc in next sc – 3 sts.
Row 10: Ch 1, turn, draw up loop in each of 3 sts, yo and pull through all loops. Fasten off.
Shape Remaining Legs
Join yarn with a sc in next unworked sc along Round 7, sc in next 6 sc – 7 sc.
Repeat Rows 2-10 of First Leg four more times. Do not fasten off on last leg.
Edging
Round 1: Sc evenly spaced around Starfish, working 3 sc in tip of each Leg and sc2tog in between each Leg, slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.
Abbreviations
ch = chain; cm = centimeters; dc = double crochet; mm = millimeters; sc = single crochet; st(s) = stitch(es); tog = together; yo = yarn over; ( ) = work directions in parenthesis the number of times specified.

instructions:
SCRUBBY
With A, ch 22.

SHAMROCK
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not turn; join to work in continuous rounds. Place marker for beginning of Round.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.

1st Clover Leaf
Row 1: Sc in next 4 sc, leave remaining sts unworked; turn—4 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; turn—6 sc.
Rows 3-4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first sc, (hdc, dc, hdc) in next sc, slip st in next 2 sc, (hdc, dc, hdc) in next sc, sc in last sc—10 sts. Fasten off and weave in ends.

2nd and 3rd Clover Leaves
Join B in next unworked sc along Round 2 of Shamrock.
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in next 4 sc, leave remaining sts unworked; turn—4 sc.

Stem
With B, ch 9; turn.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across—8 sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail. Attach between 1st and 3rd Clover Leaves.

Referring to photo for placement, with B, sew Shamrock to Scrubby.

instructions:
BEET
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of each rnd counts as dc.
• Join end of each rnd with sl st in 3rd ch of first ch-3.
With A, ch 8. See diagram on page 2.
**1st rnd: 2 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 3 dc). 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 6 dc in last ch. Rotate work to cont working along opposite side of foundation ch: skip 1st ch (ch just worked into). 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 3 dc in last ch. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. 18 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same st as last sl st. 2 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in each of next 6 dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in each of last 3 dc. Join. 30 dc.**
Fasten off.
3rd rnd: Skip first 8 dc. Re-join A with sl st in 9th dc. Ch 3. *(1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc) 6 times. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * once more, ending with 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Join. 42 dc.
4th rnd: Ch 3. *(1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc) 6 times. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * once more, ending with 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Join. 54 dc.
5th rnd: Ch 3. *(1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in next dc) 6 times. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * once more ending with 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Join. 66 dc.
Fasten off.
Cont in rows as follows:
1st row: (RS). Skip first 15 sts. Join B with sl st in 16th st. Ch 1. Skip first st. (1 sc in each of next 4 dc. 2 sc in next dc) twice. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. (2 sc in next dc. 1 sc in each of next 4 dc) twice. Sl st in next sc. Fasten off leaving rem sts unworked. Do not Turn. 39 sts.
2nd row: (RS). Skip first 17 dc of last row. Re-join B with sl st in 18th dc. Ch 2. Skip first st. Dc3tog. Ch 2. Sl st in next st. Fasten off.
LEAVES (Make 1 each in C and D)
Ch 8.
1st and 2nd rnds: Rep from ** to ** as for Beet.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. 2 dc in next dc. (1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc) twice. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. (1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc) 3 times. Fasten off, leaving rem sts unworked.

Overlap and sew Leaves to top of Beet as shown in photo.

materials: RED HEART® Scrubby™: 1 ball each 510 Glacier A, 905 Cherry B, and 10 Coconut C
Yarn needle, 2 yds black worsted weight yarn, sewing needle and white carpet thread
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Puppet measures 12” (30.5 cm) from tip of nose to end of tail.
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
PUPPET
Top of Body 
Beginning at tip of nose, with A, ch 4.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn—5 sc.
Rows 3 and 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn—9 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 4 sc, turn—8 sc and one 3-sc group.
Rows 6–8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across to center st of 3-sc group, 3 sc in center st, sc in each remaining sc—14 sc and one 3-sc group.
Rows 9–25: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Piece should measure about 6½” (16.5 cm) long.
Row 26: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc in each sc across to last 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc, turn—15 sc.
Rows 27 and 28: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 29–31: Repeat Row 26—9 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Bottom of Body
Front Section 
Work same as Rows 1–19 of Top of Body. 
Fasten off. Piece should measure about 4½” (11.5 cm) long.
Back Section 
With A, ch 18.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—17 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 6–11: Repeat Rows 26–31 of Top of Body.
Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
Place Top of Body on a flat surface. Place Back Section of Bottom of Body on Top of Body, matching last row of each section. Sew side edges together. Lay Front Section of Bottom of Body on Top of Body, placing last row of Front Section against first row of Back Section (Front Section will be shorter than Top of Body). Beginning at Row 19 of Front Section and working towards front of puppet, sew edges of Rows 19–15 of Front Section to Top of Body on each side of puppet, leaving remaining rows unsewn for Mouth. Leave last row of Front Section and first row of Back Section unsewn for hand opening.
Mouth
Top  
With B, ch 4.
Rows 1–4: Work same as Rows 1–4 of Top of Body—9 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 6 and 7: Work same as Rows 6 and 7 of Top of Body—13 sc.
Rows 8–16: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Bottom 
Work same as Rows 1–11 of Top of Mouth. 
Fasten off.
Sew Row 16 of Top and Row 11 of Bottom together.
Teeth
Holding Mouth open flat with right side facing and working in ends of rows, join C with slip st in any row, *ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in next 4 rows; repeat from * around, easing to fit as needed; join with slip st in first slip st. Pin Mouth to Top of Body and Front Section of Bottom of Body. With carpet thread, sew in place.
Tail (make 2)
With A, ch 10.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—9 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across to last sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—13 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; leave remaining 7 sc unworked, turn—8 sc.
Upper fin
Rows 6 and 7: Repeat Row 4—8 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—6 sc.
Row 9: Repeat Row 4.
Row 10: Repeat Row 8—4 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice, turn—2 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc2tog¬—1 sc. Fasten off.
Lower fin
Row 6: With right side of Row 5 facing, skip first unworked sc, join A with sc in next sc, sc in same sc, sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—8 sc.
Rows 7–12: Repeat Rows 7–12 of first half. 
With wrong sides together, sew Tails together around outer edges. Holding puppet flat on its side, sew Row 1 edges to back of piece.
Top Fin (make 2) 
Beginning at bottom edge, with A, ch 8.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across to last sc, 2 sc in last st, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn.
Row 5: Repeat Row 3.
Row 6: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] twice, turn—6 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, skip first sc, [sc2tog] twice, 2 sc in last sc—4 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Sew Top Fins together, then sew piece to top of puppet.
Bottom Fin
With A, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—5 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Work same as Rows 3 and 4 of Top Fin.
Row 4: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice, 2 sc in last sc—4 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Sew Bottom Fin to Back Section of Bottom of Body.
FINISHING
With black yarn, embroider satin stitches for eyes.
Weave in ends.

2nd rnd: With B, ch 1. Work 1 sc in each sc around working 3 sc in each corner sc. Join A with sl st to first sc. Break B.
3rd rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Miss next sc. (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next sc. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around to last 3 sc. Miss next sc. (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next sc. Miss last sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 5 (counts as dc and ch 2). *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 2. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 2. Rep from * around working (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 dc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in each corner ch-1 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 5. Fasten off.
Loop: With Back facing, join B with sl st to 2nd rnd of Edging in top right corner. Ch 12. Join with sl st in same sp. Fasten off.

instructions:
With A, ch 8. Join with sl st to form ring.

2nd rnd: With B, ch 4 (counts as tr). 1 tr in same sp as sl st. 2 tr in each sc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 4. 32 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 4 (counts as tr). (Yoh) twice and draw up a loop in same sp as last sl st. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. *(Yoh) twice and draw up a loop in next tr. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Rep from * once more. Yoh and draw through all 4 loops on hook – counts as cluster. **Ch 3. (Yoh) twice and draw up a loop in same sp as last tr.
