gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm)]. Motif = 5" [12.5 cm] from point to point.
instructions:
Motif (Make 5 with A as Color 1 and 4 each with B, C and D as Color 1)
With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in ring. Ch 1. (3 dc in ring. Ch 1) 5 times. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
2nd rnd: Sl st in each of next 2 dc and ch-1 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in same sp as last sl st. Ch 1. [(3 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1] 5 times. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.
3rd rnd: Join MC with sl st to any ch-1 corner sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. 2 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.
Finishing
Sew Motifs tog as shown in diagram on page 2, matching A side with A side, B side with B side, etc.
Hanging Loop
Holding 1 strand each of MC, A, B, C and D tog, join with sl st to top Left of stocking. Ch 15. Join with sl st to same sp as first sl st. Fasten off.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (Ombres: 2 oz/56.7 g; 95 yds /86 m)
Batik Ombre (02446) 4 balls or 300 yds [274.5 m]
Size U.S H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: To fit/carry approx 8 -10" [20.5-25.5 cm] square baking dishes.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Main Section
Ring Tab
Ch 7.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 6 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 3" [7.5 cm], ending on a WS row. Do not fasten off. Cont as follows for Top Flap:
Top Flap
1st row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 8 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows until there are 28 sc, ending on a WS row and placing markers at each end of last row. Cont as follows for Bottom:
Bottom
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until piece measures 13" [33 cm] from marked row, ending on a WS row.
Place markers on sides of Bottom 2½" [6.5 cm] and 10½" [26.5 cm] from marked row for Sides.
Cont as follows for Bottom Flap:
Bottom Flap
1st row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 26 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows until there are 6 sts, ending on a WS row.
Cont as follows for Handle:
Handle
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn 6 sc.
Rep last row until Handle measures 10" [25.5 cm] from last dec row, ending on a WS row. Fasten off.
Sides and Flaps (to be completed on sides of Bottom between markers)
**With RS facing, join yarn with sl st at first marker on side of Bottom.
1st row: Ch 1. Work 28 sc evenly across side of Bottom to next marker. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 2½" [6.5 cm].
1st row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 26 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows until there are 6 sts, ending on a WS row and placing markers at each end of last row.
Ring Tab
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn 6 sc.
Rep last row until piece measures 3" [7.5 cm] from marked row. Fasten off.**
Rep from ** to ** on opposite side of Bottom.
FINISHING
Fold Ring Tabs over and sew metal rings in position as shown in picture. Fold Handle and sew in position as shown in picture.

materials: RED HEART® Crochet Nylon™, 100% Nylon Size 18: 1 ball 40 Grey
½” (13mm) thick dowel approximately 20” (51 cm) long or desired length
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Side baskets measure 4" (10 cm) tall and 4" (10 cm) wide. Center basket measures 5" (13 cm) tall and 3" (8 cm) wide.
gauge: 13 sts = 4” (10 cm); 16 rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
SPECIAL TECHNIQUE
Magic ring: Wrap yarn around your finger with the yarn tail to the left and under the working yarn. Insert hook through the circle from front to back. Yarn over using the working yarn and pull through loop; ch 1, release circle around finger gently. Work Round 1.

NOTES
Do not join rounds with a slip st. Use st marker to mark the beginning of each round.

BASKETS
Side Baskets (Make 2)
Make a magic ring.
Round 1: 8 sc in magic ring—8 sc.
Pull yarn tail gently to close magic ring. 
Round 2: 2 sc in each st around—16 sc. 
Round 3: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—24 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around —32 sc. 
Round 5: *Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around —40 sc. 
Round 6: *Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around —48 sc. 
Round 7: *Hdc in front loop only of next st, hdc in back loop only of next st; repeat from * around —48 hdc. 
Rounds 8-16: Repeat Round 7.
Round 17: Slip st into next hdc, ch 1, *sc in next 6 hdc, sc2tog; repeat from * around; join with a slip st to first sc—42 sc.
Round 18: Ch 2, hdc in next 12 sts, turn. 
Rounds 19-22: Repeat Round 18. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for seaming hanging band to basket body later.
Note: If your dowel is a different size, check flap length before fastening off to ensure accurate fit.

Center Basket (Make 1)
Make a magic ring.
Round 1: 8 sc in magic ring—8 sc.
Pull yarn tail gently to close magic ring.
Round 2: 2 sc in each st around—16 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around —24 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around —32 sc.
Round 5: *Hdc in front loop only, hdc in back loop only; repeat from * around —32 hdc.
Rounds 6-16: Repeat Round 5.
Round 17: Slip st into next hdc, ch 1, *sc in next 6 hdc, sc2tog; repeat from * around; join with a slip st to first sc—28 sc.
Round 18: Ch 2, hdc in next 8 sts, turn. 
Rounds 19-22: Repeat Round 18. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for seaming hanging band to basket body later.
Note: If your dowel is a different size, check flap length before fastening off to ensure accurate fit.

FINISHING
Fold basket band over to meet basket edge, creating a loop. With long tail and yarn needle, sew band to basket edge. Repeat for other two baskets. Weave in all loose ends. Slide dowel through all three basket loops.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Contrast A Soft White (0316) 1 ball or 70 yds/64 m
Contrast B Gold (0321) 1 ball or 190 yds/173 m
Contrast C Shocking Pink (0718) 1 ball or 125 yds/114 m
Contrast D Pretty ’n Pink (0722) 1 ball or 125 yds/114 m
Contrast E Persimmon (0220) 1 ball or 125 yds/114 m
Contrast F Coral (0726) 1 ball or 125 yds/114 m
Contrast G Spring Green (0672) 1 ball or 290 yds/264 m
Size U.S. J/10 [6 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Floral Stem Wire 20 x 18" [45.5 cm] long.
gauge: 11 sc and 13 rows = 4" [10 cm] with 2 strands of yarn held tog.
instructions:
Notes: 
• Work with 2 strands of yarn held tog throughout.
• All Daisy pieces are worked twice, then joined tog so front and back are identical.
Leaf (make 2 pieces alike for each Daisy) (See Diagram on page 3).
With 2 strands of G, ch 11.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 2 dc in next ch. 1 tr in next ch. 2 tr in next ch. 2 dc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in last ch. Working into opposite side of foundation ch into rem loops. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 2 dc in next ch. 2 tr in next ch. 1 tr in next ch. 2 dc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 3 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Joining rnd: Place WS of 2 Leaf pieces facing each other with sts aligned, having 2nd Leaf where yarn is still joined at back. Using yarn from 2nd Leaf and working through both thicknesses, sl st loosely in each st around other edge of Leaf. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.

Stem (make 2 pieces alike for each Daisy)
With 2 stands of G, ch 43.
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. 41 dc. Fasten off.
Do not fasten off 2nd Stem. Leave yarn attached for Stem joining row.
Stem Joining row: Place WS of 2 Stem pieces facing each other with sts aligned, having 2nd Stem where yarn is still joined at back. Using yarn from 2nd Stem and working through both thicknesses, sl st loosely in each st around other edge of Stem to last 13 sts. To join Leaf: Place ‘fasten off’ end of Leaf inside 2 Stem pieces, encasing all yarn ends into Stem. Join Leaf to Stem while working next 4 joining sl sts through ALL thicknesses, taking care to encase Leaf securely. Sl st in rem 9 sts to complete joining row. Fasten off.
Using 4 lengths of Floral Stem Wire held tog, fold one end up 3" [7.5 cm]. Insert folded end into Stem opening and push down into total length of Stem. The folded end should not ‘catch’ into stitches and will be easier to push down Stem.

DAISY (make 2 pieces alike for each Daisy) (See Diagram on page 3).
Make 1 Daisy with A as Color 1 / B as Color 2.
Make 1 Daisy with B as Color 1 / C as Color 2.
Make 1 Daisy with A as Color 1 / D as Color 2.
Make 1 Daisy with B as Color 1 / E as Color 2.
Make 1 Daisy with A as Color 1 / F as Color 2. 
With 2 strands of Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 3 (counts as dc). Work 15 dc in ring. Join with sl st in top of ch 3. 16 dc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc. Fasten off. 
Begin Petals: 3rd rnd: Join 2 strands of Color 2 with sl st in any sc of 2nd rnd. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. *Ch 7. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 5 ch.* **1 sc in each of next 4 sc of 2nd rnd. Rep from * 6 times more, then from * to ** once. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc of 2nd rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 Petals.
4th rnd: *Working into rem loops of next Petal chain: 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 2 dc in next ch. 3 dc in last ch. Then working down side of Petal: 3 dc in next sc. 2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Skip next 2 sc of 3rd rnd. 1 sc in next sc of 3rd rnd. Skip next sc of 3rd rnd. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.

Joining rnd: Place WS of 2 Daisy pieces facing each other with Petals aligned, having 2nd Daisy where Color 2 yarn is still joined at back. Using Color 2 yarn from 2nd Daisy and working through both thicknesses, sl st loosely in each st around other edge of Daisy until 2 last Petals are un-joined. Work around 14 sl sts of next Petal Pull up a loop in last sl st. Stuff Daisy lightly, using blunt end of crochet hook to push stuffing into each Petal. To join Stem: Place top of Stem inside 2 Daisy pieces, encasing all yarn ends into Daisy. Join Stem while working next 9 joining sl sts (at end of current Petal and beg of last Petal) through ALL thicknesses, taking care to encase Stem securely. Complete joining rnd, at same time adding stuffing into last Petal as you work. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 3.75 mm [US F-5]
abbreviations: A, B, and C = Color A, B, and C
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 20 sts = 4" [10 cm]; 20 rows/rounds = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet.
instructions:
COLA BOTTLE
With A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 3 times—15 sc.
Rounds 7 and 8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—18 sc.
Rounds 10 and 11: Sc in each sc around and change to B in last sc of Round 11.
Rounds 12–15: With B, sc in each sc around and change to A in last sc of Round 15.
Start stuffing bottle and continue to stuff as work progresses.
Round 16: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 3 times—15 sc.
Round 17: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 3 times—12 sc.
Round 18: Sc in each sc around.
Round 19: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 3 times—9 sc.
Round 20: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 3 times—6 sc.
Rounds 21 and 22: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

CAP
With B, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

FINISHING
With B, sew Cap to top of Bottle. Label: With yarn needle and C, using photograph as a guide, embroider back stitch "Cola" on front of Bottle. Fold gold ribbon in half. Insert crochet hook around a few stitches at top of ornament, place ribbon fold on hook and draw through to form a loop. Thread ends of ribbon through loop and pull to tighten. Tie ends together with bow or overhand knot to form hanging loop. Weave in any remaining ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 334 Buff A and 316 Soft White B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4 mm [US G-6]
three 15/16” (23mm) diameter x 12” (30.5 cm) long dowels
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Tree measures 7¾” (19.5 cm) at widest point x 10½” (26.5 cm) tall without bucket; tree in bucket measures 16” (40.5 cm) tall.
gauge: 4 sc = 1” (2.5 cm); 18 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
TREE (make 3)
Triangle (make 2)
With A, ch 32.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—31 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st across to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—29 sc.
Rows 4 and 5: Repeat Row 2.
Row 6: Repeat Row 3—27 sc.
Rows 7–36: Repeat Rows 4–6 ten times—7 sc.
Rows 37–40: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 twice—3 sc.
Row 41: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in last st, turn—2 sc.
Row 42: Ch 1, sc2tog—1 sc. Fasten off. 

Skirt 
With B, ch 7; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout) 15 dc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—16 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in next st, *ch 3, dc in next 2 dc; repeat from * around, ch 3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—16 dc and 8 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in next st, 4 sc in each ch-3 space; join with slip st in first sc—32 sc. Fasten off. 

TREE 1 DECORATIONS
Circle Motif (make 2)
With B, ch 7; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in next sc, *ch 3, dc in next 2 sc; repeat from * around, ch 3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—12 dc and 6 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in next st, (slip st, beg 3-dc Cl, ch 4, 3-dc Cl) in first ch-3 space, [ch 4, 3-dc Cl] twice in each ch-3 space, ch 4; join with slip st in top of beginning Cl—12 Cls and 12 ch-4 spaces.
Round 4: Work (2 sc, ch 3, 2 sc) in each ch-4 space; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

Scallop Trim #1
With B, ch 72.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, *skip next 2 ch, 5 dc in next ch; repeat from * across to last ch, sc in last ch. Fasten off.

Scallop Trim #2
With B, ch 63. Work same as scallop trim #1.

Bucket Trim
With B, work an even number of ch as needed to fit around top edge of bucket.
Row 1: Dc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—odd number of dc.
Row 2: Ch 3, skip next dc, sc in next st, *ch 3, skip next dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * across. Fasten off.

Bow
With 2 strands of A held together, work as many ch as needed to wrap around bucket and tie a bow. Fasten off. 

ASSEMBLY
Weave in ends.
Step 1: Sew a circle motif on each triangle. 
Step 2: At top of each triangle, sew 3 pearl beads in a vertical row. 
Step 3: With right sides held together, sew triangle sides together. Turn tree right side out and stuff lightly (do not overstuff).
Step 4: With sewing needle and thread, sew short edges of scallop trim #1 together, then sew trim to bottom edge of tree. Sew short edges of scallop trim #2 together, place trim on tree, and sew to nearest round. 
Step 5: With sewing needle and thread, sew bottom edges together, leaving a ½” (1.5 cm) opening in the center for the dowel.
Step 6: Apply glue to ⅔ of dowel and insert in tree, leaving remainder of dowel for bucket. Allow glue to dry thoroughly throughout all assembly and finishing steps before handling.
Step 7: Apply glue to outside of bucket near top edge and glue bucket trim in place around. Allow to dry, then tie bow around trim. You may want to apply glue to an inconspicuous area of the knot to prevent it from unraveling and to loops to prevent drooping.

FINISHING TREE 1
Insert a Styrofoam ball in the bucket. Apply glue around the ball where it meets the inside of bucket and allow to dry. With a pin, mark the center of the ball. Lightly mark 1½” (4 cm) from the bottom edge of dowel and insert dowel into the ball up to this mark. Carefully remove the dowel and fill the hole with glue. With right side facing the tree, slide skirt onto dowel, then reinsert the dowel into the hole. Ensure that the tree is standing straight, slide the skirt down to the ball, and allow glue to dry thoroughly.

TREE 2 DECORATIONS
Large Snowflake (make 2)
With B, ch 6; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), dc in ring, *ch 1, dc in ring; repeat from * 11 times, ch 1; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—14 dc and 14 ch-1 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first ch-1 space, *ch 5, sc in next 2 ch-1 spaces, repeat from * 5 times, ch 5, sc in last ch-1 space; join with slip st in first sc—7 ch-5 spaces. Fasten off.

Medium Snowflake (make 2)
With B, ch 6; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, (sc, ch 5, sc) in same st as join, *sc in next sc, (sc, ch 5, sc) in next sc; repeat from * 4 times, sc in last sc; join with slip st in first sc—6 ch–5 spaces. Fasten off.

Lower Band Trim
With B, ch 7.
Row 1 (right side): Dc in 3rd ch from hook, *ch 1, skip next ch, dc in next ch; repeat from * once, turn—3 dc and 2 ch-1 spaces.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first dc, *ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * once, turn—3 sc and 2 ch-1 spaces.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in first sc, *ch 1, skip next sc, dc in next sc; repeat from * once, turn—3 dc and 2 ch-1 spaces.
Repeat Rows 2 and 3 until trim fits around lower rounds of tree. Fasten off.

Upper Band Trim
Work same as lower band trim, repeating Rows 2 and 3 until trim fits around upper section of tree.

Bow (make 2)
With 2 strands of A held together, work as many ch as needed to weave in and out of each band and tie a bow. Fasten off. 

Bucket Trim
With A, work as many ch as needed to fit around outside of bucket near top edge plus 2 ch.
Row 1 (right side): Dc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch across. Fasten off. 

Flower
With B, ch 6; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, *ch 5, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * 4 times, ch 5, sc in last sc; join with slip st in first sc—6 ch-5 spaces. Fasten off.

ASSEMBLY
Weave in ends.
Step 1: Sew 1 medium and 1 large snowflake on each triangle. Do not sew through outer ch-spaces of the large snowflake.
Step 2: Sew a pearl bead in center of each snowflake. Sewing through triangle, sew a bead on 3rd ch of each ch-5 of large snowflake, pulling outward slightly to create a point. 
Step 3: Repeat Step 3 of Tree 1 Assembly.
Step 4: Sew short ends of each band together to form a ring. Weave the appropriate bow through the upper and lower bands. Place the upper band on the tree and tie the bow. Position the lower band over the lowest rounds and, with sewing needle and thread, sew in place. Tie the bow. You may prefer to glue or tack the underside of the bow loops to the band so they don’t droop.
Steps 5 and 6: Repeat Steps 5 and 6 of Tree 1 Assembly. 
Step 7: Apply glue to outside of bucket near top edge and glue bucket trim in place. Sew a pearl bead in center of flower and glue flower on front of trim.

FINISHING TREE 2
See instructions for Finishing Tree 1.

TREE 3 DECORATIONS
Large Swirl (make 4)
With B, ch 6; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 5 (counts as dc, ch 2), dc in ring, *ch 2, dc in ring; repeat from * 5 times; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—8 dc and 8 ch-2 spaces.
Round 2: Slip st in next ch, (sc, ch 3, sc) in each ch-2 space around (petal made); join with slip st in first sc—8 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off.

Medium Swirl (make 2)
Work same as Round 1 of large swirl. Fasten off.

Small Swirl (make 5)
With B, ch 6; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): *Ch 3, sc in ring; repeat from * 7 times; join with slip st in base of beginning ch—8 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off.

Curved Trim
With B, ch 3.
Row 1 (right side): Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, *ch 3, 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook; repeat from * as needed to fit around lower edge of tree. Fasten off.

Bucket Trim
With A, ch 4.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 2 ch, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st, turn.
Working an odd number of rows, repeat Row 2 until trim fits around the top of the bucket. Fasten off. Sew short edges together. 
Edging Round: With right side of either edge facing, join B with sc at seam, working in ends of rows, ch 1, skip first row, sc in next row, *ch 1, skip next row, sc in next row; repeat from * around to last row, ch 1, skip last row; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. 
Repeat on opposite edge. 

ASSEMBLY
Weave in ends. 
Step 1: Sew 2 large swirls, one medium swirl, and 2 small swirls on each triangle. Sew beads and buttons as shown or where desired. 
Step 2: Repeat Step 3 of Tree 1 Assembly.
Step 3: Sew short ends of curved band together to form a ring. Position band at lower edge of tree and with sewing needle and thread, sew in place. 
Steps 4 and 5: Repeat Steps 5 and 6 of Tree 1 Assembly. 
Step 6: Apply glue around outside of bucket near top edge and glue bucket trim in place. Sew a button to center of remaining small swirl. Glue swirl to front of bucket trim. 

FINISHING TREE 3
See instructions for Finishing Tree 1.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 316 Soft White A, 624 Tea Leaf B, and 319 Cherry Red C and 312 Black for fish face D.
abbreviations: Dec (decrease) = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
gauge: 10 sts = 3”; 12 rows = 3” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook/needles to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Side (Make 2)
With A, ch 34.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 31 ch, 3 sc in last ch, working on opposite side of ch work 32 sc; turn – 67 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in 32 sc, [inc] 3 times, sc in remaining 32 sc; turn – 70 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in 33 sc, inc, sc in next 2 sc, inc, sc in 33 sc; turn – 72 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in 34 sc, [inc] 4 times, sc in 34 sc; turn – 76 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in 37 sc, [inc] twice, sc in 37 sc; turn – 78 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in 37 sc, [inc] 4 times, sc in 37 sc; turn – 82 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in 37 sc, inc, sc in next 6 sc, inc, sc in 37 sc; turn – 84 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in 38 sc, inc, sc in next 2 sc, [inc] twice, sc in next 2 sc, inc, sc in 38 sc; turn – 88 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in 27 sc, hdc in next 10 sc, 2 hdc in next sc, hdc in next 2 sc, 2 hdc in next sc, hdc in next 6 sc, 2 hdc in next sc, hdc in next 2 sc, 2 hdc in next sc, hdc in next 10 sc, sc in next 27 sc; turn – 92 sts.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in 30 sts, [skip 3 sts, 7 tr in next st, skip 3 sts, sc in next st] twice, sc in next st, [skip 3 sts, 7 tr in next st, skip 3 sts, sc in next st] twice, sc in 29 sts; turn.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in 32 sts, [inc] 3 times, sc in next 5 sts, [inc] 3 times, sc in next 6 sts, [inc] 3 times, sc in next 5 sts, [inc] 3 times, sc in 32 sc. Fasten off.
Center Paw
With B ch 6.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch, working on opposite side of ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch; do not join but work in continuous rounds – 12 sc.
Round 2: Inc in first sc, sc in next 3 sc, [inc] 3 times, sc in next 3 sc, [inc] twice – 18 sc.
Round 3: (Sc, hdc) in first sc, (hdc, dc) in next sc, 2 dc in next sc, slip st in next sc, 2 dc in next sc, (dc, hdc) in next sc, (hdc, sc) in next sc, sc in remaining 11 sc. Fasten off. Sew in place on front side of stocking.
Toe Prints (Make 4) 
Round 1: With B ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Round 2: Inc in each sc around; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Sew in place.
Fish
Row 1: With C ch 2; 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, inc in each sc across; turn – 6 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in next sc, inc, sc to last 2 sc; inc, sc in last sc; turn – 8 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 5: Repeat Row 3 – 10 sc.
Rows 6 and 7: Repeat Rows 4 and 5 – 12 sc.
Row 8: Repeat Row 4.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in next 6 sc; fin: ch 6, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, tr in next ch, hdc in last ch, sc in last 6 sc; turn.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc, skip fin, sc in last 6 sc; turn.
Row 11: Repeat Row 4.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc in first sc, dec, sc to last 3 sc; dec, sc in last sc; turn – 10 sc.
Row 13: Repeat Row 4.
Rows 14 and 15: Repeat Row 12 – 6 sc.
Row 16: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [dec] twice, sc in last sc; turn – 4 sc.
Row 17: Repeat Row 4.
Row 18: Ch 4, (2 tr, dc, hdc, sc) in first sc, slip st in next 2 sc, (sc, hdc, dc, 3 tr) in last sc; turn.
Row 19: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sts, slip st in 2 slip sts, sc in next 5 sts and in top of ch-4. Fasten off.
With D, embroider eyes and mouth. Sew Fish in place.
Finishing
Sew front and back sides together through both loops of last row.
Border and Hanging Loop
Join A in top center back st of stocking with sc; work sc evenly around; ch 10 for hanger; sc in each sc around to last 2 sc; skip last 2 sc, work 16 dc in ch-10 loop, skip first 2 sc of last round; join with a slip st in next sc. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Handicrafter Cotton Scents (42.5 g/1.5 oz; 62 m/68 yds) 62001(Powder) 86 m / 95 yds
Size 3.5 mm (U.S. E or 4) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
1 yd [95 cm] of ribbon ¼ inch [0.5 cm] wide
measurements: Approx 8 ins [20.5 cm] wide x 6 ins [15 cm] tall.
gauge: 16 sc and 18 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]
instructions:
FRONT AND BACK (make alike)
Ch 2.
1st row: (RS). 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. Turn. 4 sc.
3rd to 13th rows : Ch 1.2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 26 sc at end of 13th row.
14th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
15th row: As 3rd row. 28 sc.
16th to 22nd rows: As 14th row.
23rd row : (RS). Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook - Sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
24th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
25th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
26th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Fasten off. With RS of work facing, miss 2 sc of 22nd row. Join yarn with sl st to next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1.Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
Next row: Sl st in each of first 2 sts. Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
Note: When joining Front and Back, place stuffing inside.
Joining Back and Front: 1st rnd: Place WS of Front and Back tog. With RS of Front facing you, join MC with sl st to first ch of foundation ch, working through both thicknesses, ch 1. Work 76 sc around working 3 sc at bottom point. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd (eyelet rnd): Ch 1.*1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Miss next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Beg at top center, thread ribbon through eyelet rnd as shown in photo. Tie in bow.

Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 13 dc and 7 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Ch 3 at beg of rnds does not count as dc.
Ch 5. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring. Ch 40 for hanging loop and sl st back into ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. Work 25 sc in ch-5 ring. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. 3 dc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first dc. 75 dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. 3 dc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first dc. 225 dc.
4th rnd: Ch 3. 3 dc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first dc. 675 dc.
Fasten off.

Main Color (MC) Jute (00082) 1 ball or 120 yds/109 m

Contrast C Hot Orange (01628) 1 ball or 6 yds/5 m

abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 20 sc and 18 rnds = 4” [10 cm] before stuffing.
instructions:
Notes:
• Use the same Body, Hat, Nose and Beard Pattern for each Gnome. Pay careful attention to specific colors within the materials and pattern section for each Gnome.
• Move marker as work progresses.

BODY
Make a magic loop, demonstrated here.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 6 sc in magic loop. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. 6 sc. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
6th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
7th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 42 sc.
8th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.
9th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 54 sc.
10th to 14th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
15th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sts.
16th and 17th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
18th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 42 sts.
19th rnd: As 16th rnd.
20th rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
21st rnd: As 16th rnd.
22nd rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 30 sts.
23rd rnd: *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sts.
Fasten off. Stuff Body.

HAT
Make a magic loop.
1st rnd: (RS). 4 sc in magic loop. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. 4 sc. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 6 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 8 sc.
4th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 10 sc.
6th rnd: As 4th rnd.
7th rnd: 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. 11 sc.
8th to 14th rnds: As 7th rnd. 18 sc.
15th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 20 sc.
16th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * around. 22 sc.
17th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
18th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 26 sc.
19th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * around. 28 sc.
20th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
21st rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
22nd rnd: As 4th rnd.
23rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 42 sc.
24th rnd: As 4th rnd.
25th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.
26th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. 54 sc.
27th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 60 sc.
Fasten off at end of last rnd. Stuff Hat.

NOSE
Ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join, work in continuous rnds. 4 sc. PM for beg of rnd.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 8 sc.
3rd and 4th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
5th rnd: (Sc2tog) 4 times. 4 sts.
Fasten off. Stuff Nose.

BEARD
Cut one 6" [15 cm] length of White and tie end in a knot to form a circle.
Cut 20 – 5" [12.5 cm] lengths of White and add as fringe to the circle at the opposite end of knot.

Main Assembly
Pin Hat on Body to find placement for Nose.
Stitch Nose in place.
Pull the Beard ‘ring’ under the nose and stitch knot in place to hold beard in place under Nose.
Trim Beard.
Sew Hat to Body over top of Nose.

CHRISTMAS TREE GNOME
Make Body and Hat with MC, Nose with B.
Hat Trim
With RS facing, join A with sl st to any back sc of Hat.
1st rnd: *Ch 3. Skip next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in same sl as first sl st. Fasten off.
Star
With D, ch 4.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 9 dc in 4th ch from hook. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. 10 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *(2 dc. Ch 2. Sl st to top of last dc. 2 dc) in next dc.** 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * around, ending at **. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
With A, D, E and F using Satin St, embroider ‘light bulbs’ as shown in picture.

SANTA GNOME
Make Body and Hat with MC, Nose with A.
Hat Trim
With RS facing, join B with sl st to any back sc.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in each of next 9 sc.** 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending at **. Join with sl st to first sc. 66 sc.
Hat Belt
With C, ch 56. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sc.
2nd to 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing.
Sew Hat Belt on Hat.

Pompom: Wind B around 3 fingers 50 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hood. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Hat. With D and Straight St, embroider a ‘buckle’ over Hat Belt as shown in picture.

SNOWMAN GNOME
Make Hat with MC, Body with A and Nose with B.
Hat Stripe
With C, ch 56. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sc. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing.
Holly (make 2)
With D, ch 7.
1st rnd: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. (Sl st in next ch. Ch 2. Sl st in next st) twice. Sl st in next ch. (Sl st. Ch 3. Sl st) in last ch. Working on opposite side of ch, (Sl st in next ch. Ch 2. Sl st in next ch) twice. Sl st in last ch. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Berry
With C, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to make a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 2. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – beg cluster made. Ch 1. [(Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times. Yoh and draw through all 4 loops on hook – cluster made. Ch 1] twice. Join with sl st to first cluster. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing.

Scarf
With C, ch 111.
1st row: 1 dc in 5th ch from hook (counts as dc and ch 1). *Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 dc in next ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Fasten off.
Sew Hat Stripe on Hat. Sew Holly over Hat Stripe. Sew Berry over ends of Holly. Tie Scarf behind Beard.

SNOWFLAKE GNOME
Make Hat with MC, Body and Nose with A.
Tassel: Wrap C around a 3" [7.5 cm] piece of cardboard 20 times. Tie securely at one end. Cut across other end. Wrap yarn twice around tassel ¼” [1 cm] from tied end, and fasten securely. Attach Tassel to tip of Hat. With C, using Straight St, embroider snowflake as shown in picture.

GINGERBREAD GNOME
Make Body, Nose and Hat with MC.
Button
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing.

Icing
With A, work 1st to 11th rnds as given for Hat.
12th rnd: *Sl st in next sc. 3 dc in next sc. Skip next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off. 
With A, using Running St embroider details on Body along 8th and 9th rnds of Body as shown in picture.
With A, using Running St, embroider button details along last rnd as shown in picture.
With A, sew Button to Hat using Cross stitch.
With C, using Running St, embroider details on Icing as shown in picture.
Sew Icing on Top of Hat.
With C, using Straight St, embroider zig-zags over 24th and 25th rnds of Hat as shown in picture.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 3.75mm [US F-5] or 4mm [US G-6]
Sewing needle and white thread (to sew down ends), yarn needle
1½ yds (1.5 m) of burlap in color of your choice (shown in: Wedgewood blue)
Hot glue gun and glue sticks
Framing supplies (optional): Acid free foam core backing, sewing needle and thread to match burlap, large picture frame
abbreviations: () = work directions in parentheses into same st
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Framed doily tree shown measures about 28½ x 42½” [72.5 x 108 cm]
gauge: See instructions for each doily for gauge. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
MINI SNOWFLAKE DOILY (make 10)
Finished Size: About 3¼” (8.5 cm) diameter.
Gauge: Rounds 1-2 = 2” (5 cm) across.
Ch 6; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 5, skip same sc as joining, skip next sc, slip st in next sc, [ch 5, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] 4 times, ch 5, skip last sc; join with slip st in joining slip st of Round 1—6 ch-5 spaces.
Round 3: (Slip st, ch 1, 2 sc, ch 3, sc, ch 5, sc, ch 3, 2 sc) in first ch-5 space, (2 sc, ch 3, sc, ch 5, sc, ch 3, 2 sc) in each remaining ch-5 space around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

SMALL SNOWFLAKE DOILY #1 (make 2)
Finished Size: About 5” (12.5 cm) tip to tip.
Gauge: Rounds 1-3 = 2¾” (7 cm) across.
Ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, [sc in ring, ch 2] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc and 6 ch-2 spaces.
Round 2: (Slip st, ch 1, sc, ch 2, sc) in first ch-2 space, [ch 2, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space] 5 times, ch 2; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc and 12 ch-2 spaces.
Round 3: (Slip st, ch 1, sc, ch 3, sc) in first ch-2 space, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next 11 ch-2 spaces; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc and 12 ch-3 spaces.
Round 4: (Slip st, ch 1, sc) in first ch-3 space, [ch 5, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space] 5 times, ch 5, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc, 6 ch-5 spaces and 6 ch-3 spaces.
Round 5: Ch 2, (sc, ch 5, sc) in first ch-5 space, [ch 2, slip st in next sc, ch 1, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 1, slip st in next sc, ch 2, (sc, ch 5, sc) in next ch-5 space] 5 times, ch 2, slip st in next sc, ch 1, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 1; join with slip st in joining slip st of Round 4. Fasten off.

SMALL SNOWFLAKE DOILY #2 (make 2)
Finished Size: About 5” (12.5 cm) tip to tip.
Gauge: Rounds 1-3 = 2¾” (7 cm) across.
Special Stitch
shell = (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in indicated space.
Ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, [ch 1, sc in next sc] 11 times, ch 1; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc and 12 ch-1 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in first ch-1 space, ch 6 (counts as dc, ch 3), skip next sc, dc in next ch-1 space, [ch 3, skip next sc, dc in next ch-1 space] 10 times, ch 3, skip last sc; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-6—12 dc and 12 ch-3 spaces.
Round 4: (Slip st, ch 1, sc, ch 2, sc) in first ch-3 space, [skip next dc, shell in next ch-3 space, skip next dc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-3 space] 5 times, skip next dc, shell in last ch-3 space; join with slip st in first sc—6 shells.
Round 5: (Slip st, ch 1, sc, ch 3, sc) in first ch-2 space, [ch 3, (sc, hdc, ch 4, hdc, sc) in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 3, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-2 space] 5 times, ch 3, (sc, hdc, ch 4, hdc, sc) in ch-2 space of last shell, ch 3; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

MEDIUM SNOWFLAKE DOILY #1 (make 2)
Finished Size: About 6” (15 cm) tip to tip.
Gauge: Rounds 1-3 = 3¼ (8.5 cm) across.
Special Stitches
beg-Cl (beginning cluster) = Ch 3, *Yarn over, insert hook in indicated space, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook; repeat from * once more, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Cl (3 double crochet cluster) = Yarn over, insert hook in indicated space, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook (2 loops remain on hook); [yarn over, insert hook in same space, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] twice, yarn over, draw through all 4 loops on hook.
V-st (V-stitch): (Dc, ch 5, dc) in indicated space.
Ch 6; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Beg-Cl in ring, [ch 3, Cl in ring] 5 times, ch 3; join with slip st in top of beg-Cl—6 clusters and 6 ch-3 spaces.
Round 2: (Slip st, ch 1, sc, ch 3, sc) in first ch-3 space, [ch 3, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-3 space] 5 times, ch 3; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc and 12 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: (Slip st, ch 1, sc) in first ch-3 spaces, [ch 7, skip next ch-3 space, sc in next ch-3 space] 5 times, ch 7, skip last ch-3 space; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc and 6 ch-7 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 5 (counts as dc, ch 2), V-st in next ch-7 space, [ch 2, dc in next sc, ch 2, V-st in next ch-7 space] 5 times, ch 2; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-5—6 V-sts.
Round 5: Ch 3, slip st in next dc, ch 3, (sc, ch 5, sc) in next ch-5 space, ch 3, slip st in next dc, [ch 3, (slip st, ch 2, slip st) in next dc, ch 3, slip st in next dc, ch 3, (sc, ch 5, sc) in next ch-5 space, ch 3, slip st in next dc] 5 times, ch 3, (slip st, ch 2, slip st) in joining slip st. Fasten off.

MEDIUM SNOWFLAKE DOILY #2 (make 2)
Finished Size: About 6” (15 cm) tip to tip.
Gauge: Rounds 1-3 = 3 (7.5 cm) across.
Special Stitches
small-shell = 3 dc in indicated stitch.
Ch 6; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, [small-shell in next st, sc in next st] 5 times, small-shell in last st; join with slip st in first sc—6 small-shells.
Round 3: Ch 7 (counts as tr, ch 3), dc in center st of first small-shell, [ch 3, tr in next sc, ch 3, dc in center st of next small-shell] 5 times, ch 3; join with slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-7—6 tr, 6 dc, and 12 ch-3 spaces.
Round 4: (Slip st, ch 1, 2 sc, ch 3, 2 sc) in first ch-3 space, [ch 1, (2 sc, ch 3, 2 sc) in next ch-3 space] 11 times, ch 1; join with slip st in first sc—12 (2 sc, ch 3, 2 sc) groups and 12 ch-1 spaces.
Round 5 (wrong side): Ch 1, TURN, sc in first ch-1 space, [ch 6, sc in next ch-1 space] 11 times, ch 6; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc and 12 ch-6 spaces.
Round 6 (right side): Ch 3, TURN, (sc, ch 5, sc) in first ch-6 space, [ch 3, slip st in next sc, ch 3, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-6 space, ch 3, slip st in next sc, ch 3, (sc, ch 5, sc) in next ch-6 space] 5 times, ch 3, slip st in next sc, ch 3, (sc, ch 3, sc) in last ch-6 space, ch 3; join with slip st in same sc as joining of Round 5. Fasten off.

LARGE SNOWFLAKE DOILY #1 (make 2)
Finished Size: About 7” (18 cm) tip to tip.
Gauge: Rounds 1-3 = 3” (7.5 cm) across.
Special Stitches
shell = 5 dc in indicated stitch or space.
V-st (V-stitch) = (Dc, ch 3, dc) in indicated stitch.
Ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, [sc in ring, ch 4] 5 times, sc in ring; join with ch 1, dc in first sc (joining ch 1 and dc count as ch-4 space here and throughout)—6 sc and 6 ch-4 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 1, (sc, ch 4, sc) in first ch-4 space (the ch-4 space formed by the ch 1, dc joining), [ch 4, (sc, ch 4, sc) in next ch-4 space] 5 times; join with ch 1, dc in first sc—12 sc and 12 ch-4 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first ch-4 space, [shell in next ch-4 space, sc in next ch-4 space] 5 times, shell in last ch-4 space; join with slip st in first sc—6 shells and 6 sc.
Round 4: Ch 6 (counts as dc, ch 3), dc in same sc as joining (first V-st made), [ch 3, sc in center dc of next shell, ch 3, V-st in next sc] 5 times, ch 3, sc in center dc of next shell, ch 3; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-6—6 sc, 6 V-sts, and 12 ch-3 spaces.
Round 5: (Slip st, ch 1, sc) in ch-3 space of first V-st, [ch 3, shell in next sc, ch 3, sc in ch-3 space of next V-st] 5 times, ch 3, shell in next sc, ch 3; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc, 6 shells, and 12 ch-3 spaces.
Round 6: Ch 1, ([sc, ch 2] twice, sc) in same sc as joining, *ch 3, (sc, ch 3, sc, ch 7, sc, ch 3, sc) in center dc of next shell, ch 3, ([sc, ch 2] twice, sc) in next sc; repeat from * 4 more times, ch 3, (sc, ch 3, sc, ch 7, sc, ch 3, sc) in center dc of last shell, ch 3; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

LARGE SNOWFLAKE DOILY #2 (make 2)
Finished Size: About 7½” (19 cm) tip to tip.
Gauge: Rounds 1-3 = 3½” (9 cm) across.
Special Stitches
shell = (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in indicated space.
Ch 6; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 5 (counts as dc, ch 2), dc in next sc, [ch 2, dc in next sc] 10 times, ch 2; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-5—12 dc and 12 ch-2 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in first ch-2 space, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same ch-2 space (first shell made), [sc in next ch-2 space, shell in next ch-2 space] 5 times, sc in next ch-2 space; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—6 sc and 6 shells.
Round 4: Slip st in next 2 dc, (slip st, ch 3, 2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in ch-2 space of first shell, [ch 5, shell in ch-2 space of next shell] 5 times, ch 5; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—6 shells and 6 ch-5 spaces.
Round 5: Slip st in next 2 dc, (slip st, ch 3, 2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in ch-2 space of first shell, [ch 4, sc in next ch-5 space, ch 4, shell in ch-2 space of next shell] 5 times, ch 4, sc in next ch-5 space, ch 4; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—6 shells, 6 sc, and 12 ch-4 spaces.
Round 6: Ch 4, (slip st, ch 6, slip st) in ch-2 space of first shell, *ch 4, skip next 2 dc of same shell, slip st in last dc of same shell, [ch 4, slip st in next ch-4 space] twice, ch 4, slip st in first dc of next shell, ch 4, (slip st, ch 6, slip st) in ch-2 space of same shell; repeat from * 4 more times, ch 4, skip next 2 dc of same shell, slip st in last dc of same shell, [ch 4, slip st in next ch-4 space] twice, ch 4; join with slip st in joining of previous round. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in tails and, using sewing needle and white sewing thread, sew down ends on back side of doilies. Block each doily, if desired. Lay burlap flat and iron out any wrinkles. Arrange doilies on burlap, following layout diagram. Using hot glue, glue doilies to burlap.
Frame Tree
Cut foam core into a rectangle that extends about 3” (7.5 cm) beyond the tree on all sides and will fit into your picture frame. Carefully stretch the burlap over the foam core and pin, sew, or glue the edges to the back side. You may prefer to remove any glass from the frame before inserting the piece into the frame. Insert the piece into the picture frame. The piece could also be professionally framed.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball 001 White

abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
v-st = (tr, ch 3, tr) all in st or ch specified.
cl group (cluster group) = (5 tr, ch 3, dtr, ch 3, 5 tr) all in specified st.
cl (cluster) = * [yo] twice, draw up a loop in next tr, [yo and draw through 2 loops] twice; repeat from * 4 more times; yo and draw through all 6 loops on hook.
picot = ch 6, slip st in 5th ch from hook.
gauge: Rounds 1-7 = 4½” across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions: Ch 8; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1: Ch 3, 23 dc in ring; join with a slip st to top of ch-3 – 24 sts. Round 2: Ch 1, sc in joining, [ch 5, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc] 7 times; ch 2, dc in first sc to join and form last loop. Round 3: Ch 1, sc over dc, [ch 7, sc in next ch-5 loop] 7 times; ch 3, tr in first sc to join and form last loop. Round 4: Ch 3, 2 dc in joining tr, [ch 3, 5 dc in 4th ch of next ch-7 loop] 7 times; ch 3, 2 dc in joining tr; join with a slip st to top of ch-3. Round 5: Ch 1, sc in joining, * ch 5, sc in ch-3 space **, ch 5, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * around, end at **; ch 2, dc in first sc to join and form last loop. Round 6: Ch 1, sc over dc, [ch 7, sc in next ch-5 loop] 15 times; ch 3, tr in first sc to join and form last loop. Round 7: Ch 7, tr in joining tr, * ch 5, tr in 4th ch of next ch-7 loop, ch 5 **, v-st in 4th ch of next ch-7 loop; repeat from * around, end at **; end round. Round 8: Start round, * ch 4, skip next tr, cl group in next tr, ch 4 **, v-st over v-st; repeat from * around, end at **; end round. Rounds 9 and 10: Start round, * ch 4, cl, ch 3, cl group in dtr, ch 3, cl, ch 4 **, v-st over v-st; repeat from * around, end at **; end round. Round 11: Start round, * ch 5, cl, ch 3, cl group in dtr, ch 3, cl, ch 5 **, v-st over v-st; repeat from * around, end at **; end round. Round 12: Start round, * (ch 3, tr) all in same ch-space, ch 5, cl, ch 3, cl group in dtr, ch 3, cl, ch 5 **, v-st over v-st; repeat from * around, end at **; end round. Round 13: Start round, * ch 3, v-st in next ch-3 space, ch 5, cl, ch 3, (5 tr, ch 2, tr, ch 2, 5 tr) all in dtr, ch 3, cl, ch 5 **, v-st in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; end round. Round 14: Start round, * (ch 3, v-st] twice) all in next ch-3 space, ch 3, v-st over v-st, ch 6, cl, ch 3, 5 tr in tr, ch 3, cl, ch 6 **, v-st over v-st; repeat from * around, end at **; end round. Round 15: Start round, * [ch 3, v-st over v-st] 3 times, ch 7, sc in next tr, ch 4, work cl over 5 tr including same tr as sc was made, ch 4, sc in same tr as last leg of cl, ch 7 **, v-st over v-st; repeat from * around, end at **; end round. Round 16: Start round, * [v-st in next ch-3 space] 6 times, ch 7, sc in top of cl, ch 7 **, v-st over v-st; repeat from * around, end at **; end round. Round 17: Slip st in next ch, slip st in ch-space, ch 11, slip st in 5th ch from hook, ch 2, dtr in same ch-space, * [dtr in next ch-3 space, picot, ch 2, dtr in same ch-space] 6 times, ch 6, sc in sc, ch 6 **, (dtr, picot, ch 2, dtr) all in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; slip st in 5th ch of ch-11. Fasten off. Weave in ends. Finishing: With the ribbon, run in and out of every other stitch of the Doily until you have made it all the way around. Lay the doily flat and place the vase in the center. Evenly wrap the Doily around the vase and tie ribbon in a bow to hold it in place.

abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Draft Dodger measures 40” long x 10” diameter.

instructions:
Foundation Row (Right Side): Ch 36; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—35 sc.
Rows 1–14: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 15 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, sc in first 17 sc, Bobble in next sc, sc in next 17 sc, turn—34 sc and 1 Bobble.
Rows 16–18: Repeat Row 1 three times.
Row 19: Ch 1, sc in first 14 sc, Bobble in next sc, sc in next 5 sc, Bobble in next sc, sc in last 14 sc, turn—33 sc and 2 Bobbles.
Rows 20–22: Repeat Row 1 three times.
Row 23: Ch 1, sc in first 11 sc, [Bobble in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 2 times, Bobble in next sc, sc in last 11 sc, turn—32 sc and 3 Bobbles.
Rows 24–26: Repeat Row 1 three times.
Rows 27–30: Repeat Row 19–22.
Rows 31–158: Repeat Rows 15–30 eight times.
Row 159: Repeat Row 15.
Rows 160–174: Repeat Row 1 fifteen times. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With right side facing, using yarn needle and yarn, sew the long side edges together. Using yarn needle and yarn, sew a basting stitch around one end and pull gently, but firmly to gather. Sew end closed and weave in tail.
Assemble Inner Tube: Tube can be sewn using sewing machine, or hand sewing needle and thread. Bringing right sides together, fold fabric lengthwise. Pin and sew a ½” seam along the length of the fabric and across one short end, to create a tube. Turn tube right side out. Using funnel, fill tube with sand to within 1” of open end. Tuck in ½” of fabric across open end of tube and sew tube closed.
Insert filled fabric tube into crocheted tube. With yarn needle and yarn, weave a strand through top edge of crocheted tube and pull gently, but firmly to gather. Sew end closed and weave in tail.

instructions: Note: When working Cuff, sl st loosely and do not ch at beg of rows. Cuff: With A, ch 17. 1st row: (RS). 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sl st in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 16 sl st. 2nd row: Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each sl st across. Turn. Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 14" [35.5 cm], ending on a WS row. Join Cuff: Working in back loops only, sl st last row and rem loops of foundation ch tog. Fasten off. Leg: Join MC with sl st to side edge of Cuff. 1st rnd: Ch 1. Work 46 sc evenly around side edge of Cuff. Join with sl st to first sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep 2nd rnd until work from bottom of Cuff measures 9” [23 cm]. Heel: With RS facing, join MC with sl st to first sc. 1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 22 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep 2nd row for 2" [5 cm], ending on a WS row. Shape heel: 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 9 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 10 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 11 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 12 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 13 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 7th and 8th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 14 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 15 sts. Fasten off at end of 8th row. Joining rnd: With RS facing, join MC with sl st at left side of Heel Base. Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 23 sc of instep. Place marker. Work 7 sc up right side of Heel, 1 sc in each of next 15 sc across end of Heel and 7 sc down left side of Heel. Join with sl st to first sc. 52 sc. Nose: (make 1). With B, ch 2. 1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc. Fasten off. Ears: (make 2). With MC, ch 2. 1st row: (RS). 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. 4 sc. 3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 6 sc. 4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 8 sc. 5th to 10th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 11th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 12th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Fasten off. Antlers: (make 2). With C, ch 2. 1st row: (RS). 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 2nd to 7th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Fasten off after last row. Sew Eyes, Nose, Ears and Antlers to Stocking as shown in picture. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to marker. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep 2nd rnd until 44 sts rem. Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from joining rnd measures 5½" [14 cm]. Shape toe: 1st rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join with sl st to first sc. Cont in same manner, dec 4 sts on every rnd until 12 sts rem. Break yarn, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely. Hanging loop: With A, ch 25. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Fasten off. Fold in half and sew in position. Snowman Note: Ch 2 at beg of rows or rnds count as hdc. Eyes: (make 2). With C, ch 2. 1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 2. (1 dc. 1 hdc) in same sp as last sl st. (1 hdc. 1 dc. 1 hdc) in each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. Fasten off. Nose: (make 1). With B, ch 3. 1st row: 3 hdc in 3rd ch from hook (counts as 4 hdc). Turn. 2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Turn. 4 hdc. 3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Turn. 5 hdc. 4th to 7th rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Turn. Fasten off after 7th row. Sew Eyes and Nose to Stocking as shown in picture. Reindeer Eyes: (make 2). With C, ch 2. 1st row: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. 4 sc. 3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 6 sc. 4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join A. Turn. 8 sts. 5th row: With A, ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 hdc. Sc2tog. Turn. 6th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 7th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Fasten off.

NOTE: Instructions are for two sets as shown in photograph.

Body (make 1 each with A and D)
Ch 6.

Head

With A, ch 192. Place marker on every 50th ch for easier counting.

1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *Ch 5. Skip next 3 ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to last 2 ch. Ch 2. Skip next ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. 47 ch-5 sps.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. Skip next ch-2 sp. *7 dc in next ch-5 sp. 1 sc in next ch-5 sp.** Ch 5. 1 sc in next ch-5 sp. Rep from *, ending last rep at **. Ch 2. 1 tr in last sc. Turn. 15 pat reps.

3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first tr. *Ch 5. Skip next sc and dc. 1 sc in next dc. Ch 5. Skip next 3 dc. 1 sc in next dc.** Ch 5. Skip next dc and sc. 1 sc in next ch-5 sp. Rep from *, ending last rep at **. Ch 2. Skip next dc. 1 tr in last sc. Turn.

Rep 2nd and 3rd rows for pat until work from beg measures approx 28" [71cm], ending on a 3rd row. Join B. Break A.

With B, rep 2nd and 3rd rows once more. Join C. Break B.

With C, rep 2nd and 3rd rows once more. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Pin Curtain to measurements and cover with damp cloth, leaving cloth to dry.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 334 Buff A, 319 Cherry Red B, 313 Aran C, and 385 Royal D
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Ornament measures 6½" (16.5 cm) tall, excluding pompom.
gauge: 4 sc = 1" (2.5 cm); 4 rounds = 1" (2.5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
ORNAMENT (make 2)
Head
Beginning at top, with A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—18 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—24 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—30 sc. 
Rounds 7–11: Repeat Round 5.
Round 12: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around—15 sc.
Round 13: Repeat Round 5; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. 
With D, embroider French knot eyes on Round 10.
Body
Beginning at bottom, with B, ch 2.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of head—12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—15 sc.
Rounds 4–8: Work same as Round 5 of head.
Round 9: *Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around—12 sc. 
Round 10: Work same as Round 5 of head. Stuff body with fiberfill.
Round 11: Work same as Round 12 of head; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through last round and pull closed.
Arm (make 2) 
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work same as Round 1 of head—6 sc.
Round 2: Repeat Round 3 of head—9 sc.
Rounds 3–6: Repeat Round 5 of head; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Do not stuff.
Beard 
With C, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—2 sc.
Row 2 (right side): Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc, turn—4 sc.
Rows 3 and 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—8 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog; *working in ends of rows, work 6 sc evenly spaced* down first side; working in opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in ch; repeat from * to * up other side; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Waistband
With C, ch 18.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Hat
Ribbing
With C, ch 5.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—4 sc.
Rows 2–29: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc across, turn.
Row 30: Repeat last row; change to B, turn.
Crown
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, working in ends of rows, sc in each row across, turn—30 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—24 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—18 sc.
Row 5: Repeat Row 3.
Row 6: Ch 1, *sc in next sc, sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—12 sc.
Row 7: Repeat Row 3. 
Row 8: Ch 1, *sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Assembly
Arms Weave tail through last round and pull stitches closed, then sew in place at top of body.
Head & Body Stuff head with fiberfill. 
Push Round 13 of head onto top of body. 
With end tail, sew securely around to join head to body. Sew waistband around body.
Hat Weave tail through last row and pull closed. Working through ends of rows, sew back seam. Working in ends of ribbing, sew hat on head.
FINISHING
Pompom (make 2)
Cut a 15" (38 cm) strand of C and set aside. Wrap C around 4 fingers 50 times. 
Carefully slide loops off fingers and tie single strand very tightly around center of loops. 
Do not cut or trim center tie. Cut loops open at both ends. Shake and trim evenly to desired length. Thread ends of center tie through top of hat and secure pompom. 
Cut strand of white embroidery floss to desired length for hanging loop, thread through top of ornament and tie ends in a knot. 
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 334 Buff A, 400 Grey Heather B, 316 Soft White C, 312 Black D, and 321 Gold E

instructions:
Head and Body (For Both Man and Woman)
Beginning at top of head with A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [inc] 6 times; join—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in sc, inc] 6 times; join—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, inc] 6 times; join—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in 3 sc, inc] 6 times; join—30 sc.
Rounds 6-11: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join. Stuff as you go along.
Round 12: Ch 1, [sc in 3 sc, dec] 6 times; join—24 sc.
Round 13: Ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, dec] 6 times; join—18 sc.
Round 14: Ch 1, [sc in sc, dec] 6 times; join—12 sc.
Round 15: Ch 1, [dec] 6 times changing to B in last st; join—6 sc.
Round 16: With B, repeat Round 2—12 sc.
Round 17: Repeat Round 3—18 sc.
Round 18: Repeat Round 4—24 sc. Continue stuffing.
Rounds 19-22: Repeat Round 6. For Man only change to D in last sc of Round 22.
Rounds 23 and 24: Repeat Round 6. For Man only change to B in last sc of Round 24.
Lower body (Man and Woman)
Round 25: With B for Man, and C for Woman, working in remaining back loops only of Round 24, ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, dec] 6 times; join—18 sc. Continue stuffing.
Round 26: Ch 1, [sc in sc, dec] 6 times; join—12 sc.
Round 27: Ch 1, [dec] 6 times; join—6 sc. Fasten off.
Arms (Both Man and Woman)
With B, ch 8; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rounds 1-5: Ch 1, sc in each ch around changing to C in last sc of Round 5; join—8 sc.
Rounds 6 and 7: With C, ch 1, sc in each sc around changing to A in last sc of Round 7; join.
Row 8: Pinch arm to work through 2 thicknesses. With A, ch 1, sc in 4 sc to close; turn—4 sc.
Fingers: * Ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next ch **, slip st in next sc; repeat from * across, end at **—4 fingers. Fasten off. Stuff and whipstitch top of arm closed, leaving long tail for sewing.
Feet (Both Man and Woman)
Round 1: With D, ch 4; 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, 3 sc in last ch; join—7 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [inc] 3 times, sc in next sc, [inc] 3 times; join—14 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in 9 sc, dec3, sc in last 2 sc; join—12 sc.
Nose (Both Man and Woman)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook; join—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join. Fasten off leaving tail for sewing.
Collar (Both Man and Woman)
With C, ch 13.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn—12 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, [sc in sc, inc] 6 times—18 sc. Fasten off leaving long tail for sewing.
Man’s Hat
With B, ch 2.
Rounds 1-5: Work same as Head Rounds 1-5—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in back loops of each sc around; join.
Rounds 7-11: Ch 1, sc in both loops of each sc around changing to D in last sc of Round 11; join.
Round 12: With D, ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Round 13: Ch 1, [sc in 4 sc, inc] 6 times changing to B in last sc; join—36 sc.
Round 14: With B, ch 1, sc in front loops of each sc around; join.
Round 15: Ch 1, working in both loops [sc in 5 sc, inc] 6 times; join—42 sc.
Round 16: Ch 1, [sc in 6 sc, inc] 6 times; join—48 sc.
Round 17: Ch 1, [sc in 7 sc, inc] 6 times; join—54 sc.
Round 18: Ch 1, [sc in 8 sc, inc] 6 times; join—60 sc. Fasten off.
Man’s Hair
With D, working in remaining back loops of Round 14, join in any loop; ch 1, (sc, ch 6) in each loop around; join—36 loops. Fasten off leaving long tail for sewing to head.
Woman’s Hat
With C, ch 2.
Rounds 1-5: Work same as Head Rounds 1-5—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in back loops of each sc around; join.
Rounds 7 and 8: Working in both loops, ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Row 1: Ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, inc] 10 times; turn—40 sc.
Rows 2-6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, dec] 10 times—30 sc. Fasten off.
Tie for Woman’s Hat
With C, ch 7, sc in remaining front loops of Row 6 of Woman’s Hat, ch 7. Fasten off.
Woman’s Hair
With E, attach 6 short fringes to 6 back loops of Row 7 of woman’s hat.
Woman’s Apron
With C, ch 13.
Row 1: Sc in each ch across; turn—12 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, inc, sc in next 10 sc, inc; turn—14 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, inc, sc in next 12 sc, inc; turn—16 sc.
Rows 5-8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 8.
Tie for Woman’s Apron
With C, ch 22, 12 sc across foundation row of Apron, ch 22. Fasten off.
FINISHING (Both Man and Woman)
Using photo for placement, sew arms between Rounds 18 and 19 of body. Sew legs to bottom of body. Sew nose between Rounds 8 and 9 of head. Sew collar around neck. Sew hats in place. With D, embroider eyes and mouth. For man only, with E, embroider buckles on hat, belt, and shoes. For woman only, tie apron around waist. Trim woman’s bangs to match picture.

instructions:
SnOWFLaKe a
Ch 5.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 7. Sl st in last sc worked. (1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next dc) twice. Rep from * 4 times more. Ch 7. Sl st in last sc worked. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next dc. Do not join. Leave rem st unworked.
3rd rnd: *(6 dc. Ch 3. Sl st in last dc worked – picot made. 5 dc) in next ch-7 sp. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Miss next sc. Rep from * 5 times more. Join with sl st to last sc of 2nd rnd. Fasten off.

SnOWFLaKe B
Ch 5.

Ch 4.

2nd rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). 1 dc in next dc. (Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. 1 dc in next dc) 4 times. Ch 3. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook – picot made) in same sp as last sl st. **In next ch-3 sp: *(Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – dc cluster made. Ch 2. *(Yoh) twice and draw up a loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.* Rep from * to * once more. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – tr cluster made. Ch 5. Sl st in top of tr cluster – long picot made. Ch 2. Dc cluster.*** 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Picot. Rep from ** 3 times more, then from ** to *** once. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

SnOWFLaKe D
Ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 dc in 5th ch from hook (counts as 1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc). (Ch 1. 1 dc) 4 times in same sp. Ch 1. Join with sl st to 3rd ch. 6 dc and ch-1 sps.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice in same sp as last sl st. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – beg cluster made. Ch 1. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times in next ch-1 sp. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – cluster made. Ch 1. Cluster in next dc. *Ch 5. (Cluster in next ch-1 sp or dc. Ch 1) 3 times. Rep from * twice more. Ch 5. Join with sl st to top of beg cluster.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Beg cluster in same sp. Ch 1. Cluster in next ch-1 sp. *Ch 5. 1 sc in next ch-5 sp. Ch 5. Cluster in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Cluster in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 5. 1 sc in last ch-5 sp. Ch 5. Join with sl st to top of beg cluster.

Long picot in last cluster. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st to top of beg cluster. Fasten off.

instructions:
SMALL BOX COVER
Main Section
**With MC, ch 17. 
1st row:(RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. 
15 dc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. Miss first dc. 1 dc in next dc and each dc to end of row. Turn.**
Rep last row 9 times more.
Divide for opening: Next row: (WS). Ch 3. Miss first dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 9. Miss center 9 dc. 1 dc in each of last 3 dc. Turn.
Next row:Ch 3. Miss first dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in each of next 9 ch. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Work a further 10 rows in dc across 15 dc. Fasten off.
SIDE (make 2)
Work from ** to ** as given for Main Section
Rep last row 6 times more. Fasten off.
Joining: With WS of pieces facing each other, pin 8 rows of each Side edge to corresponding 8 rows along Main Section. With RS of Main Section facing, join MC with sl st to any corner through both thicknesses. Work 17 sc through both thicknesses up side, 15 sc across top and 17 sc down other side. Do not turn.
Next row: With A, ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Rep on other side of Cover.
Bottom Edging: Join MC with sl st at any side seam. Work 66 sc evenly around. Join A with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: With A, ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 

MEDIUM BOX COVER
Main Section
With MC, ch 35. 
1st row:(RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. 
33 dc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. Miss first dc. 1 dc in next dc and each dc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 6 times more.
Divide for opening: Next row: (RS). Ch 3. Miss first dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Ch 21. Miss center 21 dc. 1 dc in each of last 6 dc. Turn.
Next row:Ch 3. Miss first dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. 1 dc in each of next 21 ch. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Work a further 7 rows in dc across 33 dc. Fasten off.
SIDE (make 2)
Work from ** to ** as given for Main Section of Small Box Cover.
Rep last row 3 times more. Fasten off.
Joining: With WS of pieces facing each other, pin 5 rows of each side edge to corresponding 5 rows along Main Section. With RS of Main Section facing, join MC with sl st to any corner through both thicknesses. Work 10 sc through both thicknesses up side, 15 sc across top and 10 sc down other side. Do not turn.
Next row: With A, ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Rep on other side of Cover.
Bottom Edging: Join MC with sl st at any side seam. Work 96 sc evenly around. Join A with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: With A, ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

instructions:
SnOWmAn

Round 1: With B, ch 4; join with slip st to first ch to form a ring; ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join – 18 sc. Drop B and carry up wrong side of work.
Round 3: With C, ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Round 4: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 9 times; join – 27 sc. Drop C; pick up B.
Round 5: With B, ch 1, sc in first sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 13 times; join – 40 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join. Drop B; pick up C.
Rounds 7 and 8: With C, ch 1, sc in each sc around; join. Drop C; pick up B.
Rounds 9 and 10: With B, ch 1, sc in each sc around; join. Drop B; pick up C.
Rounds 11-16: Repeat Rounds 7-10, then Rounds 7 and 8 once more.
Round 17: With B, ch 3, skip first sc, dc in next sc and in each sc around; join in top of ch-3.
Rounds 18 and 19: Ch 3, dc in next dc, bpdc around next 2 sts, [dc in next 2 dc, bpdc around next 2 sts] 9 times; join in top of ch-3. Fasten off at end of Round 19. Weave in ends.
SnOWmAn’S SCARf
Leave 2” yarn tails when joining and fastening off.
With B, ch 85. Fasten off.
Row 1 (Right Side): With C, slip st in each st across. Fasten off.
Row 2: With right side facing, join B; slip st in each st across. Fasten off.
Rows 3-6: Repeat Rows 1 and 2 twice.
Trim yarn tails on both ends to 1½” for fringe.
finiSHinG
Place hat and scarf on prepared snowman.

NOTES Front post double crochet (FPdc): Yo, insert hook from front to back to front again around the post of next st, [yo and draw through 2 loops] twice. dc2tog: Yo, insert hook in next st, yo and draw yarn through st, yo, draw yarn through 2 loops on hook, sk next st, yo, insert hook in next st, yo and pull up a loop, yo and draw through 2 loops on hook, yo and draw through remaining 3 loops on hook. STOCKING Toe With A, ch 7 Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, place marker in last st to mark side; working along bottom of ch, sc in each ch across to end, sc in last ch, place unique marker in last st to mark side; do not join, work in continuous rounds. Place marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed – 12 sc. Round 2: *Sc in each sc to one sc before marked st, 2 sc in next sc, sc in marked st, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * once, ending in first sc of last round – 16 sc. Round 3: Sc in each sc around. Round 4: *Sc in each sc to one sc before marked st, 2 sc in next sc, sc in marked st, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * once – 20 sc. Round 5: Sc in each sc around. Round 6: *Sc in each sc to one sc before marked st, 2 sc in next sc, sc in marked st, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * once – 24 sc. Round 7: Sc in each sc around. Round 8: *Sc in each sc to one sc before marked st, 2 sc in next sc, sc in marked st, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * once – 28 sc. Round 9: Sc in each sc around; join with a slip st in next sc. Join B with a sc in center sc on one side of foot, evenly space 28 more sc around; join with a slip st to first sc – 29 sc. Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in next 2 sc, 3 dc in next sc, dc in next 3 sc, dc2tog over next 3 sc, *dc in next 3 sc, 3 dc in next sc, dc in next 3 sc, dc2tog over next 3 sc; repeat from * around, ending with final leg of last dc2tog in same st as beginning ch-3 of round; join with a slip st in beginning ch-3 – 3 ripples. Drop B to wrong side to be picked up later. Round 3: With right side facing, join C with a slip st in top of first dc after beginning ch-3, ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, dc2tog over next 3 dc, *dc in next 3 dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, dc2tog over next 3 dc; repeat from * around, ending with final leg of last dc2tog in same st as beginning ch-3 of round; join with a slip st in beginning ch-3 – 3 ripples. Drop C to wrong side to be picked up later. Round 4: Pick up B, slip st in top of first dc after repeat ch-3 of previous row, ch 3, dc in next 2 sc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 sts, dc2tog over next 3 sts, *dc in next 3 sts, 3 dc in next st, dc in next 3 sts, dc2tog over next 3 sts; repeat from * around, ending with final leg of last dc2tog in same st as beginning ch-3 of round; join with a slip st in beginning ch-3 – 3 ripples.
