Row 1: Join A with a sc at one side of foot, sc in next 14 sts, turn – 15 sc. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, ch 1, turn. Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across to within last st, turn, leaving last st un-worked – 14 sc. Rows 4-10: Repeat row 3 – 7 sc remain at end of last row. Row 11: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Row 12: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, sc in unworked st in row below closest to current row, slip st in side of that row, turn – 8 sc. Row 13: Skip slip st, sc in each sc across, sc in unworked st in row below closest to current row, slip st in side of that row, turn – 9 sc. Row 14-19: Repeat row 13 – 15 sc at end of last row. Fasten off. Leg NOTE: Work now progresses in rounds. Ripples will match up with the ripples on the foot. Round 1: With right side facing, join B with a slip st in first dc to the left of dc2tog in round 9 of foot, ch 3, dc in next 2 sts, 3 dc in next st, dc in next 3 sts, dc2tog over next 3 sts, *dc in next 3 sts, 3 dc in next st, dc in next 3 sts, dc2tog over next 3 sts; repeat from * around, ending with final leg of last dc2tog in same st as beginning ch-3 of round; join with a slip st in beginning ch-3 – 3 ripples. Drop B to wrong side to be picked up later. Round 2: With right side facing, join C with a slip st in top of first dc after beginning ch-3, ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, dc2tog over next 3 dc, *dc in next 3 dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, dc2tog over next 3 dc; repeat from * around, ending with final leg of last dc2tog in same st as beginning ch-3 of round; join with a slip st in beginning ch-3 – 3 ripples. Drop C to wrong side to be picked up later. Round 3: Pick up B, slip st in top of first dc after repeat ch-3 of previous row, ch 3, dc in next 2 sc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, dc2tog over next 3 dc, *dc in next 3 dc, 3 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 sc, dc2tog over next 3 dc; repeat from * around, ending with final leg of last dc2tog in same st as beginning ch-3 round; join with a slip st in beginning ch-3 – 3 ripples. Drop B. Rounds 4-15: Repeat rounds 2 and 3 (6 times). Round 16: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, work 29 more sc evenly spaced around; join with a slip st in first sc – 30 dc. Fasten off B and C. Cuff Round 1: With right side facing, join A with a slip st in any sc, ch 3, dc in each sc around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 30 dc. Round 2: Ch 3, FPdc around the post of next dc, *dc in next dc, FPdc around the post of next dc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in beginning ch-3. Round 3: Ch 3, FPdc around the post of next FPdc, *dc in next dc, FPdc around the post of next FPdc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in beginning ch-3. Fasten off. HANGING LOOP With B, ch 25, slip st in each ch across. Fasten off, leaving a sewing length. Fold hanging loop in half and sew in place on center back of cuff. FINISHING Weave in ends. materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 334 Buff A, 235 Lemon B, and 376 Burgundy C. Note: Only a small amount of each yarn color is needed.
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 3.75 mm [US F-5].
Polyester fiberfill, 18" [45.5 cm] thin gold ribbon (for hanger), yarn needle
abbreviations: A, B, and C = Color A, B, and C
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 20 sts = 4" [10 cm]; 20 rows/rounds = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CRUST
With A, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc—4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc, sc in last sc—6 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each of first 2 sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc, sc in each of last 2 sc—8 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in each of first 3 sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc, sc in each of last 3 sc—10 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, sc in each of first 4 sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc, sc in each of last 4 sc—12 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 11: Ch 1, turn, sc in each of first 5 sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc, sc in each of last 5 sc—14 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 13: Ch 1, turn, sc in each of first 6 sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc, sc in each of last 6 sc—16 sc.
Row 14: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 15: Ch 1, turn, sc in each of first 7 sc, 2 sc in each of next 2 sc, sc in each of last 7 sc—18 sc.
Row 16: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 17: Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across. Note: The free front loops should show at the bottom of the Crust when all pieces are sewn together.
Edging: Ch 1, turn, 3 sc in first sc, slip st in next sc, *3 sc in next sc, slip st in next sc; repeat from * across; working in ends of rows, work sc evenly spaced along side edge of Crust, 3 sc in point, sc evenly spaced along other side edge of Crust, slip st.
Fasten off.

CHEESE
With B, ch 2.
Rows 1–16: Work same as Rows 1–16 of Crust—18 sc.
Fasten off.

Sauce: Working in back loops only, join C with slip st in the first back loop of Row 16, slip st in each back loop across. Note: The free front loops of Row 16 should show at the top of the Cheese when all pieces are sewn together. Fasten off.

PEPPERONI (make 5)
With C, ch 3.
Row 1: Work 7 hdc in 3rd ch from hook; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

FINISHING
With A, sew Cheese to Crust, stuffing very lightly before completing seam. With C, sew each piece of Pepperoni to Cheese, inserting needle through middle of Pepperoni.
Fold gold ribbon in half. Insert crochet hook around a few stitches at the top of the ornament, place ribbon fold on hook and draw through to form a loop. Thread ends of ribbon through loop and pull to tighten. Tie ends together with a bow or overhand knot to form hanging loop.
Weave in any remaining ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of Main Color MC and Contrast Color CC. Colors Used: 319 Cherry Red, 316 Soft White, and 368 Paddy Green.
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[] = work directions given in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 12 sts = 4”; 15 rows = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
LEG
With MC, ch 31 (43, 47).
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 30 (42, 46) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Repeat Row 2 and work stripe pattern of 8 rows MC and 2 rows CC until 6 (9, 11½)” from beginning, end wrong side row. Fasten off.
HEEL: With right side facing, skip 23 (32, 35) sc; join CC and sc in last 7 (10, 11) sc; bring other side of leg around and sc in first 7 (10, 11) sc; turn – 14 (20, 22) sc.
Next Row: Ch 1, dec, sc in each sc to last 2 sc; dec; turn – 12 (18, 20) sc.
Repeat last row to dec 1 st each end of every row until 4 sts remain. Now increase 1 st at each end of every row until there are 14 (20, 22) sc. Fasten off.
FOOT: With right side facing, skip first 7 (10, 11) sc of heel, join MC and sc in last 7 (10, 11) sc, [dec over next 2 sc of leg] twice, sc in next 8 (14, 16) sc of leg, [dec over next 2 sc of leg] twice, sc in remaining 7 (10, 11) sc of heel; turn – 26 (38, 42) sc. Work even in sc and stripe pattern until foot measures 3 (5, 6)” from last row of heel, end wrong side row. Cut MC.
TOE-Next Row: With CC, ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. ** Next Row: Ch 1, dec, sc in next 9 (15, 17) sc, dec; turn – 11 (17, 19) sc.
Dec 1 st each end of every row until 3 sc remain. Fasten off. **
With wrong side facing, join CC in next sc of last long row. Repeat from ** to **.
FINISHING: Sew toe, foot, heel, and back seams.
Top Edging and Hanging Loop: With right side facing, attach CC at back seam.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each st of beginning ch around; join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join; ch 12, slip st in same st as joining; slip st in each ch of ch-12. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Heart & Sole™ with Aloe”: 1 Ball each 3940 Green Envy, 3955 Mellow Stripe, or 3945 Rustica.
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified

instructions:
Ch 8; join with a sl st in first ch to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 23 dc in ring; join with a sl st in top of ch-3 – 24 sts.
Rnd 2: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch-1 sp), * dc in next dc, ch 1; rep from * around; join with a sl st in 3rd ch of ch-4 – 24 sts and 24 ch-1 sps.
Rnd 3: Ch 3, 2 dc in next ch-1 sp, * dc in next dc, 2 dc in next ch-1 sp; rep from * around; join – 72 sts.
Rnd 4: Ch 1, sc in same ch as joining; * skip next 2 dc; ([dc, ch 1] twice, tr, [ch 1, dc] twice) all in next dc – shell made; skip next 2 dc **, sc in next dc; rep from * around, end at **; join with a sl st in first sc – 12 shells.
Rnd 5: Sl st in next 5 sts across to tr, ch 1, sc in same tr, ch 7, * sc in tr of next shell, ch 7; rep from * around; join – 12 ch-7 sps.
Rnd 6: Ch 3, 9 dc in next ch-7 sp, * dc in next sc, 9 dc in next ch-7 sp; rep from * around; join – 120 sts.
Rnd 7: Ch 3 (counts as hdc and ch-1 sp), skip next dc, * hdc in next dc, ch 1, skip next dc; rep from * around; join with a sl st in 2nd ch of ch-3 – 60 sts and 60 ch-1 sps.
Rnd 8: Sl st in next ch-1 sp, ch 3, dc in same sp, * 3 dc in next ch-1 sp **, 2 dc in next ch-1 sp; rep from * around, end at **; join – 150 sts. 
Rnd 9: Rep Rnd 4 – 25 shells. Fasten off. Weave in ends. Frame as shown.

materials: Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
measurements: Full Flower: Approx 4 ins [10 cm] wide. Flower Bud: Approx 2 ins [5 cm] long.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions: FULL FLOWER (Make 3 each with MC, A and B). Ch 4, leaving a long end to use for gathering center closed when Rose is complete. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring. 1st rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc. 2 hdc. 2 dc. 3 tr) all in ring. Join with sl st in first sc. 2nd rnd: Working behind 1st rnd, ch 1. Sl st between first 2 sc. Ch 3. Sl st between next 2 hdc. Ch 3. Sl st between next 2 dc. Ch 3. Sl st between next 2 tr. Ch 3. Sl st after last tr. Ch 3. Join with sl st to first sc. 5 ch-3 loops. 3rd rnd: *Ch 1. (5 dc. Sl st) in next ch-3 loop. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first ch 1. 5 petals. 4th rnd: Working behind last rnd, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 5. Sl st in sp between next 2 petals. Rep from * 3 times more. Ch 5. Join with sl st in first sc. 5 ch-5 loops. 5th rnd: *Ch 1. (2 dc. 4 tr. 2 dc. Sl st) in next ch-5 loop. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first ch 1. 5 petals. 6th rnd: Working behind last rnd, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 7. Sl st in sp between next 2 petals. Rep from * 3 times more. Ch 7. Join with sl st in first sc. 5 ch-7 loops. 7th rnd: *Ch 1. (3 dc. 5 tr. 3 dc. Sl st) in next ch-7 loop. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first ch 1. 5 petals. Fasten off. Thread end at starting ring onto a tapestry needle and gather center tog tightly to close flower. FLOWER BUD (Make 2 each with MC, A and B). With C, ch 2. 1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) twice. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 8 sc. 3rd rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 4 times. Join MC, A or B with sl st in first sc. 12 sc. Break C. 4th rnd: With MC, A or B, ch 1. Working in back loop only of each sc work 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Miss next sc. 5 sc in next sc – shell made. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * twice more. Miss next sc. Shell in next sc. Miss next sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 6th rnd: Working behind last rnd, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 4. Sl st in sp between next 2 petals. Rep from * once more. Ch 4. Join with sl st in first sc. 3 ch-4 loops. 7th rnd: *Ch 1. (4 dc. 1 hdc. 1 sc. Sl st) in next ch-4 loop. Rep from * twice more. Join with sl st in first ch 1. Fasten off. STEMS (make 15). With C, ch 51. 1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 50 sc. Fasten off. LEAVES (make 30): With C, ch 5. 1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 5 dc in last ch. Working into opposite side of ch into rem loops, 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. FINISHING Cut floral wire in lengths to fit stems and weave through stem. Sew 2 leaves to each stem. Attach Full Flowers or Flower Buds to stem end.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 Skein each 313 Aran A, 334 Buff B, 400 Grey Heather C, 505 Aruba Sea D, 319 Cherry Red E, 312 Black F, 256 Carrot G.
Split-ring stitch marker, stuffing, yarn needle, black embroidery floss and embroidery needle, 3 ¼” black buttons, 4 ¼” red buttons, red crayon.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
To Change Color: Work last st of row until 2 loops are left on hook, drop old color, yo with new color and complete stitch. Fasten off old color.
gauge: 16 sc = 4”; 16 rounds = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SNOWMAN
Head & Body
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 6 sts.
Round 2: 2 sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Round 3: * Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Rounds 4-7: Sc in each st around.
Round 8: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around – 9 sts.
Round 9: 2 sc in each st around – 18 sts.
Round 10: * Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Rounds 11-14: Sc in each st around.
Round 15: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around – 12 sts.
Round 16: 2 sc in each st around – 24 sts.
Round 17: * Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Rounds 18-22: Sc in each st around.
Round 23: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around – 15 sts. Add stuffing.
Round 24: Sc in next st, [sc2tog] 7 times – 8 sts. Fasten off leaving a long tail. Weave tail through remaining sts and draw tight.
Carrot Nose
With G, ch 3.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, dc in next ch. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
Hat
With F, ch 2.
Rounds 1-3: Work same as Head & Body Rounds 1-3 – 18 sts.
Round 4: Working in back loops only, sc in each st around.
Rounds 5-7: Sc in each st around.
Round 8: Working in front loops only, 2 hdc in each st around – 36 sts. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Carrot Nose in half and sew into place on Snowman’s face. Embroider eyes according to picture. Sew buttons in place. Sew Hat on Head. Weave in ends.
BOY
Head & Body
With B, ch 2.
Rounds 1-8: Work same as Snowman Head & Body Rounds 1-8 – 9 sts.
Round 9: Sc in each st around.
Round 10: 2 sc in each st around – 18 sts.
Round 11: Sc in each st around.
Round 12: Repeat Round 11; change to C.
Round 13: With C, sc in each st around. 
Cuff-Round 11: Join A in any unused loop of Round 7, ch 1, sc in front loop only of each st around; join with a slip st. Fasten off.
Thumbs (Make 2)
With E, ch 2.
Row 1: Dc in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off. Fold in half and sew in place.
Hat
With C, ch 2.
Rounds 1-3: Work same as Snowman Head & Body Rounds 1-3; change to D at end of Round 3 – 18 sts
Round 4: With D, * sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 5: Sc in each st around; change to C.
Round 6: Sc in next 3 sts, * (sc, ch 1, hdc) all in next st, dc in next 2 sts, (hdc, ch 1, sc) all in next st, ** sc in next 10 sts; repeat from * to **; sc in next 3 sts. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Hat in place. Embroider face referring to photo. Color cheeks with red crayon. Sew Legs in place. Wrap Coat around Body with opening in front; sew opening closed. Sew Coat Panel over opening; sew buttons in place. Sew Collar around neck. Sew Arms to Coat referring to photo. Tack Boy and Snowman together referring to photo.
Legs (Make 2)
With E, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 6 sts.
Round 2: 2 sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Round 3: Sc in next 5 sts, [2 sc in next st] 2 times; sc in next 5 sts – 14 sts.
Round 4: Working in back loops only, sc in each st around.
Round 5: Sc in next 5 sts, [sc2tog] 2 times; sc in next 5 sts – 12 sts.
Round 6: * Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 8 sts.
Round 7: Sc in each st around.
Round 8: Working in front loops only, * sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; change to C – 12 sts.
Round 9: With C, working in unused back loops of Round 7, sc in each st around – 8 sts.
Round 10: Sc in each st around. Fasten off. Add stuffing. Turn up cuff of boot.
Coat
With D, ch 13.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 12 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in 1st st, 2 sc in next st, * sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * across; turn – 18 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in 1st 5 sts, 2 sc in next st, * sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * across; turn – 21 sts.
Rows 4-8: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 8.
Collar
With A, ch 15.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 14 sts. Fasten off.
Coat Panel
With D, ch 9.
Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 8 sts. Fasten off.
Arms (Make 2)
With D, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 6 sts.
Round 2: * Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 9 sts.
Rounds 3-7: Sc in each st around. Fasten off D at end of Round 7.
Round 8: Join E in back loop of any st, ch 1, sc in back loop only of each st around.
Rounds 9-10: Sc in each st around. At end of Round 10, add stuffing, fasten off and draw remaining sts together.

instructions:
Snowflake 1
See Diagram on page 3.
Ch 6. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.

See Diagram on page 3.

3rd rnd: Sl st back into last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 1. 6 dc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 6. Sl st to first ch. Turn. (Ch 4. 2 tr. Ch 4. Sl st) 3 times in last ch-6 sp made  – top cluster made. Turn. 6 dc in same ch-3 sp as last 6 dc. Ch 1.** 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * 4 times more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Snowflake 3
See Diagram on page 3.
Ch 6. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd:  Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch 3). (1 dc. Ch 3) 11 times in ring. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 6. 12 ch-3 sps.
2nd rnd: Sl st in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice in same sp as last sl st. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook  – beg cluster made. [Ch 5. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times in next ch-3 sp. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – cluster made ] 11 times. Ch 5. Join with sl st to top of first cluster.
3rd rnd: (Sl st. Ch 1. 1 sc. Ch 5. 1 sc) in next ch-5 sp. *(Sl st. Ch 3. Cluster) in next cluster. (Ch 3. Cluster in top of cluster just made) twice. (Ch 3. Sl st. Ch 6. Sl st. Ch 3. Sl st) all in top of last cluster. Working down towards 2nd rnd, (Ch 3. Sl st to base of cluster) 3 times. (1 sc. Ch 5. 1 sc) in next ch-5 sp. (Sl st. Ch 3. Cluster) in next cluster. (Ch 3. Sl st. Ch 6. Sl st. Ch 3. Sl st) all in top of cluster. Working down towards 2nd rnd, ch 3. Sl st to base of cluster.** (1 sc. Ch 5. 1 sc) in next ch-5 sp. Rep from * 4 times more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Pin Snowflake to measurements. Apply spray starch if desired and steam iron lightly.
Optional: Stiffening ornaments
Use white glue or glitter glue mixed with water. ¼ water to ¾ glue.  Pin snowflakes to measurements on a piece of cardboard covered with waxed paper.  Paint the glue mixture onto the snowflake, saturating well.  Let dry for at least 10 hours before removing the pins. Carefully remove the snowflake from the paper.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball each 9388 Wheat A, 4601 Off White B, 1882 Toast C, 4614 Black D, 5142 Cherry Red E, and 4420 Guacamole F
Yarn needle, stitch markers, fiberfill, 1 pair 6 mm black safety eyes
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 18 sc = 4” (10cm); 24 rows = 4” (10cm) in single
instructions:
This darling woodland critter is happy to make his home on your mantel or tree…or wherever you please. His bright crocheted scarf helps to keep him warm and more easily spotted.

Body and Head
Note: Insert stuffing firmly every few rounds.
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. 
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times—36 sc.
Rounds 7–18: Sc in each sc around.
Round 19: [Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 20: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 21: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 22 and 23: Sc in each sc around.
Round 24: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—24 sc. 
Round 25: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times—30 sc. Place stitch marker on this round for placement of nose.
Round 26: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times—36 sc. 
Round 27: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times—42 sc.
Rounds 28–30: Sc in each sc around.
Round 31: [Sc2tog, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times—36 sc. Place stitch marker on this round for placement of nose.
Round 32: Sc in each sc around. Place stitch marker between Rounds 31 and 32 for placement of safety eyes.
Round 33: [Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 34: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times—24 sc. 
Round 35: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 36: [Sc2tog, sc in next sc] 6 times—12 sc.
Round 37: Sc2tog 6 times—6 sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Attach safety eyes between Rounds 31 and 32, 10 sts apart. Insert more stuffing as needed for a firm head. Weave tail through remaining sts and pull tightly.

Nose
With B, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. 
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] twice—14 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] twice—16 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Insert stuffing. Using photograph as a guide for shape, with D and short stitches, embroider a snout to top of nose over Rounds 3 and 4. Sew nose to head between Rounds 25 and 31.

Belly patch 
Working from bottom up, with B, ch 6.
Row 1 (right side): Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch, turn—7 sc. 
Rows 2–11: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Row 12: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 5 sc, slip st in last sc—4 sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew belly patch to front of body.

Paws (make 2)
With C, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. 
Rounds 2–9: Sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc at end of Round 9—6 sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Position paws as shown in photograph and sew to body a few rows below neck.

Feet (make 2)
Work same as Rounds 1-4 of paws; join with slip st in first sc at end of Round 4.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Insert stuffing firmly. Sew feet to bottom of body.

Ears (make 2)
With C, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. 
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 3 times—9 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Using photograph as a guide for placement, fold ears in slightly and sew to head.

Tail
Note: Insert stuffing firmly every few rounds.
With C, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in ring; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc. 
Round 2: Sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Center and sew tail to lower back of body.

Scarf
With E, ch 51.
Row 1: Hdc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch count as first hdc), hdc in each ch across—50 hdc. 
Fasten off. Cut 8 lengths of F, each 3” (7.5 cm) long. *Hold 4 lengths together and fold them in half forming a loop at the fold. Insert crochet hook in end of scarf, place fold of strands on hook and draw loop through. Insert ends of folded strands into loop and pull to tighten; repeat from * to attach remaining 4 strands to other end. Trim fringe to even length. Wrap scarf around neck and, if desired, secure in place.

FINISHING
To make hanging loop, cut a length of A 15” (38 cm) long, thread through top of head, and tie ends in a knot.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Soft™: 1 ball each 9935 Waterscape A
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: 22 sts = 4”; 24 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
NOTES:
Do not join unless otherwise stated.
Place marker in first stitch of each round and move as work progresses. 
Component pieces are worked separately and sewn together using yarn tails or matching sewing thread. 
Head and body are worked from the bottom upwards.
Stomach patch is worked in 2 row stripes. When working stripes, do not carry non-working yarn.

OWL
Head and Body
Round 1: With A, Make 6 sc in adjustable loop – 6 sts.
Round 2: 2 sc in each st – 12 sts.
Round 3: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 24 sts. 
Round 5: *Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 30 sts. 
Round 6: *Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 36 sts. 
Round 7: *Sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 42 sts. 
Round 8: *Sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 48 sts. 
Rounds 9-14: Sc in each st.
Round 15: *Sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 42 sts.
Rounds 16-23: Sc in each st.
Round 24: *Sc in 5 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 36
sts.
Rounds 25 & 26: Sc in each st around, changing to B in last st of round 26. Fasten off A.
Rounds 27-38: Sc in each st – 36 sts.
Whooo will be the cutest little ornament on the 
tree? Crochet this owl in little time to add a cute 
quirky note to your tree, or display him all year 
round and he’ll put a smile on your face.

Round 39: (Sc in next 14 sts, hdc in next 4 sts) twice – 36 
sts.
Round 40: (Sc in next 14 sts, dc in next 4) twice – 36 sts.
Fasten off, leaving 8” tail for sewing. Stuff firmly. Using tail 
and yarn needle sew top of head closed. Weave in ends.

Wings (Make 2)
With A, ch 9, join with slip st to form ring. 
Round 1: 9 sc in ring – 9 sts.
Rounds 2 & 3: Sc in each st – 9 sts.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 12 sts.
Round 5: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 6: *Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 7: Sc in each st around, changing to B in last st – 24 sts.
Round 8: With B, sc in each st.
Next Step: Flatten ring, ch 1 and working through both layers, sc in next 12 matching pairs of sts, changing to C in last st – 12 sts.
Next Row: Ch 2, 2 hdc in same st and in each st across – 24 sts. Fasten off.

Stomach Patch
With C, ch 11,
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each st across, changing to B in last st, ch 1; turn – 10 sts.
Row 2: 2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in last st, ch 1; turn – 12 sts.
Row 3: Sc in each st across, changing to F in last st, ch 1; turn – 12 sts.
Row 4: Sc in each st across, ch 1; turn.
Row 5: 2 sc in next st, sc in next10 sts, 2 sc in last st, changing to C in last st, ch 1; turn – 14 sts.
Rows 6 & 7: Sc in each st across, changing to B in last st of Row 7, ch 1; turn.
Row 8: 2 sc in next st, sc in next 12 sts, 2 sc in last st, changing to C in last st, ch 1; turn – 16 sts.
Row 9: Sc in each st across, changing to F in last st, ch 1; turn – 16 sts.
Rows 10 & 11: Sc in each st across, changing to C in last st of Row 11, ch 1; turn – 16 sts.
Rows 12 & 13: Sc in each st across. Fasten off after row 13. 
Edging: Join B to 1st st of Row 13, *picot, sc in next st, slip st in next st; repeat form * around all 4 sides. Fasten off.

Eye Patches (make 2)
Round 1: With E, sc 6 times in adjustable loop, join with a 
slip st, ch 1; turn – 6 sc.
Round 2:  2 sc in each st around, join with slip st, ch 1; 
turn – 12 sts.
Round 3: *2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in beginning sc – 18 sts). Fasten off.
Round 4: Join C in any st, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc – 18 sc. Fasten off. 

Beak
With D, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch across, ch 1; turn – 5 sts.
Row 2: Sc in each st across, ch 1; turn – 5 sts.
Row 3: Skip 1st st, sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog, ch 1; turn – 3 
sts.
Row 4: Skip 1st st, sc2tog, ch 1; turn – 1 st.
Fasten off.

Feet
Note: Each foot consists of 3 little toes. Each toe is made 
by working a sc into each of 3 chain sts. Your piece may 
become a little twisted as you work. Untwist the piece, so 
that all of the toes are facing in the same direction, before 
sewing feet to owl. For best results, do not turn rows. 
Instead, work in the back bumps of the chain sts.
With D, ch 4. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch (toe made), 
ch 3 sc, 1 ch-4 edge loop.
Row 2: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 2 ch (toe made), 
ch 4 – 3 sc, 1 ch-4 edge loop.
Row 3: Repeat Row 2
Row 4: Ch 6, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in 3 chs, leaving 2 
ch un-worked, (these ch will separate the feet), ch – 3 sc, 
1 ch-4 edge loop.
Row 5 & 6: Repeat Row 2.
Fasten off. 

FINISHING
Using sewing thread & needle, attach stomach piece to 
lower part of body, making sts along the sides and edges 
just below the picot. 
Attach wings to body using yarn tail. Sew beak & eye 
patches onto face as pictured using sewing thread. 
Using sewing thread and needle, sew on feet at bottom 
front edge of owl.  
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Celebration™: 1 ball each 9340 Aqua/Silver A, 9840 Blue/Silver B, 9740 Pink/Silver C, 9540 Purple/Silver D, 9240 Lime/Silver E, and 9640 Gold/Silver F
size 10 steel crochet hook or any size hook that will fit through bead hole
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Stocking measures 7” (18 cm) long and 5” (12.5 cm) across from toe to heel
gauge: Gauge is not important for this project.
instructions:
Assembly
Holding pieces of same color together with toes, heels, and tops matching, whipstitch around edges, leaving top open. Turn inside out.
Cuff
Note: Continue working in rounds.
With heel seam facing, insert hook in first sc to left of seam and pull up a loop.
Round 1: Working across ends of rows, ch 1, *sc in next 2 rows, 2 sc in next row, sc in next 7 rows, 2 sc in next row, sc in each of next 2 rows and seam; repeat from * once; join with slip st in first st, turn—32 sc.
Rounds 2-4: Ch 1, sc in each st; join with slip st in first st, turn.
Round 5: *Ch 1, remove hook; with steel hook, pull loop through bead hole; with standard hook, ch 1, skip next sc, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first ch—16 bell beads. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Turn over cuff.
To make loop hanger: With double strand and leaving 4” (10 cm) tails, ch 10. Fasten off, leaving 4” (10 cm) tails. Pull tails through back of cuff over seam and tie together.
Weave in all ends.
Notes
1. Each stocking is made from 2 identical pieces sewn together with one right side facing and the other with the wrong side facing.
2. Each stocking requires 16 bell beads; 96 bell beads are needed to make one stocking in each color yarn.
STOCKING (make 2 of each color)
Working from toe, ch 5.
Row 1 (right side): Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, turn—4 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last sc, 2 sc in last st, turn—6 sc.
Row 3: Repeat Row 2—8 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Row 5: Repeat Row 2—10 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in each st, ch 14, turn—10 sc and 14 chs.
Row 7: Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 12 ch, working in both loops, sc in next 10 sc, turn—23 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first 14 st, hdc in next 4 st, dc in next 5 st, turn—14 sc, 4 hdc, and 5 dc.
Rows 9-15: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn—23 sc.
Row 16: Repeat Row 8.
Row 17: Ch 1, sc in each st to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—22 sc.
Row 18: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st, turn—21 sc.
Row 19: Ch 1, sc in first 14 st, hdc in next 3 st, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st, sc in next st, slip st in last st. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”, in 319 Cherry Red, 774 Light Raspberry, 972 Pink Camo, or desired color.
Yarn needle; potpourri, scented beads or fiberfill.
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 15 sts = 4”; 10 rows = 4” in Hdc (half double crochet). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEART (Make 2)
Using color of your choice, ch 3.
Row 1 (Right Side): Work 2 hdc in 3rd ch from hook; turn – 2 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2, 2 hdc in each st; turn – 4 sts.
Row 3: Ch 2, 2 hdc in first st, hdc in each st across to last st, 2 hdc in last st; turn – 6 sts.
Rows 4-8: Repeat last row – 16 sts.
First Side
Row 9: Ch 2, hdc in next 6 sts, [yo and draw up a loop in the next st] 2 times, yo and draw through all 5 loops on the hook = hdc2tog made; turn – 7 sts, leave remaining sts unworked.
Rows 10-12: Ch 2, hdc in each st across to last 2, hdc2tog; turn – 4 sts. Fasten off.
Second Side
Row 9: With right side facing, join yarn in next st on last long row, ch 2, hdc2tog, hdc in each st across; turn – 7 sts.
Row 10-12: Ch 2, hdc2tog, hdc in each st across; turn – 4 sts. Fasten off.
FINISHING: 
With right side facing, join yarn in top center “V” of Heart, ch 1, sc in same st, sc evenly around.
Join Hearts
With wrong sides together and matching stitches, hold both Hearts together, and sc through both layers to join pieces. Leave an opening for stuffing. Stuff with potpourri, fiberfill or scented beads. Continue to sc pieces closed, slip st to first sc to join; turn.
Picot Round: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in next 2 sts, *ch 4, slip st in 3rd ch from hook – picot made, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around; slip st to first st to join; turn.
Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Contrast A Soft Ecru (01004) 1 ball or 110 yds/100.5 m
Contrast B Overcast (01042) 1 ball or 105 yds/96 m
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Beglnkdc = Insert hook down through horizontal bar in center of previous stitch, yoh and pull up a loop. Insert hook into ring, yoh and pull up a loop. Yoh and pull through first 2 loops on hook. Yoh and pull through last 2 loops on hook – Beginning Linked Dc made.

Lnkdc = Insert hook down through horizontal bar in center of previous stitch, yoh and pull up a loop. Insert hook in next stitch (through top loops in usual manner), yoh and pull up a loop. Yoh and pull through first 2 loops on hook. Yoh and pull through last 2 loops on hook – Linked Dc made.
gauge: 14 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• To join new color, work to last loops on hook of first color. Yoh with new color, draw through loops and proceed with new color.
• Do not join rnds. Move marker up each rnd to maintain rnd count.
• After set-up rnd, beg first lnkdc of each rnd in horizontal bar of last st in previous rnd.

CHARGER
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
Set-up rnd: With A, ch 3 (does not count as st). (1 dc. 4 beglnkdc) in ring. With B, 5 beglnkdc in ring. PM on last st worked. 10 sts.
1st rnd: With B, 2 lnkdc in each of next 5 sts. With A, 2 lnkdc in each of next 5 sts. 20 lnkdc.
2nd rnd: (With A, 1 lnkdc in next st. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. (With B, 1 lnkdc in next st. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. 30 lnkdc.
3rd rnd: (With B, 1 lnkdc in each of next 2 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. (With A, 1 lnkdc in each of next 2 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. 40 lnkdc.
4th rnd: (With A, 1 lnkdc in each of next 3 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. (With B, 1 lnkdc in each of next 3 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. 50 lnkdc.
5th rnd: (With B, 1 lnkdc in each of next 2 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st. 1 lnkdc in each of next 2 sts.) 5 times. (With A, 1 lnkdc in each of next 2 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st. 1 lnkdc in each of next 2 sts.) 5 times. 60 lnkdc.
6th rnd: (With A, 1 lnkdc in each of next 5 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. (With B, 1 lnkdc in each of next 5 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. 70 lnkdc.
7th rnd: (With B, 1 lnkdc in each of next 3 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st. 1 lnkdc in each of next 3 sts.) 5 times. (With A, 1 lnkdc in each of next 3 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st. 1 lnkdc in each of next 3 sts.) 5 times. 80 lnkdc.
8th rnd: With A, 1 lnkdc in each of first 40 sts. With B, 1 lnkdc in each of last 40 sts.
9th rnd: (With B, 1 lnkdc in each of next 7 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. (With A, 1 lnkdc in each of next 7 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. 90 lnkdc.
10th rnd: (With A, 1 lnkdc in each of next 4 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st. 1 lnkdc in each of next 4 sts) 5 times. (With B, 1 lnkdc in each of next 4 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st. 1 lnkdc in each of next 4 sts) 5 times. 100 lnkdc.
11th rnd: (With B, 1 lnkdc in each of next 9 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. (With A, 1 lnkdc in each of next 9 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. 110 lnkdc.
12th rnd: (With A, 1 lnkdc in each of next 5 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st. 1 lnkdc in each of next 5 sts) 5 times. (With B, 1 lnkdc in each of next 5 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st. 1 lnkdc in each of next 5 sts) 5 times. 100 lnkdc.
13th rnd: (With B, 1 lnkdc in each of next 11 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. (With A, 1 lnkdc in each of next 11 sts. 2 lnkdc in next st) 5 times. 110 lnkdc.
14th rnd: With A, 1 lnkdc in each of first 53 sts. 1 hdc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Sl st in next st. Fasten off.
Border: With 1 strand each of A and B held tog, join with sl st to last sl st of 14th rnd. Working from left to right instead of right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: 1 skein each 334 Buff A and 624 Tea Leaf or 256 Carrot B
Susan Bates® crochet hook: 5 mm [US H-8]
Susan Bates® split lock stitch markers
Poly-Fil® Poly Pellets® Weighted Stuffing Beads
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Pumpkin measures 3½" (9 cm) tall after stuffing & seaming.
gauge: 6 (sc, ch 1, sc) groups = 4" (10 cm); 14 rows = 4" (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size needles/hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
PUMPKIN
With A, create a magic ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in ring, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, (sc, ch 1, sc) in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc – 12 sc, 6 ch-1 spaces.
Pull the last loop large and leave it hanging in back of work. Tighten it again before starting a new color A round.
Round 3: Join B with slip st in first ch-1 space, ch 1, (sc, ch 1, sc) in same ch-1 space, * (sc, ch 1, sc) twice in next ch 1 space, (sc, ch 1, sc) in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to last ch-1 space, (sc, ch 1, sc) twice in last ch-1 space, join with slip st in first sc – 18 sc, 9 ch 1 spaces.
Pull the last loop large and leave it hanging in back of work. Pick up color A loop and pull it to front through first ch-1 space.
Round 4: Ch 1, * (sc, ch 1, sc) in each space around, join with slip st in first sc. Pull last the loop large and leave it hanging in back of work. Pick up color B loop and pull it to front through first ch-1 space.
Continue to switch colors in this manner after every round.
Round 5: Ch 1, * (sc, ch 1, sc) in each of next 2 ch-1 spaces, (sc, ch 1, sc) twice in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, join with slip st in first sc – 24 sc, 12 ch-1 spaces.
Round 6: Repeat round 4.
Round 7: Ch 1, * (sc, ch 1, sc) in each of next 3 ch-1 spaces, (sc, ch 1, sc) twice in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, join with slip st in first sc – 30 sc, 15 ch-1 spaces.
Rounds 8-19: Repeat round 4.
Round 20: Ch 1, * sc in first ch 1 space, ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space, (sc, ch 1, sc) in each of next 3 ch-1 spaces; repeat from * to end; join with slip st in first sc – 24 sc, 12 ch-1 spaces.
Round 21: Repeat round 4.
Round 22: Ch 1 * sc in first ch-1 space, ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space, (sc, ch 1, sc) in each of next 2 ch-1 spaces; repeat from * to end; join with slip st in first sc – 18 sc, 9 ch-1 spaces.
Round 23: Repeat round 4.
Round 24: Ch 1 * sc in first ch-1 space, ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space, (sc, ch 1, sc) in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end; join with slip st in first sc – 12 sc, 6 ch-1 spaces.
Pause here and stuff Pumpkin with pellets and fiber. Contain pellets in a thin bag (that a yarn needle can thread through) to keep them from leaking out when the pumpkin is squished.
Round 25: Ch 1, * sc2tog over next 2 sc; repeat from * to end, join with slip st in first sc – 6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a tail of B at least 96" (244 cm) long for shaping Pumpkin.
Weave tail through all sts of final round and pull tightly to close top hole, stuffing a little extra at the end if needed, as the pumpkin should be very firm.
FINISHING
Wedges
Insert yarn needle through center top of Pumpkin, exiting at center bottom. Repeat this downward motion, making 5 lines of yarn around outside of Pumpkin. Be sure to pull yarn tightly to form the wedges.
Stem
With A, create a magic ring.
Round 1: 4 sc in ring. Do not join round; mark first st and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Sc twice in each sc around – 8 sc.
Rounds 3-7: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail to sew stem to the top of the pumpkin. Stuff stem lightly, and sew to center top.
Weave in all loose ends to inside of Pumpkin.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver Ombre™ (10 oz/284 g; 482 yds/440 m)
Red Heart® Super Saver ™ (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small quantities of worsted weight acrylic yarn in brown and tan (approx 5 yds/4.5 m per pumpkin).
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.

Dcfp2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 2 times. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Trfp = (Yoh) twice and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times.
measurements: Large: Approx 11" [28 cm] in diameter by 6" [15 cm] tall. Small: Approx 7" [18 cm] in diameter by 4½" [11.5 cm] tall.
gauge: 15 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes: 
• All rnds are joined with a sl st to first st.
• Pumpkins are worked from the top down. 
Large Pumpkin (see diagram on page 5.)
**Ch 2.
1st rnd: (WS.) 10 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: (RS) Ch 1. *(1 sc. 1 dc) in next st. (1 dc. 1 sc) in next st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 20 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *(1 sc. 1 dc) in next st. 2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st. (1 dc. 1 sc) in next st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 35 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. 2 hdc in next st. Skip next st. 3 dcfp around next st. Skip next st. 2 hdc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 45 sts.
5th and alt rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Turn.**
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 2 hdc in next st. Skip next st. 1 trfp around each of next 2 sts 2 rows below. 1 trfp around skipped st. 2 hdc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 55 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next st. Skip next st. 3 dcfp in next st 2 rows below. Skip next st. (1 dcfp around st 2 rows below) 3 times. Skip next st. 3 dcfp in next st 2 rows below. Skip next st. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 65 sts.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. 2 hdc in next st. (1 dc in sp before group of 3 dcfp 2 rows below. Skip next st, 1 trfp around next 2 sts 2 rows below, Working in front of two trfp just worked, 1 trfp in front around skipped st) 3 times. 1 dc in the sp after group of 3 dcfp sts 2 rows below, 2 hdc in next st, 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 95 sts.
Mikey’s Hints:
• The dcbp in the next round are worked around sts 2 rows below that were placed in the sps before and after the groups of 3 sts that make up the braids.
• To achieve the effect shown in the Anthracite version, change the dcbp in 12th and 14th rnds to a dcfp. This will frame the braids differently.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. (1 dcbp around next st 2 rows below. 3 dcfp around each of next 3 sts 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 dcbp around next st 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next 3 sts, (1 dcbp around next dcbp 2 rows below. Skip next st. 1 trfp around each of next 2 sts rows below. Working in front of two trfp just worked, 1 trfp in front around skipped st ) 3 times. 1 dcbp around next dcbp 2 rows below. 1 sc in next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 95 sts.
15th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
16th to 31st rnds: Rep 12th to 15th rnds four times more.
32nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. Hdc2tog. (Skip next st. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts 2 rows below) 3 times. Skip next st. Hdc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 65 sts.
34th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. (Skip next st. 1 trfp around each of next 2 sts 2 rows below. Working in front of two trfp just worked, 1 trfp around skipped st) 3 times. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 55 sts.
36th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st, 1 dcfp around next st 2 rows below. Working into next 2 sts 2 rows below, dcfp2tog. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts 2 rows below. Working into next 2 sts 2 rows below, dcfp2tog. 1 dcfp around next post 2 rows below. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 45 sts.
38th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. dcfp2tog using next 2 posts 2 rows below, 1 dcfp around each of next 3 posts 2 rows below. Working into next 2 sts 2 rows below, dcfp2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 35 sts.
39th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 25 sts.
Stuff pumpkin, being careful not to overtuff (stuffing should not be visible through sts.) 
40th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. Do not turn. 15 sts.
41st rnd: As 5th rnd. 15 sts.
42nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in next st. (Sc2tog) 7 times. Join. Fasten off, leaving an approx 24” [61 cm] tail. Place yarn on a tapestry needle and feed the yarn through all stitches in the last round and pull to close.
Proceed to Pumpkin Shaping and Finishing. 
Small Pumpkin (see diagram on page 6.)
Work from ** to ** as given for large Pumpkin. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. 2 dcfp around first hdc 2 rows below. Skip next st. 1 sc in next st. Skip next st. 1 trfp around each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below. Working in front of 2 dcfp just worked, 1 trfp around skipped dcfp below. Skip 3 sts behind trfp. 1 sc in next st. 2 dcfp around next hdc 2 rows below. Skip next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 55 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1.  *1 sc in each of next 10 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 60 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
9th and alt rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.  Turn.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. Skip next st. 1 trfp around each of next 2 sts 2 rows below. Working in front of 2 trfp just worked , 1 trfp around skipped st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 60 sts.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. 3 dcfp around next 3 posts. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 60 sts.
13th to 20th rnds: Repeat 9th to 12th rnds twice more. 
21st rnd: As 9th rnd. 
Mikey’s Hint: 
• All single crochet stitches in the next round are skipped, as only trfp sts are  are worked.
22nd rnd: RS. Ch 1. *Skip next 2 sts 2 rows below. 1 trfp around each of next 2 sts 2 rows below. Working in front of 2 trfp just worked , 1 trfp around last skipped st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 45 sts.
24th rnd: Working all sts in current rnd around sts worked in 22nd rnd , *1 dcfp around next st. Dcfp2tog. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Dcfp2tog. 1 dcfp around next st. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 35 sts.
26th rnd: Ch 1. Working all sts in current rnd around sts worked in 24th rnd,  *Dcfp2tog. 1 dcfp around  each of next 3 sts. Dcfp2tog. Rep from * around. Join. Turn. 25 sts.
28th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. Do not turn. 15 sts.
Stuff Pumpkin, being careful not to overtuff Pumpkin (stuffing should not be visible through sts.) 
29th rnd: As 9th rnd. 
30th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in next st. (Sc2tog) 7 times. Join. Fasten off, leaving an approx 24” [61 cm] tail. Place yarn on a tapestry needle and feed the yarn through all stitches in the last round and pull to close.
Both Versions:
Pumpkin Shaping and Finishing 
With yarn on tapestry needle, feed needle through center of both top and bottom of Pumpkin.
Catch edge of hole at bottom of Pumpkin, and feed needle back through center of top. Pull lightly on yarn so indentation forms at top of Pumpkin as shown in photo. Secure tightly and weave in end.
Large Pumpkin Stem
With brown yarn, ch 31. 
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 30 sts.
2nd row: Ch 2 ( does not count as st). Working into back loops only across entire row , 1 hdc in each of next 10 sts. 1 sc in each of last 20 sts. Turn. 30 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. Working into back loops only , 1 sc in each of next 20 sts. 1 hdc in each of  last 10 sts. Turn. 30 sts. 
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows twice more. 
Fasten off leaving a 24” [61 cm] tail.
Small Pumpkin Stem
With brown yarn, ch 11.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 10 sts.
2nd to 7th rows: Ch 1. Working in back loops only , 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 10 sts.
Fasten off leaving a 24” [61 cm] tail.
Stem Finishing 
Fold Stem with long edges touching.
Working in  back loops only, whipstitch along edges to form a cylinder.
Once across, gather the side of the rows to pull closed. This is the top of the stem. Fasten off and weave in ends.
For the large Pumpkin Stem, stuff bottom 2/3 of stem (the section worked in hdc.) 
For the small Pumpkin Stem, stuff entire length of Stem lightly.
Place Stem on of Pumpkin, and sew in place.
Mikey’s Hint: 
• For the small Pumpkin, Mikey sewed the stem in place slightly offset from centre, to give the Stem a more natural-looking lean.
For the large pumpkin, once sewn around, do not fasten off. Curl the thinner part of the stem into a circle as shown in photo. Using a yarn needle, Run the strand up through the stem and come out where you believe the permanent “curl” should be. Whipstitch into place securely. Tie off and weave in ends. 
Curly Vines
Mikey’s Hints: 
• When fastening off, leave longer tails to sew to base of the pumpkin stem. 
• Large pumpkin uses all three vine sizes, while small pumpkin uses only two shorter lengths.
With tan yarn, ch 27 (21-15). 
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 3 sc in each ch to end of chain. Fasten off.
Sew each vine to the base of the stem where you think it looks the best!

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 Skein each 319 Cherry Red A and 316 Soft White B.
Split-ring stitch marker, small amount of fiberfill, yarn needle.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: 16 sc = 4”; 17 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Cap
With larger hook and A, ch 2.
Round 1: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 5 sts.
Round 2: 2 sc in each st around – 10 sts.
Round 3: * 2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around – 15 sts.
Round 4: * 2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around – 20 sts.
Round 5: * 2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around – 25 sts.
Round 6: * 2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 7: Sc in each st around.
Round 8: Working in back loop ONLY, * sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 9: * Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 10: * Sc2tog, sc in next st; repeat from * around – 12 sts. Fasten off, leaving a 12” tail.
Stem
With larger hook and B, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 6 sts.
Round 2: 2 sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Round 3: Sc in each st around.
Rounds 4-9: Repeat Round 3. Fasten off at end of Round 9.
Dots (Make 5)
With smaller hook and B, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off, leaving a 12” tail.
Loop
With just a small amount of red and white yarn you can crochet these easy ornaments to decorate your tree or use as package tie-ons on gifts. For a more psychedelic look, use lots of bright colors for the polka dots.
FINISHING
Pull tails of Loop through center of Cap and secure ends. Add stuffing to Cap and Stem. With long tail from Cap, sew Cap to stem, matching sts. Using tails, sew Dots to top of Cap. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Blanket Extra Thick™ (21.2 oz/600 g; 72 yds/66 m) Pumpkin (62086) or Vintage White (62008) 1 ball or 55 yds/51 m
Approx. ¼" [6 mm] diameter x 4" [10 cm] long stick or dowel for stem.
abbreviations: Sl stbl = Slip stitch through back loop only
measurements: Approximately (approx) 11" [28 cm] diameter x 8" [20.5 cm] tall, excluding stem.
gauge: 2 single crochet (sc) and 2 rows = 4" [10 cm] using Finger Crochet technique.
instructions:
Notes:
• Finger crochet technique is used. 
• No hook required. 
• Work stitches to fit thumb and first finger – making sure to not pull stitches tight. 
Chain (ch) 11.
1st row: (Right side [RS]). Using pointer finger and thumb: (Pull working yarn up through back loop of first ch and loop on your finger – Slip stitch through back loop (Sl stbl) made) in 2nd ch from last loop. 1 sl stbl in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 10 slip stitches (sl sts).
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sl stbl in each stitch (st) across. Turn.
Repeat (rep) 2nd row until work from beginning (beg) measures approx. 26" [66 cm]. Do not fasten off.
Joining row: Fold work in half, Wrong side (WS) together (tog), so first and last rows meet. Working through both thicknesses, in back loops of last row and remaining (rem) loops of foundation ch: Ch 1. 1 sl st in each st across. Fasten off.
Weave yarn through sts at end of rows on one edge of Pumpkin, pull tight to close bottom and secure on WS.
Stuff Pumpkin.
Weave yarn through sts at end of rows on rem (top) edge of Pumpkin. Insert 4" [10 cm] long stick in opening, leaving 3" [7.5 cm] outside for stem. Pull yarn tight to close opening around stick and tie off. Pull yarn tails inside Pumpkin.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 365 Coffee A, 319 Cherry Red B, 672 Spring Green C and 316 Soft White D.
Yarn needle, stitch marker, fiberfill, black embroidery floss.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 16 sc = 4”; 14 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CUPCAKE
Sides
With A, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 7 sc.
Rows 2-20: Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Using tail, sew last row to first row to make a ring.
Bottom
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around – 18 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Using tail and fitting Sides around edges of Bottom piece, sew pieces together.
Top
With C, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around – 15 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around – 18 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around – 24 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off.
Round 7: Join D to front loop of first sc of Round 6 with sc, working in front loops only, sc in each sc around – 24 sc.
Round 8: [Slip st in next sc, 3 sc in next sc] around, slip st in first st to join.
Fasten off.
Round 9: Join D in back loop of Round 6 with slip st, 4 dc in next sc, [slip st in next sc, 4 dc in next sc] around, slip st in first st to join.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
FINISHING
With wrong sides together, sew pieces together, stuffing with fiberfill before sewing closed.
Red Rose
With B, ch 7.
Row 1: Work 3 hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across.
Fasten off.
Roll length into a rose shape and sew in place in center of Top.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®, Art. E300
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 3.75 mm [US F-5]
abbreviations: A, B, C, etc. = Color A, B, C, etc.
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 20 sts = 4" [10 cm]; 20 rows/rounds = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet.
instructions:
SHELL
With A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—42 sc.
Round 8: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—48 sc.
Round 9: [Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—54 sc.
Round 10: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
LETTUCE
With B, ch 33.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 11 ch, sc in next 8 ch; leave remaining chains unworked.
Rows 2–8: Ch 13, turn, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 11 ch, sc in next 8 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Sew first row and last row together, keeping shredded lettuce ends free on each side, to form a tube. Stuff the tube lightly, then gather and sew both ends of tube closed, leaving the lettuce ends loose.
TOMATO PIECES (make 7)
With C, ch 3.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in last ch—2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
CHEESE
With D, ch 10.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—9 sc.
Rows 2–8: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
FINISHING
With A, sew Lettuce to center of wrong side of Shell, allowing lettuce ends to hang out over the edges.
With C, sew four Tomato Pieces to sc section of Lettuce, scattering and leaving middle open for Cheese.
With D, sew Cheese (diamond like) to top of Lettuce.
With C, sew three remaining Tomato Pieces to top of Cheese.
Fold up Shell. With A, sew several stitches through all layers to hold Taco shape.
Face
With yarn needle and E, using photograph as a guide, embroider a back stitch smile and French knot eyes on front of Taco.
Fold gold ribbon in half. Insert crochet hook around a few stitches at top of ornament, place ribbon fold on hook and draw through to form a loop. Thread ends of ribbon through loop and pull to tighten. Tie ends together with bow or overhand knot to form hanging loop.
Weave in any remaining ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 319 Cherry Red A, 624 Tea Leaf B, 316 Soft White C, 320 Cornmeal D.
abbreviations: A, B, C, etc. = Color A, color B, color C, etc.
() = work directions in parentheses into same st
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Stocking measures 6” wide x 26” long (15 x 66 cm)
gauge: 7 pattern repeats = 12” (30 cm); 10 rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Row 1: Sc in 12th ch from hook, sc in each remaining ch across, turn (unworked chains become hanging loop)-50 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3, (tr, dc) in first st, hdc in next st, sc in next st, slip st in each of next 2 sts, sc in next st, hdc in next st, *(dc, tr, dc) in next st, hdc in next st, sc in next st, slip st in each of next 2 sts, sc in next st, hdc in next st; repeat from * to last st, (dc, tr) in last st, turn-64 sts.
Row 3 (zig zag): Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, skip next 2 slip sts, sc in next 3 sts, *(sc, ch 1, sc) in next st, sc in next 3 sts, skip next 2 slip sts, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * to last st, 2 sc in last st; change to B, turn-7 zigzags.
Rows 4 and 5: With B, ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 3 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 3 sc, *(sc, ch 1, sc) in next ch-1 space, sc in next 3 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 3 sc; repeat from * to last sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn; change to C in last st of Row 5.
Continue to repeat Rows 4 and 5 working 2 rows in each color as in the following color sequence: C, D, A, C, B, D, C, A, B, D, A, C, D, B, A, D, C, B, A, D, C. Do not change color at end of last row. Continue with C.
Shape Heel
Row 1: With C, ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 3 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next ch-1 space, turn; leave remaining sts unworked-10 sc.
Foot
Rows 1 and 2: With B, ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 3 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 3 sc, *(sc, ch 1, sc) in next ch-1 space, sc in next 3 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 3 sc; repeat from * to last sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn; change to D at the end of Row 2.
Repeat Rows 1 and 2, working 2 rows in each color as in the following color sequence: D, A, C, D, B, C, A. Do not change color at end of last row. Continue with A.
Shape Toe
Row 1: With A, ch 1, sc in next 4 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 3 sc, *sc in next ch-1 space, sc in next 3 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 3 sc; repeat from * to last sc, sc in last sc, turn-50 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, *skip next 2 sc, sc in next 5 sc; repeat from * to last 5 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in last 3 sc, turn-36 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, *skip next 2 sc, sc in next 3 sc; repeat from * to last 4 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in last 2 sc, turn-22 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * across-8 sc. Fasten off A.
Heel Patch (make 2)
With A, ch 19.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 7 ch, skip next 2 ch, sc in last 8 ch, turn-16 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 7 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 7 sc, turn-14 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 6 sc, turn-12 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 5 sc, turn-10 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 3 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 4 sc, turn-7 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, first sc, sc in next 2 sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next 2 sc, turn-4 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, skip 3 sts, sc in last sc-1 sc.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew sole and back seam. Position heel patches on either side of stocking, sew in place and together at back seam.

materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 239 yds/219 m)
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
½” [6 mm] rhinestones, sequins or beads.
Small length of red yarn (for wreath bow).
Small piece of light cardboard (for use inside spaceship fins).
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4” [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes:
• Before start, separate the different color sections of the yarn as follows: Push the rings of color out from center. Find the point where the color changes and Break the yarn. Rep this process for the rem yarn colors. Wind each color into a separate ball.
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed, keeping color change to WS of work.
SPACESHIP BODY
Note: Do not join at end of rnd. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). PM at end of rnd to indicate end of rnd. Move marker up as each rnd is completed.
Beg at nose cone, with D, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. 5 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each of next 5 sts. 10 sc.
3rd rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
4th rnd: (1 sc in next st. 2 sc in next st) 5 times. 15 sc.
5th rnd: Sc in each st around.
6th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 4 sts. 2 sc in next st) 3 times. 18 sc.
7th rnd: Sc in each st around.
8th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 5 sts. 2 sc in next st) 3 times. 21 sc.
9th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
10th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 2 sc in next st) 7 times. 28 sc.
11th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sts. 2 sc in next st) 7 times. 35 sc.
12th - 14th rnds: Sc in each st around. Sl st in next st and fasten off D.
Striped Section
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first sc.
15th rnd: Join C with sl st in back loop of first st. ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each st around. Join.
16th rnd: With C, ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sts. 2 sc in next st) 7 times. Join. 42 sc.
17th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
18th rnd: With A, ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sts. 2 sc in next st) 7 times. Join. 49 sc.
19th and 20th rnds: With C, 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st in first sc and change to A at end of 20th rnd.
21st rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
22nd rnd: With A, ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 6 sts. 2 sc in next st) 7 times. Join. 56 sc.
23rd rnd: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
24th rnd: With C, ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 7 sts. 2 sc in next st) 7 times. Join. 63 sc.
25th and 26th rnds: With A, 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st in first sc and change to C at end of 26th rnd.
27th rnd: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
28th rnd: With C, ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Sc2tog) 7 times. Join. 56 sc.
29th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
30th rnd: With A, ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Sc2tog) 7 times. Join. 49 sc.
31st rnd: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
32nd rnd: With C, ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Sc2tog) 7 times. Join. 42 sc.
33rd rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
34th rnd: With A, ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Sc2tog) 7 times. Join. 35 sc.
35th rnd: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
Stuff spaceship body firmly and continue stuffing as work progresses.
36th rnd: With C, ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog) 7 times. Join. 28 sc.
37th and 38th rnds: With A, 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st in first sc and change to C at end of 38th rnd.
39th and 40th rnds: With C, 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st in first sc and change to A at end of 40th rnd.
41st-44th rnds: Rep 37th-40th rnds. Do not change to A at the end of 44th rnd. Fasten off A.
Work all rem rnds with C only.
45th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each st around. Join.
46th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join. 24 sc.
47th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog) 6 times. Join. 18 sc.
48th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each st. Sc2tog) 6 times. Join. 12 sc.
Finish stuffing spaceship body. Fasten off C, leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts of last rnd and pull to close opening. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.
FINS (make 3)
With D, ch 2.
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in next st. 2 sc in next st. Turn. 5 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1.1 sc in first st. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st. PM in this st (center st). 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in last st. Turn. 7 sc (3 sc on each side of marked center st).
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in marked st and move marker to st just made. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Turn. 9 sc (4 sc on each side of marked center st).
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to 1 st before marked center st. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in center st and move marker to st just made. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 11 sc (5 sc on each side of marked center st).
6th-9th rows: Rep 5th row 4 times more. Turn. 19 sc after 9th row.
Remove center marker.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in last 4 sts. Turn. 21 sc.
11th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of last 5 sts. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of last 4 sts. Turn. 23 sc.
12th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in last 6 sts. 25 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end. 
Fold piece in half bringing side edges tog. Whipstitch side edges tog.
WREATH
With B, ch 16. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 40 hdc in ring. Join with sl st in first hdc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Make Cardboard Fin Inserts
Place one fin piece flat on piece light cardboard and trace around it. Break out the triangle, rounding the corners to prevent shape from poking through. Rep to make a total of three inserts.
Hold one RS of fin and one WS of fin tog with RS facing out. Sew fins tog, inserting one cardboard piece before seam is complete. Finish sewing pieces tog then secure. Rep for all three fins.
Optional Porthole Window
Place wreath on foil cardstock. Trace a circle that is smaller in diameter than the outside of the wreath but a little larger than the diameter of the inside circle of the wreath. Break out circle and glue to back of wreath to form the reflective porthole glass. 
Note: A picture of Santa or other creature could be substituted for the foil paper so it would give the appearance of someone/something looking out of the spaceship porthole.
Glue red sequins approx ¼” [6 mm] apart or as desired around wreath. With scrap of red yarn, tie a small bow and glue it to the bottom of the wreath over the seam line if desired. 
Referring to picture as a guide to placement, sew the following pieces tog. 
Pin fins vertically with long cast-on edge against lower portion of spaceship body, making certain to space them evenly. Fins should be placed with the larger part of the triangle towards the bottom of the spaceship. Sew fins securely to bottom portion of spaceship.
Sew wreath to spaceship.
With craft glue, glue rhinestones, sequins or beads around first C-colored stripe to represent running lights approx ½” [1.5 cm] apart or as desired.
If desired, attach thread or fishing line to spaceship for hanging loop.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 334 Buff A and 365 Coffee B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 3.75 mm [US F-5]
Polyester fiberfill, 18" [45.5 cm] thin gold ribbon (for hanger), stitch marker, yarn needle
abbreviations: A and B = Color A and Color B
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 20 sts = 4" [10 cm]; 20 rows/rounds = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: redheart.com
©2017 Coats & Clark Page 1 of 2
Chocolate Chunk Cookie Ornament
Crochet a batch of cookies that will last through the years. If you are known for your cookies, this will give them a cookie to remember you as it is hung on the tree each year.
Notes
1. Cookie is made from 13 pieces: 2 Cookie Pieces and 11 Chocolate Chunks.
2. The two Cookie Pieces are sewn together and stuffed. The Chocolate Chunks are arranged and attached to the top of the Cookie.
3. Gauge is not critical for this project. Work tightly so stuffing will not show between stitches.

COOKIE PIECE (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, [sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times, sc in last 3 sc—36 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—42 sc.
Fasten off first Cookie Piece. Do not fasten off second Cookie Piece. Hold the two pieces with wrong sides together and stitches matching. Sewing through both thicknesses, sew edges of Cookie Pieces together, stuff lightly and evenly between the pieces before completing the seam.

CHOCOLATE CHUNK (make 11)
With B, leaving a 7" [18 cm] beginning tail, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—3 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a 7" [18 cm] ending tail.

FINISHING
Thread one yarn tail of one Chocolate Chunk onto yarn needle. Insert needle through Cookie from top to bottom and draw tail through. Thread other yarn tail of same Chocolate Chunk onto yarn needle. Skip one stitch on top of Cookie and insert needle through top of Cookie then out bottom of Cookie at same place as first yarn tail. Tie the two tails together at bottom of Cookie, tying tightly to form a dent in Cookie. Trim ends and draw knot inside Cookie to hide. Repeat to attach all remaining Chocolate Chunks, spreading them evenly over top of Cookie.
Fold gold ribbon in half. Insert crochet hook around a few stitches at top of ornament, place ribbon fold on hook and draw through to form a loop. Thread ends of ribbon through loop and pull to tighten. Tie ends together with bow or overhand knot to form hanging loop.
Weave in any remaining ends.
