6th to 8th rnds: Rep 2nd to 4th rnds.
9th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 12 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * 3 times more. Join. 56 sts.
10th to 12th rnds: Rep 2nd to 4th rnds.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 13 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * 3 times more. Join. 60 sts.
14th to 16th rnds: Rep 2nd to 4th rnds.
17th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 14 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * 3 times more. Join. 64 sts.
18th to 20th rnds: Rep 2nd to 4th rnds.
21st rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * 7 times more. Join. 72 sts.
22nd and 23rd rnds: Rep 2nd and 3rd rnds.
24th rnd: Ch 1. Working into back loops only of each st, *1 sc in each of next 8 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * 7 times more. Join. 80 sts.
25th rnd: Rep 3rd rnd.
26th and 27th rnds: Rep 2nd and 3rd rnds.
28th rnd: Rep 2nd rnd.
29th rnd: Ch 1. Sl st in each st around. Join. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Felted™ (9.2 oz/260 g; 249 yds/228 m)
Contrast A Ecru Fleck (80012) 1 ball or 55 yds/50 m
Contrast B Buff (80006) 1 ball or 88 yds/80 m
Contrast C Sienna Fleck (80015) 1 ball or 45 yds/40 m
Contrast D Amber Fleck (80021) 1 ball or 132 yds/120 m
Contrast E Lake (80010) 1 ball or 77 yds/70 m
Contrast F Cabernet (80007) 1 ball or 22 yds/20 m
Size U.S. J/10 (6 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Dtr = (Double treble crochet). (Yoh) 3 times. Insert hook in next stitch and pull up a loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 4 times
Hdcbl = Half double crochet through back loop
Puff St = (Yoh and draw up a loop) 3 times in next hdc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook. Ch 1 to close stitch
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
Scbl = Single crochet through back loop only
measurements: Beet: Approx 3½" [9 cm] diameter; 4½" [16.5 cm] root long excluding leaves; 8" [20.5 cm] long leaves. Small Pumpkin : Approx 5" [12.5 cm] diameter; 3" [7.5 cm] tall excluding stem. Large Pumpkin : Approx 6½" [16.5 cm] diameter; 3½" [9 cm] tall excluding stem. Small Butternut Squash: Approx 2½" [6 cm] diameter; 5" [12.5 cm] long excluding stem. Large Butternut Squash: Approx 3" [7.5 cm] diameter; 6½" [16.5 cm] long excluding stem.
gauge: 8 sc and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
BEET
Note: Join all rnds with sl st in first sc. 
With C, ch 2.
See diagram on page 4.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st.*1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. 18 sc. Join F with sl st to first sc. Break C.
4th rnd: With F, ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join. 24 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join. 30 sc.
7th and 8th rnds: As 5th rnd. 
9th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * 4 times more. Join. 25 sc. 
10th rnd: As 5th rnd.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * 4 times more. Join. 20 sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
13th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * 4 times more. Join. 15 sts. 
14th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. Join. 10 sts. 
Stuff Beet.
15th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 5 times. Join. 5 sts. 
16th to 18th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
19th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 3 sts. Fasten off.

Leaves (make 3).
With C, ch 26.
See diagram on page 4.
1st rnd: 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 10 ch. Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 1 tr in each of next 3 ch. 1 dtr in each of next 3 ch. 1 tr in each of next 2 ch. 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working along opposite side of ch into rem loops, 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 1 tr in each of next 2 ch. 1 dtr in each of next 3 ch. 1 tr in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Ch 3. Sl st in each of last 10 ch. Fasten off, leaving a long end.

PUMPKINS
The instructions are written for Small Pumpkin. If changes are necessary for Large Pumpkin the instructions will be written Small Pumpkin (Large Pumpkin). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to both sizes. 
**Note: Ch 2 does not count as hdc at beg of rnd.
With E (A), ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
See diagrams on page 4.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 8 (9) hdc in ring. Join with sl st to first hdc. 8 (9) hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 16 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *Puff st. 1 sc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of first puff st. 8 (9) puff sts.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *2 puff sts in next puff st. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of first puff st. 16 (18) puff sts.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *1 puff st in next puff st. 1 sc in sp between 2 puff sts. 1 puff st in next puff st. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of first puff st. 16 (18) puff sts. 
6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 puff st in next Puff st. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of first puff st. 16 (18) puff sts.** 
Rep last rnd 3 (5) times more. 
***Next rnd: Ch 2. *1 puff st in next puff st. Skip next sc. 1 puff st in next puff st. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of first puff st.

Next rnd: Sl st in sp between first 2 puff sts. Ch 2. Puff st in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in next sc. Puff st in sp between next 2 puff sts. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of first puff st. 8 (9) puff sts.

Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next puff st. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 (18) sc. 
Stuff Squash. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 8 (9) times. Join with sl st to first st. 8 (9) sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts. Pull tightly and fasten securely. 

Stem (make 1).
With C, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep last rnd 3 (4) times more.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *(1 hdc. 1 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * 2 (3) times more. Join with sl st to sp where first st was worked. Fasten off.

BUTTERNUT SQUASH
The instructions are written for Small Butternut Squash. If changes are necessary for Large Butternut Squash the instructions will be written thus Small Butternut Squash (Large Butternut Squash). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to both sizes. 
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first sc. 
With B (D), ch 2. 
See diagrams on page 5. 
1st rnd: 6 (7) sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 (7) sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 (14) sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 18 (21) sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from* to last 1 (4) sc. 1 sc in each of last 1 (4) sc. Join. 23 (26) sc. 
Next 6 (8) rnds: As 4th rnd. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from* to last 1 (4) sc. 1 sc in each of last 1 (4) sc. Join. 31 (34) sc.
Next 5 (7) rnds: As 4th rnd. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 (3) sc. Rep from * to last 3 (4) sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 1 (2) sc. Join. 23 (27) sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 1 sc. Rep from * to last 2 (0) sts. 1 sc in each of last 2 (0) sc. Join. 16 (18) sts.
Stuff Squash. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 8 (9) times. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 8 (9) sts. Fasten off, leaving long end.

Stem: With F, ch 7 (9).
1st row: (RS). Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 1 (3) ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of last 2 ch. Turn. 6 (8) sts. 
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdcbl in each of first 2 hdc. 1 scbl in each of next 2 sc. sl st in each of last 2 (4) sl sts. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sl st in each of first 2 (4) sl st. 1 scbl in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdcbl in each of last 2 hdc. Turn. 
Rep last 2 rows once more. 
Fold Stem lengthwise. Join foundation ch and last row with sl st. Fasten off. Sew wider side to top of Squash.

materials: RED HEART® “Holiday”: 1 ball each 1360 Aran/Gold A
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Chirper is 7” long from tip of beak to tip of tail.
gauge: 16 sc = 4”; 16 rounds = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the specified gauge.
instructions:
BODY
With C, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around – 18 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around – 24 sc.
Rounds 6-15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] around – 18 sc.
Round 17: Sc in each sc around.
Round 18: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] around – 12 sc. Stuff with polyester filling.
Round 19: [Sc2tog] around. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff tightly.
Thread tail through remaining sts and pull to close. Knot to secure.
HEAD
With B, ch 2.
Rounds 1-3: Work as for Body – 18 sc.
Rounds 4-9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: [Sc2tog] around – 9 sc.
Round 11: Working in front loops only, 2 sc in each sc around – 18 sc.
Round 12: Sc in next sc, hdc in next 2 sc, [2 hdc] in each of next 2 sc, hdc in next sc, [2 hdc] in each of next 2 sc, hdc in next 2 sc, sc in last 8 sc. Fasten off. Stuff tightly and sew onto Body.
WING
(Make 2) 
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around – 15 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] around – 12 sc.
Rounds 7-11: Sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog – 7 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through remaining sts and pull to close. Knot to secure.
TAIL
With C, ch 6.
Round 1: Work sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch, turn to work along opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch – 12 sc.
Rounds 2-9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around – 18 sc. Fasten off. Sew running stitches through both thicknesses at Round 4. Stuff lightly. Sew in place.
BEAK
With D, ch 4.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in last ch.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first 2 sts, slip st in last st. Fasten off. Fold in half and sew together. Sew in place.
FINISHING
Embroider eyes with French knot with D. Fold a length of ribbon in half and sew ends on Chirper for hanging. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver® in Cherry Red A, Buff B, Green C, Black D, and Spring Pink E
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 3.75 mm [US F-5]
abbreviations: A, B, C, etc. = Color A, B, C; etc.
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 20 sts = 4" [10 cm]; 20 rows/rounds = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
APPLE
With A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Rounds 6–13: Sc in each sc around.
Round 14: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 15: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 16: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff Apple firmly with fiberfill. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening at top of Apple, then insert needle through center of top of Apple and down through the Apple to center of bottom of Apple. Pull to form an indent in the top and in the bottom of the Apple. Weave in end securely.
STEM
With B, ch 6.
Row 1: Work 2 hdc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in each of the remaining 4 ch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
LEAF
With C, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, tr in each of next 2 ch, dc in next ch, 3 sc in last ch; working along opposite side of foundation ch, dc in next ch, tr in each of next 2 ch, dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch—15 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first 7 sts, 3 sc in next st, sc in remaining 7 sts; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
CHEEKS (make 2)
With D, ch 3.
Round 1: Work 7 hdc in 3rd ch from hook; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
FINISHING
Face: With yarn needle and E, using photograph as a guide, embroider a back stitch smile and French knot eyes on front of Apple.
With D, sew Cheeks on each side of smile.
With B, sew Stem to center top of Apple.
With C, sew end of Leaf near Stem.
Fold gold ribbon in half. Insert crochet hook around a few stitches at top of ornament, place ribbon fold on hook and draw through to form a loop. Thread ends of ribbon through loop and pull to tighten. Tie ends together with bow or overhand knot to form hanging loop.
Weave in any remaining ends.

materials: AUNT LYDIA'S® Extra Fine Crochet Thread, Size 30: 1 ball 226 Natural (for smaller sun catcher)
AUNT LYDIA'S® Fine Crochet Thread, Size 20: 1 ball 226 Natural (for larger sun catcher)
Susan Bates® Steel Crochet Hooks: 1 mm [US 12] (for smaller sun catcher) and 1.25 mm [US 9] (for larger sun catcher)
3" [7.5 cm] metal ring for smaller sun catcher
5" [12.5 cm] metal ring for larger sun catcher
abbreviations: ( ) = work all directions in parentheses in the indicated stitch or space
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: Rounds 1-4 of smaller sun catcher = 1½" [4 cm]; Rounds 1-4 of larger sun catcher = 1⅝" [4 cm].
instructions:
SMALLER SUN CATCHER
With size 30 thread and smaller hook, ch 5, slip st in first ch to form ring. 
Round 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 2: Ch 5, (counts as first dc and ch-3 space), *dc in next sc, ch 3; repeat from * around, slip st in 2nd ch of beginning ch-5 to join—8 dc and 8 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st, *2 sc in next ch-3 space, ch-3 picot, sc in same space,** sc in next dc; repeat from * 6 times, then from * to ** once, slip st in first sc to join—32 sc and 8 ch-3 picot.
Round 4: Beg 4-dtr cl, ch 7, *4 dtr cl in sc above next dc on Round 2, ch 7; repeat from * around, slip st in top of beg cl to join—8 cl and 8 ch-7 spaces.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in same st, *ch 5, tr in next ch-7 space, ch 5,** sc in top of next cl; repeat from * 6 times, then from * to ** once, slip st in first sc to join—8 tr, 8 sc, and 16 ch-5 spaces.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in same st, *2 sc in next ch-5 space, ch-3 picot, 4 sc in same space, ch-3 picot, sc in same space, sc in next tr, 2 sc in next ch-5 space, ch-3 picot, 4 sc in same space, ch-3 picot, sc in same space,** sc in next sc; repeat from * 6 times, then from * to ** once, slip st in first sc to join—128 sc and 32 ch-3 picot.
Round 7: Slip st up to and in 2nd sc between first and 2nd picots, ch 11 (counts as part of first dtr join and 1 ch-7 space), *skip next picot, 4-tr cl in 2nd sc between picots, ch 7,** work dtr joining above sc on Round 5 by inserting hook in 2nd sc after 1st picot and 2nd sc after 3rd picot, ch 7; repeat from * 6 times, then from * to ** once; dtr in 2nd sc between picots, slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-11 to join (completing first dtr join)—8 dtr join and 16 ch-7 spaces.
Round 8: Holding metal ring behind work, ch 1, working in same st, *sc between legs of dtr joining and over ring, work 17 sc in ch-7 space and over ring, sc in top of next cl and over ring, work 17 sc in ch-7 space and over ring; repeat from * around; slip st in first sc to join.
Round 9: Ch 2, 2 dc in same sc, [skip 2 sc, sc in next sc, skip 2 sc, 5 dc in next sc] 2 times, skip 2 sc, sc in next sc, skip 2 sc, 3 dc in next sc above cl, ch 5, slip st in first ch to form ring, 10 sc in ring, slip st in top of last dc made, 2 dc in same sc above cl, *skip 2 sc, sc in next sc, skip 2 sc,** 5 dc in next sc; repeat from * around to last 5 sc, 2 dc in first sc; slip st in first dc to join.
Fasten off and weave in ends. Block to open up lace sts.
LARGER SUN CATCHER
With size 20 thread and larger hook, ch 5, slip st in first ch to form ring. 
Round 1: Ch 2, 23 dc in ring, slip st in top of ch-2 to join.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same dc, ch 3, *skip 1 dc, sc in next dc, ch 3; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—12 dc and 12 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in first ch-3 space, beg 4-tr cl, ch 4, *4-tr cl in next ch-3 space, ch 4; repeat from * around, slip st in top of first cl to join—12 cl and 12 ch-4 spaces.
Round 4: (Slip st, ch 1, 5 sc) in first ch-4 space, *5 sc in next ch-4 space; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join–60 sc.
Round 5: Slip st in 2nd sc of Round 4, (slip st, ch 1, sc) in next sc, *ch 5, skip next 4 sc,** sc in next sc; repeat from * 10 times, then from * to ** once, slip st in first sc to join—12 sc and 12 ch-5 spaces.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in same sc, *ch 3, dc in next ch-5 space, triple picot, slip st around base of picot, ch 3,** sc in next sc; repeat from * 10 times, then from * to ** once, slip st in first sc to join—12 dc, 12 sc, 12 triple picot and 24 ch-3 spaces. 
Fasten off and weave in ends.
Round 7: Attach thread in center picot of any triple picot on Round 6; ch 1, sc in same st, ch 9, *sc in next center picot, ch 9; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—12 sc and 12 ch-9 spaces.
Round 8: Slip st up to and in 3rd ch of first ch-9 space, ch 4, (counts as first dc and ch-2), *(dc, ch 3, dc, ch 2, dc) in same space,** dc in next ch-9 space, ch 2; repeat from * 10 times, then from * to ** once, slip st in top of first ch-2 to join.
Round 9: (Slip st, ch 1, 3 sc) in first ch-2 space, *ch 5, dtr2tog in next ch-5 space, ch 5, 3 sc in next ch-2 space, skip 2 dc,** 3 sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * 10 times, then from * to ** once, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 10: (Slip st, ch 1, sc) in next sc, *ch 3, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-5 space,
ch 3, (sc, ch 4, sc) in top of dtr2tog, ch
3, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-5 space, ch
3, skip next sc, sc in next sc, skip next 2
sc,** sc in next sc; repeat from 10 times,
then from * to ** once, slip st in first sc
to join. Fasten off and weave in ends.
Round 11: Join thread with a slip st in
any ch-4 loop on Round 10, ch 1; holding
metal ring behind work, sc in same ch-4
loop and over ring, work 26 sc over ring,
*sc in next ch-4 loop and over ring, work
26 sc over ring; repeat from * around,
slip st in first sc to join.
Round 12: Ch 1, (sc, ch 5, sc) in same sc, 
*ch 3, skip 2 sc,** sc in next sc; repeat
from * around to last 2 sc, then from * to
** once, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 13: (Slip st, ch 1, 9 sc) in ch-5
space, *(sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-3 space;
repeat from * around to last ch-3 space,
sc, ch 2, slip st in first sc to join.
Fasten off and weave in ends. Block to
open up lace sts.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 672 Spring Green A, 706 Perfect Pink B, 316 Soft White C, 324 Bright Yellow D, 358 Lavender E, 530 Orchid F, 365 Coffee G
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 3.75mm [F-5 US], 4mm [G-6 US], and 5mm [H-8 US]
one 8” (20.5 cm) chopstick for each flower
6” (15 cm) chenille stems (1 for each carnation, daffodil, and iris leaf)
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Carnation measures 3” wide x 8” tall (7.5 x 20.5 cm). Daffodil measures 4” wide x 8½” tall (10 x 21.5 cm). Corona cup is 2” (5 cm) deep. Daisy measures 5” wide x 6½” tall (12.5 x 16.5 cm), with petals spread. Iris measures 3” wide x 8½” tall (7.5 x 21.5 cm)
gauge: 7 sc = 2” (5 cm) in pattern; 8 rows = 2” (5 cm)
instructions:
CARNATION
Stem
With medium hook and A, ch 26.
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in second ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—25 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 10 sc, ch 7, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 5 ch (leaf made), sc in next 10 sc, ch 7, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 5 ch (leaf made), sc in remaining sts, turn—25 sc and 2 leaves.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn—25 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 10 sc, [ch 7, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 5 ch (leaf made), sc in next 5 sc] twice, sc in remaining sts, do not turn—25 sc and 2 leaves.
Row 5: Working across ends of rows, sc in each row, do not turn—4 sc.
Note: Continue in rounds.
Round 6: Working in front of sts of Row 5, sc in 4th st from the hook (to form a ring), sc in remaining 3 sts. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 7: Working in outer loops only, 2 sc in each st—8 sc.
Round 8: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 4 times—12 sc.
Round 9: [Dc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times; join with slip st in first dc—6 dc and 6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Head
Grid Base
With largest hook and B, ch 4.
Round 1: [Dc, ch 1] 5 times in 4th ch from hook (beginning ch count as dc, ch 1); join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—6 dc and 6 ch-1 spaces.

Note: You will now join grid base to stem.
Round 2: Insert hook in inner loop of any st in Round 9 of stem and working through both loops of first dc, sc in first dc; working through inner loops only of each sc in Round 9 and both loops of last round, sc in each dc and ch-1 space around—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), (dc, ch 1) in each st; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—12 dc and 12 ch-1 spaces.

Petals
Ch 3.
Row 1: Working 3 sts around post of each dc, 2 sts in each ch-1 space, and 1 st around post of each sc, alternate dc and hdc in a snake-like fashion up and down the grid base. Fasten off. Note: To simulate a carnation’s many petals, randomly (ch 2, slip st around next post or in ch-1 space, ch 3), then continue working dc and hdc along the grid base.
Row 2 (optional): *Working in front loops only, join 2nd color in first st of any petal, slip st loosely in each st to end of petal. Fasten off. Repeat from * as many times as desired.
Leaf (make as many as desired)
With medium hook and A, ch 26.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in next st, working over chenille stem, sc in each ch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
Trim chenille stem as needed. Whipstitch leaves to base of stem. Bend leaves to desired curve. Weave in ends. Insert chopstick in stem.

DAFFODIL
Stem
With medium hook and A, ch 26.
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—25 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, sc in each st, turn—27 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st, do not turn.
Note: The last 2 stitches of Row 4 and all 4 stitches of Row 5 will form a ring on which the head is made. These 6 stitches will lean at an angle from the stem so the daffodil will face forward.
Row 5: Working across ends of rows, sc in each row, turn—4 sc.
Note: Continue in rounds.
Round 6: Working in front of sts of Row 5, sc in 6th st from the hook (to form a ring), sc in remaining 5 sts—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 7: Work 2 sc in each st; join with slip st in first st —12 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Head
Petals
Round 1: Join D with slip st in outer loop of any st of Round 7; working in outer loops only, [ch 4, slip st in next 2 st] 5 times, ch 4, slip st in next st—6 ch-4 spaces.
Round 2: (Sc, ch 2, dc, 2 tr, ch 3, slip st in 3rd ch from hook, tr, dc, ch 3, slip st) (petal made) in each ch-4 space; join with slip st in first st—6 petals. Fasten off, leaving a long tail to make stamens.

Corona Cup
With medium hook and D, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st—12 sc.
Round 3: Working in unworked inner loops of Round 1 of petals and both loops of previous round, sc in each st.
Rounds 4–6: Sc in each st.
Round 7: [Sc in next st, sc2tog] 4 times—8 sc.
Round 8: (Sc, dc, sc) in each st around; join with slip st in first st—24 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail to make stamens.
Weave in ends of petals and corona cup and pull up through center of corona cup. Trim to height of corona cup.
Place chopstick on stem and whipstitch edges together.

Leaf (make as many as desired)
With medium hook and A, ch 26.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—25 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st around chenille stem to last stitch, slip st in last st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
Trim chenille stem as needed. Whipstitch leaves to base of stem. Bend leaves to desired curve. Weave in ends. Insert chopstick in stem.

DAISY
Head
With smallest hook and D or G, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 st] twice—8 sc.
Round 3: Work 2 sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 3 times, 2 sc in next st—13 sc.
Round 4: Working in back loops only, sc in each st; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off. 
Round 5: Join C with slip st in front loop of any st, ch 10, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next 7 ch, slip st in same st as join (petal made), *working in front loop only, slip st in next st, ch 10, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next 7 ch, slip st in same st (petal made); repeat from * around; join with slip st in first st—13 petals. Fasten off.

Stem
Round 6 (right side): Join A with slip st in any unworked loop of Round 4, ch 2 (counts as first hdc), hdc in each loop around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—13 hdc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 7: Sc in next st, [sc2tog] 6 times—7 sc.
Round 8: Working in back loops only, sc in each st.
Rounds 9–25: Sc in each st.
Round 26: Ch 4, 2 hdc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 2 ch (leaf made), sc in each st—7 sc and 1 leaf.
Round 27: Holding leaf down against stem and working behind, sc in each st¬—7 sc.
Rounds 28–33: Sc in each st.
Round 34: Slip st in next st, [ch 15, 2 dc in 3rd ch from hook, dc in next 3 ch, hdc in next 6 ch, sc in next 3 ch (leaf made), slip st in next 2 st] 3 times—7 slip sts and 3 leaves.
Round 35: Slip st in first slip st, [working across opposite side of ch of leaf, sc in first 12 ch, 2 sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in next dc, sc in next 13 st, 2 slip st in next 2 slip sts] 3 times; join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in ends. Stiffen petals and leaves to straighten, if desired. Insert chopstick in stem.

IRIS
Stem
With medium hook and A, ch 26.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—25 sc.
Row 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Round 5: Working across ends of rows, ch 1 [sc in first row, 2 sc in next row] twice; join with slip st in first st—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
With wrong sides together, fold stem lengthwise and sew edges of Rows 1 and 4 together.

Head
Lower Petals
With D, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Holding Round 1 of head to Round 5 of stem and working through both thicknesses, inserting hook through next st of Round 1 and then inserting in next st of Round 5 from inner side, sc in each st.
Round 3: Working in inner loops only, sc in each st.
Note: Continue in rows.
Row 4: Working in outer loops only, 2 sc in next two stitches; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—4 sc.
Rows 5–9: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in first st, dc in next 2 st, sc in last st; working across ends of rows, work 7 slip sts evenly to Round 3, do not turn—2 sc and 2 dc.
Rows 11–24: Repeat Rows 4–10 twice.

Ruffle Edge
Row 25: Ch 1, working across ends of rows and in each st, (sc, dc) in each row and st evenly around every petal. Fasten off, leaving a long tail to make stamens.

Upper Petals
Round 1: With medium hook and working in unworked loops of Row 4 of lower petal, join F with slip st 2nd unworked loop behind first petal, ch 1, (sc, dc) in same st as join, (dc, sc, slip st) in next st, *(sc, dc) in next st, (dc, sc, slip st) in next st; repeat from * once; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc and 6 dc.
Note: Continue in rows.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), sc in first dc, skip next sc, sc in next dc, dc in next sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—2 sc and 2 dc.
Rows 3–5: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn—4 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first st, dc in next 2 st, sc in last st; working across ends of rows, work 7 slip sts evenly to Round 1, do not turn. Skip the slip st at the bottom.
Rows 7–11: Repeat Rows 2–6.
Rows 12–16: Repeat Rows 2–6.

Ruffle Edge
Row 17: Work same as Row 25 of lower petals.

Leaf (make as many as desired)
With A and medium hook, ch 26.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—25 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, working over chenille stem, sc in remaining sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
Using photograph as a guide, weave ends of D and F to center of flower to create stamens. Trim to desired length. Sew leaves to base of stem. Weave in ends. Insert chopstick in stem.

materials: Red Heart® Amigurumi™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 239 yds/219m) Santa (9962)
Green – is not used for this design
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
¼" [1 cm] wooden bead for nose.
4" [10 cm] piece of cardboard for beard.
Knee high stockings for weighted stuffing.
Weighted stuffing (such as aquarium gravel, plastic pellets or rice).
Pet brush or comb for fluffing beard.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 22 sc and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Note
Before start, separate the different color sections of the yarn as follows: Push the rings of color out from center. Find the point where the color changes and Break the yarn. Rep this process for the rem yarn colors. Wind each color into a separate ball.
BODY and HEAD
Notes: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed, keeping color change to WS of work. Do not join at end of rnd. Work in continuous rnds (spiral). Move marker up as each rnd is completed.
Body
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. PM for beg of rnd. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each of next 6 sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: (1 sc next sc. 2 sc in each of next sc) 6 times. 18 sc.
4th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 24 sc.
5th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 30 sc.
6th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 36 sc.
7th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 42 sc.
8th rnd: Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around.
9th rnd: Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Change to B at end of rnd. Fasten off A.
10th to 12th rnds: With B, 1 sc in each st around.
13th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Sc2tog) 6 times. 36 sts.
14th rnd: As 10th rnd.
15th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 16 sts) twice. 34 sts.
16th rnd: As 10th rnd.
17th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 15 sts) twice. 32 sts. Stuff with weighted stuffing placed in toe of a knee high. Start stuffing piece firmly. Cont stuffing piece as work progresses.
18th rnd: As 10th rnd.
19th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 14 sts) twice. 30 sts.
20th to 24th rnds: As 10th rnd.
25th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts) twice. 28 sts.
26th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts) 4 times. 24 sts.
27th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts) 6 times. Change to C at end of rnd. 18 sts. Fasten off B.
Head
28th rnd: With C, as 10th rnd.
29th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 24 sc.
30th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 30 sc.
31st to 35th rnds: As 10th rnd.
36th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. 24 sts.
37th to 39th rnds: As 10th rnd.
40th rnd: (Sc2tog) 12 times. 12 sts.
Finish stuffing piece.
41st rnd: (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.
ARMS 
With B, ch 6, leaving a long end. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each ch around. Do not join. PM for beg of rnd. 6 sc.
2nd to 12th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Join A at end of last rnd. Fasten off B. Stuff arms lightly.
13th to 15th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off. Thread end through sts of last rnd. Pull tightly. Leave end for sewing to body. 
HAT
With B, ch 36, leaving a long end. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st and each ch around. Do not join. PM for beg of rnd. 36 sc.
2nd and 3rd rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
4th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts) 6 times. 30 sts.
5th to 11th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
12th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts) twice. 28 sts.
13th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts) twice. 26 sts.
14th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 11 sts) twice. 24 sts.
15th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts) twice. 22 sts.
16th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts) twice. 20 sts.
17th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts) twice. 18 sts.
18th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts) twice. 16 sts.
19th to 21st rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
22nd rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts) twice. 14 sts.
23rd rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts) twice. 12 sts.
24th to 28th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
29th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts) twice. 10 sts.
30th to 49th rnds: 1 sc in each st around.
50th rnd: (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st) 3 times. 1 sc in last st. 7 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.
Bend end of chenille stem approx ½" [1.5 cm] to prevent sharp tip from poking through hat. Cut chenille stem to fit inside Hat. Insert chenille stem into Hat. Stuff long thin top end of hat lightly, leaving bottom of hat unstuffed.
BOOTS
Note: Boots are made in one piece, stuffed then shaped to resemble 2 boot toes.
Beg at bottom of boots with A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. PM for beg of rnd. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each of next 6 sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc next sc) 6 times. 18 sc.
4th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 24 sc.
5th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 30 sc.
6th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 36 sc.
7th and 8th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
9th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Sc2tog) 6 times. 30 sts.
10th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog) 6 times. 24 sts.
11th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog) 6 times. 18 sts.
Stuff lightly, beg with weighted stuffing placed in toe of a knee high.
12th rnd: (Sc2tog) 9 times. 9 sts. Fasten off, leaving long end. Thread end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Thread rem end of yarn through needle and shape boot toes as follows:
1. Insert needle straight down through center of 12th rnd and out of bottom of piece.
2. Wrap yarn out across piece and around outer edge, inserting needle back through center of 12th rnd.
3. Pull tightly to pucker front edge of piece, giving the appearance of rounded boot toes.
4. Rep steps 2 and 3 to ensure a secure hold. Leave end of yarn for sewing boots to bottom of body.
BEARD
Wrap C around 4" [10 cm] piece of cardboard 40 times. Tie securely at one end. Cut across other end. With pet brush or comb, comb out the strands of yarn to fluff out beard. 
Sew Beard to Head at 35th and 36th rnds.
FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide to placement, sew the following pieces together using yarn ends.
1. Sew wooden bead to head for Nose, placing it on top of beard and working over tie knot.
2. Sew arms to body approx 2 rnds down from first C-colored rnd of Head and approx 10 sts apart. (Make sure that arms are far enough apart so that they will not be hidden by beard).
3. Place hat on head so that none of the head shows except nose. Sew hat in place.
With gnome standing, trim beard into a rounded shape as desired or leave uneven.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 Ball White 001 or 453 Shaded Christmas A, 1 ball each 484 Myrtle Green B and 494 Victory Red C.
measurements: Doily measures approximately 16” from point to point.
gauge: Rounds 1-5 = 2”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
DOILY
With B ch 6; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with a slip st to first sc – 12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st to first sc – 24 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in joining slip st, sc in next 2 sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 7 times; join with slip st to first sc – 32 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in joining slip st, sc in next 3 sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 7 times; join with slip st to first sc – 40 sc.
Round 5: Ch 3, tr in joining slip st, ch 3, (tr, dc) all in next sc, *skip next sc, sc in next sc, skip next sc **, (dc, tr) all in next sc, ch 3, (tr, dc) all in next sc; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with slip st to top of ch-3 – 8 shells.
Round 6: Slip st in next tr, ch 1, *sc in next ch-3 space, ch 8; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first sc.
Round 7: Slip st in next 3 chs, ch 7, [dtr in next ch, ch 2] twice, *dtr in next ch, ch 5, skip next 2 ch, skip next sc, skip next 2 ch **, [dtr in next ch, ch 2] 3 times; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with slip st to 5th ch of ch-7.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in joining slip st, *[2 sc in ch-2 space, sc in dtr] 3 times; 5 sc in ch-5 space **; sc in next dtr; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with slip st to first sc – 120 sc.
Rounds 9 and 10: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st to first sc.
Round 11: Repeat Round 5 – 24 shells. Fasten off.
Round 12: With right side facing, join A to first ch-3 space, ch 3; work 2-dc cluster in joining ch-3 space; *ch 8, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 8 **; 3-dc cluster in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with a slip st to top of 2-dc cluster – 12 clusters.
Round 13: Ch 2, 2-dc cluster in slip st; *ch 3, (sc, ch 5, sc) all in next ch-8 space; ch 5, (sc, ch 5, sc) all in next ch-8 space; ch 3 **, 3-dc cluster in top of next 3-dc cluster; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with a slip st to top of 2-dc cluster.
Round 14: Ch 2, 2-dc cluster in slip st; *ch 5, skip ch-3 space, [sc in next ch-5 space, ch 5] 3 times **; 3-dc cluster in top on next 3-dc cluster; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with a slip st to top of 2-dc cluster.
Round 15: Ch 2, 2-dc cluster in slip st; *ch 3, sc in next ch-5 space, [ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] 3 times; ch 3**, 3-dc cluster in top of next 3-dc cluster; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with a slip st to top of 2-dc cluster.
Round 16: Repeat Round 14.
Round 17: Repeat Round 15, working ch 6 instead of ch 5.
Round 18: Repeat Round 14, working ch 6 instead of ch 5.
Round 19: Ch 2, 2-dc cluster in slip st; ch 4, sc in next ch-6 space, [ch 7, sc in next ch-6 space] 3 times; ch 4**, 3-dc cluster in top of next 3-dc cluster; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with a slip st to top of 2-dc cluster.
Round 20: Ch 2, 2-dc cluster in slip st; *ch 7, skip ch-4 space, [sc in ch-7 space, ch 7] 3 times**; 3-dc cluster in top of next 3-dc cluster; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with a slip st to top of 2-dc cluster.
Round 21: Ch 2, 2-dc cluster in slip st; *ch 4, sc in next ch-7 space, [ch 8, sc in next ch-7 space] 3 times; ch 4**, 3-dc cluster in top of next 3-dc cluster; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with a slip st to top of 2-dc cluster.
Round 22: Ch 2, 2-dc cluster in slip st; *ch 7, skip ch-4 space, sc in ch-8 space; [(dtr, trtr, ch 3, trtr, dtr) all in next sc, sc in next ch-8 space] twice; ch 7**, 3-dc cluster in top of next 3-dc cluster; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with a slip st to top of 2-dc cluster.
Round 23: Ch 2, 2-dc cluster in slip st; *ch 4, sc in ch-7 space, [ch 7, sc in next ch-3 space] twice; ch 7, sc in next ch-7 space, ch 4**; 3-dc cluster in top of next 3-dc cluster; repeat from * around, ending at **; join with a slip st to top of 2-dc cluster.
Round 24: Ch 2, 2-dc cluster in slip st; *ch 6, skip ch-4 space, sc in ch-7 space, [ch 6, sc in next ch-7 space] twice; ch 6**, (2-dc cluster, ch 3, sl st, ch 3, 2-dc cluster) all in top of next 3-dc cluster; repeat from * around, ending at **; 3-dc cluster in same st first 2-dc cluster made; do not join; mark right side of work; turn – 24 clusters.
Points
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Ch 3, 2-dc cluster in top of next cluster; ch 3, sc in next ch-6 space, ch 4, sc in next ch-6 space, ch 6, sc in next ch-6 space, ch 4, sc in next ch-6 space, ch 3; 3-dc cluster in top of next cluster; turn.
Row 2: Ch 3, 2-dc cluster in top of next cluster; ch 4, skip next ch-3 space, [sc in next ch-4 space, ch 4] 3 times; skip next ch-3 space; 3-dc cluster in top of next cluster; turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, 2-dc cluster in top of next cluster; ch 3, sc in next ch-4 space, [ch 4, sc in next ch-4 space] 3 times; ch 3, 3-dc cluster in top of next cluster; turn.
Row 4: Ch 3, 2-dc cluster in top of next cluster; ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, [sc in next ch-4 space, ch 3] 3 times; skip next ch-3 space, 3-dc cluster in top of next cluster; turn.
Row 5: Ch 3, 2-dc cluster in top of next cluster; ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3] twice; skip next ch-3 space, 3-dc cluster in top of next cluster; turn.
Row 6: Ch 3, 2-dc cluster in top of next cluster; 3-dc cluster in top of next cluster. Fasten off.
With right side facing, skip next cluster on Round 24, join A to next cluster; turn. Work Rows 1-6 for point. Repeat until all 12 points are completed. Weave in ends. Block doily before sewing on leaves.
LEAVES (Make 12 sets)
First Leaf
With B, ch 12.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook – tip made; sc in next 9 ch, (sc, ch 3, sc) all in last ch; working along opposite side of chain, sc in next 8 ch; turn.
Row 2: Ch 3, sc in next 9 sc, (sc, ch 3, sc) all in ch-3 space, sc in next 8 sc; turn.
Rows 3-12: Working in back loops only, repeat Row 2. At end of Row 12, slip st in last sc. Fasten off.
Second Leaf
Rows 1-11: Work same as for First Leaf.
Row 12 (Joining Row): With right sides of each leaf facing and working through both thicknesses, ch 3; slip st in next 9 sts and next ch-3 space; working on 2nd Leaf only, sc in back loop of next 8 sc; slip st in last sc worked. Fasten off.
BERRIES (Make 12)
With C, ch 12; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: [Slip st into next ch, ch 3; work 5-tr cluster into same ch; ch 3, slip st in same ch, skip next ch] 6 times; turn; keeping right side facing, work 5-tr cluster in same ch as last cluster. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew tip of last cluster to 6th ch of ring. Sew berries to leaves. Sew leaves between points of doily with the joining of the 2 leaves just touching the 2 clusters of Round 24. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Handicrafter® HolidaysTM (2.8 oz/80 g; 138 yds/126 m) White Sparkle (48005) - 1 ball will make approx 4 Snowflakes.
Size U.S. F/5 (3.75 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Snowflake 1: Approx 7" [18 cm] diameter. Snowflake 2: Approx 8½" [21.5 cm] diameter. Snowflake 3: Approx 10" [25.5 cm] diameter.
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Snowflake 1
Ch 6. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: *Ch 4. [(Yoh) twice and draw up a loop in ring. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice] twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - Tr cluster made. Ch 4. Sl st in ring. Rep from * 5 times more. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. Join yarn with sl st to first Tr cluster. (Ch 9. Sl st in same sp as previous sl st. Ch 3. Sl st in next Tr cluster) 5 times. Ch 9. Sl st in same sp as previous sl st. Join with sl st to first ch.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 ch. [(3 sc. Ch 3) 3 times. 3 sc] in next ch-9 loop. Rep from * 5 times more. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
4th rnd: Join yarn with sl st to first ch-3 sp. Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc. Ch 3. Sl st. Ch 4. 2 tr. Ch 4. Sl st. Ch 3. 1 dc. Ch 3. 1 sc) all in next ch-3 sp. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 4. (1 hdc. Ch 2. Sl st) in 2nd ch from hook. Ch 2. Skip next 9 sc. 2 sc in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * 5 times more. Fasten off.

Snowflake 2
Ch 7. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. (3 sc. Ch 9) 6 times in ring. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join yarn with sl st to any ch-9 loop. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in same sp as sl st. [Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-9 loop] 5 times. Ch 1. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
3rd rnd: Sl st back into last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 1. 6 dc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 6. Sl st to first ch. Turn. (Ch 4. 2 tr. Ch 4. Sl st) 3 times in last ch-6 sp made – top cluster made. Turn. 6 dc in same ch-3 sp as last 6 dc. Ch 1.** 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * 4 times more, then from * to ** once. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Snowflake 3
Ch 6. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch 3). (1 dc. Ch 3) 11 times in ring. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 6. 12 ch-3 sps.

Finishing
Pin Snowflake to measurements. Apply spray starch if desired and steam iron lightly.

materials: Bernat® Handicrafter® Cotton (1.75 oz/50 g; 80 yds/73 m)
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
DISHCLOTH A
Motif (make 4)
With A, ch 3.
1st rnd: (RS). 6 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 
Join with sl st in back loop of first hdc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 4. [(Yoh) twice. Draw up a 
loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on 
hook) twice] twice in same sp as last sl st.

abbreviations: s-inc (sc increase) = 2 sc in next st.
dec (decrease) = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
h-inc (hdc increase) = 2 hdc in next st.
gauge: 16 sts = 4”; 16 rounds = 4” in sc rounds. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
MONKEY
Legs (Make 2)
Round 1: With B, make a loop over your fingers, insert hook into the loop and draw up 1 ch; 4 sc into loop; draw up end to tighten loop – 4 sc. Do not join but work in continuous rounds. Mark last sc of round. Move marker up each round.
Round 2: [S-inc] 4 times – 8 sc.
Rounds 3 and 4: Sc in each sc around.
Rounds 5-10: With A, sc in each sc around. Cut yarn and set aside first leg.
Make 2nd leg, do not cut yarn.
Join Legs/Body
Round 1: Ch 1 for crotch, sc in the 8 sts of first leg, sc in ch between legs, sc in the 8 sc of 2nd leg, sc in remaining loop of ch – 18 sc.
Rounds 2-5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: [Dec, sc in next 4 sc] 3 times – 15 sc.
Round 7: [Dec, sc in next 3 sc] 3 times – 12 sc. Fasten off.
Head
Round 1: With A, make a loop over your fingers, insert hook into the loop and draw up 1 ch; 6 sc into loop; draw up end to tighten loop – 6 sc. Do not join but work in continuous rounds. Mark last sc of round. Move marker up each round.
Round 2: [S-inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 3: [S-inc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Rounds 4-7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: [Dec, sc in next 4 sc] 3 times – 15 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.
Muzzle
Rounds 1-2: With B, work as for Head through Round 2.
Round 3: [S-inc, sc in next 3 sc] 3 times – 15 sc. Fasten off.
Ears (Make 2)
Row 1: With A, ch 3; 8 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Fasten off.
Arms (Make 2)
Work as for Legs.
Hat
Round 1: With B, make a loop over your fingers, insert hook into the loop and draw up 1 ch; 9 hdc into loop; join with a slip st in first hdc; draw up end to tighten loop – 9 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), hdc in same st as joining, [h-inc] 8 times; join with a slip st in top of ch-2 – 18 sts.
Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next 5 hdc, [h-inc, hdc in next 5 hdc] twice – 21 sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, slip st in each st around. Fasten off.
FiNiSHiNG
Stuff Legs, Body, Head, Arms and Muzzle. Sew Head to Body. Sew Muzzle and Ears to Head. Flatten tops of Arms and sew to sides of Body. Embroider eyes with D French knots. Embroider mouth with C and make 6 satin sts across Muzzle. For topknot, cut six (6) 10” strands of C; thread strands through a st at top of hat. Knot strands together with an overhand knot at base. Trim to ½”. Sew Hat to Head.

materials: RED HEART® “Holiday”: 1 ball each 6060 Green/Green A, 140 White/Silver B, and 9090 Red/Red C.
RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 Skein 320 Cornmeal D.

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: 20 sc = 4”; 20 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Body
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 6 sts.
Round 2: 2 sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Round 3: * 2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 4: Sc in each st around.
Round 5: * 2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 6: Repeat Round 4.
Round 7: * 2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 8: Repeat Round 4, changing to B in last st.
Round 9: With B, * 2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Round 10: Repeat Round 4.
Round 11: * 2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around; change to C in last st – 42 sts.
Round 12: With C, repeat Round 4.
Round 13: * 2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts; repeat from * around; change to A in last st – 48 sts.
Round 14: With A, repeat Round 4.
Round 15: Repeat Round 4, changing to B in last st.
Rounds 16-18: With B, repeat Round 4.
Round 19: Repeat Round 4, changing to C in last st.
Rounds 20-23: With C, repeat Round 4.
Round 24: * Sc2tog, sc in next 6 sts; repeat from * around – 42 sts.
Round 25: * Sc2tog, sc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Round 26: * Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 27: * Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around – 24 sts. Add stuffing.
Round 28: * Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around – 18 sts. Finish stuffing ornament firmly.
Round 29: * Sc2tog, sc in next st; repeat from * around – 12 sts.
Round 30: Sc2tog around – 6 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. With yarn needle, weave tail through remaining sts and pull tight. Weave in ends.

Beak
With D, ch 20; join with a slip st.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around – 20 sts.
Round 2: * Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around – 16 sts.
Round 3: * Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around – 12 sts.
Round 4: * Sc2tog, sc in next st; repeat from * around – 8 sts.
Round 5: Sc in each st around.
Round 6: Sc2tog around – 4 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through remaining sts and pull tight.

Feet (Make 2)
With D, ch 2.
Round 1: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 4 sts.
Rounds 2-36: Sc in each st around.
Round 37: [Sc2tog] twice. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through remaining sts and pull tight.

Wings (Make 2)
With A, ch 10; join.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around – 10 sts.
Round 2: Sc in each st around; change to B in last st.
Round 3: With B, sc in each st around; change to C in last st.
Round 4: With C, 2 sc in each st around – 20 sts.
Round 5: Ch 2, 4 hdc in same st, [slip st in next st, skip next st, 5 hdc in next st] 4 times; slip st in last st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Use tail to tack Wing closed. Weave tail from beginning through ch and pull tight.

Top Knot
[Using A, ch 10. Fasten off.] 6 times.
Repeat with B and C.

Tail
With A, ch 10, join.
Round 1: Sc in each ch around – 10 sts.
Round 2: Sc in each st around.
Round 3: Repeat Round 2, changing to B in last st.
Round 4: With B, repeat Round 2, changing to C in last st.
Round 5: With C, 2 sc in each st around – 20 sts.
Round 6: Ch 2, 4 hdc in same st, [slip st in next st, skip next st, 5 hdc in next st] 4 times; slip st in last st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Use tail to tack Tail closed. Weave tail from beginning through ch and pull tight.

FINISHING
With the wider part of the Body at the top, sew Wings, Beak, and Tail to Body as pictured. Fold Top Knot chains in half and sew in a cluster to top of Body. Fold each Foot in half and tack to bottom of Body. Attach Eyes securely with sewing thread and needle. With A, ch 25. Sew into loop at top of Ornament. Weave in ends.

instructions:

With selected thread and hook, ch 5, slip st in first ch to form ring.

Round 2: Slip st in first ch-5 loop, ch 2 (counts as dc), 8 dc in same loop, [9 dc in next ch-5 loop] 5 times, slip st in top of beginning ch-2—6 9-dc shells. 
Round 3: (Slip st in 2nd dc, ch 1, sc in same dc, ch 3, skip 1 dc, sc in next 2 dc, ch 11, sc in same dc, sc in next dc, ch 3, skip next dc, sc in next dc, skip last dc) in first shell, *(skip first dc, sc in next dc, ch 3, skip 1 dc, sc in next 2 dc, ch 11, sc in same dc, sc in next dc, ch 3, skip next dc, sc in next dc, skip last dc) in next shell; repeat from * 4 times, slip st in first sc of round—6 ch-11 loops.
Round 4: Slip st in first ch-3 space, ch 1, *2 sc in ch-3 space, ch 3, 2 sc in same ch-3 space, 3 sc in next ch-11 space, [ch 3, 3 sc in same ch-11 space] 2 times, Triple picot in sc just made (see Special Stitches), 2 sc in same ch-11 space, [ch 3, 3 sc in same ch-11 space] 2 times, 2 sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 2 sc in same ch-3 space; starting in next ch-3 space, repeat from * 4 times then from * to ** once; turn, ch 7, slip st in 7th ch from hook to form ring; (turn, ch 1, 11 sc) in ring just made, slip st around base of ring; 2 sc in same ch-11 space, [ch 3, 3 sc in same ch-11 space] 2 times, 2 sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 2 sc in same ch-3 space; slip st in first sc of round. Fasten off and weave in ends. Block and stiffen with stiffener of choice (see Note).

Size 4.00 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.

instructions:
Daffodil (make 6): 
With A, ch 2. 
1st rnd: (RS). 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in back loop of first sc. 
First Petal: 1st row: Ch 1. 2 sc in back loop of same sc as last sl st. Ch 1. Turn. 
2nd row: 2 sc in each sc. 4 sc. Ch 1. Turn. 
3rd to 5th rows: 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Ch 1. Turn. 
6th row: (Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook - sc dec made) twice. Ch 3. Turn. 
7th row: Miss first sc. Sl st in next sc. Sl st in side of each of next 5 rows of petal. Sl st in last sc worked on 1st row and in back loop of next sc. Do not turn. 
Second to Sixth Petals: 1st row: Ch 1. 2 sc in back loop of same sc as last sl st. Ch 1. Turn. 
2nd to 7th rows: Work as given for 2nd to 7th rows of First Petal. At end of Sixth Petal, fasten off. 
Trumpet: Join C with sl st to any front loop of 1st rnd. 1st rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in next front loop of sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off. 
Leaf (make 12): With B, ch 12. 
1st rnd: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 4 ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. 
Working in other side of ch, proceed as follows: 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 4 ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in next ch. 2 sc in next ch. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Assembly: Wrap wire with B. Glue yarn ends in place when done. Thread wire through center of flower and twist the end of the wire into a tight spiral. 
Glue back of flower to wire to secure. Thread wire through point of two leaves and glue in position.

gauge: 15 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm]. Flower = 4" [10 cm] diameter. Leaf = 2½" [6 cm] long.
instructions:
FLOWER
Petal Rounds (make 2) See diagram on page 3.
With A, ch 10. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist ch.
1st row: (WS). Ch 6. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Working back down ch-6 toward ch-10 ring, 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. Sl st in next ch of ch-10 ring. Turn.
2nd row: (RS). Ch 3. 1 dc in each of first 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Working back down opposite side of last ch-6 toward ch-10 ring, 2 sc in next rem loop. 1 dc in each of next 4 rem loop. Ch 3. Sl st in same rem loop as last dc. Sl st in each of next 2 ch of ch-10 ring. Turn.
Last 2 rows form one Petal.
Rep 1st and 2nd rows 4 times more to complete 4 more Petals (total of 5 Petals), ending with sl st in same rem loop as last dc.
Fasten off.
Center
With D, ch 2.
1st rnd: (RS). 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc of rnd. Turn.
2nd rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 2 Lp st in each sc around. Join with sl st to first st of rnd. 10 Lp sts.
Fasten off.
Flower Finishing: Place two Petal Rounds RS up, aligning Ch-10 rings and offsetting Petals. Place Center RS up on top of Petal Rounds and sew all three pieces tog to form Flower (as shown in photo).

Leaf (Make 3 each with B and C).
Ch 5. See diagram on page 3.
1st rnd: (5 tr. Ch 1. 5 tr) all in 5th ch from hook (counts as ch 4. 5 tr. Ch 1. 5 tr). Ch 4. Sl st in same 5th ch from hook.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 5 sc in first ch-4 sp (working around first ch-4 along bottom edge of Leaf ). 1 sc in next tr. 2 sc in next tr. 2 hdc in next tr. 2 dc in next tr. 1 dc in next tr. (2 tr. Ch 2. 2 tr) all in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next tr. 2 dc in next tr. 2 hdc in next tr. 2 sc in next tr. 1 sc in last tr. 5 sc in next ch-4 sp (working around last ch-4 along bottom edge of Leaf ). Join with sl st in first ch-1. Fasten off.

Attaching Flower and Leaves to Craft Ring: Tie Flower and Leaves to metal craft ring as shown in photo. Center piece of felt behind metal craft ring, Flower, and Leaves. Using hot glue gun and glue sticks, glue WS of Flowers and Leaves in place along metal craft ring at the same time also gluing them to felt piece to secure in place and create a sturdy backing for the decorations. Trim edges of felt close to Flower and Leaves so it is hidden behind decorations when viewed from RS (as shown in photo).
Hanging String: Cut strand of B 20" [51 cm] long. Attach with Lark’s Head Knot to top of metal craft ring (as shown in diagram). Tie tail ends tog to desired length for hanging and trim ends.
Attach Hanging String with Lark’s Head Knot.

With A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), dc in ring, [ch 1, dc in ring] 8 times, ch 1; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—10 dc and 10 ch-1 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, [2 sc in next ch-1 space, sc in next dc] 9 times, 2 sc in last ch-1 space; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 3: Ch 20, skip next st, slip st in next st, [ch 20, skip next st, slip st in next st] 13 times, ch 20, skip last st, slip st in same st as joining—15 ch-20 spaces.
Fasten off A.
Round 4: With right side facing, join B with sc in any ch-20 space, sc again in same ch-20 space, [ch 4, 2 sc in next ch-20 space] twice, *ch 7, 2 sc in next ch-20 space, [ch 4, 2 sc in next ch-20 space] twice; repeat from * 3 more times, ch 7; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc, 5 ch-7 spaces, and 10 ch-4 spaces (2 ch-4 spaces and 6 sc along each of 5 sides between ch-7 spaces).
Round 5: Ch 2 (does not count as a st), dc in last ch-7 space of Round 4 (you may need to angle the hook backwards slightly to reach the last ch-7 space), *[skip next 2 sc, 5 hdc in next ch-4 space] twice, skip next 2 sc, (7 dc, ch 3, 7 dc) in next ch-7 space (corner made); rep from * 3 more times, [skip next 2 sc, 5 hdc in next ch-4 space] twice, skip last 2 sc, (7 dc, ch 3, 6 dc) in same ch-7 space as first dc; join with slip st in first dc—Ten 5-dc groups and five (7 dc, ch 3, 7 dc) corners (two 5-hdc groups along each of 5 sides between corners).
Fasten off B.
Round 6: With right side facing, join C with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same ch-3 space, *dc in next 3 dc, ch 2, skip next 4 dc, Fptr around next 2 sc 2 rounds below (work the Fptr all the way around the 2 sc held together, as if working around one stitch) , 2 dc in space between last skipped dc and next hdc, ch 2, skip next 5 hdc, Fptr around next 2 sc 2 rounds below, 2 dc in space between last skipped hdc and next hdc, ch 2, skip next 5 hdc, Fptr around next 2 sc 2 rounds below, 2 dc in space between last skipped hdc and next dc, ch 2, skip next 4 dc, dc in next 3 dc **, corner-shell in next corner ch-3 space; repeat from * 4 more times ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—15 (Fptr, 2 dc) groups, and 20 ch-2 spaces (3 (Fptr, 2 dc) groups and 4 ch-2 spaces along each of 5 sides).
Fasten off C.
Round 7: With right side facing, join D with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 1, (2 sc, ch 3, 2 sc) in same ch-3 space, *sc in next 5 dc, [ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, Fphdc around next Fptr, sc in next 2 dc] 3 times, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next 5 dc **, (2 sc, ch 3, 2 sc) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * 4 more times ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in first sc—15 Fphdc, and 20 ch-2 spaces (3 Fphdc and 4 ch-2 spaces along each of 5 sides).
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, sc in next sc, (2 sc, ch 3, 2 sc) in next corner ch-3 space, *sc in next 7 sc, [ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, Fphdc around next Fphdc, sc in next 2 sc] 3 times, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next 7 sc **, (2 sc, ch 3, 2 sc) in next corner ch-3 space; repeat from * 4 more times ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.
Round 9: With right side facing, join B with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 3, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same ch-3 space, *dc in next 4 sc, ch 3, skip next 5 sc, V-st in next ch-2 space, [ch 1, skip next Fphdc, skip next 2 sc, V-st in next ch-2 space] 3 times, ch 3, skip next 5 sc, dc in next 4 sc **, corner-shell in next corner ch-3 space; repeat from * 4 more times ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—20 V-sts (4 V-sts along each of 5 sides).
Fasten off B.

instructions:
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
BACKGROUND
With A, ch 83.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 82 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 37" [94 cm].
Fasten off.
Edging
1st rnd: (RS). Join B with sl st in top left corner. Ch 1. Work 1 rnd sc evenly around Background, working 3 sc in each corner. Join. Do not fasten off. Turn.
Dowel Casing
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across top of Background Edging. Turn. 85 sc.
Rep 1st row until Dowel Casing measures 3" [7.5 cm].
Fasten off. Fold Dowel Casing in half lengthwise. Sew final row to WS to form casing to insert dowel.
POCKETS (make 4 each in C, D, E, F, G, and H)
Ch 9.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 8 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 3" [7.5 cm].
Fasten off. With A, using chain st, embroider numbers 1-24 on Pockets according to diagram (see page 7).
Chain Stitch
Beg 1¼" [2.5 cm] up from bottom and 1" [2.5 cm] from side, sew 3 edges of Pockets onto Background following diagram for placement and leaving 1" [2.5 cm] between Pockets.
WREATH
With D, ch 70. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each ch around. Join. 70 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Break D. Join C. 80 hdc.
3rd rnd: With C, ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 90 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 100 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 110 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 10 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 120 hdc.
7th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 11 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 130 hdc.
8th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 12 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 140 hdc.
9th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 13 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 150 hdc.
10th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 14 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 160 hdc.
11th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 15 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 170 hdc.
12th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 16 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 180 hdc.
13th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 17 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Break C. Join D. 190 hdc.
14th rnd: With D, ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 18 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 200 hdc.
15th rnd: Skip first 2 hdc. *5 dc in next hdc. Skip next hdc. Sl st in each of next 2 hdc. Skip next hdc. Rep from * to last 3 hdc. 5 dc in next hdc. Skip next hdc. Sl st in last hdc. Join.
Fasten off.
Sew Wreath to Background as shown in photo.
Bow: With F, ch 14.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 13 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 16" [40.5 cm].
Fasten off.
Fold Bow in half widthwise. Sew ends tog.
Bow Center: With F, ch 6.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 5 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 4" [10 cm].
Fasten off. Center Bow seam in back of work. Wrap Bow Center around middle of Bow, covering Bow seam. Sew ends of Bow Center tog.
Bow Ends (make 2 alike): With F, ch 14.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 13 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 6" [15 cm]. Fasten off. Gather tops of Bow Ends with gathering stitch and sew to top of Wreath as shown in photo.
Sew Bow to top of Bow Ends as shown in photo.
ORNAMENTS
CUPCAKE (make 1 of each Version): 
Version 1: Use I as Color 1, A as Color 2, F as Color 3, and L as Color 4.
Version 2: Use M as Color 1, A as Color 2, F as Color 3, and K as Color 4. 
Note: See diagrams on page 9.
Icing: With Color 1, ch 2.
1st row: (RS). 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 8 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. 12 sc.
Do not fasten off. Do not turn.
Next row: (RS). Working along straight edge of Icing, ch 1. Work 7 sc evenly across edge. Turn. 
Next row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, *3 sc in next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. (3 sc. Sl st) all in last sc. 
Fasten off.
Cupcake Bottom: With Color 2, ch 7.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Turn. 6 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sl st in each of next 3 sts. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each of next 3 sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows twice more.
Fasten off. Sew wider side edge of Cupcake Bottom to front loops of 2nd last row of Icing.
Cherry: With Color 3, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. Ch 10 for hanging loop. Join to last sl st worked. Fasten off. Sew Cherry to top of Icing. With Color 4, embroider Sprinkles with straight st as shown in photo.
Straight Stitch
PINEAPPLE (make 2)
Note: See diagram on page 9.
With J, ch 4.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in first sc. Ch 2. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in last sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row, pushing each ch-2 to front of work. Turn. 5 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in first sc. *Ch 2. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * twice more. Ch 2. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in last sc. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row, pushing each ch-2 to front of work. Turn. 7 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
7th row: As 5th row.
8th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. (Ch 2. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Ch 2. Sc2tog. Turn.
9th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row, pushing each ch-2 to front of work. Break J. Join C.
10th row: With C, ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in first sc of previous row. Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in next sc of previous row. Ch 12 for hanging loop. 1 sc in 11th ch from hook 1 sc in next ch. 1 sc in next sc of previous row. Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in next sc of previous row. Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Sl st in first sc of previous row.
Fasten off.
CACTUS PLANT (make 1 of each version)
Version 1: Use D as Color 1 and E as Color 2.
Version 2: Use C as Color 1 and F as Color 2.
Note: See diagrams on page 9.
Cactus: With Color 1, ch 11.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 4 sc in last ch. Working into opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 22 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. Ch 10 for hanging loop. Sl st in same st as last 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Ch 7. 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 3 hdc in next ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc.
Fasten off.
Flower: With Color 2, ch 2.
1st rnd: (1 sc. 1 dc) 4 times all in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
Fasten off. Sew Flower to top of Cactus under Hanging Loop.
DONUT (make 1 of each version)
Version 1: Use N as Color 1, L as Color 2, J as Color 3.
Version 2: Use N as Color 1, E as Color 2, M as Color 3.
Note: See diagrams on page 9.
Donut: With Color 1, ch 6. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: 12 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. Ch 10 for hanging loop. Sl st in last sl st. 30 sc.
Fasten off.
Icing: With Color 2, Ch 8. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: 16 sc in ring. Join. 16 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. (1 dc. 1 sc) all in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
Fasten off. Sew Icing to Donut. With Color 3, embroider Sprinkles with straight st as shown in photo.
AVOCADO (make 2)
Note: See diagram on page 10.
With N, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Break N. Join D. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: With D, ch 1. Working in back loops only, *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Turn. 6 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
7th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sts.
8th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Break D. Join C. Turn. Do not fasten off. 2 sc.
Edging rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 10 for hanging loop. Sl st in same st as last sc. 1 sc in next sc. Work 29 sc evenly around edge of Avocado. Join.
Fasten off.
MUSHROOM (make 1 of each version)
Version 1: Use G as Color 1 and A as Color 2.
Version 2: Use F as Color 1 and A as Color 2.
Note: See diagrams on page 10.
Mushroom Cap: With Color 1, ch 9.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each sc to end of ch. Turn. 8 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 10 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 6 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sts.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
7th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Do not turn. Do not fasten off. 2 sts.

Stem: With A, ch 6.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 6 dc in last ch. Working into opposite side of foundation ch, 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in each of last 2 ch. Fasten off. 1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc.* Rep from * to * once more. Ch 10 for hanging loop. Sl st in same st as last sc. Rep from * to * around. Join. 24 sc.
Tail:Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts.
Next row: Ch 3. *(2 dc. Ch 2. Sl st) all in next st. Rep from * once more.  Fasten off.
Tusk: With Color 2, ch 5.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in next ch. 1 sc in each of last 2 ch. Fasten off. Sew Tusk to Narwhal as shown in photo.
Flippers (make 2): With Color 1, ch 2.
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off. Using Color 3, embroider eyes and mouth with straight st on Narwhal as shown in photo.

Version 1: Use H as Color 1, A as Color 2, and N as Color 3.
Version 2: Use K as Color 1, A as Color 2, and N as Color 3.
Note: See diagrams on page 11.
Body: With Color 1, ch 2.
1st row: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 8 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 12 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Do not turn. 18 sc.

Arms (make 2): With Color 1, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.

1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in next 5 sc. Do not join. 10 sc.

Fasten off. Sew Face to Head as shown in photo.

Un-ply 6" [15 cm] of Color 2. Using 1 ply of yarn, embroider glints in eyes with straight st.
Sew ends of Arms tog at top to form hanging loop.

Note: See diagrams on page 11.
With H, ch 2.
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Break H. Join D. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: With D, ch 1. 2 sc in each sc to end of row. Break D. Join J. Turn. 6 sc.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. Fasten off.
