2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Ch 10 for hanging loop. Sl st in same st as last sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Fasten off.
Body: With Color 1, ch 7.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 6 sc.
2nd to 5th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off. Sew Head to Body as shown in photo.
Arms and Legs (make 4 for each Robot): With Color 2, ch 6.
1st row: (3 sc. Sl st) all in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off. Sew Arms and Legs to Body as shown in photo.
Using Color 3, embroider eyes with straight st on Head as shown in photo.
FLAMINGO (make 2)
Note: See diagrams on page 12.
Body: With I, ch 4.
1st rnd: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next sc. 3 sc in next sc. Working into opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of last 2 ch. Join. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 10 for hanging loop. Sl st in same st as last sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 hdc in next sc. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 3. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join.
Neck and Head: Next row: Skip first sc. Sl st in each of next 3 sc. Ch 7. 5 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. Sl st in next sc of previous rnd.
Fasten off.
Beak: With N, ch 2.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Break N. Join A. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in next sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. Sl st in next sc. Fasten off.
Wing: With I, ch 2.
1st rnd: (4 sc. 1 dc. Ch 3. 1 sc) all in 2nd ch from hook. Join. Fasten off. Sew Wing to Body as shown in photo.
Front Leg: With E, ch 7.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each ch to end of ch. Fasten off. Sew Front Leg to Body as shown in photo.
Back Leg: With E, ch 9.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each of next 2 ch. Skip next ch. Sl st in each ch to end of ch. Fasten off. Sew Back Leg to Body and Front Leg as shown in photo.
Using N, embroider eye with straight st on Head.

materials: Caron® Colorama™ O’Go (6.4 oz/180 g; 228 yds/208 m)
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
gauge: 4 blocks and 4 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Notes:
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull tie to remove.
• For this pattern, colors can be easily separated by gently pulling apart and cutting at the color transition. Each color is ready to use.
• Designate each color A, B, C, D, E, etc as indicated in Shade Palette
• Blanket is worked diagonally from corner to corner.
• Note color E is in both Tabby and First Blush O’Gos.
• When working from Chart, wind small balls of the colors to be used, one for each separate area of color in the design.

With A, ch 6. (See diagram on page 3 and chart on page 4).
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each of last 2 ch. Turn. 1 block made.
2nd row: Ch 6. 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch – beg block made. (Sl st. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp – block made. Turn. 2 blocks.
3rd row: Beg block. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 3 blocks.
Keeping cont of color changes in Chart, noting that each square on grid represents 1 block and should be worked in appropriate color, rep last row until 45th row of Chart is complete. 45 blocks.
Keeping cont of Chart, proceed as follows to work sides even:
46th row: Beg block. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. Sl st in last ch-3 sp. (Do not make a block). Turn.
47th row: Sl st in each of first 3 dc. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
48th to 51st rows: Rep 46th and 47th rows twice more.
Keeping cont of Chart, proceed as follows to dec corner:
52nd row: Sl st in each of first dc. *Block in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. Sl st in last ch-3 sp. (Do not make a block). Turn.
Keeping cont of Chart, rep last row until 1 block rem. Fasten off.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® (6 oz/170 g; 315 yds/288 m)
Contrast A Soft Pink (9719) 1 ball or 117 yds/107 m
Contrast B Chartreuse (9771) 1 ball or 162 yds/148 m
Contrast C Neon Pink (9775) 1 ball or 94 yds/86 m
Size U.S. H/8 [5 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Popcorn = Work 5 dc into same stitch or space. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back into first dc of 5 dc group. Pull dropped loop through stitch. Ch 1 to secure popcorn.
measurements: Motif = 5" [12.5 cm] from point to point.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Motif 
See diagram on page 2.
Make 2 using A as Color 1 and B as Color 2.
Make 4 using A as Color 1 and C as Color 2.
Make 5 using C as Color 1 and A as Color 2.
Make 4 using C as Color 1 and B as Color 2.
Make 2 using B as Color 1 and C as Color 2. 
With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring. 

1st rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as dC). (Popcorn in ring. Ch 1) 6 times. Join with sl st to first popcorn. Fasten off Color 1. Join Color 2 with sl st to any Popcorn st.

2nd rnd: Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in same sp as last sl st. Ch 1. [(3 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in next Popcorn. Ch 1] 5 times. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 

3rd rnd: Sl st to next ch-1 corner sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. 2 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.

FINISHING 
Sew Motifs tog as shown in Assembly Diagram, matching A side to A side, B side to B side, etc.
Top Edging: Join C with sl st to top left of Stocking. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st and ch-sp around. Ch 15 for hanging loop. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Holiday”: 1 ball each 9040 Red/Silver A, 6040 Green/Silver B, and 0140 White/Silver C.
abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C
* = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Poinsettia measures 7” across. Christmas Rose measures 4” across; leaf measures 3½” long.
gauge: Gauge is not important for these projects.
instructions:
POINSETTIA
With A, ch 4; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join with a slip st in front loop of first sc.
Round 2: Ch 8, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next 4 ch, slip st in same front loop as joining, * (slip st, ch 8, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next 4 ch, slip st) all in front loop of next sc; repeat from * around – 8 petals.
Round 3: Slip st in back loop of first sc on Round 1, ch 11, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next 2 ch, tr in next 3 ch, dc in next 2 ch, slip st in same back loop, * (slip st, ch 11, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next 2 ch, tr in next 3 ch, dc in next 2 ch, slip st) all in back loop of next sc on Round 1; repeat from * around. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Center “Berries”
With B, ch 4; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring; [ch 3, 3 dc in ring, drop loop from hook and insert hook in top of beginning ch-3 from front to back, pick up dropped loop and draw through loop on hook, slip st in ring] 3 times. Fasten off, leaving 6” tail for sewing. Turn piece over. With yarn needle, weave tail through tops of sts, pull tight and knot.
To flatten flower, place right side down on towel, cover with wet cloth and lightly press with fingers until petals are flat. Do NOT iron. Allow to dry.
Sew “Berries” to center of flower.
CHRISTMAS ROSE
With C, ch 4; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 2, 7 hdc in ring; join with a slip st to top of ch-2 – 8 sts.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, ch 2, [sc in next hdc, ch 2] 7 times; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 3: * (Slip st, ch 1, 5 dc, ch 1, slip st) all in next ch-2 space; repeat from * around.
Round 4: Working behind last round and in the same sts as Round 2 is worked, ch 1, sc in beginning ch-2 of Round 1, ch 2, [sc in next hdc, ch 2] 7 times; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 5: * (Slip st, ch 1, 7 dc, ch 1, slip st) all in next ch-2 space; repeat from * around. Fasten off.
With yarn needle, weave a short piece of white yarn through the ch-2 spaces of Round 2. Pull tight and knot. Pull yarn ends underneath flower and weave in. This will push the center of the flower up a little so it stands out.
Leaves (make 3)
With B, ch 10; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, hdc in next 5 ch, dc in next ch, 7 dc in last ch, working on opposite side of starting ch, dc in next ch, hdc in next 5 ch, slip st in last 2 ch. Fasten off.
Overlap bottoms of all 3 leaves, stitch together. Sew to back of rose. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 2 skeins each 316 Soft White A and 774 Light Raspberry C; 1 skein each 319 Cherry Red B, 376 Burgundy D, 624 Tea Leaf E.
Optional: velcro® hook and loop fastener, 8”, 12”, and 16” diameter round cardboard cake boards, quilt batting and water soluble pen.
abbreviations: sc2tog = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
gauge: 20 sts = 4”; 20 rounds = 4” in sc with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CAKE
Top Layer (8” Diameter)
Round 1: With larger hook and A, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st in first sc – 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [inc] 6 times; do NOT join – 12 sc. Work in continuous rounds until otherwise indicated. Mark beginning of each round and move marker up each round.
Round 3: [Inc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 4: [Inc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 5: [Inc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 6: [Inc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times – 36 sc.
Round 7: [Inc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times – 42 sc.
Round 8: [Inc, sc in next 6 sc] 6 times – 48 sc.
Round 9: [Inc, sc in next 7 sc] 6 times – 54 sc.
Round 10: [Inc, sc in next 8 sc] 6 times – 60 sc.
Round 11: [Inc, sc in next 9 sc] 6 times – 66 sc.
Round 12: [Inc, sc in next 10 sc] 6 times – 72 sc.
Round 13: [Inc, sc in next 11 sc] 6 times – 78 sc.
Round 14: [Inc, sc in next 12 sc] 6 times – 84 sc.
Round 15: [Inc, sc in next 13 sc] 6 times – 90 sc.
Round 16: [Inc, sc in next 14 sc] 6 times – 96 sc.
Round 17: [Inc, sc in next 15 sc] 6 times – 102 sc.
Round 18: Sc in back loops only of each sc around; join with a slip st in first sc.
Rounds 19-33: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Bobble Round 34: * [Yo and draw up a loop in front loop] 3 times in same front loop, yo and draw through all 7 loops on hook, ch 1 tightly, slip st in front loop of next st; repeat from * around. Fasten off.
Top Layer Bottom Piece
Repeat Rounds 1-17 of Top Layer. Fasten off.
Middle Layer (12” Diameter)
Rounds 1-17: Repeat Rounds 1-17 of Top Layer.
Round 18: [Inc, sc in next 16 sc] 6 times – 108 sc.
Round 19: [Inc, sc in next 17 sc] 6 times – 114 sc.
Round 20: [Inc, sc in next 18 sc] 6 times – 120 sc.
Round 21: [Inc, sc in next 19 sc] 6 times – 126 sc.
Round 22: [Inc, sc in next 20 sc] 6 times – 132 sc.
Round 23: [Inc, sc in next 21 sc] 6 times – 138 sc.
Round 24: [Inc, sc in next 22 sc] 6 times – 144 sc.
Round 25: [Inc, sc in next 23 sc] 6 times – 150 sc.
Round 26: [Inc, sc in next 24 sc] 6 times – 156 sc.
Round 27: [Inc, sc in next 25 sc] 6 times – 162 sc.
Round 28: Sc in back loops only of each sc around; join with a slip st in first sc.
Rounds 29-47: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Round 48: Repeat Bobble Round 34 of Top Layer.
Middle Layer Bottom Piece
Repeat Rounds 1-27 of Middle Layer. Fasten off.
Bottom Layer (16” Diameter)
Rounds 1-27: With C, repeat Rounds 1-27 of Middle Layer.
Round 28: [Inc, sc in next 26 sc] 6 times – 168 sc.
Round 29: [Inc, sc in next 27 sc] 6 times – 174 sc.
Round 30: [Inc, sc in next 28 sc] 6 times – 180 sc.
Round 31: [Inc, sc in next 29 sc] 6 times – 186 sc.
Round 32: [Inc, sc in next 30 sc] 6 times – 192 sc.
Round 33: [Inc, sc in next 31 sc] 6 times – 198 sc.
Round 34: [Inc, sc in next 32 sc] 6 times – 204 sc.
Round 35: [Inc, sc in next 33 sc] 6 times – 210 sc.
Round 36: [Inc, sc in next 34 sc] 6 times – 216 sc.
Round 37: [Inc, sc in next 35 sc] 6 times – 222 sc.
Round 38: [Inc, sc in next 36 sc] 6 times – 228 sc.
Round 39: Sc in back loops only of each sc around; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 40: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Rounds 41-55: * Working over C with D, sc in 19 sc changing to C in 19th sc, working over D with C, sc in 19 sc changing to D in 19th sc; repeat from * around; join.
Round 56: With C, repeat Bobble Round 34 of Top Layer.
Bottom Layer Bottom Piece
Repeat Rounds 1-38 of Bottom Layer. Fasten off.
HEART TOPPER (Make 2)
Row 1 (Wrong Side): With smaller hook and B, ch 2; 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook; turn – 8 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, [inc] 8 times; turn – 16 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, inc] 3 times, sc in next 4 sc, [inc, sc in next sc] 3 times; turn – 22 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [inc, sc in next 2 sc] twice, inc, sc in next 6 sc, [inc, sc in next 2 sc] twice, inc, sc in last sc; turn – 28 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, [sc in 3 sc, inc] 3 times, sc in next 4 sc, [inc, sc in next 3 sc] 3 times; turn – 34 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, [inc] twice, sc in next 12 sc, [inc] twice, sc in next 12 sc, [inc] twice, sc in last 2 sc; turn – 40 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 6 sc, [inc] twice, sc in next 22 sc, [inc] twice, sc in next 5 sc, skip next sc, sc in last sc; turn – 42 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 3 sc, [inc] 3 times, sc in next 28 sc, [inc] 3 times, sc in next 2 sc, skip next sc, sc in last sc; turn – 46 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 4 sc, inc, sc in next 2 sc, inc, sc in next 28 sc, inc, sc in next 2 sc, inc, sc in next 3 sc, skip next sc, sc in last sc; turn – 48 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 5 sc, inc, sc in next 3 sc, inc, sc in next 26 sc, inc, sc in next 3 sc, inc, sc in next 4 sc, skip next sc, sc in last sc; turn – 50 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 7 sc, inc, sc in next 2 sc, inc, sc in next 26 sc, inc, sc in next 2 sc, inc, sc in next 6 sc, skip next sc, sc in last sc; turn – 52 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 24 sc, [inc] twice, sc in next 23 sc, skip next sc, sc in last sc; do NOT turn; working across row ends, work 7 sc evenly to center of heart, slip st in middle of heart, work 7 sc evenly across next row ends; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
SMALL HEART (Make 10)
Row 1: With smaller hook and B, ch 4; sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 2 ch; turn – 3 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Next Round: Working around entire piece, ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, rotate, sc in next row end, 2 sc in next row end, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 row ends; join – 13 sc.
Next Round: Working around the top 2 sides of the square just made, ch 1, skip first sc, 5 dc in next sc, skip next sc, slip st in space between 2 corner sc, skip next sc, 5 dc in next sc, skip next sc, slip st in next sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing to cake.
ROSE (Make 3)
Row 1: With smaller hook and B, ch 41; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 40 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, [inc, sc in next sc] 3 times, [2 hdc in next sc] 3 times, slip st in next 2 sc, [2 hdc in next sc, hdc in next sc] 3 times, slip st in next 2 sc, hdc in next sc, [2 dc in next sc] 8 times, slip st in next 2 sc, hdc in next 2 sc, dc in next 4 sc, hdc in next 4 sc; turn – 57 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in first 4 hdc, [2 hdc in next st] twice, [2 dc in next st] 3 times, sc in next 4 sts, hdc in next st, [2 hdc in next st] twice, [2 dc in next st] 3 times, slip st in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, [2 dc in next st] 5 times, slip st in next st, skip next st, slip st in next st, 2 hdc in next st, [2 dc in next st] 7 times, slip st in next st, skip next st, [sc2tog] 3 times, [2 hdc in next st] 3 times, [sc2tog] 4 times; do NOT turn; rotate piece to work across row ends; work 3 sc across row ends, work sc2tog across foundation ch to gather. Fasten off leaving long tail for finishing.
LEAVES (Make 3)
With smaller hook and E, ch 6; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 2 sc in each ch around – 12 sc.
Rounds 2-6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc2tog, sc in next sc] 4 times – 8 sc.
Round 8: [Sc2tog] 4 times – 4 sc.
Round 9: [Sc2tog] twice – 2 sc. Fasten off, closing sts and weaving end. Leave long tail for finishing.
DIAMOND EMBELLISHMENTS (Make 6)
Row 1: With larger hook and D, ch 10; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 9 sc.
Rows 2-9: Ch 1, sc in ea sc across; turn.
Begin Next Diamond: Ch 10, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 9 sc.
Repeat Rows 2-9. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Place cake Layer top side down on a flat surface. Insert cardboard round, if using optional quilt batting, wrap cardboard round first, then place inside the piece. Sew Bottom Piece to Layer, whip-stitching through remaining loop of Bobble Round and both loops of last round of Bottom Piece until it is a little over half way attached. Insert 2nd cardboard round. Begin stuffing firmly. Continue to sew and stuff the piece, smoothing the stuffing along the sides of the cake. Make certain the first cardboard round and stuffing is evenly placed by re-arranging stuffing and cardboard as needed. Repeat for other 2 layers. 
If using optional Velcro® to attach layers, attach 4” lengths using sewing needle and thread: for heart topper and top layer use 3 lengths, middle use 5, and for bottom use 7 or more Velcro lengths. 
Heart and Diamond Embellishments
Pin small hearts equally spaced around the outside of the top layer. Sew in place.
Pin diamonds around the middle layer. Sew in place.
Roses and Leaves
Gather roses. Using long yarn tail, wind roses into spirals, tack in place. Leave remaining yarn tail for attaching to cake. Attach leaves to underside of roses using yarn tail.
Heart Topper
Using water soluble marker, sketch desired number onto crocheted heart. Embroider with coordinating yarn using a satin stitch.
Lay crocheted heart on red felt, trace around heart and cut out. Make 2. Use felt cut out to trace heart onto cardboard and cut out. Sandwich crochet heart, felt heart, cardboard, felt heart and 2nd crocheted heart together. Join heart edges through the 2 heart layers; ch 1 and matching st for st, sc through both crocheted heart layers in each sc around; join. Fasten off, leaving one yarn tail.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 319 Cherry Red A, 672 Spring Green B, 512 Turqua C, and 706 Perfect Pink D
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
Special Technique
Adjustable-ring method = Wrap yarn into a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail firmly between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring, working over both strands (the tail and the ring). After the first round of stitches is worked, pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.

SNOWFLAKE (make 1 each with A, B, C, & D)
Make an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. Pull tail gently to tighten ring.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, (ch 2, sc) in each sc around, ch 2; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc and 6 ch-2 spaces. 
Round 3: *Ch 5, slip st in 3rd ch from hook, ch 4, 2 hdc in 3rd ch from hook, slip st in next ch, slip st in previously worked 3rd ch of beginning ch-5, ch 3, slip st in 3rd ch from hook, slip st in last 2 ch of beginning ch-5 (point made), slip st in next ch-2 space, ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around—6 points. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in ends. For each snowflake, cut a 7" (18 cm) strand of A. Tie a knot to form a hanging loop. Insert hook in top of any point, place fold of loop on hook and draw through point. Pull knot through loop and gently tighten. Trim ends of knot and apply drops of fabric sealant on knot if desired. Taking care not to stiffen hanging loop, apply stiffener to snowflake, pinning out each point. Allow to dry thoroughly before handling.

materials: Lily ® Sugar’n Cream (Solids: 2.5 oz/70.9 g) (Ombres: 2 oz/56.7 g)
Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Plastic pot 3H ins [9 cm] in diameter.
measurements: Pansy: Approx 2 H ins [6 cm] wide. Pansy Cluster: Approx 7 ins [18 cm] in diameter.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Pansy
With D, ch 4. Join with sl st to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in ring. Ch 2) twice. (2 sc in ring. Ch 5) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. Break D.
2nd rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to first ch-2 sp. Ch 2. (2 hdc. Ch 3. 1 sl st in first ch – Picot made. 2 hdc) all in same ch-2 sp. Miss next sc. Sl st in next sc. (2 hdc. Picot. 2 hdc) all in next ch-2 sp. [Miss next sc. Sl st in next sc. (1 hdc. 9 dc. 1 hdc) all in next ch-5 sp] 3 times. Miss next sc. Sl st in next sc. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. Fasten off.
Pansy Cluster
Make 3 Pansies each with A, B and C as Color 2.
Base: With E, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 2 dc in each sc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 16 dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 2 dc in each dc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 32 dc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 dc. Ch 12. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. (2 dc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch) 3 times. 2 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Ch 8. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 2 dc in next ch. 1 dc in next ch. 2 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. (4 long petals and 4 short petals).
FINISHING
Sew 6 Pansies around Base – one at beg of each long petal, alternating colors. Sew rem 3 Pansies inside of Base. Place stuffing inside of pot. Cover with Cluster of Pansies. Glue Cluster to pot if necessary.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 311 White A, 512 Turqua B, 319 Cherry Red C, and 3620 Glowworm D
Embroidery floss in black, orange, and white
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Ornament measures 6" (15 cm) tall, excluding pompom.
gauge: 4 sc = 1" (2.5 cm); 4 rounds = 1" (2.5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Notes
1. All sections except hat are worked in unjoined rounds with right side facing at all times. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed. Do not join until instructed.
2. Hat is worked in turned rows.

Special Stitch
sc2tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

ORNAMENT (make 1 each with B and C for hat)

Head
Beginning at top, with A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—18 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—24 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—30 sc.
Rounds 7–11: Repeat Round 5.
Round 12: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around—15 sc.
Round 13: Repeat Round 5; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

Facial Features
Refer to photograph as a guide for placement. 
With 6 strands of black embroidery floss, embroider French knot eyes on Round 10 and back stitches in a curve where desired for the mouth. 
With 12 strands of orange embroidery floss, make a French knot between the eyes and mouth, wrapping floss 3 times around needle to make a prominent carrot nose.

Body
Beginning at bottom, with A, ch 2.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of head—12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—15 sc.
Rounds 4–8: Work same as Round 5 of head.
Round 9: *Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around—12 sc.
Round 10: Work same as Round 5 of head. Stuff body with fiberfill.
Round 11: Work same as Round 12 of head; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through last round and pull closed.

Arm (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work same as Round 1 of head—6 sc.
Round 2: Repeat Round 3 of head—9 sc.
Rounds 3–6: Repeat Round 5 of head; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Do not stuff.

Hat
Ribbing
Ch 5.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—4 sc.
Rows 2–30: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc across, turn.
Crown
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, working in ends of rows, sc in each row across, turn—30 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—24 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—18 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, *sc in next sc, sc2tog; repeat from * across, turn—12 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, *sc2tog; repeat from across. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

Assembly
Arms Weave tail through last round and pull stitches closed, then sew in place at top of body.
Head & Body Stuff head with fiberfill. Push Round 13 of head onto top of body. With end tail, sew securely around to join head to body. 
Hat Weave tail through last row and pull closed. Working through ends of rows, sew back seam. Working in ends of rows of ribbing, sew hat on head.

FINISHING
Pompom (make 2)
Cut a 15" (38 cm) strand of D and set aside. Wrap D around 4 fingers 50 times. Carefully slide loops off fingers and tie single strand very tightly around center of loops. Do not cut or trim center tie. Cut loops open at both ends. Shake and trim evenly to desired length. Thread ends of center tie through top of hat and secure pompom. Cut strand of white embroidery floss to desired length for hanging loop, thread through top of ornament and tie ends in a knot. Weave in ends.

Leg

Shape Foot
Row 19: Ch 1, sc in first 8 sc, [2 sc in next sc] 6 times, sc in last 8 sc; turn – 28 sc.
Row 20: Ch 1, sc in first 8 sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times, sc in last 8 sc; turn – 34 sc.

Rows 22-26: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.

Row 27: Ch 1, sc in first 12 sc; draw up a loop in next 2 sc, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made] 6 times, sc in last 12 sc; turn – 30 sc.

Row 1: Working on opposite side of beginning ch and skipping the 9 ch of hanging loop, with right side facing, join B to first st after hanging loop; ch 1, sc in each ch across; turn – 22 sc.

Sew back and bottom seams of stocking. Sew border seam keeping hanging loop on outside.

Stocking
Work same as Green Stocking with B.

Sew back and bottom seams of stocking. Sew border seam keeping hanging loop on outside.

With C ch 5; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.

Attach Doily to Smaller Ring
Referring to photo for placement, [wrap long tail around smaller Ring then feed thread through ch-6 space] 24 times, pull tail to remove all slack, knot, weave in ends.

abbreviations: Fch = Foundation chain (underside of foundation single crochet row).

Fsc (Foundation single crochet) = Place a slip knot on hook. Ch 2. Insert hook in 2nd ch from hook and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through one loop on hook (this becomes the “chain”). Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook (this becomes the “single crochet” stitch). *Insert hook into the “chain” of the previous stitch and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through one loop on hook (the “chain”). Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook (the “single crochet”). Repeat from * for the length of foundation row.

Lp st = Loop stitch (worked on WS) = Yoh and insert hook in next stitch. Hold working yarn over top of left index finger and pull up 1” [2.5 cm] loop. Grab working yarn behind index finger and pull through stitch. Hold loop in position with right hand to front of work. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook. Loop is formed on RS of work.
measurements: Approx 20” wide x 31½" long [51 x 80 cm].
gauge: 9 sts and 10.5 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat with yarn held double.
instructions:
Note: Yarn is held doubled throughout.
1st row: (RS). Fsc 45. Turn. 45 sc.
2nd row: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. Lp st in each of next 43 sts. 1 sc in last st. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows until 83 rows are complete. Do not turn after 83rd row.
FINISHING
Ch 2. Turn to work along sides of rows. Skip first row. 1 sc in side of next row. **Ch 1. Skip next row. 1 sc in side of next row.** Rep from ** to ** to the fch. Ch 2. 1 sc in each fch. Ch 2. Rep from ** to ** along other side of rows. Ch 2. Join with sl st to first sc of 83rd row. Fasten off.

With B, ch 11

Round 1: With A, make 6 sc in adjustable loop (6 sts).

Round 3: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in st; repeat from * around – 9 sts.
Round 4: Sc in each st around – 9 sts.
Round 5: *2 sc in each st; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 6: *Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 7: *Sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 8: *Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Rounds 9-11: Sc in each st around.
Round 12: *Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 13: Sc in each st around.
Round 14: *Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Using a multi-color yarn gives this raccoon colorful markings along with his red mask and tail striping. He’s easy to crochet in the colors of your choice and will add a clever note to your holiday tree.
Round 15: *Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Using the picture as a guide, attach mask to face with matching sewing thread. Poke safety eyes through the mask and head layers. Snap the washer onto the post securely. Continue with Round 16.
Round 16: *Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 12 sts.
Round 17: Sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Continue stuffing the body as rounds are worked.
Round 18: 2 sc in each st – 24 sts.
Round 19: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Rounds 20-29: Sc in each st – 36 sts.
Round 30: *Sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 31: *Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 32: *Sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 33: *Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 12 sts.
Round 34: *Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around, changing to C in last st and fastening off A – 8 sts.
Round 35: Sc in each st – 8 sts.
Round 36: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 12 sts.
Round 37: Sc in next 6 sts, changing to B in last st, do not fasten off C, with B sc in next 6 sts – 12 sts.
Round 38: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 39: Sc in 9 sts, changing to C in last st, do not fasten off B, with C sc in next 9 sts – 18 sts.
Round 40: Sc in each st – 18 sts.
Round 41: Sc in next 9 sts, changing to B in last st, do not fasten off C, with B sc in next 9 sts – 18 sts.
Round 42: Sc in each st – 18 sts.
Round 43: *Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 12 sts.
Round 44: Sc in next 6 sts, changing to C in last st, fasten off B, with C sc in next 6 sts – 12 sts.
Round 45: *Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 8 sts.
Round 46: Sc in each st around – 8 sts.
Round 47: Sc2tog around – 4 sts.
Fasten off. Weave in ends.
EARS (Make 2)
Using A, ch 6
Row 1: Sc in back ridge of 2nd ch from hook, sc in back ridge of each ch across – 5 sts.
Row 2-5: Ch 1, turn; sc in each st.
Fasten off, leaving 8” tail for sewing. 
Fold square in half in a triangle shape. Using the yarn tail, and yarn needle, seam the edges. Using the photo as a guide, attach ears to head by sewing.
FRONT LEGS (make 2)
Using C, ch 5, join with slip st to form a ring
Row 1: Ch 1, 5 sc in ring – 5 sc.
Row 2: Sc in each st – 5 sc.
Rows 3 & 4: Repeat Row 2. Fasten off after row 4. Stuff lightly. With yarn needle and tail, weave tail through opening to close hole.
BACK LEGS (make 2)
Using C, Make 6 sc in adjustable loop – 6 sts.
Round 1: 2 sc in each st – 12 sts.
Rounds 2 & 3: Sc in each st.
Round 4: *Sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * around – 8 sts.
Round 5: (Sc in next st, sc2tog) twice, sc in last 2 sts – 6 sts.
Round 6: Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts – 5 sts.
Rounds 7-10: Sc in each st around – 5 sts.
Fasten off after round 10. Stuff lightly. With tapestry needle and tail, weave tail through opening to close hole.

Using photo as a guide, attach the legs using the yarn tail.
Weave in ends.

materials: Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
7 buttons ½ inch [15 mm] in diameter.
measurements: Approx 10 ins [25.5 cm] wide x 15 ins [38 cm] high.
gauge: 15 sc and 17 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
BACK and FRONT (make alike).
Beg at bottom of trunk, ch 11.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd to 6th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
7th row: Ch 15. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 13 ch. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Turn. 24 sc.
8th row: Ch 15. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 13 ch. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 38 sc.
9th and 10th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
11th row: (Dec row). Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of first 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook - Sc2tog made. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
12th to 14th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 4 rows 8 times more. 20 sc.
Next row: As 11th row.
Next 2 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 3 rows twice more. 14 sts.
Next row: As 11th row.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows 4 times more. 4 sts.
Work 2 rows even. Do not fasten off. Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc around outside edge of piece. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Following tracing diagram, cut star from yellow felt and sew as shown in picture. Sew garland as shown in picture. Sew buttons randomly to RS of front of tree for ornaments.
Place marker 4 ins [10 cm] down from top of tree on each side of Front and Back. Sew outside edges of Front and Back tog between markers.
Hanging Loop: With RS facing, join yarn with sl st at top of Back. Ch 24. Sl st in same sp as joining stitch. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Soft Yarn®”: 1 Ball each 9925 Really Red A, 4422 Tangerine B, and 9779 Berry C.
Split-ring stitch marker, yarn needle, 3/8” red ribbon.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Heart measures 3” tall x 4¼” across widest without ribbon.
gauge: 17 sc = 4”; 16 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HEART
With A, ch 17.
Round 1: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 6 ch, skip next 2 ch, sc in next 6 ch, 3 sc in next ch; turn to work in unused loops of beginning ch, sc in next 6 ch, (sc, ch 2, sc) all in ch-2 space, sc in last 6 ch – 32 sts.
Round 2: [2 sc in next st] 3 times; sc in next 5 sts, skip next 2 sts, sc in next 5 sts, [2 sc in next st] 3 times, sc in next 7 sts, (sc, ch 2, sc) all in ch-2 space, sc in last 7 sts – 38 sts.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 3 times, sc in next 4 sts, skip next 2 sts, sc in next 5 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 3 times; sc in next 7 sts, (sc, ch 2, sc) all in ch-2 space, sc in last 8 sts – 44 sts.
Round 4: Sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 3 times; sc in next 2 sts, skip next 2 sts, sc in next 4 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 3 times; sc in next 8 sts, (sc, ch 2, sc) all in ch-2 space, sc in last 9 sts – 50 sts.
Round 5: Sc in next 2 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 3 times; skip next 2 sts, sc in next 3 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 3 times; sc in next 9 sts, (sc, ch 2, sc) all in ch-2 space, sc in last 10 sts – 56 sts. Fasten off.
Repeat Rounds 1-5.
Joining-Round 6: With Wrong Sides together and A, slip st around, working through Round 5 of both pieces until 1” remains open on Heart; stuff with fiberfill, slip st closed. Fasten off.
Repeat Rounds 1-6 with B and C. Weave in ends.
FINISHING
Cut ribbon into 3 24” pieces. Thread ribbon into top center of each heart and tie ends into a bow.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 316 Soft White A, 312 Black B, 672 Spring Green C, 254 Pumpkin D, 358 Lavender E, 885 Delft Blue F, 319 Cherry Red G, 320 Cornmeal H, 334 Buff I, and 365 Coffee J.

Stitch marker, two 7mm acrylic gems or beads and cement glue for spider eyes, large sharp needle for embroidery, stuffing, plastic pellets or fish tank gravel and knee high hose for weight, yarn needle, small piece (approximately 2” [5 cm] diameter) of cardboard and scissors, black sewing thread and hand sewing needle.
abbreviations: sc2tog = draw up a loop in next 2 sts, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
hdc2tog = [yo and draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 5 loops on hook.
gauge: 22 sts = 4” (10 cm); 20 rows = 4” (10 cm) in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions: CUPCAKE (Spider, Pumpkin, Skull) With D or A, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do NOT join but work in continuous rounds. Place marker in first sc and move up each round. Round 1: [Inc] 6 times – 12 sc. Round 2: [Sc in next sc, inc] 6 times – 18 sc. Round 3: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] 6 times – 24 sc. Round 4: [Sc in next 3 sc, inc] 6 times – 30 sc. Round 5: [Sc in next 4 sc, inc] 6 times – 36 sc. Round 6: [Sc in next 5 sc, inc] 6 times – 42 sc. Round 7: [Sc in next 6 sc, inc] 6 times – 48 sc. Rounds 8-12: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off at end of Round 12. Round 13: Join H or J or I in back loop of any sc; working in back loops only for this round, sc in each sc around. Round 14: [Sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 42 sc. Rounds 15 and 16: Sc in each sc around. Round 17: [Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 36 sc. Rounds 18-20: Sc in each sc around. Round 21: [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 30 sc. Round 22: Sc in each sc around. Round 23: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around. Round 24: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 24 sc. Stuff firmly adding pellet packet last. Trace around the bottom of the stuffed cupcake to make cardboard cutout then insert cardboard cutout. Round 25: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 18 sc. Round 26: [Hdc in next sc, hdc2tog] 6 times – 12 sts. Cut yarn and weave through sts to close hole. Set aside. EYEBALL CUPCAKE With B, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st in first sc. Special Abbreviations sc2tog = draw up a loop in next 2 sts, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook. hdc2tog = [yo and draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 5 loops on hook. inc (increase) = 2 sc in next sc. CUPCAKE LINER With A (spider) or C (skull) or B (eyeball and pumpkin), ch 13. Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 12 sc. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc across changing to E (spider and skull) or D (eyeball) or A (pumpkin) in last sc; turn. Rows 3 and 4: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc across changing to A or C or B in last sc of Row 4; turn. Row 5: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc across; turn. Rows 6-34: Repeat Rows 2-5 seven more times, then Row 2 once more. Fasten off A, C and B. Row 35: Repeat Row 3. Join Sides-Row 36: Ch 1, working through both layers, sc in back loop of each sc of last row AND remaining loop of beginning ch across; turn. Liner Bottom-Round 37: Ch 1, working in row ends, 2 sc in first stripe, [2 sc in next stripe, 1 sc in next stripe] 9 times; join with a slip st in first sc – 28 sc. Round 38: Ch 1, sc in back loops of each sc around; join. Round 39: Ch 1, [sc in 5 sc, sc2tog] 4 times; join – 24 sc. Round 40: Ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times; join – 18 sc. Round 41: Ch 1, [hdc, hdc2tog] 6 times; join in first hdc – 12 sts. Cut yarn and weave through sts to close hole. Set aside. GAUGE: 22 sts = 4” (10 cm); 20 rows = 4” (10 cm) in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge. Designed by Nancy Anderson. All Cupcakes Weave in ends. Insert finished cupcake into cupcake liner.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: Ball #1: 1 skein each of 505 Aruba Sea A; 885 Delft Blue B and 672 Spring Green C
Ball #2: 1 skein each of 706 Perfect Pink A; 254 Pumpkin B and 319 Cherry Red C
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4.5 mm [US G-6]
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
( ) = work directions in parentheses as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: Each flower = 2” (5 cm)
instructions:
BOW
With C, ch 52. Fasten off. Tie the chain in a bow around the base of the hanger. Trim yarn at the ends of the chain.

NOTE
Size of wrapped ball may vary. Make enough flowers to cover ball completely.

BALL (using color combination for Ball #1 or Ball #2)

FLOWER A (make 11)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join B in last sc made, *ch 2, hdc in same st, ch 2, slip st in same st, slip st in next st; repeat from * around, ending with slip st in first st of last round—6 petals. Fasten off.

FLOWER B (make 11)
With B, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join A in last sc made, *ch 2, hdc in same st, ch 2, slip st in same st, slip st in next st; repeat from * around, ending with slip st in first st of last round—6 petals. Fasten off.

FINISHING
With C, wrap yarn around the Styrofoam ball, covering the entire ball. Before gluing on the flowers, attach flowers to the ball with straight pins for placement. Add glue to the back of center and petals of each flower, glue to the yarn-wrapped ball. Straight pins can be used to hold flowers in place while drying.

HANGER
With C, ch 24. Fasten off. Fold chain in half and attach ends to the top of the ball. Weave in ends.

instructions:
With A, ch 6; join with a slip st to form a ring. 
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc – 12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, [ch 3, sc in next sc] 11 times; hdc in first sc to join and form last loop – 12 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc over hdc, *(2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next space**, sc in next space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Ch 4, slip st in same st as joining, *ch 2, (sc, ch 3, sc, ch 5, sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-3 space, ch 2**, (slip st, ch 4, slip st) in next sc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in slip st of last round. materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 886 Blue A, 311 White B, and 319 Cherry Red C
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 6.5 mm [US K-10½]
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
( ) = work directions in parenthesis the number of times specified
measurements: Finished Measurements: 8" (20cm) at widest point x 12" (30.5cm) at longest point
gauge: 10½ dc = 4" (10 cm); 6 rows = 4" (10 cm) in double crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
STRIPED PENNANT
With C, ch 4.
Row 1: 2 dc in 4th ch from hook, (skipped 3 ch counts as first dc) – 3 dc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), turn, dc in same st, dc in each st across – 4 dc.
Row 3: Ch 3, turn, dc in same st, dc in each st across – 5 dc.
Rows 4-6: Change to B and repeat Row 3 for 3 rows – 8 dc on last row worked.
Rows 7-9: Change to C and repeat Row 3 for 3 rows – 11 dc on last row worked.
Rows 10-12: Change to B and repeat Row 3 for 3 rows – 14 dc on last row worked.
Rows 13-15: Change to C and repeat Row 3 for 3 rows – 17 dc on last row worked.
Rows 16-18: Change to B and repeat Row 3 for 3 rows – 20 dc on last row worked.
Dowel Flap
Row 19: Change to C, ch 1, turn, sc in each st across – 20 sc. Repeat Row 19 for 5 more times.
Fasten off.
BLUE PENNANT
With A only, work as for Striped Pennant.
STAR APPLIQUE
With B, ch 4.
Round 1: 14 dc in 4th ch from hook, (skipped 3 ch counts as first dc), slip st in top of beginning ch-3 to join – 15 dc.
Round 2: [Ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, tr in next ch, sk next 2 dc, slip st in next dc] 5 times, slip st to first ch – 5 points.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each ch and st around, slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Sew Star Applique to center of Blue Pennant. Fold Flap of each Pennant over dowel and sew in place.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Bamboo Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball 320 Mushroom.
abbreviations: Beg shell = slip st in next 2 dc and into next space, (ch 2, 2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) all in same space.
Shell = (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) all in space indicated.
Picot = ch 3, slip st in top of last st made.

Triple Picot = ch 4, slip st into the top and side of the last st made, ch 5, slip st into the same st again catching the front loop of the first ch-4 loop, ch 4, slip st into the same st again catching the front loop of the first ch-4 loop and ch-5 loop.
gauge: Rounds 1-5 = 2” across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
DOILY
Ch 5; join with a slip st in 5th ch from hook to form ring.
Round 1: Ch 2 (counts as a dc), 15 dc in ring; join with a slip st in top of ch-2 – 16 sts.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as a tr), fptr around same st as joining, * tr in next dc, fptr around same dc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of ch-3 – 32 sts.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, (dc, fpdc, dc) all in next fptr, * sc in next tr, (dc, fpdc, dc) all in next fptr; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Slip st in next dc, (slip st, ch 1, sc) all in next fpdc, * ch 4, sc in next fpdc; repeat from * around; (ch 1, dc) in first sc to join and form last space.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc over dc, * ch 5, sc in next ch-4 space; repeat from * around; (ch 1, dc) in first sc to join and form last space.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc over dc, * 5 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-5 space **, ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space; repeat from * around, end at **; (ch 2, dc) in first sc to join and form last space.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc over dc, * ch 6, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc **, ch 6, sc in next ch-5 space; repeat from * around, end at **; (ch 2, edc) in first sc to join and form last space.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc over edc, 5 dc in same sc as joining, * sc in next ch-6 space **, ch 6, sc in next ch-6 space, 5 dc in next sc; repeat from * around, end at **; (ch 2, edc) in first sc to join and form last space.
Round 9: Ch 1, sc over edc, * ch 7, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc, ch 7 **, sc in next ch-6 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 10: Slip st in ch-7 space, ch 1, 5 sc in same space, ch 3, * 5 sc in next ch-7 space, ch 3; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in front loop of first sc.
Round 11: Working in front loops only, ch 1, sc in same sc, * [ch 2, sc in next sc] 4 times, 3 sc in next ch-3 space **, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, end at **; join.
Round 12: Slip st into back loop of the first 3 sc of Round 10, working in back loops only, ch 1, sc in same sc, * ch 3, skip next 3 sc, (tr, ch 3, tr) all in next sc, ch 3, skip next 3 sc **, sc in back loop of next sc; repeat from * around, end at **; join.
Round 13: Slip st into ch-3 space, ch 1, * (2 sc, ch 3, 2 sc) all in ch-3 space, (2 sc, ch 4, 2 sc) all in next ch-3 space, (2 sc, ch 3, 2 sc) all in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Round 14: With right side facing, attach thread in any ch-4 space; (ch 2, 2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) all in same space, * ch 7, dc in next ch-4 space, ch 7 **, shell in next ch-4 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join in top of ch-2.
Round 15: Beg shell, * ch 3, (sc, ch 2, sc) all in next ch-7 space, ch 3, (tr, fptr, tr) all in next dc, ch 3, (sc, ch 2, sc) all in next ch-7 space, ch 3 **, shell in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join.
Round 16: Beg shell, * ch 6, (tr, fptr) in next tr, (tr, fptr, tr) in next fptr, (fptr, tr) in next tr, ch 6 **, shell in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join.
Round 17: Beg shell, * ch 3, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-6 space, ch 3, tr in next tr, fptr in next fptr, tr in next tr, (fptr, tr, fptr) in next fptr, tr in next tr, fptr in next fptr, tr in next tr, ch 3, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-6 space, ch 3 **, shell in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join.
Round 18: Beg shell, * ch 4, [(tr, fptr, tr) in next tr, fptr in next fptr, tr in next tr, fptr in next fptr] twice, (tr, fptr, tr) in next tr, ch 4 **, shell in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join.
Round 19: Beg shell, * ch 2, sc in next ch-4 space, ch 2, (tr, fptr, tr) in next tr, [fptr in next fptr, tr in next tr] 3 times, (fptr, tr, fptr) in next fptr, [tr in next tr, fptr in next fptr] 3 times, (tr, fptr, tr) in next tr, ch 2, sc in next ch-4 space, ch 2 **, shell in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join.
Round 20: Beg shell, * ch 3, sc in next tr, (dc, fpdc, dc) in next fptr, sc in next tr, [ch 3, skip fptr, sc in next tr] 8 times, (dc, fpdc, dc) in next fptr, sc in next tr, ch 3 **, shell in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join.
Round 21: (Slip st, ch 2, 2 dc, ch 3, dc, ch 3, 3 dc) all in next ch-3 space, * ch 3, sc in next fpdc, skip next dc, 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-3 space, [ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space] 7 times, 3 dc in next sc, skip next dc, sc in next fpdc, ch 3, skip next ch-3 space **, (3 dc, ch 3, dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join.
Round 22: Slip st to next ch-3 space, ch 2, 2 dc in same space, * ch 3, 5 dc in next dc, ch 3, 3 dc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, skip next ch-3 space and next 2 sts, sc in next dc, 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-3 space, [ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space] 6 times, 3 dc in next sc, skip next dc, sc in next dc, ch 3, skip next ch-3 space **, 3 dc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, end at **; join. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

Back
Top
