abbreviations: sc2tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Skull measures: 4" wide x 5¼" long (10 x 13.5 cm).
gauge: 12 sts = 4" (10 cm); 15 rows = 4" (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SKULL
Top
With A, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next st, *2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * 4 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first st, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * 4 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * 4 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts; repeat from * 4 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc. Do not fasten off. Continue in turned rows.
Bottom
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—8 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. 
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog, turn—6 sc.
Rows 4 and 5: Repeat Row 2. 
Do not fasten off. Continue in rounds. 
Border
Round 1: Ch 1, working in ends of rows, sc in each row across first edge of bottom; working in unworked sts of Round 6, sc in next st, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts; repeat from * 3 times, 2 sc in next st; working in ends of rows, sc in each row across other edge of bottom, ch 1, sc in each st of Row 5, ch 1; join with slip st in first sc—47 sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING 
Print template shown below. For each skull, cut forehead flower, nose, and 2 eyes from felt pieces, changing color pattern for each skull. Apply a small amount of glue on center back of each piece. Referring to photo as a guide, position pieces on skull and, with B and straight stitches, sew each piece in place. With B, embroider straight stitch teeth.

instructions:
With larger hook and A, ch 26; join with a slip st to form a ring taking care that ch is not twisted.
Rnd 1: Ch 1, sc in joining and in each ch around changing to B in last sc; join with a slip st in first sc – 26 sc. Fasten off A.
Rnds 2-5: With B, ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Start Thumb-Rnd 6: Ch 1, sc in first 12 sc, [2 sc in next sc] twice, sc in last 12 sc; join – 28 sc.
Rnd 7: Ch 1, sc in first 13 sc, [2 sc in next sc] twice, sc in last 13 sc; join – 30 sc.
Rnd 8: Ch 1, sc in first 14 sc, [2 sc in next sc] twice, sc in last 14 sc; join – 32 sc.
Rnd 9: Ch 1, sc in first 15 sc, [2 sc in next sc] twice, sc in last 15 sc; join – 34 sc.
Rnds 10-13: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Top of Mitten-Rnd 14: Ch 1, sc in first 13 sc, ch 1, skip next 8 sc (thumb), sc in last 13 sc; join – 26 sc.
Rnd 15: Ch 1, sc in first 13 sc, skip ch-1, sc in last 13 sc; join – 26 sc.
Rnds 16-23: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Rnd 24: Ch 1; [draw up a loop in next sc] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made; [sc2tog] 12 times; join – 13 sc.

Snowflake: With smaller hook and A, ch 5; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 1, [2 sc in ring, ch 3] 6 times; join with a slip st in first sc – 6 ch-3 loops.
Rnd 2: Slip st in next sc, ch 1, [(2 sc, ch 3, 2 sc) all in ch-3 loop] 6 times; join.
Rnd 3: Slip st in next sc, ch 1, [(sc, ch 3, sc, ch 5, sc, ch 3, sc) all in ch-3 loop, ch 2] 6 times; join. Fasten off and weave in ends.

materials: 1 skein each of 1601 Lettuce A and 1621 Evergreen B
1 ball 8010 White RED HEART® With Love™ Metallic
Foam cone, 4" [10 cm] diameter base x 12" [30.5 cm] tall

[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.

gauge: 16 dc = 4" [10 cm]; 12 rows = 5" [13 cm] in double crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CENTERPIECE COVER
Begin at top edge with A, ch 4. 
Round 1: Work 11 dc in 4th ch from hook, slip st in top of skipped ch-3 (counts as a dc here and throughout) to join – 12 dc. 
Round 2: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in same dc as joining, sc in each dc around, slip st in first sc – 12 sc. 
Round 3: Ch 3 (counts as a dc here and throughout), working in back loops only, dc in each sc around, slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 12 dc. 
Round 4: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in same dc as joining, 2 sc in next dc, [sc in next dc, 2 sc in next dc] 5 times, slip st in first sc – 18 sc.
Round 5: Ch 3, working in back loops only, dc in each sc around, slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 18 dc. 
Round 6: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in same dc as joining, sc in next dc, 2 sc in next dc, [sc in next 2 dc, 2 sc in next dc] 5 times, slip st in first sc – 24 sc.
Round 7: Ch 3, working in back loops only, dc in each sc around, slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Round 8: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in same dc as joining, sc in next 2 dc, 2 sc in next dc, [sc in next 3 dc, 2 sc in next dc] 5 times, slip st in first sc – 30 sc.
Round 9: Ch 3, working in back loops only, dc in each sc around, slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Round 10: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each dc around, slip st in first sc.
Round 11: Ch 3, working in back loops only, dc in each sc around, slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Rounds 12-13: Repeat Rounds 10-11. 
Round 14: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in same dc as joining, sc in next 3 dc, 2 sc in next dc, [sc in next 4 dc, 2 sc in next dc] 5 times, slip st in first sc – 36 sc.
Round 15: Ch 3, working in back loops only, dc in each sc around, slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Rounds 16-25: Repeat Rounds 10-11. 
Fasten off.
Slip over foam cone carefully, keeping rows straight. Set aside.
LARGE LEAVES (make 28 with A and 21 with B)
Ch 12.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 8 ch, 6 dc in last ch, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, dc in next 8 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in last ch – 26 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, hdc in next 10 sts, 2 hdc in each of next 4 sts, hdc in next 10 sts, sc in last st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
MEDIUM LEAVES (make 7 with A and 7 with B)
Ch 9.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 5 ch, 6 dc in last ch, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, dc in next 5 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in last ch – 20 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in each of next 4 sts, sc in next 8 sts. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
SMALL LEAVES (make 7 with A)
Ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 3 ch, 6 hdc in last ch, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, hdc in next 3 ch, sc in last ch – 14 sts. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in each of next 4 sts, sc in next 5 sts. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
SMALLEST LEAVES (make 7 with A)
Ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 3 ch, 5 hdc in last ch, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, hdc in next 3 ch, sc in last ch – 13 sts. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
STAR (make 2 with White)
Ch 2.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 5 sc.
Round 2: Working in continuous rounds, 2 sc in each sc around – 10 sc.
Round 3: [Slip st in next sc, ch 4, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, skip next sc on Round 2] 5 times around. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.
All Leaves are sewn to sc rounds of Cone Cover starting from lower edge with Large Leaves and working towards the top. Alternate colors and overlap placement of leaves on each row. Beginning along Round 22, arrange side straight edge of 7 A Large Leaves around Cone Cover so side edges touch and sew in place. Repeat to sew 7 B Large Leaves around Round 20, overlapping placement of previous row. Repeat to sew 7 A Large Leaves around Round 18, overlapping placement of previous row and easing to fit. Repeat to sew 7 B Large Leaves around Round 16, overlapping placement of previous row and easing to fit. Repeat to sew 7 A Large Leaves around Round 14, overlapping placement of previous row and easing to fit. Repeat to sew 7 B Large Leaves around Round 12, overlapping placement of previous row and easing to fit. Repeat to sew 7 A Large Leaves around Round 10, overlapping placement of previous row and easing to fit. Repeat to sew 7 B Medium Leaves around Round 8, overlapping placement of previous row and easing to fit. Repeat to sew 7 A Medium Leaves around Round 6, overlapping placement of previous row and easing to fit. Repeat to sew 7 B Small Leaves around Round 4, overlapping placement of previous row and easing to fit. Repeat to sew 7 A Smallest Leaves around Round 2, overlapping placement of previous row and easing to fit. With wrong sides together, sew 2 Stars together. Sew on to top of Cone Cover. Cut a felt circle to fit bottom edge of foam cone and secure in place.

dec; turn – 10 sc.

Next Row: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 7 sc, 
dec; turn – 8 sc. Fasten off leaving yarn end 
for shoulder seam. 
Right Front
Next Row: With wrong side facing, skip next 2 
sc of last long row; join yarn in next sc; ch 1, 
sc in same sc and in next 4 sc; turn – 5 sc. 
Next 2 Rows: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Next Row: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 2 sc, 
dec; turn – 3 sc.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in 3 sc. Fasten off leaving 
yarn end for shoulder seam.
Edging
Sew shoulder seams. With right side facing 
and larger hook, join C at lower right corner of 
ribbing; ch 1, sc evenly up right front, around 
neck and down left front. Fasten off. Weave in 
ends.
Collar
With larger hook and C, ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch 
across; turn – 6 sc.
Rows 2-15: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each 
sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 15 
leaving yarn end for attaching collar to vest.
Pin middle of collar to middle of neck on vest. 
Sew collar to neck using yarn end. Fasten off. 
Weave in ends.
FINISHING
Sew buttons evenly spaced to 1 side edge 
of vest opening with needle and thread. One 
loop of the corresponding sc from the opposite 
lapel can serve as button loop.

Bottom

Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc. 3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc. 4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Both Sizes: Next rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next 2 rnds: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off at end of 2nd rnd.
Top
Small Size only: Work from ** to ** as given above (4 rnds). Fasten off.
Large Size only: Work from ** to *** as given above (6 rnds). Fasten off.

ALOE VERA
See chart on page 3.
With B, **ch 21. 1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 1 tr in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 4 (counts as tr). Working in front loops only, 1 tr in each of next 10 tr. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Turn. 3rd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 1 tr in each tr to end of row.** 1 Triangle made. Do not fasten off. Rep from ** to ** once more. Do not fasten off.
***With B, ch 16. Next row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 1 tr in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 4 (counts as tr). Working in front loops only, 1 tr in each of next 5 tr. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Turn. 3rd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 1 tr in each tr to end of row. ***
Rep from *** to *** twice more. 5 Triangles total. Fasten off. Sew foundation ch and last row of each Triangle tog, forming Spikes. Stuff Spikes lightly. Sew Spikes to Soil as seen in picture.

SNAKE PLANT
See chart on page 3.
Large Leaf (make 4)
With C, ch 21.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 8 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working across opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 8 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Fasten off.
With RS facing, join D with sl st to first sc of 1st row.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 20 sts. (1 sc. Ch 2. Slip st in first ch. 2 sc) in next st. 1 sc in each of last 20 sts. Fasten off.

Small Leaf (make 2)
With C, ch 16.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working across opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Fasten off.
With RS facing, join D with sl st to first sc of 1st row.
2nd row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 15 sts. (1 sc. Ch 2. Slip st in first ch. 2 sc) in next st. 1 sc in each of last 15 sts. Fasten off.
Insert craft wire through center of each Leaf leaving a long end at base. Arrange Leaves inserting wires into Soil as seen in picture. Sew base of Leaves to Soil.

SUCCULENT
See chart on page 3.
With E, ch 73.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Ch 2. Sl st in same ch as last hdc. [Sl st in each of next 2 ch. (Ch 2. 1 hdc. Ch 2. Sl st) in same ch as last sl st] 7 times. [Sl st in each of next 3 ch. (Ch 3. 2 dc. Ch 3. Sl st) in same ch as last sl st] 8 times. [Sl st in each of next 4 ch. (Ch 3. 3 dc. Ch 3. Sl st) in same ch as last sl st] 8 times. Fasten off.
Coil work into spiral with beg of row at center. Sew into position on Soil as seen in picture.

instructions: To join colors, work to last loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last loops and proceed. Join all rnds with sl st. VERSION 1 CIRCLE (make 2) (See diagram on page 2). With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring. 1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 15 dc in ring. Join B to top of ch 3. Break A. 16 dc. 2nd rnd: With B, ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join C to first sc. 24 sc. 3rd rnd: With C, ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 dc in back loop only of next sc. *1 dc in next sc. 2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 dc in back loop only of next sc. Rep from * around. Join B to top of ch 3. Break C. 30 dc. 4th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in next dc. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Working in front of rnds, 1 tr in rem front loop of sc from 2nd rnd. Skip next dc (behind tr). 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * around, ending last rep at **. Join to first sc. Fasten off. 36 sts. Join Circles: Place WS of Circles facing each other, matching pat (aligning tr sts). 1st rnd: Working through both thicknesses, join D with sl st through any tr of 4th rnd. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in next tr. Rep from * around, ending at **. Join A to first sc. 2nd rnd: With A, sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. *1 hdc in next sc. 2 dc in next sc. (Ch 3. Sl st back into first of 3 ch) twice. Ch 3. Sl st back into last dc worked – trefoil picot worked. 2 dc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 3rd rnd: Join D with sl st in any ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. *Ch 6. 1 sc in top point of next trefoil picot. Ch 6. Rep from * around, ending at **. Join to first sc. 4th rnd: *8 sc in next ch-6 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 3. Sl st back into last sc worked - picot made. 8 sc in next ch-6 sp. Skip next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. 8 sc in next ch-6 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 32 for hanging loop. Sl st back into last sc worked. 8 sc in next ch-6 sp. Skip last sc. Join to first sc. Fasten off. VERSION 2 Work as for Version 1 substituting B for A, A for B, D for C and C for D.

instructions:
Note: Two Daisy Motifs are used for each ‘Flower’. They are joined WS facing each other with stem between them.
DAISY MOTIF A (Make 8)
With A, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join MC with sl st to first sc. 10 sc. Break A.
**3rd rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 7. 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 
1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Miss next sc of last rnd. 1 sc in next sc.
Rep from * around, ending with sl st in first sc. 5 petals.
Note: 5 petals from 3rd rnd will alternate with 5 petals from 4th rnd.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working behind last rnd, 1 sc in next missed sc from last rnd. *Ch 7.
1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Miss next sc.
1 sc in next missed sc from last rnd. Rep from * around, ending with sl st in first sc. 
5 petals. Fasten off.**
DAISY MOTIF B (Make 8)
With B, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join A with sl st to first sc. Break B.
2nd rnd: With A, ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join MC with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
Break B.
Work from ** to ** as given for Daisy Motif.
STEMS (make 8)
With B, ch 51.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 50 sc. Fasten off.
LEAVES (make 24): With B, ch 8.

materials: One Pound (454 g/16. oz;742 m/812 yds) Change Color Here Soft Pink (0513) 1
One size US H-8 (5 mm) crochet hook, or size to obtain gauge.
Yarn needle. Choose from small amounts of any combination of the colors.
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
HEART
Ch 3.
Row 1: Sc in second ch from hook and in next ch, turn—2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, turn—3 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—5 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—7 sc.
Row 5: Sk first sc, 5 dc in next sc (shell made), sk next sc, sl st in next sc, sk next sc, 5 dc in next sc, sk last sc, sl st in beginning ch, turn—2 shells.
Work now proceeds in rounds.
Round 6: Ch 2 (does not count as a st), 2 dc in next 3 dc, sc in next dc, sl st in next dc, sk next sl st, sl st in next dc, sc in next dc, 2 dc in next 3 dc; working in ends of rows, work 6 dc evenly spaced along side of heart; working along opposite side of foundation ch, 3 dc in space between 2 sc at base of heart; working in ends of rows, work 6 dc evenly spaced up side of heart; join with sl st in top of beginning ch—27 dc, 2 sc, and 2 sl sts.
Round 7: Ch 2, 2 dc in next 6 dc, sc in next sc, sl st between next 2 sl sts, sc in next sc, 2 dc in next 6 dc, dc in next 7 dc, 3 dc in next dc (point), dc in next 7 dc; join with sl st in top of beginning ch—41 dc, 2 sc, and 1 sl st. Fasten off.

EDGINGS (optional)
Work either of the following edgings, as desired.
Edging 1
Join yarn with sl st in sl st at center of top of heart.
Round 1: Ch 4, sk next st, *sl st in next st, ch 4, sk next st; repeat from * around; join with sl st in first sl st.
Hanging Loop (optional): Ch 14, sl st in first ch of ch-14. Fasten off.

Edging 2
Join yarn with sl st in sl st at center of top of heart.
Round 1: Sk next st, 5 dc in next st, sk next st, *sl st in next st, sk next st, 5 dc in next st, sk next st; repeat from * around; join with sl st in first sl st.
Hanging Loop (optional): Ch 14, sl st in first ch of ch-14. Fasten off.

Edging 3
Weave a piece of contrasting yarn between the sts of the last round. Weave in ends or tie ends into a bow.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Classic™ Crochet Thread size 10 (White: 400 yds/366 m; Colors: 350 yds/320 m)
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook
Size U.S. 7 (1.5 mm) Susan Bates® Steelite® crochet hook
Pipe cleaner per elf 12" [30.5 cm] long

4 small wooden balls for Hands & Feet
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 26 sc and 28 rows = 4" [10 cm] with U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) crochet hook; 36 sc and 40 rows = 4" [10 cm] with U.S. 7 (1.5 mm) crochet hook
instructions:
ELF’S TOP
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of rnds counts as dc.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
Designer Tip: Do not fully tighten the Magic Loop until after working Rnd 2. It will make it easier to get your hook into the stitches.
See Diagram on page 3, 
With U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) crochet hook, Make Magic Loop. 
Video here. 
1st rnd: Ch 3. 11 dc in magic loop. Join. PM on top of first dc for beg of rnd. 12 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 2 dc in each dc around. Join. 24 dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 1 dc in next dc. *2 dc in next d...d in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 dc.
5th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * around. Join. 60 dc.
6th rnd: Ch 5 (counts as ch 2 and 1 dc). 1 dc in same sp as sl st. * Skip next dc. (1 dc. Ch 2. 1 dc) in next dc. Rep from * around. Skip last dc. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-5. Fasten off.

ELF’S HAT
With U.S. 7 (1.5 mm) crochet hook, ch 23. 
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 22 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 20 sts.
Rep last row until 4 sts rem.
Next row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

FINISHING
Cut the pipe cleaner as follows:
3" [7.5 cm] for Body
4" [10 cm] for Arms
5" [12.5 cm] for Legs
1. Fold Leg pipe cleaner in half.
2. Fold up the lower end of the Body pipe cleaner approx ½" [3 mm] to form an “U”.
3. Place Legs in the “U” and twist closed.
4. Insert top of Body through hole in the center of Elf’s Top and push Elf’s Top down approx 1½" [4 cm].
5. Place Head wooden ball on top of Body pipe cleaner. Twist Body pipe cleaner end at top of wooden ball in a knot. Make sure it does not pull back through the hole.
6. Fold Arm pipe cleaner in half and wrap it around Body pipe cleaner approx ½" [3 mm] below Elf’s Top.
7. Slide Feet wooden balls onto Leg pipe cleaner and secure end. Rep for 2nd leg.
8. Insert the arm through V-stitch edge of Elf’s Top and attach hand wooden ball to Arm pipe cleaner. Secure end. Rep for 2nd Arm.
9. Sew back hat seam. Attach pom-pom to tip of Hat.
10. Glue Hat to Head wooden ball, keeping seam at back.
11. Insert an ornament hook through 2 sts at top of Hat to hang Tree Elf on Christmas Tree or on bottle or gift box.

Two pieces of cardboard 3” x 2½” (8 x 6 cm)

abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
