gauge: 6 sts = 1¼” (3 cm); 6 rows = 1¾” (4.4 cm) in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Join Front and Back
Hold front and back with wrong sides together; ch 1, working through both layers sc evenly down side edge, 3 sc in corner, sc across bottom edge, 3 sc in corner, sc up other side edge (do not sc across top edge), ch 20 for hanger, slip st in opposite top corner. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Sew button to top center front. Insert picture and button closed.
Flower for Red Frame
Round 1: With C, ch 2; 6 sc in 2 ch from hook.
Round 2: Working in back loops only * (slip st, ch 1, dc, ch 1) in next sc; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off. Sew to frame. Weave in ends.
Trim for Green Frame
Holding frame up side down join A with a slip st in left bottom corner sc; * ch 6, 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, slip st in next sc on frame; repeat from * across bottom. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
ORNAMENT
Tape a photo to center of each cardboard with mailing tape. Set aside.
Front (Make 1 with A and one with B)
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Ch 11; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 10 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Divide for Right Side Edge-Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc; turn leaving 8 sc unworked.
Rows 5-10: Ch 1, sc in 2 sc; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 10.
Left Side Edge: With right side facing, skip next 6 sc of Row 3; join yarn with sc in next sc, sc in last sc; turn.
Repeat Rows 5-10 same as for right side except do not fasten off; turn.
Join for Top Edge-Row 11: Ch 1, sc in next 2 sc, ch 6, sc across 2 sc of Right Side Edge; turn.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc in 2 sc, sc in 6 ch, sc in next 2 sc; turn – 10 sc.
Rows 13 and 14: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
Back (Make 1 with A and 1 with B)
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 11; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 10 sc.
Rows 2-13: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, ch 6 for button loop, sc in last 5 sc; turn.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball each 431 Pumpkin A, 1 ball 001 White B, 1 ball 012 Black C
Artificial pumpkins: 6½” (16.5 cm) white, 9” (23 cm) black, 13” (33 cm) orange
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Fits decorative pumpkins sizes 6½” (16.5 cm), 9” (23 cm), and 13” (33 cm) tall.
gauge: 32 tr = 4” [10 cm]; 8 rounds tr = 4” [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Rounds 4-11: Slip st in the next dc and ch-3 space, work Beginning Shell in same ch-3 space, * ch 5; skip next 2 dc, 3 chs and 2 dc**; work Shell in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in top of ch-3 to join—16 Shells and 16 ch-5 spaces.
Rounds 12-13: Slip st in the next dc and ch-3 space, work Beginning Shell in same ch-3 space, * ch 3; skip next 2 dc, 5 chs and 2 dc**; work Shell in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in top of ch-3 to join—16 Shells and 16 additional ch-3 spaces.
Round 14: Slip st in the next dc and ch-3 space, ch 1, sc in same space, * ch 5; skip next 2 dc, 3 chs, and 2 dc**; sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in first sc to join—16 sc and 16 ch-5 spaces. Place the Pumpkin inside the crocheted piece.
Round 15: Slip st in the next 3 chs, ch 1, sc in same ch, * ch 3, skip next sc, sc in the next ch-5-space; repeat from * around, ch 3, slip st in first sc to join—16 sc and 16 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off; weave in ends.
COVER FOR 9” PUMPKIN
With B, ch 40; being careful not to twist, slip st in top of beginning ch to join into a ring.
Round 1 (Right side): Ch 1, work 45 sc in ring; slip st in first sc to join—45 sc.
Round 2: [Ch 15, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc] 14 times, ch 7, skip last 2 sc, dtr in first ch to join—15 loops.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st, [ch 7, sc in next ch-15-space] 14 times, ch 7, slip st first sc to join—15 ch-7 loops.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same st, [ch 8, sc in next sc] 14 times, ch 8, slip st in first sc to join—15 ch-8 loops.
Round 5: Ch 13, [tr into next sc, ch 9] 14 times, slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-13 to join—15 ch-9 loops.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in same st, [ch 10, sc in next tr] 14 times, ch 10, slip st in first sc to join—15 ch-10 loops.
Round 7: Ch 15, [tr into next sc, ch 11] 14 times, slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-15 to join—15 ch-11 loops.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in same st, [ch 12, sc in next tr] 14 times, ch 12, slip st in first sc to join—15 ch-12 loops.
Round 9: Ch 16, [tr into next sc, ch 12] 14 times, slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-16 to join—15 ch-12 loops.
Round 10: Ch 1, sc in same st, [ch 13, sc in next tr] 14 times, ch 13, slip st in first sc to join—15 ch-13 loops.
Rounds 11-22: Repeat Rounds 9-10. Place the Pumpkin inside the crocheted piece.
Round 23: Ch 10, *insert hook underneath the next space created by both ch-13 loops from Rounds 21 and 22, ch 6**, tr in next sc, ch 6; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-10 to join—15 ch-6 loops.
Round 24: Ch 1, sc in same st, [ch 8, sc in next tr] 14 times, ch 8, slip st in first sc to join—15 ch-8 loops.
Round 25: Ch 1, sc in same st, [ch 6, sc in next sc] 14 times, ch 6, slip st in first sc to join—15 ch-6 loops. Fasten off; weave in ends.
COVER FOR 6½” PUMPKIN
With A, ch 40; being careful not to twist, slip st in top of beginning ch to join into a ring.
Round 1 (Right side): Work Beginning Shell in first ch, [ch 3, skip next 4 chs, work Shell in next ch] 7 times, ch 3, skip next 4 chs; slip st in top of ch-3 to join—8 Shells and 8 additional ch-3 spaces.
Round 2: Slip st in the next dc and ch-3 space, work Beginning Shell in same ch-3 space, * ch 3, skip next 2 dc and next ch, work Shell in next ch, ch 3**, skip next ch and 2 dc, work Shell in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in top of ch-3 to join—16 Shells and 16 additional ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in the next dc and ch-3 space, work Beginning Shell in same ch-3 space, * ch 3; skip next 2 dc, 3 chs and 2 dc**; work Shell in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in top of ch-3 to join—16 Shells and 16 additional ch-3 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same st, * ch 5; skip next 2 dc, 3 chs, and 2 dc**; sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in first sc to join—16 sc and 16 ch-5 spaces.
Round 5: Ch 4, 2 tr in same st, [ch 5, skip next 4 chs, 3 tr in next ch] 7 times, ch 5, skip next 4 chs; slip st in top of ch-4 to join—8 3-tr groups and 8 ch-5 spaces.
Rounds 6-7: Ch 4, tr in each of next 8 tr, * ch 15, skip next 15 chs**, tr in each of next 9 tr; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in top of ch-4 to join—8 9-tr groups and 8 ch-15 spaces.
Round 8: Ch 4, tr in same st, * tr in each of next 7 tr, 2 tr in next tr, ch 17, skip next 15 chs**, 2 tr in next tr; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in top of ch-4 to join—8 11-tr groups and 8 ch-17 spaces.
Rounds 9- 23: Ch 4, tr in each of next 10 tr, * ch 17, skip next 17 chs**, tr in each of next 11 tr; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in top of ch-4 to join—8 11-tr groups and 8 ch-17 spaces. Place the Pumpkin inside the cover.
Round 24: Ch 4, *2-tr-cluster in next 2 tr, tr in each of next 5 tr, 2-tr-cluster in next 2 tr, tr in next tr, ch 15, skip next 17 chs**, tr in next tr; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in top of ch-4 to join—8 9-tr groups and 8 ch-15 spaces.
Round 25: Ch 4, *2-tr-cluster in next 2 tr, tr in each of next 3 tr, 2-tr-cluster in next 2 tr, tr in next tr, ch 13, skip next 15 chs**, tr in next tr; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in top of ch-4 to join—8 7-tr groups and 8 ch-13 spaces.
Round 26: Ch 9, skip 5 trs, *tr in last tr of the group, ch 5, tr in the center of next ch-13-space, ch 5**, tr in the first tr of the next group, ch 5; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-9 to join—24 ch-5 spaces.
Round 27: *Ch 7; skip next ch-5 space, tr, and ch-5 space**; slip st in next tr; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in first ch to join—12 ch-7 spaces. Fasten off; weave in ends.

materials: ⅓ yd [30 cm] of 45 ins [115 cm] wide fabric.
Size 3.25 mm (U.S. 3) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
gauge: 17 dc and 8 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]
instructions:
Ch 10. 
1st row: (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) all in 4th ch from hook. Miss next 5 ch. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) all in next ch -shell made. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 6. (Shell in next ch-2 sp) twice. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-2 sp) twice. Ch 2. Miss next 2 dc. 1 dc in last dc of shell. Ch 2. 1 dc in 3rd ch of ch 6. Turn. 
4th row: Ch 6. Miss first dc. (1 dc in next dc. Ch 2) twice. (Shell in next ch-2 sp) twice. Turn. 
5th row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-2 sp) twice. Ch 2. Miss next 2 dc. 1 dc in next dc. (Ch 2. 1 dc in next dc) twice. Ch 2. 1 dc in 3rd ch of ch 6. Turn. 
6th row: Ch 6. Miss first dc. (1 dc in next dc. Ch 2) 4 times. (Shell in next ch-2 sp) twice. Turn. 
7th row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-2 sp) twice. Ch 2. Miss next 2 dc. 1 dc in next dc. (Ch 2. 1 dc in next dc) 4 times. Ch 2. 1 dc in 3rd ch of ch 6. Turn. 
8th row: Ch 6. Miss first dc. (1 dc in next dc. Ch 2) 6 times. (Shell in next ch-2 sp) twice. Turn. 
9th row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-2 sp) twice. Turn. 
Rep 2nd to 9th rows once more, then 2nd to 8th rows once. Fasten off. 
Loop: Ch 4. 
1st row: Shell in 4th ch from hook. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 3. Shell in ch-2 sp. Turn. 
Rep last row until loop measures 4 ins [10 cm]. Fasten off. 
FINISHING: Place Edging and Loop flat onto ironing board. Cover with a damp pressing cloth and apply a hot iron. Remove from ironing board when dry. Cut fabric following Diagram for front and back of stocking adding a ¼inch [6 mm] seam allowance. Sew front and back of Stocking tog. 
Tassel: (make 3). Cut a piece of cardboard 1 ¾ ins [4.5 cm] wide. Wind yarn around cardboard 35 times. Break yarn leaving a long end and thread end through a needle. Slip needle through all loops and tie tightly. Remove cardboard and wind yarn tightly around loops ¼ inch [6 mm] below fold. Fasten securely. Cut through rem loops and trim ends evenly. Sew tassels as shown. Sew edging onto front of Stocking. Sew Loop as shown.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 235 Lemon A, 726 Coral B, 505 Aruba Sea C, 3862 Jade D, and small amount of 312 Black E.
abbreviations: A, B, C, D, and E = Color A, Color B, Color C, Color D, and Color E
() = work directions in parentheses into same st
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Each chick measures about 5½” (14 cm) tall, not including tuft on top of head. Basket measures about 7½” (19 cm) around and 3½” (9 cm) tall, not including handle.
gauge: 17½ sts = 4” (10 cm); 16 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet. Rounds 1–6 = 2½” (6.5 cm) around. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CHICK (make 3)
Head/Body
Beginning at top of head, with A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). Pull gently on tail to tighten ring. Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 11 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—39 sc.
Round 8: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] 3 times—42 sc.
Rounds 9–18: Sc in each sc around.
Round 19: Sc in next 14 sc, ch 14, skip next 14 sc (for tail opening), sc in last 14 sc—28 sc and 1 ch-14 space.
Round 20: Sc in each sc and ch around—42 sc.
Round 21: [Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 22: [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 23: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 24: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog, sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 25: [Sc in next sc, sc2tog] 6 times—12 sc.
Round 26: [Sc2tog] 6 times—6 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. With yarn needle, thread tail through the front loop of each of the remaining 6 stitches and pull tight to close hole in bottom of Chick.
Tail
Round 1: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in first skipped sc of tail opening, ch 1, sc in same sc, sc in next 13 skipped sc; rotate piece to work across opposite side of tail opening ch, sc in each of the 14 ch; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—28 sc.
Round 2: *[Sc2tog] twice, sc in next 6 sc, [sc2tog] twice; repeat from * once more—20 sc.
Do not fasten off. Stuff Chick firmly and continue to add stuffing to Chick as you work. Stuff the body and head quite firmly, but stuff the tail only lightly so that it keeps a flat-ish shape.
Round 3: [Sc2tog, sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] twice—16 sc.
Round 4: [Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] twice—12 sc.
Round 5: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] twice—8 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. With yarn needle, thread tail through the front loop of each of the remaining 8 stitches and pull tight to close hole in tail of Chick.
Wings (make 2 for each Chick)
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). Pull gently on tail to tighten ring. Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] twice—8 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] twice—10 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] twice—12 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] twice—14 sc.
Round 6: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] twice—16 sc.
Slip st in next st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing wing to body.
Legs (make 2 for each Chick)
Beginning at top of leg, with A, leaving a long beginning tail for sewing, ch 12; joining with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, beginning in same ch as join, sc in each ch around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, beginning in same sc as join, [sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 3: Slip st in each sc around. Notes: Keep the slip stitches a bit loose. This will make it easier to work the next round. On the following round work behind the round of slip stitches into the single crochet stitches of Round 2. The slip stitches in this round are only decoration. They will never be worked into.
Fasten off.
Round 4: With right side facing and working behind the slip sts of Round 3, draw up a loop of B in any sc of Round 2, ch 1, beginning in same sc, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Rounds 5–7: Ch 1, beginning in same sc as join, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing leg to foot.
Feet (make 2 for each Chick)
Beginning at heel, with B, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). Pull gently on tail to tighten ring. Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Rounds 2–5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 7: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
First toe
Round 8 (first toe): Sc in next 6 sc, skip last 12 sc—6 sc. Note: The first stitch of the next round is worked into the first stitch of this round (to skip the last 12 sc of this round). This begins the first toe. Later, stitches will be worked into the skipped 12 sc to begin the other two toes.
Rounds 9 and 10: Sc in each sc around—6 sc.
Slip st in next sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Middle toe
Round 8: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in first skipped sc of Round 7 following first toe, ch 1, beginning in same sc, sc in next 3 sc, skip next 6 sc, sc in last 3 skipped sc of Round 7—6 sc. Note: Leave the beginning yarn tail hanging on the outside of the piece. The beginning tail will be used later to sew the small hole between toes closed.
Rounds 9–11: Sc in each sc around.
Slip st in next sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Third toe
Round 8: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in first skipped sc of Round 7 following middle toe, ch 1, beginning in same sc, sc in each of the remaining 6 skipped sts—6 sc. Note: Leave the beginning yarn tail hanging on the outside of the piece. The beginning tail will be used later to sew the small hole between toes closed.
Rounds 9 and 10: Sc in each sc around.
Slip st in next sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Using the back end of your crochet hook, or the eraser end of a pencil, push small amounts of stuffing down into the feet until they are fairly stiff. Although this doesn’t really change the appearance of the feet, it will make them sturdier and help keep the chick balanced on his feet. 
With yarn needle, thread ending yarn tail from each toe through the front loop of each of the remaining 6 stitches and pull tight to close hole in toe. With yarn needle and beginning yarn tails, sew the small gaps between toes closed. Weave in ends.
Beak (make 1 for each Chick)
With B, leaving a long beginning tail for sewing, ch 9.
Row 1: Dc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch does not count as a st), hdc in next ch, slip st in next 3 ch, hdc in next ch, dc in last ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Fold the strip in half so that the middle slip stitch is at the fold. The middle slip stitch will be the tip of the beak. With yarn needle and one of the yarn tails whip stitch the side edges of the folded beak together so that it stays in this folded position. Set aside. The other yarn tail will be used later to sew beak to head.
Tuft (make 1 for each Chick)
With A, leaving a long beginning tail for sewing, ch 4.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch; ch 6, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 4 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing tuft to top of head.
FINISHING CHICK
With B, sew the top of one foot to the bottom of each leg. The front of the leg should be lined up just behind Round 6 of the foot (this is where the first round of increases were made). Make sure that about 3 rounds of the heel of the foot stick out past the back of the leg.
Stuff the legs very firmly. Pin legs to the underside of body. They should be lined up with the center of the Chick’s underside, but placed outward (toward the sides) so that there is about ½–¾” (13–19mm) of space between the legs. With yarn needle and yarn tails, whipstitch around edge of legs to sew them to the underside of the Chick’s body. Pin Beak to center front of Chick and, with yarn needle and yarn tail, sew in place. Pin wings to sides of body (Note: Wings should not be stuffed; they should be flat). With yarn needle and yarn tails, sew wings to sides of body. With yarn needle and yarn tail, sew tuft to top of head, about ½” (13mm) forward from center. With yarn needle and E, make a large French knot for each eye, and add some horizontal stitches along the sides of the beak to visually separate the top beak from the bottom beak. Weave in all ends.
BASKET
Beginning at bottom, with C, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (inside basket): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). Pull gently on tail to tighten ring. Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—42 sc.
Round 8: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times—48 sc.
Round 9: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] 6 times—54 sc.
Round 10: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times—60 sc.
Round 11: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] 6 times—66 sc.
Round 12: [Sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—72 sc.
Round 13: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times—78 sc.
Round 14: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 10 sc] 6 times—84 sc.
Round 15: [Sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times—90 sc.
Round 16: [Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 7 sc] 6 times—96 sc.
Round 17: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 14 sc] 6 times—102 sc.
Round 18: [Sc in next 16 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—108 sc.
Round 19: Working in front loops only, sc in each sc around.
Rounds 20–35: Sc in each sc around.
Round 36: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 17 sc] 6 times—114 sc.
Round 37: Working in back loops only, sc in next 26 sc, ch 5, skip next 5 sc (for handle opening), sc in next 52 sc, ch 5, skip next 5 sc (for 2nd handle opening), sc in next 26 sc—104 sc and 2 ch-5 spaces.
Round 38: Sc in each sc and ch around—114 sc.
Rounds 39 and 40: Sc in each sc around; change to D in last st of Round 40.
Round 41: With D, slip st in each st around. Notes: Keep the slip stitches a bit loose. This will make it easier to work the next round. On the following round work behind the round of slip stitches into the single crochet stitches of Round 40. The slip stitches in this round are only made as decoration. They will never be worked into.
Round 42: Working behind the slip sts of Round 41, sc in each sc around.
Rounds 43–45: Sc in each sc around.
Round 46: Slip st in each st around; change to C in last st.
Round 47: With C and working behind the slip sts of Round 46, sc in each sc around.
Rounds 48–53: Sc in each sc around.
Round 54: [Sc2tog, sc in next 17 sc] 6 times—108 sc.
Hold Basket so that wrong side of the single crochet stitches show on the outside of the Basket. Fold top of Basket to outside, along Round 37 (this was the round where you worked into the back loop only) so that the right side of the single crochet stitches show on the outside of the Basket. Position Round 54 directly in front of Round 19 (where you worked into the front loop only).
Round 55: Crochet the two layers together as follows: *insert hook through back loop of next st of Round 54 and then through the unused loop of corresponding st in Round 18 directly, yarn over and draw the loop through all loops on hook (slip st made); repeat from * all the way around basket—108 sts. 
Fasten off.
Handle
With C, leaving a long beginning tail for sewing, ch 10; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in same ch as join and in each ch around—10 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Repeat Round 2 until piece measures about 14” (35.5 cm) long.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Bow
With D, ch 40; taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in same ch as join and in each ch around—40 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Sc in front loops only of the next 2 sc, place a marker in the unused back loop of the first sc of this round, sc in both loops of the next 16 sc, sc in front loops only of the next 4 sc, sc in both loops of the next 16 sc, sc in front loops only of the next 2 sc.
Rounds 3–5: Sc in each sc around. Remove beginning of round marker. Sc in next sc to establish a new beginning of round and replace the marker. The first stitch of Round 6 is now the first stitch of the rounds.
Round 6: Beginning with the next st of Round 5 and the marked unused back loop of Round 1, *insert hook through next st and then from top to bottom through the next unused back loop of Round 1, yarn over and draw loop back through the unused loop and the stitch (2 loops remain on hook), yarn over and draw through both loops on hook (first connecting sc made); repeat from * once more, sc in next 16 sts of Round 5, work connecting sc in next 4 sc and the corresponding unworked back loops of Round 1, sc in next 16 sc, work connecting sc in next 2 sc and the corresponding unworked back loops of Round 1.
Round 7: Sc in each sc around.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. With yarn needle and yarn tails, sew the front and back (narrow sections) of the center of bow together. Weave in ends.
Bow Center
With D, leaving a long beginning tail for sewing, ch 11.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—10 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off. Wrap the bow center around the center of the bow. With yarn needle and yarn tails, sew the ends of the bow center together. Sew a few stitches through all thicknesses of bow and bow center to secure bow center in place around bow.
FINISHING BASKET
With yarn needle and yarn tails, sew one end of handle to each of the openings on the sides of Basket. 
With yarn needle and yarn tails, sew bow to front of Basket, covering up the jog where the yarn color was changed.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 336 Warm Brown A, 316 Soft White B, and 319 Cherry Red C
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4 mm [US G-6]
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Man and Lady measure 5½” (14 cm) tall; House measures 5” (12.5 cm) tall; Baby measures 4½” (11.5 cm) tall.
gauge: 4 sc = 1” (2.5 cm); 4 rows = 1” (2.5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Large Heart (make 3)
With C, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join.
Round 2: (Sc, ch 2, sc) in first sc, slip st in next sc, 2 hdc in next sc, ch 1, slip st in next sc, ch 1, 2 hdc in next sc, slip st in next sc; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.
MAN 
Body (make 2)
Beginning at top of head, with A, ch 4.
Row 1 (right side): Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, 2 sc in last sc, turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * across, turn—7 sc.
Rows 3–6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc3tog, sc2tog, turn—3 sc.
Row 8: Ch 6, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 4 ch, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn—9 sc.
Row 9: Ch 6, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 4 ch, sc in each sc across, turn—14 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 10 sc, sc2tog, turn—12 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in first 10 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—10 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc in first 8 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—8 sc.
Rows 13 and 14: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
First Leg
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, sc2tog; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—3 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in last 3 sc, turn—5 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
2nd Leg
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, join A with sc in first unworked sc of Row 14, sc in next 2 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—3 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in last 2 sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—5 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; working across ends of rows, in sts, and in opposite side of foundation ch, sc evenly spaced around working 2 sc as needed in rows at curved edges; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail on one piece for sewing.
FINISHING MAN
1. Select one piece as front. Leave remaining piece unworked.
Edging Round (right side): With right side facing and working in front loops only, join A with sc in any sc, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
2. With B, embroider French knot eyes and 3 French knots across each arm and leg. Using photograph as a guide, embroider small straight stitches under eyes for smiling mouth.
3. Sew large heart on front.
4. Working through unworked back loops of Edging Round and both loops of back, sew front and back together, tucking in ends and stuffing lightly as you go.
5. Hanging Loop Join B with slip st to center of top of head, ch 15, slip st in same st as joining st. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
LADY 
Body (make 2)
Work same as man.
Bib Apron 
Bib 
With B, ch 5.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn—4 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Do not turn.
Apron
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 5 sc evenly spaced across ends of rows, turn—5 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc across, turn—20 sc.
Rows 4–6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING LADY
Work Steps 1 and 2 of Finishing Man instructions.
Sew large heart on apron. Sew apron to front of lady.
Work Steps 4 and 5 of Finishing Man instructions. Weave in ends.
BABY 
Body (make 2)
Beginning at top of head, with A, ch 4.
Row 1 (right side): Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn—6 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 3 times, turn—3 sc.
Row 7: Ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc, turn—8 sc.
Row 8: Ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, sc in each sc across, turn—12 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in last 10 sc, turn—11 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 7 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—8 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—6 sc.
First Leg
Row 1 (wrong side): Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 2 sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
2nd Leg
Row 1 (wrong side): With wrong side facing, join A with sc in first unworked sc of Row 11, sc in next 2 sc, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. 
Round 5: Work same as Round 6 of man.
Bib
With B, ch 2.
Row 1 (right side): Work 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next 2 sc, sc in last sc, turn—6 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * across, turn—8 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in next sc, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc, turn—6 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in next sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING BABY
Work Steps 1 and 2 of Finishing Man instructions.
Using photo as a guide and with 2 strands of C held together, embroider heart on bib with 2 lazy daisy stitches. Begin and end each stitch in same place in center of bib, angling stitches away from each other. Sew bib to front.
Work Steps 4 and 5 of Finishing Man instructions. Weave in ends.
Row 9: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc2tog, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog; change to A, turn—11 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—9 sc.
Rows 12–17: Repeat last 2 rows 3 times—3 sc.
Round 18: Ch 1, sc3tog; working down first side, sc in end of each row; working in opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in each ch across to last ch, 3 sc in last ch, working up other side, sc in end of end of each, 3 sc in first sc; join with slip st in next st. Fasten off.
Back
Work same as front, omitting all color changes.
Window
With B, ch 8; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 12 sc in ring. Do not join.
Round 2: Slip st in front loop of first sc, *ch 2, skip next sc, slip st front loop of next sc; repeat from * around, ch 2, skip last sc; join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.
FINISHING HOUSE
On front, work Edging Round of Finishing Man instructions.
Trim With right side of front facing and held upside down (top of piece closest to you), join B with slip st in first unworked loop of Row 9, *ch 4, skip next unworked loop, slip st in next unworked loop; repeat from * across. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Tack loops down.
Using photograph as a guide, sew window in place and embroider 2 crossing straight stitches for panes.
With C, embroider a French knot in center of each ch-4 space of trim. With B, embroider French knots around sides and lower edge of front.
Work Steps 3–5 of Finishing Man instructions. Weave in ends.

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
() = work directions in parentheses into same st
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Each letter and train engine measures about 6" [15 cm] tall.
gauge: 12 sts = 4" [10 cm]; 16 rows = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE.
instructions:
TRAIN ENGINE
ENGINE
Boiler
Beginning at front end with A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 7 and 8: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 9: With right side facing, join B with sc in first sc, sc in each remaining st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 10: With B, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 11: With right side facing, join A with sc in first sc, sc in each remaining st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 12–16: With A, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Rounds 17 and 18: With B, repeat Rounds 9 and 10. Fasten off.
Rounds 19-22: With A, repeat Rounds 11–14. Fasten off. Stuff piece.
Smoke Stack
With A, ch 6; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 6: Slip st in each st around. Fasten off. Sew smoke stack to top of boiler centered over first B-colored stripe.
Cab Roof
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in ring, [ch 2, sc in ring] 3 times, ch 2; join with slip st in first sc—4 sc and 4 ch-2 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space (corner made), [sc in next st, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space] 3 times; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc (3 sc on each of 4 sides between corners) and 4 ch-2 corner spaces.
Rounds 3–5: Ch 1, [sc in each st to next corner ch-2 space, (sc, ch 2, sc) in corner ch-2 space] 4 times, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc (9 sc on each of 4 sides between corners) and 4 corner ch-2 spaces at the end of Round 5.
Round 6: Ch 1, working in front loops only, [sc in each st to next corner ch-2 space, (sc, ch 2, sc) in corner ch-2 space] 4 times, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—44 sc (11 sc on each of 4 sides between corners) and 4 corner ch-2 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 7: With right side facing join B with slip st in any st, slip st in each st around. Fasten off.
Cab Box
Round 1 (right side): With wrong side (bottom) of roof facing and working with outer edge of roof facing you, join C with sc in free loop of 5th st (center st) of one of the sides of Round 5, sc in each st around skipping the ch-2 corner spaces; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first 4 sts, sc2tog, [sc in next 7 sts, sc2tog] 3 times, sc in last 3 sts; join with slip st in first sc—32 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, turn, [sc in each st to next sc2tog, Fpdc around sc2tog (corner made)] 4 times, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—28 sc and 4 corner post sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, turn, [sc in each st to next corner post st, Bpdc around corner post st] 4 times, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 5: Ch 1, turn, [sc in each st to next corner post st, Fpdc around corner post st] 4 times, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 6–17: Repeat Rounds 4 and 5 six times.
Fasten off.
Windows (make 4)
With D, ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across—6 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Edging Round: Ch 1, do not turn, slip st in end of each row across side edge, ch 1 at corner, slip st in ch at base of each st across opposite side of foundation ch, ch 1 at corner, slip st in end of each row across next side edge, ch 1 at corner, slip st in each st across last row. Fasten off. Sew one window to each side of cab, sewing top edge of windows one row below roof of cab.
Cab Base
With C, ch 9.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across—8 sc.
Rows 2–8: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Fasten off. Stuff cab. Sew base to lower edge of cab, adding more stuffing as you sew, as needed.
WHEEL AND AXLE (make 6)
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing and working in back loops only, join D with sc in first st, sc in same st, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc. Fasten off.
Round 4: With right side facing, join A with sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, dc-spike in free front loop of first st of Round 1 skipping the corresponding st in Round 4, [sc in next st of Round 4, 2 sc in next st of Round 4, dc-spike in free front loop of next st of Round 1 skipping the corresponding st in Round 4] 5 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sts.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, [sc in next st, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Begin stuffing piece and continue to stuff as you work.
Round 10 (begin axle): Ch 1, working in front loops only, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 11–14: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 1 skein each 1308 Tan A, 1401 Pewter B, and 1502 Iced Aqua C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Hanger measures 17” wide by 9¼” long (43 x 23.5 cm).
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
HANGER (make 1 in each color)
Work as many covering sc as needed around diagonal and horizontals bars, pushing stitches together to ensure complete coverage; join with slip st in first stitch. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
APPLIQUES
Star (make 2)
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Work in continuous rounds. Place marker on first stitch and move up as each round is completed. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: *Work 2 sc in next 2 sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—20 sc.
Continue in rows for each point.
Row 1: Ch 1, hdc in first 3 sc, slip st in next sc, turn—3 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 2, skip slip st, hdc in first 2 hdc, slip st in last hdc, turn—3 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 2, skip slip st, dc2tog (point made), ch 1; working across ends of rows, 2 slip st in first row, slip st in next 2 rows, slip st in last sc work of Round 3¬—1 point.
Repeat Rows 1–3 four times; join with slip st in beginning ch of Row 1. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing on one star.
Heart (make 2)
With B, ch 2.
Row 1 (right side): Work 2 hdc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—2 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 hdc in each hdc, turn—4 hdc.
Rows 3–5: Ch 1, 2 hdc in first hdc, hdc in each st across to last hdc, 2 hdc in last hdc, turn—10 hdc.
First Arch
Row 6: Ch 1, hdc in first 4 hdc, slip st in next hdc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—4 hdc.
Row 7: Ch 2, skip slip st, hdc in first 3 hdc, slip st in last hdc, turn—3 hdc.
Row 8: Ch 2, skip slip st, hdc in first 2 hdc, slip st in last hdc; holding piece with ends of rows facing, slip st in end of first 2 rows—2 hdc.
Second Arch
Row 6: Working in end of Row 6 of first arch, slip st in last hdc, ch 1, working in unworked sts, hdc in next 5 hdc, turn—5 hdc.
Row 7: Ch 1, hdc in first 4 hdc, slip st in last hdc, turn—4 hdc.
Row 8: Ch 2, skip slip st, hdc in first 2 hdc, slip st in next hdc, leave last hdc unworked, do not turn—2 hdc.
Edging
Round 1: Ch 1, working in ends of rows, sc 11 sts evenly down first side; work 3 sc in opposite side of foundation ch, sc 11 sts evenly up other side, 2 sc in next 2 hdc of first arch; sc in end of next 3 rows, slip st in center slip st (between arches); sc in end of next 3 rows up second arch, 2 sc in next 2 hdc; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing on one heart.
Flower (make 2)
With C, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Work in continuous rounds. Place marker on first stitch and move up as each round is completed. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, *sc in next sc, ch 5, working in back bumps only, dc in 3rd ch from hook, dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next sc (petal made); repeat from * 5 times—6 petals.
Round 4: *Working in opposite side of ch, slip st in first ch, sc in next 2 ch, 2 sc in next ch, 2 sc in ch-2 space (at top of petal), 2 sc in first dc, sc in next dc, slip st in next hdc, slip st in next sc, skip next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing on one flower.
FINISHING
Pair each applique and hanger as follows: heart on A-colored hanger, flower on B-colored hanger, and star on C-colored hanger.
With wrong sides held together and working through both sets of loops, begin whipstitching pairs of appliques together but do not complete. Using photograph as a guide, center each applique over base of hanger hook, positioning over first and last stitches on bars. Continue whipstitching around, threading yarn as needed through wrong side of stitches to close gaps around bars and hook. Secure ends. Repeat for each hanger.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®” Chunky™: 1 skein each Windsor 380 A, Buff 334 B; 2 skeins Coffee 365 C.
Tapestry needle, 15” x 15” x 15” storage ottoman.
abbreviations: A, B, etc. = color A, B, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: Rounds 1-4 = 6”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Squares (Make 5)
With A, ch 6, join with slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3, 2 dc in ring, ch 2, [3 dc in ring, ch 2] three times. Join with slip st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join B in any ch-2 space, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, ch 1, * (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space, ch 1; repeat from * around, join with slip st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Round 3: Join C in any ch-2 space, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, ch 1, 3 dc in ch-1 space, ch 1, * (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space, ch 1, 3 dc in ch-1 space, ch 1; repeat from * around, join with slip st to top of ch-3.
Round 4: Slip st to ch-2 space, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, ch 1, [3 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1] twice, * (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space, ch 1, [3 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1] twice; repeat from * around, join with slip st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Round 5: Join A in any ch-2 space, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same space, ch 1, [3 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1] three times, *(3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next ch-2 space, ch 1, [3 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1] three times; repeat from * around, join with slip st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Rounds 6-10: Work as established, continuing color sequence as follows: 1 round each B, C, C, A, B.
Round 11: Join C in any ch-2 space, ch 1, 3 sc in ch-2 space, sc in each st and ch-1 space around, working 3 sc in each ch-2 space. Join with slip st to first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. With right sides together, working in the back loops only and following diagram, join 4 squares together side by side with a sc in each st. Join first square to last square to form an open box. Join last square to top, working all the way around square to close. Turn right side out.
Edging
With right side facing, join C to any stitch along bottom of cover.
Rnd 1: Ch 1, sc in every st around, join with slip st to first st.
Rnd 2: Ch 1, slip st in back loop only of each st around. Join with slip st to first st. Fasten off.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 5 mm [US H-8]
Susan Bates® Easy Pom Pon Maker, 1¼" (3 cm) and 1¾" (4.5 cm) diameter
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc;
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified;
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: 17 dc = 5" (12.5 cm); 8 dc rows = 5" (12.5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
LEG
With B, ch 33 (43).
Row 1 (right side): Sc in second ch from hook and each ch across, turn – 32 (42) sc.
Row 2: With A, ch 3 (counts as 1 dc now and throughout), dc in next sc and each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
Row 4: With C, ch 1, sc in first dc, [ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next dc] 15 (20) times, sc in last dc, turn.
Row 5: With D, ch 1, sc in first sc, ch 1, skip next sc, [sc in next ch 1-sp, ch 1, skip next sc] 14 (19) times, sc in last ch-1 space and in last sc, turn.
Row 6: With C, repeat Row 5.
Row 7: With D, repeat Row 5.
Row 8: With C, repeat Row 5.
Row 9: With A, ch 3, dc in each sc and ch-1 space across, turn – 32 (42) dc.
Row 10: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
Row 11: With E, ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn.
For Small Stocking Only:
Row 12: Ch 3, skip first 2 sc, V-st in next sc, [skip next sc, dc in next sc, skip next sc, V-st in next sc] 6 times, [skip next sc, dc in next sc] twice, ch 1, dc in last sc, turn.
Row 13: Ch 3, dc in first ch-1 space, [skip next dc, V-st in next dc, dc in next ch-1 space] 7 times, dc in each of last 2 dc, turn.
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in each dc and ch-1 space across, turn – 32 sc.
Row 15: With A, ch 3, dc each sc across.
Fasten off.
For Large Stocking Only:
Row 12: Ch 3, dc in second sc, [skip next sc, V-st in next sc, skip next sc, dc in next sc] 10 times, turn.
Row 13: Ch 3, [dc in next ch-1 space, skip next dc, V-st in next dc] 10 times, dc in last dc, turn.
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in each dc and ch-1 space across, turn – 42 sc.
Row 15: With A, ch 3, dc each sc across, turn.
Row 16: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
Row 17: With F, ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn.
Row 18: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 19: With B, ch 1, sc in each of first 3 sc, [bobble in next sc, sc in each of next 4 sc] 7 times, bobble in next sc, sc in each of last 3 sc, turn.
Row 20: With F, ch 1, sc in each sc and bobble across, turn.
Row 21: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 22: With A, ch 3, dc in each sc across, turn.
Row 23: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
Row 24: With D, repeat Row 4.
Row 25: With C, repeat Row 5.
Row 26: With D, repeat Row 5.
Row 27: With C, repeat Row 5.
Row 28: With D, repeat Row 5.
Row 29: With A, ch 3, dc in each sc and ch-1 space across, turn – 32 (42) dc.
Fasten off.
For Both Sizes:
HEEL
With right facing, skip first 24 (32) dc, and join B with slip st in next dc.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in same dc as joining slip st and in each of last 7 (9) dc, bring edge side of stocking around and sc in each of first 8 (11) dc, ch 1, turn – 16 (21) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each of first 11 (14) sc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each of first 6 (7) sc, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, sc in next sc on row 1 of Heel, turn – 7 (8) sc worked.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, sc in next sc on row 2 of Heel, turn – 8 (9) sc worked.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, sc in next sc on row 1 of Heel, ch 1, turn – 9 (10) sc worked.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, sc in next sc on row 2 of Heel – 10 (11) sc worked.
Rows 8-13 (8-17): Continue in established pattern, working 1 more sc on each row until you have worked 16 (21) sc in a row.
Fasten off.
FOOT
With right facing, skip first 8 (10) sc of Heel, and join A with slip st in next sc.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in same st as joining slip st and in each of next 7 (10) sc, skip next 2 dc on last row of Leg, sc in each of next 12 (17) dc, skip next 2 dc, sc in each of next 8 (10) sc of Heel, turn – 28 (38) sc.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 3 and 4: With F, ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn.
Row 5: With B, ch 1, sc in each of first 1 (3) sc, [bobble in next sc, sc in each of next 4 sc] 5 (6) times, bobble in next sc, sc in each of last 1 (4) sc, turn.
Row 6: With F, ch 1, sc in each sc and bobble across, turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 8: With A, ch 3, dc in each sc across, turn.
For Small Stocking Only:
Row 9: Ch 3, dc in each dc across, turn.
For Large Stocking Only:
Row 10: With E, ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn.
Row 11: Ch 3, dc in second sc, [skip next sc, V-st in next sc, skip next sc, dc in next sc] 9 times, turn.
Row 12: Ch 3, dc in first st, [dc in next ch-1 space, skip next dc, V-st in next dc] 9 times, turn.
Row 13: Ch 1, sc in each dc and ch-1 space across, turn.
Row 14: With A, ch 3, dc in each sc across, turn.
For Both Sizes:
TOE – FIRST HALF
Row 1: With B, ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn – 28 (38) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc2tog over first 2 sc, sc in each of next 10 (15) sc, sc2tog over next 2 sc, turn – 12 (17) sts.
Rows 3-7 (3-9): Ch 1, sc2tog over first 2 sc, sc in sc to last 2 sc, sc2tog over last 2 sc, turn – 2 (3) sts.
Fasten off.
TOE – SECOND HALF
Join B with slip st in first unworked sc on Row 1 of Toe, ch 1, sc2tog over first 2 sc, sc in each of next 10 (15) sc, sc2tog over last 2 sc, turn – 12 (17) sts.
Work Rows 3-7 (3-9) same as first half of Toe.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Turn stocking inside out, Sew leg, foot and toe seams, and both corners of heels.
Turn stocking right side out.
TOP EDGING AND HANGING LOOP
With right facing, working in unused loops of foundation ch, join B with slip st in first ch.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each st around, ch 12, slip st in first sc of round, ch 1, turn, sc in each of next 12 ch, slip st in last sc of round, slip st in first sc of round.
Fasten off.
Make four 1¼" (3 cm) (1¾" (4.5 cm)) pom poms with A and B held together.
Ch 25 (35) with A, and fasten off.
Ch 40 (50) with B, and fasten off.
Tie one pom pom to each end of each ch.
Push one pom pom of each ch through hanging loop and tie so that pom poms hang unevenly.
Weave in all loose ends.

materials: Bernat® Happy Holidays (100 g/3.5 oz; 219 m/240 yds)
Size 3.5 mm (U.S. E or 4) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of black yarn for eyes.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
Head: With MC, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc. 
4th and 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc. 
8th to 16th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Shape top: 1st rnd: Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc. 
2nd and 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc. Stuff Head. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sc. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. Fasten off. 8 sc.
Hat: With MC, ch 40. Join with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each ch around. Join A. Break MC. Working in back loops only for remainder of Hat, proceed as follows:
2nd and 3rd rnds: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 35 sc. 
5th and 6th rnds: As 2nd rnd.  
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc. 
8th and 9th rnds: As 2nd rnd. 
10th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 25 sc.
11th and 12th rnds: As 2nd rnd.
Cont dec 5 sts on next rnd and every following 3rd rnd until 5 sts rem. 
Fasten off. Draw yarn through rem sts tightly and fasten securely. 
Pom-pom: Wrap MC around 2 fingers 20 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to a smooth round shape. Attach pom-pom to end of Hat as shown in picture.
Beard: With MC, ch 20.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 19 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 
Rep last row until 3 sts rem.
Next row: Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of next 3 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc3tog made. 
Fasten off.
Sew Beard and Hat to Head as shown in picture. With black yarn, embroider eyes. With A, embroider mouth and nose. Make ribbon loop and attach to top as shown in picture.

materials: Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Assorted beads for A or C only: silver, red, white ¼ inch [6 mm] in diameter.
gauge: 14 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Garland A: (Little stars). 
1st row: *Ch 11. Sl st in 4th ch from hook. (Ch 4. Sl st in same sp as last sl st) 4
times. Rep from * to required length. Ch 6. Fasten off. Glue bead in center of each
Star. 
Garland B: (Candy canes). 
1st row: *Ch 14. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 5 ch. 2 sc in each of
next 2 ch (place marker on last worked ch). Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 2 sc
in each of next 2 ch. Ch 1. Sl st in marked ch. Rep from * to required length. Ch
7. Fasten off. 
Garland C: (Flowers). 
1st row: *Ch 15. Sl st in 5th ch from hook. (Ch 1. 1 sc. Ch 2. Sl st in top of sc
– Picot made) 8 times in ch-5 ring. Rep from * to required length. Ch 9. Fasten off.
Glue bead in center of each Flower.

materials: RED HEART® 'Designer Sport™': 1 ball each 3215 Lemon Zest A, 3261 Terra Cotta B, 3570 Iced Violet C, 3620 Celadon D, 3801 Aqua Ice E, 3730 Blush Rose F and 3369 Cocoa G.
Split lock stitch marker, yarn needle, poly-fill stuffing.
abbreviations: dec (decrease) = draw up a loop in next 2 sc, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
gauge: 4 sts = 1”; 5 rnds = 1” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CHICK (Make 4) 
Head-Rnd 1: With A, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: [Inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Rnd 3: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 4: [Sc in next 3 sc, inc] 3 times – 15 sc.
Rnd 5: [Sc in next 4 sc, inc] 3 times – 18 sc.
Rnds 6 and 7: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 8: [Sc in next sc, dec] 6 times – 12 sc.
Neck-Rnd 9: [Dec] 6 times – 6 sc.
Rnd 10: Working in front loops only on this rnd, inc in each st around – 12 sc.
Body-Rnds 11 and 12: Repeat Rnds 4 and 5 – 18 sc.
Rnd 13: [Sc in next 5 sc, inc] 3 times – 21 sc.
Rnds 14-16: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 17: [Sc in next 6 sc, inc] 3 times – 24 sc.
Rnds 18 and 19: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off. Stuff head section only and sew the opening inside the neck closed.
Wing (Make 8)
Rnd 1: With A ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] twice – 8 sc.
Rnds 3-5: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off. Do not stuff. Hold flat and sew in place as pictured.
Foot (Make 8)
Row 1: With B ch 5; slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in last ch; turn.
Row 2: Ch 2, dc in dc, hdc in hdc, sc in sc, slip st in slip st. Fasten off. Sew in place as pictured.
Tail (Make 4)
With A [ch 9, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 7 ch] 3 times; join to first slip st with a slip st. Fasten off. Sew in place at lower edge of back.
Beak (Make 4)
Rnd 1: With B ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off. Sew in place as pictured. Embroider French knot eyes above beak with G.
Baby Bonnet (Make 1) 
Row 1: With C ch 10; sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 7 ch, 3 sc in last ch, working on opposite side of ch, sc in next 8 ch; turn – 19 sc.
Rows 2-6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Brim-Row 7: Working in back loops only, slip st in next sc, [3 sc in next sc, slip st in next sc] 9 times. Fasten off. Sew in place.
Father’s Hat (Make 1)
Rnd 1: With G ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: [Inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, inc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Rnd 4: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc around.
Rnd 5: Working in both loops, sc in each sc around.
Rnd 6: Working in front loops only, inc in each st around – 36 sc. Fasten off. Sew in place.
Mother’s Beret (Make 1)
Rnds 1-3: With D repeat Rnds 1-3 of Father’s Hat.
Rnd 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, inc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Rnd 6: Working in back loops for this rnd only, [sc in next sc, dec] 10 times – 20 sc.
Rnds 7 and 8: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.
Flower (Make 1)
Rnd 1: With F ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Rnd 2: (Slip st, ch 1, hdc, ch 1) all in each sc around; join with a slip st in first slip st. Fasten off. Sew to side of beret. Sew flower in place. Sew beret in place.
Baseball Cap (Make 1)
Visor-Row 1: With E ch 2; 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, [inc] 5 times; turn – 10 sc.
Hat-Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, ch 14, slip st in first sc of Row 3; turn.
Rnd 4: Skip slip st, sc in each ch and in each sc around – 21 sc. Now work in continuous rnds without joining.
Rnd 5: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 6: [Sc in next 5 sc, dec] 3 times – 18 sc.
Rnd 7: [Sc in next 4 sc, dec] 3 times – 15 sc.
Rnd 8: [Sc in next 3 sc, dec] 3 times – 12 sc.
Rnd 9: [Dec] 6 times – 6 sc. Fasten off leaving a long yarn tail. Weave yarn tail through remaining sts; draw up firmly. Sew cap in place.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream™ (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m) Beach Glass (01132) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only of next stitch
measurements: Face Scrubbies: Approx 2¾" [7 cm] diameter. Scrubbie Bag: Approx 4" [10 cm] high.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Face Scrubbies (make 8).
**Ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc 
around. Join with sl st to first 
sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc 
in next sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in 
next sc. Rep from * around. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 
2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. *1 sc in each 
of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep 
from * around. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 32 sc.**
Fasten off.
Scrubbie Bag
Work from ** to ** as given for Face 
Scrubbies. Do not fasten off. Cont 
as follows for Scrubbie Bag:
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 
3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. *1 sc in each of 
next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from 
* around. Join with sl st to first 
sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc 
around. Join with sl st to first sc.
7th rnd: Ch 4 (counts as 1 dc. Ch 1). 
Skip next sc. (1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. 
Skip next sc) 19 times. Join with sl st 
to 3rd ch of first ch-4.
8th rnd:  Ch 1. *2 sc in next ch-1 
sp. Rep from * around. Join with 
sl st to first ch-1. 40 sc.
9th to 16th rnds:  Rep 7th and 
8th rnds 4 times more.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Twisted Cord Drawstring: Cut 1 
length of yarn 36" [91.5 cm] long. 
Hold one end and with someone 
holding other end, twist strand 
to the right until it begins to curl. 
Fold the 2 ends tog and tie in a 
knot so it will not unravel. The 
strands will now twist themselves 
tog. Weave Twisted Cord through 
ch-1 sps in last 7th rnd rep.

pattern_name: FRID GE PAD LO CK AND  CH AIN (TO  CRO CH ET)
materials: Bernat ® Super Value (197 g/7 oz; 389 m /426 yds)
Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
measurements: Lock approx 4½ x 7 ins [11.5 x 18 cm]
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]
instructions:
Lock 
With A, ch 9.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 6 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 6 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 3 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 26 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 34 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 50 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 58 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Cont to work in back loops only, rep last rnd until work from 7th rnd measures 3 ins [7.5 cm].
Shape top: 1st rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 3 sts. Yoh and draw through all 4 loops on hook - sc3tog made (corner). 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 50 sts. Place marker.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 34 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 26 sts.
Stuff Lock.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sts.
Fasten off.
Sew opening closed.
Lock edging: Corners: Join A with sl st to rem front loop of any corner st of marked rnd. Working from top to bottom, sl st in rem front loop of each corner st of 7th rnd. Fasten off. Rep for rem 3 sides.
Top edging: (RS). Join A with sl st to any rem front loop of marked row. Sl st in rem front loop of each sc around. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.
Bottom edging: (RS). Join A with sl st to any rem front loop of 7th rnd. Sl st in rem front loop of each sc around. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.
Lock Shaft 
With B, ch 6. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring, being careful not to twist.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 7 ins [18 cm]. Fasten off.
Sew Lock Shaft to top of Lock as seen in picture.
Chain (make 2).
First Link: With C, ch 24. Thread chain through middle of Lock Shaft and join with sl st to form ring being careful not to twist.
Next rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each ch around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.
Second and following Links: Ch 24. Thread chain through middle of previous link and join with sl st to form ring being careful not to twist.
Next rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each ch around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.
Cont to create links as established until Chain measures approx 18 ins [45.5 cm].

pattern_name: Striped Placemats, Coasters and Napkin Rings
materials: Main color (MC) (Blue) 2 (4) balls for place mats
Contrast A (Green)  2 (3) balls for place mats
Contrast B (Orange) 2 (3) balls for place mats
Contrast C (Pink) 2 (3) balls for place mats
Main color (MC) (Blue) 1 (2) ball(s) for napkin rings and coasters
Contrast A (Green) 1 (1) ball for napkin rings and coasters
Contrast B (Orange) 1 (1) ball for napkin rings and coasters
Contrast C (Pink) 1 (1) ball for napkin rings and coasters
Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: PLACE MAT: Approx 12 x 18 ins [30.5 x 45.5 cm]. COASTER: Approx 5 ins [12.5 cm] diameter.
gauge: 14 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: When changing colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of last st, then draw new color through rem 2 loops and proceed. 
Place Mat
With MC, ch 43. 
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each ch across. 41 sts. Join A. Turn.
2nd row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. Join MC. Turn.
3rd row: With MC, ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each sc across. Join A. Turn.
4th row: As 2nd row. Join B. Turn.
5th row: With B, as 3rd row. Join C. Turn.
6th row: With C, as 2nd row. Join B. Turn.
7th row: As 5th row.
8th row: With C, as 2nd row. Join A. Turn.
9th row: With A, as 3rd row. Join MC. Turn.
10th row: With MC, as 2nd row. Join A. Turn.
11th row: As 9th row.
12th row: With MC, as 2nd row. Join C. Turn.
13th row: With C, as 3rd row. Join B. Turn.
14th row: With B, as 2nd row. Join C. Turn.
15th row: As 13th row.
16th row: With B, as 2nd row. Join MC. Turn.
17th row: With MC, as 3rd row. Join A. Turn.
Rep 2nd to 17th rows for Stripe Pat until work from beg measures approx 18 ins [45.5 cm] ending on a 4th or 8th row of pat. Fasten off.
Edging: 1st rnd: With RS facing, join MC with sl st to any corner of Mat and work 1 row of sc evenly around outer edge, working 3 sc in corners. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
NAPKIN RING
With A, ch 21.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. 20 sts. Join MC. Turn.
2nd row: With MC, ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each sc across. Join A. Turn.
3rd row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. Join MC. Turn.
4th row: As 2nd row.
5th row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. 
Fasten off. 
Sew sides tog to form ring.
COASTER
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc. Fasten off.
FLOWER
First Petal: 1st row: Join MC with sl st to front loop only of any sc. *Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in front loop only of next sc. 4 sc for petal. Turn.
Next 3 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc of petal. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. [Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops – sc2tog made] twice. Fasten off, leaving a long end.*
Second Petal: **Rejoin MC with sl st to front loop of next unworked sc of 2nd rnd. Rep from * to * once.**
Third to Sixth Petals: Rep from ** to ** 4 times more.
6 petals.
3rd rnd: Join A with sl st to rem back loop of any sc of 2nd rnd. Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 2 dc in each rem back loop around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 24 dc.
4th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last dc. 1 dc in last dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 36 dc.
5th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. *2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 4 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in last dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 50 dc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Using yarn ends from each petal, sew around outer edges of petals.

materials: Patons® Canadiana™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 205 yds/187 m)
Size U.S. 7 (4.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dc2(3-4-5)tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 2 (3-4-5) times. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
MB = (Make Bobble). Work 5 dc in next stitch. Drop loop from hook. Re-insert hook into first of 5 dc and draw dropped loop through
measurements: Approx 16" [40.5 cm] long from cuff to heel.
gauge: 14 dc and 6 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: When joining colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed.
Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
With MC, ch 40 loosely. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each st around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 6 dc, joining A at end of last dc. *With A, MB. With MC, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). 1 dc in each of next 9 dc, joining A at end of last dc. Rep from * to last 3 dc. With A, MB in next dc. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
4th and 5th rnds: As 2nd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc, joining B at end. **With B, MB. With MC, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). 1 dc in each of next 9 dc, joining B at end of last dc. Rep from * to last 8 dc. With B, MB. With MC, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). 1 dc in each of last 7 dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
7th and 8th rnds: As 2nd rnd.
Rep 3rd to 8th rnds twice more, then 3rd to 7th rnds once. Break MC.
Shape heel: 1st row: (RS). Join A with sl st to top of ch 3 at beg of last rnd. Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 19 dc. Turn. 20 dc. Leave rem 20 dc unworked for instep.
2nd to 5th rows: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
6th row: Ch 3. Dc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Dc4tog. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Dc2tog. 1 dc in last st. Turn. 15 sts.
7th row: Ch 3. Dc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Dc3tog. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Dc2tog. 1 dc in last st. Turn. 11 dc.
8th row: Ch 3. Dc2tog. 1 dc in next dc. Dc3tog. 1 dc in next dc. Dc2tog. 1 dc in last st. Turn. 7 dc.
9th row: Ch 3. Dc5tog. 1 dc in last st. Fasten off.
Edging: With RS facing, join A with sl st at side of heel at same sp as first ch 3 of heel. Work 38 sc evenly along side edge of heel. Join with sl st in same sp as last dc of heel. Fasten off.
Shape instep: 1st rnd: (RS). Join MC with sl st in next unworked dc from instep. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each of next 19 dc of instep. 1 dc in each of next 38 sc along heel edge. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 58 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 6 dc, joining A at end of last dc. With A, MB. With MC, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). 1 dc in each of next 9 dc. With A, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). With A, MB. With MC, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). With MC, 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Dc3tog. 1 dc in each of next 32 dc. Dc3tog. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 54 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 19 sts. Dc3tog. 1 dc in each of next 28 dc. Dc3tog. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 50 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 19 sts. Dc3tog. 1 dc in each of next 24 dc. Dc3tog. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 46 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc, joining B at end. With B, MB. With MC, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). 1 dc in each of next 9 dc, joining B at end of last dc. With B, MB. With MC, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Dc3tog. 1 dc in each of next 20 dc. Dc3tog. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 42 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 19 sts. Dc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 18 dc. Dc2tog. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 40 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each st around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
8th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 6 dc, joining A at end of last dc. With A, MB. With MC, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). 1 dc in each of next 9 dc, joining A at end of last dc. With A, MB. With MC, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). With MC, 1 dc in each dc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
8th and 9th rnds: Ch 3. 1 dc in each st around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
10th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc, joining B at end. With B, MB. With MC, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). 1 dc in each of next 9 dc, joining B at end of last dc. With B, MB. With MC, ch 1 for color change (does not count as st). 1 dc in each dc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
11th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each st around. Join A with sl st to top of ch 3. Break MC.
12th rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in each dc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
13th rnd: Ch 3. (Dc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc) 6 times. Dc2tog. 1 dc in last dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 33 sts.
14th rnd: Ch 3. (Dc2tog. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc) 7 times. Dc2tog. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 25 sts.
15th rnd: Ch 3. (Dc4tog) 6 times. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 7 sts. Fasten off leaving a long end. Weave end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely for toe end.
Loop: With 2 strands of MC, ch 30. Fasten off. Fold chain in half and sew in position.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: One skein each 336 Warm Brown A, 365 Coffee B, 505 Aruba Sea C, 321 Gold D, 320 Cornmeal E, and 316 Soft White F
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5.5mm [I-9 US] and 3.75mm [F-5 US]
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Cover measures 4½” tall x 4½” diameter (11.5 x 11.5 cm)
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
Tummy
With smaller hook and D, ch 2.
Rounds 1–5: Work same as Rounds 1–5 of cover; change to E at end of Round 5.
Feathers
Round 6: Ch 1, *sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, ch 15, sc in next sc, [ch 15, sc] twice in next sc, ch 15, sc in next sc, ch 15, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * once; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc. Fasten off.
Feet
With right side facing and smaller hook, join D with slip st to 5th sc from last ch-15 space made.
Row 1: [Ch 5, slip st in next sc] 4 times. Fasten off.
Beak
With smaller hook and D, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sc.
Rounds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first st at end of Round 3. Fasten off.
Eyes and Ears (make 2 each)
With smaller hook and F, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st to first sc; change to B—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc; join with slip st in first sc; change to C—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc; change to A—24 sc.
Cover
With larger hook and A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, [sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, [sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc.
Round 9: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), working in back loops only, hdc in each sc around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn.
Round 10–20: Ch 2, working in both loops, hdc in each hdc around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn. Fasten off at end of Round 20.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in next sc, hdc in next sc, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next sc, hdc in next sc, sc in next, slip st in next st. Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
Use photograph as a guide to placement of all pieces. With E, whipstitch tummy to cover. Position eyes over tummy with ears at top and pointing in opposite directions; with A, whipstitch eyes to cover. With D, whipstitch beak to cover centered between eyes and tummy.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Insert toilet tissue roll in cover.
