materials: RED HEART® Super Saver Fair Isle™, Art. E300F available in 5 oz (141 g), 236 yds (215 m); skeins
gauge: 12 sc = 4" [10 cm]; 12 rows = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
ARM WARMER (Make 2)
Bottom Ribbing
Ch 7 (8, 9, 10).
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch across – 6 (7, 8, 9) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each st across – 6 (7, 8, 9) sc.
Rows 3-18 (22, 24, 26): Repeat Row 2. Do not fasten off on last row worked.
Arm
Row 1: Ch 1, turn to work along one long side edge, sc in side of each sc row – 18 (22, 24, 26) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc to last sc, 2 sc in last sc – 20 (24, 26, 28) sc.
Repeat Rows 2-3 until there are 26 (28, 30, 32) sts on last row worked.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 13 (13½, 14, 15)" [33 (34, 35.5, 38) cm] from lower edge of Bottom Ribbing, end with wrong side row. Do not fasten off on last row worked.
Top Ribbing
Note: Top ribbing is joined to top edge of arm every row by working sts of ribbing and then working a slip st in next st of Arm.
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 7 (8, 9, 10), sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch across, slip st in first sc of Arm – 6 (7, 8, 9) sc.
Row 2: Slip st in next sc of Arm, ch 1, turn, skip previous slip st, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across of Ribbing – 6 (7, 8, 9) sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across Ribbing, slip st in next sc of Arm.
Repeat Rows 2-3 across entire top of Arm, end with right side row.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
FINISHING
Sew seam, leaving a 1" [2.5 cm] opening at wrist for thumb, if desired. Weave in ends.

materials: Caron® x Pantone™ (3.5 oz /100 g; 127 yds/116 m) Ocean Surf (01008) 2 braids
Sizes U.S. J/10 (6 mm) and U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only of next stitch.
Splsc = Split single crochet: work sc between ‘legs’ of stitch (splitting stitch) instead of through top loops.
Splsc2tog = Draw up a loop between “legs" of each of next 2 stitches (splitting stitch) instead of through top loops. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: One size to fit average adult.
gauge:
12 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook.
10 splsc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
• Before working with Caron® x Pantone™ multi-shade yarn braid, separate each color link and wind into 5 separate balls.
• Each color link will be referenced by its Pantone # (see ball band)
• Designate each different shade of the 5 separate yarn balls as Contrast A, B, C, D and E as noted in Materials section (or as desired).

MITTENS (make 2 alike)
Cuff: With A and smaller hook, ch 13.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 12 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 7" [18 cm], ending on a WS row. Do not fasten off.
Join Seam: Working in back loops only, sl st last row and rem loops of foundation ch tog. Fasten off. Join B with sl st at seam and proceed as follows:
Note: Do not join at ends of rnds. Cont working in spiral placing marker on first st of rnd for easier counting.
Change to larger hook and beg working in rnds:
1st rnd: With B, ch 1. Work 24 sc evenly around.
2nd rnd:  Skip next ch. 1 splsc in each st around.
3rd to 6th rnds: 1 splsc in each st around.
Shape thumb gusset: 1st rnd:  1 splsc in each of next 11 sts. 2 splsc in each of next 2 sts. 1 splsc in each st to end of rnd. 26 sts.
2nd rnd: 1 splsc in each st around.
3rd rnd:  1 splsc in each of next 12 sts. 2 splsc in each of next 2 sts. 1 splsc in each st to end of rnd. 28 sts.
4th rnd: 1 splsc in each st around.
5th rnd:  1 splsc in each of next 13 sts. 2 splsc in each of next 2 sts. 1 splsc in each st to end of rnd. 30 sts. Join C. Break B.
6th rnd: With C, 1 splsc in each st around.
7th rnd:  1 splsc in each of next 11 sts. Ch 2. Place marker on 2nd ch. Skip next 8 sts. 1 splsc in each st to end of rnd.
8th rnd:  1 splsc in each of next 11 sts. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 splsc in each st to end of rnd. Join D. Break B. Then proceed as follows:
Note: When changing colors in chart, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed in next color. Carry color when not in use loosely across top of row and work sts around it being sure to maintain gauge.
1st to 15th rnds:  Work rows 1 to 15 of Chart, noting each square represents 1 splsc, reading all rnds from right to left, noting 12-st rep will be worked twice. Join C. Break D and E.
16th rnd:  With C, 1 splsc in each st around, then proceed as follows:
Shape top: 1st rnd:  (1 splsc in each of next 2 sts. Splsc2tog)  6 times. 18 sts.
2nd rnd:  (Splsc2tog. 1 splsc in next st) 6 times. 12 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.
Thumb: Join C with sl st at marker. Ch 1. 1 sc in each loop of ch-2 sp. 1 splsc in each of next 8 sts.
Note: Do not join at ends of rnds. Cont working in spiral placing marker on first st of rnd for easier counting.
Next rnd: Skip ch-1. 1 splsc in each st around. 10 sts. Join E. Break C.
Next rnd: With E, 1 splsc in each st around.
Rep last rnd until Thumb from marker measures 2“ [5 cm].
Next rnd:  (Splsc2tog) 5 times. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.
Fold Cuff in half towards RS.

materials: RED HEART® “Soft Yarn”: 1 ball each 4614 Black A and 4600 White B.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 11 sts = 4”; 4 rows = 4” in pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SLEEVE
Leaving an 18” yarn tail with A, ch 42 (48); join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring taking care that ch is not twisted.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in each ch around; join with a slip st in top of ch-3 – 42 (48) sts.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, [ch 3, skip next 3 dc, dc in next 3 dc] 6 (7) times, ch 3; join in top of ch-3.
Rounds 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, and 17: Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch-3 space), skip next 2 dc, 3 dc in next ch-3 space, [ch 3, skip next 3 dc, 3 dc in next ch-3 space] 6 (7) times, ch 3, 2 dc in last ch-3 space; join in 3rd ch of ch-6.
Rounds 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, and 16: Ch 3, 2 dc in ch-3 space, [ch 3, skip next 3 dc, 3 dc in next ch-3 space] 6 (7) times, ch 3; join.
Round 18: Ch 3, 2 dc in next space, [dc in next 3 dc, 3 dc in next space] 6 (7) times, dc in last 3 dc; join.
Round 19: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join.
Straps: Ch 245, slip st in next 22 (25) dc, ch 245, slip st in next dc. Fasten off.
FLOWER MOTIF
With A, ch 6; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 16 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch-3 space), skip first 2 sc, [dc in next sc, ch 3, skip next sc] 7 times; join with a slip st in 3rd ch of ch-6.
Round 3: Ch 1, [(sc, hdc, 5 dc, hdc, sc) all in ch-3 space] 8 times; join in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 4: Join B between 2 sc, ch 1, sc in same place as joining, ch 6, [sc between next 2 sc, ch 6] 7 times; join.
Round 5: Ch 1, [(sc, hdc, 6 dc, hdc, sc) in ch-6 space] 8 times; join.
Round 6: Slip st in next 5 sts, [ch 7, skip next 9 sts, slip st in next st (6th st of petal)] 7 times, ch 7; join in 6th slip st.
Round 7: Ch 3, (dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in same st as joining, 6 dc in ch-7 space, [(2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in next slip st, 6 dc in ch-7 space] 7 times; join in top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Finishing
With 18” yarn tail of A, sew motif across lower edge of sleeve from first ch-2 space across next 20 sts to 3rd ch-2 space. Fasten off.
Join B in next ch-2 space, [slip st in next 10 dc, slip st in next space] 4 times; join with a slip st in first slip st, forming cuff of sleeve. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: 1 skein each 3955 Wildflower A and 385 Royal B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 5.5 mm [US I-9]
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Wrister measures 9" (23 cm) in circumference and 11" (28 cm) long
gauge: 18 sts (including ch sts) = 4" (10 cm); 15 rows = 4" (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size needles/hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
NOTES
1. You may have to tighten or loosen some stitches as you go in order to keep the color pooling intact. Keep a variety of hook sizes on hand to help resize your stitches.
2. Different dye lots of the same colorway may change the number of stitches obtained in any given color. Count the number of stitches YOU get to work through one full sequence, as well as in each color section, and maintain that throughout the pattern.
MOSS STITCH
Ch an even number of sts.
Row 1: Skip 3 ch, sc in next ch, * ch 1, skip 1 foundation ch, sc in next ch; repeat from * to end, turn.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as a stitch now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2 (counts as a stitch now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Repeat Row 3 only for Moss st.
WRISTERS
With A, ch through at least 1 full color sequence, with the last loop on hook being the first loop of a new color just after a color change in the yarn. 
Row 1 (right side): Skip 3 ch (counts as as st), sc in the 4th ch from hook, * ch 1, sc around the foundation ch (instead of going into a ch st); repeat from * until 1 full color sequence has been completed on this row. Count the number of sc made in each individual color in the colorway and note it down. Leave remaining ch sts unworked. Undo one st repeat (sc, ch 1), turn.
Row 2 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Note: As you work this row and all remaining rows, you MUST get the correct number of sc in each color in order to maintain the planned color pooling. Change hook sizes, or actual st used, to get the correct color in place. If you use the same number of sts per color that you counted on Row 1, it will work out.
Row 3 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in the next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Note: The color of the sts on this row will shift to the left or right by 1 st from the previous right side row depending on the colorway and if you are right or left handed. It doesn’t matter which direction the stitch shifts as long as it is off-set by 1.
Row 4 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in the next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Rows 3-34: Repeat Rows 3 and 4 alternately.
Fasten off. 
Make other Wrister the same.
FINISHING
Squish or stretch the sts on foundation chain to match the width of the rest of the piece. You can slide the sts around along the foundation chain, as with an adjustable ring. Unravel unused foundation ch sts and weave in yarn tail to secure foundation.
Sew foundation row to final row.
Edging
Work edging at both openings of wristers as follows:
Join B with a slip st in any space along edge.
Round 1: Ch 2, * sc in next space, ch 1; repeat from * around, join with slip st in beginning ch-2 space.
Rounds 2-7: Ch 2, * sc in next ch-1 space, ch 1; repeat from * around, slip st in beginning ch-2 space.
Fasten off.

materials: Caron® Colorama Halo™ Perfect Phasing™ (8 oz/227 g; 481 yds/440 m) Magenta and Mandarin (76019) 1 ball or 120 yds/110 m
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Hdcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: One size to fit average adult’s palm.
gauge: 12 sc and 13 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as hdc.
• Yarn has gradual changing color from Color A to Color B. Determine for yourself what shade will de A and B.

Left Mitten
Cuff: Beg with darkest section of Color A, ch 20 loosely. Join with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 20 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdcfp around first st. *1 hdcbp around next st. 1 hdcfp around next st. Rep from * to last st. 1 hdcbp around last st. Join with sl st to first hdcfp.
Rep 2nd rnd for 2" [5 cm].
Next 6 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.

Shape thumb gusset: Next rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 21 sc. Rep last rnd 8 times more. 29 sc. Next rnd: Ch 1. Skip first 9 sc. 1 sc in each rem sc around. Join with sl st to ch-1 sp. 20 sc. PM on last sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until work from marker measures 4" [10 cm]. Fasten off.

Shape top: Join Darkest section of Color B with sl st to first sc.
1st rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 4 sts. Fasten off , leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and secure.

Thumb: With RS facing, join Darkest section of Color B with sl st at top of thumb gusset. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 9 more sc evenly spaced around opening. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd until Thumb measures 2" [5 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 5 sts. Fasten off , leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and secure.

Right Mitten: Work as for Left Mitten, substituting Color B for Color A and Color A for Color B.

materials: Caron® One Pound™ (16 oz/453.6 g; 812 yds/742 m)
Note: 1 ball will make approx 8 (6-4) Pairs of Mittens
Size U.S. 7 (4.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
gauge: 13 hdc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions: The instructions are written for smaller size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written thus ( ). When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes. Mittens (make 2 alike) **Cuff: With MC, ch 10 (12-14). 1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 9 (11-13) sts. 2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 4½ (5-7)" [11.5 (12.5-18) cm], ending on a WS row. Do not fasten off. Join seam: Working in back loops only, sl st last row and rem loops of foundation ch tog. Do not fasten off. Turn work and proceed as follows:** Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc. **Beg working in rnds: 1st rnd: Ch 1. Work 18 (22-28) sc evenly around. Join with sl st to first sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Rep 2nd rnd 1 (1-2) time(s) more, then proceed as follows:** Shape thumb gusset: 1st rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 8 (10-13) hdc. 2 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc. 20 (24-30) hdc. 2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 8 (10-13) hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc. 22 (26-32) hdc. 3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 8 (10-13) hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc. 24 (28-34) hdc. Size Adult only: 4th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 13 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc. 36 hdc. All Sizes: Next rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 9 (11-14) hdc. Ch 2. Place marker on 2nd ch. Skip next 6 (6-8) hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc. Next rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 9 (11-14) hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc. 20 (24-30) hdc. Next rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Rep last rnd until work after Cuff measures 3½ (4½-6)" [9 (11.5-15) cm]. Shape top: 1st rnd: Ch 2. [1 hdc in each of next 3 (4-3) hdc. Hdc2tog] 4 (4-6) times. Join with sl st to first hdc. 16 (20-24) sts. 2nd rnd: Ch 2. [1 hdc in each of next 2 (3-2) hdc. Hdc2tog] 4 (4-6) times. Join with sl st to first hdc. 12 (16-18) sts. Sizes 8/10 yrs and Adult only: 3rd rnd: Ch 2. [1 hdc in each of next (2-1) hdc. Hdc2tog] (4-6) times. Join with sl st to first hdc. 12 sts. All Sizes: Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely. Thumb: Join yarn with sl st at marker. Ch 2. 1 hdc in each rem loop of ch-2 sp. 1 hdc in each of next 6 (6-8) hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 8 (8-10) hdc. Next rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Rep last rnd until Thumb from marker measures 1½ (1½-1¾)" [4 (4-4.5) cm]. Next rnd: Ch 2. (Hdc2tog) 4 (4-5) times. Join with sl st to first st. 4 (4-5) sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.

materials: Patons® Classic Wool DK superwash™ (50 g/1.75 oz; 114 m/125 yds)
Version A Main Color (MC) Deep Olive (12205) 1 ball
Version B Main Color (MC) Dark Grey Heather (12042) 1 ball
Size 3.5 mm (U.S. E or 4) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
measurements: One size to fit average woman.
gauge: 19 sc and 22 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
notes: 
•   When working ribbing, sl st loosely, do not ch at beg of rows and carry 
colors not in use along side of work.
•   When joining colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw 
new color through last 2 loops then proceed.
•   Carry color when not in use loosely across top of previous rnd and 
work sts around it to avoid stranding.

stripe Pat
With MC, work 2 rows.
With A, work 2 rows.
These 4 rows form Stripe Pat.

ribbing
With MC, ch 16. 
1st row: (RS). Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sl st 
in each ch across. Turn. 15 sts.
2nd row: Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each of next 15 sl st. Join A. 
Turn. 
Following Stripe Pat, rep 2nd row until work from beg measures approx 
6" [15 cm] ending with 2 rows of A. Fasten off.
Sew 1st row and last row tog to form cuff.
Working along side edge of ribbing, join MC with sl st to any row end.

Mitt: Beg working in rnds: 1st rnd: Ch 1. Working along side edge of 
ribbing, work 30 sc evenly around. Join with sl st to first sc. 

2nd to 4th rnds: Ch 1. Work Chart I to end of chart, noting 5-st rep will 
be worked 6 times. Join with sl st to first sc at end of each rnd.
5th rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. (2 sc in next sc) twice. 
1 sc in each of next 14 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
6th rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 
1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. (Work 1st row of Chart I) 3 times. With MC, (2 sc in next sc) 
twice. (Work 1st row of Chart I) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 34 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. (Work 2nd row of Chart I) 3 times. With MC, 1 sc in each 
of next 4 sc. (Work 2nd row of Chart I) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. (Work 3rd row of Chart I) 3 times. With MC, 2 sc in next sc. 
1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. (Work 3rd row of Chart I) 3 times. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
10th rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
11th rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc 
in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 38 sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. (Work 1st row of Chart I)  3 times. With MC, 1 sc in each 
of next 8 sc. (Work 1st row of Chart I)  3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 
13th rnd: Ch 1. (Work 2nd row of Chart I) 3 times. With MC, 2 sc in next sc. 
1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. (Work 2nd row of Chart I) 3 times. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
14th rnd: Ch 1. (Work 3rd row of Chart I) 3 times. With MC, 1 sc in each 
of next 10 sc. (Work 3rd row of Chart I) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc.
15th rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc 
in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 42 sc.
16th rnd: As 10th rnd.
17th rnd: Ch 1. (Work 1st row of Chart I) 3 times. With MC, 2 sc in next sc. 
1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 2 sc in next sc. (Work 1st row of Chart I) 3 times. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 44 sc.
18th rnd: Ch 1. (Work 2nd row of Chart I) 3 times. With MC, 1 sc in each 
of next 14 sc. (Work 2nd row of Chart I) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc.
19th rnd: Ch 1. (Work 3rd row of Chart I) 3 times. With MC, ch 5. Miss 
next 14 sc (thumb opening). (Work 3rd row of Chart I) 3 times.
20th rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 ch. 
1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 35 sc.
21st rnd: As 10th rnd.
22nd to 24th rnds: Ch 1. Work Chart I to end of chart, noting 5-st rep 
will be worked 7 times. Join with sl st to first sc at end of each rnd. 
25th rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 
26th and 27th rnds: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st 
to first sc. Fasten off after last rnd.

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Bamboo Crochet Thread, Size 3: 1 (2) Balls 619 Old Gold.
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 24 sc = 4”; 24 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
WRISTER (Make 2)
Ch 36 (44); without twisting ch, join with a slip st to first ch.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, sc in each st around; join; turn – 36 (44) sts.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st, * ch 3, yo, insert hook into same st, pull up loop, yo, draw through 2 loops, yo, skip next 3 sts, pull up loop in next st, yo, draw through 2 loops, yo, draw through all 3 loops – beginning dc2tog made; ch 3, sc in same st; repeat from * around to last 3 sts; ch 3, working into same st as beginning, beginning dc2tog, ch 3; join; turn – 9 (11) beginning dc2tog.
Round 3: Ch 4, dc in top of next beginning dc2tog, ch 3, sc in same st, * ch 3, dc2tog cluster, ch 3, sc in same st; repeat from * around; ch 3, joining cluster; turn.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same st, * ch 3, dc2tog cluster, ch 3, sc in same st; repeat from * through last dc2tog cluster, ch 3, working into same st as beginning, dc2tog cluster, ch 3; join; turn.
Rounds 5-6: Repeat Rounds 3-4.
Begin Thumb Opening-Row 7: Ch 4, dc in top of next dc2tog cluster, ch 3, sc in same st, * ch 3, dc2tog cluster, ch 3, sc in same st; repeat from * around; ch 3, ending cluster; turn. Do not join.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in same st, * ch 3, dc2tog cluster, ch 3, sc in same st; repeat from * through last dc2tog cluster; ch 3, working into beginning dc, dc2tog cluster, ch 3, sc in same st; turn.
Rows 9-12: Repeat Rows 7-8. On last row, slip st into 1st sc to close thumb opening.
Rounds 13-14: Repeat Rounds 3-4.
Wrist Edging-Round 15: Slip st into ch-3 space, ch 3, 4 dc in same space, sc in next space, * 5 dc in next space, sc in next space; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Finger Edging
With Right Side facing, join in any unused loop of original ch, ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), (dc, ch 1, dc) all in same st, skip next 3 sts, * (dc, ch 1, dc, ch 1, dc) all in next st, skip next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join in 3rd ch of beginning ch. Fasten off. 
Weave in all ends and block lightly.

pattern_name: Put a Bow On It Crochet Hair Clip
materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Light Sage (0631) or Delft Blue (0885) or Light Raspberry (0774)
Size U.S. 7 [4.5 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Susan Bates® open ring stitch markers.
Hot glue gun and glue sticks.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 4" [10 cm] wide x 4½" [11.5 cm] tall.
gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4” [10 cm].
instructions:
BOW
Ch 4.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 7 sc. Place marker at end of last row.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from marked row measures 2" [5 cm], ending on a WS row.
Shape front of Bow as follows:
1st row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 5 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.
3rd and 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 7 sc. Place marker at end of last row. 8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 8th row until work from last marked row measures 2" [5 cm], ending on a WS row.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 5 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off.
TIE
Ch 9.
1st row: 1 hdc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 8 hdc. Fasten off.
Wrap Tie around Bow as shown in photo. Join first st to last st of row to secure Tie.
LEFT TAIL
Ch 10.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 2 sc in last chain. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 11 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 12 sc.
4th row: As 2nd row. 13 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to last sc. 3 sc in last sc. Work 3 sc evenly along shaped edge of Tail. Working into rem loops of foundation ch, work 3 sc in first ch. 1 sc in each of next 8 ch. Fasten off.
RIGHT TAIL
Ch 10.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 2 sc in last chain. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 11 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 12 sc.
4th row: (RS). As 2nd row. 13 sc. Fasten off.
With RS facing, join yarn with sl st to first unworked loop of foundation ch.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 ch. Work 3 sc evenly along shaped edge of tail. 3 sc in last st of 4th row. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew Tails to WS of Bow. Hot glue Bow to hair clip.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft™ or Caron® Simply Soft Brights™ (6 oz/170 g; 315 yds/288 m) in Neon Pink (39775) or Iris (39747) or Super Duper Yellow (B9612) or Limelight (B9607) or Blue Mint (B9608) - 1 ball or 68 yds/62 m
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Standard elastic hair ties approx 1½" [4 cm] diameter
Susan Bates® Split-lock stitch count markers
measurements: To cover standard hair tie, approx 1½" [4 cm] diameter.
gauge: 13 single crochet (sc) and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes:
• Scrunchie is worked in a continuous spiral around elastic hair tie.
• To keep track of rounds (rnds), place a stitch marker in the 1st stitch of each rnd.
Chain (ch) 13. Wrap chain around elastic hair tie and then join chain with slip stitch (sl st) to first ch to form ring, being careful to not twist chain.

materials: Patons® Canadiana™ (100 g/3.5 oz; 187 m/205 yds)
Size 5 mm (U.S. H/8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
gauge: 14 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written thus ( ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes.
Note: Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc throughout.
Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc.
Hat is worked from the top down.
HAT
With MC and leaving a long tail, ch 33 (42-48). Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist ch. (See Diagram 1 on page 2).
1st rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. Miss next 2 ch. *(1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in next ch. Miss next 2 ch. Rep from * 9 (12-14) times more. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4. 11 (14-16) V-sts.

Special Stitch
beg-dc (beginning double crochet) = Beginning with empty hook and leaving a long beginning tail to weave n later, [yarn over] twice, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop, [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice. Note: If preferred, a traditional beginning double crochet can be worked as follows: Join yarn with slip st in indicated stitch, ch 3.
Notes
1. To make a smaller hat, use a hook one size smaller. To make a larger hat, use a hook one size larger.
2. Hat is worked in joined rounds, beginning at top of hat. Join but do not turn rounds.

4. To change color, fasten off old color and join new color in indicated stitch as instructed. The new color is joined in different stitches to help hide the joins.

Weave in ends.

Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice - 1 dcfp made
Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Trfp = (Yoh) twice and draw up a loop around post of next st at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times - 1 trfp made
gauge: 15 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
• Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as st.
CROWN
See Diagram 1 on page 3.
Beg at top of Hat, with E, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 2. 10 hdc in ring. Join. Fasten off. 10 hdc.
2nd rnd: Join D with sl st to first st. Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. Fasten off. 20 hdc. 
3rd rnd: Join C with sl st to first st. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as join. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. Fasten off. 30 hdc. 
4th rnd: Join E with sl st to first st. Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc around. Join. Fasten off.
5th rnd: Join A with sl st to first st. Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 2 sc. *2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 hdc in last sc. Join. Fasten off. 40 hdc.  
6th rnd: Join B with sl st to first st. Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 3 hdc. * 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last dc. Join. Fasten off. 50 hdc.  
7th rnd: Join C with sl st to first st. Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc around. Join. Fasten off.
8th rnd: Join E with sl st to first st. Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 4 sc. *2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 hdc in last sc. Join. Fasten off. 60 hdc. 
9th rnd: Join D with sl st to first st. Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 5 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. Fasten off. 70 hdc.
10th rnd: Join A with sl st to first st. Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc around. Join. Fasten off.
11th rnd: Join B with sl st to first st. Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 6 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join. Fasten off. 80 hdc.  
12th rnd: Join C with sl st to first st. Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc around. Join. Fasten off.
13th rnd: Join D with sl st to first st. Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.
14th rnd: Join E with sl st to first st. Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.
15th rnd: Join D with sl st to first st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as join. *1 dcfp around post of next sc 3 rnds below (Color D - rnd). Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 dcfp around post of next sc 3 rnds below (Color D - rnd). Skip last sc. Join. Fasten off.
16th rnd: Join C with sl st to first st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as join. 1 sc in next dcfp. *1 trfp around post of next sc 4 rnds below (Color C - rnd). Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 trfp around post of next sc 4 rnds below (Color C - rnd). Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join. Fasten off.
17th rnd: Join B with sl st to first st. Ch 2. (1 hdc in each of next 25 sts. Hdc2tog) twice. 1 hdc in each st to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Join. Fasten off. 77 sts.
18th rnd: Join A with sl st to first st. Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Fasten off. 77 sc.
MOTIF  
See Diagram 2 on page 3.
With Color 1, ch 3. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join. Fasten off. 
2nd rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to any sc. Beg cluster in same sp as sl st. Ch 2. *Cluster in next sc. Ch 2. Rep from * around. Join. Fasten off. 8 clusters.
3rd rnd: Join Color 3 with sl st to any ch-2 sp. Ch 2  (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 1. (2 hdc. Ch 3. 2 hdc) in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1.** 2 hdc in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join. Fasten off. 
4th rnd: Join A with sl st to 2nd ch of any corner ch-3 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in each st (hdc and ch) around. Join. Fasten off. 44 sc. (11 sc for each side).

materials: TLC® 'Baby': 1 skein each 5737 Powder Pink A and 5011 White C.
RED HEART® 'Buttercup™': 1 skein 4276 Light Blue Multi B.
abbreviations: Bpdc (Back post double crochet) = Yo, insert hook from the back side of the work to front and to back again around the post of the indicated stitch on a previous row; yo and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), yo and draw through two loops (2 loops on hook), yo and draw through two loops (1 loop on hook)

Fpdc (Front post double crochet) = Yo, insert hook from the front side of the work to back and to front again around the post of the indicated stitch on a previous row; yo and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), yo and draw through two loops (2 loops on hook), yo and draw through two loops (1 loop on hook)
sc2tog =  [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
gauge: With 2 strands of A, 14 sts = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Band
With 2 strands of A held together as one, ch 48 (56), and without twisting ch, join into a ring with slip st in first ch. Round 1 (right side): Ch 3 (count as dc here and throughout), dc in each ch around, join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 48 (56) dc. Rounds 2-4: Ch 3, Fpdc around the post of next st, *Bpdc around the post of next 2 sts**, Fpdc around the post of next 2 sts; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with slip st around the post of beginning ch-3.
Ruffle
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in tfl ONLY of each dc around, join with slip st in first sc. Round 6: Ch 1, sc in first st, *skip next sc, 5 dc in next sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, omitting last sc, join with sl st in first sc – 12 (14) shells. Fasten off.
Crown
Round 1: With right side facing, join one strand of B in remaining back loop of any st in round 4 of band, ch 1, working tbl ONLY, sc in each dc around, join with slip st in first sc. Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each of first 6 sc, *sc2tog in next 2 sts**, sc in each of next 6 sc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with slip st in first sc – 42 (49) sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each of first 5 sc, *sc2tog in next 2 sts**, sc in each of next 5 sc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with slip st in first sc – 36 (42) sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in each of first 4 sc, *sc2tog in next 2 sts**, sc in each of next 4 sc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with slip st in first sc – 30 (35) sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in each of first 3 sc, *sc2tog in next 2 sts**, sc in each of next 3 sc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with slip st in first sc – 24 (28) sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in each of first 2 sc, *sc2tog in next 2 sts**, sc in each of next 2 sc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with slip st in first sc – 18 (21) sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, *sc2tog in next 2 sts; repeat from * around, sc in last 0 (1) st, join with slip st in first sc – 9 (11) sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, *sc2tog in next 2 sts; repeat from * around, sc in last st, join with slip st in first sc – 5 (6) sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, *sc2tog in next 2 sts; repeat from * around, sc in last 1 (0) st, join with slip st in first sc – 3 (3) sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. With C, make a pompom and attach it to the top of the hat.

materials: Patons® Classic Wool DK Superwash™ (1.75 oz/50 g; 125 yds/114 m) Claret (12532) or Mallard Teal (12203) or Gold (12609) 2 balls
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
gauge: 19 sts and 22 rnds = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Beg at top of crown, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sts.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
4th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch1.1sc)innextch-1sp.Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sts.
5th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sts.
6th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 3 times. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 60 sts.
7th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 4 times. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 72 sts.
8th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
9th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 5 times. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 84 sts.
10th rnd: As 8th rnd.
11th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 6 times. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 96 sts.
12th rnd: As 8th rnd.
13th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 15 times. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 102 sts.
14th rnd: As 8th rnd.
Rep last rnd for pat until work from beg measures 7" [18 cm].
Next rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 4 times. *Ch 1. Skip next 3sts:(sc,ch-1spandsc).1scin next ch-1 sp. (Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 4 times. Rep from * to last 9 sts. Ch 1. Skip next 3 sts: (sc, ch-1 sp and sc). (1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 86 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Ribbing
1st rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). Dcfp around first sc. *Dcbp around next sc. Dcfp around next sc. Rep from * to last sc. Dcbp around next sc. Join with sl st to top of ch 2.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). Dcfp around first dcfp. *Dcbp around next dcbp. Dcfp around next dcfp. Rep from * to last st. Dcbp around last dcbp. Join with sl st to top of ch 2.
Rep last rnd until Ribbing measures approx 2" [5 cm]. Fasten off.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® (6 oz/170.1 g; 315 yds/288 m)
Sizes U.S. 7 (4.5 mm) and U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: One size to fit average Adult.
gauge: 13 hdc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Stripe Pat
With A: 1 rnd.
With B: 1 rnd.
With A: 1 rnd.
With C: 1 rnd.
With D: 1 rnd.
With C: 1 rnd.
With A: 1 rnd.
With B: 1 rnd.
With A: 1 rnd.
These 9 rnds form Stripe Pat.
Notes: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st throughout.
Do not break yarn when changing colors. Carry color not in use up loosely up back of work.
To change color, work to last loops on hook of first color, yoh with new color and proceed. Carry color not in use loosely up WS of work.
Ribbing: With A and smaller hook, ch 8
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 7 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 19½" [49.5 cm], when slightly stretched. Do not fasten off.
Join last row and first row tog with 1 row of sc to form tube.
Beg working in rnds: 
Foundation rnd: Ch 2. Working along side edge of ribbing, work 84 hdc evenly around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
Change to larger hook.
Beg Stripe Pat and proceed as follows:
1st rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in next hdc. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 3 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Skip next hdc. Rep from * around. Join B with sl st to first hdc.
2nd rnd: With B, ch 2. Working in back loops only, *1 hdc in next hdc. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 3 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Skip next hdc. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first hdc.
Rep last rnd for Zig Zag pat and cont in Stripe Pat until work from beg measures approx 7½" [19 cm].
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, proceed as follows:
Shape crown: 1st rnd: Ch 2. Working in back loops only, *1 hdc in next hdc. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. Skip next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 70 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. Working in back loops only, *1 hdc in next hdc. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. Skip next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 56 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. Working in back loops only, *1 hdc in next hdc. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Skip next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 42 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 2. Working in back loops only, *1 hdc in next hdc. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Skip next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 28 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 2. Working in back loops only, *Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 14 sts. Break yarn, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.

materials: Red Heart® All in One™ Granny Square™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 417 yds/381 m)
Pink Punch (2001) - Size S: 1 (165 yds/151 m), Size M: 1 (196 yds/179 m), Size L: 1 (242 yds/221 m)
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
measurements: Sizes S M L - Finished Hat Circumference: 18" [45.58 cm] - 20" [51 cm] - 22" [56 cm]
gauge: 14 half double crochet (hdc) and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions: Note: Yarn is worked as ‘self-striping’ yarn, allowing colors to change as they appear. Brim: Ch 10. 1st row: (RS). 1 single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 9 sc. 2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row 63 (69 - 77) times more. Joining row: Ch 1. With first and last rows together, working through both thicknesses, slip stitch (sl st) in each st to end of row. Do not turn. 1st rnd: Working across long side of Brim, ch 1. Work 64 (70 - 78) sc evenly around. Join. 2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 half double crochet (hdc) in each sc around. Join. 3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first hdc. *Skip next hdc. 2 sc in next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. Skip last hdc. Join. 64 (70 - 78) sc. Rep last 2 rnds 7 (8 - 9) times more. [16 (18 - 20) rnds total]. Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. Skip last sc. Join. 32 (35 - 39) sc. Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 1 (2 - 2) sc. Skip last 1 (2 - 2) sc. Join. 16 (17 - 19) sc. Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 1 (2 - 2) sc. Skip last 1 (2 - 2) sc. Join. 8 (8 - 9) sc. Fasten off, leaving long end. Weave end through remaining stitches. Pull tightly. Fasten securely. PomPom: Wind yarn around 4 fingers 100 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Hat. Notes: Ch 2 at beginning of rnd does not count as a st. Join all rnds with sl st to first st.

materials: RED HEART® “Soft Yarn”: 1 ball each 9925 Really Red A; and 4601 Off White B.
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Hat Circumference: 18”. Instructions are for size 2 years.
gauge: 14 sts = 4”; 15 rows = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Round 1: With A, ch 2; 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [inc] 3 times; join – 6 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, inc] 3 times; join – 9 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, inc] 3 times; join – 12 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, inc] 3 times; join – 15 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, inc] 3 times; join – 18 sc.
Rounds 7-21: Continue in this manner, increasing 3 sc every round and working one more sc between increases until there are 63 sc.
Rounds 22-40: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join. Change to B in last sc of last round. Cut A.
With B, work 5 rounds even in sc. Fasten off.

Ball Adornment
Round 1: With B, ch 2; 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [inc] 3 times; join – 6 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [inc] 6 times; join – 12 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Round 5: Ch 1, [dec] 6 times; join – 6 sc. Stuff ball with extra B yarn to make it puffy.
Round 6: Ch 1, [dec] 3 times; join – 3 sc. Fasten off.
Attach Ball Adornment to tip of hat. Weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart ™ Heat Wave™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 198 yds/181 m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from left to right. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.

Dcfp2(3)tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 2(3) times. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first dc or dcfp.
Ch 72 loosely. Join with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist chain.
1st rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as st here and throughout). 1 dc in each ch around. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp around each of first 2 dc. *Dcbp around next dc. Dcfp around each of next 2 dc. Rep from * to last dc. Dcbp around last dc. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp around each of first 2 dcfp. *Dcbp around next dcbp. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. Rep from * to last dcbp. Dcbp around last dcbp. Join. Rep last rnd twice more.
Next rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp around each of first 2 dcfp. 1 hdc in next dcbp. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. *1 hdc in next dcbp. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. 2 dcfp around next dcbp. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. (1 hdc in next dcbp. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp) twice. Rep from * to last 7 sts. 1 hdc in next dcbp. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. 2 dcfp around next dcbp. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. 1 hdc in last dcbp. Join. 78 sts.
Proceed in Cable Twist Pat as follows:
1st rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp around each of first 2 dcfp. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. *1 hdc in next hdc. Skip next 3 dcfp. Dcfp around each of next 3 dcfp. Working behind last 3 dcfp worked, dcfp around each of 3 skipped sts - Cr6F made. (1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp) twice. Rep from * to last 8 sts. 1 hdc in next hdc. Cr6F over next 6 dcfp. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join.
2nd to 5th rnds: Ch 2. Dcfp around each of first 2 dcfp. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. *1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 6 dcfp. (1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp) twice. Rep from * to last 8 sts. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 6 dcfp. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join.
Rep 1st to 5th rnds for Cable Twist Pat until Hat measures approx 5" [12.5 cm], ending on a 4th rnd of pat.
Shape top: 1st rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp around each of first 2 dcfp. Skip next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. *1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 6 dcfp. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. Skip next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. Rep from * to last 8 sts. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 6 dcfp. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join. 72 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp around each of first 4 dcfp. *1 hdc in next hdc. Cr6F over next 6 dcfp. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 4 dcfp. Rep from * to last 8 sts. 1 hdc in next hdc. Cr6F over next 6 dcfp. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp around first dcfp. Dcfp2tog. Dcfp around next dcfp. *1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 6 dcfp. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around next dcfp. Dcfp2tog. Dcfp around next dcfp. Rep from * to last 8 sts. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 6 dcfp. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join. 66 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp3tog. *1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 6 dcfp. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp3tog. Rep from * to last 8 sts. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around each of next 6 dcfp. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join. 54 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp around first dcfp. *1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around next dcfp. (Dcfp2tog) twice. Dcfp around next dcfp. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around next dcfp. Rep from * to last 8 sts. 1 hdc in next hdc. Dcfp around next dcfp. (Dcfp2tog) twice. Dcfp around next dcfp. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join. 42 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp around first dcfp. *Skip next hdc. Dcfp around next dcfp. Dcfp2tog. Dcfp around next dcfp. Skip next hdc. Dcfp around next dcfp. Rep from * to last 6 sts. Skip next hdc. Dcfp around next dcfp. Dcfp2tog. Dcfp around next dcfp. Skip last hdc. Join. 24 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp around first dcfp. *Dcfp3tog. Dcfp around next dcfp. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Dcfp3tog. Join. 12 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 2. Dcfp around first dcfp. *Dcfp around next dcfp. Rep from * around. Join. Break yarn leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts.
FINISHING Pompom: Wind yarn around 4 fingers approx 120 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to a smooth round shape. Sew to top of Hat.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 Skein 235 Lemon A.
RED HEART® “Kids”: 1 Skein 2945 Bikini Multi B.
Crochet Hooks: 5.5mm [US I-9], 5mm [US H-8] and 6.5mm [US10.5-K] hook.
Pink round beads, matching thread and needle, stitch marker, yarn needle.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: 12 dc = 4” using 5.5mm [I-9] hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
With A and 5.5mm [I-9] hook, ch 54, slip st in first ch to form ring. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 1: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), hdc in each ch around, slip st in beginning ch to join – 54 hdc.
Rounds 2-3: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc around, slip st in beginning ch.
Round 4: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in each hdc around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Rounds 5-6: Ch 3, dc in each dc around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 7: Ch 2, hdc in each dc around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 8: Ch 2, hdc in next 4 hdc, [skip next hdc, hdc in next 5 hdc] to last st, skip last st, slip st in top of beginning ch – 45 hdc. 
Round 9: Ch 3, dc in each hdc around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Rounds 10-11: Ch 3, dc in each dc around, slip st in beginning ch.
Round 12: Ch 2, hdc in next 3 dc, [skip next dc, hdc in next 4 dc] around to last st, slip last st, slip st in top of beginning ch – 36 sts. 
Round 13: Ch 2, hdc in next 2 hdc, [skip next hdc, hdc in next 3 hdc] around to last st, skip last st, slip st in top of beginning ch – 27 sts. 
Round 14: Ch 2, hdc in next hdc, [skip next hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc] around to last st, slip last st, slip st in top of beginning ch – 18 sts. 
Round 15: Ch 2, skip next hdc, [hdc in next hdc, skip next hdc] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 9 sts.
Round 16: Ch 1, [sc in next hdc, skip next hdc] around, slip st in first st – 4 sts. 
Round 17: [Slip st in next sc, skip next sc] around, slip st to first st – 2 sts.
Fasten off.

Right Ear Flap 
Mark center of front of Hat. 
Row 1: With wrong side facing and 5.5mm [I-9] hook, join A in st 3” to left of marked center front, ch 3, dc in next 9 sts. 
Row 2-6: Ch 3, turn, dc in next 9 dc.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, skip first dc, hdc in next 6 dc, skip next st, slip st in last dc. 
Fasten off.

Left Ear Flap 
Row 1: With right side facing and 5.5mm [I-9] hook, join A in st 3” to left of marked center front, ch 3, dc in next 9 sts. 
Row 2-6: Ch 3, turn, dc in next 9 dc.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, skip first dc, hdc in next 6 dc, skip next st, slip st in last dc. 
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Edging and Ties
Row 1: With right side facing and 5.5mm [I-9] hook, join B in any st along edge in back of Hat, ch 2, hdc in each st around, working 3 hdc in each skipped st on Row 7 of Ear Flaps, to center of Ear Flap, ch 60 for Tie, slip st in same space along edge of Hat, hdc in each st along edge of Hat to center of opposite Ear Flap, ch 60 for Tie, slip st in same st along edge of Hat, hdc in each st around to first st, slip st in top of beginning ch. 

Whipper Braids (Make 9)
With 1 strand of A and B held together and 6.5mm [K-10.5] hook, join yarn in any st at Row 15 at top of Hat, ch 50. 
Fasten off. 
Make 8 more Whipper Braids in each st around Row 15.

SWIRLY FLOWER (Make 2)
Petals (Make 6 with A and 6 with B for each Flower)
With 5mm [H-8] hook, ch 4, slip st in first ch to form a loop.
Round 1: Ch 2, work 7 hdc in ring, slip st in top of beginning ch 2, to join.
Round 2: Ch 1 (counts as sc), sc in same st, [2 sc in each hdc] around, slip st in beginning ch – 16 sc. 
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Swirly Flower
Arrange Petals counterclockwise in a spiral flower, alternating colors. Sew together in center with A. 
Sew Flower to center of Right Earflap.
Sew 6 to 10 pink beads in center of Flower.
Weave in ends.

brim Top

Round 21: [Sc in next sc, dec] 4 (6, 6) times – 8 (12, 12) sc.

Round 7: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in 25th dc of previous round, ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—56 sc. Fasten off A.
Round 8: With right side facing, join B with beg-dc in 29th sc of previous round, dc in each st around; join with slip st in beg-dc. Fasten off B.
Round 9: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in 29th dc of previous round, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off A.
Rounds 10 and 11: Repeat Rounds 8 and 9.
Round 12: Repeat Round 8.
Round 13: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A with beg-dc in same st as joining, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 14: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, *ch 1, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around to last st, ch 1, skip next st; join with slip st in first sc—28 ch-1 spaces and 28 sc.
Round 15: Ch 1, skipping the sc sts, work 2 sc in each ch-1 space around; join with slip st in first sc—56 sc. Fasten off A.

Special Stitch
beg-dc (beginning double crochet) = Beginning with empty hook and leaving a long beginning tail to weave in later, [yarn over] twice, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop, [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice. Note: If preferred, a traditional beginning double crochet can be worked as follows: Join yarn with slip st in indicated stitch, ch 3.

Notes
1. To make a smaller hat, use a hook one size smaller. To make a larger hat, use a hook one size larger.
2. Hat is worked in joined rounds, beginning at top of hat. Join but do not turn rounds.
3. Hat stripes are worked in the following color sequence: 3 rounds with A, 1 round with B, [1 round with A, 1 round with B] 4 times, 3 rounds with A.
4. To change color, fasten off old color and join new color in indicated stitch as instructed. The new color is joined in different stitches to help hide the joins.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

Fold back brim. Using photograph as a guide, sew flower to hat. Weave in ends.

Chain 1, skip first stitch, work rev sc (see Special Stitches) evenly along the side, slip st to first st to join; fasten off. Join yarn to second side and repeat. Weave in all ends.

Notes
1. Ribbing is worked first. Hat is worked in turned rows then back seam is sewn.
2. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Carry old color loosely up side of piece until next needed.

Special Stitches
dc2tog = [Yarn over, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops] 2 times, yarn over, draw through all 3 loops on hook.
sc2tog = [Draw up a loop in next st] 2 times, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

Directions are for size to fit Teens. Changes for size to fit Adult are in parentheses.

CROCHET HAT
Ribbing
With A, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across – 5 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in back loops of each st across.
Rows 3-59 (65): Repeat Row 2.
Do not fasten off.

Body
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, rotate to work into row ends, work 60 (66) sc evenly along row ends of ribbing – 60 (66) sts. 
Row 2: Sc in each st across.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, changing to B in last st.
Row 4-9: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), turn, skip first st, dc in each remaining st across.
Row 10: Ch 3, turn, skip first st, dc in each remaining st across, changing to C in last st.
Rows 11-12: Ch 3, turn, skip first st, dc in each remaining st across.
Row 13: Ch 3, turn, skip first st, dc in next 3 sts, dc2tog, [dc in next 4 dc, dc2tog] 9 (10) times – 50 (55) sts.
Row 14: Ch 3, turn, skip first st, dc in next 2 dc, dc2tog, [dc in next 3 dc, dc2tog] 9 (10) times – 40 (44) sts.
Row 15: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 10 (11) times – 30 (33) sts.
Row 16: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] 10 (11) times – 20 (22) sts.
Row 17: Ch 1, turn, [sc2tog] 10 (11) times – 10 (11) sts.
Row 18: Ch 1, turn, [sc2tog] 5 times, (sc in last st) – 5 (6) sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

FINISHING
Weave yarn tail through sts of Row 18 and pull to close tightly. Fasten securely. With Right Sides facing, align row ends and sew back seam. Weave in ends. With A, B, and C held together, follow our tutorial on using the Susan Bates Easy Wrap Pom-Pom Maker or follow these directions: Wrap yarn around 3½” [9 cm] piece of heavy cardboard (the more wraps, the fuller the pompom). Gently remove wraps from cardboard. Cut a 12” (30.5 cm) length of yarn and tie it tightly around center of wraps. Do not cut the ends of this center tie. Cut ends of wraps. Fluff and trim pompom to even strands. Use ends of center tie to attach pompom to top of hat.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 316 Soft White A and 312 Black B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Hat measures 16 (18, 20)” [40.5 (45.5, 51) cm] circumference at brim.
gauge: 13 sts = 4” (10 cm); 7½ rounds = 4” (10 cm) in double crochet.
instructions:
With A, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1 (right side): Work 12 hdc in ring; join with slip st in first st—12 hdc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first st—24 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 1, dc in first st, 2 dc in next st, [dc in next st, 2 dc in next st] 11 times; join with slip st in first st—36 dc.
Round 4: Ch 1, dc in first 2 sts, 2 dc in next st, [dc in next 2 sts, 2 dc in next st] 11 times; join with slip st in first st—48 dc.

Round 5: Ch 1, dc in first 7 (3, 3) sts, 2 dc in next st, [dc in next 7 (3, 3) sts, 2 dc in next st] 5 (11, 11) times; join with slip st in first st—54 (60, 60) dc.
Sizes Small and Medium only
Rounds 6–10 (11): Ch 1, dc in each st around; change to B; join with slip st in first st. 
Rounds 11 (12) and 12 (13): Ch 1, dc in each st around; join with slip st in first st. Do not fasten off.

Size Large only
Round 6: Ch 1, dc in first 9 sts, 2 dc in next st, [dc in next 9 sts, 2 dc in next st] 5 times; join with slip st in first st—66 dc.
Rounds 7–12: Ch 1, dc in each st around; change to B; join with slip st in first st.
Rounds 13 and 14: Ch 1, dc in each st around; join with slip st in first st. Do not fasten off.

Right Earflap
Row 1: Ch 2 (counts as first dc here and throughout), skip next st, dc in next 5 sts, skip next st, dc in next st; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—7 dc.
Row 2: Ch 2, skip next st, dc in next 3 sts, skip next st, dc in last st, turn—5 dc.
Row 3: Ch 2, skip next st, dc in next st, skip next st, dc in last st, turn—3 dc. Fasten off.
With right side of right earflap facing and back seam to the right, count to the left from earflap and place marker on 25th (29th, 33rd) st.

Left Earflap
With right side facing, join B with slip st in marked st and work same as right earflap.

Directions are for size Small. Changes for sizes Medium and Large are in parentheses.

Special Technique
Adjustable-ring method = Wrap yarn in a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail firmly between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring, working over both strands (the tail and the ring). After the first round of stitches is worked, pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.

Join with sc = Place a slip knot on hook, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through both loops on hook.

Notes
1. Hat is made in joined rounds with earflaps worked back and forth in rows.
2. Panda’s facial features are made separately and sewn to front of hat.
3. Chain 1 at the beginning of a round or row does not count as a stitch.

Edging
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, join B with sc in any st at center back between earflaps, sc in each st around and working 3 sc in end of each row; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

Ears (make 2)
With B, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1 (right side): Work 10 hdc in ring; join with slip st in first st—10 hdc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Ch 1, hdc in first st, 2 hdc in next st, [hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st] 4 times; join with slip st in first st—15 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 1, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first st.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first st—15 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

With front facing, flatten hat and place stitch markers at Rounds 2 and 4 on each side of hat. Flatten each ear and sew between markers.

Nose
With B, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1: Work 10 hdc in ring; join with slip st in first st—10 hdc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
With front of hat facing and using photograph as a guide for placement, center nose where desired in A-colored section and sew in place.

Eyes (make 2)
With B, ch 7.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 4 ch, 5 hdc in last ch; working on opposite side of foundation ch, sc in first 5 ch, 2 sc in last ch, join with slip st in first st—17 sts.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 4 sts, 2 hdc in next 5 sts, sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in last 2 sts, join with slip st in first st—25 sts. Fasten off.

With front of hat facing and using photograph as a guide for placement, position eyes on either side of nose, turning one piece to opposite side, and sew in place. Sew buttons to eyes with a strand of B if contrast stitching is desired.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

Braids (make 2)
Cut nine 28” (71 cm) strands of B. Separate into 3 hanks of 3 strands each. Thread each hank through last row of earflap and fold over so strands are doubled. Braid doubled hanks until 4” (10 cm) of strands remain, tie an overhand knot tightly, and trim ends evenly.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® Marled™ (5 oz/141 g; 240 yds/219 m)
Harvest Red Marl (0005) 1 ball or 214 yds/196 m
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Hat is worked sideways.
• Ch 2 at beg of rows does not count as hdc.
Ch 44, leaving a 24" [61 cm] long end for seaming later.
Foundation row:  (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to last 5 ch. 1 sc in each of last 5 ch. 42 sts. Turn.
1st row: (WS). Ch 1. 1 scbl in each of first 5 sts. 1 hdc in horizontal bar created below each st in previous row to end of row (bar is below loops normally worked on WS – see diagram). Turn.
2nd row:  Ch 2. 1 hdc in horizontal bar created below each st in previous row to last 5 sts. 1 scbl in each of last 5 sts. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows until Hat (at widest point) measures approx 20" [51 cm], when slightly stretched. Fasten off.
