Thread end from foundation ch, onto yarn needle and weave yarn through last scbl of each row and gather tightly. Sew back seam. Turn back cuff as shown.

pattern_name: Preemie to Toddler Crochet Baby Set
materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® Ombre™ (10 oz/283 g; 482 yds/440 m)
Size U.S. F/5 (3.75 mm) for Booties and U.S. H/8 (5 mm) for Hat
Susan Bates® crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dc2(3-5)tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 2 (3-5) times. Yoh and draw through all 3 (4-6) loops on hook
Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
Twisted sc = Insert hook in next stitch. Bring hook over yarn instead of yarn over hook and pull up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook.
measurements: Hat: To fit head circumference: Preemie ( Newborn- 6/12 mos- 18/24 mos) 9½" ( 12-16-17½)" [24 (30.5-40.5-44.5 cm]. Booties: To fit baby’s foot: 3/6 (12/18) mos.
gauge: 17 sc and 19 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook. 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size Preemie for Hats and 3/6 mos for Booties. If changes are necessary for sizes Newborn, 6/12 or 18/24 mos for Hats and 12/18 mos for Booties, the instructions will be written thus ( ). When only one number is given, it applies to all sizes.
HAT
With larger hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 twisted sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 twisted sc in next sc. 1 twisted sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 twisted sc in next sc. 1 twisted sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
Sizes Newborn, 6/12 and 18/24 mos only: 5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 twisted sc in next sc. 1 twisted sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 twisted sc in next sc. 1 twisted sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
Sizes 6/12 and 18/24 mos only: 7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 twisted sc in next sc. 1 twisted sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 twisted sc in next sc. 1 twisted sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc.
Sizes Preemie and 18/24 mos only: Next rnd: Ch 1. *2 twisted sc in next sc. 1 twisted sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 27 (54) sc.
All sizes: Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 twisted sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. PM on last rnd. Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 3 ( 3½-4-4½)" [7.5 (9-10-11.5) cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each st around. Join with sl st to first sl st. Rep last rnd 2 (3-4-5) times more. Fasten off.
BOOTIES
With smaller hook, ch 16 (22).
1st row: (RS). 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 4 (7) ch. 2 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in next ch. 2 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of next 4 (7) ch. 2 sc in last ch. 21 (27) sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 ( 10) sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 ( 10) sc. 2 sc in last sc. 27 (33) sts. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 ( 13) sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 ( 13) sc. 2 sc in last sc. 33 (39) sts. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 ( 16) sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 ( 16) sc. 2 sc in last sc. 39 (45) sts. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 5 times more.
Shape Instep
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 scbl in each of next 13 (16) sc. (Dc3tog) twice. 1 dc in next sc. (Dc3tog over next 3 sts) twice. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each of next 13 ( 16) sc. (Dc5tog) 5 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off.
Strap (make 2).
Ch 33 (40).
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. 32 (39) sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 2. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc and 2 sc in ch-2 sps to end of row. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew back and sole seam. Sew Strap to Bootie as shown in picture. Sew buttons to correspond to buttonholes.

materials: RED HEART® Soft Yarn: 1 ball 4601 Off White
Heavy-weight interfacing or stiff cardboard or plastic for brim
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: 16 dc = 4”; 9 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CAP
Ch 4, slip st in first st to form ring. 
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), work 7 dc in ring, slip st to top of beginning ch to join, place marker for beginning of round – 8 sts.
Round 2: Ch 3, 2 dc in same space, 3 dc in each st around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 24 sts.
Round 3: Ch 3, [(dc and Fpdc) in next st, dc in next 2 sts] 7 times, (dc and Fpdc) in next st, dc in last st, slip st in top of beginning ch – 32 sts; 8 Fpdc.
Round 4: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1 here and throughout), skip next st, [(dc and Fpdc) in next st, ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st, ch 1, skip next st] 7 times, (dc and Fpdc) in next st, ch 1, skip next st, slip st in top of beginning ch – 40 sts.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in ch-1 space, dc in next st, *(dc and Fpdc) in next st, [dc in ch-1 space, dc in next st] twice; repeat from * 6 more times, (dc and Fpdc) in next st, dc in ch-1 space st, slip st in top of beginning ch – 48 sts.
Round 6: Ch 4, skip next st, dc in next st, *ch 1, skip next st, (dc and Fpdc) in next st, [ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st] twice; repeat from * 6 more times, ch 1, skip next st, (dc and Fpdc) in next st, ch 1, skip next st, slip st in top of beginning ch – 56 sts.
Round 7: Ch 3, *[dc in ch-1 space, dc in next st] twice, (dc and Fpdc) in next st, dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next st; repeat from * 6 more times, [dc in ch-1 space, dc in next st] twice, (dc and Fpdc) in next st, dc in next ch-1 space, slip st in top of beginning ch – 64 sts.
Round 8: Ch 4, skip next st, *[dc in next st, ch 1, skip next st] twice, (dc and Fpdc) in next st, ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st, ch 1, skip next st; repeat from * 6 more times, [dc in next st, ch 1, skip next st] twice, (dc and Fpdc) in next st, ch 1, skip next st, slip st in top of beginning ch – 72 sts.
Round 9: Ch 3, *[dc in ch-1 space, dc in next st] 3 times, Fpdc in next Fpdc, dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next st; repeat from * 6 more times, [dc in ch-1 space, dc in next st] 3 times, Fpdc in next Fpdc, dc in next ch-1 space, slip st in top of beginning ch – 72 sts.
Round 10: Ch 4, skip next st, *[dc in next st, ch 1, skip next st] 2 times, dc in next st, Fpdc in next Fpdc, ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st, ch 1, skip next st; repeat from * 6 more times, [dc in next st, ch 1, skip next st] 2 times, dc in next st, Fpdc in next Fpdc, ch 1, skip next st, slip st in top of beginning ch – 72 sts.
Rounds 11-15: Repeat Rounds 9-10, end with Round 9.
Round 16: Slip st in each st around. 
Fasten off. 
BRIM
Top Side
Mark 22 sts on front of Hat on Round 16 for Brim.
Row 1: With right side facing, join yarn in first marked st, working in front loops only, sc in each next 22 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loops in next 4 sts on Hat – 26 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loops in next 4 sts on Hat – 30 sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loop in next st on Hat – 31 sts.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loop in next st on Hat – 32 sts.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loop in next st on Hat – 33 sts.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loop in next st on Hat – 34 sts.
Fasten off.
Bottom Side
Row 1: With wrong side facing, join yarn on wrong side of Row 1 of Brim, sc in back loops of first 22 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loops in next 4 sts on Hat – 26 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loops in next 4 sts on Hat – 30 sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loop in next st on Hat – 31 sts.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loop in next st on Hat – 32 sts.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loop in next st on Hat – 33 sts.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loop in next st on Hat – 34 sts.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Using Brim as a template, cut a piece of interfacing or stiff cardboard or plastic to same dimensions. Slip piece in between layers of Brim and sew Brim closed. 
Weave in ends.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® (6 oz/170 g; 315 yds/288 m) Off White (9702) 1 ball
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first sc.
Ribbing: Ch 8.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 7 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work, when slightly stretched, from beg measures 19½" [49.5 cm].** Do not fasten off.
Set-up rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1) 36 times across longer side of ribbing. Join. PM for beg of rnd. Proceed in pat as follows:
See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next sc) 4 times. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Rep from *, ending last rep with: (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Skip last ch-1 sp). Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 5. Skip next (ch-1 sp, 1 dc) twice. From front, sl st in next ch-1 sp 2 rows below. Ch 5. Skip next (1 dc, ch-1 sp) twice. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * ending last rep with: 1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Skip last ch-1 sp. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *(Working behind ch-5 sp, ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next dc 2 rows below) 4 times. (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Rep from * ending last rep with: (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Skip last ch-1 sp). Join.
Rep last 2 rnds until work from beg measures 8½" [21.5 cm], ending on a 3rd rnd.
Shape crown: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next dc) 4 times. Ch 1. Skip next (ch-1 sp, sc, ch-1 sp). 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending last rep with: Ch 1. Skip next (ch-1 sp, sc, ch-1 sp). Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Ch 1. Skip next (ch-1 sp, sc, ch-1 sp). 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending last rep with: Ch 1. Skip next (ch-1 sp, sc, ch-1 sp). Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Ch 1. Skip next (ch-1 sp, sc, ch-1 sp). 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around ending last rep with: Ch 1. Skip next (ch-1 sp, sc, ch-1 sp). Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Skip next (ch-1 sp, sc, ch-1 sp). 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending last rep with: Ch 1. Skip next (ch-1 sp, sc, ch-1 sp). Join. Fasten off leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.
Pompom: Wind yarn around 3 fingers 100 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Hat. Sew short ends of ribbing tog.

materials: Bernat® Fabwoolous™ (6 oz/170 g; 360 yds/280 m) Cream (25001) 1 ball
Size U.S. 8 (5 mm) knitting needles or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: C2F = Knit into front loop of 2nd stitch on left-hand needle, then knit 1st stitch, slipping both stitches off needle together.
C2L = Purl through back loop of 2nd stitch on left-hand needle (behind first stitch), then knit first stitch, slipping both stitches off needle together.
C2R = Knit into front loop of 2nd stitch on left-hand needle, then purl first stitch, slipping both stitches off needle together.
gauge: 18 sts and 24 rows = 4" [10 cm] in stocking st.
instructions:
Cast on 114 sts.
1st row:  (RS). K2. *P2. K2. Rep from * to end of row.
2nd row:  P2. *K2. P2. Rep from * to end of row.
3rd row:  K1. *C2L. C2R. Rep from * to last st. K1.
4th row:  P1. K1. *P2. K2. Rep from * to last 4 sts. P2. K1. P1.
5th row:  K1. P1. *C2F. P2. Rep from * to last 4 sts. C2F. P1. K1.
6th row:  As 4th row.
7th row:  K1. *C2R. C2L. Rep from * to last st. K1.
8th row:  As 2nd row.
Rep these 8 rows once more.
Next row:  (Fold ridge). Purl.
Proceed as follows, reversing rows from RS to WS as follows:
1st row: (RS). K2. *P2. K2. Rep from * to end of row.
2nd row: P2. *K2. P2. Rep from * to end of row.
3rd and 4th rows: As 1st and 2nd rows once more.
5th row: K1. *C2L. C2R. Rep from * to last st. K1.
6th row: P1. K1. *P2. K2. Rep from * to last 4 sts. P2. K1. P1.
7th row: K1. P1. *C2F. P2. Rep from * to last 4 sts. C2F. P1. K1.
8th row: As 6th row.
9th row: K1. *C2R. C2L. Rep from * to last st. K1.
10th row: As 2nd row.
11th and 12th rows:  As 1st and 2nd rows.
These 12 rows form pat.
Cont in pat until work from fold ridge measures approx 5½" [14 cm], ending with 10th row of pat.
Shape top: 1st row:  (RS). K2. P2. K2. *P2tog. K2. (P2. K2) twice. Rep from * to end of row. 105 sts.
2nd and alt rows: Knit all knit sts and purl all purl sts as they appear.
3rd row: K2. P2. K2. *P1. K2. P2tog. K2. P2. K2. Rep from * to end of row. 96 sts.
5th row: K2. P2tog. K2. *(P1. K2) twice. P2tog. K2. Rep from * to end of row. 86 sts.
7th row: K2. P1. K2. *P1. K2tog. (P1. K2) twice. Rep from * to end of row. 77 sts.
9th row: K2. P1. K2tog. *P1. K1. P1. K2tog. P1. K2. Rep from * to end of row. 67 sts.
11th row: K2tog. P1. K1. *(P1. K1) twice. P1. K2tog. Rep from * to end of row. 57 sts.
13th row: K1. *K2tog. Rep from * to end of row. 29 sts.
Break yarn, leaving a long end. Draw end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely. Sew center back seam, reversing seam for cuff turnback.
Pompom:  Wind yarn around 4 fingers 60 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to top of Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to form pompom. Sew to top of Hat.

materials: RED HEART® With Love® Metallic: 1 ball 8922 Fuchsia
abbreviations: [] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 11 sts = 4” (10 cm); 8 rounds = 4” (10 cm) in hdc with A.
instructions:
CLOCHE
Brim
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 7; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 2 (does NOT count as a st), working in back loops, hdc in first sc and in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, working in back loops, hdc in first hdc and in each hdc across; turn.
Repeat Row 3 until brim is 22” (56 cm) long.
Crown
Ch 1, work 60 sc across one long edge; join with a slip st to first sc to form a circle. Place marker in first st of round. Do not join but work in continuous rounds, moving marker up each round.
Round 1: Hdc in first sc and in each sc around – 60 hdc.
Round 2: Hdc in first hdc and in each hdc around.
Repeat Round 2 until piece measures 5½” (14 cm) from lower edge.
Shape Crown
Next Round: [Hdc in 3 hdc, dec] 12 times – 48 hdc.
Work 1 round even.
Next Round: [Hdc in 2 hdc, dec] 12 times – 36 hdc.
Work 1 round even.
Next Round: [Hdc in hdc, dec] 12 times – 24 hdc.
Work 1 round even.
Next Round: [Dec] 12 times – 12 hdc.
Next Round: [Dec] 6 times; join with a slip st in next st – 6 hdc. Fasten off.
Weave yarn end through last 6 sts and draw top closed. Sew brim seam. Weave in loose ends.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 6.5 mm [US K-10½], 5.5 mm [US I-9]
Stitch markers, large eye needle, pompom maker
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C
() = work all directions in parentheses in the indicated stitch or space
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Child's size Small (fits 17"-19" head); changes for Teen-Adult size Large (fits 19"-20" head) are in parentheses.
gauge: 12 dc = 4” [10 cm]; 6 rows dc = 4” [10 cm] using larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Using larger hook and A, ch 4, join with slip st in first ch to form ring. Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 3 (counts as first dc now and throughout), 11 dc in ring, join in top of ch-3 (see Notes); turn—12 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in same first st, 2 dc in each dc around, join; turn—24 dc. 
Round 3: Ch 1 (does not count as a st now and throughout), (slip st, dc) in each dc around (see Notes), join in first slip st; turn—48 sts.
Rounds 4-5: Ch 1, *slip st in next dc, dc in next slip st; repeat from * around, join; turn—48 sts.
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in each st around, join; turn—48 dc.
Round 7: Ch 3, dc in next 6 (2) dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next 7 (3) dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, join; turn—54 (60) dc.
Round 8: Ch 1, *slip st in next dc, dc in next dc; repeat from * around, join; turn—54 (60) sts. 
Rounds 9-10: Ch 1, *slip st in next dc, dc in next slip st: repeat from * around, join; turn—54 (60) sts. 
Rounds 11-12: Ch 3, dc in each st around, join; turn—54 (60) dc.
Round 13: Ch 1, *slip st in next dc, dc in next dc; repeat from * around, join; turn—54 (60) sts.
Round 14: Ch 1, *slip st in next dc, dc in next slip st; repeat from * around, join; turn—54 (60) sts.
Round 15: Ch 1, *slip st in next dc, dc in next slip st; repeat from * around, join; do not turn—54 (60) sts.
Round 16 (Large size only): Ch 3, dc in each st around, join—60 dc.
Round 16 (17): Ch 1, *sc in next 7 (8) sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around; join in first sc—48 (54) sts. Fasten off A.
Round 17 (18): Join B in first st, ch 1, sc in each st around; join—48 (54) sc. 
Round 18 (19): Skip first sc (join was worked in this st), slip st in next 5 sc, ch 1 (does not count as a st), sc in next sc; place stitch marker in sc just made; sc in next 34 (40) sc, slip st in last 7 sc; join—48 (54) sts. Fasten off B.
With smaller hook and Right Side facing, join C in marked sc of previous round. From here forward work in rows.
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 3, dc in same first sc, fpdc around post of next sc two rounds below, *dc in next sc, fpdc around post of next sc two rounds below; repeat from * 15 (18) times, 2 dc in last sc (skip remaining slip sts); turn—37 (43) sts.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in same first dc, *dc, bpdc; repeat from * 16 (19) times, dc in next dc, 2 dc in top of ch-3; turn—39 (45) sts.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in same first dc, fpdc,*dc, fpdc; repeat from * 17 (20) times, 2 dc in top of ch-3—41 (47) sts. To make first Tie: ch 25 (27); turn, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 23 (25) chs—24 (26) slip sts.
Row 4 (Small size only): Continuing to work across top of Row 3, hdc in first 2 dc, bphdc, *hdc, bphdc; repeat from * 17 times, hdc in last 2 sts—41 sts. To make second Tie: ch 25; turn, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 23 chs—24 slip sts. Continuing to work across top of Row 4, slip st in each st across—41 slip sts. Fasten off.
Row 4 (Large size only): Continuing to work across top of Row 3, dc in first 2 dc, bpdc, *dc, bpdc: repeat from * 20 times, dc in last 2 sts—47 sts. To make second Tie: ch 27; turn, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 25 chs—26 slip sts. Continuing to work across top of Row 4, slip st each st across—47 slip sts. Fasten off.
FINISHING Referring to photo for placement, make a large pompom and sew to crown of Hat; make 2 small pompoms and sew one to each Tie end. Weave in all ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein 319 Cherry Red.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 13 sts = 4”; 10 rounds = 4” in hdc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
With larger hook, ch 64 (68); join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring taking care that ch is not twisted.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around; join with a slip st in first sc – 64 (68) sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Ponytail Opening-Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, ch 10, skip next 9 sc, sc in each sc around; join.
Round 4: Ch 1, hdc in first sc, 9 hdc in ch-10 space, hdc in each sc around; join with a slip st in first hdc.
Rounds 5 and 6: Ch 1, hdc in each hdc around; join.
Round 7: Ch 1, [2 hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 3 hdc] 16 (17) times; join – 80 (85) hdc.
Rounds 8 and 9: Repeat Round 5.
Round 10: Ch 1, [hdc in next 4 hdc, skip next hdc] 16 (17) times; join – 64 (68) hdc.
Round 11: Ch 1, [hdc in next 3 hdc, skip next hdc] 16 (17) times; join – 48 (51) hdc.
Rounds 12-14: Repeat Round 5.
Round 15: Ch 1, [hdc in first hdc, skip next hdc] 24 (25) times, hdc in next 0 (1) hdc; join – 24 (26) hdc.
Round 16: Ch 1, sc in each hdc around; join.
For large only: 
Round 17: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Both Sizes-Round 17 (18): Ch 1, [sc in sc, skip next sc] 12 (13) times; join – 12 (13) sc.
Round 18 (19): Ch 1, [sc in sc, skip next sc] 6 times, sc in next 0 (1) sc; join – 6 (7) sc. Fasten off leaving a 6” yarn end. Weave yarn end through remaining sts; draw up firmly, fasten securely. Weave in ends.
Brim
Row 1: Skip 9 sts under Ponytail Opening and next 19 (20) sts of Round 1; with smaller hook, join yarn around the post of next sc; ch 1, sc around next 17 (19) sc; turn.
Rows 2-6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 6. Weave in ends.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream (Solids: 50 g/1.75 oz or Ombres and Prints 42.5 g/1.5 oz)
KIDS VERSION Contrast A (00056 Yellow) 1 ball
Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
STRIPE VERSION
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in ring. Join B with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: With B, ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join C with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: With C, ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join D with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd: With D, ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 6 times. Join A with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
5th rnd: With A, ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 6 times. Join B with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
Last 4 rnds form Stripe Pat.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, inc 6 sts on every row, as before to 48 (54-60) sts, then every following alt row to 60 (66-72) sts.
Cont in Stripe Pat, work 9 (10-12) rows even.
Next rnd: With appropriate color, working from left to right instead of right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
PLAIN VERSION
Work as given for Stripe Version, omitting reference to color changing.

materials: Red Heart® With Love®(7 oz/198 g; 370 yds/338 m)
Sizes U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) and U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: S (M-L): Approx 18 (20, 22)" [45.5 (51, 56) cm] circumference at brim.
gauge: 12 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Notes:
• Hat is made in joined rounds with RS facing at all times.
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.
HAT
With larger hook and A, ch 4. Join with sl st to make a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, ch 12, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, ch 12, sc in next st] 7 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc and 8 ch-12 loops.
Note: Hold ch-12 loops in front of rounds and do not work into loops until instructed.
4th rnd: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 2 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 7 times; join with slip st in first sc—32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 7 times; join with slip st in first sc—40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 4 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 7 times; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 4 sts, ch 12, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts, ch 12, sc in next st] 7 times; join with slip st in first sc—56 sc and 8 ch-12 loops.
8th to 10th rnds: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—56 sc.
Size Small only:
11th rnd: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sts, ch 12, sc in next st, [sc in next 6 sts, ch 12, sc in next st] 7 times; join with slip st in first sc—56 sc and 8 ch-12 loops.
12th rnd: Repeat 8th rnd—56 sc.
Size Medium only:
11th rnd: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 5 sts, ch 12, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts, ch 12, sc in next st] 7 times; join with slip st in first sc—64 sc and 8 ch-12 loops.
12th rnd: Repeat 8th rnd—64 sc.
Size Large only:
11th rnd: Work same as 11th rnd of size Medium.
12th rnd: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 7 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts] 7 times; join with slip st in first sc—72 sc.
All sizes:
13th and 14th rnds: Repeat 8th rnd.
15th rnd: Ch 1, sc in first 6 (7, 8) sts, ch 12, sc in next st, [sc in next 6 (7, 8) sts, ch 12, sc in next st] 7 times; join with slip st in first sc—56 (64, 72) sc and 8 ch-12 loops.
16th to 18th rnds: Repeat 8th rnd.
19th to 34th rnds: Repeat 15th to 18th rnds four times.
Fasten off.
Beginning at top of hat, draw 2nd ch-12 loop through first ch-12 loop, draw 3rd ch-12 loop through 2nd ch-12 loop; repeat in this manner down side of hat until all 8 ch-12 loops are worked (cable made), then repeat for each remaining set of 8 ch-12 loops around—8 cables.
35th rnd: With right side facing, join B with sc in first sc, sc in next 5 (6, 7) sts, inserting hook in first ch-12 loop, sc in next st, [sc in next 6 (7, 8) sts, inserting hook in next ch-12 loop, sc in next st] 7 times; join with slip st in first sc—56 (64, 72) sc.
36th and 37th rnds: With smaller hook, repeat 8th rnd; change to C at end of 37th rnd.
38th and 39th rnds: Repeat 8th rnd. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Pompom: Wind B around 3 fingers 100 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hood. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Hat.

materials: Patons® Classic Wool Worsted™ (100 g/3.5 oz; 192 m/210 yds)
Contrast A Aran Tweed (84008) or Cognac Heather (77532) 1 ball
Contrast B Cognac Heather (77532) or Aran Tweed (84008) 1 ball
Size 4 mm (U.S. G/6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
measurements: One size to fit average woman’s head.
gauge: 15 dc and 7½ rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Beg at crown, with A, ch 4. Join with sl st to form a ring. (See Diagram on page 2).
1st rnd: Ch 3. 8 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 9 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dcfp in each dc around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 18 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *With A, 1 dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. With B, 1 dc in sp between last dcfp and next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 27 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *With A, 1 dcfp around next dcfp. With B, 1 dc in sp between last dcfp and next st. With A, 1 dcfp around next dcfp. With B, 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 36 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *With A, 1 dcfp around next dcfp. With B, 1 dc in next dc. With A, 1 dcfp around next dcfp. With B, 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 45 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *With A, 1 dcfp around next dcfp. With B, 2 dc in next dc. With A, 1 dcfp around next dcfp. With B, 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 54 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 2. *With A, 1 dcfp around next dcfp. With B, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 72 sts.
8th rnd: With B, ch 3. 1 dc in each st around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Place marker at end of rnd.
9th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. With A, (yoh) twice. Draw up a loop around post of first dcfp at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. (Yoh) twice. Draw up a loop around post of next dcfp at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – beg trfp cluster made. *Miss next dc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. With A, (yoh) twice. Draw up a loop around post of last dcfp worked at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. (Yoh) twice. Draw up a loop around post of next dcfp at front of work inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – trfp cluster made. Rep from * around, ending with: miss next dc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. With A, trfp cluster over last dcfp and first dcfp. Miss next dc. With B, 1 sc in last dc. Join with sl st to first sc.
10th rnd: With B, ch 3. 1 dc in each st around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
11th rnd: Ch 1. With A, trfp cluster over last trfp cluster and next trfp cluster. Miss first dc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 3 dc. *With A, trfp cluster over last trfp cluster worked and next Trfp cluster. Miss next dc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st.
Rep 8th to 11th rnds until work from marked rnd measures approx 4" [10 cm], ending on 9th rnd.
Next rnd: Ch 2. With A, dcfp around first sc. *With B, dcbp around next sc. With A, dcfp around next trfp cluster. With B, dcbp around next sc. With A, dcfp around next sc. Rep from * around, ending with B, dcbp around last sc. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 2. With A, dcfp around first dcfp. *With B, dcbp around next dcbp. With A, dcfp around next dcfp. Rep from * around, ending with B, dcbp around last dcbp. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 718 Shocking Pink A, 886 Blue B, 316 Soft White C, and 324 Bright Yellow D
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Hat measures: 20” (51 cm) in circumference at brim; Length: 7½” (19 cm)
gauge: 17 dc = 5” [12.5 cm]; 9 rows dc = 5” [12.5 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size needles/hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
HAT
With A, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1: Work 12 dc in ring; join with slip st in first dc—12 dc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 dc in each dc around; join with slip st in first dc—24 dc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc] 12 times; join with slip st in first dc—36 dc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [dc in each of next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc] 12 times; join with slip st in first dc—48 dc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [dc in each of next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc] 12 times; join with slip st in first dc—60 dc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [dc in each of next 9 dc, 2 dc in next dc] 6 times; join with slip st in first dc—66 dc.
Rounds 7–13: Ch 1, dc in each dc around; join with slip st in first dc. Do not fasten off.
Right Earflap
Row 1: Ch 2 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc2tog, dc in each of next 4 dc, dc2tog, dc in next dc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—8 dc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn—8 sc.
Row 3: Ch 2, dc2tog, dc in each of next 2 sc, dc2tog, dc in last sc, turn—6 dc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn—6 sc.
Row 5: Ch 2, [dc2tog] twice, dc in last sc, turn—4 dc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in each dc across—4 sc. Fasten off.
With right earflap facing and back seam to the right, place st marker 26 spaces to the left of the last st from right earflap.
Left Earflap
Join A with slip st in marked st.
Row 1–6: Work same as rounds 1–6 of right earflap.
Border
Round 1: Join A with slip st in center back between earflaps, ch 1, sc evenly around, working sc in each st and in end of each sc row and 3 sc in the end of each dc row; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Eye (make 2)
With B, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1: Work 12 dc in ring; join with slip st in first dc—12 dc. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join C with slip st in any dc, ch 1, 2 dc in same dc as join and in each dc around; join with slip st in first dc—24 dc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Nose
With D, leaving a long tail, make an adjustable ring, ch 3.
Row 1: Work 3 dc in ring, ch 3, slip st in ring. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Ear (make 2)
With A, leaving a long tail, make an adjustable ring, ch 3.
Row 1: Work 3 dc in ring, picot, 3 dc in ring, ch 3, slip st in ring. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Cut a 6” (15 cm) strand each of B, C and D. Hold strands together and fold in half to form a loop. Insert crochet hook from right side through picot. Place fold on hook and draw fold through, forming a loop. Thread ends of strands through loop and pull to tighten. Trim ends evenly.
ASSEMBLY
Refer to photograph as a guide for placement of all pieces.
Braid (make 2)
Cut three 28” (71 cm) strands each of B, C, and D. Separate each color. Thread strands between stitches on last row of earflap. Fold in half and braid doubled strands together until 4” (10 cm) of fringe remains, knot to fasten, trim ends evenly.
Eyes
Center eyes on forehead and with C, sew in place.
Nose
Cut two 4” (10 cm) strands of D, knot one to the top of the first dc on nose, knot 2nd to the top of the 5th dc on nose. Position nose between eyes. Thread tails through eyes and hat to wrong side and tie securely.
Ears
Flatten hat so eyes are facing and centered. Place stitch marker on each side of round 3 where desired. Thread tails from ear to wrong side of hat at stitch marker and tie securely.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Hat is worked sideways with short rows.
• Take care to not work sl sts too tightly.
• Follow modified slst2tog instructions above to prevent holes from forming at crown.
Ch 64.
1st row: (RS). Working into horizontal “bump” at back of each ch, sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 63 sts.
2nd and alt rows: Ch 1. Sl st in back loop only of each st to end of chain. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sl st in back loop only of each st to last 2 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 61 sts.
5th row: As 3rd row. 59 sts.
7th row: As 3rd row. 57 sts.
9th row: As 3rd row. 55 sts.
11th row: As 3rd row. 53 sts.
13th row: As 3rd row. 51 sts.
15th row: Ch 1. Sl st in back loop only of each st to end of row. Sl st in back loop only of next 2 sts of row 2 rows below. Turn. 53 sts.
17th row: Ch 1. Sl st in back loop only of each st to end of row. Slst2tog, working into side of last st 4 rows below and back loop only of next st 6 rows below. Sl st in back loop only of next st. Turn. 55 sts.
19th row: As 17th row. 57 sts.
21st row: As 17th row. 59 sts.
23rd row: As 17th row. 61 sts.
25th row: As 17th row. 63 sts.
26th row: As 2nd row.
First wedge complete. Rep 3rd to 26th rows 4 times more.
Rep 3rd to 25th rows once more.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Weave end through last st of each row along top edge and gather tightly. Sew back seam, reversing seam approx 3½" [9 cm] for cuff.

Heavy-weight interfacing or plastic for brim

instructions:
Crown
Ch 4, slip st in first ch to form ring. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring – 6 sts.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] – 18 sts.
Round 4: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] – 24 sts.

Round 6: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] – 36 sts.
Round 7: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] – 42 sts.
Round 8: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts] – 48 sts.
Round 9: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in same space, dc in next 7 sts, [2 dc in next st, dc in next 7 sts] – 54 sts.
Round 10: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts] – 60 sts.
Round 11: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts] – 66 sts.
Round 12: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts] – 72 sts.
Round 13: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 11 sts] – 78 sts.
Round 14: Ch 3, dc in each st around.
Rounds 15-18: Sc in each st around.
Rounds 19-28: Repeat Rounds 14-18.
Round 29: Hdc in each st around, slip st in first st. Fasten off.
Brim
Top Side
Mark 22 sts on front of Hat on Round 29 for Brim.
Row 1: With right side facing, join yarn in first marked st, working in front loops only, sc in each next 22 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loops in next 4 sts on Hat – 26 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loops in next 4 sts on Hat – 30 sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loop in next st on Hat – 31 sts.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loop in next st on Hat – 32 sts.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loop in next st on Hat – 33 sts.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loop in next st on Hat – 34 sts.
Fasten off.
Bottom Side
Row 1: With wrong side facing, join yarn on wrong side of Row 1 of Brim, sc in back loops of first 22 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loops in next 4 sts on Hat – 26 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loops in next 4 sts on Hat – 30 sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loop in next st on Hat – 31 sts.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loop in next st on Hat – 32 sts.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in front loop in next st on Hat – 33 sts.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across, sc in back loop in next st on Hat – 34 sts.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Using Brim as a template, cut a piece of stiff interfacing or plastic to same dimensions. Slip piece in between layers of Brim and sew Brim closed. Weave in ends.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® (6 oz/170.1 g; 315 yds/288 m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at back of work inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook
Hdcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook
Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
gauge: 13 hdc and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
The instructions are written for smaller size. If changes are necessary for larger size the instructions will be written thus ( ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to both sizes.
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as st.
HAT
With MC, ch 3.
1st rnd: 10 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first hdc. 10 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 20 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last st. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 30 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 40 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 50 hdc.
Size 6-12 mos only: 6th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 23 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 24 hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 52 hdc.
7th to 15th rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
16th and 17th rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdcfp around first hdc. *1 hdcbp around next hdc. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdcbp around last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc.
Fasten off.
Size 18-24 mos only: 6th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 4 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 60 hdc.
7th to 17th rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
18th and 19th rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdcfp around first hdc. *1 hdcbp around next hdc. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdcbp around last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc.
Fasten off.
Ears (make 2)
With MC, ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 7 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 5 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Fasten off.
Ear edging: With RS facing, join MC with sl st to bottom right corner of Ear. Work sc evenly along 2 sides, having 3 sc in top corner. Fasten off.
Large Flower (make 1)
With A, ch 21.
1st row: 7 dc in 4th ch from hook. *Sl st in next ch. 8 dc in next ch. Rep from * to last ch. Sl st in last ch. Fasten off.
Sew Flower tog into coil as shown in picture.
Small Flower (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 10 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in same st as last sl st. *Sl st in next sc. 3 dc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. Sl st in last sc. Fasten off.
Leaves (make 2)
With B, ch 11.
1st rnd: 3 tr in 5th ch from hook. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in next ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working into rem loops along opposite side of ch, 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 4 tr in last ch. Join with sl st to top of ch-4. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Ears, Flowers, and Leaves to Hat as shown in picture.

Yarn over hook (Yoh) and draw through all loops on hook - sc2together (sc2tog) made. *1 sc in each of 6 (7) hdc. Sc2tog. Repeat (rep) from * around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 56 (64) stitches (sts). 2nd rnd: With A, ch 2. Working into back loops only, 1 hdc in each st around. Join MC with sl st to first hdc. 3rd rnd: With MC, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 (6) hdc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 48 (56) sts. 4th rnd: As 2nd rnd. 5th rnd: With MC, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 (5) hdc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 40 (48) sts. 6th rnd: As 2nd rnd. 7th rnd: With MC, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 (4) hdc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 32 (40) sts. 8th rnd: As 2nd rnd. 9th rnd: With MC, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 (3) hdc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 24 (32) sts. 10th rnd: With A, ch 2. *Working into back loops only, 1 hdc in each of next 1 (2) st(s). (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - Hdc2together (Hdc2tog) made. Rep from * around. Join MC with sl st to first hdc. 16 (24) sts. Size 6-10 yrs only: 11th rnd With MC, ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 8 sts. Adult size only: 11th rnd: With MC, ch 1. *1 sc in next hdc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 16 sts. 12th rnd: With A, ch 2. *Working into back loops only, Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. 8 sts. Both sizes: Fasten off, leaving a long end. materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 1 skein each 1308 Tan A, 1012 Black B, and 1401 Pewter C
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5.5mm [US I-9] and 6.5mm [US K-10.5]
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 10 sc = 4” (10 cm); Rounds 1–4 = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
With larger hook and A, make an adjustable ring. 
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), 7 hdc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—8 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 2, hdc in same st as join, 2 hdc in each remaining st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—16 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in same st as join, hdc in next st, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in same st as join, hdc in next 2 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—32 hdc.
Round 5: Ch 2, hdc in same st as join, hdc in next 3 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—40 hdc.
Round 6: Ch 2, hdc in same st as join, hdc in next 4 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 4 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—48 hdc.
Size Large only:
Round 7: Ch 2, hdc in same st as join, hdc in next 5 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—56 hdc.
Both sizes:
Rounds 7–16 (8–17): Ch 1, hdc in same st as join and in each st around; join with slip st in first hdc—48 (56) sts. 
Note For a slouchier appearance, repeat last round as many times as desired. 
Fasten off.
Round 17 (18): With right side facing and smaller hook, join B with sc in first st, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 18 (19): Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in each st around; change to C; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 19 (20): Ch 1, sc in first dc, *skip next 2 dc, Fptr around next sc 2 rounds below, ch 1, working in front of Fptr just made, Fptr around sc 2 rounds below first skipped dc, skip next 3 dc from last sc made, sc in next 5 dc; repeat from * around to last 7 dc, skip next 2 dc, Fptr around next sc 2 rounds below, ch 1, working in front of Fptr just made, Fptr around sc 2 rounds below first skipped dc, skip next 3 dc from last sc made, sc in last 4 dc; join with slip st in first sc—30 (35) sc, 12 (14) Fptr, and 6 (7) ch-1 spaces.
Round 20 (21): Ch 3, dc in each st and ch-1 space around; change to B; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—48 (56) dc.
Round 21 (22): Ch 1, sc in first 5 dc, *skip next 2 dc, Fptr around next sc 2 rounds below, ch 1, working in front of Fptr just made, Fptr around sc 2 rounds below first skipped dc, skip next 3 dc from last sc made, sc in next 5 dc; repeat from * around to last 3 dc, skip next 2 dc, Fptr around next sc 2 rounds below, ch 1, working in front of Fptr just made, Fptr around sc 2 rounds below first skipped dc; join with slip st in first sc—30 (35) sc, 12 (14) Fptr, and 6 (7) ch-1 spaces.
Round 22 (23): Ch 1, sc in each st and ch-1 space around; join with slip st in first sc—48 (56) sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Stripes™”: 1 Ball 944 Breezy Stripes A.
abbreviations: Scdec: [Pull up a loop in next st] 2 times; yo and pull through all 3 loops on hook.
gauge: Rounds 1-6 = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
With A, ch 3; join with a slip st into a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in ring – 6 sts.
Round 2: Slip st in each st around – 6 sts.
Round 3: 2 sc in each st around – 12 sts.
Round 4: * Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 5: * Sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Round 6: * Sc next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Round 7: * Sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Round 8: * Sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 42 sts.
Round 9: * Sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 48 sts.
Round 10: * Sc in next 7 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 54 sts.
Round 11: Sc in each st around.
Round 12: * Sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 60 sts.
Rounds 13-14: Repeat Round 11.
Rounds 15-16: Working in blo, sc in each st around.
Round 17: Working in blo, * sc in next 9 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 66 sts.
Round 18: Repeat Round 15.
Round 19: * Sc in next 10 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 72 sts.
Rounds 20-22: Repeat Round 15.
Round 23: Repeat Round 15; fasten off. Mark 13th, 22nd, 50th, and 59th sts.
Earflaps
Row 1: With Right Side facing, join A in marked st (st 13), ch 1, sc in same st and in next 9 sts; turn – 10 sts.
Rows 2-3: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, scdec in 1st 2 sts, sc in next 6 sts, scdec; turn – 8 sts.
Rows 5-7: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
Row 8: Ch 1, scdec in 1st 2 sts, sc in next 4 sts, scdec; turn – 6 sts.
Row 9: Ch 1, scdec in 1st 2 sts, sc in next 2 sts, scdec; turn – 4 sts.
Row 10: Ch 1, [scdec] 2 times – 2 sts. Fasten off.
Repeat Rows 1-10 for 2nd Earflap; beginning Row 1 in marked st 50.
FINISHING
Edging
Join A in final st of Round 23, ch 1, * (slip st, ch 1, slip st) in each st around to Earflap, (slip st, ch 1, slip st) in side of each row of Earflap, slip st in top of Row 10; ch 25, slip st in back ridge of 2nd ch from hook and in next 23 sts – tie made; slip st in top of Row 10, (slip st, ch 1, slip st) in each row continuing around Earflap; repeat from * around next Earflap; (slip st, ch 1, slip st) in each st around; join. Fasten off.
Tie Decoration
Join B in 20th st of Tie, slip st in next 3 sts, turn to work up other side of Tie, slip st in next 4 sts. Fasten off. Repeat for other Tie.
Brim Decoration
Join B in front loop of last st on Rnd 23.
Round 1: Working in unused front loops of Hat only, slip st in each st around.
Rounds 2-4: Repeat Round 1.
Round 5: Repeat Round 1. Fasten off.
Tassel (Make 3)
Row 1: Join A in any st of Round 2 on Hat; ch 10. Fasten off A.
Row 2: Join B in 1st ch of Tassel, slip st in each ch. Fasten off.
[Repeat Rows 1-2] twice, leaving 1 slip st of Round 2 between Tassels.
Weave in all ends.

10th rnd: Ch 2. 1 dcbp around first st. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. *1 dcbp around each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to last st. 1 dcbp around last st. Join with sl st to first st.

instructions:

MOTIFS

Motif 2: D as Color 1, E as Color 2, C as Color 3.
Motif 3: A as Color 1, B as Color 2, E as Color 3.

7th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sc.

instructions:

With A, ch 48 (54); taking care not to twist, join with slip st in first ch.
Round 1 (right side): Sc in each ch around. Do not join. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed—48 (54) sc.
Rounds 2–6: Sc in each sc around.
Size Large only:
Round 7: [Sc in next 7 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—48 sc.
Rounds 8–13: Sc in each sc around.
Both sizes:
Round 7 (14): [Sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—42 sc.
Rounds 8 (15)–13 (20): Sc in each sc around.
Round 14 (21): [Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—36 sc.
Rounds 15 (22)–20 (27): Sc in each sc around.
Round 21 (28): [Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc.
Rounds 22 (29)–27 (34): Sc in each sc around.
Round 28 (35): [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Rounds 29 (36)–34 (41): Sc in each sc around.
Round 35 (42): [Sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—18 sc.
Rounds 36 (43)–41 (48): Sc in each sc around.

Rounds 5 and 6: Repeat Round 2 twice.
Round 7: Ch 1, working in back loops only, (sc, ch 5, sc) in each sc; join with slip st in first sc, turn—96 (108) sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, holding each ch-5 group to front of work and working in back loops only, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc, turn.
Rounds 9–12: Repeat Rounds 7 and 8 twice—384 (432) sc. Fasten off.
BEARD
With B, ch 25.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch to last ch, 2 sc in last ch, turn—26 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, working in back loops only, (sc, ch 3, sc) in first sc, [ch 3, sc] 10 times, [ch 3, sc2tog] twice, [ch 3, sc] 10 times, [ch 3, sc] twice in last sc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, working in back loops only, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 10 sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn.
Rows 4 and 5: Repeat Rows 2 and 3.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2.
Row 7: Ch 1, working in back loops only, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 9 sc, ch 4, skip next 6 sc, sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—22 sc and 1 ch-4 space.
Row 8: Ch 1, working in back loops only, (sc, ch 3, sc) in first sc, [ch 3, sc] 9 times, sc in next sc, 4 sc in ch-4 space, sc in next sc, [ch 3, sc] 9 times, (sc, ch 3, sc) in last sc, turn—28 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, holding each ch-3 group to front of work and working in back loops only, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 10 sc, working in both loops, sc in next 6 sc, working in back loops only, sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in last sc—30 sc. Fasten off.

Fold last round at top of hat in half and stitch edges together.
With B and pompom maker, make a 2½" (6.5 cm) pom pom and sew to top end of hat.
Place hat on wearer’s head and adjust beard to fit. Stitching across ends of rows, sew beard to wrong side of brim.
Optional: Cut two 8" (20.5 cm) lengths of B, attach securely to each end of Row 7 or 8 of beard. Tie beard to Round 2 of hat brim.
Weave in ends.

abbreviations: Splsc = Split single crochet: work sc between ‘legs’ of stitch (splitting stitch) instead of through top loops
Sc2togspl = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc between ‘legs’ of stitch. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 15 sts and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm] in split sc pat.
instructions:
Note: When working from chart, carry yarn not in use loosely across top of work. Work next row over strand of yarn which is not in use. Do not join at ends of rnds unless otherwise stated. Cont working in spiral placing marker on first st of rnd for easier counting.
Ribbing: With A, ch 11.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row:  Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg, when slightly stretched, measures 19½" [49.5 cm].** Do not fasten off.
Proceed as follows:
Set-up rnd:  Ch 1. Work 80 sc across longer side of ribbing. Do not join. PM for beg of rnd.
Cont working in spiral as follows: Beg working Chart, noting 2-st rep will be worked 40 times, reading rnds from right to left.

1st rnd: 1 splsc in each sc around. Rep last rnd, and cont working Chart until Rnd 28 of Chart is complete.
Break all colors but B.
Shape crown: 1st rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 6 sts. Sc2togspl. Rep from * around. 70 sts.
2nd and alt rnds: 1 splsc in each sc around.
3rd rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 5 sts. Sc2togspl. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sts.
5th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 4 sts. Sc2togspl. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sts.
7th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2togspl. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.
9th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2togspl. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
11 rnd:  *1 splsc in next st. Sc2togspl. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sts.
Break yarn, leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely. Sew ends of ribbing together.

Pompom:  Wind 4 strands of B, 1 strand each A, C, D and E around 4 fingers 40 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Hat.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® Ombres™ (4 oz/113 g; 204 yds/186 m) Contrast A Stormy Weather (08243) 1 1 1 ball
Caron® Simply Soft® (6 oz/170.1g; 315 yds/288 m) Contrast B Black (39727) 1 1 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge. 1 Susan Bates® stitch marker.
abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger size(s) the instructions will be written 2/4 yrs (8/10 yrs - Adult). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes.
Beg at crown, with A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd and alt rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
Cont as established, inc 8 sc evenly spaced every alt rnd until there are 56 (64-72) sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 7 (8-9)" [18 (20.5-23) cm].
Beg working in rows: First Earflap:
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 14 (16-18) sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Earflap measures 2 (2½-3)" [5 (6-7.5) cm], ending on a WS row.
Next row: (RS). Ch 1. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 4 (5-6) sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * once more. Turn. 11 (13-15) sts.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 (3-4) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 (4-5) sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 8 (10-12) sts.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 0 (1-2) st(s). Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 1 (2-3) st(s). Sc2tog. Turn. 4 (6-8) sts.
Size 2/4 yrs only: Next row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. 2 sts.
Size 8/10 yrs only: Next row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 3 sts.
Size Adult only: Next row: Ch 1. (Sc3tog) twice. Sc2tog. 3 sts.
All sizes: Fasten off.
With RS facing, skip next 8 (8-11) unworked sc. Join A with sl st to next st. Work from ** to ** as given for First Earflap.
Nose
With B, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). 2 hdc in first sc. 2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 2 hdc in each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.
Eyes (make 2)
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Nose and Eyes to front of Hat as shown in picture. With C, embroider a little glint in each Eye using straight stitch.
Pompom Ears (make 2)
Wind 1 strand each of B and C around 4 fingers 60 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center. Cut through each side loops. Trim to a smooth round shape. Sew 1 pompom to each side of Hat at top as shown in picture.

materials: Red Heart® Heat Wave™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 198 yds/181 m)
Sizes U.S. 7 (4.5 mm) and U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
5 yds (4.5 m) of white worsted weight yarn.
abbreviations: Split sc = Insert hook between 2 strands of vertical V in the middle of sc instead of usual way. Draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook.
measurements: Hat: To fit child 2/4 yrs (6/8 yrs) old. Cowl: 24 (26) [61 (66) cm] around x 10 (12) [25.5 (30.5) cm] deep.
gauge: 13 split sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm] on larger hook.
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger size the instructions will be written thus ( ). When only one number is given, it applies to both sizes. For ease in working, circle all numbers pertaining to your size.

HAT
With smaller hook and MC, ch 9 (11).
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 8 (10) sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 18 (20)" [45.5 (51) cm]. With larger hook, join last row and 1st row tog with 1 row of sc to form tube.
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first split sc.

Foundation rnd: (RS). Ch 1. Working along side edge of ribbing, work 59 (65) sc evenly around. Join. Place marker on last st at end of each rnd and move marker at end of each rnd.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 split sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 8 (8½)" [20.5 (21.5) cm]. Fasten oﬀ.

FINISHING
Inner Ears (make 2).
With A and smaller hook, ch 4.
1st row: 5 dc in 4th ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. 2 dc in first sc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in last dc. Fasten oﬀ. Sew Inner Ears to Hat as shown in photo.

COWL
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first sc/split sc. With larger hook and MC, ch 78 (86). Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist chain.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. Place marker on last st at end of each rnd and move marker up on subsequent rnds.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 split sc in each st around. Join.
Rep 2nd rnd until work from beg measures 10 (12)" [25.5 (30.5) cm]. Fasten oﬀ.

FINISHING
Whiskers (make 6).
With white yarn and smaller hook, ch 15.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of ch. Fasten oﬀ.

Nose
With A and smaller hook, ch 4.
1st row: 5 dc in 4th ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc to end of row. Fasten oﬀ. Sew Whiskers and Nose to Hat as shown in photo.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream™ (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbl = Double crochet in back loop
measurements: One size to fit head circumference: 21" [53.5 cm].
gauge: 13 dc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Hat is worked using Tapestry crochet techniques. To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw loop in next color through 2 loops on hook to complete st and proceed in next color.
• Carry color not in use loosely across top of previous row and work color in use around it.
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
• Hat is worked from Top down, ending at the brim. The pattern ‘pinwheels’ in a counter-clockwise direction at top, and then transitions into a clockwise direction on the side.
• Join all rnds with sl st to top of ch 3.
TOP
With A, Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 9 dc in ring. Join. 10 dc.
2nd rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. *With B, 2 dc in next dc. With A, 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join. 20 dc. (5 groups of A and 5 groups of B).
3rd rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 1 dc in next dc. *With A, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. With A, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 2 dc. With B, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in last dc. Join. 30 dc.
4th rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. *With B, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. With A, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * to last 3 dc. With B, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Join. 40 dc.
5th rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *With B, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. With A, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * to last 4 dc. With B, 2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Join. 50 dc.
6th rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. *With B, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. With A, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. Rep from * to last 5 dc. With B, 2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. Join. 60 dc.
7th rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. *With B, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. With A, 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Rep from * to last 6 dc. With B, 2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Join. 70 dc.
SIDE
1st rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dcbl in each of next 5 dc. *With B, 1 dcbl in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dcbl in each of next 7 dc. Rep from * to last 8 dc. With B, 1 dcbl in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dcbl in last dc. Join.
2nd rnd: With A, working in both loops, ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. *With B, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Rep from * to last 9 dc. With B, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Join.
3rd rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *With B, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Rep from * to last 10 dc. With B, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dc in each of last 3 dc. Join.
4th rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. *With B, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Rep from * to last 11 dc. With B, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Join.
5th rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. *With B, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Rep from * to last 12 dc. With B, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dc in each of last 5 dc. Join.
6th rnd: With A, ch 3. *With B, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Rep from * to last 13 dc. With B, 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. With A, 1 dc in each of last 6 dc. Join.
BRIM
1st rnd: With B, ch 3. 1 dcbl in same sp as sl st. (1 dcbl in next dc. 2 dcbl in next dc) twice. 1 dcbl in next dc. (With B, 1 dcbl. With A, 1 dcbl) in next dc. *With A, (1 dcbl in next dc. 2 dcbl in next dc) 3 times, 1 dcbl in next dc. With B, (2 dcbl in next dc. 1 dcbl in next  dc) 3 times. (With B, 1 dcbl. With  A, 1 dcbl) in next dc. Rep from * to last 7 sts. (With A, 1 dcbl in next dc. 2 dcbl in next  dc) 3 times. 1 dcbl in next dc. Join. 105 dc.
2nd rnd:  With B, ch 3. Working in both loops,  1 dc in each dc to 1 st before color change. *With A, 1 dc in each dc to 1 st before color change. With B, 1 dc in each dc to 1 st before color change. Keeping cont of pinwheel pat, rep from * around. Join.
3rd rnd: With B, ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Keeping cont of pinwheel pat and beg with B, work each color section to 1 st before color change, inc as follows, using appropriate color: *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 2 dc. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Join. 140 dc.
4th rnd: With B, ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to 1 st before color change. *With A, work 1 dc in each dc to 1 st before color change. With B, work 1 dc in each dc to 1 st before color change. Rep from * around, ending with A. Join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: Caron® Colorama™ O’Go™ (6.4 oz/180 g; 228 yds/208 m) Lippy (68004) 1 O’Go
Sizes U.S. J/10 (6 mm) and U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 12 sts and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat with larger hook.
instructions:
Notes:
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull tie to remove.
• For this pattern, colors can be easily separated by gently pulling apart and cutting at the color transition. Each color is ready to use.

Stripe Pat
With D, work 4 rnds.
With A, work 2 rnds.
With C, work 4 rnds.
With A, work 2 rnds.
These 12 rnds form Stripe Pat.

HAT 
Ribbing: With E, ch 11.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. Rep last row until work from beg measures 21" [53.5 cm] when slightly stretched. Do not fasten off. Join last row and first row tog with 1 row of sc. Break E.

Change to larger hook and proceed as follows:
1st rnd: Join D with sl st to side edge at join. Ch 1. Working along side edge, work 64 sc evenly around. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending with ‘Ch 1. Skip next sc.’ Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd rnd: Sl st in last ch-1 sp just worked at end of last rnd. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ‘Ch 1. Skip next sc.’ Join with sl st to first sc.

First 3 rnds of Stripe Pat are complete. Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last rnd until 12 rnds of Stripe Pat are complete. Break A. Join B at end of last rnd.

Shape Crown: 1st rnd: With B, sl st in last ch-1 sp just worked at end of last rnd. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. (Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. Skip next [sc. Ch-1 sp. sc]. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Ch 1. Skip next [sc. Ch-1 sp. sc]. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ‘Skip next: sc, ch-1 sp and sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sts.
2nd rnd: Sl st in last ch-1 sp just worked at end of last rnd. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ‘Ch 1. Skip next sc.’ Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd rnd: Sl st in last ch-1 sp just worked at end of last rnd. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. *Ch 1. Skip next [sc. Ch-1. Sc]. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ‘1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc.’ Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts and pull up tightly. Fasten securely.

Pompom: Holding strands of A, B and C, wind yarn around 4 fingers approx 60 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to smooth round shape. Attach Pompom to top of Hat.

materials: RED HEART® Heads Up™: 1 ball each of 12 Black A and 779 Bright Pink B
abbreviations: A and B = Color A and Color B
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: Rounds 1–5 = 4¼” (11 cm) diameter. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With A, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Work 8 sc in ring; join with slip st in front loop of first sc—8 sc.
Note: Work first stitch of each round in same stitch as joining slip stitch unless otherwise instructed.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times; join with slip st first sc—24 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—32 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—40 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in first st, *skip next st, small-shell in next st, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around to last 3 sts, skip next st, small-shell in next st, skip last st; join with slip st in first sc—10 small-shells and 10 sc.
Round 7: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), 2 dc in same st as joining (first small-shell made), sc in center dc of next small-shell, *small-shell in next sc, sc in center dc of next small-shell; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 8: (Slip st, ch 1, sc) in next dc (center dc of first small-shell), large-shell in next sc, *sc in center dc of next small-shell, large-shell in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—10 large-shells and 10 sc.
Fasten off A.
Round 9: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in center dc of first large-shell, ch 1, sc in same dc, large-shell in next sc, *sc in center dc of next large-shell, large-shell in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off B.
Round 10: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in center dc of first large-shell, ch 1, sc in same dc, large-shell in next sc, *sc in center dc of next large-shell, large-shell in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off A.
Rounds 11 and 12: Repeat Rounds 9 and 10.
Round 13: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in center dc of first large-shell, ch 1, sc in same dc, sc in next dc, *hdc in next dc, dc in next sc, hdc in next dc, sc in next 3 dc; repeat from * around to last 4 sts, hdc in next dc, dc in next sc, hdc in next dc, sc in last dc; join with slip st in first sc—60 sts.
Rounds 14 and 15: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 16: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in same st as joining then skip this st, *ch 3, skip next sc, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around to last sc, ch 3, skip last sc; join with slip st in same st as joining—30 ch-3 spaces.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® (6 oz/170 g; 315 yds/288 m) Ocean (9759) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook).
measurements: Hat: One size to fit Adult. Cowl: Approx 20" [51 cm] around face x 23" [58.5 cm] around neck x 8" [20.5 cm] deep.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm]. 13 sts and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 2 does not count as st. 
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
COWL
Ribbing: Ch 8. 
**1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 7 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.**
Rep last row until Ribbing, without stretching, measures 20" [51 cm]. Do not fasten off. 
Set-up rnd: Turn work sideways. Ch 2. Work 64 hdc evenly across long side of ribbing. Join. PM for beg of rnd. 

Proceed in pat as follows:
1st and 2nd rnds: Ch 2. 1 dcbp around each st around. Join. 
3rd rnd: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 15 sts. 2 dc in next st) 4 times. Join. 68 dc.
4th and 5th rnds: As 1st and 2nd rnds. 
6th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 16 sts. 2 dc in next st) 4 times. Join. 72 dc.
7th and 8th rnds: As 1st and 2nd rnds. 
9th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 17 sts. 2 dc in next st) 4 times. Join. 76 dc.
10th and 11th rnds: As 1st and 2nd rnds. Fasten off. 
Bottom Ribbing: Rep from ** to ** as given for Ribbing. Rep last row until Bottom Ribbing, without stretching, measures 23" [58.5 cm]. Fasten off. Sew Bottom Ribbing to last rnd of Cowl. 
HAT
Ribbing: Ch 8. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 7 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Ribbing, when slightly stretched, measures 19½" [49.5 cm]. Do not fasten off. 
Set-up rnd: Turn work sideways. Ch 2. Work 64 hdc evenly across long side of ribbing. Join. PM for beg of rnd. 
Proceed in Ridged Pat as follows:
1st and 2nd rnds: Ch 2. 1 dcbp around each st around. Join. 
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. 68 dc.
Rep last 3 rnds for Ridged Pat until work from beg measures approx 6" [15 cm], ending on a 2nd rnd of pat.
Shape crown: 1st rnd: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of first 3 sts. *Skip next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last st. Skip last st. Join. 48 sts.
2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 2. 1 dcbp around each st around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of first 2 sts. *Skip next st. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to last st. Skip last st. Join. 32 sts.
5th and 6th rnds: As 2nd and 3rd rnds.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 1 dc in first st. *Skip next st. 1 dc in next st. Rep from * to last st. Skip last st. Join. 16 sts.
8th and 9th rnds: As 2nd and 3rd rnds. Fasten off at end of 9th rnd.
Thread end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely. 
FINISHING
Sew sides of Ribbing for Cowl and Hat. Sew Hat to Cowl at center back, overlapping ribbing of Cowl on top of Hat ribbing for 4" [10 cm].

materials: RED HEART® Shimmer®: 1 ball 1403 Pewter A
RED HEART® Boutique Ribbons®: 1½ yd (1.4 m) 1938 City B
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
dec (decrease) = [yarn over and draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 5 loop on hook.
measurements: Cloche fits most women. Finished Circumference: 22” (56 cm)
gauge: 11 sts = 4” (10 cm); 8 rounds = 4” (10 cm) in hdc
instructions:
Brim
Row 1 (Right Side): With A, ch 7; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 2 (does NOT count as a st), working in back loops, hdc in first sc and in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, working in back loops, hdc in first hdc and in each hdc across; turn.
Repeat Row 3 until brim is 22” (56 cm) long.
Crown
Ch 1, work 60 sc across one long edge; join with a slip st to first sc to form a circle. Place marker in first st of round. Do not join but work in continuous rounds, moving marker up each round.
Round 1: Hdc in first sc and in each sc around – 60 hdc.
Round 2: Hdc in first hdc and in each hdc around.
Repeat Round 2 until piece measures 4½” (11.4 cm) from lower edge.
Shape Crown
Next Round: [Hdc in 3 hdc, dec] 12 times – 48 hdc.
Work 2 rounds even.
Next Round: [Hdc in 2 hdc, dec] 12 times – 36 hdc.
Work 2 rounds even.
Next Round: [Hdc in hdc, dec] 12 times – 24 hdc.
Work 2 rounds even.
Next Round: [Dec] 12 times – 12 hdc.
Next Round: [Dec] 6 times; join with a slip st in next st – 6 hdc. Fasten off.
Weave yarn end through last 6 sts and draw top closed. Sew brim seam. Weave in loose ends.
Flower
Cut a 1½ yd (1.4 m) length of B. Thread a 12” (30.4 cm) piece of A on a yarn needle. Weave A through top holes of B, gathering gently and forming into layered circular ruffles. Knot to secure. Tack to hat.

instructions:
HAT
With A, ch 62.

Rounds 2-10: Ch 1, turn, (sc, hdc, dc) in first sc, *skip next dc and hdc, (sc, hdc, dc) in next sc; repeat from * across to last 3 sts, skip next dc and hdc, sc in sc. Do not fasten off.
Joining Row: With right sides together, fold Hat in half crosswise, turn to work along side edges, working through both layers along edges of rows, sc evenly spaced to Row 1. Do not fasten off.
Top Edge
Round 1: With wrong side facing, turn to work opposite foundation ch, ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), *hdc in sc, hdc in ch-2 space; repeat from * around, slip st in top of beginning ch to join – 40 hdc.

Joining Row: Flatten Hat and working through both layers, slip st across 20 sts to join top of Hat.

Band
Round 1: With right side facing, join B in seam on lower edge of Hat, ch 1, sc in each st around, slip st in first sc to join – 60 sts.

Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in each sc around, slip st in top of beginning ch.

Round 6: Ch 2, hdc in each st around, slip st in top of beginning ch.

Round 8: Ch 1, [sc in next 10 sc, ch 2, sc in same sc] around, slip st in first st.

Weave in ends.

USING THIS GUIDE Click on the underlined words throughout the pattern to access our library of helpful tools. NOTES • To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color. Carry color not in use carefully up wrong side of hat when next needed. • Chain (Ch) 2 at beginning (beg) of round (rnd) does not count as stitch (st). HAT With A, make a slip knot and place it on hook. Slip knot Make a loop with yarn and fold it on itself to make a pretzel shape. Then draw through to make slip knot. Chain 2 (Ch 2). *Yarn over hook (Yoh), draw through loop – 1 chain made. Repeat (rep) from * once more – 2 chains made. 1st rnd: 7 (8) single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook. Join with slip stitch (sl st) in first sc. You will have 7 sc in this rnd if you are making S/M size Hat and 8 sc in this rnd if you are making L/XL size Hat.
