Join with sl st in first hdc. 14 (16) hdc. 3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in next hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc) 6 (7) times. Join with sl st in first hdc. 21 (24) hdc. 4th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc) 6 (7) times. Join with sl st in first hdc. 28 (32) hdc. 5th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc) 6 (7) times. Join with sl st in first hdc. 35 (40) hdc. 6th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc) 6 (7) times. Join with sl st in first hdc. 42 (48) hdc. 7th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc) 6 (7) times. Join with sl st in first hdc. 49 (56) hdc. 8th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc) 6 (7) times. Join with sl st in first hdc. 56 (64) hdc. Next 1 (2) rnd(s): Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in first hdc. Join B at end of last rnd. Next 2 rnds: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in top of first hdc. Join A at end of last rnd. Next 3 rnds: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in first hdc. Next rnd [increase (inc) rnd]: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc) 13 (15) times. Join with sl st in first hdc. Join B. 70 (80) hdc. Next 2 rnds: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in top of first hdc. Join A at end of last rnd. Next 4 rnds: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in top of first hdc. Join B at end of last rnd. Next 2 rnds: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in top of first hdc. Join A at end of last rnd. Next 4 rnds: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in top of first hdc. Join B at end of last rnd. Size S/M only: Next 4 rnds: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in first hdc. Size L/XL only: Next 2 rnds: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in first hdc. Next 2 rnds: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in top of first hdc. Join B at end of last rnd. Next 2 rnds: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in first hdc. Both sizes: Fasten off. To fasten off yarn, cut yarn leaving a long tail. Pull end through loop on hook and pull gently to tighten. FINISHING Using yarn needle, Weave in all yarn tails. We love seeing your makes! abbreviations: Fphdc (front post half double crochet): Yarn over, insert hook from front to back then to front, going around post of indicated st, draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through all loops on hook. Skip st behind Fphdc.
Fphdc2tog: [Yarn over, insert hook from front to back then to front, going around post of next st, draw up a loop] 2 times, yarn over and draw through all loops on hook.

Hdc in Third Loop: Skip top two loops of next hdc of previous row, yarn over, insert hook in third horizontal loop at back of work that corresponds to skipped st and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through all loops on hook.

hdc2tog in Third Loop: [Skip top two loops of next hdc of previous row, yarn over, insert hook in third horizontal loop at back of work that corresponds to skipped st and draw up a loop] 2 times, yarn over and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Hat circumference at bottom edge: 20 (22) [51 (56) cm]
gauge: 11 sc = 4" [10 cm]; 14 rows = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet working in back loops only. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Brim
Ch 9 (10).
Row 1: Sc in 2nd st from hook, sc in each ch to end of row – 8 (9) sts. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each stitch across – 8 (9) sts.
Row 3: Repeat Row 2 until 54 (58) rows have been completed. 
Joining Row: Ch 1, turn, fold piece in half, lining up sts of foundation ch and last row, working through both layers, slip st across to join first and last rows to form a loop. 
Body
Round 1: Ch 1, working along long edge of Brim, hdc 56 (60 sts) evenly spaced around, slip st in first hdc to join – 56 (60) sts.
Round 2: Ch 1, hdc in third loop in each st around, slip st in first st – 56 (60) sts.
Round 3: Ch 1, Fphdc around each of next 2 sts, hdc in third loop of next 2 sts, *Fphdc around each of next 2 sts, hdc in third loop of next 2 sts; repeat from * around, slip st in first Fphdc – 56 (60) sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, hdc in third loop in next 2 sts, Fphdc around each of next 2 sts, *hdc in third loop of next 2 sts, Fphdc around each of next 2 hdc; repeat from * around, slip st in first hdc. 
Rounds 5-20: Repeat Rounds 3 and 4.
Shape Crown
Round 21: Ch 1, Fphdc2tog, hdc2tog in third loop, *Fphdc2tog, hdc2tog in third loop; repeat from * around, slip st in first Fphdc2tog – 28 (30) sts.
Round 22: Ch 1, hdc in each st around, slip st in first hdc. 
Fasten off. Cut yarn, leaving a long tail. 
Weave tail in and out of every st around and pull tight to gather. Secure end.

Weave in ends.

Size U.S. K/101/2 (6.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 10 hdc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Note: This project is worked top-down in the round. The right side of the work is always facing.

SPECIAL ABBREVIATIONS
Inc (Increase): Work 2 half-double crochet in stitch or sp indicated.
FPhdc (Front-post half double crochet): Work a half-double crochet around the front of the post of the stitch indicated.
BPhdc (Back-post half double crochet): Work a half-double crochet around the back of the post of the stitch indicated.

HAT
Crown
Make an adjustable ring as follows: Wrap yarn around your finger with the yarn tail to the left and under the working yarn. Insert hook through the circle from front to back. Yarn over using the working yarn and pull through loop; ch 1, release circle around finger gently.

1st rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), 9 hdc into adjustable ring, sl st to first hdc to join rnd; tighten yarn tail to close the ring – 10 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2, hdc in first sp (counts as inc), inc in each sp between each hdc around; sl st to first hdc to join rnd – 20 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2, hdc in sp between each st around; sl st to first hdc to join rnd.
4th rnd: Ch 2, hdc in first sp (counts as inc), hdc in next sp, *inc in next sp, hdc in next sp; repeat from * around; sl st to first hdc to join rnd – 30 hdc.
5th rnd: Rep 3rd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 2, hdc in first sp (counts as inc), hdc in next 2 sps, *inc in next sp, hdc in next 2 sps; repeat from * around; sl st to first hdc to join rnd–40 hdc.
7th rnd: Rep 3rd rnd.

Size S only: 
8th rnd: Ch 2, hdc in first sp (counts as inc), hdc in next 7 sps, *inc in next sp, hdc in next 7 sps; repeat from * around; sl st to first hdc to join rnd–45 hdc.
9th rnd: Ch 2, hdc in first sp (counts as inc), hdc in each sp around; sl st to first hdc to join rnd – 46 hdc.

Size M Only: 
8th rnd: Ch 2, hdc in first sp (counts as inc), hdc in next 3 sps, *inc in next sp, hdc in next 3 sps; repeat from * around; sl st to first hdc to join rnd–50 sts.
9th rnd: Rep 3rd rnd.

All Sizes: Rep 3rd rnd 8 (11) times more.

Brim
1st rnd: Ch 2 (counts as BPhdc), FPhdc in next st, *BPhdc in next st, FPhdc in next st; repeat from * around; sl st to first st to join rnd.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (counts as BPhdc), FPhdc in next FPhdc, *BPhdc in next BPhdc, FPhdc in next FPhdc; repeat from * around; sl st to first st to join rnd.
3rd rnd: Rep 2nd rnd. Fasten off. Break yarn, leaving a 6" (15 cm) tail.

FINISHING
With yarn needle, weave in yarn ends. Block as desired.

instructions:
Note: When working from chart, carry yarn not in use loosely across top of work. Work next row over strand of yarn which is not in use. Do not join at ends of rnds unless otherwise stated. Cont working in spiral placing marker on first st of rnd for easier counting.
Ribbing: With A and larger hook, ch 11.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg, when slightly stretched, measures 19½" [49.5 cm].** Do not fasten off.
Change to smaller hook and proceed as follows:
Set-up rnd: Ch 1. Work 80 sc across longer side of ribbing. Do not join. PM for beg of rnd.
Cont working in spiral as follows: Beg working Chart, noting 2-st rep will be worked 40 times, reading rnds from right to left.
1st rnd: 1 splsc in each sc around.
Rep last rnd, and cont working Chart until Rnd 28 of Chart is complete.
Break all colors but B.
Shape crown: 1st rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 6 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 70 sts.
2nd and alt rnds: 1 splsc in each sc around.
3rd rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 5 sts. Sc2togspl. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sts.
5th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 4 sts. Sc2togspl. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sts.
7th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2togspl. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.
9th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2togspl. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
11 rnd: *1 splsc in next st. Sc2togspl. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sts.
Break yarn, leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely. Sew ends of ribbing together.

instructions:
INSTRUCTIONS
Note: Hat is worked from the top down.
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd and alt rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.

Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 7 (8-9)" [18 (20.5-23) cm].

1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 14 (16-18) sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.

Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 0 (1-2) st(s). Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 0 (1-2) st(s). Sc2tog. Turn. 3 (5-7) sts.

Attach Muzzle to front of Hat as shown in picture, having Teeth between Muzzle and Hat edge. Sew Eyes above Muzzle. With Black yarn, embroider nostrils. Sew Spikes down center back of Hat.
Size 6/8 only: Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. 3 sts.
Size 10/12 only: Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Sc3tog. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.
All sizes: Fasten off.
With RS facing, skip next 8 (8-11) unworked sc. Join MC with sl st to next st. Ch 1. Work from ** to ** as given for First Earflap.
Muzzle

20 (24-25) sc.

Ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.

Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times; join with slip st first sc—24 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—32 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—40 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in each st around.
Round 7: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc.
Round 8: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in next 2 sts, skip next 2 sts, shell in next st, *skip next 2 sts, dc in next 3 sts, skip next 2 sts, shell in next st; repeat from * around to last 2 sts, skip last 2 sts; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—6 shells and 18 dc.
Round 9: Ch 1 (elongate this first loop slightly here and throughout), Fpdc around beginning ch-3, FPdc around each of next 2 dc, shell in center dc of next shell, *Fpdc around each of next 3 dc, shell in center dc of next shell; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first Fpdc—6 shells and 18 Fpdc.
Rounds 10 and 11: Ch 1, Fpdc around each of first 3 Fpdc, shell in center dc of next shell, *Fpdc around each of next 3 Fpdc, shell in center dc of next shell; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first Fpdc.
Round 12: Ch 1, Fpdc around each of first 3 Fpdc, ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next dc, slip st in next 3 dc, sc in next dc, *ch 1, skip next dc, Fpdc around each of next 3 Fpdc, ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next dc, slip st in next 3 dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * around to last dc, ch 1, skip last dc; join with slip st in first Fpdc—18 slip sts, 12 sc, 12 ch-1 spaces, and 18 Fpdc.
Round 13: Ch 1, Fpdc around each of first 3 Fpdc, ch 1, skip next ch-1 space, sc in next 5 sts, *ch 1, skip next ch-1 space, Fpdc around each of next 3 Fpdc, ch 1, skip next ch-1 space, sc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around to last ch-1 space, ch 1, skip last ch-1 space; join with slip st in first Fpdc—30 sc, 12 ch-1 spaces, and 18 Fpdc.
Round 14: Ch 3, dc in each st and ch-1 space around—60 sts.
Round 15: Ch 1, sc in each dc around; join with slip st in first sc, TURN.
Folded Brim
Round 16 (wrong side): Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st around; join with slip st in back loop of first sc.
Round 17: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st around; join with slip st in both loops of first sc.
Round 18: Ch 1, (sc, ch 2, sc) in first sc, *skip next sc, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next sc; repeat from * around to last sc, skip last sc; join with slip st in first sc—30 (sc, ch 2, sc) scallops.
Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Fold brim up.
Special Stitches
Fpdc (Front post double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from front side of work to back and to front again around post of indicated stitch; yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice.
shell = Work 7 dc in indicated stitch.
Notes
1. To make a smaller hat, use a hook one size smaller. To make a larger hat, use a hook one size larger.
2. Hat is worked in joined rounds, beginning at top of hat. Join but do not turn rounds unless otherwise instructed. The join serves as back seam of hat.

instructions:

Round 9: Ch 1, 2 sc in same sc as joining, 2 sc in next sc, Fphdc around post of next dc, [2 sc in each of next 2 sc, Fphdc around post of next dc] 7 times; join – 40 sts.

Round 12 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, *ch 1, skip Fphdc **, sc in next 5 (7, 7, 7) sc; repeat from * to last 4 (6, 6, 6) sc, end at **; sc in last 4 (6, 6, 6) sc; join; TURN.
Round 13 (Right Side): Ch 1, 1 (1, 1, 2) sc in same sc as joining, sc in next 4 (6, 6, 5) sc, [2 sc in next sc] 0 (0, 0, 1) time, Fphdc around next Fphdc 2 rows below, * 1 (1, 1, 2) sc in next sc, sc in next 4 (6, 6, 5) sc, [2 sc in next sc] 0 (0, 0, 1) time, Fphdc around next Fphdc 2 rows below; repeat from * around; join; TURN – 48 (64, 64, 80) sts.
Baby (Child, Adult) Only: Repeat Rounds 12 and 13 until 6 (7, 8,)” from beginning, end Round 13; do NOT turn.
Large Adult Only-Round 14: Ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, * ch 1, skip Fphdc **, sc in next 9 sc; repeat from * to last 8 sc, end at **; sc in last 8 sc; join; TURN.
Round 15: Ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, sc in next 8 sc, Fphdc around next Fphdc 2 rows below, [sc in next 9 sc, Fphdc around next Fphdc 2 rows below] 7 times; join; TURN.

instructions:
USING THIS GUIDE
Click on the underlined words throughout the pattern to access our library of helpful tools.
NOTES
• When changing colors, work hdc to last 3 loops on hook. Draw new color through last 3 loops on hook and proceed in new color, keeping color change to WS of work.
• Carry color not in use along top of last row and work new sts around carried color.
• Ch 1 at beg of rnds does not count as hdc.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first hdc at end of rnd.

CROWN
With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to make ring. See diagram on page 6.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 hdc in ring. Join with sl st to first hdc. 10 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. *With Color 2, 2 hdc in next hdc. With Color 1, 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. With Color 2, 2 hdc in last hdc. Join Color 1 with sl st to first hdc. 20 hdc.
3rd rnd: With Color 1, ch 1. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 2 hdc in next hdc. *With Color 2, 1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc.** With Color 1, 1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 3 times, then from * to ** once more. Join Color 1 with sl st to first hdc. 30 hdc.
4th rnd: With Color 1, ch 1. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. *With Color 2, 1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc.** With Color 1, 1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 3 times, then from * to ** once more. Join Color 1 with sl st to first hdc. 40 hdc.
5th rnd: With Color 1, ch 1. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. *With Color 2, 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc.** With Color 1, 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * 3 times, then * to ** once more. Join Color 1 with sl st to first hdc. 50 hdc.
6th rnd: With Color 1, ch 1. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. *With Color 2, 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc.** With Color 1, 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Rep from * 3 times, then from * to ** once more. Join Color 2 with sl st to first hdc. 60 hdc.

Proceed in Check Pat as follows:
7th to 10th rnds: With Color 2, ch 1. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. *With Color 1, 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. With Color 2, 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc.** Rep from * 3 times, then from * to ** once more. Join Color 2 with sl st to first hdc at end of 7th to 9th rnds. Join Color 1 with sl st to first hdc at end of 10th rnd.
11th to 14th rnds: With Color 1, ch 1. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. *With Color 2, 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc.** With Color 1, 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. Rep from * 3 times, then from * to ** once more. Join Color 1 with sl st to first hdc at end of 11th to 13th rnds. Join Color 2 with sl st to first hdc at end of 14th rnd.

BRIM
15th rnd: With Color 2, working in back loops only, ch 1. 1 hdcbl in same sp as sl st. 1 hdcbl in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdcbl in next hdc. 1 hdcbl in each of next 2 hdc. *With Color 1, 1 hdcbl in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdcbl in next hdc. 1 hdcbl in each of next 2 hdc.** With Color 2, 1 hdcbl in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdcbl in next hdc. 1 hdcbl in each of next 2 hdc. Rep from * 3 times, then from * to ** once more. Join Color 2 with sl st to first hdc. 70 hdc.
16th rnd: With Color 2, ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. *With Color 1, 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc.** With Color 2, 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * 3 times, then from * to ** once more. Join Color 2 with sl st to first hdc. 80 hdc.
17th rnd: With Color 2, ch 1. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. *With Color 1, 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc.** With Color 2, 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * 3 times, then from * to ** once more. Join Color 2 with sl st to first hdc. 90 hdc.
18th rnd: With Color 2, ch 1. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. *With Color 1, 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc.** With Color 2, 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * 3 times, then from * to ** once more. Join Color 2 with sl st to first hdc. 100 hdc.
19th rnd: With Color 2, ch 1. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. *With Color 1, 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc.** With Color 2, 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * 3 times, then from * to ** once more. Join Color 2 with sl st to first hdc. 110 hdc.
20th rnd: With Color 2 only, ch 1. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 10 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 
Break Color 2.
21st rnd: With Color 1, sl st in each hdc around. Join with sl st in first sl st.

gauge: 10 sts = 4" (10 cm); 8 rows = 4" (10 cm) in crossed sc with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Brim
With smaller hook, ch 9.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 8 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in blo in each st across, turn. Repeat Row 2 forty-six (forty-eight) more times. Bring short ends of Brim together. Sc across short ends, stitching through both ends at the same time to seam. Do not fasten off.
Body
Change to larger hook.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each Brim row end around; join with a slip st to first sc, turn – 48 (50) sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, *skip next sc, sc in next sc, sc in previous skipped sc; repeat from * around, join with a slip st to 1st sc, turn.
Repeat Round 2 until hat measures 7" (17.75 cm) long.
Crown Decreases
Round 1: Ch 1, *sc2tog, [skip next sc, sc in next sc, sc in previous skipped sc] two (three) times, sc2tog; repeat from * around, join with a slip st to 1st sc, turn – 12 (10) sts dec, 36 (40) sts total.

materials: RED HEART® Boutique™ “Eclipse™”: 1 Ball each 9329 Trail A and 9251 Sunset B.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 12 dc = 4”; 8 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
With A, ch 6, slip st in first chain to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1 (counts as sc here and throughout), work 
11 sc in ring, slip st in first st to join – 12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc 
in same space, 2 dc in each sc around, slip st in top of 
beginning ch to join – 24 dc. 
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each dc around, slip st in beginning 
ch – 24 sc. 
Round 4: Ch 1, [ch 5, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc] 7 times, 
ch 5, skip last 2 sc, slip st in beginning ch – 8 ch-5 spaces. 
Round 5: Ch 1, [(hdc, 6 dc, hdc) in next ch-5 space, sc in 
next sc] 7 times, (hdc, 6 dc, hdc) in last ch-5 space, slip st 
in beginning ch. 
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in each hdc, dc and sc around, slip st 
in top of beginning ch – 72 dc.
Round 7: Ch 3, dc in each dc around, slip st in top of 
beginning ch.
Round 8: Ch 3, dc in same space, [dc in next 5 dc, 2 dc in 
next dc] 11 times, dc in last 5 dc, slip st in top of beginning 
ch – 84 dc. 
Round 9: Ch 4 (counts as tr here and throughout), tr in 
each dc around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 10: Ch 4, tr in each tr around, slip st in top of 
beginning ch.
Round 11: Ch 3, skip next tr, [dc in next 5 tr, skip next tr] 13 
times, dc in last 4 tr, slip st in top of beginning ch – 70 dc.
Rounds 12-13: Ch 3, dc in each dc around, slip st in top of 
beginning ch.
Round 14: Ch 3, [dc in next 13 dc, skip next dc] 4 times, 
dc in last 12 dc, slip st in top of beginning ch – 66 sts.
Round 15: Ch 3, dc in each dc around, slip st in top of 
beginning ch.
Round 16: Change to B, ch 1, sc in each dc around, slip 
st in beginning ch. 
Round 17: Work in continuous rounds. Place marker for 
beginning of round. [Dc in next sc, sc in next sc] around.
Round 18: Sc in each st around. 
Round 19: [Sc in next 10 sc, skip next sc] around, slip st 
in first st – 55 sts. 
Fasten off.
Turn Hat inside out.
FINISHING
Top Stitching
With right side facing and holding Hat upside down and 
working from right to left, join B and slip st in first st 
between Rounds 13 and 14, ch 1, slip st in each st around 
to first st, slip st across rounds to first st between Rounds 
10 and 11, slip st in each st around to first st, slip st across 
rounds to first st between Rounds 7 and 8, slip st in each 
st around to first st, slip st to first st to join. 
Fasten off. 
Brim
Mark 22 sts at front of Hat. 
Row 1: With right side facing, join B in first marked st, slip 
st around post of marked 22 sts.
Rows 2-6: Ch 2, turn, sc in each st across.
Last Round: Join A and working with A and B held 
together, ch 2, turn, sc in each sc across Brim, sc evenly 
spaced along edge of Brim, sc in each st around last round 
of Hat, sc evenly spaced along edge of Brim, slip st in first 
st to join. 
Fasten off. 
Weave in ends.

instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written thus ( ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes.

Ribbing: With MC, ch 7 (8-8).
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 6 (7-7) sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 63 (71-75) times more.

Rep last rnd until Hat from lower edge measures 7½ (8-8½)" [19 (20.5-21.5) cm], ending on a WS rnd.

2nd rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
3rd rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each next 5 (4-4) sc. Rep from * to last 5 (4-7) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 3 (2-5) sc. Join. Turn. 48 (55-58) sc.
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 (3-3) sc. Rep from * to last 5 (4-2) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 3 (2-0) sc. Join. Turn. 40 (44-46) sc.
6th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
7th rnd: (RS). Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 20 (22-23) sc. Fasten off leaving a long end. Weave end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.
Pompom: Wind A around 4 fingers 100 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Hat.

instructions:

instructions:
HAT
With larger hook and B, ch 44 (52, 56); join with a slip st to first ch, making sure ch is not twisted.

LADYBUG
Body
With smaller hook and A, ch 4.
Row 1 (Right Side): Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc; turn – 12 sc.
Rows 3-7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, changing to B in last sc; turn.
Rows 9-10: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 11: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 6 times; turn – 6 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, draw up a loop in each of next 6 sc, yo and draw through all 7 loops on hook.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
Wings (Make 2)
With smaller hook and A, ch 4.

Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc across; turn – 12 sc.
Rows 3-7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 8: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 6 times; turn – 6 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, draw up a loop in each of next 3 sc, yo and draw through all 4 loops on hook.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
Legs (Make 3)
With smaller hook and B, ch 24.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
FINISHING
Sew body seam, filling body with fiberfill. With yarn needle and B, embroider a line of chain stitches down back of body and French knot spots on wings. Sew legs across bottom of body so that they evenly extend on each side. Sew wings to back of body. Glue wiggle eyes. Sew Ladybug to center top of hat. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 1 ball 1505 Peacock
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5.5mm [US I-9] (for single crochet sections) and 6.5mm [US K-10.5] (for texture pattern sections)
Stitch marker, pompom maker, Yarn needle.
abbreviations: ( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Finished Circumference: 20 (22)” (51 (56) cm), Finished Height: 11” (28 cm)
gauge: 12 sts = 4” (10 cm); 13 rounds = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet with smaller hook. 10 sts = 4” (10 cm); 10 rounds = 4” (10 cm) in texture pattern with larger hook.
instructions:
HAT
With smaller hook, make an adjustable ring. 
Note: If preferred, a beginning ring can be 
made as follows: With smaller hook, ch 4; join 
with slip st in first ch.
First Single Crochet Section
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join 
with slip st in first sc—8 sc. Place a marker 
in the last sc made. Move marker up as each 
round is completed.
Note: Work first stitch of every round in the 
same stitch as joining.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join 
with slip st in first sc—16 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, *sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; 
repeat from * around; join with slip st in first 
hsc—24 sc.
Size Small Only
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with 
slip st in first sc, TURN.
Size Large Only
Round 4: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next 
st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in 
first sc, TURN—32 sts.
Both Sizes
First Texture Pattern Section
Change to larger hook. 
Round 5 (wrong side): Ch 1, *hdc in next st, 
slip st in next st; repeat from * around; do not 
join—24 (32) sts.
Directions are for size Small. Changes for 
size Large are in parentheses
Finished Circumference: 20 (22)” (51 (56) cm)
Finished Height: 11” (28 cm)
Special Technique
Adjustable-ring = Wrap yarn into a ring, 
ensuring that the tail falls behind the working 
yarn. Grip ring and tail between middle finger 
and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, 
yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a 
loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring. 
After the first round of stitches is worked, pull 
gently on tail to tighten ring.
Notes
1. Hat is worked in rounds beginning at 
top of hat. Sections of single crochet are 
alternated with sections of a texture pattern 
created with half double crochet and slip 
stitches. In single crochet sections, the last 
stitch of each round is joined to the first 
stitch with a slip stitch. In texture pattern 
sections, only the first and last rounds are 
joined. Pay careful attention to instructions 
to know when to join and when not.
2. The texture pattern is created by working 
half double crochet stitches into the slip 
stitches and slip stitches into the half 
double crochet stitches of the previous 
round. When working increase rounds not 
all half double crochet stitches are worked 
into slip stitches and not all slip stitches are 
worked into half double crochet stitches, 
but half double crochet stitches are always 
alternated with slip stitches.
3. Only turn rounds when instructed to do 
so. Single crochet sections are worked 
with right side facing, and texture pattern 
sections are worked with wrong side facing.
Size Small Only
Round 6: *Slip st in next st, hdc in next st, 
(slip st, hdc) in next st; repeat from * around; 
do not join—32 sts.
Size Large Only
Round 6: *Slip st in next st, hdc in next st, slip 
st in next st, (hdc, slip st) in next st, hdc in 
next st, slip st in next st, hdc in next st, (slip st, 
hdc) in next st; repeat from * around; do not 
join—40 sts.
Both Sizes
Round 7: *Hdc in next st, slip st in next st; 
repeat from * around; do not join—32 (40) sts.
Round 8: *Slip st in next st, hdc in next st; 
repeat from * around; do not join.
Round 9: *Hdc in next st, slip st in next st; 
repeat from * around; join with slip st in first 
hdc, TURN.
Second Single Crochet Section
Change to smaller hook.
Round 10 (right side): Ch 1, sc in each st 
around; join with slip st in first sc—32 (40) sts.
Round 11: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 (4) sts, 2 sc in 
next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st 
in first sc—40 (48) sts.
Round 12: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join 
with slip st in first sc.
Round 13: Ch 1, *sc in next 4 (5) sts, 2 sc in 
next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st 
in first sc—48 (56) sts.
Rounds 14 and 15: Ch 1, sc in each st around; 
join with slip st in first sc, TURN.
Second Texture Pattern Section
Change to larger hook.
Round 16 (wrong side): Ch 1, *hdc in next st, 
slip st in next st; repeat from * around; do not 
join.
Round 17: *Slip st in next st, hdc in next st; 
repeat from * around; do not join.
Size Small Only
Round 18: *Hdc in next st, [slip st in next st, 
hdc in next st] twice, (slip st, hdc) in next st, 
slip st in next st, [hdc in next st, slip st in next 
st] twice, (hdc, slip st) in next st; repeat from * 
around; do not join—56 sts.
Size Large Only
Round 18: *[Hdc in next st, slip st in next st] 
3 times, (hdc, slip st) in next st; repeat from * 
around; do not join—64 sts.
Both Sizes
Round 19: *Slip st in next st, hdc in next st; 
repeat from * around; do not join—56 (64) sts.
Round 20: *Hdc in next st, slip st in next st; 
repeat from * around; join with slip st in first 
hdc, TURN.
Third Single Crochet Section
Change to smaller hook.
Rounds 21–24 (right side): Ch 1, sc in each 
st around; join with slip st in first sc. TURN at 
end of Round 24.
Third Texture Pattern Section
Change to larger hook.
Round 25 (wrong side): Ch 1, *hdc in next st, 
slip st in next st; repeat from * around; do not 
join.
Round 26: *Slip st in next st, hdc in next st; 
repeat from * around; do not join.
Round 27: *Hdc in next st, slip st in next st; 
repeat from * around; do not join.
Round 28: Repeat Round 26.
Round 29: *Hdc in next st, slip st in next st; 
repeat from * around; join with slip st in first 
hdc, TURN.
Fourth Single Crochet and Texture 
Pattern Sections
Work same as Third Single Crochet and 
Texture Pattern Sections.
FINISHING
Pompom
Following manufacturer instructions, make a 
pompom of any size you prefer. Tie pompom 
to top of hat. 
Weave in ends.

Notes: 
•   To join new color, work to last 2 loops on hook. Draw new color through last 2 loops then proceed with new color.
•   Carry colour when not in use loosely across top of previous rnd and work sts around it to prevent stranding.
Version A
With MC and smaller hook, ch 66. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist chain.
1st rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). 1 hdc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 66 hdc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in next hdc. d cfp around next st. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
Rep last rnd twice more. 
Next rnd: Ch 2. *(1 hdc in next hdc. dcfp around next st. 1 hdc in next hdc) 10 times. 2 hdc in next hdc. dcfp around next st. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * once more. Join with sl st to first hdc. 68 sts.
Change to larger hook and proceed in pat as follows:
1st rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: *With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. With a, 1 long sc in next st 1 row below. Miss next sc (behind long sc just worked). 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
3rd rnd: With a, ch 1. 1 sc in in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
4th rnd: *With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. With a, 1 sc in next sc. With MC, 1 long sc in next sc 1 row below. Miss next sc (behind long sc just worked). 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last 4 rnds, substituting B for a. 
Rep last 4 rnds, substituting C for a. 
Rep last 4 rnds, substituting D for a. 
Rep last 4 rnds, substituting C for a. 
Rep last 4 rnds, substituting B for a. 
Rep last 4 rnds. 
**Shape top: 1st rnd: Ch 1. (With B, sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. sc2tog) 4 times. 60 sts. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *With B, ch 1.  sc2tog. (With B, 1 sc in next sc. With MC, 1 long sc in next sc 1 row below. Miss next sc (behind long sc just worked). 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) twice. With B, 1 sc in next sc. With MC, 1 long sc in next sc 1 row below. Miss next sc (behind long sc just worked). 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * 3 times more. 52 sts. Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (With MC, sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. sc2tog) 4 times. 44 sts. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *With B, sc2tog. With MC, 1 sc in next sc. With B, 1 long sc 1 row below. Miss next sc (behind long sc just worked). 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With MC, 1 sc in next sc. With B, 1 long sc 1 row below. Miss next sc (behind long sc just worked). 1 sc in next sc. With B, draw up a loop in next sc 1 row below. Miss next sc. Draw up a loop in next sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – st2tog made. Rep from * 3 times more. 36 sts. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (With C, sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. sc2tog) 4 times. 28 sts. Join with sl st to first sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (With C, sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. sc2tog) 4 times. 20 sts. Join with sl st to first sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. (With C, sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. sc2tog) 4 times. 12 sts. Join with sl st to first sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. With C, (sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sts. Join with sl st to first sc.**
Version B
With B and smaller hook, ch 68. Join with sl st to first chain to form a ring, taking care not to twist chain.
1st rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). 1 hdc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 68 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in next hdc. d cfp around next st. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around.
Change to larger hook and proceed in pat as follows:
1st rnd: With B, 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: *With B, 1 sc in first sc. With a, 1 long sc in next st 1 row below. Miss next sc (behind long sc just worked). 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd rnd: With a, 1 sc in in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: *With B, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With a, 1 sc in next sc. With B, 1 long sc in next sc 1 row below. Miss next sc (behind long sc just worked). Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last 4 rnds of pat until work from beg measures approx 5" [12.5 cm], ending on a 4th row of pat.
Shape top: Cont changing colors as before, work from ** to ** as given for Version A.

materials: Bernat® Softee® Baby Chunky™ (5 oz/140 g; 155 yds/142 m) Main Color (MC) Teddy Brown (96016) 1 ball
Bernat® Pipsqueak™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 101 yds/92 m) Contrast A Vanilla (59008) 1 ball
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: To fit baby head sizes 6-12 (18-24) months.
gauge: Bernat® Softee® Baby Chunky™: 10 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm]. Bernat® Pipsqueak™: 9 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
The instructions are written for smaller size. If changes are necessary for larger size the instructions will be written thus ( ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to both sizes. Note: Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc. With MC, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 3. 11 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 12 dc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 2 dc in each dc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 24 dc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 3. *2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around, omitting final dc in last rep. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 36 dc. 
Size 6-12 mos only: Next rnd: Ch 3. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around, omitting final dc in last rep. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 45 dc. 
Size 18-24 mos only: Next rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 48 dc. 
Both sizes: Next rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 45 (48) dc. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 6 (7)" [15 (18) cm]. 
Earflaps 
Right Earflap: 1st row: Sl st in each of next 5 sts. Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 
**2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn. 
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Turn. 
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Fasten off.**
Left Earflap 
Skip next 15 (18) sts after Right Earflap. Join MC with sl st to next st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. Work from ** to ** as given for Right Earflap. 
Earflap Edging: With RS facing, join A with sl st at top corner of Earflap. Ch 1 and work 28 sc evenly around sides and bottom of each Earflap. Fasten off. 
Front Flap 
With RS facing, join A with sl st in first skipped st at center front between Earflaps. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 14 (17) sc. Turn. 
1st to 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn. 
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 
5th row: As 1st row. 
Rep 4th and 5th rows twice more. 9 (12) sc rem. Fasten off. 
Fold Front Flap up and tack to body of Hat as shown in photo. 
Ties (make 2). 
Ch 21. 
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each ch to end of ch. Fasten off. 
Attach ties to bottom of each Earflap as shown in photo.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 (1, 2, 2) ball(s) 9940 Light Grey Heather A and 1 ball 9770 Rose Blush B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Snood fits 11 (13½, 16½, 19½)” (28 [33, 42, 49.5] cm) circumference around neck.
gauge: 12 sc = 4” (10 cm); 15 rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Notes
1. Neckband and hood are one piece worked back and forth in turned rows. Antlers and ears are worked separately and sewn to hood.
2. Antlers and Rounds 1–3 of antler branches are worked in continuous (spiral) rounds. Do not turn or join at end of rounds unless instructed. Place marker on first stitch and move up as each round is completed.
SNOOD
Neckband
Leaving a long tail for sewing, with A, ch 10 (13, 16, 19).
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—9 (12, 15, 18) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st across, turn.
Rows 3–32 (40, 50, 58): Repeat Row 2; do not turn at end of last row.
Hood
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, working in ends of rows, sc in each row across, turn—32 (40, 50, 58) sc.
Rows 2–12 (16, 21, 25): Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 13 (17, 22, 26): Ch 1, sc in first 14 (18, 23, 27) sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in each remaining st across, turn—30 (38, 48, 56) sc.
Row 14 (18, 23, 27): Ch 1, sc in first 13 (17, 22, 26) sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in each remaining st across, turn—28 (36, 46, 54) sc.
Row 15 (19, 24, 28): Ch 1, sc in first 12 (16, 21, 25) sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in each remaining st across, turn—26 (34, 44, 52) sc.
Row 16 (20, 25, 29): Ch 1, sc in first 11 (15, 20, 24) sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in each remaining st across—24 (32, 42, 50) sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Assembly
Fold last row together to form top of hood. With end tail and working through both thicknesses, whipstitch sts of last row together. With beginning tail, whipstitch first and last rows of neckband together.
Edging
With right side of hood facing and working in ends of rows, join A with sc in Row 1, work 31 (39, 49, 57) sc evenly around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Antler (make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place stitch marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed. Stuff lightly with fiberfill as you go.
Round 2: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around—9 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each st around.
Repeat Round 3 until antler measures 4” (10 cm) or desired length. At end of last round, join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Antler Branch
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work same as Round 1 of antler—6 sc.
Rounds 2 and 3: Work same as Round 3 of antler—9 sc.
Note: Continue in turned rows.
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—4 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice—2 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Referring to photograph as a guide, sew open end of antler branch to side edge of antler.
Ear (make 2)
Inner ear
With B, ch 16 (16, 20, 20).
Row 1 (right side): Dc in 4th ch from hook (skipped 3 ch count as first dc), dc in next 8 (8, 12, 12) ch, hdc in next 2 ch, sc in next ch, 3 sc in last ch; working in opposite side of foundation ch, skip first ch, sc in next 1 (2) ch, hdc in next 2 (1) ch, dc in next 9 (9, 13, 13) ch, dc in first ch of beginning ch-3, turn—29 (29, 37, 37) sts.
Sizes Extra-Small and Small only:
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 14 sts, 3 sc in next st, sc in each st across to beginning ch-3, sc in top of beginning ch—31 (31) sc. Fasten off.
Sizes Medium and Large only:
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in next 15 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, (hdc, dc, hdc) in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, dc in each st across to beginning ch-3, dc in top of beginning ch—39 (39) sts. Fasten off.
Outer Ear
With A, repeat Rows 1 and 2 of Inner Ear. At the end of Row 2, turn, do not fasten off.
Row 3: Holding right side of outer ear to wrong side of inner ear and working through both thicknesses, ch 1, sc in first 15 (15, 19, 19) sts, (hdc, dc, hdc) in next st, sc in each st across to last sc (beginning ch-3), sc in last sc (top of beginning ch)—33 (33, 41, 41) sts.
Joining Row: Fold bottom edge in half, ch 1, working through both thicknesses, work 5 sc evenly spaced across. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING
Referring to photograph as a guide, sew antlers and ears to hood. Weave in ends.

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Classic Crochet Thread size 10™: 2 balls of 451 Parakeet
gauge: 23 sts and 10 rows dc = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions: With 2 strands of thread held together as one throughout, ch 6; join with a slip st in first ch. Round 1: Ch 1, 16 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc—16 sc. Round 2: Ch 6 (counts as dc, ch 3), skip next sc, *dc in next sc, ch 3, skip next sc; repeat from* around, join with a slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-6—8 ch-3 spaces. Round 3: Ch 1, (sc, hdc, 5 dc, hdc, sc) in each ch-3 space around, join with a slip st in first sc—8 shells. Round 4: Ch 1, BPsc in first sc, *ch 8, skip next shell, skip next sc**, BPsc of next sc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in first sc—8 ch-8 spaces. Round 5: Ch 1, (sc, hdc, 6 dc, hdc, sc) in each ch-8 space around, join with a slip st in first sc—8 shells. Round 6: Repeat Round 4. Round 7: Slip st in each of next 3 ch, ch 1, (sc, ch 4, sc, ch 4) in each ch-8 loop around; join with a slip st in first sc—16 ch-4 spaces. Round 8: Slip st in next ch-4 space, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 5 dc in same ch-4 space, *ch 2, 2 dc in next ch-4 space, ch 2**, 6 dc in next ch-4 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—16 ch-2 spaces. Round 9: Ch 3, skip first 2 dc, dc in each of next 4 dc, *ch 3, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc, ch 3, skip next dc**, dcd in each of next 5 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—16 ch-3 spaces. Round 10: Ch 3, skip first 2 dc, dc in each of next 3 dc, *ch 4, skip next ch-3 space, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc, ch 4, skip next dc**, dc in each of next 4 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—16 ch-4 spaces. Round 11: Ch 3, skip first 2 dc, dc in each of next 2 dc, *ch 4, skip next ch-4 space, dc in each of next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc, ch 4, skip next dc**, dc in each of next 3 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—16 ch-4 spaces. Round 12: Ch 3, skip first 2 dc, dc in next dc, *ch 5, skip next ch-4 space, dc in each of next 5 dc, ch 4, skip next dc**, dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—16 ch-5 spaces. Round 13: Ch 3, dc in next dc, *5 dc in next ch-5 space, dc in each of next 5 dc, 5 dc in next ch-5 space**, dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—136 dc. Rounds 14-30: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Round 31: Ch 3, dc in next dc (counts as dc2tog), *dc in each of next 2 dc, dc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—102 sts. Round 32: Ch 3 (counts as FPdc), dc in each of next 2 dc, *FPdc around the post of next dc2tog, dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Round 33: Ch 3 (counts as FPdc), dc in each of next 2 dc, *FPdc around the post of next FPdc, dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® "Light & Lofty®": 4 Ounces 9330 Cape Cod.
abbreviations: [] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 7 sts = 4"; 8 rows = 4" in pat. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Ch 4; join with a sl st to form a ring. 
Rnd 1: Ch 3, 11 (13) dc into ring; join with a sl st in top of ch-3 – 12 (14) sts. 
 
Rnd 2: Ch 3, FPdc around joining st, [dc in next dc, FPdc around same dc] 11 (13) times; join with a sl st in top of ch-3 – 24 (28) sts. 
 
Rnd 3: Ch 3, dc in joining st, FPdc around FPdc, [2 dc in next dc, Fpdc around Fpdc] 11 (13) times; join – 36 (40) sts. 
 
Rnd 4: Ch 3, skip joining st, dc in dc, FPdc around Fpdc, [dc in next 2 dc, FPdc around FPdc] 11 (13) times; join. 
 
Rnds 5-10: Rep Rnd 4. TURN at end of Rnd 10. 
 
Rnds 11-15: Ch 3, working on Wrong Side, skip joining st, FPdc around each st around; join. Fasten off at end of Rnd 15. 
 
Weave in ends. Turn up brim.

materials: RED HEART® Soft Essentials Baby™: 1 ball each 6001 Cotton A and 6724 Rosewater B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Hat directions are for size 16" (40.5 cm) head with changes for size 18" (45.5 cm) and 20" (51 cm) in parentheses.
gauge: 16 sc and 16 rows of sc = 4" [10 cm], 5 bobbles in pattern = 4" [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
HAT
Band
With A, ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook (beginning ch-1 does not count as a st, now and throughout) and each ch across; turn—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 16" [40.5 cm] long. (18" [45.5 cm], 20 [51 cm]).
Body
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, work 54 (63, 72) sc evenly spaced along long edge of Band; turn—54, 63, 72 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, bobble in next sc; repeat from * across; turn—18 (21, 24) bobbles, 36 (42, 48) sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, *sc in top of bobble, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * across; turn—54 (63, 72) sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, *bobble in next sc, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * across; turn—18 (21, 24) bobbles, 36 (42, 48) sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, sc in top of bobble; repeat from * across; turn—54 (63, 72) sc.
Rows 6-14 (6-18, 6-18): Repeat Rows 2-5 another 2 (3, 3) times, then work Row 2 once.
Shape Crown
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, *sc in next 4 (5, 6) sts, sc2tog; repeat from * across; turn—45 (54, 63) sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, *bobble in next sc, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * across; turn—15 (18, 21) bobbles, 30 (36, 42) sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 (4, 5) sts, sc2tog; repeat from * across; turn—36 (45, 54) sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, bobble in next sc; repeat from * across; turn—12 (15, 18) bobbles, 24 (30, 36) sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 (3, 4) sts, sc2tog; repeat from * across; turn—27 (36, 45) sts.
Row 6: Ch 1, *bobble in next sc, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * across; turn—9 (12, 15) bobbles, 18 (24, 30) sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, *sc in next 1 (2, 3) st(s), sc2tog; repeat from * across; turn—18 (27, 36) sts.
Row 8: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, bobble in next sc; repeat from * across; turn—6 (9, 12) bobbles, 12 (18, 24) sc.
For Size 16" (40.5 cm)
Row 9: Ch 1, sc2tog 9 times; turn—9 sts.
Row 10: Ch 1, *bobble in next sc, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * across—3 bobbles, 6 sc. Fasten off, leaving an 18" (45.5 cm) tail.
For Size 18" (45.5 cm)
Row 9: Ch 1, *sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * across; turn—18 sts.
Row 10: Ch 1, *bobble in next sc, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * across; turn—6 bobbles, 12 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc2tog 9 times; turn—9 sts.
Row 12: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, bobble in next sc; repeat from * across—3 bobbles, 6 sc. Fasten off, leaving an 18" (45.5 cm) tail.
For Size 20" (51 cm)
Row 9: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * across; turn—27 sts.
Row 10: Ch 1, *bobble in next sc, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * across; turn—9 bobbles, 18 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, *sc in next st, sc2tog; repeat from * across; turn—18 sts.
Row 12: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, bobble in next sc; repeat from * across; turn—6 bobbles, 12 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, sc2tog 9 times; turn—9 sts.
Row 14: Ch 1, *bobble in next sc, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * across—3 bobbles, 6 sc. Fasten off, leaving an 18" (45.5 cm) tail.
All Sizes
Use tail to sew seam down back of Hat, weave in ends.
EARS (Make 2)
Inner Ear
With B, ch 11.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 8 chs, 3 sc in last ch; working up other side of foundation ch, sc in next 9 chs; turn—21 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 10 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in next 10 sc—23 sc. Fasten off and set aside.
Outer Ear
With A, ch 11.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 8 chs, 3 sc in last ch; working up other side of foundation ch, sc in next 9 chs; turn—21 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 10 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in next 10 sc; turn—23 sc. Place Inner Ear on top of Outer Ear.
Row 3: Continuing with A and working through both Inner Ear and Outer Ear held together; ch 1, sc in next 11 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in next 11 sc; turn—25 sc. Rows 4 and 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around. At end of Row 5, do not turn; fasten off and weave in ends.
FINISHING
Referring to photo for placement, position Ears at sides of Hat and sew in place.

materials: Patons® Uplands™ (3.2 oz/90 g; 99 yds/90 m) Chocolate Cherry Mix (98007) 1 ball
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 11 single crochet (sc) and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: Chain (ch) 2 at beginning (beg) of rounds (rnds) does not count as stitch (st). Join each rnd with a slip stitch (sl st) to first st of rnd.
Ch 3.
1st rnd: 10 half double crochet (hdc) in 3rd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. 20 hdc. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Repeat (rep) from * around. 30 hdc. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. 40 hdc. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. 50 hdc. Join.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. 60 hdc. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join.
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 7" [18 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 single crochet (sc) in each of next 8 hdc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yarn over hook (yoh) and draw through all loops on hook - Single crochet 2 together (sc2tog) made. Rep from * around. 54 sc. Join.
Next 2 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.
Brim: Join yarn with sl st to 13th sc of last rnd.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 27 sc. Sc2tog. Turn.
Next 3 rows: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Continuing (cont) along side of Brim and around edge of Hat, work sc evenly around. Join. Fasten off.
Band
Ch 40.
1st row: 1 double crochet (dc) in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew Band to Hat at top of Brim. Sew one button to each end of Brim.

materials: RED HEART® “Holiday”: 1 Ball each 140 White/Silver A and 9090 Red/Red B.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 12 dc = 4”; 8 rounds = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Brim
With A, ch 11. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 10 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each ch across.

Round 7: Ch 3, [dc2tog, dc in next 8 (9) dc] 5 times, dc2tog, dc in next 7 (8) dc, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 54 (60) sts.

Round 13: Ch 3, [dc in next 3 (4) dc, dc2tog, dc in next 2 dc] 5 times, dc in next 3 (4) dc, dc2tog, dc in next dc, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 36 (42) sts.
Round 14: Repeat Round 2. 
Round 15: Ch 3, [dc2tog, dc in next 4 (5) dc] 5 times, dc2tog, dc in next 3 (4) dc, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 30 (36) sts.
Round 16: Repeat Round 2. 
Round 17: Ch 3, [dc in next 2 (3) dc, dc2tog, dc in next dc] 5 times, dc in next 2 (3) dc, dc2tog, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 24 (30) sts.
Round 18: Repeat Round 2.

Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in same st, hdc in next hdc, * 2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next hdc; repeat from * around, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 30 hdc.

Round 5: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc around; slip st to top of beginning ch to join.

Round 6: Ch 2, hdc in same st, hdc in next 2 hdc, * 2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc; repeat from * around, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 40 hdc.

Round 7: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc around; slip st to top of beginning ch to join.

Round 8: Ch 2, hdc in same st, hdc in next 3 hdc, * 2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 3 hdc; repeat from * around, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 50 hdc.

Round 9: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc around; slip st to top of beginning ch to join.

Round 10: Ch 2, hdc in same st, hdc in next 24 (4, 4) hdc, * 2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 24 (4, 4) hdc; repeat from * around, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 52 (60, 60) hdc.

Size Child ONLY:
Round 11: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc around; slip st to top of beginning ch to join.

Round 12: Ch 2, hdc in same st, hdc in next 11 hdc, * 2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 11 hdc; repeat from * around, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 65 hdc.

Body (All Sizes):
Round 1: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc around; slip st to top of beginning ch to join, turn.

Repeat Round 1 four (six, six) times.

Last round: Ch 1, sc in same st and each st around, slip st to 1st sc to join.

Fasten off, leaving a 6” (15.25 cm) tail.

Ear (make 2)
Make adjustable ring; yarn over and pull up a loop.

Row 1: Ch 2, work 7 hdc into ring, turn. Pull beginning yarn tail to close adjustable ring.

Row 2: Ch 2, 2 hdc in 1st hdc, hdc in next 5 hdc, 2 hdc in last hdc, turn – 9 hdc.

Row 3: Ch 2, 2 hdc in 1st hdc, hdc in next 7 hdc, 2 hdc in last hdc – 11 hdc.

Fasten off, leaving a 6” (15.25 cm) tail.

FINISHING
With right side facing, flatten hat with the joining seam at the center back. Center one Ear on the 5th (6th, 6th) round of the flattened hat crown. Using the Ear yarn tail and yarn needle, sew the ear in place. Repeat on the opposite side with the second ear.

With yarn needle, weave in all loose ends.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® (6 oz/170.1 g; 315 yds/288 m)

materials: Caron® Colorama™ O’Go™ (6.4 oz/180 g; 228 yds/208 m) Blue Mustang (68016) 1 O’Go
Size U.S. M/N (9 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.

Fdc (Foundation double crochet) = Ch 3. Yoh. Insert hook in 3rd ch from hook and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through one loop on hook (ch made). (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice (1 dc made). *Yoh. Insert hook into ch stitch and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through one loop on hook (ch made). (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice (1 dc made). Rep from *.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.

Sc/dcfp2tog = Draw up a loop in next st. Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next st at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: One size to fit average Adult.
gauge: 8 sc and 11 rows = 4” [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• This hat is made by changing to a new color in the skein when indicated. If preferred, you can crochet straight through the skein without changing colors.
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull tie to remove.
• Separate colors by gently pulling apart and cutting at the color transition. Each color is ready to use. For this pattern, colors can be easily separated by gently pulling apart and cutting at the color transition.
• Each color is ready to use. Follow color guide shown in Materials section for each O’Go (Contrast A to E). You may find it helpful to place each color section in its own resealable (zip lock) bag and label each bag A to E.
• Fasten off after 8th rnd of Crown shaping for a ponytail style beanie.
• Rnds are joined with a sl st to first st.
See chart on page 3.
1st rnd (RS):  With A, fdc 48. Join to work in the round. Use the tail end to sew the bottom of the row closed. 48 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 dcfp around first st. 1 hdc in next st. *1 dcfp around next st. 1 hdc around next st. Rep from * around. Join.
3rd rnd: As 2nd rnd. Break A. Join B.
4th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
5th rnd: As 4th rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts 2 rnds below. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join.
7th rnd: As 4th rnd.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 dcfp around next dcfp 2 rnds below. Skip next dcfp 2 rnds below. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. 1 dcfp around skipped dcfp 2 rnds below. Rep from * around. Break B. Join C.
9th rnd: As 4th rnd.
10th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 dcfp around next dcfp 2 rnds below. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. 1 dcfp around next dcfp 2 rnds below. Rep from * around. Join.
11th rnd: As 4th rnd.
12th rnd: As 10th rnd.
13th rnd: As 4th rnd.  Break C. Join D.
14th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. 1 dcfp around first dcfp of rnd 2 rnds below. 1 dcfp around next dcfp 2 rnds below. Skip next dcfp 2 rnds below. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around skipped dcfp 2 rnds below. 1 dcfp in next dcfp 2 rnds below. Skip next dcfp 2 rnds below. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join.
15th rnd: As 3rd rnd.

Shape Crown
1st rnd:  Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 dcfp around first dcfp 2 rnds below. 1 dcfp around next dcfp 2 rnds below. *1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp 2 rnds below. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Join. 40 sts.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. Skip  first st. *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Dcfp2tog around last skipped and next dcfp sts 2 rnds below. Skip 2 sts behind decrease. Rep from * around finishing last rep with dcfp2tog in last dcfp 2 rnds below and first dcfp of rnd 2 rnds below. Join. 32 sts. Break D. Join E.
4th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc2tog in first 2 sts. 1 sc in  next st. 1 dcfp around next dcfp 2 rnds below. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. 1 dcfp around next dcfp 2 rnds below. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts.
6th  rnd: As 2nd rnd..
7th rnd:  Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 dcfp around the next dcfp st 2 rnds below. *Sc2tog. 1 dcfp around the next dcfp st 2 rnds below. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sts.
8th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
Note: Fasten off after 8th rnd of Crown shaping for ponytail style beanie.
9th rnd: Ch 1. Sc/dcfp2tog in each (pair of) st around. Join. 8 sts.
10th rnd: Ch 1. (Dcfp2tog) 4 times. Join. 4 sts. Fasten off leaving a long tail. Use tail to gather top of crown closed.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 672 Spring Green A, 254 Pumpkin B and 324 Bright Yellow C.
abbreviations: sc2tog: [Draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

A, B, C = color A, B, C; ch = chain; dc = double crochet; mm = millimeters; sc = single crochet; st(s) = stitch(es); [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified; * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Hat measures 18” in circumference. Fits Child’s size 2-4 years.
gauge: 5 dc = 1½”; 3 Rounds dc = 1½”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Beginning at top of hat with A, ch 4; join into a ring with slip st in first ch.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 11 dc in ring; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch 3 – 12 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in first st, 2 dc in each dc around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch 3 – 24 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch 3 – 36 dc.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch 3 – 48 dc.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch 3 – 60 dc.
Rounds 6-13: Ch 3, dc in each dc around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch 3.
Round 14: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, *skip 2 dc, 5 sc in next dc, skip 2 dc, sc in next dc, repeat from * around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch 3. Fasten off.
Hat Scales (make 2)
With B, ch 43.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn – 42 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in next 6 sc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog over next 2 sc, sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog over next 2 sc, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, [sc2tog over next 2 sc] twice, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc2tog over next 2 sc, work 4 sc evenly spaced down side of scale.
Row 7: Sc in next 6 sc in Row 1.
Repeat Rows 3-7 (5 times); then repeat Rows 3-6 once, turn.
Joining Row: With wrong sides of hat scales together, ch 1, working through double thickness, sc evenly across top of scales, working 3 sc in top of each scale, leaving bottom open. Stuff each scale very lightly then sew scales in place on top of hat.
Tail
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, do not join. Work in a spiral, marking beginning of each round, moving marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Round 3: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 8 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 10 sc.
Round 5: *Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 12 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 15 sc.
Rounds 8-9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: *Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 18 sc.
Rounds 11-12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: *Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 21 sc.
Rounds 14-27: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.
Tail Scales
With B, ch 26.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, ch 1, *3 dc in next ch, skip next ch, slip st in next ch**, ch 1; repeat from * across, ending last repeat at **. Fasten off. Sew to top center of tail. Stuff tail and sew in place.
Large Spot (make 2)
With C, ch 2.
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, do not join, work in a spiral as before.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 18 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 24 sc. Fasten off, leaving long sewing length.
Medium Spot (make 4)
Work same as Large Spot through Round 3. Fasten off, leaving long sewing length.
Small Spot (make 2)
Work same as Large Spot through Round 2. Fasten off, leaving long sewing length. Randomly arrange spots on each side of hat and sew in place.

instructions: The instructions are written for smaller size. If changes are necessary for larger size the instructions will be written thus ( ). Join with sl st to first hdc. 2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 16 hdc. 3rd rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in next sc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 24 hdc. 4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 32 hdc. 5th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 40 hdc. 6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 48 hdc. 7th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 56 hdc. Size 6/8 yrs only: 8th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 64 hdc. Both sizes: Place marker at end of last rnd. Next rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 4½ (5) ins [11 (12.5) cm]. Join A at end of last rnd. With A, rep last rnd for 3 ins [7.5 cm]. Fasten off. Bear Version EARS (make 2). Inner Ear: **With A, ch 2. 1st row: (RS). 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of first 3 sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 7 sc. 3rd row: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 11 sc. 4th row: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 15 sc. 5th row: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. 19 sc.** Fasten off. Outer Ear: With MC, work from ** to ** as given for Inner Ear. Do not break MC. With WS of Inner and Outer Ears tog, with MC work through both thicknesses as follows: Next row: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Do not turn. 23 sc. Next row: Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc across. Fasten off. FINISHING Fold A section to RS for cuff. Sew Ears to Hat. With white felt, cut out eye circles 1 ¼ ins [3 cm] diameter. With A, embroider eyes over felt, using satin stitch. Embroider nose and snout as shown in photo. Devil Version Horns (make 2) **With MC, ch 12. Join with sl st to first sc to form a ring. 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.** Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 3 ins [7.5 cm]. Shape points: 1st rnd: Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – sc2 tog made. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 9 sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 3rd rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2 tog. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join with sl st to first st. 6 sc. 4th rnd: As 2nd rnd. 5th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2 tog) 3 times. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread yarn through rem sts. Pull tightly. Stuff Horns. Thread yarn down side of Horn. Pull slightly to form bend. Secure yarn. Sew horns in position. Tail Work from ** to ** as given for Horns. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 12 ins [30.5 cm]. Fasten off. Fringe: Cut 12 strands of MC 3 ins [7.5 cm] long. Taking 1 strand, knot into fringe around end of Tail. Trim fringe evenly. Tie end of Tail into knot, leaving fringe free. Sew Tail to back of Hat. With white felt cut out eyes 1 ¼ ins [3 cm] diameter. With MC, sew in position using Satin stitch.

materials: RED HEART® Baby Hugs™ Medium: 1 ball each 4012 Ink A, 4001 Frosting B, and 4255 Orangie C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Hat stretches to fit 13-15” (15-17”, 17-19”) [33-38 (38-43, 43-48.5) cm] head circumference.
gauge: 12 hdc = 4” (10 cm); 7 rows = 3” (7.5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
With A, make an adjustable ring. 
Round 1: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), 7 hdc in ring—8 hdc. 
Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 hdc in each st around—16 hdc.
Round 3: *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st; repeat from * 7 times—24 hdc. 
Round 4: *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts; repeat from * 7 times—32 hdc. 
Round 5: *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts; repeat from * 7 times—40 hdc. 
Size Small only:
Round 6: Hdc in each st around.
Size Medium only:
Round 6: *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 19 sts; repeat from * once—42 hdc. 
Size Large only:
Round 6: *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 9 sts; repeat from * 3 times—44 hdc.
All sizes:
Rounds 7–12 (7–13, 7–14): Hdc in each st around—40 (42, 44) hdc.
Round 13 (14, 15): Hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first hdc. 
Fasten off. 
First Earflap
Flatten hat and place marker on 3rd st from either side edge.  
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, join A with slip st in marked st, ch 2, hdc in next 7 (7, 8) sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—8 (8, 9) hdc. 
Row 2: Ch 2, skip next st, hdc in each remaining st across, working last st in top of beginning ch, turn—7 (7, 8) hdc.
Row 3–6 (3–6, 3–7): Repeat Row 2—3 hdc. 
Fasten off. 
2nd Earflap
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, skip next 12 (13, 13) unworked sts, join A with slip st in next st, ch 2, hdc in next 7 (7, 8) sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—8 (8, 9) hdc. 
Rows 2–6 (2–6, 2–7): Repeat Rows 2–6 (2–6, 2–7) of First Earflap. 
Note For size Large only, do not turn at end of Row 7.
Edging Round (right side): Ch 1, sc in each st and row end around, working additional sts as needed in outer corners so piece lays flat; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Face
With B, ch 16.
Row 1 (wrong side): Hdc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning skipped ch count as first hdc) and in each ch across—15 hdc. 
Rows 2–7: Ch 2, hdc in each st across. 
Row 8: Skip first 3 sts, 5 tr in next st, slip st in next st, skip next 3 sts, 5 tr in next st, slip st in last st; do not turn—10 tr and 2 slip sts.
Edging Round (right side): Work same as Edging Round of Earflaps. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Eye (make 2)
With A, ch 2, 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
FINISHING
Sew eyes to face.
With C and straight stitches, embroider triangular beak between eyes. 
Sew face to hat.
Weave in ends.

materials: Caron® x Pantone™ (3.5 oz /100 g; 127 yds/116 m)
Contrast B, C, D, E and F Purple Pops (01017) 1 braid
Size U.S. J/10 (6 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 12 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Before working with Caron® x Pantone™ multi-shade yarn braid, separate each color link and wind into 5 separate balls. 
• Each color link will be referenced by its Pantone # (see ball band)
• Designate each different shade of the 5 separate yarn balls as Contrast A, B, C, D, E and F as noted in Materials section (or as desired).
• Due to finite amount of yarn in each shade, pattern gauge must be matched to ensure successful results
• When working from chart and joining new color, work to last 2 loops on hook of last st. Draw new color through 2 loops, then proceed in new color.
• Carry color not in use across top of previous rnd and work sts around it to prevent stranding.

Ribbing:

measurements: Hat measures 16½ (18½, 20½)” [42 (47, 52) cm] circumference at brim.
gauge: 12 sts = 4” (10 cm); 6 rows = 4” (10 cm) in double crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Round 4: Ch 1, 2 dc in first st, dc in next 2 st, *2 dc in next, dc in next 2 st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc— 48 dc.
Round 5: Ch 1, 2 dc in first st, dc in next 23 (5, 3) sts, *2 dc in next st, dc in next 23 (5, 3) sts; repeat from * 0 (6, 10) times; join with slip st in first dc— 50 (56, 60) dc.
