Round 6: Ch 1, 2 dc in first st, dc in next 29 sts, 2 dc in next st, dc in next 29 sts; join with slip st in first dc—62 dc.
All sizes
Rounds 6 (6, 7)–7 (8, 9): Ch 1, dc in each st around; change to B at end of last round; join with slip st in first dc. 
Rounds 8 (9, 10) and 9 (10, 11): Ch 1, sc in each st around; change to A at end of last round; join with slip st in first sc. 
Round 10 (11, 12): Ch 2 (counts as first dc), dc in each st around; change to B; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Rounds 11 (12, 13) and 12 (13, 14): Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. 
Fasten off. 
Ear (make 4) 
With B and leaving a long tail, make an adjustable ring.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 3 (counts as first dc), 4 dc in ring, ch 1, 4 dc in ring, ch 3 (counts as last dc); join with slip st in ring—10 dc and 1 ch-1 space. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Pull gently, but firmly, on beginning tail to tighten ring. 
Directions are for size Small. Changes for sizes Medium and Large are in parentheses. 
Special Technique
Adjustable-ring method = Wrap yarn in a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail firmly between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring, working over both strands (the tail and the ring). After the first round of stitches is worked, pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Notes
1. Hat is worked in joined rounds with right side facing. Cat’s ears and flower are made separately and sewn to hat.
2. Ch 1 at beginning of rounds does not count as a stitch.
3. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Cut old color.
HAT 
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 dc in ring; join with slip st in first dc—12 dc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 dc in each st around; join with slip st in first dc—24 dc.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 dc in first st, dc in next st, *2 dc in next, dc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—36 dc.
Edging (work twice)
Hold wrong side of one ear to right side of another ear.
Row 1: With right side of top ear facing and working through both thicknesses, join A with slip st in top of beginning ch, ch 2, hdc in next 4 sts, slip st in ch-1 space, ch 3, slip st in 3rd chain from hook, hdc in next 4 sts, ch 2; join with slip st in top of ending ch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Flower
With B, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 8 hdc in ring; join with slip st in first hdc—8 hdc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring. 
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, [ch 3, sc in next st] 7 times, ch 3; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc and 8 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: (Slip st, ch 1, hdc, ch 1, slip st—petal made) in each ch-3 space; join with slip st in first slip st—8 petals.
FINISHING
For each ear, weave A tails between pieces. Thread all B tails through center bottom of ear. Lay hat flat with seam at center back and place stitch markers on each side of Round 3. Thread B tails through stitches at markers and tie securely on wrong side of hat. 
Sew flower in place where desired.
Weave in ends.

Note: Ch 3 counts as dc throughout.
Texture Stripe Stitch: Ch 1, sc in same st, *tr in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around, omitting last sc.

HAT
Round 1: With A ch 4, 11 dc in 4th ch from hook, join with slip st to top of ch – 12 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in same st, [2 dc] in each st around, join with a slip st in first st – 24 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, 2 dc in next st, *dc in next st, 2 dc in next st; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in first st – 36 dc.
Work for 0 (1, 0, 1) round.

Child Sizes Only
Next Round: Ch 3, *2 dc in next st, dc in next 5 (2) sts; repeat from * around, omitting last dc, join with a slip st to first st – 42 (48) sts.
Work in dc for 5 (6) rounds.
Change to B and work in Texture Stripe Stitch.
Change to A and work 1 round in dc.
Fasten off.

Adult Size S/M Only
Next Round: Ch 3, *2 dc in next st, dc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around, omitting last dc, join with a slip st to first st – 42 sts.
Next Round: Ch 3, dc in same st, dc in next 2 dc, *2 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc; repeat from * around to last 4 sts, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, join with a slip st to first st – 54 sts.

Adult Size M/L Only
Next Round: Ch 3, *2 dc in next st, dc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around, omitting last dc, join with a slip st to first st – 48 sts.
Next Round: Ch 3, *2 dc in next st, dc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around, omitting last 2 dc – 60 sts.

Both Adult Sizes
Work in dc for 6 rounds.
[Change to B and work in Texture Stripe Stitch.
Change to A and work 1 round in dc] twice.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Head’s Up™: 1 ball each 689 Bright Green A, 852 Navy B, 229 Sunshine C
abbreviations: A, B, and C = Color A, Color B, and Color C
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 10 sts = 4” (10 cm); 3 rounds = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Round 1 (right side): With A ch 3, work 11 hdc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch counts as first hdc); join with slip st in top of beginning ch—12 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), hdc in same st as joining (increase made), 2 hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next st, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—36 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in each of next 2 sts, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in each of next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—48 hdc.
20” Circumference Only
Rounds 5–7: Ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off A.
Round 8: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in same st as joining, ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off B.
Round 9: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in same st as joining, ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off A.
Round 10: With right side facing, draw up a loop of C in same st as joining, ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off C.
Round 11: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in same st as joining, ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off A.
Round 12: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in same st as joining, ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off B.
Round 13: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in same st as joining, ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Do not fasten off A.
Round 14: Ch 1, TURN, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Softee® Chunky™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 108 yds/99 m)
Main Color (MC) Clay (28041), Redwood (28522), Soft Taupe (28011), Ultra Blue (28742) or Glowing Gold (28607) 1 1 ball
Contrast A Grass (28223), Soft Taupe (28011), Pumpkin (28630), Glowing Gold (28607) or Clay (28041) 1 1 ball
Size U.S. M/13 (9 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
The instructions are written for smaller size. If changes are necessary for larger size, the instructions will be written thus ( ). When only one number is given, it applies to both sizes. For ease in working, circle all numbers pertaining to your size.

With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
Size 8/12 only: 5th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 15 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 34 sc.
Both sizes: Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 2. Skip first sc. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last ch-1 sp. Join with sl st to beg ch-2.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around. Ch 1. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last 2 rnds until Hat from beg measures 7½ (8) [19 (20.5) cm]. Fasten off.
Next rnd: Join A with sl st to any ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Pompom: Wind 2 strands of A around 4 fingers approx 40 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to a smooth round shape. Sew pompom to top of Hat.

materials: Patons® Classic Wool WorstedTM (3.5 oz/100 g; 210 yds/192 m) Blue Heather (77118) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcfp = Yoh and insert hook from front to back around post of next stitch. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook.)
measurements: One size to fit average woman’s head.
gauge: 14 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
Beg at crown, ch 3. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 15 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 16 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around each of next 2 dc. 1 dc in sp between last dc and next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 24 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in sp between last dcfp and next dcfp. 1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 32 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dcfp around next dcfp. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 40 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dcfp. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 48 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dcfp around next dcfp. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 56 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dcfp. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 64 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 2. *3 dcfp around dcfp 2 rows below. Miss next sc. 1 dc in next sc. Miss next sc. Rep from * 15 times more. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
10th rnd: As 8th rnd.
11th rnd: Sl st in next st. Ch 3 (counts as dc). Miss next sc. 3 dcfp around dc 2 rows below. Miss next sc. *1 dc in next sc. Miss next sc. 3 dcfp around dc 2 rows below. Miss next sc. Rep from * 14 times more. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
12th rnd: As 8th rnd.
13th rnd: Sl st in each of next 2 sts. Ch 3 (counts as dc). Miss next sc. 3 dcfp around dc 2 rows below. Miss next sc. *1 dc in next sc. Miss next sc. 3 dcfp around dc 2 rows below. Miss next sc. Rep from * 14 times more. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
Rep 12th and 13th rnds until work from beg measures 8" [20.5 cm], ending on a 13th rnd. Do not fasten off.
Band: 1st and 2nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sc. Do not fasten off.
Brim: Beg working in rows: 1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 46 sc. Turn. Leave rem sc unworked.
2nd to 10th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off at end of last row.
FINISHING
Fold Brim of Hat at corners and sew into place with button on each side as shown in photo.

materials: Patons® Highland Bulky™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 83 yds/76 m) Main Color (MC) Tidal (13010) 1 ball
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Scbp = Draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left.
Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook
Splsc = Split single crochet: work sc between ‘legs’ of stitch (splitting stitch) instead of through top loops
Sc2togspl over 3 sts = Draw up a loop in next sc between ‘legs’ of stitch. Skip next stitch. Draw up a loop in next sc between ‘legs’ of stitch. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 8 sts and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm] in split sc/scbp pat.
instructions:
Note: Do not join at ends of rnds unless otherwise stated. Cont working in spiral placing marker on first st of rnd for easier counting.
With MC, ch 40. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring, taking care to not twist chain.
1st rnd:  1 sc in each ch around. 40 sc. Do not join. Work in continu - ous rnds (see note).
2nd rnd: *1 splsc in next st. 1 scbp. Rep from * around.
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 6" [15 cm].
Shape crown: 1st rnd: *Sc2togspl over 3 sts. 1 scbp. 1 splsc in next st. 1 scbp. Rep from * to last 4 sts. Sc2togspl over 3 sts. 1 scbp. 26 sts.
2nd rnd: *1 splsc in next st. 1 scbp. Rep from * around.
3rd rnd: *Sc2togspl over 3 sts. 1 scbp. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 splsc in next st. 1 scbp. 14 sts.
4th rnd: *1 splsc in next st. 1 scbp. Rep from * around.
5th rnd:  *Sc2togspl over 3 sts. 1 scbp. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 splsc in next st. 1 scbp. 8 sts.
Break yarn, leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts. Pull tightly and fasten securely.
Pompom:  Wind 2 strands of A around 4 fingers 50 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Hat.

9th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 hdc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 21 (24-24) sts.

Join with sl st to first sc. 51 sts. 5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 41 sts. 7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 31 sts. 9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 21 sts. 10th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc3tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 7 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end through rem sts and fasten securely. Pompom: Wind yarn around 3 fingers 100 times. Round 9: *Sc in each of next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—54 sc.

Round 26: Sc in each sc around.
Round 27: Change color to A, sc in each sc around—60 sc.
Round 28: *Sc in each of next 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—66 sc.
Round 29: *Sc in each of next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—72 sc.

materials: Patons® Classic Wool WorstedTM (3.5 oz/100 g; 205 yds/187 m) Lemongrass (77223) 2 balls
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and insert hook from back to front around post of next stitch. Yoh and draw up a loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and insert hook from front to back around post of next stitch. Yoh and draw up a loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
measurements: One size to fit average woman's head.
gauge: 14 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Ribbing: Ch 13.
1st row: (RS). Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sl st in each ch across. Turn. 12 sts.
2nd row: Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each of next 12 sl st. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 18" [45.5 cm], ending on a WS row.
Do not fasten off.
Join back seam: Working in back loops only, sl st last row and rem loops of foundation ch tog. Do not fasten off. Turn work and proceed as follows:
Note: Ch 3 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
Beg working in rnds: 1st rnd: Ch 3. Work 70 dc evenly around. Join with sl st to first dc. 70 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around next dc. 1 dcbp around each of next 9 dc) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 8 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
4th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 7 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
5th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 4 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 6 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
6th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 5 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
7th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dcbp around first st. (1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 5 sts) 6 times. 1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 4 sts. Join with sl st to first dcbp.
8th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sts. (1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 5 sts) 6 times. 1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 3 sts. Join with sl st to first dcbp.
9th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dcbp around each of next 3 sts. (1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 5 sts) 6 times. 1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sts. Join with sl st to first dcbp.
10th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dcbp around each of next 4 sts. (1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 5 sts) 6 times. 1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around next st. Join with sl st to first dcbp.
11th rnd: As 6th rnd.
12th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around next dc. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around each of next 8 dc) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 63 sts.
13th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around each of next 6 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 56 sts.
14th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around each of next 4 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 49 sts.
15th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 4 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 42 sts.
16th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 4 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around next st) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 35 sts.
17th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dcbp around first st. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around next st) 6 times. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Skip next st. Join with sl st to first dcbp. 28 sts.

With larger hook and MC, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.

With smaller hook and A, ch 2. 1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

With smaller hook and A, ch 2. 1st row: (RS). 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc to end of row. 10 sc.  Break A. Join MC. Turn. 3rd row: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. (1 hdc. 1 dc) in next sc. (1 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Fasten off.

With smaller hook and MC, make as given for Inner Ear, omitting all reference to color changes.

Join Ears: With WS of Inner Ear and Outer Ear facing each other, and RS of Inner Ear facing, join MC with sl st to first sc. 1st row: Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Fasten off.

Sew Eyes, Nose and Ears to Hat as seen in picture.

abbreviations: Hdcfl = Half double crochet in front loop only

instructions:

Work 3 rnds with A.

Beg at crown, with A, ch 4. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring.

Beg with B, cont in Stripe Pat as follows:
4th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 2 hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 2 hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 32 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 3 hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 3 hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 40 hdc.

Earflaps: Place markers on 5th hdc on each side of center back (joining hdc), leaving 8 hdc unworked at center back.
First Earflap: 1st row: (RS). Join F with sl st in marked hdc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 15 (17) hdc. Turn.
16 (18) sc.
**Next 2 (4) rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn.
14 (16) sts.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows twice more.
8 (10) sts at end of last row.
Next 2 rows: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn.
4 (6) sts at end of last row. Fasten off.**
Second Earflap: 1st row: (RS). Skip next 20 hdc of Hat. Join F with sl st in next hdc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 15 (17) sts to marker. Turn.
16 (18) sc.
Work from ** to ** as given for First Earflap.
Edging: With RS facing, join F with sl st at center back. Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 rnd of reverse sc evenly around all outer edges. Join with sl st to first reverse sc. Fasten off.
Ties: (make 2). Cut 4 lengths each of E and F 11" [24 cm] long. With someone holding opposite end, twist strands to the right until they begin to curl tightly. Fold strands in half. Wrap F around cord approx 10 times 1" [2.5 cm] from end to secure ends. Trim ends. Attach tie to each Earflap.
Top Twisted cord: Cut 10 lengths each of A and B 15" [38 cm] long. With someone holding opposite end, twist strands to the right until they begin to curl tightly. Fold strands in half. Wrap A around cord approx 20 times 1" [2.5 cm] from end to secure ends. Trim ends. Attach to top of Hat.

Row 3: Ch 2, dc2tog over next 2 sts, dc in each st to last 3 sts, dc2tog over next 2 sts, dc in last st, turn – 8 (10, 10) dc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn – 8 (10, 10) sc.
Repeat the last 2 rows 0 (1, 1) more times – 8 sc.
Next 2 rows:
Row 1: Ch 2, [dc2tog over next 2 sts] twice, dc in last st, turn – 4 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across – 4 sc. 
Fasten off.
With earflap facing up, skip 28 (30, 32) sts to the left of last earflap st on brim, and join B with slip st in next st.
Work other Earflap the same way.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Border for Cap Version
Next 2 rounds: Ch 1, sc in each st around.
Fasten off.
Border for Earflap Version
Join B with slip st in center back of hat. 
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each st and 4 sc in each sc-row edge around, join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.
Pom Poms
With A and B held together, make a pom pom and sew to top of hat.
Maple Leaf
With A, form an adjustable loop
Round 1: Ch 2 (counts as 1 dc), 11 dc in ring; join with slip st in first st – 12 dc. 
Round 2: Ch 2, (picot, hdc) in same st as joining slip st, (hdc, picot, hdc) in next st, (hdc, picot, ch 2, slip st) in next st, (slip st, ch 2, picot, dc) in next st, (dc, picot, dc) in next st, (dc, picot, ch 2, slip st) in next st, (slip st, ch 2, picot, hdc) in next st, (hdc, picot, hdc) in next st, (hdc, picot, ch 2, slip st) in next st, slip st in next st, ch 5, skip 1 ch, sc in each of next 4 ch (stem), slip st in Round 1 to join stem, slip st in beginning ch-2 to join round.
Fasten off.
Position Maple Leaf as desired onto hat and use markers to hold in place.
Assuring picots are defined, use yarn needle to sew in place.
Weave in all loose ends.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball each 4600 White A and 9925 Really Red B
RED HEART® Buttercup®: 1 ball 4270 White C
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5mm [US H-8], 5.5mm [US I-9] and 8mm [US L-11]
Yarn needle, stitch markers, velcro hook and loop fastener tape, white sewing thread and sewing needle
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Hat measures 18 (20)" [44 (51) cm] circumference. Beard measures 8" [20.5 cm] at widest point x 5½" [14 cm] long.
gauge: 16 sc = 4" [10 cm]; 12 rows = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet using 5.5mm [US I-9] and A. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Ribbed Band
With 5mm [US H-8] hook and A, ch 7. 
Row 1: Working in back loops only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 6 sts.
Row 2: Working in back loops only, ch 1, turn, sc in each st across – 6 sts. 
Repeat Row 2 until 55 (68) rows have been worked.
Last Row: With right sides together, fold band in half to line up sts of first and last rows, ch 1, turn, working through used loops of foundation ch and front loops of last row, sc in each st across to join. Do not fasten off. 
Hat Crown
Round 1: Turn Ribbed Band right side out and ready to work along one long edge, change to 5.5mm [US I-9] hook and begin working in round, ch 1, sc 56 (68) sts evenly spaced around, slip st in first sc to join – 56 (68) sts. Fasten off.
Round 2: With right side facing, join B in any st with slip st, ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st around, slip st in first sc to join – 56 (68) sts. Place stitch marker in first st to mark beginning of round.
Rounds 3-17: Working through both loops in continuous rounds, sc in each st around.
Round 18: *Sc2tog, sc in next 26 (32) sts; repeat from * once more – 54 (66) sts.
Shape Crown
For Small Hat Only
Rounds 19: Repeat Round 17.
Round 20: *Sc2tog, sc in next 7 sts; repeat from * around – 48 sts.  
Round 21: Sc in each st around.
Round 22: *Sc2tog, sc in next 6 sts; repeat from * around – 42 sts.
Rounds 23-24: Sc in each st around for 2 rounds.
Round 25: *Sc2tog, sc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Rounds 26-28: Sc in each st around for 3 rounds.
Round 29: *Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Rounds 30-32: Sc in each st around for 3 rounds.
Round 33: *Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Rounds 34-35: Sc in each st around for 2 rounds.
Round 36: *Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Round 37: Sc in each st around.
Round 38: *Sc2tog, sc in next st; repeat from * around – 12 sts.
Rounds 39-41: Sc in each st around for 3 rounds.
Round 42: *Sc2tog, sc in next st; repeat from *around – 8 sts.
Round 43: Sc in each st around.
Round 44: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around. 
Fasten off, leaving a long end. 
Using yarn needle, weave end through sts and pull tightly to close hole. Secure end. 
For Large Hat Only
Rounds 19-21: Sc in each st around for 3 rounds.
Round 22: *Sc2tog, sc in next 9 sts; repeat from * around – 60 sts.
Rounds 23-25: Sc in each st around for 3 rounds.
Round 26: *Sc2tog, sc in next 8 sts; repeat from * around – 54 sts.
Rounds 27-30: Sc in each st around for 4 rounds.
Round 31: *Sc2tog, sc in next 7 sts; repeat from * around – 48 sts.
Rounds 32-37: Sc in each st around for 6 rounds.
Round 38: *Sc2tog, sc in next 6 sts; repeat from * around – 42 sts.
Rounds 39-42: Sc in each st around for 4 rounds.
Round 43: *Sc2tog, sc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around – 36 sts.
Rounds 44-46: Sc in each st around for 3 rounds.
Round 47: *Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts; repeat from * around – 30 sts.
Rounds 48-50: Sc in each st around for 3 rounds.
Round 51: *Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around – 24 sts.
Rounds 52-53: Sc in each st around for 2 rounds.
Round 54: *Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around – 18 sts.
Rounds 55-56: Sc in each st around for 2 rounds.
Round 57: *Sc2tog, sc in next st; repeat from *around – 12 sts.
Rounds 58-59: Sc in each st around for 2 rounds.
Round 60: *Sc2tog, sc in next st; repeat from *around – 8 sts.
Round 61: Sc in each st around. 
Round 62: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. 
Using yarn needle, weave end through sts and pull tightly to close hole. Secure end. 
POMPOM  
With A, cut 18" [46 cm] length of yarn and set aside. Hold hand as if to shake hands, with fingers together and extended. 
Wrap yarn around extended fingers for 120 wraps.
While wraps are still on fingers, fold 18" [46 cm] length of yarn in half and slip under all the wraps. With folded yarn in place, slip wrapped yarn off fingers. Tie yarn length tightly around wraps in a secure knot. 
Hold yarn wraps tightly in fist with tie ends dangling from bottom of fist and the looped wraps extending over top of closed fist. Carefully cut loops open to form pompom. Grasp by tie and shake to fluff out. Trim wrap ends evenly. 
Using tie ends, attach to top of Hat.
BEARD
Beginning at bottom edge, with 8mm [USL-11] hook and C, ch 3.
Row 1: Ch 2 (does NOT count as a hdc here and throughtout), 3 hdc in 2nd ch from hook – 3 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2, turn, 2 hdc in first st, hdc in next st, 2 hdc in last st – 5 sts.
Row 3: Ch 2, turn, [hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st] 2 times, hdc in last st – 7 sts. 
Row 4: Ch 2, turn, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in last 2 sts – 9 sts.
Row 5: Ch 2, turn, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, [hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st] 2 times, hdc in last 2 sts – 12 sts. 
Row 6: Ch 2, turn, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in last 2 sts – 16 sts. 
Row 7: Ch 2, turn, hdc in each st across.
Shape Moustache and Mouth Opening 
Row 8: Ch 2, turn, dc in 6 sts, ch 4, skip next 4 sts, dc in last 6 sts.
Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Weave in ends. 
With sewing thread and needle, sew a 1" [5 cm] piece of hook side of hook and loop fastener on right side on either side edge of Row 8. Sew corresponding loop pieces on wrong side along inside edge of Hat, adjusting placement so Beard fits face comfortably.

gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Beginning (Beg) at top of crown, chain (ch) 2.
1st round (rnd): 6 single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook. Join with slip stitch (sl st) to first sc. 6 stitches (sts).
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same space (sp) as last sl st. *Ch 1. 1 sc in next sc. Repeat (Rep) from * around, ending with ch 1. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sts.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sts.
4th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sts.
5th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sts.
6th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 3 times. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 60 sts.
7th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
8th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 4 times. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 72 sts.
9th rnd: As 7th rnd.
10th rnd: Sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 5 times. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around, ending with ch 1. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 84 sts.
11th rnd: As 7th rnd.
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 7" [18 cm].
Edging: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *(1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc) 4 times. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last ch-1 sp. Join with sl st to first sc. 76 sc. Turn.
Note: Turn at each end of all Edging rnds to form Ridge Pat.
2nd rnd: [Wrong side (WS)]. Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
3rd rnd: [Right side (RS)]. Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rnds for Ridge Pat 4 times more. Fasten off.

instructions:
With B, ch 48 loosely; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.

Rounds 2–4: Ch 2, Fpdc around next st, *hdc in next st, Fpdc around next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2—24 hdc and 24 Fpdc.

Body
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2, Fpdc around next st, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next st, *hdc in next 3 sts, Fpdc around next st, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next st; repeat from * to last 2 sts, hdc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2—32 hdc and 16 Fpdc.
Fasten off B.
Round 2 (wrong side): With wrong side facing, draw up a loop of A in same st as joining slip st, ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, TURN—48 hdc. Work all following rounds with A only.
Round 3 (right side): Ch 2, skip first Fpdc 2 rounds below, Fptr around 2nd Fpdc 2 rounds below, hdc in next st (of previous round), working in front of last Fptr made, Fptr around skipped (first) Fpdc 2 rounds below, *hdc in next 3 sts, skip next Fpdc 2 rounds below, Fptr around next Fpdc 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, working in front of last Fptr made, Fptr around skipped Fpdc 2 rounds below; repeat from * to last 2 sts, hdc in last 2 sts, turn; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn—32 hdc and 16 Fptr.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn.
Round 5: Ch 2, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, Fpdc around first Fptr 2 rounds below, *hdc in next 3 sts, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below; repeat from * to last 2 sts, hdc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn.
Rounds 6–17: Repeat Rounds 2–5 three times.
Rounds 18–20: Repeat Rounds 2–4.

Shape Top of Hat
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2, Fpdc around first Fptr 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below, *hdc2tog, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below; repeat from * to last 2 sts, hdc2tog; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn—24 hdc and 16 Fpdc.
Round 2: Ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2—40 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 2, skip first Fpdc 2 rounds below, Fptr around 2nd Fpdc 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, working in front of last Fptr made, Fptr around skipped (first) Fpdc 2 rounds below, *hdc2tog, skip next Fpdc 2 rounds below, Fptr around next Fpdc 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, working in front of last Fptr made, Fptr around skipped Fpdc 2 rounds below; repeat from * to last st, skip last st, turn; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn—16 hdc and 16 Fptr.
Round 4: Ch 2, [hdc2tog] 15 times, skip last st; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn—16 sts.
Round 5: Ch 1, beginning in same ch as join, sc2tog around; join with slip st in first st, turn—8 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through top of stitches in last round and pull tight to close opening at top of hat. Carefully secure end on wrong/inside of hat.

FINISHING
Pompom (optional)
With B and following pompom maker directions, make a 2" [5 cm] pompom and attach to top of hat.
Weave in ends.

Row 12: Repeat Row 2. Fasten off B.

Second Parallelogram
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in first st of last row of previous parallelogram, ch 1, beginning in same st as joining, sc2tog, sc in each st across to last sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn.
Rows 2–12: Work same as Rows 2–12 of first parallelogram. Fasten off A.

Third Parallelogram
With B, work same as second parallelogram. Fasten off B.

Fourth Parallelogram
With A, work same as second parallelogram. Fasten off A, leaving a long tail for sewing. With long tail, sew last and first rows together to form a ring. Take care to sew through both loops of the stitches of the last row and the remaining two loops of the foundation chain.

Top of Hat
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in end of last row of last parallelogram, ch 1, sc in the end of each row around; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc.
Note: Work first stitch of each round in same stitch as joining slip stitch unless otherwise instructed.
Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off A.
Round 4: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in the 32nd sc of Round 3, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Note: This new joining location is now at the center back of hat.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc. Fasten off B.
Round 6: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in first sc of previous round, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.

Rounds 7 and 8: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, [sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc. Fasten off A.
Round 10: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in the first sc of previous round, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 11: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc. Fasten off B.
Round 12: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in the 2nd sc of previous round, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 13: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 14: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 15: Ch 1, [sc in next st, sc2tog] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc. Fasten off A, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull to tighten. Weave in end securely on wrong side of hat.

Lower Edging
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in end of row of parallelogram directly below back seam (joining of last 12 rounds), ch 1, sc in end of each row around; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc.
Round 2: Skip same st as joining, *ch 2, skip next st, slip st in next st; repeat from * around to last st, ch 2, skip last st; join with slip st in joining slip st of previous round. Fasten off A.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 12 hdc = 4”; 10 rows = 4” using smaller hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:

With the smaller hook, ch 54 (60, 66), slip st in first ch to form ring. Place marker for beginning of round.

Rounds 2-4: Ch 2, hdc in each st around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Rounds 5-8: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in each st around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 9: Ch 2, hdc in each st around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 10: Ch 2, hdc in next 4 sts, skip next st, [hdc in next 5 sts, skip next st] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 45 (50, 55) sts.
Rounds 11-13: Ch 3, dc in each st around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 14: Ch 2, hdc in next 3 sts, skip next st, [hdc in next 4 sts, skip next st] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 36 (40, 44) sts.
Round 15: Ch 2, hdc in next 2 sts, skip next st, [hdc in next 3 sts, skip next st] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 27 (30, 33) sts.
Round 16: Ch 2, hdc in next st, skip next st, [hdc in next 2 sts, skip next st] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 18 (20, 22) sts.
Round 17: Ch 2, skip next st, [hdc in next hdc, skip next hdc] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 9 (10, 11) sts.

Fasten off.
FINISHING
Asymmetric Brim
Row 1: With right side facing and larger hook, count 11 sts to left of first st on Round 1, sc in next 29 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, skip 2 sc, sc in next sc and each sc across.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across to last st, skip last st.
Rows 4-17: Repeat Rows 2-3.
Row 18: Repeat Row 2.
Do not fasten off.
Hat Edging
With wrong side facing, work sc evenly spaced along edge of Brim, hdc in each st along opposite edge of foundation ch to opposite edge of Brim, sc evenly spaced along opposite edge of Brim, sc in each st across Row 18, ch 10 for buttonhole, slip st in first st to join.
Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Medley™: 1 (1, 2) ball(s) 930 Garden, 940 Volcano or 952 Stained Glass A and 1 (1, 1) ball 920 Sandy B

gauge: 10 sts = 4” (10 cm); 8 rows = 4” (10 cm) in half double crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
With A, form an adjustable ring.

Round 2: Ch 1, 2 hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first hdc—20 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 1, *2 hdc in first st, hdc in next st; repeat from * 9 times; join with slip st in first hdc—30 hdc. 
Round 4: Ch 1, *2 hdc in first st, hdc in next 2 sts; repeat from * 9 times; join with slip st in first hdc—40 hdc.
Round 5: Ch 1, *2 hdc in first st, hdc in next 7 (3, 3) sts; repeat from * 4 (9, 9) times; join with slip st in first hdc—45 (50, 50) hdc.
Size Large only:
Round 6: Ch 1, *2 hdc in first st, hdc in next 9 sts; repeat from * 4 times; join with slip st in first hdc—55 hdc.
All sizes:
Rounds 6–13 (6–15, 7–15): Ch 1, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first hdc. Do not fasten off. 
Right Earflap 
Row 1 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), skip next st, hdc in next 5 sts, skip next st, hdc in next st, turn—7 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 2, skip next st, hdc in next 3 sts, skip next st, hdc in last st, turn—5 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 2, skip next st, hdc in next st, skip next st, hdc in last st—3 hdc. Fasten off.
Forehead Flap
Row 1 (right side): With right side and front edge of earflap facing, skip next 2 sts of last round, join B with sc in next st, sc in the next 15 (17, 19) sts, turn—16 (18, 20) sc.
Rows 2–6 (6, 8): Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. 
Fasten off.
Left Earflap
Row 1 (right side): With right side of forehead flap facing, skip next 2 sts of last round, join A with slip st in next st, ch 2, skip next st, hdc in next 5 sts, skip next st, hdc in next st, turn—7 hdc.
Rows 2 and 3: Work same as Rows 2 and 3 of right earflap.
FINISHING
Edging Round: With right side facing, join A with sc in center st at back of hat, sc in each st to first earflap, *2 sc in end of each row of first side, ch 11, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across (earflap tie made), 2 sc in end of each row of 2nd side*, sc in each st to forehead flap, sc in end of each row of first side, sc in each st across, sc in end of each row of 2nd side, sc in each st to next earflap; repeat from * to * once, sc in each remaining st; join with slip st in first sc. Using photograph as a guide, turn up forehead flap and sew a button in each upper corner, working through both thicknesses of flap and hat to secure. 
Pompom

8th rnd: With B, ch 2. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 64 hdc.

With B and smaller hook, ch 13.

2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sc. 1 dc in each of next 3 sc. Turn. 11 sts.

With B and smaller hook, ch 13. 1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each chain across. Turn. 12 sc. 2nd row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of first 3 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 11 sts. 3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 1 dc in each of last 3 dc. Join Window and Window Frame:

instructions:
With A, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.

Special Stitch
Front Post double crochet: Yarn over, insert hook from front to back to front around post of indicated stitch; yarn over and draw up loop, [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice.
HAT
With A, make an adjustable ring as follows: Wrap yarn around index finger, forming a ring, remove ring from finger and hold working yarn behind ring. Insert hook into ring, yarn over and draw a loop through the ring. Work Round 1 in ring, then pull tail to cinch ring closed.
Round 1: Chain 3 (counts as first double crochet here and throughout), work 9 more double crochet in ring; join with slip stitch in top of beginning ch – 10 double crochet.
Round 2: Chain 3, double crochet in same stitch as join (increase made), 2 double crochet in each stitch around; join with slip stitch in top of beginning chain – 20 double crochet.
Round 3: Chain 3, double crochet in same stitch as join, double crochet in next stitch, [2 double crochet in next stitch, double crochet in next stitch] 9 times; join and change to C with slip stitch in top of beginning chain – 30 double crochet.
Round 4: With C, chain 3, double crochet in same stitch as join, double crochet in next 2 stitches, [2 double crochet in next stitch, double crochet in next 2 stitches] 9 times; join and change to B with slip stitch in top of beginning chain – 40 double crochet.
Round 5: With B, chain 1 (counts as first single crochet here and throughout), single crochet in same stitch as join, single crochet in next 3 stitches, [2 single crochet in next stitch, single crochet in next 3 stitches] 9 times; join and change to A with slip stitch in beginning chain – 50 single crochet.
Round 6: With A, chain 2 (counts as first half double crochet here and throughout), half double crochet in same stitch as join, half double crochet in next 4 stitches, [2 half double crochet in next stitch, half double crochet in next 4 stitches] 9 times; join and change to B with slip stitch in top of beginning chain – 60 half double crochet.
Round 7: With B, chain 3, double crochet in same stitch as join, double crochet in next 5 stitches, [2 double crochet in next stitch, double crochet in next 5 stitches] 9 times; join with slip stitch in top of beginning chain – 70 double crochet.
Round 8: Chain 3, double crochet in each stitch around; join with slip stitch in top of beginning chain.
Round 9: Chain 2, half double crochet in each stitch around; join and change to C with slip stitch in top of beginning ch.
Round 10: With C, chain 2, half double crochet in each stitch around; join and change to A with slip stitch in top of beginning chain.
Round 11: With A, chain 3, double crochet in each stitch around; join and change to B with slip stitch in top of beginning chain.
Round 12: With B, chain 1, single crochet in each stitch around; join and change to C with slip stitch in beginning chain.
Round 13: With C, chain 1, single crochet in each stitch around; join and change to A with slip stitch in beginning chain.
Round 14: With A, chain 3, double crochet in each stitch around; join with slip stitch in top of beginning chain.
Round 15: Chain 3, double crochet in each stitch around; join and change to B with slip stitch in top of beginning chain.
Round 16 (front post stitch round): With B, chain 3, Front Post double crochet around beginning chain of previous round, *double crochet in next stitch, Front Post double crochet around same stitch; repeat from * around; join with slip stitch in top of beginning chain – 140 stitches.
Round 17: Chain 3, skipping all Front Post double crochets of Round 16, double crochet in each double crochet around; join with slip stitch in top of beginning chain – 70 double crochet.
Round 18 (front post stitch round): Ch 3, Front Post double crochet around first Front Post double crochet 2 rows below, *double crochet in next stitch, Front Post double crochet around next Front Post double crochet 2 rows below; repeat from * around; join with slip stitch in top of beginning chain – 140 stitches.
Round 19: Ch 3, skipping all Front Post double crochet of Round 18, double crochet in each double crochet around; join with slip stitch in top of beginning chain – 70 double crochet.
Round 20: Repeat Round 18.
Round 21: Chain 1, skipping all Front Post double crochet of previous round, slip stitch in each double crochet around; join with slip stitch in beginning chain. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in all ends. With C and pompom maker, make a 2”/5cm pom-pom. Sew pom-pom to top of hat.

Make Pom pom using A and 3 or 4 fingers of hand as follows:
1. Cut 18” (45.5 cm) length of yarn and set aside. Hold hand as if to shake hands, with fingers together and extended.
2. Wrap yarn around extended fingers for 120 wraps.
3. While wraps are still on fingers, fold cut length of yarn in half and slip under the wraps. With folded yarn in place, slip the yarn off fingers. Tie yarn length tightly in a secure knot.

instructions:

With A, ch 54 (60), taking care not to twist sts, slip st in first ch to form a ring. Place marker for beginning of round. Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in each chain around, slip st in top of beginning ch-3 to join – 54 (60) dc. 
Rounds 2-4: Ch 3, Fpdc in next st, *dc in next st, Fpdc; repeat from * around, slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Do not cut A. There was a typo here of an extra dc after the Fpdc.
Round 5: Change to B, ch 1, sc in same st, *skip 2 sts, Shell in next st, skip 2 sts, sc in next st; repeat from * around to last 5 sts, skip 2 sts, Shell in next st, skip 2 sts, slip st in first sc – 9 (10) Shells with a sc in between each Shell. Cut B.
Round 6: Change to A, ch 3, dc in st below first sc on Round 4, *ch 2, sc in 3rd dc of Shell, ch 2, 2 dc in st on Round 4 below next sc; repeat from * around to last Shell, ch 2, sc in 3rd dc of Shell, ch 2, slip st in top of beginning ch-3. 2 dc will be worked in st in row below sc between Shells to cover sc completely. This allows the contrasting colored Shell to "pop" out of main color.
Round 7: Ch 2, dc in next st (counts as dc2tog), *dc in each of next 2 ch, dc in next sc, dc in each of next 2 ch, dc2tog; repeat from * to last 5 sts, dc in each of next 2 ch, dc in next sc, dc in each of next 2 ch, slip st in first dc – 54 (60) dc. You will be working dc2tog over the 2 dc of previous row. This will return your st count to 54 (60 sts).
Round 8: Change to C and repeat Round 5. Cut C.
Round 9: Change to A, ch 3, dc in corresponding st in round below first sc, *ch 2, sc in 3rd dc of Shell, ch 2, 2 dc in corresponding st in round below next sc; repeat from * around to last Shell, ch 2, sc in 3rd dc of Shell, ch 2, slip st in top of beginning ch-3. This is the same as Round 6, working the 2 dc in the st in the row below previous row to cover the sc of the previous row.
Round 10: Repeat Round 7.
Round 11: Change to D and repeat Round 5. Cut D.
Rounds 12-13: Change to A and repeat Rounds 9-10.
Round 14: Change to E and repeat Round 5. Cut E.
Round 15-16: Change to A and repeat Rounds 9-10.
Round 17: Ch 2, dc2tog over next 2 sts (counts as first dc3tog here and throughout), dc in next 3 sts, *dc3tog over next 3 sts, dc in next 3 sts; repeat from * 7 (8) more times, slip st in first dc2tog – 36 (40) sts.
Round 18: Ch 2, dc2tog over next 2 sts, *dc in next st, dc3tog over next 3 sts; repeat from * to last st, dc in last st, slip st in first dc2tog – 18 (20) sts.
Round 19: Ch 2 (does not count as a st), (dc3tog) 6 times, dc in each st to end of round if necessary, slip st in first dc3tog.

Using long tail, weave end through top of last row and pull to close. Secure end. Weave in ends.

instructions:
With A, ch 62.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc and dc in same st, *skip 2 ch, work (sc, hdc, dc) in next ch; repeat from * across to last 3 ch, skip 2 ch, sc in last ch.

Joining Row: With right sides together, fold Hat in half crosswise, turn to work alongside edges, working through both layers along edges of rows, sc evenly spaced to Row 1. Do not fasten off.
Top Edge
Round 1: With wrong side facing, turn to work opposite foundation ch, ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), *hdc in sc, hdc in ch-2 space; repeat from * around, slip st in top of beginning ch to join – 40 hdc.
Rounds 2-4: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc, slip st in top of beginning ch. Do not fasten off.
Joining Row: Flatten Hat and working through both layers, slip st across 20 sts to join top of Hat.

Band
Round 1: With right side facing, join B in seam on lower edge of Hat, ch 1, sc in each st around, slip st in first sc to join – 60 sts.
Rounds 2-3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in each sc around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Rounds 5-6: With C, ch 2, hdc in each hdc around, slip st in beginning ch.
Rounds 7-8: Ch 1, sc in each hdc around, slip st into first st. Fasten off.
Round 9: With A, ch 1, sc in each sc around, slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

Rounds 7–15: Ch 1, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first st. Do not fasten off. Directions are for size X-Small. Changes for sizes Small, Medium, Large, and X-Large are in parentheses. Special Technique: Adjustable-ring method = Wrap yarn in a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail firmly between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring, working over both strands (the tail and the ring). After the first round of stitches is worked, pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring. Join with sc = Place a slip knot on hook, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through both loops on hook. Color Sequence: At the end of each round, change color as in the following sequence: Work 1 round with A, 1 round with B, 1 round with C, 1 round with D. Notes: 1. Hat is made in joined rounds with earflaps worked back and forth in rows. 2. Chain 1 at the beginning of a round or row does not count as a stitch. 3. In rounds only, change color in each size according to color sequence until otherwise instructed. 4. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Cut old color. Size Large only: Round 6: Ch 1, hdc in first 4 sts, 2 hdc in next st, [hdc in next 4 sts, 2 hdc in next st] 9 times; join with slip st in first st—60 hdc. Rows 2–8 (9, 10, 11, 12): Ch 2, (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in ch-1 space, dc in top of beginning ch, turn. Fasten off. Round 1 (right side): Ch 2, Fpdc around next st, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next st, *hdc in next 3 sts, Fpdc around next st, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next st; repeat from * to last 2 sts, hdc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, TURN—32 hdc and 16 Fpdc. 
Round 2 (wrong side): Ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn—48 hdc.

Notes
1. In following rounds, you will be instructed to work around or skip a stitch "2 rounds below". A stitch "2 rounds below" is in the round numbered 2 less than the round currently being worked. For example, if you are working Round 3, a stitch "2 rounds below" is in Round 1.
2. Always skip the stitch "behind" a post stitch. The stitch "behind" a post stitch is in the round you would usually have worked into.
3. When instructed to work in next stitch, but not "2 rounds below", work into the next stitch of the previous round (that you would usually work into).
4. Refer to the stitch diagram to clarify the post stitch pattern.

Round 3: Ch 2, skip first Fpdc 2 rounds below, Fptr around 2nd Fpdc 2 rounds below, hdc in next st (of previous round), working in front of last Fptr made, Fptr around skipped (first) Fpdc 2 rounds below, *hdc in next 3 sts, skip next Fpdc 2 rounds below, Fptr around next Fpdc 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, working in front of last Fptr made, Fptr around skipped Fpdc 2 rounds below; repeat from * to last 2 sts, hdc in last 2 sts, turn; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn—32 hdc and 16 Fptr.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning  ch-2, turn.
Round 5: Ch 2, Fpdc around first Fptr 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below, *hdc in next 3 sts, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below; repeat from * to last 2 sts, hdc in last 2 sts; join with slip st in top of beginning  ch-2, turn.
Rounds 6–17: Repeat Rounds 2–5 three times.
Rounds 18–20: Repeat Rounds 2–4.

Shape Top of Hat
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2, Fpdc around first Fptr 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below, *hdc2tog, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, Fpdc around next Fptr 2 rounds below; repeat from * to last 2 sts, hdc2tog; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn—24 hdc and 16 Fpdc.
Round 2: Ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2—40 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 2, skip first Fpdc 2 rounds below, Fptr around 2nd Fpdc 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, working in front of last Fptr made, Fptr around skipped (first) Fpdc 2 rounds below, *hdc2tog, skip next Fpdc 2 rounds below, Fptr around next Fpdc 2 rounds below, hdc in next st, working in front of last Fptr made, Fptr around skipped Fpdc 2 rounds below; repeat from * to last st, skip last st, turn; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn—16 hdc and 16 Fptr.
Round 4: Ch 2, [hdc2tog] 15 times, skip last st; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn—16 sts.
Round 5: Ch 1, beginning in same ch as join, sc2tog around; join with slip st in first st—8 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave tail through top of stitches in last round and pull tight to close opening at top of hat. Carefully secure end on wrong/inside of hat.

FINISHING
Pompom (optional)
Following pompom maker directions, make a 2" [5 cm] pompom and attach to top of hat. Weave in ends.

gauge: Rounds 1-4 = 4” (10cm) diameter. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Rounds 7-15: Hdc in each st around.

First Earflap

Row 17: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 12 (14) sts – 12 (14) sts.

Row 23: Repeat Row 19.
Row 24: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 2 (4) sts, sc2tog – 4 (6) sts.

Size Small/Medium Only

Size Medium/Large Only

Second Earflap 
With Right Side facing, skip 12 (14) sts from First Earflap for back of Hat; join same color section as for First Earflap in next st.
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 11 (13) sts – 12 (14) sts. 
Repeat Rows 18-26 (27) of First Earflap. Do not fasten off.
Directions are for size Small/Medium. Changes for size Medium/Large are in parentheses.
Notes
1. Hat is worked in a continuous spiral with Right Side facing at all times. Do not join and do not turn unless otherwise indicated. Use a stitch marker in the first stitch of each round to mark progress. Color changes occur with yarn naturally.
2. Earflaps are worked in turned rows in only one color.
3. Edging is worked in joined rounds with Right Side facing at all times using the same single color as Earflaps. Cut yarn as needed to maintain single color.
Special Stitches
hdc3tog = [Yarn over, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop] 3 times, yarn over and draw through all 7 loops on hook.
sc2tog = [Insert hook in next st, draw up a loop] 2 times, yarn over and draw through 3 loops on hook.
HAT
Crown
Ch 3; join with slip st to form ring. 
Round 1: Ch 1, work 9 (10) hdc in ring – 9 (10) sts.
Round 2: 2 hdc in each st around – 18 (20) sts.
Round 3: [Hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st] 9 (10) times – 27 (30) sts.
Round 4: [Hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st] 9 (10) times – 36 (40) sts.
Round 5: [Hdc in next 3 sts, 2 hdc in next st] 9 (10) times – 45 (50) sts.
Round 6: [Hdc in next 4 sts, 2 hdc in next st] 9 (10) times – 54 (60) sts.

Edging
Round 1: Ch 1, turn, 3 sc in first st (corner made), sc in next st, 3 sc in next st (corner made), sc in each row end of earflap to last row, hdc3tog using last row end, corner join of earflap and hat, and first st of hat, sc in next 16 (18) sts across front of hat, hdc3tog using last st of hat, corner join of hat and earflap, and first row end on side of next earflap, sc in each row end of earflap, 3 sc in next st (corner made), sc in next st, 3 sc in next st (corner made), sc in each row end of earflap to last row, hdc3tog using last row end of earflap, corner join of earflap and hat, and first st of hat, sc in next 10 (12) sts across back of hat, hdc3tog using last st of hat, corner join of hat and earflap, and first row end of earflap, sc in side of each row of earflap, join with slip st to beginning sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first st and in each remaining st around; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off.  
FINISHING
Weave in all ends.
Braids
Make 24 strands of each color, each 24” (61cm) long, and 2 wrapping strands, each approximately 6” (15cm) long. Each braid strand is made from 4 strands of each color. Pull a braid strand through each of the center 3 sc on bottom of earflaps. Pull one half of strand all the way through sc. Braid each side, leaving approximately 2” (5cm) fringe. Secure each braid with wrapping strand. 
PomPom
Repeatedly wrap yarn around 4 fingers of hand (more wraps make a fluffier pompom). Thread a strand of yarn under center of wraps and tie a knot. Cut through wraps on opposite side from knot. Fluff pompom and trim evenly. Use the ends of the knotted strand to tie pompom to center of crown.

Rows 3–5: Repeat Rows 3–5 of back leg openings—5 (7, 7, 9) V-sts. Rows 6–11: Repeat Rows 3 and 4 of back leg openings 3 times—11 (13, 13, 15) V-sts. Row 12: Repeat Row 5 of back leg openings. First Shoulder and Neck Row 1: Ch 1, V-st in first 3 V-sts, slip st in next V-st; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—3 V-sts. Row 2: Ch 1, slip st in first V-st, V-st in each V-st across—2 V-sts. Row 2: Repeat Row 2 of first shoulder and neck; change to B. Do not fasten off. Contrast Band Work same as contrast band of back. ASSEMBLY Sew side seams from last row of leg opening to armhole. Round 4: Ch 1, *beg V-st2tog, V-st in next 1 (2, 3, 4) V-st(s); repeat from * once, end V-st2tog, turn—5 (7, 9, 11) V-sts. Round 5: Ch 1, V-st in each V-st around; join with slip st in first sc, turn. Round 7: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—5 (7, 9, 11) sc. Fasten off. 2nd Sleeve Round 1 (right side): With back facing, join A with sc in first V-st of Row 1 of right armhole, ch 1, sc in same st (first V-st made); working in ends of rows, work 7 (9, 11, 13) V-sts evenly around armhole; join with slip st in first sc, turn—8 (10, 12, 14) V-sts. 9th row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 11 dc. (Dc2tog) twice. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn. 24 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.
Fold top of Hood, aligning sts of last row. Sew top of Hood closed using long tail.
CAPE
With RS facing, join A with sl st to rem loop of foundation ch at bottom left of Hood. See diagram on page 3.
1st row: Ch 2. 2 dc in first ch. *1 dc in next ch. 2 dc in next ch. Rep from * to last ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. 45 dc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * end of row. Do not turn. 60 dc.
Cape Edging
Front edging: (RS). Ch 1. Working up right front edge of Hood, Work 24 sc evenly to top of Hood (2 sc in side of each row). Work 24 sc evenly down left side. Join B with sl st to first dc of last row of Cape. 1st rnd: With B, skip first st. *5 dc in next st. Skip next st. Sl st in next st. Skip next st. Rep from * along bottom of Cape, up right front edge and down left front edge. Join with sl st to last st. Fasten off.
TIES (Make 2)
Make Bobble: Holding 2 strands of B tog, ch 4. [Yoh and draw up a long loop in 4th ch from hook (same height as ch-3). Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook] 4 times. Yoh and draw through rem 5 loops on hook. Ch 1. Sl st in 4th ch from hook (same sp as Bobble just worked) to create Bobble end. Ch 20. Fasten off leaving long tail. Using tail, attach each tie to front edge of Hood at 1st row. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 312 Black A, 324 Bright Yellow B; small amount 316 Soft White C.
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5mm [US H-8] and 6mm [US J-10].
abbreviations: sc2tog = draw up a loop in next 2 sc, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
A, B, C = color A, B, C
gauge: 13 sts = 4” (10 cm); 14 rounds = 4” (10 cm) in sc with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Beginning at lower edge, with larger hook and A, ch 44 (52, 56); join with a slip st to first ch, making sure ch is not twisted.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around; join with a slip st in back loop of first sc – 44 (52, 56) sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each sc around; join with a slip st in back loop of first sc.
Maintain Stripe Pattern and repeat Round 2 until piece measures 6 (7, 8)” [15 (18, 20) cm] from beginning. Fasten off.
Sew a seam straight across the top of the hat. Fold the corners formed by the top seam into the center of the hat and tack in place.
Bumblebee Body
Row 1: Beginning at rear end, with smaller hook and A, ch 4; 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc across changing to B in last st; turn – 12 sc.
Row 3: With B, ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 4: Repeat Row 3 changing to A at end of row.
Bumblebee Wings (Make 2)
Row 1: With smaller hook and C, ch 3; 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in next sc; turn – 4 sc.
Rows 2-4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, draw up a loop in next 4 sc, yo and draw through all 5 loops on hook. Fasten off.
Bumblebee Antenna (Make 2)
With A and smaller hook, ch 4. Fasten off.
Assembly
Sew seam of bumblebee, stuffing with fiber fill before closing seam. Sew wings and antennae to bumblebee in place as shown. Glue wiggle eyes in place. Sew completed bumblebee to center top of hat.

materials: 5.5 mm [US I-9] Susan Bates® Crochet Hook
abbreviations: ( ) = work directions in parentheses in same st
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: 10 sts = 4" (10 cm); 9 rows = 4" (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Ch 29.
Row 1 (right side): Slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 4 ch, (sc, dc) in next st, *skip next ch, (sc, dc) in next ch; repeat from * across, turn—5 slip sts, 12 sc, and 12 dc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, skip first dc, (sc, dc) in next sc, *skip next dc, (sc, dc) in next sc; repeat from * across, sc in each slip st, turn—17 sc and 12 dc.
Row 3: Ch 1, slip st in back loop only of first 5 sc, skip first dc, (sc, dc) in next sc, *skip next dc, (sc, dc) in next sc; repeat from * across to last 4 sts, leave last 4 sts unworked, turn—5 slip sts, 10 sc, and 10 dc.
Row 4: Repeat Row 2—15 sc and 10 dc.
Row 5: Ch 1, slip st in back loop only of first 5 sc, skip first dc, (sc, dc) in next sc, *skip next dc, (sc, dc) in next sc; repeat from * 8 times, sc2tog in last sc worked and in first unworked sc 2 rows below, turn—12 sc, 12 dc, and 5 slip sts.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2—17 sc and 12 dc.
Rows 7–42 (46, 50): Repeat last 4 rows 9 (10, 11) times.
Row 43 (47, 51): With wrong sides held together and working through both thicknesses, slip st in each st across. Fasten off, leaving an 18" (45.5 cm) tail.
FINISHING
To close top of hat, working in ends of rows, weave tail from front to back through first row, skip next row, weave from back to front through next row, *skip next row, weave from front to back through next row, skip next row, weave from back to front through next row; repeat from * around, pull gently to close. With beginning tail, make an overhand knot. Cut tails to 6" (15 cm).
Edging Round: With right side facing and working in ends of rows, join yarn with sc in any row, sc in each row around; join with slip st in first sc.
Pompom
Follow manufacturer’s directions to make a 3½" (9 cm) pompom and tie to top of hat. Draw tails to wrong side. Weave in ends.

gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Stripe Pat
Work 1 rnd of each color: B, C, D, E, F, B, G, A
These 8 rnds form Stripe Pat.
HAT
Ribbing: With A, ch 12.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 11 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg, when slightly stretched, measures 19½" [49.5 cm].** Do not fasten off.
1st rnd: Work 64 sc across longer side of ribbing. Join with sl st to first sc.
Proceed in Stripe Pat as follows:
1st rnd: With B, ch 4. 1 dc in same sp as sl st – beg V-st made. *Skip next sc. V-st in next sc. Rep from * around. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4. Fasten off. 32 V-sts.
2nd rnd: Join C with sl st in first ch-1 sp. Beg V-st in same sp as sl st. *V-st in next V-st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4.
First 2 rnds of Stripe Pat are complete.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last rnd until work from beg measures 7½" [19 cm].
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, proceed as follows:
Shape crown: 1st rnd: Join appropriate color with sl st in first ch-1 sp. Beg V-st in same sp as sl st. V-st in each of next 6 V-sts. Skip next V-st. * V-st in each of next 7 V-sts. Skip next V-st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4. 28 V-sts.
2nd rnd: Join appropriate color with sl st in first ch-1 sp. Beg V-st in same sp as sl st. V-st in each of next 5 V-sts. Skip next V-st. * V-st in each of next 6 V-sts. Skip next V-st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4. 24 V-sts.
3rd rnd: Join appropriate color with sl st in first ch-1 sp. Beg V-st in same sp as sl st. V-st in each of next 4 V-sts. Skip next V-st. * V-st in each of next 5 V-sts. Skip next V-st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4. 20 V-sts.
4th rnd: Join appropriate color with sl st in first ch-1 sp. Beg V-st in same sp as sl st. V-st in each of next 3 V-sts. Skip next V-st. * V-st in each of next 4 V-sts. Skip next V-st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4. 16 V-sts.
5th rnd: Join appropriate color with sl st in first ch-1 sp. Beg V-st in same sp as sl st. V-st in each of next 2 V-sts. Skip next V-st. * V-st in each of next 3 V-sts. Skip next V-st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4. 12 V-sts.
6th rnd: Join appropriate color with sl st in first ch-1 sp. Beg V-st in same sp as sl st. Skip next V-st. *V-st in next V-sts. Skip next V-st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4. Fasten off. 6 V-sts.
Thread yarn through rem V-sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely. Sew ends of ribbing.
Pompom: Wind A around 3 fingers 100 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Hat.

With MC, 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * to last 6 sts. With B, 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. With MC, 1 sc in each of last 3 sts. instructions:
Note: Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc throughout.

With larger hook, ch 4.

4th rnd: Ch 3. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around to last dc. 1 dc in last dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 54 dc.
5th rnd: Ch 3. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in last st from previous rnd keeping ch 3 at back of work. *Miss next st. 1 dc in next st. Working in front of dc just worked, 1 dc in missed st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch-3.
6th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
7th rnd: Working in both loops, as 5th rnd.

Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – dc2tog made. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. Rep from * to last 2 dc. Dc2tog. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 45 sts.
10th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Y oh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - sc2tog made. Rep from * around. 36 sts. Fasten off.

1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) twice. 2 sc in next sc. 28 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

instructions:

Round 4: Ch 3, dc in same st as joining, dc in next dc, fpdc around fpdc, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc, fpdc around fpdc] 8 times; join – 36 sts.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in same st as joining, dc in next 2 dc, fpdc around fpdc, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, fpdc around fpdc] 8 times; join – 45 sts.
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in same st as joining, dc in next 3 dc, fpdc around fpdc, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc, fpdc around fpdc] 8 times; join – 54 sts.

brim-Round 16: Turn work so wrong side of hat is facing you; ch 3, dc in each st around; join.
Round 17: Ch 3, fpdc in next dc, [dc in next 2 dc, fpdc in next dc] 17 times, dc in last dc; join.
Rounds 18-20: Ch 3, fpdc around fpdc, [dc in next 2 dc, fpdc around fpdc] 17 times, dc in last dc; join.
Round 21: Ch 1, (slip st, ch 4, slip st) in next st, [slip st in next 2 dc, (slip st, ch 4, slip st) in next st] 17 times, slip st in last st; join in first slip st. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® (6 oz/170.1 g, 315 yds/288 m)

instructions:
Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed, keeping color change to WS of work.
HAT
Cuﬀ  : With A, ch 55 (65).
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 54 (64) sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Join B.
3rd and 4th rows: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Join C at end of last row.

First Point
Note: First point is worked over the 20 (24) C-colored sc only.
21st row: (RS). With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 20 (24) sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 20 (24) sc.
**22nd and 23rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
24th row: (decrease row): Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 18 (22) sts.
25th to 27th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
28th row: As 24th row. 16 (20) sc.
29th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
30th row: As 24th row. 14 (18) sc.
31st to 40th (44th) rows: As 29 and 30 rows 5 (7) times more. 4 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. **

With RS facing, join B with sl st in first unworked B-colored sc following First Point.

materials: 1 skein Red Heart Super Saver in Spring Green (672) or Cherry Red (319) and Soft White (316)
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified

gauge: 13 dc = 4" [10 cm] in double crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With A, ch 4.
Round 1: Work 9 dc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch does not count as first dc here and throughout), join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 9 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (does not count as first dc here and throughout), dc in same space as join, 2 dc in space between each st, slip st in top of beginning ch – 18 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in same space, 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 27 dc.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in same space, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 36 dc.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in same space, dc in next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 45 dc.
For Medium, Large, X-Large and XX-Large Only 
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in same space, dc in next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 54 dc.
For Large, X-Large and XX-Large Only 
Round 7: Ch 3, dc in same space, dc in next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next 5 dc, 2 dc in next dc] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 63 dc.
For X-Large and XX-Large Only 
Round 8: Ch 3, dc in same space, dc in next 5 dc, 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next 6 dc, 2 dc in next dc] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 72 dc.
For XX-Large Only 
Round 9: Ch 3, dc in same space, dc in next 6 dc, 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next 7 dc, 2 dc in next dc] around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 81 dc.
Begin Pattern Stitch
Round 1: Ch 3, dc in each st around – 45 (54, 63, 72, 81) dc.
Round 2 (Cross Stitched): Ch 3, [skip next st, dc in next 2 sts, working in front of 2 dc just worked, dc in skipped st – Crossed dc made] around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each st around
Repeat Rounds 2-3 of Pattern st two more times for a total of 3 Crossed Stitch rounds.
Repeat Round 1 of Pattern st until piece measures 6 (7, 8, 8½, 8½)" [15 (18, 20.5, 21.5, 21.5) cm]. Fasten off.

ANTLERS (make 2)
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook – sc. Place stitch marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed. Stuff lightly with fiberfill as you go.
Round 2: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] around – 9 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each st around.
Repeat Round 3 until Antler measures 4" [10 cm] or desired length. At end of last round, slip st in first sc to join. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Antler Branch
With B, ch 2. 
Rounds 1-3: Repeat Rounds 1-3 as for Antler – 9 sc.
Note: Continue to work in back and forth in rows.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, leave remaining sts unworked, turn – 4 sc. 
Row 5: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice – 2 sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. 
Referring to photograph as a guide, sew open end of Antler Branch to side edge of Antler.

EARS (make 2)
Outer Ear
With A, ch 12.
Row 1: Dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in next 4 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, sc in next ch, 3 sc in last ch, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, sc in next ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 5 ch, d in first ch of beginning ch, turn – 20 sts.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in next 6 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, sc in next st, 3 sc in next st, sc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, dc in next 6 sts, dc in top of beginning ch – 22 sts.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in next 6 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, sc in next 5 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, dc in next 6 sts, dc in top of beginning ch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Inner Ear
With B, ch 10.
Row 1: Dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in next 2 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, sc in next ch, 3 sc in last ch, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, sc in next ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 3 ch, d in first ch of beginning ch, turn – 16 sts.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in next 4 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, sc in next st, 3 sc in next st, sc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, dc in next 4 sts, dc in top of beginning ch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
Sew Inner Ear in center of Outer Ear. Pinch sides of Outer Ear to center and tack down. Following photo, sew Ears and Antlers on to top of Hat. Weave in ends.

Ch 39 (49-57-59) loosely. (See Diagram on page 3).

Next row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to last sc. Working to end of row: (1 scbl in next sc. 1 sc in next sl st) 6 (6-7-7) times. Turn. 38 (48-56-58) sc.** 

Rep from ** to ** once more.

Rep from *** to *** once more. 
Fasten off. 
Lower Section:  With WS facing, working across rem sts of Main Section, join yarn with sl st to back loop of next sc. 
1st row:  (WS). Ch 1. Working in back loops only,  Sc2tog. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Turn.

3rd row: As 1st row.

Sew back seam. Weave yarn through last sl st of each row along top edge. Gather tightly and fasten securely.
