Note: All rnds are joined with sl st to first hdc. Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
Change to larger hook. 
1st rnd: Ch 2. Working around straight edge of ribbing, work 56 hdc evenly around. Join. 
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 
Rep 2nd rnd until work from lower edge measures 6½" [16.5 cm].
Shape Crown: 1st rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 6 sts. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 49 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 42 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 4 sts. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 35 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 28 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 21 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in next hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 14 hdc. 
7th rnd: Ch 2. *Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 7 hdc. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and secure tightly.

materials: Red Heart® Heat Wave Prints™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 164 yds/150 m) Ultra Violet (9540) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: HBdc = Yoh and insert hook in next stitch. Yoh and draw through stitch and first loop on hook. Yoh and draw through 1 loop on hook. Yoh and draw through both loops on hook – herringbone double crochet made.

HB2dctog = (Yoh and insert hook in next stitch. Yoh and draw through stitch and first loop on hook. Yoh and draw through 1 loop on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – herringbone double crochet 2 together made.
Hdcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook
Hdcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: Join all rnds with sl st to first st. Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st. With A, ch 68. Join with sl st to first ch making sure not to twist ch.

1st rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in each ch around. Join. 68 sts.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 hdcfp around next st. 1 hdcbp around next st. Rep from * around. Join. Rep 2nd rnd 5 times more.

Next rnd: Ch 2. 1 HBdc in each st around. Join. Turn.

Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 6" [15 cm], ending on a WS rnd.

Shape top: 1st rnd: (RS). Ch 2.
*1 HBdc in each of next 15 sts. HBdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 64 sts. Turn.

2nd rnd: Ch 2. *1 HBdc in each of next 14 sts. HBdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sts. Turn.

3rd rnd: Ch 2. *1 HBdc in each of next 8 sts. HBdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sts. Turn.

4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 HBdc in each of next 7 sts. HBdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sts. Turn.

5th rnd: Ch 2. *1 HBdc in each of next 6 sts. HBdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 42 sts. Turn.

6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 HBdc in each of next 5 sts. HBdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sts. Turn.

7th rnd: Ch 2. *1 HBdc in each of next 4 sts. HBdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts. Turn.

8th rnd: Ch 2. *1 HBdc in each of next 3 sts. HBdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sts. Turn.

9th rnd: Ch 2. *1 HBdc in each of next 2 sts. HBdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sts. Turn.

10th rnd: Ch 2. *1 HBdc in next st. HBdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 12 sts.

Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts.

pattern_name: Stitch Club Chunky Crochet Beanie + Tutorial
materials: Patons ® Norse™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 211 yds /193 m) Tawny Coral (91008) 1 ball
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
gauge: 11 sts and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm] in scbl pat.
instructions:
Note: Hat is worked sideways
Ch 42.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 41 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in first sc. 1 scbl in each sc to last sc. Leave last sc unworked. 40 sts. Turn.
3rd row: Sl st in back loop only of first sc. 1 scbl in next sc. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. 39 sts. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in first sc. 1 scbl in each sc to last sc. Leave last st unworked. 38 sts. Turn.
5th row: Sl st in back loop only of first sc. 1 scbl in next sc. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. 37 sts. Turn.
6th to 9th rows: As 4th and 5th rows twice more. 33 sts.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row, working into skipped sts and sl sts of previous rows. 41 sc. Turn.
11th to 13th rows: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd to 13th rows 3 times more. Break yarn leaving a long end. Thread yarn through side of sts at top of Hat and cinch to close.
FINISHING
With yarn end, sew foundation ch and last row tog. Thread yarn through side of sts at top of Hat and cinch to close.

materials: Patons® Canadiana (3.5 oz/100 g; 205 yds/187 m) Deep Orchid (10332) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and insert hook from back to front around post of next stitch. Yoh and draw up a loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and insert hook from front to back around post of next stitch. Yoh and draw up a loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
measurements: One size to fit average woman.
gauge: 14 sc and 17 rows = 4” [10 cm].
instructions:
Ribbing: Ch 13.
1st row: (RS). Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sl st in each ch across. Turn. 12 sts.
2nd row: Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each of next 12 sl st. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 18" [45.5 cm], ending on a WS row.
Do not fasten off.
Join back seam: Working in back loops only, sl st last row and rem loops of foundation ch tog. Do not fasten off. Turn work and proceed as follows:
Note: Ch 3 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
Beg working in rnds: 1st rnd: Ch 3. Work 70 dc evenly around. Join with sl st to first dc. 70 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around next dc. 1 dcbp around each of next 9 dc) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 8 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
4rd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 7 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
5th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 4 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 6 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
6th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 5 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
7th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dcbp around first st. (1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 5 sts) 6 times. 1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 4 sts. Join with sl st to first dcbp.
8th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sts. (1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 5 sts) 6 times. 1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 3 sts. Join with sl st to first dcbp.
9th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dcbp around each of next 3 sts. (1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 5 sts) 6 times. 1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sts. Join with sl st to first dcbp.
10th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dcbp around each of next 4 sts. (1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 5 sts) 6 times. 1 dcfp around each of next 5 sts. 1 dcbp around next st. Join with sl st to first dcbp.
11th rnd: As 6th rnd.
12th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around next dc. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around each of next 8 dc) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 63 sts.
13th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around each of next 6 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 56 sts.
14th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around each of next 4 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 49 sts.
15th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 4 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sts) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 42 sts.
16th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 4 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around next st) 7 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 35 sts.
17th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dcbp around first st. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around next st) 6 times. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Skip next st. Join with sl st to first dcbp. 28 sts.
18th rnd: Ch 3. Skip first st. (1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around next st) 6 times. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. 1 dcbp around next st. Join with sl st to first dcbp. 21 sts.
Fasten off leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.
Sew Pompom to top of Hat.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 1 skein each 1401 Pewter A, 1704 Bubblegum B, 1101 Eggshell C, and 1012 Black D
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Hat measures 18½” (47 cm) circumference at brim. Hat will stretch to fit a range of sizes.
gauge: 9 dc = 2½” (6.5 cm) in pattern; 6 rows = 2½” (6.5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Ribbing
With A, ch 12.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—11 sc.
Rows 2–66: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across, turn. Do not turn at end of Row 66.
Crown
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, working across ends of rows, sc in each row, turn—66 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in each sc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each dc, turn.
Rows 4–7: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 twice.
Row 8: Repeat Row 2.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in first 9 dc, sc2tog, [sc in next 9 dc, sc2tog] 5 times, turn—60 sc.
Row 10: Repeat Row 2.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in first 8 dc, sc2tog, [sc in next 8 dc, sc2tog] 5 times, turn—54 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc in first 7 sc, sc2tog, [sc in next 7 sc, sc2tog] 5 times, turn—48 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, sc in first 6 sc, sc2tog, [sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] 5 times, turn—42 sc.
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, sc2tog, [sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 5 times, turn—36 sc.
Row 15: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, sc2tog, [sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 5 times, turn—30 sc.
Row 16: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, sc2tog, [sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 5 times, turn—24 sc.
Row 17: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, sc2tog, [sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog] 5 times, turn—18 sc.
Row 18: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, [sc in next sc, sc2tog] 5 times, turn—12 sc.
Row 19: Ch 1, [sc2tog] times—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Trunk
With A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times; join with slip st in first sc—9 sc.
Round 3: Working in back loops only, sc in each sc.
Rounds 4–7: Sc in each sc.
Round 8: Work 2 sc in next sc, sc in each remaining sc—10 sc.
Rounds 9 and 10: Sc in each sc.
Rounds 11–14: Repeat Rounds 8 and 9 twice—12 sc.
Round 15: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 2 times—14 sc.
Round 16: Sc in each sc.
Round 17: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] 2 times—16 sc.
Round 18: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 4 times—20 sc.
Round 19: Work 2 sc in next 6 sc, sc in remaining sc—26 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Note: First 12 sts of Round 19 is top of trunk.
Tongue
With B, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Mouth
With A, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc—10 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
White of Eye (make 2)
With C, ch 2.
Round 1 (wrong side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in next sc, 2 hdc in next sc, 2 dc in next sc, 2 hdc in next sc, 2 sc in next 2 sc; join with slip st in first sc—12 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Iris
With D, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Ear (make 4 - 2 each in A and B)
Ch 12.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—11 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc, turn—22 sc.
Rows 3–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—20 sc.
Rows 7–10: Repeat Rows 5 and 6 twice—16 sc.
Rows 11–13: Repeat Row 6 three times—10 sc.
Fasten off.
Round 14: With right sides facing, hold 2 ears (1 each of A and B) together, working through both thicknesses and across opposite side of foundation ch, join A with sc in first ch of Row 1, 2 sc in same ch as join, sc in each ch to last ch, 3 sc in last ch; sc evenly across ends of rows of first side to Row 13; 3 sc in first st of Row 13, sc in each st to last st, 3 sc in last st; sc evenly across ends of rows of 2nd side; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING
Weave tail through stitches of last row of hat and pull gently but firmly to close. Sew edges of rows together to seam back of hat.
Stuff trunk with fiberfill so that trunk turns upward. Using photograph as a guide, position top of trunk on front of hat and sew trunk in place.
Sew tongue into curve of mouth. Sew straight edge of mouth (across ends of rows) under trunk.
Sew iris to white of eye. With tail of C, sew 1 small straight stitch on iris. Sew eyes on crown on either side of trunk.
Top knot fringe: Cut 2 or 3 lengths of A, each 6-8” (15-20.5 cm) long. Thread through top of crown and tie in place. Brush to fluff and trim to desired length.
Using photograph as a guide, position and sew ears to sides of crown.
Weave in ends.

pattern_name: Chic and Quick Messy Bun Hat
materials: RED HEART® Soft Essentials™: 1 ball Turquoise 7508
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Hat circumference at bottom edge: 21 (22)” [53 (56) cm].
gauge: 16 sts = 4” (10 cm); 8 rounds = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
HAT
Band
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc into 2nd ch from hook and each ch across — 7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, slip st in each sc — 7 slip sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each slip st. Repeat Rows 2 and 3 until band measures 21 (22)” [53 (56) cm].
Crown
Round 1 (Right Side): With right side facing, join yarn in first st with a slip st, ch 1, sc in same st, sc 71 (79) sts evenly spaced along one long edge of Band; slip st in first sc to join – 72 (80) sc.
Rounds 2-4: Dc in each sc around; join with slip st to first dc – 72 (80) dc.
Round 5: *Dc in next 3 sts, skip next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first dc — 54 (60) dc.
Round 6: *Dc in next 2 sts, skip next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first dc — 36 (40) dc.
Round 7: *Dc in next st, skip next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first dc — 18 (20) dc.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
With yarn needle, seam band. Weave in all loose ends.

materials: Bernat® Softee ChunkyTM (3.5 oz/100 g; 108 yds/99 m) Clay (28041) 2 balls
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from left to right. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
measurements: One size to fit average woman’s head.
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4” [10 cm]
instructions:
Ribbing: Ch 7.
1st row: (RS). Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sl st in each ch across. Turn. 6 sts.
2nd row: Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each of next 6 sl sts. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 21" [53.5 cm], ending on a WS row. Do not fasten off.
Join back seam: Working in back loops only, sl st last row and rem loops of foundation ch tog. Do not fasten off. Turn work and proceed as follows:
Note: Ch 3 at beg of rnd does not count as st. (See diagram on page 2)
1st rnd: Ch 3. Work 40 dc evenly around. Join with sl st to first dc. 40 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 dc) 8 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcbp around next st. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. 1 dcbp around next st) 8 times. Join with sl st to first dcbp.
4rd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcbp around each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts) 8 times. Join with sl st to first dcbp.
5th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around next st. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts) 8 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
6th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around next st) 8 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
Rep last 5 rnds until work from beg measures approx 8” [20.5 cm], ending on 6th rnd.
Shape top: 1st rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Skip next st. 1 dcbp around next st) 8 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 32 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. Skip next st) 8 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 24 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. Skip next st) 8 times. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 16 sts.
Fasten off leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.
Pompom
Wind yarn around 4 fingers approx 100 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Hat.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft™ (6 oz/170.1 g; 315 yds/288 m)
Sizes U.S. G/6 (4 mm) and U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge
Small amount of black worsted weight yarn for eye embroidery
Small amount of stuffing for eyes
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
measurements: One size to fit Child 4 to 8 yrs
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes: 
• Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as hdc.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
BERET
Beg at Crown, with A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 10 hdc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 20 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 50 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 60 hdc.
7th rnd: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 70 hdc.
8th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 80 hdc.
9th rnd: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 90 hdc.
10th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * around. Join hdc. 100 hdc.
11th rnd: Ch 2. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 110 hdc.
Next 3 rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join.
Dec rnds: 1st rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 100 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 *1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 90 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 80 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 70 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 54 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st around. Join. Fasten off.
EYES (make 2)
Eyelid: With smaller hook and A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sc.
5th and 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.
Eyeball: With smaller hook and B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long tail to sew Eyeball to Eyelid.
FINISHING
With black worsted weight yarn, embroider Pupil with Satin st as shown in photo.
Using long tail from Eyeball, sew Eyeball to Eyelid, stuffing gently before finishing seam.
Attach Eyes to top of Beret as shown in photo.
SATIN STITCH

materials: 1 skein each 3520 Peacock Feather A and 3620 Fern B
abbreviations: dec (decrease) = [draw up a loop in next sc] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 15 sts = 4”; 16 rows = 4” in sc. Rounds 1-5 = 3” across
instructions:
Hat
With A, ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc – 8 sc.
Round 2: With B, ch 1, inc in each sc around; join – 16 sc.
Round 3: With A, ch 1, [sc in sc, inc] 8 times; join – 24 sc.
Round 4: With B, ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, inc] 8 times; join – 32 sc.
Round 5: With A, ch 1, [sc in 3 sc, inc] 8 times; join – 40 sc.
Round 6: With B, ch 1, [sc in 4 sc, inc] 8 times; join – 48 sc.
Round 7: With A, ch 1, [sc in 5 sc, inc] 8 times; join – 56 sc.
12 Months Size Only-Round 8: With B, ch 1, sc in each sc around; join – 56 sc.
Toddler Size Only-Round 8: With B, ch 1, [sc in 6 sc, inc] 8 times; join – 64 sc.
Both Sizes-Rounds 9-25 (9-29): Continue to alternate color every round, ch 1, sc in each sc around; join. Fasten off after Round 25 (29).
Earflaps & Front Flap
Beginning at center back joining, place markers for Earflaps at st 8, 21, 36, and 49 (9, 24, 41, and 56). Earflaps are worked between markers 8 and 21 (9 and 24) and between markers 36 and 49 (41 and 56).
Place different color markers for Front Flap at st 22 and 35 (25 and 40).
Left Earflap
Row 1: With right side facing, join A with sc in marked st 8 (9), sc to marked st 21 (24); turn – 14 (16) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across.
Row 3: Ch 1, dec, sc to last two sc; dec – 12 (14) sts.
Rows 4-11 (4-13): Repeat Rows 2 and 3 4 (5) times – 4 sc.

Special Stitches
BPdc (back post double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from back to front and then to back again around post of next stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice.
BPhdc (back post half double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from back to front and then to back again around post of next stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
BPdc2tog (back post double crochet decrease) = [Yarn over, insert hook from back to front and then to back again around post of next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
hdc2tog (half double crochet decrease) = [Yarn over, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up loop] 2 times, yarn over and draw through all 5 loops on hook.
reverse sc (reverse single crochet) = Work single crochet in opposite direction from which you would usually work (left to right if you are right-handed and right to left if you are left-handed). This stitch is also known as crab stitch.

2nd rnd: Join B with sl st in next corner ch-1 sp. Ch 4 (counts as dc. Ch 1). 3 dc in same ch-1 sp as sl st. *(3 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in next corner ch-1 sp. Rep from * twice more. 2 dc in next corner ch-1 sp (same sp as beg ch 4). Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch 4. Break B.
3rd rnd: Join C with sl st in next corner ch-1 sp. Ch 4 (counts as dc. Ch 1). 3 dc in same ch-1 corner sp as sl st. *Skip next 3 dc. 3 dc in sp between next 3 dc. Skip next 3 dc. (3 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in next corner ch-1 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in next ch-1 corner sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-4. Break C.
4th rnd: Join D with sl st in next ch-1 corner sp. Ch 4 (counts as dc. Ch 1). 3 dc in same ch-1 corner sp as sl st. *(Skip next 3 dc. 3 dc in sp between next 3 dc) to next corner ch-1 sp. Skip next 3 dc. (3 dc. Ch 1. 3 dc) in next corner ch-1 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in next ch-1 corner sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-4.
Work a further 3 (4) rnds as established, working 1 more group of 3-dc before each corner ch-1 sp each rnd, in established color sequence, beg next rnd with A.
Fasten off, leaving long tail for seaming.
FINISHING
With WS tog and sts aligned, sew across 2 sides of Squares using whipstitch to form top and back seams.
BOTTOM EDGING
See diagram on page 3.
Turn Bonnet to work along bottom edge.
1st row: (RS). Join A with sl st in ch-1 sp at right corner. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 21 (24) dc to next ch-1 sp. Sc2tog over next 2 ch-1 sps. 1 sc in each d to last ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last ch-1 sp. Turn. 45 (51) sts.
2nd to 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
Fasten off.
FRONT EDGING AND TIES
See diagram on page 3.
1st row: (RS). Join A with sl st to last sc of last row of Bottom edging. Ch 1. Working into side(s) of last sc of Bottom edge, 1 sc in side of last sc of next 4 rows. 1 sc in each of next 21 (24) dc to ch-1 sp. Sc2tog over next 2 ch-1 sps. 1 sc in each of next 21 (24) dc to Bottom edge. 1 sc into side of last sc of next 4 rows. 51 (57) sts.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
4th row: Ch 29. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 27 ch (first tie made). 1 sc in each st of Front edging to end of row. 
Second tie: Ch 29. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 27 ch. Join with sl st into side of last sc of 4th row. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Classic™”: 1 Skein each 645 Honey Gold A and 513 Parakeet B.
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Hat fits most women. Hat Circumference: 20”.
gauge: 17 sts = 4”; 13 rows = 4” in pattern with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BAND: With smaller hook and A, ch 6.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 5 sc.
Rows 2-80: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off leaving an 8” end. Sew top of last row to beginning ch to form a circle, being sure that rows are not twisted.
Lower Edging: With right side facing and larger hook, join A at seam; ch 1, sc in each row end around; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
CROWN-Rnd 1 (Right Side): With right side facing and larger hook, join A at opposite side of seam; ch 1, sc in each row end around; join in first sc – 80 sc.
Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 2, skip first st, * Fphdc in next 9 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, Fphdc in next 7 sts **, hdc in next 2 sts; repeat from * to last st, end at **; hdc in last st; join with a slip st in top of ch-2.
Rounds 4 and 5: Ch 2, hdc in next st, * Fphdc in next 7 sts, hdc in next 4 sts, Fphdc in next 5 sts **, hdc in next 4 sts; repeat from * to last 2 sts, end at **; hdc in last 2 sts; join.
Rounds 6 and 7: Ch 2, hdc in next 2 sts, * Fphdc in next 5 sts, hdc in next 6 sts, Fphdc in next 3 sts **, hdc in next 6 sts; repeat from * to last 3 sts, end at **; hdc in last 3 sts; join.
Rounds 8 and 9: Ch 2, hdc in next 3 sts, * Fphdc in next 3 sts, hdc in next 8 sts, Fphdc in next st **, hdc in next 8 sts; repeat from * to last 4 sts, end at **; hdc in last 4 sts; join.
Rounds 10 and 11: Ch 2, hdc in next 4 sts, * Fphdc in next st **, hdc in next 19 sts; repeat from * to last 14 sts, end at **; hdc in last 14 sts; join.
Shape Top-Rnd 12: Ch 2, hdc in next 7 sts, hdc2tog, [hdc in next 8 sts, hdc2tog] 7 times; join – 72 sts.
Rnd 13: Ch 2, hdc in next 6 sts, hdc2tog, [hdc in next 7 sts, hdc2tog] 7 times; join – 64 sts.
Rnd 14: Ch 2, hdc in next 5 sts, hdc2tog, [hdc in next 6 sts, hdc2tog] 7 times; join – 56 sts.
Rnd 15: Ch 2, hdc in next 4 sts, hdc2tog, [hdc in next 5 sts, hdc2tog] 7 times; join – 48 sts.
Rnd 16: Ch 2, hdc in next 3 sts, hdc2tog, [hdc in next 4 sts, hdc2tog] 7 times; join – 40 sts.
Rnd 17: Ch 2, hdc in next 2 sts, hdc2tog, [hdc in next 3 sts, hdc2tog] 7 times; join – 32 sts.
Rnd 18: Ch 2, hdc in next st, hdc2tog, [hdc in next 2 sts, hdc2tog] 7 times; join – 24 sts.
Rnd 19: Ch 2, hdc2tog, [hdc in next st, hdc2tog] 7 times; join – 16 sts. Fasten off. Weave yarn end through.
VISOR-Row 1: With right side facing, larger hook and a double strand of A, skip 25 sc from seam of Band, join in next sc; ch 1, work Fpsc across next 30 sc; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st to last 2 sc; sc2tog; turn – 28 sc.
Rows 4 and 5: Repeat Row 3 – 24 sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Edging: With right side facing and smaller hook, join B at back; ch 1, work sc around Band and Visor; join to first sc. Fasten off.
FLOWER: With smaller hook and B, ch 5; join with a slip st to form a ring, ch 1.
Rnd 1:  10 sc in ring, join to 1st sc, ch 1.
Rnd 2:  2 sc in each st around, join to 1st sc, ch 4.
Rnd 3:  Dc in same st, ch 2 (2dc, ch 2 in next sc) around, sl st in 3rd ch of ch 4.  Fasten off.
Attach to left side of hat.

materials: RED HEART® Hygge™: 1 ball 8568 Slate Blue
Yarn needle, pompom maker or 2" (5 cm) piece of heavy cardboard.
measurements: Hat measures 20 (22)" circumference at brim x 16" long [51 (56) x 40.5 cm], excluding pompom.
gauge: 8 sc = 4" (10 cm); 7 rows = 4" (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Notes
1. Hat is worked vertically with short rows to create the curve at the top of the piece.
2. Work in back loops only as instructed for more stretch at the brim.
3. When instructed to work into a stitch "2 rows below", work into the row numbered 2 less than the current row. For example, if you are working Row 4, a stitch "2 rows below" is Row 4 – 2 = Row 2.
HAT
Leaving a long tail for sewing, ch 33. 
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—32 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in back loops of first 5 sts, sc in next 24 sts; leave last 3 sts unworked, turn—29 sc. 
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 24 sts, sc in back loops of last 5 sts, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in back loops of first 5 sts, sc in next 24 sts, sc in next 3 sts 2 rows below, turn—32 sc. 
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 27 sts, sc in back loops of last 5 sts, turn.
Rows 6–33 (6–37): Repeat last Rows 2–5 seven (eight) times.
Rows 34–36 (38-40): Repeat Rows 2–4. 
Fasten off.
FINISHING
With first and last rows held together, sew through both thicknesses to seam. Secure last stitch but do not cut. Weave tail through short row ends at top of hat and pull gently to close. Secure and pull tail to wrong side.
Following pompom maker directions, make 2" (5 cm) pompom or make pompom as follows: Wrap yarn around 2" (5 cm) piece of heavy cardboard (the more wraps, the fuller the pompom). Gently remove wraps from cardboard. Cut a 12" (30.5 cm) strand and tie it tightly around center of wraps. Do not cut the ends of this center tie. Cut ends of wraps. Fluff and trim pompom. Use ends of center tie to tie pompom to top of hat.
Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Softee Baby™ (9.9 oz/280 g; 724 yds/662 m)
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
4 yds [3.75 m] yellow yarn for ‘seed’ embroidery.
gauge: 16 hdc and 13 rnds = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written thus ( ). When only one number is given, it applies to all sizes.

Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of each rnd does not count as hdc.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.

HAT
With MC, ch 3.
1st rnd: 12 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 24 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join hdc. 36 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join. 48 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 11 (3-2) hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 11 (3-2) hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 11 (3-1) hdc. Join. 52 (60-64) hdc.

6th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 4½ (5-5)" [11.5 (12.5-12.5) cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Turn.
Next rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc around. Join. Turn.
Next rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.

Leaf Clusters (make 2)
With A, ch 15.
First Leaf: 1st rnd: **1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 6 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in last ch. Working into opposite side of ch, 1 sc in first ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 6 ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc.** Do not fasten off, proceed as follows.
Second Leaf: Ch 15. 1st rnd: Work from ** to ** as given for First Leaf. Fasten off.
Stem: With A, ch 7. Join in rnd with sl st to first ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Do not join. Work rem rnds in spiral.
2nd to 6th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
7th rnd: Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. (Sc2tog) twice. Join. Break yarn leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts (top of Stem).

FINISHING
Join Leaf Clusters and Stem: Sew centers of Leaf Clusters tog to form 4 leaf shape. Sew Stem securely in center. Pin Leaf Clusters/Stem to top of Hat with leaves evenly placed around. Using backstitch and A, sew center of each leaf to Hat leaving sides of leaves open.
Seeds: With yellow yarn, embroider 3 rounds of straight stitches approx. 1" [2.5 cm] apart (see photo).

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Classic Crochet Thread size 10™: 2 balls of 275 Coral
gauge: 23 sts and 10 rows dc = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With 2 strands of thread held together as one throughout, ch 6; join with a slip st in first ch. 
Round 1: Ch 1, 16 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc—16 sc.  
Round 2: Ch 6 (counts as dc, ch 3), skip next sc, *dc in next sc, ch 3, skip next sc; repeat from *around, join with a slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-6—8 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, (sc, hdc, 5 dc, hdc, sc) in each ch-3 space around, join with a slip st in first sc—8 shells.
Round 4: Ch 1, BPsc in first sc, *ch 8, skip next shell, skip next sc**, BPsc of next sc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in first sc—8 ch-8 spaces.
Round 5: Ch 1, (sc, hdc, 6 dc, hdc, sc) in each ch-8 space around, join with a slip st in first sc—8 shells.
Round 6: Repeat Round 4.
Round 7: Slip st in each of next 3 ch, ch 1, (sc, ch 4, sc, ch 4) in each ch-8 loop around; join with a slip st in first sc—16 ch-4 spaces.
Round 8: Slip st in next ch-4 space, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 5 dc in same ch-4 space, *ch 2, 2 dc in next ch-4 space, ch 2**, 6 dc in next ch-4 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—16 ch-2 spaces.
Round 9: Ch 3, skip first 2 dc, dc in each of next 4 dc, *ch 3, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc, ch 3, skip next dc**, dcin each of next 5 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—16 ch-3 spaces.
Round 10: Ch 3, skip first 2 dc, dc in each of next 3 dc, *ch 4, skip next ch-3 space, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc, ch 4, skip next dc**, dc in each of next 4 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—16 ch-4 spaces.
Round 11: Ch 3, skip first 2 dc, dc in each of next 2 dc, *ch 4, skip next ch-4 space, dc in each of next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc, ch 4, skip next dc**, dc in each of next 3 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—16 ch-4 spaces.
Round 12: Ch 3, skip first 2 dc, dc in next dc, *ch 5, skip next ch-4 space, dc in each of next 5 dc, ch 4, skip next dc**, dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—16 ch-5 spaces.
Round 13: Ch 3, dc in next dc, *5 dc in next ch-5 space, dc in each of next 5 dc, 5 dc in next ch-5 space**, dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—136 dc.
Rounds 14-30: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Round 31: Ch 3, dc in next dc (counts as dc2tog), *dc in each of next 2 dc, dc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—102 sts.
Round 32: Ch 3 (counts as FPdc), dc in each of next 2 dc, *FPdc around the post of next dc2tog, dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Round 33: Ch 3 (counts as FPdc), dc in each of next 2 dc, *FPdc around the post of next FPdc, dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: Size U.S. D/3 (3.25 mm) crochet Hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdc-slip (half double crochet slip stitch) = Yoh and draw up a loop into horizontal bar created below st in previous row (bar is below loops normally worked on WS – see diagram) and through all loops on hook
measurements: To fit infant 0-3 mos. Circumference: Approx 15½" [39.5 cm].
gauge: 20 sts and 18 rows = 4" [10 cm] in sc/hdc pat
instructions:
Notes:
• Toboggan is worked in rnds from top downwards.
• The lower ribbing is worked separately in hdc-slip (half double crochet slip stitch). 
• Take care not to work the hdc-slip stitches too tightly.

Version 1 (3-Color Version)
With A, make an adjustable ring: Wrap yarn into a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring. After the first round of stitches is worked, pull gently on tail to tighten ring.

1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 hdc in ring. Join. 8 hdc.

2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.

3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in next sc. *2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 hdc.

4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 hdc. *2 sc in next hdc. 1 sc in each of next 2 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc.

5th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sc. *2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 hdc.

6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 4 hdc. *2 sc in next hdc. 1 sc in each of next 4 hdc.  Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.

7th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sc. *2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 56 hdc.

8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 6 hdc. *2 sc in next hdc.  1 sc in each of next 6 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 64 sc.

9th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 7 sc. *2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 72 hdc.

10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 8 hdc. *2 sc in next hdc. 1 sc in each of next 8 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 80 sc.

11th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each sc around. Join.

12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc around. Join.

Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.

Work Rounds 13-42 as follows:
Change yarn color to B at the beginning of Round 15.
Change yarn color to C at the beginning of Round 29.
Change yarn color as follows: Fasten off old yarn color and draw up a loop of new yarn color in same sp as sl st.

13th to 42nd rnds: Rep Rounds 11 and 12. Fasten off.

RIBBING
With C, ch 10.

1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 8 hdc.

2nd row: Ch 1. *1 hdc-slip in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. Rep last row until work from beg measures length to fit around Toboggan. Do not fasten off.

Edge Ribbing and Join Ribbing into a Ring: Do not turn, working along long edge of Ribbing, ch 1. 1 sc evenly spaced along edge. Bring short edges of ribbing tog, matching sts. Working through both thicknesses, sl st in each st across to join Ribbing into a ring. 

Attach Ribbing to Toboggan: Make sure that the ridges of Ribbing face outwards. Place Toboggan inside ring of Ribbing, matching sts of last round of Toboggan and ends of rows along unworked long edge of Ribbing. Working through both thicknesses, sl st loosely around to join Ribbing to lower edge of Toboggan. Fasten off.

TOP KNOT
Join A with sl st to top of Toboggan. Ch 22.

1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Sl st in top of Toboggan. Turn.

2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st across. Turn.

Slip st in top of Toboggan at end of last row. Fasten off and weave in ends. Tie into knot.

Version 2 (Solid Version)
Work as given for 3-Color Version, omitting all references of color changings.

instructions: Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st. Carry colors when not in use loosely up WS of work. Both Sizes: Beg at top of Hat, with A, ch 20. Join with sl st to first ch to make a ring. 1st rnd: Ch 1. Work 24 sc in ring. Join with sl st to first sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 2. Cluster V-St in same sc as last sl st. *Skip next sc. Join with sl st to beg of first Cluster V-St. 24 Cluster V-Sts. 7th rnd: Sl st across top of first Cluster V-St to ch-1 sp. Join B. Ch 2. Cluster V-St in same ch-1 sp as last sl st. Cluster V-St in ch-1 sp of each Cluster V-St around. Join with sl st to beg of first Cluster V-St. 24 Cluster V-Sts. 8th rnd: Sl st across top of first Cluster V-St to ch-1 sp. Join A. Ch 2. Cluster V-St in same ch-1 sp as last sl st. Cluster V-St in ch-1 sp of each Cluster V-St around. Join with sl st to beg of first Cluster V-St. 24 Cluster V-Sts. 9th and 10th rnds: As 7th and 8th rnds. 11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *2 sc in ch-1 sp of next Cluster V-St. 1 sc between 2 Cluster V-Sts from previous rnd. 2 sc in ch-1 sp of next Cluster V-St. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 72 sc. 12th to 16th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off and weave in ends.

materials: Caron® Swirl Cakes™ (8 oz/227 g; 252 yds/230 m) Toasted Almond (22013) 1 ball
Sizes U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) and U.S. K/10.5 (6.5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Hdchl = *Work 1 hdc into horizontal bar created below stitch in previous row (bar is below loops normally worked on WS – see diagram).
Popcorn = Work 3 dc in next stitch. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back in first dc. Pull loop through. Ch 1 to secure popcorn.
Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only of next stitch
gauge: 9 sc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Ribbing: With smaller hook, ch 9.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 8 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Ribbing, when slightly stretched, measures 22" [56 cm]. Do not fasten off.
Ch 1. Join last row and 1st row tog, working 1 row of sc through both thicknesses. Do not fasten off.
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st. 
Change to larger hook and proceed as follows:
1st rnd: Ch 2. Work 55 hdc evenly along side edge of ribbing. Join with sl st to first hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdchl in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. Popcorn in next st. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
5th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *Popcorn. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
7th rnd: As 4th rnd.
Rep 2nd to 7th rnds for pat until work from beg measures approx 8" [20.5 cm], ending on a 3rd or 6th rnd.
Beg crown decs: 1st rnd: Ch 2. *Hdc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 44 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdchl in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 2. *1 hdc in first st. Popcorn in next st. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *Hdc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 33 sts.
5th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. *1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. Popcorn in next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
7th rnd: Ch 2. *Hdc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 hdc in next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 22 sts.
8th rnd: As 2nd rnd.
9th rnd: Ch 2. *Hdc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Thread end through rem sts, draw up tightly. Fasten securely.

materials: Hat 1: 1 skein each 520 Minty A, 235 Lemon B, and 312 Black C
Hat 2: 1 skein each 235 Lemon A, 726 Coral B, and 312 Black C
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4mm [US F-5] and 4.5mm [US G-6]
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Single crochet 2 together: [Pull up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 13 sts = 4" (10 cm); 10 rounds = 4" (20 cm) in half double crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
With A and larger hook, form an adjustable loop as follows: Make a loop over your fingers, insert hook into the loop and draw up 1 ch.
Round 1: 10 hdc into loop; join with a slip st in first hdc; pull end to tighten loop – 10 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 1 (does not count as a st here and throughout), 2 hdc in same st as joining, 2 hdc in each st around; join with slip st to first hdc – 20 sts.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next hdc, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next hdc; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first hdc – 30 sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, 2 hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next 2 hdc, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 hdc; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first hdc – 40 sts.
Round 5: Ch 1, 2 hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next 3 hdc, *2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 3 hdc; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first hdc – 50 sts.
Baby Size Only
Round 6: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in each hdc around; join with slip st to first hdc – 50 sts
Rounds 7-12: Ch 1, hdc in next hdc and in each hdc around; join with slip st to first hdc.
Round 13: Ch 1, sc in each st around.
Fasten off.   
Toddler Size Only
Round 6: Ch 1, 2 hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next 4 hdc, *2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 4 hdc; repeat from * around; join with slip st to first hdc – 60 sts.
Rounds 7-13: Ch 1, hdc in next hdc and in each hdc around; join with slip st to first hdc.
Round 14: Ch 1, sc in each st around.
Fasten off.
Eyes (Make 2)
With C and smaller hook, make an adjustable loop over your fingers, insert hook into the loop and draw up 1 ch.
Round 1: 5 hdc into loop; join with a slip st in first hdc; draw up end to tighten loop. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for attaching to hat later.
Beak
With smaller hook and B, ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each of next 2 sc, sc2tog, turn – 4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn – 4 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice, turn – 2 sts.
Row 5: Sc2tog.   
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for seaming later.
Top Knot (Make 3 or 4)
With smaller hook and A, ch 7.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for seaming later.
FINISHING
Referring to photo for placement, sew eyes and beak to hat using long tails and yarn needle. Thread yarn needle with long tails from top knot and thread through top of hat. Secure on wrong side. Weave in all loose ends.

materials: Patons® Canadiana™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 205 yds/187 m) Dark Grey Mix (10042) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcfp = Yoh and insert hook from front to back around post of next stitch. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook.)
measurements: One size to fit a verage woman’s head.
gauge: 14 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
Beg at crown, ch 3. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring. (See diagram on page 2).
1st rnd: Ch 3. 7 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 8 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dcfp around each dc around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 16 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around each of next 2 dcfp. 1 dc in sp between last dcfp and next dcfp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 24 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in sp between last dcfp and next dcfp. 1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 32 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dcfp around next dcfp. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 40 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dcfp. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 48 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 1 dcfp around next dcfp. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 56 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around next dcfp. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dcfp around next dcfp. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 64 sts.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sc.
10th rnd: Ch 2. *3 dcfp around dcfp 2 rows below. Miss next sc. 1 dc in next sc. Miss next sc. Rep from * 15 times more. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
11th rnd: As 9th rnd.
12th rnd: Sl st in next st. Ch 3 (counts as dc). Miss next sc. 3 dcfp around dc 2 rows below. Miss next sc. *1 dc in next sc. Miss next sc. 3 dcfp around dc 2 rows below. Miss next sc. Rep from * 14 times more. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
13th rnd: As 9th rnd.
14th rnd: Sl st in each of next 2 sts. Ch 3 (counts as dc). Miss next sc. 3 dcfp around dc 2 rows below. Miss next sc. *1 dc in next sc. Miss next sc. 3 dcfp around dc 2 rows below. Miss next sc. Rep from * 14 times more. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
Rep 13th and 14th rnds until work from beg measures 8" [20.5 cm], ending on a 14th rnd. Do not fasten off.
Band: 1st and 2nd rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sc. Do not fasten off.
Brim: Beg working in rows: 1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 46 sc. Turn. Leave rem sc unworked.
2nd to 10th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off at end of last row.
FINISHING
Fold Brim of Hat at corners and sew into place with button on each side as shown in photo.

materials: Caron® Colorama Halo™ Perfect Phasing™ (8 oz/227 g; 481 yds/440 m) Graphite Frost (76006) 2 balls or 601 yds/549.5 m
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) Susan Bates® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Y oslst (Yarn Over Slip Stitch) = Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch pulling loop just made through 2 loops on hook (1 loop rem)
measurements: Approx 27¾" [70.5 cm] around x 20" [51 cm] tall.
gauge: 15 yoslst and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm] in 2x2 Ribbing Pat.
instructions:
Notes: 
• Yarn has gradual changing color from Color A to Color B. Determine for yourself what shade will be A and B. 
• To maintain ombre effect when joining new ball join 2nd ball matching color from previous ball, letting colors change gradually. Excess of yarn can be used later for I-cord. 
• Hood is worked from bottom up in one piece beg in round and then continued flat in rows. When working in rounds, work is turned after each round. 
• It can be easy to miss first and last sts when working yarn over slip stitches (yoslst), so counting your sts every rnd/row may be beneficial. 
COWL 
Beg with Color A (darkest end of ball in this design), loosely ch 104. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring, being careful not to twist ch. 
Foundation rnd: (RS). Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 yoslst in first ch. 1 yoslst in each ch to end of rnd. Join. Turn. 104 sts. 
1st rnd: (WS). Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 yoslst in each st around. Join. Turn. 
2nd rnd: (RS). Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 yoslst in each st around. Join. Turn. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. Working under horizontal bar created in row below, 1 yoslst in each st around. Join. Turn. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working under horizontal bar created in row below, 1 yoslst in each st around. Join. Turn. 
HORIZONTAL BAR CREATED IN ROW BELOW 
Rep last 4 rnds until work from beg measures approx 7" [18 cm], ending on a 3rd rnd and placing markers on 52nd and 53rd sts of last rnd. Fasten off. 
HOOD 
With same end of yarn just fastened off, ch 5, leaving a 36" [91.5 cm] long end for seaming Drawstring Casing later. Cont as follows: 
Joining Row: (RS). Working under horizontal bar created in last row across, 1 yoslst in 53rd st (leftmost marked st). 1 yoslst in each st around to next marker. Ch 6. 115 sts. Do not join. 
Work back and forth in rows as follows: 
1st row: (WS). Working in back loops only across row, 1 yoslst in 2nd ch from hook. 1 yoslst in each of next 4 ch. 1 yoslst in each of next 104 sts. 1 yoslst in each of last 5 ch. Turn. 114 sts. 
**2nd row: (RS). Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 yoslst in each st to end of row. Turn. 
3rd and 4th rows: Ch 1. Working under horizontal bar created in row below, 1 yoslst in each st to end of row. Turn.** 
Proceed in 2x2 Ribbing Pat as follows: 
1st row: (WS). Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 yoslst in each st to end of row. Turn. 
2nd to 4th rows: Rep from ** to **. 
Rep 1st to 4th rows for 2x2 Ribbing, until work from beg of Cowl measures approx 16¼" [41.5 cm], ending on a 4th row. 
Shaping Back of Hood 
1st row: (WS). Ch 1. Working in back loops only across row, 1 yoslst in each of first 42 sts. 1 sl st in each of next 13 sts. Skip next st. 1 sl st in each of next 2 sts. Skip next st. 1 sl st in each of next 13 sts. 1 yoslst in each of last 42 sts. Turn. 112 sts. 
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only across row, 1 yoslst in each of first 42 sts. 1 sl st in each of next 28 sts. 1 yoslst in each of last 42 sts. Turn. 
3rd and 4th rows: Ch 1. Working under horizontal bar created in row below, 1 yoslst in each st to end of row. Turn. 
5th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only across row, 1 yoslst in each of first 42 sts. 1 sl st in each of next 12 sts. Skip next st. 1 sl st in each of next 2 sts. Skip next st. 1 sl st in each of next 12 sts. 1 yoslst in each of last 42 sts. Turn. 110 sts. 
6th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only across row, 1 yoslst in each of first 42 sts. 1 sl st in each of next 26 sts. 1 yoslst in each of last 42 sts. Turn. 
7th and 8th rows: As 3rd and 4th rows. 
9th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only across row, 1 yoslst in each of first 42 sts. 1 sl st in each of next 11 sts. Skip next st. 1 sl st in each of next 2 sts. Skip next st. 1 sl st in each of next 11 sts. 1 yoslst in each of last 42 sts. Turn. 108 sts. 
10th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only across row, 1 yoslst in each of first 42 sts. 1 sl st in each of next 24 sts. 1 yoslst in each of last 42 sts. Turn. 
11th and 12th rows: As 3rd and 4th rows. 
13th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only across row, 1 yoslst in each of first 42 sts. 1 sl st in each of next 10 sts. Skip next st. 1 sl st in each of next 2 sts. Skip next st. 1 sl st in each of next 10 sts. 1 yoslst in each of last 42 sts. Turn. 106 sts. 
14th row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only across row, 1 yoslst in each of first 42 sts. 1 sl st in each of next 22 sts. 1 yoslst in each of last 42 sts. Turn. 
15th row: As 3rd row. 
Fold in half (RS tog) and work through both thickness along top of Hood to join first 53 sts and last 53 sts, working 1 sl st under each pair of horizontal bars created in last row to fold. Fasten off. Turn Hood right-side out. 
Drawstring 
Ch 173. 
1st row: (RS). Working into horizontal ‘bump’ at back of each ch, 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Fasten off. 172 sts. 
FINISHING 
Drawstring Casing: Turn first 4 sts and last 4 sts of Hood Portion to WS (inside) and whipstitch into place, leaving bottom edge of Drawstring Casing open. Pin safety pin to one end of Drawstring. Work Drawstring through Casing. Remove safety pin.

materials: Red Heart ™ Heat Wave™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 198 yds/181 m)

gauge: 13 hdc and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:

count as st.
• To join new color, work to last loops on hook of first color. Yoh with new
color, draw through loops and
proceed with new color.

With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch
to form a ring.

around. Join. 16 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc
in next hdc) 8 times. Join. 24 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc) 8 times.
Join. 32 hdc.

Join. 40 hdc.

around. Join.

materials: RED HEART® Velvety™:  1 ball each 9803 Lake A and 9407 Kitty B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Hat measures 18 (21)” (45.5 [53.5] cm) circumference at the brim and 7 (8)” (18 [20.5] cm) in length.
gauge: 9 hdc = 4” (10 cm); 10 rounds = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With A, ch 3; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as 1 hdc here and throughout), work 7 hdc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—8 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 2, hdc in first st, 2 hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—16 hdc.
Change to B.
Round 3: Ch 2, 2 hdc in next st, * hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st, * hdc in each of next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch 2—32 hdc.
Change to A.
Round 5: Ch 2, hdc in each of next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, * hdc in each of next 3 sts, 2 hdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—40 hdc.
Round 6 (for size Large only): Ch 2, hdc in each of next 3 sts, 2 hdc in next st, * hdc in each of next 4 sts, 2 hdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—48 hdc.
Continue changing colors in established stripe sequence for remainder of hat.
Next round: Ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Repeat the last round until hat measures 7 (8)” (18 [20.5] cm) from center crown to bottom edge.

pattern_name: Give a Hoot Crochet Owl Hat
materials: RED HEART® With Love™: 1 skein each 1942 Plum Jam A, 1703 Candy Pink B, 1530 Violet C, 1101 Eggshell D.
Two 18mm round flat-back acrylic crystals, one 18mm marquise flat-back acrylic crystal, glue, stitch marker, yarn needle.
abbreviations: A, B, C, and D = Color A, B, C, and D
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 10 sts = 4” over single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
With 2 strands of A held together, ch 2.
Round 1 (Right Side): Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join, work in continuous rounds—5 sc. Place marker in last stitch to indicate end of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—10 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—15 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—20 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—25 sc.
Round 6: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—30 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—35 sc.
Round 8: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—40 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each sc around.
Round 10: [Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—45 sc.
Round 11: Sc in each sc around.
Round 12: [Sc in next 8 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—50 sc.
Round 13: Sc in each sc around.
Round 14: [Sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times—55 sc.
Rounds 15–25: Sc in each sc around.
Do not fasten off.

EARFLAPS
Row 1: Ch 1, turn, skip next st, sc in next 8 sc; leave remaining sts unworked—8 sc.
Rows 2–8: Ch 1, turn, skip next st, sc in each remaining st across—1 sc at the end of Row 8. Fasten off.
Sc in end of each row down side of earflap, sc in next 31 sc of last round of hat.
Repeat Rows 1-8 for second earflap.
Sc in end of each row down side of second earflap, sc in each remaining sc of last round of hat. Change to one strand each of B and C held together. Do not fasten off.

EDGING
Round 1: With one strand each of B and C held together, sc evenly around lower edge of hat and earflaps, working 3 sc in point of each earflap.
Round 2: Slip st in each sc around.
Fasten off.

EYES (make 2)
With 2 strands of A held together, ch 3.
Round 1: Work 11 dc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch counts as first dc); join with slip st in top of beginning ch—12 dc. Change to 2 strands of D held together.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc), hdc in same st as join, 2 hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 hdc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

BEAK
With 2 strands of C held together, ch 5.
Round 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 2 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, hdc in next 2 ch; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
Sew eyes to front of hat. Sew beak centered below eyes. Glue one round acrylic crystal to center of each eye. Glue marquise acrylic crystal to center of beak. Weave in all ends.

Top Tassels (make 3)
Cut 8 strands each of B and C, 14” long. Hold all strands together and fold in half. Insert crochet hook in top of hat and draw fold through to form a loop. Thread the ends of the strands through the loop and pull to tighten. Repeat to attach 2 more tassels to top of hat, nestling the tassels around Round 2 of the hat. Trim tassels to about 4”.

Earflap Tassels (make 2)
Cut 12 strands each of B and C, 24” long. Hold all strands together and use crochet hook to draw strands through tip of earflap, line up the ends of the strands. Hold all strands together and tie an overhand knot. Trim ends to 3½”.

Ch 36 (42-54-60-66). Join with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist ch.

materials: Bernat® Softee Cotton™ (4.2 oz/120 g; 254 yds/232 m)
Version 2: Contrast A Feather Gray (69002) 1 ball
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Bean Stitch = Insert hook in next st. Yoh and pull up a loop (2 loops on hook). (Yoh in the same stitch pull up a loop) twice. (6 loops on hook.) Yoh and pull through 5 loops on hook. Yoh and pull a loop through remaining loops.
measurements: One size to fit average Adult.
gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes
• Double strand by using the interior and exterior strand of the same ball at the same time for each colour used.
• Ch 3 counts as dc at beg of rnd.
Rnd 1: (RS) 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
Rnd 2: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 10 sc.
Rnd 3: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
Rnd 4: Ch 3. 1 dc in next st, 1 sc around last post. *1 dc in next 2 sts. 1 sc around last post. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 30 sts.

instructions:
HAT
Round 1 (Right Side): With A ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, do not join and do not turn—6 sc.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.

Round 9: [Sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—48 sc.
Round 10: Sc in each sc around.
Round 11: [Sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—54 sc.
Round 12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: [Sc in next 8 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—60 sc.
Round 14: [Sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—66 sc.
Rounds 15–25: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off A.
Teeth
Round 26: Join B with slip st in first sc, ch 1, sc in each sc around.
Round 27: Slip st in next sc, *ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, tr in last ch (tooth made), skip next 3 sc of Round 26, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st in last sc. Fasten off B.
Horn
Round 1 (Right Side): With C ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, do not join—6 sc.
Round 2: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice—8 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice—10 sc.
Round 4: Sc in each sc around.
Round 5: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] twice—12 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—15 sc.
Round 8: Sc in each sc around.
Round 9: [Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times—18 sc.
Round 10: Sc in each sc around.
Round 11: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—24 sc.
Round 12: Sc in each sc around.
Round 13: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times—30 sc.
Rounds 14–16: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off C, leaving a long tail for sewing horn to hat.
Eye
Rounds 1–3: With B, work Rounds 1–3 of Hat—18 sc.
Rounds 4–6: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off B, leaving a long tail for sewing eye to hat.
Pupil
Round 1: With D, work Round 1 of Hat; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. Fasten off D, leaving a long tail for sewing pupil to eye.

materials: Caron® Simply Soft® (6 oz/170 g; 315 yds/288 m) Main Color (MC) Country Blue (9710) 1 ball

With MC, ch 37 loosely.

1 hdc in each ch to last 10 ch. 1 sc in each of last 10 ch. Turn. 35 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sl st in back loop of first sc. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Work in horizontal bar only at front of work, created by hdc (see diagram), 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 2. Work in horizontal bar only, at front of work, created by hdc, 1 hdc in each st to last 9 sc. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 
4th row: Ch 1. Sl st in back loop of first sc. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Work in horizontal bar only at front of work, created by hdc, 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
5th row: Ch 2. Work in horizontal bar only, created by hdc, at front of work, 1 hdc in each st to last 7 sc. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 
6th row: Ch 1. Sl st in back loop of first sc. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Work in horizontal bar only, created by hdc at front of work, 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
7th row: Ch 2. Work in horizontal bar only, created by hdc, at front of work, 1 hdc in each st to last 5 sc. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 
8th row: Ch 1. Sl st in back loop of first sc. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Work in horizontal bar only, created by hdc at front of work, 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
9th row: Ch 2. Work in horizontal bar only, created by hdc, at front of work, 1 hdc in each st to last 3 sc. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 
10th row: Ch 1. Sl st in back loop of first sc. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in next sc. Work in horizontal bar only, created by hdc at front of work, 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
11th row: Ch 2. Work in horizontal bar only, created by hdc, at front of work, 1 hdc in each st to last sc. Working to end of row: (1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sl st) 5 times. Turn. 35 sts. 
Rep 2nd to 11th rows 6 times more. 
Fasten off, leaving a long end. 
FINISHING
Sew back seam. Weave MC through last sl st of each row along top edge. Gather tightly and fasten securely.
Pompom: (Make 2). Wind 1 strand each of A and B around 2 fingers 40 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Hat. 
Cord: With B, make chain 35" [89 cm] long. 
1st row: Sl st in back bump of 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Fasten off. 
Thread cord through sts as shown in picture 2" [5 cm] above bottom edge, beg and ending at one side of Hat. Try Hat on. Tie ends in a bow, so Hat fits snugly. Sew pompom to each end of cord.

abbreviations: dc2tog: *Yo, insert hook in st and draw up loop, yo, draw yarn through 2 loops, yo, insert hook in next st, yo, draw yarn through 2 loops, yo, draw through 3 loops.
Fpdc (front post double crochet): Yo, insert hook from front to back to front around the post of next st, (yo, draw yarn through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Bpdc (back post double crochet): Yo, insert hook from back to front to back around the post of next st, (yo, draw yarn through 2 loops on hook) twice.

Larks Head Knot: Fold 4 strands of yarn in half and using your crochet hook, pull the folded end through the stitch from front to back, hook the strands and pull them through the loop. Tighten knot by pulling the strands away from your design.

instructions:
HAT
Start at the top center, ch 4; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring. 
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 11 dc in ring; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 12 sts. 
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in first st, 2 dc in each st around; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 24 sts.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in next st, 2 Fpdc in next st, *dc in next 2 sts, 2 Fpdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 32 sts
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in next 2 sts, 2 Fpdc in next st, *dc in next 3 sts, 2 Fpdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 40 sts
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in next st, Fpdc in next st, dc in next st, 2 Fpdc in next st, *dc in next 2 sts, Fpdc in next st, dc in next st, 2 Fpdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 48 sts
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in next 4 sts, 2 Fpdc in next st, *dc in next 5 sts, 2 Fpdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 56 sts
Round 7: Ch 3, dc in next st, Fpdc in next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts, 2 Fpdc in next st, *dc in next 2 sts, Fpdc in next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts, 2 Fpdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 64 sts
Round 8: Ch 3, dc in next 6 sts, 2 Fpdc in next st, *dc in next 7 sts, 2 Fpdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 72 sts
Round 9: Ch 3, dc in next st, Fpdc in next 4 sts, dc in next 2 sts, 2 Fpdc in next st, *dc in next 2 sts, Fpdc in next 4 sts, dc in next 2 sts, 2 Fpdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 80 sts
Round 10: Ch 3, dc in next 8 sts, 1 (2, 2) Fpdc in next st, *dc in next 9 sts, 1 (2, 2) Fpdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 
80 (88, 88) sts.
Round 11: Ch 3, dc in next st, Fpdc in next 5 (6, 6) sts, dc in next 2 sts, 1 (1, 2) Fpdc in next st, * dc in next 2 sts, Fpdc in next 5 (6, 6) sts, dc in next 2 sts, 1 (1, 2) Fpdc in next st, * repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 80 (88, 96) sts.
Round 12: Ch 3, dc in next 8 (9, 10) sts, Fpdc in next st, *dc in next 9 (10, 11) sts, Fpdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3. 
Round 13: Ch 3, Fpdc in next 7 (8, 9) sts, dc in next st, Fpdc in next st, *dc in next st, Fpdc in next 7 (8, 9) sts, dc in next st, Fpdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3.
Round 14-19: Repeat Rounds 12-13 three times.
Round 20: Ch 3, Fpdc in next 8 (9, 10) sts, 2 Fpdc in next st, *Fpdc in next 9 (10, 11) sts, 2 Fpdc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of ch-3 – 
88 (96, 104) sts.
Rounds 21-24 (21-25, 21-25): Ch 3 (does not count as a st), Fpdc around first ch-3 post in previous round, Fpdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of first Fpdc – 88 (96, 104) FPdc. Fasten off.
Ear Flaps
Left Flap
Row 1: With RS facing, join yarn with slip st in 20th (22nd, 24th) sts to the left of center front FPdc, ch 3 (does not count as a st for remainder of pattern), Fpdc in same st, Fpdc in each of next 14 sts – 15 Fpdc.
Row 2: Ch 3, Bpdc around first st, Bpdc in each st across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, Fpdc around first st, Fpdc in next 6 sts, skip next st, Fpdc in each st across; turn – 14 sts
Row 4: Repeat Row 2.
Row 5: Ch 3, Fpdc around first st, Fpdc in each st across; turn. 
Row 6: Repeat Row 2
Row 7: Ch 3, Fpdc around first st, Fpdc in next 2 sts, skip next st, Fpdc in next 6 sts, skip next st, Fpdc in last 3 sts; turn – 12 sts
Row 8: Repeat Row 2
Row 9: Ch 3, Fpdc around first st, Fpdc in next 2 sts, skip next st, Fpdc in next 4 sts, skip next st, Fpdc in last 3 sts – 10 sts. Fasten off
Right Flap
Fold hat in half. 
Row 1: With RS facing, join yarn with slip st in 34th (36th, 38th) sts to the right of center front FPdc, ch 3 (does not count as a st for remainder of pattern), Fpdc in same st, Fpdc in each of next 14 sts – 15 Fpdc.
Rows 2-9: Repeat Rows 2-9 of Left Ear Flap. Fasten off.
Border
Round 1: With RS facing, join yarn in center back slip st, ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in each st across to ear flap, *work 15 dc evenly spaced across right side of ear flap, working across last row of ear flap, **dc2tog in next 2 sts; repeat from ** 4 more times, work 15 dc evenly spaced across left side of earflap*, dc in each st across front of hat to next ear flap; repeat from * to * once, dc in each st across back of hat to beginning; join with slip st in top of ch-3. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Braided Ear Flap Ties
Cut four 24” lengths of yarn for each fringe. Join 6 fringes with a lark’s head knot in 6 sts across bottom edge of each flap. Using 2 adjacent fringes for each section, separate fringes into 3 sections. Braid 3 sections for desired length. Cut an 8” length of yarn, tie at the bottom of the braid, wrap several times around and weave into the bottom of the braid. Trim the yarn evenly at the end of the braid.
PomPom
Make a 3” pompom and attach to the top of the hat.
Weave in ends.

Crown

Round 4: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] – 24 sts.
Round 5: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] – 30 sts.
Round 6: Sc in each st around.
Round 7: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] – 36 sts.
Round 8: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] – 42 sts.
Round 9: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts] – 48 sts.
Round 10: Ch 2, dc in each st around, join with slip st to top of ch 2 – 48 sts.
Round 11: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts] – 54 sts.
Round 12: Repeat Round 10.
Round 13-14: Repeat Round 6.
Round 15: Repeat Round 10.
Round 16-17: Repeat Round 6.
Fasten off.
Heart Flap (Make 2)
With B, ch 4, slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc), work 12 dc in ring – 13 sts.
Round 2: Sc in each st; turn.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in same st, 2 dc in next 2 sts, hdc in next st, sc in next 2 sts, 3 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts, hdc in next st, 2 dc in next 3 sts; turn – 21 sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, skip first st, 2 sc in next 4 sts, sc in next 5 sts, 3 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next 4 sts, slip st 6 sts across the top of the heart – 36 sts.

Ear Flaps: Count in 6 sts from the center back on each side of hat. Pin earflaps 1” up from bottom edge of hat. With B, sew across heart along hat edge. 
Border: With B, join yarn at the center back of hat. Ch1, sc in same st, sc in next 5 sts, slip st in the front loops around the right earflap, sc across the front of the hat, slip st in the front loops around the left earflap, sc in the remaining 6 sts of hat. Fasten off.

instructions:
Notes:

With E ch 10.

Planned Pooling 
Argyle Hat
Start you pooling adventure with a small 
project like this fresh argyle hat. Then go on 
to create larger garments and throws.
Hat measures 21" (53.5 cm) in

NOTES
1. It is highly recommended that you
watch Marly Bird’s tutorial videos
on planned color pooling before 
beginning this project.
2. You may have to tighten or loosen 
some stitches as you go in order to 
keep the color pooling intact. Keep a 
variety of hook sizes on hand to help 
resize your stitches.
3. Different dye lots of the same
colorway may change the number
of stitches obtained in any given
color. Count the number of stitches
YOU get to work through one full
sequence, as well as in each color
section, and maintain that throughout
the pattern.
4. Hat is worked flat and then seamed
using whip stitch.
MOSS STITCH
Ch an even number of sts.
Row 1: Skip 3 ch, sc in next ch, * ch 
1, skip 1 foundation ch, sc in next ch; 
repeat from * to end, turn.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as a stitch now and 
throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 
1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to 
end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, 
turn.
Row 3: Ch 2 (counts as a stitch now and 
throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 
1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to 
end finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, 
turn.
Repeat Row 3 only for Moss st.
SPECIAL STITCH
Sc2tog = Single crochet 2 together: 
[Pull up a loop in next st] twice, yo and 
draw through all 3 loops on hook. 
SPECIAL TECHNIQUE
Crab Stitch: Sc in last st of previous row 
or rouned, * sc in next st to the RIGHT 
of last st worked; repeat from * to end 
of row or round (reversing normal 
direction of work).
HAT
With A, ch through 3 full color 
sequences, with the last loop on hook 
being the first loop of a new color just 
after a color change in the yarn. 
Row 1 (right side): Skip 3 ch (counts 
as a st), sc in the 4th ch from hook, * 
ch 1, sc around the foundation ch 
(instead of going into a ch st); repeat 
from * until 1 full color sequences has 
been completed. Count the number 
of sc made in each individual color in 
the colorway and note it down. Work 2 
more full color sequences, maintaining 
the same number of sc made in each 
individual color. Leave remaining ch sts 
unworked. Undo one st repeat (sc, ch 1), 
turn.
Row 2 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as 
a st now and throughout), sc in next 
ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; 
repeat from * to end finishing with a sc 
in last ch-3 space, turn.
Note: As you work this row and all 
remaining rows, you MUST get the 
correct number of sc in each color in 
order to maintain the planned color 
pooling. Change hook sizes, or actual st 
used, to get the correct color in place. 
If you use the same number of sts per 
color that you counted on Row 1, it will 
work out.

Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHIING
Squish or stretch the sts on foundation 
chain of Trim to match the width of the 
rest of the piece. You can slide the sts

Seaming
With wrong side facing, thread long 
yarn tail through remaining sts on the 
last row of the crown and pull tight like 
a drawstring. Then, use whip st to sew 
the side seam of the hat to the bottom. 
Edging
Turn hat upside down. With right side 
facing and working across foundation 
edge, join B with a slip st foundation ch

Round 1 (right side): * Ch 1, sc in next

PomPom

materials: RED HEART® Heads Up™: 1 ball each of 401 Steel A and 531 Maroon B
