instructions:
Round 1 (right side): Work 8 sc in ring; join with slip st in front loop of first sc—8 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 8 times; join with slip st first sc—24 sc. Fasten off A.
Round 4: With right side facing, join B with beg-dc in 13th sc of previous round, dc in same st, dc in next 2 sts, [2 dc in next st, dc in next 2 sts] 7 times; join with slip st in beg-dc—32 dc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—40 sc. Fasten off B.
Round 6: With right side facing, join A with beg-dc in 17th sc of previous round, dc in same st, dc in next 4 sts, [2 dc in next st, dc in next 4 sts] 7 times; join with slip st in beg-dc—48 dc. Fasten off A.
Round 7: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in 21st dc of previous round, ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 8 times; join with slip st in first sc—56 sc. Fasten off B.
Round 8: With right side facing, join A with beg-dc in 25th sc of previous round, dc in each st around; join with slip st in beg-dc.
Round 9: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off A.
Round 10: With right side facing, join B with beg-dc in 29th sc of previous round, dc in each st around; join with slip st in beg-dc.
Round 11: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off B.
Round 12: With right side facing, join A with beg-dc in 15th sc of previous round, dc in each st around; join with slip st in beg-dc. Fasten off A.
Round 13: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in same st as joining, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 14: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, *ch 1, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around to last st, ch 1, skip last st; join with slip st in first sc—28 ch-1 spaces and 28 sc.
Round 15: Ch 1, sc in each sc and ch-1 space around; join with slip st in first sc—56 sc. Fasten off B.
Place markers for back and front of hat: Mark joining st of Round 15 for back of hat. Mark 29th st from back of hat marker for center front of hat.
Visor
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in 12th st before center front marker, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 9 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st (marked center st), sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts, turn—28 sc. Remove marker from center front st.
Row 2: Ch 1, skip first st, slip st in next st, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts, hdc in next 3 sts, dc in next 3 sts, 2 dc in each of next 2 sts, dc in next 3 sts, hdc in next 3 sts, sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog, turn; leave last 2 sts unworked—24 sts (not counting the slip st).

Edging Round (right side): With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in marked st at back of hat, remove marker, ch 1, sc in each st to visor, sc evenly spaced across entire edge of visor, sc in each st to end of round; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

instructions:
CAP: With CB, ch 4; join with a sl st in first ch to form a ring.

Rnd 4: Ch 1, [hdc in next 3 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 8 times changing to CB in last hdc; join; turn – 40 hdc.

Rnd 5: With CB, ch 1, [hdc in next 4 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 8 times; join – 48 hdc.

Rnd 6: Ch 1, [hdc in next 5 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 8 times changing to CA in last hdc; join – 56 hdc.

Rnds 7 and 8: With CA, ch 1, hdc in each hdc around; join; turn.

Rnds 9 and 10: Rep Rnds 7 and 8 with CB.

Rnds 11-15: Rep Rnd 7 with CA. Fasten off.

First Earflap-Row 1: With right side facing, join CA in 7th hdc from back joining; ch 1, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next 10 hdc; turn – 11 hdc.

Row 2: Ch 1, hdc in each hdc across; turn.

Row 3: Ch 1, dec, hdc in next 7 hdc, dec; turn – 9 hdc.

Rnd 5: Ch 1, dec, hdc in next 5 hdc, dec; turn – 7 hdc.

Row 6: Ch 1, dec, hdc in next 3 hdc, dec; turn – 5 hdc.

This chenille yarn is so soft and wonderful to touch that baby will enjoy wearing this hat! The easy crochet pattern will work up quickly for last minute gifts for boy or girl babies.

Special Stitches
sc2tog (single crochet 2 stitches together) = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
sc3tog (single crochet 3 stitches together) = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop in next st] 3 times, yarn over and draw through all 4 loops on hook.

Notes: Hat is worked in joined rounds, with right side always facing, beginning at top of Hat. Earflaps are worked back and forth in rows beginning over a portion of the stitches in the last round of Hat.

HAT
Ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—30 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc.
Round 7: Ch 1, [sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—42 sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, [sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—48 sc.
Round 9: Ch 1, [sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—54 sc.
Round 10: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.
Repeat last round until piece measures about 6 in. (15 cm) from beginning. Do not fasten off.

First Earflap
Row 1 (right side): (Slip st, ch 1, sc) in next sc, sc in next 8 sc, turn; leave remaining sts unworked—9 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in next 9 sc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc, turn—7 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [sc2tog, sc in next sc] twice, turn—5 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc3tog, sc in last sc, turn—3 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off.

Second Earflap
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing, skip next 20 unworked sc of last round of Hat (for front of Hat), join yarn with sc in next sc, sc in next 8 sc, turn; leave remaining sts unworked (for back of Hat)—9 sc.
Rows 2–8: Work same as Rows 2–8 of First Earflap. Do not turn at the end of Row 8. Do not fasten off.

Edging and Ties
Sc in end of each row across side edge of Second Earflap, sc in each unworked sc across back of Hat, sc in end of each row across side edge of First Earflap; working across last row of Earflap, sc in first sc, ch 41 (for first Tie), slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, skip next sc, sc in last sc; sc in end of each row across next side edge of First Earflap, sc in each unworked sc across front of Hat, sc in end of each row across edge of Second Earflap; working across last row of Earflap, sc in first sc, ch 41 (for 2nd Tie), slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, skip next sc, sc in last sc; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in ends.

Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – dcfp2tog made**. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from* around, ending at **. Join B with sl st to first sc. 80 (100) sts.

(1 dcfp around post of next dcfp. 1 sc in next sc) 1 (2) time(s). 1 dcfp around post of next st. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending with 1 dcfp around post of last st. Size 6/8 only: Next rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dcfp around post of next st. (1 sc in next sc. 1 dcfp around post of next dcfp) twice. 1 sc in next sc. Dcfp2tog over next 3 sts. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending with 1 dcfp around post of last dcfp. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sts.

instructions:
Notes: 
• To achieve the look shown in photos, work Triangle Motifs and Brim using only the first 4 colors as ‘self-striping’ yarn, allowing colors to change as they appear.
• Make sure to cut off and set aside the longest color length (either Black or Soft White) to use for joining and edges.
Triangle Motif (Make 3)
See Diagram on page 3.
Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 5 (counts as 1 dc and ch-2 sp). (3 dc. Ch 2) twice in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-5.
2nd rnd: Sl st in next ch-2 sp. Ch 5 (counts as 1 dc and ch-2 sp). 2 dc in ring. *1 dc in each of next 3 dc to next ch-2 sp. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * once more. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in first ch-2 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-5.
3rd to 5th rnds: Sl st in next ch-2 sp. Ch 5 (counts as 1 dc. Ch-2 sp). 2 dc in ring. *1 dc in each dc to next ch-2 sp. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * once more. 1 dc in each dc to first ch-2 sp. 1 dc in first ch-2 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-5.
Fasten off at end of 5th rnd.
Join Motifs
FLAT SLIP STITCH JOIN
Notes:  
• Hold working yarn (Black or Soft White) underneath work to create a flat seam. 
• Keep a loose, even tension on the yarn while joining to keep Motifs flat and even. Too tight tension will cause them to bunch up. 
Place 2 Motifs beside each other, RS up. 
Join yarn (Black or Soft White) with sl st to left Motif in ch-1 corner sp. Insert hook from front to back into back loop of corner ch-1 on this same left Motif. Insert hook from front to back into back loop of corner ch-1 sp of right Motif. (3 loops now on hook). Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook.  *Insert hook from front to back into back loop of next st on left Motif. Insert hook from front to back into back loop of corresponding st of right Motif. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook. Rep from * to end of Motif. 
Join 3 Motifs along side edges to create Cap top.
BOTTOM EDGE
1st rnd: (RS). Join yarn (Black or Soft White) with sl st to any ch-2 sp along bottom edge. Ch 3 (counts as dc). Work 1 dc into each dc, ch-2 sp and into center of join between each Motif. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Do not fasten off.
Place joined Motifs of Cap onto Hat to determine if another rnd of sts is needed to align with bottom edge of Hat when slightly stretched. If needed, work 1 more rnd of either sc, hdc or dc into each dc around to achieve proper depth. Fasten off. Weave in ends on WS.
BRIM
See Diagram on page 3.
Note: Instructions are written to fit an average Baseball cap brim length of approx 3" [7.5 cm] long and 8" [20.5 cm] wide.  
Ch 16.
1st row: (RS). 2 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 3 dc). *1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 2 dc in next ch. Rep from * to last 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 3 dc in last ch. Turn. 
20 dc.
2nd row: Ch 3. 2 dc in first dc (counts as 3 dc). 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 6 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. 3 dc in last dc. Turn. 26 dc.
3rd row: Ch 3. 2 dc in first dc (counts as 3 dc). 1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc. (1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc) twice. 1 dc in each of next 8 dc. (2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc) twice. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 3 dc in last dc. Turn. 36 dc.
4th row: Sl st in each of first 9 dc. Dc2tog over next 2 dc. (2 dc in next dc) twice. 1 dc in each of next 10 dc. (2 dc in next dc) twice. Dc2tog. Sl st in next dc. Turn. 20 sts.
5th row: Sl st in first dc2tog and each of next 2 dc. Hdc2tog. 2 hdc in next dc. 1 hdc in each of next 9 dc. 2 hdc in next dc. Hdc2tog. Sl st in next st. 15 sts. Fasten off.
Edging: 1st row: (RS). Join yarn (Black or Soft White) with sc to first dc of 3rd row at right ‘corner’ of Brim. Work 1 sc in each st to last dc of 3rd row (left ‘corner’ of Brim). Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing Brim to Cap.

FINISHING
CAP
Place lengths of Peel and Stick adhesive from top of crown down sides of purchased Cap. Take off only the back layer of the tape using Cap seams as guides and pressing firmly into place. Once tape is positioned, place joined crocheted piece onto Cap, centering 1 Motif at front. Working from top down, carefully peel top layer of tape off and press crocheted piece into place, stretching slightly. Once crocheted piece is properly in position and adhered, it’s a good idea to further secure it by placing lengths of Peel and Stick along bottom edge.
BRIM
Before attaching Brim, it’s helpful to place a st marker at center of Brim piece and also mark center of purchased Cap brim. Place lengths of Peel and Stick around Cap brim as close to edge as possible. Peel off top layer of tape and attach crocheted Brim piece, ensuring center markers are aligned.
After Brim is attached, sew edge of Brim to cap piece with whipstitch using length of yarn (Black or Soft White).

3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc) 8 times. Join with sl st to first hdc. 27 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc) 8 times. Join with sl st to first hdc. 36 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc) 8 times. Join with sl st to first hdc. 45 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Yoh. Draw loop through next hdc. With B, draw yarn through all loops on hook. Yoh. Draw loop through next hdc. With A, draw yarn through all loops on hook. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
7th and 8th rnds: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl to to first hdc.
Rep 6th to 8th rnds until work from 5th rnd measures approx 8” [20.5 cm], ending on an 8th rnd. Break A.
Ribbing: 1st rnd: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdcfp around first st. *1 hdcbp around next st. 1 hdcfp around next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. Rep 2nd rnd 3 times more. Fasten off.
Pompom: Wind B around 4 fingers approx 150 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to a smooth round shape. Sew to top of Hat.

materials: Bernat® Forever Fleece Finer™ (9.9 oz/280 g; 385 yds/352 m) Main Color (MC) Unicorn (76027) 1 ball
Size U.S. J/10 (6 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
1.5 yds (1.4 m) each of worsted weight black and white yarn.
abbreviations: Hdcbtw = Work 1 hdc in space between next 2 hdc.
Hdc2tog = Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 sps. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: One size to fit 18 mos-2 yrs.
gauge: 10 hdc and 9.5 rnds = 4" [10 cm] in Hat Body Pat.
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc. HAT Beg at top of Hat with MC, ch 3. 1st rnd: 6 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join with sl st to top of ch-2 on this and all rnds. 6 hdc. 2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdcbtw in sp before first hdc. *2 hdbtw in next sp. Rep from * around. Join. 12 hdc. 3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdcbtw in sp before first hdc. *1 hdcbtw in next sp. 2 hdcbtw in next sp. Rep from * around, ending with 1 hdcbtw in last sp. Join. 18 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdcbtw in sp before first hdc. *2 hdcbtw in next sp. (1 hdcbtw in next sp) twice. Rep from * around, ending with 1 hdcbtw in last sp. Join. 24 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdcbtw in sp before first hdc. *(1 hdcbtw in next sp) twice. 2 hdcbtw in next sp. Rep from * around, ending with: (1 hdcbtw in next sp) twice. Join. 32 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdcbtw in sp before first hdc. *2 hdcbtw in next sp. (1 hdcbtw in next sp) 3 times. Rep from * around, ending with 1 hdcbtw in last sp. Join. 40 hdc.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdcbtw in sp before first hdc. *(1 hdcbtw in next sp) 4 times. 2 hdcbtw in next sp. Rep from * 6 times more. (1 hdcbtw in next sp) twice. 2 hdcbtw in next sp. 1 hdcbtw in last sp. Join. 49 hdc.
8th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdcbtw in sp before first hdc. *1 hdcbtw in next sp. Rep from * around. Join. Rep 8th rnd until work from beg measures 7" [18 cm]. First Earflap: 1st row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdcbtw in sp before first hdc. (1 hdcbtw in next sp) 12 times. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. **2nd to 4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdcbtw between first 2 hdc. (1 hdcbtw in next sp) 11 times. 1 hdc in top of ch 2. Turn. 13 hdc.
5th to 8th rows: Ch 2. Hdc2tog over first 2 sps. *1 hdcbtw in next sp. Rep from * to last 2 sps. Hdc2tog over next sp and top of ch 2. Turn. 5 hdc at end of 8th row.
9th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog over first 2 sps. 1 hdcbtw in next sp. Hdc2tog over next sp and top of ch 2. Fasten off.**
Second Earflap: 1st row: (RS). Skip next 13 unworked sps (center front). Join MC with sl st in next sp. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp. *1 hdcbtw in next sp. Rep from * 11 times more. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. Rep from ** to ** as given for First Earflap.
Edging: (RS). Join A with sl st at base of First Earlap (back of Hat). Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around outer edges of Earflaps and Hat. Join. Fasten off. SPIKE STRIP: With A, ch 53. Spike 1: 1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 6 sc.
3rd and 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Fasten off.
Spikes 2 to 9: 1st row: Skip next 2 ch. Join A with sl st in next ch. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Turn.
2nd to 6th rows: Work as given for Spike 1.
Spike Strip Edging: (RS). Join MC with sl st in base of Spike 1. Ch 1. Work 13 sc evenly around sides of Spike 1. (Ch 1. Work 13 sc evenly around sides of next Spike) 8 times. Fasten off.
SNOUT: With A, ch 5. 1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working in opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join. 10 sc.
2nd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. Work 1 sc in each sc around, working 3 sc in center sc at each end of rnd. Join. 26 sc at end of 5th rnd. Fasten off.
Note: Do not join end of rnds when making Horns and Tusk. Work in continuous spiral. Move marker up each rnd to keep count.
HORNS (make 2): With A, ch 10. Join with sl st to first ch. 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. PM on last sc. 10 sc.
2nd to 5th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around. 6th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 8 sc.
7th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 6 sc.
8th rnd: (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) twice. 4 sc.
9th rnd: (Sc2tog) twice. Fasten off. Draw end tightly through rem sts.
TUSK: With A, ch 10. Join with sl st to first ch. 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. PM on last sc. 10 sc.
2nd to 5th rnds: Work as for 6th to 9th rnds of Horn.
Sew Spike Strip, Snout, Horns and Tusk in position (see photo). With black yarn, embroider eyes with satin stitch on Hat as shown adding final sts of white yarn as highlight.

materials: Patons® Classic Wool Worsted™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 194 yds/177 m) Contrast A Desert (77752) 1 ball
Patons® Alpaca Blend™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 155 yds/142 m) Contrast B Yam (01021) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Optional: Sticky-back water soluble fabric stabilizer to transfer embroidery motif.
abbreviations: Hdcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Hdcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 14 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm] with Contrast A.
instructions:
Notes:
Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.

With A, ch 72. Join with sl st to first ch making sure not to twist ch.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each ch around. Join. 72 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. *1 hdcfp around next hdc. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. Rep from * around. Join. Rep 2nd rnd for 2" [5 cm].
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 6½" [16.5 cm].
Shape top:
1st rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 64 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 56 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 16 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 8 sc. Fasten off leaving long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.

Using B and template, embroider floral motif onto side of Hat (see page 3).
Optional: Using a sticky-back water soluble stabilizer, draw embroidery design on stabilizer, attach onto Hat and embroider.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver Ombre™: 1 skein 3967 Sea Coral
Susan Bates Easy Wrap Pompom Maker or 3½" (9 cm) piece of heavy cardboard
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Hat measures 18 (20, 22, 24)" [45.5 (51, 56, 61) cm] circumference at brim.
gauge: 16 sts = 4½" (11.5 cm); 10 rows = 3½" (9 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Brim
Ch 6.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—5 sc. 
Rows 2–64 (70, 78, 84): Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 65 (71, 79, 85): With first and last rows held together, ch 1, working through both thicknesses, slip st in each st across. Do not turn.

Body
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing and working in ends of rows, ch 1, 2 sc in first row, *skip next row, 2 sc in next row; repeat from * around to last row, skip last row; join with slip st in first sc—64 (70, 78, 84) sc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (does not count as a st), hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first hdc—64 (70, 78, 84) hdc.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first hdc, *skip next hdc, 2 sc in next hdc; repeat from * around to last hdc, skip last hdc; join with slip st in first sc—64 (70, 78, 84) sc.
Rounds 4-16 (18, 20, 22): Repeat last 2 rounds 16 (18, 20, 22) times.
Round 17 (19, 21, 23): Ch 1, sc in first st, *skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around to last st, skip last st; join with slip st in first sc—32 (35, 39, 42) sc.
Round 18 (20, 22, 24): Ch 1, sc in first st, *skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around to last 1 (2, 2, 1) st(s), skip last 1 (2, 2, 1) st(s); join with slip st in first sc—16 (17, 19, 21) sc.
Round 19 (21, 23, 25): Ch 1, sc in first st,*skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around to last 1 (2, 2, 2) st(s), skip last 1 (2, 2, 2) st(s); join with slip st in first sc—8 (8, 9, 10) sc. Fasten off, leaving a 12" (30.5 cm) tail.

FINISHING
Weave tail through every other st of last round, working through last st as needed. Pull gently to close and secure tail.

Pompom
Following pompom maker directions, make 3½" (9 cm) pompom or make pompom as follows: Wrap yarn around 3½" (9 cm) piece of heavy cardboard (the more wraps, the fuller the pompom). Gently remove wraps from cardboard. Cut a 12" (30.5 cm) length of yarn and tie it tightly around center of wraps. Do not cut the ends of this center tie. Cut ends of wraps. Fluff and trim pompom. Use ends of center tie to attach pompom to top of hat.
Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Super Value™ (7 oz/197 g; 440 yds/402 m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: To fit 3 mos (6 mos-12 mos-4/6 yrs-8/10 yrs-Teen).
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger size(s) the instructions will be written thus ( ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes.
Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as st.
• Rnds are joined with a sl st to first st.
With A, beg using magic loop method, demonstrated here.
1st rnd: Ch 2. 10 dc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dc in each st around. Join. 20 sts.

3rd rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sts.

Size 0-3 mos only:
5th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 9 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 44 sts.
6th to 11th rnds: Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. Do not fasten off.

Size 6-12 mos only:
5th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sts.
6th to 12th rnds: Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. Do not fasten off.

Size 12-24 mos only:
5th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 9 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 55 sts.
7th to 13th rnds: Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. Do not fasten off.

Size 4/6 yrs only:
5th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sts.
7th to 14th rnds: Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. Do not fasten off.

Size 8/10 yrs only:
5th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 14 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 64 sts.
8th to 15th rnds: Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. Do not fasten off.

Size Teen only:
5th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 60 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 2. *2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 14 sts. Rep from * around. Join. 64 sts.
8th to 16th rnds: Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. Do not fasten off.

All sizes: First Earflap
1st row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each of next 10 (10-12-12-14-14) sts. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. Dc2tog. 1 dc in each st to last 2 sts. Dc2tog. Turn. 8 (8-10-10-12-12) sts.
Rep last row 2 (2-3-3-4-4) times more. 4 sts.
Next row: Ch 2. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 14 (16-16-18-18-20) times. Fasten off.

Second Earflap
On opposite edge of Hat from First Earflap, join A with sl st. Work as given for First Earflap.

Sloth Claws (work at end of both Earflaps)
Join B with sl st to bottom of Earflap.
1st row: *Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Sl st in next st along bottom of Earflap. Rep from * twice more. Fasten off.

Eye Patches (make 2)
With C, ch 7.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working into opposite side of chain, 1 sc in each stitch until end of chain. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. 2 sc in each of next 3 sts. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail.

Eyes (make 2)
With D, begin using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 6 sc in ring. Join. Fasten off.
Stitch Eyes to corners of Eye Patches as shown in photo.

Face
With B, ch 12.
1st rnd: 1 dc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to last ch. 3 dc in last ch. Working into opposite side of chain, 1 dc in each st to last st. 3 dc in last st. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st) 5 times. 2 dc in each of next 3 sts. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st) 4 times. 2 dc in each of last 3 sts. Join.

Sizes 4/6 yrs, 8/10 yrs, and Teen only:
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dc in first st. 1 dc in each st to last st. 2 dc in last st. Join. Fasten off.

Nose
With D, beg using magic loop method.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Stitch Nose to middle of Face as shown in photo. Backstitch on a smile. Stitch Face to middle front of Hat. Stitch Eye Patches to sides of Face.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 312 and 316 Soft White B.
Crochet Hooks: 4mm [US G-6] and 3.5mm [US E-4] (for appliqué).
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Small: 6” wide x 3“ tall. Medium/Large: 7½” wide x 3½” tall.
gauge: With larger hook, 18 sts = 4”; 20 rows sc = 4”. Gauge is not overly important for this project since the hat is designed to sit on top of the head. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Hat Brim (make 2)
With larger hook and A, ch 21 (31).
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 20 (30) sc.
NOTE: On opposite side of foundation ch, mark placement of crown by placing a marker in 6th (11th) ch from each end of foundation ch.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 5 (10) sts, place marker, hdc in next 3 sts, [dc in next st, 2 dc in next st] twice, hdc in next 3 sts, sc in next st, place marker, sc in last 4 (9) sts, turn – 32 (42) sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 5 (10) sts, hdc in next 12 sts, sc in last 5 (10) sts, turn – 22 (32) sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 5 (10) sts, hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, dc in next st, 2 dc in each of next 2 sts, dc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st, sc in last 5 (10) sts, turn – 26 (36) sts.
Row 5: Ch 2 (does not count as a st), hdc in first st, sc in next 4 (9) sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in each of next 2 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts, 2 hdc in next st, sc in next 4 (9) sts, hdc in last st, turn – 32 (42) sts. Fasten off size Small, leaving a long sewing length.
Size Medium/Large only
Row 6: Ch 2, hdc in first st, sc in next 9 sts, hdc in last st, turn – 42 sts.
Row 7: Ch 2, hdc in first st, sc in next 9 sts, hdc in st, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 5 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 6 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next 5 sts, 2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st, sc in next 9 sts, hdc in last st – 46 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long sewing length.
Hat Crown/Gusset
Row 1: With right side facing and larger hook, join A with a slip st in back loop of first marked ch on opposite side of foundation ch, working in back loops of ch sts only, ch 1, sc in same st and in next 8 ch sts, turn leaving remaining sts unworked – 9 sts.
Row 2-4: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. Fasten off size Small, leaving a long sewing length.
Size Medium/Large only
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each st across. Fasten off, leaving a long sewing length.
ASSEMBLY
With yarn needle and sewing length, working in inside loops of sts, whipstitch last row of Crown/Gussett to corresponding marked sts of foundation ch on second Hat Brim. Weave in ends.
APPLIQUÉ
Size Small only
Skull
With smaller hook and B, ch 3.
Row 1: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next st, turn – 3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn – 4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc last sc, turn – 6 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in next 3 sts, skip next sc, sc in last sc, turn – 4 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a sewing length.
Cross Bones (make 2)
With smaller hook and B, ch 2.
First End: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc, ch 9.
Second End: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a sewing length.
Size Medium/Large only
Skull
With smaller hook and B, ch 3.
Row 1: 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next st, turn – 3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn – 5 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] twice, turn – 7 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, skip first st, sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog over last 2 sts, turn – 5 sts.
Row 7: Ch 1, skip first st, sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog over next 2 sts, slip st in last st.
Fasten off, leaving a sewing length.
Cross Bones (make 2)
With smaller hook and B, ch 2.
First End: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc, ch 11.
Second End: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a sewing length.
Ear Loop: With larger hook, join A with slip st in corner at base of Row 1 of Crown/Gusset, ch 10 (16) or desired length to fit over ear, skip side edge of Crown/Gusset, slip st in corner on opposite side of Crown/Gusset where last row is joined to other Brim (Ear Loop made). Fasten off. Tie: With larger hook, join A to center of Ear Loop just formed, ch 33 (50) or desired length for Tie. Fasten off. Repeat Ear Loop and Tie on opposite side of Crown/Gusset.
FINISHING
Lay out Cross Bones in an “X” configuration on front of hat as pictured and with yarn needle and sewing length, whipstitch bones in place. With yarn needle and A, satin st 2 eyes and a triangular shaped nose as pictured on Skull. Whipstitch skull onto hat as pictured. Place 2 Brim pieces together with wrong sides facing, With yarn needle and A, matching sts, whipstitch Brim pieces together across short edges. Brim shape is maintained by making a stitch through both parts in 2 different locations on the top edge of the brim, (do not sew entire brim closed). Hold hat together at the top. Tack the 2 layers together as indicated by the letter “A” on the schematic, using a single stitch. Weave in ends. Tie to dog’s head using ties, being careful not to tie the piece too tightly. The chain loop is designed to hold the hat straight on the head and can be used to poke ears through as needed.

pattern_name: Preemie to Toddler Size Crochet Hats
materials: Caron® Kindness™ (7 oz/198 g; 345 yds/315 m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: To fit head circumference: Preemie 9½" [24 cm], Newborn 12" [30.5 cm], 6/12 mos 16" [40.5 cm], 18/24 mos 17½" [44.5 cm]
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written thus ( ). When only one number is given, it applies to all sizes.
Ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
Sizes Newborn, 6/12 and 18/24 mos only: 5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
Sizes 6/12 and 18/24 mos only: 7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc.
Sizes Preemie and 18/24 mos only: Next rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 27 (54) sc.
All sizes: Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. PM on last rnd. Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 3 (3½-4-4½)" [7.5 (9-10-11.5) cm].

instructions:
HAT
Brim
Ch 6.

Row 65 (71, 79, 85): With first and last rows held together, ch 1, working through both thicknesses, slip st in each st across. Do not turn.
Body
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing and working in ends of rows, ch 1, 2 sc in first row, *skip next row, 2 sc in next row; repeat from * around to last row, skip last row; join with slip st in first sc—64 (70, 78, 84) sc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (does not count as a st), hdc in each st around; join with slip st in first hdc—64 (70, 78, 84) hdc.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first hdc, *skip next hdc, 2 sc in next hdc; repeat from * around to last hdc, skip last hdc; join with slip st in first sc—64 (70, 78, 84) sc.
Rounds 4-16 (18, 20, 22): Repeat last 2 rounds 16 (18, 20, 22) times.
Round 17 (19, 21, 23): Ch 1, sc in first st, *skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around to last st, skip last st; join with slip st in first sc—32 (35, 39, 42) sc.
Round 18 (20, 22, 24): Ch 1, sc in first st, *skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around to last 1 (2, 2, 1) st(s), skip last 1 (2, 2, 1) st(s); join with slip st in first sc—16 (17, 19, 21) sc.
Round 19 (21, 23, 25): Ch 1, sc in first st, *skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around to last 1 (2, 2, 2) st(s), skip last 1 (2, 2, 2) st(s); join with slip st in first sc—8 (8, 9, 10) sc. Fasten off, leaving a 12" (30.5 cm) tail.

Weave tail through every other st of last round, working through last st as needed. Pull gently to close and secure tail.
Pompom
Following pompom maker directions, make 3½" (9 cm) pompom or make pompom as follows: Wrap yarn around 3½" (9 cm) piece of heavy cardboard (the more wraps, the fuller the pompom). Gently remove wraps from cardboard. Cut a 12" (30.5 cm) length of yarn and tie it tightly around center of wraps. Do not cut the ends of this center tie. Cut ends of wraps. Fluff and trim pompom. Use ends of center tie to attach pompom to top of hat.
Weave in ends.

instructions:
HAT
With A, create a magic ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 dc in ring; join with slip st in first dc – 12 dc
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 dc in each dc around; join with slip st in first dc – 24 dc 
Round 3: Ch 1, [dc in next st, 2 dc in next st] 12 times; join with slip st in first dc – 36 dc 
Round 4: Ch 1, [dc in 2 each of next sts, 2 dc in next st] 12 times; join B with slip st in first dc. Break A – 48 dc
For 2 largest sizes only:
Next round: Ch 1, [dc in each of next 0 (7, 3) sts, 2 dc in next st] 0 (8, 12) times, join with slip st in first dc – 48 (54, 60) dc.
For all sizes:
Next 5 (5, 6) rounds: Ch 1, dc in each st around; slip st to join - 48 (54, 60) dc.
Earflaps
Row 1: Ch 2 (counts as 1 dc here and throughout), dc2tog over next 2 sts, dc in each of next 4 sts, dc2tog over next 2 sts, dc in next st, turn – 8 dc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn – 8 sc.
Row 3: Ch 2, dc2tog over next 2 sts, dc in each of next 2 sts, dc2tog over next 2 sts, dc in last st, turn – 6 dc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn – 6 sc.
Row 5: Ch 2, [dc2tog over next 2 sts] twice, dc in last st, turn – 4 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in each st across – 4 sc. 
Fasten off.
With earflap facing up, skip 20 (22, 24) sts to the left of last earflap st on brim, and join B with slip st in next st.
Work other Earflap the same way.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Border for Cap Version
Next 2 rounds: Ch 1, sc in each st around.
Fasten off.
Border for Earflap Version
Join B with slip st in center back of hat. 
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each st and 4 sc in each sc-row edge around, join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.
Pom Pom
With A and B held together, make a pom pom and sew to top of hat.
Maple Leaf
With A, form an adjustable loop
Round 1: Ch 2 (counts as 1 dc), 11 dc in ring; join with slip st in first st – 12 dc.
Round 2: Ch 2, (picot, hdc) in same st as joining slip st, (hdc, picot, hdc) in next st, (hdc, picot, ch 2, slip st) in next st, (slip st, ch 2, picot, dc) in next st, (dc, picot, dc) in next st, (dc, picot, ch 2, slip st) in next st, (slip st, ch 2, picot, hdc) in next st, (hdc, picot, hdc) in next st, (hdc, picot, ch 2, slip st) in next st, slip st in next st, ch 5, skip 1 ch, sc in each of next 4 ch (stem), slip st in Round 1 to join stem, slip st in beginning ch-2 to join round.

Position Maple Leaf as desired onto hat and use markers to hold in place.
Assuring picots are defined, use yarn needle to sew in place.
Weave in all loose ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 672 Spring Green A, 3945 Blue Suede B, 254 Pumpkin C, and 512 Turqua D
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5mm [US H-8] and 5.5mm [US I-9]
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Hat measures 14 (16, 18)” (35.5 [40.5, 45.5] cm) in circumference at brim.
gauge: 10 dc = 3” (7.5 cm); 8 rows = 4” (10 cm) in pattern with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
With larger hook and A, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1 (right side): Work 12 dc in ring; join with slip st in first dc—12 dc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Ch 1 (does not count as a st here and throughout), 2 dc in each st around; change to B; join with slip st in first dc—24 dc.
Round 3: Ch 1, hdc in first st, 2 hdc in next st, [hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st] 11 times; change to A; join with slip st in first hdc—36 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 1, dc in first 2 sts, 2 dc in next st, [dc in next 2 sts, 2 dc in next st] 11 times; join with slip st in first dc—48 dc.
Size Small only:
Round 5: Ch 1, dc in each st around; change to C; join with slip st in first dc.
Sizes Medium and Large only:
Round 5: Ch 1, dc in first 7 (3) sts, 2 dc in next st, [dc in next 7 (3) sts, 2 dc in next st] 5 (11) times; change to C; join with slip st in first dc—54 (60) dc.
All sizes:
Round 6: Ch 1, hdc in each st around; change to A; join with slip st in first hdc.
Rounds 7 and 8: Ch 1, dc in each st around; change to D; join with slip st in first dc.
Round 9: Repeat Round 6.
Size Small only:
Rounds 10 and 11: Ch 1, dc in each st around; join with slip st in first dc. Do not fasten off.
Directions are for size Small. Changes for sizes Medium and Large are in parentheses.
Hat measures 14 (16, 18)” (35.5 [40.5, 45.5] cm) in circumference at brim.
Special Stitch
dc2tog = [Yarn over, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] 2 times, yarn over, draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Special Techniques
Adjustable-ring method: Wrap yarn in a ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the working yarn. Grip ring and tail firmly between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first round in the ring, working over both strands (the tail and the ring). After the first round of stitches is worked, pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Join with sc: Place a slip knot on hook, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through both loops on hook.
Notes
1. Hat is worked in joined rounds with right facing at all times. Earflaps are worked back and forth in rows.
2. Dino spines are made separately in continuous rounds (spirals) and sewn to back of hat. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
3. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Cut old color.
Sizes Medium and Large only:
Round 10: Ch 1, dc in each st around; join with slip st in first dc.
Round 11: Ch 1, dc in each st around; change to B; join with slip st in first dc.
Round 12: Repeat Round 6.
Round 13: Ch 1, dc in each st around; join with slip st in first dc.
Do not fasten off.
Size Large only:
Round 14: Repeat Round 13. Do not fasten off.
Right Earflap
Row 1: Ch 2 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc2tog, dc in next 4 sts, dc2tog, dc in next st; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—8 dc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, dc2tog, dc in next 2 sts, dc2tog, dc in last st, turn—6 dc.
Row 4: Repeat Row 2.
Row 5: Ch 2, [dc2tog] twice, dc in last st—4 sc.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2. Fasten off.
Left Earflap
With right side of Round 11 (13, 14) facing, join A with sc in 20th (22nd, 24th) stitch to the left of the right earflap.
Work same as Rows 1–6 of right earflap.
Border
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, join B with sc in any st at center back of hat, sc in each st around, working sc in end of each sc row and 3 sc in end of each dc row of ear flaps; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Dino Spines
Size Small only: make 4 – 1 each with A, B, C, and D
Sizes Medium and Large only: make 5 – 2 with A, 1 each with B, C, and D
With smaller hook, make an adjustable loop, ch 1.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring—6 sc. Do not join. Work in continuous rounds. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 3 times—9 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 3 times—12 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 3 times—15 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 3 times—18 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each st around.
Round 7: Sc in next 17 sts, slip st in next st; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Braids
Cut six 28” (71 cm) lengths of each color. Separate each 6-strand group into 2 hanks of 3 strands each.
Thread one hank of each color through last row of earflap and fold over so strands are doubled. Braid doubled hanks until 4” (10 cm) of strands remain, tie an overhand knot tightly, and trim ends evenly. Repeat with remaining hanks for other earflap.
Dino Spines
Fold hat in half so earflaps and edges are evenly aligned. Using photograph as a guide and beginning at top of hat, place stitch markers on center back at fold for placement of each dino spine.
Weave in ends of dino spines. Flatten each spine and with A, sew in place, working through the back loops only of rounds of contrasting color.
Weave in remaining ends.

Join. 20 sts. 3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 hdc in each of first 2 sts. 1 dcfp around last st worked into. Rep from * around. (Hdc2tog) 6 (7) times. Dcfp around next dcfp. Rep from * around. Join. 70 (80) sts. 2nd and 3rd rnds: Ch 1. *Skip next st. 1 hdc in each st to next dcfp. 1 hdc in next dcfp. 1 dcfp around same dcfp. materials: Yarn needle and extra-large 3” (7.5 cm) pompom maker (optional)

gauge: 11 sts = 4” [10 cm]; 8 rows = 4” [10 cm] in Double Crochet with smaller hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Round 1: Using B and smaller hook, ch 2, 8 sc in the 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st in the first sc of the round (slip sts are used to join every round and are not counted as a st) – 8 sc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc here and throughout), dc in the first st, 2 dc in each st to the end; join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 16 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in the first st, *1 dc in the next st, 2 dc in the next st; repeat from * until 1 st remains, dc 1; join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 24 dc.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in the first st. *1 dc in each of the next 2 sts, 2 dc in the next st; repeat from * until 2 sts remain, dc to the end; join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 32 dc.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in the first st, *1 dc in each of the next 3 sts, 2 dc in the next st; repeat from * until 3 sts remain, dc to the end; join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 40 dc.
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in the first st, *1 dc in each of the next 4 sts, 2 dc in the next st; repeat from * until 4 sts remain, dc to the end; join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 48 dc.
Toddler size only: Skip Rounds 7 and 8. Resume work on Round 9.
Round 7: Ch 3, dc in the first st, *1 dc in each of the next 5 sts, 2 dc in the next st; repeat from * until 5 sts remain, dc to the end; join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 56 dc.
Rounds 8-9: Ch 3, dc to the end; join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 48 (56, 56) dc.
Fasten off B. Join A in the top of the beginning ch.
Round 10: Ch 3, *2 dc, 1 tr into the base of the next st, dc; repeat from * until 3 sts remain, 2 dc, 1 tr in the base of the next st; join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 33 (39, 39) dc, 12 (14, 14) tr.
Round 11: Ch 3, dc to the end; join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 48 (56, 56) dc.
Row 12: Ch 3, dc until 1 st remains; turn, leaving last st unworked – 47 (55, 55) dc.
Toddler Size Only: Skip rows 13-14. Resume work on row 15.
Child Size Only: Skip row 13. Resume work on row 14.
Adult Size Only: Proceed with Row 13.
Rows 13-16: Ch 3, dc to the end; turn – 47 (55, 55) dc.
Round 17: Ch 5, skip the first 3 sts of the row, dc in the next st; dc until 3 sts remain, ch 5, skip 2 sts, sc in the last st.
Sizes Toddler and Adult Only:
Row 18 (right side): Turn, ch 1, 8 sc in the ch-5 space, sc to the next ch-5 space, 8 sc in the next ch-5 space, turn work; working in ends of rows, 2 sc in each dc to the base of the split, 2 sc in the base of the split; 2 sc in each dc in ends of rows; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

Row 18 (wrong side): Do not turn. Ch 1; working in ends of rows, 2 sc in each dc to the base of the split, 2 sc in the base of the split, 2 sc in each dc in ends of rows, 8 sc in the ch-5 space, sc to the next ch-5 space, 8 sc in the next ch-5 space; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Ties (make 2)
Measure and cut two lengths of yarn at 100 (110, 120)” [250 (275, 300) cm] each. Holding the two yarn strands together, fold in half and put through one of the 8-sc loops at the bottom edge of the work. With the yarn still folded over, use the larger hook to work a ch to the end of the yarn. When about 4” (10 cm) remain, fasten off. If you are making tassels, leave yarn tails and do not weave them in. If you are not making tassels, weave in the ends of the ties.
Tassels (make 2; optional)
Make and attach tassels to the end of the ties if desired.
Pompom (optional)
Make and attach one extra-large pompom to the crown of the hat if desired. Secure it tightly and weave in any ends.

instructions:
HAT  
Hat ribbing: With smaller hook, ch 13.

2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

Change to larger hook and proceed in rnds as follows:
Notes: 
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc. 
• Ch 4 at beg of rnd counts as dc and ch 1. 
(See Chart I on page 3.)
1st rnd:  Ch 1. Working along straight edge of ribbing, work 80 sc evenly around. Join with sl st to first sc.

materials: Bernat® Softee Cotton™ (4.2 oz/120 g; 254 yds/232 m) Feather Gray (69002) 2 balls
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dtrfp = (Yoh) 3 times and draw up a loop around post of indicated stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 4 times.
Pc = (Popcorn stitch.) Work 3 dc into same stitch or space. Drop loop from hook. Insert hook from front to back into first dc of 3 dc group. Pull dropped loop through st. Ch 1 to secure popcorn.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
V-st = V Stitch. (1 hdc, ch 1, 1 hdc) all in the same st or sp.
gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm] with yarn held double.
instructions:
Notes:
• Work with yarn held double by using both the interior and exterior ends of the same ball
• When needing to triple strand for the brim, use interior end of rem ball. Yarn management will be addressed in relevant section of pattern.
Ch 3 counts as dc at beg of rnd. 
• Ch 2 doesn’t count as st at beg of rnd.
Top of Hat
Ch 2. 
1st rnd: (RS.) 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 5 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next st. 1 sc around post of dc just worked. *1 dc in each of next 2 sts. 1 sc around post of last dc worked. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 30 sts. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same st as sl st. Ch 2. Skip next st. 1 sc in next st. *1 sc in next st. Ch 2. Skip next st. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc and 10 ch 2 sps. 
6th rnd: Sl st to next ch-2 sp. (Ch 3. 4 dc) in ch-2 sp. *5 dc in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * around. Join with sc to top of ch 3. 50 sts. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in sp between next two 5-dc groups. Ch 2. Skip next 2 sts. 1 sc in next st. Ch 2. Skip to sp between next two 5-dc groups. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to firstsc. 20 sc and 20 ch-2 sps.  
8th rnd: Sl st to next ch 2 sp. Ch 3, 2 dc in same ch sp. *3 dc in each ch-2 sp around. Join with sc to top of ch 3. 60 sts. 
9th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in sp between next two 3-dc groups. Ch 1. Skip next st. 1 sc in next. Ch 1. Skip to sp between next two 3-dc groups. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc and 40 ch 1 sps. 
10th rnd: Sl st to next ch 1 sp. Ch 2. Pc in same sp. V-st in next ch-1 sp. *Pc in next ch-1 sp. V-st in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of first pc. 20 v-sts and 20 pc. 
Tip: In next rnd, work into use ch 1 sps created by v-stitches. 
11th rnd: Sl st around front post of first pc from prev rnd. Ch 3 (counts as dcfp). 3 dc in next ch 1 sp. *Dcfp around next pc st. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of beg ch 3. 80 sts. 
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Sc2tog. *1 sc in next 8 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around Join with sl st to first sc. 72 sc.
13th rnd:  Ch 3. 1 dc in each st around. Join with sl to top of beg ch 3. 72 dc. 
Tip: In following rnd, dtrfp sts are worked into sts 2 rnds below and 3 sts back from current st. The dtrfp sts worked in a given rnd are counted as part of the active rnd, not the rnd they are worked into. See Chart on page 3.
14th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first st.   1 dtrfp around 2nd last sc of 12th rnd. *1 sc in next st. Skip next sc from 12th rnd. 1 dtrfp around next sc of 12th rnd. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc and 36 dtrfp. 
15th rnd: As 13th rnd. 72 dc.
Tip: In 16th rnd, dtrfp sts will be worked around dtrfp sts found in 14th rnd.  This will cause the double treble front posts to lean back, which will complete the look of an narrow stitch. The first dtrfp to use will be the second one worked in the 14th rnd. It may feel like it’s too far away to be going around but you have to trust in me; the height of the double treble st accounts for this distance.
16th rnd: Ch 1. Skip first dtrfp from 2 rnds below. *1 dtrfp around the next dtrfp 2 rnds below. Skip next dc from prev rnd. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first trfp. 36 sc and 36 dtrfp. 
17th rnd:  Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 16 sts. Rep from * times more. Join with sl st to first sc. 68 sc.
18th rnd:  Ch 1. Working in  back loops only, 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 68 sc.
19th rnd: As 13th rnd. 68 dc.
Tip: At the end of 19th rnd, when joining rnd with slip stitch, add third strand onto hook as you pull through to finish rnd. 
Brim
Notes: 
• To ensure that brim has a smooth and uniform appearance, increases have been staggered.
• All rnds are joined with sl st to first sc.
20th rnd:  With yarn held triple, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 16 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 72 sc.
21st rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 84 sc.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of  next 3 sts. 2 sc in next st. *1 sc in each of next 6 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. 1 sc in each of last 3 sts. Join. 96 sc.
23rd rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 108 sc.
24th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. 2 sc in next st. *1 sc in  each of next 8 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. 1 sc in each of last 4 sts. Join. 120 sc.
25th rnd:  Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each st around. Join. 120 sc. 
Tip: You will notice that the ball of yarn with 2 working strands is becoming depleted. Drop the exterior strand of first ball. Join the exterior strand from the ball incorporated at the end of 19th rnd.
26th to 28th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. 120 sc. 
Tip: In the next rnd, you will be working into the 28th rnd, as well as the unworked front loops from the 25th rnd. This helps give the brim a rolled effect. 
29th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around, working into both sc from 28th rnd, as well as corresponding front loop from 25th rnd. Join.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
My hat has been damp blocked and also sprayed with Speed Starch. DO NOT IRON this project. There is acrylic in the yarn mix which will melt if ironed. The Speed Starch provides structure to the Hat without being stiff. 
1. Dampen the hat and prepare a tea towel with a cup that will hold up the middle of the hat. 
2.Generously spray the hat, especially the brim on the top and underside. 
3. Place the hat on a tea towel and over the cup so it holds up the middle of the hat. Shape the brim into a circle. 
4. Let the hat naturally dry over 12 to 24 hours.

materials: AUNT LYDIA'S® Metallic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball 0001S White/Silver
abbreviations: ( ) = work all directions in parentheses in the indicated stitch or space
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Finished Comb measures 4" wide by 1 3/4" high [10 cm x 4.5 cm]
gauge: Rounds 1-4 of Large Flower = 1 5/8" [4 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
LARGE FLOWER
Leaving long tail, ch 4, slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 sc in ring, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same sc, *ch 3, skip next sc, sc in next sc, ch 3; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 3: Slip st in first ch-3 space, *[ch 3, tr] 2 times in same space, ch 3, slip st in same space,** slip st in next ch-3 space; repeat from * 4 times, then from * to ** once; do not join.
Round 4: Ch 1, fpsc around first sc of Round 2, *4 sc in next ch-3 space, 5 sc in next ch-3 space, 4 sc in next ch-3 space,** fpsc around next sc of Round 2; repeat from * 4 times, then from * to ** once, slip st in first fpsc to join. Fasten off and weave in ends.

LEAF (MAKE 2)
Ch 6, slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, 12 sc in ring, slip st in first sc to join; (ch 2, 4-dc cl, ch-3 picot, ch 3, slip st) in same sc.
Round 2: Ch 3, sc in top loop of 3rd ch from hook; working in back loop only of each st, sc in next 5 sc, ch 2, skip next sc, sc in next 5 sc; slip st in first sc of Round 1; ch 3, turn.
Round 3 (Wrong Side): Sc in top loop of 3rd ch from hook; working in front loop only of each st, sc in next 5 sc, sc in next ch-2 space, ch 2, sc in same space, sc in next 5 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, ch 3, turn.
Round 4: Sc in top loop of 3rd ch from hook; working in back loop only of each st, sc in next 6 sc, sc in next ch-2 space, ch 2, sc in same ch-2 space, sc in next 5 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, ch 3, turn.
Round 5: Sc in top loop of 3rd ch from hook; working in front loop only of each st, sc in next 6 sc, slip st in next ch-2 space; leave remaining sts unworked, ch 3. Fasten off, leaving long tail.

STAR FLOWER
Leaving long tail, ch 4, slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 sc in ring, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same sc, *(2 dc, tr, ch-3 picot, 2 dc) in next sc,** sc in next sc; repeat from * 4 times, then from * to ** once, slip st in first sc to join. Fasten off and weave in ends.

SMALL FLOWER
Leaving long tail, ch 4, slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, [sc in ring, ch 3] 12 times, slip st in first sc to join. Fasten off and weave in ends.

SPIRAL BUD (MAKE 3)
Ch 9, working in top loop of each ch throughout, 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 3 sc in each of next 7 chs. Fasten off, leaving long tail. Thread tail on tapestry needle and weave it up through center of the spiral, then catch first sc of the 5-sc on the needle and pass it back through center to secure tail.

FINISHING
Lay thread end across top of the Comb, secure by wrapping thread around top of the Comb, 6-7 wraps between each tooth and over thread. (Add 1 or 2 wraps around ends if needed.) Referring to photo for placement, attach Leaves and Flowers by sewing through wraps on the Comb. Sew a Leaf to each end of the Comb. Sew the center of the Large Flower to the Comb, but do not sew down the petals. Sew the center of the Star Flower to the Comb. Sew the Small Flower to the Comb, slightly tucked under the petals of the Star Flower. Sew the Spirals on: one in the center of the Large Flower, one under the Small Flower, and one between the petals of the Star Flower. Weave in all ends.

instructions:
HEADBAND
First Flower
With A, ch 5. 
Round 1 (right side): (3-dc Cl, ch 4, slip st) in 5th ch from hook, [ch 4, 3-dc Cl, ch 4, slip st] 3 times in same ch, ch 1; change to B and cut A. 
Stem and Leaves 
Row 1: Ch 9, make leaf, ch 10, make leaf, ch 3; change to C; drop, but do not cut, B.
Second Flower
Round 1 (right side): Ch 6, (3-dc Cl, ch 4, slip st) in 5th ch from hook, [ch 4, 3-dc Cl, ch 4, slip st] 3 times in same ch; change to B and cut C.
TRAILING LEAVES
Row 1: With wrong side of first flower facing, join B with slip st in last slip st, ch 16, make leaf, ch 14, make leaf, ch 12, make leaf, ch 14, make leaf, ch 16, make leaf, ch 12, make leaf, ch 20, make leaf, ch 6, make leaf. Fasten off.

Gently tighten beginning and end tails of threads to ensure that chains at color changes are uniform in size and tension. Weave in ends. Secure in wearer’s hair with bobby pins.
Special Stitches
3-dc Cl (3 double crochet cluster) = Yarn over, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook (2 loops remain on hook); [yarn over, insert hook in same stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] 2 times, yarn over, draw through all 4 loops on hook.
make leaf = sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 2 ch, slip st in next ch; leave remaining ch unworked.
Notes
1. Do not fasten off B thread at the end of each set of stem and leaves. Carry behind each flower until next needed.
2. To change color, work last chain of old color. Yarn over with new color and draw through loop on hook to complete first chain. Proceed with new color. Cut old color unless otherwise instructed.

Round 15: Ch 3, dc in next 2 hdc, *ch 1, skip next 2 hdc,

hdc, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 16: Ch 3, dc in each dc and ch-1 space around,

In the first sp to the left of post, 1 whdc. 1 whdc in each sp to end of row, placing final whdc between last st and turning ch. Turn. Rep 2nd row until Headband measures 19½" [49.5 cm] for an average Woman’s size head or to desired size. Note: Make headband 3" [7.5 cm] less than your head circumference. Finishing: Step 1: Lay Headband out and fold in half. Slide one side of Headband across so one corner is matched up to the middle of the other edge. Step 2: Fold the right hand side around the back. Step 3: Fold the left hand side around the front, giving you 4 layers Step 4: Sew with yarn needle through all four layers. Knot ends tog and clip. Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com

RedHeart.com
Page 1 of 1
Floating Bats 
Headband
Perfect for wearing to an upcoming party, or 
anywhere you might be this Halloween. Create 
bats with a bit of crochet thread, stiffen them 
and then attach to a headband with chenille 
stems. Bewitching!

Second Wing
With Right side facing, attach thread in the 
back loop of the third dc from the second ear.
Rows 1-4: Work same as for First Wing. 
Fasten off and weave in ends.

FINISHING
Stiffen Bats using decoupage sealer or a 
mixture of half white glue and half water. 
Soak each piece in the stiffener, blot the 
excess, then pin to a blocking board or padded 
surface, being sure the picots and wing tips 
are sharp and stand out.
After pieces are dry, wrap the headband with 
4-5 pipe cleaners or chenille stems to cover
it. Insert one of the wires through the center
of a Bat, bending the wire tip back to hold the
Bat in place. Referring to photo for placement,
leave a length of 3 to 5 inches of wire before
wrapping the rest of the wire around the
headband to secure it. Repeat with the rest of
the Bats, alternating colors.

Note
Work all stitches in the back loop only unless 
otherwise indicated.

BAT (Make 3 Purple and 2 Black)
Make an Adjustable Loop and ch 3 (counts  
as dc).
Round 1 (Right side): Work 6 dc in ring, picot 
(first ear), 2 dc in ring, picot (second ear), 10 
dc in ring, slip st in top of beginning ch-3 to 
join—19 dc. Leave a small opening in the 
center of the ring so there is room to insert 
a pipe cleaner or chenille stem later. Do not 
fasten off; continue to make First Wing.

First Wing
Row 1: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and 
throughout), hdc in same beginning st, 2 hdc 
in each of next 3 dc; turn—8 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc in same beginning st, hdc 
in each of next 6 hdc, 2 hdc in top of ch-2; 
turn—10 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 2, hdc in same beginning st, 2 hdc 
in next hdc, hdc in each of next 6 hdc, 2 hdc in 
each of next hdc and top of ch-2; turn—14 hdc.
Row 4: Ch 2, hdc in same beginning st, picot, 
* hdc in next 4 hdc, picot; repeat from * twice,
hdc in top of ch-2—15 hdc, 4 picots. Fasten
off and weave in ends.

Designed by Cristina Mershon

Version 1

Next row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Fasten off.
First Section

Next row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Join pieces: Next row: Ch 3 (counts as d c). 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. Cross first section beneath second section just worked. Work 1 dc in each of next 5 dc of first section. Turn. 10 dc.
Next row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 22" [56 cm]. Fasten off.
Sew ends tog.
Version 2
Ch 18.
1st row: 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 16 dc.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 10" [25.5 cm]. 
Next row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
Next row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Fasten off.
First Section
Join yarn with sl st to first unworked st. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Join pieces: Next row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Cross first section beneath second section just worked. Work 1 dc in each of next 8 dc of first section. Turn. 16 dc.
Next row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 22" [56 cm]. Fasten off.
Sew ends tog.

instructions:
HEADBAND COVER
Top Half
With A, ch 55.

Rnd 2: *Ch 3, (tr, hdc) in same st, (hdc, tr, ch 3, slip st) in next st**, slip st in next st; repeat from * once; repeat from * to ** once, ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in each of next 3 ch, slip st in base of first st (stem made). Fasten off, leaving a sewing length.

materials: Red Heart® With Love® (7 oz/198 g; 370 yds/338 m) Blue Hawaii (1803) or Iced Aqua (1502) or Cameo (1711) 1 ball
Note: 1 ball will make approx 66 Flowers, 50 Bows or 20 Pompoms.
Flower and Bow Versions: Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge. Super glue. Snap-on hair clips.
Pompom Version: 2" [5 cm] wide piece of cardboard. Super glue. Snap-on hair clips.
measurements: Flower: Approx 2" [5 cm] diameter. Bow: Approx 2" x 3" [5 x 7.5 cm]. Pompom: Approx 2" [5 cm] diameter.
gauge: 14 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
FLOWER
Ch 18.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 17 sc.
2nd row: [Ch 1. (1 sc. 1 hdc. 1 sc) in next sc. Ch 1. Sl st in next ch – petal made] 3 times. [Ch 2. (1 hdc. 1 dc. 1 hdc) in next sc. Ch 2. Sl st in next ch – petal made] 5 times. 8 petals. Fasten oﬀ leaving long end.
With RS facing up, roll petals inward as shown in picture and secure spiral on WS with yarn end.
BOW
Ch 10.
1st row: (RS). Working into horizontal “bump” at back of each ch, 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 9 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 9 sc.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 1½" [4 cm], ending on a RS row. Do not fasten oﬀ or turn at end of last row.
Edging: With RS facing, ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around Bow, having 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten oﬀ.
Tie: Wrap length of yarn around center of Bow 10 times and secure tightly.
POMPOM
Wind yarn around cardboard approx 75 times. Remove from cardboard and tie tightly in center, leaving 2 long ends for attaching to hair clip. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape.
FINISHING
Glue a Flower, Bow or Pom-Pom to each snap-on hair clip as shown in photo.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein 312 Black for Kitty

abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: rows = 4” (10 cm) in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
EEK! A MOUSE!
Ear Back (Make 2)
With A, ch 3, slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, 6 sc in ring, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around, slip st in first sc – 12 sc.
Round 3: Repeat Round 2 – 24 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc – 32 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc – 40 sc.
Fasten off.
Ear Front (Make 2)
With B, work as for Ear Back through Round 4. Change to A and complete Round 5. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With right sides together, sew Ear Front to Ear Back leaving approximately 1” (3 cm) unsewn. Turn Ears right side out. Cut and position a length of wire to fit around inside edges of each Ear. Secure ends together and slip wire inside each Ear to hold shape. Position lower edge of each Ear evenly spaced apart on headband and sew on securely. Weave in ends.
Note
1. Kitty Ears are worked in two pieces from lower edge to tip. Two Ears are then sewn together and stuffed with fiberfill. Lower edge is sewn onto a purchased headband.
2. Mouse Ears are worked in continuous rounds from center to outside edges.
Special Stitches
sc2tog = [Draw up a loop in next st] 2 times, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
sc3tog = [Draw up a loop in next st] 3 times, yarn over and draw through all 4 loops on hook.
KITTY, KITTY
Ears (Make 4)
Ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 7 sc.
Rows 2-3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog, turn – 5 sc.
Row 5: Repeat Row 2.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next sc, sc2tog, turn – 3 sc.
Row 7: Repeat Row 2.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc3tog.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew 2 Ears together, leaving beginning edge unsewn. Lightly stuff with fiberfill sew closed. Repeat with second Ear. Position lower edge of each Ear evenly spaced apart on headband and sew on securely. Weave in ends.

pattern_name: Puffy Flower Crochet Headband & Hair Clips
materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® Craft Kit Gradients™ - 1 kit
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
measurements: Hairband = Approx 12" [30.5 cm] long, excluding ties. Hairclips = Approx 2½" [6 cm] diameter for Flower, excluding clips.
gauge: Puffy Flower Motif = Approx 2½" [6 cm] diameter.
instructions:
PUFFY FLOWER MOTIF
With Color 1, ch 2, leaving a tail approx 3" [7.5 cm] long, 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to any sc. 
Fasten off Color 1, leaving a tail approx 3" [7.5 cm] long.
2nd rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to any sc. *Ch 3 (counts 
as dc). Yoh and draw up a long loop, equal in height 
to beg ch 3. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 
6 times all in same sc as sl st. Yoh and draw through 
6 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through last 2 loops. 
Ch 3. Sl st in same sc – Petal Cluster made. Sl st in next 
sc. Rep from * 5 times more. Sl st in same sc as first 
sl st. Fasten off, leaving a 3" [7.5 cm] long tail for assembly.  
6 petals total.

HAIRBAND
For all Versions, use A as Color 1, and make 2 Puffy Flower 
Motifs each with B and C as Color 2 and 1 Puffy Flower Motif 
with D as Color 2.

Assembly
On WS of each Motif, pull ends of Color 1 to close hole, and 
tie ends tog tightly to secure.
With WS facing, join Motifs tog at tips of petals, using yarn 
needa and tails from fasten off to sew them tog into 1 strip 
of 5 Puffy Flower Motifs in following sequence: B, C, D, C, B.

Ties
With RS facing, join A with sl st to last Puffy Flower Motif, 
between petals.
Ch 50. Fasten off.
Rep on other end.

With yarn needle, weave in ends on WS of work.

HAIR CLIPS
Make Puffy Flower Motif for each Clip.
For Each Version use D as Color 1 and A as Color 2.

Notes:
• When joining and fastening off each color, leave a 
tail approx. 3" [7.5 cm] long to tie and secure on WS 
during finishing.
• Tie ends tog tightly on WS to secure and weave ends 
into petals and trimming to hide.
Glue Motif to Hair Clip.

Size U.S. G/6 [4 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Bow
Ch 4.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Turn. 5 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 7 sc.
5th row: As 3rd row.
6th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 9 sc.
7th to 9th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
10th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 7 sts.
11th row: As 3rd row.
12th row: As 11th row. 5 sts.
13th row: As 3rd row.
14th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. 3 sts. Turn.
15th row: As 3rd row.
16th to 29th rows: Rep 2nd to 15th rows once more.
Fasten off.
Bow Center
Ch 10.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. 8 hdc. Fasten off, leaving a long end.
FINISHING
Fold sides of Bow towards center, aligning final row against foundation row. Sew ends tog. Wrap Bow Center around Bow and sew ends tog securely (WS of Bow).

I-Cord Headband
Ch 3.
1st row: Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in 3rd ch from hook. 3 loops on hook.
2nd row: Drop last 2 loops off hook, pinching them securely with left hand to avoid dropping loops. Yoh and draw up a loop in rem loop on hook. (Place next dropped loop on hook. Yoh and draw up a loop) twice.
Rep 2nd row until I-Cord Headband measures head circumference when slightly stretched.
Final row: Yoh and draw loop through all 3 ch. 1 loop rem on hook. Fasten off. Sew ends tog.
Sew Bow in position to cover seam of I-cord.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 319 Cherry Red A, and 334 Buff B.

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Motifs sewn together measure 7” across at widest point.
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
MOTIF (Make 2)
With A, ch 4, slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, work 12 sc ring, slip st in first st to join – 12 sc. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in same sc, 2 sc in each sc around, slip st in first sc – 24 sc.
Round 3: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), hdc in same sc, *hdc in next 2 sc, 2 hdc in next sc; repeat from * to last 2 sc, hdc in next 2 sc, slip st in top of beginning ch – 32 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in same next hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc, [2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc] 4 times, (2 hdc, ch 2, 2 hdc) in next hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc, hdc in same next hdc, [2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc] 4 times, (2 hdc, ch 2, 2 hdc) in next hdc, slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail on one motif.
Trim
With right side of one Motif facing, join B in any st and slip st in each hdc around, slip st in first st. Fasten off. Repeat on second Motif.
FINISHING
Position one Motif overlapping Motif with long tail end by 1½”. Position feather trim down center of right side of lower Motif, slipping end in overlap, and sew to lower Motif. Using long tail, sew Motifs together. Arrange beads in center of upper Motif and sew in place.
Ties
With right side facing, join B in center of point of one Motif, make a ch 15” long. Fasten off. Repeat to make a Tie on opposite point of joined Motifs. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Soft Baby Steps®: 1 ball each 9590 Lavender A and 9700 Baby Pink B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
