Notes:
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.
• Ch 2 at beg of row or rnd does not count as st.
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts ad dc.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.

MOTIF (make 2)
See diagram on page 3.
With C, ch 6. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 15 dc in ring. Join. 16 dc.

2nd rnd: Ch 5 (counts as dc and ch-2). *1 dc in next dc. Ch 2. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-5. Fasten off. 16 dc and 16 ch-2 sps.

3rd rnd: Join D with sl st in any ch-2 sp. Ch 3. (1 dc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in same sp as sl st. *(Ch 2. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp) 3 times. Ch 2. **(2 dc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join.

4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. *3 sc in corner ch-3 sp. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. (1 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp.** 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join. Fasten off.

5th rnd: Join B with sl st to any corner sc (center st of 3-sc grouping). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around, working 3 sc in each corner sc. Join. Fasten off.

6th rnd: Join A with sl st to any corner sc (center st of 3-sc grouping). Ch 2. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each sc around, working 3 hdc in each corner st. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for seaming.

BODY
Stripe Pat
*(With D, 2 rows. With A, 2 rows) 3 times. Fasten off D.
(With C, 2 rows. With A, 2 rows) 3 times. Fasten off C.
(With B, 2 rows. With A, 2 rows) 3 times. Fasten off B.
These 36 rows form Stripe Pat.
Note: Body section is worked in rnds, turning at end of each rnd to maintain consistent texture with sections that are worked flat.

LEG (make 2)
With D, ch 40. Proceed in Stripe Pat as follows, taking care to maintain color changes and carry unused color up WS of work:
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 38 hdc.
2nd to 4th rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 40 hdc.
First 5 rows of of Stripe Pat are complete.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep 2nd to 5th rows twice more. 44 hdc.
Next 3 rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off Left Leg. Do not fasten off when making Right Leg.

Join Legs: 1st rnd: (RS). Keeping cont of Stripe Pat and beg with Right Leg, ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Working into Left Leg, 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. 92 hdc. Join. PM for beg of rnd (Center Back). Turn.

2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. Turn.

3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 44 hdc. 2 hdc in each of next 2 hdc (Center Front crotch sts). 1 hdc in each hdc to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. 96 hdc. Join. Turn.

Next 31 rnds: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. Turn.
Fasten off at end of last rnd.
Sew Leg inseams.

Join Motifs to Body: Fold Body flat and mark center front st. Mark 9th st on each side of center st. 19 sts total for Motif. Rep for Back.
With RS facing of Motif and Body, place Motif between markers. Whipstitch Motif to Front as shown in photo tutorial. Whipstitch is worked from center hdc of first to last 3-hdc corner on bottom edge. Rep for second Motif and Back.
See video here.

FRONT STRAPS
Left Strap: With RS facing, mark 5th hdc on front of Body at right from Front Motif. Join D with sl st to marked hdc.
**1st row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 5 sts. Turn. 5 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until Strap from beg measures 6½" [16.5 cm], ending on a RS row. Fasten off.**

Right Strap: With RS facing, join D with sl st to first hdc on front of Body at left from Front Motif.
Rep from ** to ** as given for Left Strap.

BACK STRAPS
Left Strap: With RS facing, mark 5th hdc on back of Body at right from Back Motif. Join D with sl st to marked hdc.
***1st row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 5 sts. Turn. 5 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until Strap from beg measures 7½" [19 cm], ending on a WS row. 
Next row: (RS-buttonhole row). Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 2 hdc. Ch 2. Skip next hdc 1 hdc in each of last 2 sts. Turn.
Next row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 2 hdc. 1 hdc in next ch-2 sp. 1 hdc in each of last 2 hdc. Turn. 
Next 3 rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. Fasten off at end of last row.***

Right Strap: With RS facing, join D with sl st to first hdc on back of Body at left from Back Motif.
Rep from *** to *** as given for Left Strap.

Sew Straps into place along Motif edge. 
Try Romper on. Fold Right Back Strap (with buttonhole) over corresponding Front Strap.
PM on Front Strap to correspond to buttonhole for Bobble placement.
With RS facing, join D with sl st at Front Strap marker. Ch 3 (does not count as st). Bobble in same sp as sl st. Sl st in same sp as first sl st. Do not fasten off. Remove loop from crochet hook and place loop around Bobble base, extending loop as needed to fit. Pull yarn end to secure.

materials: Bernat® Softee Baby™ (5 oz/140 g; 362 yds/331 m)
Bernat® Softee Baby Cotton™ (4.2 oz/120 g; 254 yds/232 m)
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet through back loop only
measurements: To fit chest measurement: 6 mos 17" [43 cm], 12 mos 18" [45.5 cm], 18 mos 19" [48.5 cm], 24 mos 20" [51 cm]
gauge: 20 sts and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm] in sc/ch-1 pat.
instructions:
The instructions are written for smaller size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written 6 (12-18-24) mos. Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes.

Notes: 
• Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as st. 
• Do not break color at end of row. Carry color not in use loosely up side of work.
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color. 

STRIPE PAT
With A, work 2 rows. 
With B, work 2 rows. 
These 4 rows form Stripe Pat. 

RIGHT & LEFT LEGS (make alike).
With B, ch 34 (40-46-54).
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. 
Turn. 33 (39-45-53) sc. 

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row twice more. 

Proceed in Stripe Pat as follows: 
1st row: (RS). With A, ch 1. [ Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc] 6 (6-8-8) times. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. 
Turn. 39 (45-53-61) sc.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 
*Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 
Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 39 ( 45-53-61) sts (sc and ch-1). Join B. 

3rd row: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp and sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 

4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. Join A. 

4 rows of Stripe Pat are complete. 
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last 2 rows until work from beg measures 3½" [9 cm], ending on 4th row. 
Fasten off at end of Left Leg. Do not fasten off at end of Right Leg.

Join Legs and shape crotch: 
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, proceed as follows:
1st row: (RS). With A, ch 2 (2-6-6). 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp and sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last sc. Ch 3 ( 3-9-9). 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp and sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last sc. Ch 3 ( 3-7-7). Turn.

2nd row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Ch 1. Skip next ch. (1 sc in next ch. Ch 1. Skip next ch) 0 ( 0-2-2) time(s). 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. (Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 1 ( 1-3-3) time(s). Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 1 sc in first sc of next leg. **Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from ** to last 2 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. (Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 sc in next ch) 1 ( 1-3-3) time(s). Turn. 
85 (97-127-143) sts (sc and ch-1).

3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp and sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.

4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 

Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last 2 rows until work from joining row measures approx 7 ( 8-9-10)" [18 ( 20.5-23-25.5) cm], ending with 2 rows of A. 

Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, proceed as follows: 
Shape Front Bib: With RS facing, skip next 22 (24-30-34) sts. Join B with sl st to next ch 1 sp. 
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 1. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 22 ( 24-30-34) sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Rep from * to last ch-1 sp and sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 

3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Pat to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 

4th row: Work even in pat. Turn. 
Rep last 2 rows until there are 25 (29-31-33) sts. Break A. 

With B, work 2 rows even. Do not fasten off. 

Straps: 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc) twice. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 6 sts (sc and ch-1 sp).

**2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 

3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc) twice. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows for 6 ( 7-8-9)" [15 (18-20.5-23) cm], ending on a WS row.

Next row: (RS - buttonhole row). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. Skip next 3 sts. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.

Next row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.

Next row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Fasten off.**

FINISHING
Sew back seam. Sew Leg seams. Try on Romper. Sew crossed straps to back edge of Romper. Sew buttons in position as shown in photo.

materials: Lily® Sugar'n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Main Color (MC) Blueberry (01725) 1 ball or 25 m/27 yds
Contrast A Red (00095) 1 ball or 3 m/3 yds
Contrast B Sage Green (00084) 1 ball or 3 m/3 yds
Blackberry Version: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® Scents (2 oz/56.7 g; 95 yds/ 86 m) Main Color (MC) Red (00095) 1 ball or 25 m/27 yds
Contrast A Black Currant (50318) 1 ball or 8 m/9 yds
Contrast B Sage Green (00084) 1 ball or 3 m/3 yds
Orange Slice Version: Main Color (MC) Tangerine (01699) 1 ball or 25 m/27 yds
Contrast A Hot Orange (01628) 1 ball or 8 m/9 yds
Contrast B White (00001) 1 ball or 3 m/3 yds
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
measurements: Approx 3" (7.5 cm) in diameter. To fit standard wide mouth canning jar.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Basic Topper (See Chart on page 2). 
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. (Ch 1. 1 dc) 4 times in next sc. Ch 1. Miss next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
9th rnd: Ch 5 (counts as 1 dc and ch 2). Miss next 2 ch-1 sps. [(1 dc. Ch 1) twice. 1 dc] in next ch-1 sp. Miss next 2 ch-1 sps. *Ch 2. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 2. Miss next 2 ch-1 sps. [(1 dc. Ch 1) twice. 1 dc] in next ch-1 sp. Miss next 2 ch-1 sps. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 5.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in next dc. *Ch 2. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Ch 5. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc) in next ch-1 sp. Ch 2. ** 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * around, ending at **. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Strawberry (make 2).
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 4 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – sc2tog made. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc.
Stuff Strawberry Lightly.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 4 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 4 sc.
Fasten off.
Strawberry Top (make 2).
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: (1 sc. Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook) 6 times in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Sew Strawberry Top to Strawberry.
Blackberry (make 2).
Note: Push tr to RS of work.
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: (1 sc. 1 tr) 3 times in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *(1 sc. 1 tr) in next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Stuff Blackberry lightly.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in next st. (Yoh) twice and draw up a loop in next st. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 4 times – dec made. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st.
Fasten off.
Blackberry Top (make 2).
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: (1 sc. Ch 2. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook) 5 times in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Sew Blackberry Top to Blackberry.
Orange Slice (make 2).
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join B with sl st to first sc. Break MC. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: With B, ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first sc. Break B. 18 sc.
Fold work in half.
Join A with sl st to sc at fold. Working through both thicknesses, proceed as follows:
4th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times.
Fasten off. With B, embroider ‘segments’ using straight st.
FINISHING (All versions)
Tie: With B, ch 55. Sew one Strawberry, Blackberry, or Orange Slice to each end of Tie. Wrap Tie around Topper.

materials: Lily® Sugar'n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Main Color (MC) Red (00095) 1 ball or 13 yds/12 m
Contrast A Jute (00082) 1 ball or 5 yds/4 m
Contrast B White (00001) 1 ball or 7 yds/5 m
Main Color (MC) Warm Brown (01130) 1 ball or 20 yds/18 m
Contrast A Red (00095) 1 ball or 7 yds/6 m
Contrast A Jute (00082) 1 ball or 7 yds/6 m
Contrast B White (00001) 1 ball or 1 yd/1 m
Sizes U.S. G/6 (4 mm) and U.S. H/8 (5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Santa: Approx 5" [12.5 cm] tall, including pompom. Reindeer: Approx 4" [10 cm] tall, excluding antlers.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Note: When joining new color, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed.
SANTA VERSION
**With MC and larger hook, ch 18. Join with sl st to first ch to make a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Rep last rnd 4 times more, joining A at end of last rnd.**
With A, rep 2nd rnd 3 times more. Join MC at end of last rnd.
Next rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sts rem. Next 2 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 6 sts rem.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 3 sts rem. Fasten off.
Beard
With B and larger hook, ch 5.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd to 4th rows: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 10 sc at end of 4th row.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 6th and 7th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. Fasten off at end of 7th row.
With RS facing, skip next 6 unworked sc. Join B with sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
Next 2 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. Fasten off at end of last row.
Pompom: Wind B around 2 fingers approx 15 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to a smooth round shape. Attach pom-pom to top of Hat.
FINISHING
Attach Beard to Body as shown in picture. With black embroidery floss, embroider eyes on face using French knots.
REINDEER VERSION
With MC and larger hook, work from ** to ** as given for Santa, omitting reference to color change.
Next rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc. Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 22 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. With A, (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times in next st. Yoh and draw through 4 loops on hook – bobble nose made. With MC, 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next 5 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off at end of last rnd, leaving a long end. Sew top of Reindeer closed.
Antlers (make 2)
With B and smaller hook, ch 12. 1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. *Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch of foundation ch. Rep from * once more. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Fasten off.
Eyes (make 2).
With C and smaller hook, ch 2. 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Scarf
With A and smaller hook, ch 45. 1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Attach Antlers to top of Reindeer head. Sew eyes to front of head. With black embroidery floss embroider eyes. Tie Scarf around neck.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball each 9388 Wheat A, 4614 Black B, 9518 Teal C, and 9523 Dark Leaf D
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Case measures 7” wide x 4” long (18 x 10 cm).
gauge: 15 sc = 4” (10 cm); 15 rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CASE
With A, ch 27.
Round 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across to last ch, 2 sc in last ch; working in opposite side of foundation ch, skip first ch, sc in next 25 ch; join with slip st in first sc—52 sc.
Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Repeat Round 2; change to B.
Round 5: Ch 1, spike st in first st, sc in next st, *spike st in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 6: Repeat Round 2; change to C.
Round 7: Repeat Round 5.
Round 8: Repeat Round 2; change to D.
Round 9: Repeat Round 5.
Round 10: Repeat Round 2; change to A.
Round 11: Repeat Round 5.
Rounds 12–14: Repeat Round 2.
Flatten case and place st marker in center st on back edge for buttonhole.
Round 15: Ch 1, sc in each st around to marked st, ch 15 (buttonhole made), sc in marked st, sc in each remaining st around; join with slip st in first sc—52 sc and 1 buttonhole.
Round 16: Slip st in each sc and ch around; join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With A, sew button to center front of case below top edge.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball each 9518 Teal A, 9522 Leaf B, and 9870 Deep Sea C
Yarn needle, locking stitch markers or seaming pins, 4½” (11.5 cm) of ¾” (2 cm) wide sew-on Velcro®, sewing needle and matching thread
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Bag measures 14” wide x 13” long (35.5 x 33 cm) with flaps folded over.
gauge: 16 sts = 4” (10 cm); 16 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet.
instructions:
Panel #2
With B, ch 53.
Row 1: Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn—52 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 1, hdc in each hdc across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 9½” (24 cm). Fasten off.

Panel #3
With C, ch 53.
Row 1: Dc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch counts as first dc) and each ch across, turn—52 dc.
Row 2: Ch 1, dc in each dc across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 12” (30.5 cm) ending on wrong side row.
Do not fasten off.

Note: The three flaps that follow are added to the top edge of Panel #3.

Flap #1
Row 1: Ch 1, dc in first 8 dc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—8 dc.
Rows 2–6: Ch 1, dc in each dc across, turn. Fasten off.

Flap #2
With right side facing, skip next 14 dc from last flap and join C with slip st in next st.
Row 1: Ch 1, dc in same st as join, dc in next 7 dc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn.
Rows 2–6: Ch 1, dc in each dc across, turn. Fasten off.

Flap #3
With right side facing, skip next 14 dc from last flap and join C with slip st in next st.
Row 1: Ch 1, dc in same st as join, dc in last 7 dc, turn.
Rows 2–6: Ch 1, dc in each dc across, turn. Fasten off.

Bag measures 14” wide x 13” long (35.5 x 33 cm) with flaps folded over.

Special Stitch
sc2tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

Special Technique
Join with sc = Place a slip knot on hook, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through both loops on hook.

Notes
1. Bag is made in panels worked back and forth in rows and joined together to form pockets.
2. Backstitching vertically across rows creates pockets of varying sizes.
3. Velcro® fasteners are sewn to flaps to secure bag around the bar of a walker.
4. At the beginning of each row on Panels 2 and 3, draw up first chain to height of half double crochet or double crochet stitch. This first chain does not count as a stitch; do not work into this chain at the end of a row. Work first stitch of each row in last stitch of previous row.

BAG
Panel #1
With A, ch 53.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—52 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 6” (15 cm). Fasten off.

FINISHING
Joining Panels
Lay panel #2 on panel #3 with side and lower edges matching. Lay panel #1 on panel #2 in same manner. Hold panels together with locking stitch markers or seaming pins.

Round 1 (right side): With right side of first row facing, insert hook through all thicknesses and join A with sc in opposite side of last foundation ch; working across ends of rows and through all thicknesses, sc 22 sts evenly across panel #1, sc 10 sts evenly across panel #2, sc 12 sts evenly across panel #3 to first row of flap #1, *sc 9 sts evenly across ends of rows of first side of flap, 3 sc in first st, sc in next 6 sts, 3 sc in last st, sc 9 sts evenly across ends of rows of other side of flap**, sc2tog over same st as last sc and first st after flap, sc in each st to last st before next flap, sc2tog over last st and end of first row of next flap; beginning in same row as last st made, repeat from * twice ending at **; continuing across ends of rows and through all thicknesses, sc 12 sts evenly across panel #3, sc 10 sts evenly across panel #2, sc 22 sts evenly across panel #1; working in opposite side of foundation ch and through all thicknesses, 3 sc in first ch, sc in each ch across to first sc, 2 sc in same ch as first sc; join with slip st in first sc—262 sc.

Round 2: Slip st in each sc around; join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.

Pockets
With right side facing, place stitch markers or seaming pins on 19th and 29th sts from right edge. Place additional markers or pins on same sts across various rows as a sewing guideline.

With A and working through all thicknesses, backstitch over the 19th st of each row from bottom edge to top edge of panel #1. Secure and cut yarn. With B and working through all thicknesses, backstitch over 19th st of each row of panel #2. Secure and cut yarn.
With A and working only through panels #1 and #2, backstitch over 29th stitch of each row of panel #1. Secure and cut yarn.

Flaps
Cut three 1½” (4 cm) lengths of Velcro®. With sewing needle and thread, sew Velcro to wrong side of flaps and top of panel, leaving sufficient room to wrap around the bar of a walker.

Weave in ends.

pattern_name: Crochet Graduation Cap Mason Jar Topper
materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Main Color (MC) Black (00002) 1 ball or 49 yds/45 m
Contrast A Yellow (00010) 1 ball or 10 yds/9 m
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
4" [10 cm] wide piece of cardboard for tassels.
4" [10 cm] square piece of black cardboard for filling (optional).
abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) indicated spaces. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: To fit 500 ml regular mouth Mason jar with 2¾" [7 cm] diameter opening.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 4 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 3 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 sc in first st. [1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next st] 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in joining sl st. Join with sl st in ch-2 sp. 16 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 1 sc in first ch-2 sp. [1 sc in each of next 4 sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 sc in joining sl st. Join with sl st in ch-2 sp. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. 1 sc in first ch-2 sp. [1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 1 sc in joining sl st. Join with sl st in ch-2 sp. 32 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. 1 sc in first ch-2 sp. [1 sc in each of next 8 sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 1 sc in joining sl st. Join with sl st in ch-2 sp. 40 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 1 sc in first ch-2 sp. [1 sc in each of next 10 sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 1 sc in joining sl st. Join with sl st in ch-2 sp. 48 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 2. 1 sc in first ch-2 sp. [1 sc in each of next 12 sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 1 sc in joining sl st. Join with sl st in ch-2 sp. 56 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 2. 1 sc in first ch-2 sp. [1 sc in each of next 14 sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next ch-2 sp] 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 1 sc in joining sl st. Join with sl st in ch-2 sp. 64 sc.
10th rnd: Working in back loops only, (sl st in next sc) twice. Ch 1. 1 sc in same st as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. (Sc2tog, skipping ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc) 3 times. Sc2tog in next sc and first sl st. Join with sl st to first sc. 60 sc.
11th rnd: Working in both loops, sl st in next st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same st as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. (Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc) 3 times. Sc3tog in next 2 sc and sl st join. Join with sl st to first sc. 52 sc.
12th rnd: Sl st in next st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same st as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. (Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc) 3 times. Sc3tog in next 2 sc and sl st join. Join with sl st to first sc. 44 sc.
13th rnd: Sl st in next st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same st as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. (Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc) 3 times. Sc3tog in next 2 sc and sl st join. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
14th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc) 3 times. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
15th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
16th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd once more. Fasten off.
Tassel
Wrap A around 4" [10 cm] piece of cardboard 25 times. Tie securely at one end with 16" [40.5 cm] length of yarn. Cut across other end. Wrap yarn 6 times around Tassel ¾" [2 cm] from tied end. Fasten securely. Attach tassel to top of Cap as shown in photo.
Optional: Stuff square cardboard into Cap.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver™ (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 8" [20.5 cm] high. Fits one-quart Mason jar.
gauge: 15 sc and 18 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.

SANTA
Beg at top of Head, with A, ch 37.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 36 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 42 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row 7 times more. Join B. With B, rep last row 14 times more. Fasten off, leaving a long end.

HAT CUFF
Note: Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc. With C, ch 44.
1st row: (WS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 42 dc.
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Fasten off, leaving long end.

HAT TOP
With A, ch 2. 1st row: (WS). 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 6 sc.
2nd and alt rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 12 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 18 sc.
7th row: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 2 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 24 sc.
9th row: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 3 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 30 sc.
10th to 16th rows: As 2nd row. Fasten off, leaving a long end.
Pompom: Wind C around 3 fingers 60 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape.

NOSE
With B, ch 2. 1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end.

BEARD CURLS (make 17)
With C, ch 8. 1st row: (RS). 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. 21 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end.

FINISHING
Sew Hat Cuff to Santa as shown in picture. Sew back seam. With D, embroider eyes using Satin stitch. Sew Hat Top side seam. Sew top opening closed. Sew pompom securely to tip of Hat Top. Sew to Santa as shown in picture. Sew Nose and Beard Curls in place as shown in picture. Satin Stitch

instructions:
Notes: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc. Join all rnds with sl st to first hdc.

With A, ch 3. Join with sl st to form a ring. 
1st rnd:  Ch 2. 6 hdc in ring. Join. 6 hdc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * once more. Join. 9 hdc. 
4th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 
5th rnd:  Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Rep from * once more. Join. 12 hdc. 
6th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 
7th rnd:  Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of the next 3 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * once more. Join. 15 hdc. 
8th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 
9th rnd:  Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * once more. Join. 18 hdc. 
10th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 
11th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Rep from * once more. Join. 21 hdc. 
12th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 
13th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. Rep from * once more. Join. 24 hdc. 
14th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 
15th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. Rep from * once more. Join. 27 hdc. 
16th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 
17th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 8 hdc. Rep from * once more. Join. 30 hdc. 
18th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 
19th rnd:  Ch 2. Working in front loops only, 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. Rep from * once more. Join. 33 hdc. 
20th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. Fasten off. 
BEARD 
Join B with sl st to any back loop of 19th rnd of Hat. 
1st rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in back loop of each hdc around. Join. 33 hdc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 10 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 10 hdc. Rep from * once more. Join. 36 hdc. 
3rd rnd: *Ch 10. Sl st in next hdc. Rep from * around. Fasten off.
NOSE 
With C, ch 3. Join with sl st to form a ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc. 1 dc. 2 sc. 1 dc) into ring. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long end. 
FINISHING 
Sew Nose to Beard just below Hat. Place lid cover on top of jar.

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C

instructions:

Rows 3-21: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 22: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), turn, dc in next 5 sc, 2 dc in next sc, [dc in next 6 sc, 2 dc in next sc] 5 times – 48 dc.
Row 23: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next st, skip next st, 5 dc next st, sk next st] 11 times, sc in next st skip next st, 5 dc in next st, sc in last st. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.

ARM (make 2)
Note: Arm is worked in continuous rounds. 
With A, ch 2. 
Round 1: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Place marker for beginning of round.

Round 6: (Sc in next sc, ch 3, work 4 dc in same sc, remove hook and put it through top of ch-3, draw loop of last dc through) all in same st for thumb, sc in remaining 11 sc.
Round 7: Skip thumb, sc in next 11 sc. 
Rounds 8-11: Sc in each sc around. 
Fasten off, leaving long end for sewing. 
Stuff hand section, do not stuff arm. 

FINISHING
Flatten last round of each arm and sew one arm on either side of Cozy.

Embroidery
Note: It may be easier to work embroidery while Cozy is on the jar. 
Refer to photo for placements.
Use a double strand of B and satin stitch to embroider mouth. Use satin stitch to embroider two eyes. 
Weave in ends.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Baker’s Cotton: 1 ball 900 Red or 700 Pink
2” (5 cm) foam ball for Small jar cover
21⁄2” (6.5 cm) foam ball for Large jar cover
two 6” (15 cm) felt squares in white or color to match yarn
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Pin Cushion fits lid of Small 16-oz pint Mason jar or Large 32-oz wide-mouth quart Mason jar.
gauge: 21 sc = 4” (10 cm); 26 rows sc = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size needles/hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions: Round 12: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each of next 5 sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in each of next 3 sc] 9 times; slip st in first sc to join—52 sc. Fasten off and weave in ends. Cushion Side for size Large: Continue working into last Round of Top. Rounds 9-12: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; slip st in first sc to join—48 sc. Round 13: Ch 2 (counts as a hdc), hdc in same st as joining, hdc in each of next 3 sc, [2 hdc in next sc, hdc in each of next 3 sc] 11 times; slip st in top of beginning ch-2 to join—60 hdc. Fasten off and weave in ends. Lid Side Band (Instructions for size Large are in parentheses): Ch 60 (72); being careful not to twist, join with a slip st to form a ring. Round 1: Ch 2 (counts as a hdc), hdc in each ch around; slip st in top of beginning ch-2 to join—60 (72) hdc. Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as hdc and ch-1), [skip next hdc, hdc in next hdc, ch 1] around until 1 hdc remains, skip last hdc; slip st in 2nd ch of beginning ch-3 to join—30 (36) hdc and 30 (36) ch-1 spaces. Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc and ch-1 space around; slip st in top of beginning ch-2 to join—60 (72) hdc. Fasten off and weave in ends. Flower: Ch 4, join with a slip st to form a ring. Round 1 (Right side): Ch 2 (counts as a hdc), 11 hdc in ring; slip st in top of beginning ch-2 to join—12 hdc. Round 2: Ch 2, dc in same st as joining, (tr, dc) in next hdc, ch 2, [(slip st, ch 2, dc) in next hdc, (tr, dc) in next hdc, ch 2] 5 times; join with slip st in base of beginning ch-2—6 petals. Fasten off and weave in ends. Assembly: 1. Carefully cut the foam ball in half. 2. Slightly stretch a felt square to cover the top of the ball (you may need to cut a few slits in order to keep it smooth). Fold the felt under the ball about ½”. Glue the ends of the felt down, but do not glue the felt on the round part of the ball, as it will make it difficult to pin into. Do not use hot glue, as this can melt the foam. Place a few pins in the ball to hold everything together while it dries. Let it dry upside down so it does not stick to your surface. 3. Cut a piece of felt to cover the bottom cut edge of the ball and glue it on. Place a few pins in the ball to hold everything together while it dries. Let it dry upside down so it does not stick to your surface. 4. Sew a Flower and button on top of the Pin Cushion (optional). 5. Place the felt-covered foam ball half inside the Pin Cushion cover, then glue the bottom of the ball to the top of the Mason jar lid. When the glue is dry, slip the outer piece of the jar lid into place. 6. Cut 5 strands of yarn each 20” (51 cm) long. Thread the strands through Round 2 of the Lid Side Band, referring to photo for placement. Place the Lid Side Band around the outer piece of the jar lid and tie the strands of yarn together, then clip the ends. Slide the tied strings around until the knot is inside the Band, or sew a Flower and button over the knot.

abbreviations: A, B, C, D, E, F = Colors A, B, C, D, E, F
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Finished tree is 7" (17.75 cm) wide and 10" (25.5 cm) tall, including star. To fit universal-size mason jar lid: 2¾“ (70mm) diameter. To fit wide-mouth mason jar: 3⅜” (86mm) diameter.
gauge: 12 sts = 4” [10 cm]; 7 rows = 4” [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
TREE BASE
Note: To substitute the adjustable ring, ch 3 and join to first ch.
With A, make an adjustable ring as follows: Wrap yarn around your finger with the yarn tail to the left and under the working yarn. Insert hook through the circle from front to back. Yarn over using the working yarn and pull through loop.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in adjustable ring, join to first sc. Pull starting end tight to close the circle – 6 sc.
Rounds 2 & 3: Sc in each of next 6 sts. 
Round 4: Working in back loops only, (hdc, dc) in next st, 1 dc in next st, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in next st; repeat from * once more – 9 sts.
Round 5: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 2 sts; repeat from * 2 more times – 12 dc. 
Round 6: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 3 sts; repeat from * 2 more times – 15 dc. 
Round 7: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 4 sts; repeat from * 2 more times – 18 dc. 
Round 8: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 5 sts; repeat from * 2 more times – 21 dc. 
Round 9: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 6 sts; repeat from * 2 more times – 24 dc. 
Round 10: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 7 sts; repeat from * 2 more times – 27 dc.
Round 11: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 8 sts; repeat from * 2 more times – 30 dc.
Round 12: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 9 sts; repeat from * 2 more times – 33 dc.
Round 13: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 10 sts; repeat from * 2 more times – 36 dc.
Round 14: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 11 sts; repeat from * 2 more times – 39 dc.
Round 15: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 12 sts; repeat from * 2 more times – 42 dc.
Round 16: Working in back loops only, *2 dc in next st, 1 dc in each of next 13 sts; repeat from * 2 more times, 1 hdc in next st, 1 sc in next st, slip st in next st – 48 sts.
Do not fasten off.
OUTER LAYER OF TREE
Note: You will now be working into all the front loops left behind.
Round 1: Turn, *ch 3, skip 2 sts, slip st into next front loop; repeat from * around.
Repeat this round until you have reached the top of the tree and worked the last front loop.
Next round: Turn, 3 sc in first ch space, sc into slip st, *(2 dc, Picot Stitch, 2 dc) in next ch space, sc in next slip st; repeat from * around.
Repeat this round until you have reached the bottom of the tree; sc in st after the last ch space.
Fasten off.
STAR TREE TOPPER (Make 2)
With C, make an adjustable ring. 
Round 1: Ch 1, 5 sc in adjustable ring, join to first sc. Pull starting end tight to close the circle – 5 sc.
Round 2: *Ch 3, turn; skip 1 ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch, slip st into next sc; repeat from * 4 more times.
Fasten off, leaving a 24” (61 cm) tail. 
GARLAND
With B, ch 200. 
Row 1: Slip st into 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 199 slip sts.
Fasten off, leaving a 60” (152.5 cm) tail.
CHRISTMAS ORNAMENTS (Make 3 each using C, D, E, and F)
Make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in adjustable ring, join to first sc. Pull starting end tight to close the circle.
Fasten off, leaving a 12” (30.5 cm) tail. 
FINISHING
With yarn needle and long tail, join the front and back of the star together and attach to the top of tree.
Using long yarn tail, attach garland around tree, sliding the needle and yarn through the garland between branches.
Using long yarn tails, attach ornaments to tree.
Weave in all loose ends. Place the lid cover on top of the jar.

abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

gauge: 10 hdc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm] holding 2 strands tog.
instructions:
Note: Join at end of each rnd with sl st to top of first st.
BASKET
**Holding 2 strands of A tog, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 9 hdc in ring. Join. 9 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 18 hdc.**
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 36 hdc.
4th to 9th rnds: Ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Fasten off.

LID
Work from ** to ** as given for Basket.
3rd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 hdc in 1st hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 2 hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 2 hdc. Join. 24 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdc last hdc. Join. 36 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join.
Fasten off.

STEM
With 2 strands of B, ch 7.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 6 sc.
2nd to 4th rows:  Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Do not fasten off.

BASIC JAR COZY

Round 6: * Sc in each of next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 36 sts.

Round 8: * Sc in each of next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 48 sts.
Round 9: * Sc in each of next 11 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 52 sts.
Round 10: Sc in back loop only of each stitch around.
Rounds 11-15: Sc in each st around.
Round 16: * Sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in each of next 24 sts; repeat from * once more – 50 sts.
Rounds 17- 33: Sc in each st around.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

PIRATE VERSION
Pirate Hat Ribbed Band
With B and smaller hook, ch 4.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each of next 2 ch, turn – 3 sc.
Rows 2-35: Ch 1, working in back loops, sc in each st across, turn.
Join last row to first row by working a row of sc through both layers.
Pirate Hat Body
Begin working in rounds as follows:
Round 1: Ch 1, working into row ends of Ribbed Band, work 44 sc evenly spaced around, join with slip st in first sc.
Change to A and larger hook.
Note: For remainder of hat, work all sts in back loops only.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each st around, join with slip st in first sc.
Change to B; continue using larger hook for remainder of hat.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each st around, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 4-11: Repeat rounds 2 and 3, alternating colors.
Change to A.
Round 12: Ch 1, sc2tog over first 2 sts, [sc in each of next 8 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts] 4 times, sc in each of last 2 sts, join with slip st in first sc2tog – 39 sts.
Change to B.
Round 13: Ch 1, sc in each st around, join with slip st in first sc.
Change to A.
Round 14: Ch 1, sc2tog over first 2 sts, [sc in each of next 7 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts] 4 times, sc in last st, join with sc in first sc2tog – 34 sts.
Change to B.
Round 15: Repeat Round 13.
Change to A.
Round 16: Ch 1, [sc in next st, sc2tog over next 2 sts] 11 times, sc in last st, join with slip st in first sc – 23 sts.
Change to B.
Round 17: Repeat Round 13.
Change to A.
Round 18: Ch 1, sc in first st, [sc2tog over next 2 sts] 11 times, join with slip st in first sc – 12 sts.
Change to B; fasten off A.
Round 19: Ch 1, [sc2tog over next 2 sts] 6 times, join with slip st in first sc2tog – 6 sts.
Fasten off.
Weave yarn tail through top opening to close hole.
Weave in ends.
Pirate Eye Patch
With B and smaller hook, ch 7.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd st from hook and in each st across, turn – 6 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, skip first st, sc in each next 3 sts, sc2tog over last 2 sts, turn – 4 sts.
Fasten off.
Eye Patch Ties
With B and smaller hook, ch 7, slip st across top row of Eye Patch just made, ch 7.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
Finishing
Referring to the photo for placement and using sewing needle and thread, sew button to Cozy for eye. Sew Eye Patch to Cozy in the same manner, curving the ties upward so their ends are level with top edge of Cozy.

SKELETON VERSION
Skeleton Eyes (make 2)
With B and smaller hook, ch 3.
Round 1: 3 hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, rotate piece 180 degrees so that you are working into unused loops at bottom of foundation ch, 3 hdc in each of next 2 ch, join with slip st in first hdc – 12 hdc.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
Skeleton Nose
Ch 2, 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
Finishing
Referring to the photo for placement and using sewing needle and thread, sew Eyes and Nose to Cozy. Embroider mouth using single strand of B and yarn needle and working in short straight sts. Secure and trim ends.

JACK-O-LANTERN VERSION
Using template found at end of pattern, cut out felt shapes using sharp fabric scissors.
Finishing
Place Cozy over jar. Referring to the photo for placement, pin features securely to cozy. Remove jar and sew features on using sewing needle and thread.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 ball 672 Spring Green.
measurements: Pencil Case is 7” wide x 9½” long.
gauge: 15 sc = 4”; 16 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Ch 26.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 25 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc – 25 sc.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 4½” from beginning, end with a right side row.
Bottom Fold Row (Wrong Side): Ch 1, work sc in each st 2 rows below – 25 sc. 
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 14” from beginning, end with a right side row.
Top Fold Row (Wrong Side): Repeat Bottom Fold Row.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 15½” from beginning. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Fold top and bottom edges to wrong side along Fold Rows. Working though both layers, sc evenly along edges of each row to secure pockets. 
With right side facing, slip st down center of Pencil Case, working through both layers to divide into two Pockets.
Ties (make 2)
Ch 31. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each st across. 
Fasten off. 
Place ties 1” from top and 1” from bottom. Sew to case at center point. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein 629 green tones.
gauge: GAUGE: 13 sc = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
HOOK CASE
Flap
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 2, beginning in 2nd ch from hook, work 20 fsc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc between each st across, turn – 20 sc.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 3” from beginning, end with a right side row.
Top Fold Row (Wrong Side): Ch 1, turn, working in front loop only, sc in each st across – 20 sc.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 7” from Top Fold Row, end with a right side row.
Bottom Fold Row (Wrong Side): Ch 1, turn, working in front loop only, sc in each st across – 20 sc.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 5” from Bottom Fold Row, end with a right side row. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Fold bottom to right side along Bottom Fold Row. Working through both layers, work sc to join layers together along one side edge to Bottom Fold Row, working in back loops only, slip st in each st across, work sc to join layers together along opposite side edge. Fasten off. 
With right side facing, join yarn at edge of Flap and work backwards sc around to center of Row 1, ch 21, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across to Flap edge for Tie, work in backwards sc around to opposite edge of Flap. Fasten off.
Weave in ends. Sew button on bottom section opposite Tie. Divide bottom in desired number of pockets and mark. Work running stitches through both layers to secure pockets.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of black embroidery floss for embroidery.
abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 12½" [32 cm] long x 5" [12.5 cm] wide.
gauge: 15 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Alligator Body (make 2)
With MC, ch 2.
1st row: (RS). 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd and alt rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc.
5th and 7th rows: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 9 sc at end of 7th row.
9th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 10 sc.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows 4 times more. 14 sc at end of last row. Place marker at beg of last row.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from marker measures 4" [10 cm], ending on a WS row.
Shape Head:
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last 3 sc. Sc3tog. Turn. 12 sts. Place marker at end of row.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 11 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 10 sts.
4th row: As 2nd row. 9 sts.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from 2nd marked row measures 3" [7.5 cm], ending on a RS row.
Next row: (WS). Skip first sc. 6 dc in next sc. Sl st in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
‘Scales’: With RS facing, join MC with sl st to top of Head at marker.
1st row: Ch 1. Work 29 sc evenly along top edge of Alligator to approx 2" [5 cm] from end of tail. Turn.
2nd row: Skip first sc. *3 hdc in next sc. Sl st in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten off.
Rep for other side.
Eyes (make 2)
With A, ch 3.
1st rnd: 8 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.
With black embroidery floss, embroider pupil as shown in photo.
FINISHING
With WS tog, join MC with sl st to Tail where ‘Scales’ end (2" [5 cm] from end of Tail). Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc to join pieces along bottom of Alligator, around snout to top of Head at marked row.
Fasten off.
With black embroidery floss, embroider mouth using straight st, being careful to not sew through both thicknesses. With A, embroider teeth.
Sew in zipper along top opening.
Feet (make 2)
With MC, ch 6.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 5 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd and 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Turn. Fasten off.
Sew Feet to bottom of Body as shown in picture.

materials: 1 skein each Minty 520 A and Mushroom 369 B
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: To fit universal-size jar lid: 2¾“ (70mm) diameter
gauge: 16 sts = 4” [10 cm]; 12 rows = 4” [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
JAR LID COVER
With A, make an adjustable ring as follows: Wrap yarn around your finger with the yarn tail to the left and under the working yarn. Insert hook through the circle from front to back. Yarn over using the working yarn and pull through loop.
Round 1: Ch 1, 8 hdc in adjustable ring; join to first hdc, pull yarn tail tightly to close the ring – 8 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 1 (does not count as st here and throughout), 2 hdc in each of the next 8 hdc; join to first hdc – 16 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 hdc in first st, 1 hdc in next st, *2 hdc in next st, 1 hdc in next st; repeat from * 6 more times, join to first hdc – 24 hdc.
Round 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each of the next 2 sts, *2 sc in next st, 1 sc in each of the next 2 sts; repeat from * 6 more times, join to first sc – 32 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in the back loop only of each sc; join to first sc – 32 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, hdc in each st around; join to first hdc – 32 hdc.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join to first sc – 32 sc.
Round 8: Slip st in each st around. Fasten off.
DOG BONE (make 2)
Round 1: With B, ch 9, 3 hdc in second ch from hook, 1 sc in each of next 6 ch, 3 hdc in last ch; rotate piece to work up the other side of the ch, 1 sc in each of next 6 ch; join to first hdc – 6 hdc, 12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 2, 3 tr in first st, sc in next st, 3 tr in next st, ch 2, slip st into same st, slip st into next 7 sts, ch 2, 3 tr in same st, sc in next st, 3 tr in next st, ch 2, slip st into same st, slip st into last 5 sts – 12 tr, 2 sc, 6 ch, 14 slip sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail on one side of the bone for seaming later.
FINISHING
With yarn needle and long tail, seam the front and back of the bone together. Join the bottom of the dog bone to the top of the lid cover. Weave in all loose ends. Place the lid cover on top of the jar.

pattern_name: Light Up The Love Crochet Jar Cozy
materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m) Ecru (00004) or Rose Pink (00046) or Hot Pink (01740) or Red (00095) 1 ball or 65.5 yds/60 m

instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc. Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
Jar Cozy 
Ch 2. 
1st rnd: 7 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 7 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 14 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 21 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 28 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 35 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
8th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 17 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 hdc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Turn.
9th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 16 hdc. Ch 3. Skip next 3 sts. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join. Turn.
10th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 15 hdc. Ch 5. Skip next 5 sts. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join. Turn.
11th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 14 hdc. Ch 7. Skip next 7 sts. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join. Turn.
12th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 13 hdc. Ch 9. Skip next 9 sts. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join. Turn.
13th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 13 hdc. Ch 4. Skip next 4 ch. 1 hdc in next ch. Ch 4. Skip next 4 ch. 1 sc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join. Turn.

pattern_name: SANTA AND REINDEER CROCHET BOTTLE TOPPERS
materials: Bernat® Super Value™ (7 oz/197 g; 440 yds/402 m)
Sizes U.S. G/6 (4 mm) and U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Santa: Approx 5" [12.5 cm] tall, including pompom; Reindeer: Approx 4" [10 cm] tall, excluding antlers
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Note: When joining new color, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed.
SANTA VERSION
**With MC and larger hook, ch 18. Join with sl st to first ch to make a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 4 times more, joining A at end of last rnd.**
With A, rep 2nd rnd 3 times more. Join MC at end of last rnd.
Next rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sts rem.
Next 2 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st. 6 sts rem.
Next 2 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 3 sts rem. Fasten off.
Beard
With B and larger hook, ch 5.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd to 4th rows: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 10 sc at end of 4th row.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
6th and 7th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. Fasten off at end of 7th row.
With RS facing, skip next 6 unworked sc. Join B with sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
Next 2 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn. Fasten off at end of last row.
Pompom: Wind B around 2 fingers approx 15 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to a smooth round shape. Attach pom-pom to top of Hat.
FINISHING
Attach Beard to Body as shown in picture. With black embroidery floss, embroider eyes on face using French knots.
REINDEER VERSION
With MC and larger hook, work from ** to ** as given for Santa, omitting reference to color change.
Next rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 22 c.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sc. With A, (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times. Yoh and draw through 4 loops on hook – bobble nose made. With MC, 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next 5 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off at end of last rnd, leaving a long end.
Sew top of Reindeer closed.
Antlers (make 2)
With B and smaller hook, ch 12.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. *Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch of foundation ch. Rep from * once more. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Fasten off.
Eyes (make 2).
With C and smaller hook, ch 2. 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Scarf
With A and smaller hook, ch 45.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Attach Antlers to top of Reindeer head. Sew eyes to front of head. With black embroidery floss embroider eyes. Tie Scarf around neck.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball each 9870 Deep Sea A, 9440 Light Grey Heather B

measurements: Fits standard size small and large Mason jars. Small finished circumference: 7” [18 cm], Height: 5” [13 cm]. Large finished circumference: 8” [20 cm], Height: 7” [18 cm].
gauge: 12 dc = 4” [10 cm] and 4 rows = 3” [7.5 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.

Block lightly if desired.

Dry flat away from heat and direct sunlight. Trim piece if necessary to measurements 5 x 20 ins [12.5 x 51 cm]. IMPORTANT TO KNOW BEFORE FELTING Record all the measurements and changes before and after felting. You will be able to adjust the method to produce proper results. Always test a sample. Different colored yarns may felt differently. Colorfastness can be affected by very hot water. Any crochet that has been properly felted becomes very dense and matted. HOW TO FELT Using low water level, run a Hot/Cold cycle for 5 to 15 min. Add a pair of old jeans for agitation. Add 2 tablespoons of baking soda for a small load. After one cycle, check for size. Repeat if necessary. Run through the rinse and dry spin cycle. Do not use a clothes dryer. Lay felted piece onto a dry towel, away from direct heat or sunlight. Shape piece to correct measurements. If an edge ripples, baste a thread through the edge and gather in. Remove the thread after the felting is dry. Fold bottom 4 ins [10 cm] to RS to form pocket and top 6 ins [15 cm] to WS of piece (see Diagram). Blanket st through both thicknesses along sides of piece. TREE
With B, make a magic loop.

6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.

7th rnd: Working in front loops only, skip first sc. *(1 hdc. 1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc. 1 hdc) all in next sc.** Skip next 2 sc. Rep from * 5 times more, then from * to ** once. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to back loop of first skipped sc of 6th rnd.
8th rnd: Working into rem loops of 6th rnd, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
9th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. Join. 18 sts.
10th rnd: Working in front loops only, skip first sc. *(1 hdc. 1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc. 1 hdc) all in next sc.** Skip next 2 sc. Rep from * 4 times more. Skip next sc. Working into both loops, sl st in each of last 3 sc. Join with sl st to back loop of first skipped sc of 9th rnd.
11th rnd: Working into rem loops of 9th rnd and sl sts of 10th rnd, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
12th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. Join. 15 sts.
13th rnd: Working in front loops only, skip first sc. *(1 hdc. 1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc. 1 hdc) all in next sc.** Skip next 2 sc. Rep from * 3 times more, then from * to ** once. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to back loop of first skipped sc of 12th rnd.
14th rnd: Working into rem loops of 12th rnd, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
Stuff Tree lightly.
15th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. Join. 12 sts.
16th rnd: Working in front loops only, skip first sc. *(1 hdc. 1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc. 1 hdc) all in next sc.** Skip next 2 sc. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Skip last sc. Join with sl st to back loop of first skipped sc of 15th rnd.
17th rnd: Working into rem loops of 15th rnd, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
18th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join. 6 sts.
19th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 3 times. Join. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses of 19th rnd, sl st across opening to close. Fasten off.

Body

materials: Polyester fiberfill, 18" [45.5 cm] thin gold ribbon (for hanger), stitch marker, yarn needle.
abbreviations: A, B, and C = Color A, B, and C

gauge: 20 sts = 4" [10 cm]; 20 rows/rounds = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HOT DOG
With A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook—5 sc. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—10 sc.
Rounds 3–19: Sc in each sc around, adding stuffing as you go.
Round 20: [Sc2tog] 5 times—5 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Finish stuffing Hot Dog. Thread tail through stitches of last round and pull to close opening at end of Hot Dog.
MUSTARD
With B, ch 30.
Fasten off, leaving a very long tail. With yarn tail sew Mustard in a squiggle along one side of Hot Dog.
BUN (make 2)
With C, ch 2.
Top
Row 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in each sc across—10 sc.
Rows 3–18: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 19: Ch 1, turn, [sc2tog] 5 times—5 sc.
Row 20: [Insert hook in next sc and draw up a loop] 5 times (6 loops on hook), yarn over and draw through all loops on hook. Pull tightly.
Sides and Underside
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 42 sc evenly spaced all the way around outer edge of top of bun. Do not join, work in continuous rounds (spirals). Place a marker for beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Working in back loops only, [sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—36 sc.
Round 3: Working in both loops, [sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—30 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog] 6 times—24 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff piece very lightly. Sew lengthwise seam. Sew one long edge of the two pieces of Bun together, sewing through the unused loops of Round 1.
FINISHING
Place Hot Dog into Bun with Mustard facing outwards. With C, sew Bun to Hot Dog, trying not to indent Buns.
Fold gold ribbon in half. Insert crochet hook around a few stitches at top of ornament, place ribbon fold on hook and draw through to form a loop. Thread ends of ribbon through loop and pull to tighten. Tie ends together with bow or overhand knot to form hanging loop.
Weave in any remaining ends.

4th rnd: (WS). With A, sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 2 dc in same sp as last sl st. Ch 1. (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) twice. Skip next (3 dc, ch-2, 3 dc) for armhole. (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) 3 times. Skip last (3 dc, ch-2, 3 dc) for armhole. Join B with sl st in 3rd ch of ch-3. Turn.
5th rnd: (RS). With B, sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 2 dc in same sp as last sl st. Ch 1. (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) 5 times. Join E with sl st in 3rd ch of ch-3. Turn.
6th rnd: (WS). With E, as 5th rnd. Join C. Turn.
7th rnd: (RS). With C, as 5th rnd. Join A. Do not turn.
8th rnd: (RS). With A, ch 1. 1 sc in same st as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. (1 sc in each of next 3 dc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 5 times. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
Sleeves: 1st rnd: (RS). Join A with sl st in ch-2 sp. Ch 3. 2 dc in same sp as sl st. Ch 1. Skip next 3 dc. 3 dc in ch-1 sp of dividing rnd (same sp where 3 dc was worked). Ch 1. 3 dc in ch-1 sp before (3 dc, ch-2, 3 dc) of dividing rnd (same sp where 3 dc was worked). Ch 1. Join B with sl st in 3rd ch of ch-3. Turn.
2nd rnd:  (WS). With B, sl st into ch-1 sp. Ch 3. 2 dc in same ch-1 sp. Ch 1 (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) twice. Join E with sl st in 3rd ch of ch-3. Turn.
3rd rnd: (RS). With E, as 2nd rnd. Join C. Turn.
4th rnd: (WS). With C, as 2nd rnd. Join A. Do not turn.
5th rnd: (WS). With A, ch 1. 1 sc in same st as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 dc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. (1 sc in each of next 3 dc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Join with sl st in 1st sc. Fasten off.
Rep on opposite side.
VERSION II
Body:  With B, ch 8. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.

materials: Bernat® Macramé™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 44 yds/40 m)
Contrast A Natural (66001) 1 ball or 1.5 yds/1.3 m
Contrast B Olive (66007) 1 ball or 1.5 yds/1.3 m
¾" [2 cm] wooden bead with a hole big enough to pass two strands of Bernat® Macrame™ through it
measurements: Approx 6" [15 cm] long, excluding hanging loop.
gauge: Not specified.
instructions:
Note: Text in bold refers to knots illustrated with diagrams.
1. Cut 1 cord of A 10" [25.5 cm] long.
2. Fold cord in half and tie to top of wooden ring using Lark’s Head Knot.
3. Draw ends of cord through wooden bead from opposite sides for mustache. Trim.
4. Cut 5 cords of A 10" [25.5 cm] long.
5. Fold cords in half and tie to bottom of wooden ring using Lark’s Head Knot.
6. Cut length of ribbon for hanging loop and glue to back of top Lark’s Head Knot.
7. Make Hat by cutting ½" [1.5 cm] wide piece of toilet paper tube.
8. Cut 12 cords of B 10" [25.5 cm] long.
9. Fold cords in half and tie around toilet paper tube with Lark’s Head Knot.
10. Place Hat on wooden ring, ensuring hanging loop comes out of top of Hat.
11. Cut 1 cord of B 10" [25.5 cm] long and wrap twice around middle of Hat, tucking loose ends into work.
12. Un-ply loose ends of each cord to create fringe in ‘moustache’, ‘beard’, and top of Hat by twisting cord clockwise until plies loosen, separating plies from the cut end up to knot. Comb fringe and trim evenly into desired shape.

materials: Worsted Gauge Yarn (as supplied in kit)
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 3" [7.5 cm] tall, not including Hanging Loop.
gauge: 18 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm]. Crochet a gauge swatch.
instructions:
Notes:
• Ornament is worked in continuous rnds, do not join at end of rnd.
• Move marker as work progresses in last st of each rnd. 
• Working with Stitch Markers . 
• The workings of a crochet stitch . 

SNOWMAN

Body See diagram on page 3.
With A, make magic loop.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in loop. PM in last st. Pull Magic Loop tight.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 16 sc. How to do crochet increases .
3rd rnd: (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 8 times. 24 sc.
4th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 8 times. 32 sc.
5th to 10th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
11th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 8 times. 24 sts.
12th rnd: (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 16 sts.
13th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. 12 sts.
Stuff Body firmly.

Head:

14th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around.
15th rnd: (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 18 sc.
16th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 24 sc.
17th to 19th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Stuff Head lightly, cont stuffing as next rnds are worked.
20th rnd: (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 8 times. 16 sts.
21st rnd: (Sc2tog) 8 times.
22nd rnd: (Sc2tog) 4 times. Fasten off leaving long tail. Using long tail, weave through tops of sts in last rnd and pull tight to close. Fasten off.

Arms (make 2 alike)
See diagram on page 3.
With B, leaving long tail, ch 2.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn.
2nd to 5th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Turn.
6th row: (Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next sc. Sl st in sc of 5th row) 3 times. Fasten off.
Using long tail, sew one arm to either side of Body, as shown.

Scarf
See diagram on page 3.
With C, ch 31.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc each ch to end of chain. Turn. 30 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
Wrap Scarf around Snowman, between Head and Body. Cross ends of Scarf at front of Snowman and sew in place using C.

Hanging Loop
Cut a strand of A 5" [12.5 cm] long. Fold strand in half and tie ends to form Hanging Loop. Pull Hanging Loop halfway through top of Snowman, pull Hanging Loop through itself and tighten to secure. Alternate: With A and yarn needle, pass yarn through top of Snowman and base of provided Keychain Clasp. Whipstitch and tie securely as close to top of Snowman as possible and weave in ends.

Details
Split black yarn into 2 plies and embroider face onto Head of Snowman using Straight stitch for mouth, and French Knot for eyes. Embroider buttons to Body of Snowman using French Knot, as shown. Do not split D, embroider carrot nose onto Head of Snowman using Satin Stitch as shown.

materials: Medium Weight (#4) yarn of your choice
Contrast A Red 1 ball or 22 yds/20 m
Contrast B White 1 ball or 4 yds/3.5 m
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of black worsted weight yarn.
abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 3" [7.5 cm] tall, excluding Hanging Loop.
gauge: 18 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm]. Crochet a gauge swatch.
instructions:
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
STOCKING
With A, ch 9.
See diagrams on page 3.
1st rnd: (RS). 2 sc in 2nd.ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 6 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working in opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 6 ch. 1 sc in same sp as first sc. Join. 18 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 1 sc in same sp as first sc. Join. 22 sc.
3rd to 6th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 20 sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Sc3tog. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join. 16 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join. 14 sc
10th to 14th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
At end of 14th rnd, join with sl st to back loop of first st.
15th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. Sc2tog. Join in both loops. 10 sc.
Stuff Stocking firmly.
16th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 5 times. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Using long tail, weave through tops of sts in last rnd and pull tight to close.
Cuff: Join B with sl st to any rem loop of 14th rnd of Stocking.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each st around. Join. 14 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, loosely sl st in each sc around. Join and fasten off.
Hanging Loop
Cut a strand of B 5" [12.5 cm] long. Fold strand in half and tie ends to form Hanging Loop. Pull Hanging Loop halfway through top of Stocking Cuff, then pull Hanging Loop through itself and tighten to secure.
Alternate: With B and yarn needle, pass yarn through top of Stocking Cuff and base of provided Keychain Clasp. Whipstitch and tie securely as close to top of Stocking as possible and weave in ends.
Face
Split black yarn into 2 plies and embroider face onto front of Stocking near the toe, as shown.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver™ (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Size U.S. 7 [4.5 mm] crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Rainbow: Approx 4" [10 cm] high x 5" [12.5 cm] wide. Champagne Bottle: Approx 6" [15 cm] high x 2" [5 cm] diameter. Mushroom: Approx 4" [10 cm] high x 3" [7.5 cm] diameter.
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: All rnds are joined with sl st to first sc. 
RAINBOW
With E, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 12 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 24 sc. Break E. Join A.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 36 sc. Break A. Join D.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join 48 sts. Break D. Join G.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join 60 sts. 

Fold in half. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 row of sc in each of next 30 (paired) sts. Fasten off. 
Hanging Loop
Join G with sl st to center of Top of Rainbow. Ch 16. Join with sl st in same place as joining sl st. Fasten off and secure ends. 
Pompom Clouds (make 2).
Wind F around 3 fingers approx 50 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center with length of yarn approx 5" [12.5 cm] long. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to a smooth round shape. Using long tail, tie one pompom to each end of Rainbow as shown in photo. 

CHAMPAGNE BOTTLE
Label
With D, ch 7.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 6 sc.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 3 sc.
Edging rnd: (RS). Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sl st evenly around perimeter of label. Join. Fasten off.
Bottle
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 10 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 20 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each st around. Join.
5th to 10th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Note: Sew Label to Bottle as shown in photo before decreases. Stuff base of Bottle Lightly.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 25 sc.
12th and alt rnds: As 5th rnd.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 20 sc.
15th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 15 sc.
17th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 10 sc.
18th to 24th rnds: As 5th rnd. Break A. Join H.
25th to 27th rnds: With H, as 5th rnd. 
Add additional stuffing as needed. Break yarn leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.
Hanging Loop
Join H with sl st to center of Top of Champagne. Ch 16. Join with sl st in same place as joining sl st. Fasten off and secure ends.
MUSHROOM
Stem
With H, ch 2.
1st rnd: (RS). 10 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
3rd to 10th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
11th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 20 sc.
12th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next st. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
14th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join. 50 sc.
Fasten off. Stuff Stem.
Cap
With G, ch 2.
1st rnd: (RS). 10 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd and alt rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each st around. Join. 20 sc.

instructions:
Santa
With MC, ch 2.

with sl st to first sc.12 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 
sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc.  
2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each 
of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. *2 
sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep 
from * to last 3 sc.  2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in 
each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 
36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each
