around. Join with sl st to first sc.
11th rnd: Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in each of 
next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops 
on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of 
next 5 sc. Rep from * around. Join A with

12th rnd: With A, ch 1. Working in back 
loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 
13th rnd: Ch 1. Working in both loops,  
*1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from 
* around. Join  with sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
14th to 16th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc
around. Join B with sl st to first sc.
17th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc
around. Join with sl st to first sc.
18th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops
only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join MC with
sl st to first sc.
19th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in both
loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with
sl st to first sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of
next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
21st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around.
Join with sl st to first sc.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 
Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. 
Join with sl st to first sc.
24th rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. 
Rep from * around. 12 sc.
25th and 26th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc 
around. Join B with sl st to first sc at end

27th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc 
around. Join with sl st to first sc.

28th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream™ (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m) Contrast A Warm Brown (01130) 2 balls or 170 yds/155 m
Contrast B Soft Ecru (01004) 1 ball or 78 yds/71 m
Contrast C Dark Pine (00016) 1 ball or 28 yds/25.5 m

Sizes U.S. D/4 (3.5 mm) and U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.

instructions:
Pudding (make 2)
With A and larger hook, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as 
last sl st. 2 sc in each sc around. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as 
last sl st. *2 sc in  next sc. 1 sc in 
next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 2 sc 
in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Turn. 18 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as 
last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 
2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 
2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as 
last sl st. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in 
each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to 
last 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in 
each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to 
first sc. Turn. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as 
last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 
2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last  
4 sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 36 sc. Fasten off.
Icing
With B and larger hook, ch 5.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 
Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc 
in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. 
Turn. 
Rep last row 3 times more. 12 sc.
Final row: (RS). Ch 2 (counts as 
hdc). 2 dc in first sc. Skip next  
2 sc. Sl st in next sc. Skip next sc. 
(2 dc in next sc) twice. Skip next 
sc. Sl st in next sc. Skip next 2 sc. 
(2 dc. 1 hdc) in last sc. Fasten off.
Leaf (make 2)
With C and smaller hook, ch 6.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Ch 3. 
Sl st back into last sc worked – 
picot made. 1 sc in next ch. 3 sc 
in last ch (left tip). Working into 
opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each 
of next 2 ch. Picot. 1 sc in each of 
last 2 ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Fasten off, leaving a long end for 
sewing.
Cherry
With D and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten 
off, leaving a long end for sewing.
FINISHING
Place WS of 2 Pudding pieces 
facing each other. Position Icing 
on top and pin pieces tog. Join A 
with sl st through all thicknesses 
at left corner of Icing. Ch 1. Work 
1 rnd of sc around outer edge to 
join all pieces. Join with sl st to 
first sc. Fasten off.
Sew Leaves and Cherry in position.
Hanging Loop: Cut 10" [25.5 cm] 
length of B. Fold in half and 
attach to top of Pudding. Knot tog 
leaving approx 1" [2.5 cm] ends.

Ch 256; join into a ring with a slip st in first ch.
Round 1: Ch 1, working in back bump of ch 
sts, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch 
around; join with a slip st in first sc—256 sc.
Round 2: Ch 5 (counts as tr, ch 1), skip first st, 
skip next st, *Cl in next st, ch 1, skip next st**, 
tr in next st, ch 1, skip next st; repeat from * 
around, ending last repeat **; join with a slip 
st in 4th ch of beginning ch-5—32 Cl, 32 tr.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in each st and 
ch-1 space around; join with a slip st in first 
sc—256 sc. 
First Lace Edging
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in each of next 
2 sts, *skip next st, shell in next st, skip next 
st**, sc in each of next 5 sts; repeat from * 
around, ending last repeat at **, sc in each 
of last next 2 sts; join with a slip st in first 
sc—32 shells; 160 sc.
Rnd 4: Ch 1, sc in first st, *ch 3, skip next 
5 sts, Heart in next st, ch 3, skip 5 sts**, sc 
in next st; repeat from * around, ending last 
repeat at **; join with a slip st in first sc—32 
sc, 32 Hearts, 64 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off.
Second Lace Edging
With right side facing, working across opposite 
side of foundation ch, join thread to in ch at 
base of first sc in Round 1 of Center Strip. 
Rounds 1-2: Repeat Rounds 1-2 of First Lace 
Edging.
Flower Petals
Leaving a sewing length, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 10 sc in 2nd ch 
from hook; join with a slip st in first sc, tighten 
beginning tail to close center—10 sc.
Finished measurements: 2” (5 cm) wide x 32” 
(81.5 cm) long (adjustable), without elastic 
Fitting Tip: Elastic should be ¾” smaller than 
bride’s thigh measurement once sewn into 
a ring. Crocheted Garter should be 2” (5.1 
cm) less than twice the thigh measurement.
Foundation can be adjusted in increments of 8
ch sts to make larger or smaller as needed.
Special Abbreviations
3-trCluster (Cl): *Yarn over (twice), insert hook
in indicated st or sp, yarn over, draw up a loop,
[yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook]
twice; repeat from * twice, yarn over, draw
through remaining loops on hook.
Small Shell (shell): Ch 1, [dc, ch 1] 3 times in
indicated st.
Heart Shell (Heart): (Dc, [ch 4, dc in top of
previous dc, dc] twice) in indicated st.
Beaded Chain Stitch (bch): Side bead up
thread, close to hook, yarn over, draw thread
through loop.
Beaded Single Crochet (bsc): Insert hook in
st or space, yarn over, draw up a loop, slide
bead up close to hook, yarn over, draw thread
through both loops on hook.
Pattern Notes
Garter is crocheted in 2 steps. First a mesh 
strip is worked in the round with one side 
of lace edging crocheted off top of strip. 
Then thread is attached to opposite side of 
foundation ch and matching lace edging is 
crocheted around d opposite side of strip. 
Flower is crocheted in 2 parts, then sewn 
together and sewn to center strip of garter.
Once crocheted part of garter is finished, 
elastic is woven through center strip and ends 
are sewn together.

materials: Sizes 4.5 mm (U.S. 7) and 5.5 mm (U.S. I or 9) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 14 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] with smaller crochet hook. 14 sts and 14 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] with larger crochet hook in pat.
instructions:
Note: When changing colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of last st, then draw new color through rem 2 loops and proceed. 
TOWEL I
With MC and larger hook, ch 46. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *Ch 1. Miss next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to end of ch. Turn. 45 sts. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. *Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 2 sc. Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 
Rep last 2 rows until work from beg measures 13 ins [33 cm], ending with RS facing for next row. Join A. 
Change to smaller hook and proceed as follows:
Edging: 1st row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, work 46 sc across. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 2. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first ch-2 sp. *Ch 2. (2 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten off. 
Towel Topper: With B and smaller hook, ch 2. 1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc. Fasten off.
FLOWER
First Petal: 1st row: Join D with sl st to front loop only of any sc. *Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. 2 sc in front loop only of next sc. 4 sc for petal. Turn. 
Next 4 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn. 
Next row: Ch 1. (Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook - sc2tog made) twice. Fasten off leaving a long end.*
Second Petal: **Rejoin D with sl st to front loop of next unworked sc of 2nd rnd. Rep from * to * once.**
Third to Sixth Petals: Rep from ** to ** 4 times more. 6 petals.
3rd rnd: Join A with sl st to rem back loop of any sc of 2nd rnd. Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp. 2 dc in each rem back loop around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 24 dc.
4th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last dc. 1 dc in last dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 36 dc.
5th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. *2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 4 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in last dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 50 dc.
6th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. *2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 6 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. 2 dc in last dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 66 dc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each dc around. Ch 7 (loop). Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Using yarn ends from each petal, sew around outer edges of petals.
TOWEL II
Work as given for Towel I, substituting A for D and D for A. 
TOWEL III
Work as given for Towel I, substituting D for B, C for D and B for A. 
TOWEL IV
Work as given for Towel I substituting A for B, B for D and C for A. 
FINISHING
Pleat top edge of each Towel to fit Towel Toppers. Sew in position.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: (1, 1, 2, 2, 2) skeins each 334 Buff A, 330 Linen B and 1 skein 320 Cornmeal C.
1 yard ribbon-1½” wide, 4 gold metal D rings-1½”, stitch markers, yarn needle.

measurements: Corset Belt measures 6” wide x 20 (23½, 27½, 32, 36, 40)” long, excluding ribbon lacing.
gauge: 13 sts = 4”; 7 rows = 4” using 1 strand of A and B held together. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Belt
Center Panel
Holding 1 strand of A and B held together, ch 21.
Row 1: Dc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch across – 19 dc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), turn, dc in each dc – 19 dc.
Repeat Row 2 until 18 (20, 22, 26, 28, 32) rows have been worked.
Fasten off.
Side Panels (Make 2)
Holding 1 strand of A and B held together, ch 18 (22, 26, 30, 34, 38).
Row 1: Dc in 3rd ch from hook, dc in each ch across, turn – 16 (20, 24, 28, 32, 36) dc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), turn, dc in each dc – 16 (20, 24, 28, 32, 36) dc.
Repeat Row 2 until 11 rows have been worked.
Row 12: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), turn, hdc in each dc across.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
With wrong side facing, position one side edge of one Side Panel along first row of Center Panel. Position side edge of second Side Panel along last row of Center Panel. Whipstitch pieces together.
Holding 2 strands of C together, work 3 large cross-stitches over seams on right side.
Lacing Trim
Row 1 (Right Side): With right side facing and 1 strand of A and C held together, skip 1” along opposite side edge of one Side Panel and join yarn in side edge, ch 3, dc 12 sts evenly spaced along edge, leaving last 1” unworked – 13 dc.
Row 2: Ch 3, turn, dc in each dc across.
Fasten off.
Repeat along side edge of opposite Side Panel.
Edging
Round 1: With right side facing and holding 1 strand of B and C together, join yarn in any st along long edge, ch 1, sc evenly spaced around all edges of Belt, working 2 sc in each corner, to first st, slip st in first st to join.
Position 2 D rings evenly spaced on each Lacing Trim, opposite each other, and using C, sew on securely.
Weave in ends.
Lace ribbon through D rings to close Belt and tie ends into a bow.

Ruffled Chain

instructions:

Armband
Ch 36. See diagram on page 3.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. *Ch 3. (1 dc. Ch 5. 1 dc) all in next sc. Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-5 sp. Rep from * twice more. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 5 (counts as dc and ch-2 sp). 1 dc in first sc. *Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-5 sp. Ch 3.** (1 dc. Ch 5. 1 dc) all in next sc. Rep from * once, then from * to ** once. (1 dc. Ch 2. 1 dc) in last sc. Turn.

6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. 1 sc in ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next dc. *3 sc in next ch-3 sp. Skip next sc. 3 sc in next ch-3 sp.** Skip next dc. 6 sc in next ch-5 sp. Skip next dc. Rep from * once, then from * to ** once. 1 sc in next dc. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in last dc. Turn. 36 sc.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 9 sc. Ch 3. Skip next 2 sc. Sl st in next sc. Ch 10. Skip next 12 sc. Sl st in next sc. Ch 3. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 9 sc.

Picot. 1 sc) in next ch-4 sp.* (2 sc. Picot. 3 sc.) in next ch-4 sp. Rep from * to * once more. Working around sts at edge of Armband, [2 sc. Ch 6. Sl st in 6th ch from hook – button loop made. 4th row: Sl st in each of first 3 dc and ch-2 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same ch-2 sp as last sl st. Ch 2. 2 sc in next ch-4 sp. Ch 1. 2 sc in next ch-4 sp. Ch 2. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in last ch-2 sp. Turn.
5th row: Sl st in each of first 3 dc and ch-2 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same ch-2 sp as last sl st. Ch 3. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in ch-1 sp. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. Ch 3. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in last ch-2 sp. Turn.
6th row: Sl st in each of first 3 dc and ch-2 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same ch-2 sp as last sl st. Ch 1. 1 sc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. 1 sc in next hdc. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in last ch-2 sp. Turn.

10th row: Sl st in each of first 2 sc. Work 16 sc into Finger Loop opening. Sl st in next sc. Fasten off.

instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com and www.crochettoday.com

RedHeart.com
Page 1 of 2
Ruffled Rose Pin
Crochet a fabric rose to adorn a jacket, wear at your waist or update a hat. We’re sure you’ll find many occasions to enjoy wearing this pin…or perhaps giving it! Make it in any of the trendy fabrics available in Boutique Sassy. Each hank has enough yardage to make two flowers.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Place marker in first sc to indicate beginning of round. Move marker up as each round is completed. Draw about 2½” (6.5 cm) of beginning tail of B through open center of round from right side to wrong side. Pull on beginning tail of A to close opening tightly around tail of B; join with slip st in first (marked) sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 RfldSC in each of next 6 sts, hold B to wrong side of work; join with slip st in first st—12 RfldSC.
Fasten off A. Cut B, leaving a 2½” (6.5 cm) tail.
Pin Back Circle
With A, leaving an 8” (20.5 cm) beginning tail, make an adjustable slip knot and place it on hook, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 6 times; join with slip st in first sc—18 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a 10” (25.5 cm) tail.
FINISHING
Finish Ruffled Circle: Weave in tails of A. On wrong side, tie ends of B together tightly with a square knot. Trim excess fabric.
Finish Pin Back Circle: With beginning tail, sew pin back to right side of pin back circle. Weave in remainder of beginning tail on wrong side.
Assemble: Hold ruffled circle and pin back circle with wrong sides together and pin back circle centered on ruffled circle. With ending tail sew pin back circle to ruffled circle sewing through tops of Round 2 sts of ruffled circle and in to gully between Rounds 2 and 3 of pin back circle. Weave in any remaining ends.
Special Stitch
RfldSC (ruffled single crochet) = With loop of A on hook and holding B with holes along top, insert hook through a hole from front of fabric to back, [lift hook over top edge of fabric and insert through next hole from front to back] 4 times, insert hook into indicated stitch or space on project, yarn over and draw loop through project and through fabric on hook until only 2 loops of A remain on hook, yarn over and draw through remaining 2 loops.
Special Technique
Adjustable-slip knot = Create your beginning slip knot as usual but pull up the loop from the beginning tail instead of the working yarn. This allows the first chain loop to be expanded when working the first round of stitches and then closed tightly by pulling on the beginning tail.

materials: STITCH NATION by Debbie Stoller™ Full o’ Sheep™: 1 ball each 2701 Cupcake A and 2640 Thyme B.
Sharp yarn needle, 1 ½” bar pin, straight pins.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color a, Color B, Color C etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
3-ch-picot = ch 3, insert hook in front loop (horizontal bar) of the dc just made and in the left strand (vertical bar) of the same st, yo and pull through all three loops.
measurements: Flower measures 8” in diameter before felting, 5 ½” after felting.
gauge: Gauge is not important, but the stitches need to be loose to felt the yarn successfully.
instructions:
Round 1:  With A, ch 2, 6 sc in second ch from the hook; join to first sc – 6 sc.
Round 2: (First row of petals) working in the front loops only of the previous round, slip st into first sc, [ch 4, working in the back humps of the chain, sc in second ch from the hook and the next 2 ch, slip st in front loop of next sc] 5 times; ch 4, working in the back humps of the chain, sc in second ch from the hook and the next 2 ch, slip st into back loop of first sc – 6 petals.
Round 3: Working behind the petals and in the back loops only of round 1 ch 1, 2 sc in each sc in the round; join to first sc – 12 sc.
Round 4: (Second row of petals) working in the front loops only of the previous round, slip st into first sc, [ch 5, working in the back humps of the chain, sc in second ch from the hook and the next 3 ch, slip st in front loop of next sc] 11 times; ch 5, working in the back hump of the chain, sc in second ch from the hook and the next 3 ch, slip st into back loop of first sc – 12 petals.
Round 5: Working behind the petals and in the back loops only of round 3, ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times; join to first sc – 18 sc.
Round 6: (Third row of petals) working in the front loops only of the previous round, slip st into first sc, [ch 5, working in the back hump of the chain sts, sc in second ch from the hook and the next 3 ch, slip st in next sc] 17 times; ch 5, working in the back hump of the chain, sc in second ch from the hook and the next 3 ch, slip st into back loop of first sc – 18 petals.
Round 7: Working behind the petals and in the back loops only of round 5, ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times; join to first sc – 24 sc.
Round 8: (Fourth row of petals) working into both loops of the round 7, [ch 6, sc in the back hump of the second ch from the hook and the next 4 ch, slip st in next sc] 23 times; ch 6, sc in the back hump of the second ch from the hook and the next 4 ch, join to first petal – 24 petals. Fasten off.  Weave in ends.
Leaves (Make 2)
Round 1: Ch 2, 7 sc in second ch from the hook; do not join; turn.
Round 2: Ch 1, (hdc, dc) in first sc; ch 2, (sc, hdc, dc) in next sc; ch 2, (sc, hdc) in next sc; (2 dc, 3-ch-picot, dc) in next sc; (hdc, sc) in next sc; ch 2, (dc, hdc, sc) in next sc; ch 2, (dc , hdc) in next sc; ch 1, slip st into same sc.
Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Backing
Round 1:  With C, ch 2, 6 sc in second ch from the hook; join to first sc – 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc; join to first sc – 12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times; join to first sc – 18 sc.
Round 4:  Ch 1, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times; join to first sc – 24 sc. 
Fasten off.  Weave in ends.
Felting
Before assembling the flower, put the pieces into pillowcases and tie closed. Place them in a washing machine with hot water and a small amount of detergent. Check regularly during the wash cycle until desired amount of felting is achieved. Rinse soap and squeeze out excess water. To shape flower, curve the petals inward, shaping them toward the center; pin or tie petals in place. Let dry. Block remaining pieces into desired shapes and let dry. 
ASSEMBLY
arrange leaves on back of flower, pin into place and stitch to the chrysanthemum with B. Place backing on the chrysanthemum over the leaves; pin and stitch into place with A. Sew bar pin onto back.

12th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 5 sts.
13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sts.
14th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. 3 sts.

Note: Rem sts will be where Wing is sewn to Body.

With F, ch 9.

With F, ch 9.
Work from ** to ** as given for Left Wing.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. (1 hdc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. 2 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in each of last 6 sc.

With G, ch 3.

With G, ch 5.

materials: RED HEART® Team Spirit™: 1 skein 947 Royal/White
13” [33 cm] x 13” [33 cm] foam stadium seat
abbreviations: sc2tog: [Draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Sized to fit a 13” [33 cm] x 13” [33 cm] foam sporting seat, available at most sporting goods stores.
gauge: 12 sc = 4” [10 cm]; 12 rows = 4” [10 cm] in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SEAT COVER (Make 2)
Ch 32. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 31 sts.
Rows 2-5: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc to last sc, 2 sc in last sc – 39 sc on last row worked.
Rows 5-24: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. 
Row 25: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, sc 2tog – 37 sc.
Rows 26-32: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. 
Row 33: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, sc2tog – 35 sc.
Rows 34-35: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. 
Shape First Side
Row 36 (Right Side): Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 10 sc, leave remaining sts unworked – 11 sc.
Row 37: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 9 sc, sc2tog – 10 sc.
Row 38: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 8 sc – 9 sc.
Row 39: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 7 sc, sc2tog – 8 sc.
Cut yarn, placing last loop of st on a stitch holder or safety pin to be picked up on Joining Row.
Shape Second side 
Row 36 (Right Side): Skip next 11 unworked sc on Row 35, join yarn with ch 1 in next sc, sc in same sc, sc in 10 sc, sc2tog – 11 sc.
Row 37: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 9 sc – 10 sc.
Row 38: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 8 sc, sc2tog – 9 sc.
Row 39: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 7 sc – 8 sc. Fasten off.
Joining Row 40 (Right Side): With right side facing, join yarn in st on stitch holder or safety pin on First Side, ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc across next 6 sc, ch 11, working across sts of Second Side, sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog.
Row 41: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 5 sc, sc in next 11 ch, sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog – 23 sc.
Row 42: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. 
Row 43: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 21 sc. 
Row 44: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 19 sc. Fasten off.
Outside Edging
Round 1: With right side facing and working along opposite edge of foundation ch, join yarn in last ch of Row 1, sc in same ch, sc in next 30 ch, turn to work alongside edge, work 44 sc evenly spaced alongside edge, turn to work along top edge, sc across next 19 sc, turn to work along opposite side edge and work 44 sc evenly spaced along edge to first sc, slip st in first sc to join – 138 sc. 
Round 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc around, slip st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING
With wrong sides together, sew Seat Covers together alongside and bottom edges, leaving space to insert foam seat. Insert foam seat. Sew remaining sides and top closed. Overlap Handle pieces and sew closed. Weave in ends.

materials: Patons® Classic Wool (100 g/3.5 oz) 77732 (That’s Pink) 1 ball
Size 4.5 mm (U.S. 7) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
gauge: 18 dc and 6 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Small Petals (make 5)
Ch 4.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working into rem loops on opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 2 dc in next sc. 5 dc in next sc. 2 dc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Fasten off.

Medium Petals (make 6)
Ch 6.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working into rem loops on opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 4 ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 2 dc in next sc. 5 dc in next sc. 2 dc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Fasten off.

Large Petals (make 5)
Ch 9.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 6 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working into rem loops on opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 7 ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 2 dc in next sc. 5 tr in next sc. 2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew ends of each group of petals tog tightly (small, medium and large) overlapping petals slightly to form spirals. Ends of petals will curl. Sew 3 layers of petals tog placing medium layer on top of large layer and small layer on top of medium layer.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 1 skein each 1101 Eggshell A and 1012 Black B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5.5 mm [US I-9] and 3.75 mm [US F-5]
Susan Bates® Easy-wrap pompom maker, 1.75” (4.5 cm) diameter
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Cuff measures 3¾” (9.5 cm) wide and 14½ (17)” [37 (43) cm] in circumference.
gauge: 12 sc = 4” (10 cm); 14 rows = 4” (10 cm) with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE.
instructions:
CUFFS (make 2)
With A and larger hook, ch 22.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each sc across – 21 sc.
Rows 2-50 (59): Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

SPOTS (make 4)
With B and smaller (larger) hook, ch 3.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, turn – 2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc, turn – 4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each of next 2 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn – 6 sc.
Rows 5-6 (7-8): Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 7 (9): Ch 1, sc2tog over first 2 sc, sc in each of next 2 sc, sc2tog over last 2 sc, turn – 4 sc.
Row 8 (10): Ch 1, sc2tog over first 2 sc, sc2tog over last 2 sc, turn – 2 sc.
Row 9 (11): Ch 1, sc2tog over 2 sc, turn – 1 sc.
Row 10 (12): Ch 1, sc in sc.
Fasten off.

EYES (make 4)
With A and smaller hook, ch 3 (4), join with slip st to form ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 5 (6) sc in ring, join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

PUPILS (make 4)
With B and smaller hook, ch 3 (5), join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Fasten off.

NOSE (make 2)
With B and smaller hook, ch 2,
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, 3 sc in sc, turn.
Row 3 (for adult size only): Ch 1, sc in each sc across.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
With yarn needle and A, whip stitch first and last rows together. This will be center back seam. Fold cuff evenly in half. Holding cuff with fold facing downward, join A with sc in center back seam at outer edge of cuff, reverse sc around edge, join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

Attach Features
Fold each cuff in half, placing seam at center back. Press pieces very lightly with a warm steam iron, placing double thickness of fabric between iron and features. Place a small dab of craft glue on backs of all features and press firmly onto cuff, using photo as placement guide. Allow to dry briefly. With yarn needle and matching yarn, sew pieces to cuff. Be sure not to catch back side of folded cuff when sewing.
Weave in ends.

POMPOMS
Make 4 pompoms using both colors held together. With yarn needle and tails of yarn at center of pompom, sew a pompom to each side of cuff at the fold. Pull tails up through pompom and out the top. Trim ends even with rest of pompom.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball 484 Myrtle Green

instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com and www.crochettoday.com
©2013 Coats & Clark
Instead of the usual necklace, change up your style with this lovely crocheted piece. It buttons in the back, making it easy to add to any dress or top.
COLLAR
Flower (make 2)
Ch 3, join in a ring with a slip st. Place marker.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc), work 9 dc in ring. Join to top of ch 3 with slip st—10 dc.
Round 2: Ch 1, (sc, ch 7, sc, ch 1) in same st, *skip 1 dc, (sc, ch 7, sc, ch 1) in next dc; repeat from * around. Join to first sc with slip st—5 petals.
Round 3: Ch 1, (sc, 2 hdc, 3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc, 2 hdc, sc) in each ch-7 space around. Join to first sc with slip st. Set aside.
Neckband
Ch 122.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch—121 sts.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), *dc in next st, 2 dc in next st; repeat from * across—181 sts.
Row 3: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), skip 1 dc, dc in next st, *ch 1, skip 1 st, dc in next st; repeat from * across.
Row 4: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), dc in dc, *ch 1, dc in dc; repeat from * across.
Row 5: Ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in each dc and ch-1 space across.
Row 6: *Slip st in next st, skip 4 sts, [ch 1, tr] 7 times in next st, ch 1, skip 4 sts;** repeat from * 7 more times, slip st in next st, [ch 3, slip st in ch-2 space on flower petal, ch 3, skip 3 sts, slip st in next st, ch 3, slip st in ch-2 space on next flower petal of same flower, ch 3, skip 3 sts, slip st in next st] twice, repeat from * to ** 8 times (omit first slip st on first repeat only), end slip st in last st.
Row 7: Sc in ch-1 space, *ch 3, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat across to top of 8th scallop, ch 3, sc in first unattached ch-2 space of flower petal, ch 3, [sc in next dc, ch 3, sc in first dc of next petal, ch 3, sc in next dc, ch 3, sc in ch-2 space, ch 3, sc in next dc, ch 3, sc in next dc, ch 3] twice, sc in ch-2 space of next petal, ch 3, sc in ch-2 space of 2nd flower, ch 3, [sc in first dc of next petal, ch 3, sc in next dc, ch 3, sc in ch-2 space, ch 3, sc in next dc, ch 3, sc in next dc, ch 3] twice, [sc in next dc, ch 3] twice, sc in ch-2 space, ch 3, ch 3 in top of next scallop,
**ch 3, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from ** to end. Fasten off.
Sew button to one edge at neck. Use first dc st as button loop. 
Weave in ends. Block and starch.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Metallic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 3 (3, 3, 4, 4, 4) balls 001P White/Pearl
small amount of fiberfill stuffing or 2 crystal buttons ⅝” (1.6 cm) for Center Ball of Large Side Flowers
abbreviations: ( ) = work all directions in parentheses in the indicated stitch or space
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Finished Length: 25 (27, 29, 31, 33, 35)" [63.5 (68.5, 73.5, 79, 84, 89) cm], Finished Width: 6" (15 cm) for all sizes
gauge: Frilled Rose Center Motif, Rounds 1-11, measures 2¾” (7 cm) across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
First End and First Side
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 19, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 17 chs; turn—18 sc.
Row 2: Skip first sc, (slip st, ch 1, sc) in next sc, sc in next 16 sc; turn—17 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 16 sc (leave last sc unworked); turn—16 sc.
Row 4: Skip first sc, (slip st, ch 1, sc) in next sc, sc in next 14 sc; turn—15 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 14 sc (leave last sc unworked); turn—14 sc.
Row 6: Skip first sc, (slip st, ch 1, sc) in next sc, sc in next 12 sc; turn—13 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first 12 sc (leave last sc unworked); turn—12 sc.
Row 8: Skip first sc, (slip st, ch 1, sc) in next sc, [ch 5, skip next 4 sc, sc in next sc] twice; turn—3 sc, 2 ch-5 loops.
Row 9: Ch 5, sc in first ch-5 space, ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space, ch 2, dc in last sc; turn—2 ch-5 loops, 2 sc, 1 dc.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in first dc, [ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] twice; turn—3 sc, 2 ch-5 loops.
Repeat Rows 9 and 10 until Belt is 11 (12, 13, 14, 15, 16)” [28 (30.5, 33, 35.5, 38, 40.5) cm] long without stretching. Do not fasten off.
Center Section
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 5, sc in dc, [ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] twice; turn—3 ch-5 loops, 3 sc.
Row 2: [Ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] 3 times, ch 2, tr in same ch-5 space; turn—3 ch-5 loops, 3 sc, 1 ch-2 loop, 1 tr.
Row 3: Ch 5, sc in tr, [ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] 3 times; turn—4 ch-5 loops, 4 sc.
Row 4: [Ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] 3 times, dc in next sc; turn—3 ch-5 loops, 3 sc, 1 dc.
Row 5: Ch 3, sc in first ch-5 space, [ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] twice; turn—1 ch-3 loop, 3 sc, 2 ch-5 loops.
Row 6: [Ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] twice, ch 2, dc in next sc; turn—2 ch-5 loops, 2 sc, 1 ch-2 loop, 1 dc.
Second Side
Repeat Row 10 of First Side, then repeat Rows 9 and 10 until Belt is 23 (25, 27, 29, 31, 33)” [58.5 (63.5, 68.5, 73.5, 79, 84) cm] long without stretching. Do not fasten off.
Second End with Buttonholes
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, sc in first sc, [5 sc in next ch-5 space] twice, sc in last sc; turn—12 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across; turn—13 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 12 sc, 2 sc in last sc; turn—14 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across; turn—15 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 14 sc, 2 sc in last sc; turn—16 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across; turn—17 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first 16 sc, 2 sc in last sc; turn—18 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, [ch 3, skip 3 sc, sc in next 3 sc] twice, ch 3, skip 3 sc, sc in last 2 sc—10 sc, 3 ch-3 loops. Do not turn, but rotate Belt to continue working along the upper edge.
Edging
Round 1 (Wrong Side): Working into sides of Rows of Second End across upper edge, ch 3, skip Rows 8 and 7, dc in end of Row 6, ch 1, skip Row 5, dc in end of Row 4, ch 1, skip Row 3, dc in end of Row 2, skip Row 1. Working into sides of Rows of Second Side, *ch 1, dc over sc in end of Row 10, ch 1, dc in ch-5 space at end of Row 9; repeat from * across Second Side, ch 1, dc over sc of last sc of Row 10 before Center Section. Working into Sides of Rows of Center Section, ch 1, dc in end of Row 6, ch 1, skip Row 5, dc in end of Row 4, ch 1, skip Row 3, dc in end of Row 2, skip Row 1. Working into sides of Rows of First Side, *ch 1, dc over sc in end of Row 10, ch 1, dc in ch-5 space at end of Row 9; repeat from * across First Side, ch 1, dc over sc in end of Row 8. Working into sides of Rows of First End, ch 1, skip Row 7, dc in end of Row 6, ch 1, skip Row 5, dc in end of Row 4, ch 1, skip Row 3, dc in end of Row 2, ch 1, skip Row 1. Rotate Belt to continue working in the back of the foundation chain of the First End.
Working across First End, sc in first sc and next 16 sc, 2 sc in last sc—19 sc. Rotate Belt to continue working along the lower edge.
Working into sides of Rows of First End, sc in end of next 7 Rows. Working into sides of Rows of First Side, sc in ch-5 space of first Row 9, *ch 5, slip st in 4th ch from hook, ch 2, sc in ch-5 space of next Row 9; repeat from * across to Row 1 of Center Section (first increase on lower edge). Working into sides of Center Section, ch 5, slip st in 4th ch from hook, ch 2, skip next ch-5 space, sc in next ch-5 space, ch 5, slip st in 4th ch from hook, ch 2, (sc, ch 5, slip st in 4th ch from hook, ch 2, sc) in next ch-3 space, ch 5, slip st in 4th ch from hook, ch 2, sc in next ch-5 space, ch 5, slip st in 4th ch from hook, ch 2, skip next ch-5 space, sc in next ch-5 space. Working into sides of Rows of Second Side, *ch 5, slip st in 4th ch from hook, ch 2, sc in ch-5 space of next Row 9; repeat from * across Second Side, ch 2, sc in ch-5 space of last Row 9 before Second End. Working into sides of Rows of Second End, sc in end of next 7 Rows. Do not turn, but rotate Belt to continue working along the Second End with Buttonholes.
Working across Second End, sc in first 2 sc, *(2 sc, ch 2, 2 sc) in next ch-3 space, skip next sc, sc in next sc, skip next sc, repeat from * once, (2 sc, ch 2, 2 sc) in next ch-3 space, skip next sc, sc in next sc—6 sc, 3 ch-2 loops. Do not turn, but rotate Belt to continue working along the upper edge.
Upper Edge Finishing
Working across upper edge, (3 sc, ch-3 p, sc) in first ch-3 space, *2 sc in next ch-1 space, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-1 space; repeat from * across to last ch-1 space, 2 sc in last ch-1 space, slip st in next sc to join. Fasten off, weave in ends.
FRILLED ROSE CENTER MOTIF
Note: See Special Technique for how to string beads.
String 8 bicone crystal beads. Ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, [sc, bsc] 8 times in ring, slip st in first sc to join; turn so beads face up—8 sc, 8 bsc.
Round 2 (Right Side): Ch 1, sc in same sc, ch 3, skip next bsc, *sc in next sc, ch 3, skip next bsc; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—8 sc, 8 ch-3 loops.
Round 3: Slip st into first ch-3 loop, ch 1, *(sc, 5 dc, sc) in same loop; repeat from * in each loop around, slip st in first sc to join—16 sc, 40 dc (8 Petals).
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same sc, [ch 2, sc in next dc] 5 times, ch 2, sc in next sc, *sc in next sc, [ch 2, sc in next dc] 5 times, ch 2, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—56 sc, 48 ch-2 loops.
Round 5: Ch 2; working behind Petals just finished, work a sc around first sc from Round 2, ch 4, *sc around next sc on Round 2, ch 4; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—8 sc, 8 ch-4 loops behind Petals.
Round 6: Slip st into first ch-4 loop, ch 1, *(sc, 7 dc, sc) in same loop; repeat from * in each loop around, slip st in first sc to join—16 sc, 56 dc (8 Petals).
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in same sc, [ch 2, sc in next dc] 7 times, ch 2, sc in next sc, *sc in next sc, [ch 2, sc in next dc] 7 times, ch 2, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—72 sc, 64 ch-2 loops.
Round 8: Ch 2; working behind Petals just finished, work a sc around first sc from Round 5, ch 5, *sc around next sc on Round 5, ch 5; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—8 sc, 8 ch-5 loops behind second set of Petals.
Round 9: Slip st into first ch-5 loop, ch 1, *(sc, 9 dc, sc) in same loop; repeat from * in each loop around, slip st in first sc to join—16 sc, 72 dc (8 Petals).
Round 10: Ch 1, sc in same sc, [ch 2, sc in next dc] 9 times, ch 2, sc in next sc, *sc in next sc, [ch 2, sc in next dc] 9 times, ch 2, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—88 sc, 80 ch-2 loops.
Round 11: Ch 2; working behind Petals just finished, work a sc around sc from Round 8, ch 6, *sc around next sc on Round 8, ch 6; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—8 sc, 8 ch-6 loops behind third set of Petals.
Round 12: Slip st into first ch-6 loop, ch 1, 7 sc in same loop, [7 sc in next ch-6 loop] 6 times, slip st into next ch-6 loop, ch 2, 13 dc in same loop; turn—49 sc, 14 dc. Do not fasten off. Place stitch markers in the 20th sc and in the 30th sc.
TOP FAN
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in same dc, sc in next 12 dc and top of ch-2; turn—14 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in same sc, ch 4, skip 1 sc, sc in next sc, [ch 4, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc] 3 times, ch 2, skip 1 sc, dc in next sc; turn—5 ch-4 loops (last ch-2 and dc count as a ch-5 loop).
Row 3: Beg btr cluster (see Special Stitches) in first ch-4 loop, ch 3, btr cluster (see Special Stitches) in next ch-4 loop, ch 3, (btr cluster, ch 3, btr cluster) in next ch-4 loop, [ch 3, btr cluster in next ch-4 loop] twice; turn—6 btr clusters.
Row 4: Slip st in top of btr cluster just made, *(3 sc, ch 3, 3 sc) in next ch-3 space**, skip next btr cluster; repeat from * 3 times, then from * to ** once, slip st in top of last btr cluster. Fasten off, weave ends in.
CENTER SCROLLS
Note: Stitches for Row 1 are worked into the back loops of the foundation chain. For Row 3, Right Scroll is joined to the Frilled Rose Center Motif with Right Sides facing up, and Left Scroll is joined the Rose with Wrong Sides facing up. Refer to photo for placement.
Right Scroll
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 18, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 10 chs, [2 sc in next ch, sc in next ch] 3 times; being careful not to twist, slip st in the opposite side of the 9th ch from hook; turn—20 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, skip slip st, sc in next sc, ch 1, hdc in next sc, [ch 2, dc in next sc] 6 times, [ch 1, skip next sc, dc in next sc] 4 times, ch 1, skip next sc, hdc in next sc, ch 1, skip next sc, 3 sc in next sc; continuing to work around top edge, slip st in back loop of first ch of Row 1; turn—4 sc, 2 hdc, 10 dc.
Row 3: Slip st in marked 30th sc on Round 12 of Frilled Rose Center Motif, skip slip st on Scroll, slip st in next sc on Scroll, skip next sc on Rose, slip st in next sc on Rose; working remaining sts on Scroll, sc in next 2 sc, [(2 sc, ch-3 p, sc) in next ch-1 space] 6 times, [(2 sc, ch-3 p, 2 sc) in next ch-2 space] 6 times, (sc, ch-3 p, sc) in next ch-1 space, slip st in next sc, slip st in joining from Row 1—46 sc, 13 picots. Fasten off, weave ends in.
Left Scroll
Rows 1-2: Same as for Right Scroll.
Row 3: Slip st in marked 20th sc on Round 12 of Frilled Rose Center Motif; working toward Right Scroll, skip slip st on Scroll, slip st in next sc on Scroll, skip next sc on Rose, slip st in next sc on Rose; working remaining sts on Scroll, sc in next 2 sc; starting at top of Right Scroll, [(2 sc, ch 1, slip st into picot on Right Scroll, ch 1, slip st in top of last sc made (joined picot made), sc) in next ch-3 space] 3 times, [(2 sc, ch-3 p, sc) in next ch-1 space] 3 times, [(2 sc, ch-3 p, 2 sc) in next ch-2 space] 6 times, (sc, ch-3 p, sc) in next ch-1 space, slip st in next sc, slip st in joining from Row 1—46 sc, 3 joined picots, 10 picots. Fasten off, weave ends in.
CENTER LEAF
Note: Center Leaf is joined to the Center Scrolls with Right Sides facing up. Refer to photo for placement.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 10, 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 5 chs, hdc in next ch, 3 sc in last ch; working into opposite side of foundation chain, hdc in next ch, dc in next 5 chs, hdc in next ch, sc in last ch, slip st in first sc to join—6 sc, 4 hdc, 10 dc.
Round 2: Ch 1, (2 sc, ch-3 p, sc) in first sc, sc in next sc, sc in next hdc, ch-3 p, sc in next 3 dc, ch-3 p, sc in next 2 dc, sc in next hdc, ch-3 p, sc in next sc, slip st in first sc to join—24 sc, 3 joined picots, 5 picots. Fasten off, weave ends in.
SMALL ACCENT FLOWER (Make 2)
Ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form ring. [Ch 2, 3 dc in ring, ch 2, slip st in ring] 5 times—15 dc (5 Petals). Fasten off, weave ends in.
LARGE SIDE FLOWERS (Make 2)
Ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, 16 sc in ring, slip st in first sc to join—16 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, ch 7, 2 sc in in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 4 chs, sc in next ch] 8 times, slip st in first sc to join—40 sc, 32 hdc (8 Petals).
Round 3: (Ch 1, sc) in first sc; *working in back loops of sts on Petal, ch 1, skip first st, hdc in next st, [ch 1, dc in next st] 4 times, ch 1; continuing to work around top edge, dc in next sc, ch 2, dc in same sc, ch 1, dc in next sc, [ch 1, dc in next hdc] 3 times, ch 1, hdc in next hdc, ch 1, skip next 2 sc**, sc in next sc; repeat from * 6 times, then from * to ** once, slip st in first sc to join—8 sc, 16 hdc, 80 dc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same sc, *sc in next ch-1 space, [2 sc in next ch-1 space] twice, [(sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-1 space] 3 times, (sc, [ch 2, sc] 3 times) in next ch-2 space, [(sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-1 space] 3 times, [2 sc in next ch-1 space] twice; fold Petal in half with Right Sides together and work a slip st through the first and last ch-1 spaces held together, sc in next sc between Petals; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—200 sc. Fasten off, weave ends in.
Sew ⅝” (1.6 cm) crystal button into cup formed in center of Flower or make optional Center Ball
Center Ball
Ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, 8 sc in ring, slip st in first sc to join—8 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, *2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—12 sc.
Rounds 3-4: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 5: Ch 1, *sc2tog, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—8 sc. Stuff Ball with fiberfill.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc2tog around, slip st in first st to join—4 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Tuck first end inside Ball, then use outside end to sew Ball closed. Sew Ball into cup formed in center of Flower.
SIDE SCROLL (Make 2)
Rows 1-2: Same as for Right Scroll.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in next sc, ch-3 p, sc in next sc, (sc, ch-3 p, sc) in next sc, [(2 sc, ch-3 p, sc) in next ch-1 space] 6 times, [(2 sc, ch-3 p, 2 sc) in next ch-2 space] 6 times, (sc, ch-3 p, sc) in next ch-1 space, slip st in next sc, slip st into joining from Row 1—48 sc, 15 picots. Fasten off, weave ends in.
MEDIUM FRILLED ROSE (Make 4 for size Small or as many as desired for larger sizes)
Note: See Special Technique for how to string beads.
String 6 bicone crystal beads. Ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, [sc, bsc] 6 times in ring, slip st in first sc to join; turn so beads face up—6 sc, 6 bsc.
Round 2 (Right Side): Ch 1, sc in same sc, ch 3, skip next bsc; *sc in next sc, ch 3, skip next bsc; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—6 sc, 6 ch-3 loops.
Round 3: Slip st into first ch-3 loop, ch 1, *(sc, 5 dc, sc) in same loop; repeat from * in each loop around, slip st in first sc to join—12 sc, 30 dc (6 Petals).
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same sc, [ch 2, sc in next dc] 5 times, ch 2, sc in next sc, *sc in next sc, [ch 2, sc in next dc] 5 times, ch 2, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—42 sc, 36 ch-2 loops.
Round 5: Ch 2; working behind Petals just finished, work a sc around first sc from Round 2, ch 4, *sc around next sc on Round 2, ch 4; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—6 sc, 6 ch-4 loops behind Petals.
Round 6: Slip st into first ch-4 loop, ch 1, *(sc, 7 dc, sc) in same loop; repeat from * in each loop around, slip st in first sc to join—12 sc, 42 dc (6 Petals).
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in same sc, [ch 2, sc in next dc] 7 times, ch 2, sc in next sc, *sc in next sc, [ch 2, sc in next dc] 7 times, ch 2, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, slip st in first sc to join—56 sc, 48 ch-2 loops. Fasten off, weave ends in.
SIDE LEAF (Make 4 for size Small or as many as desired for larger sizes)
Round 1: Same as for Center Leaf.
Round 2: Ch 1, (2 sc, ch-3 p, sc) in first sc, sc in next sc, sc in next hdc, ch-3 p, sc in next 3 dc, ch-3 p, sc in next 2 dc, sc in next hdc, ch-3 p, sc in next sc, (2 sc, ch-3 p, sc) in next sc, sc in next sc, sc in next hdc, ch-3 p, sc in next 3 dc, ch-3 p, sc in next 2 dc, sc in next hdc, ch-3 p, sc in next sc, slip st in first sc to join—24 sc, 8 picots. Fasten off, weave ends in.
SHELL EDGE LEAF (Make 4)
Round 1: Same as for Center Leaf.
Round 2: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 2), dc in same sc, ch 2, skip next sc, hdc in next hdc, [ch 2, skip next dc, dc in next dc] twice, ch 2, skip next dc, hdc in next hdc, ch 2, skip next sc, hdc in next sc, ch 2, hdc in same sc, ch 2, skip next sc, hdc in next hdc, [ch 2, skip next dc, dc in next dc] twice, ch 2, skip next dc, hdc in next hdc, ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch of beginning ch-4 to join—4 hdc, 8 dc, 12 ch-2 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first ch-2 space, ch 4, slip st in 2nd ch from the hook and next 2 chs, 2 sc in same ch-2 space, [(sc, 2 dc, sc) in next ch-2 space] 5 times, (sc, 3 dc, sc) in next ch-2 space, [(sc, 2 dc, sc) in next ch-2 space] 5 times, slip st in first sc to join—26 sc, 23 dc, one 3-st Stem. Fasten off, weave ends in.
FINISHING
Block Belt and all pieces before assembly. Refer to photo for arrangement of Flowers, Scrolls, and Leaves.
1. Sew a crystal bead to the center of a Small Accent Flower. Sew the Flower over the Center Scrolls and Center Leaf joining.
2. Sew a crystal bead to the center of the Frilled Rose Center Motif. Center the Rose over the middle of the Belt and sew in place.
3. Sew a Large Side Flower on each side of the Frilled Rose Center Motif as shown. Flowers should overlap slightly.
4. Sew the Side Scrolls in place as shown under the Petals of the Large Side Flowers on each side.
5. Sew the 2 Shell Edge Leaves in place as shown on each side.
6. Sew the Medium Frilled Roses in place as shown on each side.
7. Decide where to place the Medium Frilled Rose with two Side Leaves on the back of the Belt. Sew the 2 Leaves in place, and sew the Rose over the center where the Leaves meet. Repeat on the second side. Add more of these on the larger sizes if desired.
8. Sew a crystal bead to the center of the last Small Accent Flower. Sew the Flower over the picot at the upper edge of the First End of the Belt.
9. Sew the three 3/8” (0.95 cm) crystal buttons on the First End of the Belt.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream (Solids: 70.9 g/2.5 oz) or (Ombres: 56.7 g/2 oz)
Size 4.5 mm (U.S. 7) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Small amount of yellow for Bullion st.
measurements: Work from beginning measures approximately 5 ins [12.5 cm] before proceeding with final finishes.
gauge: 13 sc and 15 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook. Draw loop in next color through 2 loops on hook to complete st and proceed in next color.
With MC, ch 7.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 6 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: As 2nd row.
4th row: (Buttonhole row). Ch 1. 1 sc in first 2 sc. Ch 2. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. Rep last row until work from beg measures 5 ins [12.5 cm] ending with RS facing for next row.
Proceed as follows: 1st row: Working in back loop only of each st, ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. 8 sc. Turn.
2nd row: Working in both loops, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 4 times. Turn. 12 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Working in back loop only of each st, as 2nd row.
6th row: Working in both loops, ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. 16 sc. Turn.
7th and 8th rows: As 4th row.
9th row: Working in back loop only of each st, ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. 20 sc. Turn.
10th row: Working in both loops, as 2nd row.
11th row: As 4th row.
12th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. 24 sc. Turn.
13th row: Working in back loops only, as 2nd row.
14th and 15th rows: Working in both loops, as 4th row. Fasten off.
With RS of work facing, join B with sl st to first front loop of 1st row.
**1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
2nd row: With A, ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). 1 dc in next sc. *(Ch 1. 1 dc) twice all in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten off. ** With RS of work facing, join B with ss to first front loop of 5th row. Work from ** to ** as given above. With RS of work facing, join B with ss to first front loop of 9th row. Work from ** to ** as given above. With RS of work facing, join B with sl st to first front loop of 13th row. Work from ** to ** as given above. Fold top in half to WS and sew button in position. Sew Pansy at RS as illustrated.
Pansy: With D, ch 4. Join with sl st to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in ring. Ch 2) 5 times. Join with sl st to first sc. Break D.
2nd rnd: Join B with ss to any ch-2 sp. Ch 2. (2 hdc. Ch 3. 1 ss in first ch – Picot made. 3 hdc) all in same ch 2 sp. [Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. (3 hdc. Picot. 3 hdc) all in next ch 2 sp] twice. [Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. (1 hdc. 9 dc. 1 hdc) all in next ch 2 sp] twice. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Join with ss to top of ch 2. Fasten off. Embroider bullion st at center of Pansy.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® Super Craft Kit™ – 1 kit
Sizes U.S. H/8 (5 mm) and I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
Coats & Clark® Yarn Zip 9" [23 cm] in Black.
Optional: 2 Charm backs for Bogg Bag. Hot glue gun and glue sticks.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 12 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Notes:
• To use Coats & Clark™ Yarn Zip, a foundation of chain stitches will be worked directly into the zipper. 
• Body of Pouch is then worked directly into these chains on zipper.
• To change colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color, yoh with new color and proceed.
Setting Up Stitches on Coats & Clark™ Yarn Zip
Prepare zipper:
Using a pen or pencil, make small dots along right side of zipper ¼" [0.6 cm] up from bottom zipper stop and 8" [20.5 cm] up from this bottom mark. Make small markings every evenly spaced between these 2 points along right side of loose-weave channel on zipper tape so there are 25 dots spaced evenly along side of zipper.
Repeat on left side of zipper.
Begin working into zipper: 
With smaller hook, insert hook into top of zipper at bottom mark ¼" [0.6 cm] up from zipper stop. With A, holding yarn behind zipper, draw up a loop. Insert hook at next marking and draw up a loop (2 loops on hook). Draw this loop through first loop, being sure to not pull too tightly.
Continue in this manner, inserting hook at each marking, pulling up a loop and drawing it through loop on hook. Once top of zipper is reached, you should have 24 chain sts along right side of zipper.
Pull zipper head down below top marking. Working across top of zipper, insert hook into top marking on left side, drawing up a slightly longer loop to span across top of zipper.
Work down left side of zipper as on opposite side to bottom marking. Make 1 last chain st across bottom of zipper, into same space as first chain.
Pull loop from top of zipper to WS and fasten off. Cut yarn leaving approx 4" [10 cm] tail.
POUCH
1st rnd: With larger hook, join A with sl st to first ch st on right side. Ch 1. Working through right ‘leg’ of chain only, 1 sc in each ch to top of zipper (24 sc). Work 1 sc in ch across top of zipper. 1 sc in each of next 24 ch down left side of zipper. Work 1 sc in ch across bottom of zipper. Join with sl st to first sc. 50 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 20 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * once more. Join with sl st to first st. 46 sts.
3rd and 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
Join MC with sl st to first sc at end of 4th rnd. Fasten off B.
5th to 20th rnds: With MC, rep last rnd.
Fasten off, leaving a long yarn end to seam bottom of Pouch. 
FINISHING
Beg with 1st rnd (pick up rnd) at top of work, work cross stitch, using Cross Stitch Chart onto one side of Pouch over 5th to 19th rnds. Note that 1 sc is equal to 1 square on Chart. With F, work straight stitch over indicated sc, as shown on Chart.
Lay Pouch flat, aligning sts of last rnd. Using yarn tail, sew bottom of Pouch closed.
Zipper Pull
Cherries  (Make 2).
With B and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join. PM on last st.
Cont working in spiral, moving end of rnd marker up each rnd.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd to 5th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around.
Note: To stuff cherries, wrap B around two fingers 5 times.
Stuff Cherries after 5th rnd.
6th rnd: (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail. With yarn needle, draw end through rem sts and pull tightly. Fasten securely and weave in ends.
Cord
With C and smaller hook, leaving long tail, ch 40. Fasten off, leaving long tail.
Feed cord through zipper pull opening, so even length of chains are on either side. Tie Cord in a bow, having loops approx 1¼" [3 cm] long. Sew Cherries to each end of Cord using long tails. 
Optional: Bogg Bag Charms
Using hot glue gun, secure 2 plastic Bogg Bag charms to back of pouch (opposite side from cross stitch) using hot glue gun, over 2nd and 3rd rnds, spaced to align with Bogg Bag openings.

pattern_name: Mini Me Doll Size Crochet Dress
materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Classic Crochet Thread Size 10 (Colors: 350 yds/320 m) Fuchsia (69023) 1 ball or 38 yds/35 m
Size U.S. B/1 (2.25 mm) Susan Bates® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: One size to fit 12" [30.5 cm] fashion doll.
gauge: 26 sc and 28 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as st.
• Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc.
• Ch 4 at beg of row counts as tr.
BODY
**Ch 34 loosely. See diagram on page 3.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *1 dc in next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Turn. 33 sts.
2nd row: Ch 3. *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. *1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
4th row: As 2nd row.
5th row: (RS). Ch 2. Hdc2tog. *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 sc in next dc. Hdc2tog. Turn. 31 sts.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. *1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in last st. Turn.
7th row: Ch 3. *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. *1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
9th row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. *1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 dc in next sc. Hdc2tog. Turn. 29 sts.
10th row: Ch 3. *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in last st. Turn.
11th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. *1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
12th row: Ch 3. *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
13th to 16th rows: As 5th to 8th rows. 27 sts.
17th to 20th rows: As 7th and 8th rows twice more.
21st row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first sc. *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to last dc and sc. 1 sc in next dc. 2 hdc in last sc. Turn. 29 sts.
22nd row: Ch 3. 1 sc in next hdc. *1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next hdc. 1 dc in last hdc. Turn.
23rd row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first dc. *1 dc in next sc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last sc and dc. 1 dc in next sc. 2 hdc in last dc. Turn. 31 sts.
24th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first hdc. 1 dc in next hdc. *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next hdc. 1 sc in last hdc. Turn.
25th row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first sc. *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to last dc and sc. 1 sc in next dc. 2 hdc in last sc. Turn. 33 sts.
26th row: Ch 3. 1 sc in next hdc. *1 dc in next sc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next hdc. 1 dc in last hdc. Turn.
27th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Fasten off.
Shape front: With RS facing, skip first 11 sc. Join yarn with sl st to next sc.
1st row: (RS). Ch 13. Sl st in each of next 2 sc. Ch 11. Sl st in each of next 2 sc. Ch 9. Sl st in each of next 2 sc. Ch 11. Sl st in each of next 2 sc. Ch 13. Sl st in next sc. Fasten off.
Neck choker and shoulder straps: 1st row: Ch 10. Sl st in first ch-13 loop. Ch 1. Sl st in next ch-11 loop. Ch 1. Sl st in next ch-9 loop. Ch 1. Sl st in next ch-11 loop. Ch 1. Sl st in next ch-13 loop. Ch 11. Turn.
2nd row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 9 ch. (1 sc in next sl st. 1 sc in next ch) 4 times. 1 sc in next sl st. 1 sc in each of last 10 ch. Turn. 29 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew shoulder straps along back edge 3 sts in from side edges.
Sew back seam.
Bottom edging:
1st rnd: (RS). Join yarn with sl st at back seam. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, proceed as follows: Ch 4 (counts as hdc and ch-2). (Skip next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. Ch 2) 16 times. Join with sl st to 2nd ch of ch-4.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left, as usual, work 1 reverse sc in same sp as sl st. *1 reverse sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 reverse sc in next hdc. Rep from * to last ch-2 sp. 1 reverse sc in last ch-2 sp. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball 9528 Lilac A
RED HEART® Boutique Fur™: 2 balls 9554 Eggplant B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 5.5mm [US I-9] and 6.5mm [US K-10.5]
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
measurements: Topper measures 10” (25.5 cm) circumference x 5” (12.5 cm) high.
gauge: 8 sts = 4” (10 cm); 8 rows
instructions:
CUFF (make 2)
With A and smaller hook, ch 11.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—10 sc.
Row 2: Working in back loops only, ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 3–40: Repeat Row 2.
Joining Row: Holding first and last rows together and working through both thicknesses, ch 1, slip st in each sc across. Do not fasten off.
Edging Round: Working in ends of rows, ch 1, sc in each row around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Top
Round 1 (RS): With larger hook and right side of opposite edge facing, join B with sc in end of any row, working in ends of rows, sc evenly spaced around; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc.

abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements:
CAT PAW: Approx 4" x 4" [10 x 10 cm] 
CAT: Approx 4" long x 3½" wide [10 x 9 cm]

gauge: 8 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
CAT PAW 
Paw
With A, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in first sc. *2 hdc in each sc around. Join with sl st to top of ch-2. 16 hdc.
3rd rnd: Skip first hdc. *[(1 dc. Ch 1) twice. 1 dc) in next hdc (Toe made). Sl st in next hdc. Rep from * 3 times more. (4 Toes total). 
Fasten off.

Toebean  (make 4).
With B, ch 2.
1st row: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Fasten off leaving a long tail.
Thread tail through top of first sc and pull tightly to create small circle.
Using tail, sew Toebean to Paw in center of each Toe.
Big Bean
With B, ch 4.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not  turn. Working in rem loops of ch,  1 sc in next ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long end.
Sew Big Bean to Paw below Toebeans.

CAT
Head
With A, ch 5.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not  turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each of first 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of next 6 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 28 sc.
4th rnd: (Ears). Sl st in each of first 2 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc 2nd ch from hook. 1 dc in next ch. Skip next sc. Sl st in next sc (Ear made). 
Fasten off.

EYES  (Make 2).
With A, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.
With A, embroider pupils using straight st.

FINISHING
Sew Eyes to Head.
With C, embroider nose and mouth using straight st.

MOUSE
Body
See diagram on page 5.
With A, ch 9.
1st rnd: 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in next ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 sc in next ch. (2 sc. Ch 1. 2 sc) in last ch. Do not  turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. 1 dc in next ch. 4 dc in last ch. Join with sl st to top of beg ch-3. 18 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 2 (counts as hdc). 1 hdc in first dc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 dc. 1 sc in each of next 2 hdc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in ch-1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 dc. 2 hdc in each of next 3 dc. Join with sl st to top of ch-2.
Make Tail: Sl st in next hdc. Ch 6. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 
Sl st in each of next 4 ch. Sl st to same dc as last sl st.
Fasten off.

Arms  (Make 2).
With A, ch 6.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each ch to end of chain.
Fasten off, lea.

Ears  (Make 2).
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Break B. Join A with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: With A, ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 9 sc.
Fasten off.

Cheese
With C, ch 5.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Turn. 1 st.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in st. 
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew Ears to top of Body as shown in photo.
Sew Arms to body at either side. Position Cheese on front of Body and secure arms by sewing through both thicknesses.
With Black, embroider eyes. With B, embroider nose.

instructions:
HOLDER
With A, ch 4, join with slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc, do not turn – 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc, do not turn – 12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, *sc in first st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc, turn – 18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in flp only of each sc around; join with slip st in first sc, turn – 18 sc.
Rounds 5-7: Ch 1, working in both loops of sts, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc – 18 sc. Drop A, join B.
Round 8: With B, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc – 18 sc. Drop B, pick up A.
Rounds 9-13: With A, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc – 18 sc.
Switch Opening
Work now progresses in rows.
Rows 14-18: Ch 1, sc in each st; do not join, turn – 18 st.
Work now progresses in rounds.
Round 19: Ch 1, sc in each of 18 sts, join with slip st in first sc – 18 sc.
Round 20: With A, ch 1, sc in each of next 7 sts; with E, sc next sts; with A, sc in next 2 sts; with E, sc in next sts; with A, sc in each of next 7 sts; join with slip st in first sc, turn – 18 sc.
Round 21: With A, ch 1, sc in each of next 6 sts; with E, sc in next st; with D, sc in next st; with E, sc in next 2 sts; with D, sc in next st; with A, sc in each of last 6 sts; join with slip st in first st – 18 sc.
Round 22: Repeat round 20.
Round 23: With A, ch 1, *sc in each of next 2 sts, 2 sc in next; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first st; turn – 24 sc. Drop A, pick up C.
Round 24: With C, ch 1, sc in each of next 5 sts, holding first ring to surface, sc over ring and each of next 2 sts, sc in each of next 10 sts, holding 2nd ring to surface, sc over ring and each of next 2 sts, sc in each of last 5 sts; join with slip st in first st; turn – 24 sc. Drop C, pick up D.
Rounds 25-26: With D, ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc; turn – 24 sc.
Round 27: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first st; turn – 30 sc.
Rounds 28-29: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc; turn – 30 sc.
Round 30: Ch 1, (sc, ch 4, sc) in first st, *skip 1 st, (sc, ch 4, sc) in next sc; repeat from * around, skip last st; join with slip st in first sc – 30 sc; 15 ch-4 loops. Fasten off.
NOSE
With C, ch 4, join with slip st in first st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc – 6 sc. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing. With yarn needle and tail, sew nose onto body centered under eyes on round 15.
SCAR
With D and yarn needle, embroider scar onto face as pictured.
STRAP
With D, join with slip st in one ring on side of body, ch 40, slip st in clasp, 
Row 1: Ch 1, turn; sc in each of next 40 ch, slip st in first ring, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each of next 40 sts, slip st in clasp. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
