pattern_name: Red Heart Cares Crochet First Aid Kit
materials: RED HEART® Super Saver® Accent™: 1 skein 361 Putty A or RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein 3950 Charcoal A
AUNT LYDIA’S® Fashion Crochet Size 3, Art. 182 available 100% Mercerized Cotton, 150 yd (147m) balls
RED HEART® Super Saver® Accent™, Art. E303 available in 4 oz (113 g), 202 yd (184 m) skein
RED HEART® Super Saver®, Art. E300 available in solid color 7 oz (198 g), 364 yd (333 m) skein
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 3.75mm [US F-5], 3.5mm [US E-4] and 2.25mm [US B-1]
Stitch markers, yarn needle, four size 4 black brass sew-on snaps for inner pocket flaps, two ⅞” [22 mm] brushed metal buttons for outer flap closure, matching sewing thread, needle and straight pins
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Kit measures 8” [20.5 cm] wide x 8” [20.5 cm] tall x 3” [7.5 cm] deep when folded.
gauge: 15 sc = 4” [10 cm]; 15 rows = 4” [10 cm] in single crochet using size 3.75mm [US F-5] crochet hook and A.
instructions:
NOTES
1. This retro-look tri-fold Red Cross inspired first aid kit is designed to hold lots of bulky first aid supplies with the help of two gusseted pockets for better organization. Snaps on the inner flaps keep the items secure in the pockets.
2. Pieces are worked separately and are sewn together. Leave long ends at beginning and end of pieces for sewing. Two Pockets are joined by a gusset piece along bottom edges. Pockets are gusseted and worked in the round for smoother look.
3. Some steps are worked back and forth in rows and others are worked in the round.
4. The iconic Red Cross logo is worked with a small hook, using size 3 crochet thread, for a more finely detailed look, and is sewn together using hand-sewing thread.

SPECIAL TECHNIQUES
Adjustable loop ring: Holding the thread a few inches [cms] from the end, wrap around your finger. Do not remove wrap from finger, insert hook into the wrap and draw up a loop of working thread. Chain one to secure the loop and remove ring from finger. Work stitches of first round in the ring. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.

SPECIAL ABBREVIATIONS
sc2tog: [Draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

KIT
POCKET (make 2)
Beginning at bottom pocket gusset with A and size 3.75mm [US F-5] crochet hook, ch 31.
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 30 sts. 
Rows 2-5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 
Round 6: Begin working in rounds, ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each st across, turn to work along side edge, sc 5 sts evenly spaced along side edge, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, sc in next 30 ch, turn to work along opposite side edge, sc 5 sts evenly spaced along side edge – 70 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Place marker in first st for placement of Bottom Gusset.
Rounds 7-31: Working in continuous rounds, sc in each st around.

Shape Inner Pocket Flap
Row 32: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in next 30 sts, leave remaining sts unworked – 30 sts.
Rows 33-37: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), turn, hdc in each st across.
Row 38: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 
Fasten off. 

BOTTOM GUSSET 
Row 1: With right side facing and size 3.75mm [US F-5] crochet hook, join A to unused loop of marked st of Round 6 with a slip st, ch 1, working in unused loops, sc in same st and in next 29 sts – 30 sc. 
Rows 2-9: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 
Fasten off.
Sew edges of Row 9 to unused loops of Round 6 of second Pocket. Pocket Flaps should face each other when folded together. 

OUTER FLAP
With size 3.5mm [US E-4] crochet hook and A, ch 32.
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 31 sts. 
Rows 2-28: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 29: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 28 sts, sc2tog – 29 sts.
Row 30: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 26 sts, sc2tog – 27 sts.
Row 31: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 24 sts, sc2tog – 25 sts.
Row 32: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 22 sts, sc2tog – 23 sts. Fasten off.
Row 33: With right side facing, size 3.5mm [US E-4] crochet hook, join A with a slip st in first row of Outer Flap, slip st evenly spaced around sides and last row of Outer Flap, leave opposite edge of foundation ch unworked. Fasten off.

Sew Outer Flap to unworked loops of Row 32 on Pocket 1. Fasten off.

RED CROSS LOGO
Center Cross
With size 2.25mm [US B-1] crochet hook and C, ch 19.
Row 1: Working in back bumps only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 18 sts. 
Rows 2-6: Ch 1, turn, sc each st across. 
Fasten off.

First Cross
Row 7: With right side facing and working along last row, skip first 6 sts, join C in next st with a slip st, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 5 sts, leave remaining sts unworked – 6 sts.
Rows 8-12: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 
Fasten off. 

Second Cross
Working along opposite edge of foundation ch, repeat Rows 7-12 of First Cross. 

WHITE CIRCLE
With size 2.25mm [US B-1] crochet hook and B, make an adjustable loop.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in adjustable loop – 6 sts. 
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each st around, slip st in first sc to join – 12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times, slip st in first sc to join – 18 sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times, sc in space before join, slip st in first sc – 25 sc. 
Round 5: Ch 1, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times, sc in last st, slip st in first sc – 31 sc.
Round 6: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times, sc in last sc, slip st in first sc – 37 sc. 
Round 7: Ch 1, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times, sc in last sc, slip st in first sc – 43 sc. 
Round 8: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times, 2 sc in last sc, slip st in first sc – 50 sc. 
Round 9: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times, sc in last 2 sc, slip st in first sc – 56 sc. 
Round 10: Ch 1, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] 6 times, sc in last 2 sc, slip st in first sc – 62 sc. 
Round 11: Ch 1, [sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times, sc in last 2 sc, slip st in first sc – 68 sc. 
Round 12: Ch 1, [sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times, sc in last 2 sc, slip st in first sc – 74 sc. 
Round 13: Ch 1, [sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times, sc in last 2 sc, slip st in first sc – 80 sc. 
Fasten off. 

FINISHING
Sew female side of 2 snaps on right side of each Pocket, about 1” [25 mm] down from last edge before Pocket Flap shaping and 5” [12.5 cm] apart. Sew corresponding male part on wrong side along top edge of Pocket Flaps. 
Fold Pocket fronts together, lining up edges. 
Fold Outer Flap over top edge of Pockets to outside edge of Pocket 2. Sew two buttons, 5” [12.5 cm] apart, just below bind-off edge of Outer Flap. 
Buttonloops
With right side facing and using size 3.75mm [US F-5] crochet hook, join A along edge of Outer Flap with a slip st, lining up with button, ch 5, slip st in next st on Outer Flap. Fasten off. 
Repeat to make second buttonloop above second button. 
Sew Red Cross in center on right side of White Circle. Sew Circle on right side of Outer Flap. 
Weave in ends.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread size 10: 1 ball 450 Aqua
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 1.4 mm [US 8] steel hook
abbreviations: [] = work directions given in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Bookmark measures approximately 2¼” (6 cm) wide by 6¼” (16 cm) long. Butterfly measures 2¼” (6 cm) wide by 1¼” (3 cm) tall.
gauge: 11 sts = 1” (3 cm); 4 rows = 1” (3 cm) in dc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Bottom Trim
Row 1: With right side facing, working across opposite side of foundation ch, join thread with slip st in 4th ch, ch 3, dc in each of next 21 ch sts (7 blocks made), turn, leaving remaining sts unworked.
Row 2: Slip st in each of first 4 sts (decrease made), ch 3, dc in each of next 15 dc, turn, leaving remaining sts unworked.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first dc, *ch 3, skip next dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * across—7 ch-3 spaces.
BUTTERFLY
Head and Body (make 2)
Ch 10.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 8 ch (slip st, 3 hdc, slip st) in last ch (head), working across opposite side of foundation ch, slip st in each ch across. Fasten off and set aside.
Large Wing (make 2)
Ch 5.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—4 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—6 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 5, (counts as tr, ch 1), skip first sc, tr in next sc, *ch 1, tr in next sc; repeat from * across, turn—5 ch-1 spaces.
Edging
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each tr and ch-1 space across; working across side edge of wing, work 3 sc in next row-end tr, sc in each of next 3 row-end sc, working across bottom edge of foundation ch, sc in each ch across, working across other side edge, sc in each of next 3 row-end sc, 3 sc in next row-end tr, join with slip st in first sc.
Bookmark measures approximately 2¼” (6 cm) wide by 6¼” (16 cm) long. Butterfly measures 2¼” (6 cm) wide by 1¼” (3 cm) tall.
SPECIAL ABBREVIATIONS
dc3tog: *Yarn over, insert hook in next st, yarn over, draw yarn through st, yarn over, draw yarn through 2 loops on hook; repeat from * twice, yarn over, draw yarn through 4 loops on hook.
HOW TO READ PATTERN
Each solid square is equal to a “block” of “dc in next dc, dc in next 2 sts or ch-2 space, dc in next dc”. Each open square is equal to a “space” of “dc, ch 2, skip next 2 sts, dc.” The dc at the end of each square also counts as the first dc of the next block or space. For example, a block followed by a space = dc in next 4 sts, ch 2, skip next 2 sts, dc in next dc.
BOOKMARK
Starting at bottom, ch 30. 
Row 1 (Right Side): Dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in each ch across 9 blocks made), turn.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in next 3 dc (block made), *ch 2, skip next 2 sts, dc in next 7 dc (1 space and 2 blocks made); repeat from * once, ch 2, skip next 2 sts, dc in last 4 dc (1 space and 1 block made), turn.
Rows 3-24: Continue to work in blocks and spaces following chart.
Row 25: Slip st in each of first 4 sts (decrease made), ch 3, dc in each st across to last 4 dc, turn, leaving remaining sts unworked (decrease made) (7 blocks made), turn.
Rows 26-28: Repeat Row 25 (1 block at end of last row). Fasten off.
Designed by Carlotta L. C. Craig
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *ch 3, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat * 4 more times. Fasten off and set aside. Fasten off and set aside.
Large Wing (make 2)
Ch 3.
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, turn—2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc across, turn—4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), skip first sc, d in next sc, *ch 1, dc in next sc; repeat from * across, turn—3 ch-1 spaces.
Edging
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each dc and ch-1 space across; working across side edge of wing, work 2 sc in next row-end dc, sc in each of next 2 row-end sc, working across bottom edge of foundation ch, sc in each ch across, working across other side edge, sc in each of next 2 row-end sc, 2 sc in next row-end dc, join with slip st in first sc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *ch 3, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat * twice. Fasten off and set aside. 
Antennae 
Ch 25. Fasten off. Make an overhand knot on both ends and set aside.
Right Side Assembly
Row 1: With right side facing, hold one large wing with smaller end up. Join thread in first sc, ch 1, sc in first sc, sc in next 2 sc. With right side facing, place small wing behind large wing; insert hook through 4th sc of large wing and first sc of small wing, working through double thickness, work 2 sc in same st, sc in next sc of small wing. Fasten off.
Left Side Assembly
Row 1: With right side facing, hold other small wing with smaller end up. Join thread in first sc, ch 1, sc in first sc. With right side facing, place remaining large wing behind small wing; insert hook through 2nd sc of small wing and first sc of large wing, working through double thickness, work 2 sc in same st, sc in next 3 sts of large wing. Fasten off.
FINISHING  
With tapestry needle, and right sides facing, placing both large wings on same end, sew wings together across last row of wings. 
Place one head and body on both sides of assembled wings (right side facing out and with head at large wing end) and sew in place. Before head is sewn together, slip center of antennae between head pieces and complete sewing heads together. 
With right side of bookmark facing, join thread to first st on last row, ch 3, dc3tog over next 3 dc, ch 50, slip st to bottom of butterfly’s body.  
Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Luster Sheen®: 1 ball 0915 Cherry Red
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 3.75 mm [US F-5]
30 sewing pins, 5” (12.5 cm) x 5” (12.5 cm) piece of Styrofoam® at least ½” (13 mm) thick
2” (5 cm) piece of ¾” (2 cm) red “hook and loop” Sew-on fastener such as Velcro
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Celtic Knot measures: 3” wide x 5” long (8 wide x 13 long cm). To Fit Waist: 25-27 (28-30, 31-33, 35-37)” [63.5-68.5 (71-76, 79-84, 89-94) cm]. Finished Waist: 27 (30, 33, 37)” [8.5 976, 84, 94) cm]
gauge: 20 sts = 4” (10 cm); 20 rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
FINISHING
Using straight pins, pin Knot Diagram onto Styrofoam block. With right sides facing up, lay out all 4 cords on work surface. Mark 2 cords (A & B) with a pin 8” (21 cm) in from the left side (approximately 35 sc). Mark 2 cords (C & D) with a pin 8” (20.5 cm) in from the right side (approximately 35 sc)
Step 1: Place Cord A on Knot Diagram lining up pin with * on diagram and laying 8” (21 cm) on the left. Continue to lay the right-hand side of Cord A on the diagram following the path of the knot (see arrows). Use pins to hold cord in place.
Step 2: Place Cord C on Knot Diagram lining up pin with ** on diagram and laying 8” (21 cm) on the right. Continue to lay the left-hand side of Cord C on the diagram following the path of the knot (see arrows). Use pins to hold cord in place. Make sure to pass over and under correctly.
Repeat Step 1 with Cord B so Cord B lays side-by-side with Cord A, making sure to pass over and under correctly.
Repeat Step 2 with Cord D so Cord D lays side-by-side with Cord C.
Remove all pins and knot from block. Carefully adjust the knot gradually by pulling the cord ends so there are no spaces between the woven cords. Make sure there is at least 7½” (19 cm) of each cord on the left and right side of the knot. (see Diagram 2)
Assembling the Belt
Lay the woven cords right side up on work surface. Measure 7” (18 cm) out from the right and left side of the knot and mark with a pin on each cord.

CROCHET CORD (make 4)
Ch 145.
Row 1 (Right Side): Working in the back bar of each ch, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across—144 sc. Cord should measure 29” (74 cm) long. Fasten off, leaving a long sewing length.

BACK CLOSURE TAB (make 2)
Ch 12.
Row 1 (right side): Working in back bar of each ch, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn—11 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 3–21 (28, 35, 45): Repeat Row 2.
NOTE: For larger belt, add more rows to Closure Tab. Fasten off, leaving a long sewing length.

NOTE: It is fine if the length of the cords vary. Their ends will be hidden under the closure tabs.
Step 3: With right side facing up, line up a Back Closure Tab with the 7” (18 cm) mark across all 4 cords. Pin cords onto back of tab using photo as a guide. Repeat Step 3 with other Back Closure Tab and other side of cords. Using a yarn needle and sewing lengths, sew all cords to the wrong side of the Closure Tabs. Weave in ends.
Using a yarn needle and a length of yarn, sew together all cords (A to B and C to D) on wrong side of knot. Continue to sew cords together around edges of knot so there are no gaps between the paired cords. Weave in all ends.
Separate 2” (5 cm) piece of Hook and Loop Sew-on Fastener – Using sewing needle and matching thread, sew on fastener at edge of Back Closure Tab, adjusting for proper fit. Repeat with other piece of fastener so that it aligns with first piece. The fastening edges of the Back Closure Tabs should overlap approximately 1” (2.5 cm).
Wet block belt unfastened with all cords extending out from knot neatly. Allow to dry overnight. Do not steam block belt or belt will lose its ability to stretch and fit snuggly.

materials: Patons® Classic Wool Worsted™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 194 yds/177 m) Honey (77756) 3 balls
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Cr4B = Skip next 2 stitches. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 stitches. Working behind 2 dcfp just made, 1 dcfp around post of each of 2 skipped stitches 2 rows below.
Cr4F = Skip next 2 stitches. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 stitches. Working in front of 2 dcfp just made, 1 dcfp around post of each of 2 skipped stitches 2 rows below.
Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Front: Approx 12" [30.5 cm] wide x 10” [25.5 cm] deep from shoulder. Back: Approx 12” [30.5 cm] wide x 8” [20.5 cm] deep from shoulder.
gauge: 14 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of row counts as hdc.
• When working Cr4F, Cr4B and Dcfp sts in cable pat on RS rows, always skip sts directly behind them from previous row.
• Front has Cable Pat and is 2" [5 cm] longer than Back.
• Back has side details with plain center section.

FRONT
***Ribbing: Ch 46. See diagram on page 4.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook (counts as 2 hdc). 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 45 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. *1 dcbp around post of next hdc. 1 dcfp around post of next hdc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 dcbp around post of next hdc. 1 hdc in top of turning ch-2. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. *1 dcfp around post of next st. 1 dcbp around post of next st. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 dcfp around post of next st. 1 hdc in top of turning ch-2. Turn.
4th row: Ch 2. *1 dcbp around post of next st. 1 dcfp around post of next st. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 dcbp around post of next st. 1 hdc in top of turning ch-2. Turn.***
Proceed in pat as follows:
Set-up 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. (1 sc in next st. 1 dcfp around post of next st 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Cr4F. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Cr4F. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Cr4F. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. (1 dcfp around post of next st. 1 sc in next st) 3 times. Turn. 46 sts.
2nd and WS rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 1 dcfp around post of next st 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. *1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * twice more. (1 dcfp around post of next dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 1 dcfp around post of next st 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. *1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below.** 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * once more, then from * to ** once. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. (1 dcfp around post of next dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Turn.
7th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 1 dcfp around post of next st 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below. *1 sc in each of next 6 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 4 dcfp 2 rows below. Rep from * once more. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. (1 dcfp around post of next dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Turn.
9th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 1 dcfp around post of next st 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below. *1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Cr4B. Rep from * once more. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. (1 dcfp around post of next dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Turn.
11th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 1 dcfp around post of next st 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. *1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below.** 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * once more, then from * to ** once. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. (1 dcfp around post of next dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Turn.
13th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 1 dcfp around post of next st 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. *1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 2 dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * twice more. (1 dcfp around post of next dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Turn.
15th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 1 dcfp around post of next st 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. *1 dcfp around post of each of next 4 dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Rep from * once more. 1 dcfp around post of each of next 4 dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. (1 dcfp around post of next dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Turn.
17th row: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 1 dcfp around post of next st 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. (Cr4F. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts) twice. Cr4F. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. (1 dcfp around post of next st. 1 sc in next st) 3 times. Turn.
18th row: As 2nd row.
Rep 3rd to 18th rows for Cable Pat until work from beg measures approx 7½" [19 cm], ending on a 18th row of pat.

Shape neck: Next row: (RS). Pat across 16 sts (neck edge). Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Pat to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows twice more, then 1st row once. 9 sts rem.
Work 3 rows even in pat.
Fasten off.
With RS facing, skip next 14 sts. Join yarn with sl st to next st. Ch 1 (does not count as st). Pat to end of row. Turn.
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Pat to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows twice more, then 1st row once. 9 sts rem.
Work 3 rows even in pat.
Fasten off.

BACK
Work from *** to *** as given for Front.
Set-up 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. (1 sc in next st. 1 dcfp around post of next st 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 16 sts. 2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 16 sts. (1 dcfp around post of next st. 1 sc in next st) 3 times. Turn. 46 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 1 dcfp around post of next st 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 34 sts. (1 dcfp around post of next st. 1 sc in next st) 3 times. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows until work from beg measures 8" [20.5 cm], ending on a WS row.
Fasten off.

COLLAR
Sew shoulder seams.
Note: Collar is worked side to side.
Ch 30.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook (counts as 2 hdc). 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 29 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. *1 hdc in horizontal bar created below next hdc (below loops normally worked – see diagram). Rep from * to last st. 1 hdc in top of ch-2. Turn.
Rep last row until Collar (when slightly stretched) measures length to fit around neck edge. Fasten off.
Sew side of Collar to neck edge, having Collar seam at left shoulder. Sew Collar seam. Fold Collar in half towards RS as shown.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 400 Grey Heather A and 313 Aran B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Legwarmer measures 12½” long x 15” circumference at top edge (32 x 38 cm).
gauge: 6 sts = 2” (5 cm); 9 rounds = 4” (10 cm) in pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Edging
Round 1: With right side of top edge facing and working across opposite side of foundation ch, join B with slip st in any ch, ch 3, 2 dc in same ch, skip next 2 ch, slip st in next ch, *3 dc in next ch, skip next 2 ch, slip st in next ch; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—11 3-dc groups.
Cording (make 2)
With A, ch 91.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 9 ch, sc in next 70 sts, 2 sc in last 10 ch—110 sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With right side of legwarmer facing and seam in back, weave cording through ch-2 spaces of Round 3, beginning and ending at outer side of legwarmer. Evenly adjust ends and tie to fit around leg. 
Weave in ends.
Notes
1. Legwarmer is made in joined rounds from top edge down.
2. To make wider or narrower legwarmers, increase or decrease beginning chains in multiples of 4.
Special Stitch
Fpdc (Front post double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from front side of work to back and to front again around post of indicated stitch; yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), yarn over and draw through 2 loops (2 loops on hook), yarn over and draw through 2 loops (1 loop on hook).
LEGWARMER (make 2)
With A, ch 44; taking care not to twist, join with slip st in first ch.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), hdc in each ch around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch, turn—44 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 2, hdc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch, turn.
Round 3: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in next st, *ch 2, skip next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around, ch 2, skip last 2 sts; join with slip st in top of beginning ch, 22 dc and 11 ch-2 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in next st, 2 dc in first ch-2 space, *dc in next 2 sts, 2 dc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch, turn—44 sts.
Rounds 5–27: Ch 3, dc in next 2 sts, Fpdc around next st, *dc in next 3 sts, Fpdc around next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 28: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Bright Yellow (0324) 1 ball or 20 yds/19 m
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Small amount of black worsted weight yarn
measurements: Approx 2½" [6.5 cm] in diameter, not including key ring
gauge: 12 single crochet (sc) and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
USING THIS GUIDE
Click on the underlined words throughout the pattern to access our library of helpful tools.
NOTES
• Emoticon is made from two circular Head pieces.
• Each Head piece is worked in continuous rounds (spiral).
• One Head piece is embroidered with a smiley face. Then the Head pieces are sewn together and lightly stuffed using extra yarn.
• Optionally, a split key ring is attached to the top of each finished Emoticon.

Head (make 2 the same)
Make a slip knot and place it on the hook.
Slip knot
Make a loop with yarn and fold it on itself to make a pretzel shape. Then pull through to make slip knot.

Chain (ch) 2.
Yarn over hook (Yoh), draw through loop – 1 chain made.
Repeat (rep) last step once more – 2 chains made.
1st rnd: Work 6 single crochet (sc) in second ch from hook. Do not turn.
Insert hook into second ch from hook under the two top loops (do not count loop on hook as a chain); yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through both loops on hook – 1 sc made.
Rep last step 5 times more – 6 sc made. Continue (cont) working in a spiral as follows:
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each of next 6 sc. 12 sc total.
Rep 5 times more around – 12 sc made.
3rd rnd: (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. 18 sc total.
4th rnd: (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Slip stitch (sl st) into first sc. 24 sc total.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Repeat (rep) Head instructions for 2nd piece.
With small amount of black yarn, and yarn needle, embroider face details onto one Head piece, using photo as guide.
Finishing
Using yarn needle and long tails from Head pieces, whipstitch (see diagram) two Head pieces together (tog) halfway around outside of circle, with smiley face facing out. Using leftover yarn, wrap around 3 fingers 30 times. Trim yarn, leaving a long tail, and slide wraps off fingers. Using the tail, tie around bundle of yarn to create stuffing. Stuff Head pieces with yarn bundle before completing the seam. Weave in all yarn tails. Optionally, attach split key ring to top of Emoticon.
We love seeing your makes! Share your photos using #YARNSPO and tag us @yarnspirations on Instagram or find us on Facebook.

materials: Lily® Sugar ’n Cream (Solids: 70.9 g/2.5 oz/109 m/120 yds)
Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Finished Measurements: approx. 29 ins [73.5 cm] long.
gauge: 14 hdc and 11 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]
instructions:
Note: T urning ch 2 does not count as st. When changing colors, work to the last 2 loops on the hook of last st, then draw new color through rem 2 loops and proceed. 
FRONT
With MC, ch 58. 
1st row:(RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. T urn. 56 hdc. 
2nd row:Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. T urn. 
Rep last row until work from beg measures 29 ins [73.5 cm], ending with RS facing for next row. 
**Next row:Ch 3. (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st) 3 times. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook– Hdc3tog made. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 4 sts. Hdc3tog over next 3 sts. 1 dc in last st. T urn. 
Rep last row to 8 sts. Fasten off.**
Place markers at each end of last row. 
BACK
With MC, ch 58. 
1st row:(RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. T urn. 56 hdc. 
2nd row:Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. T urn. 
Rep last row 4 times more.  Work from ** to **, as given for Front. 
Joining Back and Front:Place WS of Back and Front tog, matching shapes and pin them tog. With RS of work facing, join MC with sl st to left marked corner of Front. Proceed as follows:  
1st rnd:Working through both thicknesses, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 30 sc evenly down left "shoulder", 2 sc in corner and 12 sc down left side. Working in Front only, 92 sc down left side of Front, 3 sc in corner, 1 sc in each of next 54 sts across bottom of Front, 3 sc in corner and 92 sc up right side of Front. Working through both thicknesses, 12 sc up right side, 2 sc in corner, and 30 sc evenly up right "shoulder". Working in Front only, 15 sc across top of Front. Join A in rnd with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd:With A, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in next sc. *With B, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around, working 3 sc in corners. Join with sl st to first sc.  
3rd rnd:Beg with appropriate color, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc, changing colors, as in 2nd row. Join B with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd:With B, ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left, as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
POCKET A (make 4)
With MC, ch 27. 
1st row:(RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. T urn. 26 sc. 
2nd to 4th rows:Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. . 
5th and 6th rows:Ch 1. T urn 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (With B, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. With B, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. T urn. 
7th and 8th rows:Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. T urn.
Rep last 4 rows twice more, then 5th and 6th rows once more. Break A and B. 
Next 3 rows:With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. T urn. Do not turn at end of last row.  
Next row:(RS). With MC, ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left, as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
POCKET B (make 1)
With B, ch 59. 
1st row:(RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. (With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. With B, 1 sc in each of next 2 ch) 14 times. T urn. 58 sc. 
2nd row:With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. (With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 14 times. T urn. 
3rd and 4th rows:With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. (With MC, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 14 times. T urn. 
5th and 6th rows:With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. (With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 14 times. T urn.
7th and 8th rows:With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 46 sc. With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. T urn. 
9th and 10th rows:With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 46 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With A, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With B, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. T urn. 
Rep last 4 rows 3 times more, joining MC at end of last row. 
Next row:(RS). With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Do not turn.  
Next row: Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left, as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
Tie: With B, ch 15. Sl st to WS at top edge.  Ch 15. Fasten off. Insert hanger and use ties to secure at back. 
HEART
With B, ch 2. 
1st row:(RS). 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join A. T urn. 2 sc. 
2nd row:With A, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. With B, 1 sc in same sc (increase made). With B, 1 sc in next sc. With A, 1 sc in same sc (increase made). T urn.  
1st and 2nd rows of Chart are complete.
Cont in chart until 22nd row of Chart has been completed, working increases as before. 28 sc. 
23rd row:(RS). Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook - Sc2tog made. Pat across 11 sc. Tu rn . Leave rem sts unworked. 
24th row:Ch 1. Pat to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. T urn. 
25th row:Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. Pat to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. T urn. 
26th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. Pat to last 2 sts. Fasten off. 
With RS of work facing, miss 2 sc of 22nd row. Join MC with sl st to next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Pat to last 2 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. T urn. 
Next rnd:Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. Pat to end of row.  T urn. 
Next row:Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. Pat to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sts.
T urn. 
Next row:Ch 1. Sl st in each of first 2 sts. Ch 1. Pat to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Fasten off. 
With RS of work facing, join B with sl st to bottom point of Heart. Ch 1. 3 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around Heart. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Next rnd:With B, ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left, as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off. Sew on Heart as illustrated, stuffing lightly as you sew it on. Sew on Pockets as illustrated, stitching down center of Pocket B.  
Reverse Sc Chart Key.

materials: 1 skein each 256 Carrot B and 672 Spring Green C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: X-Large Cover measures 18" [45.5 cm] long x 11" [28 cm] circumference. Large Cover measures 16" [40.5 cm] long x 10" [25.5 cm] circumference. Medium Cover measures 16½" [42 cm] long x 9" [23 cm] circumference. Small Cover measures 14½" [37 cm] long x 8" [20.5 cm] circumference.
gauge: 18 sc = 5" [12.5 cm]; 10 rows = 3" [7.5 cm] in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
X-LARGE COVER
Bottom Ribbing
With A, ch 37.
Row 1: Working in back bars only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 36 sc.
Rows 2-28: Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across.
Joining Row: Ch 1, turn, with right sides together, fold ribbing in half, bringing first row up behind last row, working through back loops of sts of both layers, sc in each st across. Do not fasten off. Turn right side out (joining row to the inside).
Top
Round 1 (Right Side): Turn to work along long edge, ch 1, sc in end of each row around, join with slip st in first sc – 28 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 35 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, *sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 40 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc and change to B in join.
Round 6: With B, ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc and change to A in join. Cut B.
Round 7: With A, ch 1, sc in same st as join, sc in each st around, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc and change to C in join.
Rounds 9-11: With C, ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc, changing to A in join of Round 11. Cut C.
Rounds 12-13: With A, repeat Round 7, changing to B in join of Round 13.
Round 14: With B, repeat Round 6.
Rounds 15-19: Repeat Rounds 7-11, changing to A in join of Round 19.
Round 20: With A, ch 1, *sc2tog, sc in next 6 sc; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 35 sc.
Round 21: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc, changing to B in join.
Round 22: With B, ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc, changing to A in join – 28 sc. Cut B.
Round 23: With A, ch 1, *sc2tog, sc in next 5 sc; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 24 sc.
Round 24: Ch 1, sc in next sc, *sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * to last 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc, join with slip st in first sc – 18 sc.
Round 25: Ch 1, *sc2tog, sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc – 12 sc.
Round 26: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 6 times, join with slip st in first sc – 6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a 12" [30.5 cm] tail. With yarn needle, thread tail through sts of last round and draw tight to close hole.

LARGE COVER
Bottom Ribbing
With A, ch 37.
Work Rows 1-24 and Joining Row as for X-Large Cover.
Top
Round 1 (Right Side): Turn to work along long edge, ch 1, sc in end of each row around, join with slip st in first sc – 24 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 30 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in next sc, [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 5 times, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 3 sc, join with slip st in first sc – 36 sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc and change to B in join.
Round 6: With B, ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc and change to A in join. Cut B.
Round 7: With A, ch 1, sc in same st as join, sc in each st around, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc and change to C in join.
Rounds 9-11: With C, ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc, changing to A in join of Round 11. Cut C.
Rounds 12-13: With A, repeat Round 7, changing to B in join of Round 13.
Round 14: With B, repeat Round 6, changing to A in join.
Round 15: With A, ch 1, *sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 30 sc.
Round 16: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 17: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 24 sc.
Round 18: Ch 1, sc in next sc, *sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * to last 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc, join with slip st in first sc – 18 sc.
Round 19: Ch 1, *sc2tog, sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc – 12 sc.
Round 20: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 6 times, join with slip st in first sc – 6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a 12" [30.5 cm] tail. With yarn needle, thread tail through sts of last round and draw tight to close hole.

MEDIUM COVER
Bottom Ribbing
With A, ch 35.
Rows 1-22: Work Bottom Ribbing Rows 1-22 of X-Large Cover – 34 sc.
Work Joining Row as for X-Large Cover.
Top
Round 1 (Right Side): Turn to work along long edge, ch 1, sc in end of each row around, join with slip st in first sc – 22 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, [sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 times, join with slip st in first sc – 28 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times; join with slip st in first sc, changing to B in join – 32 sc.
Round 5: With B, ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc and change to A in join. Cut B.
Rounds 6-18: Repeat Rounds 7-19 as for X-Large Cover, changing to A in join of Round 18.
Round 19: With A, ch 1, [sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] 4 times, join with slip st in first sc – 28 sc.
Round 20: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc, changing to B in join.
Round 21: With B, ch 1, *sc2tog, sc in next 5 sc; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc, changing to A in join – 24 sc. Cut B.
Round 22: With A, ch 1, sc in next sc, *sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * to last 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc, join with slip st in first sc – 18 sc.
Round 23: Ch 1, *sc2tog, sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc – 12 sc.
Round 24: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 6 times, join with slip st in first sc – 6 sc. Fasten off, leaving a 12" [30.5 cm] tail. With yarn needle, thread tail through sts of last round and draw tight to close hole.

SMALL COVER
Bottom Ribbing
With A, ch 33.
Rows 1-20: Work Bottom Ribbing Rows 1-20 of X-Large Cover – 32 sc.
Joining Row: Work Joining Row as for X-Large Cover.
Top
Round 1 (Right Side): Turn to work along long edge, ch 1, sc in end of each row around, join with slip st in first sc – 20 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, [sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times, join with slip st in first sc – 24 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, [sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, sc in last 3 sc; join with slip st in first sc – 28 sc.
Rounds 5-14: Work Rounds 5-14 as for Large Cover, changing to A in join of Round 14.
Round 15: With A, ch 1, [sc2tog, sc in next 5 sc] 4 times, join with slip st in first sc – 24 sc.
Round 16: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 17-19: Work Rounds 18-20 as for Large Cover. Fasten off, leaving a 12" [30.5 cm] tail. With yarn needle, thread tail through sts of last round and draw tight to close hole.

FINISHING
Weave in ends. Using pompom maker and all colors, make a medium pompom for each Cover. Tie one pompom at tip of each Cover.

materials: Small ivory button, matching thread and needle, rustproof pins, spray starch, yarn needle
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Collar measures 15” (38cm) circumference at neck edge, 23” (58.5cm) circumference at lower edge and 3½” (9cm) length.
gauge: 48 tr = 4” (10cm); Rows 1-7 of Ruffle = 2” (5cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Row 2: Ch 4 (counts as tr here and throughout), [tr in next st, skip next st] twice, *V-st in next st, skip next st, tr in next 3 sts, skip next st; repeat from * across to last 6 sts, V-st in next st, [skip next st, tr in next st] twice, tr in last st, turn – 31 V-sts and 96 tr.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, *ch 3, sc in V-st, ch 3, skip next st, sc in next st, work ([tr, ch 1] 4 times, tr) in next V-st (Fan made), skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * across, ch 3, sc in last V-st, ch 3, sc in last st, turn – 15 Fans.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first st, ch 1, sc in next ch-3 space, *ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, tr in first 4 sts of Fan, work Lg V-st in next st, tr in last 4 sts of Fan, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * across, ch 3, sc in last ch-3 space, ch 1, sc in last sc, turn.
Row 5: Ch 4, ([tr, ch 1] twice, tr) in first ch-3 space, *skip 2 sts of Fan, sc in next st, ch 3, sc in Lg V-st, ch 3, skip next st of Fan, sc in next st, ([tr, ch 1] 4 times, tr) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * across, skip 2 st of Fan, sc in next st, ch 3, sc in last Lg V-st, ch 3, skip next st of Fan, sc in next st, work ([tr, ch 1] twice, tr) in last ch-3 space, tr in last sc, turn – 14 Fans and 2 half Fans
Row 6: Ch 4, work Lg V-st in next st, tr in next 4 sts, *sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, tr in first 4 sts of Fan, work Lg V-st in next st, tr in last 4 sts of Fan; repeat from * across, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, sc in last ch-3 space, tr in next 4 sts, work Lg V-st in next tr, tr in last tr, turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first st, *ch 3, sc in Lg V-st, ch 3, skip next st, sc in next st, work ([tr, ch 1] 4 times, tr) in next ch3-space, skip first 2 sts of next Fan, sc in next st; repeat from * across, ch 3, sc in last Lg V-st, ch 3, sc in last tr, turn – 15 Fans.
Rows 8-13: Work Rows 4-7 once, then Rows 4-5 once more.
Fasten off.

Edging
With right side facing and working along row edges of Ruffle, join thread in edge of Row 1 of Ruffle, sc in same st, [ch 3, sc in edge of next tr] across to first tr of Row 13, turn to work along Row 13, ch 1, sc in first tr, (ch 2, sc) in same st, hdc between first 2 tr, *(dc, ch 1, dc) in next st, hdc in next 4 sts, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, hdc in next 4 sts; repeat from * across Row 13, (dc, ch 1, dc) in next st, hdc between next 2 tr, (sc, ch 2, sc) in last tr, ch 1, turn to work along row edges of Ruffle, sc in side of last tr, [ch 3, sc in edge of next tr] across Row 1 – 27 ch-3 spaces and 19 points on Fans.

FINISHING
Weave in ends. Fold Neckband to wrong of Ruffle and sew in place, leaving buttonhole end free. Sew button to other end of Neckband under Ruffle. Mist thoroughly with water and pin to stretch out pattern and eliminate gathers. Allow to dry completely. Lightly spray with starch to keep shape.

materials: Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Glue gun and glue stick to cover hanger hook with yarn if desired
gauge: 14 sts and 10 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
BACK and FRONT (make 2 pieces alike).
With MC, ch 57.
1st row:(WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 56 sc.
2nd row:Ch 3 (counts as dc). Miss first sc. 1 dc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 4 (counts as tr). (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – dc2tog made. Dc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 dc in each dc to last 5 sts. (Dc2tog over next 2 sts) twice. 1 tr in last st. Turn.
4th row:Ch 1. 1 sc in first st. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. 1 sc in each st to last 5 sts. (Sc2tog over next 2 sts) twice. 1 sc in last st. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows 5 times more. 8 sts. Fasten off. Place marker at end of last row.
Joining Back and Front: Place WS of Back and Front tog with hanger in between both pieces, matching shapes and pin them tog. With RS of work facing, join MC with sl st to left marked corner of Front.
Proceed as follows: 1st rnd: Working through both thicknesses: ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 30 sc evenly down left “shoulder” and 3 sc down left side. 3 sc in corner. 1 sc in each of next 54 sc across bottom. 3 sc in corner. 3 sc up right side. Stuff lightly, wrapping stuffing around metal hanger, then work 30 sc evenly up right “shoulder”. Work 16 sc evenly around top edge. Join with sl st in first sc.
2nd rnd: Working around top 16 sc only: ch 1. (Sc2tog) 8 times. Join with sl st in first st.
3rd rnd:Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 4 times. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Edging: Join A with sl st in bottom right corner. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in next sc. Rep from * across to opposite corner. Fasten off.
FLOWER
With A, ch 4. 1st rnd: 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. Ch 3. (Sl st. Ch 3. 1 dc. Ch 3) 4 times in same sp. Sl st in same sp. Fasten off.
Sew Flower to front of hanger as shown in picture.
If desired, use hot glue to attach MC to hanger hook wrapping 2 strands tog at same time around hook.

materials: RED HEART® Soft Baby Steps®: 1 ball 9702 Strawberry
abbreviations: ( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Bun cover measures 9” circumference x 3¾” long (23 x 9.5 cm)

BUN COVER
Ch 2.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each of 254 Pumpkin A, 312 Black B
Yarn needle, two ½”-5⁄8” (12-15 mm) buttons
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Cuff measures 6” (15 cm) long and 2½” (6.5 cm) wide.
gauge: 16 sts = 4” (10 cm); 14 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With A, ch 24.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across—23 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, with A, sc in first 7 sc, sc2tog; with B, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; with A, sc2tog, sc in last 7 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, with A, sc in first 6 sc, sc2tog; with B, 2 sc in next sc; [with A, sc in next sc; with B, sc in next sc] twice, with A, sc in next sc; with B, 2 sc in next sc; with A, sc2tog, sc in last 6 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, with A, sc in each sc across.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, with A, sc in first 10 sc; with B, sc in next 3 sc; with A, sc in last 10 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, with A, sc in first 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc; with B, sc3tog; with A, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 9 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, with A, sc in first 7 sc; with B, sc in next 3 sc; with A, sc in next 3 sc; with B, sc in next 3 sc; with A, sc in last 7 sc
Row 8: Ch 1, turn, with A, sc in first 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc; with B, sc3tog; with A, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; with B, sc3tog; with A, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 6 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, with A, sc in each sc across.
Button Loops and Edging: Working in ends of rows down side of piece, sc in end of Row 9, [ch 3, skip ends of next 3 rows, sc in end of next row] twice, slip st evenly spaced across lower edge of piece, side edge, and in all sts of Row 9; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING: Sew buttons opposite button loops. Weave in ends.
Special Stitches: sc2tog = [Draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
sc3tog = [Draw up a loop in next st] 3 times, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Note: 1. Work tightly for a firm cuff.
2. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Drop old color to the wrong side. Proceed with new color. Do not cut old color. Carry old color evenly across wrong side of work when next needed.
3. Decreases, increases, and color changes are used to create the pumpkin face. Each row has the same number of decreases and increases, so the stitch count remains the same throughout.

instructions:

pattern_name: Crochet Full of Woe Lace Collar & Cuffs
materials: Size U.S. 7 [1.5 mm] Susan Bates® Steelite™ crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
Picot = Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook
measurements: Collar Neckband: Approx 15 ( 17)" [ 38 ( 43) cm] around. Cuff Band: Approx 7 ( 9)" [ 18 ( 23) cm] around.
gauge: 10 dc and 4 rows = 1" [2.5 cm].
instructions:
The instructions are written for smaller size. If changes are necessary for larger size the instructions will be written thus ( ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to both sizes.

Notes:
• Neckband is worked first, then Lace Collar is worked along longer edge of Neckband.
• Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc.

Neckband
Ch 12. See diagram on page 4.
1st row: 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 10 dc.
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 9 dc. Turn.
Rep 2nd row 58 ( 66) times more.
Next row: (Buttonhole row). Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Dc2tog. Ch 2. Dc2tog. 1 dc in each of last 3 dc. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. 2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of last 4 sts. 10 sc.** 62 ( 70) rows total. Do not fasten off.

Lace Collar
Turn work sideways and proceed across long side as follows:
1st row: Ch 3. 3 dc around post of first dc. 1 dc around post of next dc. *(2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all around post of next dc. 1 dc around post of next dc. Rep from * 28 ( 32) times. 4 dc around post of next dc. Turn. 29 ( 33) groups of (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc).

2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Skip next 3 dc. *(4 tr. Ch 2. 4 tr) all in next ch-2 sp. Skip next 5 dc. 1 dc in next ch-2 sp. Skip next 5 dc. Rep from * 13 ( 15) times more. (4 tr. Ch 2. 4 tr) all in next ch-2 sp. Skip next 3 dc. 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Turn. 15 ( 17) groups of (4 tr, ch 2, 4 tr).

3rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *Ch 1. (1 tr in next tr. 2 tr in next tr) twice. Ch 3. Skip next ch-2 sp. (2 tr in next tr. 1 tr in next tr) twice. Ch 1.** Skip next 5 sts. 1 dc in next ch-2 sp. Skip next 5 sts. Rep from * 6 ( 7) times more, then rep from * to ** once. 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Turn. 8 ( 9) ch-3 sps.

4th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Skip next ch-1 sp. *Ch 6. Skip next 6 tr. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all in next ch-3 sp. Ch 6. Skip next 6 tr.** 1 tr in next ch-1 sp. Skip next dc. 1 tr in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * 6 ( 7) times more, then rep from * to ** once. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Turn. 16 ( 18) ch-6 sps.

5th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-6 sp. Skip next 2 dc. (4 tr. Ch 2. 4 tr) all in next ch-2 sp. Skip next 2 dc. 1 sc in next ch-6 sp. Ch 3.** 2 tr in next tr. Ch 1. 2 tr in next tr. Rep from * 6 ( 7) times more, then rep from * to ** once. 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Turn. 8 ( 9) groups of (4 tr, ch 2, 4 tr).

6th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *Skip next (ch-3 sp, sc). (1 tr in next tr. 2 tr in next tr) twice. Ch 3. Skip next ch-2 sp. (2 tr in next tr. 1 tr in next tr) twice.** Ch 1. Skip next (sc, ch-3 sp and 2 tr). 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next 2 tr. Rep from * 6 ( 7) times more, then rep from * to ** once. Skip next (sc, ch-3 sp). 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Turn. 8 ( 9) ch-3 sps.

7th to 12th rows: Rep last 3 rows twice more.

13th row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 4 dc. *1 sc in each of next 6 tr. (2 sc. Picot. 2 sc) all in next 3-ch sp. 1 sc in each of next 6 tr.** 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * 6 ( 7) times more, then rep from * to ** once. 1 sc in each of next 4 dc. 8 ( 9) Picots. Fasten off.

Cuff Band (Make 2)
Ch 12. 
1st row: 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 10 dc.
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 9 dc. Turn.
Rep 2nd row 26 ( 35) times more.
Next row: (Buttonhole row). Ch 3. 1 dc in each of first 2 dc. Dc2tog. Ch 2. Dc2tog. 1 dc in each of last 3 dc. Turn.
Next row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 dc. 2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of last 4 dc. 10 sc. 30 ( 38) rows total. Do not fasten off.

Lace Cuff
Turn work sideways and proceed across long side as follows:
1st row: Ch 3. 3 dc around post of 1st dc. 1 dc around post of next dc. *(2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all around post of next dc. 1 dc around post of next dc. Rep from * 13 ( 16) times. 4 dc around post of next dc. Turn. 14 ( 17) groups of (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc).

2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Skip next 3 dc. *(4 tr. Ch 2. 4 tr) all in next ch-2 sp. Skip next 5 dc. 1 dc in next ch-2 sp. Skip next 5 dc. Rep from * 5 ( 7) times more. (4 tr. Ch 2. 4 tr) all in next ch-2 sp. Skip next 3 dc. 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Turn. 7 ( 9) groups of (4 tr, ch 2, 4 tr).

3rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *Ch 1. (1 tr in next tr. 2 tr in next tr) twice. Ch 3. Skip next ch-2 sp. (2 tr in next tr. 1 tr in next tr) twice. Ch 1.** Skip next 5 sts. 1 dc in next ch-2 sp. Skip next 5 sts. Rep from * 2 ( 3) times more, then rep from * to ** once. 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Turn. 4 ( 5) ch-3 sps.

4th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Skip next ch-1 sp. *Ch 6. Skip next 6 tr. (2 dc. Ch 2. 2 dc) all in next ch-3 sp. Ch 6. Skip next 6 tr.** 1 tr in next ch-1 sp. Skip next dc. 1 tr in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * 2 ( 3) times more, then rep from * to ** once. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Turn. 8 ( 10) ch-6 sps.

5th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-6 sp. Skip next 2 dc. (4 tr. Ch 2. 4 tr) all in next ch-2 sp. Skip next 2 dc. 1 sc in next ch-6 sp. Ch 3.** 2 tr in next tr. Ch 1. 2 tr in next tr. Rep from * 2 ( 3) times more, then rep from * to ** once. 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Turn. 4 ( 5) groups of (4 tr, ch 2, 4 tr).

6th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. *Skip next (ch-3 sp, sc). (1 tr in next tr. 2 tr in next tr) twice. Ch 3. Skip next ch-2 sp. (2 tr in next tr. 1 tr in next tr) twice.** Ch 1. Skip next (sc, ch-3 sp and 2 tr). 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next 2 tr. Rep from * 2 ( 3) times more, then rep from * to ** once. Skip next (sc, ch-3 sp). 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Turn. 4 ( 5) ch-3 sps.

7th to 9th rows:  Rep last 3 rows once more.

10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 dc. *1 sc in each of next 6 tr. (2 sc. Picot. 2 sc) all in next 3-ch sp. 1 sc in each of next 6 tr.** 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. instructions: Wrap double stick tape around outside edge of the hanger, leaving ends untaped. Make sure the whole outside surface is covered. Foundation: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 42 chs, [3 sc in next ch, placing marker in 2nd sc, sc in next 77 chs] 3 times, 3 sc in next ch, placing marker in 2nd sc, sc in next 34 chs; without twisting row, join with slip st in first sc to create open square – 320 sc.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, sc in next 2 sts, [*skip next st, shell in next st, skip next st, sc in next 5 sts*; repeat from * to * across to last st before marker, skip next st, lgshell in marked st, moving marker to 3rd dc of lgshell, skip next st, sc in next 5 sts] 4 times; repeat from * to * across to last 5 sts, skip next st, shell in next st, skip next st, sc in next 2 sts; join with slip st in first st – 36 shells, 4 lgshells and 200 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, [*ch 3, sk next 2 sc, skip next dc, heart in next dc, ch 3, skip next dc, sk next 2 sc, sc in next sc*; repeat from * to * across to last 2 sc, skip last 2 sc, sk next dc, ch 3, heart in next dc, ch 3, sc in next marked dc, ch 3, heart in next dc, ch 3, skip next dc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc] 4 times; repeat from * to * across to last 2 sc before last shell, skip next 2 sc, skip next dc.

It’s easy to add a bit of glamour to your look with this ruffled collar. Crocheted with ribbon type yarn that has a beautiful sheen, it can take a plain top into dinner party mode.

Note: In Rows 2 and 3, when instructed to “insert hook in opening in ladder, insert hook into an opening of the ladder that is closest to the hook. This may require skipping 1-3 openings between insertions.

Row 2 (right side): Rotate piece to work across the band side of Row 1, insert hook through outer edge of band, insert hook into opening in ladder of working yarn and draw st through band (2 sts on hook), insert hook in next opening in ladder of working yarn and draw through both sts on hook (single crochet made – 1 st remains on hook), *insert hook from front to back through each of the next 3 openings in ladder of working yarn (4 sts on hook), draw the first st on hook through the other 3 sts on hook (1 st remains on hook), insert hook through outer edge of band of Row 1 at next natural ruffle (about 1½” (4 cm) from last insert location), insert hook in opening in ladder of working yarn and draw st through band (2 sts on hook), insert hook in next opening in ladder of working yarn and draw through both sts on hook (1 st remains on hook); repeat from * all the way across Row 1.

Cut yarn, leaving a 5” (12.5 cm) tail to weave in.

Row 3 (right side): With right side facing and beginning about 6 (6, 7)” (15 (15, 18) cm) from beginning edge of Row 2, insert hook through outer edge of band side of Row 2, insert hook into next opening in ladder of working yarn about 5” (12.5 cm) from beginning of yarn and draw through band (1 st on hook), *insert hook from front to back through each of the next 3 openings in ladder of working yarn, draw the first st on hook through the other 4 sts on hook, insert hook through outer edge of band of Row 2 at next natural ruffle (about 1½” (4 cm) from last insert location), insert hook into opening in ladder of working yarn and draw st through band (2 sts on hook), insert hook in next opening in ladder of working yarn and draw through both sts on hook; repeat from * across to the last 6 (6, 7)” (15 (15, 18) cm) of Row 2, leave these last 6 (6, 7)” (15 (15, 18) cm) unworked.

Cut yarn leaving 5” (12.5 cm) tail to weave in.

FINISHING
Weave all ends into the ruffles, pull ends through and trim.

materials: RED HEART® "LusterSheen®": 1 Skein each of colors required: see individual patterns.
For Each Trim: One 1/2" diameter flat white button for attaching to Crocs™; small amount of stuffing material; yarn needle.
abbreviations: Dec = draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook – 1 stitch decreased.

beg = beginning; ch = chain; dec = decrease; hdc = half double crochet; lp = loop; mm = millimeters; rem = remaining; rep = repeat; rnd = round; sc = single crochet; sl = slip; st(s) = stitch (es); tog = together; * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated; [] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 7 sts = 1"; 6 rnds = 1" in sc rnds.
instructions:
NOTES FOR ALL TRIMS: 
• Most pieces are worked in continuous rounds without joining unless otherwise specified. 
• Always leave a long end of yarn for sewing when you fasten off. 
• You can always embroider eyes instead of using beads or buttons if you prefer. 
• Sew the small flat white button to the wrong side of the finished trim. 

SUN 
LusterSheen® Colors: 0227 Buttercup, 0002 Black and 0915 Cherry Red. 
Additional Materials: 2 Black 1/2" buttons. 

Directions: With Buttercup, ch 2. 
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc. 
Rnd 3: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times – 16 sc. 
Rnd 4: Sc in each sc around. 
Rnd 5: Sc in back lps of each sc around. 
Rnd 6: [Dec] 8 times – 8 sc. Fasten off. Stuff lightly. Draw remaining sts together. 

Rays: Attach Buttercup in any remaining front loop of Rnd 4; * ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, skip next loop, slip st in next loop; repeat from * around. Fasten off. 

Finishing: Embroider Cherry Red smile. Sew black buttons in place for sunglasses. Embroider Black straight sts for center and sides of sunglasses. 

OCTOPUS 
LusterSheen® Colors: 0995 Ocean and 0002 Black. 
Additional Materials: 2 Tiny purple buttons for eyes. 

Directions: With Ocean, ch 2. 
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc. 
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc. 
Rnd 4: Sc in each sc around. 
Rnd 5: [Sc in next sc, dec] 6 times – 12 sc. Stuff lightly. 
Rnd 6: [Dec] 6 times – 6 sc. Fasten off. Draw remaining sts together. 

Tentacles (Make 8): With Ocean, ch 6; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across. Fasten off. 

Finishing: Sew tentacles in place around Rnd 5. Sew eyes in place. Embroider smile with Black. 

FISH 
LusterSheen® Colors: 0300 Serenity and 0002 Black. 
Additional Materials: 1 Tiny black bead for eye. 

Directions: With Serenity, ch 2. 
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc. 
Rnds 3-7: Sc in each sc around. Stuff lightly. 
Rnd 8: [Dec] 6 times; turn – 6 sc. 
Row 9: Holding Rnd 8 flat and working through both thicknesses, sc in 3 sc; turn. 
Row 10: Ch 2, (hdc, sc) all in first sc, slip st in next sc, (sc, hdc, sl st) all in last sc. Fasten off. 

Fin: With Serenity, ch 4; sc in 3rd ch from hook, slip st in last ch. Fasten off. 

Finishing: Sew fin in place. Embroider smile with Black. Sew bead in place for eye. 

LADYBUG 
LusterSheen® Colors: 0913 Warm Red and # 0002 Black. 

Directions-Body: With Warm Red, ch 2. 
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc. 
Rnd 3: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times – 15 sc. 
Rnd 4: Sc in each sc around. 
Rnd 5: Sc in back loops of each sc around. Stuff lightly. 
Rnd 6: [Dec] 7 times, sc in next sc – 8 sc. Fasten off. Draw remaining sts together. 

Head: With Black, ch 2. 
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Rnds 2 and 3: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off. 

Finishing: Sew head in place. Embroider Black French knot spots and a long st up center of back. 

FLOWER 
LusterSheen® Colors: 0227 Buttercup and 0735 Hot Pink. 

Directions: With Buttercup, ch 2. 
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Rnd 2: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times – 9 sc. 
Rnd 3: Sc in back loops of each sc around. 
Rnd 4: [Dec, sc in next sc] 3 times – 6 sc. Stuff lightly. Fasten off. Draw remaining sts together. 

Petals-Rnd 1: Attach Hot Pink in any remaining front loop of Rnd 2 with a sc; sc again in same loop, [2 sc in next loop] 8 times – 18 sc. 
Rnd 2: [Slip st in next 2 sc, 3 hdc in next sc] 6 times; join with a slip st in first slip st. Fasten off. 

BEE 
LusterSheen® Colors: 0007 Vanilla, 0002 Black and 0227 Buttercup. 
Additional Materials: 2 Tiny blue beads for eyes. 

Directions-Body: With Buttercup, ch 2. 
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Rnd 2: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times – 9 sc. 
Rnds 3 and 4: Sc in each sc around. 
Rnd 5: [Sc in next sc, dec] 3 times – 6 sc. Stuff lightly. Fasten off. Draw remaining sts together. 

Head: With Black, ch 2. 
Rnd 1: 6 Sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Rnd 2: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.  

Wings: With Vanilla, [ch 7, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 5 ch; join with a slip st in first sc] twice. Fasten off. 

Finishing: With Black, embroider back st around body between Rnds 3 and 4. Sew head in place. Sew eyes and wings in place. Tie a small strand of Black to top of head for feelers; trim.

instructions:
A
Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 
Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch for center bar. 
1 sc in each of next 3 ch from original ch-8. Turn. Ch 4. Sl st in 
tip of center bar. Ch 5. Turn. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in 
each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in sl st. 1 sc in each of last 4 ch. Join with 
sl st in first st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
B
Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. Turn. 7 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 5. Skip first 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 6. Skip next 
2 sc. Sl st in last sc. Turn.
3rd row: Skip first sl st. 1 sc in each of next 6 ch. Sl st in next 
sc. 1 sc in each of last 5 ch. Join with sl st in edge of 1st row.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
 C
Ch 13.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. 12 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Shape into ‘C’ when 
sewing in position.
D
Ch 17.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 6 ch. 
3 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 7 ch. 2 sc in last ch. 
Join with sl st in first st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
E
Ch 8.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. (Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch of original ch-8) 
twice. Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. Sl st in 
side of last sc along ch-8. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
 F
Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 
Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each 
of next 3 ch of original ch-8. Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
1 sc in next ch. Sl st in last ch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail 
for sewing.
G
Ch 15.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook. 1 sc in next ch. Sl st in same sp as original sl st. 1 sc in 
each of rem 13 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Shape into ‘G’ when 
sewing in position.
H
Left Side
Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 
Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch for center bar. 
1 sc in each of next 3 ch of original ch-8.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

Right Side
Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. 7 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew Sides tog along 
center bar.
I
Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. 7 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
J
Ch 10.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 sc in 
side of last sc along original ch-10. Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook. 1 sc in next ch. Sl st in same sc along side.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Shape into “J” while 
sewing in position.
K
Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 
Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Sl st 
in last sc along original ch-8. Ch 4. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Sl st in same sc along side. 1 sc in 
rem ch of original ch-8.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
L
Ch 12.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Skip 
next ch. 1 sc in each of last 7 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
M
Ch 21.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 9 ch. 
Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in 
rem 10 ch of orginal ch-21.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Shape into ‘M’ while 
sewing in position.
N
Ch 25.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 6 ch. Skip 
next ch. 1 sc in each of next 8 ch. Skip next ch. 1 sc in each of 
rem 7 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Shape into ‘N’ while 
sewing in position.
O
Ch 17. Join with sl st in first ch to make a ring.
1st rnd: 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st in first sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
P
Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. Turn. 7 sc.
2nd row: Ch 5. Skip first 3 sc. Sl st in next sc. Turn. Leave 
rem sts unworked.
3rd row: 1 sc in each ch of ch-5. Sl st in last ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Q
Ch 17. Join with sl st in first ch to make a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 sc in 
each ch around. Join with sl st in first ch. Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch 
from hook. 1 sc in next ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
R
Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. Turn. 7 sc.
2nd row: Ch 5. Skip first 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc for center sc. 
Ch 5. Turn. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. 
Sl st in center sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 ch of first ch-5 sp. 
Join with sl st in edge of 1st row. Fasten off, leaving a long 
tail for sewing.
S
Ch 17.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. 16 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Shape into ‘S’ while 
sewing in position.
T
Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 sc in 
side of last sc along original ch-8. Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook. 1 sc in next ch. Sl st in same sc along side.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
U
Ch 17.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. 16 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Shape into ‘U’ while 
sewing in position.
V
Ch 18.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. 17 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Shape into ‘V’ while 
sewing in position.
W
Work as given for M, reversing direction while sewing in place.
X
Make 2 pieces alike. Ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. 7 sc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Shape pieces into ‘X’ b crossing in center while sewing 
in position.
Y
1st row: (Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 
3 ch) twice. Sl st in first ch. Ch 5. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Join with sl st in original sl st.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Z
Ch 16.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. Skip 
next ch. 1 sc in each of next 5 ch. Skip next ch. 1 sc in each of 
rem 4 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Shape into ‘Z’ while 
sewing in position.
#
Bars (make 4 alike).
Ch 9.
1st row: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in each ch to end of 
chain. Fasten off leaving long tail for sewing.
Shape into ‘#’ while sewing in position, having 2 vertical bars 
leaning slightly to right.
Background  (Make 1 per letter).
Note: Background is worked side to side.
Ch 10.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end 
of chain. Turn. 9 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures approx  
½" [1.25 cm] wider than desired letter.
With RS facing, sew letter to front of background as shown.
With Hot glue gun, glue plastic bag charm back to back 
of background.

instructions:
FLOWER
Shown in photos as follows:
With H as Color 1 and E as Color 2. 
With L as Color 1 and I as Color 2. 
With D as Color 1 and A as Color 2. 
With J as Color 1 and C as Color 2. 
With F as Color 1 and K as Color 2.
With O as Color 1 and S as Color 2.
With U as Color 1 and M as Color 2. 
With V as Color 1 and O as Color 2.
With D as Color 1 and P as Color 2.
With M as Color 1 and D as Color 2. 
With Color 1, beg using magic loop method demonstrated here. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 12 sc in ring. Join Color 2 with sl st to first sc. Break Color 1.
2nd rnd: With Color 2, (1 hdc. 1 dc. 1 hdc) all in same sp as sl st. Sl st in next sc. *(1 hdc. 1 dc. 1 hdc) all in next sc. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to base of first hdc. Fasten off.

BOW
Shown in photos in B, D, E, F, J, L, M, N, P , and S. 
Ch 6.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 5 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 3 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Turn. 1 st.
5th row: Ch 1. 3 sc in next sc. Turn. 3 st.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc.
7th and 8th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Do not fasten off.
Final rnd: (Work 7 sc evenly across long edge of Bow. 2 sc in next corner sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

BOW TIE
Ch 6.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Fasten off. 5 sc.
Wrap Tie around Bow as shown in photo. Join first st to last st of row to secure, with join on WS of work.

HEART
Shown in photos in A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, M, N, O, and P.
Make Magic Loop.
1st rnd: (Sl st. 1 dc. 3 tr. 3 dc. 1 tr. 3 dc. 3 tr. 1 dc) all in ring. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off. Cinch loop closed tightly.

FINISHING
