materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 256 Carrot A, 512 Turqua B, 319 Cherry Red C, and 316 Soft White D
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 3.75mm [US F-5], 5 mm [US H-8]
abbreviations: A, B, C, D = color A, B, C, D
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 22 sts = 4” (10 cm); 20 rows = 4” (10 cm) in sc with smaller hook. Note: Gauge is not overly important for this project but stitches in the stuffed portion must be tight enough to prevent stuffing showing through.
instructions:
Ears (Make 2)
With A and smaller hook, ch 5; sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, 2 sc in last ch, working in remaining loops on opposite side, sc in 3 ch, (slip st, ch 1, slip st) in next sc, slip st in next 3 sc, (slip st, ch 1, slip st) in next sc, slip st in next 3 sc. Fasten off leaving long tail for attaching ear to head.

Antlers (Make 2)
With D and smaller hook, ch 8.
Working in back bumps on wrong side of ch for each section, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, ch 4, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 2 ch, slip st in next 3 ch on ch-8, ch 4, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and next 2 ch, slip st in last ch of ch-8. Fasten off leaving long tail for sewing.

Scarf
With B and larger hook, ch 43.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across changing to C in last st; turn – 42 sc. Cut B.
Row 2: With C, ch 1, sc in each sc across changing to B in last st; turn. Cut C.
Row 3: With B, ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off. 
Fringe: Cut 4” (10 cm) strands of yarn. Knot fringe across each end of scarf as follows: fold strand in half forming a loop; insert the crochet hook through the fabric from the wrong side and draw the loop through, then draw the yarn ends through the loop and tighten. Trim yarn ends.

REINDEER
Head
Round 1: With A and smaller hook, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join but work in continuous rounds. Place marker in first sc and move up each round.
Round 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Rounds 4-6: Sc in each sc around.
Neck Opening-Round 7: Sc in first 12 sc, ch 4, skip next 4 sc, sc in last 2 sc.
Round 8: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rounds 9-11: Sc in each sc around.
Round 12: [Sc in next 2 sc, dec] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 13: Sc in each sc around.
Round 14: [Sc in next sc, dec] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 15: [Sc in next sc, dec] 4 times – 8 sc. Stuff head firmly.
Round 16: [Dec] 4 times – 4 sc. Fasten off.
Finish stuffing. Use yarn end threaded on tapestry needle to close hole. Set aside.

Neck
With A and smaller hook, attach yarn to any st at neck opening.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each sc and ch around; do not join – 8 sc.
Round 2: Sc in each sc around.
Round 3: 2 Hdc in each sc around – 16 hdc.
Round 4: [Hdc in next 7 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] twice – 18 hdc.
Rounds 5-9: Hdc in each hdc around.
Rounds 10 and 11: Sc in each hdc around. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew beads randomly on antlers. Sew ears and antlers to head with yarn ends.
Locate desired eye placement and with A, soft sculpture eye socket by taking st in one eye placement, then insert needle and run it across to other eye placement area. Bring needle out at this 2nd eye area and pull tightly causing yarn to make indentation for eye socket. Repeat process again and then bring yarn out behind ear and knot securely. Weave in yarn end. Sew wiggle eyes securely in eye sockets just made.
Sew pom pom nose to face.
Slip onto bottle, tie scarf around neck.

instructions:
Ch 66.
Foundation Row: Slip st in 12th ch from hook (beginning skipped ch count as first slip st, ch 5, 5 skipped ch), [ch 5, skip next 5 ch, slip st in next ch] 9 times, turn—10 ch-5 spaces.
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc in first ch-5 space, (ch 1, 5 sc) in next 8 ch-5 spaces, ch 1, (6 sc, ch 2, 6 sc) in beginning ch space, working in opposite side of Foundation Row, (ch 1, 5 sc) in next 8 ch-5 spaces, ch 1, 6 sc in last ch-5 space, hdc in first sc (hdc counts as last ch-2 space), turn—104 sc, 18 ch-1 spaces, and 2 ch-2 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 4 (counts as first dc and ch-1 space), (dc, [ch 1, dc] twice) in same ch-2 space, **ch 1, dc in next sc, ch 1, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc, ch 1, skip next 2 sc, {(dc, [ch 1, dc] 3 times) in next ch-1 space, ch 1, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc*, ch 2, sc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc, ch 1, skip next 2 sc} 5 times, ending last repeat at *, ch 1, skip next 2 sc, dc in next sc, ch 1**, (dc, [ch 1, dc] 3 times) in next ch-2 space, repeat from ** to **; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch, do not turn—28 sc, 52 dc, 64 ch-1 spaces, and 16 ch-2 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in next ch-1 space, ch 3 (counts as first dc), small picot, *[dc, cl in dc just made, triple picot, (slip st, cl) in dc of last cl made, dc] in next ch-1 space, small picot, dc in next ch-1 space, [small picot, dc] twice in next 2 ch-1 spaces, skip next sc and ch-1 space, sc in next dc, ch 2, skip next ch-1 space, {(sc, picot, sc) in next ch-1 space, sc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, sc in next ch-1 space, sc in next ch-2 space, picot, ch 1, sc in next ch-2 space, sc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, sc in next ch-1 space} 4 times, (sc, picot, sc) in next ch-1 space, ch 2, skip next dc, sc in next dc, skip next ch-1 space and sc, [dc, small picot] twice in next 2 ch-1 spaces*, dc in next ch-1 space, small picot, repeat from * to *; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—24 dc and 72 sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.
Blocking is optional but recommended for best appearance. To block, fill a bowl with water, add liquid starch if a lightly stiffened finish is preferred. Soak bookmark, then gently finger press out excess liquid, taking care not to pull or twist stitches. Lay piece on a blocking mat and pin out edges to open and emphasize picots. Allow to dry thoroughly before handling. Referring to photograph, weave ribbon from back to front through each ch-5 space. Fold each ribbon end in half lengthwise and trim to make a “V” shape.

materials: RED HEART® “Soft Yarn”: 1 ball each 9388 Wheat A, 9937 Garden Print B, and 9522 Leaf C.
abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C
gauge: 14 sts = 4”; 20 rows = 4” in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BELT
With A, ch 90 (98, 106).
Row 1 (Right Side): Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 89 (97, 105) hdc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each hdc across; turn.
Rows 3 and 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 4.
Row 5: With right side facing, skip first 5 sc, join B in next sc; ch 1, sc in each sc across to last 5 sc; TURN, leaving remaining 5 sc unworked – 79 (87, 95) sc.
Rows 6-8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 8.
Ruffle Trim-Row 9: With right side facing, join C in first sc of Row 8; ch 3, 2 dc in same sc, 3 dc in each sc across; turn.
Row 10: Ch 1, hdc in each dc across. Fasten off.
Top Ties
With C, ch 80, with right side facing, sc in each ch across foundation ch, ch 80. Fasten off.
Bottom Tie
Join C in next free sc of Row 4; ch 1, sc in same sc and in next 4 sc, ch 80. Fasten off.
Repeat Bottom Tie on opposite side.
Weave in all ends.
Embellishment
Sew cowrie shells evenly across (about 1 inch apart) on right side, along the length of the belt just above Row 5.

materials: STITCH NATION by Debbie Stoller™ Full o’ Sheep™: 1 ball each 2705 Peony A and 2640 Thyme B
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Flower measures 5” diameter before felting; 4” diameter after felting.
gauge: Gauge is not important, but the stitches need to be loose to felt the yarn successfully.
instructions:
ROSE
Flower
Round 1: With A, ch 3; join with slip st to first ch forming a ring. Ch 1, [(sc, ch 2, 2 dc, ch 2) in ring] 5 times; join to first sc – 5 petals.
Round 2: Working behind the petals, ch 1, slip st into back of first sc, ch 2; [slip st into the back of the next sc, ch 2] 4 times; join to first slip st – 5 ch-2 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1; [(sc, ch 2, 3 dc, ch 2, sc) in next ch-2 space] 5 times; join to first sc – 5 petals.
Round 4: Working behind the petals, ch 1, slip st into back of first sc; [ch 2, skip 1 dc, slip st into the 2 strands at the base of the next dc, ch 2, slip st into the upside down “V” formed by the last sc of one petal and the first sc of the next petal] 4 times; ch 2, skip 1 dc, slip st into back of next dc, ch 2, join to first slip st – 10 ch-2 spaces.
Round 5: Ch 1, [(sc, ch 2, 3 dc, ch 2, sc), in next ch-2 space] 10 times; join to first sc – 10 petals.
Fasten off and weave in ends.
Leaves (Make 2)
Center Vein: With B, ch 7; working into the back of the chains, slip st into the second ch from the hook, slip st in next 5 ch, ch 1 – 6 slip sts.
Round 1: Starting on the opposite side and working into the back loops of the center vein; (slip st, ch 1, hdc) into first ch, dc into next 3 ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, (slip st, ch 2, slip st) into back loop of turning chain; working down the slip st side, sc in next slip st, hdc in next slip st, dc in next 3 slip sts, (hdc, ch 1, slip st) into last slip st; join to turning ch – 16 sts.
Fasten off and weave in ends.

felted rose pin
Add a bright flower to anything you please! This flower is crocheted and then felted so it will last indefinitely. It’s definitely a great idea for updating your look or for gifting.

Backing
Round 1: With A, ch 2, 6 sc in second ch from the hook; join to first sc – 6 sc.
Round 2: Ch1, 2 sc in each sc; join to first sc – 12 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc; [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 5 times; join to first sc – 18 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 2 sc; [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 5 times; join to first sc – 24 sc. 
Fasten off and weave in ends.

Felting
Before assembling the flower, put the pieces into pillowcases and tie closed. Place them in a washing machine with hot water and a small amount of detergent. Check during the wash cycle regularly until desired amount of felting is achieved. Rinse soap and squeeze out excess water. Block into desired shapes and let dry. Hint: Overlap the outer petals of the rose, pin into place and let dry.

ASSEMBLY
Sew bead or button into the middle of the rose. Arrange two leaves on the back of rose; pin into place and stitch to the rose with B. Place backing on the rose, over the leaves; pin and stitch into place with A. Sew bar pin onto back.

materials: RED HEART® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball of 201 White
¼” (6 mm) wide smooth braided elastic. Note: Sample uses 18” (45.5 cm)
15 - White Pearl Size 6/0 Czech glass “E” beads
abbreviations: 3-trCluster (Cl): *Yarn over (twice), insert hook in indicated st or sp, yarn over, draw up a loop, [yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook] twice; repeat from * twice, yarn over, draw through remaining loops on hook.
Small Shell (shell): Ch 1, [dc, ch 1] 3 times in indicated st.
Heart Shell (Heart): (Dc, [ch 4, dc in top of previous dc, dc] twice) in indicated st.
Beaded Chain Stitch (bch): Side bead up thread, close to hook, yarn over, draw thread through loop.
Beaded Single Crochet (bsc): Insert hook in st or space, yarn over, draw up a loop, slide bead up close to hook, yarn over, draw thread through both loops on hook.
measurements: Finished measurements: 2” (5 cm) wide x 32” (81.5 cm) long (adjustable), without elastic.
gauge: 8 sts = 1” (2.5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
GARTER
Center Strip
Ch 256; join into a ring with a slip st in first ch.
Round 1: Ch 1, working in back bump of ch sts, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch around; join with a slip st in first sc—256 sc.
Round 2: Ch 5 (counts as tr, ch 1), skip first st, skip next st, *Cl in next st, ch 1, skip next st, tr in next st, ch 1, skip next st; repeat from * around, ending last repeat; join with a slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-5—32 Cl, 32 tr.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in each st and ch-1 space around; join with a slip st in first sc—256 sc.
First Lace Edging
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in each of next 2 sts, *skip next st, shell in next st, skip next st, sc in each of next 5 sts; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, sc in each of last next 2 sts; join with a slip st in first sc—32 shells; 160 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first st, *ch 3, skip next 5 sts, Heart in next st, ch 3, skip 5 sts, sc in next st; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in first sc—32 sc, 32 Hearts, 64 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off.
Second Lace Edging
With right side facing, working across opposite side of foundation ch, join thread to in ch at base of first sc in Round 1 of Center Strip.
Rounds 1-2: Repeat Rounds 1-2 of First Lace Edging.
Flower Petals
Leaving a sewing length, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 10 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st in first sc, tighten beginning tail to close center—10 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, (sc, ch 5, sc) in first st, ch 1, skip next st, *(sc, ch 5, sc) in next st, ch 1; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—5 ch-5 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 1, (sc, hdc, 4 dc, ch 1, bch 1, ch 1, 4 dc, hdc, sc) in each ch-5 space around; join with a slip st in first sc—5 petals. Fasten off.
Flower Center
Ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st in first sc, tighten beginning tail to close center—5 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 bsc in each st around; join with a slip st in first sc—10 bsc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends on Garter Strip.
For Flower, weave ends to middle of Petals and Center. Using tails, sew center to middle of petals, then sew completed flower on right side to a cluster on garter center strip.
Weave elastic through Round 2 of Center Strip, pushing tr sts to back and clusters to front. With sewing needle and thread, sew ends of elastic together.

pattern_name: A BIZARRE & UNEXPECTED TWISTER OF FATE CROCHET WITCH FEET
materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m) Contrast A Soft White (0316) 1 ball or 275 yds/251 m
Contrast B Black (0312) 1 ball or 260 yds/238 m
Red Heart® Super Saver® Metallic™ (5 oz/142 g; 255 yds/233 m) Contrast C Red (0390) 1 ball or 160 yds/146 m
Size U.S. 7 [4.5 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Approx 9½" [24 cm] long x 8½" [21.5 cm] wide, assembled.
gauge: 17 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Legs are joined onto flat Base piece during Finishing to ensure Legs stay together and secure placement.
• Base can be ‘hidden’ and secured depending on end use.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first sc of rnd unless otherwise indicated. 
• Carry color when not in use loosely up WS of work unless otherwise stated.
Stripe Pat
With A, work 2 rows/rnds.
With B, work 2 rows/rnds. 
These 4 rows/rnds form Stripe Pat. 
BASE
With A, ch 37.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 36 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
First 2 rows of Stripe Pat are now in place. 
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep 2nd row 18 times more. Fasten off. 
LEG (Make 2)
See diagram on page 4.
With A, beg using magic loop method demonstrated here .  
1st rnd: 6 sc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 35 sc.
Beg working in Stripe Pat. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Drop A. Join B. 
First 2 rnds of Stripe Pat are now complete. Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep 8th rnd 16 times more. 
Fasten off. 
Heel Flap
Join B with sl st to 28th st of rnd (8th st to right of rnd join.)
1st row: Ch 1. 1 st in same st as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. Turn, leaving rem sts unworked. 17 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Drop B. Join A.
Working in Stripe Pat, rep 2nd row 6 times more.
Shape heel: 1st row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 9 sc. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sts. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sts. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 7 sts. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 9 sts.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st across. Do not turn.
Drop A. Join B. 
Stuff leg.
Note: Remainder of Foot is worked in Stripe Pat, beg with 2 rnds of B. 
See diagram on page 4.
Shape instep: 1st rnd: (RS). With B, work 11 sc evenly down left side of Heel. PM between last and next sc. 1 sc in each of next 18 sc of Instep. PM between last and next sc. Work 11 sc evenly up right side of Heel. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc at top of Heel. Join with sl st to first sc. 49 sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to 2 sts before first marker. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to next marker. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 47 sts. 
3rd to 8th rnds: As 2nd rnd. 35 sts. 
9th to 12th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
13th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sts. 
14th to 16th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Stuff foot as you go.
Shape toe: Fold Foot flat and PM at each side edge for side shaping. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to 2 sts before next marker. (Sc2tog) twice. Rep from * once more. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 26 sts.
Rep last rnd 3 times more. 14 sts rem. Fasten off. Finish stuffing foot. Fold toe flat and sew seam. 
SHOES (make 2)
See diagram on page 5.
Toe
Note: Work Toe in spiral in continuous rnds. Move marker onto first st at beg of each rnd.
With C, beg using magic loop method. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in ring. 
2nd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 9 sc.
3rd rnd: *1 sc in each of 2 next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 12 sc.
4th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 15 sc.
5th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
6th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Join. 
7th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 21 sc.
8th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
9th rnd: As 6th rnd. 
10th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 27 sc.
11th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
12th rnd: As 6th rnd.
13th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. 35 sc.
14th to 18th rnds: As 6th rnd. Turn at end of 18th rnd.
Proceed working Sides of Shoe in rows as follows:
1st row: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 33 sts.
2nd to 4th rows: As 1st row. 27 sts.
5th to 12th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to last 3 sts. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn. 29 sts. 
14th row: As 13th row. 31 sts. 
15th to 17th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
18th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 11 sc. PM on last st. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 
19th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until work from marked row measures 1½" [4 cm].
Fasten off. 
With WS facing, join C with sl st to next unworked st after marked st.
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in same st as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn. 
Leave rem sts unworked.
Cont on these 9 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 7 sts.
3rd and 4th rows: As 2nd row. 3 sts rem. Fasten off. 
With WS facing, join C with sl st to next unworked st from 17th row of Side of Shoe.
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in same st as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 11 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from 17th row of Side of Shoe measures 1½" [4 cm].
Fasten off. 
Shoe Heel Seaming
Join back seam of Sides of Shoe at Heel (marked in red on diagram) With Flat Sl St using C.
FLAT SL ST
Align seam to center of Heel (marked with “x” on diagram). 
Sew curved seam for back of heel along light blue section marked on diagram. Shoe Heel Seaming
Bow (make 2). 
See diagram on page 6.
With C, ch 6.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 5 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 3 sts. 
4th row: Ch 1. Sc3tog. Turn. 1 st.
5th row: Ch 1. 3 sc in next st. Turn. 3 sc. 
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 3 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc.
7th and 8th rows: As 2nd row. 
Do not fasten off. 
Edging rnd: Turn work. (Work 7 sc evenly across long edge of Bow. 2 sc in next corner sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. 
Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Wrap a strand of C around center of Bow several times. Sew to Shoe as shown in photo. 
FINISHING
Seam Legs to Base as shown in photo. Place Shoes on feet and secure with some stitches if desired.

instructions: Note: Only use LED bulbs with this acrylic lampshade. Do not use incandescent, halogen, or any other type of bulb as they may generate excessive heat, which could damage the acrylic material or pose a fire risk. The instructions are written for Small size. If changes are necessary for larger size the instructions will be written Small (Large). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to both sizes. MOTIFS Motif I: Make 2 (4) using A as Color 1, B as Color 2, and C as Color 3. Motif II: Make 2 (4) using B as Color 1, C as Color 2, and A as Color 3. Motif III: Make 2 (4) using C as Color 1, A as Color 2, and B as Color 3. Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st. See Diagrams on page 4. With Color 1, beg using magic loop method, demonstrated here. 1st rnd: Ch 2. (3 dc in ring. Ch 3) 4 times. Join with sl st to first dc. Fasten off Color 1. 2nd rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to any ch-3 sp. Ch 2. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. [Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp] 3 times. Ch 1. 3 dc in first ch-3 sp. Ch 3. Join with sl st to first dc. Fasten off Color 2. 3rd rnd: Join Color 3 to any ch-3 sp. Ch 2. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. [Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp] 3 times. Ch 1. 3 dc in first ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. Join with sl st to first dc. Fasten off. Following Assembly Diagram on page 3, join Motifs tog into a strip, whipstitching through back loops only. Join first and last Motifs to form a ring. WHIPSTITCH Upper Granny Stripes Stripe Pat With A, work 1 rnd. With B, work 1 rnd. With C, work 1 rnd. These 3 rnds form Stripe Pat. With RS facing, join A with sl st to top right ch-3 sp of any Motif. **1st rnd: Ch 2. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. *3 dc in next ch-3 sp (next Motif). (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first dc. Break A. 2nd rnd: Join B with sl st to any ch-1 sp. Ch 2. 3 dc in same ch-1 sp. Ch 1. *3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dc.  Break B.** First 2 rnds of Stripe Pat are now complete. Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep 2nd rnd 4 (10) times more. Do not fasten off C. Top Edging See Diagram on page 4. 1st rnd: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each dc and ch-1 sp around. Join. 96 (192) sts. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. [Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook – Picot made. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Picot) 18 times] once (twice).  Fasten off. Lower Granny Stripes With RS facing, join A with sl st to bottom right ch-3 sp of any Motif. Work from ** to ** as given for Upper Granny Stripes. With C, rep 2nd rnd once more. Do not fasten off C. Lower Edging See Diagram on page 4. 1st rnd: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each dc and ch-1 sp around. Join. 96 (192) sts. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. [Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Picot. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Ch 2. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Picot) 18 times] once (twice).  Join. Fasten off. materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball each 494 Victory Red A, 12 Black B, and 424 Peach C
AUNT LYDIA’S® Metallic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball 1P White/Pearl D

[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Assembled Santa measures 1¾” x 3” (4.4 x 8 cm)
gauge: 10 dc = 1” (4 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Hat
With A, ch 10.
Row 1 (Right Side): Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 9 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 2, skip first st, dc in next st, dc in each st to last 2 sts, dc2tog; turn – 7 dc.
Rows 3 and 4: Repeat Row 2 – 3 dc.
Row 5: Ch 2, skip first dc, dc2tog; turn; turn – 2 dc.
Row 6: Ch 3, dc in next dc; turn – 2 dc.
Row 7: Ch 3, dc in next dc changing to B; turn.
Row 8: With B, ch 3, 2 dc in first dc, ch 1, turn, slip st in top of ch-3. Fasten off.
Beard
With D, ch 11.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 10 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 hdc in each sc across; turn – 20 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 1, skip first hdc, slip st in next 5 hdc, skip next hdc, [3 hdc in next hdc] twice, tr in next 3 hdc, [3 hdc in next hdc] twice, skip next hdc, slip st in last 5 hdc. Fasten off. 
Finishing
Weave in ends. Block if pieces won’t lie flat. With right side facing on all pieces and following photo for placement, glue Arms to Body, glue Face to tip of Body, glue Beard and Hat on Face. Glue assembled Santa to front of card.
Special Abbreviation
dc2tog (worked over 2 sts) = [yarn over and draw up a loop in next st, yarn over and draw through 2 loops] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Body
With A, ch 17.
Row 1 (Right Side): Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 16 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 2, skip first st, dc in next st (counts as dc2tog), dc in each st to last 2 sts, dc2tog; turn – 14 dc.
Rows 3-7: Repeat Row 2 – 4 dc.
Row 8: Ch 1, skip first dc, hdc in next 2 dc, ch 1, slip st in last dc – 2 hdc. Fasten off.
Left Arm
With right side facing, join A in end of Row 5 of Body.
Row 1: Ch 1, 3 hdc around post of dc on Row 5 of Body; turn – 3 hdc
Rows 2-4: Ch 1, hdc in each hdc; turn. At end of Row 4 change to B.
Row 5: With B, ch 1, hdc in each hdc; turn.
Row 6: Ch 2, skip first hdc, 2 dc in next hdc, ch 2, slip st in last hdc. Fasten off.
Right Arm
With right side facing, join A in end of Row 5 of Body opposite Left Arm. Repeat Rows 1-6 of Left Arm.
Face
With C, ch 4; join with slip st to form ring; ch 1, 8 sc in ring; do NOT join; sc in each sc around without joining until circle measures 1” in diameter, working 2 sc in next sc whenever ...

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball of 9010 Charcoal or 9851 Royal Blue A

instructions:
BOOT TOPPER (Make 2)

RUFFLE
Yarn Note: Stretch one end of B open for 10” (25.5 cm) and lay flat, with the edge with the metallic thread at the bottom. Work stitches into the top two mesh loop threads of the yarn, leaving the metallic edge loose to form Ruffle.

Round 1 (Right side): *Skip next end of row st, skip next mesh loop, insert hook in next end of row st and next mesh loop and pull up a loop, skip next mesh loop, insert hook in next mesh loop, Yo and pull through 2 loops on hook (sc made); repeat from * around; join with slip st to first sc: 20 (25, 30) sc.

instructions:
Notes:
•  Turn at end of each rnd to alternate RS and WS of work.
•  Work ‘Bobble’ on WS rnds.
•  Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as stitch.
•  Join all rnds with sl st to first st unless otherwise indicated.
SMALL VERSION
**Ch 3.
1st rnd: (RS). 4 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join. 4 hdc. Turn.
2nd rnd: (WS). Ch 1. (1 sc. Bobble) in each hdc around. Join. 8 sts. Turn.
3rd rnd: (RS). Ch 2. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in next st) 4 times. Join. 12 sts. Turn.
4th rnd:  (WS). Ch 1. *1 sc in next dc. Bobble in next dc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
5th rnd: (RS). Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. Turn.
6th rnd: As 4th rnd.
7th rnd: (RS). Ch 2. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts) 4 times. Join. 16 sts. Turn.
8th rnd: As 4th rnd.
9th rnd: As 5th rnd.
10th rnd: As 4th rnd.
11th rnd:  (RS). Ch 2. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts) 4 times. Join. 20 sts. Turn.
12th rnd: As 4th rnd.
13th rnd:  (RS). Ch 2. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 4 sts) 4 times. Join. 24 sts. Turn.
14th rnd: As 4th rnd.
15th rnd: (RS). Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. Fasten off, leaving long yarn end.
MEDIUM VERSION
Work from ** to ** as given for Small Version.
15th rnd:  (RS). Ch 2. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 5 sts) 4 times. Join. 28 sts. Turn.
16th rnd:  (WS). Ch 1. *1 sc in next dc. Bobble in next dc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
17th rnd:  (RS). Ch 2. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 6 sts) 4 times. Join. 32 sts. Turn.
18th rnd: As 16th rnd.
19th rnd: (RS). Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. Fasten off, leaving long yarn end.
LARGE VERSION
Work from ** to ** as given for Small Version.
15th rnd:  (RS). Ch 2. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 5 sts) 4 times. Join. 28 sts. Turn.
16th rnd:  (WS). Ch 1. *1 sc in next dc. Bobble in next dc. Rep from * around. Join. Turn.
17th rnd: (RS). Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. Turn.
18th rnd: As 16th rnd.
19th rnd:  (RS). Ch 2. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 6 sts) 4 times. Join. 32 sts. Turn.
20th rnd: As 16th rnd.
21st rnd: (RS). Ch 2. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 7 sts) 4 times. Join. 36 sts. Turn.
22nd rnd: As 16th rnd.
23rd rnd:  (RS). Ch 2. (2 dc in next st. 1 dc in each of next 8 sts) 4 times. Join. 40 sts. Turn.
24th rnd: As 16th rnd.
25th rnd: (RS). Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join. Fasten off, leaving long yarn end.
FINISHING
Insert foam form into Tree, stretching Tree slightly to fit and folding final rnd over lower edge of foam form. Thread yarn end onto needle and weave through final rnd to gather and secure around foam. Pin Tree in position to foam if desired.

materials: RED HEART® Soft Baby Steps: 1 skein each 9600 White A, 9800 Baby Blue (for boy) or 9700 Baby Pink (for girl) B.
Small child’s hanger, yarn needle, fiberfill, 2–7/16” buttons La Mode® 2064, ¼” ribbon, glue gun and glue stick.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: 8 sts = 4”; 8 rows = 4” in pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BODY
Row 1: With larger hook and A, ch 11 and PBS in 2nd ch from hook. Sc in next ch, alternate PBS and sc across, ch 1—10 sts.
Row 2: PBS in each sc and sc in each PBS across; ch 1 and turn—10 sts.
Row 3: Work (PBS, sc) in first sc (increase made); PBS in each sc and sc in each PBS across to last 2 sts; (sc, PBS) in next st (increase made); sc in last sc; ch 1 and turn—12 sts.
Row 4: Repeat Row 2—12 sts.
Row 5: Repeat Row 3—14 sts.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2—14 sts.
Row 7: Repeat Row 3—16 sts.
Rows 8-12: Repeat Row 2—16 sts.
Row 13: Repeat Row 3—18 sts.
Rows 14-16: Repeat Row 2—18 sts.
Row 17: Repeat Row 3—20 sts.
Rows 18-20: Repeat Row 2—20 sts.
Row 21: Repeat Row 3—22 sts.
Rows 22-24: Repeat Rows 2—22 sts.
Row 25: PBS in first sc; sc2tog; PBS in each sc and sc in each PBS across to last 4 sts; sc2tog; PBS in next sc and sc in last st; ch 1 and turn—20 sts.
Rows 26-28: Repeat Rows 18-20—20 sts.
Row 29: Repeat Row 25—18 sts.
Rows 30-32: Repeat Rows 18-20—18 sts.
Row 33: Repeat Row 25—16 sts.
Rows 34-36: Repeat Rows 18-20—16 sts.
Row 37: Repeat Row 25—14 sts.
Rows 38-40: Repeat Rows 18-20—14 sts.
Row 41: Repeat Row 25—12 sts.
Row 42: Repeat Row 18—12 sts.
Row 43: Repeat Row 25—10 sts.
Row 44: Repeat Row 18—10 sts.
At the end of Row 44 fold piece in half. Sew ends up and place hanger inside. Sew top part of pouch around top of hanger.
HEAD
Round 1: With larger hook and B, ch 2; [PBS, sc] 3 times in 2nd ch from hook, do not join—6 sts.
Round 2: Change to A, (PBS, sc) in each st around—12 sts.
Round 3: *PBS in next sc; sc and PBS in next st; repeat from * around—18 sts.
Round 4: *PBS in next sc; sc in next PBS; (PBS, sc) in next st; repeat from * around—24 sts.
Round 5: *PBS in next sc; sc in next PBS; PBS in next sc; (sc, PBS) in next st; repeat from * around—30 sts.
Round 6: *Sc in next 3 sc; 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st and fasten off—30 sts.
EARS
(Make 2 Outer Ears and 2 Inner Ears)
Outer Ears
Row 1: With smaller hook and A, ch 2 and 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook; ch 1 and turn—3 sts.
Row 2: 2 sc in first sc; sc in next sc; 2 sc in last sc; ch 1 and turn—5 sts.
Row 3: Sc in each sc across, ch 1 and turn—5 sts.
Row 4: Repeat Row 2—7 sts.
Row 5: Repeat Row 3—7 sts.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2; ch 1 and turn—9 sts.
Row 7: Repeat Row 2 and fasten off—9 sts.
Inner Ears
With smaller hook and B, repeat Rows 1-7 of outer ear pattern. When inner ear is complete, with A work 1 row of slip st around piece except across base. Place wrong sides of outer and inner ears together and slip st through both pieces to join.
MUZZLE
Round 1: With smaller hook and B, ch 2 and 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join—3 sts.
Round 2: With A; 2 sc in each sc around—6 sts.
Round 3: *Sc in sc; 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—9 sts.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sc; 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—12 sts.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around; slip st in next sc and fasten off.
FINISHING
Fold ears in half and sew in place on head. Sew head to body. Stuff muzzle and sew in place on head. Tie ribbon in a bow and glue under head as shown.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver™ Super Craft Kit™ - 1 Kit
Contrast A Soft White 1 ball or 93 yds/85 m
Contrast B Shocking Pink 1 ball or 11 yds/10 m
Contrast C Cherry Red 1 ball or 22 yds/20 m
Contrast D Pumpkin 1 ball or 22 yds/20 m
Contrast E Saffron 1 ball or 22 yds/20 m
Contrast F Spring Green 1 ball or 22 yds/20 m
Contrast G Royal 1 ball or 11 yds/10 m
Contrast H Lavender 1 ball or 11 yds/10 m
Contrast I Gray Heather 1 ball or 22 yds/20 m
Contrast J Jade 1 ball or 22 yds/20 m
Sizes U.S. D/3 (3.25 mm) and U.S. 7 (4.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge
Susan Bates® split lock stitch markers
Optional: Coats Dual Duty XP® all-purpose thread in matching color
measurements: Leg Insert Strip: Approx 5" [12.5 cm] wide x 30" [76 cm] long.
gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
TRIANGLE MOTIF (make 2)
See diagram on page 4.
Triangle Motif 1: Color 1 – Shocking Pink; Color 2 – Spring Green.
Triangle Motif 2: Color 1 – Cherry Red; Color 2 – Jade.
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch 3). (3 dc. Ch 3) twice in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-6. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to any ch-3 sp. Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch 3). 3 dc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 2. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * once more. Ch 2. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-6. Fasten off.
3rd rnd: Join Soft White with sl st to any ch-3 sp. Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch 3). 3 dc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * once more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-6. Fasten off.
SQUARE MOTIF (make 10 total)
See diagram on page 4.
Square Motif 1 (make 2): Color 1 – Pumpkin; Color 2 – Gray Heather; Color 3 – Saffron.
Square Motif 2 (make 2): Color 1 – Jade; Color 2 – Saffron; Color 3 – Spring Green.
Square Motif 3 (make 2): Color 1 – Royal; Color 2 – Shocking Pink; Color 3 – Jade.
Square Motif 4 (make 2): Color 1 – Cherry Red; Color 2 – Lavender; Color 3 – Pumpkin.
Square Motif 5 (make 2): Color 1 – Spring Green; Color 2 – Cherry Red; Color 3 – Gray Heather.
With larger hook and Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 5 (counts as dc and ch 2). (1 dc. Ch 2) 7 times in ring. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-5. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to any ch-2 sp. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in same sp as sl st. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-2 sp) 7 times. Ch 1. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off.
3rd rnd: Join Color 3 with sl st to any ch-1 sp. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in same sp as sl st. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 5. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) 3 times. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 5. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.
4th rnd: Join Soft White with sl st to any ch-5 sp. Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch 3). 3 dc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-5 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-6. Fasten off.
Join 2 Motifs: Work 1st to 3rd rnds as given for Square Motif.
4th rnd: With larger hook, join Soft White with sl st to any ch-5 sp. Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch 3). 3 dc in same sp as sl st. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. *(3 dc. Ch 1. Sl st in corresponding ch-3 sp of adjoining Motif. Ch 1. 3 dc) in next ch-5 sp.* Sl st in corresponding ch-1 sp of adjoining Motif. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Sl st in corresponding ch-1 sp of adjoining Motif. Rep from * to * once more. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-5 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-6. Fasten off.
LEG INSERT STRIP (make 2)
Make 2 Strips joining 1 Triangle Motif and 5 Square Motifs into first Strip as shown in photo.
FINISHING
Pin Leg Insert Strips to measurements. Cover with a damp cloth, leaving cloth to dry. We chose slim fit denim jeans with 30" [76 cm] inseam. Cut outer side seam carefully from hem edge upward for approx 29" [73.5 cm], following along seam line.
Side edges of opening: Fold side edge of jeans opening to WS and press in position. Using tailor’s chalk, draw a line to establish height of 1 row of sc - approx ¼" [.5 cm] from edge of fold line. Mark spots approx 3/8" [.75 cm] evenly spaced apart to indicate where each sc will be worked.
Optional: Fold side edge of jeans opening to WS of fabric and press in position. With sewing machine set to longest stitch length, sew ¼" [.5 cm] from folded edge. Note: Be sure to keep fabric flat as this row of machine stitches will later be worked into with crochet hook.
Foundation row to attach Leg Insert Strip: With RS of jeans facing, beg at hem edge, insert U.S. D/3 (3.25 mm) crochet hook through all layers of fabric from front to back. Yoh with Soft White and draw up a loop, being careful not to split strands of yarn. *Insert crochet hook into next marked spot approx 3/8" [.75 cm] apart. Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook – sc made. Rep from * up bottom of jeans to top of opening, then down across opposite side of opening to hem edge. Fasten off.
Align Leg Insert Strip, having Triangle Motif at top of opening - slightly adjust to fit length of opening as needed. With A, sew Leg Insert Strip to foundation row through back loops, using Whipstitch.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m) Main Color (MC) 2 balls
Red Heart® All in One™ Granny Square™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 417 yds/381 m) Contrast A 1 ball
Red Heart® All in One™ Flower Square™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 417 yds/381 m) Contrast C 1 ball

abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: To fit hip measurement XS/S/M 32-42" [81.5-106.5 cm] L/XL/2XL 44-52" [112-132 cm] Finished hip measurement (Pants will stretch to fit) XS/S/M 37" [94 cm] L/XL/2XL 49" [124.5 cm]
gauge: Motif = Approx 6" [15 cm] square.
instructions:
The instructions are written for size XS/S/M. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written XS/S/M (L/XL/2XL). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to both sizes.

GRANNY SQUARE
Notes: 
• Granny Square Motifs begin with Color 1 (shortest color rep) from center of pull-skein, leaving a 4" [10 cm] tail to weave in.
• Each color aligns with 1 rnd in the Motif with 5 colors in total. If too much color is left at end of rnd, pull back some sts and slightly loosen gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change. If too little color is left, pull back some sts and slightly tighten gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change.
• When Motif is complete, cut yarn where Color 5 (longest color rep) ends, leaving a tail for weaving in. Begin next Motif with Color 1 and repeat 5 rnds for each Motif.
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
• Ch 6 at beg of rnds counts as dc and ch-3 sp.
• Join all rnds with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-6 unless otherwise indicated.

Make 10 (14) Motifs with A.
Make 11 (14) Motifs with B.
See diagram on page 4.

With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
4th and 5th rnds: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
Fasten off.

FLOWER POWER SQUARE
Notes: 
• Each Color aligns with specific round(s) in the Motif using 3 Colors in total.
• Motif begins with Color 1 (shortest color rep) from center of pull-skein, leaving a 4" [10 cm] tail to weave in.
• 2nd and 3rd rnds will be worked in Color 2.
• 4th, 5th and 6th rnds will be worked in Color 3.
• If too much color is left at end of rnd, pull back some sts and slightly loosen gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change. If too little color is left, pull back some sts and slightly tighten gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change.
• Leave long tail of Color 3 at end of Motif to use for joining Motifs during finishing.
• Adjust gauge as needed working 4th, 5th and 6th rounds of Flower Motif to maintain 6" [15 cm] square finished size to match finished size of Granny Motifs.

Make 10 (14) Motifs with C.
Make 11 (14) Motifs with D.
See diagram on page 4.

With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. Work 9 dc in ring. Join. 10 dc. Color 1 complete.
2nd rnd: Color 2 begins. Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 2 dc in each dc around. Join. 20 dc.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next dc. (Ch 3. 1 tr) in same st as last sl st. 3 tr in next dc. (1 tr. 1 dc) in next dc. Sl st in next dc. *(1 dc. 1 tr) in next dc. 3 tr in next dc. (1 tr. 1 dc) in next dc. Sl st in next dc. Rep from * around, ending by joining with sl st to top of ch-3 of previous (2nd) rnd. Color 2 complete.

How to wear: Link to video here.
Hold pants Front in front of you by grabbing one Front Tie with each hand. Bring your hands behind your back and tie the strings together like you would tie an apron. The pants should be snug around your waist.
You should be left with fabric and two Back Ties hanging down in front of you. This is the back of your pants. Take the fabric and pull it between your legs so it ends up behind you bringing it to waist level. The pants should now cover the back of your legs.
Starting from behind your back, take one Back Tie in each hand and wrap them around your waist. Tie them together in the front and make sure they’re secure.

abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.

Lnkdc = Insert hook down through lower horizontal bar in center of previous lnktr, yoh and draw up a loop. Insert hook in next stitch (through top loops in usual manner), yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through first 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through last 2 loops on hook – Linked Dc made.

Lnkdtr = Insert hook down through horizontal bar in center of previous lnkhdc, yoh and draw up a loop. Insert hook down through horizontal bar in right-most hdc one row below and draw up a loop. Insert hook down through horizontal bar in right-most hdc two rows below and draw up a loop. Draw up a loop in next unworked stitch three rows below. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 4 times – Linked Double Treble made.
Lnkhdc = Draw up a loop in center loop from previous stitch. Draw up a loop in next hdc (through top loops in usual manner). Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – Linked Hdc made.

Lnkhdc2tog = Draw up a loop in centre loop from previous st. Draw up a loop in next hdc (through top loops in usual manner). Yoh and draw up a loop in next hdc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook. – Linked Hdc2tog made.

Lnktr = Insert hook down through second lowest horizontal bar in center of previous lnkdtr, yoh and draw up a loop. Insert hook down through lowest horizontal bar in center of previous lnkdtr, yoh and draw up a loop. Draw up a loop in next stitch. (Yoh and draw through first 2 loops on hook) 3 times – Linked Tr made.

See diagram on page 8. Next row: (WS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. 1 lnkhdc in each of next 31 sts. (Working into next unworked st 3 rows below, 1 lnkdtr in next st. 1 lnktr in next st. 1 lnkdc in next st. 1 lnkhdc in next st) 11 times. 1 lnkhdc in each st to end of row. Fasten off. 96 sts.

Cut a rectangle measuring 9" x 13" [23 x 33 cm] using 3" [7.5 cm] thick foam for Armrest.

Using a spray adhesive, attach Back of Chaise foam pieces together.
As shown in Foam Assembly Diagram I on page 10.

SEAMING CHAISE COVER
See Flat Seaming Diagrams on page 11.

Match points marked A and B as indicated in Flat Seaming Diagrams.

PM 5" [12.5 cm] up from base of Front and Back Armrest caps, noting that marker is placed on left side of Front Armrest Cap and on the right side of Back Armrest Cap as shown in Flat Seaming Diagrams.

See Finished Seaming Diagrams on page 11.
With RS facing, match the following pairs and tack tog using safety pins, locking stitch markers, or waste yarn as follows: Match E to W, X to F, U to G, and H to V. Using a whipstitch, seam tog from E/W to H/V.

See diagrams on page 12.
With RS facing, match the following pairs and tack tog using safety pins, locking stitch markers, or waste yarn as follows: match T to I, Q to J, and K to R. Using a whipstitch, seam tog from T/I to K/R.
Make and Join Gusset
With MC, ch 14.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 lnkhdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 12 sts.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. 1 lnkhdc in each st to end of row. Turn.

Seam tog using whipstitch, replacing markers to be visible on RS of work when finished.

With RS facing, align Back Panel to Gusset tack tog using safety pins, locking stitch markers, or waste yarn, ensuring that the points indicated along Back Panel correspond to markers along Seat.
Seam tog using whipstitch from Y to X, X to A3, A3 to A2.
FRINGE
With A, ch 161.

Cut 6 lengths of A 62" [157.5 cm] long. With all strands tog, hold one end and with someone holding other end, twist strands to the right until they begin to curl. materials: 1 skein 3950 Charcoal or 400 Grey Heather B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 5 mm [US H-8]
Extra hooks in neighboring sizes (see notes)
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: Gauge: 17 sts (including ch sts) = 4" (10 cm); 17 rows = 4" (10 cm) in Moss Stitch. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
MOSS STITCH
Ch an even number of sts.
Row 1: Skip 3 ch, sc in next ch, * ch 1, skip 1 foundation ch, sc in next ch; repeat from * to end, turn.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as a stitch now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2 (counts as a stitch now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Repeat Row 3 only for Moss st.
SPECIAL TECHNIQUE
Crab Stitch: Sc in last st of previous row or round, * sc in next st to the RIGHT of last st worked; rep from * to end of row or round (reversing normal direction of work).
FRONT
With A, ch through 2 full color sequences, with the last loop on hook being the first loop of a new color just after a color change in the yarn.
Row 1 (right side): Skip 3 ch (counts as a st), sc in the 4th ch from hook, * ch 1, skip 1 foundation ch, sc in next ch; repeat from * until 1 full color sequence has been completed. Count the number of sc made in each individual color in the colorway and note it down. Work 1 more full color sequence, maintaining the same number of sc made in each individual color, then work one more st repeat (sc, ch 1). Leave remaining ch sts unworked, turn.
Row 2 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Note: As you work this row and all remaining rows, you MUST get the correct number of sc in each color in order to maintain the planned color pooling. Change hook sizes, or actual st used, to get the correct color in place. If you use the same number of sts per color that you counted on Row 1, it will work out.
Row 3 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in the next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Note: The color of the sts on this row will shift to the left or right by 1 st from the previous right side row depending on the colorway and if you are right or left handed. It doesn’t matter which direction the stitch shifts as long as it is off-set by 1.
Row 4 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in the next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Note: The color of the sts on this row will shift to the left or right by 1 st from the previous wrong side row depending on the colorway and if you are right or left handed. It doesn’t matter which direction the stitch shifts as long as it is off-set by 1.
Repeat Rows 3 and 4 until length of piece is equal to its width, ending on a Row 3 (right side row).
Unravel unused foundation ch sts and weave in yarn tail to secure foundation.
Border
With right side facing and smaller hook, join B with slip st in ch-2 space at beginning of last row.
Round 1 (right side): 2 sc in the same ch-2 space as joining slip st, sc in each ch-1 space and each sc across last row, 3 sc in corner sc, sc in each row edge down the side, 3 sc in corner sc, sc in each foundation st, 3 sc in corner ch-2 space, sc in each row edge up other side, sc in beginning ch-2 space (same space as joining slip st), join with slip st in first sc.
Round 2 (right side): Ch 1, 2 sc in same st as joining slip st. * sc in each sc to corner, 3 sc in corner st; repeat from * twice more, sc in each sc to end, sc in first st (same st as joining slip st), join with slip st in first sc.
Repeat Round 2 until piece measures 17 x 17" (43 x 43 cm).
Fasten off.
FOR TEXTURED BACK
Buttonhole Piece
With B, ch 59.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in second ch from hook and each ch across, turn – 58 sc
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, * dc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * to last st, dc in last st, turn.
Repeat Rows 2 until work measures 15¾" (40 cm) from beginning, ending after a wrong side row.
Next Row (buttonhole row, right side): Ch 1, sc in first st, [dc in next st, sc in next st] 4 times, * ch 1, skip next st, [sc in next st, dc in next st] 4 times, sc in next st; repeat from * 3 more times, ch 1, skip next st, [sc in next st, dc in next st] 4 times, turn.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in first st, [dc in next st, sc in next st] 3 times, dc in next st, * sc in next ch-1 space, [dc in next st, sc in next st] 4 times, dc in next st; repeat from * 3 more times, sc in next ch-1 space, [dc in next st, sc in next st] 4 times, dc in last st, turn.
Repeat Row 2 as above twice more.
Fasten off
Button Panel
With B, ch 59.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in second ch from hook and each ch across, turn – 58 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. 
Repeat the last row twice more.
Fasten off.
With wrong sides facing together, pin the Button Panel to top of Front piece, and Buttonhole Panel to sides and bottom of Front piece.
FOR PLAIN BACK
Buttonhole Panel
With B, ch 55.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in second ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 54 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. 
Work evenly in sc until work measures 8¼" (21 cm) from beginning, ending after a wrong side row.
Next Row (buttonhole row, right side): Ch 1, sc in each of first 4 sts, * ch 2, skip next 2 sts, sc in each of next 9 sts; repeat from * 3 more times, ch 2, skip next 2 sts, sc in last 4 sts, turn.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in each of first 4 sts, * 2 sc in next ch-2 space, sc in each of next 9 sts; repeat from * 3 more times, 2 sc in next ch-2 space, sc in each of last 4 sts, turn.
Work 2 more rows evenly in sc.
Fasten off.

• Pillow is made from two panels of different sizes worked back and forth in rows. When joining, ease the back panel to fit the front panel.

4th row: Ch 3. Dcfp around each of next 4 dcbp. *Dcbp around each of next 4 dcfp. Dcfp around each of next 4 dcbp. Rep from * to last st. 1 dc in last dc. Turn.

6th row: Ch 3. Dcbp around each of next 4 dcbp. *Dcfp around each of next 4 dcfp. Dcbp around each of next 4 dcbp. Rep from * to last dc. 1 dc in last dc. Turn. 
7th row: As 4th row.
8th and 9th rows: As 3rd and 4th rows.

Rep 3rd to 10th rows until work from beg measures approx 24" [61 cm], ending on 3rd or 7th row. Fasten off.
Back Panel

With right side facing, rotate square to first side, ch 1, working across ends of rows, skip first row, *work 3 hdc in next row, skip next row; repeat from * to Row 1; work 3 hdc in corner ch of Row 1, working across opposite side of foundation ch, hdc in each ch across to next corner ch, 3 hdc in next corner ch; working across ends of rows of 2nd side, skip first row, repeat from * to Row 35; work 3 hdc in first sc of Row 35, **hdc in each dc and ch-space of next fan, skip next sc; repeat from ** across Row 35; join with slip st in first hdc.

How to Make a gauge Swatch
Ch 13.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—12 sc.
Rows 2-16: Ch 1, turn; sc in each sc across. Swatch should measure 4” square. Adjust hook size if necessary to obtain correct gauge.
Note: To change colors, work last st of old color until 2 loops remain on hook, drop old color to wrong side, yo with new color and draw through both loops on hook. When colors will be used again in same row, carry colors across wrong side, working over them every few sts across long sections.
PILLOW
Back
With A, ch 53.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—52 sc.
Rows 2-66: Ch 1, turn; sc in each sc across. At end of row 66, do not fasten off.
Back Edging
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, turn; sc in each sc across row 66, rotate work, sc in edge of each row across left edge, rotate work, sc in free loop of each ch across bottom, rotate work, sc in edge of each row across right edge; join with slip st in first sc—236 sc. Fasten off.
Front (Use B, C and D for Pillow 1; B, C, D and E for Pillow 2 or B, C, D and F for Pillow 3)
Starting with B, work same as Back using the appropriate chart for changing colors and direction of Rows. Rows numbered on right-hand side are worked with right side facing. Rows numbered on left-hand side are worked with wrong side facing. In areas where consecutive Rows are worked on right side, fasten off first right side Row, then begin next right side Row (and each consecutive right side row) with sc in first sc on right side, fastening off each right side Row until next area with alternating (right side, wrong side) Rows.
Front Edging
Work same as Back Edging, matching edging colors with colors used on Front. Carry along colors not in use at back of work.
Assembly
With wrong sides of Front and Back together and Front facing, join A with slip st at top right-hand corner of Front. Working in back loops only of both thicknesses, sc in each sc along 3 edges, securing them together. Insert pillow form. Sc in each remaining sc along last edge. Join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Braided Edging 
With Front facing, join A with sc in first sc on any edge, ch 4. Remove hook and allow ch sts to dangle at front of work. Skip next sc and join B with sc in next sc, ch 4. Remove hook and allow ch sts to dangle at front of work. *Place A loop back on hook. Skip next sc, sc in next sc, ch 4. Remove hook and allow ch sts to dangle at front of work. Place B loop back on hook. Skip next sc, sc in next sc, ch 4. Remove hook and allow ch sts to dangle at front of work. Repeat from * around. Place A loop back on hook and join with slip st in first A sc. Fasten off A. Place B loop back on hook and join with slip st in first B sc. Fasten off B.
Note: When working Braided Edging, always make sure chains are twisted in same direction around entire pillow.
Finishing
Weave in all ends.

14th row: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. *With MC, 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. With B, Popcorn in next sc. (With B, 1 sc in next sc. Popcorn in next sc) twice. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. With B, Popcorn in next sc. (With B, 1 sc in next sc. Popcorn in next sc) twice. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
15th row: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. *With MC, 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. With B, 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. With B, 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
16th row: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. *With MC, 1 sc in next sc. With B, Popcorn in next sc. (With B, 1 sc in next sc. Popcorn in next sc) twice. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. With B, Popcorn in next sc. (With B, 1 sc in next sc. Popcorn in next sc) twice. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
17th row: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. *With B, 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. With B, 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
18th row: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. *With B, Popcorn in next sc. (With B, 1 sc in next sc. Popcorn in next sc) twice. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. With B, Popcorn in next sc. (With B, 1 sc in next sc. Popcorn in next sc) twice. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
19th row: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. *With MC, 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. With B, 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. With B, 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * to last 4 sts. With MC, 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Break B. Turn.
20th and 21st rows: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
22nd to 29th rows: As 6th to 13th rows, substituting C for A.
30th to 37th rows: As 14th to 21st rows, substituting A for B.
38th to 45th rows: As 6th to 13th rows, substituting B for A.
46th to 53rd rows: As 14th to 21st rows, substituting C for B.
54th to 85th rows: As 6th to 37th rows once more.
86th to 88th rows: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off at end of 88th row.

BACK (make 2 alike)
Ch 9. 
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. Turn. 8 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until work from beg (when slightly stretched) measures 22" [56 cm]. Do not fasten off. 
Turn work sideways and proceed as follows: 
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. Work 78 sc evenly across side of ribbing. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep 2nd row until work from beg (including ribbing) measures 14” [35.5 cm]. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Overlap Back pieces to match Front measurements with ribbing at center. Place Back pieces on Front with WS facing each other. Pin Back pieces to Front to secure while joining as follows:
With RS of Front facing, join C with sl st to both thicknesses at top right corner of Pillow.
1st rnd: Ch 1. Working through all thicknesses, work sc evenly around all edges, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to st. 
Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 2 skeins 885 Delft Blue A and 1 skein 316 Soft White B
abbreviations: Dec (decrease) = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 12 sts = 4”; 8 rows = 3” in pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
PILLOW (Make 2)
With A ch 55.
Row 1 (Right Side): Dc in 3rd ch from hook, * skip next ch, (sc, dc) in next ch; repeat from * to last 2 ch; skip next ch, sc in last ch; turn.
Rows 2-45: Ch 1, dc in first sc, * skip next dc, (sc, dc) in next sc; repeat from * to last 2 sts; skip next dc, sc in top of turning ch; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 45.

Statue
Begin at lower edge, with B ch 18.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 17 sc.
Rows 2-5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 6: Ch 3, 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, sc in next 17 sc; turn – 20 sc.
Rows 7 and 9: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 8: Ch 1, dec, sc in next 18 sc; turn – 19 sc.
Row 10: Ch 2, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 18 sc, inc; turn – 21 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, inc, sc to last sc, inc; turn – 23 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, inc, sc in each sc across; turn – 24 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, sc in each sc to last sc; inc; turn – 25 sc.
Divide for Book- Row 14 (Right Side): Ch 1, inc, sc in next 3 sc, dec; TURN – 6 sc.
Row 15: Ch 1, dec, sc in next 3 sc, inc; turn – 6 sc.
Row 16: Ch 1, slip st in first sc, dec, sc in next sc, dec. Fasten off.

Torso-Row 14: Resume working across all stitches: with right side facing, join B in next sc of last long row; ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn – 19 sc.
Rows 15-18: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Divide for Arm-Row 19 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc, dec; TURN – 5 sc.
Row 20: Ch 1, dec, sc in next 3 sc; turn – 4 sc.
Rows 21-28: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 29: Ch 1, [dec] twice; turn – 2 sc.

Torch-Row 30: Ch 1, [inc] twice; turn – 4 sc.
Row 31: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [inc] twice, sc in last sc; turn – 6 sc.
Row 32: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.

Flame-Row 33: Ch 1, slip st in next 2 sc, ch 1, sc in next 2 sc; TURN; turn – 2 sc.
Row 34: Ch 1, [inc] twice; turn – 4 sc.
Rows 35 and 36: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 37: Ch 1, [dec] twice; turn – 2 sc.
Row 38: Ch 1, dec; turn – 1 sc.
Row 39: Ch 1, sc in sc. Fasten off.

Neck and Head-Row 19: Resume working across all stitches: with wrong side facing, join B in next sc of last long row; ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn – 13 sc.
Row 20: Ch 1, dec, sc to last 2 sc; dec; turn – 11 sc.
Row 21: Ch 1, sc to last 2 sc; dec; turn – 10 sc.
Row 22: Ch 1, dec, sc to last 2 sc; dec; turn – 8 sc.
Rows 23 and 24: Ch 1, inc, sc to last sc; inc; turn – 12 sc at end of Row 24.
Rows 25-29: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Rows 30 and 31: Ch 1, dec, sc to last 2 sc; dec; turn – 8 sc at end of Row 31.
Edging
Ch 1, sc around entire piece, working 3 sc in each lower corner and in tip of flame, and increasing as necessary in other corners to keep work flat; join with a slip st in first sc.
Sew statue to front of pillow as shown in picture.

Points of Crown
With B, [ch 8, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 2 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in last 2 ch] 7 times. Fasten off. Sew around top of head.

Sew pillow front to back around 3 sides; insert pillow form, then continue sewing 4th side closed.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 3 skeins 3933 Dove A
RED HEART® Boutique Sashay Fringe™: 3 balls each 1968 Indigo B and 1975 Misty C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
gauge: 10 sts = 3½” (9 cm); 8 rows hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Cover
With A, ch 53.
Foundation Row (right side): Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—52 hdc.
Rows 1 and 2: Ch 2 (does not count as first st here and throughout), hdc in each st across, turn.
Row 3 (wrong side): Ch 2, working in front loop only, hdc in each st across, turn. Place st marker on end of row.
Rows 4 and 5: Ch 2, hdc in each st across, turn.
Row 6 (right side): Ch 2, working in back loop only, hdc in each st across, turn. Place st marker on end of row.
Repeat Rows 1–6 until piece measures 42” (106.5 cm). Fasten off.
With wrong side of cover facing, center pillow on cover and overlap ends to encase pillow. Pin side edges together and turn pillow so front of cover is facing. Place an additional marker on the first Row 3 closest to top edge to indicate first Ruffle Row. Remove all pins and stitch markers except those markers on the double-marked Row 3 and the next 10 marked rows down the front.
Cut eleven 3” (7.5 cm) strands of A (for fastening off mesh yarn at end of each Ruffle Row).

Ruffles
With B, work first Ruffle Row in double-marked Row 3.
Ruffle Row: Fold under cut edge and insert hook from back to front through doubled “thickness” of first space; working across marked row, insert hook in first unworked loop of cover, insert hook from front to back in next space and draw strand through all loops on hook (1 loop on hook), ruf hdc in each unworked loop across to last loop, insert hook from back to front in next space, fold B under and insert hook through double “thickness” of next space, insert hook in last unworked loop, pick up strand of A and draw through all loops on hook. Tie ends of A tightly in a square knot and cut B.
Repeat Ruffle Row with C in next marked row; repeat alternately with B and C in next 8 marked rows; then repeat once with B in last marked row.

FINISHING
Optional Apply fabric sealant to cut edge of mesh yarn to prevent unraveling.
With right side facing, place stitch marker on each side of row 18” (45.5 cm) below first Ruffle Row. With right sides together, fold lower section of cover at marked row over ruffles, then fold upper section at first Ruffle Row over lower section, overlapping evenly and ensuring that side edges match. Pin side edges closed. With A and working through all thicknesses, sew side edges together. Weave in ends. Turn cover right side out and insert pillow.

materials: Bernat® Maker Outdoor™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 249 yds/228 m)
Contrast B Summer Storm Gray (99003) 1 ball
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Round pillow form 16" [40.5 cm] in diameter.
gauge: 9 sc and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
FRONT AND BACK (Make 1 in Contrast A. Make 1 in Contrast B)
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc.
Ch 3.
1st rnd:  8 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 16 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 24 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in next hdc. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times all in next stitch. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook – bobble made. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 2 hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Bobble in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 32 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. 2 hdc in next st. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 hdc in each of last 3 sts. Join with sl st to first hdc. 40 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Bobble in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 4 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Bobble in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 48 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. *1 hdc in each of next 5 sts. 2 hdc in next st. Rep from * to last 5 sts. 1 hdc in each of last 5 sts. Join with sl st to first hdc. 56 hdc.
8th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Bobble in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 6 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Bobble in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 64 sts.
9th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. *1 hdc in each of next 7 sts. 2 hdc in next st. Rep from * to last 7 sts. 1 hdc in each of last 7 sts. Join with sl st to first hdc. 72 hdc.
10th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. Bobble in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 8 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 7 hdc. Bobble in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 80 sts.
11th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. *1 hdc in each of next 9 sts. 2 hdc in next st. Rep from * to last 9 sts. 1 hdc in each of last 9 sts. Join with sl st to first hdc. 88 hdc.
12th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. Bobble in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 10 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. Bobble in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 96 sts.
13th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 11 sts. 2 hdc in next st. Rep from * to last 11 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 11 sts. Join with sl st to first hdc. 104 hdc.
14th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 11 hdc. Bobble in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 12 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 11 hdc. Bobble in last hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 112 sts.
15th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.
Note: Insert pillow form at half-way point of joining Front and Back.
Join Front and Back: With WS tog, join B with sl st to any hdc. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 sc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Anne Geddes Baby™: 2 balls 100 Lily A, 1 ball each of 203 Daffodil B, 504 Robin C, 702 Rosie D and 591 Posy E for Version 1
OR 1 ball each of 100 Lily A, 504 Robin C and 801 Bluebell F for Version 2
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4mm [US G-6], 3.5mm [US E-4] and 3.25mm [US D-3]
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
gauge: 17 sc = 4” [10cm]; 19 rows = 4” [10cm] in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
FINISHING
Square Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join A in any corner st of Square, ch 1, sc 32 sts evenly spaced along each side of Square, slip st in first sc to join.
Repeat Edging around each Square.
Arrange 4 different contrasting Squares into 16” [40.5 cm] Square for Version 1. Arrange 2 Squares from each contrasting color, alternating colors, for Version 2. Turn each Square 90 degrees from previous Square so stripes are perpendicular to each other. With A, whipstitch 4 Squares together for Front piece. Repeat for Back piece.
Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join A in any corner st of Front piece, ch 1, sc 65 sts evenly spaced along each side of Front piece, working 3 sc in each corner, slip st in first sc to join.
Repeat Edging around Back piece.
Hold Front and Back pieces together with wrong sides together. Working through both layers, sc Front and Back pieces together around 3 sides. Insert pillow form. Sc last side closed. Fasten off. 
Weave in ends. 
Sew a button in each corner and in center of each side along top edge of Cozy for Pennant Bunting.
PENNANT BUNTING
Make 6
With 3.5mm [US E-4] hook and A, ch 24.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 23 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Decrease Row: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 21 sts.
Next Row: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Repeat last 2 rows until 3 sts remain.
Last Row: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc2tog. 
Fasten off.
Edging Round: With 3.5mm [US E-4] hook, join A in first ch along opposite edge of foundation ch, ch 8, slip st in same st for button loop, sc in each ch across, ch 8, slip st in same st for button loop, turn to work alongside edge, sc 20 sts evenly spaced along edge to last st, 3 sc in point, turn to work along opposite side edge, sc 20 sts evenly spaced along opposite side edge, slip st to first st. Fasten off.
Bunny or Bear Head
Make 6 Bunnies or Bears; 2 each in color of choice
With 3.25 [US D-3] hook, ch 4.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in next ch, sc in last ch – 4 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first st, 2 sc in next 2 sts, sc in last st – 6 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in last st – 8 sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in last st – 10 sts.
Rows 5-7: Sc in each st across.
Row 8: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 8 sts.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 2 sts, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last 2 sts – 6 sts.
Row 10: Ch 1, turn, skip first st, sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog – 4 sts.
Edging Round: Sc evenly spaced around edges to first st, slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Bunny Ears
Make 2 for each Bunny
With same color and 3.25 [US D-3] hook, ch 5.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 2 ch, 5 hdc in last ch, turn to work opposite edge of foundation ch, sc in next 3 ch, slip st to first sc to join. 
Fasten off.
Bear Ears
Make 2 for each Bear
With same color and 3.25 [US D-3] hook, ch 2.
Round 1: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Muzzle
Make 6
With A and 3.25 [US D-3] hook, ch 4.
Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next ch, 3 sc in last ch, turn to work opposite edge of foundation ch, sc in next 2 ch, slip st to first sc to join. 
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Refer to photograph while finishing. Sew Muzzle to Bunny or Bear face using sewing thread. For Bunny, stitch triangle shape at top of muzzle and fill in. Shape muzzle by making a vertical stitch with sewing thread at bottom center and pull tightly.
For Bear, nose is located in middle of muzzle; stitch triangle shape and fill in.
Embroider eyes on face. Sew Ears in place. Sew a Bunny or Bear Head in center of each Pennant. Sew Bunting onto pillow top using sewing thread in swag formation or as desired, leaving individual pennants loose.

gauge: 8 hdc = 4" [10 cm]; 7 rows = 4" [10 cm] in half double crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BOLSTER PILLOW END PIECE 1
Ch 4.
Round 1: Work 11 dc in 4th ch from hook, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 (skipped ch-3 count as first dc) – 12 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in same st as join, 2 dc in each dc around, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 24 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in same st as join, dc in next dc, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc] 11 times, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 36 dc.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in same st as join, dc in next 2 dc, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next 2 dc] 11 times, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 48 dc.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in same st as join, dc in next 3 dc, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc] 11 times, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 60 dc.
Fasten off and set aside.
END PIECE 2
Work Rounds 1-5 same as for End Piece 1. Do not fasten off.
BODY
Round 6: Ch 2 (counts as a hdc here and throughout), working in back loops only, hdc in each dc around, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2 – 60 hdc.
Round 7: Ch 2, working in both loops, hdc in each hdc around, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2 – 60 hdc.
Repeat last round 24 more times. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Insert pillow form into Body of pillow. Use yarn needle to sew first end piece to open end of body, enclosing pillow form. Weave in ends.

8th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 4 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 44 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 4 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 48 sc.

11th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 4 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 56 sc.

18th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of rem sc around. Join. 52 sc.
19th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of rem sc around. Join. 48 sc.
20th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of rem sc around. Join. 44 sc.
21st rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. 1 sc in each of rem sc around. Join. 40 sc.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (2 sc in next sc . 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Join. 48 sc.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Join. 56 sc.
24th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Join. 64 sc.
25th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Join. 72 sc.
26th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.

4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 60 sts.

7th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 54 sts.
8th and 9th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
10th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 48 sts.
11th and 12th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
13th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 42 sts.
14th and 15th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
16th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 36 sts.
17th and 18th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.

25th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 st. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
26th and 27th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
28th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 12 sts.
