FEET (make 4).
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 44 sc.
7th rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. (Sc2tog) 10 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 34 sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep 9th rnd until work from 7th rnd measures 3" [7.5 cm].
Proceed as follows: 
1st rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog) twice. Join. 30 sts.

3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 27 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 24 sts.

Large Spikes (make 9).

3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 6 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 8 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 10 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 12 sc.

10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

instructions:
FRONT AND BACK HEART (make alike)

With MC, ch 2.

29th to 44th row: Rep 27th and 28th rows 8 times more, inc 2 sts every other row, ending on a WS row. 70 sts at end of 44th row.

Proceed with Right Lobe as follows:
Right Lobe
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 34 sc. Turn leaving rem sts unworked. 34 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Skip first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 32 sts.

Left Lobe
With RS facing, skip next 2 unworked sc of 56th row of Lower Heart. Join MC with sl st to next sc. 1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 34 sc.
Beg with 2nd row, work as for Right Lobe across left side of Lower Heart.

Trim
1st rnd: (RS). Join MC with sl st to bottom tip of Lower Heart. Work sc evenly around Heart, making sure total number of sc is a stitch multiple of 4. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.

Joining Front and Back: 1st rnd: (RS). With WS of Front and Back facing each other, join A with sl st to any edge st of Pillow. Ch 1. Note: Bobble Pompom Edging worked over st multiple of 4 sts.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 4. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 10 times all in 4th ch from hook. Yoh and draw through all 11 loops on hook. Bobble Pompom in 4th ch from hook. Sl st in same 4th ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.

With MC, ch 43.
Foundation row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 41 hdc.

Next row: (RS). Ch 2. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. Place marker at end of last row.
Next row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 16" [40.5 cm], ending on a WS row.
Next row: (RS). Ch 2. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn. Place marker at end of last row.
Next row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures approx 20" [51 cm], ending on a WS row.

Ribbing: With A, ch 9.

instructions:
Note: Work in back loops only throughout.
Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
SIDE ONE
With 2 strands of A held tog, ch 4. 
Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 11 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 12 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 24 dc.
Break 1 strand of A. Join 1 strand of B.
3rd rnd: With 1 strand each of A and B held tog, ch 3. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last dc. 1 dc in last dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 36 dc.
4th rnd: Ch 3. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 2 dc. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Break A. Join 2nd strand of B. 48 dc.
5th rnd: With 2 strands of B held tog, ch 3. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 3 dc. 1 dc in each of last 3 dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 60 dc.

SIDE TWO
With 2 strands of B held tog, ch 4. 
Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 11 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 12 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 24 dc. Break 1 strand of B. Join 1 strand of A.
3rd rnd: With 1 strand each of B and A held tog, ch 3. Working in back loops, 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last dc. 1 dc in last dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 36 dc.
4th rnd: Ch 3. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 2 dc. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Break B. Join 2nd strand of A. 48 dc.
5th rnd: With 2 strands of A held tog, ch 3. Working in back loops only, 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 3 dc. 1 dc in each of last 3 dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 60 dc.
6th rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). Working in back loops, 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *1 dc in each of next 4 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 4 dc. 1 dc in each of last 4 dc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 72 dc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With WS of Sides One and Two tog, join B with sl st to back loop of any dc. Working through both thicknesses, join sides by working 1 sl st into back loop of each dc around. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Gumdrop®: 3 balls 620 Cherry A
RED HEART® Lolli™: 1 ball 9764 Watermelon B
Yarn needle, 2 stitch markers, four 1½” (38 mm) buttons, 16” (40.5 cm) square pillow form, sewing needle and matching thread (optional).
abbreviations: A and B = Yarn A, and Yarn B
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 9 sts = 4” (10 cm); 8 rows = 4” (10 cm) in pattern with A. CHECK YOUR GAUGE.
instructions:
Rows 2–5: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), hdc in each st across; change to B at end of Row 5, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, loosely sc in each st across; change to A, turn—36 sc.
Rows 7–9: Repeat Row 2 three times; change to B at end of Row 9.
Row 10: Repeat Row 6.
Rows 11–15: Repeat Row 2 five times; change to B at end of Row 15.
Rows 16–65: Repeat Rows 6-15 five times.

Flap
Row 66: Repeat Row 6. Note. Place a stitch marker at each end of row for assembly.
Rows 67 and 68: Repeat Row 2 twice.
Row 69 (buttonhole row): Ch 2, hdc in first 6 sts, ch 2, skip next 2 sts (for buttonhole), hdc in next 5 sts, ch 2, skip next 2 sts, hdc in next 6 sts, ch 2, skip next 2 sts, hdc in next 5 sts, ch 2, skip next 2 sts, hdc in remaining sts, turn—28 hdc and 4 ch-2 spaces (for buttonholes).
Row 71: Ch 2, *hdc in each st to next ch-2 space, hdc in next 2 ch; repeat from * 3 times, hdc in remaining sts—36 hdc. Fasten off. 
Fold cover at Row 33 so that Row 1 is aligned with marked row and all B rows match. Pin sides together. Hold cover with wrong side of flap facing and to your left (hold to your right if you are left-handed).
Row 72: Working through both thicknesses and across ends of rows between first 2 sts, join B with sc in first row at bottom of cover, sc evenly spaced across ends of rows and flap to last row, 3 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 3 sc in last st, working across ends of rows, sc evenly spaced across other end of flap and ends of rows through both thicknesses and between first 2 sts. Fasten off.

Notes
1. Hold two strands of A together throughout.
2. Working with B:
   a. The yarn is comprised of a strand of chenille and a strand of thread. Treat the yarn as if it were one strand; do not work into spaces between the chenille and thread. 
   b. Work with a slightly looser tension than with A.
   c. Begin each wrong side row with a plain section of yarn, not at a cluster of loops (if necessary, cut off the first cluster before joining the yarn at the end of the previous row). When you reach a cluster, do not work into it or pull through a loop; instead, guide it to the right side of the fabric and continue to crochet with the plain sections of the strand.
3. To change yarn at the end of a row or round, work last stitch of old yarn to last yarn over. Yarn over with new yarn and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new yarn. Cut old yarn.
4. Catch the tails behind the stitching of the next row to minimize weaving in ends. Weaving in doesn’t need to be too precise as all ends will be tucked into the wrong side of the pillow cover before the pillow form is inserted.
5. If your buttons are sew-through style with holes, be sure to create a shank when sewing to the pillow cover so the fabric doesn’t tug when buttoned.

PILLOW COVER
With 2 strands of A held together, ch 37.
Row 1 (right side): Hdc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch counts as first hdc) and in each ch across, turn—36 hdc.
obtain the gauge.

instructions:
USING THIS GUIDE
Click on the underlined words throughout the pattern to access our library of helpful tools.

NOTES
• Chain (Ch) 2 at beg of row does not count as half double crochet (hdc).
• Cross stitch details are worked after Pillow Front is complete.
• Row gauge is taller than usual to accommodate for the cross stitch stitches.

FRONT
With MC, chain (ch) 86.
1st row: 1 single crochet (sc) in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 85 stitches (sts).
2nd row: 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Repeat (Rep) 2nd row until 85 rows are worked.
Fasten off.
Using Cross Stitch Charts, cross stitch design onto Front, noting that 1 sc is equal to 1 square on Chart. Design is divided into 6 charts shown on pages 5 to 10.

BACK (make 2 alike)
With MC, ch 86.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 85 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 14" [35.5 cm].
Next row: Ch 2. 1 half double crochet (hdc) in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. *1 half double crochet front post (hdcfp) around next hdc. 1 half double crochet back post (hdcbp) around next hdc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 16" [40.5 cm].
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Joining Front and Back: Overlap Back pieces to match Front, with ribbed sections in center to create opening to insert pillow form. Pin in place for easier joining. With RS facing, join yarn with slip stitch to any corner st of Pillow. Ch 1. Working through all thicknesses, work sc evenly around 4 sides of Pillow, having 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Insert pillow form.

instructions:
MOTIF
With A, make 9.
See Diagram on page 2.
Notes: 
•  Motifs begin with Color 1 (shortest section of color rep) from center of ball, leaving a 4" [10 cm] tail to weave in.
•  All color changes occur at end of rnd where colors are spliced together.
•  Each color aligns with 1 rnd in the Motif with 5 colors in total. 
•  If too much color is left at end of rnd, pull back some sts and slightly loosen gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change. 
•  If too little color is left, pull back some sts and slightly tighten gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change.
•  Color change occurs where yarn is spliced together and should align with sl st at end of rnd. 
•  If splicing is visible on RS adjust sts so splice sits to WS or work over splice on next rnd.
•  At end of final rnd Motif should measure 10½" [26.5 cm] square. 
Cut yarn where Color 5 (longest section of color rep) ends, leaving approx 42" [106.5 cm] tail at end of Motif for joining.
•  Begin next Motif with Color 1 and rep 5 rnds for each Motif.
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
• Ch 6 at beg of rnds counts as dc and ch-3 sp.
• Join all rnds with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-6 unless otherwise indicated.
Ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join. 
2nd rnd: Sl st in next ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
4th and 5th rnds:  Sl st in next ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
Fasten off, leaving 42" [106.5 cm] tail.
FINISHING
Seaming with Flat Sl St Join: (RS). With B, sl st Motifs tog, working through back loops only and keeping working yarn to WS of work to create a flat sl st chain detail on RS of work (see diagram). Join Motifs into 3 horizontal strips, having 3 Motifs in each strip. Join 3 Strips tog following Seaming Diagram.
Note: Keep working yarn to WS of work so only flat sl st chain is visible on RS.
Assembly 
Fold 3 corners to meet in center, as shown in Assembly diagram, to form a square. With B, and using the Flat Slip St Join method, join seams on RS, leaving 4th corner open to insert pillow form. Insert pillow form. Join rem seam. 
Note: Pillow form will fit snugly.
Tassels (Make 4)
Wrap B around a 6" [15 cm] piece of cardboard 20 times. Tie securely at one end. Cut across other end. Wrap A 5 times around tassel 1" [2.5 cm] from tied end and fasten securely. Using long tails, sew 1 Tassel to each corner of Pillow (as shown in photo).

instructions:
Snowflake Motif
With B, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1 here and throughout), [dc, ch 1] 11 times in ring, join with a slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—12 ch-1 spaces.
Round 2: Slip st in next ch-1 space, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 2 dc in next ch-1 space, *ch 2, dc in next ch-1 space, 2 dc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * 5 times, ch 2, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—6 ch-2 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in next st, *2 dc in next st, (dc, ch 3, dc) in next ch-2 space**, dc in each of next 2 sts, 2 dc in next st; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—6 ch-3 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 4, [skip next st, dc in next st, ch 1] twice, *(dc, ch 3, dc) in ch-3 space**, [ch 1, skip next st, dc in next] 3 times; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—6 ch-3 spaces; 24 ch-1 spaces.
Round 5: Ch 3, [dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next dc] 3 times, *dc in next ch-3 space, ch 7, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each of next 6 ch (spoke made), dc in same space in Round 4**, [dc in next dc, dc in next ch-1 space] 4 times, dc in dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, dc in next dc, dc in next ch-1 space, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—6 spokes.
Round 6: Ch 3 (counts as hdc, ch 1), [skip next st, hdc in next st, picot, ch 1] 3 times, skip next st, *skip first ch of spoke, slip st in next ch, slip st in next 4 ch sts of spoke, [ch 4, hdc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 2 ch, slip st in top middle of spoke] twice, working on opposite side of the spoke, slip st in each of next 4 sc**, [ch 1, skip next st, hdc in next st, picot, ch 1] 5 times, skip next st; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, ch 1, skip next st, hdc in next, picot, ch 1, skip next st, slip st to 2nd ch of beginning ch-3, picot, slip st in first ch-1 sp. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
FINISHING
To shape snowflake, mist with water, flatten and pin out to shape. After motif is dry, center and pin to pillow. Using matching sewing thread and sewing needle, sew snowflake motif to pillow around edges.
Special Abbreviations
picot: Ch 3, slip st in 3rd ch from hook.
Special Technique
adjustable ring: Holding yarn a few inches from the end, wrap around two fingers. Insert hook into wrap, pull up a loop, ch 1, remove loop from fingers. Work stitches of first round into the ring. To tighten ring, pull gently but firmly on yarn tail.
NOTES
For smooth, firm finish, pillow cover is worked in the round with yarn held doubled in un-joined rounds. The width has a 2” (5 cm) negative ease. It measures 2” [5 cm] shorter than pillow form for a tight, firm fit.
Keep pillow insert handy to check for fit. Alter size of pillow cover by adding or subtracting beginning chains & rounds as desired. Snowflake motif is worked separately in joined rounds with yarn held doubled and is sewn onto pillow top using matching sewing thread & sharp sewing needle for best results.
COVER
With smaller hook with 2 strands of A held together as one, ch 86 and without twisting ch, join with a slip st in first ch.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around, do not join—86 sc. Work in a spiral. Place marker in first st and move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2-57: Sc in each st around. Fasten off, leaving a sewing length. Turn cover inside out and whip stitch 1 end closed. Turn right side out, insert pillow form and whip stitch end closed. Set aside.

Special Stitches 
sc2tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

Round 6: Change to C, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 4 sts, [2 sc in st, sc in next 4 sts] 5 times, slip st in first st – 36 sts.
Round 7: Change to B, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 5 sts, [2 sc in st, sc in next 5 sts] 5 times, slip st in first st – 42 sts.
Round 8: Change to A, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 6 sts, [2 sc in st, sc in next 6 sts] 5 times, slip st in first st – 48 sts.
Rounds 9-17: Keeping in stripe pattern as established, ch 1, sc in each sc, slip st to first st.
Fasten off. Cut yarn, leaving a long tail. Make a pompom with C and sew on top of Hat.

PILLOW COVER
With larger hook and A, ch 90.
Round 1: Hdc in 3rd chain from hook and each ch across, slip st to first st to join – 88 sts.
Rounds 2-49: Hdc in each st around.
Fasten off. Cut yarn, leaving a long tail.

CLOSING STRAP
With smaller hook and A, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each sc across – 7 sts.
Rows 2-30: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Fasten off. Cut yarn, leaving a long tail.

FINISHING
Using long tails, stuff Muzzle with fiberfill and sew on to lower portion of Head. Flatten Ears and sew on either side of Head. Attach buttons or safety eyes on Head above Muzzle. Using black embroidery thread and straight stitches, sew nostrils on Muzzle and eyebrows above eyes. Sew Hat to top of Head, stuffing lightly with fiberfill. Sew last round of Pillow Cover closed. Insert pillow and sew opposite end closed. Sew Head in center of one long edge of Pillow Cover. Sew one end of Closing Strap in center of one short side of Pillow Cover. Sew one side of hook and loop fastener to opposite end of Closing Strap. Sew corresponding side of hook and loop fastener to corresponding spot on opposite short side of Pillow Cover. Weave in ends.

With wrong sides of 2 hearts held together, slip st through Round 5 of both layers until 1” remains open. Add fiberfill, slip st closed. Weave in ends. Repeat with remaining 2 hearts.

Round 1: With right side of Front facing, join D in upper right hand corner st, ch 3 (counts as first dc), 2 dc in corner st, ch 1, [skip next st, dc in next st] across to last st, 3 dc in last st, turn to work along side edge, 2 dc in edge of row, [ch 1, skip next row, dc in next row] across to last 2 rows, ch 1, skip next row, 2 dc in last row, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, 3 dc in first st, ch 1, [skip next st, dc in next st] across to last st, 3 dc in last st, turn to work along side edge, 2 dc in edge of row, [ch 1, skip next row, dc in next row] across to last 2 rows, ch 1, skip next row, 2 dc in last row, ch 1, join with slip st to top of beginning ch 3.  
Fasten off.  
Round 2: Join B in top of beginning ch, ch 1, sc in first 3 dc, *[dc in next dc 2 rounds below, pulling dc up to current level of work, sc in next dc] across to first dc of corner 5-dc, sc in next 5 dc; repeat from * around to last side, [dc in next dc 2 rounds below, pulling dc up to current level of work, sc in next dc] across to last 2 dc, sc in next 2 dc, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts, *[skip next st, sc in next 3 sts] 12 times, sc in next 48 sts; repeat from * around to last side, [skip next st, sc in next 3 sts] to last 2 sts, sc in next 2 sc, join with slip st in first sc.
Repeat Border around Pillow Block.
FINISHING
Round 1: Holding wrong sides together, join B in one Block with crochet hook, working through sts of two Blocks, ch 1, sc in each st around 3 sides, turn to work along last side, sc in each st across on only 1 piece 
Fasten off. 
Insert pillow form. 
Whipstitch opening closed. 
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 3 skeins 661 Frosty Green A, 2 skeins 971 Camouflage B.
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 10 sts = 4”; 11 rows = 4” in sc with smaller hook and double strand of yarn. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Head
With smaller hook and double strand of A; ch 2, 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join but work in continuous rounds. Mark last st of round and move marker up each round.
Round 1: 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 2: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 3: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 5: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc] 6 times – 36 sc.
Round 6: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc] 6 times – 42 sc.
Round 7: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 6 sc] 6 times – 48 sc.
Rounds 8-19: Sc in each sc around.
Round 20: [Sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 42 sc.
Round 21: [Sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 36 sc.
Round 22: * [Sc2tog] 4 times, sc in next 10 sc; repeat from * around – 28 sc.
Round 23: * [Sc2tog] twice, sc in next 10 sc; repeat from * around – 24 sc. Fasten off leaving long tail for sewing.
Stuff Head with fiberfill, adding more as necessary before closing.
Shell
With larger hook and triple strand of B, ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc throughout), 11 hdc in ring; join with a slip st in top of ch-2 – 12 sts.
Round 2: Ch 2, 3 hdc in next hdc, [hdc in next hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc] 5 times; join – 24 sts.
Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in next hdc and in each hdc around; join.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in next hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc, [hdc in next 3 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc] 5 times, hdc in last hdc; join – 36 sts.
Round 5: Ch 2, hdc in next 2 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc, [hdc in next 5 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc] 5 times, hdc in last 2 hdc; join – 48 sts.
Round 6: Ch 2, hdc in next 3 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc, [hdc in next 7 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc] 5 times, hdc in last 3 hdc; join – 60 sts.
Round 7: Ch 2, hdc in next 4 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc, [hdc in next 9 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc] 5 times, hdc in last 4 hdc; join – 72 sts.
Round 8: Ch 2, hdc in next 5 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc, [hdc in next 11 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc] 5 times, hdc in last 5 hdc; join – 84 sts.
Round 9: Ch 2, hdc in next 6 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc, [hdc in next 13 hdc, 3 hdc in next hdc] 5 times, hdc in last 6 hdc; join – 96 sts.
Round 10: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc around. Fasten off.
Pillow Cover
With smaller hook and double strand of A, ch 74; join with a slip st in first ch being careful that ch is not twisted.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around; do not join – 74 sc. Work in continuous rounds as for Head.
Rounds 2-50: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off leaving long tail for closing seam.
Closing Strap
With smaller hook and double strand of A, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 7 sc.
Rows 2-30: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off leaving long tail for attaching to pillow cover.
Finishing
Using a long needle and thick thread, create eyes by sewing the buttons onto the face as pictured. Weave and trim ends.
Sew end seam of pillow cover closed, using yarn tail. Insert pillow and close opposite seam in same fashion.
Center shell on turtle body. Attach by sewing using yarn, making seams 1” from the edge of the shell to form shell edge.
Working along the short sides of the rectangular pillow, locate the midpoint. Pin the closing strap at this midpoint and attach securely by sewing using yarn tail. On the opposite side sew a 2” wide piece of loop side of the Velcro to the pillow cover using matching sewing thread and a sharp needle. Sew hook part of the Velcro along the end of the strap.
Working along the longer side of the rectangular pillow, locate the midpoint of the pillow and attach the head securely with yarn and a tapestry needle.

instructions:
Notes: 
• When changing color at end of 1st rnd, draw new color through 2 loops on hook and proceed in new color.
• Close and secure center of magic loop by pulling beginning and end tails of center color tightly and tying ends together. Cut yarn leaving approx 1" [2.5 cm] tail – no need to weave these ends in as they will be on inside of pillow and may be used to close spaces between Motifs once complete.
• Motifs are joined as you work.
• Work yarn from center of cake, allowing color changes to occur naturally.

**FIRST FLOWER MOTIF**
See Diagram on page 3.
With A, make magic loop.
1st rnd: Ch 2 (does not count as hdc). 12 hdc in Magic loop. Join B with sl st to top of first hdc. Pull tail end tightly to close center hole and secure on WS. Break B.

2nd rnd: With B, ch 3 (counts as dc). Yoh and draw up a long loop, equal in height to beg ch-3 in same hdc as sl st. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 6 times. Yoh and draw through 6 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through last 2 loops. Ch 3. Sl st in same hdc – first Petal made. *1 sc in next hdc. (Sl st. Ch 3. Cluster. Sl st) in next hdc – Petal Cluster made. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sc in last hdc. 6 petals total.

3rd rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). *1 sc in top of next Petal. Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. Rep from * 5 times more. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-4. Fasten off.

**SECOND MOTIF (Join 1 side)**
Work from ** to ** as given for First Motif, using B for 1st rnd and joining A to work subsequent rnds. 3rd rnd: With A, ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). 1 sc in top of next Petal. Join with sl st in sc in top of any Petal of adjoining Motif. Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in top of next Petal. Sl st in sc in top of next Petal of adjoining Motif. *Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in top of next Petal. Rep from * 3 times more. Ch 1. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-4. Fasten off.

**NEXT MOTIF (Join 2 sides)**
Using B for 1st rnd and joining A to work subsequent rnds, work from ** to ** as given for First Flower Motif.
3rd rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). 1 sc in top of next Petal. Sl st in sc in top of first (right) adjoining Motif before existing join. Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in top of next Petal. Sl st in same sc as existing join. Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in top of next Petal. Sl st in sc in top of second (left) Motif after existing join. *Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in top of next Petal. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-4. Fasten off.

**FINISHING**
Following Assembly Diagram as color reference, join rem Motifs. Fold piece and sew Petals at either end together, matching ‘peaks and valleys’. Align ‘peaks and valleys’ along sides and sew Petals tog on one side. Insert pillow form and sew opposite side edge.

instructions:
Notes:

FRONT
With A, ch 36.
Working Chart, noting each square of chart is equal to 1 sc and reading RS rows from right to left and WS rows from left to right. Do not carry color not in use across top of previous row. Change colors by drawing new color through last 2 loops on hook and proceed with new color.

pattern_name: Square Peg and Round Holes Pillow
materials: STITCH NATION by Debbie Stoller™ “Full o’ Sheep™”: 3 balls 2205 Little Lamb 2510 A
STITCH NATION by Debbie Stoller™ “Full o’ Sheep™”: 7 balls 2205 Little Lamb 2510 A
3 yards heavy cotton yarn in a contrasting color
abbreviations: A, B, and C = color A, color B, and color C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Pillows measures 16” x 16” square, after felting.
gauge: 10 sts and 8 rows = 4” in half double crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge. Gauge is loose so that yarn will felt.
instructions:
Square Peg Pillow
Squares (Make 2)
Round 1 (Right Side): With C, ch 3 (beginning ch counts as hdc), 7 hdc in 3rd ch from hook; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—8 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), [3 hdc in next st (corner made), hdc in next st] 3 times, 3 hdc in next st (corner made); join with slip st in top of beginning ch—16 hdc (consisting of four 3-hdc corners and 1 hdc on each side between corners).
Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in next st, [3 hdc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts] 3 times, 3 hdc in next st, hdc in next st; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 hdc. Place a marker in the center hdc of each 3-hdc corner.
Round 4: Ch 2, [hdc in each st to next marker, 3 hdc in marked st, move marker to center hdc of 3-hdc corner just made] 4 times, hdc in each remaining st to end of round; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—32 hdc.
Repeat Round 4 until square measures 5” across. Fasten off C. 
NOTE: Each round increases the stitch count by 8 stitches.
With Right Side facing, join A with slip st in top of beginning ch. 
Repeat Round 4 once. Fasten off A. 
With Right Side facing, join B with slip st in top of beginning ch. 
Repeat Round 4 until square measures 16” across. Fasten off B. 
With Right Side facing, join A with slip st in top of beginning ch. 
Repeat Round 4 until square measures 25” across. Fasten off first square. Do not fasten off 2nd square.
FiNiSHiNg
Hold squares with Wrong Sides together. 
Seaming: Working through both thicknesses, [sc in each st to next corner st, sc in corner st] 2 times, sc in each st to about 2” from next corner. Note: Three sides of pillow should now be seamed, with top edge and top corners left open. 
With doubled strand of heavy cotton yarn, baste top edge and corners together. Note: It is very important that basting yarn is cotton. Cotton is easier to remove after pillow has been felted.
Felt Pillow: Weave in ends (except ends of basting yarn). Place pillow in washing machine. Wash using hot water, maximum agitation, and a small amount of laundry soap. Check progress of felting every 3-5 minutes. Remove pillow from washer before spin cycle. Repeat wash cycle until desired level of felting is achieved. Rinse in sink. Gently squeeze excess water from pillow, pull into shape and allow pillow to dry. Remove basting cotton. Insert pillow form. With A, sew top edge and corners closed.
Felting Hints: A few pairs of jeans or a couple of old bath towels (avoid very fluffy towels that may produce lint) can be added to the washing machine to increase agitation. Place pillow in a lingerie bag or pillow case before felting to capture lint.

rouNd HoleS Pillow
Squares (Make 2)
Round 1 (Right Side): With A, ch 3 (beginning ch counts as hdc), 7 hdc in 3rd ch from hook; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—8 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), [3 hdc in next st (corner made), hdc in next st] 3 times, 3 hdc in next st (corner made); join with slip st in top of beginning ch—16 hdc (consisting of four 3-hdc corners and 1 hdc on each side between corners).
Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in next st, [3 hdc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts] 3 times, 3 hdc in next st, hdc in next st; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 hdc. Place a marker in the center hdc of each 3-hdc corner.
Round 4: Ch 2, [hdc in each st to next marker, 3 hdc in marked st, move marker to center hdc of 3-hdc corner just made] 4 times, hdc in each remaining st to end of round; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—32 hdc. 
Repeat Round 4 until square measures 25” across. NOTE: Each round increases the stitch count by 8 stitches.
Fasten off first square. Do not fasten off 2nd square.
Circles (Make 9 – 4 with B and 5 with C)
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 3 (beginning ch counts as hdc), 7 hdc in 3rd ch from hook; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—8 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), hdc in same st as join, 2 hdc in each remaining st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—16 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 2, 2 hdc in next st (increase made), [hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st (increase made)] 7 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 hdc. Place a marker in 2nd hdc of each 2-hdc increase.

Whether used on the sofa or in the bedroom, this adorable owl adds a touch of color and playfulness to your style. Crochet him in the colors shown, or change them up to suit your décor.
OWL
Note When fastening off, leave long tails on each piece for sewing.
Body
Beginning at top of head, with B, ch 10.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—9 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc to last sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—11 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Rows 4–9: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 three times—17 sc.
Rows 10 and 11: Repeat Row 3.
Rows 12–14: Repeat Row 2—23 sc.
Rows 15–28: Repeat Row 3.
Row 29: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—21 sc.
Rows 30 and 31: Repeat Row 3.
Rows 32–37: Repeat Row 29—9 sc.
Fasten off.
Ears (make 2)
With B, ch 6.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next sc, sc2tog, turn—3 sc.
Rows 4 and 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc3tog—1 sc. Fasten off.
PILLOW (make 2)
With A, ch 49.
Row 1 (right side): Dc in 4th ch from hook (beginning ch count as first dc) and in each ch across, turn—47 dc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), *dc in front loop of next dc, dc in back loop of next dc; repeat from * to last 2 sts, dc in front loop of next dc, dc in top of beginning ch, turn.
Rows 3–23: Repeat Row 2.
Fasten off.
Edging
Note Skip a stitch as needed to work an odd number of stitches on each side between 3-sc groups in each corner.
Round 1: With right side facing and G, join with sc in first corner dc, 2 sc in same st as join, sc in each st to next corner dc, 3 sc in corner dc; sc evenly spaced across ends of rows of first side; working across opposite
Belly
With C, ch 8.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—7 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc to last sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—15 sc.
Rows 6–13: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Rows 14–17: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—7 sc.
Row 18: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. Fasten off.
Eyes (make 2)
With D, ch 6.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—5 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn.
Fasten off.
With smaller hook, join E with sc in any sc.
Edging: Sc in each sc and in end of each row around; join with slip st to first sc. Fasten off.
Eye Pupil (make 2)
With F, ch 3.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and last ch, turn—2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. Fasten off.
Wing (make 2)
With E, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, turn—3 sc.
Rows 3–7: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in remaining sc, turn—8 sc.
Rows 8–12: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in remaining sc, turn—3 sc.
Fasten off.
Beak
With G, ch 5.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—4 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each sc, turn. Fasten off.
Feet (make 2)
With G, ch 3.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and last ch, turn—2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—6 sc.
Rows 4 and 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 6: Ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, skip next 2 sc, slip st in next sc, ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, skip next sc, slip st in next sc, ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, slip st in last sc. Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
Use photograph as a guide to all placement. Sew ears to top of head and belly to body. Fold one edge of each eye under slightly and place eyes with these straight edges together on head; sew in place. Sew pupils on each eye close to center of face with points positioned vertically (like a diamond shape). With points placed vertically, sew beak between eyes. Center owl body on one pillow square and sew with running stitches. Sew wings and feet to body and pillow.
FINISHING
Edging: With wrong sides together, larger hook, and working through both thicknesses, join E with sc in any center sc of 3-sc group, picot, sc in same sc as join, [*picot, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * to center sc of next 3-sc group, (sc, picot, sc) in center sc] 3 times, insert pillow form, **picot, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from ** to first sc; join with slip st to first sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

Round 4: Slip st into ch-1 sp, ch 2; 2-dc cluster in same space, ch 5; *skip next ch-1 space, 3-dc cluster in next ch-1 space, ch 5*; repeat from * to * around, ending with a slip st into top of the 2-dc cluster – 8 ch-5 loops.

Fasten off. Weave ends in.
Heart 1
Row 1: Join thread in any ch-4 loop, ch 3, 4 tr in same loop – 5 tr.
Row 2: Ch 3, turn; tr in first st, tr in next tr, 3 tr in next tr, tr in next tr, 2 tr in next tr – 9 tr.
Row 3: Turn, sc in first tr, (dc, tr) in next tr, (2 tr, dc) in next tr, sc in next tr, slip st in next tr, sc in next tr, dc in next tr, 2 tr in next tr, (tr, dc) in next tr, sc in next tr – 15 sts.
Fasten off. Weave ends in.

Row 1: Join thread in next ch-4 loop on Round 5 to left of previously worked Heart; ch 3, 4 tr in same ch-4 loop – 5 tr.
Row 2: Ch 3, turn, tr in same st, tr in next tr, 3 tr in next tr, tr in next tr, 2 tr in next tr; slip st in sc at end of Row 3 of previous Heart – 9 tr.
Row 3: Turn, sc in 1st tr, (dc, tr) in next tr, (2 tr, dc) in next tr, sc in next tr, slip st in next tr, sc in next tr, (dc, 2 tr) in next tr, (tr, dc) in next tr, sc in next tr – 15 sts.
Fasten off. Weave ends in.

Row 1: Join thread in next ch-4 loop on Round 5 to left of previously worked Heart; ch 3, 4 tr in same ch-4 loop – 5 tr.

Round 6: Working towards the valley between heart points, join thread in the second tr of Row 3 of Heart; ch 4, dc in same st; ch 5, (dc, ch 2, dc) in the second tr on next point on same heart, ch 5; *(dc, ch 2, dc) in the second tr on first point on the next heart; ch 5, (dc, ch 2, dc) in the second tr on next point on same heart; ch 5*; repeat from * to * around, ending with a slip st into the 2nd ch of beginning ch-4 – 16 ch-2 sps.
Round 7: Slip st into ch-2 space, ch 5, tr in same space, ch 2; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-5 space, ch 7; (sc, ch 3 sc) in next ch-5 space, ch 7; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-5 space, ch 2; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-2 space, ch 2; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-5 space, ch 2; *(tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-2 space, ch 2; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-5 space, ch 7; (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-5 space, ch 7; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-5 space, ch 2; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-2 space, ch 2; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-5 space, ch 2*; repeat from * to * around, ending with a slip st into the 3rd ch of beginning ch-5 – 4 ch-3 spaces.

Hearts 9-12

Row 2: Ch 3, turn; tr in first st, tr in next tr, 3 tr in next tr, tr in next tr, 2 tr in next tr – 9 tr.
Row 3: Turn, sc in first tr, (dc, tr) in next tr, (2 tr, dc) in next tr, sc in next tr, slip st in next tr, sc in next tr, dc in next tr, 2 tr in next tr, (tr, dc) in next tr, sc in next tr – 15 sts.
Fasten off. Weave ends in.
Round 8: Working towards the valley between heart points, join thread in the second tr of Row 3 of any Heart; ch 1, sc in same st, ch 13, sc in the second tr on the next point of same heart, ch 7; (dtr, ch 2, dtr) in next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space; (dc, ch 2, dc) in next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space; (dtr, ch 2, dtr) in next ch-2 space, ch 7; *sc in the second tr on first point of next heart, ch 13, sc in the second tr on the next point of same heart, ch 7; (dtr, ch 2, dtr) in next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space; (dc, ch 2, dc) in next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space; (tr, ch 2, tr) in next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space; (dtr, ch 2, dtr) in next ch-2 sp, ch 7*; repeat from * to * around ending with slip st in first sc of round – 4 ch-13 spaces.
Round 9: Ch 7; *(sc, ch 4, tr, ch 2, dtr, ch 3, dtr, ch 2, tr, ch 4, sc) in next ch-13 space; ch 4, tr in next sc, ch 4; (sc, ch 4, tr) in next ch-7 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space; 4 tr in first ch of next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, tr in next ch-2 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-2 space, ch 3, tr in next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, 4 tr in first ch of next ch-2 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space; (tr, ch 4, sc) in next ch-7 space, ch 4**; tr in next sc, ch 4*; repeat from * to * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st into third ch of beginning ch-7 – 8 4-tr groups.
Round 10: Ch 6, *etr2tog worked in same tr and next tr; ch 3, tr in same tr, ch 2; (3 tr, ch 3, 3 tr) in next ch-3 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, tr in next tr, ch 3; etr2tog worked in same tr and next tr, ch 3, tr in same tr, ch 3, etr2tog worked in same tr and next tr, ch 3, tr in same tr, ch 5, 4-tr cluster worked in next 4 tr; ch 5, tr in next tr, ch 2, tr2tog worked in same tr and next tr, ch 2, tr in same tr, ch 5, 4-tr cl worked in next 4 tr, ch 5, tr in next tr, ch 3, etr2tog worked in same tr and next tr, ch 3**, tr in same tr, ch 3*; repeat from * to * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st into third ch of beginning ch-6 – 8 4-tr clusters.
Round 11: Ch 1, sc in same st, *3 sc in next ch-3 space, sc between next etr2tog, 3 sc in next ch-3 space, 3 sc in next ch-2 space, sc in next 3 tr, 5 sc in next ch-3 space, sc in next 3 tr, 3 sc in next ch-2 space, 3 sc in next ch-3 space, sc between next etr2tog, 3 sc in next ch-3 space, sc in next tr, 3 sc in next ch-3 space, sc between next etr2tog, 3 sc in next ch-3 space, 5 sc in next ch-5 space, sc in top of 4-tr cl, 5 sc in next ch-5 space, 3 sc in next ch-2 space, sc between next 2 tr, 3 sc in next ch-2 space, 5 sc in next ch-5 space, sc in top of next 4-tr cl, 5 sc in next ch-5 space, 3 sc in next ch-3 space, sc between next etr2tog, 3 sc in next ch-3 space**, sc in next tr*; repeat from * to * around, ending last repeat at **; slip st in first sc of round – 304 sc.
Round 12: Ch 3, skip next sc, dc in next sc, [ch 1, skip next sc, dc in next sc] 7 times, *[ch 1, dc in same sc] 3 times, [ch 1, skip next sc, dc in next dc] 38 times*; repeat from * to * 3 times; (ch 1, dc in same sc) 3 times; (ch 1, skip next sc, dc in next dc) 29 times; ch 1, slip st into second ch of beginning ch-3 – 164 dc.

Back
Row 1: Ch 88, dc in 5th ch from hook, [ch 1, skip 1 ch, dc in next ch] 41 times – 43 dc.
Row 2: Ch 3, turn; dc in next dc, [ch 1, dc in next dc] 40 times; ch 1, dc in the 2nd ch of beginning ch-3 – 43 dc.
Rows 3-42: Repeat Row 2.

Block to a 7¼” (18.4 cm) square to match Pillow Front.
FABRIC PILLOW
Cut 2 pieces of fabric 8¼” (21 cm) square. With right sides facing, sew the 2 pieces of fabric together using a ½” (12.7 mm) seam, leaving a 2-3” (5 – 7.6 cm) opening on one side. Turn right side out. Press if necessary. Stuff with fiber fill until firm but not hard. Do not over stuff pillow. Use needle and sewing thread to sew opening closed.
ASSEMBLY 
With wrong sides facing and working through both top and bottom pieces, attach thread in any corner ch-1 space; *(sc, picot, sc, picot, sc) in same ch-1 space (corner made); [sc in next ch-1 space, picot, sc in same space] 41 times*, repeat from * to * around pillow, inserting pillow before working up the final side of pillow. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Tie two 15” (38 cm) pieces of ribbon to the center of the pillow, trim ends.

instructions:
Notes:

See diagram on page 2. 
With A, form an adjustable loop.

2nd rnd:  Ch 2. 2 dc in each dc around. Join. 24 dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. (1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc) 12 times. Join. 36 dc.
4th rnd:  Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc) 12 times. Join. 48 dc.
5th rnd:  Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in next dc) 12 times. Join. 60 dc.
6th rnd:  Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 4 dc. 2 dc in next dc) 12 times. Join. 72 dc.
7th rnd:  Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 5 dc. 2 dc in next dc) 12 times. Join. 84 dc.

8th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 6 dc. 2 dc in next dc) 12 times. Join. 96 dc.
9th rnd: Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 7 dc. 2 dc in next dc) 12 times. Join. 108 dc.
10th rnd:  Ch 2. (1 dc in each of next 8 dc. 2 dc in next dc) 12 times. Join. 120 dc.

Tassels: (Make 48). Wrap B around a 3" [7.5 cm] piece of cardboard 20 times. Tie securely at one end. Cut across other end. Wrap yarn 6 times around tassel 1" [2.5 cm] from tied end, and fasten securely. Attach Tassels evenly spaced in every 3rd st around joining rnd of Pillow.

materials: Sewing needle and matching sewing thread
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: Each Motif = 4¾” x 4¾”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
FIRST MOTIF
With Color 1, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form ring. 
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), 11 dc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 12 dc. Fasten off Color 1, join A between first and last dc of round 1.
Round 2: With Color 2, ch 3, dc in same space, *2 dc between next 2 dc; repeat from * around, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 24 dc. Fasten off Color 2, join Color 3 between first and last dc of round 2.
Round 3: With Color 3, ch 3, 2 dc in same space, *skip next 2 dc, 3 dc between last skipped and next dc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch 4 – 36 dc. Fasten off Color 3, join Color 4 between first and last dc of round 2.
Round 4: With Color 4, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in same space, *[ch 1, skip next 3 dc, 2 dc between last skipped and next dc] twice, ch 1, skip next 3 dc, (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) between last skipped and next dc; repeat from * twice; repeat from * to ** once join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 4 corner ch-1 spaces; 9 dc and 3 ch-1 spaces on each side. Fasten off. 

SECOND MOTIF (joining across one side)
Work same as First Motif joining to previous motif(s) while completing round 4 by replacing ch-1 spaces on side to be joined with sc in corresponding ch-1 space(s) on preceding motif(s), following assembly diagram for placement. Fasten off.

BORDER
Round 1: With right side facing, join A with slip st in any corner ch-1 space, ch 1, *2 sc in corner ch-1 space, sc in each st and space across; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc – 56 sc on each side.
Round 2: Ch 1, *2 sc in sc, sc in each sc to next corner; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *2 sc in next sc, sc in each sc to next corner; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
FINISHING
With sewing needle and matching thread, sew pillow cover to top of pillow.

instructions:
Notes: 
• Join with sl st to first hdc at end of each rnd.
• To join new color, work to last loops on hook of previous color. Yoh with new color, draw through rem loops, and proceed in new color.
FRONT AND BACK
Make 1 Front - Color 1 is A, Color 2 is B, Color 3 is C.
Make 1 Back - Color 1 is D, Color 2 is E, Color 3 is F.
With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to form ring. See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 hdc in center of ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 16 hdc.
3rd rnd: As 2nd rnd. 32 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * around. Join Color 2. Break Color 1. 48 hdc.
6th rnd: With Color 2, ch 1. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 56 hdc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 13 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 60 hdc.
PETALS
Note: Petals are worked back and forth in rows.
First Petal
**1st row: (RS). With Color 2, ch 1. 1 hdc in each of next 10 hdc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. Join Color 3. Break Color 2.
2nd and 3rd rows: With Color 3, ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn. 8 sts.
5th and 6th rows: Rep last row twice more. 4 sts.
Fasten off.**
Second Petal
Join Color 2 with sl st to next unworked hdc of 7th rnd of Flower Center.
Work from ** to ** as given for First Petal.
Third to Sixth Petals
Work as given for Second Petal 4 times more.
FINISHING
Joining Front and Back
With WS of Front and Back tog, RS of Front facing, and Petals aligned, join B with sl st to first st of any Petal.
1st rnd: Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, *1 sc in each of 4 sts along top edge of Petal, 6 sc down side of Petal, 1 sc before next Petal. 6 sc up side of next Petal. Rep from * around, stuffing as you go. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

instructions:
FRONT
Ch 59.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. Turn. 58 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to 
end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row 68 times more  
(70 rows total), placing marker at 
end of every 10th row. Fasten off.
Fringe Strips (make 7) 
Ch 59. 
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of 
chain. Turn. 58 sc.
2nd row:  Ch 1. *Sl st in next sc. 
Draw up a loop 10" [25.5 cm] long. 
Twist loop 30 times. Sl st back into 
same st, allowing twisted loop to 
coil around itself.  Rep from * to 
end of row.  Fasten off.
BACK (make 2 pieces alike)
Ribbing: Ch 9.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
1 sc in each ch to end of chain. 
Turn.  8 sc.
2nd row:  Ch 1. Working in back 
loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of 
row. Turn.  
Rep last row until work from 
beg (when slightly stretched)  
measures 19½" [49.5 cm]. Do not 
fasten off. Proceed as follows:
1st row:  Turn work sideways.  
Ch 1. Work 58 sc evenly along side 
of Ribbing. Turn. Place marker at 
end of row.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to 
end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until work from  
marker measures 11" [28 cm].  
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Fringe Strips to Front of  
Cushion with 1 Fringe Strip along 
top edge and 1 along each marked 
row (every 10th row), ensuring 
Fringe all falls in same direction as 
shown in photo. 
Joining Front and Back:  Overlap 
Back pieces to match Front, with 
ribbed sections in center to create 
opening to insert pillow form. Join 
yarn with sl st to any corner st of 
Cushion. Ch 1. Working through all 
thickness, work sc evenly around 
4 sides of Cushion, having 3 sc in 
each corner. Insert pillow form.

1st rnd: Ch 3. 2 dc in ring. (Ch 3. 3 dc) 3 times in ring. Ch 3. Join. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join B with sl st in any ch-3 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next corner ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. Join. Fasten off.
3rd rnd: Join C with sl st to any corner ch-3 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Join.
4th rnd: Join A with sl st to any corner ch-3 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *(Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) to end of rnd. Ch 1. Join. Fasten off.
First 4 rnds of Stripe Pat are complete.
Rep 4th rnd until all 17 rnds of Stripe Pat are worked, joining with A at end of last rnd. Do not fasten off.
Next rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each st around, working 5 sc in each corner ch-3 sp. Join. Fasten off.
Joining rnd: With WS facing tog, join A with sl st to any sc. Working through both thicknesses, and working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work reverse sc evenly around 3 sides having 3 sc in each corner sc. Insert pillow form. Work in reverse sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Flower Center

Note: Petals are worked back and forth in rows.

**1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 hdc in each of next 10 hdc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc.

gauge: Pillow Cover #1: 3 repeats = 4½" [11.5 cm] and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm]; Pillow Cover #2: 12 dc = 4" [10 cm] and 4 rows = 4” [10 cm]; Pillow Cover #3: 3 repeats = 3¾” [9.5 cm] and 8 rows = 4” [10 cm]
instructions:
PILLOW COVER #1
GAUGE: 3 repeats = 4½" [11.5 cm] and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
Special Stitch
CL (Cluster) = [Yarn over, insert hook and draw up a loop] 4 times in same st, yarn over and draw through all 9 loops on hook.
Front
With A, ch 46.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Hdc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch-2 counts as first hdc, now and throughout) and each ch across—45 hdc.
Row 2 (Right Side): Ch 2, *CL in next st, hdc in next 3 sts; repeat from * across—34 hdc, 11 CLs.
Row 3: Ch 2, hdc in each st across—45 hdc.
Row 4: Ch 2, *hdc in next 2 sts, CL in next st, hdc in next st; repeat from * across—34 hdc, 11 CLs.
Row 5: Repeat Row 3.
Repeat Rows 2-5 until Front measures 17" [43 cm]; fasten off and weave in ends. 
Back (Make 2)
With B, ch 47.
Row 1: Dc in 4th ch from hook (beginning ch-3 counts as first dc, now and throughout) and each ch across—45 dc.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in each st across.
Repeat Row 2 until Back measures 10" [25.5 cm]; fasten off and weave in ends.
Finishing
Overlap Back pieces by 3" [7.5 cm] to make a 17" [43 cm] square. Referring to photo for placement, sew buttons to lower piece and push buttons between stitches of upper piece. Holding Front and Back with Wrong Sides together, with A, sc pieces together around 3 sides. Insert pillow form and sc last side together. Fasten off and weave in ends.

PILLOW COVER #2
GAUGE: 12 dc = 4" [10 cm] and 4 rows = 4” [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
Special Stitches
Fpdc (Front post double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from front to back and to front again around the post of the indicated stitch on a previous row; yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), yarn over and draw through 2 loops twice.
Bpdc (Back post double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from back to front and to back again around the post of the indicated stitch on a previous row; yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), yarn over and draw through 2 loops twice.
Front
With C, ch 49.
Row 1 (Right Side): Dc in 4th ch from hook (beginning ch-3 counts as first dc) and each ch across—47 dc.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as first dc, now and throughout), *Fpdc in next 3 sts, Bpdc in next 3 sts; repeat from * across to last 4 sts, Fpdc in next 3 sts, dc in top of turning ch—24 Fpdc, 21 Bpdc, 2 dc.
Rows 3 & 4: Ch 2, *Bpdc in next 3 sts, Fpdc in next 3 sts; repeat from * across to last 4 sts, Bpdc in next 3 sts, dc in top of turning ch—24 Bpdc, 21 Fpdc, 2 dc.
Rows 5 & 6: Repeat Row 2.
Repeat Rows 3-6 until Front measures 17" [43 cm]. 
Back (Make 2)
With A, work same as for Pillow #1.
Finishing
With C, work same as for Pillow #1.

PILLOW COVER #3
GAUGE: 3 repeats = 3¾” [9.5 cm] and 8 rows = 4” [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
Note: The last dc of each 4-dc block will lay on top of the first 3 sts. Be sure to pull up a long enough loop so the fabric does not pucker. The stitch should look similar on both sides.
Front
With B, ch 51.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn—50 sc. 
Row 2 (Right Side): Ch 3 (counts as first dc), *skip next sc, dc in next 3 sc, dc in skipped sc (see Note); repeat from * across to last st, dc; turn—12 4-dc blocks, 2 dc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn—50 sc.
Repeat Rows 2-3 until Front measures 17" [43 cm].
Back (Make 2)
With C, work same as for Pillow #1.
Finishing
With B, work same as for Pillow #1.

abbreviations: Kfb = Increase 1 stitch by knitting into front and back of next stitch
Sl1Pwyib = Slip next stitch purlwise with yarn in back of work
Sl1Pwyif = Slip next stitch purlwise with yarn in front of work
gauge: 17 sts and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger needles in Basketweave Pat. 11.5 sts and 23 rows = 4" [10 cm] with smaller needles in garter st.
instructions:
Notes:
• Basketweave Pat worked over multiples of 3 sts.
• Pillow is worked in 1 piece from side to side and folded in half and seamed on 3 sides in Finishing.
• Fringe is added in Finishing
Pillow
With larger needles, cast on 117 sts. 
1st row: (RS). Knit.
2nd row:  P3. *Sl1Pwyif. P2. Rep from * to end of row.
3rd row:  K2. *Slip next st onto cable needle and leave at front of work. K2. Slip st from cable needle onto right-hand needle without working it. Rep from * to last st. K1.
4th row: *P2. Sl1Pwyif. Rep from * to last 3 sts. P3.
5th row:  K1. *(Sl1Pwyib) twice. Slip next st onto cable needle and leave at front of work. Slip first 2 slipped sts from right-hand needle back onto left-hand needle. Slip st from cable needle onto right-hand needle without working it. K2. Rep from * to last 2 sts. K2.
Rep 2nd to 5th rows to form Basketweave Pat. Cont in Basketweave Pat until work from beg measures 24" [61 cm]. Cast off.
Fringe Strip (make 2)
With smaller needles, cast on 7 sts.
1st row: (RS). Kfb. K2tog. K4. 7 sts.
2nd row: K4. Kfb. K2tog. 7 sts.
Rep last 2 rows until work from beg measures 11" [28 cm], ending on a WS row, noting that Fringe Strip will stretch to approx 14" [35.5 cm] when unravelled.
Cast off 2 sts. Fasten off st on right-hand needle. Slip rem 4 sts off needle and unravel every row to create looped fringe.
FINISHING
Seam Pillow: Fold pillow in half, aligning 2 side edges, sew side and bottom seams. Insert pillow form. Sew rem side seam closed.
Attach Fringe: Sew Fringe Strips to side seams of Pillow (as shown in photo).

5" [12.5 cm] piece of heavy cardboard (for making tassels)

measurements: Pillow measures about 18 x 18" [45.5 x 45.5 cm]
gauge: 9 sts = 4" [10 cm]; 10 rows = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet (sc), with 2 strands of yarn held together.
instructions:
PILLOW COVER PIECE (make 2)
With 2 strands of A held together, ch 40. 
Row 1 (wrong side): Working in back bumps only, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across—39 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. 
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in first 3 sts, Bobble in next st, [sc in next 7 sts, Bobble in next st] 4 times, sc in last 3 sts—34 sc and 5 Bobbles.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across—39 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in first 5 sts, Bobble in next st, [sc in next 3 sts, Bobble in next st] 7 times, sc in last 5 sts—31 sc and 8 Bobbles.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across—39 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in first 7 sts, Bobble in next st, [sc in next 7 sts, Bobble in next st] 3 times, sc in last 7 sts—35 sc and 4 Bobbles.
Rows 8–10: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Rows 11–42: Repeat Rows 3–10 four more times.
Rows 43 and 44: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Fasten off.
Edging Round: With right side facing and 2 strands of B held together, join yarn with slip st in any st of last row, ch 1, work sc stitches as evenly spaced as possible along all 4 sides of piece, working 3 sc in each corner. Take care to work the same number of sc along each side; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Seaming: Hold the two pieces together with Bobble zig-zags running in the same direction, stitches matching and wrong sides facing inwards. With right side facing and 2 strands of B held together, working in inner loops of both pieces at the same time, join yarn with slip st in any edging st, slip st in each remaining edging st all the way around, and insert pillow form before completing seam. Fasten off.
Tassels (make 4)
Holding 1 strand each of A, B, and C together, Wrap yarn about 10 times around 5" (12.5 cm) piece of heavy cardboard. Thread a 10" (25.5 cm) single strand of any of the yarn colors under the top of the wraps and tie into a tight knot for top of tassel. Do not trim the ends of the tie. Slip wraps off of cardboard. Tie a 10" (25.5 cm) length of yarn around wraps about ¾" (19 mm) from top for tassel neck. Wrap ends of tie around wraps about 6 times and then draw ends to inside of tassel. Cut the lower ends of the wraps and trim to even. Use yarn needle and ends of tie (at top of tassel) to sew one tassel securely to each of the four corners. Weave in ends.

Round 4 (1-sided join): With right side facing, sc join F in any ch-1 space, ch 3, sc in same space, skip next st, sc in next st, (sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-1 space, skip next st, sc in next st, (dc, ch 3, dc, [ch-3 join, dc] twice) in next ch-1 space, skip next st, sc in next st, [(sc, ch-3 join, sc) in next ch-1 space, skip next st, sc in next st] twice, (dc, [ch-3 join, dc] twice, ch 3, dc) in next ch-1 space, skip next st, sc in next st, *[(sc, ch 3, sc) in next ch-1 space, skip next st, sc in next st] twice, [dc, (ch 3, dc) 3 times] in next ch-1 space, skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—28 sc, 16 dc, 14 ch-3 spaces, and 6 ch-3 joins. Body
Round 1: With right side facing, join F with slip st in any join between motifs, ch 3, 2 dc in same space, 2 sc in next ch-3 space, [hdc in next sc, 2 sc in next ch-3 space] 3 times, *3 dc in next join between motifs, 2 sc in next ch-3 space, [hdc in next sc, 2 sc in next ch-3 space] 3 times; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—64 sc, 24 hdc, and 24 dc.

Round 5: With B, repeat Round 3.
Round 6: Repeat Round 4.

Round 8: Repeat Round 4.

Round 10: Repeat Round 4.

Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as join and in next 5 sts, [sc2tog, sc in next st, sc2tog, sc in next 9 sts] 7 times, sc2tog, sc in next st, sc2tog, sc in each remaining st; join with slip st in first sc—96 sc.

Rounds 1–3: With colors of Sequence 1, repeat Rounds 1–3 of motif.
Round 4: With right side facing, repeat Round 4 (no join).
Round 5: With right side facing, join D with slip st in center ch-3 space between dc, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in same space, [ch 1, 3 dc in next ch-3 space] 4 times, *ch 1, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space, [(ch 1, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space] 4 times; repeat from * around, ch 1; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—72 dc, 20 ch-1 spaces, and 4 ch-3 spaces. abbreviations: Hdcbl = Half double crochet in back loop only
Hdc/f_l = Half double crochet in front loop only
Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
gauge: 13 hdc and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of rows does not count as hdc.
• To change colors, work to last 3 loops on hook of first color. Draw new color through last 3 loops and proceed with new color.
FRONT
With MC, ch 66. 
Set-up row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *1 dc in next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Turn. 65 sts.
**1st row: (WS). Ch 3 (counts as dc). *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. *1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.**
Last 2 rows form Griddle St Pat.
Cont in Griddle St Pat until work from beg measures approx 2½" [6.5 cm], ending on a RS row. Break MC. Join A.
Proceed as follows:
1st row: (WS). With A, ch 2. 1 hdc/f_l in each st to end of row. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdcbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
Last 2 rows form Texture Pat.
With A, cont in Texture Pat until work from beg measures 5½" [14 cm], ending on a WS row. Break A. Join B.
With B, cont in Texture Pat until work from beg measures 8½" [21.5 cm], ending on a WS row. Break B. Join C.
With C, cont in Texture Pat until work from beg measures 11½" [29 cm], ending on a WS row. Break C. Join D.
With D, cont in Texture Pat until work from beg measures 14½" [37 cm], ending on a WS row. Break D. Join E.
With E, cont in Texture Pat until work from beg measures 17½" [44.5 cm], ending on a WS row. Break E. Join MC.
Next row:  (RS). With MC, ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in first dc. *1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
Working from ** to **, cont in Griddle St Pat until work from beg measures 20" [51 cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off.
BACK (make 2 pieces alike)
Ribbing: With MC, ch 8.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. Turn. 7 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg (when slightly stretched) measures 20" [51 cm]. Do not fasten off.
Proceed as follows:
1st row: (WS). Turn work sideways. Ch 1. Work 65 sc evenly across side of ribbing. Turn.
2nd row: (RS). 1 sc in first sc. *1 dc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
Working from ** to **, cont in Griddle St Pat until work from beg measures 13" [33 cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off.
Fringe:  Cut lengths of yarn 8" [20.5 cm]. Taking 3 strands together, fold in half and knot into fringe into remaining front loops of each st across last row of each Contrast Color section.
Trim evenly.
FINISHING
With RS together, overlap Back pieces to match Front with ribbed sections in center to create opening to insert pillow form. Sew outer edge seams.

instructions:
WING MOTIF (make 8)
See Diagram on page 3.
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 5 (counts as 1 dc and ch-2 sp throughout). [(2 dc. Ch 1) twice. 2 dc. Ch 2. (2 dc. Ch 1) twice. 1 dc] in ring. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-5. Fasten off. 6 x 2-dc clusters, 4 x ch-1 sps, 2 x ch-2 corner sps.
2nd rnd: Join B with sl st to first corner ch-2 sp. Ch 5. 3 dc in same ch-2 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) twice. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next corner ch-2 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) twice. 2 dc in first corner ch-2 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-5. Fasten off.
3rd rnd: Join C with sl st to first corner ch-2 sp. Ch 5. 3 dc in same ch-2 sp. *Ch 1. 4 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 4 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1.* (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next corner ch-2 sp. Rep from * to * once more. 2 dc in first ch-2 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-5. Fasten off.
4th rnd: Join D with sl st to first ch-2 sp. Ch 5. 3 dc in same ch-2 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc between 2nd and 3rd dc of next 4-dc group. Ch 1. (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) twice. 3 dc between 2nd and 3rd dc of next 4-dc group. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1.* (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * to * once more. 2 dc in first ch-2 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-5. Fasten off.
5th rnd: Join A with sl st to first ch-2 sp. Ch 5. 3 dc in same ch-2 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) twice. (4 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) 3 times. (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) twice.* (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * to * once more. 2 dc in first ch-2 sp. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-5. Fasten off.

BODY (make 2)
See Diagram on page 3.
With B, ch 31.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to last ch. 3 sc in last ch, placing marker on first of these 3 sts. Working across opposite side of foundation ch, 1 sc in each ch to last ch, 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. 62 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to marked st, 2 sc in each of next 3 sc, moving marker to first of these 6 sts, 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. 2 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 68 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to marked st. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times, removing marker. 1 sc in each sc to last 4 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 74 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Do not fasten off at end of second Body piece.

Join Body: Align 2 Body pieces with WS facing tog and second Body piece (with working yarn attached) facing on top.
1st rnd: Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, sc in each sc around, stuffing Body lightly before end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Note: Use locking st markers or safety pins to assemble Wings.
Assemble Wings: Place 2 Wing Motifs side by side with RS facing up and corners aligned as seen in Assembly Diagram. Sew Wing Motifs tog from corner ch-2 sp to center of Motif side, ending at 2nd dc of center 4-dc cluster. Rep - joining pairs of 2 Wing Motifs to create 4 Wings.
Note: Using shapes of Assembled Wings as a guide, cut out 4 pieces of fabric to match each Wing and place against WS of Wing before completing joining rnd and final stuffing.

Left Wing: Place 2 Wings tog with WS facing each other and 2 un-seamed corner ch-2 sps pointing to the left.
Join A with sl st to any corner ch-2 sp of Wing.
Joining rnd: Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc in each st and ch-1 sp around, working 3 sc in each corner ch-2 sp and stuffing Wing lightly before end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Right Wing: Place next 2 Wing Motifs tog with WS facing each other, and 2 un-seamed corner ch-2 sps pointing to the right.
Work Joining rnd as given for Left Wing.

Join Left Wing to Body: Center long left edge of Body along flat edge of Left Wing (see Assembly Diagram), with RS of each piece facing up. **Use locking stitch markers or safety pins to hold pieces in place. Join D with sl st to back loop only of st where Body meets Left Wing at marker. With yarn at back and working through back loops only, sl st in each st between markers to join. Fasten off.**

Join Right Wing to Body: Center long right edge of Body along flat edge of Right Wing (see Assembly Diagram), with RS of each piece facing up. Work from ** to ** as given for Join Left Wing to Body.

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
