gauge: 8 sts = 2” (5 cm); 8 rows = 2” (5 cm) in single crochet with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
PILLOW
House of Bricks
With larger hook and A, ch 23.
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—22 sc.
Rows 2–10: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn; change to B at end of Row 10. 
Row 11: Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 12–22: Repeat Row 2.
Fasten off.
Edging
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, join B with sc in first sc, 2 sc in same sc (corner made), sc in each sc across to last st, 3 sc in last sc (corner made); working in ends of rows, work 20 sc evenly down side changing to A as needed to match rows; working in opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch (corner made), sc in each ch across to last ch, 3 sc in last ch (corner made); working in ends of rows, work 20 sc evenly up side changing to B as needed to match rows; join with slip st in first sc—92 sc. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join C with sc in first sc, sc in each sc around working 3 sc in center sc of each corner (corner made); join with slip st in first sc—100 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, working back loops only, sc in each sc around working 3 sc in center sc of each corner (corner made); join with slip st in first sc—108 sc. Fasten off.
Window Sill 
Row 1: With right facing and working in unworked front loops of Row 11, join C with sc in first sc, sc in each sc across—22 sc. Fasten off. 
House of Sticks 
Rows 1–10: With D, work same as Rows 1–10 of house of bricks.
Rows 11–22: With E, work same as Rows 11–22 of house of bricks.
House of Straw 
Rows 1–10: With B, work same as Rows 1–10 of house of bricks.
Rows 11–22: With F, work same as Rows 11–22 of house of bricks.
Wolf Panel
Rows 1–10: With J, work same as Rows 1–10 of house of bricks.
Rows 11–22: With I, work same as Rows 11–22 of house of bricks.
PIG (make 3)
Work all pieces with smaller hook.
Head (make 3) 
With G, ch 6.
Round 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working on opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 3 ch, 2 sc in last ch—12 sc. Do not join rounds until instructed; place marker on first st and move up as each round is completed. 
Round 2: Work 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next 3 sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in last 2 sc—18 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—24 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—30 sc.
Round 5: *Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—36 sc. Fasten off.
Snout (make 3) 
With H, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Do not join rounds until instructed; place marker on first st and move up as each round is completed. 
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Round 3: Working in back loops only, slip st in each sc around; join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.
Ear (make 6) 
With H, ch 2.
Row 1 (right side): Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc3tog, sc in last sc, turn—3 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Row 5: Ch 1, sc3tog (tip of ear made)—1 sc. 
Fasten off. 
Shirt (make 3 - 1 each with A, J, and K) 
Ch 15.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—14 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 4 and 5: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—12 sc. 
Fasten off. 
WOLF
Work all pieces with smaller hook.
Head 
With F, ch 9.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—8 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn—16 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 7–9: Ch 1, sc in next sc, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc, turn—10 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—8 sc.
Rows 11–13: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 14: *Ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in last ch (ear made)*, skip first 2 sc, slip st in next 3 sc; repeat from * to * once, skip next 2 sc, slip st in last sc. Fasten off.
Nose
With K, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. 
Neck 
With C, ch 6.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—5 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn; change to F at end of Row 4. 
Rows 5 and 6: Ch 1, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—7 sc.
Rows 7 and 8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Fasten off.
BACK PANEL
With J, ch 51.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—50 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 3, dc in each sc across, turn.
Row 5–36: Repeat Rows 3 and 4 sixteen times. 
Do not fasten off.
Edging
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 3 sc in first sc (corner made), sc in each sc across to last sc, 3 sc in last sc (corner made); *working 1 sc in end of sc rows and 2 sc in end of dc rows, work 54 sc across side*; working in opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch (corner made), sc in each ch across to last ch, 3 sc in last ch (corner made); repeat from * to * once; join with slip st in first sc—216 sc.
Fasten off.
Round 2: Join C with sc in first sc, sc in each sc around working 3 sc in center sc of each 3-sc corner; join with slip st in first sc—224 sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, working back loops only, sc in each sc around working 3 sc in center sc of each 3-sc corner; join with slip st in first sc—232 sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Use photograph as a guide for placement of stitches and squares. 
House of Bricks With C, embroider back stitches horizontally between Rows 1 and 2, Rows 3 and 4, and each pair of rows thereafter. Separate bricks with back stitches worked vertically between horizontal lines. Begin first vertical line between first 2 stitches of Rows 2 and 3; begin first vertical line between 3rd and 4th stitches of Rows 4 and 5. Separate bricks by skipping 4 stitches between vertical stitches and alternate placement of stitches as you work across the square.
House of Sticks With D and K, embroider chain stitches for branches on each section. With J, embroider French knot leaves on branches.
House of Straw With B and E, embroider as many straight stitches as desired for pieces of straw.
Pigs
Snout With 6 strands of embroidery floss, embroider French knot nostrils and back stitches for smile. Sew snout in place. Insert black eyes and secure. If desired, vary the placement of eyes on each pig so faces appear different.
Ears Sew first row of ear to head, then pull tip of ear down over last 2 rounds of head. Tack in place.
Shirt Sew shirt in place on upper section of square. Place head on top edge of shirt and sew.
Wolf 
Sew nose on head. Embroider back stitches for smile. Insert yellow eyes and secure. With C, work a small back stitch over the first stitch of Row 8 of neck, work next back stitch close to the first allowing a ½-¾” (1.5-2 cm) long loop to form; *holding the loop in place, work next back stitch close to the last one made; repeat from * as many times as needed to create loops and back and forth across all C rows. Fasten off.
Sew neck and head to wolf panel.
Front Panel
Arrange houses and wolf panel and sew together through both sets of loops. 
Pull tails to wrong side of front panel to minimize weaving in ends.
Border
Hold front and back panels with wrong sides together, matching corners and easing sides to fit. 
Round 1: With larger hook and working in both sets of loops, join C with sc in center sc of any corner, 2 sc in same sc, *sc evenly spaced across to next corner, 3 sc in next corner; repeat from * twice; insert pillow form, sc evenly spaced across last side; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Symphony™ (7.9 oz/225 g; 309 yds/282 m) Pebbles (21001) 1 ball
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
gauge: 10 sc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc.
FRONT AND BACK (Make 2 pieces alike)
Ch 3. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 7 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 8 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. (1 hdc. 1 dcfp) in each dc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. 16 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 dcfp around next dc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last st. 1 dcfp around last st. Join with sl st to first hdc. 24 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in next hdc. 1 dcfp around next st. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 hdc in next hdc. 1 dcfp around last st. Join with sl st to first hdc. 32 sts.

5th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around next st. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts. 1 dcfp around last st. Join with sl st to first hdc. 40 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 1 dcfp around next st. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 4 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. 1 dcfp around last st. Join with sl st to first hdc. 48 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. *1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. 1 dcfp around next st. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 5 sts. 1 hdc in each of next 4 sts. 1 dcfp around last st. Join with sl st to first hdc. 56 sts.

Cont in pat as established, inc 8 sts every rnd until piece measures 16" [40.5 cm] diameter. Fasten off.
Note: Insert pillow form at halfway point of joining Front and Back.
Join Front and Back: With WS of pieces tog, join B with sl st to any st. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Caron® Tea Cakes™ (8.5 oz/240 g; 204 yds/186 m) Smoked Fruit (34001) 5 balls
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume™ crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Approx 24" [61 cm] wide x 24" [61 cm] high before stuffing.
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as hdc. 
• Join all rnds with sl st to first hdc.
COVER  
Ch 3.
1st rnd: 8 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join. 8 hdc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 16 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc) 8 times. Join. 24 hdc. 
4th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in next hdc (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc) 7 times. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join. 32 hdc. 
5th rnd: Ch 2. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc) 8 times. Join. 40 hdc. 
6th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc.(2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc) 7 times. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 2 hdc. Join. 48 hdc. 
7th rnd: Ch 2. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc) 8 times. Join. 56 hdc. 
8th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc) 7 times. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 3 hdc. Join. 64 hdc.
9th to 17th rnds:  Cont in this manner, inc 8 hdc evenly around next 9 rnds (as established). 136 hdc.  
18th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. Place marker at end of rnd. 
Rep last rnd until work from marked rnd measures 19" [48 cm]. 
Shape bottom: Next rnd:  
Ch 2. (1 hdc in each of next 15 hdc. Hdc2tog) 8 times. Join. 128 sts rem.
Next rnd:  Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of the next 7 hdc. (Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of the next 14 hdc) 7 times. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of the next 7 hdc. Join. 120 sts rem.
Next rnd: Ch 2. (1 hdc in each of next 13 hdc. Hdc2tog) 8 times. Join. 112 sts rem.
Next rnd:  Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. (Hdc2tog. 1 sts in each of next 12 hdc) 7 times. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. Join. 104 hdc rem. 
Next rnd: Ch 2. (1 hdc in each of next 11 hdc. Hdc2tog) 8 times. Join. 96 sts rem.
Next rnd:  Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. (Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 10 hdc) 7 times. Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. Join. 88 sts rem. Fasten off. 
Insert stuffing until Pouf is stuffed firmly. Thread 2 strands of yarn through last rnd. Pull slightly to secure cover over stuffing.
Fasten strands securely.

materials: Red Heart® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 724 Baby Pink a, 319 Cherry Red B, 528 Medium Purple C, 512 Turqua d.
Polyester fiberfill, stitch markers, yarn needle.
abbreviations: sc2tog: [Insert hook next st, yo, draw yarn through st] twice, yo, draw yarn through 3 loops on hook.
a, B, C, d = Color A, B, C, D
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: Rows 1-7 of bottom wing = 2” long x 1 ¾ “ wide. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Bottom Wings (make 2)
Left Side
With a, ch 7. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 4 ch, hdc in last ch, turn – 6 sts. 
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn – 6 sc. 
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, hdc in last sc, turn – 6 sts. 
Row 4: Repeat row 2. 
Rows 5-6: Sc in each sc across, turn – 6 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each of next 4 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn – 8 sc. 
Rows 8-10: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Row 11: Repeat row 7 – 10 sc. 
Rows 12-14: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn – 10 sc. 
Row 15: Repeat row 7 – 12 sc. 
Row 16: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Row 17: Repeat row 7 – 14 sc. 
Rows 18-20: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Row 21: Ch 1, sc2tog in first 2 sts, sc in each sc across to last 2 sts, sc2tog in last 2 sts, turn –12. 
Rows 22-24: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Row 25: Repeat row 21 – 10 sc. 
Row 26: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Rows 27-29: Repeat row 21 – 4 sc at end of last row. 
Fasten off.
Right Side
Row 1: With right side facing, join a in first ch on opposite side of foundation ch, ch 1, hdc in first ch, sc in each of next 5 ch, turn – 6 sts. 
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn – 6 sc. 
Row 3: Ch 1, hdc in first sc, sc in next 5 sc, turn – 6 sts. 
Row 4: Repeat row 2. 
Repeat rows 5-29 of left side. Fasten off.
Border
Round 1: With right side facing, join a in center ch at top of wings, ch 1, sc in center ch, working around right side, 2 sc in end of row 1, sc in end of row 2, 2 sc in end of row 3, sc in end of rows 4-16, 2 sc in end of rows 17 and 18, sc in end of rows 19-28, 2 sc in first sc at end of row 29, sc in each of next 3 sc, sc in end of each row to row 19, 2 sc in end of rows 18 and 17, sc in end of each row to end of right side, sc in center ch at bottom of wings, sc in end of rows 1-16 of left side, 2 sc in end of rows 17-18, sc in end of rows 19-28, sc in first 3 sc of row 29, 2 sc in last sc in row 19, sc in end of each row through row 19, 2 sc in end of rows 18 and 17, sc in end of each row through row 4, 2 sc in end of row 3, sc in end of row 2, 2 sc in end of row 1, slip st in first sc to join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
top Wings (make 2)
Right Side
With D, ch 3. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, turn – 2 sc. 
Rows 2-12: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn – 2 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, turn – 3 sc. 
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, turn – 4 sc.
Rows 15-20: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 21: Ch 1, [sc2tog in next 2 sts] twice – 2 sc. 
Row 22: Ch 1, sc2tog in next 2 sts – 1 sc. Fasten off.
Left Side 
Row 1: With right side facing, join D in first ch on opposite side of foundation ch, ch 1, sc in first ch, sc in next ch, turn – 2 sc.
Repeat rows 2-22 of right side on left side. Fasten off.
Border
Round 1: With right side facing, join a in center ch at top of top wings, ch 1, working around right side of top wings, slip st in same ch, *slip st in end of next 10 rows, sc in end of next 11 rows, 3 sc in end sc, sc in end of next 11 rows, slip st in end of next 10 rows*, slip st in center ch on bottom of top wings, working around left side, repeat from * to * once; join.
Round 2: Ch 1, *slip st in next 13 sts, sc in next 9 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in next 9 sc, slip st in next 13 sts*, slip st in center slip st on bottom, repeat from * to * once; join.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, *sc in each of next 22 sts, 2 sc in each of next 3 sc, sc in each of next 22 sts, sc in next slip st (center st at bottom), repeat from * to * once; join.
Fasten off.
Round 4: With right side facing, join C in first sc of round 3, ch 1, slip st in same sc, *slip st in next 16 sc, sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in each of next 6 sc, sc in next 6 sc, slip st in next 16 sc*, slip st in next sc, repeat from * to * once; join.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join.
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.
Top Border
Place a marker in center 2 sc at each end of top wings, 7th and 18th sc from each end on top edge. 
With right side facing, join B in 7th sc to the left of marked center 2 sts on left hand side of top wings. 
Row 1: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 11 sc, slip st in each sc across to next marked sc, sc in next 11 sc, 2 sc in next sc, turn, leaving remaining sts unworked. 
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each of next 12 sc, slip st in each slip st across to next sc, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn. 
Row 3: Ch 1, (hdc, sc) in first sc, sc in next 13 sc, slip st in each slip st across to next sc, sc in next 13 sc, (sc, hdc) in last sc, do not turn. Fasten off. 
With right side facing, join D in first hdc of row 3. 
Row 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first hdc, sc in each sc across to next slip st, slip st in next 2 sc, slip st and in each slip st across, slip st in next 2 sc, sc in each sc across to last hdc, 2 sc in last hdc, turn. 
Row 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across to next slip st, slip st in each slip st across to next sc, sc in each sc across to last sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn. 
Row 6: Ch 1, (hdc, sc) in first sc, sc in next 14 sc, slip st in each slip st across, sc in next 14 sc, (hdc, sc) in last sc, do not turn. Fasten off. 
With right side facing, join a in first hdc of row 6. 
Rows 7-8: With a, repeat rows 4-5. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
assembly
Place one marker 1½” to the right and 1½” to the left of center on top of top wings. With a strand of any color yarn, weave over and under sts from one marker to the other marker and pull to tighten and cinch in sts to equal about 2”. On bottom edge, mark 9th sc to the right of marked end of right top wing and 9th sc to the left of marked end of left top wing. 
Mark center between end 2 sc of both bottom wings. Then mark 16th sc to the left of bottom left wing and 16th sc to the right of bottom right wing. Place top wings over center of bottom wings. Pin in place. Pin together where marked sc of top and bottom wings meet. With C, using running st, sew together top and bottom wings through sc of last round of top wing and ends of rows on bottom wing. 
edging 
With right side facing, join C in first sc to the left of bottom center ch of bottom wing. 
Round 1: Ch 1, work around entire butterfly by working sc in each sc, sc in each slip st, sc in end of each row, 2 sc in each hdc, and 3 sc in 2 corner scs at top of top wings; join. 
Fasten off. 
Center Body
With B, ch 4. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn – 3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn – 5 sc.
Rows 4-6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across to last sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn – 7 sc.
Rows 8-16: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 17: Ch 1, sc2tog in first 2 sts, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog in last 2 sts, turn – 5 sc.
Row 18: Ch 1, sc2tog in first 2 sts, sc in next sc, sc2tog in last 2 sts, turn – 3 sc.
Body Border
Round 1: With right side facing, ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, working across side edge of body, sc in end of each row to bottom, working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next ch, 2 sc in center ch, sc in last ch, working across side edge of body, sc in each row to top; join. Do not fasten off.
First Antenna
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in same sc, turn
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in next sc, turn.
Rows 3-8: Repeat row 2. 
Row 9: Ch 1, (sc, 2 hdc) in next sc. Fasten off. 
Second Antenna
With right side facing, join B in next sc on top of body border.
Rows 1-8: Repeat rows 1-8 of first antenna.
Row 9: Ch 1, (2 hdc, sc) in next sc. Fasten off. 
Position body at center with first and last rows over edge at bottom and top. Sew onto wings with B through sc of border round using a running st. 
Large Flower (make 4)
With B, ch 4; join with a slip st to form ring.
Round 1: [Sc in ring, ch 5] 5 times; join – 5 ch-5 spaces. 
Round 2: *5 sc in next ch-5 space, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around, ending with last slip st in joining slip st of last round. Fasten off leaving a 16” tail. 
Small Flower (make 4)
With B, ch 4, join; join with a slip st to form ring.
Round 1: [Sc in ring, ch 4] 5 times; join – 5 ch-5 spaces. 
Round 2: *4 sc in next ch-4 space, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around, ending with last slip st in joining slip st of last round. Fasten off leaving a 16” tail. 
FINISHING
Pin 1 small and 1 large flower on each side of bottom wings. Sew flowers on with tails of yarn. Place 2 butterfly pieces together with right sides facing out. With C, sew front to back using a whipstitch through border round, leaving a space open at the bottom center for stuffing. Fill with polyester fiberfill and sew opening closed. With B, sew top edges of body together and bottom edges of body together using a running st. With B, sew corresponding antennae together. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 315 yds/288 m)
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 12 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Motif 
See Chart on page 2.
With Color 1, ch 5. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout). 11 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch‑3. Fasten off. Skip ch‑3. Join Color 2 in first sp. 12 dc.
2nd rnd: With Color 2, ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. *Skip next dc. 2 dc in next sp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to top of ch‑3. Fasten off. Skip first ch‑3. Skip next dc. Join Color 3 in next sp between 2 dc.
3rd rnd: With Color 3, ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same sp as last sl st. *Skip next 3 dc. 3 dc in next sp. Skip next 3 dc. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next sp. Rep from * twice more. Skip next 3 dc. 3 dc in next sp. Join with sl st to top of ch‑3. Fasten off. Join Color 4 in first ch‑2 sp.
4th rnd: With Color 4, ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same ch‑2 sp as last sl st. *(Skip next 3 dc. 3 dc in next sp) twice. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch‑2 sp. Rep from * twice more. (Skip next 3 dc. 3 dc in next sp) twice. Join with sl st to top of ch‑3. Fasten off. Join Color 5 in first ch‑2 sp.
5th rnd: With Color 5, ch 2 (counts as hdc). (2 hdc. Ch 2. 3 hdc) in same ch‑2 sp as last sl st. *(Skip next 3 dc. 3 hdc in next sp) 3 times. (3 hdc. Ch 2. 3 hdc) in next ch‑2 sp. Rep from * twice more. (Skip next 3 hdc. 3 hdc in next sp) 3 times. Join with sl st to top of ch‑3. Fasten off.
Follow Guides below for colors and quantities of Motifs:
FINISHING
Front and Back (make alike): Sew Motifs tog following Seaming Diagram. Joining Front and Back: With WS facing each other, place Front and Back pieces tog. With RS of Front facing, Join A with sl st to any corner st of Pillow. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work sc evenly around 3 sides of Cushion, having 3 sc in each corner. Insert pillow form before joining last side. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Caron® Jumbo Twirl™ (12 oz/340 g; 578 yds/528 m)
Contrast A Mustard Ribbon (83010) 1 ball or 255 yds/232 m
Contrast B Soft Sage Ribbon (83013) 1 ball or 340 yds/311 m
Contrast C Off White Ribbon (83003) 1 ball or 340 yds/311 m
Contrast D Iris Ribbon (83013) 1 ball or 340 yds/311 m
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Cluster = (Yoh and draw up a long loop, equal in height to beg ch-3. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 6 times all in same hdc as sl st. Yoh and draw through 6 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through last 2 loops.
gauge: Flower Motif = 3" [7.5 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• When changing color at end of 
round, draw new color through 
2 loops on hook and proceed in 
new color.
• Motifs are joined as you work.
First Motif
See diagram on page 2.
**With A, make magic loop.
1st rnd: Ch 2 ( does not count as 
hdc). 12 hdc in magic loop. Join 
Color 2 with sl st to top of first hdc. 
Break A. Pull end tightly to close 
center hole and secure on WS.

2nd rnd: With Color 1, ch 3 (counts 
as dc). (Yoh and draw up a long loop, 
equal in height to beg ch-3. Yoh and 
draw through 2 loops on hook) 6 times 
all in same hdc as sl st. Yoh and draw 
through 6 loops on hook. Yoh and 
draw through last 2 loops. Ch 3. Sl st in same hdc – first Petal made. *1 sc in next hdc. (Sl st. Ch 3. Cluster. Ch 3. Sl st) in next hdc – Petal Cluster made. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sc in last hdc. 6 petals total.**

3rd rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc. Ch 1). *1 sc in top of next Petal. Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. Rep from * 5 times more. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-4. Fasten off.

Second Motif (Join 1 side)
Work from ** to ** as given for First Motif.
3rd rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc. Ch 1). 1 sc in top of next Petal. Join with sl st in sc in top of any Petal of adjoining Motif. Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in top of next Petal. Sl st in sc in top of next Petal of adjoining Motif. *Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in top of next Petal. Rep from * 3 times more. Ch 1. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-4. Fasten off.

Next Motif (Join 2 sides)
Work from ** to ** as given for First Motif.
3rd rnd: Ch 4 (counts as dc. Ch 1). 1 sc in top of next Petal. Sl st in sc in top of first (right) adjoining Motif before existing join. Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in top of next Petal. Sl st in same sc as existing join. Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in top of next Petal. Sl st in sc in top of second (left) Motif after existing join. *Ch 1. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in top of next Petal. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of beg ch-4. Fasten off.

Following Assembly Diagram as color reference, work rem Motifs, joining as shown.
FINISHING
When assembly is complete, fold piece and align ‘peaks and valleys’ along sides. Sew Petals tog on one side. Insert pillow form and sew opposite side edge.

materials: Bernat® Colorwhirl™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 77 yds/70 m)
Size U.S. Q (16 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 5 dc and 2½ rows = 4" [10 cm] in Bargello Pat.
instructions:
Note: To join new color, work to last loops on hook of first color. Yoh with new color, draw through loops and proceed with new color.
Stripe Pat 
With A, 2 rows.
With B, 2 rows.
With C, 2 rows.
These 6 rows form Stripe Pat.
With A, ch 61. See diagram on page 2.
Foundation row:  (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in next ch.  Ch 3. Sl st in next ch. Skip next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. Skip next 2 ch. Slip st in next ch. *Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. Ch 3. Sl st in next ch. Skip next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. Skip next 2 ch. Slip st in next ch. Rep from * to last 3 ch. Ch 3. 1 dc in each of last 3 ch. Turn.
1st row: (WS). *Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 3. Sl st in top of next ch 3 from previous row. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Sl st in top of next ch-3 from previous row. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc and top of ch-3 from previous row. Turn.

2nd row:  (RS). Working in back loops only,  *Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Ch 3. Sl st in top of next ch 3 from previous row. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Sl st in top of next ch-3 from previous row. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc and top of ch-3 from previous row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows for Bargello Pat. First 3 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.
Cont in Bargello and Stripe Pat until work from beg measures approx 48" [122 cm], ending with 2nd row of C.
Fasten off.
FINISHING: Fold work in half with WS tog. Sew 2 sides of tog. Insert pillow form. Sew rem edge closed.

materials: Caron® Cotton Cakes™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 530 yds/485 m)
Size U.S. G/6 (4 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 15 sc and 18 rows = 4" [10 cm]. 1 Motif = 6" [15 cm] square.
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as a st. Join all rnds with sl st to first hdc.

MOTIF (make 18)
With A, ch 3. See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd:  10 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join. 10 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 20 hdc.
3rd rnd:  Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as last sl st. *1 hdc in next hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Join. 30 hdc.
4th rnd:  Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as last sl st. *1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * to last 2 hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 2 hdc. Join. 40 hdc.
5th rnd: Join MC with sl st to back loop of first hdc. Ch 2. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in same sp as last sl st. *1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. 1 dc in next hdc. (1 dc. 1 tr. 1 dc) in next hdc. 1 dc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Rep from * twice more. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc. 1 dc in next hdc. Join. 48 sts.
6th rnd:  Ch 2. Working in both loops, 1 hdc in same sp as last sl st. *1 hdc in each st to next corner tr. (1 hdc. 1 dc. 1 hdc) in next corner tr. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of rnd. Join. 56 sts.
7th rnd:  Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as last sl st. 1 hdc in each hdc around, working 3 hdc in corner dc. Join. 64 sts. Fasten off.
With RS facing each other and using MC, working through both thicknesses, crochet 3 Motifs into Strip. With MC, crochet 3 Strips tog to make Front and Back pieces. With WS facing of Front and Back tog, working through both thicknesses, join MC with sl st to any corner.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as sl st. *Work 45 sc across to next corner. 3 sc in corner. Rep from * twice more. Insert pillow form. Work 45 sc to end of rnd. 1 sc in same sp as first 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Skip next 2 sc. 6 dc in next sc. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 5 sc. Skip next 2 sc. 6 dc in next sc. Skip next 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Caron® Spice Cakes™ (8 oz/227 g; 239 yds/218 m)
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcfl = Double crochet in front loop only
Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
gauge: 8 sc and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: When joining new balls of yarn take care to match color changes as closely as possible to maintain color striping repeat.
FRONT
Ch 40 (multiple of 11 ch + 7). See diagram on page 2.
1st row: (RS). Working into horizontal “bump” at back of each ch, 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 ch. (1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 7 ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 2 ch. Turn. 39 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. (1 hdc in next hdc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 1 dcfl in next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 1 hdc in next hdc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. (Ch 5. Skip next 4 sts. Sl st in rem loop of next dc 2 rows below. Ch 5. Skip next 4 sts. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. (Working into sts 2 rows below and in front of ch-5 sp, 1 hdc in next hdc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 1 dcfl in next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 1 hdc in next hdc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows for pat until work from beg measures approx 17½" [44.5 cm], ending on 3rd row. Next row: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. (Working into sts 2 rows below and in front of ch-5 sp, 1 hdc in next hdc. 1 dc in each of next 7 sts. 1 hdc in next hdc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Fasten off.
BACK (make 2)
Ribbing: Ch 6.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. Turn. 5 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg (when slightly stretched) measures 18" [45.5 cm]. Do not fasten off. Proceed as follows:
1st row: (WS). Turn work sideways. Ch 1. Work 36 sc evenly across side edge of ribbing. Turn.
2nd row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 11" [28 cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With RS tog, overlap Back pieces to match Front with ribbed sections in center to create opening to insert pillow form. Sew outer edge seams. Turn Pillow RS out. Insert pillow form.

materials: Bernat® Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 315 yds/288 m)

abbreviations: First Popcorn = Ch 3 (counts as ddc). 3 dc in same sp as sl st. Drop loop from hook, insert hook in 3rd ch of ch 3 and pull dropped loop through
Popcorn = 4 dc in next sc. Drop loop from hook, insert hook in first dc of 4 dc group and pull dropped loop through
gauge: 11 sc and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Stripe Pat (turn at end of each rnd)
With B – 6 rnds.
With A – 2 rnds.
With B – 2 rnds.
These 10 rnds form Stripe Pat.
FRONT
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in ring. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: First popcorn. *Ch 1. Popcorn in next sc. Rep from * around. Ch 1. Join with sl st to top of first popcorn. 10 popcorns.
3rd rnd: First popcorn. *Ch 1. Popcorn in next ch-1 sp. Ch 2. Popcorn in next popcorn. Rep from * around, ending with: Popcorn in last ch-1 sp. Join with sl st to top of first popcorn. 20 popcorns.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. 2 sc in next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 50 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. *Ch 7. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 5 ch. Sl st in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * 24 times more, ending with sl st in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 25 points.
Proceed in Stripe Pat, work in rnds, turning at end of each rnd as follows:
1st rnd: (RS). With B, ch 1. *Working in rem loops of foundation ch. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) in side of last sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Skip next sl st and sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
2nd rnd: (WS). Skip first sc. *Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next ch 1 sp. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Skip next 2 sc. Rep from * around, ending with: 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Skip next sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
3rd rnd: (RS). Skip first sc. *Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Skip next 2 sc. Rep from * around, ending with: 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Skip next sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
First 3 rnds of Stripe Pat are complete.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last 2 rnds until 10 rnds of Stripe Pat are complete.
Cont with A only until work between outer points measures 18" [45.5 cm] in diameter. Fasten off.
BACK
Work as given for Front, substituting A for B and B for A.
FINISHING
Sew Front and Back tog through back loops, matching points of Front with valleys of Back and leaving opening for pillow form. Insert pillow form. Sew opening closed.

materials: Contrast A Soft Sunshine 1 ball or 34 yds/31 m

gauge: 10 sc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
STRIPE PAT
Work 7 rows each in A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H. These 56 rows form Stripe Pat.
FRONT & BACK (Make 2 alike).
With A, ch 31.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 30 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
First 2 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep 2nd row until 56 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Note:
• To change color while working joining rnd, work to last 2 loops on hook. Draw new color through 2 loops on hook to complete st and proceed in next color.
Join Front and Back:
With WS of Front and Back facing each other, join A with sl st to bottom right corner.
1st rnd: With A, ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, 1 sc into side of each of next 7 rows, joining B at end of last st. With B, work 1 sc into side of each of next 7 rows, joining C at end of last st.
Cont as established, changing colors as needed to correspond with Stripe Pat, having 3 sc in each top corner and working 1 sc in each sc along top edge in H. Cont in same manner down left side edge, working 3 sc in last row (with A). Insert Pillow form. Work 1 sc in each rem loops of foundation ch. Work 2 sc in same sp as first sc. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 376 Burgundy A, 3941 Chile B, 3950 Charcoal C, 400 Grey Heather D, 3946 Razzle E, 360 Café Latte F, 726 Coral G
Yarn needle, three 18” (45.5 cm) knife edge square pillow forms
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: Rounds 1-3 = 4” (10 cm) in diameter. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com and www.crochettoday.com

This colorful granny starts out round and then becomes a square. By just changing the order of the colors, you can crochet the perfect trio of pillows.
Round 6: Join next color with slip st in any ch-2 space, ch 3, dc in same space, *ch 1, 2 dc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * to beginning ch-3, ch 1; join with slip st in top of beginning ch 3—48 dc and 24 ch-1 spaces. Note: In Round 7, count each dc and each ch-1 space as a stitch. When you are instructed to skip or work into a stitch, the stitch may be a dc or it may be a ch-1 space.
Round 7: Slip st in next dc and ch-1 space, ch 4 (counts as tr), (tr, ch 3, 2 tr) in same ch-1 space (first corner made), *[ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st] twice, [ch 1, skip next st, sc in next st] 4 times, [ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st] twice, ch 1, skip next st, [2 tr, ch 3, 2 tr] in next ch-1 space (next corner made); repeat from * twice, [ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st] twice, [ch 1, skip next st, sc in next st] 4 times, [ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st] twice, ch 1, skip next st; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-4—16 tr, 36 ch-1 spaces, and 4 corner ch-3 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 8: Join next color with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 3, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same ch-3 space, *dc in each st and ch-1 space to next corner, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in corner ch-3 space; repeat from * twice, dc in each st and ch-1 space to beginning ch-3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—100 dc.
Round 9: Slip st in next dc and corner ch-3 space, ch 3, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same ch-3 space, *dc in each dc to next ch-3 space, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in each corner ch-3 space; repeat from * twice, dc in each dc to beginning ch-3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—116 dc. Fasten off.
Round 10: Join next color with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 3, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same ch-3 space, skip next dc, *(2 dc in next dc, skip next dc) to next corner, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next corner ch-3 space, skip next dc; repeat from * twice, (2 dc in next dc, skip next dc) to beginning ch-3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—128 dc.
Round 11: Slip st in next dc and corner ch-3 space, ch 3, (dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in same ch-3 space, *[2 dc in space between next two 2-dc groups] 15 times, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next corner ch-3 space; repeat from * twice, [2 dc in space between next two 2-dc groups] 15 times to beginning ch-3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—136 dc. Fasten off.
Round 12: Join next color with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 4, (tr, ch 3, 2 tr) in same ch-3 space, *tr in each dc to next corner ch-3 space, (2 tr, ch 3, 2 tr) in next corner ch-3 space; repeat from * twice, tr in each dc to beginning ch-3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-4—152 tr.
Round 13: Slip st in next tr and corner ch-3 space, ch 3, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same ch-3 space, ch 1, dc between first 2 tr, [ch 1, dc between next 2 tr] 18 times, *ch 1, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next ch-3 space, [ch 1, dc between next 2 tr] 19 times; repeat from * twice, ch 1; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—92 dc and 76 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
Round 14: Join next color with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch 3, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same ch-3 space, *dc in each dc and ch-1 space to next corner ch-3 space, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next corner ch-3 space around; repeat from * twice, dc in each dc and ch-1 space to beginning ch-3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—184 dc. Fasten off.
Round 15: Join next color with slip st in any corner ch-3 space, ch-3, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same ch-3 space, *dc in each dc to next corner ch-3 space, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next corner ch-3 space around; repeat from * twice, dc in each dc to beginning ch-3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—200 dc. Fasten off.
Assembly
With wrong sides of 2 identical squares held together and working through both layers, join yarn of Round 15 with slip st to any dc, slip st in each dc and ch-space, working 3 slip st in each corner, until 3 sides are joined. Insert pillow form, slip st in each remaining dc and ch-space to first slip st; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each Charcoal 3950 A, Turqua 512 B, Flamingo 259 C, Spring Green 672 D, and Aran 313 E
abbreviations: Hdc inc: Work 2 hdc in same st – 1 st increased.
Hdc dec: Work 1 hdc over two sts – 1 st decreased.
A, B, C, D, E = color A, B, C, D, E
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Pillow case fits pillow form sized: 12” x 16” (30 x 41 cm)
gauge: 11 sts = 4” [10 cm]; 9 rows = 4” [10 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
PILLOW
Diamond Motif (make 4)
With A, make a slip knot, leaving a 16” (40.5 cm) tail for seaming. Ch 3, hdc in 3rd ch from hook, turn.
Row 1: Ch 2 (does not count as st here and throughout), hdc inc in first st, turn – 2 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc inc in each st across, turn – 4 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 2, hdc inc in first st, hdc to last st, hdc inc in last st, turn – 6 hdc.
Rows 4–12: Repeat Row 3.
Fasten off A. Attach B to last worked hdc.
Row 13: Ch 2, hdc in each st across, turn – 24 hdc.
Row 14: Ch 2, hdc dec, hdc to last two sts, hdc dec, ch 2, turn – 22 hdc.
Rows 15-22: Repeat Row 13.
Row 23: Ch 2, [hdc dec] twice, turn – 2 hdc.
Row 24: Ch 2, hdc dc.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for seaming.
Make 3 more diamond motifs using the following color combinations:
Motif 2: D and E
Motif 3: B and E
Motif 4: C and A
Single Triangle (make 6)
With C, make a slip knot, leaving a 16” (40.5 cm) tail for seaming.
Ch 3, hdc in 3rd ch from hook, turn.
Row 1: Ch 2, hdc inc in first st, turn – 2 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc inc in each st across, turn – 4 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 2, hdc inc in first st, hdc to last st, hdc inc in last st, turn.
Rows 4–12: Repeat Row 3.
Fasten off.
Make 5 more single triangles in the following colors: 1 A, 1 B, 1 C, 2 D.
Half Triangles (make 4)
With B, make a slip knot, leaving a 16” (40.5 cm) tail for seaming.
Ch 3, hdc in third ch from hook, turn.
Row 1: Ch 2, hdc inc in first st, turn – 2 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc inc in first st, hdc, turn – 3 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 2, hdc to last st, hdc inc in last st, turn – 4 hdc.
Row 4: Ch 2, hdc inc in first st, hdc to end of row, turn – 5 hdc.
Rows 5-12: Repeat Rows 3 and 4.
Fasten off.
Make 3 more Half Triangles, one each in the following colors: A, D, and E.
ASSEMBLY
Seam the motifs together using the long tails and the diagram below.
Weave in any loose ends, securing any gaps left from seaming where the motifs meet. Your rectangle should now measure 34” (86 cm) long and 11” (28 cm) tall.
FINISHING
Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join E in any corner; ch 2, *3 hdc in corner, hdc in each st along the edge until you reach the next Small Triangle, hdc in gap between triangles, hdc in each st along the edge to next corner; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first hdc. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join A to center of any 3-hdc corner, ch 2, *3 hdc in center of 3-hdc group, hdc in the third loop (the loop found just below the back loop of the st) of each st around; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first hdc. Fasten off.
Round 3: Fold pillow case in half with wrong sides together, lining up triangles. Join D to either top corner, ch 1, sc across, catching both loops from both sides at once to seam the two sides together to corner, sc the first st of the 3-hdc group.
Fasten off.
Note: If you want to omit the button flap, place pillow form in case, and sc to join around entire pillow with D, seaming the pillow inside.
Repeat Round 3 on the opposite side, seaming up the edge with a row of sc.
Flap
Attach E in last st joined by Round 3 from Edging.
Row 1: Ch 2, hdc across to the last st joined by Round 3 at the end of the row, turn.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc in each st across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until the flap measures roughly 3” (8 cm).
Buttonholes
Tack or pin buttons to your case right below the flap, arranging them evenly across the edge; * hdc in each st to next button, ch 4; repeat from * across row. Fasten off.
Sew buttons to pillow case. Weave in ends and block if desired.

materials: Lily® Sugar ’n Cream (70.9 g/2.5 oz/109 m/120 yds) Main Color (MC) (00083 Cornflower Blue) 6 balls

instructions:
FRONT 
With MC and larger hook, ch 79.
1st row:(RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 78 sc.

Turn.

Join B. Turn.

Join B. Turn.

Turn.

FINISHING
Appliqué Words
“I’m”
For ‘I’, with B and smaller hook, ch 4.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across.
Turn.
Rep 2nd row 13 times more. Fasten off.
For ‘’’ (apostrophe), with B and smaller hook, ch 3.
1st row: (RS). 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
Sl st in next ch. Fasten off.
For ‘m’, with B and smaller hook, ch 3.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
1 sc in next ch. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across.
Turn.
Rep 2nd row 3 times more.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdc in next st. Turn.
7th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 sc in next sc. Turn.
8th to 11th rows: Rep 6th and 7th rows twice more.
12th row: Ch 7 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.  1 sc in each of next 5 ch. 1 sc in next sc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Turn.
13th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
14th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdc in last sc. Turn.
15th to 20th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st across. Turn. Fasten off at end of 20th row.
“digging”
For ‘d’, with B and smaller hook, ch 3.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
1 sc in next ch. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd to 15th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
**Place a marker on last sc worked. Do not fasten off. Do not turn.
Sl st in side of last 2 rows. Ch 10. Miss side of next 5 rows. Sl st in side of next 2 rows. Turn.
Work 1 sc in each of next 10 ch. Sl st in marked sc. Fasten off.**
For ‘i’ (make 2), with B and smaller hook, ch 3.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
1 sc in next ch. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd to 7th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn. Fasten off at end of 7th row.
For '.' (dot), with B and smaller hook, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
For ‘g’ (make 3), with B and smaller hook, ch 3.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
1 sc in next ch. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across.
Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Turn.
5th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 sc in next sc. Turn.
6th to 21st rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st across.
Rep from ** to ** as for ‘d’.
For ‘n’, with B and smaller hook, ch 3.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
1 sc in next ch. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd to 5th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdc in next st. Turn.
7th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 sc in next sc. Turn.
8th to 11th rows: Rep 6th and 7th rows twice more.
12th row: With working yarn, ch 7. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 5 ch. 1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next hdc. Ch 2. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in next sc. Fasten off.
“this!”
For ‘t’, with B and smaller hook, ch 3.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
1 sc in next ch. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
5th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
6th to 11th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st across. Turn.
With separate length of yarn, join B with sl st to first sc of last row. Ch 2. Fasten off.
12th row: Ch 3. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 ch. Turn. 6 sc.
13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
14th row: Sl st in each of first 3 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. Leave rem sc unworked.
15th and 16th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn. Fasten off.
For ‘h’, with B and smaller hook, ch 3.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
1 sc in next ch. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd to 5th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdc in next sc. Turn.
7th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 sc in next sc. Turn.
8th to 11th rows: Rep 6th and 7th rows twice more.
With separate length of yarn, join B with sl st to first hdc of last row. Ch 7. Fasten off.
12th row: Ch 7. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 5 ch. 1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next hdc. 1 sc in each of next 7 ch. Turn. 15 sc.
13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
Work ‘i’ as for ‘digging’.
For ‘s’, with B and smaller hook, ch 3.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.
1 sc in next ch. Turn. 2 sc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 sc in next sc. Turn.
5th to 8th rows: Rep 3rd and 4th rows twice more.
9th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first sc. 1 sc in next hdc. Turn.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Turn.
11th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 sc in next sc. Turn.
12th to 17th rows: Rep 10th and 11th rows 3 times more.
18th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next hdc. Fasten off.
For ‘!’, with B and smaller hook, ch 11.
1st rnd: Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. Sl st in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 8 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working along opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 8 ch . Sl st in last 2 ch. Fasten off.
Work '.' (dot) as for 'i'.
Position ‘I’m digging this!’ letters on Front as shown. Sew around outer edge of letters securely.
Pin Front and Back pieces to Side Panel, having markers on Side Panel at corners of Front and Back.

Work rem of rnd in sc across Front only, leaving Side Panel free to insert zipper. Join B with sl st to first sc. Break MC.
Next rnd: With B, ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Sew zipper in position.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 1 skein each of 1308 Tan A, 1907 Boysenberry B, 1620 Clover C, 1623 Mallard D, and 1601 Lettuce E.

small-Cl (2 double crochet cluster) = Yarn over, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook (2 loops remain on hook); yarn over, insert hook in same stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops, yarn over, draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Cl (3 double crochet cluster) = Yarn over, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook (2 loops remain on hook); [yarn over, insert hook in same stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops] 2 times, yarn over and draw through all 4 loops on hook.
V-st (V-stitch) = (Sc, ch 3, sc) in indicated stitch.
dc2tog-over 3 (double crochet 2 stitches together worked over 3 stitches) = Yarn over, insert hook in next cluster, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops, skip next ch-1 space, yarn over, insert hook in next cluster, yarn over and pull up a loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
shell = (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in indicated space.
Notes
1. Pattern is for pillow front and is worked with 2 strands of yarn held together throughout, beginning with center motif.
2. Center motif is worked in joined rounds beginning at center. Rounds are worked with right side facing at all times. Do not turn rounds.
3. End sections are worked back and forth in rows across two opposite side edges of the center motif to form the piece into a rectangle.
4. Size of piece can be adjusted to fit size of preferred purchased pillow.

Row 1: With right side facing and 2 strands of B held together, draw up a loop in ch-2 space of any corner shell, ch 2 (does not count as a st here and throughout), dc in same ch-2 space, skip next dc, dc in each dc across to 1 dc before next corner ch-2 space, skip next dc, dc in ch-2 space of shell, turn; leave remaining sts unworked.
Row 2: Ch 2, dc in each dc across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 four more times or until piece is long enough to cover one end of pillow, when center motif is placed at center of pillow. Fasten off.
Second End Section
With right side facing and 2 strands of B held together, draw up a loop in ch-2 sp of first unworked shell following first end section, to work across opposite side of center motif. Work second end section same as first end section, but do not fasten off when section is complete.

If necessary, turn piece so that right side is facing, ch 1, sc evenly spaced around entire outer edge of pillow front, working 2 sc in each corner; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Block piece, if desired. With sewing needle and matching thread, whipstitch pillow front to front of purchased pillow.

instructions:
Note: Ch-3 at beg of rnds/rows counts as dc.
PILLOW FRONT
With A, ch 29.
