Working in back loops only, *Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join B with sl st to first sc. 16 sts. Next rnd: With B, ch 1. Working in back loops only, Sc2tog around. Join with sl st to first sc. 8 sts. Fasten off leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely. OAK LOG Ends (make 2) (See Chart on page 3) With A, ch 2. 1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join A with sl st to first sc. 2nd rnd: With A, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in each sc around. Join B with sl st to first sc. 16 sc. 3rd rnd: With B, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 24 sts. 4th rnd: With A, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join B with sl st to first sc. 32 sts. 5th rnd: With B, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 40 sts. 6th rnd: With A, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 44 sts. Fasten off. Bark Note: Work is turned at end of every 2nd row. (See Chart below) With C, ch 38. 1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 1 tr in each of next 3 ch. 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Rep from * to end of chain. Remove hook from last st leaving a long loop to prevent unraveling. Do not turn. With RS still facing, join A with sl st to back loop only of first sc. 2nd row: (RS). With A, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Remove hook from last st leaving a long loop. Turn. Pick up C loop from 1st row and tighten on hook. 3rd row: (WS). With C, ch 4 (counts as tr). Working in front loops only, *1 tr in next sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 tr in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Remove hook from last st leaving a long loop. Do not turn. With WS still facing, pick up A loop from 2nd row and tighten on hook. 4th row: (WS). With A, ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Remove hook from last st leaving a long loop. Turn. Pick up C loop from 1st row and tighten on hook. 5th row: (RS). Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in 1st sc. *1 sc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 tr in each of next 3 sc. 1 dc in each of next 2 sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Remove hook from last st leaving a long loop to prevent unraveling. Do not turn. With RS still facing, join A with sl st to back loop only of first sc. 6th row: (RS). As 2nd row. Rep rows 3 to 6 until work from beg measures approx 18¾" [47.5 cm], ending on a 6th row. Fasten off. Sew last row to foundation ch to form tube. FINISHING Sew one End to open side of Bark. Insert pillow form. Sew other End to rem open side.

pattern_name: Goldilocks and the Three Bears Pillow
materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 334 Buff A, 316 Soft White B, 360 Café Latte C, 312 Black D, 320 Cornmeal E, 885 Delft F, 706 Perfect Pink G, 313 Aran H, 381 Light Blue I, 672 Spring Green J, 324 Bright Yellow K
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 4mm [US G-6] and 5mm [US H-8]
Yarn needle, stitch marker, 16” (40.5 cm) square pillow form, red crayon (to shade cheeks), black embroidery floss (for facial features)
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.;
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 10 sts = 3” (7.5 cm); 7 rows = 3” (7.5 cm) in alternating rows of double crochet and single crochet with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
PILLOW
Sides (make 2) With larger hook and A, ch 50.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—49 sts.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each dc across, turn.
Rows 4–17: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 seven times.
Row 18: Repeat Row 2; change to B.
Row 19: Repeat Row 3.
Rows 20–35: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 eight times.
Last round (right side): Ch 1, 3 sc in first st, sc in each remaining st across to last st, 3 sc in last st; working in ends of rows, sc evenly down first side; working across opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in each ch across to last ch, 3 sc in last ch; working in ends of rows, sc evenly up other side; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

PAPA BEAR
Head Beginning at top of head, with C, ch 4.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in next ch, sc in last ch, turn—4 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next 2 sc, sc in last sc, turn—6 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn—8 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, 3 sc in first sc, sc in last 7 sc, turn—10 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first 8 sc, sc2tog, turn—9 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in last 7 sc, turn—8 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc, turn—6 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last sc—4 sc. Fasten off.

Arm (make 2) Beginning at hand, with C, ch 2. 
Row 1 (right side): Work 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc; change to E, turn—3 sc.
Rows 4–9: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc3tog—1 sc. Fasten off.

Foot (make 2) Beginning at top of leg, with C, ch 4. 
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in last 2 sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—5 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.

Ear (make 2) With C, ch 2. 
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 hdc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first hdc—6 hdc. Fasten off.

Shirt Beginning at neck edge, with E, ch 7.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn—8 sc.
Rows 3–7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off.

Pants With F, ch 7.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in next ch, sc in next 2 ch, 2 sc in next ch, sc in last ch, turn—8 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
First leg Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—4 sc.
Rows 6 and 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off. 

Second leg Row 1: With right side of pants and first leg facing, join F with sc in first unworked st of Row 5, sc in remaining sts, turn—4 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off.

MAMA BEAR
Head Work same as Papa Bear head.
Arm With C throughout, work same as Papa Bear arm.
Foot (make 2) Beginning at top of leg, with C, ch 4. 
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in last 2 sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—5 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.

Ear Work same as Papa Bear ear.
Dress Beginning at neck edge, with G, ch 7.
Rows 1–4: Work same as Rows 1–4 of Papa Bear pants—8 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first 2 sc, sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in last 2 sc—12 sc. Fasten off.

Flower (make 2) With G, ch 2. 
Round 1 (right side): Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, [ch 1, slip st] 4 times in same ch, ch 1; join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.

BABY BEAR (front side)
Head Rows 1–4: Work same as Rows 1–4 of Papa Bear head—8 sc.
Rows 5 and 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc, turn—6 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last sc—4 sc. Fasten off.

Arm With C, ch 2.
Row 1 (right side): Work 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in last sc, turn—2 sc.
Rows 4–6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Row 7: Ch 1, sc2tog—1 sc. Fasten off.

Foot (make 2) Beginning at top of leg, with C, ch 3. 
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next ch, turn—2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in last sc, turn—3 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, 2 sc in last sc—4 sc. Fasten off.

Ear (make 2) With C, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc—6 sc. Fasten off.

Sun Suit Beginning at top of suit, with E, ch 6. 
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn—5 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 2 sc, turn—6 sc.
Rows 5 and 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
First leg Row 7: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—3 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 9: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in last 2 sc—4 sc. Fasten off.

Second leg Row 1: With right side of sun suit and first leg facing, join E with sc in first unworked st, sc in last 2 sc, turn—3 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Repeat Rows 8 and 9 of first leg.

GOLDILOCKS
Head Beginning at top of head, with H, ch 4. 
Rows 1–3: Work same as Rows 1–3 of Papa Bear head—6 sc.
Rows 4 and 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice—2 sc. Fasten off. 

BED
Mattress With I, ch 16.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—15 sc.
Rows 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Fasten off.

Head Post With F, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 hdc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in first hdc, turn. Continue in rows.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first hdc, turn—2 sc.
Rows 3–15: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Fasten off.

Foot Post Work same as Rows 1–12 of head post. 
Fasten off.

Blanket With J, ch 13.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—12 sc.
Rows 2–11: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Fasten off.

BOAT PICTURE 
Background With E, ch 9.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn—8 sc.
Rows 2–8: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Round 9: Ch 1, working in each st, in ends of rows, and in opposite side of foundation ch, slip st evenly around; join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.

Frame Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, join F with sc in back loop of any slip st, working in back loops only, sc in each slip st around working 3 sc in each corner st; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

Large Sail With B, ch 6. 
Row 1 (right side): Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in last 2 ch. Fasten off.
Small Sail With B, ch 4. 
Row 1 (right side): Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in last ch. Fasten off.

BABY BEAR (back side) 
Work all pieces same as Baby Bear for front side including 2 arms.

FINISHING 
(See Stitch Illustrations on next page) Use photograph as a guide for placement of embroidery stitches and pieces. Embroider and sew in place with right side of each piece facing. 

Papa Bear With D, embroider satin stitch nose and eyes and a lazy daisy stitch for the mouth.
Mama Bear Embroider face same as Papa Bear. With G, embroider chain stitches along lower edges of feet. Embroider long straight stitches for a strap across each foot. Sew flower to top of each strap.

Baby Bear (front side) With D, embroider satin stitch eyes, nose, and mouth. Stitch mouth in an inverted V-shape so bear appears to be frowning.

Goldilocks With 3 strands of black embroidery floss held together, embroider couch stitch eyes and mouth. Embroider a French knot on each eye. Color cheeks with red crayon. 

Hair Beginning at side edge of head near cheek, with K, work a small stem stitch over the end of a row, working across ends of rows and in sts, work next stem stitch close to the first allowing a ½-¾” (1.5-2 cm) long loop to form; *holding the loop in place, work next stem stitch close to the last one made; repeat from * across as many times as needed to create curls. Fasten off. Fluff loops up.

Boat Picture Sew sails in place on picture. With J, embroider satin stitch boat under sails. With D, embroider stem stitches between sails for mast. With G, embroider satin stitches for flag.

Baby Bear (back side) Embroider eyes and nose same as Baby Bear on front side. Work mouth with satin stitches so bear appears to be smiling. With right sides facing, arrange all pieces except flowers on front and back sides of pillow, layering as needed, and pin in place. Sew all pieces in place. Weave in ends.

Sides Hold front and back sides with wrong sides together. With a long strand of B, sew through inner loops around 3 sides, insert pillow form, and sew through remaining stitches to close pillow sides. Weave in ends.

materials: Caron® Jumbo™ (12 oz/340 g; 595 yds/544 m) Main Color (MC) Bouquet (09042) 1 ball
Caron® One Pound™ (16 oz/453.6 g; 812 yds/742 m) Contrast A Oﬀ White (10514) 1 ball
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
12" x 18" [30.5 x 45.5 cm] pillow form. Stitch marker.
abbreviations: Lp st = Loop stitch = Insert hook in next stitch. Wrap working yarn over top of index finger, from front to back, to form 1" [2.5 cm] loop. Placing tip of hook behind yarn at front of index finger, Yoh and draw up a loop onto hook. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook, dropping loop off index finger to back of work (see diagram). Loop will be formed on RS of work.

Lpst2tog = Loop stitch 2 together = Draw up a loop in next stitch. Insert hook in next stitch. Wrap working yarn over top of index finger, from front to back, to form 1" [2.5 cm] loop. Placing tip of hook behind yarn at front of index finger, Yoh and draw up a loop onto hook. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 12" x 18" [30.5 x 45.5 cm], excluding fringe.
gauge: 12 sc and 13 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
FRONT
Notes:
• Front is worked from corner to corner in diagonal (bias) rows.
• To join new color, work to last loops on hook of previous color. Yoh with new color, draw through rem loops and proceed with new color.
Inc Section:
With MC, ch 2.
1st row: (RS). 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 Lp st in each of 2 sc. Turn. 4 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Turn. 6 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. 2 Lp st in first sc. 1 Lp st in each sc to last sc. 2 Lp st in last sc. Turn. 8 sts.
5th to 14th rows: Rep 3rd and 4th rows 5 times more. Join A. Break MC. Turn. 28 sts.
15th row: (RS). With A, ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Turn. 30 sc.
16th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Join MC. Break A Turn. 32 sc.
17th row: With MC, ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Turn. 34 sc.
18th row: Ch 1. 2 Lp sts in first sc. 1 Lp st in each sc to last sc. 2 Lp sts in last sc. Turn. 36 sts.
19th to 30th rows: Rep 17th and 18th rows 6 times more. Join A. Break MC. Turn. 60 sts.
Body Section:
1st row: (RS). With A, ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Join MC. Break A. Turn.
3rd row:  With MC, ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. Lpst2tog. 1 Lp st in each st to last st. 2 Lp st in last st. Turn.
5th to 16th rows: Rep 3rd and 4th rows 6 times more. Join A. Break MC. Turn.
17th row: (RS). With A, ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
18th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Join MC. Break A. Turn.
Dec Section:
1st row: (RS). With MC, ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 58 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Lpst2tog. 1 Lp st in each sc to last 2 sc. Lpst2tog. Turn. 56 sts.
3rd to 14th rows: Rep 1st and 2nd rows 6 times more. Join A. Break MC. Turn. 32 sts.
15th row: (RS). With A, ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 30 sc.
16th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join MC. Break A. Turn. 28 sts.
17th row: With MC, ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 26 sc.
18th row: Ch 1. Lpst2tog. 1 Lp st in each sc to last 2 sc. Lpst2tog. Turn. 24 sts.
19th to 28th rows: Rep 17th and 18th rows 5 times more. 4 sts.
29th row: (RS). Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sc.
30th row: Ch 1. Lpst2tog. Fasten off.
BACK (make 2 pieces alike)
Ribbing: With A, ch 7.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 6 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg (when slightly stretched) measures 12" [30.5 cm]. Do not fasten off. Proceed as follows:
1st row: Turn work sideways. Ch 1. Work 36 sc evenly along side of Ribbing. Turn. PM at end of row.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from marker measures 10" [25.5 cm]. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Blocking: Pin pieces to the following measurements:
Front: 12" x 18" [30.5 x 45.5 cm] Back (each piece): 12" [30.5 cm] square.
Cover with a damp towel to dry.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 2 skeins 4313 Aran Fleck A, 1 skein each 406 Med. Thyme B, 320 Cornmeal C, 365 Coffee D and 336 Warm Brown E
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 4mm [US G-6] and 5.5 mm [US I-9]
abbreviations: A, B, C, etc. = color A, B, C, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
sc2tog = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Pillow cover fits 18” (46 cm) pillow form
gauge: 12 sts = 4” (10 cm); 9 rows = 4” (10 cm) in dc with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain gauge.
instructions:
PILLOW
Pillow Top (Make 2)
With A and larger hook, ch 50.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 49 sc.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as first dc), skip first sc, dct in each sc across; turn – 49 dc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each dc to last st, sc in top of ch-2; turn.
Rows 4-37: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 17 times; do not fasten off.
Border
Ch 1, sc around pillow working 3 sc in each corner and working 47 sc between corners; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Giraffe
Begin at bottom of body with C and smaller hook, ch 34.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 33 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog; turn – 31 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across; turn – 30 sc.
Row 5: Repeat Row 2.
Rows 6-9: Repeat Rows 4 and 5 twice – 28 sc.
Row 10: Repeat Row 3 – 26 sc.
Row 11: Repeat Row 4 – 25 sc.
Row 12: Repeat Row 3 – 23 sc.
Row 13: Repeat Row 2.
Row 14: Repeat Row 4 – 22 sc.
Rows 15-17: Repeat Row 2.
Row 18: Repeat Row 4 – 21 sc.
Row 19-24: Repeat Rows 2 and 4 three times – 18 sc.
Rows 25-27: Repeat Row 3 – 12 sc at end of Row 27.
Row 28: Repeat Row 4 – 11 sc.
Row 29: Repeat Row 2.
Rows 30-33: Repeat Rows 4 and 2 twice – 9 sc.
Row 34: Repeat Row 4 – 8 sc.
Rows 35-44: Repeat Row 2.
Chin-Row 45: Ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, sc in next 8 sc; turn – 12 sc.
Row 46: Ch 1, sc in next 11 sc; 2 sc in last sc; turn – 13 sc.
Row 47: Ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, sc in next 12 sc, 2 sc in last sc; turn – 16 sc.
Rows 48 and 49: Repeat Row 2.
Row 50: Ch 1, sc in next 14 sc, sc2tog; turn – 15 sc.
Row 51: Repeat Row 3 – 13 sc.
Row 52: Ch 1, sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog; turn, leaving remaining sts unworked – 7 sc.
Row 53: Repeat Row 3 – 5 sc.
Row 54: Repeat Row 2. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Using photo as a guide, sew Giraffe to one Pillow Top, lightly stuffing face. Sew button eyes to Giraffe’s face. Use 12 strands of embroidery floss to backstitch mouth and embroider French knot nostrils.
Ear (Make 2)
With C and smaller hook, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, 3 sc in last ch, working in remaining loops along opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 4 ch; turn – 11 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, 3 sc in next sc, sc in last 5 sc. Fasten off.
Sew bottom of one Ear to each side of Giraffe’s head, then tack center of each Ear in place, leaving ends free for dimension.
Mane
With D and smaller hook, ch 31; skip first ch from hook, * insert hook into next ch, using a left-hand finger to control the loop size, catch both strands of yarn below the loop on finger with the hook, pull loops through the ch, yo and pull through all 3 loops on hook; repeat from * across. Fasten off.
Sew Mane to back of neck.
Horn (Make 2)
With E and smaller hook, ch 5; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; slip st in next 3 ch. Fasten off.
Sew Horns to top of head.
Large Spot (Make 4)
Round 1: With E and smaller hook, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join in first sc – 12 sc. Fasten off.
Small Spot (Make 5)
Work same as Large Spot through Round 1. Fasten off.
Sew Large and Small Spots to Giraffe’s neck and body as desired.
Leaf (Make 10)
With B and smaller hook, ch 18.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 15 ch, 3 sc in last ch, working in remaining loops along opposite side of foundation ch, sc in 16 ch; turn – 35 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, hdc in next sc, dc in next 2 sc, tr in next 11 sc, 2 tr in next sc, 5 tr in next sc, 2 tr in next sc, tr in next 11 sc, dc in next 2 sc, hdc in next sc, sc in last 2 sc; turn – 41 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 20 sts, 3 sc in next st, sc in last 20 sts. Fasten off.
Tack leaves in place, leaving some ends free for dimension.
Finishing
Working through both thicknesses with wrong sides together, sc Pillow Tops together along 3 sides; insert pillow form, sc last side closed; join to first sc. Fasten off. Weave in all ends.

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Contrast A Sea Gull Grey (10931) 1 ball
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Popcorn = Work 5 dc in indicated stitch. Drop loop from hook. Re-insert hook from front to back into first dc of 5-dc group. Pull dropped loop through stitch. Ch 1 to close popcorn.
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
Notes:
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops and proceed, keeping color change to WS of work.
• Carry yarn not in use loosely across top of previous row and work sts around it to prevent stranding.
• Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
• Pillow is worked in 2 halves with foundation chain at the middle of Pillow.

CROCHET  I  SKILL LEVEL: INTERMEDIATE

MATERIALS
Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) 
Contrast A Sea Gull Grey (10931) 1 ball
Contrast B Vintage White (10006) 2 balls
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.

Crochet stitches add interest to your décor with these three pillow covers—Subtle Texture in Wine, Waffle Weave in Toast and Braided Cables in Leaf. All feature the same back with button band, so you can remove covers and easily wash them.

FRONT-Subtle Texture
With A, ch 54.

With C, ch 52.

Repeat Rows 2-6 for Braided Cables pattern until 17½” from beginning, end wrong side row. Fasten off.
Finish same as for Subtle Texture Pillow.

materials: 3 balls STITCH NATION by Debbie Stoller™ “Full o’ Sheep™” in 2260 Clementine A
1 ball each of 2925 Passion fruit B, 2205 Little Lamb C, and 2012 Black Sheep D
abbreviations: A, B, C, etc. = color A, B, C, etc.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Pillow measures 14” wide x 10” high after felting.
gauge: 10 sts = 4”; 8 rows = 4” in hdc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
PILLOW
Body (Make 1)
Round 1: With A, ch 3, 7 hdc into 3rd ch from hook; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch – 8 sts.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), hdc in same st as joining, 2 hdc in each hdc around; join – 16 sts.
Round 3: Ch 2, 2 hdc in next hdc, [hdc in next hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 7 times; join – 24 sts.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in next hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc, [hdc in next 2 hdc, 2 hdc in next hdc] 7 times; join – 24 sts.
Continue to increase 8 sts every round working one more hdc between each of the 8 increases until the circle measures 20” across. Fasten off leaving 36” long yarn tail.
Wings (Make 2)
Round 1: With B, ch 20; 3 hdc in 3rd ch from hook, hdc in next 16 ch, 4 hdc in last ch, working on opposite side of beginning ch, hdc in next 16 ch; join – 40 sts.
Round 2: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, 2 hdc in next 3 hdc, hdc in next 16 hdc, 2 hdc in next 4 hdc, hdc in next 16 hdc; join – 48 sts.
Round 3: Ch 2, * [2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next hdc] 3 times, 2 hdc in next hdc *, hdc in next 17 hdc; repeat from * to *; hdc in next 16 hdc; join – 56 sts.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in next hdc, * [2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc] 3 times, 2 hdc in next hdc *, hdc in next 18 hdc; repeat from * to *; hdc in next 16 hdc; join – 64 sts.
Round 5: Ch 2, hdc in next 2 hdc, * [2 hdc in next hdc, hdc in next 3 hdc] 3 times, 2 hdc in next hdc *, hdc in next 19 hdc; repeat from * to *; hdc in next 16 hdc; join – 72 sts.
Continue to increase 8 sts every round as established every round for 5 more rounds – 112 sts. Fasten off leaving 36” long yarn tail.
Eyes (Make 2)
Round 1: With C, ch 3, 7 hdc in 3rd ch from hook; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch – 8 sts.
Round 2: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, 2 hdc in next 2 hdc, (hdc, dc, tr, dc, hdc) all in next hdc, 2 hdc in next 3 hdc, (hdc, dc, tr, dc, hdc) all in next hdc; join. Fasten off leaving 18” long yarn tail.
Beak (Make 1)
Row 1: With D, ch 3, 3 hdc in 3rd ch from hook; turn – 4 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc in first hdc, 2 hdc in next 2 hdc, 2 hdc in top of beginning ch; turn – 8 sts.
Rows 3 and 4: Ch 2, hdc in first hdc, 2 hdc in each hdc across and in top of ch-2; turn – 32 sts at end of Row 4. Fasten off leaving 18” long yarn tail.
Assembly
Fold body circle in half. Sew beak to one end. Arrange eyes and wings to be symmetrical on each side (front and back) of body. Sew each piece down to circle. Tack wings in several places to hold them snuggly against the body. With D, embroider pupils on eyes. Fold batting in several layers to fill bird shape. Cut to correct shape. Slip st around edge of body to close pillow, adding more stuffing to corners and edges. Fasten off. Weave in all ends.
Felting
Place assembled pillow in washing machine with old towels or jeans. Use hot water, detergent and longest wash cycle. Check felting progress frequently. When felted as desired, remove from washer and rinse in sink. Squeeze out excess water. Pull and stretch to desired shape, tugging at batting to even out filling. Allow to dry in warm draft for a day or two. With C, embroider dots on wings.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 4 skeins each 1502 Iced Aqua A and 1932 Minty B

gauge: 4 pattern repeats = 4" (10 cm) (one pattern repeat consists of one slip stitch and one half double crochet); 10 rows = 4" (10 cm) in slip stitch and half double crochet; 9 dc = 4" (10 cm); 6 rows = 5" (12.5 cm) in double crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Notes
1. Pillow cover is made of one long panel, folded and seamed.
2. Hold 2 strands of yarn together throughout.
3. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Proceed with new color. Fasten off old color.
Special Technique
Join with sc = Place a slip knot on hook, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop, yarn over and draw through both loops on hook.
PILLOW Cover
With 2 strands of A held together, loosely ch 45.
Row 1 (right side): (Slip st, hdc) in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—44 hdc.
Row 2: (Slip st, hdc) in each hdc across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 24" (61 cm) long, changing color to 2 strands of B in last row.
Next row: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in each st across, turn—44 dc.
Repeat last row until piece measures 47" (119.5 cm).
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Fold cover in half widthwise. With wrong sides held together, working through both thicknesses, and holding 2 strands together, sc join B in end of top row, sc in end of each row across to fold. Fasten off. Repeat for 2nd side edge. Weave in ends. Insert pillow form. Sew buttons evenly spaced across A-colored top edge, using spaces between dc as buttonholes or place buttons on B-color top edge and sew through both thicknesses to permanently close cover.

instructions:
Notes:

• Back is worked in 2 pieces that are over-lapped to create opening to insert pillow form.
FRONT 
With MC, ch 60.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 59 sc.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
4th row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 8 sc. 1 scbl in each of next 3 sc. (1 sc in each of next 17 sc. 1 scbl in each of next 3 sc) twice. 1 sc in each of last 8 sc. Turn.
5th and alt rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sc. 1 scbl in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 scbl in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 scbl in each of next 2 sc. (1 sc in each of next 11 sc. 1 scbl in each of next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 scbl in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 scbl in each of next 2 sc) twice. 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. 1 scbl in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 scbl in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. (1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 1 scbl in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 scbl in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 scbl in each of next 3 sc) twice. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Turn.
10th row: As 8th row.
12th row: As 6th row.
14th row: As 4th row.
15th to 19th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
20th to 62nd rows: Beg on a RS row, rep 4th to 19th rows twice more, then rep 4th to 14th rows once.
63rd and 64th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off.
BACK (make 2 pieces alike)
Ribbing: With A, ch 7.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 6 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg (when slightly stretched) measures 20" [51 cm]. Do not fasten off.
Proceed as follows:
1st row: Turn work sideways. Ch 1. Work 59 sc evenly along side of Ribbing. Turn. PM at end of row.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from marker measures 11" [28 cm]. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Fringe: Cut strands of A, B, and C each 3½" [9 cm] long. With RS of Front facing, taking 3 strands tog, fold in half and knot into fringe in each rem (unworked) loop of sc along 4th, 6th, 8th, 10th, 12th and 14th row reps, as shown in Chart on page 3, noting each square represents 1 sc.
Joining Front and Back: Overlap Back pieces to match Front, with ribbed sections in center to create opening to insert pillow form. With RS facing, join MC with sl st to any corner st of Pillow. Ch 1. Working through all thicknesses sc evenly around with 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

With A, ch 17. (See Diagram on page 2).

With A, ch 33.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 32 sc.

Cont on 6 center sts for neck.
Next 7 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off.

LIMBS (make 4)
Note: Limbs are worked in a continuous spiral. Do not join rnds. Move marker up each rnd to maintain rnd count.
Beg at bottom edge, with A, ch 9.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 7 ch. Working into opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of next 8 ch. 16 sc. Place marker on last st.
2nd to 60th rnds: 1 sc in each sc around, moving marker up each rnd (see Note).
Fasten off, leaving 24" [61 cm] yarn tail (sew this edge to Torso).

EYES (make 2)
With B, make magic ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. Work 11 dc in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off, leaving 16" [40.5 cm] yarn tail.

MOUTH
With B, ch 11.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. 10 sc. Fasten off, leaving 16" [40.5 cm] yarn tail.

SPINE
With B, ch 22.
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. 20 dc. Fasten off, leaving 36" [91.5 cm] yarn tail.

Using yarn tails, sew Eyes and Mouth onto Head as shown in photo.
With B, embroider Nose by forming an upside-down V between Eyes and Mouth using Straight Stitch.

Torso: Using yarn tail, sew Spine onto Front piece of Torso as shown in photo.

Limbs: Tie knots in each Limb as shown in photo to mimic elbow and knee joints.
Using yarn tails, sew Limbs to Torso as shown in photo.

abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: 10 sc = 3” [7.5 cm]; 9 rows = 3½” [9 cm] in half double crochet using smaller hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
PILLOW COVER
Back 
With smaller hook, ch 61. 
Row 1 (right side): Hdc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—60 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 1, hdc in each st across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 18” [45.5 cm]. Fasten off.
Front 
Work same as back until piece measures 2½” [6.5 cm] ending on a right side row.
Menorah Base Row: Ch 1, hdc in first 15 sts, working in front loops only, hdc in next 30 sts, working in both loops, hdc in remaining sts, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 18” [45.5 cm]. Fasten off.
MENORAH
Work all sections with smaller hook.
Base
Row 1 (right side): With right side of front facing, join yarn with sc in first unworked front loop of Menorah Base Row, sc in each unworked front loop across, turn—30 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, work 14 cross sc to last st, sc in last st, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, work 15 cross sc across, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st across to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—28 sts. Fasten off.
Stem
Row 1 (right side): With right side of Base facing, join yarn with sc in 12th st, sc in next 5 sts, turn—6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc), slip st in next st, [hdc in next st, slip st in next st] twice, turn—3 hdc and 3 slip sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in each hdc, turn—6 sc.
Repeat last 2 rows until stem measures 2¼” [5.5 cm] end with Row 2. Do not fasten off.
Remove hook from last stitch and place loop on locking stitch marker.
Row 4 (right side): With right side facing, join yarn from other end of ball to first ch of beginning ch-2, ch 3. Fasten off. 
Remove loop from marker and return to hook, ch 4, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, 2 sc in each hdc across to beginning ch, 2 sc in top of beginning ch-2, sc in each ch across, turn—12 sc.
Row 5: Ch 2, slip st in first st, *hdc in next st, slip st in next st; repeat from * across to last st, (hdc, slip st) in last st, turn—7 hdc.
Row 6: Ch 2, 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, 2 sc in each hdc across to beginning ch, 2 sc in top of beginning ch, turn—16 sc. Place marker in first ch.
Left Branch
Row 1: Ch 5, slip st in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch count as first hdc here and throughout), hdc in next ch, slip st in next ch, working across sts of hdc in next st, slip st in next st, hdc in next st, leave remaining sts unworked, turn—4 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each hdc across to beginning ch, 2 sc in top of beginning ch turn—8 sc.
Rows 3-6: Repeat Rows 1 and 2 twice.
First Candle
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts, leave remaining sts unworked, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, work cross sc, sc in last st, turn.
Repeat last row until candle measures 3” [7.5 cm] from Row 1.
Flame 
Row 1: Ch 1, skip first st, sc in next st, slip st in last st, turn—1 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in st, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, slip st in st. Fasten off.
2nd Candle
Row 1: With wrong side of Left Branch facing, skip first 3 unworked sts of Row 6, join yarn with sc in next st, sc in same st, sc in last st, turn—3 sc.
Repeat Row 2 of First Candle until 2nd Candle measures 3½” [9 cm] from Row 1.
Repeat Rows 1-4 of Flame. 
3rd Candle
Row 1: With wrong side of Row 4 of Left Branch facing, work same as Row 1 of 2nd Candle—3 sc.
Repeat Row 2 of First Candle until 3rd Candle measures 4” [10 cm] from Row 1.
Repeat Rows 1-4 of Flame. 
4th Candle
Row 1: With wrong side of Row 2 of Left Branch facing, skip next 3 unworked sts, join yarn with sc in next st, sc in last 2 sts—3 sc.
Repeat Row 2 of First Candle until candle measures 4½” [11.5 cm] from Row 1.
Repeat Rows 1-4 of Flame. 
Center Candle (Shamash)
Row 1: With right side of Left Branch facing, skip first 4 sts of Row 3, join yarn with sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next st, sc2tog, turn—3 sc.
Repeat Row 2 of First Candle until candle measures 8” (20.5 cm) from Row 1.
Repeat Rows 1-4 of Flame. 
Right Branch
Row 1 (right side): With right side of Stem facing, join yarn with slip st in marked st of Row 6, ch 6, slip st in 3rd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, slip st in last ch, hdc in first st, slip st in next st, hdc in next st, leave remaining sts unworked, turn—4 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each hdc across to beginning ch, 2 sc in top of beginning ch turn—8 sc.
Row 3: Ch 5, slip st in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch count as first hdc here and throughout), hdc in next ch, slip st in next ch, hdc in next st, slip st in next st, hdc in next st, leave remaining sts unworked, turn—4 hdc.
Rows 4 and 5: Repeat Rows 2 and 3.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2.
First Candle
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts, leave remaining sts unworked, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, work cross sc, sc in last st, turn.
Repeat last row until candle measures 3” [7.5 cm] from Row 1.
Flame 
Row 1: Ch 1, skip first st, sc in next st, slip st in last st, turn—1 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in st, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, slip st in st. Fasten off.
2nd Candle
Row 1: With right side of Right Branch facing, skip first 3 unworked sts of Row 6, join yarn with sc in next st, sc in same st, sc in last st, turn—3 sc.
Repeat Row 2 of First Candle until 2nd Candle measures 3½” [9 cm] from Row 1.
Repeat Rows 1-4 of Flame. 
3rd Candle
Row 1: With right side of Right Branch facing, skip first 3 unworked sts of Row 4, work same as Row 1 of 2nd Candle—3 sc.
Repeat Row 2 of First Candle until 3rd Candle measures 4” [10 cm] from Row 1.
Repeat Rows 1-4 of Flame. 
4th Candle
Row 1: With right side of Right Branch facing, skip next 3 unworked sts of Row 2, join yarn with sc in next st, sc in last 2 sts—3 sc.
Repeat Row 2 of First Candle until candle measures 4½” [11.5 cm] from Row 1.
Repeat Rows 1-4 of Flame. 
FINISHING
Weave in ends or pull through to wrong side of cover. Position and pin in place each section and candle, ensuring that base, stem, and center candle are centered, branches are spread evenly across the same rows, and candles are evenly spaced apart. You may prefer to baste menorah to front cover with contrasting thread or “overpin” the sections to ensure that they don’t shift while sewing. 
Optional 
Lightly stuff with fiberfill and enclose as you sew.
Applique Edging 
With double strand of yarn, work stem stitch around all edges. Work a French knot in top of each flame. 
Joining Round: With larger hook, wrong sides of front and back covers held together and working through both thicknesses, join double strand of yarn with sc in end of any row or st, evenly space reverse sc around 3 sides, insert pillow form, evenly space reverse sc across to first st, join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

With MC, ch 13.

materials: RED HEART® “Designer Sport™”: 2 Balls each 3002 Black CA and 3101 Ivory CC, small amount of 3701 Blossom CD for the nose and mouth, small amount of 3650 Pistachio CE for the eyes.
abbreviations: dec1 (decrease 1 st) = draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
dec2 (decrease 2 sts) = draw up a loop in each of next 3 sc, yarn over and draw through all 4 loops on hook.
To Change Color in Sc: work last sc before change until 2 loops are on hook, drop color in use, with next color to be used yarn over and draw through 2 loops; continue with new color.
measurements: Cat Neck Pillow measures 34” long x 8” wide.
gauge: 12 sts = 4”; 14 rnds = 4” in sc with 2 strands of yarn. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. With any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
MUZZLE: With C, ch 4; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Rnd 1: 2 Sc in each ch around – 8 sc.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 16 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 32 sc.
Rnd 5: [Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 40 sc.
Rnds 6-8: Sc in each sc around – 40 sc.
Rnd 9: [Sc in next 3 sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 8 times – 32 sc. Break off C.
Rnd 10-HEAD: With A, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 16 times – 48 sc.
Rnds 11-21: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 22: [Sc in next 4 sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 8 times – 40 sc.
BODY-Row 23: Sc in next 19 sc, 2 sc in next sc, drop A, with C, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 19 sc; turn – 42 sc.
Row 24: Ch 1, sc in next 20 sc, 2 sc in next sc, drop C, with A, 2 sc in next sc, sc in each sc to end; turn – 44 sc.
Row 25: Ch 1, sc in each A sc to last A sc, 2 sc in next sc, drop A, with C, 2 sc in next sc, sc in each sc across – 46 sc; turn.
Row 26: Ch 1, sc in each C sc, drop C, with A, sc in each sc across; turn.
Rows 27-40: Repeat Rows 25 and 26 – 60 sc at end of Rows 39 and 40.
Row 41: Ch 1, sc in each A sc, drop A, with C, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 42: Ch 1, sc in each CC sc, drop C, with A, sc in each sc across; turn.
Rows 43-70: Repeat Rows 41 and 42.
Row 71: Ch 1, sc in each sc of A to last 3 A sc, dec2 changing to C, with C, dec2 over next 3 sc, sc in each sc across; turn – 56 sc.
Row 72: Ch 1, sc in each C, drop C, with A, sc in each sc across; turn.
Rows 73-80: Repeat Rows 71 and 72 – 40 sc. Break off CC.
Rnd 81: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, bring opposite end around, sc in row end to form a ring – 40 sc. Now work in rnds without joining.
Rnd 82: [Sc in next 3 sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 8 times – 32 sc.
Rnd 83: [Sc in next 2 sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 8 times – 24 sc.
Rnd 84: [Sc in next sc, skip next sc, sc in next st] 8 times – 16 sc.
TAIL-Rnds 85-97: Sc in each sc around – 16 sc.
Rnds 98-105: Skip the first sc, sc in each sc around – 8 sc at end of last rnd.
Rnd 106: Sc in every other sc around – 4 sc.
Rnd 107: Slip st in every other sc to close tip of tail – 2 sts.
Fasten off, leaving 8” end. After assembly (below), thread this end into needle, weave needle in and out of every other rnd on top of tail and into end of body. Draw yarn up, to gather tail slightly and causing tip of tail to curve. Secure and weave in end.
ASSEMBLY: Stuff and shape head, body and base of tail (DO NOT STUFF TAIL). Sew body opening closed. Thread needle with A, weave needle in and out of top of body, (just above body seam) turn and continue to weave needle in and out of bottom of body, (just below body seam). Holding starting and ending gather ends together, carefully gather sides, causing body to curve to desired shape. Tie gather ends to secure. Weave in ends.
LEGS (Make 4): With C, ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rnd 1: 2 Sc in each ch around – 8 sc.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 16 sc.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 24 sc.
Rnds 4-8: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 9: [Sc in every other sc] 8 times, sc in each sc around – 16 sc. Break off C.
Rnds 10-22: With A, sc in each sc around. Stuff and shape paw (DO NOT STUFF LEG).
Row 23: Ch 1, flatten leg opening to close, turn, slip st through both thicknesses to close – 8 slip sts. Fasten off, leaving end long enough to sew leg onto body. Overlap back legs slightly when attaching.
Optional Toe: With ONE strand of yarn, stitch through paw, tighten and secure, weave in ends. Repeat twice on each paw.
EARS (Make 2): With A, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, dec1, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, dec1; turn – 5 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Rows 5 and 6: Repeat Rows 3 and 4 – 3 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, dec2. Fasten off. Sew ear onto to head and shape.
NOSE: With D, ch 2; 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off. Sew nose onto muzzle.
Mouth: With 2 strands of D, embroider mouth with Split Stitch, slipping needle between the 2 strands.
Whiskers: With 1 strand of A, embroider whiskers with straight stitch.
EYES (Make 2): With E, ch 2; hdc in 2nd ch from hook, with A dc in same ch, with E (hdc, sc) all in same ch. Fasten off. Sew onto head.
HINT: After attaching eyes, push needle out through back of head, repeat same for second eye, out through the same st in back of head. Tie ends together (as you tighten, head will shape); weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 315 yds/288 m) Softened Blue (32008) 2 balls
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
gauge: 12 sts and 7 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Waffle Pat.
instructions:
FRONT
Note: Waffle Pat worked over foundation ch multiple of 4 ch +5.
Ch 61.
1st row: (WS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc).  1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 59 dc.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). *1 dcfp around next st. 1 dcbp around each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 dcfp around next st. 1 dc in last st. Turn.
3rd row:  Ch 3 (counts as dc). *1 dcbp around next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 dcbp around next dc. 1 dc in last dc. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows of Waffle Pat until work from beg measures 20" [51 cm], ending on a RS row.
Fasten off.
BACK (make 2 pieces alike)
Ribbing: Ch 7.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn.  6 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until work from beg (when slightly stretched) measures 20" [51 cm]. Do not fasten off. Proceed as follows:
1st row:  Turn work sideways. Ch 1. Work 59 sc evenly along side of Ribbing. Turn. Place marker at end of row.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
Rep last row until work from marker measures 11" [28 cm]. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Joining Front and Back: Overlap Back pieces to match Front, with ribbed sections in center to create opening to insert pillow form. Pin in place for easier joining. With RS facing, join yarn with sl st to any corner st of Pillow. Ch 1. Working through all thicknesses, work sc evenly around 4 sides of Pillow, having 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Insert Pillow form.

materials: Caron® Jumbo™ (12 oz/340 g; 595 yds/544 m) Main Color MC Pink Kiss (09051) 2 balls or 975 yds/887 m
Caron® One Pound™ (16 oz/453.6 g; 812 yds/742 m) Contrast A Grass Green (10620) 1 ball or 180 yds/165 m
Contrast B Black (10503) 1 ball or 55 yds/50 m
Small amount of White (10501) for embroidery
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) Susan Bates® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Joined dc = Insert hook into top horizontal bar of dc just worked and draw up a loop.
Insert hook into next ch and draw up a loop. 3 loops on hook.
(Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. – Joined dc made

Joined dc-to-tr = Insert hook into top horizontal bar of tr just worked and draw up a loop. Skip next horizontal bar of same tr. Insert hook into next ch and draw up a loop. 3 loops on hook. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. – Joined dc-to-tr made

Joined tr = Insert hook into top horizontal bar of tr just worked and draw up a loop. Insert hook into second horizontal bar of same tr and draw up a loop. Insert hook into next ch and draw up a loop. 4 loops on hook. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times. – Joined tr made.

Joined tr-to-dc = Insert hook into top horizontal bar of dc just worked and draw up a loop. Insert hook into bottom vertical bar at base of same dc and draw up a loop. Insert hook into next ch and draw up a loop. 4 loops on hook. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times. – Joined tr-to-dc made.

Joined tr-to-dtr = Insert hook into top horizontal bar of dtr just worked and draw up a loop. Insert hook into second horizontal bar of same dtr and draw up a loop. Skip next horizontal bar of same dtr. Insert hook into next ch and draw up a loop. 3 loops on hook. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. – Joined tr-to-dtr made.

Joined dtr = Insert hook into top horizontal bar of dtr just worked and draw up a loop. Insert hook into second horizontal bar of same dtr and draw up a loop. Insert hook into bottom vertical bar at base of same tr and draw up a loop. Insert hook into next ch and draw up a loop. 5 loops on hook. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 4 times. – Joined dtr-to-tr made.

Joined dtr-to-tr = Insert hook into top horizontal bar of tr just worked and draw up a loop. Insert hook into second horizontal bar of same tr and draw up a loop. Insert hook into third horizontal bar of same dtr and draw up a loop. Insert hook into next ch and draw up a loop. 5 loops on hook. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 4 times. – Joined dtr made
Scbp = Draw up a loop around post of next st at back of work inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook - 1 scbp made
Splsc = Split single crochet: work sc between ‘legs’ at front and back of stitch (splitting stitch) instead of through top loops.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop between ‘legs’ in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
measurements: Approx 16" [40.5 cm] diameter x 17" [43 cm] tall, excluding leaves.
gauge: 12 sc and 13 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Do not join at ends of rnds unless otherwise stated. Cont working in spiral placing marker on first st of rnd for easier counting and moving marker up as you progress. With MC, ch 2. See diagram on page 5.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 6 sc. PM on first st.
2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc around. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * around. 18 sc.
4th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. 24 sc.
5th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. 30 sc.
6th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. 36 sc.
7th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Rep from * around. 42 sc.
8th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 48 sc.
Cont in same manner, inc 6 sc every rnd until there are 96 sc.
Next rnd: 1 splsc in each sc around.
Next rnd: Cont in same manner, work 1 splsc in each sc and inc 6 sc evenly around.
Rep last 2 rnds 4 times more. 126 sc.
Next 2 rnds: 1 splsc in each sc around.
Next rnd: Cont in same manner, work 1 splsc in each sc and inc 6 sc evenly around.
Rep last 3 rnds 4 times more. 156 sc. PM as second set at end of last rnd.
Next rnd: 1 splsc in each sc around.
Rep last rnd until work from second marker measures 5" [12.5 cm].
Shape Top: 1st rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 12 sc. Splsc2tog. 1 splsc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * around. 150 sts.
2nd and alt rnds: 1 splsc in each st around.
3rd rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 23 sc. Splsc2tog. Rep from * around. 144 sts.
5th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 11 sc. Splsc2tog. 1 splsc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 138 sts.
7th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 21 sc. Splsc2tog. Rep from * around. 132 sts.
9th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 10 sc. Splsc2tog. 1 splsc in each of next 10 sc. Rep from * around. 126 sts.
11th rnd: *1 splsc in each of next 19 sc. Splsc2tog. Rep from * around. 120 sts.
Cont in same manner, work splsc in each sc and dec 6 sts as established on every following alt rnd until there are 24 sts, suffing pillow as you go. Join with sl st to first sc at end of last rnd.
Next rnd: (Rnd for leaves). Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Note: Do not join at end of rnds. Work in spiral as before.
Next rnd: *1 splsc in next sc. Sc2tog. 1 splsc in next sc. Rep from * around. 18 sts.
Finish stuffing pillow.
Next rnd: 1 splsc in each st around.
Next rnd: *1 splsc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 12 sts.
Next rnd: 1 splsc in each st around.
Next rnd: *Sc2tog. Rep from * around. 6 sts. Fasten off. Thread yarn through rem sts. Pull tightly. Fasten securely.
LEAVES
First stem: 1st row: Join MC with sl st to rem loop of any sc of Rnd for leaves. *Ch 40. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook.
