12th rnd: 1 lnkdc in last st from prev rnd. 1 lnkdc in each of next 9 lnkdc. 2 lnkdc in next lnkdc. *1 lnkdc in each of next 10 lnkdc. 2 lnkdc in next lnkdc. Rep from * around. 120 lnkdc. 
13th rnd: As 10th rnd. 
14th rnd: 1 lnkdc in last st from prev rnd. 1 lnkdc in each of next 10 lnkdc. 2 lnkdc in next lnkdc. *1 lnkdc in each of next 11 lnkdc. 2 lnkdc in next lnkdc. Rep from * around. 120 lnkdc. 
15th rnd: 1 lnkdc in last st from prev rnd. 1 lnkdc in each of next 11 lnkdc. 2 lnkdc in next lnkdc. *1 lnkdc in each of next 12 lnkdc. 2 lnkdc in next lnkdc. Rep from * around. 130 lnkdc. 
16th rnd: As 10th rnd. 
17th rnd: 1 lnkdc in last st from prev rnd. 1 lnkdc in each of next 12 lnkdc. 2 lnkdc in next lnkdc. *1 lnkdc in each of next 13 lnkdc. 2 lnkdc in next lnkdc. Rep from * around. 140 lnkdc. 
18th rnd: 1 lnkdc in last st from prev rnd. 1 lnkdc in each of next 13 lnkdc. 2 lnkdc in next lnkdc. *1 lnkdc in each of next 14 lnkdc. 2 lnkdc in next lnkdc. Rep from * around. 150 lnkdc. 
19th to 22nd rnds: As 10th rnd. 
23rd rnd: Beg in last st from prev rnd, work 1 lnkdc in each lnkdc to last 3 sts. 1 hdc in next lnkdc. 1 sc in each of last 2 lnkdc. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
With WS facing, join Top to Bottom, working 1 rnd of sc in C evenly around perimeter and through both thicknesses. When rnd is half-way complete, insert pillow form, and cont working rnd of sc. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Baby Blanket™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 72 yds/65 m)
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 7 sc and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook, yoh with new color. Pull through 2 loops on hook to complete st and proceed in new color.
Front and Back (make alike).
With A, ch 20.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 19 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn. 22 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in each of next 6 sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Join B. Break A. Turn. 28 sts.
6th row: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) three times. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn. 34 sts.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Join C. Break B. Turn.
9th row: With C, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn. 40 sts.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
11th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 3 times. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn. Break C. Join D. Turn. 46 sts.
12th row: With D, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc) 3 times. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn. 52 sts.
14th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Join E. Break D. Turn.
15th row: With E, ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc) 3 times. (1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn. 58 sts.
16th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
17th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc) 3 times. (1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Turn. 64 sts.
18th to 20th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off.
Seaming: With RS facing, sew Front and Back together aligning stripes and leaving a small space open for stuffing. Stuff Pillow making sure to shape into a rainbow arc. Sew remaining seam.

materials: 1 skein each of 530 Orchid A, 347 Light Periwinkle B, 320 Cornmeal C, 706 Perfect Pink D, 885 Delft Blue E, 313 Aran F, 624 Tea Leaf G, 726 Coral H, 724 Baby Pink I, 672 Spring Green J, 321 Gold K, and 235 Lemon L
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4 mm [US G-6]
abbreviations: A, B, C, etc. = Color A, Color B, Color C etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 14 sts = 4” (10 cm); 10 rows = 4” (10 cm) in alternating rows of sc and dc (as on back). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
FRONT
First Mattress
Beginning at lower edge with A, ch 44.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—43 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, skip first st, (slip st, dc) in next st, *skip next st, (slip st, dc) in next st; repeat from * to last st, skip last st, sc in turning ch, turn—43 sts.
Row 3: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in each st across working last dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, skip first st, (slip st, dc) in next st, *skip next st, (slip st, dc) in next st; repeat from * to last 2 sts, skip next st, sc in turning ch, turn—43 sts.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each st across and change to B in last st, turn—43 sc.

Second Mattress
Rows 1–3: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 4 (right side): Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sts, Fpdc around sc 2 rows below (in Row 2); repeat from * to last st, sc in last st, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each st across and change to C in last st, turn.

Third Mattress
Row 1 (right side): Ch 3, dc in each st across, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 dc in first st, *skip next 2 sts, (sc, 2 dc) in next st; repeat from * to last 2 sts, skip next st, sc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, turn, dc in each st across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st across and change to D in last st, turn.

Fourth Mattress
Rows 1 and 2: Sc in each st across and change to E in last st of Row 2, turn.
Row 3 (right side): Ch 1, sc in first st, *Fpsc around next st 2 rows below (in Row 1), sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * to last 2 sts, Fpsc around next st 2 rows below, sc in last st, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st across and change to D in last st, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first st, *Fpsc around next Fpsc of Row 3, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * to last 2 sts, Fpsc around next Fpsc of Row 3, sc in last st, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in each st across and change to F in last st, turn.

Fifth Mattress
Rows 1–4: Ch 1, (hdc, dc) in first st, *(skip next 2 sts, (sc, hdc, dc) in next st; repeat from * to last 2 sts, skip last 2 sts, sc in turning ch and change to G in last st of Row 4, turn.

Sixth Mattress
Row 1 (right side): Ch 3, sc in next dc, hdc in next hdc, *dc in next sc, sc in next dc, hdc in next hdc; repeat from * across, turn.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, *Fpdc around next st, Bpdc around next st; repeat from * to last 2 sts, Fpdc around next st, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 4: Ch 3, *Bpdc around next st, Fpdc around next st; repeat from * to last 2 sts, Bpdc around next st, dc in top of turning ch and change to H in last st, turn.

Seventh Mattress
Note: When changing color in this section, carry color not in use across wrong side of piece until next needed.
Row 1 (right side): With H, ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, [change to I, sc in next 2 sts; change to H, sc in next 2 sts] 10 times; change to I, sc in last st, turn.
Row 2: With I, ch 1, sc in first st, [change to H, sc in next 2 sts; change to I, sc in next 2 sts] 10 times; change to H, sc in last 2 sts and change to I in last st, turn.
Row 3: With I, ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, [change to H, sc in next 2 sts; change to I, sc in next 2 sts] 10 times; change to H, sc in last st, turn.
Row 4: With H, ch 1, sc in first st, [change to I, sc in next 2 sts; change to H, sc in next 2 sts] 10 times; change to I, sc in last 2 sts and change to E in last st, turn. Fasten off H and I.

Eighth Mattress
Rows 1-4: Ch 1, sc in each st across and change to F in last st of Row 4, turn.

Background above Bed
Row 1 (right side): Ch 3, dc in each st across, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Rows 3–12: Repeat Rows 1 and 2 five more times.

Edging Round (right side): Ch 1, sc evenly spaced around entire outer edge of front, working 3 sc in each corner; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

BACK
With D, ch 44.
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—43 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Rows 4–39: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 eighteen more times.

Edging (right side): Ch 1, work sc evenly spaced around entire outer edge of back, working 3 sc in each corner; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

BLANKET
With B, ch 31.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—30 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3, working in back loops only, dc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Rows 4–12: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 four more times, then repeat Row 2 once more.
Row 13: Ch 1, *3 hdc in next st, skip next st, slip st in next st, skip next st; repeat from * to last 2 sts, 3 hdc in next st, slip st in last st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

PRINCESS HEAD (make 2)
With I, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—5 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in last st, turn—7 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in last st, turn—9 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 7 sts, 2 sc in last st, turn—11 sc.
Rows 6–10: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Rows 11 and 12: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—7 sc at the end of Row 12.
Fasten off.
Embroider Facial Features: With E, embroider French knot eyes on to face. With H, embroider couched stitch mouth below eyes. Rub red crayon lightly onto face for checks.

PEA (make 2)
With J, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral).
Round 2: Sc in next 6 sts; slip st in next st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Weave the tail through the sts of the last round and pull to gather and shape piece into a ball.

CROWN (make 2)
With K, ch 10.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—9 sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 2 ch, skip next 2 sts of Row 3, slip st in next st, ch 7, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next 3 ch, skip next 3 sts of Row 3, slip st in next st, ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 2 ch, skip next st of Row 3, slip st in last st. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

COLLAR
With B, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, turn—7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, 3 hdc in first st, [slip st in next st, 3 hdc in next st] 3 times. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

LETTER “A”
With F, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch for center bar, sc in next 3 ch of ch-8, turn, ch 3, slip st in tip of center bar, ch 5, turn, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 3 ch, sc in slip st, sc in last 3 ch, slip st in top of “A”. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

LETTER “N”
With F, ch 25.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 6 ch, skip next ch, sc in next 8 ch, 3 sc in next ch, sc in last 7 ch. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

LETTER “D”
With F, ch 17.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 6 ch, 3 sc in next ch, sc in next 7 ch, 2 sc in last ch; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

LETTER “T”
With F, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, sc in top of “T”, ch 3, turn, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next ch, slip st in top of “T”. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

LETTER “H”
First Half: With F, ch 8. Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch for center bar, sc in next 3 ch of ch-8. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Second Half: With F, ch 8. Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each remaining ch across. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Sew first and second halves together at tip of center bar.

LETTER “E”
With F, ch 8.
Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook, [ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, sc in next 3 ch of ch-8] twice, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch, slip st in corner of “E”. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

BRAIDS (make 2)
Cut 13 lengths of L, each about 23” (58.5 cm). Cut another 2 pieces of L, about 10” (25.5 cm) long. Hold 12 lengths together and tie the 13th tightly around center. Do not trim center tie, use it later for sewing braids to head. Divide the 12 lengths on one side of tie into 3 groups of 4 strands each and braid for 3–4” (7.5–10 cm), tie one of the shorter pieces of L around end of braid to secure. Repeat to braid lengths on either side of tie.

FINISHING
Assemble Front
Using photograph as a guide and using long tails for sewing, sew princess head and blanket near top of front. Sew braid to top of head. Sew crown above braid. Sew a pea between two bottom mattresses.

Assemble Back
Using photograph as a guide and using long tails for sewing, sew princess head, braids, crown and collar in place on back. Sew letters in place below princess. Sew a pea below the letters.

Assemble Pillow
Hold front and back with wrong sides together. Working from right side and through both thicknesses, join F with sc in any corner, work sc evenly spaced across 3 sides, working 3 sc in each corner, insert pillow form and work sc across fourth edge. Fasten off.

Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Blanket™ and Bernat® Blanket Tie Dye-ish™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m)
Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 7 half double crochet (hdc) and 6 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of rounds (rnds) does not count as hdc.
• Join with slip stitch (sl st) at end of each rnd.
FRONT AND BACK (make alike)
With A, chain (ch) 3.
1st rnd:   8 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Join. 8 hdc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 16 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Repeat (Rep) from * around. Join. 24 hdc.
4th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc.  *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 hdc.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc. 56 hdc.
Continue (Cont) as established, increasing (inc) 8 stitches (sts) each rnd to 96 hdc (10 hdc worked between each inc).
Next rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Join Front and Back:  With WS of Front and Back together (tog), join B with sl st to any hdc. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 sc in each hdc around, insert pillow form at halfway point and cont around to end. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. Working from right to left instead of left to right as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.

materials: Yarn: Bernat® Softee Chunky™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 108 yds/99 m)
Contrast A Taupe Gray (28048) - 1 ball or 88 yds/80 m
Contrast B Gray Rose (28800) - 1 ball or 64 yds/58 m
Contrast C Gray Blue (28802) - 1 ball or 73 yds/67 m
Contrast D Brass (28807) - 1 ball or 79 yds/72 m
Tools: Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook, Susan Bates® yarn needle, 20" [51 cm] square pillow form, tape measure
measurements: Approximately (approx) 26½" [67.5 cm] square before assembly. 20" [51 cm] square after assembly.
gauge: 1st to 4th rnds = 4" [10 cm] in pattern (pat).
instructions:
Chain (Ch) 4. Chain *Yarn over hook (Yoh), draw through loop – 1 chain made. Repeat (rep) from* 3 times more – 4 chains made. Stripe Pattern (Pat) 1st to 4th rnds: With A. 5th and 6th rnds: With B. 7th to 9th rnds: With D. 10th and 11th rnds: With C. 12th rnd: With B. 13th rnd: With D. 14th rnd: With A. 15th rnd: With C. 16th and 17th rnds: With A. 18th to 20th rnds: With D. 21st and 22nd rnds: With C. 23rd and 24th rnds: With B. 25th and 26th rnds: With A. These 26 rnds form Stripe Pat. With A, make a slip knot and place it on your hook. Slip knot Make a loop with yarn and fold it on itself to make a pretzel shape. Then pull through to make slip knot. Insert hook and pull ends to tighten – slip knot made. Join with slip stitch (sl st) to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. *Working into ring, 1 single crochet (sc). Ch 2. Rep from * 3 times more. Join. 2nd rnd: Sl st in next ch-2 space (sp). Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in same ch-2 sp as sl st. Ch 1. *(1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * twice more. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in same ch-2 sp. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch 1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Join.
4th rnd: Sl st in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in same ch-2 sp. *(Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) to next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc.** (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join. First 4 rnds of Stripe Pat are complete. Rep 4th rnd, keeping continuity (cont) of Stripe Pat, until all 26 rnds of Stripe Pat are complete. To change colors, Fasten off. Join 2nd Color with sl st into any ch-2 sp.
Assembly: Fold 3 corners to meet in center as shown in diagram to form a square. With A, sew seams leaving 4th corner open to insert pillow form. Insert pillow form. Sew remaining (rem) seam closed. We love seeing your makes! Share your photos using #YARNSPO and tag us @yarnspirations on Instagram or find us on Facebook.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 624 Tea Leaf A, 347 Light Periwinkle B, 313 Aran C, 341 Light Grey D, 726 Coral E, 321 Gold F, 530 Orchid G, 368 Paddy Green H, 381 Light Blue I, 365 Coffee J, 320 Cornmeal K, 360 Café Latte L, and 256 Carrot M
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 3.75 mm [US F-5] and 5 mm [US H-8]
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
gauge: 9 sts = 2½” (6.5 cm); 6 rows = 2½” (6.5 cm) in alternating rows of double crochet and single crochet with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
PILLOW
Sides (make 2)
With larger hook and A, ch 51.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—50 sts.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Rows 4–21: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 nine times; change to B at end of Row 21.
Rows 22–37: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 eight times, do not turn at end of Row 37.
Last round (right side): Working in ends of rows of first side, sc evenly across changing to A in Row 22; working across opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in each ch across to last ch, 3 sc in last ch; working in ends of rows of other side, sc evenly across changing to B in Row 21, 3 sc in first st, sc in each st across to last st, 3 sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Note: Work all remaining pieces with smaller hook. Fasten off with long tails for sewing.

GIRL
Head and Body
Beginning at top of head, with C, ch 7.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn—6 sc.
Rows 2–5: Ch 1, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, sc in each st to last 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in last st, turn—14 sc.
Rows 6–11: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Rows 12–15: Ch 1, sc in first st, sc2tog, sc in each st to last 3 sts, sc2tog, sc in last st, turn—6 sc.
Row 16: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, sc2tog, sc in last 2 sts, turn—5 sc.
Rows 17 and 18: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 19: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st; change to D, turn—7 sc.
Rows 20 and 21: Ch 4, 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 2 ch, sc in each st, turn—15 sc.
Row 22: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st, turn—17 sc.
Rows 23 and 24: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. Do not fasten off.

First Arm
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in first 3 sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—3 sc.
Rows 2–10: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. Fasten off.

Jumper
Row 1 (right side): With right side of Row 24 facing, skip first unworked st, join E with sc in next unworked st, sc in next 8 sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—9 sc.
Rows 2–10: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Fasten off.

Second Arm
Row 1 (right side): With right side of Row 24 facing, skip next unworked st, join D with sc in next unworked st, sc in remaining sts, turn—3 sc.
Rows 2–10: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.

Edging
Last Round: Ch 1, working in each st and in ends of rows, sc evenly around arms, body, and head working 3 sc in each outer corner of arms and changing colors as needed to match each section. Fasten off.

Jumper Strap (make 2)
With E, ch 4.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn—3 sc.
Rows 2–7: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. Fasten off.

Collar (make 2)
With D, ch 10.
Row 1: Working in 2nd and 3rd ch from hook, sc2tog, hdc in next ch, [yo, insert hook in next ch, pull up a loop] 3 times (7 loops on hook), yo and draw through all 7 loops, hdc next ch, sc2tog. Fasten off.

Ear (make 2)
With C, ch 3.
Row 1: 5 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. Fasten off.

Hat
With F, ch 31.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn—30 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sts, hdc in next st, dc in next st, [dc2tog] 9 times, dc in next st, hdc in next st, sc in last 4 sts, turn—21 sts.
Rows 3–5: Ch 1, sc in first 4 sts, hdc in next st, dc in next 11 sts, hdc in next st, sc in last 4 sts, turn.
Row 6: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice, hdc in next st, dc in next 11 sts, hdc in next st, [sc2tog] twice, turn—17 sts.
Row 7: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice, hdc in next st, dc in next 7 sts, hdc in next st, [sc2tog] twice, turn—13 sts.
Row 8: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice, hdc in next st, dc in next 3 sts, hdc in next st, [sc2tog] twice, turn—9 sts.
Rows 9 and 10: Ch 1, sc in next st, hdc in next 2 sts, dc in next 3 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, sc in last st, turn.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc2tog, hdc in next st, dc in next 3 sts, hdc in next st, sc2tog, turn—7 sts.
Row 12: Ch 1, sc2tog, hdc in next 3 sts, sc2tog—5 sts. Fasten off.

Bow
With E, ch 7; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): *Ch 2, 12 hdc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch* (first bow loop made), ch 7; join with slip st in first ch to form 2nd ring; repeat from  * to * once (2nd bow loop made), **ch 7, hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in next 4 ch, slip st in last slip st of 2nd bow loop just made; repeat from ** working last slip st in last slip st of first bow loop. Fasten off.

FLOWER (make 7)
Petals
With G, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): [(Hdc, ch 1, slip st, ch 1) in 2nd ch from hook] 4 times; join with slip st in same ch. Fasten off.

Small Leaf (make 7)
With H, ch 4.
Row 1 (right side): *Sc in 2nd ch from hook, dc in next ch, slip st in last ch*, ch 4; repeat from * to * once. Fasten off.

EGG (make 2)
With I, ch 2.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—1 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in sc, turn—2 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc, turn—4 sc.
Round 4: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice; working in sts and in ends of rows, sc evenly around; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off.

BRANCHES
Large Branch
With J, ch 24.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 13 ch, hdc in next 6 ch, dc in last 3 ch—23 sts. Fasten off.

Small Branch
With J, ch 10.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 5 ch, hdc in last 3 ch—9 sts. Fasten off.

Large Leaf (make 3)
With H, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, do not join—6 sc.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in first sc, (sc, hdc) next sc, 3 dc in next sc, ch 2, slip st in 2nd ch, 2 dc in next sc, (hdc, sc) next sc, 2 sc in last sc; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

SUN
With K, ch 2.
Row 1: Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, turn—2 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn—6 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 2 sc, turn—8 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 3 sc, turn—10 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 4 sc, turn—12 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 5 sc, turn—14 sc.
Row 8: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 6 sc, turn—16 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 7 sc, turn—18 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 8 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 8 sc, turn—20 sc.
Row 11: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 9 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 9 sc, turn—22 sc.
Row 12: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in next 10 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last 10 sc, turn—24 sc.
Row 13: Ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in last ch, skip first 2 sc, slip st in next sc, *ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in last ch, skip next 2 sc, slip st in next sc; repeat from * across. Fasten off.

ROBIN (make 2)
Head and Body
With L and smaller hook, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, do not join—6 sc.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—12 sc.
Continue in rows.
Row 3: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * twice; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—9 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in next 4 sc; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—4 sc.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in next sc, 2 sc in next 2 sc, sc in last sc, turn—6 sc.
Rows 6 and 7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 8: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last sc, turn—4 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, [sc2tog] twice. Fasten off.

Breast
With M, ch 6.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next 3 ch, sc in last ch. Fasten off.

Tail
With L, ch 8.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in last 2 ch, turn—7 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as first dc), dc in next dc, hdc next 2 sts, sc in last 3 sts. Fasten off.

Wing
With L, ch 6.
Row 1 (right side): Work 2 dc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch count as first dc), hdc in next 2 ch, slip st in last ch, turn—6 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, skip slip st, sc in next st, hdc in next st, ch 2, slip st in next st; leave remaining sts unworked. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Use photograph as a guide for embroidery stitches and placement of pieces. Position all pieces with right side facing. To minimize finishing, draw ends of all tails to wrong side.

Girl
Jumper straps Sew to top of jumper and over shoulders.
Collar Overlap edges of pieces at neck and sew in place between jumper straps.
Ears Sew in place on sides of head.
Head and Body
With black embroidery floss, embroider a French knot for each eye, straight stitches for eyebrows and nose, and curved couch stitch for mouth. Color cheeks with red crayon. Position head and body on front side, aligning lower edges of arms and jumper with Row 1 of front side, and sew to pillow with matching colors and leaving ears unsewn.
Braid (make 2)
Wrap C around 10” (25.5 cm) piece of cardboard 9 times. Cut a 12” (30.5 cm) length of C and tie it tightly around wraps at one end of cardboard. Cut wraps at other end. Fold the bundle in half at tied end so that you have 18 strands; separate into 3 hanks and braid to 3½” (9 cm) or desired length. Tie a short strand of yarn around the bottom of the braid and trim ends evenly. Thread tying tails through pillow on side of head and secure to wrong side of front. Sew braid as desired to front side.
Hat and Bow Fold up brim and sew hat in place leaving front edge of brim unsewn. Sew bow to hat where desired.
Flowers Randomly arrange petals on A-colored section of front side and sew in place. Sew a small leaf under each petal piece.
Branches, Large Leaves, and Eggs Sew branches, large leaves, and eggs in place. To make a nest, with L, embroider straight stitches of varying lengths and at different angles around and over lower edges of eggs. Sun Sew to upper right corner.
Bird Sew tail to end of body and breast under body of bird. Overlap lower half of wing on upper body. With K, embroider French knot eye. Sew 1 bird to top of hat and other bird to B-colored section of back side. With 2 strands of F held together, embroider open beak with straight stitches on each bird and on bird on back side only, embroider legs with straight stitches.
Sides
Hold front and back sides with wrong sides together.
Round 1: With larger hook and working through inner loops, join A with sc in any st, sc in each st around, working 3 sc in center st of each 3-sc group and inserting pillow form before 4th side is completed; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Soft™: 2 skeins 4422 Tangerine A, 3 skeins 9939 Jewel Tone B

abbreviations: PS (puff stitch) = [Yo and draw up a loop, yo and draw through 2 loops] 5 times in st or space specified, yo and draw through all 6 loops on hook.
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Pillows measure 16” in diameter excluding ruffled edging.
gauge: Rounds 1-9 = 4” across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Round 1: Ch 6; join with a slip st to form a ring; ch 3 (counts as dc), 14 dc in ring; join with a slip st to top of ch-3 – 15 dc.
Work in back loops every round EXCEPT for Rounds 7, 8, 11, and 14.
Round 2: Ch 3, PS in next dc, ch 1, 2 sc in next dc, [PS in next dc, ch 1, 2 sc in next dc] 6 times; join with a slip st to top of ch-3 – 29 sts.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in same st as joining, sc in each st and ch around; join to first sc – 30 sc.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in next sc, 2 dc in next sc, [dc in next 2 sc, 2 dc in next sc] 9 times; join – 40 dc.
Round 5: Ch 3, PS in next dc, ch 1, 2 sc in each of next 2 dc, [PS in next dc, ch 1, 2 sc in each of next 2 dc] 12 times; join – 79 sts.
Round 6: Ch 1, 2 sc in same st as joining, sc in each st and ch around; join – 80 sc.
Round 7: Ch 3, 2 dc in same st as joining, skip 2 sc, [3 dc in next sc, skip next 2 sc] 25 times, 3 dc in next sc, skip last sc; join – 81 dc.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, skip next 2 dc, [PS in space between 3-dc-groups, ch 1, sc in next dc, skip next 2 dc] 27 times; join – 82 sts.
Round 9: Ch 1, skip first sc, sc in each st and ch around; join – 81 sc.
Round 10: Ch 3, dc in next sc, [2 dc in next sc, dc in next 2 sc] 26 times, 2 dc in last sc; join – 108 dc.
Round 11: Ch 3, PS in next dc, ch 1, sc in next 2 dc, [PS in next dc, ch 1, sc in next 3 dc] 26 times; join – 135 sts.
Round 12: Ch 1, sc in each st and ch around; join – 135 sc.
Round 13: Ch 3, dc in each sc around; join – 135 dc.
Round 14: Ch 3, PS in next dc, ch 2, [sc in next dc, skip next dc] twice, * PS in next dc, ch 2, [sc in next dc, skip next dc] 3 times; repeat from * 17 more times, PS in next dc, ch 2, sc in next dc, skip next dc; join – 118 sts.
Round 15: Ch 1, 2 sc in same st as joining, sc in each st and ch around; join – 119 sc.
Round 16: Ch 3, 2 dc in next sc, ch 1, skip next 3 sc, [3 dc in next sc, ch 1, skip next 2 sc] 38 times; join – 156 sts.
Round 17: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining and next 2 dc, [PS in next ch-1 space, ch 1, sc in next 3 dc] 38 times, PS in next ch-1 space, ch 1; join in first sc – 195 sts.
Round 18: Ch 1, sc in first 3 sc, [sc in PS, skip ch-1, sc in next 3 sc] 38 times, sc in last PS; join – 156 sc.
Ruffled Edging (Work on 1 Side Only Of Each Pillow)
Round 1: Working in back loops, ch 6, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc, [ch 5, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc] 50 times, (ch 2, dc) in first ch of ch-6 to join and form last loop – 52 loops.
There’s nothing like a pillow for adding comfort and color to a room. This round pillow can be crocheted in little time in just the right shade to add a nice accent. Place it right where you need it to feel comfortable as you read or watch television.

abbreviations: Bobble Pompom = (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 10 times in 4th ch from hook. Yoh and draw through all 11 loops on hook. Ch 1 tightly to close.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 17" [43 cm] tall x 20" [51 cm] wide, excluding Bobble Pompom Edging.
gauge: 14 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plas-
tic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull tie to remove.
• Start crocheting! 
• Use O’Go to self-stripe as you go.

FRONT AND BACK HEART (make alike)
Lower Heart
With MC, ch 2.
1st row: (RS). 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 2 sc in next sc. Turn. 4 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 6 sc.
4th to 26th rows:  Rep 3rd row 23 times more, inc 2 sts each row. 52 sts at end of 26th row.
27th row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
28th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 54 sts.
29th to 44th row:  Rep 27th and 28th rows 8 times more, inc 2 sts every other row, ending on a WS row. 70 sts at end of 44th row.
45th to 56th row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

Proceed with Right Lobe as follows:
Right Lobe
1st row:  (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 34 sc. Turn leaving rem sts unworked. 34 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Skip first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 32 sts.
4th and 5th rows:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
6th to 8th rows:  Rep 3rd to 5th rows once more. 30 sc at end of 8th row.
9th row: As 3rd row. 28 sts.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
11th to 15th rows:  As 3rd row. 18 sts at end of 15th row.
16th row:  Ch 1. Skip first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. Sc2tog. Ch 1. Sl st in last sc. Fasten off.

Left Lobe
With RS facing, skip next 2 unworked sc of 56th row of Lower Heart. Join MC with sl st to next sc. 
1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 34 sc.
Beg with 2nd row, work as for Right Lobe across left side of Lower Heart.

Trim
1st rnd: (RS). Join MC with sl st to bottom tip of Lower Heart. Work sc evenly around Heart, making sure total number of sc is a stitch mul -
tiple of 4. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd to 5th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Joining Front and Back: 1st rnd: (RS). With WS of Front and Back facing each other, join A with 
sl st to any edge st of Pillow. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, sc in each sc around, leaving 
approx 4" [10 cm] hole for stuff -
ing. Stuff Pillow. Complete rnd of 
sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Do not fasten off.

Proceed with Bobble Pompom Edging as follows:
Note: Bobble Pompom Edging worked over st multiple of 4 sts.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 4. (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 10 times all in 4th ch from hook. Yoh and draw through all 11 loops on hook. Ch 1 tightly to close - Bobble Pompom made. Sl st in same 4th ch from hook (Bobble Pompom will naturally fold in half forming a ball shape). 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. *1 sc in next sc. Ch 4. Bobble Pompom in 4th ch from hook. Sl st in same 4th ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc.  Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.

instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
Top and Bottom: Make 2 pieces alike.
Ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first dc. 16 dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 dcfp around each dc around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 32 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 2. *(Dcfp around post of next dcfp) twice. 1 dc in sp between 2 groups of 2 dcfp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 48 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 2. *(Dcfp around post of next dcfp) twice. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
6th rnd: Ch 2. *(Dcfp around post of next dcfp) twice. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 64 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Ch 4. Dcfp around post of next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
8th rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Ch 6. Dcfp around post of next dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 80 sts.
9th rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Ch 6. Dcfp around post of next dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
10th rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Ch 6. Dcfp around post of next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 96 sts.
11th rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Ch 6. Dcfp around post of next dc. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
12th rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Ch 6. Dcfp around post of next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 112 sts.
13th rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Ch 6. Dcfp around post of next dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
14th rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Ch 6. Dcfp around post of next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 128 sts.
15th rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Ch 6. Dcfp around post of next dc. 1 dc in each of next 6 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
16th rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Ch 6. Dcfp around post of next dc. 1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dcfp. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. 144 sts.
17th rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Ch 6. Dcfp around post of next dc. 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. Rep last rnd (with no further increases) until work from center (radius) measures approx 15" [38 cm] or 30" [76 cm] total width.
Make chain links: With RS facing, twist first horizontal ch-4 bar of 7th rnd to form loop. Draw 2nd horizontal ch-6 bar of 8th rnd through first loop without twisting. Rep, drawing next horizontal ch-6 bar through previous loop without twisting until all loops have been worked. Note: Twisting only first horizontal ch-4 bar will prevent gaps in work.
Next rnd: Ch 2. *Dcfp around post of next dcfp. Sl st in rem loop of chain link to secure. Dcfp around post of next dc. 1 dc in each of next 7 dc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first dcfp. Fasten off.
Join Pieces: With WS of Top and Bottom facing each other and final rnds aligned (taking care to match pat), join yarn with sl st through both thicknesses to any dc. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, join Top and Bottom edges tog with sl st in each st around, inserting pillow forms as you work. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.

abbreviations: Sc2tog = (Insert hook into front loop only of next sc) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - Invisible Sc2tog made.

gauge: 8 sc and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Work rnds in continuous spiral, placing marker at first st and moving marker each subsequent rnd.

instructions:
Rows 2–13: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in first 8 sc; change to J, sc in last 11 sc, turn.
Row 15: Ch 1, sc in first 11 sc; change to first color, sc in last 8 sc, turn.
Rows 16 and 17: Repeat Rows 14 and 15.
Row 18: Repeat Row 14.
Row 19: Ch 1, sc in first 11 sc; change to first color, sc next 3 sc; change to J, sc in next 2 sc; change to first color, sc in last 3 sc, turn.
Row 20: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc; change to J, sc in next 4 sc; change to first color, sc in next 2 sc; change to J, sc in last 11 sc, turn.
Row 21: Ch 1, sc in first 11 sc; change to first color, sc in next sc; change to J, sc in next 6 sc; change to first color, sc in last sc. Fasten off first color, leaving a long tail for sewing. Cut J.
Back Side
With J, ch 58.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—57 sc.
Rows 2–63: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off.
Mouse
With A, ch 27.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next 9 ch; leave remaining ch unworked for tail, turn—11 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as first st), dc in next 6 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, sc in last 2 sts, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, slip st in first st, sc in next 8 sts, hdc2tog—9 sts. Fasten off.
Ear (make 2)
With A, ch 3.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 hdc in 3rd ch from hook; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—6 hdc. Fasten off.
Special Stitch
hdc2tog = [Yarn over, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up loop] 2 times, yarn over and draw through all 5 loops on hook.
sc2tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Special Technique
Join with sc = Place a slip knot on hook, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through both loops on hook.
Notes
1. Nine kitten and nine puppy motifs are made separately in squares and sewn together for fronts of pillows. J is the background color of all squares and remaining colors are each worked once (“first color”).
2. Cat applique is made separately and sewn to back of puppies pillow. Mouse applique is made separately and sewn to back of kittens pillow.
3. To change color, work last stitch of old color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new color and draw through all loops on hook to complete stitch. Drop old color but do not cut until instructed. Proceed with new color.
4. Use photograph as a guide for embroidery and placement of sewn-on pieces.
FREE KITTENS PILLOW
Front Side
Square (make 9 – 1 each in A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, and I)
With first color, ch 20.
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—19 sc.
= 2” (5 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE.
Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
FINISHING FOR KITTENS PILLOW
Faces
Thread embroidery floss onto needle and fold over to double the strands. With all 12 strands held together, embroider French knot eyes and nose. Sew one vertical straight stitch from nose and 2 stitches as an inverted “V” for mouth.
Mouse
With floss, embroider French knot eye and satin stitch nose.
Place mouse on back side. Tuck one ear between head and back side and place other ear slightly on top of head. Sew body and ears in place leaving top of ears and tail unsewn. Add strands of carpet thread as whiskers, if desired.
Weave in ends.
Pillow
Using assembly diagram as a guide and with right sides facing, sew squares together with ending tails for front side. Pull tails to wrong side of piece to minimize weaving in.
Joining Round: With wrong sides held together and working through both thicknesses, join J with sc in first st of top row, 2 sc in same st, sc in each st across to last st, 3 sc in last st; working across ends of rows, sc in each row to bottom row; working in opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in each ch across to last ch, 3 sc in last ch; insert pillow form; working across ends of rows, sc in each row to top row; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
PUPPIES FOR SALE PILLOW
Front Side
Square (make 9 – 1 each in A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, and I)
Rows 1–13: Work same as Rows 1–13 of squares of kittens pillow.
Row 14: Ch 1, sc in first 10 sc; change to J, sc in last 9 sc, turn.
Row 15: Ch 1, sc in next 9 sc; change to first color, sc in last 10 sc, turn.
Rows 16–19: Repeat Rows 14 and 15 twice; change to J in last st of Row 19, turn.
Row 20: Ch 1, sc in first sc; change to first color, sc in next 8 sc; change to J, sc in last 10 sc, turn.
Row 21: Ch 1, sc in first 11 sc; change to first color, sc in next 6 sc; change to J, sc in last 2 sc. Fasten off J. Cut first color, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Ear (make 18 – 2 each in A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, and I)
Ch 4.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, 5 hdc in last ch; working in opposite side of foundation ch, hdc in next ch, sc in last ch—9 sts. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing.
Back Side
Work same as back side of kittens pillow.
Cat
With A, ch 8.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn—9 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in last sc, turn—11 sc.
Rows 4–6: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Rows 7–9: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—5 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *2 sc in next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * once, turn—7 sc.
Row 12: Repeat Row 2—9 sc.
Rows 13–15: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 16: Repeat Row 7—7 sc.
Row 17: *Ch 5, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in last ch*, skip first 2 sc, slip st in next sc; repeat from * to * once, skip next 2 sc, slip st in last sc. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing.
Tail
With A, ch 30.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, [sc2tog] 5 times, sc in remaining ch—24 sc. Fasten off leaving a long tail for sewing.
FINISHING FOR PUPPIES PILLOW
Faces
Embroider faces same as kittens pillow.
With pink floss, embroider satin stitches vertically for tongue.
Sew matching ears on Row 20 at 2nd and 9th stitches from edge.
Cat
Embroider eyes and nose same as kitten’s face. Embroider smile with back stitches.
Sew cat and tail on back of pillow.
Pillow
Follow assembly and joining directions same as kitten pillow.

13th rnd: *2 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl. (1 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl) 12 times. Rep from * around. 140 hdc3bl.
14th rnd: *2 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl. (1 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl) 13 times. Rep from * around. 150 hdc3bl.
15th rnd: *2 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl. (1 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl) 14 times. Rep from * around. 160 hdc3bl.
16th rnd: *2 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl. (1 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl) 15 times. Rep from * around. 170 hdc3bl.
17th rnd: *2 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl. (1 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl) 16 times. Rep from * around. 180 hdc3bl.
18th rnd: *2 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl. (1 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl) 17 times. Rep from * around. 190 hdc3bl.
19th rnd: *2 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl. (1 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl) 18 times. Rep from * around. 200 hdc3bl.
20th rnd: *2 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl. (1 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl) 19 times. Rep from * to last 20 sts. 2 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl. (1 hdc3bl in next hdc3bl) 16 times. 1 sc in each of next 3 hdc3bl. Join with sl st to first hdc3bl. 210 sts.**
21st rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 210 sts.
22nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc.
23rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc and ch to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
BACK
Work from ** to ** as given for Front. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Thread faux leather strap through holes made with ch sps in 22nd rnd of Pillow Front; tie knots in both ends to secure Straps. Sew Back and Front tog, inserting pillow form when seam is halfway complete.

materials: RED HEART Super Saver Stripes™: 4 skeins 4962 Fruity Stripe
abbreviations: Dec Shell: [Yarn over, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] 5 times, yarn over, draw through all loops on hook.
gauge: 3 shells = 5" [12.5 cm]; 8 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pattern stitch.
instructions:
PILLOW (make 2)
Ch 88.
Row 1: (Right Side) 2 dc in fourth ch from hook, skip next 2 ch, sc in next ch, [skip next 2 ch, Shell in next ch, skip next 2 ch, sc in next ch] 13 times, skip next 2 ch, 3 dc in last ch.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in first dc, [ch 3, Dec Shell over next 5 sts, ch 3, sc in next dc] 13 times, ch 3, Dec Shell over next 5 sts, ch 3, sc in top of beginning ch-3.
Row 3: Ch 3, turn, 2 dc in first sc, [sc in top of next Dec Shell, Shell in next sc] 13 times, sc in top of next Dec Shell, 3 dc in last sc.
Rows 4-48: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 for twenty two times, then repeat Row 2 once more. Fasten off.

With wrong sides together and lining up top, bottom and side edges, whipstitch 3 sides together. Insert pillow form. Whipstitch last side closed. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 2 Skeins 505 Aruba Sea A; 1 Skein each 316 Soft White B and 373 Petal Pink C.
Fiberfill, standard size pillow, two 1” buttons, 1½” diameter or doll safety eyes, hook & loop fastener, black embroidery thread, stitch markers, yarn needle.
abbreviations: sc2tog = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

A, B, C = Color A, B, C; ch = chain; hdc = half double crochet; mm = millimeters; sc = single crochet; st(s) = stitch(es); tog = together; [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified; * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Pillow Cover fits standard size pillow, 18” across x 14” front to back.
gauge: 16 sc = 4”; 16 rows = 4” using smaller hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions: Head: Starting at muzzle with larger hook and B, ch 11. Round 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in same st, sc in next 8 ch, 4 sc in last ch, turn to work along opposite side of foundation ch, skip first ch, sc in next 8 ch, 2 sc in last ch, place marker for beginning of round – 24 sts. Round 2: 2 sc in next 2 sts, sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in next 4 sts, sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in last 2 sts – 32 sts. Round 3: [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] twice, sc in next 8 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 4 times, sc in next 8 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] twice – 40 sts. Round 4: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts] 4 times, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in last st – 46 sts. Rounds 5-11: Sc in each st around. Round 12: Change to A, sc in each st around. Round 13: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 22 sts] twice – 48 sts. Rounds 14-16: Sc in each st around. Round 17: [Sc in next 7 sts, 2 sc in next st] 6 times – 54 sts. Round 18: Sc in each st around. Round 19: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts] 6 times – 60 sts. Round 20: Sc in each st around. Round 21: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts] 6 times – 66 sts. Round 22: Sc in each st around. Round 23: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts] 6 times – 72 sts. Rounds 24-27: Sc in each st around. Round 28: [2 sc in next st, sc in next 11 sts] 6 times – 78 sts. Rounds 29-33: Sc in each st around. Round 34: [Sc2tog, sc in next 11 sts] 6 times – 72 sts. Round 35: [Sc2tog, sc in next 10 sts] 6 times – 66 sts. Round 36: Sc in each st around. Round 37: [Sc2tog, sc in next 9 sts] 6 times – 60 sts. Round 38: [Sc2tog, sc in next 8 sts] 6 times – 54 sts. Round 39: [Sc2tog, sc in next 7 sts] 6 times – 48 sts. Pillow pals are a unique way for a child to have a stuffed friend that is also a pillow. The fantasy unicorn is perfect for a little girl’s imaginary play. Crochet him in her favorites colors. Round 40: [Sc2tog, sc in next 6 sts] 6 times – 42 sts. Round 41: [Sc2tog, sc in next 5 sts] 6 times – 36 sts. Stuff Head with fiberfill, adding more as necessary before closing. Round 42: [Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts] 6 times – 30 sts. Round 43: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts] 6 times – 24 sts. Round 44: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts] 6 times – 18 sts. Round 45: [Sc2tog, sc in next st] 6 times – 12 sts. Round 46: [Sc2tog] 6 times – 6 sts. Fasten off. Cut yarn, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through sts and pull to close. Knot to secure. Ears (Make 2): With smaller hook and A, ch 9, slip st in first st to join, place marker for beginning of round. Round 1: Sc in each ch around – 9 sc. Round 2: Sc in each st around. Round 3: [2 sc in each st] around – 18 sc. Rounds 4-10: Sc in each st around. Round 11: [Sc2tog, sc in next st] 6 times – 12 sts. Round 12: Sc in each st around. Round 13: [Sc2tog, sc in next st] 4 times – 8 sts. Round 14: Sc in each st around. Round 15: [Sc2tog, sc in next st] twice, sc2tog – 5 sts. Round 16: Sc in next st, [sc2tog] twice – 3 sts. Fasten off. Cut yarn, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through sts and pull to close. Knot to secure. Mane: With larger hook and C, ch 26. Row 1: Working in back nub of foundation ch, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 25 sc. Round 2: Turn to work in opposite side of foundation ch, [ch 8, slip st in next st] in each ch across, turn to work along sc, [ch 8, slip st in next st] in each sc. If desired, work [ch 8, slip st in next st] down center of foundation ch to add fullness. Fasten off. Cut yarn, leaving a long tail. Tail: With larger hook and C, ch 13. Row 1: Working in back nub of foundation ch, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 12 sc. Round 2: Turn to work in opposite side of foundation ch, [ch 12, slip st in next st] in each ch across, turn to work along sc, [ch 12, slip st in next st] in each sc. If desired, work [ch 12, slip st in next st] down center of foundation ch to add fullness. Fasten off. Cut yarn, leaving a long tail. Horn: With smaller hook and B, ch 12, slip st in first st to join, place marker for beginning of round. Round 1: Sc in each ch around – 12 sc. Rounds 2-4: Sc in each st around. Round 5: [Sc2tog, sc in next 4 sts] twice – 10 sc. Rounds 6-9: Sc in each st around. Round 10: [Sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts] twice – 8 sts. Round 11: [Sc2tog, sc in next 2 sts] twice – 6 sts. Round 12: [Sc2tog] 3 times. Fasten off. Cut yarn, leaving a long tail. Thread tail through sts and pull to close. Knot to secure. Pillow Cover: With larger hook and A, ch 90. Round 1: Hdc in 3rd chain from hook and in each ch across, slip st to first st to join – 88 sts. Rounds 2-49: Hdc in each st around. Fasten off. Cut yarn, leaving a long tail. Closing Strap: With smaller hook and A, ch 8. Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each sc across – 7 sts. Rows 2-30: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Fasten off. Cut yarn, leaving a long tail. FINISHING: Using long tails, flatten Ears and sew on either side of Head. Attach buttons or safety eyes on upper portion of Head. Stuff Horn and sew on Head in between Ears. Using black embroidery thread and straight stitches, sew nostrils on Muzzle. Sew Mane from just behind Horn down center of Head. Sew last round of Pillow Cover closed. Insert pillow and sew opposite end closed. Sew Head in center of one long edge of Pillow Cover. Sew Tail in center of opposite long edge of Pillow Cover. Sew one end of Closing Strap in center of one short side of Pillow Cover. Sew one side of hook and loop fastener to opposite end of Closing Strap. Sew corresponding side of hook and loop fastener to corresponding spot on opposite short side of Pillow Cover. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Blanket Breezy™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 530 yds/485 m) Surfs Up (70008) 2 balls
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only of next stitch
gauge: 12 sc and 13 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Front (including fringe) is worked before Back and Finishing.
FRONT 
Ch 59.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 58 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
4th to 63rd rows: Rep 2nd and 3rd rows 30 times more.
64th row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row.
Fasten off. 
Proceed with Fringe as follows:
Fringe: Separate 1 full ball of yarn into each individual shade and designate each shade A, B, C, D, E by yardage/weight with A having the most yardage and E having the least.
Cut strands of A, B, C, D, and E each 7" [18 cm] long. With RS of Front facing, taking 1 strand, fold in half and knot into fringe in each rem loop along 2nd row reps and 64th row, as shown in Chart, noting each square represents 1 sc. 
BACK
Ch 59.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 58 sc.
2nd to 64th rows:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Joining Front and Back: 1st rnd: With WS of Front and Back facing each other, join yarn with sl st to any corner st of Cushion. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work sc evenly around 3 sides of Cushion, having 3 sc in each corner. Insert pillow form. Complete rnd of sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Softee® Chunky™ Tweeds™  (10.5 oz/300 g; 316 yds/289 m)
Contrast A Burgundy Tweed (11007) 1 ball or 304 yds/278 m

Size U.S. L/11 (8 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only of next stitch
Scbl2tog = Draw up a loop in back loop only of each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Scfl = Single crochet in front loop only of next stitch
Scfl2tog = Draw up a loop in front loop only of each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loop on hook.
gauge: 8.5 sc and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Pillow Front is worked from corner to corner.
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook, yoh with new color. Pull through 2 loops on hook to complete st and proceed in new color.

FRONT and BACK (make 2 alike)

Stripe Pat 1
With A, work 8 rows. Join B. Break A.
With B, work 2 rows. Join C. Break B.
With C, work 2 rows. Join A. Break C.
With A, work 2 rows. Join C. Break A.
With C, work 2 rows. Join B. Break C.
With B, work 2 rows. Join C. Break B.
With C, work 2 rows. Join A. Break C.
With A, work 10 rows. Join C. Break A.
With C, work 4 rows. Join B. Break C.
With B, work 2 rows. Join C. Break B.
With C, work 4 rows. Join B. Break C.
With B, work 2 rows. Join C. Break B.
With C, work 2 rows. Join A. Break C.
With A, work 2 rows. Join C. Break A.
With C, work 6 rows. Fasten off.
These 60 rows form Stripe Pat 1.

With A, ch 2.

Inc section: 1st row:  (RS). 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row:  Ch 1. 2 scfl in each of next 2 sc. Turn. 4 sc.
3rd row:  Ch 1. 2 scbl in first sc. 1 scbl in each sc to last sc. 2 scbl in last sc. Turn. 6 sc.
4th row:  Ch 1. 2 scfl in first sc. 1 scfl in each sc to last sc. 2 scfl in last sc. Turn. 8 sc.
First 4 rows of Stripe Pat 1 are complete.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat 1, rep 3rd and 4th rows 13 times more. Turn. 60 sc.
PM at both beg and end of last row.
First 30 rows of Stripe Pat 1 are complete.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat 1, proceed with Dec Section as follows:

Dec Section: 1st row:  (RS). With A, ch 1. Scbl2tog. 1 scbl in each sc to last 2 sc. Scbl2tog. Turn. 58 sc.
2nd row:  Ch 1. Scfl2tog. 1 scfl in each st to last 2 sc. Scfl2tog. Turn. 56 sc.
First 32 rows of Stripe Pat 1 are complete.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat 1, rep 1st and 2nd rows 13 times more. 4 sc.
Next row: With C, ch 1. Scbl2tog twice. Turn. 2 sc.
Next row:  Ch 1. Scfl2tog. Fasten off.

Weaving:

Stripe Pat 2
With A, weave 3 rows.
With B, weave 2 rows.
With A, weave 4 rows.
With C, weave 2 rows.
With A, weave 8 rows.
With C, weave 2 rows.
With A, weave 4 rows.
With B, weave 2 rows.
With A, weave 4 rows.
With B, weave 2 rows.
With A, weave 4 rows.
With C, weave 2 rows.
With A, weave 8 rows.
With C weave 2 rows.
With A, weave 4 rows.
With B, weave 2 rows.
With A, weave 3 rows.
These 58 rows form Stripe Pat 2.

With RS facing, turn work 45 degrees so last row is at top and work looks like a diamond. Beg working from right to left beg at right tip of diamond. Using the marked row (30th row) as a guide proceed as follows. 
Note: See diagram on page 3.
1st row:  With RS facing and taking 2 strands of A with tapestry needle, weave under each of rem 3 loops along 2nd row of rem loops. Fasten ends of strands in place, ensuring strand does not gather fabric.
2nd row:  With RS facing and taking 2 strands of A with tapestry needle, weave under each of rem 5 loops along 3rd row of rem loops. Fasten ends of strands in place, ensuring strand does not gather fabric.
3rd row:  With RS facing and taking 2 strands of A with tapestry needle, weave under each of rem 7 loops along 4th row of rem loops. Fasten ends of strands in place, ensuring strand does not gather fabric.

4th row:  With RS facing and taking 2 strands of B with tapestry needle, weave under each of rem 9 loops along 5th row of rem loops. Fasten ends of strands in place, ensuring strand does not gather fabric.
First 4 rows of Stripe Pat 2 are complete. Keeping cont of Stripe Pat 2, cont in this manner, weaving under each row of rem loops across (as shown in diagram), breaking and joining yarn as necessary.

FINISHING
Joining Front and Back:  With WS facing each other, join B with sl st to any corner st of Pillow. Ch 1. Working through both thicknesses, work sc evenly around 3 sides of Pillow, having 3 sc in each corner. Insert pillow form. Complete rnd of sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Bernat® Crushed Velvet™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 315 yds /288 m) Soft Gray (16001) 3 balls

abbreviations: Double-loop-st = Wrap yarn around index finger twice and hold behind work, insert hook into indicated stitch and between the yarn wraps and your finger, remove your finger from wraps and draw wraps through stitch (leaving part of each wrap on other side of fabric to form loops), yarn over and draw through all loops on hook. Note: Loops form on side of fabric that is facing away from you.
gauge: 12 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
FRONT
Ch 2.
1st rnd: (WS). (Double-loop-st. Ch 2) 4 times, all in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first st.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. *Double-loop-st in next st. (Double-loop-st. Ch 2. Double-loop-st) all in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first st.

3rd rnd: Ch 1. *Double-loop-st in each st to ch-2 corner sp. (Double-loop-st. Ch 2. Double-loop-st) all in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * 3 times more. Double-loop-st in each st to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first st.

Rep last rnd until a total of 21 rnds have been worked.

Next rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each st to ch-2 corner sp. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first st.

Rep last rnd until work measures 22" [56 cm] across.

Fasten off.

BACK (make 2 pieces alike)
Ch 11.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row.
Rep last row until work from beg (when slightly stretched) measures 22" [56 cm]. Do not fasten off.

1st row: (RS). Turn work sideways. Ch 1. Work 66 sc evenly across side of ribbing. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 13½" [34 cm].

Fasten off.

FINISHING
Overlap Back pieces to match Front, with ribbed sections in center to create opening to insert pillow form. Sew outer edge seams.

instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as stitch.
FRONT 
Weaving Strips (Make 30 in MC, 15 each in A and B.)
Ch 92.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 90 hdc.
2nd row: (WS) Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Fasten off.

With MC, ch 89.
1st row: (RS). With MC, 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 87 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.

Front Weaving

Weave 1 B Strip, RS up, in opposite Strips from A. Rep with rem Strips, alternating A and B. See Diagram. When weaving is complete, secure ends of Strips with safety pins. materials: Bernat® Super Value™ (197 g/7 oz; 389 m/426 yds)
1¼" [3 cm] button with shank (to be covered for ‘nose’)
abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
