materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Note: 1 ball of MC and A will make 2 Potholders.
Size U.S. F/5 (3.75 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Grapes
With MC, ch 5.
1st row: (RS). (Yoh and draw up 
a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 
loops on hook) 5 times in 5th ch 
from hook. (Missed ch-4 counts 
as 1 dc and ch-1 sp). Yoh and draw 
through all 6 loops on hook. Ch 1. 1 
dc in same ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. (Yoh and draw up 
a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 
loops on hook) 4 times in first 
ch-1 sp. Yoh and draw through 
all 5 loops on hook – beg cluster 
made. Ch 1. (Yoh and draw up a 
loop.Yoh and draw through 2 loops 
on hook) 5 times in top of next 
cluster. Yoh and draw through all  
6 loops on hook – Cluster made. 
Ch 1. Cluster in last ch-1 sp. Turn. 
3rd row: Beg cluster in top of first 
cluster. *Ch 1. Cluster in next ch-1 
sp. Rep from * to last cluster. Ch 1. 
Cluster in top of last cluster.
Rep last row 5 times more. 
9 clusters. Turn.
Next row: Sl st in top of first cluster 
and next ch-1 sp. Beg cluster in 
same ch-1 sp. *Ch 1. Cluster in next 
ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last Cluster. 
Turn.
Rep last row twice more. 6 Clusters. 
Fasten off. 
Leaf: (make 2).
With A, ch 10.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from 
hook. 1 sc in each of next 7 ch. 
3 sc in last ch. Working into 
opposite side of ch, 1 sc in each of 
next 6 ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. Miss first sc. 
Working in back loops only, 1 sc in 
each of next 6 sc. 3 sc in next sc. 
1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Turn. 
Rep last row 4 times more.
Next row: Ch 3. Miss first sc. Sl st in 
back loop of next sc. 
Fasten off.
Hanging Loop
With A, ch 5. Join with sl st to form 
ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 11 dc in 
ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Leaves and Hanging Loop to 
top of Grapes as shown in picture.

materials: Bernat® Handicrafter® Holidays (Solids: 4 oz/113 g; 200 yds/184 m; Ombres: 3.5 oz/100 g; 170 yds/155 m)
Main Color (MC) Acorn Brown (13520) 38 m/41 yds
Contrast A Autumn Red (13430) 32 m/35 yds
Size U.S. E/4 (3.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
gauge: 16 sc and 20 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
INSTRUCTIONS
Note: 1 ball of each color will make approx 3 Napkin Rings.
Napkin Ring
Make each with A and B.
Ch 26. Join with sl st to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st in first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
Rep 2nd rnd until work from beg measures 1¾" [4.5 cm]. Fasten off.
Acorn
Make each with A and B.
Ch 15. Join with sl st to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 15 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
3rd and 4th rnds: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) 3 times. Join with sl st to first st. 12 sts. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. Join with sl st to first st. 6 sts.
8th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 3 times. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off. Thread end through rem loops and fasten securely.
Acorn ‘Hat’
Join MC with sl st to any rem loop on 2nd rnd.
1st rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next loop. 1 sc in each of next 2 loops. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 20 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Stuff Acorn.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 10 times. Join with sl st to first st. 10 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 5 times. Join with sl st to first st. 5 sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Skip last st. Join with sl st to first st. Ch 3. Sl st in first ch. Fasten off.
Leaf
With MC, ch 16.
1st row: 1 dc in 3rd ch from hook. *Ch 2. (Sl st. Ch 2. 1 dc) all in next ch. Rep from * to end of ch. Ch 2. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Acorn with A to Ring made in B, and Acorn with B to Ring made in A. Sew 1 Leaf to each Ring.

materials: AUNT LYDIA'S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball each 421 Goldenrod A, 431 Pumpkin B, 310 Copper Mist C, 449 Forest Green D, 672 Olive E, 119 Violet F, and 196 Cardinal Red G
Susan Bates® Steel Crochet Hook: 2.1 mm [US 3]
abbreviations: join with sc = Place a slip knot on hook, insert hook in indicated stitch, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through both loops on hook.
picot = Ch 3, slip st in 3rd ch from hook.
popcorn = Work 5 dc in indicated stitch, drop loop from hook, insert hook from front to back in first dc of the 5 dc just made, return dropped loop to hook and draw through.

tr3tog (treble crochet 3 stitches together) = *[Yarn over] twice, insert hook in next st, yarn over and pull up a loop, [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice; repeat from * 2 more times, yarn over and draw through all 4 loops on hook.
gauge: Rounds 1–5 = measure about 4" [10 cm] across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
DOILY
With A, make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Beg-Cl in ring, [ch 5, Cl in ring] 7 times, ch 5; join with slip st in top of beginning ch – 8 clusters and 8 ch-5 spaces. Fasten off A and weave in ends.

Round 2: With right side facing, draw up a loop of G in any ch-5 space, (beg-popcorn, ch 3, popcorn) in same ch-5 space, *ch 3, (popcorn, ch 3, popcorn) in next ch-5 space; repeat from * around, ch 3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—16 popcorns and 16 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off G and weave in ends.

Round 3: With right side facing, draw up a loop of E in any ch-3 space, ch 8 (counts as dc, ch 5), dc in next ch-3 space, *ch 5, dc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ch 5; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—16 dc and 16 ch-5 spaces.

Round 4: Slip st in first ch-5 space, ch 3 (counts as dc), 5 dc in same ch-5 space, 6 dc in each of next 15 ch-5 spaces; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—Sixteen 6-dc groups. Fasten off E and weave in ends. 

Round 5: With right side facing, join C with sc in first dc of any 6-dc groups, sc in next 5 dc, Fpdc around next dc of Round 3, *sc in next 6 dc of Round 4, Fpdc around next dc of Round 3; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—16 Fpdc and sixteen 6-sc groups. Fasten off C and weave in ends.

Round 6: With right side facing, draw up a loop of F in back loop of any st, ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in back loop of each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—112 dc. Fasten off F and weave in ends.

Round 7: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in any st, beg-tr3tog, *ch 4, tr3tog; repeat from * around, skip last st; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—37 tr3tog and 37 ch-4 spaces. Fasten off B and weave in ends.

Round 8: With right side facing, draw up a loop of D in any ch-4 space, ch 3 (counts as dc), 4 dc in same ch-4 space, 5 dc in each ch-5 space around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—Thirty-seven 5-dc groups. Fasten off D and weave in ends.

Round 9: With right side facing, join A with sc in first dc of any 5-dc group, sc in next 4 dc, Fpdc around next tr3tog of Round 7, *sc in next 5 dc of Round 8, Fpdc around next tr3tog of Round 7; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—Thirty-seven 5-sc groups and 37 Fpdc. Fasten off A and weave in ends.

Round 10: With right side facing, draw up a loop of G in any Fpdc, (beg-Cl, ch 3, Cl) in same st, (Cl, ch 3, Cl) in each Fpdc around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—74 clusters and 37 ch-3 spaces (thirty-seven (Cl, ch 3, Cl) groups). Fasten off G and weave in ends.

Round 11: With right side facing, draw up a loop of C in any ch-3 space, ch 3 (counts as dc) 4 dc in same ch-3 space, 5 dc in each ch-3 space around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—Thirty-seven 5-dc groups. Fasten off C and weave in ends.

Round 12: With right side facing, join F with sc in first dc of any 5-dc group, sc in next 4 dc, dc in next space between (Cl, ch 3, Cl) groups of Round 10, *sc in next 5 dc of Round 11, dc in next space between (Cl, ch 3, Cl) groups of Round 20; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—Thirty-seven 5-sc groups and 37 dc. Fasten off F and weave in ends.

Round 13: With right side facing, draw up a loop of E in back loop of first sc of any 5-sc groups, ch 3 (counts as dc); working in back loops only, dc in next 4 sc, *ch 2, skip next dc, dc in next 5 sc; repeat from * to last dc, ch 2, skip last dc; join wth slip st in top of beginning ch—Thirty-seven 5-dc groups and 37 ch-2 spaces. Fasten off E and weave in ends.

Round 14: With right side facing, draw up a loop of B in any ch-2 space, beg-Cl in same ch-2 space,*ch 5, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc, ch 5, skip next 2 dc, Cl in next ch-2 space; repeat from * to last 5-dc group, ch 5, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc, ch 5, skip next 2 dc; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—37 clusters, 37 sc, and 74 ch-5 spaces. Fasten off B and weave in ends.

Round 15: With right side facing, draw up a loop of A in any Cl, ch 3 (counts as dс), (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same Cl, *ch 5, (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in next Cl; repeat from * around, ch 5; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—37 (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) groups and 37 ch-5 spaces (between the groups). Fasten off A and weave in ends.

Round 16: With right side facing, draw up a loop of D in any ch-3 space, (beg-Cl, ch 1, Cl, ch 1, Cl) in same ch-3 space, *ch 3, sc in next ch-5 space, ch 3, (Cl, ch 1, Cl, ch 1, Cl) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * to last ch-5 space, ch 3, sc in last ch-5 space, ch 3; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—37 (Cl, ch 1, Cl, ch 1, Cl) groups, 37 sc, and 74 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off D and weave in ends.

Round 17: With right side facing, draw up a loop of  E in first ch-1 space of any (Cl, ch 1, Cl, ch 1, Cl) group, ch 3 (counts as dc), picot, 2 dc in same ch-1 space, (2 dc, picot, 2 dc) in next ch-1 space, dc in next ch-5 space of Round 15, *(2 dc, picot, 2 dc) in each of next 2 ch-1 spaces of Round 16, dc in next ch-5 space of Round 15; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off E and weave in ends.

FINISHING
Weave in any remaining ends.

pattern_name: Holiday or Any Day Table Runner
materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® “Classic Crochet Thread”, Size 10: 2 balls 449 Forest Green
abbreviations: () = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Table Runner measures 14” wide x 25” long.
gauge: One motif measures about 3¼” diameter. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
First Motif
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 7; join with slip st in if first ch to form a ring; ch 3 (counts as first dc), 23 dc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 dc.
Round 2: Ch 2, 2-dc Cl in same st as join, ch 4, skip next d...d, ch 1, (3-dc Cl, [3-ch, 3-dc Cl] 2 times) in next ch-3 space, ch 1] 3 times; repeat from ** around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream™ (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Contrast A Ecru (00004) 2 balls or 219 yds/200 m
Contrast B Tangerine (01699) 1 ball or 34 yds/31 m
Contrast C Robin’s Egg (01215) 1 ball or 34 yds/31 m
Contrast D Sage Green (00084) 1 ball or 34 yds/31 m
Contrast E Warm Brown (01130) 1 ball or 34 yds/31 m
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 17" [43 cm] long x 12" [30.5 cm] wide.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as hdc.
With A, ch 58.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. (1 hdc in next ch. Ch 1. Skip next ch) 4 times. 1 hdc in each of next 38 ch. (Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 hdc in next ch) 4 times. 1 hdc in last ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. (1 hdc in next hdc. Ch 1) 4 times. 1 hdc in each of next 38 hdc. (Ch 1. 1 hdc in next hdc) 4 times. 1 hdc in last hdc. Break A. Join B. Turn.
3rd row: With B, Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. (1 hdc in next hdc. Ch 1) 4 times. 1 hdc in each of next 38 hdc. (Ch 1. 1 hdc in next hdc) 4 times. 1 hdc in last hdc. Break B. Join A. Turn.
4th row: With A, as 3rd row. Break A, join C.
5th row: With C, as 3rd row. Break C. Join A.
6th row: With A, as 3rd row. Break A, join D.
7th row: With D, as 3rd row. Break D, join A.
8th row: With A, as 3rd row. Break A, Join E.
9th row: With E, as 3rd row. Break E. Join A.
With A only, rep 3rd row until piece measures approx 8" [20.5 cm], join E at end of last row.
Cont in pat, working 1 row each in following sequence: E, A, D, A, C, A, B, A.
Next row: With A, ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc and ch-1 sp across. Fasten off.
Vertical Surface Sl St Lines:
With RS facing, join B with sl st to center first ch-1 sp at foundation row at back. Keeping yarn at back (WS) of work, sl st into each ch-1 sp in alternate rows above joining sp to create a straight vertical line of surface sl sts to top of Placemat, taking care to sl st loosely to avoid pulling in work as you stitch. Fasten off.
Rep Vertical Sl St Line in following sequence: C, D, E. Turn Placemat and rep for opposite side edge.
FINISHING
With RS facing, join E with sl st to any corner. Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around each side edge, working 3 sc in each corner. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated

gauge: GAUGE: Rnds 1-5 = 4 1/4” across; Rnds 1-23 = 20” across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.

Rnd 20: Ch 3, * tr in sp, ch 3, dc around post of tr just made **, dc in next dc; rep from * around, end at **; join in top of ch-3.
Rnd 21: Ch 9, * skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 6; rep from * around; join in 3rd ch of ch-9.
Rnd 22: Ch 3, 2 dc in same st as joining, * ch 2, sc in sp, ch 2 **, 3 dc in next dc; rep from * around, end at **; join.
Rnd 23: Sl st to first sc, ch 9, * dc in next sc, ch 6; rep from * around; join in 3rd ch of ch-9.
Rnd 24: Ch 4, * [dc, ch 1] 3 times all in sp **, dc in next dc, ch 1; rep from * around, end at **; join in 3rd ch of ch-4.
Rnd 25: Ch 3, tr around post of st directly below, dc in same st, * ch 1, skip next dc, dc in next dc, tr around post of same dc, dc in same dc; rep from * around; sc in top of ch-3 to join and form last sp.
Rnd 26: Ch 7, * sc in next sp, ch 4 **, dc in next sp, ch 4; rep from * around, end at **; join in 3rd ch of ch-7.
Rnd 27: Ch 5, 2 dc in same st as joining, * ch 2, 8 dtr in next dc, ch 2 **; (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in next dc – shell made; rep from * around, end at **; dc in same st as joining; join in 3rd ch of ch-5.
Rnd 28: (Sl st, ch 5, 2 dc) all in ch-2 sp, * ch 2, [dc in next dtr, ch 1] 7 times, dc in next dtr, ch 2, skip next sp **, shell in next sp; rep from * around, end at **; dc in same sp as joining; join in 3rd ch of ch-5.
Rnd 29: (Sl st, ch 5, shell) all in ch-2 sp, * ch 2, skip ch-2 sp, sc in ch-1 sp, [ch 3, sc in ch-1 sp] 6 times, ch 2, skip ch-2 sp **, (2 dc, ch 2, shell) all in next ch-2 sp; rep from * around, end at **; (2 dc, ch 2) in same sp as joining; join in 3rd ch of ch-5.
Shape Tips-Row 30: (Sl st, ch 3, dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in ch-2 sp, ch 2, sc in ch-3 sp, [ch 3, sc in ch-3 sp] 5 times, ch 2, skip ch-2 sp, shell in next ch-2 sp; TURN.
Row 31: Sl st to sp, (ch 3, dc, ch 2, 2 dc) all in sp – beg shell made; ch 2, sc in ch-3 sp, [ch 3, sc in ch-3 sp] 4 times, ch 2; shell in ch-2 sp of shell – shell over shell made; turn.
Row 32: Beg shell, ch 2, sc in ch-3 sp, [ch 3, sc in ch-3 sp] 3 times, ch 2, shell over shell; turn.
Row 33: Beg shell, ch 2, sc in ch-3 sp, [ch 3, sc in ch-3 sp] twice, ch 2, shell over shell; turn.
Row 34: Beg shell, ch 2, sc in ch-3 sp, ch 3, sc in ch-3 sp, ch 2, shell over shell; turn.
Row 35: Beg shell, ch 2, sc in ch-3 sp, ch 2, shell over shell; turn.
Row 36: Sl st to sp, ch 2, holding back last lp on hook, dc in same sp, 2 dc in sp of last shell, yo and through all 4 lps on hook. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Holiday: 1 ball each 9090 Red/Red A, 1360 Aran/Gold B, and 6060 Green/Green C.

instructions:
PLACEMAT
With A, ch 64.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 63 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3; yo and draw up a loop in first sc, yo and draw through 2 loops, skip next sc, yo and draw up a loop in next sc, yo and draw through 2 loops, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook – CL made; * ch 1, CL (use same sc as last leg of last CL, skip next sc, use next sc); repeat from * across; dc in last sc (same sc as last leg of last CL); turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first dc, * sc in next st, sc in next space; repeat from * to last 2 sts; sc in next st, sc in top of ch-3; turn.
Repeat Rows 2 and 3 twelve more times. Fasten off.
Border
Round 1: With right side facing, attach A in first sc of last row worked; ch 1, * (sc, ch 2, sc) all in first st, work 61 sc across to last st, (sc, ch 2, sc) all in last st, work 41 sc along side to next corner sc; repeat from * once more; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 2: Attach B in any corner ch-2 space; (ch 2, [yo and draw up a loop] twice, yo and draw through all 5 loops on hook – begining PS (puff st) made, ch 1; yo and draw up a loop] 3 times, yo and draw through all 7 loops on hook – PS made) all in space, ** ch 1, skip next sc, * PS in next sc, ch 1, skip next sc; repeat from * to next corner ***; (PS, ch 1, PS) all in next corner space; repeat from ** around, end at ***; join in top of begining PS. Fasten off.
Round 3: Attach A in any corner ch-1 space; ch 1, ** (sc, ch 2, sc) all in corner space, ch 2, * sc in next space, ch 2; repeat from * to next corner space; repeat from ** around; join.
Round 4: Slip st into ch-2 space, ch 1, ** ([sc, ch 3] twice, sc) all in corner ch-2 space, * (sc, ch 3, sc) all in next space; repeat from * to next corner; repeat from ** around; join. Fasten off.
Leaf (Make 4)
With C, ch 8; sc in 2nd and 3rd ch from hook, * (hdc; ch 3, slip st in 3rd ch from hook – P3 (picot) made; hdc) all in next ch, sc in next ch, (hdc, P3, hdc) all in next ch *, sc in next ch, (sc, P3, sc) all in last ch; work across opposite side of ch: sc in next ch; repeat from * to * once; sc in last 2 ch, slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Sew 2 Leaves in upper left and lower right corners of placemat. With a double strand of B, make 3 French Knot berries between leaves.
Set your holiday table in style with this lovely set. Alternate the colors so that you use up all 3 balls of yarn. These are perfect small projects for gift giving.

COASTER
With B ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring.

Round 2: Attach A in any dc; ch 1, 2 sc in each st around; join with a slip st in first sc – 34 sc.
Round 3: Ch 4, * CL, ch 1; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in 3rd ch of ch-4 – 17 CL.
Round 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in same ch as joining, 2 sc in space, * sc in CL, 2 sc in space; repeat from * around; join – 52 sc. Fasten off.
Border
Round 1: With right side facing, attach B in any sc; begining PS in same sc, ch 1, skip next sc, * PS in next sc, ch 1, skip next sc; repeat from * around; join in top of begining PS – 26 PS. Fasten off.
Round 2: Attach A in any ch-1 space; ch 1, * sc in space, ch 2; repeat from * around; join.
Round 3: Slip st into ch-2 space, ch 1, * (sc, ch 3, sc) all in space; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

instructions:
apple 
note: Stuff Apple as you work.

1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 6 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 18 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 30 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join with 
sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
9th to 12th rnds: As 7th rnd.
13th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Draw up loop in each of next 
2 sc. Yoh and draw loop through all loops on hook – sc2tog made) 6 times. 
Join with sl st to first sc. 30 sts.
14th rnd: As 7th rnd.
15th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. Join with sl st 
to first sc. 24 sts.
16th rnd: As 7th rnd.
17th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. Join with sl st 
to first sc. 18 sts.
Lightly stuff Apple.
18th and 19th rnds: As 7th rnd.
20th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 6 times. Join with sl st to first

leaF

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball each of 226 Natural A, 805 Blue Hawaii B, 310 Copper Mist C, 422 Golden Yellow D, 484 Myrtle Green E, 131 Fudge Brown F
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 2.25 mm [US B/1]
Size 1/5 darning needle (large eye, sharp point)
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: First 7 rounds = ½” (9 cm) in diameter. Circle = 1” (2.5 cm) in diameter. CHECK YOUR GAUGE.
instructions:
Round 5: With right side facing, join A in any st, ch 3, 3 dc in same st, *[skip next 2 sts, 4 dc in next st] 3 times, skip next 3 sts, 4 dc in next st; repeat from * twice, skip next 2 sts, 4 dc in next st, skip next 2 sts; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—56 dc; 14 4-dc groups. Fasten off A.
Round 6: With right side facing, join C in first dc, ch 2, skip first st, hdc in each of next 3 dc, dc in space before next dc, *hdc into next 4 dc, hdc in space before next dc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2—70 hdc.
Round 7: Ch 2, skip first st, hdc in each of next 3 sts, 2 hdc in next st, *hdc in each of next 4 sts, 2 hdc in next st; rep from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2—84 hdc. Fasten off C. 
Prepare round for attachment of circles by placing 14 stitch markers evenly spaced around. Line them up with the center of each 4-dc group from Round 5, leaving 4 sts between markers.
Round 8:
First Circle 
With D, leaving a 5” (12.5 cm) tail, ch 3, join with slip st to form ring.
Round 1: Ch 4 (counts as tr here and throughout), 19 tr in ring; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-4, slip st in any marked st in Round 7, slip st in last st of Circle—20 tr. Fasten off D.
Second through Thirteenth Circles 
With D, leaving a 5” (12.5 cm) tail, ch 3, join with slip st to form a ring.
SPECIAL STITCHES
cluster = Yarn over (twice), insert hook in designated space, yarn over, draw up a loop to the height of a dc, yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook, [yarn over, draw up a loop in same space, yo, draw through 2 loops] twice (5 loops on hook), yarn over, draw through 4 loops, yarn over, draw through last 2 loops.
tr2tog = *Yarn over (twice), insert hook in next st, draw up a loop, [yarn over, draw yarn through 2 loops on hook] twice; repeat from * once, yarn over, draw yarn through 3 loops on hook.
NOTE
Press mandala several times during construction to make it lay flat and show stitches clearly, especially after yellow circles and blossoms are added.
DOILY
With A, ch 3, join with slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 14 dc in ring; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—15 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in first st, 2 dc in each dc around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—30 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, 2 dc in next dc, *dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—45 dc. Fasten off A.
Round 4: With right side facing, join B with slip st in any st, ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), skip first st, hdc in each dc around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2—45 hdc. Fasten off B.

Round 1: Ch 4, 16 tr in ring, skip 4 sts to the left of last join in Round 7, slip st in next marked st, 3 tr in ring of current Circle, skip 3 sts on previous Circle to the left of joining, slip st in next tr; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-4 of current Circle—20 tr. Fasten off D.
Fourteenth Circle 
With D, leaving a 5” (12.5 cm) tail, ch 3, join with slip st to form ring.
Round 1: Ch 4, 11 tr in ring, skip 4 sts to the right of where First Circle is joined to Round 7, slip st in next tr on First Circle, 4 tr in center ring of current Circle, skip 4 sts to the left of last join in Round 7, slip st in next marked st, 4 tr in ring of current Circle, skip 3 sts on previous Circle to the left of joining, slip st in next tr; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-4 of current Circle—20 tr. Fasten off D.
Round 9: With right side facing, skip 1 tr to the left of join between any 2 Circles in Round 8, join C in next tr, ch 2, skip first st, hdc in next st, sc in each of next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in each of next 2 sts, hdc in each of next 2 sts, *skip last st of current Circle and first st on next Circle, hdc in each of next 2 sts, sc in each of next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in each of next 2 sts, hdc in each of next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2—140 sts. Fasten off C.
Round 10: With right side facing, skip 4 sts to the left of space between any 2 Circle, join E with a slip st in next sc in Round 9, ch 1, sc in same st, *ch 5, skip next 5 sts, work cluster in space between circles, ch 5, skip next 4 sts**, sc in next st; rep from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in first sc—28 ch-5 loops. Fasten off E.
Round 11: With right side facing, join B in ch-5 loop to the left of any cluster, ch 4, 5 tr in same loop, ch 1, *6 tr in next loop, ch 5, skip next ch-5 loop, dc in next sc, ch 5, skip next ch-5 loop**, 6 tr in next loop, ch 1; repeat from * around, ending last repeat **; join with a slip st in top of  beginning ch-4—14 ch-5 loops; 7 ch-1 spaces; 14 groups of 6-tr. Fasten off B.
Round 12: With right side facing, join F in ch-5 loop after any single dc, ch 1, *7 sc in ch-5 loop, hdc in each of next 6 tr, 2 dc in next ch-1 space, hdc in each of next 6 tr, 7 sc in next ch-5 loop; repeat from * around—198 sts. Fasten off F.
Round 13 (fan round): *With right side facing, locate space between 2 sc, centered over any single dc in Round 11, join D with a slip st in 3rd sc to the right, skip next 2 sc, work 6 dc in space before next sc (in space directly over dc in Round 11), skip next 2 sc, sl st in next sc, fasten off; repeat from * around—7 Fans.
Round 14: With right side facing, skip 1 sc to the left of last slip st made in any Fan, join C with a slip st in next st, ch 1, starting in same st, *sc in each of next 20 sts, leaving 1 st free before next Fan, ch 8, skip next Fan, skip next sc; repeat from * around—7 ch-8 loops. Fasten off C.
Round 15 (arch round): *With right side facing, join C with a slip st, 3 sts to the right of any ch-8 loop, do not ch, sc in next st, hdc in next st, 12 dc in next ch-8 loop, hdc in next st, sc in next st, slip st in next st, fasten off; repeat from * around—7 Arches.
Round 16: With right side facing, join A with a slip st last slip st of any Arch, ch 4, tr in each of next 15 sts, [dc in next 2 sts, 2 dc in next st, dc in next 3 sts, 2 dc in next st] twice, dc in next 2 sts**, tr in each of next 16 sts; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-4—252 sts.
Round 17: With right side facing, join E with a slip st in first st, ch 1, sc loosely in each st around. Fasten off E. 
Place 7 evenly spaced stitch markers around, placing 1 marker centered over each ch-1 space in Round 11 for 7 blossoms.
Round 18:
Blossom (make 7)
Round 1: With D, ch 4 (counts as dc), 11 dc in 4th ch from hook; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-4—12 dc. 
Round 2: Do not ch, *skip next dc, 8 dc in next st, skip next dc, slip st in next dc; repeat from * twice—3 petals. Attach stitch marker to ending loop, so it can be brought back up later. Cut thread but do not fasten off.
Row 3: With right side facing, join C with a slip st in 5th st to the right of join, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in each of next 4 sts, sc in joining slip st, sc in next 5 sts. Fasten off C.
Joining: Pull marked D loop up from Blossom Round 2, remove marker. Place D loop on hook, slip st in marked st in Round 17, slip st in top of beginning ch-4 of Round 1 of Blossom. Fasten off D.
Round 19: With right side facing, join C in first st to the left of last sc in Row 3 of any Blossom, ch 1, starting in same st, *[sc in each of next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st] twice, sc in next 4 sts, slip st in next sc in Row 3 of same Blossom, working in sts of Round 17, skip next 5 sts from joining of Blossom, *[tr2tog over next 2 sts] twice, dc in next 2 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, sc in next 10 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, dc in next 2 sts, [tr2tog over next 2 sts] twice; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off C.
Round 20: With right side facing, join B with slip st 6th sc over first Blossom, do not ch, sc in next 6 sts, slip st in next st, fasten off; repeat from * over top of each Blossom around. 
Round 21: With right side facing, join A with a slip st in first sc of Round 20, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts, hdc in sc at base of same sc, hdc in next 2 sts, dc in next 3 sts, tr in each of next 24 sts, dc in next 3 sts, hdc in next 2 sts, hdc in sc at base of next sc in Round 20; repeat from * around, increasing more as necessary to keep work flat; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off A.
Round 22: With right side facing, join F in first sc, ch 1, sc loosely in each st around; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Round 23: With right side facing, join A with a slip st in first sc, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts, hdc in next 3 sts, dc in next 3 sts, tr in each of next 24 sts, dc in next 3 sts, hdc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around, increasing more as necessary to keep work laying flat; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 24: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, making sts snug but not too tight. Press mandala to shape.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 2 skeins 319 Cherry Red
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Table Runner: 18½" [47 cm] wide by 90½" [230 cm] long
gauge: Gauge is not critical for this project.
instructions:
SNOWFLAKE 1 (make 2 for each repeat; 6 total for Runner)
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 4, join with slip st to form ring, ch 1, work 12 sc in ring, join with slip st in first sc – 12 sc. 
Round 2: *Ch 7, skip next st, slip st in next st; repeat from * around working last slip st in same space as beginning ch-7 – 6 ch-7 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in next 3 ch, *(slip st, [ch 5, slip st] 3 times) all in next ch, slip st in next 6 ch; repeat from * 5 times, slip st in next 3 ch, (slip st, [ch 5, slip st] 3 times) all in next ch, slip st in last 3 ch – 18 ch-5 spaces. Fasten off.

SNOWFLAKE 2 (make 2 for each repeat plus 1 extra for end; 7 total for Runner)
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 4, join with slip st to form ring, ch 4, (counts as a dc and ch 1), *dc in ring, ch 1; repeat from * 11 times, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4 – 12 dc and 12 ch-1 spaces.
Round 2: Slip st in next ch-1 space, *(hdc, dc, ch 3, dc, hdc) all in next ch-1 space, slip st in next ch-1 space; repeat from * around, working last slip st in same ch-1 space as beginning slip st – 6 slip sts 12 hdc, 12 dc and 6 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in each st to next ch-3 space, ch 3, (counts as first dc), (dc, ch 9, 2 dc) all in same space, ch 3, *(2 dc, ch 9, 2 dc) all in next ch-3 space, ch 3; repeat from * around, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 24 dc, 6 ch-9 spaces and 6 ch-3 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 1, *sc in next 2 sts, sc in next 2 ch, picot, sc in next 2 ch, (sc, triple picot, sc) all in next ch, sc in next 2 ch, picot, sc in next 2 ch, sc in next 2 sts, skip next ch, slip st in next ch, skip next ch; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 84 sc, 12 picots and 6 triple picots. 
Fasten off.

SNOWFLAKE 3 (make 2 for each repeat plus 1 extra for end; 7 total for Runner)
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 4, join with slip st to form ring, *ch 5, slip st in ring; repeat from * 5 times – 6 ch-5 spaces. 
Round 2: Slip st in next 3 ch, ch 9, (counts as dc, plus ch-6 for triple picot), triple picot in 6th ch from hook, ch 5, *dc in center ch of next ch-5, triple picot, ch 5; repeat from * around, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-9 – 6 triple picot and 6 ch-5 spaces. Fasten off.

SNOWFLAKE 4 (make 2 for each repeat; 6 total for Runner)
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 4, join with slip st to form ring, ch 1, work 12 sc in ring, join with slip st in first sc – 12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 8 (counts as dc and ch 5), skip next st, *dc in next st, ch 5, skip next st; repeat from * around, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-8 – 6 dc and 6 ch-5 spaces.
Round 3: *Sc in next 2 ch, (sc, ch 3, sc) all in next ch, sc in next 2 ch, slip st in next st; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 36 sc and 6 ch-3 spaces.
Round 4: Slip st in each st to next ch-3 space, ch 5, slip st in same space, ch 5, slip st in next slip st, ch 5, *(slip st, ch 5, slip st) all in next ch-3 space, ch 5, slip st in next slip st, ch 5; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first slip st – 18 ch-5 spaces.
Round 5: Slip st in next 3 ch, *triple picot, ch 1, skip next 3 ch, slip st in next ch, ch 5, skip next 6 ch, slip st in next ch, ch 1, slip st in in center ch of next ch-5; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first slip st. Fasten off.

SNOWFLAKE 5 (make 2 for each repeat; 6 total for Runner)
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 4, join with slip st to form ring, ch 1, work 12 sc in ring, join with slip st in first sc – 12 sc. 
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, ch 3, *sc in next st, ch 3; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 12 sc and 12 ch-3 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in next ch-3 space, *(dc, ch 3, dc) all in next ch-3 space, slip st in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, working last slip st in same space as first slip st– 12 dc and 6 ch-3 spaces.
Round 4: *Sc in next dc, (sc, ch 5, sc) all in next ch-3 space, sc in next dc, slip st in next slip st; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc – 24 sc and 6 ch-5 spaces.
Round 5: *Slip st in next sc, slip st in next 3 ch, triple picot, slip st in next 2 ch, slip st in next 2 sc, slip st in next slip st, slip st in next sc; repeat from * around – 6 triple picots. Fasten off.

SNOWFLAKE 6 (make 4 for each repeat; 12 total for Runner)
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 4, join with slip st to form ring, ch 8 (counts as dc and ch 5), [dc in ring, ch 5] 5 times, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-8 – 6 dc and 6 ch-5 spaces. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in ends. Immerse in cool water, squeeze out excess water, taking care not to wring or twist. Place the piece on a flat, covered surface, gently stretch to open lace pattern. Leave until completely dry.

instructions:
Body
With A, ch 2
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st to first sc to join. 
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as st here and throughout), turn, sc in same st, work 2 sc in each st around, slip st to top of beginning ch to join – 12 sts. 
Round 3: Ch 2, turn, sc in same st, sc in next st, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 5 times, slip st to top of beginning ch – 18 sts.
Round 4: Ch 2, turn, sc in same st, sc in next 2 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] 5 times, slip st to top of beginning ch – 24 sts.
Round 5: Ch 2, turn, sc in same st, sc in next 3 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] 5 times, slip st to top of beginning ch – 30 sts.
Round 6: Ch 2, turn, sc in same st, sc in next 4 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] 5 times, slip st to top of beginning ch – 36 sts.
Round 7: Ch 2, turn, sc in same st, sc in next 5 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] 5 times, slip st to top of beginning ch – 42 sts.
Round 8: Ch 2, turn, sc in same st, sc in next 6 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts] 5 times, slip st to top of beginning ch – 48 sts.
Round 9: Ch 2, turn, sc in same st, sc in next 7 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts] 5 times, slip st to top of beginning ch – 54 sts.
Round 10: Ch 2, turn, sc in same st, sc in next 8 sts, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts] 5 times, slip st to top of beginning ch – 60 sts.
Left Arm
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in next 9 sts. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, skip first sc, sc in 8 sc. 
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, skip first sc, sc in 7 sc. 
Row 4: Change to B, ch 1, turn. Do not cut A. skip first sc, sc in next 6 sc. 
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 6 sc.
Row 6: Change to A, ch 1, turn, sc in next 6 sc.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog. 
Row 8: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 5 sc.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog. 
Row 10: Ch 1, turn, skip first sc, sc in next sc, sc2tog, turn to work along edge of rows, slip st in next 3 rows, (hdc, dc, hdc, slip st) in next row for Thumb.
Fasten off.
Left Leg
With right side facing, skip 4 sc along edge of Front from Left Arm, join A in next sc. 
Row 1: Ch 1, work 8 sc across.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 8 sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 8 sc.
Row 4: Change to B, ch 1, turn, sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 7 sc.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 7 sc.
Row 7: Change to C, ch 1, turn, sc in next 7 sc. 
Row 8: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 6 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, turn to work along edge of rows, (hdc, dc) in next row, (hdc, sc, slip st) in next row.
Fasten off.
Right Leg
With wrong side facing, skip 9 sc along edge of Front from edge of Left Leg. Join A in next st and work as for Left Leg.
Right Arm
With wrong side facing, skip 4 sc along edge of Front from edge of Right Leg. Join A in next st and work as for Left Arm.
Beard
With right side facing, join B in first sc after Left Arm. 
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in next 8 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc to last 2 sts, sctog. 
Repeat Row 2 until 1 st remains. 
Fasten off. 
Fold Beard to right side of Front. 
Head
Row 1: Join B in first st of Beard, working through sts of both layers of Beard and Front, work 9 sc across.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, skip next sc, sc in each sc.
Row 3: Repeat Row 2. 
Rows 4 – 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 7 sc. 
Rows 6-7: Change to D, ch 1, turn, sc in next 7 sc. 
Row 8-9: Change to B, ch 1, turn, sc in next 7 sc. 
Row 10: Change to A, ch 1, turn, sc in next 7 sc. 
With A, repeat Row 2 until 1 st remains. 
Fasten off. 
BACK
With A only, work Body and Right Arm as for Front. 
FINISHING
Using C, embroider 2 French knots on Front Head for eyes. Using A, embroider 1 French Knot for nose. 
With wrong sides together, join A through both layers of Front and Back at edge of Left Arm, sc evenly around edges working through sts of both layers of Body and Head to tip of Head, ch 20 for hanging loop, slip st in same st, sc though sts of both layers of remaining edge of Head, Right Arm and Body to edge of Right Leg. Fasten off.
With B make a pompom and tie on to hanging loop.
Belt
With C, ch 21, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. 
Fasten off. 
Using E, work Chain Stitch embroidery to make a square in center of Belt for Buckle. 
Sew Belt across Front. 
Weave in ends.

Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.

Hot Pad Squares (make 2)
Ch 22.
1st row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 21 sc.
2nd row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Bobble in next sc. 1 sc in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
3rd row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows 8 times more. Fasten off.
Joining Squares and Working Border
Place one Square on top of the other with WS facing and align. Join yarn with sl st to any corner. Working through both thicknesses of Hot Pad for joining rnd, proceed as follows:
1st rnd (joining rnd):  Ch 2. (3 dc in corner. Work 1 dc in each of next 21 sts. 3 dc in corner. PM on center st. Work 21 dc evenly along edge to next corner) twice. Join with sl st to first dc.
2nd rnd:  Ch 2. Working 1 st around each unmarked st and 3 sts around each marked st, work in alt (Dcfp. Dcbp) ribbing, working 3 sts around each marked st. PM on center st. Join with sl st to first dc.
3rd rnd: As 2nd rnd. Fasten off.
YouTube video: https://youtu.be/tgQN8WzIZ7s

pattern_name: Mug Cozy, Tea Cozy, and French Coffee Press Cozy
materials: Size 5 mm (U.S. H or 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
Size 3.25 mm (U.S. D or 3) crochet hook for buttons
Patons® Decor (100 g / 3.5 oz; 190 m / 208 yds)
measurements: Mug Cozy: Approx 10 ins [25.5 cm] around x 4 ins [10 cm] high. Tea Cozy: Approx 21 ins [53.5 cm] around x 8 ½ ins [21.5 cm] high. French Coffee Press Cozy: Approx 12 ins [30.5 cm] around x 7 ins [18 cm] high.
gauge: 12 sts and 14 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] with larger hook in pat.
instructions:
MUG COZY
With A or B and larger hook, ch 28.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. Turn. 27 sc.
**2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *D cfp around next sc 2 rows below. Miss sc behind dcfp. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. D cfp around next sc 2 rows below. Miss sc behind dcfp. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st across. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *D cfp around next dcfp 2 rows below. Miss sc behind dcfp. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. D cfp around next dcfp 2 rows below. Miss sc behind dcfp. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
6th row: As 4th row.
Last 2 rows form pat.**
Join B or A. Beg with a RS row, cont in pat until work from beg measures 4 ins [10 cm] ending on a RS row. Do not fasten off. Cont as follows:
Side edging: Work 2 sc down side edge.
*Ch 4. Miss ¾ inch [2 cm] along side edge.*
Work sc down side to 1 inch [2.5 cm] before next corner. Rep from * to *. Work 2 sc down side to corner. Fasten off.
Buttons (make 2): With A or B and smaller hook, ch 2.
Note: Join all rnds with sl st in first sc.
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made. Rep from * 5 times more. 6 sts.
Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts. Sew on buttons to correspond to button loops.
TEA COZY (make 2 pieces alike).
With B and larger hook, ch 31.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. Turn. 30 sc.
Work from ** to ** as given for Mug Cozy.
Join A. Beg with a RS row, cont in pat until work from beg measures 6 ½ ins [16.5 cm], ending on a WS row.
Shape top: 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *D cfp around next dcfp 2 rows below. Miss sc behind dcfp. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. D cfp around next dcfp 2 rows below. Miss sc behind dcfp. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 21 sts.
2nd and 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st across. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *D cfp around next dcfp 2 rows below. Miss sc behind dcfp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *D cfp around next dcfp 2 rows below. Miss sc behind dcfp and next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sts. D cfp around next dcfp 2 rows below. Miss sc behind dcfp. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 12 sts.
6th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog over next 2 sts) 6 times. Fasten off. Break yarn leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts. Sew wide seams 3 ins [7.5 cm] from top edge and 1 ½ ins [4 cm] from bottom edge, leaving space between open for spout or handle.
Topper: With A and smaller hook, ch 2.
Work 1st and 2nd rnds as given for Button on Mug Cozy.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * 5 times more. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog over next 2 sts) 9 times. Join. 9 sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog over next 2 sts) 4 times. 1 sc in last st. 5 sts. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts. Sew Topper in position.
FRENCH COFFEE PRESS COZY
With A and larger hook, ch 34.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. Turn. 33 sts.
Work from ** to ** as given for Mug Cozy.
Join B. Beg with a RS row, cont in pat until work from beg measures 7 ins [18 cm], ending on a RS row. Do not fasten off. Cont as follows:
Side edging: Work 2 sc down side edge.
*Ch 4. Miss ¾ inch [2 cm] along side edge.*
Work sc down side to beg of center button loop. Rep from * to *. Work sc down to 1 inch [2.5 cm] before next corner. Rep from * to *. Work 2 sc down side to corner. Fasten off.
Buttons (make 3). With A, work as given for Mug Cozy. Sew on buttons to correspond to button loops.

materials: Bernat® Maker™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 317 yds/290 m)
Contrast A Black (06004) 2 balls or 380 yds/346 m
Contrast B Clay (06002) 1 ball or 290 yds/265 m
Size U.S. J/10 (6 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 12 sc and 13 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Note: To change colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of first color, yoh with new color and draw through rem 2 loops. Carry color when not in use loosely up WS of work.
With A, ch 2. See chart on page 3. 
1st rnd: 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join B with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd:  With B, ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 2 sc in each sc around. Join A with sl st to first sc. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: With A, ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). *1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. Rep from * around. Join B with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4.
4th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Working behind 3rd rnd, 2 dc in same sp as next dc 1  rnd below.** 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * around, ending at **. Join A with sl st to first sc. 36 sts.
5th rnd:  With A, ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1). Skip next st. *1 dc in next st. Ch 1. Skip next st. Rep from * around. Join B with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4.
6th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Working behind last rnd, work 2 dc in next skipped st.** 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * around, ending at **. Join A with sl st to first sc. 54 sts.
7th rnd:  With A, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. *2 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Rep from * around. Join B with sl st to first sc. 60 sc.
8th rnd: With B, as 5th rnd. Join A with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4.
9th rnd: With A, as 6th rnd. Join B with sl st to first sc. 90 sts.
10th rnd: With B, as 5th rnd. Join A with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 4. 
11th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Working behind last rnd, work 2 dc in next skipped st. (1 sc in next dc. Working behind last rnd, work 1 dc in next skipped st) twice.** 1 sc in next dc.  Rep from * around, ending at **. Join B with sl st to first sc. 105 sts. 
12th rnd: With B, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. (1 sc in each of next 20 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 4 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join A with sl st to first sc. 110 sc. 
13th rnd: As 5th rnd.
14th rnd:  With B, ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Working behind last rnd , work 2 dc in next skipped st.(1 sc in next dc. Working behind last rnd, work 1 dc in next skipped st) 4 times.** 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * around, ending at **. Join A with sl st to first sc. 122 sts.
15th rnd: As 5th rnd.
16th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Working behind last rnd, work 2 dc in next skipped st. (1 sc in next dc.  Working behind last rnd, work 1 dc in next skipped st) 5 times. 1 sc in next dc.  Rep from * around to last st. Working behind last rnd, work 1 dc in last skipped st. Join A with sl st to first sc. Break B. 134 sts.
17th rnd: With A, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. (1 sc in each of next 11 sc. 2 sc in next sc) 10 times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 145 sc.
18th rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each A, Delft Blue (885) and B, Light Blue (381)
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Mat measures 14" [35.5 cm] from point to opposite point, blocked.
gauge: 1 motif = 4" wide x 6¼" long [10 x 16 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
MOTIF (make 2 each with A, B, and C)
Make an adjustable ring.
Round 1: Ch 1, *(sc, hdc, dc, tr, ch 3, tr, dc, hdc) in ring; repeat from * once; join with slip st in first sc – 14 sts and 2 ch-3 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 5 (counts as first dc, ch 2), dc in first sc, *dc in next 3 sts, (3 dc, ch 4, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space, dc in next 3 sts*, (dc, ch 2, dc) in next sc; repeat from * to * once; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch – 28 dc, 2 ch-2 spaces, and 2 ch-4 spaces. Pull gently on tail to tighten ring but do not close completely.
Round 3: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), *(dc, ch 3, dc) in next ch-2 space, dc in each st around to next ch-4 space, (3 dc, ch 5, 3 dc) in next ch-4 space*; dc in each st around to next ch-2 space; repeat from * to * once, dc in each remaining st; join in top of beginning ch with invisible join, leaving a long tail for sewing – 44 dc, 2 ch-3 spaces, and 2 ch-5 spaces.
FINISHING
Arrange six pieces as shown in photo or in color scheme desired with ch-5 spaces at center and outer points. With right sides of 2 motifs held together, working through both sets of loops and beginning in center ch of nearest ch-3 space, whipstitch in each st and ch across, ending in center ch of next ch-5 space at center of Mat. Secure and cut tail. Repeat to join each remaining motif to previous motif. Weave in ends.
Block to finished measurement, pinning out outer ch-5 spaces to accentuate each point and straighten edges. Spray with fabric stiffener if desired.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® “Classic Crochet Thread,” Size 10: 1 ball 420 Cream.
abbreviations: beg cl (beginning cluster) = ch 5, * [yo] 3 times, draw up a loop in ch-2 space, [yo and draw through 2 loops] 3 times; repeat from * 3 more times in same space, yo and draw through all 5 loops on hook.
cl (cluster) = * [yo] 3 times, draw up a loop in ch-2 space, [yo and draw through 2 loops] 3 times; repeat from * 4 more times in same space, yo and draw through all 6 loops on hook.
picot = ch 3, sc in 3rd ch from hook.
gauge: Flower Motif = 2¾” x 2¾” after blocking. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
PLACEMAT
First Flower Motif
Round 1: Ch 2; 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 5, [dc in next sc, ch 2] 7 times; join with a slip st in 3rd ch of ch-5 – 8 spaces.
Round 3: Slip st in first space, beg cl in same space, ch 10, [cl in next space, ch 10] 7 times; join with a slip st in top of beg cl. Fasten off.
Second Flower Motif
Rounds 1 and 2: Work as First Flower Motif.
Round 3: Slip st in first space, beg cl in same space, ch 5, holding motifs wrong sides together sc in corresponding ch-10 loop of completed motif, ch 5, cl in next space on working motif, ch 5, sc in next ch-10 loop on completed motif, ch 5, * cluster in next space, ch 10; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off.
Repeat Second Flower Motif until 5 rows of 7 motifs in all are joined, joining on one or 2 sides as required.
Fill In Lace (Work in spaces between all motifs)
Round 1: Ch 2; 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 5, sc in any ch-5 space between motifs, [ch 5, slip st in next sc on Fill in Lace, ch 5, sc in next ch-5 space] 7 times, ch 5, slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Border
Join thread in any ch-10 loop; ch 1, (3 sc, picot, 3 sc, 3 picots, 3 sc, picot, 3 sc) all in each ch-10 loop around AND work (3 sc, picot, 3 sc) all in each ch-5 loop around; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Finishing
Block to measurements.

abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions given in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: Placemat Rnd 1 = 6¼” long x 1¼” wide. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With A ch 25.
Rnd 1: 4 Dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in next 20 ch, 5 dc in last ch, working on opposite side of beg ch, dc in next 20 st; join with a slip st to top of ch-3 – 50 sts.
Rnd 2: Ch 3, dc in same ch as joining, [2 dc in next dc] 4 times, dc in next 20 dc, [2 dc in next dc] 5 times, dc in next 20 dc; join – 60 sts.
Rnd 3: Ch 3, dc in same ch as joining, [2 dc in next dc] 9 times, dc in next 20 dc, [2 dc in next dc] 10 times, dc in next 20 dc; join – 80 sts.
Rnd 4: Ch 1, (sc, ch 4, sc) all in same ch as joining, skip next dc, * (sc, ch 4, sc) all in next dc, skip next dc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st to first sc.
Rnd 5: Slip st into space, ch 1, * (sc, ch 4, sc) all in space; repeat from * around; join.
Rnds 6 and 7: Repeat Rnd 5.
Rnd 8: Slip st into space, ch 1, 3 sc in space, * [ch 2, 3 sc in next space] 9 times, ch 2, [2 sc in next space] 10 times, ch 2 **, 3 sc in next space; repeat from * to **; join.
Rnd 9: Ch 3, skip first sc, dc in next 2 sc, * [3 dc in next space, dc in next 3 sc] 9 times, 3 dc in next space, dc in next 20 sc, 3 dc in next space **, dc in next 3 sc; repeat from * to **; join.
Rnds 10 and 11: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join.
Rnd 12: Ch 1, (sc, ch 4, sc) all in same ch, skip next dc, * (sc, ch 4, sc) all in next dc, skip next dc; repeat from * around; join to first sc.
Rnds 13-15: Repeat Rnd 5. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Scrubby Smoothie™: 2 balls each 9341 Grey A, 2138 Refreshing B, and 9287 Caribbean C
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
( ) = work directions in parenthesis the number of times specified.
measurements: Table Runner measures 12" [30 cm] x 58" [147 cm].
gauge: 5 blocks = 4" [10 cm]; 5 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pattern stitch.
instructions:
RUNNER
With A, ch 6.
Row 1: Dc in 4th ch from hook (skipped first 3 ch count as ch-3 space here and throughout), dc in next 2 ch – 1 block.
Row 2: Ch 6, turn, dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in next 2 ch, (slip st, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space – 2 blocks.
Row 3: Ch 6, turn, dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in next 2 ch, [(slip st, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space] to end of row – 3 blocks.
Rows 4-15: Following chart for color changes, repeat Row 3, adding one more block each row – 15 blocks on last row worked.
Row 16: Turn, slip st in first 3 sts, [(slip st, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space] to end of row – 15 blocks.
Row 17: Ch 6, turn, dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in next 2 ch, [(slip st, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space] to last block, slip st in ch-3 space of last block – 15 blocks.
Rows 18-71: Following chart for color changes, repeat Rows 16-17.
Row 72: Following chart for color changes, repeat Row 16.
Rows 73-86: Turn, slip st in first 3 sts, [(slip st, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space] to last block, slip st in ch-3 space of last block – 1 block decreased each row, 1 block remains on last row worked.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 2 balls 431 Pumpkin A, 1 ball 12 Black B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 1.6mm [US #6] steel crochet hook
abbreviations: A and B = Color A and Color B
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Table runner measures 40 x 13” (101.5 x 33 cm) not including fringe. Fringe adds about 10” (25.5 cm) to the length.
gauge: 14 mesh = 4” (10 cm); 16 rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
With A, ch 128.
Row 1 (right side): Dc in 8th ch from hook (first open-mesh made), [ch 2, skip next 2 ch, dc in next ch] 10 times (10 more open-mesh made), dc in next 21 ch (7 solid-mesh made), [ch 2, skip next 2 ch, dc in next ch] 4 times (4 open-mesh made), dc in next 27 ch (9 solid-mesh made), [ch 2, skip next 2 ch, dc in next ch] 10 times (10 open-mesh made), turn—41 mesh.

Row 2: Ch 5 (counts as dc, ch 2 here and throughout), skip first ch-2 space, dc in next dc (first open-mesh made), [ch 2, dc in next dc] 8 times (8 more open-mesh made), 2 dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next 7 dc (3 solid-mesh made), [ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc] 5 times (5 open-mesh made), dc in next 6 dc, [2 dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next dc] 4 times, dc in next 9 dc (9 solid-mesh made), [ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc] 4 times (4 open-mesh made), [2 dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next dc] twice (2 solid-mesh made), [ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next dc] 8 times (8 open-mesh made), ch 2, dc in 3rd ch of turning ch (last open-mesh made), turn.

Row 3: Ch 5, skip first ch-2 space, dc in next dc, [ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next dc] 7 times, 2 dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next 4 dc, ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc, [ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next dc] 4 times, [ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc] 9 times, [ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next dc] 5 times, ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc, dc in next 6 dc, 2 dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next dc, [ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next dc] 7 times, ch 2, dc in 3rd ch of turning ch, turn.

Rows 4–78: Continue to work pattern following chart.

Rows 79–155: Turn chart upside down and work rows again in opposite order, beginning with Row 77 and working down through Row 1.

Fasten off.

BORDER
Notes
1. First 2 rounds of border will look like a checkerboard of open- and solid-mesh.
2. Notice that there is a column of open-meshes across each long edge of the runner. You will work into the spaces and posts (at top of each row) between the spaces in the same way that you would work across the top of a row of open-meshes.
3. When working across the top edge, work into the stitches (each ch and each dc count as one st) of the last row. When working across the lower edge, work into the opposite side of the foundation chain (each ch counts as one st).

With right side facing, join B with slip st in a corner to work across a long edge of the runner.

Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), 2 dc in space at end of next row, ***dc at top of same row, *ch 2, skip space at end of next row, dc at top of row, 2 dc in space at end of next row, dc at top of row; repeat from * across long side edge to next corner space, (3 dc, ch 5, 3 dc) in corner space; working across short edge of runner, dc in next st, ch 2, skip next 2 sts (this may be 2 dc or a ch-2 space), dc in next st, **dc in next 3 sts (this may be 3 dc or a ch-2 space and a dc), ch 2, skip next 2 sts, dc in next st; repeat from ** across short edge to next corner space, (3 dc, ch 5, 3 dc) in corner space; repeat from *** to work border across 2nd long side and 2nd short side ending at last corner space, 3 dc in last corner space, ch 5; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3, do not turn.

Round 2: Ch 5, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc, *2 dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next dc, ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc; repeat from * to next corner space, (3 dc, ch 5, 3 dc) in corner space, [dc in next dc, **ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc, 2 dc in next ch-2 space, dc in next dc; repeat from ** to next corner space, (3 dc, ch 5, 3 dc) in corner space] 3 times; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-5.

Round 3: Ch 5, skip first ch-space, dc in next dc, **ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, dc in next dc, ch 2, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc; repeat from * to next corner space, ch 2, (dc, ch 5, dc) in 3rd ch of corner ch-5, ch 2, skip remainder of corner ch-5, dc in next dc; repeat from ** around, ch 2; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-5. 
Fasten off.

TRIPLE KNOT FRINGE
Attach Fringe: Cut 4 strands of B, each 12” (30.5 cm) long. Hold all 4 stands together and fold in half. Insert crochet hook from right side to wrong side through first space on one short edge of runner, place fold on hook and draw fold through to right side, thread ends of strands through loop formed by fold and pull on the ends to tighten (fringe knot made). Repeat this process to attach a fringe to every space across both short ends of runner.

First Row of Knots: Turn runner over so wrong side is facing you. Separate first 2 fringes into 2 groups of 4 strands each. Begin with the 2nd group of 4-strands from the first fringe and the first group of 4-strands from the 2nd fringe. Tie the two groups together with an overhand knot and pull tight about ¾” (19 mm) below the fringe knots. Repeat this process all the way across, leaving the last 4-strand group loose. Repeat across other short edge. Note: The first and last 4-strand groups of each short side should be loose.

Second Row of Knots: Beginning with the first (un-tied) 4-strand group from previous row, separate the next group of strands into 2 groups of 4-strands each and tie the first of these two 4-strand groups to the previous 4-strand group with an overhand knot about ¾” (19 mm) below the previous knots. Repeat this process all the way across both short edges. Trim ends as desired.

FINISHING: Weave in ends. Block and starch piece as desired.

materials: RED HEART “Eco-Cotton™ Blend”: 2 Ball each 1926 Currant A, 1105 Vanilla B, and 1870 Denim C. This will make 2 sets including placemat, coaster and napkin ring.
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions given in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Placemat measures 13½” high x 18” wide. Coaster measures 6” across.
gauge: 15 sts = 4”; 9 rows = 4” in dc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
PLACEMAT
With A, ch 58. 
Row 1 (Right Side): Dc in 4th ch from hook and in each ch across, changing to B in last st; turn – 56 sts. 
Row 2: With B, ch 3, skip first dc, dc in next dc and in each dc across, dc in top of ch-3; turn.
Repeat Row 2 and work stripe pat of 1 more row B, then [2 rows A, 2 rows B] 4 times, then 1 more row A, changing to C in last dc of last row. Cut A and B.
Border
Round 1: With C, ch 1, work sc evenly around all 4 sides, working 3 sc in each corner; join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 2: Ch 3, skip first sc, dc in each sc around, working 5 dc in center sc of each 3-sc corner group; join to top of ch-3.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in each dc around, working 3 sc in center dc of each 5-dc corner group; join. 
Rounds 4-7: Repeat Rounds 2 and 3 twice more, changing to A in last sc of Round 7. Work 1 round sc with A. Fasten off.
Star (Make 4)
With B, ch 2; sc in 2nd ch from hook, * ch 3, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch **, sc in same ch as first sc *; repeat from * to * 3 more times, then from * to ** once more; join – 5 points. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing. Sew 1 star in each corner. Weave in ends.
COASTER
Round 1: With B, ch 4; 14 dc in 4th ch from hook; join with a slip st to top of ch, changing to C – 15 sts.
Round 2: With C, ch 3, working over B, 4 dc in same st as joining, changing to B in last dc; * with B and working over C, [yo and draw up a loop in next dc, yo and draw through 2 loops] twice, with C, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook – cluster made **; with C and working over B, 5 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, end at **; join – 30 sts. 
Cut B.
Round 3: With C, ch 3, dc in same st as joining, [dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc] twice; yo, insert hook from front to back to front around the post of the next cluster and draw loop through, [yo and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice – front post dc (fpdc) made; * 2 dc in next dc, [dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc] twice, fpdc; repeat from * around; join – 45 sts.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in same st as joining, dc in next 2 sts, * 2 dc in next st, dc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join – 60 sts.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in same st as joining, dc in next 3 sts, * 2 dc in next st, dc in next 3 sts; rrepeat from * around, changing to A in last dc; join – 75 sts. Cut C.
Round 6: With A, ch 1, sc in each st around; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
NAPKIN RING
With C ch 18; join with a slip st to first ch, taking care not to twist ch.
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each ch around; join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 2: Ch 3, skip first sc, dc in next sc and in each sc around; join with a slip st to top of ch-3.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same ch as joining and in each dc around; join and change to A.
Round 4: With A , ch 1, sc in each sc around; join. Fasten off.
Attach A in remaining loops of beg ch and work 1 Round sc on opposite side; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends. With B, make 1 star same as for placemat and sew to ring.

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® “Fashion Crochet Thread” Size 3: 3 Balls 226 Natural.
gauge: Motif = 4¼” across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
FIRST MOTIF
Ch 10; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 3, 23 dc in ring; join with a slip st to top of ch-3—24 sts.
Rnd 2: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, * ch 5; holding back last loop on hook, dc in next 3 dc, yo and through all 4 loops on hook—3-dc-cluster (3-dc-cl) made; ch 5, ** dc in next 3 dc; repeat from * around, end at **; join with a slip st to top of ch-3.
Rnd 3: Ch 2, holding back last loop on hook, dc in next 2 dc, yo and through all 3 loops on hook—beginning cl made; * [ch 6, sc in next loop] twice **, ch 6, 3-dc-cl; repeat from * around, end at **; ch 3, tr in top of beginning cl to join and form last loop.
Rnd 4: Ch 5, sc in next loop, * ch 5, (3 tr, ch 7, 3 tr) all in next loop **, [ch 5, sc in next loop] twice; repeat from * around, end at **; ch 5; join with a slip st to tr. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

SECOND MOTIF
Rnds 1-3: Work same as First Motif.
To join on one side-Rnd 4: Ch 5, sc in next loop, ch 5, * 3 tr in next loop on current motif, ch 3, sc in ch-7 loop of completed motif, ch 3, 3 tr in same loop on current motif *, [ch 2, sc in next loop on completed motif, ch 2, sc in next loop on current motif] twice, ch 2, sc in next loop on completed motif, ch 2; repeat from * to * once more—one side joined; complete Rnd 4 as for first motif.
Join 3 x 7 motifs, joining on 2 sides as required. Where 4 corners meet, work corner joining sc into previous corner joining sc.
To join on 2 sides-Rnd 4: Ch 5, sc in next loop, ch 5, * 3 tr in next loop on current motif, ch 3, sc in ch-7 loop of completed motif (or in sc of previous joining), ch 3, 3 tr in same loop on current motif **, [ch 2, sc in next loop on completed motif, ch 2, sc in next loop on current motif] twice, ch 2, sc in next loop on completed motif, ch 2; repeat from * once more, then from * to ** once more—2 sides joined; complete Rnd 4 as for first motif.

EDGING-Rnd 1: With right side facing, attach thread in any corner ch-7 loop. Ch 1, ** [sc, ch 7] twice all in corner loop, * sc in next ch-space, ch 7; repeat from * to next corner loop; repeat from ** around; join with a slip st to first sc.

Rnd 2: Slip st in next 2 ch and into ch-7 loop, ch 4, (2 tr, ch 5, 3 tr) all in corner loop, ch 2, * 3 tr in next loop, ch 2 **; repeat from * to next corner; (3 tr, ch 5, 3 tr) all in corner loop, ch 2; repeat from * around, end at **; join with a slip st to top of ch-4. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball 275 Coral
abbreviations: () = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: small flower = about 1½” [4 cm] diameter; small leaf = about 1 x 1½” [2.5 x 4 cm]. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CENTER FLOWER
Ch 6; slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 6 (counts as dc, ch 3), dc in ring, [ch 3, dc in ring] 4 times, ch 3; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch—6 dc and 6 ch-3 spaces.
Round 2: (Sc, hdc, 3 dc, hdc, sc) in each ch-3 space around; do not join—6 petals.
Round 3: Working behind petals, slip st around post of first dc of Round 1, *ch 5, slip st around post of next dc in Round 1; repeat from * 4 more times, ch 5; join with slip st in first slip st—6 ch-5 spaces.
Round 4: (Sc, hdc, 4 dc, hdc, sc) in each ch-5 space around; do not join—6 petals.
Round 5: Working behind petals, slip st around first dc in Round 1, *ch 7, slip st around post of next dc in Round 1; repeat from * 4 more times, ch 7; join with slip st in first slip st—6 ch-7 spaces.
Round 6: (Sc, hdc, 7 dc, hdc, sc) in each ch-7 space around; join with slip st in first sc—6 petals.
Fasten off.

SMALL LEAF (make 6)
Make an adjustable ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2 (does not count as a st), 10 hdc in ring; join with slip st in first hdc to join—10 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 4 (counts as tr), (tr, dc) in same st as joining, 2 hdc in next st, 2 sc in next st, 2 hdc in next st, (2 dc, tr) in next st, picot, (tr, 2 dc) in next st, 2 hdc in next st, 2 sc in next st, 2 hdc in next st, (dc, 2 tr) in next st; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 sts and 1 picot.
Fasten off.

LACE LEAF I (make 6)
Ch 14; slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 23 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—23 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, [ch 3, skip next st, hdc in next st] 4 times, ch 3, skip next st, dc in next st, ch 3, skip next st, (tr, ch 6, tr) in next st, ch 3, skip next st, dc in next st, [ch 3, skip next st, hdc in next st] 4 times, ch 3; join with slip st in first sc—13 sts, 12 ch-3 spaces, and 1 ch-6 space. Do not fasten off.
Round 3: Ch 16 (for stem), sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 14 ch, 4 sc in each of first 6 ch-3 spaces, (4 sc, ch 2, 4 sc) in next ch-6 space, 4 sc in each of next 6 ch-3 spaces; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

SINGLE STEM (make 6)
Ch 28.
Row 1 (RS): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 9 ch, puff in next st, sc in next 16 ch – 26 sc and 3 puffs.

SHORT ROW LEAF (make 12)
Ch 9.
Round 1 (right side): Sc in 3rd ch from hook (2 skipped ch count as beginning ch-2 space) and in next 5 ch, (sc, 3 hdc, sc) in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next 6 ch, 3 sc in beginning ch-2 space; do not join—20 sts.
Row 2: Do not turn, sc in next 5 sc; leave remaining sts unworked.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, working in front loops only, sc in first 6 sts, 3 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts; leave remaining sts unworked.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in first 7 sts, 3 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts; leave remaining sts unworked.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, working in front loops only, sc in first 6 sts, 3 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts.
Fasten off.

LACE LEAF II (make 12)
Ch 14; slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as Rounds 1 and 2 of Lace Leaf I. Do not fasten off.
Round 3: Ch 7 (for stem), sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 5 ch, 4 sc in first 6 ch-3 spaces, (4 sc, ch 2, 4 sc) in next ch-6 space, 4 sc in each of next 6 ch-3 spaces; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

SMALL FLOWER (make 12)
Ch 6; slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Rounds 1–4: Work same as Rounds 1–4 of Center Flower; join end of Round 4 with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

ASSEMBLY
Arrange pieces following Assembly Diagram. Whipstitch pieces together. Sew just a few stitches where the pieces touch and carefully weave in ends.

BORDER
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, join thread with sc in center st of top petal of any Small Flower, ch 20, sc in st near middle of side edge of next Lace Leaf II, *ch 20, sc in center st of top petal of next Small Flower, ch 20, sc in st near middle of side edge of next Lace Leaf II; repeat from * around, ch 20; join with slip st in first sc—24 ch-20 spaces and 24 sc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 27 dc in first ch-20 space, *dc in next sc, 27 dc in next ch-20 space; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—672 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3 (counts as dc), (dc, picot, 2 dc) in same st as joining, *ch 1, skip next 6 sts, (2 dc, picot, 2 dc) in next st; repeat from * to last 6 sts, ch 1, skip next 6 sts; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—96 picot.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in any remaining ends. Block. Apply fabric stiffener following instructions on container. Pin out doily and allow to dry.

pattern_name: Bernat Handicrafter Cotton Dish Cloth and Pot Holder
materials: Bernat Handicrafter Cotton (Solids: 50 g/1.75 oz) or (Ombres: 42.5 g/1.5 oz)
Pot Holder: Size 4 mm (U.S. G/6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Dishcloth: Size 4.5 mm (U.S. 7) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Pot Holder Finished Size: Approx 8 x 8 ins [20.5 x 20.5 cm]. Dish Cloth Finished Size: Approx 11 x 11 ins [28 x 28 cm].
gauge: Pot Holder: 15 sts and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] in sc with 4 mm hook. Dish Cloth: 8 loops and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] in loop pat with 4.5 mm hook.
instructions:
POT HOLDER
BACK: With MC and 4 mm hook, ch 29. Foundation row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Ch 1. Turn. 28 sts.
1st row: 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Ch 1. Turn. This row forms pat. Cont in pat until work from beg measures approx 8 ins [20.5 cm] ending with RS facing for next row. Do not turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Work 22 sc along side edge, 3 sc in first st of lower edge, 1 sc in each of next 26 sts along lower edge, 3 sc in next st, 22 sts along side edge, 3 sc in first st of top edge, 1 sc in each of next 26 sts along top edge, 3 sc in next st. Ss to 1st ch 1. Fasten off.
FRONT: With A, work as given for Back.
Edging: With WS tog, proceed as follows: 1st rnd: Join MC to any st. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 round sc, inc at corners as before. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: Join A to any st, work 1 round sc, inc at corners as before. Fasten off.
3rd round: With MC work as given for 2nd round.
DISHCLOTH
With MC and 4.5 mm hook, ch 42.
Foundation row: (RS). 1 sc in 4th ch from hook. *Ch 2. Miss next ch. 1 sc in next ch. Rep from * to end of ch. Turn. 20 loops.
1st row: Ch 3. *1 sc in next ch 2 loop. Ch 2. Rep from * to last ch 2 loop. 1 sc in ch 3 loop. Turn. This row forms pat. Cont in pat until work from beg measures 8 ins [20.5 cm] ending with RS facing for next row. Fasten off.
Border: With RS facing, join A to ch 3 loop at end of last row.
1st round: Ch 1. * (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc) in corner loop - corner made. Ch 2. (1 sc in next loop. Ch 2) 19 times along side. Rep from * 3 times more. Ss to first sc.
2nd round: * Work corner loop. Ch 2. **1 sc in next loop. Ch 2. Rep from ** to next corner. Rep from * 3 times more. Fasten off.
