materials: Lily Sugar’n Cream 4-ply Worsted Weight, 2.5 oz/70.9 g
Size 4.50 mm (U.S. H or 7) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 13 sc and 15 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]
instructions:
Utensil Holder: 
Note: To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook. Draw loop in next color through 2 loops on hook to complete st and proceed in next color. 
With MC, ch 3. Join with sl st to form a ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join with sl st to first sc. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc. 3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc. 4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc. 5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc. 6th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 4 sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc. 7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to back loop of first sc. 8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in back loop of each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 9th rnd: Ch 1. Working through both loops, 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
Rep last rnd 6 times more. 
**Next rnd: With B, as 9th rnd. 
Next 3 rnds: With A, as 9th rnd.  
Next rnd: With B, as 9th rnd.  
Next 6 rnds: With MC, as 9th rnd.** 
Rep from ** to ** once. 
Next rnd: With MC, working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Join MC with sl st to any front loop of 8th rnd. Next rnd: Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 sc in each front loop around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Sew Daffodil (see below) to Utensil Holder as illustrated in photograph. 
Pot Holder: With MC, ch 24. 
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. 23 sc. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row twice more, ending last row with join B by drawing through last 2 loops of sc. Next row: With B, as 2nd row. Next row: With MC, as 2nd row. Next row: With B, as 2nd row. Next 17 rows: With MC, as 2nd row. Fasten off. 
With RS of work facing, join A with sl st to any corner. 1st rnd: With A, ch 1. 3 sc in same st as last sl st. 1 sc in each st around working 3 sc in corner sts. 2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Ch 10 (hanging loop). Join in rnd with sl st to first ch. Fasten off. 
Beg with 6th st from left edge, with B embroider 2 rows of chain st, 1 st apart as illustrated. Sew on Daffodil at top corner under hanging loop as illustrated. 
Daffodil: With A, ch 2. 
1st rnd: (RS). 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc. First Petal: 1st row: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sc as last sl st. Ch 1. Turn. 2nd row: 2 sc in each sc. 4 sc. Ch 1. Turn. 3rd row: 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. 6 sc. Ch 1. Turn. 4th row: 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Ch 1. Turn. 5th row: Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook - sc dec made. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc dec over next 2 sts. Ch 1. Turn. 6th row: (Sc dec over next 2 sts) twice. 2 sts. Ch 3. Turn. 7th row: Miss first sc. Sl st in next sc. Sl st in side of each of next 6 rows of petal. Sl st in last sc worked on 1st row and in next sc. Do not turn. 
Second to Sixth Petals: 1st row: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sc as last sl st. Ch 1. Turn. 2nd to 7th rows: Work as given for 2nd to 7th rows of First Petal. At end of Sixth Petal, fasten off. 
Trumpet: With A, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st in first sc. 2nd rnd: 2 sc in each sc. 10 sc. 3rd and 4th rnds: 1 sc in each sc. 5th rnd: Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook. (1 sc in next sc. Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook) 9 times.
Join with sl st in next sc. Fasten off.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream Stripes (56.7 g / 2 oz) 10 balls
Size 5 mm (U.S H / 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Ch 2.

Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row for 52 ins [132 cm], ending with a WS row.
Next row: (RS). Ch 1. Draw up a loop in first 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook - sc2tog made. 1 sc in every sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sts. Turn.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Sizes U.S. D/3 (3.25 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: Beg V-st (beginning V-stitch) = [Ch 3 (counts as hdc and ch 1). 1 hdc] in indicated space
Surface sl st (surface sl stitch) = With yarn on WS, insert hook in indicated stitch or space. Yoh and pull up a loop to RS and through loop on hook
V-st (V-stitch) = (1 hdc. Ch 1. 1 hdc) in indicated stitch
gauge: 16 sc and 17 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes 
• Spider web is worked in surface sl stitching in straight lines and concentric circles. 
• When instructed to work into a V-stitch, work into the ch-1 sp of the V-stitch. 
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
• Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as st. 
TABLE TOPPER 
With A, make an adjustable ring: 
Wrap yarn into ring, ensuring that tail falls behind working yarn. 
Grip ring and tail firmly between middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through center of ring, yo (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work sts of first rnd in ring, working over both strands (tail and ring). After first rnd of sts is worked, pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring. 
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 2. 12 hdc in ring. Join. 12 hdc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 24 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next 2 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 hdc.
4th rnd: Beg V-st in same sp as last sl st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. *V - st in next st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. Rep from * around. Join. 8 V-sts and 24 hdc.

abbreviations: A, B, C = color A, B, C
() = work directions in parentheses into same st
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Each Star = 12” in diameter. Runner = 12” (30.5 cm) wide x 60” (152.5 cm) long.
gauge: 12 sts and 14 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
STAR (make 3 with A and 2 with B)
Center
Ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 10 sc in 2nd ch from hook, do not join – 10 sc. Place marker in first st of round and move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around – 20 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 30 sc.
Round 4: * Sc in next two stitches, two sc in the next; repeat from* 10 times – 40 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: *Sc in each of next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 50 sc.
Round 7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: *Sc in each of next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 60 sc.
Round 9: Sc in each each sc around.
Round 10: *Sc in each of next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st; repeat from * around – 70 sc.
Round 11: Sc in each sc around.
Work now progresses in rows.
Point #1
Row 1: Sc in each of next 12 sts, turn, leaving remaining sts unworked – 12 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc2tog over first 2 sts, sc in each st across to last 2 sts, sc2tog over last 2 sts, turn – 10 sts.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 4–9: Repeat Rows 2-3 (3 times) – 4 sc at end of last row.
Row 10: Ch 1, [sc2tog over next 2 sts] twice, turn – 2 sts.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc2tog over next 2 sts – 1 st. Fasten off.
Points #2-5
Row 1: With right side facing, skip next 2 sts after last point, join same color with standing sc in next sc, sc in each of next 11 sc, turn, leaving remaining sts unworked – 12 sc.
Row 2-11: Work same as Rows 2-11 of Point #1.
Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join C with standing sc at side of any point, *sc evenly across to top of point, 3 sc in point, sc evenly across other side of point, sc in next 2 sc in Round 11 of Center; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off C.
Finishing
Weave in ends. Using photograph as a guide, sew stars together at the points with C.

16th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * around. 112 sc.
17th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Rep from * around. 119 sc.
18th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Rep from * around. 126 sc.
19th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 17 sc. Rep from * around. 133 sc.
20th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Rep from * around. 140 sc.
21st rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 19 sc. Rep from * around. 147 sc.
22nd rnd: *1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * around. 154 sc.
23rd rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 21 sc. Rep from * around. 161 sc.
24th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. Rep from * around. 168 sc.
25th rnd: *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 23 sc. Rep from * around. 175 sc.
26th rnd: *1 sc in each of next 11 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc.* Rep from * to * 6 times, then from * to ** once. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Sl st in each of next 2 sc. Sl st to first sc to join. 182 sts.
Fringe: Cut strands of yarn 6" [15 cm] long. Taking 5 strands tog, fold in half and knot into fringe in every other st around Placemat. Trim fringe evenly so length from base of knot and end of fringe is 2" [5 cm] long.

materials: Bernat® Handicrafter® Cotton (1.75 oz/50 g; 80 yds/73 m)
Size U.S. 7 (4.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Utensil Holder: Approx 9" [23 cm] high. Pot Holder: Approx 8" [20.5 cm] square.
gauge: 13 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
UTENSIL HOLDER
Note: To change color, work to last  
2 loops on hook. Draw loop in next color 
through 2 loops on hook to complete st 
and proceed in next color.
With MC, ch 3. Join with sl st to first ch to 
form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 8 sc in ring. Join with sl st 
to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 
2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 16 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 
*1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from 
* to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st to 
first sc. 24 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 
*1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 
Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 
2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 
*1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 
Rep from * to last 3 sc. 1 sc in each of last 
3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 
*1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 
Rep from * to last 4 sc. 1 sc in each of last  
4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 48 sc. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 
1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to 
back loop of first sc.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 
Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc 
around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
9th rnd: Ch 1. Working through both 
loops, 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in 
each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
Rep last rnd 6 times more.
**Next rnd: With B, as 9th rnd.
Next 3 rnds: With A, as 9th rnd.
Next rnd: With B, as 9th rnd.
Next 6 rnds: With MC, as 9th rnd.**
Rep from ** to ** once.
Next rnd: With MC, working from left to 
right, instead of from right to left as usual, 
work 1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join 
with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Join MC with sl st to any front loop of 8th 
rnd. 
Next rnd: Working from left to right, instead 
of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse 
sc in each front loop around. Join with  
sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Make Daffodil (see page 2) and sew to 
Utensil Holder as illustrated in photograph.
 
POT HOLDER
With MC, ch 24.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook.  
1 sc in each sc to end of row. 23 sc. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each 
sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row twice 
more, ending last row with join B by 
drawing through last 2 loops of sc. 
Next row: With B, as 2nd row. 
Next row: With MC, as 2nd row. 
Next row: With B, as 2nd row. 
Next 17 rows: With MC, as 2nd row. 
Fasten off.
With RS of work facing, join A with sl st to 
any corner. 
1st rnd: With A, ch 1. 3 sc in same st as 
last sl st. 1 sc in each st around working 3 
sc in corner sts. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right, 
instead of from right to left as usual, work  
1 reverse sc in each sc around. Join with  
sl st to first sc. Ch 10 (hanging loop). Join 
in rnd with sl st to first ch. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Beg with 6th st from left edge, with B 
embroider 2 rows of chain st, 1 st apart as 
illustrated. Sew on Daffodil at top corner 
under hanging loop as illustrated.
Daffodil
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: (RS). 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
Join with sl st in first sc. 
First Petal: 1st row: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sc 
as last sl st. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc. 4 sc. Turn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each 
of next 2 sc. 2 sc in last sc. 6 sc. Turn. 
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row.  
Turn. 
5th row: Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of 
next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on 
hook - Sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next  
2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 
6th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. 2 sts. Turn. 
7th row: Ch 3. Skip first sc. Sl st in next sc. 
Sl st in side of each of next 6 rows of Petal. 
Sl st in last sc worked on 1st row and in 
next sc. Do not turn.
Second to Sixth Petals: 1st row: Ch 1.  
2 sc in same sc as last sl st. Ch 1. Turn. 
2nd to 7th rows: Work as given for 2nd 
to 7th rows of First Petal. At end of Sixth 
Petal, fasten off.
Trumpet: With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join 
with sl st in first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join 
with sl st to first sc. 10 sc. 
3rd and 4th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc 
around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from hook.  
(1 sc in next sc. Ch 3. Sl st in 3rd ch from 
hook) 9 times. Join with sl st in next sc. 
Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 313 Aran A, 334 Buff B, and 320 Cornmeal C.
abbreviations: Ldc = Work dc over ch-1 space into st two rows below.
gauge: 12 sc = 4”; rows 1-3 in pattern = 1¼” CHECK YOUR GAUGE: Use any size hook to obtain gauge.
instructions:
With A, ch 34.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 33 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, * ch 1, skip 1 sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * across; change to C.
Row 3: With C, ch 1, sc in first sc, * Ldc over next ch-1 space into sc 2 rows below, sc in next sc; repeat from * across; turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, * ch 1, skip next Ldc, sc in next sc; repeat from * across; turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn – 33 sc.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2, changing to B in last st.
Row 7: With B, repeat Row 3.
Row 8: Repeat Row 4.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc in first sc, skip next space, * shell in next sc, skip next space, sc in next sc, skip next space; repeat from * across; turn.
Row 10: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), dc in 1st sc, * sc in center dc of next shell, ch 1, dc in next sc, ch 1; repeat from * across to last shell; sc in center dc of last shell, 2 dc in last sc; turn.
Row 11: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn – 33 sc.
Row 12: Repeat Row 2, changing to A in last st.
Rows 13-16: With A, repeat Rows 3-6; change to C in last st of Row 16.
Rows 17-20: With C, repeat Rows 3-6; change to B in last st of Row 20.
Rows 21-26: With B, repeat Rows 7-12; DO NOT change color at end; fasten off.
With Right Side facing, attach A in unused loop of beginning ch; ch 1, sc in same ch and in each ch across; turn.
Repeat Rows 2-26.
BORDER: With Right Side facing, attach A in beginning ch on long side edge; ch 1.
Rnd 1: Sc in same ch and in end of each row to corner; (sc, ch 2,sc) in end sc – corner made, * Ldc over next ch-1 space into sc 2 rows below, sc in next sc; repeat from * across short side; corner in end sc, sc in end of each row down long side; corner in end sc; repeat from * across 2nd short side; corner, sc in end of remaining rows of 2nd long side. Join with a slip st to beginning sc; turn – 53 sc on each long side.
Rnd 2: Ch 1, sc in next sc, ch 1, * skip next st, sc in next st, ch 1; repeat from * to ch-2 space, corner in ch-2 space **; repeat from * to ** around placemat; join; turn.
Rnd 3: Slip st in next ch-1 space, ch 3 (counts as 1st dc of shell), 2 dc in same space, sc in next ch-1 space, * shell in next ch-1 space, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to corner, 5 dc in corner ch-2 space, sc in next ch-1 space **; repeat from * to ** around mat; join to top of beginning ch-3; fasten off.
Rnd 4: With Right Side facing, attach C in any sc near center of any side, ch 1, sc in same st, * ch 1, (sc, ch 2,sc) in center dc of shell, ch 1, sc in next sc; repeat from * to corner; ch 1, skip 1 dc, corner in next dc, ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next sc **; repeat from * to ** around placemat; join to last ch-1 to beginning sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING: Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Handicrafter Stripes (42.5 g / 1.5 oz) (21317 Violet Stripes) 2 balls
Size 5 mm (U.S. H / 8) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 12 sc and 13 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
Ch 34.
1st row:(RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of ch.
Turn. 33 sc. Work in sc for 17 ins [43 cm]. Fasten off.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Fine Crochet Thread, Size 20: 1 ball 226 Natural A and 1 ball 201 White B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: Motif measures 3¼” (8 cm) by 33⁄8” (8.5 cm) after blocking. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
First Medallion
Ch 10, slip st in 10th ch from hook to form a ring, ch 1; working into ring just made, (sc, hdc, [3 dc, ch-3 picot] 5 times, 2 dc, hdc, sc) all in ring; sc in same sc of Round 1 ring, sc in next 4 sc of Round 1.
Second and Third Medallions
Ch 10, slip st in 10th ch from hook to form a ring, ch 1; working into ring just made, (sc, hdc, 3 dc, ch 1, sc into last picot on previous Medallion to join, ch 1, slip st in top of last dc made, [3 dc, ch-3 picot] 4 times, 2 dc, hdc, sc) all in ring; sc in same sc of Round 1, sc in next 4 sc of Round 1.
Fourth Medallion
Ch 10, slip st in 10th ch from hook to form a ring, ch 1; working into ring just made, (sc, hdc, 3 dc, ch 1, sc into last picot on previous Medallion to join, ch 1, slip st in top of last dc made, [3 dc, ch-3 picot] 3 times, 3 dc, ch 1, sc in first picot on first Medallion to join, ch 1, slip st in top of last dc made, 2 dc, hdc, sc) all in ring; sc in same sc of Round 1, sc in next sc of Round 1; join with slip st in first sc of Round 2. Fasten off. Weave ends in.
Round 3: With right side facing, attach A in the center picot of any Medallion; ch 1, sc in same picot, *ch 6, skip next picot, (2 tr tr, ch 7, 2 tr tr) over picot joining between Medallions, ch 6, skip next picot**, sc in next picot; repeat from * twice, then from * to ** once; join with slip st in first sc.

Round 4: Ch 1, * sc over sc and into the center picot on Round 3, ch-3 picot, (4 sc, hdc, dc, edc) all in next ch-6 space, tr in next tr tr, ch-3 picot, tr in next tr tr, (3 tr, ch-3 picot, 4 tr, ch-5 picot, 4 tr, ch-3 picot, 2 tr) all in next ch-7 space, tr in next 2 tr tr, ch-3 picot, (edc, dc, hdc, 4 sc) all in next ch-6 sp**; repeat from * 3 times; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Weave ends in.
MOTIF #1 (Basic Motif) Make 1
With A, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, 16 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

Note: Round 2 consists of four Medallions that are joined as they are worked.

Round 2: With right side facing, attach B in front loop of first sc of Round 1; working in front loops only, ch 1, sc in same sc; sc in next 2 sc.

Round 4: Ch 1, * sc over sc and into the center picot on Round 3, ch-3 picot, (4 sc, hdc, dc, edc) all in next ch-6 space, tr in next tr tr, ch-3 picot, tr in next tr tr, (3 tr, ch-3 picot, 4 tr, ch 5, sc in ch-5 picot on adjoining motif, ch 5, slip st in top of last tr made, 4 tr, ch 1, sc in next picot on adjoining motif, ch 1, slip st in top of last tr made, 2 tr) all in next ch-7 space, tr in next 2 tr tr, ch 1, sc in next picot on adjoining motif, ch 1, slip st in top of last tr made, (edc, dc, hdc, 4 sc) all in next ch-6 sp; join with slip st in first sc of Round 4. Fasten off. Weave ends in.

MOTIF #2 (One-Sided Joining Motif) Make 7
Rounds 1-3: Same as for Motif #1.

Round 4: Ch 1. First and Second Corners
Same as for Round 4 of Motif #1 from * to ** (worked twice, once for each of the first 2 corners).

Third Corner
Sc over sc and into the center picot on Round 3, ch-3 picot, (4 sc, hdc, dc, edc) all in next ch-6 space, tr in next tr tr, ch-3 picot, tr in next tr tr, (3 tr, ch-3 picot, 4 tr, ch 2, sc in ch-5 picot on adjoining motif, ch 2, slip st in top of last tr made, 4 tr, ch 1, sc in next picot on adjoining motif, ch 1, slip st in top of last tr made, 2 tr) all in next ch-7 space, tr in next 2 tr tr, ch 1, sc in next picot on adjoining motif, ch 1, slip st in top of last tr made, (edc, dc, hdc, 4 sc) all in next ch-6 sp.

Fourth Corner
Sc over sc and into the center picot on Round 3, ch-3 picot, (4 sc, hdc, dc, edc) all in next ch-6 space, tr in next tr tr, ch 1, skip next picot on adjoining motif, sc in next picot on adjoining motif, ch 1, slip st in top of last tr made, tr in next tr tr, (3 tr, ch 1, sc in next picot on adjoining motif, ch 1, slip st in top of last tr made, 4 tr, ch 2, sc in next ch-5 picot on adjoining motif, ch 2, slip st in top of last tr made, 4 tr, ch-3 picot, 2 tr) all in next ch-7 sp, tr in next 2 tr tr, ch-3 picot, (edc, dc, hdc, 4 sc) all in next ch-6 sp; join with slip st in first sc of Round 4. Fasten off. Weave ends in.

MOTIF #3 (Two-Sided Joining Motif) Make 12
Rounds 1-3: Same as for Motif #1.

Round 4: Ch 1. First Corner
Same as for Round 4 of Motif #1 from * to **.

Second Corner
Same as for Third Corner of Motif #2.

Third Corner
Sc over sc and into the center picot on Round 3, ch-3 picot, (4 sc, hdc, dc, edc) all in next ch-6 space, tr in next tr tr, ch 1, skip next picot on first adjoining motif, sc in next picot on first adjoining motif, ch 1, slip st in top of last tr made, tr in next tr tr, (3 tr, ch 1, sc in next picot on first adjoining motif, ch 1, slip st in top of last tr made, 4 tr, ch 2, sc in next ch-5 picot where the 3 motifs are joined, ch 2, slip st in top of last tr made, 4 tr, ch 1, sc in next picot on second adjoining motif, ch 1, slip st in top of last tr made, 2 tr) all in next ch 7 space, tr in next 2 tr tr, ch 1, sc in next picot on second adjoining motif, ch 1, slip st in top of last tr made, (edc, dc, hdc, 4 sc) all in next ch-6 sp.

Fourth Corner
Same as for Fourth Corner of Motif #2.

EDGING
Round 1: Starting on a short side of the doily with right side facing, attach B in the ch-5 picot at the top right corner; ch 10, tr in same picot. Side 1 (Worked across four motifs)
* [Ch 4, sc in next picot] twice, ch 4, (tr, ch 4, tr) in next picot, [ch 4, sc in next picot] twice, ch 4**, (tr, ch 4, tr) over next ch-5 picot motif joining; repeat from * twice, then from * to ** once; (tr, ch 7, tr) in next ch-5 picot on corner.

Side 2 (Worked across five motifs)
* [Ch 4, sc in next picot] twice, ch 4, (tr, ch 4, tr) in next picot, [ch 4, sc in next picot] twice, ch 4**, (tr, ch 4, tr) over next ch-5 picot motif joining; repeat from * 3 times, then from * to ** once; (tr, ch 7, tr) in next ch-5 picot on corner.

Side 3
Same as for Side 1.

Side 4
* [Ch 4, sc in next picot] twice, ch 4, (tr, ch 4, tr) in next picot, [ch 4, sc in next picot] twice, ch 4**, (tr, ch 4, tr) over next ch-5 picot motif joining; repeat from * 3 times, then from * to ** once; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-10.

Round 2: Slip st in corner ch-7 space, ch 3, 12 tr in same space, 3 sc in next ch-4 space,
* [7 tr in next ch-4 space, 3 sc in next ch-4 space] around to next ch-7 space**, 13 tr in ch-7 space, 3 sc in next ch-4 space; repeat from * twice, then from * to ** once; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.

Round 3: With right side facing, attach A in back loop of 3rd ch of beginning ch-3 of Round 2; working in back loops only, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 3 tr, * ch-3 picot, [sc in next 3 tr, ch-3 picot] twice, sc in next 3 tr, skip next sc, sc in next sc, [skip next sc, sc in next 4 tr, ch-3 picot, sc in next 3 tr, skip next sc, sc in next sc, skip next sc] around to next corner**, sc in next 4 tr; repeat from * twice, then from * to ** once; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends. Block doily to size.

materials: AUNT LYDIA’S® Fashion Crochet Thread Size 3: 2 balls 65 Warm Teal.
Straight pins and foam surface for blocking (optional).
gauge: Rounds 1-4 = 5½ from point to point. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the specified gauge.
instructions:
Ch 8; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 23 dc in ring; join with a slip st in third ch of beginning ch-3 – 24 dc.
Round 2: Ch 4, * dc in next dc, ch 1, repeat from * around; join with a slip st in third ch of beginning ch-4 – 24 dc and ch-1 space.
Round 3: Ch 3, * 2 dc in next ch-1 space, dc in next dc, repeat from * around, ending last repeat with 2 dc in last space; join with a slip st in third ch of beginning ch-3 – 72 dc.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, * skip 2 dc, (dc, ch-1, [tr, ch 1] 3 times, dc – shell made) in next dc; skip 2 dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc – 12 shells.
Round 5: Slip st to center ch-1 space of first shell, ch 1, sc in same space, * ch 7, sc in center ch-1 space of next shell, repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc – 12 ch-7 loops.
Round 6: Ch 3, [9 dc in next loop, dc in next sc] 12 times; join with slip st in third ch of beginning ch-3 – 120 dc.
Round 7: Ch 4, * skip next dc, dc in next dc, ch 1, repeat from * around; join with slip st in third ch of beginning ch-4 – 60 ch-1 space.
Round 8: Repeat Round 3 – 180 dc.
Round 9: Ch 8, yo, pull up a loop in sixth ch from hook, yo, skip 2 dc, pull up a loop in next dc, [yo and pull through 2 loops] 4 times (begin cross st made), [Cross St] around; join with a slip st in sixth ch of beginning ch-8 – 60 Cross Sts.
Round 10: Ch 3, * 2 dc in next ch-2 space, dc in first leg of next Cross St, repeat from * around; join with a slip st in third ch of beginning ch-3 – 180 dc.
Round 11: Repeat Round 4 – 30 shells.
Round 12: Repeat Round 5 – 30 ch-7 loops.
Round 13: Ch 3, * 7 dc in next loop, dc in next sc, repeat from * around; join with a slip st in third ch of beginning ch-3 – 240 dc.
Round 14: Repeat Round 7 – 120 ch-1 space.
Round 15: Repeat Round 3 – 360 dc.
Round 16: Repeat Round 4 – 60 shells; fasten off.
FINISHING
To block (optional), stretch and pin doily into circle. Spray with water until damp; let dry thoroughly. If not blocking, press gently on WS using cotton setting with steam.

materials: Aunt Lydia’s® Classic Crochet size 10: 2 Balls 001 White or 805 Blue Hawaii.
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: Motif = 3” x 3” square. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
FIRST MOTIF: Ch 20.
Row 1: Dc in 8th ch from hook, [ch 2, skip next 2 ch, dc in next ch] 4 times; turn – 5 spaces.
Rows 2-4: Ch 5, skip first dc, [dc in next dc, ch 2, skip 2 ch] 4 times, dc in 3rd ch of ch-5; turn.
Row 5: Ch 5, skip first dc, [dc in next dc, ch 2, skip 2 ch] 3 times, dc in next dc, ch 1, skip next 2 ch, tr in 3rd ch of ch-5 to form last space. 
Now work in rounds as follows: 
Round 1: Ch 1, 6 sc over tr, * sc in next st, 2 sc in next space, sc in next st, sc in next space; [ch 5, sc in 5th ch from hook – picot made] 5 times; sc in sc made in space, sc in same space, sc in next st, 2 sc in next space, sc in next st **, 7 sc in next corner space; repeat from * around, end at **; sc in next space; join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 2: Slip st in next 4 sc, * ch 7, skip next picot, sc in next picot, ch 11 for corner, skip next picot, sc in next picot, ch 7, skip next picot, skip next 6 sc **, slip st in next 5 sc; repeat from * around, end at **; join with a slip st to first slip st. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
SECOND MOTIF: Work same as for First Motif until Round 1 has been completed. When working the joining, insert the hook from the wrong side into the appropriate loop on finished motif. Motifs are joined with slip sts in 4 corresponding loops along each side. Where corners meet, join corner loops by working the slip st into the slip st of a previous joining.
Round 2-Joining Round: Slip st in next 4 sc, ch 7, skip next picot, sc in next picot, ch 5, slip st in any ch-11 loop on First Motif, ch 5, skip next picot on 2nd Motif, sc in next picot, ch 3, slip st in next ch-7 loop on First Motif, ch 3, skip next picot and next 6 sc on 2nd Motif, slip st in next 5 sc, ch 3, slip st in next ch-7 loop on First Motif, ch 3, skip next picot on 2nd Motif, sc in next picot, ch 5, slip st in next ch-11 loop on First Motif, ch 5, skip next picot on 2nd Motif, sc in next picot, ch 7, skip next picot and next 6 sc on 2nd Motif, slip st in next 5 sc; complete same as for First Motif begin at *.
Join 4 strips of 10 squares, joining on 2 sides where required after the first strip.
EDGING-Round 1: With right side facing, join thread in corner loop; ch 1, sc in corner loop, * ch 5, sc in next loop, ch 5, skip next 2 slip sts, dc in next slip st, [ch 5, sc in next loop] twice **, ch 2, dc in joining, ch 2, sc in next loop; repeat from * to next corner loop, end at **; work 4 more sc in corner loop; repeat from * around; join with a slip st to first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, * [5 sc in next ch-5 loop, sc in next st] 4 times **, 2 sc in next ch-2 loop, sc in next dc, 2 sc in next ch-2 loop, sc in next sc; repeat from * to corner, end at **; sc in next sc, 3 sc in next sc ***, sc in next 2 sc; repeat from * around, end at ***; sc in last sc; join to first sc.
Round 3: Slip st in next 2 sc, ch 3, dc in next 2 sc, * ch 5, skip next 3 sc **, dc in next 3 sc; repeat from * to corner, end at **; dc in next sc, 3 dc in next sc, dc in next sc; repeat from * around; ch 2, tr in top of ch-3 to join and form last loop.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc over tr, * skip next dc, 3 tr in next dc, skip next dc, sc in next ch-5 loop; repeat from * to corner; skip next dc, [3 tr in next dc] 3 times, skip next dc **, sc in next ch-5 loop; repeat from * around, end at **; join to first sc.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, * ch 1, skip next tr; (2 dc, ch 3, slip st in top of last dc, dc) all in next tr – group made; ch 1, skip next tr, sc in next sc; repeat from * to corner; ch 1, skip next tr, [group in next tr, skip next tr] 4 times, ch 1 **, sc in next sc; repeat from * around, end at **; join to first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: AUNT LYDIA'S® Classic Crochet Thread, Size 10: 1 ball 401 Orchid Pink
abbreviations: ( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
gauge: Rounds 1-5 measure 4" (10 cm) across. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
DOILY
Ch 10; slip st in 1st ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as 1st dc here and throughout), 25 dc in ring, join with slip st to 1st dc – 26 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, *(dc, ch 3, dc) in next dc, skip next dc; repeat from * around to last dc, (dc, ch 3) in last dc, join with slip st to 1st dc – 13 (dc, ch 3, dc) groups.
Round 3: Ch 3, 3 dc in next ch-3 space, *ch 2, 4 dc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ch 2, join with slip st to 1st dc – 13 4-dc groups, 13 ch-2 spaces.
Round 4: Ch 3, dc in same st as join, dc in each of next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *ch 2, 2 dc in next dc, dc in each of next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 2, join with slip st to 1st dc – 13 6-dc groups, 13 ch-2 spaces.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in each of next 5 dc, *ch 2, dc in each of next 6 dc; repeat from * around, ch 2, join with slip st to 1st dc.
Round 6: Ch 3, dc in same st as join, dc in each of next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc, *ch 2, 2 dc in next dc, dc in each of next 4 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, ch 2, join with slip st to 1st dc – 13 8-dc groups, 13 ch-2 spaces.
Rounds 7-8: Ch 3, dc in each of next 3 dc, *ch 2, dc in each of next 4 dc; repeat from * around, ch 2, join with slip st to 1st dc – 26 4-dc groups, 26 ch-2 spaces.
Round 9: Repeat Round 4 – 26 6-dc groups, 26 ch-2 spaces.
Rounds 10-11: Repeat Round 5.
Round 12: Repeat Round 6 – 26 8-dc groups, 26 ch-2 spaces.
Rounds 13-14: Ch 3, dc in each of next 7 dc, *ch 2, dc in each of next 8 dc; repeat from * around, ch 2, join with slip st to 1st dc.
Rounds 15-18: Repeat Round 7 – 52 4-dc groups, 52 ch-2 spaces.
Round 19: Ch 3, dc in next dc, *ch 5, dc in each of next 2 dc, ch 2, dc in each of next 2 dc; repeat from * around, ch 2, join with slip st to 1st dc – 104 2-dc groups, 52 ch-5 spaces, 52 ch-2 spaces.
Round 20: Ch 1, *10 dc in next ch-5 space, ch 1, sc in next ch-2 space, ch 1; repeat from * around, join with slip st to beginning ch 1 – 52 10-dc groups, 52 sc, 104 ch-1 spaces.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in all ends. Wash and lay flat to block.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® Super Size (4 oz/113 g; 190 yds/174 m) Main Color (MC) Rainforest (18812) 3 balls or 480 yds/437 m

Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) Susan Bates® flexible Afghan crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
measurements: Approx 12" [30.5 cm] wide x 52" [132 cm] long, excluding fringe.
gauge: 13 sts and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Tunisian Top Stitch Pat. Note: 1 row of Tunisian Top Stitch Pat = Forward and Return Pass.
instructions:
Note: Table Runner is worked lengthwise.
With Tunisian hook and A, ch 174 loosely.
1st row: Forward pass: (Right to left). Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each rem ch to end of chain, leaving all loops on hook. 173 sts on hook. Do not turn.
Return pass: (Left to right after working Forward pass of each row). Yoh and draw through last loop only (for edge st). *Yoh and draw through 2 loops. Rep from * until 1 loop rem on hook. Do not turn.

2nd row: Forward pass: (Right to left). Draw up a loop in horizontal strand between 2nd and 3rd sts (see photos below). *Draw up a loop in horizontal strand between next 2 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Draw up a loop in horizontal strand between last 2 sts. Draw up a loop in edge st. Return pass.

Rep 2nd row for Tunisian Top Stitch pat 10 times more – 12 rows total have been worked.
Tip: Count sts on hook after Return pass to make sure st count remains 173 sts throughout.

12th row: Forward pass: (Right to left). With MC, work as before. Join A. Return pass with A.
13th row: Forward pass: (Right to left). With A, work Forward Pass as before. Join MC. Return pass with MC.
14th to 17th rows: Rep 12th and 13th rows twice more. Break A.
With MC only work a further 12 rows in Top Stitch pat. Fasten off.
Block Runner with T-pins on a flat surface and steam press on WS of work. Allow Runner to dry and remove pins.
Fringe: Cut 24 lengths of A and 112 lengths of MC 15" [38 cm] long. Taking 4 strands tog, knot 3 fringes with A evenly spaced across center of each end to correspond with A stripes. Taking 4 strands tog, knot 7 fringes with MC evenly spaced across either side of A section on each end as shown. Trim fringe evenly.

Turn. Rep last row until Coaster from beg measures 4 ins [10 cm], ending with RS facing for next row. Fasten off. materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 5 (6, 7, 8) skeins 1944 Fruit Punch A; 1 skein each 1252 Mango B, 1502 Iced Aqua C, 1909 Holly Berry D
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 6 mm [US J-10]
Extra hooks in neighboring sizes (see notes)
abbreviations: A, B, C, D = Color A, Color B, etc
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: 15 sts (including ch sts) = 4" (10 cm); 15 rows = 4" (10 cm) in Moss Stitch.
instructions:
NOTES
1. It is highly recommended that you watch Marly Bird’s tutorial videos on planned color pooling before beginning this project.
2. You may have to tighten or loosen some stitches as you go in order to keep the color pooling intact. Keep a variety of hook sizes on hand to help resize your stitches.
3. Different dye lots of the same colorway may change the number of stitches obtained in any given color. Count the number of stitches YOU get to work through one full sequence, as well as in each color section, and maintain that throughout the pattern.
4. The width of your table runner should be approximately one-third the width of your table and allow for 6" (15 cm) to hang over each end. It shouldn't hang lower than your tablecloth if you're layering linens.

SPECIAL STITCH
Standing sc = with new yarn, place slip knot on hook and sc in indicated st, as opposed to the traditional joining of new yarn using a slip st.

MOSS STITCH
Ch an even number of sts.
Row 1: Skip 3 ch, sc in next ch, * ch 1, skip 1 foundation ch, sc in next ch; repeat from * to end, turn.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as a stitch now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2 (counts as a stitch now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Repeat Row 3 only for Moss st.

TABLE RUNNER
With A, ch through 2 full color sequences, with the last loop on hook being the first loop of a new color just after a color change in the yarn.
Row 1 (right side): Skip 3 ch (counts as a st), sc in the 4th ch from hook, * ch 1, sc around the foundation ch (instead of going into a ch st); repeat from * until 1 full color sequence has been completed on this row. Count the number of sc made in each individual color in the colorway and note it down. Work 1 more full color sequence, maintaining the same number of sc made in each individual color. Leave remaining ch sts unworked. Undo one st repeat (sc, ch 1), turn.
Row 2 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Note: As you work this row and all remaining rows, you MUST get the correct number of sc in each color in order to maintain the planned color pooling. Change hook sizes, or actual st used, to get the correct color in place. If you use the same number of sts per color that you counted on Row 1, it will work out.
Row 3 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in the next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Note: The color of the sts on this row will shift to the left or right by 1 st from the previous right side row depending on the colorway and if you are right or left handed. It doesn’t matter which direction the stitch shifts as long as it is off-set by 1.
Row 4 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in the next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Note: The color of the sts on this row will shift to the left or right by 1 st from the previous wrong side row depending on the colorway and if you are right or left handed. It doesn’t matter which direction the stitch shifts as long as it is off-set by 1.
Repeat Rows 3 and 4 until Table Runner measures 2" (5 cm) shorter than desired length, ending on a Row 4 (wrong side row).

FINISHING
Squish or stretch the sts on foundation chain of Trim to match the width of the rest of the piece. You can slide the sts around along the foundation chain, as with an adjustable ring. Unravel unused foundation ch sts and weave in yarn tail to secure foundation.

Edging
With right side facing and working across foundation edge, join B with slip st in foundation ch st under last sc of Row 1.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc once more in same ch, * ch 1, sc in next space between sc of Row 1; repeat from * to ch-3 corner space, (ch 1, sc) 3 times in corner space, rotate Table Runner to work along long side edge, (ch 1, sc) in each ch space at edge of every other row to corner sc, (ch 1, sc) twice around corner sc, rotate Table Runner to work along top edge, (ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space to corner ch-2 space, (ch 1, sc) 3 times in corner space, rotate Table Runner to work along long side edge, (ch 1, sc) in each ch space at edge of every other row to corner sc, (ch 1, sc) twice around corner sc, ch 1, join with sl st in beginning ch 2.
Fasten off.

Twisted Chain Border
With right side facing, join C with a standing sc in any ch-1 space, ch 6, elongate loop on hook and remove hook, join D with a standing sc in next ch-1 space, ch 6, elongate loop on hook and remove hook, * place C loop back on hook, sc in next ch-1 space, ch 6, elongate loop on hook and remove hook, place D loop back on hook, sc in next ch-1 space, ch 6, elongate loop on hook and remove hook; repeat from * around, join with slip st in the first sc of each color.
Fasten off.
Weave in all loose ends.

Stripe Pattern
Work 3 rows with MC.
Work 2 rows with A.
Work 2 rows with MC.
Work 2 rows with B.
Work 2 rows with MC.
Work 2 rows with A.
Work 3 rows with MC.
These 16 rows form Stripe Pat.
With MC, ch 29.
1st row: (WS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch and each ch to end of ch. Turn. 27 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in 1st hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc through back loop only. *1 hdc in next hdc through front loop only. 1 hdc in next hdc through back loop only. Rep from * to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
2nd row of Stripe Pat is now complete. Rep last row until 16 rows of Stripe Pat are complete. Fasten off.
Edging: With RS of work facing, join B with sl st to any corner of Pot Holder. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Ch 12. Join with sl st to first ch- loop made. *Work 23 sc along side of Pot Holder to next corner. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 sc) in corner. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Solid Version
With MC, work as given for Stripe Version, omitting all references to color changes.
Edging: With B, work as given for edging for Stripe Version.
Daisy Motif: Make 2 Daisy Motifs (one for each Pot Holder).
With Yellow, ch 5. Join in rnd.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in rnd. Join White with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: With White, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 7. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5 petals.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in missed sc in last rnd. *Ch 7. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in next missed sc in last rnd. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc.
5 petals.
Note: 5 petals from 2nd rnd should alternate with 5 petals from 3rd rnd. Fasten off.
Sew 1 Daisy Motif to each Pot Holder at corner with loop as shown in picture.

Next row: Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc). (Yoh and draw up loop in next dc. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw yarn through all 3 loops on hook - dc2tog made.
*1 dc in next dc. Dc2tog over next 2 dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 32 dc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off.

1st rnd: Ch 1. 10 sc in rnd. Join B with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 7. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 5 petals.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in missed sc in last rnd. *Ch 7. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 1 sc in next missed sc in last rnd. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 5 petals.

instructions: With A, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring. Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join with slip st in front loop of first sc—8 sc. Round 2: Ch 2, working in front loops only, (5-dc Cl, ch 3, slip st) in same st as joining, (slip st, ch 2, 5-dc Cl, ch 3, slip st) in each of next 7 sc —8 clusters. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 3 (right side): With right side facing, working behind clusters of Round 2 and into sts of Rounds 1, join C in back loop of any sc of Round 1, working in back loops only, ch 2, tr in same sc (first ch-2 and tr count as first 2-tr Cl), ch 1, 2-tr Cl in same sc, *ch 1, (2-tr Cl, ch 1, 2-tr Cl) in next sc; repeat from * around, ch 1; join with slip st in top of first cluster—16 clusters and 16 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 4 (right side): With right side facing, join B in any ch-1 space of Round 3, ch 1, sc in same ch-1 space, *ch 5, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * around, ch 5; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc and 16 ch-5 spaces. Round 5: (Slip st, ch 1, 2 sc, ch 2, 2 sc) in first ch-5 space, (2 sc, ch 2, 2 sc) in each of next 15 ch-5 spaces around; join with slip st in first sc—sixteen (2 sc, ch 2, 2 sc) groups. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 6 (right side): With right side facing, join A in any ch-2 space, ch 3 (counts as tr), (tr, 4-tr popcorn, ch-4 picot, 2 tr) in same ch-2 space, (2 tr, 4-tr popcorn, ch-4 picot, 2 tr) in each of next 15 ch-2 spaces around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—sixteen (2 tr, popcorn, picot, 2 tr) groups. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 7 (right side): With right side facing, join B in ch-4 space of any picot, ch 1, sc in same ch-4 space, *ch 7, sc in ch-4 space of next picot; repeat from * around, ch 7; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc and 16 ch-7 spaces. Round 8: (Slip st, ch 1, 3 sc, ch 3, 3 sc) in first ch-7 space, (3 sc, ch 3, 3 sc) in each of next 15 ch-7 spaces; join with slip st in first sc—sixteen (3 sc, ch 3, 3 sc) groups. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 9 (right side): With right side facing, join C in any ch-3 space, ch 1, sc in same ch-3 space, ch 3, (tr, ch 3, tr, ch 4, tr, ch 3, tr) in next ch-3 space, *ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, (tr, ch 3, tr, ch 4, tr, ch 3, tr) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ch 3; join with slip st in first sc—eight (tr, ch 3, tr, ch 4, tr, ch 3, tr) groups, 8 sc, and 16 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 10 (right side): With right side facing, join A in any sc, ch 2 (counts as dc), *skip next ch-3 space, (2 tr, 4-tr popcorn, ch-4 picot, 2 tr) in next ch-3 space, (tr, 4-tr popcorn, ch-4 picot, [tr, 4-tr popcorn, ch-4 picot] twice, tr) in next ch-4 space, (2 tr, 4-tr popcorn, ch-4 picot, 2tr) in next ch-3 space **, dc in next sc; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—8 pattern repeats. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 11 (right side): With right side facing, join B in ch-4 space of 3rd picot, ch 12 (counts as dc, ch 10), skip next picot, dtr2tog-over-picots, *ch 10, skip next picot **, dc in next picot, ch 10, skip next picot, dtr2tog-over –picots; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in 2nd ch of beginning ch-12—8 dtr2tog-over- picots, 8 dc and 16 ch-10 spaces. Round 12: Ch 1, sc in same ch as joining, *11 sc in next ch-10 space, sc in space between the 2 legs of the next dtr2tog, 11 sc in next ch-10 space **, sc in next dc; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in first sc—192 sc. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 13 (right side): With right side facing and working in back loops only, join C in first sc of previous round, ch 2 (counts as dc), 2-dc Cl in same sc, ch 1, working behind cluster just made, sc in last sc of previous round, *skip next unworked sc, 3-dc Cl in next sc, ch 1, working behind cluster just made, sc in skipped sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—96 clusters, 96 sc, and 96 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 14 (right side): With right side facing, join B in first sc, ch 1, 2 sc in same sc, 2 sc in each remaining sc around; join with slip st in front loop of first sc—192 sc. Round 15: Ch 3 (counts as dc, ch 1), working in front loops only, skip next sc, dc in next sc, *ch 1, skip next sc **, dc in next sc; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in 2nd ch of beginning ch—96 dc and 96 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 16 (right side): With right side facing and working in back loops only, join A in first skipped sc, ch 3 (counts as dc, ch 1), dc in next skipped sc, *ch 1, dc in next skipped sc; repeat from * around, ch 1; join with slip st in 2nd ch of beginning ch-3—96 dc and 96 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off and weave in ends. Note: In Round 17, stitches are worked into ch-space/dc pairs. Each pair consists of a ch-1 space from Round 15 and a dc from Round 16. Insert the hook into the ch-space and the dc, then work the indicated stitches. Round 17 (right side): With right side facing, join B by inserting hook in first ch-1 space of Round 15 and 2nd ch of beginning ch-3 of Round 16, ch 1, 3 sc in same ch/space pair, [2 sc in next ch-1 space of Round 15 and next dc of Round 16 at the same time] 5 times, *3 sc in next ch-1 space of Round 15 and next dc of Round 16, [2 sc in next ch-1 space of Round 15 and next dc of Round 16] 5 times; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc—208 sc. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 18 (right side): Repeat Round 13—104 clusters, 104 sc, and 104 ch-1 sps. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 19 (right side): With right side facing, join B in sc of 2nd to last cluster of previous round, ch 1, 2 sc in same sc, 2 sc in each remaining sc around; join with slip st in front loop of first sc —208 sc. Round 20: Slip st in next sc, ch 1, sc in same sc, ch 10, skip next 6 sc, sc in next sc, *ch 9, skip next 5 sc, sc in next sc, ch 10, skip next 6 sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * to last 5 sc, ch 9, skip last 5 sc; join with slip st in first sc—32 sc, 16 ch-9 spaces, and 16 ch-10 spaces. Place a marker in any one of the ch-9 spaces. Round 21: Slip st in first ch-10 space, ch 1, (5 sc, ch 3, 5 sc) in same ch-space, (5 sc, ch 3, 5 sc) in each remaining ch-9 space and ch-10 space around; join with slip st in first sc—thirty-two (5 sc, ch 3, 5 sc) groups. Round 22 (right side): With right side facing, join C in the ch-3 space directly above the marked ch-9 space of Round 20, remove the marker, ch 1, sc in same ch-3 space, ch 4, (tr, [ch 4, tr] 3 times) in next ch-3 space, *ch 4, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 4, (tr, [ch 4, tr] 3 times) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ch 4; join with slip st in first sc—sixteen (tr, [ch 4, tr] 3 times) groups. Fasten off and weave in ends. Round 23 (right side): With right side facing, join A in first sc, ch 3 (counts as tr), *skip next ch-4 space, (2 tr, 4-tr popcorn, ch-4 picot, 2 tr) in next ch-4 space, (tr, 4-tr popcorn, ch-4 picot, 2 tr, 4-tr popcorn, triple-picot, 2 tr, 4-tr popcorn, ch-4 picot, tr) in next ch-4 space, (2 tr, 4-tr popcorn, ch-4 picot, 2 tr) in next ch-4 space **, tr in next sc; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—16 pattern repeats. Fasten off and weave in ends. FINISHING: Weave in any remaining ends. Block doily.

instructions:

Fasten off D.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Block doily to finished measurements.

With A, starting at center, ch 214.

Row 3: Ch 3, skip first sc, dc in next sc, * ch 2, sc in ch-3 space, ch 2, dc in next 2 sc; repeat from * across; turn.

Border
Row 1: With B, repeat Row 2.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in first sc, dc in next dc, * ch 2, sc in ch-3 space, ch 2, dc in next 2 sc; repeat from * across; work one more dc in last sc changing to C; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 3 dc, ch 3, * sc in next 2 dc, ch 3; repeat from * to last 3 sts; sc in next 2 dc and in top of ch-3; turn.

Second Side
With right side facing, attach A in first st of beginning ch and work across remaining loops as follows:
Row 1 (Right Side): Ch 3, skip first st, dc in next st, * ch 2, skip next st, sc in next st, ch 2, skip next st, dc in next 2 sts; repeat from * across; turn.
Complete same as First Side.
Crocheted with sparkly yarn and embellished with holly leaves and berries, this table runner will grace your table all season long.

Edging
Row 1: With right side facing, skip edge of first Border, attach B at short end of First Side; ch 1, work 42 sc evenly across First and Second Side edge, leaving Second Border unworked, turn
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in first sc, dc in next sc, [ch 2, skip next sc, sc in next sc, ch 2, skip next sc, dc in next 2 sc] 8 times, work one more dc in last sc changing to C; turn.

Repeat Edging on opposite short end.

With C, ch 14; sc in 2nd ch from hook, * sc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, (tr, ch 3, slip st in top of tr, tr) all in next ch, dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, (tr, ch 3, slip st in top of tr, tr) all in next ch, dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next 2 ch, ch 3 **, slip st in last sc made; working on opposite side of beginning ch, sc in next 2 sts, hdc in next st, dc in next st, (tr, ch 3, slip st in top of tr, tr) all in next st, dc in next st, hdc in next st, dc in next st, (tr, ch 3, slip st in top of tr, tr) all in next st, dc in next st, hdc in next st, sc in next 2 sts; slip st in first sc. With B, ch 2, 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off leaving long end to sew to runner.

Sew corners of Border and Edge rows together. Sew groups of 4 leaves with 3 berries to runner as shown. With sewing thread and needle sew gold beads in middle of each berry.

Referring to photograph, match the Main Section and one of the End Points together with Right Sides facing. Sew the 2 pieces together using the back loop of the top layer and the front loop of the bottom layer, being careful not to pull yarn too tightly. Repeat for other End Point.

Make 2 Ties: ch 70; fasten off and weave in ends. Cut a piece of cardboard 16” x 6” wide (40.5 cm x 15 cm).

Slip the loops off the cardboard. Lay the looped yarn flat, with one Tie at the left and the other at the right. Using a ruler, locate the mid section of the loops and carefully cut the yarn loops through the middle to form two Tassels.
Gently shake first Tassel to straighten out the yarn strands. Cut 12” (30.5 cm) piece of yarn and wrap yarn around Tassel several times, about 1½” (4 cm) from the top. With C, ch 7 leaving a 3" [7.5 cm] tail. (Yoh and draw up a loop in 4th ch from hook. Yoh and draw through 2 loops) twice. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook. Ch 1. Sl st) all in same ch – Cluster made. 
*Ch 5. (Yoh and draw up a loop in 4th ch from hook. Yoh and draw through 2 loops) twice. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook. Ch 1. Sl st in same ch as last sl st - Pearl made.  
Long String (Make 5) Rep from * 6 times more (8 Pearls total). Fasten off.
Short String (Make 4) Rep from * twice more (4 Pearls total). Fasten off.
FINISHING
Attach Strings of Pearls to Dirt by feeding tail ends through sps between 8 sc of 2nd rnd of Dirt, alternating long and short strings.
Thread tail of rem long string through 1st ch and feed through center of Dirt.
Tie ends of tails tog on WS and secure by weaving in ends.
Join dirt to Pot
1st rnd: With sts of Dirt and last rnd of Pot aligned, join by working sl st through back loop of Pot and front loop of Dirt, stuffing Pot before joining with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.
Hanging Straps
Ch 30, leaving tails approx 3" [7.5 cm] at beg and end of ch.
Fasten off.
Using tail ends, attach Straps to each side edge, spaced approx 6 sts apart, making sure eyes and mouth are centered in the front.  
Top Loop
With A, ch 10. 
Bring this chain beneath Straps and join with sl st in 1st ch to enclose Straps and create Top Loop.

pattern_name: Crochet Train Track Tree Skirt Set
materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m) Contrast A Black (0312) 1 ball or 335 yds/306 m
Contrast B Cherry Red (0319) 1 ball or 77 yds/70 m
Red Heart® Jumbo™ (14 oz/396 g; 744 yds/681 m) Contrast C Aran (0313) 1 ball or 720 yds/658 m
Contrast D Turqua (0512) 1 ball or 77 yds/70 m
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dc-spike = Double crochet spike stitch - Yoh and draw up a loop in indicated stitch of row/round below and pull up a loop to height of current row. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
Scfl = Single crochet in front loop only
Surface Sl st = Holding working yarn at back of work, insert hook into indicated stitch. Yoh and draw up a loop. Insert hook into next stitch. Yoh and pull loop through to front of work.
measurements: Tree Skirt: Approx 24" [61 cm] deep. Train: Approx 6" [15 cm] tall.
gauge: 12 sc and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm]. 12 dc and 6 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc.
• Join each rnd with sl st in first st.
• To change colors, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through loops and proceed in new color.

TREE SKIRT
Sky Section: With D, ch 31.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next ch. *2 sc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Rep from * to last ch. 2 sc in last ch. Turn. 40 sc.
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first sc. 1 dc in each of next 3 sc. *2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 50 dc.
3rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc *2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 60 dc.
4th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc *2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 5 dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 70 dc.
Cont as established, inc 10 dc evenly across each row, for 16 rows more. 230 dc. Join C at end of last row.
Snow Section: 21st row:  (RS). With C, ch 1. Working in front loops only, loosely sl st in each dc to end of row. Turn. 230 sl sts.
22nd row: Working in back loops only of last D row, ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each of next 23 dc. *2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 22 dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 240 dc.
23rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each of next 24 dc. *2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 23 dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 250 dc.
24th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each of next 25 dc. *2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 24 dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 260 dc.
25th to 30th rows:  Cont as established, inc 10 dc evenly across each row. Join A at end of last row. 320 dc at end of 30th row.
Tracks: 31st row:  (RS). With A, ch 1. 2 sc in first dc. 1 sc in each of next 31 dc. *2 sc in next dc. 1 sc in each of next 31 dc. Rep from * to end of row. Join C. Turn. 330 sc.
32nd row: With C, ch 3. 1 dc in first sc. 1 dc in each of next 32 sc. *2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 32 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 340 dc.
33rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each of next 33 dc. *2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 33 dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 350 dc.
34th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each of next 34 dc. *2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 34 dc. Rep from * to end of row. Join A. Turn. 360 dc.
35th row: With A, ch 1. 2 sc in first dc. 1 sc in each of next 35 dc. *2 sc in next dc. 1 sc in each of next 35 dc. Rep from * to end of row. Join C. Turn. 370 sc.
36th row: With C, ch 3. 1 dc in first sc. 1 dc in each of next 36 sc. *2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 36 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 380 dc.
37th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each of next 37 dc. *2 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each of next 37dc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 390 dc.
38th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first dc. 1 sc in each of next 38 dc. *2 sc in next dc. 1 sc in each of next 38 dc. Rep from * to end of row. 400 sc. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Track Rails: With A, work surface sl st perpendicular to Track rows, beg at 31st row and ending at 35th row, beg approx 2" [5 cm] from split in Tree Skirt. Cont working surface sl st in this way, spaced approx every 2" [5 cm]. Weave in ends.

TRAIN ENGINE
Boiler
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 6 times. Join. 24 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 6 times. Join. 30 sc.
6th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc around. Join.
7th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
8th to 22nd rnds:  As 7th rnd. Fasten off. Stuff Boiler piece.

Smokestack
With A, ch 6. Join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd:  Ch 1. Work 6 sc in ring. Join.
2nd and 3rd rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
4th rnd:  Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
6th rnd:  Sl st in each st around. Fasten off. Sew Smokestack to top of Boiler centered over 9th rnd.

Cab Roof
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. (Ch 2. 1 sc) 3 times all in same sp as first st. Ch 2. Join. 4 sc and 4 ch-2 sps.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in next ch-2 sp. *1 sc in next sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * twice more. Join. 12 sc and 4 ch-2 sps.
3rd to 5th rnds:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to next ch-2 sp. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 36 sc and 4 ch-2 sps at end of 5th rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *1 scfl in each st to next ch-2 sp. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 scfl in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Fasten off. 44 and 4 ch-2 sps.

Cab Box
1st rnd: (RS). With WS of Cab Roof facing, and working from outside in towards center, join B with sl st in back loop of 5th sc (center st) of one of the sides of 5th rnd. Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around skipping all ch-2 sps. Join. Turn. 36 sc.
2nd rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. Sc2tog. * 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * twice more. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join. Turn. 32 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to next sc2tog. 1 dcfp around sc2tog (corner made). Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Turn. 28 sc and 4 corner post sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to next corner dcfp st. 1 dcbp around next st. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Turn.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to next dcbp st. 1 dcfp around next st. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Turn.
6th to 17th rnds:  As 4th and 5th rnds 6 times. Fasten off.

Windows (make 4 alike)
With C, ch 7.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 6 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Do not turn.
Edging: Ch 1. 1 sl st in end of each row across side edge. Ch 1 at corner. Sl st in each ch of foundation ch. Ch 1 at corner. Sl st in end of each row across next side edge. Ch 1 at corner. Sl st in each st across. Fasten off. 
Sew 1 Window to each side of Cab Box, sewing top edge of Windows 1 row below roof of Cab.

Cab Base
With B, ch 9.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 8 sc.
2nd to 8th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Fasten off. Stuff Cab. Sew Cab Base to lower edge of Cab, adding more stuffing as needed.

Wheel & Axle (make 10)
With A, Ch 2.
1st rnd:  (RS) 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join. Fasten off.
2nd rnd: With RS facing, join C with sl st in back loop of first sc. Ch 1. 2 scbl in same st as sl st. 2 scbl in each sc around. Join. 12 scbl.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 5 times more. Join. Fasten off. 18 sc.
4th rnd:  (RS). Join A with sl st in first sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same st as join. 2 sc in next sc. 1 dc-spike in front loop of next sc of 1st rnd. Skip next sc. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 dc-spike in front loop of next sc of 1st rnd. Skip next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. Join. 24 sts.
5th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join
6th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc around. Join
7th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
8th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * 5 times more. Join. 18 sts.
9th rnd:  Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * 5 times more. Join. 12 sts. Stuff piece and cont to stuff as you work.
10th rnd: (Axle rnd). Ch 1. 1 scfl in each sc around. Join.
11th to 14th rnds:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing Axles tog. Sew ends of 2 Axles tog to make a total of 5 pairs of Wheels and Axles.

FINISHING TRAIN ENGINE
Sew open end of Boiler to one side of Cab, just below Window. Sew 3 sets of Wheels and Axles evenly spaced along lower edge of Engine and Cab. Weave in ends.

Train Car
Base
With B, ch 2.
1st rnd: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. (Ch 2. 1 sc) 3 times all in same sp as first st. Ch 2. Join. 4 sc and 4 ch-2 sps.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in next ch-2 space. *1 sc in next sc. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * twice more. Join. 12 sc and 4 ch-2 sps.
3rd to 5th rnds:  Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to next ch-2 sp. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in next ch-2 sp. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. 36 sc and 4 ch-2 sps at end of 5th rnd. Turn at end of 5th rnd, do not fasten off.

Sides
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st around skipping ch-2 sps. Join. Turn. 36 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sc. Sc2tog. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Sc2tog. Rep from * twice more. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join. Turn. 32 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to next sc2tog. 1 dcfp around sc2tog (corner made). Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Turn. 28 sc and 4 corner post sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to next dcfp-st. 1 dcbp around next st. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Turn.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *1 sc in each sc to next dcbp-st. 1 dcfp around next st. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Turn.
6th to 8th rnds:  As 4th and 5th rnds, ending on 4th rnd rep. Fasten off.
9th rnd: (WS). Join A with sl st to top of any corner post st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same st as sl st. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Do not turn. 32 sc.
10th to 14th rnds: As 9th rnd.
Finishing
Fold top of Train Car sides to RS, aligning 14th and 10th rnds. Sew 14th rnd to 10th rnd to secure. Sew rem 2 sets of Wheels and Axles evenly spaced along lower edge of Train Car Base. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Suede-ish™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 179 yds/164 m) Main Color (MC) Ocean Waves (91020) 3 balls
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 12½" [32 cm] diameter x 13" [33 cm] high.
gauge: 14 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
BASKET
Note: Join each rnd with sl st to first st.
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join. 24 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Rep from * around. Join. 48 sc.
Cont in this manner, inc 8 sc evenly around next 8 rnds (as established). 88 sc.
Fasten off at end of last rnd.
Next rnd: Join MC with sl st to back loop of first sc. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each sc around. Join.
Proceed as follows: 1st rnd: Ch 2. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each st around. Join.
Rep last row for pat until Basket when standing measures approx 10" [25.5 cm] tall. Join A. Break MC.
With A, cont in pat until Basket when standing measures approx 13" [33 cm].
Fasten off.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m) Teal (01133) 3 balls or 356 yds/323 m
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
11½" [29 cm] diameter x 10¼" [26 cm] high plant pot.
Hot glue gun and glue sticks to secure Cozy to Plant Pot (optional).
abbreviations: Bobble = (Yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 5 times in indicated stitch. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Dcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Hdcbp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at back of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook.
Hdcfp = Yoh and draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook.
Picot = Ch 4. Sl st in 4th ch from hook.
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
Scfp = Draw up a loop around post of next stitch at front of work, inserting hook from right to left. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook.
Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only of next stitch
measurements: Approx 1 1½" [29 cm] diameter x 8¼" [21 cm] high, excluding fringe.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm]. 19 sts and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Diamond Pat Section. Diamond Pat Motif = 3.5" [9 cm] wide x 32" [81.5 cm] long. Note: Gauge is important to ensure project matches purchased plant pot size.
instructions:
COZY
Note: Cozy is worked in one piece starting with Diamond Pattern Section worked from side to side. Next, Diamond Pattern Section is seamed and Top and Bottom Sections are worked around Top and Bottom edges (see diagram on page 4).
Diamond Pat Section (worked side to side):
Ch 18.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Ch 9. Skip next 9 ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in last ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. Ch 2. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sc. Ch 7. Skip next ch-9. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sc. Ch 2. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. Ch 3. Skip next ch-2. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 dc. Ch 5. Skip next ch-7. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 dc. Ch 3. Skip next ch-2. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. Ch 4. Skip next ch-3. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 dc. Picot. Skip next ch-5. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 dc. Ch 4. Skip next ch-3. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. Ch 4. Skip next ch-4. 1 scfp around each of next 2 dc. Bobble in ch-4 sp created by Picot. 1 scfp around each of next 2 dc. Ch 4. Skip next ch-4. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1hdcbp around next hdc. Ch 3. Skip next ch-4. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sc. Ch 5. Skip next Bobble. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sc. Ch 3. Skip next ch-4. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-3. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 dc. Ch 7. Skip next ch-5. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 dc. Ch 2. Skip next ch-3. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. Skip next ch-2. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 dc. Ch 9. Skip next ch-7. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 dc. Skip next ch-2. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
9th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. 1 scfp around each of next 2 dc. Ch 9. Skip next ch-9. 1 scfp around each of next 2 dc. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. Ch 2. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sc. Ch 7. Skip next ch-9. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 sc. Ch 2. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
11th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. Ch 3. Skip next ch-2. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 dc. Ch 2. Working over all 5 ch to enclose them, 1 sc in ch-5 sp 5 rows below. Ch 2. 1 dcfp around each of next 2 dc. Ch 3. Skip next ch-2. 1 hdcfp around next hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
12th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. Ch 4. Skip next ch-3. 1 dcbp around each of next 2 dc. Picot. Skip next: (Ch 2. 1 sc. Ch 2). 1 dcbp around each of next 2 dc. Ch 4. Skip next ch-3. 1 hdcbp around next hdc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
Rep 5th to 12th rows 10 times more, then rep 5th to 8th rows once.
Fasten off.
Seaming: With RS facing each other, fold Diamond Pattern Section in half aligning short ends with each other. Working through both thicknesses and making sure to match pat, sl st evenly across short ends. Fasten off. Turn Diamond Pattern Section RS out.
Join yarn with sl st to 3rd ch of first ch-5 section above seamed edge (ch-5 from 3rd row). Working over all 5 ch to enclose them (working across seam), 1 sc in ch-5 sp 5 rows below to match repeating Diamond Pattern around. Fasten off.
Top Section
Note: Do not join at ends of rnds (unless otherwise stated). Cont working in spiral placing marker on first st of rnd for easier counting.
With RS facing, join yarn with sl st at seam to work around Top edge of Diamond Pat Section (see diagram).
1st rnd: Ch 1. Work 10 sc evenly around Top edge of Diamond Pat Section working sts around sides of sc sts.
2nd rnd: Skip ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around.
3rd rnd: 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of 109 sc around. 1 sc.
4th rnd: 1 sc in each of first 54 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 54 sc around. 1 sc.
5th rnd: 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.
Bottom Section:
Note: Do not join at ends of rnds (unless otherwise stated). Cont working in spiral placing marker on first st of rnd for easier counting.
With RS facing, join yarn with sl st at seam to work around Bottom edge of Diamond Pat Section (see diagram).
1st rnd: Ch 1. Work 98 sc evenly around Bottom edge of Diamond Pat Section working sts around sides of sc sts.
2nd rnd: Skip ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 96 sc. 97 sc.
3rd rnd: 1 sc in each of next 24 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 46 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 23 sc. 95 sc.
4th rnd: Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 46 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 45 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 93 sc. Do not fasten off. Cont with Twisted Tabs (see diagram) as follows:
Tabs
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 scbl in each of first 3 sc. Turn.
2nd to 8th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Turn. - First Tab made.
Fasten off.
With RS facing, join yarn with sl st in next st along rnd. Rep 1st to 8th rows to create next Tab. Fasten off. Cont working in this manner, working individual 3-st Tabs around. 31 Tabs.
Twist Tabs and begin working in rnds: 1st rnd: With RS facing, twist first Tab so WS of top of Tab is facing and Tab has a single twist in it. Join yarn with sl st in first sc of Tab to work around. Ch 1. 1 scbl in each of next 3 sc. Twist second Tab in same manner as first, being sure to twist in same direction. 1 scbl in each of 3 sc across second Tab. Cont working in this manner, twisting each Tab and working 1 scbl in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 93 sc.

2nd rnd:  Ch 1. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 29 sc) 3 times. 90 sc.
3rd rnd: Skip ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Surface Crochet:
Top of Twisted Tabs:  With RS facing, join yarn with sl st at first rem loop aligned with seam from 1st row of Twisted Tabs. Ch 1. 1 sc in each rem loop around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Bottom of Twisted Tabs: Work as for Top of Twisted Tabs around 1st rnd at bottom of Twisted Tabs.
Top Hdc Ridge:  With RS facing, join yarn at seam with sl st around first hdc of Top Hdc Ridge of Diamond Pat Section (see chart). Ch 1. Sc evenly around, working sts around hdc sts. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Bottom Hdc Ridge:  Work as for Top Hdc Ridge around Bottom Hdc Ridge of Diamond Pat Section.
Elastic Thread Weaving:  (WS). With sewing needle and elastic thread, weave elastic thread through every other st around 2nd row from Top Edge of Cozy, being sure thread is not visible on RS of work. Tie thread tightly so Cozy fits snuggly around pot. Rep on 3rd and 4th rows from Top Edge of Cozy (3 rows of elastic thread weaving in total).
Optional: To keep Cozy from sliding down slippery pot surface, use hot glue gun and glue sticks to apply small dots of glue to WS around Top Edge of Cozy. Let dry. Fringe: Cut strands of yarn 3½" [9 cm] long. Taking 1 strand, fold in half and knot into fringe in each sc around bottom edge of Cozy. Un-ply each strand of yarn in fringe.
Fringe: Cut yarn 10 to 14 ins [25.5 to 35.5 cm] long. Taking 2 or 3 strands together for each fringe knot into fringe across cast on and cast off edges. Trim fringe evenly.

Round 3: Ch 3, 2 dc in next st, *dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, slip st in top of ch-3 – 36 dc.
Round 4: Ch 3, working in back loops only, dc in each st around, slip st in top of ch-3.

Weave in ends.
