instructions:
SCARF
Ch 185 loosely.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 184 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3, skip first sc, * back cross dc over next 2 sc; repeat from * to last sc; dc in last sc; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each dc across and in top of ch-3; turn.
Rows 4-5: Repeat Rows 2 and 3.
Row 6: Ch 1, sc in first sc, * ch 2, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * across. Fasten off.
With wrong side facing, attach yarn on opposite side of beginning ch.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Ch 3, skip first ch, * back cross dc over next 2 ch; repeat from * to last ch; dc in last ch; turn.
Rows 2-5: Repeat Rows 3-6. At end of last row, do not fasten off.
Border
Rnd 1: Ch 3, working across long edge, 4 dc in first sc, sc in next ch-2 space, * 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * to last sc; 5 dc in last sc; working across short end, [sc in end of next sc row, 3 dc over post of dc at end of next row] 4 times, sc in end of next sc row **, 5 dc in next corner sc, sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * to ** once more; join with a slip st in top of ch-3. Fasten off. 
Weave in ends.
CLOCHE
Ch 4; join with a slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc.
Rnd 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each sc around; join – 16 sc.
Rnd 3: Ch 1, [sc in sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times; join – 24 sc.
Rnd 4: Ch 1, [sc in 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times; join – 32 sc.
Rnds 5 and 6: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join.
Rnd 7: Ch 1, [sc in sc, 2 sc in next sc] 16 times; join – 48 sc.
Rnd 8: Repeat Rnd 5.
Rnd 9: Ch 1, [sc in 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 12 times; do NOT join – 60 sc. Mark first sc of next rnd and then move marker up as you work.
Rnds 10-20: Sc in each sc around without joining.
Rnd 21: [Sc in 14 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 4 times; join to first sc – 64 sc.
Rnd 22: Ch 3, working behind the ch-3, dc in last sc of last rnd, * back cross dc over next 2 sc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of ch-3.
Rnd 23: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join.
Rnd 24: Repeat Rnd 22.
Rnd 25: Ch 1, sc in each st around decreasing 1 st at end of rnd; join; TURN – 63 sc.
Rnd 26 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, * sc in sc, ch 2, skip 2 sc; repeat from * around; join; TURN.
Rnd 27 (Right Side): Ch 1, * sc in ch-2 space, 3 dc in next sc; repeat from * around; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Optional Flower
With a pink section of yarn, ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc. 
Rnd 2: [Ch 3, slip st in next sc] 7 times, ch 3, slip st in joining slip st of Rnd 1.
Rnd 3: Ch 1, working behind ch-3 spaces in sc of Rnd 1 and to the left of slip sts of Rnd 2, sc in first sc, [ch 4, sc in next sc] 7 times, ch 4; join in first sc.
Rnd 4: Ch 1, working behind ch-4 spaces in same sc of Rnd 1 and to the left of sc of Rnd 3, sc in first sc, [ch 5, sc in next sc] 7 times, ch 5, join in first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends. Add a pretty button or bead to the center of flower and then sew onto side of cloche.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver Pooling®: 1 skein 8310 Haute A
RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein 311 White B
Susan Bates® Easy Pom Pom Maker, 1½" (4 cm) diameter
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Hat measures 8 x 22" (20.5 x 56 cm) not including brim edging; Cowl measures 8 x 30" (20.5 x 76 cm). All measurements given with pieces laid flat, before assembly.
gauge: 3 full sc sts per each length of one color in Moss st. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
MOSS STITCH
Ch an even number of sts.
Row 1: Skip 3 ch, sc in next ch, * ch 1, skip 1 foundation ch, sc in next ch; repeat from * to end, turn.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Repeat Row 3 only for Moss st.
HAT / COWL
With A, ch through at least 1 full color sequence, with the last loop on hook being the first loop of a new color just after a color change in the yarn.
Row 1 (right side): Skip 2 ch (counts as a sc), sc in the 3rd ch from hook, * ch 1, sc around the foundation ch (instead of going into a ch st); repeat from * until 1 full color sequences has been completed. The number of sc made in each individual color in the colorway should be 3. Leave remaining ch sts unworked. Undo one st repeat (sc, ch 1), turn.
Note: If at this point you are NOT getting 3 sc per color then redo the row with a different hook size. Getting 3 sc per color with this yarn is essential to making this technique work.
Row 2 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end finishing with a sc in last ch-3 space, turn.
Note: As you work this row and all remaining rows, you MUST get the correct number of sc in each color in order to maintain the planned color pooling. Change hook sizes, or actual st used, to get the correct color in place.
Row 3 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in the next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Note: The color of the sts on this row will shift to the left or right by 1 st from the previous right side row depending on the colorway and if you are right or left handed. It doesn’t matter which direction the st shifts as long as it is off-set by 1.
Row 4 (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), sc in next ch-1 space, * ch 1, sc in the next ch-1 space; repeat from * to end, finishing with a sc in last ch-2 space, turn.
Note: The color of the sts on this row will shift to the left or right by 1 st from the previous wrong side row depending on the colorway and if you are right or left handed. It doesn’t matter which direction the st shifts as long as it is off-set by 1.
Repeat Rows 3 and 4 until piece measures 22" (56 cm) ending on a Row 4 (wrong side row).
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Squish or stretch the sts on foundation chain to match the width of the rest of the piece. You can slide the sts around along the foundation chain, as with an adjustable ring. Unravel unused foundation ch sts and weave in yarn tail to secure foundation.
For Hat only:
Brim Edging
With B and right side facing and working across side edge, join with slip st.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as a st now and throughout), skip one row, * sc in next row, ch 1, skip on row; rep from * to end.
Row 2: Ch 2 (does not count as a st), * fpdc around next sc, dc in next ch-1 sp; repeat from * to end, turn.
Rows 3 – 6: Ch 2 (does not account as a st), * fpdc around next st, bpdc around next st; repeat from * to end, turn.
Fasten off.
Sew together foundation chain edge and final row of piece.
Position the seam to the back of the hat, then seam together the non brim edge of hat together.
With B, make 2 pompoms and sew one to each corner of Hat.
Weave in all loose ends.
For Cowl only:
Sew together foundation chain edge to the final edge of piece.
Weave in all loose ends.

Next rnd: Working around outer edge only, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Ch 3. Ss in first ch – picot made. Rep from * to opposite side. Fasten off. With A, make button loop at center back on left side. Sew button in position. If desired, embroider day of week onto bib as illustrated. 5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.

Sew center back seam. With RS of work facing, join A with sl st at center back. Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Work 5 sc down side of instep. 3 sc in corner sc. 3 sc across end of instep. 3 sc in corner sc. Work 5 sc along other side of instep. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Join with sl st to first st. 33 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join MC with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, work 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off. Join center foot seam.

instructions:
SCARF
Note: The cabled center column is stitched first, then the stripes are stitched on either side of the cabled center column.
Center Column
With A, Ch 7.
Row 1 (RS): Dc in 4th ch from hook (skipped ch count as dc) and in each ch across. Do not fasten off throughout center column. Turn – 5 dc.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), bpdc around next dc, fpdc around next dc, bpdc around next dc, hdc in top of tch. Turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, cable across next 3 sts, hdc in top of tch. Turn.
Rows 4-158: Repeat Rows 2-3 (ending with a Row 2).
Fasten off.
Stripes
Note: Turn project sideways and begin working over row ends. Leave yarn ends long to be hidden in fringe.
Row 1: With RS facing, join A with sc, sc in end st of each row across. Fasten off. Do not turn throughout stripes.
Row 2: With RS facing, join C with dc in first st, ldc in back loop of each sc across. Fasten off.
Row 3: With RS facing, join A with dc in first st, ldc in back loop of each dc across. Fasten off.
Rows 4-5: With RS facing, join B with dc in first st, ldc in back loop of each dc across. Fasten off.
Row 6: With RS facing, join A with dc in first st, ldc in back loop of each dc across. Do not fasten off.
Row 7: Ch 1, skip first st, reverse sc in each dc across. Fasten off. Turn project over and with RS facing, repeat Rows 1-7 to created stripes on the other side of the cables.
Fringe
Cut yarn 9” long, and with three strands held together add a tassle to the end of each corresponding color row.
FINGERLESS MITTS (make 2)
With A, ch 44.
Row 1: Insert hook into 3rd ch from hook, yo and pull up a loop, insert hook into 4th ch from hook, yo and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), [yo and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice (creates first ldc). Ldc in each remaining ch across. Fasten off. Do not turn throughout Mitts – 41 ldc.
Row 2: With RS facing join C with dc in first st, Ldc in back loop of each st across. Fasten off.
Rows 3 – 18: Repeat Row 2 with changing color each row in the following order: A, B, B, A, C, A, B, A, C.
Seaming
With RS facing line up the bottom of Row 1 with the top of Row 18, whipstitch 22 stitches from the edge going through the foundation of Row 1 and back loop of Row 18. Fasten off. Skip 10 stitches to create thumbhole, whipstitch as established the final 10 stitches. Fasten off. Weave in all loose ends.
Thumb
Round 1: Join B with dc in any st of thumbhole, Ldc in back loops evenly around thumbhole. Do not join.
Round 2: Ldc in each back loop of st around. Fasten off.
HAT
Note: Hat is crocheted flat then seamed to create tube. One end is cinched to create crown. Other end is crocheted around to create brim.
With A, ch 34.
Row 1: Insert hook into 3rd ch from hook, yo and pull up a loop, insert hook into 4th ch from hook, yo and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), [yo and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice (creates first ldc). Ldc in each remaining ch across. Fasten off. Do not turn throughout hat. - 31 ldc.
Row 2: With RS facing join Suite with dc in first st, Ldc in back loop of each st across. Fasten off.
Rows 3 – 45: Repeat Row 2 with changing color each row in the following order: A, B, B, A, C, A, B, A, C.
Seaming
With RS facing line up the bottom of first row with the top of the last row, whipstitch going through the foundation of first row and back loop of last row across to create tube, do not fasten off.
Weave in and out of ends of stripes all the way around, cinch tight and secure to create crown of hat. Fasten off.
Brim
Note: Brim is worked along edge of hat in rows, then seamed together at end.
Row 1: With RS facing, join A with sc to edge of hat. Place 131 sc evenly around edge of hat. Do not fasten off. Turn. – 132 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), dc in back loop of each sc across. Do not fasten off. Turn
Row 3: Ch 2 (counts as first st), *bpdc around next dc, fpdc around next dc; repeat from * across, hdc in top of tch. Do not fasten off. Turn.
Row 4: Ch 2 (counts as first st), *bpdc around next st, cable across next 3 st; repeat from * across, hdc in top of tch. Do not fasten off. Turn.
Row 5: Repeat Row 3.
Row 6: Ch 2 (counts as first st), *skip next st, fpdc around next st; repeat from * across, hdc in top of tch. Fasten off. Weave in loose ends. With WS facing whipstitch seam of brim.

Special Stitch
long-dc (Long double crochet) = Yarn over, 
insert hook in indicated stitch 2 rows below, 
yarn over and draw up a loop (to current row 
height), [yarn over and draw through 2 loops 
on hook] twice. Note: Do not work into the 
corresponding stitch in the current working row.
long-sc (Long single crochet) = Insert hook 
in end of indicated row, yarn over and draw 
up a loop (to current row height), yarn over 
and draw through 2 loops on hook. Note: Do 
not work into the corresponding stitch in the 
current working row.
sc2tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over 
and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw 
through all 3 loops on hook.
sc3tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over 
and pull up a loop] three times, yarn over 
and draw through all 4 loops on hook. 
dc2tog = [Yarn over, insert hook in next 
stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, 
draw through 2 loops] twice, yarn over, draw 
through all 3 loops on hook.

To change color, work last stitch of old color

Round 3: Working behind last rnd, slip st in 
first back loop of Rnd 1, ch 3 (counts as first 
dc), dc in same loop, 2 dc in each back loop; 
join with slip st to first dc—24 dc.
Round 4: Ch 2, 2 hdc in same st as joining, 3 
hdc in each dc around; join with slip st in first 
hdc—72 hdc. Fasten off.
Bottom Wing Decorations
Oval (make 2)
Work same as blue circle Rounds 1-3, do not 
fasten off E at the end of Round 3.
Note: Continue working in rows to Last Round.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in 
next 8 sc, turn—9 sc.
Rows 5-7: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 
sc, sc2tog, turn—3 sc at end of Row 7.
Last round: Ch 1, sc3tog, sc evenly space 
around to last sc, 3 sc in last sc. Fasten off.
ASSEMBLY
Using photograph as a guide, sew decorations 
on wings. 
With 2 strands of F threaded together and 
beginning at each wing’s Row 1, sew together 
through upper wing Row 27 and lower wing 
Row 38. Repeat for second set of wings.
Align top inner edge of left wings to Row 60 
of body. With 2 strands of A threaded together, 
sew wings to body ending at Row 16 of body. 
Repeat for right wings.

Weave in ends.

pattern_name: Baby’s Gone A Hunting Vest and Hat
materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 2 skeins 971 Camouflage A, 1 skein 312 Black B for Hat.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
gauge: 16 sc = 4”; 18 rows = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Note: Vest is worked from the center of Back to center of Right Front. Stitches are then picked up along opposite edge of foundation chain and worked to center of Left Front. 
VEST
RiGHT BACK
With A ch 27 (31, 33, 39).
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn – 26 (30, 32, 38) sts.
Repeat Row 2 until 6 (8, 10, 12) rows have been worked. 
Shape Neck
Next Row: Ch 1, work in sc across, ch 5, turn. 
Next Row: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch and st across, turn – 30 (34, 36, 42) sts.
Work until 5 (7, 7, 9) rows have been worked for shoulder. 
Shape Armhole 
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in next 16 (16, 18, 20) sc, turn. Leave remaining sts unworked for armhole.
Row 2: Sc2tog for armhole, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in 13 (13, 15, 17) sc, sc2tog, turn. 
Row 4: Sctog, sc in each sc across, turn. 
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in 11 (11, 13, 15) sc, sc2tog, turn – 12 (12, 14, 16) sc.
Work for 7 rows. 
Row 13: Ch 1, sc in 11 (11, 13, 15) sc, 2 sc in next sc, turn – 13 (13, 15, 17) sc.
Row 14: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 15: Ch 1, sc in 13 (13, 15, 17) sc, 2 sc in next sc, turn – 15 (15, 18, 19) sc.
Row 16: Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, sc in each sc across, turn – 16 (16, 18, 20) sc.
FRONT
Row 17: Ch 1, sc in 16 (16, 20) sc, ch 15 (19, 19, 23), turn. 
Row 18: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch and st across, turn – 30 (34, 36, 42) sts.
Work in sc until 5 (7, 7, 9) rows have been worked for shoulder. 
Shape Neck
Row 1: Ch 1, sc to last 5 sts, slip st in next st, turn. 
Row 2: Skip slip st, sc2tog, sc to end of row, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc to 5 (7, 3, 3) sts before sctog, slip st in next st, turn. 
Row 4: Skip slip st, sc2tog, sc to end of row, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc to last 5 (7, 3, 3) sts before sctog, slip st in next st, turn. 
Row 6: Sc2tog, sc to end of row, turn – 12 (12, 22, 28) sc.
For 18 and 24 months Only:
Row 7: Ch 1, sc to last (3, 3) sts before sctog, slip st in next st, turn. 
Row 8: Sc2tog, sc to end of row, turn.
Row 9: Ch 1, sc to last (3, 3) sts before sctog, slip st in next st, turn. 
Row 10: Sc2tog, sc to end of row, turn (14, 20) sts.
For 24 months Only:
Row 11: Ch 1, sc to last (3) sts before sctog, slip st in next st, turn. 
Row 12: Sc2tog, sc to end of row, turn – (16) sc.
For All Sizes: 
Work 3 rows in sc on 12 (12, 14, 16) sc.
Fasten off.
LEFT BACK
Working along opposite side of foundation chain at center of Back, work 26 (30, 32, 38) scs. Work as for Right Side reversing shaping. 
FiNiSHiNG
Sew Shoulders together.
Armband: With right side facing, join yarn at center of underarm, work sc evenly around armhole, join with a slip st to first sc. Fasten off.
Repeat for second armhole. 
Edging  
Mark for 3 buttons on Right Front. 
Round 1: With right side facing, join yarn in any st and work in sc evenly around lower edge, Front edges and neck edge, working 3 sc in corners and ch 2 opposite where marked for buttons on Left Front for buttonholes, slip st to first sc to join.  
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc, working 3 sc in corners and 2 sc in each ch-2 space, slip st to first sc to join.
Fasten off.
Weave in ends. Sew buttons opposite buttonholes.
HAT
With A, ch 4, slip st to first ch to form a ring. 
Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring. Place a marker for beginning of round. 
Round 2: Ch 1, work 2 sc in each st, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 12 sc.  
Round 3: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next st] around, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 18 sc.  
Round 4: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts] around, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 24 sc.  
Round 5: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts] around, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 30 sc.  
Round 6: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts] around, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 36 sc.  
Round 7: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts] around, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 42 sc.  
Round 8: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts] around, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 48 sc.  
Round 9: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 7 sts] around, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 54 sc.  
Round 10: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts] around, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 60 sc.  
Round 11: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 9 sts] around, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 66 sc.  
For Larger Size Only:
Round 12: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts] around, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 72 sc.  
For All Sizes: 
Next Round: Ch 1, sc in each sc around, slip st in first sc to join, turn – 66 (72) sts.
Repeat last Round until 10 rounds have been worked.
Visor
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in next 9 (10) sc, 2 sc in next 2 sc, sc in next 9 (10) sc, turn – 22 (24) sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in next sc 1 (0) time, [sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] across to last 3 (2) sts, sc in next sc 1 (0) time, sc2tog.
Rows 3-4: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn.
Fasten off.
Edging: With right side facing, join B in next st on Hat after last st on first row of Visor and ch 1, sc in each st around to st before first st of first row of Visor. 
Fasten off. 
Ear Flap
With right side facing, skip 4 sc from edge of Visor. Join A in next st.
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in next 12 sc, turn. 
Rows 2-8: Repeat Row 1. 
Rows 9-11: Sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn.
Fasten off. 
Count 16 sts from opposite side of Visor and join yarn. 
Work as for first Ear Flap.
Edging: Join B in any st and ch 1, sc in each st and row around edges of Hat, Visor and Ear Flaps. 
FiNiSHiNG
With B, make 2 twisted cords, each 11” long. Attach to one end to point of each Ear Flap. Fold Ear Flaps up and tie cords together on top of Hat.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each of 311 White A and 322 Pale Yellow B.
Optional: 1 yellow ribbon rosette, 1½” wide yellow lace, ¼” satin ribbon, sewing needle and thread.
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C etc.
gauge: 3 dc loops = 1”; Rows 1 - 5 = 2”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
DRESS
Front and Back (make 2)
Bodice
Row 1: With double-ended hook and A, ch 32, (size 12 months only ch 36), dc loop in 3rd ch from hook and each ch across, turn.
Row 2: With B, work loops off hook, do not turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, dc loop in each horizontal bar across, turn.
Row 4: With A, work loops off hook, do not turn.
Row 5: Ch 2, dc loop in each horizontal bar across, turn.
Repeat Rows 2 - 5 once more.  Repeat Rows 2 - 4 once more.
First Shoulder
Row 1: Ch 2, dc loop in next 7 (size 12 months only in next 9) horizontal bars; turn, leaving remaining sts unworked.
Row 2: With B, work loops off hook, do not turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, dc loop in each horizontal bar across, turn.
Row 4: With A, work loops off hook, do not turn.
Row 5: Ch 2, dc loop in each horizontal bar across, turn.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2.
Row 7: Ch 1, sc in each horizontal bar across. Fasten off.
Second Shoulder
Row 1: With double-ended hook, working in unworked sts of last row of panel, skip next 15 horizontal bars, join A with slip st in next horizontal bar, ch 2, dc loop in each horizontal bar to end, turn.
Rows 2 - 7: Repeat pattern for first shoulder.
Skirt
Row 1: With double-ended hook, working in bottom loops of starting ch, join B with slip st in first loop, ch 2, dc loop in same loop, (dc loop in next loop, 2 dc loops in next loop) across to end, turn.
Row 2: With A, work loops off hook, do not turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, (4 dc loops in next 4 vertical bars at same time, dc loop in next vertical bar) across to end, turn.
Row 4: With B, work loops off hook, do not turn.
Row 5: Ch 2, dc loop in each horizontal bar across, turn.
Repeat Rows 2 - 5 three (four, five) more times. Repeat Rows 2 - 4 once more.
Last row: Ch 1, sc in each horizontal bar across. Fasten off.
Whipstitch shoulder seams.
Trim
With regular hook and working in row ends, join A with sc in last row of skirt on Back, 2 sc in end of same row, work 2 sc into each color section up to shoulder seam and back down to hem on Front, 3 sc in last row end; working across bottom edge of skirt, sc across, working up opposite side, work 3 sc in first row end; continue along remaining side and bottom edge as before, join with slip st in beginning sc. Fasten off. 
Whipstitch side seams, leaving top 26 sts on each side open for armholes.
Armhole Trim
With regular hook, join A with sc in first st past seam on armhole, sc in next 2 sts, keeping last loop of each st on hook, 2 dc in next st, yo, draw through both loops on hook, (cluster made) ch 3, sc in 3rd ch from hook, (picot made), cluster in next st, [ch 2, sc in next st, ch 2, cluster in next st, picot, cluster in next st] 6 more times, sc in each remaining st to end, join with slip st in beginning sc.  
Fasten off.  Repeat for second armhole.
Neck Trim
With regular hook, join A with sc in first unworked horizontal bar of neck edge, sc in each horizontal bar, working in row ends of shoulder, work 2 sc into each color section; sc in each horizontal bar on opposite neck edge, work 2 sc into each color section on second shoulder, join with slip st in beginning sc. Fasten off. If desired, with sewing needle and thread, stitch 1½” wide lace to neck border. Cut desired length of satin ribbon. Tie in a bow and sew to center of top panel just below lace. Sew rosette to center of ribbon bow.
Hem Trim
With regular hook, working in bottom of skirt, join A with slip st in center of either side seam, ch 3, keeping last loop of each st on hook, 2 dc in same space, yo, draw through all loops on hook, picot, keeping last loop of each st on hook, 3 dc in same space, yo, draw through all loops on hook, ch 2, sc in next st, [ch 2, keeping last loop of each st on hook, dc in next st, 2 dc in next st, yo, draw through all loops on hook, (large cluster made), picot, large cluster in next 2 sts, ch 2, sc in next st] up to next side seam, ch 2, (large cluster, picot, large cluster) in center of seam, ch 2, sc in next st, ch 2, [large cluster in next 2 sts, picot, large cluster in next 2 sts, ch 2, sc in next st, ch 2] to end, join with slip st in top of beginning ch.  Fasten off. Weave in ends.
HAT
Row 1: With double-ended hook and B, ch 57 (62, 67), dc loop in 3rd ch from hook and each ch to end, turn.
Row 2: With A, work loops off hook, do not turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, 4 dc loop in next 4 vertical bars at same time, (dc loop in next vertical bar, 4 dc loops in next 4 vertical bars at same time) to end, ending with dc loop in last vertical bar, turn.
Row 4: With B, work loops off hook, do not turn.
Row 5: Ch 2, dc loop in each horizontal bar across, turn.
Rows 6-13: Repeat Rows 2 – 5 two more times.
Row 14: Yo, pull through all loops on hook. Fasten off, leaving a long length for sewing.
Pull yarn to gather top of hat and secure. Sew back seam. 
Brim
Round 1: With regular hook and working in bottom loops of Row 1, join A with sc in any st, sc2tog 2 [1, 0] times, sc in each st to end, join with slip st in beginning sc. Do not turn.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, ch 2, keeping last loop of each stitch on hook, 2 dc in next st, yo, draw through both loops on hook (cluster made), ch 3, sc in 3rd ch from hook (picot made), cluster in next st, ch 2, *sc in next st, ch 2, cluster in next st, picot, cluster in next st, ch 2; repeat from * around, join with slip st in beginning sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

materials: Main Color (MC) Hot Pink (08416) 1 ball for Cap, 2 balls for Bag
Contrast A Deep Pink (02210) 1 ball for Cap, 1 ball for Bag
Contrast B Hot Lilac (08317) 1 ball for Cap, 2 balls for Bag
Sizes U.S. H (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
¼ yds (0.25 m) of lining fabric for bag.
measurements: Cap: To fit child 6 yrs old. Bag: Approx 7" [18 cm] wide by 10" [25.5 cm] tall.
gauge: 13½ sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm]. 1 Motif = 2½" [6 cm] in diameter.
instructions:
Motif I
With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join A with sl st to first sc. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: With A, ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join B with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off leaving an end approx 6" [15 cm] long for sewing.

Motif II
Work as given for Motif I, substituting A for MC, B for A, and MC for B.

Motif III
Work as given for Motif I, substituting B for MC, MC for A, and A for B.

CAP
Make 3 each of Motifs I, II and III (9 in total).
Crown: With MC, ch 2.
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join A with sl st to first sc. 8 sc.
2nd rnd: With A, ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. 16 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join B with sl st to first sc. 24 sc.
4th rnd: With B, ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 32 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 40 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 4 sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sc. Join MC with sl st to first sc. 48 sc.
8th rnd: With MC, as 6th rnd.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 5 sc. 1 sc in each of last 5 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sc.
10th rnd: As 6th rnd.

Top: Join MC with sl st to top of any Motif in top rnd.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (Ch 7. 1 sc in top of next Motif) 8 times. Ch 7. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 ch) 9 times. 72 sc. Join A with sl st to first sc.
3rd rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th to 6th rnds: As 3rd rnd. Join B with sl st to first sc at end of 6th rnd.
7th rnd: With B, as 3rd rnd.
8th rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). Miss first sc. 1 dc in next sc. 1 dc in each sc around. Join with sl st to top of ch 3.
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
10th rnd: With B, as 3rd rnd. Fasten off.

Drawstrings (make 2)
Cut 1 strand each of MC, A and B 64" [162.5 cm] long. With 3 strands tog hold one end and with someone holding other end, twist strands to the right until they begin to curl. Fold the 2 ends tog and tie in a knot so they will not unravel. The strands will now twist themselves tog.
Beg at side of Bag, thread first Drawstring through dc rnd, over and under 3 posts. Knot ends tog. Beg at opposite side, thread second Drawstring in same manner and knot ends tog.

Lining: Cut lining fabric 8" [20.5 cm] by 24" [61 cm]. Sew short ends tog using French seam. Press ½" [1.5 cm] to WS along top and bottom edges. Sew top and bottom edges of Lining to inside of Bag having top edge just below dc rnd.

11th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 6 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 6 sc. 1 sc in each of last 6 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 64 sc.
12th rnd: As 6th rnd.
13th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to last 7 sc. 1 sc in each of last 7 sc. Join A with sl st to first sc. 72 sc.
14th rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
15th and 16th rnds: As 14th rnd. Join B with sl st to first sc at end of 16th rnd.
17th to 20th rnds: With B, as 14th rnd. Join MC with sl st to first sc at end of 20th rnd.
21st rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Fasten off.

FINISHING
With RS of work facing, arrange 9 Motifs alternating Motifs I, II and III. Sew Motifs tog through 1 sc of last rnd to form a circle (see picture).
With MC, sew circle of Motifs to lower edge of Crown through 1 sc of last rnd.

BAG
Make 6 each of Motifs I, II and III as given for Cap (18 in total).
Base: Work as given for Crown of Cap.

FINISHING
With RS of work facing, arrange 9 Motifs alternating Motifs I, II, and III. Sew Motifs tog through 1 sc of last rnd to form a circle. Rep for second set of 9 Motifs.
Sew circles of Motifs tog through 1 sc of last rnd where they meet (see picture).
Sew bottom circle of Motifs to top edge of Base through 1 sc of last rnd.

With WS tog stitch a seam ½" [1.5 cm] from edge. Trim this seam to 1/8" [3 mm] and press to one side. Fold fabric with RS tog along seam line and press. Stitch a seam ¼" [6 mm] from fold.

instructions: Left Leg: With A, ch 27 (29, 31). Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch, turn—26 (28, 30) sc. Rows 2–10: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Row 11: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st, turn—28 (30, 32) sc. Rows 12–31: Repeat Rows 2–11 twice—32 (34, 36) sc. Rows 32–34 (38, 42): Repeat Row 2. Rows 5: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—28 (30, 32) sc. Rows 6-13: Repeat Rows 2-5 twice—24 (26, 28) sc. Rows 14-16: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Left Shoulder: With right side of back facing, skip next 12 sts and join A with sc in next st. Row 1: Sc in next 5 (6, 7) sts, turn—6 (7, 8). Rows 2-3: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Fasten off at end of Row 3. Left Front: With right side of body facing, skip next st of Row 42 (46, 50) and join A with sc in next st. Row 1: Sc in each st, turn—16 (17, 18) sc. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st, turn—15 (16, 17) sc. Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Rows 5–10: Repeat Rows 3 and 4 three times—12 (13, 14) sc. Rows 11-13: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—6 (7, 8) sc. Rows 14–19: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Fasten off at end of Row 19. Sew fronts to shoulders. Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st and ch-1 space—208 (226, 238) sc. Fasten off. Front Button Band Rick Rack: With right side facing, join B with sc around post of first st of Row 1 of front button band. Row 2 (buttonhole row): Ch 1, sc in first 2 sts, *ch 1, skip next st (buttonhole made), sc in next 5 sts; repeat from * 5 (6, 7) times,* sc in next 8 (6, 4) sts; repeat from * to * once; sc in remaining sts, turn—56 (72, 68) sc and 12 (14, 16) buttonholes. Sleeve Cap (make 2): With right side of armhole facing, join A with sc in 8th row below shoulder seam. Row 1: Working over ends of rows, sc in next 15 rows around shoulder; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—16 sc. Rows 2-4: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—10 sc. Fasten off at end of Row 4. Sleeve (make 2): With right side of armhole facing, join A with sc in first unworked st at underarm. Round 1: Sc in same st as join, working across ends of rows, sc in each row to sleeve cap, sc in each row of sleeve cap; working in last row of sleeve cap, sc2tog, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog; working across ends of rows, sc in each row of sleeve cap to last row, 2 sc in last row; join with slip st in first sc—40 sc. Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Round 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st up to last 2 sts, sc2tog; join with slip st in first st—38 sc. Round 4: Repeat Round 2. Rounds 5 and 6: Repeat Rounds 3 and 4—36 sc. Round 7: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st to shoulder, sc2tog, sc in each remaining st; join with slip st in first st—34 sc. Round 8: Repeat Round 2. Rounds 9–16: Repeat Rounds 7 and 8 four times—26 sc. Round 17: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st to shoulder, [sc2tog] twice, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog; join with slip st in first st—22 sc. Round 18: Repeat Round 2. Rounds 19 and 20: Repeat Rounds 7 and 8 once—20 sc. Rounds 21–29 (33, 37): Ch 1, sc in each st; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off at end of Round 29 (33, 37). Sleeve Rick Rack: With right side facing, join B with sc in any st of round previously made. Round 1: Work 2 sc in same st, *skip next st, working around post of st of Round 27 [31, 35] of sleeve, 3 FPsc around next st, skip next st in round previously made, 3 sc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. VEST Body: With C, ch 47 (51, 55). Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch, turn—46 (50, 54) sc. Rows 2–10 (14, 18): Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Left Front: Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in first 6 (7, 8) sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—6 (7, 8) sc. Rows 2-24: Repeat Row 1 twenty-three times. Fasten off at end of Row 24. Back: With right side facing, skip next st on last row of body and join C with sc in next st. Row 1: Sc in next 31 (33, 35) sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—32 (34, 36) sc. Rows 2–24: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Fasten off at end of Row 24. Right Front: With right side facing, skip next st on last row of body and join C with sc in next st. Row 1: Sc in next 5 (6, 7) sts—6 (7, 8) sc. Rows 2-24: Repeat Row 1 twenty-three times. Fasten off at end of Row 24. Sew fronts to back. Edging: Note Continue working in rounds. Place markers in indicated sts and move marker up as each round is completed. With right side facing, join C with sc in end of Row 1 on right front. Round 1: Working over ends of rows, 4 sc in same space as join, place marker in 3rd st of 5-st group, sc in each row to last row before back, sc2tog over last row and first st of back, sc in each st in back to last st of back, sc2tog over last st and first row of left front, sc in each row of left front to Row 1, 5 sc in Row 1, mark 3rd st of 5-st group, working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in each ch; join with slip st in first sc, turn—140 (152, 164) sc. Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 1, *sc in each st to next marked st, 5 sc in marked st; repeat from * once, sc in remaining st; join with slip st in first sc, turn—156 (168, 180) at end of Round 3. Fasten off at end of Round 3. Vest Rick Rack: With right side facing, join B with sc in any st of last round. Round 1: Work 2 sc in same st as join, skip next st, working around post of next st of Round 1 of edging, 3 FPsc around next st, skip next st in round previously made, *3 sc in front loop only of next st, skip next st of Round 1 of edging, 3 FPsc around next st, skip next st in round previously made; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Vest Border: Note Continue working in continuous, unturned rounds. With right side facing, join D with sc in marked st on right front. Round 1 (right side): Working in skipped sts and unworked back loops behind rick rack, 4 sc in same st as join, sc in each st to next marker, 5 sc in marked st, sc in each st to end; join with slip st in first sc—164 (176, 188) sc. Remove markers. Rounds 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each st; join with slip st in first sc. Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first 45 st, [sc2tog] 10 times across back, sc in each remaining st; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Armhole Edging (make 2): With right side of right armhole facing, join C with sc in skipped st between front and back. Round 1: Working over ends of rows of armhole, sc in each row; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Repeat for left armhole. BOW TIE First Half: With D, ch 4. Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch, turn—3 sc. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Row 3: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st, turn—5 sc. Rows 4-7: Repeat Rows 2 and 3 twice—9 sc. Rows 8-11: Repeat Row 2 four times. Row 12: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—7 sc. Row 13: Repeat Row 2. Rows 14–17: Repeat Rows 12 and 13 twice—3 sc. Fold first half in half, matching sts of Rows 1 and 17. Joining Row: Ch 1, working through both thicknesses, sc in each st, turn. Second Half: Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. Rows 2-17: Repeat Rows 2-17 of first half. Do not fasten off. Edging: Pivot bowtie to work in ends of rows, ch 1, sc in each row of first side. Fasten off. Join D to first row of opposite side, working in ends of rows, ch 1, sc in each row. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. Fold second half in half and sew Row 17 to center of bow. Strap: With D, ch 4. Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch, turn—3 sc. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn. Repeat Row 2 until strap measures approximately 11” (28 cm). Buttonhole Row: Ch 1, sc in first st, ch 1, skip next st, sc in last st, turn—2 sc. Repeat Row 2 until strap measures approximately 12” (30.5 cm). Fasten off. With sewing needle and matching thread, sew one button to opposite end from buttonhole. Center strap to back of bow and sew with yarn needle and tail. BEANIE Note Work in continuous rounds. Place marker at beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed. With A, ch 3, join with slip st to form ring. Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, 10 sc in ring—10 sc. Round 2: 2 sc in first st and in each remaining st—20 sc. Round 3: Sc in each st. Round 4: *2 sc in next st, sc in next st; repeat from * around—30 sc. Round 5: *2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around—40 sc. Round 6: *2 sc in next st, sc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around—50 sc. Rounds 7 and 8: Repeat Round 3. Sizes 12 month and 18 month only: Round 9: *2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts; repeat from * around—60 sc. Size 18 month only: Round 10: *2 sc in next st, sc in next 5 sts; repeat from * around—70 sc. All Sizes: Rounds 9-28 (10-30, 11–32): Repeat Round 3 twenty (twenty-one, twenty-two) times. Round 29 (31, 33): *Sc in next 3 (4, 5) sts, sc2tog; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc – 40 (50, 60) sc. Brim: Round 1: Ch 1, working in front loops only, sc in each st; join with slip st in first sc. Rounds 2-9: Ch 1, sc in each st around, join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off at end of Round 9. Beanie Rick Rack: With wrong side of brim facing, join B with sc in any st. Round 1: Work 2 sc in same st as join, skip next st, working around post of next st of Round 7 of brim, 3 FPsc around next st, *skip next st in round previously made, 3 sc in next st, skip next st, working around post of next st of Round 7 of brim, 3 FPsc around next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. PEPPERMINT CANDY (Make 7): With B, ch 4, join with slip st to form ring. Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, (sc in ring, ch 1) 6 times—6 sc and 6 ch-1 sps. Fasten off. Round 2: With right side facing, join C with slip st in any sc, *hdc in next ch-1 space, slip st in next sc; repeat from * 5 times; join with slip st in same sc as first join—6 hdc and 6 slip sts. Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first slip st, sc in back loop only of next hdc, *sc in next slip st, sc in back loop only of next hdc; repeat from * around, join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing. FINISHING: Sew 1 peppermint candy to center of bow. Using photograph as a guide, sew 6 candies evenly spaced under rick rack to wrong side of brim. Weave in ends. Block lightly, if necessary.

materials: Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Blanket: Approx 32" [81 cm] wide x 38" [96.5 cm] long.
gauge: 16 sts and 10½ rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
Pullover
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written thus ( ).
FRONT
With A, ch 38 (41-44-47).
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. 37 (40-43-46) sc. Turn.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 9 (10-11-11) sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * twice more. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. JoinMC.Turn. 40 (43-46-49) sts.
Proceed in pat as follows:
1st row: With MC, ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each sc across. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. Join A.Turn.
3rd row: With A, ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in first sc. *Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. *1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. 1 sc in last ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in last sc. Join MC. Turn.
5th row: With MC, ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in next sc. *2 dc in next ch-3 sp. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to turning ch 3. 2 dc in top of turning ch.
Turn.
These 2nd to 5th rows form pat.
Work a further 5 (9-9-13) rows in pat, ending on 2nd row of pat. Fasten off.
Shape armholes: Next row: (RS). Miss first 3 sc. Join A with sl st to next sc. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in same sc. *Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. Rep from * to last 6 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. Leave rem 3 sc unworked.
Cont even in pat on rem 34 ( 37-40-43) sts for 3 (7-7-11) more rows, ending on 2nd row of pat.
Shape neck: Left Side: 1st row: (RS). With A, ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in first sc. *Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. Rep from * 1 (1-2-2) time(s) more.Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 dc in next sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-3 sp. *Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. 1 sc in last ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in last sc. Join MC. Turn.
3rd row: With MC, ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in next sc. *2 dc in next ch-3 sp. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * 0 (0-1-1) time more. 1 dc in next ch-3 sp. Yoh and draw up a loop in same sp. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw up a loop in next sc. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw up a loop in top of ch 3. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through all 4 loops on hook – dc3tog made. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. Join A. Turn.
5th row: With A, ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in first sc. [Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc] 0 (0-1-1) time. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 dc in next sc. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first dc. (Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-3 sp) 1 (1-2-2) time(s). 1 hdc in last sc. Join MC. Turn.
7th row: With MC, ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in next sc. (2 dc in next ch-3 sp. 1 dc in next sc) 1 (1-2-2) time(s). Turn. 5 (5-8-8) sts.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. Fasten off.
Right Side: 1st row: With RS facing, miss center 8 (11-8-11) sc. Join A with sl st to next sc. Ch 3. *Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. Rep from * 2 (2-3-3) times more.Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. *1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. Rep from * 1 (1-2-2) time(s) more. 1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 2. 1 sc in next ch-3 sp. 1 dc in last ch-3 sp. Join MC. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. Yoh and draw up a loop next sc. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw up a loop in next ch-2 sp. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – dc2tog made. *1 dc in next sc. 2 dc in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * 1 (1-2-2) time(s) more. 2 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st across. Join A. Turn.
5th row: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in first sc. [Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc] 1 (1-2-2) time(s). Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
6th row: Ch 3. (1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3) 1 (1-2-2) time(s). 1 sc in last ch-3 sp. Join MC. Turn.
7th row: With MC, ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in next sc. (2 dc in next ch-3 sp. 1 dc in next sc) 1 (1-2-2) time(s). Turn. 5 (5-8-8) sts.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. Fasten off.
BACK
Work from ** to ** as given for Front.
Cont even in pat on rem 34 (37-40-43) sts until armhole measures same length as Front, ending on a 2nd row of pat. Fasten off.
SLEEVES
With A, ch 25 (28-31-34).
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch across. 24 (27-30-33) sts. Turn.
2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 11 (13-14-16) sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Join MC. Turn. 25 (28-31-34) sts.
Work from *** to *** as given for Front.
Shape sides: 1st row: (WS). Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each dc across to last dc. 2 sc in last dc. Join A. Turn.
2nd row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. *Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. Rep from * to last 4 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 5 (counts as hdc and ch 2). *1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. 1 sc in last ch-3 sp. Ch 2. Miss next sc. 1 hdc in last sc. Join MC. Turn.
4th row: With MC, ch 3 (counts as dc). 2 dc in next ch-2 sp. 1 dc in next sc. *2 dc in next ch-3 sp. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to turning ch. 3 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
5th row: As 1st row.
6th row: With A, ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in first sc. Miss next sc. *(1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 4 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
7th row: Ch 5 (counts as hdc and ch 2). *1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. 1 sc in last ch-3 sp. Ch 2. 1 hdc in last sc. Join MC. Turn.
8th row: With MC, as 4th row. Rep 1st to 4th rows once more.
Sizes 12 mos, 18 mos and 2 yrs only: Rep 5th to 8th rows once.
Size 2 yrs only: Rep 1st to 4th rows once more.
All sizes: 35 (48-51-60) sts.
Cont even in pat until Sleeve from beg measures 7½ (8½-10-11) [19 (21.5-25.5-28) cm]. Fasten off. Place markers on side edges of sleeves ¾" [2 cm] down from final row.
POCKET
With MC, ch 33 (33-36-36).
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each ch across. 31 (31-34-34) sts. Turn.
Beg with 2nd row, work 5 rows even in pat as given for Front.
Shape sides: 1st row: (RS). With A, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 2. *Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. Rep from * to last 6 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 2. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 sc in first ch-2 sp. *Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Rep from *, ending with 1 sc in last ch-3 sp. Ch 2. Miss next ch-2 sp. 1 hdc in last sc. Join MC. Turn.
3rd row: With MC, ch 3. 1 dc in next ch-2 sp counts as dc2tog). *1 dc in next sc. 2 dc in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. 1 dc in next ch-3 sp. Yoh and draw up a loop in same sp. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Yoh and draw up a loop in last sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – dc2tog made. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st across. Join A. Turn.
5th row: With A, ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in first sc. *Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
6th row: Ch 2. 1 sc in first ch-3 sp. *Ch 3. 1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. Ch 2.Miss last ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in last sc. Turn.
7th to 10th rows: As 3rd to 6th rows.
11th row: As 3rd row.
12th row: As 4th row.
Fasten off. 16 (16-19-19) sts.
FINISHING
Sew shoulder seams.
Neck edge: With RS facing, join A with sl st to left shoulder seam. Ch 1.Work 60 (63-63-68) sc evenly around neck edge. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next 3 rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Next rnd: Work 1 reverse sc (from Left to Right) in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.
Sew in sleeves placing rows above markers along unworked sts of Front and Back to form square armholes. Sew side and sleeve seams. Sew pocket to Front as shown in picture.
Blanket
Note: Blanket is worked lengthwise.
With MC, ch 150.
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each ch across. 148 sts. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc across. Join A.Turn.
3rd row: With A, ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in first sc. *Miss next 2 sc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. *1 sc in next ch-3 sp. Ch 3. Rep from * to last ch-3 sp. 1 sc in last ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in last sc. Join MC. Turn.
5th row: With MC, ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in next sc. *2 dc in next ch-3 sp. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to turning ch 3. 2 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
Rep rows 2 to 5 for pat until work from beg measures approx 31" [79 cm], ending on a 2nd row of pat. Fasten off.
Top Edging: 1st row: With RS facing, join MC with sl st to top right corner of Blanket. Ch 1.Work 1 row of sc evenly across top edge to opposite corner. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in each sc across. Fasten off.
Bottom Edging: Work as for Top edging, joining MC in bottom left corner.
Outer Edging: With RS facing, join A with sl st to bottom right corner of Blanket. Ch 1. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in same sp. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in side of next sc of Bottom edging. *(1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next rem loop of foundation ch. Miss next 2 loops. Rep from * across the side ending with: (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in last loop. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in side of next dc of Top edging. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in top of same dc. Miss next 2 sts. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next st. Rep from ** to ** to next corner dc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next corner dc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in side of same dc. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in next st of side. Rep from ** to **, ending with (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in last st. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in side of next dc of Bottom edging. (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in top of same dc. Rep from ** to ** across Bottom edging, ending with (1 sc. Ch 3. 1 dc) all in last st. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Baby Clouds™”: 6 skeins 9008 Cotton Candy A, 1 skein 9311 Cloud B
RED HEART® “Baby Clouds™”: 2 skeins 9724 Pink Lemonade A (or 9025 Blue Sky or 9311 Cloud)
RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein 312 Black B
Crochet Hooks: U.S. Sizes K-10½ [6½mm] and I-9 [5½ mm]
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B, etc.
measurements: Blanket measures 56” across outer points. Bear stands approximately 21” tall.
gauge: In pattern – Rnds 1 and 2 = 6” across not including ch-3 loops. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
With A, ch 6; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 3, 15 dc in ring; join with a slip st to top of ch-3 – 16 sts.
Rnd 2: Ch 3, dc in next dc, ch 3, [dc in next 2 dc, ch 3] 7 times; join to top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.
Rnd 3: Attach B in any ch-3 space. Ch 6 (counts as a dc and a ch-3 space), 3 dc in same space, [(3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) all in next ch-3 space] 7 times, 2 dc in first space; join to 3rd ch of ch-6. Fasten off.
Rnd 4: Attach A in ch-3 space after joining. Ch 6, 2 dc in same space, * dc in next 2 dc, skip next 2 dc **, dc in next 2 dc; (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in ch-3 space – corner made; repeat from * to last 2 sts, end at **; dc in next dc, dc in same ch as joining of previous rnd, dc in first space; join to 3rd ch of ch-6.
Rnd 5: Slip st in next ch of ch-6, slip st in space, ch 6, 2 dc in same space, * dc in next 3 dc, skip next 2 dc **, dc in next 3 dc, work corner; repeat from * to last 3 sts, end at **; dc in next 2 dc, dc in same ch as joining of previous rnd, dc in first space; join to 3rd ch of ch-6.
Rnd 6: Slip st in next ch of ch-6, slip st in space, ch 6, 2 dc in same space, * dc in next 4 dc, skip next 2 dc **, dc in next 4 dc, work corner; repeat from * to last 4 sts, end at **; dc in next 3 dc, dc in same ch as joining of previous rnd, dc in first space; join to 3rd ch of ch-6. Fasten off.
Rnd 7: Attach B in ch-3 space after joining. Ch 6, 2 dc in same space, * dc in next 5 dc, skip next 2 dc **, dc in next 5 dc, work corner; repeat from * to last 5 sts, end at **; dc in next 4 dc, dc in same ch as joining of previous rnd, dc in first space; join to 3rd ch of ch-6. Fasten off.
Rnd 8: Work same as Rnd 4 EXCEPT work 6 dc on each side of corner.
Rnd 9: Work same as Rnd 5 EXCEPT work 7 dc on each side of corner.
Rnd 10: Work same as Rnd 6 EXCEPT work 8 dc on each side of corner.
Rnd 11: Work same as Rnd 7 EXCEPT work 9 dc on each side of corner.
Rnd 12: Work same as Rnd 4 EXCEPT work 10 dc on each side of corner.
Rnd 13: Work same as Rnd 5 EXCEPT work 11 dc on each side of corner.
Rnd 14: Work same as Rnd 6 EXCEPT work 12 dc on each side of corner.
Rnd 15: Work same as Rnd 7 EXCEPT work 13 dc on each side of corner.
Rnd 16: Work same as Rnd 4 EXCEPT work 14 dc on each side of corner.
Rnd 17: Work same as Rnd 5 EXCEPT work 15 dc on each side of corner.
Rnd 18: Work same as Rnd 6 EXCEPT work 16 dc on each side of corner. Weave in ends.
Ears (Make 2)
With A and larger hook, ch 4; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; place a contrasting length of yarn between the last st and the next st to mark end of rnd. Do not join, but work in continuous rnds.
Rnd 2: 2 Sc in each sc around – 16 sc.
Rnds 3 and 4: Sc in each sc around.
Row 5: Fold ear in half, ch 1, working through both layers, work 8 sc across. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Muzzle
With A and larger hook, work same as Ears through Rnd 2.
Rnd 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 24 sc.
Rnds 4 and 5: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Nose
With B and smaller hook, ch 3; 5 hdc in 3rd ch from hook, ch 3, slip st in same ch. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing.
Eyes (Make 2)
With B and smaller hook, ch 2; 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing; tie ends together to round the eye.
Arms (Make 2)
With A and larger hook, work same as Ears through Rnd 2.
Rnds 3-14: Sc in each sc around. Stuff lightly and shape.
Wrist-Rnd 15: [Draw up a loop in next 2 sc, yo and draw yarn through all 3 loops on hook] 4 times, sc in next 8 sc – 12 sc.
Paw-Rnd 16: Sc in next 4 sc, [2 sc in next sc] 8 times – 20 sc.
Rnds 17-19: Sc in each sc around. Stuff lightly and shape.
Rnd 20: [Sc in next 3 sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 4 times – 16 sc.
Rnd 21: Sc in every other sc around – 8 sc.
Rnd 22: Slip st in every other sc around. Fasten off.
Legs (Make 2)
With A and larger hook, work same as Ears through Rnd 2.
Rnds 3-16: Sc in each sc around. Stuff lightly and shape.
Ankle-Rnd 17: [Draw up a loop in next 2 sc, yo and draw yarn through all 3 loops on hook] 4 times, sc in next 8 sc – 12 sc.
Rnd 18: [3 Sc in next sc] 4 times, sc in next 8 sc – 20 sc.
Rnds 19-22: Sc in each sc around. Stuff lightly and shape.
Rnds 23-25: Work same as Arms Rnds 20-22. Fasten off.
Optional-Toes: Stitch through paw with yarn, tighten and secure. Repeat twice more for 3 toes.
Head & Body
With A and larger hook, work same as Ears through Rnd 2.
Rnd 3: 2 sc in each sc around – 32 sc.
Rnds 4-13: Sc in each sc around.
Neck-Rnd 14: [Draw up a loop in next 2 sc, yo and draw yarn through all 3 loops on hook] 16 times – 16 sc.
Body-Rnd 15: 3 Sc in each sc around – 48 sc.
Rnds 16-28: Sc in each sc around.
Rnd 29: [Sc in next 6 sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 42 sc.
Rnd 30: [Sc in next 4 sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 7 times – 35 sc.
Rnd 31: [Sc in next 5 sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 5 times – 30 sc.
Rnd 32: [Sc in next 3 sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 24 sc. Stuff and shape head. Sew arms and legs onto body: leaving a 6” tail on outer side of arm or leg, stitch through limb and into body and back through limb several times at the same point (this method allows limbs to be movable), then tie yarn ends together in a knot; weave ends into arm or leg. Rnd 33: [Sc in next sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc] 8 times – 16 sc. Stuff body lightly and shape. Weave yarn through the stitches of Rnd 14 (neck), gathering neck to shape. Knot yarn ends together; weave in ends. Rnd 34: Sc in every other sc around – 8 sc. Rnd 35: Slip st in every other sc around. Fasten off.
Assembly
Cup ears and sew them to head. Sew muzzle in place onto head, stuffing lightly. With B in yarn needle, embroider mouth through the muzzle and the stuffing into the head to shape muzzle. Sew nose to muzzle above mouth. Sew eyes in place.

Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com

Crochet your huggable little guy a Prince

Round 4: Ch 1, (hdc in next 2 sts, 2 hdc in

Round 5: Ch 1, (hdc in next 3 sts, 2 hdc in

Rounds 7–15: Ch 1, hdc in each st; join with

Size Toddler only
Round 6: Ch 1, (hdc in next 4 sts, 2 hdc in 
next st) 10 times; join with slip st in first 
st—60 hdc.
Round 7: Ch 1, (hdc in next 29 sts, 2 hdc 
in next st) 2 times; join with slip st in first 
st—62 hdc. 
Rounds 8–17: Ch 1, hdc in each st; join with 
slip st in first st. Do not fasten off.
Size Child only
Round 6: Ch 1, (hdc in next 4 sts, 2 hdc in

Round 7: Ch 1, (hdc in next 5 sts, 2 hdc in 
next st) 10 times; join with slip st in first 
st—70 hdc. 
Rounds 8–19: Ch 1, hdc in each st; join with 
slip st in first st—70 hdc. Do not fasten off.
All sizes
Right Earflap
Row 1 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as first hdc 
here and throughout), skip next st, hdc in 
next 7 sts, skip next st, hdc in next; leave 
remaining sts unworked, turn—9 hdc.
Directions for hat are for size Baby. 
Changes for sizes Toddler and Child are in 
parentheses.

circumference at brim

Special Stitch 
Picot = Ch 3, slip st in 3rd ch from hook.
Special Technique
Adjustable-ring method—Wrap yarn in a 
ring, ensuring that the tail falls behind the 
working yarn. Grip ring and tail firmly between 
middle finger and thumb. Insert hook through 
center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) 
and draw up a loop. Work stitches of first 
round in the ring. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail 
to tighten ring when instructed.
Notes
1. Hat is worked from top down in joined
rounds with right side facing at all times.
2. Earflaps are worked back and forth in rows.
3. Pillow is made of 2 sides, each worked in
joined rounds. Bear features are made in
separate pieces and sewn to pillow.
HAT
Working from top down, with smaller hook and 
A, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1 (right side): Work 10 hdc in ring; 
join with slip st in top of first hdc—10 hdc. 
Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring. 
Place marker for beginning of round and move 
marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Ch 1 (does not count as a st here or 
throughout), 2 hdc in each st; join with slip st 
in first st—20 hdc.
Round 3: Ch 1, (hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st) 
10 times; join with slip st in first st—30 hdc.
pattern; 11 rows = 4” (10 cm).

hook to obtain the gauge.

Baby Steps®, Art. E746

What you will need:
RED HEART® Soft Baby Steps®: 2 
balls 9401 Elephant A, 1 ball each 
9200 Baby Yellow B and 9505 Aqua D
RED HEART® Soft®: 1 ball 4614 
Black C
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks:  
5mm [H-8 US] and 6mm [J-10 US].
Yarn needle, stitch markers,

GAUGE: 11 hdc = 3” (7.5 
cm) in pattern; 11 rows = 4” (10 cm)
ROWS 2, 4, and 6: Ch 1, sc in each st to 
beginning ch, sc in top of beginning ch, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, skip next st, hdc in next 5 sts, 
skip next st, hdc in next, turn—7 hdc.
Row 5: Ch 2, skip next st, hdc in next 3 sts, 
skip next st, hdc in next, turn—5 hdc.
Row 7: Ch 2, skip next st, hdc in next st, skip 
next st, hdc in next, turn—3 hdc. Fasten off. 
With right side of hat facing, place marker 
in 22nd (24th, 26th) st to the left of last st in 
Row 1.
Left Earflap
With smaller hook, join A with slip st in 
marked st.
Work same as Rows 1–7 of right earflap.
Border
Round 1: With smaller hook and right side 
facing, join A in any st at back of hat, ch 1, 
sc in same st as join and in each st around, 
working 3 sc in end of each row of earflap; 
join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. 
Ears (make 2)
With smaller hook, A, and leaving a long tail, 
make an adjustable ring, ch 2.
Row 1 (wrong side): Work 11 dc in ring 
(beginning ch counts as first dc), turn—12 dc. 
Row 2: Ch 1, hdc in each st around, with 
wrong side facing, ch 3, slip st through center 
of ring—12 hdc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail 
for sewing. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to 
tighten ring.
Crown
With B, ch 40; taking care not to twist ch, join 
with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc in each ch; join 
with slip st in first st—40 sc. Place marker for 
beginning of round and move marker up as 
each round is completed.
Round 2: [Slip st in next st, (sc, picot, sc) in 
next st] 20 times; join with slip st in first st. 
Fasten off.
Round 3: With right side facing, join D with 
slip st around post of any st in Round 1, slip st 
loosely around post of each st. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
With seam at center back, flatten hat and 
place stitch markers on each end of Round 7 
for placement of ears. With beginning and end 
tails, tie each ear to marked stitch.
With B, whipstitch crown to Round 4.
Braids
Cut 18 lengths of A, each measuring 25” (63.5 
cm). Separate into 6 hanks of 3 strands each. 
Thread 3 hanks through last row of earflap 
and fold over so strands are doubled. Braid 
doubled hanks until 4” (10 cm) of strands 
remain, tie an overhand knot tightly, and trim 
ends evenly. Repeat with remaining hanks for 
other earflap.
Weave in ends.
PILLOW 
Sides (make 2: 1 in A and 1 in C)
With larger hook and two strands yarn held 
together, make an adjustable loop, ch 1.
Work same as Rounds 1–7 of size Child hat.
Ears (make 2)
With larger hook, 2 strands of A held together, 
and leaving a long tail, make an adjustable 
ring, ch 2. 
Work same as Rows 1 and 2 of ears of hat.
Crown
With larger hook and 2 strands of B held 
together, ch 28; taking care not to twist ch, 
join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Work same as Rounds 1–3 of crown of hat.
Nose
With larger hook and C, make an adjustable 
loop, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 11 dc in ring 
(beginning ch counts as first dc); join with slip 
st in top of beginning ch—12 dc. Fasten off, 
leaving a 10” (25.5 cm) tail for sewing.
Eye (make 2)
With larger hook and C, make an adjustable 
loop, ch 1.
Round 1 (right side): Work 8 sc in ring; join 
with slip st in top of first st—8 sc. Fasten off, 
leaving a 10” (25.5 cm) tail for sewing.
FINISHING
Using photograph as a guide, sew eyes and 
nose to side A of pillow.
To form mouth, join C with slip st to lower 
center edge of nose, work 4 slip sts evenly 
down to Round 5. Fasten off. Join C with slip 
st between Rounds 4 and 5 around 5th st 
from either side of vertical stitching just made; 
working around sts along curve of the rounds, 
work 9 slip sts evenly—10 slip sts. Fasten off.
Border
With wrong sides together, larger hook, 2 
strands of A held together, and working 
through both thicknesses, join yarn with slip st 
to left lower end of sides, ch 1, sc in same st 
as join and in each st around; leave 20 sts at 
bottom unworked. 
Place marker in last stitch so it does not 
unravel, drop hook, and sew remaining pieces.
Center crown on top of pillow over border and 
sew in place.
Sew ears on each side of crown.
Stuff pillow with fiberfill.
Sc in remaining sts of border; join with slip st 
in first sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® "Soft Baby®", Art.E705 (7 ounce/575 yard solid; 6 ounce/430 yard print, multicolor and twinkle skeins)
