Weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® 1000 g™ (35 oz/1000 g; 1856 yds/1698 m)
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
measurements: Sizes Child Adult Small Adult Large. Hat: 18¼" [46.5 cm] 19½" [49.5 cm] 21" [53.5 cm] around. Mittens: 6 x 7½" [15 x 19 cm] 7½ x 11½" [19 x 29 cm] 9½ x 12" [24 x 30.5 cm] circumference x length. Scarf: Approx 7" [18 cm] x 72" [183 cm], excluding fringe.
gauge: 12 sc and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook. 14 sc and 16 rnds = 4" [10 cm] with smaller hook.
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written Child ( Adult S - Adult L ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes.
SCARF
With larger hook, ch 24.
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 22 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Repeat 2nd row until Scarf measures 72" [183 cm]. Fasten off.
Fringe: Cut 90 lengths of yarn 10" [25.5 cm] long. Divide into 18 groups of 5 strands each - 9 groups for each end of Scarf.
Spacing fringe groups evenly along short ends of Scarf, fold a fringe group in half to form a loop. Draw center of fringe group through end of Scarf, using crochet hook if desired. Thread fringe tails through loop and tighten to secure. Rep for each group of fringe. Trim fringe ends evenly.
HAT
Cuff: With larger hook ch 64 ( 68-74). Join with sl st to first ch, taking care chain is not twisted.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st in back loop of first sc. Turn. 64 ( 68-74) sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc around. Join with sl st in back loop of first sc. Turn.
Rep 2nd rnd until work from beg measures 5 ( 5½-5½)" [ 12.5 ( 14-14) cm] slightly stretched. Do not turn at end of last rnd.
Crown: Change to smaller hook.
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: (RS) Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Do not turn.
Rep last rnd until work from beg measures 9 ( 10-10)" [ 23 ( 25.5-25.5) cm], decreasing 0 ( 0-2) sc on last round. 64 ( 68-72) sc.
Shape Top: 1st rnd: Ch 1. [Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 11 ( 12-13) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc] 4 times. Join. 56 ( 60-64) sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. [Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 ( 10-11) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc] 4 times. Join. 48 ( 52-56) sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. [Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 7 ( 8-9) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc] 4 times. Join. 40 ( 44-48) sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. [Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 ( 6-7) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc] 4 times. Join. 32 ( 36-40) sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. [Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 ( 4-5) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc] 4 times. Join. 24 ( 28-32) sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. [Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 1 ( 2-3) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc] 4 times. Join. 16 ( 20-24) sts.
Adult Small and Adult Large Sizes Only: Next rnd: Ch 1. [Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next ( 0-1) sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc] 4 times. Join. ( 12-16) sts.
All Sizes: Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off, leaving a long end. Weave end through rem sts and draw up tightly. Fasten securely.
MITTENS
Cuff: With smaller hook, ch 15 ( 21-24).
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. 14 ( 20-23) sc. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row 16 ( 20-22) times more. Join 1st and last rows of Cuff using flat sl st join through both thicknesses. Note: Keep working yarn to WS of work so only flat sl st chain is visible on RS. Do not fasten off.
FLAT SL ST JOINING DIAGRAM
Hand: 1st rnd: Working into row ends on Cuff, work 18 ( 22-26) sl sts loosely evenly around. Join with sl st to first st.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. [1 sc in each of next 8 ( 10-12) sts. 2 sc in next st] twice. Join. 20 ( 24-28) sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. [1 sc in each of next 9 ( 11-13) sc. 2 sc in next sc] twice. Join. 22 ( 26-30) sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. [1 sc in each of next 10 ( 12-14) sc. 2 sc in next sc] twice. Join. 24 ( 28-32) sc.
Adult Small and Adult Large sizes only: 5th rnd: Ch 1. [1 sc in each of next ( 13-15) sc. 2 sc in next sc] twice. Join. ( 30-34) sc.
Adult Large size only: 6th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 16 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. Join. 36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 17 sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. Join. 38 sc.
All sizes: Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Rep last rnd 0 ( 2-2) times more. Thumb Opening: Next rnd: Ch 1. [1 sc in next 20 ( 26-32) sc. Ch 4 ( 5-6). Skip rem sts. Join with slip st to first sc. Upper Hand: Note: Upper Hand is worked in continuous rnds. Do not join. PM at end of each rnd to keep count.
Next rnd: 1 sc in each st around. Rep last rnd 7 ( 8-11) times more. 24 ( 31-38) sc.
Adult Small size only: Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc around. 30 sts.
All Sizes: Upper Hand Shaping 1st rnd: [1 sc in each of next 10 ( 13-17) sc. Sc2tog] twice. 22 ( 28-36) sts.
2nd rnd: [1 sc in each of next 9 ( 12-16) sc. Sc2tog] twice. 20 ( 26-34) sts.
3rd rnd: [1 sc in each of next 8 ( 11-15) sc. Sc2tog] twice. 18 ( 24-32) sts.
4th rnd: [1 sc in each of next 7 ( 10-14) sc. Sc2tog] twice. 16 ( 22-30) sts.
Adult Small and Adult Large sizes only: 5th rnd: 1 sc in each st around.
6th rnd: [1 sc in each of next ( 9-13) sc. Sc2tog] twice. ( 20-28) sts.
Next rnd: (Sc2tog) ( 10-14) times. All sizes: Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 8 ( 5-7) times. Fasten off. Weave end through rem sts and draw up tightly. Fasten securely.
Thumb: 1st rnd: With RS facing, join yarn with sl st, to thumb opening, closest to Upper Hand. Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. 8 ( 9-12) sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join.
Rep 2nd rnd 3 ( 6-7) times more. Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join. 6 ( 7-10) sts.
Final rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 3 ( 3-5) times. 1 sc in last 0 ( 1-0) sc. Join. 3 ( 4-5) sts. Fasten off. Weave end through rem sts and draw up tightly. Fasten securely.

materials: 3 cm [¾”] wide waistband elastic, length as required
matching sturdy thread for elastic casing
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: 12 Fdc = 10 cm [4”]; In shell pattern of yoke, 2 shells = 7.5 cm [3]”; 4 rows = 6.5 cm [2½”]; In shell pattern of body, 2 repeats of shell, ch-4 = 10 cm [4”]; 2 repeats of shell, ch-5 = 11.5 cm [4½”]; 5 rows shell over shell = 10 cm [4”]; Pineapple Lace, at Round 22 (before completing individual points), one repeat = 16.5 [6½”]
instructions:
Round 1 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, dc in same dc as joining, [dc in next dc, ch 5, skip next 2 dc, dc in next dc] 19 (21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 31) times, dc in next dc, skip next 2 dc, (ch 3, htr in first dc) to join and form last space; TURN – 20 (22, 24, 26, 28, 30, 32) spaces.
Round 2 (Right Side): Ch 3, tr in first space, [Sh in next space] 19 (21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 31) times, 2 tr in same space as beginning, (ch 1, dc in top of ch-3) to join and form last space and complete last shell; turn – 20 (22, 24, 26, 28, 30, 32) shells.
Round 3: Ch 1, 2 dc in first space, [ch 5, 2 dc in next ch-2 space] 19 (21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 31) times, (ch 3, htr in first dc) to join and form last space; turn.
Rounds 4-7: Repeat Rounds 2-3 twice more.
Skirt Hip/ Poncho Shoulder
Round 8: Ch 3, tr in first space – begin round made; [ch 1, Sh in next ch-space] 19 (21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 31) times, ch 1, 2 tr in same space as beginning, (ch 1, dc in top of ch-3) to join and form last space and complete last shell; turn.
Round 9: Begin round, [ch 2, SOS] 19 (21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 31) times, ch 2; 2 tr in same space as beginning, ch 1, dc in top of ch-3; turn – end round made.
Round 10: Begin round, [ch 3, SOS] 19 (21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 31) times, ch 3, end round.
Round 11: Begin round, [ch 4, SOS] 19 (21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 31) times, ch 4, end round.
Note: To shorten or lengthen skirt, omit or add repeats of Round 11 (to hip) and/or Round 14 (to mid-thigh) before beginning pineapple lace, end by working a Round 14.
Rounds 12-13: Repeat Round 11 twice (or for length desired).

Round 14: Begin round, [ch 5, SOS] 19 (21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 31) times, ch 5, end round.
Rounds 15-16: Repeat Round 14 twice (or for length desired).
Pineapple Lace-Round 17: Begin round, * ch 3, tr in next ch-5 space, ch 3, SOS, ch 5 **, SOS; repeat from * around, end at **; end round – 10 (11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16) repeats.
Round 18: Begin round, * ch 4, SOS, skip next ch-3 space, ch 3, 2 tr in next tr, ch 3 **, SOS; repeat from * around, end at **; end round.
Round 19: Begin round, * ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, [2 tr in next tr] twice, ch 3, SOS, ch 3 **, SOS; repeat from * around, end at **; end round.
Round 20: Begin round, * ch 3, SOS, ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, [2 tr in next tr] 4 times, ch 3 **, SOS; repeat from * around, end at **; end round.
Round 21: Begin round, * ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, tr in next tr, [ch 1, tr in next tr] 7 times, ch 3, SOS, ch 1 **, SOS; repeat from * around, end at **; end round.
Round 22: Begin round, * ch 1, SOS, [ch 3, dcin next ch-1 space] 7 times, ch 3 **, SOS; repeat from * around, end at **; end round.

Pineapple Points (Complete each point separately)
First Point-Row 1 (Wrong Side): Ch 3, (tr, ch 2, 2 tr) all in first space, ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, [dc in next ch-3 space, ch 3] 6 times, SOS; TURN.
Row 2: Ch 2, SOS, ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, [dc in next ch-3 space, ch 3] 5 times, SOS; turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, SOS, ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, [dc in next ch-3 space, ch 3] 4 times, SOS; turn.
Row 4: Ch 2, SOS, ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, [dc in next ch-3 space, ch 3] 3 times, SOS; turn.
Row 5: Ch 2, SOS, ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, [dc in next ch-3 space, ch 3] twice, SOS; turn.
Row 6: Ch 2, SOS, ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, dcin next ch-3 space, ch 3, SOS; turn.
Row 7: Ch 2, SOS, ch 1, SOS; turn.
Row 8: Ch 2, 2 tr in ch-2 space of first shell, 2 tr in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 2, slip st in next tr of shell. Fasten off.
For remaining 9 (10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15) pineapple points; with wrong side of skirt facing, join yarn in ch-2 space of next shell and repeat Rows 1-8 of First Point.

Waistband
Round 1: With right side facing, join yarn in any ch of foundation at waist; ch 1, dc in same ch, dc in each ch around; join in first dc; turn.
Rounds 2-5: Ch 1, dc in each dc around; join; turn. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

Elastic
Cut waistband elastic to fit waist plus a few cm [inches] overlap. Secure thread around the stem of any dc of Round 1 of waistband on the wrong side. Holding elastic along inside of waistband, moving from left to right, make a herringbone stitch casing: Skip the dc of Round 5 directly above beginning dc of Round 1, insert needle around post of next dc of Round 5, make a backstitch; skip next dc of Round 1, backstitch around post of next dc; skip next dc of Round 5, backstitch around post of next dc, working over elastic each time, careful not to catch elastic, sliding elastic as you go as needed to distribute fullness of waistband all around. End with backstitch in same dc as beginning. Secure and cut thread. Overlap ends of elastic and sew together securely.

materials: Red Heart® Baby TLC™:  5 (6) balls 5011 White.
Crochet Hooks: 4mm [US G-6] and 5mm [US H-8] for garments, and 5.5mm [US I-9] for blanket.
1 yd, ¼” wide white ribbon, four ⅜” buttons (for garments), yarn needle.
abbreviations: () = work directions in parentheses into same st
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Blanket measures 34” x 34”. To Fit: 17 (18)”; Finished Chest: 19 (20)”; Finished Length: 22½ (24)”
gauge: 17 sts = 4”; 24 rows = 4” in single crochet with smallest hook; 2 (ch 3, 3 dc, sc) pattern repeats = 3”; 6 rows = 2¼” in lace pattern with middle-sized hook; 14 sts = 4”; 7 rounds = 4” with 2 strands held together and largest hook (for blanket). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hooks to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
GOWN BODICE
With smallest hook, ch 82 (86).
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—81 (85) sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Divide for Backs and Front
First Half of Back
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, sc in first 17 (18) sc, turn; leave remaining sts unworked for armholes, front and second half of back—17 (18) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across, turn—16 (17) sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—15 (16) sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Repeat last row until piece measures 4” from beginning, end with a Wrong Side row.
Shape Shoulder
Next Row (Right Side): Ch 1, sc in first 5 sc, turn; leave remaining sts unworked—5 sc.
Next 2 Rows: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off.

FRONT
Row 1 (Wrong Side): With Wrong Side facing, skip next 6 unworked sc (for armhole) following first half of back, join yarn with sc in next st, sc in next 34 (36) sc, turn; leave remaining sts unworked for second armhole and half of back—35 (37) sc.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—31 (33) sc at the end of Row 3.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Repeat last row until front measures 3” from beginning, end with a Wrong Side row.
Divide for Neck
First Shoulder
Next Row (Right Side): Ch 1, sc in first 10 (11) sc for first shoulder, turn; leave remaining sts unworked for neck and second shoulder—10 (11) sc.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across, turn—9 (10) sc.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—8 (9) sc.
Repeat last 2 rows until 5 sc remain.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Repeat last row until piece measures same as back.
Fasten off.

Second Shoulder
Next Row (Right Side): Skip next 11 unworked sc following first shoulder (for neck), join yarn with sc in next sc, sc in each remaining sc across—10 (11) sc.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—9 (10) sc.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across, turn—9 (10) sc.
Repeat last 2 rows until 5 sc remain.
Next Row: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Repeat last row until piece measures same as back.
Fasten off.

Second Half of Back
Row 1 (Wrong Side): With Wrong Side facing, skip next 6 unworked sc (for armhole) following front, join yarn with sc in next sc, sc in each remaining sc across, turn—17 (18) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across to last 2 sc, sc2tog, turn—16 (17) sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each sc across, turn—15 (16) sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Repeat last row until piece measures 4” from beginning, end with a Wrong Side row. Fasten off.

Shape Shoulder
Next Row (Right Side): With Right Side facing, skip first 10 (11) sc, join yarn with sc in next sc, sc in each remaining sc across, turn—5 sc.
Next 2 Rows: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off.

Sew shoulder seams.

SKIRT
Row 1 (Wrong Side): With Wrong Side facing and smallest hook, working across opposite side of bodice foundation ch, join yarn with sc in first ch, sc in each ch across, turn—81 (85) sc.
Row 2: Ch 3, 3 dc in first sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc, [ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, skip next sc, sc in next sc, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc] 11 times, [ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, skip next 2 sc, sc in next sc] 0 (1) time(s), turn—23 (24) 3-dc groups.
Change to middle-sized hook.
Rows 3–5: Ch 3, 3 dc in first sc, sc in next ch-3 space, *ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * across, turn.

Work now proceeds in rounds.
Round 6 (Right Side): Ch 3 (counts as dc), 2 dc in first sc, sc in next ch-3 space, *ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * across, ch 3; join piece into a round by working a slip st in top of first ch-3, turn.
Round 7: Ch 1, *sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc, turn.
Round 8: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 2 dc in same sc as join, sc in next ch-3 space, *ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around, ch 3; join with slip st in top of first ch-3, turn.
Repeat last 2 rounds until skirt measures 18 (19½)” from bodice, end with a Wrong Side row.

Edging Round (Right Side): Ch 3, 4 dc in same sc as join, sc in next ch-3 space, *5 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of first ch-3. Fasten off.

SLEEVES (make 2)
Beginning at top of sleeve, with middle-sized hook, ch 12.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, [ch 3, 3 dc in next ch, sc in next ch] 5 times, turn—Five 3-dc groups.
Row 2: Ch 4, 3 dc in first sc, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 5 times, tr in same sc as last 3 dc, turn—6 groups.
Row 3: Ch 4, 3 dc in space between tr and next dc, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 5 times, (sc, ch 3, 3 dc, tr) in last ch-4 space, turn—7 groups.
Row 4: Ch 4, 3 dc between tr and next dc, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 6 times, (sc, ch 3, 3 dc, tr) in last ch-4 space, turn—8 groups.
Row 5: Ch 3, 3 dc between tr and next dc, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 7 times, (sc, ch 3, 3 dc, tr) in last ch-4 space, turn—9 groups.
Row 6: Ch 3, 3 dc between tr and next dc, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 8 times, sc in last ch-3 space, turn—9 groups.
Rows 7 and 8: Ch 3, 3 dc in first sc, sc in next ch-3 space, *ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * across, turn.
Row 9: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 3 dc in first sc, [2 sc in next ch-3 space, 3 dc in next sc] 8 times, sc in top of first ch-3, turn—45 sts.

Cuff
Change to smallest hook.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in first st, *skip next st, sc in next st; repeat from * across, turn—23 sc.
Rows 11–13: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew side edges of cuff together (only sew the cuff seam). Place seam of one sleeve at center of underarm of bodice, and sew sleeve in place, easing cap to fit. Repeat to sew in other sleeve.

Buttonband
Row 1: With Right Side facing and smallest hook, join yarn with sc to work across right edge of back opening, sc evenly spaced across right back edge, turn.
Rows 2 and 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off.

Buttonhole band
Row 1: With Right Side facing and smallest hook, join yarn with sc to work across left edge of back opening, sc evenly spaced across left back edge, turn. Place 4 markers evenly spaced across Row 1, for buttonhole placement. Place first marker near top of back opening, next marker near bottom of back opening and remaining 2 markers evenly spaced between the first two.
Row 2 (buttonhole): Ch 1, [sc in each sc to next marker, ch 2, skip marked sc] 4 times, sc in each remaining sc across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, [sc in each sc to one sc before next ch-2 space, skip sc before ch-2 space, 2 sc in ch-2 space] 4 times, sc in each remaining sc across. Fasten off.

Neck Edging
Row 1: With Right Side facing, join yarn with sc at beginning of neck edge, sc evenly spaced across neck edge. Fasten off.

Overlap buttonhole band over button band and sew bottom of bands together and to lower edge of back opening. Weave in ends. Sew buttons opposite buttonholes.

BONNET
With middle-sized hook, ch 5; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 17 dc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—18 dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in same st as join, 2 dc in each dc around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—36 dc.
Row 3: Ch 3, 3 dc in same st as join, skip next dc, sc in next dc, *ch 3, skip next dc, 3 dc in next dc, skip next dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * across to last dc, turn; leave last dc unworked, do not join—Nine 3-dc groups.
Row 4: Ch 3, 3 dc in first sc, sc in next ch-3 space, *ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * across, turn.
Repeat last row until piece measures 6 (6½)” from center of ring, end with a Wrong Side row.
Next Row: Ch 3, 4 dc in first sc, sc in next ch-3 space, *5 dc in next sc, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * across; rotate piece to work across side edges (for neckband), ch 1, sc in end of each row down side edge, sc in unworked dc of Round 2, sc in end of each row up other side edge, turn.
Next 2 Rows: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Weave in ends. Sew ½ yd of ribbon to each front corner of bonnet, for ties.

BLANKET
With 2 strands held together and largest hook, ch 5; join with slip st to form a ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 2 dc in ring, [ch 2, 3 dc in ring] 3 times ch 2; join with slip st in top of beginning ch, turn—Four 3-dc groups.
Round 2 (Wrong Side): Ch 3, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in first ch-2 space (corner made), [dc in each dc to next ch-2 space, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in ch-2 space (corner made)] 3 times, dc in next 2 dc; join with slip st in top of beginning ch, turn—7 dc across each side.
Rounds 3–14: Ch 3, [dc in each dc to next corner ch-2 space, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in ch-2 space] 4 times, dc in each dc to end of round; join with slip st in top of beginning ch, turn—55 dc across each side at end of Round 14.
Begin Lace
Round 15: Ch 1, skip ch-3 of join, *sc in next dc, ch 3, skip next 2 dc, 3 dc in next dc**, skip next 2 dc; repeat from * to next corner ch-2 space, ending last repeat at **, (sc, [ch 3, sc] twice) in corner ch-2 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next dc, skip next 2 dc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in first sc, turn—48 ch-3 spaces.
Round 16: Ch 3, 2 dc in same sc as join, *sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3 **, 3 dc in next sc; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with slip st in top of beginning ch, turn.
Round 17: Ch 1, *sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc, turn.
Round 18: Repeat Round 16.
Round 19: Ch 1, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 6 times, *(sc, [ch 3, sc] twice) in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 11 times; repeat from * around, working sts in last brackets 5 times instead of 11 times; join with slip st in first sc, turn—56 ch-3 sps.
Rounds 20–22: Repeat Rounds 16 and 17, then repeat Round 16 once more.
Round 23: Ch 1, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 7 times, *(sc, [ch 3, sc] twice) in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 13 times; repeat from * around, working sts in last brackets 6 times instead of 13 times; join with slip st in first sc, turn—64 ch-3 sps.
Rounds 24-26: Repeat Rounds 20-22.
Round 27: Ch 1, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 8 times, *(sc, [ch 3, sc] twice) in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 15 times; repeat from * around, working sts in last brackets 7 times instead of 15 times; join with slip st in first sc, turn—72 ch-3 sps.
Rounds 28-30: Repeat Rounds 20–22.
Round 31: Ch 1, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 9 times, *(sc, [ch 3, sc] twice) in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc, [sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, 3 dc in next sc] 17 times; repeat from * around, working sts in last brackets 8 times instead of 17 times; join with slip st in first sc, turn—80 ch-3 sps.
Rounds 32-24: Repeat Rounds 20–22.
Round 35: Ch 1, *sc in next ch-3 space, 5 dc in next sc; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 312 Black A, 356 Amethyst B, 316 Soft White C, and 400 Grey Heather D
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
( ) = work directions in parentheses in same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Blanket measures: 24” x 24” (30” x 30”, 36” x 36”) [61 x 61 (76 x 76, 91.5 x 91.5) cm], without border. Hat measures: 14 (16, 18, 20)” [35.5, (40.5, 45.5, 51) cm] circumference at brim.
gauge: 12 dc = 4” (10 cm) in pattern; check your gauge. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BLANKET
With A, ch 74 (92, 110).
Row 1 (wrong side): Dc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch counts as first dc) and in each ch across, turn—72 (90, 108) sts.
Row 2: Ch 2 (does not count as a st here and throughout), dc in first st, [skip next st, dc in next st, working in front of st just made, dc in skipped st] 35 (44, 53) times, dc in top of beginning ch; change to B, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, dc in each st across.
Row 4: Ch 2, dc in first st, [skip next stitch, dc in next stitch, working in front of stitch just made, dc in skipped stitch] 35 (44, 53) times, dc in last st; change to C in last st, turn.
Rows 5–40 (48, 56): Repeat Rows 3 and 4 twenty (twenty-four, twenty-eight) times and change color as in the following color sequence: Work 2 rows with C, 2 rows with D, *2 rows with A, 2 rows with B, 2 rows with C, 2 rows with D; repeat from * 3 (4, 5) times. Change to A in last st of Row 40 (48, 56).
Sizes Small and Medium only
Rows 41 (49) and 42 (50): Repeat Rows 3 and 4 once more.
Fasten off.
Size Large only
Rows 57–62: Repeat Rows 3 and 4 three times more and change color as in the following color sequence: Work 2 rows with A, 2 rows with B, 2 rows with C.
Fasten off.
Border
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, join D with sc in first st of last row, 2 sc in same st, sc in each st across to last st, 3 sc in last st; working in ends of rows of first side, *4 sc in next even-numbered row, skip next odd-numbered row; repeat from * to first row; working across opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in each ch across to last ch, 3 sc in last ch; working in ends of rows of other side, **skip next odd-numbered row, 4 sc in next even-numbered row; repeat from ** to first sc; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
HAT
With A, make an adjustable ring, ch 1.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2 (counts as first dc here and throughout), work 11 dc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—12 sts. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Ch 2, dc in same st as join, 2 dc in each st; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—24 sts.
Round 3: Ch 2, dc in same st as join, dc in next st, [2 dc in next st, dc in next st] 11 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—36 sts.
Round 4: Ch 2, dc in same st as join, dc in next 2 sts, [2 dc in next st, dc in next 2 sts] 11 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—48 sts.
Sizes Medium, Large, and Extra Large only
Round 5: Ch 2, same st as join, dc in next 7 (3, 3) sts, [2 dc in next st, dc in next 7 (3, 3) sts] 5 (11, 11) times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—54 (60, 60) sts.
Size Extra Large only
Round 6: Ch 2, same st as join, dc in next 9 sts, [2 dc in next st, dc in next 9 sts] 9 times; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—66 sts.
All sizes
Round 5 (6, 6, 7): Ch 1, sc in each st around; change to B; join with slip st in first sc—48 (54, 60, 66) sts.
Round 6 (7, 7, 8): Ch 2, dc in the last st of previous round, [skip next stitch, dc in next stitch, working in front of stitch just made, dc in skipped stitch] 23 (26, 29, 32) times; change to A; join with slip st in top of beginning ch.
Round 7 (8, 8, 9): Repeat Round 5 (6, 6, 7); change to C.
Round 8 (9, 9, 10): Repeat Round 6 (7, 7, 8).
Round 9 (10, 10, 11): Repeat Round 5 (6, 6, 7); change to D.
Round 10 (11, 11, 12): Repeat Round 6 (7, 7, 8).
Round 11 (12, 12, 13): Repeat Round 5 (6, 6, 7).
Round 12 (13, 13, 14): Ch 2, dc in each st around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Do not fasten off.
Sizes Large and Extra Large only
Round 14 (15): Repeat Round 13 (14). Do not fasten off.
Earflaps
Note: Continue in rows.
Right Earflap
Row 1: Ch 2, skip next st, dc in next 7 (9, 9, 9) sts, skip next st, dc in next st; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—9 (11, 11, 11) sts.
Row 2: Ch 2, skip next st, dc in next 5 (7, 7, 7) sts, skip next st, dc in the last st—7 (9, 9, 9) sts.
Row 3: Ch 2, skip next st, dc in next 3 (5, 5, 5) sts, skip next st, dc in the last st—5 (7, 7, 7) sts.
Row 4: Ch 2, skip next st, dc in next 1 (3, 3, 3) st(s), skip next st, dc in the last st—3 (5, 5, 5) sts.
Size Small only
Fasten off.
Sizes Medium, Large, and Extra Large only
Row 5: Ch 2, skip next st, dc in next st, skip next st, dc in the last st—3 (3, 3) dc. Fasten off.
Left Earflap
With right side facing, join A with slip st in 18th (20th, 22nd, 24th) st to the left of last st of right earflap. Work same as right earflap.
Border
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing, join D with sc in any st at center back of hat, sc in each st around, working 2 sc in ends of each row of ear flaps; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Anne Geddes Baby™: 2 balls of 100 Lily A; 1 ball each of 112 Night Night B, 902 Ladybug C and 691 Grass D
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 4.25 mm [US G-6]
Yarn needle, stitch marker and three ½” (13mm) sew-on snaps.
abbreviations: A, B, C, D = color A, B, C, D
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Finished Chest: 20 (22, 24)” (51 [56, 61] cm), Finished Length: 9 (10½, 12)” (23 [26.5, 30.5) cm), Hat: To fit head size 15 (17)” (38 [43] cm)
gauge: 14 sts and 16 rows in Puff Stitch Pattern = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
Body
With A, ch 70 (78, 86)
Set-up Row: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch across turn – 69 (77, 85) sc. 
Work even in patt until body measures 5 (6, 7)” (12.5 [15, 18] cm) from beginning, ending with a wrong side row.
Divide for Fronts and Back
Right Front
Row 1: Work in patt across first 17 (19, 21) sts, turn. 
Work even in patt on 17 (19, 21) sts until front measures 2 (2½, 3)” (5 [ 6.5, 7.5] cm), ending with a right side row. 
Shape Neck
Next Row: Work in patt across to last 8 sts, turn, leaving remaining sts unworked – 9 (11, 13) sts.
Work even on 9 (11, 13) sts until Right Front measures 4 (4½, 5)” (10 [11.5, 12.5] cm) from beginning of armhole. Fasten off.
Back
Row 1: With right side facing, join A with a slip st in first st to the left of Row 1 of Right Front, work in established patt across first 35 (39, 43) sts, turn, leaving remaining sts unworked.
Work even on 35 (39, 43) sts, until Back measures 4 (4½, 5)” from beginning of armhole. Fasten off.
Left Front
Row 1: With right side facing, join A with a slip st in first st to the left of Row 1 of Back, work in established patt across last 17 (19, 21) sts, turn. 
Work even in patt on 17 (19, 21) sts until Left Front measures 2 (2½, 3)” (5 [ 6.5, 7.5] cm), ending with a wrong side row.
Sweater directions are for child’s size 6 months. Changes for 12 months and 18 months are in parentheses. 
Hat directions are for size Small. Changes for Large are in parentheses.
Sweater is worked in one piece to underarm, then divided into fronts and back.
Puff St Pattern (patt)
(Worked on a multiple of 4 + 1 sts). 
Ch a multiple of 4 + 1 + 1 (for turning ch).
Set-up Row: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch across turn.
Row 1 (wrong side): Ch 1, sc in each of first 3 sc, *puff st in next sc**, sc in each of next 3 sts; repeat from * across, ending last repeat at **, sc in last ch, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *puff in next sc, sc in each of next 3 sc; repeat from * across, turn.
Row 4: Repeat Row 2.
Repeat Rows 1-4 for patt.
Sew Fronts to Back at shoulders.
Sleeve (make 2)
With A, ch 22 (22, 26). 
Set-up Row: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch across turn – 21 (21, 25) sc. 
Work in patt, inc 1 st at each end of every 4th row 4 (6, 7) times. Then, work even in patt on 29 (33, 39) sts until Sleeve measures 6 (7, 8)” (15 [18, 20.5] cm) from beginning. Fasten off, leaving a long sewing length. Sew Sleeve seams. Sew top of Sleeves into armholes.
Left Front Band
Row 1: With right side facing, join A with a slip st to top left-hand corner of Left Front edge, ch 1, work 27 (33, 38) sc evenly space across to bottom edge, turn. 
Rows 2-4: Ch1, sc in each st across, turn. 
Fasten off. 
Right Front Band
Row 1: With right side facing, join A with a slip st to bottom right-hand corner of Right Front edge, ch 1, work 27 (33, 38) sc evenly space across to neck shaping, turn. 
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn. Fasten off. 
Edging
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in each st across Right Front to neck, 2 sc in corner st, sc evenly around neck edge, 2 sc in corner st, sc in each st across Left Front edge to bottom edge. Turn. 
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across Left Front to neck, 2 sc in corner st, sc evenly around neck edge, 2 sc in corner st, sc in each st across Right Front edge to bottom edge. Fasten off.
Big Black Buttons (make 3)
With B, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, do not join, work in a spiral. Mark beginning of each round, moving marker up as work progresses. 
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around – 12 sc.
Round 3: Sc in each sc around.
Round 4: [Sc2tog over next 2 sts] around – 6 sts. Fasten off, leaving a 12” (30.5 cm) sewing length. Thread sewing length onto yarn needle. Run through top of sts in last round and gather.
FINISHING
With Right Front Band over left for girls and Left Front Band over Right for boys, sew snaps to appropriate front band starting 1” (2.5 cm) below neck edge, and spacing remaining snaps 2 (2½, 3)” (5 [6.5, 7.5] cm) apart down front band. Sew one Button over each snap on top band.
HAT
Back
With A, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook, do not join, work in a spiral. Mark beginning of each round, moving marker up as work progresses. 
Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around – 16 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 24 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in each of next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 32 sc.
Round 5: *Sc in each of next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 40 sc.
Round 6: *Sc in each of next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 48 sc.
Round 7: *Sc in each of next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 56 sc.
Round 8: *Sc in each of next 6 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 64 sc.
Round 9: *Sc in each of next 7 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 72 sc. Do not fasten off.
Size L Only
Round 10: *Sc in each of next 8 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around – 80 sc. Do not fasten off.
All Sizes
Sides
Work now progresses in rows.
Row 1 (wrong side): Ch 1, turn, sc in each of first 53 (61) sts, turn, leaving remaining sts unworked.
Work even in patt until Sides measure 5 (6)” (12.5 [15] cm) from beginning. Fasten off A.
Attached Scarf
Row 1: With C, ch 32, with right side of Bonnet facing, *working across side edge of Side, [sc2tog over next 2 row-end sts]*; repeat from * to * across to back neck edge, starting in base of last st worked, [sc2tog over next 2 sts], then work [sc2tog over next 2 sts] 9 times across back neck, repeat from * to * across other side edge of Sides, ch 33, turn.
Row 2 (wrong side): With C, hdc in 3rd ch from hook, hdc in each ch and st across – 94 (98) hdc. Drop C to be picked up later. Do not turn.
Row 3: With wrong side facing, join D with a slip st in beginning ch-2 of Row 2, ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), hdc in each st across, turn. Drop D to be picked up later. 
Row 4 (right side): Pick up C through last st of previous row, ch 2, hdc in each st across. Drop C to be picked up later. Do not turn.
Row 5: Pick up D through last st of previous row, ch 2, hdc in each st across, turn. Drop D to be picked up later. 
Repeat Rows 4-5 once, then repeat Row 3 once. Fasten off C and D. Weave in ends.
BOOTS (make 2)
Cuff
With A, ch 24, and without twisting ch, join into a ring with a slip st in first ch. 
Round 1: Ch 2, hdc in each ch around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2 – 24 hdc. 
Round 2: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2.
Repeat Round 2 until cuff measures 4” (10 cm) from beginning. Fasten off A.
Foot
Round 1: With right side facing, skip first 8 sts, join C with a slip st in next st, ch 1, sc in each st around; join with a slip st in first sc – 24 sc. 
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with a slip st in first sc. 
Instep
Work now progresses in rows.
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in each of first 9 sts, turn, leaving remaining sts unworked – 9 sts. 
Rows 2-4 (6): Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn.
Row 5 (7): Ch 1, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in each of next 5 sts, sc2tog over last 2 sts – 7 sts. Fasten off.
Continue Foot
Work now progresses in rounds.
Round 1: With right side facing, join C 8th st at center back of heel, ch 2 (counts as hdc), hdc in each of next 7 sts, working in row-end sts, work 4 (6) hdc evenly space across edge of instep, 2 hdc in corner, hdc in each of 7 sts across toe, 2 hdc in corner, work 4 (6) hdc evenly space across edge of instep, hdc in each of next 7 sts on back of heel; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2 – 34 (38) sts  
Rounds 2-3: Ch 2, hdc in each st around join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2. Fasten off.
Sole
Round 1: With right side facing, join B with a slip st in first st, ch 1, skip first st, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in each of next 12 (14) sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in next st, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in each of next 12 (14) sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; join with a slip st in first st – 29 (33) sts. 
Round 2: Ch 1, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in each of next 10 (12) sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in next st, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in each of next 10 (12) sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; join with a slip st in first st – 25 (29) sts. 
Round 3: Ch 1, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in each of next 8 (10) sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in next st, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in each of next 8 (10) sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; join with a slip st in first st – 21 (25) sts. 
Round 4: Ch 1, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in each of next 6 (8) sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in next st, sc2tog over next 2 sts, sc in each of next 6 (8) sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; join with a slip st in first st – 17 (21) sts.  Fasten off, leaving a 12” (30.5) sewing length. Sew Sole seam closed, lengthwise. Weave in ends. 
Fold cuff down.

materials: RED HEART® “Heart and Sole™ with Aloe”-Vest: 4 (5, 6, 7, 8) Balls 3945 Rustica
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Finished Bust: 32 (36, 40, 44, 48)”. Finished Length: 17 (18, 19, 20, 21)”. Hat Circumference: 20 (22)”.
gauge: 18 sts = 4”; 15 rows = 4” in hdc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
VEST
BODY (Worked from side to side): Ch 42 (45, 47, 49, 52).
Row 1 (Right Side): Hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn—40 (43, 45, 47, 50) hdc.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc across; turn.
Repeat Row 2 until 32 (36, 40, 44, 48)” from beginning. Fasten off.
With right side facing, attach yarn at right edge of one long side; ch 1, work 144 (162, 180, 198, 216) sc evenly across; turn.
LEFT FRONT: Ch 2, hdc in first 30 (33, 36, 39, 42) sts; TURN. Working on these sts only work even in rows of hdc for 8 (8 1/2, 9, 9 1/2, 10)”. Fasten off.
BACK: With wrong side facing, skip next 12 (15, 18, 21, 24) sc of last long row for underarm, attach yarn in next sc; ch 2, hdc in same sc and in next 59 (65, 71, 77, 83) hdc; TURN—60 (66, 72, 78, 84) hdc. Work even until same length as Left Front. Fasten off.
RIGHT FRONT: With wrong side facing, skip next 12 (15, 18, 21, 24) sc of last long row for underarm, attach yarn in next sc; ch 2, hdc in same sc and in each sc to end; turn—30 (33, 36, 39, 42) hdc. Work even until same length as Left Front. Fasten off.
FINISHING: With wrong sides together, fold Fronts over Back; fold top corners of Fronts down to form “lapels” as in photo; sew button through both layers of fabric to hold lapels in place. Sew shoulder seams. Weave in ends.
HAT
BRIM (Worked from side to side): Ch 20.
Row 1 (Right Side): Hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn—18 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc in each hdc across; turn. Repeat Row 2 until 20 (22)” from beginning. Fasten off.
CROWN: With right side facing, attach yarn at right edge of one long side; ch 2, work 90 (100) hdc evenly across; turn. Work even in hdc for 3 1/2 (4)”.
Shape Top-Next Row: Ch 2, * hdc in 8 hdc; [yo and draw up a loop in next hdc] twice, yo and draw through all 5 loops on hook – decrease made; repeat from * across; turn—81 (90) hdc.
Next Row: Ch 2, * hdc in 7 hdc, decrease; repeat from * across—72 (80) hdc.
Next Row: Ch 2, * hdc in 6 hdc, decrease; repeat from * across—63 (70) hdc.
Continue in this manner, decreasing 1 st every row by working one less hdc between decreases until 9 (10) hdc remain. Fasten off, leaving 18” for sewing.
FINISHING: With yarn needle, weave end through top of last sts; gather up firmly; fasten securely. Sew back seam. Weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart® Heat Wave™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 198 yds/181 m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dcbp = Yoh and insert hook from back to front around post of next stitch. Yoh and draw up a loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
Dcfp = Yoh and insert hook from front to back around post of next stitch. Yoh and draw up a loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice.
measurements: Hat: One size to fit adult. Cowl: Approx 14" [35.5 cm] deep x 28" [71 cm] around.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
HAT 
Ribbing: Ch 13. 
1st row: (RS). Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sl st in each ch across. Turn. 12 sts. 
2nd row: Working in back loops only, 1 sl st in each of next 12 sl sts. Turn. 
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 18" [45.5 cm], ending on a WS row. Do not fasten off.
Join back seam: Working in back loops only, sl st last row and rem loops of foundation ch tog. Do not fasten off. 
Turn work and proceed as follows: 
Note: Ch 3 at beg of rnd does not count as st. 
Join all rnds with sl st to first dc or dcfp or dcbp.
Beg working in rnds: 1st rnd: 
Ch 3. Work 70 dc evenly around. Join. 70 dc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around next dc. 1 dcbp around each of next 9 dc) 7 times. Join. 
3rd rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 2 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 8 sts) 7 times. Join. 
4th rnd: Ch 3. (1 dcfp around each of next 3 sts. 1 dcbp around each of next 7 sts) 7 times. Join.

Playsuit & Hat 
Create a bee outfit for baby and then take

for years to come.
Size 12 months only
Change to A, and work 2 more rows – 42 rows.
All Sizes
Shape Armholes: 
Next Row: Change to C, slip st across first 3 
sts, decrease 1 st over next 2 sts, hdc in each 
st across to last 5 sts, decrease 1 st in next 2 
sts, leave last 3 sts unworked, ch 2, turn – 31 
(33, 34) hdc.
Next Row: Decrease 1 st over first 2 sts, hdc 
in each st across to last 2 sts, decrease 1 st 
over last 2 sts, ch 2, turn – 29 (31, 32) hdc.
Next Row: Repeat last row – 27 (29, 30) hdc.
Next Row: Work even, ch 2, turn.
Next Row: Repeat last row until piece 
measures 2½” (5cm) from start of armhole 
shaping, ch 2, turn.
Next Row: Hdc across first 8 sts, ch 2, turn, 
leaving remaining sts unworked. Work as set 
on those 8 sts until piece measures 3 (3½, 4)” 
[8 (9, 10)cm] from start of armhole shaping. 
Fasten off. Work same for other shoulder strap.
FRONT
Work as for Row 1 of Back.
Work even 2 rows, then work as for Row 2 
of Back and continue as for Back to armhole 
shaping. 
Shape Armholes 
Work same as first 3 rows of Back, ch 2, turn.
Next Row: Work across first 8 sts, decrease 
1 st over next 2 sts, ch 2, turn, leaving 
remaining sts unworked - 9 sts.
Next Row: Decrease 1 st over first 2 sts, work 
across 7 remaining sts – 8 sts.
Work across those 8 sts until piece measures 
same as Back. Fasten off. Work same for other 
shoulder strap.

for sizes 6-9 months and 12 months are in 
parentheses

BACK 
With A, ch 19 (19, 22).

across to last st, 3 hdc in last st, ch 2, turn –

Row 3: 2 hdc in first st, then hdc in each st

Row 8: Repeat Row 2 – 35 hdc.

(41, 42) hdc.

Repeat Rows 13-16 once more – 40 rows.

With right sides together, sew shoulder and

Edging
With right side facing and C, sc evenly around

With B, ch 4, join to form a ring.

Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc 
in next st, *2 hdc in next st, hdc in next st;

Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc

Yoke
Starting at neck edge, with A, ch 50.
Row 1: Dc into 4th ch from hook, *2 dc in next ch, dc in next 3 ch; repeat from * across to last 2 ch, 2 dc in next ch, dc in last ch; turn—60 dc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in next dc, *2 dc in next dc, dc in next 4 dc; repeat from * across to last 3 sts, 2 dc in next dc, dc in last 2 dc; turn—72 dc.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, *2 dc in next dc, dc in next 5 dc; repeat from * across to last 3 sts, 2 dc in next dc, dc in last 2 dc; turn—84 dc.
Row 4: Ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, *2 dc in next dc, dc in next 6 dc; repeat from * across to last 4 sts, 2 dc in next dc, dc in last 3 dc; turn—96 dc.
Row 5: Ch 3, dc in next 3 dc, *2 dc in next dc, dc in next 7 dc; repeat from * across to last 4 sts, 2 dc in next dc, dc in last 3 dc; turn—108 dc.

Row 6: Ch 3, dc in next 3dc, *2 dc in next dc, dc in next 8 dc; repeat from * across to last 5 sts, 2 dc in next dc, dc in last 4 dc; turn—120 dc.
Row 7: Ch 3, dc in next 3 dc, *2 dc in next dc, dc in next 9 dc; repeat from * across to last 6 sts, 2 dc in next dc, dc in last 5 dc; turn—132 dc.
Sizes 9, 12, and 18 Months Only
Row 8: Ch 3, dc in next 4 dc, *2 dc in next dc, dc in next 10 dc; repeat from * across to last 6 sts, 2 dc in next dc, dc in last 5 dc; turn—144 dc.
Sizes 12 and 18 Months Only
Row 9: Ch 3, dc in next 4 dc, *2 dc in next dc, dc in next 11 dc; repeat from * across to last 7 sts, 2 dc in next dc, dc in last 6 dc; turn—156 dc.
Size 18 Months Only
Row 10: Ch 3, dc in next 5 dc, *2 dc in next dc, dc in next 12 dc; repeat from * across to last 7 sts, 2 dc in next dc, dc in last 6 dc; turn—168 dc.

Divide for Fronts, Back and Sleeves
Row 8 (9, 10, 11): Ch 1, dc in next 17 (19, 22, 24) dc, ch 6 (8, 8, 10) for underarm, skip next 30 (32, 32, 34) dc for sleeve, dc in next 36 (40, 46, 50) dc for back, ch 6 (8, 8, 10) for underarm, skip next 30 (32, 32, 34) dc for sleeve, dc in last 18 (20, 23, 25) dc; turn—84 (96, 108, 120) sts.

Skirt
Row 1: Ch 3, skip first 2 dc, fan in next dc, *skip next 5 dc, fan in next dc; repeat from * across to last 3 dc, skip next 2 dc, dc in top of turning ch; turn—14 (16, 18, 20) fans.
Directions are for size 6 months. Changes for sizes 9, 12 and 18 months are in parentheses.

Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first dc, *(sc, ch 3) in next 3 ch-1 spaces, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * across, sc in top of turning ch; turn—42 (48, 54, 60) ch-3 spaces. 
Row 3: Ch 3, skip next ch-3 space, *fan in next ch-3 space**, skip next 2 ch-3 spaces; repeat from * across, ending last repeat at **, skip next ch-3 space, dc in last sc; turn.
Repeat Rows 2-3 until skirt measures 4 (4, 5, 5)” (10 [10, 12.5, 12.5] cm) from beginning, ending with Row 2 of pattern. Fasten off A, join C.
Last Row: With C, repeat Skirt Row 3. Fasten off C.

Sleeve Edging
Row 1: With right side facing and, join C in first (2nd, 2nd, 4th) dc of skipped sleeve sts on either sleeve opening, work Skirt Row 1 across dc section of sleeve—5 fans. Fasten off C. Repeat Sleeve Edging across other Sleeve opening

Collar
With B, ch 63. 
Row 1: Fan in 6th ch from hook, *skip next 5 ch, fan in next ch; repeat from * across to last 3 ch, skip next 2 chs, dc in last ch; turn—10 fans.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first dc, *(sc, ch 3) in next 3 ch-1 spaces, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * across, sc in top of turning ch; turn—30 ch-3 spaces. Fasten off B, join C.
Row 3: With C, repeat Skirt Row 3. Fasten off C.
With right sides facing up, lay collar on top of neckline. Pin in place. With B, slip st collar to neck edge. Fasten off B.
Sew button to left front edge where desired. Use space between sts on right front, opposite button for buttonhole.

Headband
With A, ch 9.
Row 1: Dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in each ch across, turn—7 sts.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), skip first st, dc in each dc across, turn—7 dc.
Repeat row 2 until headband measures 16” (40.5 cm) from beginning or 1½” (4 cm) less than head circumference.
Without twisting headband, hold both ends together, slip st last row to foundation ch, matching sts.

Flower
With B, make an adjustable ring. 
Round 1: Ch 1, 12 sc in ring; join with a slip st in first sc—12 sc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in first sc, 2 dc in each sc around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off B, leaving a 12” (30.5 cm) sewing length—24 dc. Join C.
Round 3: With C, *ch 4, tr2tog over next 2 sts, ch 4, slip st in next 2 dc; rep from * around. 
Fasten off C.

FINISHING
Weave in ends. Sew flower to headband over seam.

HAT
With A, ch 86.
Row 1 (Wrong Side): Ch 1, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each remaining ch across. Fasten off.
Row 2 (Right Side): Join A with slip st in first sc on Row 1, ch 1, sc in same sc, *sk next 2 chs, shell in next ch, sk next 2 sc, sc in next sc, repeat from * across. Fasten off.
Row 3: Join B with slip st between first 2 sts of last row, ch 3, 2 dc in same space, sc in 3rd dc of next shell, *shell in next sc, sc in 3rd dc of next shell, repeat from * across, 3 dc in last sc. Fasten off.
Row 4: Hold piece with right side facing, join C with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-3 on last row worked, ch 1, sc in same ch, shell in next sc, *sc in 3rd dc of next shell, shell in next sc, repeat from * across, sc in last dc. Fasten off.
Rows 4-14: Repeat Rows 3 and 4, in following color sequence: 1 row A, 1 row B, 1 row C.
Row 15: Repeat Row 3.
ASSEMBLY
With A, whipstitch ends of rows together on wrong side to form back seam.
TOP TRIM
Round 1 (Right Side): With right side facing, join B with slip st in any st on Row 15, ch 4, work (dc, ch 1) 55 times evenly spaced around Row 15, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4. Turn.
Round 2: Slip st in next ch-1 space, ch 4, work (dc, ch 1) in each remaining ch-1 space around, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4. Fasten off.
Round 3: With right side facing and working behind Round 1, join A with slip st in same space on Row 15 as beginning ch-4 of Round 1 made, ch 4, work (dc, ch 1) in same space as each dc worked on Round 1, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4. Turn.
Round 4: Slip st in next ch-1 space, ch 4, work (dc, ch 1) in each remaining ch-1 space around, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4. Fasten off.
Round 5: With right side facing and working behind Round 3, join C with slip st in same space on Row 15 as beginning ch-4 of Round 3 made, ch 4, work (dc, ch 1) in same space as each dc worked on Round 3, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4. Turn.
Round 6: Slip st in next ch-1 space, ch 4, work (dc, ch 1) in each remaining ch-1 space around, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4. Fasten off.
BAND
Round 1: Join A with slip st in sc at back seam; ch 3, dc in each sc around, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.
Round 2: Join C with slip st in dc at back seam; ch 3, dc in each sc around, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.
Round 3: Join B with slip st in dc at back seam; ch 3, dc in each sc around, join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.
Round 4: Join A with slip st in dc at back seam; ch 1, *sc in 1st and 2nd dc, 2 sc in 3 dc, repeat from * around; join with slip st in beginning ch-1. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Weave 12-inch strand of B through sts on Row 15. Gather to close top opening and secure ends.
SCARF
With A, ch 257.
Row 1 (Right Side): Shell in 5th ch from hook, *sk next 3 chs, sc in next ch, sk next 3 chs, shell in next ch, repeat from * across to last 4 chs, sk next 3 chs, sc in last ch. Fasten off.
Row 2: Hold piece with right side facing, join B with slip st in space formed by beginning 4 sk chs on last row worked, ch 3, 2 dc in same space, sc in 3rd dc of next shell, *shell in next sc, sc in 3rd dc of next shell, repeat from * across to last sc, 3 dc in last sc. Fasten off.
Row 3: Hold piece with right side facing, join C with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-3 on last row worked, ch 1, sc in same ch, shell in next sc, *sc in 3rd dc of next shell, shell in next sc, repeat from * across to last 3 dc, sk next 2 dc, sc in last dc. Fasten off.
Rows 4-11: Repeat Rows 2 and 3, in following color sequence: 1 row A, 1 row B, 1 row C.
Row 12: With C, repeat Row 2.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.
FRINGE
Cut 8-inch lengths of each color. Fold 2 strands of A in half. Draw folded end through side of Row 1; pull ends through fold and tighten knot. Matching color of knot with color of row and using 2 strands for each knot, tie knot in side of each row on each short end of scarf. Trim ends even.

Turn. 50 sts. 11th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of the first 2 sc. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 38 sts. 12th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Turn. 13th row: Ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left, as usual, work 1 reverse sc in next st, *Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 sc in next dc. Rep from * around neck. Sl st in last dc. Fasten off. Sew sleeve seams and underarms. Cut 36" [91.5 cm] of ribbon. Weave under and over dc of 12th row. Knot ends of ribbon and cut ends at an angle below knots. HAT Ch 41. 1st row: (RS). Shell in 5th ch from hook. *Skip next 3 ch. Shell in next ch. Rep from * to last 4 ch. Skip next 3 ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. (9 shells and 1 dc at each side). 2nd row: Ch 3. Shell in ch-1 sp of each shell, ending with dc in top of turning ch-3. Turn. 3rd to 7th rows: As 2nd row. Fasten off at end of last row. Back of Hat: Join yarn with sl st in ch-3 sp of beg chain before 4th shell from side. 1st row:  (RS). Ch 3. Shell at base of each of the next 3 shells. 1 dc in next ch-3 space. Turn. Work in pat for 3 more rows. 5th row: Ch 3. (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) in each shell. 1 dc in top of turning ch-3. Turn. Rep 5th row once more. Fasten off. Sew back seam. Lower Edge: Join yarn with sl st on RS at lower front edge. 1st row: (RS). Working across neck edge. 2 sc in each shell row, 11 sc across back edge. 2 sc in each row on other side. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 2. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn. 4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc and 2 sc in each ch-2 sp. Fasten off. Weave in ends. Cut 36" [91.5 cm] of ribbon. Lace through eyelets at neck edge. Finish ribbon as for Sweater. BOOTIES Note: Do not join at end of rnd. Work in spiral rnds. Ch 10. 1st rnd: 3 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of the next 7 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working along other side of chain, 1 sc in each of the next 7 sc. Do not turn. PM for beg of rnd. 2nd rnd: 2 sc in each of the next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of the next 7 sc. 2 sc in each of the next 3 sc. 1 sc in each of the next 7 sc. 3rd rnd: *1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * twice. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. (1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc) twice. 1 sc in each of the next 7 sc. 4th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. 5th rnd:  (Ridge around sole). *1 scbp around next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc. 6th rnd:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Rep last rnd twice more. Join with sl st to first sc at end of last rnd. Fasten off. INSTEP Ch 4. 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 2 ch. Turn 3 sc. 2nd row:  Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc (increase made). 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc. 3rd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of the next 3 sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 7 sc. 4th to 6th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of the next 7 sc. Turn. Fasten off at end of last row. UPPERS Ch 8. 1st row: (RS). 1 sc in each of next 7 sc of Instep. Turn. 2nd row: Ch 8. Shell in 4th ch from hook. Skip next 2 ch. Shell in next ch. Skip next 2 sts. Shell in next sc. Skip next 3 sc. Shell in next sc *Skip next 2 sts. Shell in next st. Rep from *, ending with: skip next st. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. 3rd to 6th rows: Ch 3. Shell in each shell to last dc. 1 dc in last dc. Turn. Fasten off at end of last row. Sew back seam. Sew instep and uppers to sole. Cut two 18" [45.5 cm] long pieces of ribbon. Weave through sps just above instep. Finish ribbon as for Sweater. BLANKET Note: Ch 3 at beg of row counts as dc. Ch 127. 1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 125 dc. 2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn. 3rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of the next 5 dc. (Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc) 56 times. Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn. 4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc and ch-1 sp across. Turn. 125 sc. 5th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of the next 5 sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. (Skip next 3 sc. Shell) 13 times. Skip next 2 sc. 1 dc in next sc. Skip next 2 sc. (Shell. Skip next 3 sc) 12 times. Shell in next sc. Ch 1. Skip next 3 sc. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 dc in each of the last 5 dc and in top of beginning ch-3. Turn. 6th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of the next 5 dc. Ch 1. Skip ch-1 space, dc in next dc. Ch 1. (Shell in ch-1 space of next shell] 13 times. 1 dc in center single dc. (Shell in ch-1 space of next shell] 13 times. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 space. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn. 7th to 55th rows: Repeat 6th row. 56th row: Ch 1. Work 125 sc spaced evenly across to match 4th row. Turn. 57th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of the next 5 sc. *Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 dc in next sc. Rep from * to last 6 sc. 1 dc in each of last 6 sc. Turn. 58th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of the next 5 dc. *1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from *, ending with 1 dc in each of last 6 dc. Turn. 59th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn. 60th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc to end of row. Fasten off. With WS facing, join yarn with sl st at beg of foundation chain. Ch 1. Work 125 sc across foundation chain. Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 334 Buff A, 313 Aran B, 319 Cherry Red C, and 312 Black D.
Yarn needle, stuffing material, split-lock stitch marker.
abbreviations: h-inc (hdc increase) = 2 hdc in next st.
s-inc (sc increase) = 2 sc in next st.
dec (decrease) = [draw up a loop in next st] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Hat directions are for baby size (18” circumference); changes for toddler size (20½” circumference) are in parentheses. Sock Monkey measures 14” high.
gauge: 14 sts = 4”; 10 rounds = 4” in hdc rounds. 16 sts = 4”; 16 rounds = 4” in sc rounds. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauges.
instructions:
BABY HAT
Round 1: With A, make a loop over your fingers, insert hook into the loop and draw up 1 ch; 9 hdc into loop; join with a slip st in first hdc; draw up end to tighten loop – 9 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), hdc in same st as joining, [h-inc] 8 times; join with a slip st in top of ch 2 – 18 sts.
Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next hdc, [h-inc, hdc in next hdc] 5 times; join – 27 sts.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next 2 hdc, [h-inc, hdc in next 2 hdc] 8 times; join – 36 sts.
Round 5: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next 3 hdc, [h-inc, hdc in next 3 hdc] 8 times; join – 45 sts.
Round 6: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next 4 hdc, [h-inc, hdc in next 4 hdc] 8 times; join – 54 sts.
Round 7: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next 5 hdc, [h-inc, hdc in next 5 hdc] 8 times; join – 63 sts.
Toddler Hat Only- Round 8: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next 6 hdc, [h-inc, hdc in next 6 hdc] 8 times; join – 72 sts.
Both Sizes-Round 8 (9): Ch 2, hdc in next hdc and in each hdc around; join.
Rounds 9 and 10 (10 and 11): With B, repeat Round 8 (9).
Rounds 11 and 12 (12 and 13): With C, repeat Round 8 (9).
Rounds 13 and 14 (14 and 15): With B, repeat Round 8 (9).
Round 15 (16): Ch 1, slip st in each st around. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
Ear (Make 2)
Row 1: With B, ch 3; 4 hdc in 3rd ch from hook; turn – 5 sts.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), hdc in first hdc, [h-inc] 4 times; turn – 10 sts.
Row 3: Ch 2, hdc in first hdc, hdc in next hdc, [h-inc, hdc in next hdc] 4 times; turn – 15 sts.
Row 4: Ch 2, hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 2 hdc, [h-inc, hdc in next 2 hdc] 4 times; turn – 20 sts.
Toddler Size Only-Row 5: Ch 2, hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 3 hdc, [h-inc, hdc in next 3 hdc] 4 times; turn – 25 sts.
Both Sizes-Row 5 (6): Ch 1, slip st in each st across. Fasten off.
Ear Lining (Make 2)
With C, work as for Ear through Row 3 (4). Fasten off.
FiniSHinG
Sew Ear Linings to Ears. Sew Ears to sides of Hat. Weave in all ends.
MOnKEY
Legs (Make 2)
Round 1: With B, make a loop over your fingers, insert hook into the loop and draw up 1 ch; 6 sc into loop; draw up end to tighten loop – 6 sc. Do not join but work in continuous rounds. Mark last sc of round. Move marker up each round.
Round 2: [S-inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Rounds 3-8: Sc in each sc around.
Rounds 9-26: With A, sc in each sc around. Cut yarn and set aside first leg. Make 2nd leg, but do NOT cut yarn.
Join Legs/Body
Round 1: Ch 2 for crotch, sc in the 12 sc of first leg, sc in each ch between legs, sc in the 12 sc of 2nd leg, sc in remaining loops of ch – 28 sc.
Rounds 2-16: Sc in each sc around.
Round 17: [Dec, sc in next 5 sc] 4 times – 24 sc.
Round 18: [Dec, sc in next 4 sc] 4 times – 20 sc.
Round 19: [Dec, sc in next 3 sc] 4 times – 16 sc. Fasten off.
Head
Round 1: With A, make a loop over your fingers, insert hook into the loop and draw up 1 ch; 6 sc into loop; draw up end to tighten loop – 6 sc. Do not join but work in continuous rounds. Mark last sc of round. Move marker up each round.
Round 2: [S-inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 3: [S-inc, sc in next sc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 4: [S-inc, sc in next 2 sc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Rounds 5-11: Sc in each sc around.
Round 12: [Dec, sc in next 4 sc] 4 times – 20 sc.
Round 13: [Dec, sc in next 3 sc] 4 times – 16 sc. Fasten off.
Muzzle
Rounds 1-3: With B, work as for Head through Round 3.
Rounds 4 and 5: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.
Ears (Make 2)
Row 1: With A, ch 3; 8 dc in 3rd ch from hook; turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, slip st in each st across. Fasten off.
Arms (Make 2)
Work as for Legs.
Hat
Round 1: With B, make a loop over your fingers, insert hook into the loop and draw up 1 ch; 9 hdc into loop; join with a slip st in first hdc; draw up end to tighten loop – 9 hdc.
Round 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), hdc in same st as joining, [h-inc] 8 times; join with a slip st in top of ch-2 – 18 sts.
Round 3: Ch 2, hdc in same st as joining, hdc in next hdc, [h-inc, hdc in next hdc] 5 times; join – 27 sts.
Round 4: Ch 2, hdc in next hdc and in each hdc around; join.
Round 5: Ch 1, slip st in each st around. Fasten off.
FiniSHinG
Stuff Legs, Body, Head, Arms and Muzzle. Sew Head to Body. Sew Muzzle and Ears to Head. Flatten tops of Arms and sew to sides of Body. Embroider eyes with D French knots. Embroider mouth with C and make 6 satin sts across Muzzle. For topknot, cut eight (8) 10” strands of C; thread strands through a st at top of hat. Knot strands together with an overhand knot at base. Trim to 1”. Sew Hat to Head.

materials: Bernat® Softee® Baby™ (4.9 oz/140 g; 362 yds/331 m) Sizes 6 mos 12 mos White (02000) 1 1 ball
Sizes U.S. C/2 (3 mm) and U.S. E/4 (3.5 mm) crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Dc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook). Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next st) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
Picot = Ch 4. Sl st in 4th ch from hook
measurements: To fit chest measurement: 6 mos  17"  [43 cm], 12 mos  18" [45.5 cm]. Finished chest: 6 mos  20" [51 cm], 12 mos  22½" [57 cm]. Bonnet and Booties: One size to fit 6 mos.
gauge: Cardigan and Bonnet: 19 sts and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook in pat. Booties: 17 hdc and 12½ rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger size(s) the instructions will be written thus ( ). When only one number is given, it applies to all sizes.

Cardigan
Body
With larger hook, ch 100 (113).
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. *Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Rep from * to last ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. 98 (111) sts.

2nd row: Ch 3. Skip first dc. *1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 4 sts. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in top of ch-3. Turn.

3rd row: Ch 3. Skip first dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next dc. *Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last st. 1 dc in top of ch-3. Turn.

Last 2 rows form pat.

Rep last 2 rows 6 times more, then 2nd row once. PM at beg of last row.

Right Front: 1st row: (RS). Sl st in each of first 2 sts. Ch 3. Pat across 21 (22) sts. Turn. 22 (23) sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

2nd row: Sl st in each of first 2 sts. Ch 3. Pat to last st. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

Rep last row once more. 18 (19) sts.

Proceed as follows:

1st row: (WS). Ch 3. Pat to last st. Turn. Leave rem st unworked.

2nd row: Sl st in each of first 2 sts. Ch 3. Pat to end of row. Turn.

Rep last 2 rows twice more, then 1st row once. 11 (12) sts. Fasten off.

Back: With RS facing, skip next 4 (8) sts of marked row. Join yarn with sl st to next st and proceed as follows:

Next row: (RS). Ch 3. Pat across 43 (45) sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 44 (46) sts.

Next row: Sl st in each of first 2 sts. Ch 3. Pat to last st. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

Rep last row once more. 40 (42) sts.

Work 7 rows even in pat. Fasten off.

Left Front: With RS facing, skip next 4 (8) sts of marked row. Join yarn with sl st to next st and proceed as follows:

Next row: (RS). Ch 3. Pat to last st. Turn. Leave turning ch unworked. 22 (23) sts.

Next row: Sl st in each of first 2 sts. Ch 3. Pat to last st. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

Rep last row once more. 18 (19) sts.

Proceed as follows:

Next row: (WS). Sl st in each of first 2 sts. Ch 3. Pat to end of row. Turn.

Next row: Ch 3. Pat to last st. Turn. Leave rem st unworked.

Rep last 2 rows twice more, then 1st row once. 11 (12) sts. Fasten off.

Sleeves
With larger hook, ch 31 (35).
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. *Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Rep from * to last ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. 29 (33) sts.

2nd row: Ch 3. Skip first dc. Pat to last st. 2 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.

Rep 2nd row 7 times more. 37 (41) sts.

Next row: Ch 3. Skip first dc. Pat to end of row. Turn.

Size 12 mos only: Rep last row twice more.

All Sizes: Shape Top: Next row:  Sl st in each of first 4 (6) sts. Ch 3. Pat to last 3 (5) sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

Next 4 (6) rows: Sl st in first 3 sts. Ch 3. Pat to last 2 sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

Size 12 mos only: Next row: Sl st in each of first 4 sts. Ch 3. Pat to last 3 sts.

All Sizes: Fasten off.

FINISHING
Hem Edging: With RS facing and smaller hook, join yarn with sl st to hem edge corner of Left Front. Work 1 sc in each ch of foundation chain. Turn. 97 (109) sc.

Next row: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *Picot. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. Picot. Skip 1 sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Fasten off.

Sew shoulder seams, leaving center back 18 sts free to form Back neck.

Front and Neck Edging: With WS facing and smaller hook, join yarn with sl st to lower edge of hem at base of Left Front. Work 47 sc evenly up Left Front, 18 sc across Back neck and 47 sc down Right Front to lower edge of hem. Turn. 112 sc.

Next row: (Buttonhole row). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *Ch 2. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * twice more. Ch 2. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sts. *Picot. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 5 sts. Picot. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of last 4 sts. Fasten off.

Cuff Edging:  With RS facing and smaller hook, join yarn with sl st to hem edge of Sleeve. Work 1 sc into each ch of foundation ch. Turn. 29 ( 33) sts.

Next row: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *Picot. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. Picot. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Fasten off.

Sew in Sleeves. Sew Sleeve seams. Sew on buttons to correspond to buttonholes. 

Bonnet
Bonnet Back:  With larger hook, ch 23.

1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 2 dc). 1 dc in each of next 2 ch. *Ch 1. Skip next ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Rep from * to last ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. 21 sts.

2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc). Skip first dc. *1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * to last 4 sts. 1 dc in next dc. Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in top of ch-3. Turn.

3rd row: Ch 3. Skip first dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next dc. *Ch 1. Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last st. 1 dc in top of ch-3. Turn.

Last 2 rows form pat.

Work 3 rows in pat, ending on a WS row.

Next row: Sl st in each of first 2 sts. Ch 3. Pat to last st. Turn. Leave rem st unworked.

Next row: Sl st in each of first 2 sts. Ch 3. Pat to last st. Leave rem st unworked. Fasten off.

Bonnet Body: With RS facing and larger hook, join yarn with sl st to bottom right corner of Back just worked. Working up the right side of Back, proceed as follows: Ch 3. 1 dc around same dc post as last sl st. (2 dc around next dc post. Ch 1. 1 dc around next dc post) 4 times. Skip last dc post. Pat across top of Back. Working down left side of Back, proceed as follows: Skip first dc post. 1 dc around next dc post. Ch 1. (2 dc around next dc post. 1 dc around next dc post. Ch 1) 3 times. (2 dc around next dc post) twice. Turn. 53 sts.

Work 8 rows even in pat. PM at each end of last row.

Brim: Work 3 rows in pat.

Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc and ch-1 sp to end of row. Turn.

Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. *Picot. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Rep from * to last 3 sc. Picot. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Fasten off.

Bonnet Band:  Fold back Brim at markers. With larger hook, join yarn with sl st to bottom left corner of Bonnet. Ch 1. Work 46 sc along bottom edge of Bonnet between markers. Ch 17. Turn.

1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 15 ch. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. Ch 2. Skip next 2 sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to last 4 sts. 2 sc in next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in each of last 2 sc. Turn.

5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew button on Bonnet Band to correspond to buttonhole.

Booties
Note: Ch 2 at beg or rnd does not count as st.

With larger hook, ch 12.
1st rnd: 4 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as 5 dc). 1 dc in each of next 7 ch. 9 dc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 dc in each of next 7 rem loops. 4 dc in same sp as first 4 dc. Join with sl st to top of ch-3. 32 dc.

2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in same sp as last sl st. 2 hdc in each of next 4 dc. 1 hdc in each of next 7 dc. 2 hdc in each of next 9 dc. 1 hdc in each of next 7 dc. 2 hdc in each of next 4 dc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 50 hdc.

3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 15 hdc. (Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts) 6 times. 1 hdc in each of next 11 hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 44 sts.

4th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 12 hdc. (Hdc2tog. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sts) 6 times. 1 hdc in each of last 8 hdc. Join with sl st to first hdc. 38 sts.

5th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 10 hdc. (Dc2tog) 8 times. 1 dc in each of last 11 hdc. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. 30 sts.

6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st and in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.

7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in next sc. *Picot. Skip next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to last sc. Picot. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Right Strap: With larger hook, ch 14. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 11 ch. 4 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, ch 2. Skip next 2 loops. 1 sc in each of next 9 loops. 2 sc in last loop. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.

Left Strap: With larger hook, ch 14. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 9 ch. Ch 2. Skip next 2 ch. 4 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working in rem loops of foundation ch, 1 sc in each of next 11 loops. 2 sc in last loop. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew strap to Bootie as illustrated. Sew button to correspond to buttonhole.

materials: RED HEART® Baby Sheen™: 3 (3, 4, 4) balls 0600 Sunshine A
Two 1” buttons, sewing needle and matching sewing thread, yarn needle
abbreviations: V-st: (Dc, ch 1, dc) in same st or space
shell: 2 hdc in same st or space
measurements: Finished Bust/Chest: 23 (24, 25, 26)”. Hat circumference: 16 (17, 18)”. Sweater directions are given for size 6 months. Changes for sizes 12 months, 18 months, and 24 months are in parentheses. Hat directions are for size small. Changes for medium are in parentheses.
gauge: 18 sts = 4”; 12 rows = 4” in dc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain gauge.
instructions:
YOKE
Starting at neck edge, with larger hook and A, ch 62 (62, 68, 68).
Row 1: Dc in 3rd ch from hook, dc in each of next 8 (8, 9, 9) ch sts (right front section), V-st in next ch (inc made), dc in each of next 8 (8, 9, 9) ch sts (right sleeve section), V-st in next ch, dc in each of the next 20 (20, 22, 22) ch sts (back section), V-st in next ch, dc in each of the next 8 (8, 9, 9) ch sts (left sleeve section), V-st in next ch, dc in each of 10 (10, 11, 11) rem ch sts (left front section), turn — 10 (10, 11, 11) dc in each front section; 8 (8, 9, 9) dc in each sleeve section; 20 (20, 22, 22) dc in back section; 4 V-sts.
Row 2: Ch 3, (counts as a dc here and throughout), skip first dc, dc in each of next 10 (10, 11, 11) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of next 10 (10, 11, 11) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of next 22 (22, 24, 24) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of next 10 (10, 11, 11) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of last 11 (11, 12, 12) sts, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in each of next 11 (11, 12, 12) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of next 12 (12, 12, 14, 14) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of next 24 (24, 26, 26) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of next 12 (12, 14, 14) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of last 12 (12, 13, 13) sts, turn.
Row 4: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in each of next 12 (12, 13, 13) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of next 14 (14, 16, 16) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of next 26 (26, 28, 28) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of the next 14 (14, 16, 16) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of the next 13 (13, 14, 14) dc, turn.
Row 5: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in each of next 13  (13, 14, 14) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, 1 dc in each of next 16 (16, 18, 18) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of next 28 (28, 30, 30) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of next 16 (16, 18, 18) dc, V-st in next ch-1 space, dc in each of last 14 (14, 15, 15) sts, turn.
Row 6: Ch 3, skip first dc, *dc in each dc to next ch-1 space, V-st in next ch-1 space; repeat from * 3 times, dc in each remaining st across, turn.
Rows 7-15 (16, 16, 16): Repeat Row 6, increasing 8 stitches every row till you have 24 (25, 26, 26) sts on first front, V-st, 36 (38, 40, 40) sts on first sleeve, V-st, 48, (50, 52, 52) sts on back, V-st, 36 (38, 40, 40) sts on second sleeve, V-st, 24 (25, 26, 26) sts on second front, turn — 176 (184, 192, 192) dc; 4 ch-1 spaces.
BODY
Next row will divide the yoke into fronts, back and sleeve openings.
Row 1: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in each of next 24 (25, 26, 26) dc across for first front, ch 2 (3, 3, 5) for underarm, skip next 38 (40, 42, 42) dc for sleeve opening, dc in each of next 50 (52, 54, 54) dc for back, ch 2 (3, 5, 5), skip next 38 (40, 42, 42 dc for sleeve opening, dc in each of last 25 (26, 27, 27) sts for second front, turn — 100 (104, 108, 108) dc; 2 (3, 5, 5) ch sts at each underarm.
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), skip first dc, 2 hdc in next dc (shell made), *skip next dc, shell in next st; repeat from * across, working shell in every other ch at underarm, turn — 52 (54, 56, 58) shells.
Row 3: Ch 2, shell in the space between the first and second cluster of previous row, *shell in space between the next 2 shells, repeat from * across to last cluster, skip last cluster, hdc in top of tch, turn  — 51 (53, 55, 57) shells.
Row 4: Ch 2, shell in space between the first hdc and the first shell, *shell in space between next 2 shells; repeat from * across to last cluster, skip last cluster, hdc in top of tch, turn — 52 (54, 56, 58) shells.
Rep Rows 3-4 until body measures 6 (6½, 7, 7½)” from underarm.
Bottom Edging
Change to smaller hook.
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in each dc across row, turn.
Rows 2-4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across, turn. Fasten off.
RIGHT SLEEVE
Last row of bottom edging is right side.
Row 1: With right side facing, join A  in first ch at underarm of right sleeve opening, ch 2, shell in same st, *skip next st, shell in next st; repeat from * around armhole opening, hdc in last st, do not join, turn — 19 (21, 22, 23) shells.
Rep Rows 3-4 of body pattern until sleeve measures 5½ (6, 6½, 7)” from beginning.
Cuff Edging
Change to smaller hook. Rep bottom edging of body. Fasten off leaving a 24” sewing length.
LEFT SLEEVE
Rep right sleeve in left sleeve opening.
Left Front Edging
Row 1: With right side facing, using smaller hook, join B at top of left front edge, ch 1, work 24 (26, 28, 28) sc evenly spaced across row-end sts of yoke, work 28 (30, 32, 34) sc evenly spaced across body to row-end sts of bottom of left front, turn — 52 (56, 60, 62) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
Right Front and Neck Edging
Row 1: With right side facing, using smaller hook, join B at bottom of right front edge, ch 1, work 28 (30, 32, 34) sc evenly spaced across row-end sts of body to beginning of yoke, work 24 (26, 28, 28) sc evenly spaced across to top of yoke, turn — 52 (56, 60, 62) sc.
Row 2 (buttonhole row): Ch 1, sc in each of first 13 (15, 17, 17) sc, ch 2, skip 2 sc for buttonhole, sc in each of next 5 sc, ch 2, skip 2 sc sc in each sc across to bottom edge, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each sc across working 2 sc in each ch-2 space, work 3 sc in last sc at corner, sc evenly across neck edge to top of left front, 3 sc in corner sc, sc in each st across left front. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew underarm seams. With sewing needle and thread, sew buttons to left front opposite buttonholes. Fold top points of left and right fronts to right side to form lapels. Weave in ends. Do not iron, if blocking is needed, lay sweater on a padded surface, sprinkle with water, pat into shape, allow to dry.
HAT
Crown
With larger hook and A, ch 5, join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (does not count as a st here and throughout hat), 10 dc in ring, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 — 10 dc.
