Round 2: Ch 3, 2 dc in each dc around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 — 20 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, *dc in next dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 — 30 dc.
Round 4: Ch 3, *dc in each of the next 2 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 — 40 dc.
Round 5: Ch 3, *dc in each of next 3 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 — 50 dc.
Rnds 6-7 (7, 8): Continue in pattern same as Round 5, increasing 10 sts each round, always working 1 more stitch between increases, until 70 (70, 80) dc are on work.
Size Medium Only
Round 8: Ch 3, *dc in each of the next 13 dc, 2 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3 — 75 dc.
All Sizes
Sides
Round 1: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout hat), hdc in next 1 (1, 0) dc, 2 hdc in next dc, *skip next dc, 2 hdc in next dc; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2, turn — 36 (38, 40) shells.
Round 2: Ch 2, skip first shell, *shell in space between next 2 shells; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3, turn — 35 (37, 39) shells.
Round 3: Ch 2, 2 hdc in space between the tch and the first cluster, *shell in space between next 2 clusters; repeat from * around, shell in space between last cluster and tch, join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3, turn — 36 (38, 40) shells turn.
Rep Rounds 2-3 until sides measure 2¾ (3, 3¼)” from beginning.
Hat Edging
Round 1: With smaller hook and B, ch 1, sc in each st around, join with a slip st in first sc — 71 (76, 81) sc).
Rounds 2-3: Ch 1, sc in each st around, join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
FLOWER (optional)
Small Flower
With smaller hook and A, ch 4, join with a slip st to form a ring. 
Round 1: Ch 1, 10 sc in ring, join with a slip st in first sc — 10 sc.
Round 2: *Ch 2, 3 dc in next st, ch 2, slip st in next st; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in first sc — 5 petals. Fasten off, leaving a sewing length.
Large Flower
With smaller hook and B, ch 4, join with a slip st to form a ring. 
Round 1: Ch 1, 10 sc in ring, join with a slip st in first sc — 10 sc.
Round 2: *Ch 3, 5 tr in next st, ch 3, slip st in next st; repeat from * around, join with a slip st in first sc — 5 petals. Fasten off, leaving a sewing length.
FINISHING
With right sides facing up, sew small flower centered on top of large flower and sew to side of hat. Weave in ends.
Red Heart® Baby Sheen™, Art 795 available in solid color 3.5 oz (100g), 307 yd (281 m) and multicolor 3 oz (85g), 261 yd (239 m).
ABBREVIATIONS: A, B = Color A, B; ch = chain; dc = double crochet; hdc = half double crochet; mm = millimeters; sc = single crochet; st(s) = stitch (es); [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified; * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.

materials: RED HEART® “Soft Yarn”: 1 Ball each 3720 Lavender CA, 2541 Blue Sky CB, and 4601 Off White CC
abbreviations: CL2: Yo and draw up a lp in next dc, yo and draw through 2 lps, skip next 2 sc, yo and draw up a lp in next dc, yo and draw through 2 lps, yo and draw through all 3 lps rem on hook.
CL3: Yo and draw up a lp in next st, yo and draw through 2 lps, skip next 3 sts, yo and draw up a lp in next st, yo and draw through 2 lps, yo and draw through all 3 lps rem on hook.
Shell: (2 dc, ch 3, 2 dc) all in st or sp indicated.
measurements: Hat fits most women. Scarf measures approximately 6” x 71”.
gauge: 14 sts (2 repeats) = 3½”; 6 rows = 4” in pattern. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SCARF
With CA, ch 281.
Rnd 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook, * ch 1, skip next 2 ch, shell in next ch, ch 1, skip next 2 ch, sc in next ch **, sc in next ch; rep from * across, end at **; turn to work on opposite side of beg ch; sc in same ch as last sc; rep from * across, end at ** changing to CB in last sc; join with a sl st to first sc – 40 ch-3 sps on each side.
Rnd 2: With CB, ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, sc in ch-1 sp, ** ch 3, dc in next 2 dc, shell in ch-3 sp, dc in next dc, * CL2, dc in next dc, shell in ch-3 sp, dc in next dc; rep from * across first side; dc in next dc, ch 3, sc in ch-1 sp **, sc in next 2 sc, sc in ch-1 sp; rep from ** to ** across next side; sc in last sc changing to CC; join.
Rnd 3: With CC, ch 1, sc in same sc as joining, sc in next sc, sc in ch-3 sp, ** ch 3, skip next 2 dc, dc in next 2 dc, shell in ch-3 sp, dc in next dc, * CL3, dc in next dc, shell in ch-3 sp, dc in next dc; rep from * across first side; dc in next dc, ch 3, skip next 2 dc, sc in ch-3 sp **, sc in next 4 sc, sc in ch-3 sp; rep from ** to ** across next side; sc in last 2 sc changing to CA; join.
Rnd 4: With CA, ch 1, sc in same sc as joining and next 2 sc, 2 sc in ch-3 sp, ** ch 3, skip next 2 dc, dc in next 2 dc, shell in ch-3 sp, dc in next dc, * CL3, dc in next dc, shell in ch-3 sp, dc in next dc; rep from * across first side; dc in next dc, ch 3, skip next 2 dc, 2 sc in ch-3 sp **, sc in next 6 sc, 2 sc in ch-3 sp; rep from ** to ** across next side; sc in last 3 sc; join. Fasten off.
HAT
With CC, ch 4; join with sl st in first ch to form ring.
Rnd 1: Ch 3, 13 dc in ring; join with sl st in top of ch-3 – 14 sts.
Rnd 2: Ch 3, dc in same st as joining, [2 dc in next dc]13 times; join – 28 sts.
Rnd 3: Ch 3, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc] 13 times, 2 dc in last dc; join – 42 sts.
Rnd 4: Ch 3, [2 dc in next dc, dc in next dc] 20 times, 2 dc in last dc; join – 63 sts.
Rnd 5: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining, * ch 1, skip next 2 dc, shell in next dc, ch 1, skip next 2 dc, sc in next dc **, sc in next dc; rep from * around, end at **; join in first sc – 9 ch-3 sps.
Rnd 6: Sl st in sp, sl st in next 2 dc, ch 3, * shell in ch-3 sp, dc in next dc, CL2 **, dc in next dc; rep from * around end at ** and working 2nd leg of CL2 in first dc of previous rnd; join in top of ch-3.
Rnd 7: St in next 2 dc, ch 3, * shell in ch-3 sp, dc in next dc, CL3 **, dc in next dc; rep from * around end at ** and working 2nd leg of CL3 in first dc of previous rnd; join.
Rep Rnd 7 four more times. Fasten off.
Brim-Next Rnd: With WRONG SIDE facing (this will be the right side when brim is turned up), attach CA in 2nd dc of shell; ch 3, * shell in ch-3 sp, dc in next dc, CL3 **, dc in next dc; repeat from * around end at ** and working 2nd leg of CL3 in first dc of previous rnd; join. Fasten off.
Rep last rnd 6 more times in following color sequence: [CB, CC, CA] twice. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Handicrafter Cotton (Solids: 50 g/ 1.75 oz/73 m/80 yds)
Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 14 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]
instructions:
BIB
With MC, ch 28.
1st row: (RS). (1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc – shell made) in 5th ch from hook. *Miss next 2 ch. Shell in next ch. Rep from * to last 2 ch. Miss next ch. 1 dc in last ch. Turn. 8 shells.
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. *Shell in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * across ending with 2 dc in 3rd ch of turning ch. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 4. 1 dc in first dc. *Shell in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * across ending with shell in 3rd ch of turning ch. Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. *Shell in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * across, ending with shell in 4th ch of turning ch and 1 dc in 3rd ch of turning ch. Turn. 10 shells.
5th row: Ch 3. *Shell in next ch-1 sp. Rep from * across ending with 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 6½ ins [16.5 cm], ending with RS facing for next row.
Shape neck: 1st row: (RS). (Shell in next ch-1 sp) 3 times. 1 dc in first dc of next shell. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 3. 2 dc in first ch-1 sp. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. (Yoh and draw up a loop in next dc. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – dc2tog made. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in dc2tog. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
5th row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. Dc2tog over next st and top of turning ch. Turn.
6th to 8th rows: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
9th row: Ch 3. (1 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Fasten off.
With RS of work facing, miss next ch-1 sp and dc of shell last worked. Miss next 2 shells. Miss next dc and ch-1 sp of next shell. Join MC with sl st to next dc of same shell.
1st row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) 3 times. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 2 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. Miss first st. Dc2tog over next 2 sts. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in next dc2tog. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
5th row: Ch 3. Miss first 2 sts. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
6th to 8th rows: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
9th row: Ch 3. (1 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Fasten off.
Edging: Join A with sl st to top left corner of neck edge. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 1 row sc evenly around all edges. Join with sl st to first sc. Ch 5 for button loop. Join with sl st to next sc. Fasten off. Sew button in position.
FLOWER (make 3)
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: (Ch 3. 1 dc. Ch 3. Sl st) all in same sp as last sl st. *(Sl st. Ch 3. 1 dc. Ch 3. Sl st) all in next sc. Rep from * around. Fasten off. Sew Flowers to Bib as shown in picture.
BOOTIES
Sole: With MC, ch 10.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 7 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working along opposite side of ch, work 1 sc in each rem loop of next 7 sts. 2 sc in next loop. Join with sl st to first st. 20 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. 3 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. 3 sc in last st. Join with sl st to first st. 24 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. 3 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 11 sts. 3 sc in next st. 1 sc in last st. Join with sl st to first st. 28 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. 3 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts. 3 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Join A with sl st to first st. 32 sts.
5th rnd: With A, ch 1. Working in back loop only of each st, work 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. (2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st) 3 times. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 35 sts.
7th and 8th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.
Upper: 1st row: With RS of work facing, miss first 6 sts of last rnd. Join A with sl st to next st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 5 sts. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 4 sts. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 3 sts. Fasten off leaving a 6 ins [15 cm] end. Thread end through tapestry needle and sew seam at center of upper.
Ankle Strap: Left Foot: With A, ch 13. With RS of work facing, work 1 sc in each of center 5 sc at back of heel. Turn.
Next row: Ch 7. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch or sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off. Join A with sl st at opposite side of strap at top corner. Ch 3 for button loop. Join with sl st to foundation ch. Fasten off.
Ankle Strap: Right Foot: With A, ch 6. With RS of work facing, work 1 sc in each of center 5 sc at back of heel. Turn.
Next row: Ch 14. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch or sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc or ch-1 sp to end of row. Ch 3 for button loop. Join with sl st to foundation ch. Fasten off.
Flower: With MC, make 2 as given for Bib. Sew 1 Flower to each Bootie as illustrated.
Sew buttons to correspond to button loops.

materials: RED HEART® With Love®: 1 skein 1704 Bubblegum A
RED HEART® Boutique Sashay®: 1 ball 1953 Tutu B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 6mm [J-10 US] and 5mm [H-8 US]
Yarn needle, stitch marker, sewing needle and thread to match
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Diaper Cover measures 18 (19, 20)” [45.5 (48.5, 51) cm] circumference at waist. Hat measures 17” (43 cm) circumference.
gauge: 9 sts = 4” (10 cm) in pattern; 12 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet with larger hook. 12 sts = 4” (10 cm) in pattern; 10 rows = 4” (10 cm) in half double crochet with smaller hook.
instructions:
DIAPER COVER
Front
With larger hook and A, ch 21 (23, 25).
Row 1 (right side): Sc in second ch from hook and in each ch across, turn—20 (22, 24) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until front measures 3½ (4½, 5½)” [9 (11.5, 14) cm], ending on right side row.
Leg openings
Row 1: Slip st in first 3 sts, sc in next 14 (16, 18) sts; leave last 3 sts unworked, turn—14 (16, 18) sc.
Row 2 (right side): Sc2tog, sc in each st to last 2 st, sc2tog, turn—12 (14, 16) sc.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Rows 4–9 (11, 13): Repeat Rows 2 and 3 three (four, five) times—6 sc.
Row 10 (12, 14): Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st, turn—8 sc.
Row 11 (13, 15): Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Rows 12 (14, 16)–17 (21, 25): Repeat Rows 10 (12, 14) and 11 (13, 15) three (four, five) times, turn—14 (16, 18) sc.
Rows 18 (22, 26) and 19 (23, 27): Ch 4, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, sc in each st across, turn—20 (22, 24) sc.
Directions are for size Infant 3 months. Changes for sizes Infant 6 months and Infant 12 months are in parentheses.
Back
Row 20 (24, 28): Ch 1, working in back loops only, sc in each st, turn.
Row 21 (25, 29): Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.
Repeat last 2 rows until back measures 3½ (4½, 5½)” [9 (11.5, 14) cm] from Row 19 (23, 27), ending with a Row 21 (25, 29).
Fasten off.
Ruffles
*Join B with slip st (see Special Techniques) to first unworked front loop of Row 20 (24, 28), ch 1, sc in each unworked loop across. Fasten off. Repeat from * for each right side row to top of back.
Optional: With sewing needle and matching thread, sew down the loose ends of B at last st of each row. With A, sew side seams.
Waistband
With right side facing and larger hook, join A with slip st in last st before side seam.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 4 (counts as first dc and ch 1), skip next st, *dc in next st, ch 1, skip next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—20 (22, 24) dc and 20 (22, 24) ch-1 sps.
Round 2: Ch 1, reverse sc in each dc and ch-1 space around; join with slip st in first st—40 (44, 48) reverse sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Join A with sc in any st of leg opening and sc evenly spaced around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Repeat for 2nd leg opening. Weave in ends.
Cut two 1 yd (1 m) lengths of B for ties. Make a knot at each end to prevent tearing. Thread through ch-1 spaces of front from side seam to side seam; repeat for back. Tie bows at sides.
HAT
With smaller hook and A, ch 7.
Round 1: Work 3 sc in second ch from hook, hdc in next 4 ch, 3 sc in last ch; working on opposite side of foundation ch, hdc in next 4 ch—14 sts. Place marker in first st and move up as each round is completed.
Round 2: [2 sc in next 3 sc, hdc in next 4 hdc] twice—20 sts.
Round 3: *[Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, hdc in next 4 hdc; repeat from * once—26 sts.
Round 4: *[Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, hdc in next 4 hdc; repeat from * once—32 sts.
Round 5: *[Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, hdc in next 4 hdc; repeat from * once—38 sts.
Round 6: *[Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, hdc in next 4 hdc; repeat from * once—44 sts.
Round 7: *[Sc in next 5 sc, 2 sc in next sc] 3 times, hdc in next 4 hdc; repeat from * once—50 sts.
Round 8: Hdc in each st around.
Repeat last round until hat measures 5½” (14 cm). Do not fasten off.
Brim
Round 1: [Work 2 hdc in next 12 sts, sc in next 13 sts] twice—74 sts.
Round 2: *[Hdc in next st, 2 hdc in next st] 12 times, hdc in next 13 sts; repeat from * once—98 sts.
Round 3: Hdc in each st; join with slip st in first st.
Round 4: Ch 1, reverse sc in each st; join with slip st in first st. Fasten off.
FINISHING HAT
Weave in ends.
Hatband  
Cut a 19” (48.5 cm) length of B. Fold under ½” (1.5 cm) on each end and sew ends together with matching thread. Place just above brim, positioning seam where bow will be sewn; tack in place.
Bow  
Cut 5” (12.5 cm) and 10” (25.5 cm) lengths of B. Tie a knot in each end of longer piece. Fold into a bow shape (two loops and two straight ends). Wrap shorter piece of B around center of bow. Using sewing needle and matching thread, sew to hatband over seam.

pattern_name: MOM’N ME PUFF HAT AND FINGERLESS CROCHET GLOVES
materials: Red Heart® Super Saver™ (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Size U.S. I/9 [5.5 mm] crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdcbl = Half double crochet in back loop only
Puff st = (Yoh and draw up a long loop) 3 times in indicated stitch. 7 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook. Ch 1 to close stitch – puff st made.
measurements: Hat and Gloves: To fit Child 3/5 yrs (Adult). Gloves to fit hand circumference: 6 (7.5)" [15 (19) cm] Hat to fit head circumference: 19 (22)" [48 (56) cm]
gauge: 8 puff sts and 8 rows = 4" [10 cm] in pat.
instructions:
The instructions are written for smaller size. If changes are necessary for larger size the instructions will be written thus ( ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes.

CROCHET  I  SKILL LEVEL: EASY 

GLOVES (make 2 alike)
Cuff: With B, ch 7 ( 9).
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 5 ( 7) hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdcbl in each st to end of row. Turn
Rep last row 10 ( 14) times more. With RS facing each other, fold first and last rows tog. Ch 1. Work sl sts through both thicknesses across to join cuff in rnd. Do not fasten off. 
Cont in rnds as follows:
Body of Glove: 1st rnd: With B, ch 1. Work 24 ( 30) sc around side edge of cuff. Join A with sl st to first sc. Do not break B. 
2nd rnd: With A, ch 3. (Puff st in next sc. Skip next sc) 12 ( 15) times. Join B with sl st to top of first puff st. 12 ( 15) puff sts.
3rd rnd: With B, ch 4 (counts as dc and ch-1 sp). (Puff st in between next 2 puff sts) 12 ( 15) times. Join A with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-4.
4th rnd:  With A, ch 3. Puff st between dc and first puff st. (Puff st between next 2 puff sts)  Rep 11 ( 14) more times. Join B with sl st to top of first puff st.
5th and 6th rnds: Rep last 2 rnds 1 ( 2) time(s) more.
7th rnd:  (Thumb rnd) With B,  ch 5 (counts as dc and ch-2 sp). Skip first 2 puff sts. (Puff st between next 2 puff sts) 10 ( 13) times more. Join A with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-5.
8th rnd: With A, sl st into ch-2 sp. Ch 3. 2 dc in ch-2 sp. 1 dc in top of next puff st. (1 dc between next 2 puff sts. 1 dc in top of next puff st.) 10 ( 13) times. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-3. Fasten off.

HAT
Beg at top of Hat with A, ch 4. Join with sl st in first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. Work 6 puff sts into ring. Join B with sl st in top of first puff st. 6 puff sts.
2nd rnd: With B, ch 3. *2 puff sts between next 2 puff sts. Rep from * 5 times more. Join A with sl st in top of first puff st. 12 puff sts.
3rd rnd: With A, ch 3. *2 puff sts between next 2 puff sts. 1 puff st between next 2 puff sts. Rep from * 5 times more. Join B with sl st in top of first puff st. 18 puff sts.
4th rnd: With B, ch 3. *2 puff sts between next 2 puff sts. 1 puff st between each of next 2 puff sts. Rep from * 5 times more. Join A with sl st in top of first puff st. 24 puff sts.
5th rnd: With A, ch 3. *2 puff sts between next 2 puff sts. 1 puff st between each of next 3 puff sts. Rep from * 5 times more. Join B with sl st in top of first puff st. 30 puff sts.
Size Adult: only 6th rnd: With B, ch 3. *2 puff sts between next 2 puff sts. 1 puff st between each of next 4 puff sts. Rep from * 5 times more. Join A with sl st in top of first puff st. 36 puff sts.
7th rnd: With A, ch 3. *2 puff sts between next 2 puff sts. 1 puff st between each of next 5 puff sts. Rep from * 5 times more. Join B with sl st in top of first puff st. 42 puff sts.
Both sizes: Next rnd: With B, ch 3. *Puff st between next 2 puff sts. Rep from * 29 ( 41) more times. Join A with sl st in top of first puff st.
Rep last rnd 3 ( 5) times more, alternating colors A and B. Fasten off.

Brim: With B, ch 7 ( 9).
1st row: 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 5 ( 7) hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdcbl in each st to end of row. Turn
Rep last row 36 ( 42) times more.
With RS facing each other, fold first and last rows tog. Ch 1. Work sl sts through both thicknesses across to join Brim in rnd. Do not fasten off.

Join Brim to Hat: Turn Hat WS out and align Brim with last rnd of Hat. Ch 1. Work 30 ( 42) sl sts through both thicknesses of side edge of Brim and hat. Fasten off and turn Hat RS out.
Pompom:  Wind 1 strand each of A and B tog around 4 fingers 50 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Hat.

materials: Cream 14 ¼ oz (405 g) for size 6
Cream 3½ oz (100 g) for Doll's Version
Sizes G/6 (4.00 mm), H/8 (5.00 mm), and K/10 ½ (6.50 mm) crochet hooks
abbreviations: CL = (Yoh. Draw up a loop in next st) 3 times. Yoh and draw through all 7 loops on hook.
measurements: Sizes for Girl’s Version: Chest measurement 2 22 ins [56 cm], 4 24 ins [61 cm], 6 26 ins [66 cm]; Finished chest 2 26 ins [66 cm], 4 28 ins [71 cm], 6 30 ins [76 cm]; Doll’s Version Size: To fit 18 ins [45 cm] Springfield Collection Doll.
gauge: Cardigan: 12 dc and 8 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] with size H/8 hook. Hat: 14 dc and 9 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] with size G/6 hook.
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes, the instructions will be written thus (  ).

Girl’s Cardigan
Note: Cardigan is worked sideways.

BACK
With size H/8 hook, ch 36 (42-46).
1st row:(WS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as first dc). 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. Turn.
34 (40-44) sts.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as first dc). Miss first dc. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 13 (14-15) ins [33 (35.5-38) cm]. Fasten off.

RIGHT FRONT
With size K/10½ hook, ch 36 (42-46) loosely. (Front edge).
1st row: With size H/8 hook, 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each of next 18 (23-26) ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 (2-3) ch. Turn. Leave rem 11 (12-12) ch unworked. 23 (28-32) sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 (2-3) sc. 1 hdc in next st. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. Miss first dc. 1 dc in each of next 22 (27-31) sts. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch of foundation ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 2 ch. Turn. Leave rem 5 (6-6) ch unworked. 29 (34-38) sts.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. 1 hdc in next st. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 3. Miss first dc. 1 dc in each of next 28 (33-37) sts. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch of foundation ch. 1 hdc in next ch. 1 sc in each of next 1 (2-2) ch. Turn. 34 (40-44) sts.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
7th row: (WS). Ch 5. CL in first sc. Ch 1. Miss next 2 sc. *(1 dc. Ch 2. CL) all in next sc. Ch 1. Miss next 2 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 dc in last sc. Turn.
***8th row: Ch 2. *2 sc in next ch-2 sp. Working behind previous row, 1 dc in next sc of 6th row. Rep from * to turning ch-5. 2 sc in ch-5. 1 sc in 3rd ch of turning ch-5. Turn.
9th row: Ch 3. Miss first st. 1 dc in each st to end of row. 1 dc in top of turning ch-2. Turn.
10th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 7th to 10th rows once more.
Next row: As 9th row.
Size 6 only: Next row: Ch 3. Miss first st. 1 dc in each st to end of row.
All Sizes: Fasten off.
***

LEFT FRONT
Rep from ** to ** as given for Right Front. Fasten off. Do not turn.
Rejoin yarn with ss to first sc of last row and proceed as follows:
Next row: (WS). Ch 5. CL in same sc as last ss. Ch 1. Miss next 2 sc. *(1 dc. Ch 2. CL) all in next sc. Ch 1. Miss next 2 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 dc in last sc. Turn.
Rep from *** to *** as given for Right Front.

SLEEVES 
With size H/8 hook, ch 23 (25-25).
1st row: 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 21 (23-23) sts.
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each dc to last dc. 2 dc in last dc. Turn. 23 (25-25) sts.
3rd row: Ch 3. Miss first dc. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows 5 (8-9) times more, then 2nd row 2 (0-0) times.  37 (41-43) sts. Fasten off.

Sleeve Ribbing (make 2 alike)
With size H/8 hook, ch 5.
****1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in back loop only of each sc to end of row. Turn.****
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 7 (7½-7½) ins  [18 (19-19) cm], when slightly stretched. Fasten off.

Body Ribbing (make 1)
With size H/8 hook, ch 7.
Rep from **** to **** as given for Sleeve Ribbing.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 25 (27-29) ins [63.5 (68.5-73.5) cm], when slightly stretched. Fasten off.

Band: With size H/8 hook, ch 110 (123-136).
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 109 (121-135) sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 82 (91-98) sc. [Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 (6-6) sc] 4 (4-5) times. Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 (2-2) sc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc and ch-1 sp to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Sew shoulder seams. Place markers 6 (6½-7) ins [15 (16.5-18) cm] down from shoulder seams on Fronts and Back of Cardigan. Sew in Sleeves between markers. Sew ribbing onto Sleeves. Sew Sleeve and side seams. Sew ribbing onto Body. Sew Band onto Cardigan. Sew buttons to correspond to buttonholes.

Girl’s Cap
With size G/6 hook, ch 4. Ss to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as first dc). 11 dc in ring. Ss to top of ch 3. 12 dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last ss. 2 dc in each dc around. Ss to top of ch 3. 24 dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last ss. *1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last dc. 1 dc in last dc. Ss to top of ch 3. 36 dc.
4th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last ss. *1 dc in each of next 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 2 dc. 1 dc in each of last 2 dc. Ss to top of ch 3. 48 dc.
5th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last ss. *1 dc in each of next 3 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 3 dc. 1 dc in each of last 3 dc. Ss to top of ch 3. 60 dc.
6th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last ss. *1 dc in each of next 9 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 9 dc. 1 dc in each of last 9 dc. Ss to top of ch 3. 66 dc.
7th rnd: Ch 3. Miss first dc (where last ss was worked). 1 dc in next dc and each dc around. Ss to top of ch 3.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each dc around. Ss in first sc.
9th rnd: Ch 5. CL in same st as last ss. Ch 1. Miss next 2 sc. *(1 dc. Ch 2. CL) all in next st. Ch 1. Miss next 2 sc. Rep from * to end of rnd. Ss in 3rd ch of ch-5.
10th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first ch-2 sp. Working behind previous rnd, 1 dc in next sc of 8th rnd. *2 sc in next ch-2 sp. Working behind previous rnd, 1 dc in next sc of 8th rnd. Rep from * to end of rnd. Ss in first sc.
11th rnd: Ch 3. Miss first sc (where last ss was worked). 1 dc in next sc and each st around. Ss to top of ch 3.
Rep 8th to 11th rnds once more, then 8th rnd once. Fasten off.

Doll’s Cardigan
Note: Cardigan is worked sideways.

BACK
With size H/8 hook, ch 24.
1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook (counts as first dc). 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 22 sts.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as first dc). Miss first dc. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 6½ins [16.5 cm]. Fasten off.

FRONTS (make 2 alike)
With size H/8 hook, ch 24 loosely. 1st row: (RS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each of next 20 ch. 22 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 5. CL in first sc. Ch 1. Miss next 2 sc. *(1 dc. Ch 2. CL) all in next sc. Ch 1. Miss next 2 sc. Rep from * to last sc. 1 dc in last sc. Turn.
5th row: Ch 2. *2 sc in next ch-2 sp. Working behind previous row, 1 dc in next sc of 3rd row. Rep from * to turning ch-5. 2 sc in ch-5. 1 sc in 3rd ch of turning ch-5. Turn.
6th row: Ch 3. Miss first st. 1 dc in each st to end of row. 1 dc in top of turning ch-2. Turn.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc to end of row. Turn.
8th and 9th rows: Ch 3. Miss first st. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off at end of 9th row.

SLEEVES 
With size H/8 hook, ch 15.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 14 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. Miss first st. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 1 dc in each dc to last dc. 2 dc in last dc. Turn.
Rep 3rd and 4th rows twice more. 20 sts. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Place markers on top edge of Back, 2½ins [6 cm] in from left and right sides. Sew Fronts to Back along shoulders to markers. Place markers 3¼ins [8.5 cm] down from shoulder seams on Fronts and Back. Sew in Sleeves between markers. Sew side and sleeve seams. 
Front, Neck and Bottom Edging: Join yarn with ss to bottom corner of Right Front. With size H/8 hook, ch 1. Work 21 sc up right front, 3 sc in corner st, 24 sc around neck edge, 3 sc in corner st, and 21 sc down Left Front. Ch 1. Work 45 sc along bottom edge.
2nd row: (Bottom edge only). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 45 sc. Fasten off.

Sew on buttons as illustrated. Note: Spaces between dc posts create buttonholes.

Doll’s Cap
With size G/6 hook, ch 4. Ss to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as first dc). 11 dc in ring. 12 dc. Ss to top of ch 3.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last ss. 2 dc in each dc around. 24 dc. Ss to top of ch 3.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last ss. *1 dc in next dc. 2 dc in next dc. Rep from * around to last dc. 1 dc in last dc. Ss to top of ch 3. 36 dc. Ss to top of ch 3.
4th to 7th rnds: Ch 3. Miss first dc (where last ss was worked). 1 dc in next dc and each dc around. Ss to top of ch 3.
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each dc around. Ss in first sc. Fasten off.

pattern_name: Crochet Bear Hat and Diaper Cover
materials: RED HEART® Babyhugs™ Medium: 1 ball each 4801 Blueberry A and 4562 Aloe B
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4mm [US G-6] and 5mm [US H-8]
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Diaper Cover Waist: 15 (16, 17)" [38 (40.5, 43) cm]; Hat circumference at bottom edge: 13 (14, 15)" [33 (35.5, 38) cm]
gauge: 16 sc = 4" [10 cm]; 18 rows = 4" [10 cm] in single crochet using larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Diaper Cover
BACK
Waistband
With B and smaller hook, ch 6 (6, 8). 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 5 sc.
Rows 2-44 (46, 48): Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across.
Body
Row 1: Change to larger hook and A, ch 1, turn to work along long edge of Waistband, sc 44 (46, 48) sts evenly spaced along edge – 44 (46, 48) sts. 
Rows 2-16 (16, 18): Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Shape Leg
Row 17 (17, 19): Turn, skip first sc, slip st in next 3 sc, sc in next 36 (38, 40) sc, leave remaining 4 sc unworked – 36 (38, 40) sc.
Row 18 (18, 20): Turn, skip first sc, slip st in next 3 sc, sc in next 28 (30, 32) sc, leave remaining 4 sc unworked – 28 (30, 32) sc.
Row 19 (19, 21): Turn, skip first sc, slip st in next 3 sc, sc in next 20 (22, 24) sc, leave remaining 4 sc unworked – 20 (22, 24) sc.
Row 20 (20, 22): Turn, skip first sc, slip st in next 3 sc, sc in next 12 (14, 16) sc, leave remaining 4 sc unworked – 12 (14, 16) sc.
Row 21 (21, 23): Ch 1, turn, sc in next sc, sc2tog, sc in next 6 (8, 10) sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc – 10 (12, 14) sc.
For 6 and 12 Months Size Only 
Row (22, 24): Ch 1, turn, sc next sc, sc2tog, sc in next (6, 8) sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc – (10, 12) sc.
For All Sizes
Last 2 Rows: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
FRONT
Waistband
With B and smaller hook, ch 6 (6, 8). 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 5 sc.
Rows 2-17 (17, 19): Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across.
Body
Row 1: Change to larger hook and A, ch 1, turn to work along long edge of Waistband, sc 17 (17, 19) sts evenly spaced along edge – 17 (17, 19) sts.
Rows 2-16 (17, 18): Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Shape Leg
Row 17 (18, 19): Ch 1, turn, sc in next sc, sc2tog, sc in next 11 (11, 13) sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc – 15 (15, 17) sc.
Row 18 (19, 20): Ch 1, turn, sc in next sc, sc2tog, sc in next 9 (9, 11) sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc – 13 (13, 15) sc.
Row 19 (20, 21): Ch 1, turn, sc in next sc, sc2tog, sc in next 7 (7, 9) sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc – 11 (11, 13) sc.
Row 20 (21, 22): Ch 1, turn, sc in next sc, sc2tog, sc in each sc to end or row – 10 (10, 12) sc.
Last 3 Rows: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew Front and Back pieces together along crotch and side seams. 
Leg Cuff 
Round 1: With right side facing and smaller hook, join B at crotch seam with a slip st, ch 1, sc in same st, sc 32 (33, 35) more sc evenly around around leg opening, slip st in first sc to join – 33 (34, 36) sc.
Rounds 2-3 (3, 4): Ch 1, sc in each sc around.
Fasten off. Repeat around opposite leg opening.
HAT
Rib
With smaller hook and A, ch 10.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 9 sc.
Rows 2-52 (56, 60): Ch 1, turn, working in back loops only, sc in each sc across.
Body
Row 1: With B and larger hook, ch 1, turn to work along long edge, sc in edge of each row – 52 (56, 60) sc.  
Rows 2-11 (12, 14): Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Shape Crown
Row 12 (13, 15): Ch 1, turn, [sc in next 11 (12, 8) sc, sc2tog] 4 (4, 6) times – 48 (52, 54) sc.
Row 13 (14, 16): Ch 1, turn, [sc in next 6 (11, 7) sc, sc2tog] 6 (4, 6) times – 42 (48, 48) sc.
Row 14 (15, 17): Ch 1, turn, [sc in next 5 (6, 6) sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 36 (42, 42) sc.
Row 15 (16, 18): Ch 1, turn, [sc in next 4 (5, 5) sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 30 (36, 36) sc.
Row 16 (17, 19): Ch 1, turn, [sc in next 3 (4, 4) sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 24 (30, 30) sc.
Row 17 (18, 20): Ch 1, turn, [sc in next 2 (3, 3) sc, sc2tog] 6 times – 18 (24, 24) sc. 
Row 18 (19, 21): Ch 1, turn, [sc in next 0 (2, 2) sc, sc2tog] 6 (4, 6) times – 9 (18, 18) sc.
For 6 and 12 Months Size Only 
Row (20, 22): Ch 1, turn, [sc2tog] 9 times – (9, 9) sc.
For All Sizes
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew back seam. With A, embroider a little bear face using satin st for eyes and nose and straight sts for mouth.
Ear (make 2)
With B and larger hook, ch 4.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, 5 hdc in last ch, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, hdc in next ch, sc in last ch.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in next sc, hdc in next 3 sts, 3 hdc in next st, hdc in next 3 sts, sc last sc.
For 6 and 12 Months Size Only 
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, [sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc next sc] 3 times, sc in last 2 sc.
For All Sizes
Fasten off, leaving a long end for sewing. Sew one Ear on either side of head. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Handicrafter Cotton (Solids: 50 g/ 1.75 oz/73 m/80 yds)
Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 14 hdc and 10 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]
instructions:
BIB
With MC, ch 21.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. *Ch 1. Miss next ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. Rep from * to end of ch.  Turn. 19 sts.
2nd row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in each st or ch 1 sp to last st. 2 hdc in last st. Join A.  Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. *(Yoh) twice and draw up a loop in missed ch of foundation ch 2 rows below in front of work. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times– long tr made. Miss next st  (behind long tr). 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last st. 1 sc in last st.  Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Join MC.  Turn.
5th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. *Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 hdc in last st. Ch 2.  Turn.
6th row: 2 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in each st or ch sp to last st. 2 hdc in last st. Join A.  Turn.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. *Long tr in next missed st 2 rows below. Miss next st (behind long tr). 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Long tr in next missed st 2 rows below. Miss next st (behind long tr). 1 sc in each of next 2 sts.  Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Join MC.  Turn. 27 sts.
Cont even in pat as placed in last 8 rows for 12 more rows.
Shape neck: 1st row: (RS). With MC, ch 2. Pat across 6 sts. Yoh and draw up a loop in next st. Draw up a loop in next st. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook– hdc2tog made. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog over first 2 sts. Pat to end of row. Join A. Ch 1.  Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. Pat to last 2 sts. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made.  Turn. 5 sts.
Work 6 rows even in pat.
Next row: (WS). Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. Pat to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Join A.  Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Pat to last st. 2 sc in last st.  Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. Pat to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Join MC.  Turn.
Next row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. Pat to last st. 2 hdc in last st.  Turn.
Next row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. Pat to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Fasten off.
With RS of work facing, miss next 11 sts. Join MC with sl st to next st. Ch 2. Hdc2tog over this st and next st. Pat to end of row.  Turn.
Work to correspond to first side, reversing all shapings.
Edging: Join A with sl st to top left corner of neck edge. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 1 row sc evenly around all edges. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Working around outer edge only, ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc to opposite side. Fasten off. With A, make button loop at center back on left side. Sew button in position.
BOOTIES
With A, ch 28.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 27 sts.  Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Join MC.  Turn.
3rd row: With MC, ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. *Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 hdc in next st.  Turn. 
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in each st or ch 1 sp to end of row. Join A.  Turn.
5th row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in first st. *Long tr in next missed ch 2 rows below. Miss next st (behind long tr). 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Long tr in next missed ch 2 rows below. Miss next st (behind long tr). 1 sc in last st.  Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 sc in each of last 3 sts.  Turn. 23 sts.
7th row: (Eyelet row). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. *Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts.  Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st or ch 1 sp to end of row. Fasten off.
Instep: 1st row: With RS of work facing, miss first 7 sts. Join A with sl st to next st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts.  Turn. 9 sts.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to end of row.  Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row.  Turn.
4th row: As 2nd row.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
Sew center back seam. With RS of work facing, join A with sl st at center back seam. Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Work 5 sc down side of instep. 3 sc in corner sc. 5 sc across end of instep. 3 sc in corner sc. Work 5 sc along other side of instep. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Join with sl st to first st. 35 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join MC with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only work 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 11 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 11 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st.
Fasten off. Join center foot seam.
Drawstring: 
With MC, chain a length to measure 16 ins [40.5 cm]. Fasten off. Weave drawstring through eyelet row. Knot ends of drawstring.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream (Solids: 70.9 g/2.5 oz/109 m/120 yds)
Contrast A: (Lt Blue) 1 ball for Teddy Set
Contrast A: (Pink) 1 ball for Sweetheart Set
Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge
1¼ yards [1.15 m] of ¼ inch [6.50 mm] ribbon for Teddy Set Bib and Booties
1 yard [.9 m] of ¼ inch [6.50 mm] ribbon for Sweetheart Set Booties
measurements: Finished sizes vary depending on versions chosen.
gauge: 14 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]
instructions:
Note: when working from chart, wind small balls of the colors to be used, one for each separate area of color in the design. Start new colors at appropriate points. To change colors, work until there are 2 loops on hook of last st before color change. Draw next color through 2 loops and proceed.

BIB
With MC, ch 20.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 19 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
4th row: As 2nd row. 23 sts.
Bear Version: 5th row: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sts. Work 1st row of Bear Chart across next 17 sts. With MC, 1 sc in each of last 3 sts. Turn. (See chart on page 10.) Chart is now in position.
Heart Version: 5th row: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. Work 1st row of Heart Chart across next 19 sts. With MC, 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Turn. Chart is now in position.
Both Versions: 6th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. Keeping cont of chart, work 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Turn.
7th row: Keeping cont of chart, ch 1. Work 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
8th and 9th rows: Rep last 2 rows once more. 27 sts.
Cont even, working chart of choice to end of chart. Break A.
With MC, cont even until work from beg measures 6½ ins [16.5 cm], ending with RS facing for next row.
Shape neck: 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sts. Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook– sc2tog made. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn. 5 sts.
Work 10 rows even.
Next row: (WS). Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. Pat to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows twice more. Fasten off.
With RS of work facing, miss next 11 sts. Join MC with sl st to next st. Ch 1. Sc2tog over this st and next st. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Work to correspond to first side, reversing all shapings.

Sweetheart or Teddy Set (to crochet)

Edging: Join A with sl st to top left corner of neck edge. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. Work 1 row sc evenly around all edges. Join MC with sl st to first sc.
Next row: With MC, working around outer edge only, ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. Ch 1. Miss next sc. Rep from * to last st. 1 sc in last st. Fasten off.
Next row: With RS of work facing, join A with sl st to first st of last row. Ch 1. Miss first st. *1 sc in next st below ch 1 sp. Ch 1. Miss next st. Rep from * ending with 1 sc in last sc. Fasten off. With A, make button loop at center back on left side. Sew button in position.
Bear Version: Cut 7 ins [18 cm] length of ribbon. Tie around bear’s neck in bow as illustrated. Stitch securely in position on WS.

BOOTIES
With A, ch 28. Join in rnd with sl st in first ch.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join MC with sl st to first sc. 28 sc.
2nd rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. *Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around ending with ch 1. Miss last sc. Join A with sl st to first sc.
3rd rnd: With A, ch 2. Miss first sc (where last ss was worked). *1 sc in sc from 1st rnd below next ch 1 sp. Ch 1. Miss next sc. Rep from * around, ending with 1 sc in sc from 1st rnd below last ch-1 sp. Join with sl st to first ch of ch 2.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *1 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next ch 1 sp. Rep from * around ending with 1 sc in last sc. Join MC with sl st to first sc.
5th to 7th rnds: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
8th rnd: (Eyelet rnd). 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. *Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Join with sl st to first sc.
9th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 23 sc.
Instep: 1st row: With RS of work facing, miss first 7 sts. Join MC with sl st to next st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Turn. 9 sts.
2nd to 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Sc2tog. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
With RS of work facing, join MC with sl st at center back. Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Work 5 sc down side of instep. 3 sc in corner sc. 3 sc across end of instep. 3 sc in corner sc. Work 5 sc along other side of instep. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Join with sl st to first st. 33 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join A with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: With A, ch 1. Working in back loops only, work 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off. Join center foot seam. Weave ribbon through eyelet row.

materials: RED HEART® Super Tweed®: 3 (3, 4, 4) skeins 7803 Blue Bayou. Note: 2 (2, 3, 3) balls are needed for sweater only. 1 ball is needed for leg warmers only.
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 5.0mm [US H-8], 5.5mm [US I-9] and afghan crochet hook 5.5mm [US I-9]
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: With larger hook, 13 sts and 11 rows in hdc or cable pattern = 4” (10cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size needles/hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
SWEATER
Bottom Ribbing
With larger hook ch 8 leaving a sewing length. Row 1: Working in blo of ch sts, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 7 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in blo of each st across; turn.
Repeat Row 2 until ribbing measures 24(26, 27½, 29)” (61 [66, 68.5, 73.5] cm) from beginning. Fasten off, leaving a sewing length.
Left Front Panel Extension
With larger hook ch 12 (12, 14, 14). Row 1: Working in blo of ch sts, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 11 (11, 13, 13) sts; turn.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), working in blo, dc in next 9 (9, 10, 10) sts, hdc in last st; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, working in flo, slip st in each st across; turn – 11 (11, 13, 13) slip sts.
Rows 4-5: Repeat Rows 2-3 once. Fasten off.
Right Front Panel Extension
With larger hook, ch 12 (12, 14, 14).
Row 1: Working in blo of ch sts, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 11 (11, 13, 13) sts.
Row 2: Ch 3, working in blo, dc in each st across; turn – 11 (11, 13, 13) dc.
Row 3: Ch 1, working in flo, slip st in each st across; turn – 11 (11, 13, 13) slip sts.
Rows 4-5: Repeat Rows 2-3 once. Do not fasten off; continue to Body, Row 1.
Body
Row 1 (right side): Working over Right Front Panel Extension, ch 3, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12) sts, working across long edge of Bottom Ribbing, work 78 (85, 90, 95) hdc evenly spaced across, working across Left Front Panel Extension, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12) sts, hdc in blo of last st; turn – 100 (107, 116, 121) sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, slip st in flo of first 11 (11, 13, 13) sts, hdc in each of next 78 (85, 90, 95) sts, slip st in flo of last 11 sts; turn – 100 (107, 116, 121) sts.
Begin Cable Pattern
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12), hdc in next 0 (1, 1, 2) sts, work Cable Row 1, hdc in each of next 1 (3, 4, 5) sts, work Cable Row 1, hdc in each of next 8 (9, 12, 13) sts, work Cable Row 1, hdc in each of next 1 (3, 4, 5) sts, work Cable Row 1, hdc in next 0 (1, 1, 2) sts, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12) sts, hdc in blo of next st; turn – 100 (107, 116, 121) sts.
Row 4: Repeat Row 2.
Row 5: Ch 3, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12), hdc in next 0 (1, 1, 2) sts, work Cable Row 3, hdc in each of next 1 (3, 4, 5) sts, work Cable Row 3, hdc in each of next 8 (9, 12, 13) sts, work Cable Row 3, hdc in each of next 1 (3, 4, 5) sts, work Cable Row 3, hdc in next 0 (1, 1, 2) sts, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12) sts, hdc in blo of next st; turn.
Row 6: Repeat Row 2.
Row 7: Ch 3, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12), hdc in next 0 (1, 1, 2) sts, work Cable Row 5, hdc in each of next 1 (3, 4, 5) sts, work Cable Row 5, hdc in each of next 8 (9, 12, 13) sts, work Cable Row 5, hdc in each of next 1 (3, 4, 6) sts, work Cable Row 5, hdc in next 0 (1, 1, 2) sts, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12) sts, hdc in blo of next st; turn.
Row 8: Repeat Row 2.
Row 9: Ch 3, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12), hdc in next 0 (1, 1, 2) sts, work Cable Row 7, hdc in each of next 1 (3, 4, 5) sts, work Cable Row 7, hdc in each of next 8 (9, 12, 13) sts, work Cable Row 7, hdc in each of next 1 (3, 4, 5) sts, work Cable Row 7, hdc in next 0 (1, 1, 2) sts, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12) sts, hdc in blo of next st; turn.
Row 10: Repeat Row 2.
Repeat Rows 3-10 until Body measures 7½ (9, 10, 12)” (19 [23, 25.5, 30.5] cm) from beginning, ending with a wrong side row.
DIVIDE FOR FRONTS AND BACK
RIGHT FRONT
Row 1 (right side): Ch 3, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12) sts, hdc in next 0 (1, 1, 2) st, working in established pattern, work next Cable Row, hdc in next 0 (1, 2, 3) sts; turn, leaving remaining sts unworked – 28 (30, 33, 34) sts.
Row 2 (buttonhole row 1) (wrong side): Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), hdc in next 16 (18, 19, 20) sts, in panel work: slip st in flo of next 2 sts, ch 2, skip next 2 sts, slip st in flo of next 3 (3, 5, 5) sts, ch 2, skip next 2 sts, slip st in flo of next 2 sts; turn.
Row 3 (buttonhole row 2): Ch 3, dc in blo of each slip st and ch across; continue in pattern across working established cable row.
Rows 4-5 (5, 7, 7): Work even in established pattern.
Rows 6-7 (6-7, 8-9, 8-9): Repeat Rows 2-3 (Buttonhole Rows 1-2).
Rows 8-9 (8-9, 10-11, 10-11): Work even in established pattern.
Shape Neck
Next Row: Ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), hdc in next 14 (16, 17, 18) sts, hdc2tog over next 2 sts; turn, leaving remaining sts unworked – 16 (18, 19, 20) sts.
Continue in established cable pattern over 16 (18, 19, 20) sts for 3” (7.5 cm) from beginning of Shape Neck. Fasten off.
BACK
Row 1: With right side facing, join yarn in first hdc to the left of Right Front, work in established pattern over next 44 (47, 50, 53) sts; turn, leaving remaining sts unworked. Continue in pattern until Back measures same as finished Right Front.
LEFT FRONT
Row 1: With right side facing, join yarn in first hdc to the left of Back, ch 1 (2, 2, 2), hdc in next 0 (0, 1, 2) st, work Cable Row 1, hdc in next 0 (1, 1, 2) st, dc in blo of next 10 (10, 12, 12) sts, hdc in blo of next st; turn – 28 (30, 33, 34) sts.
Rows 2-9 (2-9, 2-11, 2-11): Work even in established pattern.
Shape Neck
Next Row: Ch 1, slip st in flo of first 11 (11, 13, 13) sts, hdc2tog over next 2 sts, hdc in next 15 (17, 18, 19) sts; turn – 16 (18, 19, 20) sts not counting slip sts.
Continue in established cable pattern over first 16 (18, 19, 20) sts for 3” (7.5 cm) from beginning of Shape Neck. Fasten off.
SLEEVES (make 2) 
Ribbing
With larger hook, ch 5.
Row 1 (right side): Slip st in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 4 slip sts.
Row 2: Ch 3, dc in blo of next 2 sts, hdc in blo of next st; turn. Mark this as the right side.
Row 3: Ch 1, slip st in flo of each st across; turn – 4 slip sts.
Repeat Rows 2-3 until Ribbing measures 11 (11½, 12, 12½)” (28 [29, 30.5, 31.5] cm) from beginning. Do not fasten off.
Sleeve Body
Rotate to work across long edge of Ribbing.
Row 1: Ch 2, work 38 (38, 44, 44) hdc evenly spaced across long edge of Ribbing; turn – 39 (39, 45, 45) hdc.
Row 2: Ch 2, hdc in each st across, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until Sleeve measures 3½ (4, 4½, 5)” (9 [10, 11.5, 12.5] cm) from top of Ribbing.
Edging
With right side of Sleeve facing, using afghan hook, pick up 35 (37, 39, 41) loops across opposite side of side of Ribbing.
Work even in Tss for 3 rows. Bind off.
FINISHING
Sew Fronts to Back across shoulder. Sew side and sleeve seams. Sew front panel extensions to bottom ribbing. Sew buttons to Left Front opposite buttonholes.
Neckband
With right side of Sweater facing, using afghan hook, pick up loops around neck edge, about one loop per st.
Work even in Tss for 3 rows. Bind off.
Weave in ends.
LEG WARMERS (make 2)
With larger hook, ch 35 (41, 48, 55).
Row 1: With smaller hook, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each of next 6 ch, place marker, with larger hook, hdc in each of next 19 (24, 30, 36) ch, place marker, sc in each of last 8 (9, 10, 11); turn – 34 (40, 47, 54) sts. Move markers up as work progresses.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in blo of first 8 (9, 10, 11) sts, hdc in each of next 19 (24, 30, 36) sts, with smaller hook, sc in blo of last 7 sts; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in blo of first 7 sts, with larger hook 19 (24, 30, 36) hdc, 8 (9, 10, 11) sc blo. Turn.
Repeat Rows 2-3 until Legging measures 8 3/4 (9½, 10½, 11)” (22 [24, 26.5, 28] cm) ending with Row 2 of pattern.
Fold first row to back of work and attach as follows: with smaller hook, ch 1, working through double thickness, *sc in blo of next sc in last row and in corresponding ch of foundation ch; repeat from * 6 times; with larger hook, slip st in each of next 19 (24, 30, 36) hdc and in corresponding ch sts of foundation ch; sc in blo of each of last 8 (9,10, 11) sc and corresponding ch sts of foundation ch. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: Size 3.25 mm (U.S. D or 3) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
¼ yrd [0.3 m] of lining fabric for Purse
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook - Sc2tog made.
measurements: Purse: Approx 7 x 10½ ins [18 x 26.5 cm].
gauge: 8½ V-sts and 12 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] 1 Motif = 3½ ins [9 cm] square.
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written thus (  ).
MOTIF [make 10 (10-11-11-12)]
Ch 8. Join in ring.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 15 sc in rnd. Join with sl st in first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 6 (counts as dc and ch 3). *Miss next sc. 1 dc in next sc. Ch 3. Rep from * 6 times more. Join with sl st in 3rd ch of ch 6.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. *(1 sc. 1 hdc. 1 dc. 1 hdc. 1 sc) all in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc.
4th rnd: *Ch 5. (Miss next sc, hdc, dc, hdc). 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first ch of ch 5.
5th rnd: Ch 1. *(1 sc. 1 hdc. 3 dc. 1 hdc. 1 sc) all in next ch-5 sp. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc.
6th rnd: Sl st in next hdc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Ch 4. *Miss next 2 dc. 1 sc in next dc. Ch 4. (Miss next hdc, 2 sc). 1 sc in next hdc. Ch 4. Miss next 2 dc. 1 sc in next dc**. Ch 7. (Miss next hdc, 2 sc). 1 sc in next hdc. Ch 4. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Ch 7. Sl st in first sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. (4 sc in next ch-4 sp) 3 times. *(3 sc. Ch 2. 3 sc) in next corner ch-7 sp. (4 sc in next ch-4 sp) 3 times. Rep from * twice more. (3 sc. Ch 2. 3 sc) in next corner ch-7 sp. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Joining Motifs:
Sizes XS, M and XL only: Place 2 motifs with RS facing tog. Working through both thicknessess, proceed as follows: Join yarn with sl st to any corner ch. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 10 times. Fasten off.
Sizes S and L only: With RS of 2 motifs facing, proceed as follows: join yarn with sl st to any corner ch of First motif. Ch 1. Sl st to corner ch of second motif. *Ch 2. Miss next sc of first motif. Sl st in next sc. Ch 2. Miss next sc of second motif. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * to corner sc of both motifs. Fasten off. Foundation rnd for Body: Size XS only:
With RS of work facing, join yarn with sl st to any motif corner sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Work 21 sc across top of motif. 1 sc in joining sp between motifs. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 220 sc.
ABBREVIATIONS: www.patonsyarns.com/glossary
Sizes M and XL only:With RS of work facing, join yarn with sl st to any motif corner sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 20 sc across top of first motif. [(1 sc in joining sp between motifs. Work 21 sc across top of next motif)(4-1) time(s). 2 sc in joining sp between motifs. Work 21 sc across top of next motif](2-4) times. (1 sc in joining sp between motifs. Work 21 sc across top of next motif) (0-3) times. 1 sc in joining sp between motifs. Join with sl st to first sc. (244-268) sc.
Sizes S and L only: With RS of work facing, join yarn with sl st to any corner sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 20 sc across top of first motif. [2 sc in joining sp between motifs. Work 21 sc across top of next motif) (4-2) time(s). 3 sc in joining sp between motifs. Work 21 sc across top of next motif] (1-3) time(s). (2 sc in joining sp between motifs. Work 21 sc across top of next motif) (4-1) time(s). (3-2) sc in joining sp between motifs. Join with sl st to first sc. (232-256) sc.
FRONT
All Sizes: **1st row:(RS). Ch 3 (counts as dc). Miss next sc. [(1 dc. Ch 1. 1 dc) all in next sc - V-st made. Miss next 2 sc] 35 (37-39-41-43) times. V-st in next sc. Miss next sc. 1 dc in next sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 36 (38-40-42-44) V-sts.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). V-st in each V-st to end of row. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
Last row forms pat.
Cont in pat until work from foundation rnd measures 13 ins [33 cm], ending with RS facing for next row.
Armhole shaping: 1st row:Sl st in first dc. (Sl st in next dc, ch 1 sp, dc) 3 times. Sl st in next dc. Ch 3 (counts as dc). Miss next ch 1 sp and dc. V-st in each V-st to last 4 V-sts. 1 dc in next dc of next V-st. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in ch-1 sp of next V-st. V-st in each V-st to last V-st. 1 dc in ch-1 sp of last V-st. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. Miss first 2 dc. V st in each V-st to last dc. Miss last dc. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn. 26 (28-30-32-34) V-sts.**
Work 3 (3-3-5-5) rows even in pat.
V-neck shaping: ***1st row: Ch 3. V-st in each of next 12 (13-14-14-15) V-sts. 1 dc in ch-1 sp of next V-st. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in ch-1 sp of next V-st. V-st in each V-st to end of row. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. V-st in each V-st to last dc. Miss last dc. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows until there are 6 (7-8-9-10) V-sts.
Cont even in pat until armhole measures 7 ½ (7 ½-8-8½-8½) ins [19 (19-20.5-20.5-21.5) cm], ending with RS facing for next row. Fasten off.***
With WS of work facing, join yarn to top of turning ch and work from *** to *** as given above for Right Front, noting RS rows become WS.
BACK
Work from ** to ** as given for Front omitting references to leave rem sts unworked.
Cont even in pat until armhole measures 2 rows less than Front, ending with RS facing for next row.
Back neck shaping: Next row: Ch 3. V-st in each of next 6 (7-8-9-10) V-sts. 1 dc in next dc of next V-st. Turn.
Leave rem sts unworked.
Next row: Ch 3. V-st in each V-st to end of row. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Fasten off.
With WS of work facing, join yarn with sl st to top of turning ch. Ch 3. V-st in each of next 6 (7-8-9-10) V-sts. 1 dc in first dc of next V-st. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
Next row: Ch 3. V-st in each V-st to end of row. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Fasten off.
SLEEVES
Make 3 Motifs.
Join Motifs in a row as given for Size S of Front.
Foundation row: With RS of work facing, join yarn with sl st to right corner sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 25 sc across top of first motif. (4 sc in joining sp between motifs. Work 23 sc across top of next motif) twice. Turn. 80 sc.
Next row: (WS). Ch 3 (counts as dc). (Miss next sc. V-st in next sc. Miss next sc) 26 times. 1 dc in last sc. Turn. 26 V-sts.
2nd row: Ch 3 (counts as dc). V-st in each V-st to end of row. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
Last row forms pat.
Rep last row 13 (3-3-3-3) times more.
Proceed as follows: 1st row: (RS). Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. V-st in each V-st to end of row. 2 dc in top of ch 3. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. Miss first dc. 1 dc in next dc. V-st in each V-st to last dc. 1 dc in last dc. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. Miss first dc. V-st in next dc. V-st in each V-st to last dc. V-st in last dc. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. V-st in each V-st to end of row. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn. 30 sts V-st.
Rep last row 10 (8-4-2-2) times more.
Sizes S, M, L and XL only: Rep last (12-8-6-6) rows (1-2-3-3) time(s) more. (30-32-34-34) V-sts.
All Sizes: Shape Top: 1st row: Sl st in first dc. (Sl st in next dc, ch 1 sp, dc) twice. Sl st in next dc. Ch 3 (counts as dc). Miss next ch 1 sp and dc. V-st in each V-st to last 3 V-sts. Miss next dc and ch-1 sp of next V-st. 1 dc in next dc of same V-st. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in ch-1 sp of next V-st. V-st in each V-st to last V-st. 1 dc in ch-1 sp of last V-st. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. Miss first 2 dc. V-st in each V-st to last dc. Miss last dc. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows until there are 6 V-sts.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
V-Neck Edging: Sew right shoulder seam. With RS of work facing, join yarn with sl st to corner of left front neck edge. Ch 1. Work 34 (34-37-37-40) sc down left front V-neck edge. Body Edging: With RS of work facing, join yarn to any corner sc of Motif.
Work as given for Foundation rnd for Body for appropriate size, to last 2 sts. (2 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st in first sc. 220 (232-244-256-268) sc.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Miss next 2 sc. (2 dc. Ch 3. Sl st in top of dc - Picot made. 3 dc) all in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around, ending with 1 sc in last sc. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.

Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. *Miss next 2 sc. (2 dc. Picot. 3 dc) in next sc. Miss next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * around. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off.

Make 12 motifs.
Join 3 motifs in row as follows: Place 2 motifs with RS facing tog. Join yarn with sl st to any corner ch sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. (Ch 1. Miss next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 11 times. Fasten off.
Join 2 rows for Front or Back in same manner as given for joining Motifs.
Note: Ch 2 does not count as st.
Gusset and bottom: (worked in one piece). Ch 4.
1st row:(RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in next ch. Ch 2. Turn.
2nd row: 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Ch 2. Turn.
3rd row: 2 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Ch 2. Turn.
4th to 6th rows: 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Ch 2. Turn.
7th row: 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Ch 2. Turn.
8th to 11th rows: As 4th to 7th rows.
12th row: 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Ch 2. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 20 ins [51 cm], ending with RS facing for next row.
Next row:(Yoh and draw up a loop in next st) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - Hdc2tog made. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 2 hdc. Hdc2tog over last 2 hdc. Ch 2. Turn.
Next and alt WS rows: 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Ch 2. Turn. Rep last 2 rows to 2 hdc. Fasten off at end of last row.
Lining: Before joining Front, Back and sides tog, mark WS of lining according to the shape of each piece with ¾ ins [1.5 cm] seam allowance on side and bottom edges and ½ ins [1 cm] seam allowance to top edges. Cut out lining pieces. Sew bottom seam of Front, Back and sides tog using french seam (see diagram). Sew sides using french seam. Stitch along top of Front, Back and sides lining ½ ins [1 cm] from edge. Press lining to WS along this stitching line.
Joining Front, Back and Gusset: With WS of Front and Gusset tog, join yarn with sl st to top left corner of Front. Ch 1. Working through both thicknessess, work 1 row of sc down left side of Front, across bottom and up right side of Front. Do not turn.
Next row: Working from left to right instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off.
Repeat for Back.
Handles (make 2).
Ch 80.
1st row:(RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of ch. Turn.
Next 3 rows: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Fold Handle lengthwise and insert pipecleaner, working through both thicknessess, work 1 sc in each hdc and foundation ch to end of row. Fasten off.
Sew handles to Front and Back as illustrated. Sew in zipper.

instructions:
BLANKET
With A, ch 138.

Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first dc, (ch 4, sc) in each ch-1 space across, ch 4, sc in top of beginning ch, turn—28 sc and 27 ch-4 spaces.
Row 3: Ch 2 (counts as first dc), 4 dc in first ch-4 space, (ch 1, 4 dc) in each remaining ch-4 space across, dc in last sc, turn—110 dc and 26 ch-1 spaces.
Rows 4–73: Repeat last 2 rows alternately and change color as in the following color sequence: Work 4 rows with B, 2 rows with A, 2 rows with C, 2 rows with D, 2 rows with C, 2 rows with A, [6 rows with B, 2 rows with A, 2 rows with C, 2 row with D, 2 rows with C, 2 rows with A] 3 times, 6 rows with B, 2 rows with A.
Fasten off.
Border
Round 1 (right side): With right side facing and working in ends of rows, join D with sc in end of first row, 2 sc in same row, *3 sc in each even-numbered (sc) row across, 3 sc in last odd-numbered (dc) row*; working in last row, sc in each dc and ch-1 space across; working in ends of rows of other side, 3 sc in first odd-numbered (dc) row; repeat from * to * once; working in opposite side of foundation ch, sc in each ch across; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Place marker on center sc of each 3-sc group in odd-numbered (dc) rows and move up as next round is completed.
Round 2: With right side facing, join C with slip st in any sc except marked st, ch 2 (counts as first hdc), hdc in each st around working 3 dc in each marked st; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off.
Round 3: With D, repeat Round 2.
HAT
With D, make an adjustable loop.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 2 (does not count as a st here and throughout), 12 dc in ring; join with slip st in first dc—12 dc. Pull gently, but firmly, on tail to tighten ring.
Round 2: Ch 2, 2 dc in each st around; join with slip st in first dc, turn—24 dc.
Round 3: Ch 2, 2 dc in first st, dc in next st, *2 dc in next st, dc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—36 dc.
Round 4: Ch 2, 2 dc in first st, dc in next 2 sts, *2 dc in next st, dc in next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—48 dc.
Size Small only:
Round 5: Ch 2, 2 dc in first st, dc in next 4 sts, 2 dc in next st, *dc in next 5 sts, 2 dc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—57 dc.
Size Medium only:
Round 5: Ch 2, 2 dc in first st, dc in next 3 sts, *2 dc in next st, dc in next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—60 dc.
Round 6: Ch 2, 2 dc in first st, dc in next 19 sts, *2 dc in next st, dc in next 19 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—63 dc.
Size Large only:
Round 5: Work same as Round 5 of size Medium.
Round 6: Ch 2, dc in first 3 sts, 2 dc in next st, *dc in next 6 sts, 2 dc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in first dc—69 dc.
All sizes:
Round 6 (7, 7 and 8): Ch 2, dc in each st around; join with slip st in first dc.
Fasten off.
Round 7 (8, 9): With right side facing, join C with slip st in any dc, ch 3 (counts as first dct here and throughout), 2 dc in same st, *skip next 2 sts, 3 dc in next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch—nineteen (twenty-one, twenty-three) 3-dc groups. Fasten off.
Round 8 (9, 10): With right side facing, join B with slip st in center dc of first 3-dc group, ch 3, 2 dc in same st, 3 dc in center dc of each remaining 3-dc group around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch. Fasten off.
Round 9 (10, 11): With A, repeat Round 8.
Round 10 (11, 12): With right side facing, join D with sc in any st, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc—57 (63, 69) sc.
Round 11–14 (12–15, 13–16): Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

Rows 3-104 (128): Repeat Row 2. Do not fasten off at end of last row, but turn to work edging.

Ch 1, sc evenly around scarf, working 3 sc in corners; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

Fringe
Cut 30 (38) 6” pieces each of A and B. Row 13: With A, ch 3, dc in next 2 sc, *with C, dc in next 3 sc, with A, dc in next 3 sc; repeat from * across to last 4 (0, 2, 4) sc; with A, dc in next 3 (0, 0, 3) dc, with next color in sequence, dc in last 1 (0, 2, 1) sc; turn.
Row 14: Working with A over C sts and working with B over A sts, to create a checker pattern, ch 3, dc in each dc across; turn.

materials: RED HEART® “Stripes™”: 6 balls 944 Breezy Stripe A.
RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 ball each 316 Soft White B, 883 Spa Blue C, 256 Carrot D, and 327 Light Coral E.
Crochet Hooks: 5mm [US H-8] for blanket; 4mm [US G-6] for doll.
Yarn needle, split lock stitch marker, stuffing, brown and red pearl cotton for embroidery.
abbreviations: bobble = * [yo] twice, insert hook in next sc and draw up a loop, [yo and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice; repeat from * 4 more times in same sc, yo and draw through all 6 loops on hook.
dec (decrease) = [draw up a loop in next sc] twice, yo and draw through all 3 loops on hook.
measurements: Blanket measures 36” x 36”. Doll is 11½” high.
gauge: 12 sts = 4”; 6 rows = 4” in dc with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BLAnKET
Square (Make 16)
With larger hook and A, ch 6.
Row 1: Dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in next 2 ch; turn.
Row 2: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in next 2 dc, 4 dc in ch-space; turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in next 2 dc, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next dc, dc in next 2 dc, dc in top of ch-3; turn.
Row 4: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in each dc to corner space, (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in corner ch-2 space, dc in each dc across and in top of ch-3; turn.
Rows 5-13: Repeat Row 4 – 25 dc on each side of ch-2 corner space. 
Round 14: Ch 1, 3 sc in first dc, sc in next 24 dc, 3 sc in next ch-2 space, sc in next 24 dc, 3 sc in top of ch-3, 24 sc across row ends, 3 sc in corner, 24 sc across row ends; join with a slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Assembly
Arrange squares on flat surface in 4 rows of 4 as follows: on bottom row have diagonal lines go from bottom left to top right corner. On next row have diagonals go from right to left. On next row go from left to right. On top row go from right to left. Slip st squares together through back loops of sc round with right side facing you.
Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join B in sc before center corner sc; ch 1, sc in each sc around blanket and 3 sc in each corner; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around making a bobble between each square over the seam and in each center corner sc; join in first sc. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
This blanket may look like you had to use many colors of yarn, but this amazing yarn automatically stripes as you crochet! It makes a wonderful gift with a Baby Doll Toy for play time.

Ears (Make 2)
Row 1: With smaller hook and E, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; turn – 6 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off. Sew in place.
Hair
With double strand of D embroider a few loop stitches on top of head.
Collar
Row 1: With smaller hook and B, ch 5; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 4 sc.
Rows 2-24: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 24. Sew around neck and turn collar down.
Bib
Row 1: With smaller hook and C, ch 11; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 10 sc.
Rows 2-7: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 7. Sew in place.
Strap (Make 2) 
Row 1: With smaller hook and C, ch 21; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 20 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across. Fasten off. Sew straps in place criss-crossing on back. Embroider red satin st buttons on front of strap.
Front Pocket
Row 1: With smaller hook and A, ch 8; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 7 sc.
Rows 2-5: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 5. Sew in place.
Back Pocket
With smaller hook and A, ch 6; sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 5 sc.
Rows 2-4: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn. Fasten off at end of Row 4. Sew in place.

RED HEART® “Stripes™”, Art. E760 available in 3.5 oz (100 g), 170 yd (156 m) balls. 
RED HEART® “Super Saver®” Jumbo Art. E302 available in solid color 14 oz, (396 g), 744 yd (681 m) skeins.

ABBREVIATIOnS: A, B, C, etc. = color A, B, C, etc; ch = chain; dc = double crochet; mm = millimeters; sc = single crochet; st(s) = stitch(es); yo = yarn over; * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated; [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.

BABY DOLL TOY
Round 1: Begin at top of head with E and smaller hook, ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Do not join but work in continuous rounds. Mark first st of round and move marker up each round.
Round 2: [Inc] 6 times – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, inc] 6 times – 18 sc.
Round 4: [Sc in next 2 sc, inc] 6 times – 24 sc.
Round 5: Sc in each sc around.
Round 6: [Sc in next 3 sc, inc] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 7: [Sc in next 4 sc, inc] 6 times – 36 sc.
Rounds 8-15: Sc in each sc around.
Round 16: [Dec] 18 times – 18 sc.
Rounds 17 and 18: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.
Round 19: Join B with sc in first sc of Round 18, sc again in same sc, [inc] 17 times – 36 sc.
Round 20: [Sc in next 5 sc, inc] 6 times – 42 sc.
Rounds 21-29: Sc in each sc around. Fasten off.
Round 30: Join C with sc in first sc of Round 29, sc in each sc around – 42 sc.
Rounds 31-41: Sc in each sc around.
Round 42: [Sc in next 5 sc, dec] 6 times – 36 sc.
Round 43: [Sc in next 4 sc, dec] 6 times – 30 sc.
Round 44: Sc in each sc around.
Round 45: [Sc in next 3 sc, dec] 6 times – 24 sc. Fasten off. Stuff head and body. Sew bottom seam. Shape legs by sewing through all layers with a back stitch up middle, pulling tightly. Make arms in same manner on sides of body. Embroider face with brown satin st eyes, straight st eyebrows and nose. Back stitch smile with red.

materials: RED HEART® “Light & Lofty®”: 2 Skeins No. 9617 Pheasant (or 9376 Wine) CA.
RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 2 Skeins No. 330 Linen (or 376 Burgundy) CB.
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: Tote measures approximately 11" wide x 8" high. Scarf measures approximately 4 1/2" wide x 54" long.
gauge: 8 sts = 4"; 7 rows = 4" in sc. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
TOTE
NOTE: Use 1 strand CA and 2 strands CB held together as one unless otherwise specified.

FRONT AND BACK (Alike): With 1 strand CA and 2 strands CB, ch 19. 
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 18 sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc across; turn.
Rows 3-14: Rep Row 2. Fasten off.
FINISHING: Sew sides and bottom.
Edging-Rnd 1: With right side facing, attach one strand CA at a seam; ch 3, dc in each sc around; join with a sl st in top of ch-3.
Rnd 2: * Ch 3, sl st around post of next dc; rep from * around; join in first ch of ch-3.
Rnd 3: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join.
Rnd 4: Rep Rnd 2.
Rnd 5: Sl st in top of dc of Row 3, ch 3, * sl st in next dc, ch 5; rep from * around; join. Fasten off.

Straps (Make 2): With one strand CA and two strands CB held together, ch 41.

SCARF
With 2 strands of CB, ch 102.
Rnd 1: 2 Sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in each ch across to last ch; (2 sc, ch 2, 2 sc) all in last ch; working on opposite side of foundation ch, sc in each ch across to first ch; 2 sc in first ch, ch 2; join with a sl st in first sc.
Rnd 2: Ch 3, working in BACK LOOP ONLY, dc in each sc around, working (dc, [ch 1, dc] twice) in each end ch-2 sp; join. Cut CB.
Rnd 3: With right side facing, attach CA around the post of any dc; ch 3, * sl st around the post of the next dc, ch 3; rep from * around; join in first ch of ch-3.
Rnd 4: Sl st in top of dc, ch 3, * sl st in next dc, ch 3; rep from * around; join. Fasten off. Weave in ends.
