pattern_name: Too Cute Skirt and Flower Headband
materials: 1” wide elastic, sewing needle and thread, yarn needle
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Finished Waist Measurement: 20 (20½, 21, 22, 23)” Length: 7½ (8, 9, 10, 11)” Finished Head Measurement: 14 (16, 18)” with 3” stretch.
gauge: 12 sc = 4”; 16 rounds = 4”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
WAISTBAND
Cut a length of elastic 1” longer than finished waist measurement. Overlap additional 1” on opposite end of elastic forming a ring. With sewing needle and thread, securely stitch in place.
First Half
Round 1: Ch 58 (60, 62, 66, 70); join with slip st to form ring. Ch 1, sc in each ch; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off after last round.
Second Half
Round 1: Working down from foundation ch loops of Round 1 of first half; join yarn with sc in any loop, sc in each loop around; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each st around, join with slip st in first sc.
Fold waistband over elastic. Working first row of skirt through both Round 4 of first and second half of waistband at same time:
Feminine sparkle, ruffles and flowers are combined here for utter cuteness—just what little girls love. Crochet this skirt and headband set in ivory as shown, or choose her favorite bright color.
HEADBAND (make 2)
Row 1: Ch 5, sc in second ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 4 sc.
Rows 2–56 [64, 72]: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn. Fasten off after last row.
Holding both pieces together, working through both thicknesses at the same time, into the side of rows of a short end, join yarn with sc in first st, sc in each row across. Fasten off.
Cut elastic piece 15 [17, 19]”, overlapping 1”, with sewing needle and thread, stitch securely to form circle. Working over elastic, in row ends of second side, through both thicknesses at same time, join yarn with sc in first row, sc in each st across, fasten off leaving a long length for sewing. With yarn needle, whipstitch ends of headband together and join to opposite end, whipstitch together opening at opposite end.
Skirt
Round 1: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
Rounds 2–4: Ch 1, sc in each st around evenly spacing 2 inc; join with slip st in first sc. 64 (66, 68, 72, 76) sc.
Round(s) 5 (5, 5–7, 5–9, 5–11): Ch 1, sc in each st around evenly spacing 4 inc; join with slip st in first sc. 68 (70, 80, 92, 104) sc.
SIZES 18, 24 MONTH, 2T, 4T ONLY
Round 6 (8, 10, 12): Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc.
RUFFLES
Round 1 – first half of ruffle: Turn, working in back loops only of last round, slip st in first loop, ch 2, (counts as hdc), 2 hdc in same space, 3 hdc in each loop around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, ch 1, slip st in side of beginning-ch, slip st, ch 1.
Round 1 – second half of ruffle: Turn, working in unused loops of same round, slip st in first loop, ch 2, hdc in each loop around, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2.
Round(s) 2 (2–3, 2–5, 2–7, 2–9): Repeat first and second half of Round 1.
Rounds 3–5 (4–6, 6–8, 8–10, 10–12) – first half: Repeat first half of Round 1.
Rounds 3–5 (4–6, 6–8, 8–10, 10–12) – second half: Repeat second half of Round 1 and evenly spacing an extra hdc 4 times within each round– 80 (82, 92, 104, 116) sc.
BOTTOM RUFFLES
Round 1–first half: Working in front loop only of last round, ch 3, (counts as dc), 2 dc in same loop, 5 dc in next loop, *3 dc in next loop, 5 dc in next loop; repeat from * around, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Round 1–second half: Ch 3, working in unused loops of same round behind first half of ruffles, slip st in first ch, ch 4, (counts as tr), 4 tr in same loop, 5 dc in each loop around, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-4, Fasten off.
RUFFLE EDGING
Round 1: Working in second half of Round 5 (5, 7, 8, 10), join yarn with slip st in any st, ch 3, *slip st in next st, ch 3; repeat from * around. Fasten off.
18, 24 MONTH, 2T, 4T ONLY
Round 2: Working in second half of Round 6 [8, 9, 11], repeat Round 1.
2T, 4T ONLY
Round 3: Working in second half of Round 9 [10], repeat Round 1.
FLOWER
Round 1: Ch 3; join with slip st to form ring, ch 2, (counts as hdc), 19 hdc in ring; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, ch 2; turn – 20 hdc.
Round 2 first half: Working in back loop only, 2 hdc in first loop of round 1, 3 hdc in each loop around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-2, ch 1, sl st in first ch of beginning ch. 60 hdc.
Round 2 – second half: Turn, working in unused loops of round 1, slip st in first loop, ch 3, (counts as dc), dc in each loop around; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 20 dc.
Round 3: Ch 3, working in front loop only of round 2 second half, 4 dc in same loop, 5 dc in each loop around, join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3 – 100 dc. Fasten off leaving a long length for sewing. Using tail and yarn needle, weave end through all sts of round 1 and pull center closed.
FINISHING: With yarn needle, stitch flower to headband over seam.

materials: 18 Ounces No. 9334 Café Au Lait CA
abbreviations: * = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Poncho measures 23.5" long from shoulder to hem and 63" around at lower edge. Hat circumference is 21".
gauge: In dc – 5 sts = 3"; 4 rnds = 4" with smaller hook. In sc – 5 sts = 3"; 8 rnds = 4" with smaller hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
PONCHO
With smaller hook and CA, ch 40; join with a sl st to form a ring, being careful not to twist ch. 
Rnd 1: Ch 1, 2 sc in first ch, sc in next 7 ch, * 2 sc in next ch, sc in next 7 ch; rep from * around; join with a sl st to first sc – 45 sc.
Rnd 2: Ch 3, dc in same sc as joining, dc in next 2 sc, * 2 dc in next sc, dc in next 2 sc; rep from * around; join with a sl st to top of ch-3 – 60 sts. 
Rnds 3 and 4: Ch 3, dc in each dc around; join to top of ch-3.
Rnd 5: Ch 3, dc in same ch as joining, dc in next 3 dc, * 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 3 dc; rep from * around; join – 75 sts.
Rnds 6 and 7: Rep Rnd 3.
Rnd 8: Ch 3, dc in same ch as joining, dc in next 4 dc, * 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 4 dc; rep from * around; join – 90 sts.
Rnds 9 and 10: Rep Rnd 3.
Rnd 11: Ch 3, dc in same ch as joining, dc in next 5 dc, * 2 dc in next dc, dc in next 5 dc; rep from * around; join – 105 sts.
Rnds 12-21: Rep Rnd 3, changing to CB in last dc of Rnd 21. Cut CA.
Rnds 22-24: With CB rep Rnd 3. Fasten off.
Neckband-Rnd 1: With right side facing, smaller hook, and working on opposite side of beg ch, join CB in any lp, ch 1, sc in each lp around; join with a sl st to first sc – 40 sc.
Rnds 2-5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join. 
Fasten off at end of Rnd 5. Weave in ends.
HAT
Brim: With larger hook and CB, ch 34; join with a sl st to form a ring, being careful not to twist ch. 
Rnd 1: Ch 1, sc in first ch, dc in next ch, * sc in next ch, dc in next ch; rep from * around; join with a sl st to first sc; turn – 34 sts.
Rnd 2: Ch 1, sc in first dc, dc in next sc, * sc in next dc, dc in next sc; rep from * around noting that last dc is worked into same sc as joining of previous rnd; turn.
Rep Rnd 2 until 7" from beg, changing to CA in last st of last rnd, do not turn.
Crown: Next Rnd (Right Side):Change to smaller hook, ch 1, sc in each st around inc 1 st; do not join but mark end of rnd by placing a contrasting thread between the last and first sts – 35 sc. Do not turn.
Work even in rnds of sc for 31/2".
Shape Top: [Draw up a lp in next 2 sc, yo and draw through all 3 lps on hook – dec made; sc in next 3 sc] 7 times – 28 sc.
Next Rnd: [Dec, sc in next 2 sc] 7 times – 21 sc.
Next Rnd: [Dec, sc in next sc] 7 times – 14 sc.
Next Rnd: [Dec] 7 times – 7 sc; sl st in next sc.
Fasten off. 
Weave yarn through remaining sts, draw up tightly and fasten securely. Fold brim in half to the right side.

materials: Red Heart® Heat Wave™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 198 yds/181 m)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Hat: One size to fit adult. Scarf: Approx 9" x 81" [23 x 206 cm], excluding fringe.
gauge: 13 hdc and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
HAT
Note:
• Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first hdc.
• To join colors, work to last 3 loops on hook at end of rnd. Draw new color through rem loops and proceed with new color. 
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring. 
1st rnd: Ch 2. 8 hdc in ring. Join. 
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 2 hdc in each hdc around. Join. 16 hdc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc) 8 times. Join. 24 hdc. 
4th rnd: Ch 2. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc) 8 times. Join. 32 hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc) 8 times. Join. 40 hdc.
6th rnd: Ch 2. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 4 hdc) 8 times. Join. 48 hdc.
7th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join C at end of rnd.
8th rnd: With C, ch 2. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 5 hdc) 8 times. Join A at end of rnd. 56 hdc.
9th rnd: With A, as 7th rnd.
10th rnd: Ch 2. (2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 6 hdc) 8 times. Join. 64 hdc. 
11th to 14th rnds: As 7th rnd. Join B at end of last rnd. 
15th rnd: With B, as 7th rnd. Join C at end of rnd.
16th rnd: With C, as 7th rnd. Join B at end of rnd.
17th to 22nd rnds: With B, as 7th rnd. Fasten off .
Pompom: Wind C around 4 fingers approx 80 times. Remove from fingers. Tie tightly in center, leaving 2 long ends for attaching to Hat. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew to Hat. 
SCARF
Note:
• Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as st.
• To join colors, work to last 3 loops on hook at end of row. Draw new color through rem loops and proceed with new color.
With B, ch 32. 
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 30 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row working in Stripe Pat as follows: 
3rd to 6th rows: With B, joining C at end of last row. 
7th row: With C, joining B at end of row.
8th to 13th rows: With B, joining C at end of last row.
14th to 34th rows: Rep 7th to 13th rows 3 times more.
35th row: With C, joining A at end of row.
36th to 41st rows: With A, joining C at end of last row.
42nd row: With C, joining A at end of row.
Rep 36th to 42nd rows 16 times more.
Next 6 rows: With B, joining C at end of last row.
Next row: With C, joining B at end of row. 
Rep last 7 rows 3 times more.
Next 6 rows: With B. 
Fasten off .
Fringe: Cut strands of A and C 15" [38 cm] long. Taking 2 strands of each together (4 strands total) fold in half and knot into fringe across both ends of Scarf. Trim fringe evenly.
Fringe: Cut yarn 10 to 14 ins [25.5 to 35.5 cm] long. Taking 2 or 3 strands together for each fringe knot into fringe across cast on and cast off edges. Trim fringe evenly.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream (Solids: 70.9 g/ 2.5 oz/109 m/120 yds)
Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
gauge: 14 hdc and 10 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]
instructions:
BIB
With MC, ch 21.
1st row: (RS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. *Ch 1. Miss next ch. 1 hdc in each of next 3 ch. Rep from * to end of ch.  Turn. 19 sts.
2nd row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in each st or ch 1 sp to last st. 2 hdc in last st. Join A. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. *(Yoh) twice and draw up a loop in missed ch of foundation ch 2 rows below in front of work. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times– long tr made. Miss next st  (behind long tr). 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last st. 1 sc in last st. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Join MC. Turn.
5th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. *Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 hdc in last st. Ch 2. Turn.
6th row: 2 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in each st or ch sp to last st. 2 hdc in last st. Join A. Turn.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. *Long tr in next missed st 2 rows below. Miss next st (behind long tr). 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 3 sts. Long tr in next missed st 2 rows below. Miss next st (behind long tr). 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Join MC. Turn. 27 sts.
Cont even in pat as placed in last 8 rows for 12 more rows.
Shape neck: 1st row: (RS). With MC, ch 2. Pat across 6 sts. Yoh and draw up a loop in next st. Draw up a loop in next st. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook– hdc2tog made. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog over first 2 sts. Pat to end of row. Join A. Ch 1. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. Pat to last 2 sts. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made. Turn. 5 sts.
Work 6 rows even in pat.
Next row: (WS). Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. Pat to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Join A. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. Pat to last st. 2 sc in last st. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. Pat to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Join MC. Turn.
Next row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. Pat to last st. 2 hdc in last st. Turn.
Next row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first st. Pat to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog. Fasten off.
With RS of work facing, miss next 11 sts. Join MC with sl st to next st. Ch 2. Hdc2tog over this st and next st. Pat to end of row. Turn.
Work to correspond to first side, reversing all shapings.
Edging: Join A with sl st to top left corner of neck edge. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 1 row sc evenly around all edges. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Working around outer edge only, ch 1. Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 reverse sc in each sc to opposite side. Fasten off. With A, make button loop at center back on left side. Sew button in position.
BOOTIES
With A, ch 28.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 27 sts. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Join MC.  Turn.
3rd row: With MC, ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. *Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 hdc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 hdc in next st. Turn. 
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. 1 hdc in each st or ch 1 sp to end of row. Join A. Turn.
5th row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in first st. *Long tr in next missed ch 2 rows below. Miss next st (behind long tr). 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. Long tr in next missed ch 2 rows below. Miss next st (behind long tr). 1 sc in last st. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. *Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 4 sts. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 sc in each of last 3 sts. Turn. 23 sts.
7th row: (Eyelet row). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. *Ch 1. Miss next st. 1 sc in each of next 2 sts. Rep from * to last 2 sts. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Turn.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st or ch 1 sp to end of row. Fasten off.
Instep: 1st row: With RS of work facing, miss first 7 sts. Join A with sl st to next st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Turn. 9 sts.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row.  Turn.
4th row: As 2nd row.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
Sew center back seam. With RS of work facing, join A with sl st at center back seam. Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Work 5 sc down side of instep. 3 sc in corner sc. 5 sc across end of instep. 3 sc in corner sc. Work 5 sc along other side of instep. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Join with sl st to first st. 35 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join MC with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only work 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st.

Dec 1 st at neck edge on next 2 rows – 8 (10, 12, 12, 12) sts. Work even until 10 (12, 13, 14, 15)” from beg. Fasten off. With wrong side facing, skip 16 (16, 16, 18, 20) sts of last long row, attach yarn in next st, work in pat to end. Complete to correspond to first side. FRONT: Work same as back until 8½ (10½, 11½, 12½, 13½)” from beg, end right side row. Divide for Neck/Shoulders: Work in pat across 12 (14, 16, 16, 16) sts; turn. Dec 1 st at neck edge on next 4 rows – 8 (10, 12, 12, 12) sts. Work even until front measures same as back to shoulders. Fasten off. With wrong side facing, skip next 12 (12, 12, 14, 16) sts of last long row, attach yarn in next st, work in pat to end. Complete to correspond to first side. SLEEVES: With CA, ch 21 (25, 25, 27, 29). Work Rows 1-9, then Rows 4-7 same as Back across 20 (24, 24, 26, 28) sts, shaping sides by inc 1 st each end of 3rd row, then every right side row 5 more times – 32 (36, 36, 38, 40) sts. Continue in Pat 1 with CA until sleeve measures 6 (7½, 9, 10, 11)” from beg. Fasten off. FINISHING: Sew shoulder seams. Mark 4½ (5, 5, 5½, 5¾)” down from shoulders. Place center of sleeve top at shoulder seam and sew in place between markers. Edging (Work around neck, sleeves and lower body edges): With right side facing, attach CB at a seam; ch 1, work sc evenly around; join with a sl st to first sc. Fasten off. BLANKET: With CA, ch 107. Row 1 (Right Side): Rep Row 1 of Sweater Back – 106 sts. Rows 2-9: Work 8 rows Pat 1. Rows 10-12: Rep Rows 4-6 of Sweater Back. Rows 14-21: Work 9 rows Pat 1. Rep Rows 10-21 of Blanket six more times. Fasten off. Border-Rnd 1: With right side facing, attach CB in first sc of last row worked; ch 1, [(sc, ch 2, sc) all in sc for corner, work 103 sc across to corner] 4 times; join with a sl st in first sc. Rnd 2: Ch 1, ** (sc, ch 3, sc) all in ch-2 sp, ch 3, skip next sc, * sc in next sc, ch 3, skip next sc; rep from * to next corner; rep from ** around to last 2 sc; sc in next sc, (ch 1, dc in first sc) to join and form last sp. Rnd 3: Ch 1, sc over dc, ch 3, ** (sc, ch 3, sc) all in corner ch-3 sp, ch 3, * sc in next ch-3 sp, ch 3; rep from * to next corner; rep from ** around; join with a sl st in first sc. Fasten off. Rnd 4: With right side facing, attach CA in any ch 3 sp; ch 1, * (sc, ch 3, sc) all in sp; rep from * around; join. Fasten off. Rnd 5: With right side facing, attach CB in any ch 3 corner sp; ch 1, ** (sc, ch 3, sc) all in corner sp, ch 3, * sc in next sp, ch 3; rep from * to next corner; rep from ** around working (ch 1, dc in first sc) to join and form last sp. Rnd 6: Rep Rnd 3. Rnd 7: Rep Rnd 4. Fasten off.

pattern_name: Sock It to Me Scarf & Headband
materials: RED HEART® “Heart & Sole® with Aloe”: 2 balls 3965 Razzle Dazzle.
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Scarf measures 4” wide x 60” long (each half measures 4” wide x 30” long). Headband measures 3” wide (including ruffle) x 18” long (slightly stretched).
gauge: 16 sts = 4”; 10 rows = 4” in scarf pattern, using smaller hook; 20 sts = 4” in headband pattern (slightly stretched lengthwise), using larger hook and holding 2 strands of yarn together. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SCARF
First Half
Foundation ch: With larger hook and 2 strands held together ch 100. Fasten off.
Round 1 (Right Side): With smaller hook, join 1 strand with slip st in first ch of foundation ch, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), 4 dc in same ch, dc in each ch across to last ch, 5 dc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, dc in each ch across to last ch; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—206 dc. Fasten off.
Round 2 (Right Side): With Right Side facing and smaller hook, working in spaces between sts, join 1 strand with slip st in space between first and 2nd dc of 5-dc group at one end, ch 3, (dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in same space (corner made), dc in next space, (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in next space (corner made), dc in each space across to 5-dc group at other end, (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in space between first and 2nd dc of 5-dc group (corner made), dc in next space, (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in next space (corner made), dc in each space to end of round; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3—4 corners, with 1 dc between corners on short ends, and 100 dc between corners on long sides. Fasten off.
Round 3 (Right Side): With Right Side facing and smaller hook, slip st in ch-1 space of first corner, ch 3, dc in same ch-1 space, skip next 2 dc of corner, 2 dc in next space (between last dc of corner and next dc), 2 dc in next space, skip first 2 dc of next corner, (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in corner ch-1 space, skip next 2 dc of corner, 2 dc in next space, *skip next space, 2 dc in next space; repeat from * across to next corner, skip first 2 dc of next corner, (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in corner ch-1 space, skip next 2 dc of corner, 2 dc in next 2 spaces, skip first 2 dc of next corner, (2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in corner ch-1 space, skip next 2 dc of corner, 2 dc in next space, **skip next space, 2 dc in next space; repeat from ** to first corner, skip first 2 dc of corner, 2 dc in same ch-1 space as beginning, ch 1; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3.
Rounds 4 and 5 (Right Side): Ch 3, dc in same ch-1 space (of first corner), skip next dc, 2 dc in next space (between the dc sts of the next 2-dc of corner), *skip next 2 dc, 2 dc in next space (between the dc sts of the next 2-dc of corner), repeat from * across to 1 dc before next corner ch-1 space, skip next dc, [(2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in corner ch-1 space, skip next dc, 2 dc in next space, **skip next 2 dc, 2 dc in next space; repeat from ** across to 1 dc before next corner ch-1 space, skip next dc] 3 times, 2 dc in same ch-1 space as beginning, ch 1; join with slip st in top of beginning ch-3. Fasten off.
Second Half
Make same as first half. Do not fasten off at the end of Round 5.
Join Halves: Hold short edges of both halves together; working through both thicknesses across short edge, slip st in corner ch-1 space, slip st in each space between 2-dc groups across to next corner, slip st in corner ch-1 space. Fasten off. If preferred, fasten off and sew short edges together.
Corner Petals
With Right Side facing and larger hook, join matching color with sc in corner ch-1 space of scarf, [ch 6, sc in same ch-1 space] 5 times. Fasten off. Repeat to work petals in remaining 3 corners.
FInISHInG
Weave in ends.
HEADBAnD
With larger hook and 2 strands held together, ch 14.
Row 1: Dc in 4th ch from hook (beginning ch counts as first dc), [ch 1, skip next ch, dc in next ch] 5 times, turn—7 dc and 5 ch-1 spaces.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), [dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, skip next dc] 5 times, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures about 20” from beginning, slightly stretched.
Join Ends: Hold foundation ch and last row together, with sts matching, working through both thicknesses, slip st in each st across. Fasten off.
Ruffle
Join 1 strand with sc in end of any row, ch 5, sc in end of same row, *ch 5, (sc, ch 5, sc) in end of next row; repeat from * around, ch 5; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. With 1 strand repeat around other edge.
FInISHInG
Weave in ends.
RED HEART® “Heart & Sole® with Aloe”, Art. E745 available in solid color and multi color 1.76 oz (50 g), 213 yd (195 m) balls.

materials: RED HEART® 'Soft Yarn ™', Art. E728 (5 ounce/256 yard solid; 4 ounce/204 yard multi color ball)
abbreviations: CA, CB, CC = Colors A, B, C
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Scarf measures 5½" x 60". Hat Circumference: 18 (20, 22)". Wrist circumference: 7 (7½, 8)".
gauge: Scarf: 8 sts = 4"; 10 rows = 4" with 3 strands using larger hook in pat. Hat & Wristlets: 15 sts = 4"; 18 rows = 4" with one strand and smaller hook in pat.
instructions:
SCARF
With larger hook and one strand each CA, CB, and CC held tog as one, ch 121.
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 120 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in BACK LP ONLY of each sc across; turn.
Rep Row 2 for pat until there are a total of 14 rows – about 7" when slightly stretched. Fasten off.
FINISHING: Make 2 large pompoms: wrap CA, CB, and CC held tog around a 3" cardboard 75 times. Remove from cardboard, tie tightly in middle; clip, then trim ends. Gather ends of scarf, fasten securely. Sew a pompom to each end. Weave in ends.

HAT
With smaller hook and CA, ch 35 (39, 43).
Work in pat same as for Scarf over 34 (38, 42) sc until there are a total of 76 (80, 84) rows – about 18 (20, 22)" when slightly stretched. Fasten off.
FINISHING: Sl st seam tog: Holding beg ch edge with wrong side facing, sl st into first ch AND into BACK LP ONLY of last sc row, continue across both edges sl st corresponding ch and back lps tog across. Fasten off.
Crown Shaping: Turn right side out. With right side facing, smaller hook and CA, attach yarn at seam; ch 1, work 76 (80, 84) sc around entire top edge; join with a sl st in first sc.

WRISTLETS (Make 2)
With smaller hook and CA, ch 20 (22, 24).
Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 19 (21, 23) sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in BACK LP ONLY of first 9 (10, 11) sc, ch 1, skip next sc, sc in BACK LP ONLY of next 9 (10, 11) sc; turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in BACK LP of each sc and ch across; turn.
Rep Rows 2 and 3 for pat until there are a total of 30 (32, 34) rows. An eyelet for wrist tie is created by ch-1 sps.
FINISHING: Sl st side seam tog as for back seam of Hat. Turn right side out.
Top Edging: Work same as for Hat Brim Edging working 28 (30, 32) sc at top edge.
Bottom Edging: Work same as for Hat Brim Edging working 30 (32, 34) sc at bottom edge.
Weave in ends.
Tie (Make 2): With smaller hook and CA, ch 85. Fasten off. Beg and ending at side edge, weave tie through ch-1 sps at wrist. Make 4 small pompoms: wrap CA, CB, and CC around a 1½" cardboard 30 times; remove from cardboard, tie in center; clip, then trim ends. Sew one pompom on each end of each tie. Weave in ends.

materials: Sugar Bush® Rapture™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 211 yds/193 m)
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Wooden button ¼" [3 cm] for Hat.
measurements: Hat: To fit head circumference S 21" [53.5 cm], M 22" [56 cm], L 23" [58.5 cm]. Scarf: Approx 8" x 80" [20.5 x 203 cm], excluding fringe.
gauge: 14 dc and 9 rows = 4" [10 cm]
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger size(s) the instructions will be written thus ( ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes. Notes:
• Ch 2 at beg of row or rnd does not count as hdc.
• Ch 3 at beg of row or rnd counts as dc.
• When changing colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of last st, then draw new color through rem 2 loops and proceed.
• Carry color not in use along side edge of work. 
HAT
With MC, ch 66 (70-74). Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring, taking care not to twist chain.
Ribbing: 1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in back hump of each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. 66 (70-74) sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each sc around. Join with sl st to top of first hdc.
3rd to 6th rnds: Ch 2. Working in horizontal bar only, created by hdc at back of work, (see diagram), 1 hdc in each st around. Join with sl st to top of first hdc. Proceed in Stripe Pat as follows:
7th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each st around. Join A with sl st to top of ch 3.
8th rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in each st around. Join MC with sl st to top of ch 3.
Rep last 2 rnds 7 times more.
Next rnd: Ch 3. *Skip next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * around. 33 (35-37) dc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Drawstring: With A, ch 100. Fasten off. Weave drawstring through final rnd of dc. Pull drawstring tight for a slouchy hat or leave slightly open for a messy bun to pull through top. Sew wooden button to side of Hat on Ribbing band.
SCARF
With MC, ch 31.
Ribbing: 1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 30 sc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn.
3rd to 8th rows: Ch 2. Working in horizontal bar only, created by hdc at back of work, (see diagram), 1 hdc in each st to end of row. Turn. Join A at end of last row.
Proceed in Stripe Pat as follows: 1st row: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Join MC. Turn. 2nd row: With MC, ch 3. 1 dc in each st to end of row. Join A. Turn. Rep last 2 rows 6 times more. Next row: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Join MC. Turn. Next 7 rows: Rep 2nd to 8th rows of Ribbing Pat. Next 45 rows: Rep 1st and 2nd rows of Stripe Pat 22 times, then 1st row once. Next 7 rows: Rep 2nd to 8th rows of Ribbing Pat. Next 15 rows: Rep 1st and 2nd rows of Stripe Pat 7 times, then 1st row once. Next 7 rows: Rep 2nd to 8th rows of Ribbing Pat. Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each hdc to end of row. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Pin Scarf to measurements. Cover with a damp cloth leaving cloth to dry. Fringe: Cut strands of A 20" [51 cm] long. Taking 6 strands tog, fold in half and knot into fringe across both ends of Scarf. Trim fringe evenly. Fringe: Cut yarn 10 to 14 ins [25.5 to 35.5 cm] long. Taking 2 or 3 strands together for each fringe knot into fringe across cast on and cast off edges. Trim fringe evenly.

materials: RED HEART® With Love™ 1 skein each 1703 Candy Pink A and 1807 Boysenberry B.
abbreviations: shell: (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in same space.
sc2tog: [Insert hook in next st, yo, draw yarn through st] twice, yo, draw yarn through 3 loops on hook.
dc2tog: [Yo, insert hook in next st, yo, draw yarn through st, yo, draw through 2 loops on hook] twice, yo, draw through 3 loops on hook.
[] = work directions given in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
measurements: Finished measurements: Hat: 16 (18)” in circumference. Hat: 8.5 (10)” in diameter. Wristers: 2¾ (3¼)” wide; 3 (3½)” long.
gauge: 16 sts & 14 rows = 4” CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
HAT
Band
With A, leaving a 8” sewing length, ch 5 (7).
Row 1: Working in back bar of each ch, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in each ch across; turn—4 (6) slip sts.
Row 2: Working in back loops only, slip st in each st across, turn—4 (6) slip sts.
Repeat row 2 until 106 (114) rows have been worked or band measures 14 (15)” from beginning. Do not fasten off. Rotate to begin working along sides of rows. Work now progresses in rounds.
Crown
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 64 (80) sc evenly spaced across side edge of band; join with a slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), skip first sc, dc in each sc around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—64 (80) dc. Fasten off A.
Round 3: With right side facing, join B with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3, ch 1, sc in same st, *ch 2, skip 1 dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * around to last dc, ch 2, skip last dc; join with a slip st in first sc—32 (40) ch-2 spaces.
Round 4: Slip st in next ch-2 space, ch 1, sc in same ch-2 space, *shell in next ch-2 space, sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * around, ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in first sc—16 (20) shells. Fasten off B.
Round 5: With right side facing, join A with a slip st in ch-2 space of any shell, ch 1, sc in same space as joining, ch 5, (sc, ch 5) in each ch-2 space around; join with a slip st in first sc—16 (20) ch-5 spaces.
Round 6: Slip st in next ch-5 space, ch 1, 5 sc in each ch-5 space around; join with a slip st in first sc—80 (100) sc.
Round 7: Ch 3, skip first sc, dc in each sc around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—80 (100) dc.
Size L Only
Round 8: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in each of next 2 dc, dc2tog over next 2 sts, *dc in each of next 3 dc, dc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—80 dc.
Both Sizes
Round 8 (9): Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in next 7 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts, *sc in next 8 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—72 sts.
Round 9 (10): Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts, *sc in next 7 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—64 sts.
Round 10 (11): Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts, *sc in next 6 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—56 sts.
Round 11 (12): Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts, *sc in next 5 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—48 sts.
Round 12 (13): Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts, *sc in next 4 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—40 sts.
Round 13 (14): Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts, *sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—32 sts.
Round 14 (15): Ch 1, sc in first st, sc in next st, sc2tog over next 2 sts, *sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—24 sts.
Round 15 (16): Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc2tog over next 2 sts, *sc in next sc, sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—18 sts.
Round 16 (17): Ch 1, *sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—9 sts.
Round 17 (18): Ch 1, sc in first sc, *sc2tog over next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in first sc—5 sts. Fasten off leaving a sewing length. With yarn needle, weave sewing length through tops of sts in last round, gather top and secure.
FINISHING
With yarn needle and sewing length, sew brim seam. Weave in ends.
WRISTERS (make 2)
Wrist Band
With A, leaving a 8” sewing length, ch 7 (9).
Row 1: Working in back bar of each ch, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in each ch across; turn—6 (8) slip sts.
Row 2: Working in back loops only, slip st in each st across, turn—6 (8) slip sts.
Repeat row 2 until 38 (42) rows have been worked or band measures 5 (5½)” from beginning. Do not fasten off. Rotate to begin working along side edge of wrist band. Work now progresses in rounds.
Round 1 (right side): Ch 1, work 16 (20) sc evenly spaced across side edge of band; join with a slip st in back loop only of first sc.
Round 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), working in back loops only, skip first sc, dc in each sc around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-3—16 (20) dc.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, *ch 2, skip next dc, sc in next dc; repeat from * around to last dc, ch 2, skip last dc; join with a slip st in first sc—8 (10) ch-2 spaces.
Round 4: Slip st in next ch-2 space, ch 1, sc in first ch-2 space, *shell in next ch-2 space, sc in next ch-2 space; repeat from * around ending last repeat at **; join with a slip st in first sc—4 (5) shells. Fasten off A.
Round 5: With right side facing, join B to remaining front loop of any sc in Round 1, ch 1, sc in same st as joining, *ch 2, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * around to last sc, ch 2, skip last sc; join with a slip st in first sc—8 (10) ch-2 spaces.
Round 6: Repeat round 4. Fasten off B.
FINISHING
With yarn needle and sewing length, sew wrist band seam. Weave in ends.

materials: Optional: ¾ Yard of ½” elastic
abbreviations: * or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions given in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: Beret fits most women. Scarf measures 4¼” wide x 40” long.
gauge: Gauge: Beret - Rounds 1-2 = 3” across. Scarf - Rounds 1-4 = 4¼” across; 4 repeats of (ch 1, 3 dc) = 4¼”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BERET
Ch 5; join with a slip st to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3, 2 dc in ring, ch 1, [3 dc in ring, ch 1] 4 times; join with a slip st to top of ch-3.
Round 2: (Slip st, ch 3, 2 dc) all in next dc, * ch 1, 3 dc in next space **, ch 1, skip next dc, 3 dc in next dc; repeat from * around, end at **; sc in top of ch-3 to join and form last ch-1 space—10 3-dc groups.
Round 3: Ch 3, 2 dc over sc; [ch 1, 3 dc] twice all in next ch-1 space – increase made; * ch 1, 3 dc in next space, increase in next space; repeat from * around; sc in top of ch-3 to join—15 3-dc groups.
Round 4: Ch 3, 2 dc over sc, * ch 1, 3 dc in next space; repeat from * around; sc in top of ch-3 to join.
Round 5: Ch 3, 2 dc over sc, * ch 1, 3 dc in next space, inc in next space **, ch 1, 3 dc in next space; repeat from * around, end at **; sc in top of ch-3 to join—20 3-dc groups.
Round 6: Repeat Round 3—30 3-dc groups.
Rounds 7-10: Repeat Round 4.
Round 11: Repeat Round 4 EXCEPT end with “ch 1, slip st in top of ch-3” instead of “sc in top of ch-3” to join.
Round 12: Ch 3, dc in next dc and in each dc around skipping all ch-1 spaces; join with a slip st in top of ch-3—90 sts.
Round 13: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining and in next 6 dc; draw up a loop in next 2 dc, yo and through all 3 loops on hook—decrease made; * sc in next 7 dc, decrease over next 2 dc; repeat from * around; join to first sc—80 sc.
Rounds 14-21: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join to first sc. Fasten off after Round 21 leaving a long (30”) end.
Fold sc band in half to wrong side and slip st in place to wrong side of Round 13. Weave in ends.
Optional: Cut elastic to head measurement plus ½”. Overlap ends of elastic by ½” and sew together. Fold sc band in half over circle of elastic and slip st in place.

SCARF
Ch 140.
Round 1: 2 Dc in 4th ch from hook, * ch 1, skip 3 ch, 3 dc in next ch; repeat from * to last 4 ch; ch 1, skip 3 ch **, (3 dc, [ch 2, 3 dc] twice) all in last ch; repeat from * across opposite side of beginning ch, end at **; [3 dc, ch 2] twice all in same ch as first 2 dc; join with a slip st to top of ch-3.
Round 2: Slip st in next 2 dc and into ch-1 space, ch 3, 2 dc in space, * ch 1, 3 dc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to corner space; ch 1; (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) all in corner ch-2 space—corner made; ch 1, work corner in next space; repeat from * around; sc in top of ch-3 to join and form last ch-1 space.
Round 3: Ch 3, 2 dc over sc, * ch 1, 3 dc in next space; repeat from * to corner space; ch 1, work corner, ch 1, 3 dc in next space, ch 1, work corner; repeat from * around; sc in top of ch-3 to join.
Round 4: Ch 3, 2 dc over sc, * ch 1, 3 dc in next space; repeat from * to corner space; ch 1, work corner, ch 1, [3 dc in next space, ch 1] twice, work corner; repeat from * around; ch 1; join with a slip st to top of ch-3. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Soft®: 16 balls 9621 True Green
Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 6mm [US J-10] and 5.5mm [US I-9]
Stitch marker (for hook change at center section)
abbreviations: ( ) = work directions in parentheses into same st
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Throw measures 44 x 60” (112 x 152.5 cm); Pillow measures 13 x 17” (33 x 43 cm)
gauge: 14 sts = 4” (10 cm); 8 rows = 4” (10 cm) in pattern with larger hook.
instructions:
Ribbing
With larger hook, ch 155.
Row 1 (wrong side): Dc in 3rd ch from hook (beginning ch counts as first st), dc in each remaining ch across, turn—154 sts.
Rows 2–7: Ch 2 (counts as first st here and throughout), *Fpdc around next st, Bpdc around next st; repeat from * to end of row, hdc in turning ch-space, turn.

THROW
Row 8: Ch 3 (counts as first st here and throughout), [Fptr around next st, Bptr around next st] 5 times, [2/2 Back Cross, 2/2 Front Cross] 7 times; place marker in last st made; change to smaller hook, dc in next 21 sts, place marker in last st made; change back to larger hook, [2/2 Back Cross, 2/2 Front Cross] 7 times, [Bptr around next st, Fptr around next st] 4 times, Bptr around next st, dc in turning ch-space, turn.
Row 9: Ch 2, [Fpdc around next st, Bpdc around next st] 4 times, Fpdc around next st, Bpdc around each of next 56 sts (to marked st); change to smaller hook, dc in next 21 sts; change back to larger hook, Bpdc around each of next 56 sts (to last 10 sts), [Fpdc around next st, Bpdc around next st] 5 times, turn.
Row 10: Ch 3, [Fptr around next st, Bptr around next st] 5 times, 2/2 Back Cross, 2/2 Front Cross, [2/2 Front Cross, 2/2 Back Cross] 5 times, 2/2 Back Cross, 2/2 Front Cross; change to smaller hook, dc in next 21 sts; change back to larger hook, 2/2 Back Cross, 2/2 Front Cross, [2/2 Front Cross, 2/2 Back Cross] 5 times, 2/2 Back Cross, 2/2 Front Cross, [Bptr around next st, Fptr around next st] 4 times, Bptr around next st, dc in turning ch-space, turn.
Row 11: Repeat Row 9.

materials: Bernat® Handicrafter Cotton (Solids: 50 g/ 1.75 oz/73 m/80 yds)
Size 4 mm (U.S. G or 6) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Finished measurements: Bib measures 6½ ins [16.5 cm].
gauge: 14 sc and 16 rows = 4 ins [10 cm]
instructions:
BIB
With MC, ch 20.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. T urn. 19 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. Ch 1. T urn.
3rd row: 1 sc in each st to end of row. T urn.
4th to 9th rows: Rep last 2 rows 3 times more.
27 sts.
Cont even until work from beg measures 6½ ins [16.5 cm], ending with RS facing for next row.
Shape neck: 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 6 sts. Yoh and draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made. Turn.Leave rem sts unworked.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in each st to end of row. T urn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. T urn. 5 sts.
Work 10 rows even.
Next row: (WS). Ch 1. 2 sc in first st. Pat to last 2 sts. Sc2tog. T urn.
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each st to last st. 2 sc in last st. T urn.
Rep last 2 rows twice more. Fasten off.
With RS of work facing, miss next 11 sts. Join MC with sl st to next st. Ch 1. Sc2tog over this st and next st. 1 sc in each st to end of row. T urn.
Work to correspond to first side, reversing all shapings.
Edging: Join A with sl st to top left corner of neck edge. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 1 row sc evenly around all edges. Join with sl st to first sc.
Next rnd: Working around outer edge only, ch 1. *1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Ch 3. Ss in first ch – picot made. Rep from * to opposite side. Fasten off. With A, make button loop at center back on left side. Sew button in position. If desired, embroider day of week onto bib as illustrated. With A, split yarn into 2 plys and embroider letters using chain stitch.

BOOTIES
With MC, ch 16.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch.  T urn. 15 sts.
2nd row: Working into back loop only of each st, ch 1. Work 1 sc in each st to end of row. T urn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 6¼ ins [16 cm] when slightly stretched. Do not fasten off.
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. Work 23 sc evenly across long edge of cuff. Join A. T urn.
2nd row: With A, ch 1. Work 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off.
Instep: 1st row: With RS of work facing, miss first 7 sts. Join A with sl st to next st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. T urn. 9 sts.
2nd to 4th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. T urn.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Sc2tog. T urn.
6th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. Fasten off.
Sew center back seam. With RS of work facing, join A with sl st at center back. Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Work 5 sc down side of instep. 3 sc in corner sc. 3 sc across end of instep. 3 sc in corner sc. Work 5 sc along other side of instep. 1 sc in each of next 7 sts. Join with sl st to first st. 33 sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join MC with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: With MC, ch 1. Working in back loops only, work 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 12 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st.
Next rnd: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Sc2tog. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off. Join center foot seam.

With RS of work facing, miss next ch-1 sp and dc of shell last worked. Miss next 2 shells. Miss next dc and ch-1 sp of next shell. Join MC with sl st to next dc of same shell. 
1st row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) 3 times. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 2 dc in next ch 1 sp. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 3. Miss first st. Dc2tog over next 2 sts. (Shell in next ch 1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
4th row: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in next dc2tog. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
5th row: Ch 3. Miss first 2 sts. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
6th to 8th rows: Ch 3. (Shell in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Turn.
9th row: Ch 3. (1 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. 1 dc in top of turning ch. Fasten off.
Edging: Join A with sl st to top left corner of neck edge. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. Work 1 row sc evenly around all edges. Join with sl st to first sc. Ch 5 for button loop. Join with sl st to next sc. Fasten off. Sew button in position.
FLOWER (make 3)
With A, ch 2.
1st rnd: 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: (Ch 3. 1 dc. Ch 3. Sl st) all in same sp as last sl st. *(Sl st. Ch 3. 1 dc. Ch 3. Sl st) all in next sc. Rep from * around. Fasten off. Sew Flowers to Bib as shown in picture.
BOOTIES
Sole: With MC, ch 10.
1st rnd: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 7 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Working along opposite side of ch, work 1 sc in each rem loop of next 7 sts. 2 sc in next loop. Join with sl st to first st. 20 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. 3 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. 3 sc in last st. Join with sl st to first st. 24 sts.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 9 sts. 3 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 11 sts. 3 sc in next st. 1 sc in last st. Join with sl st to first st. 28 sts.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. 3 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of next 13 sts. 3 sc in next st. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Join A with sl st to first st. 32 sts.
5th rnd: With A, ch 1. Working in back loop only of each st, work 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 10 sts. (2 sc in next st. 1 sc in next st) 3 times. 1 sc in each st to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first sc. 35 sts.
7th and 8th rnds: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first st. Fasten off.
Upper: 1st row: With RS of work facing, miss first 6 sts of last rnd. Join A with sl st to next st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. 1 sc in each of next 5 sts. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through 3 loops on hook – sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 6 sts. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 5 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 5 sts. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 4 sts. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 3 sts. Fasten off leaving a 6 ins [15 cm] end. Thread end through tapestry needle and sew seam at center of upper.
Ankle Strap: Left Foot: With A, ch 13. With RS of work facing, work 1 sc in each of center 5 sc at back of heel. Turn.
Next row: Ch 7. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch or sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off. Join A with sl st at opposite side of strap at top corner. Ch 3 for button loop. Join with sl st to foundation ch. Fasten off.
Ankle Strap: Right Foot: With A, ch 6. With RS of work facing, work 1 sc in each of center 5 sc at back of heel. Turn.
Next row: Ch 14. 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch or sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc or ch-1 sp to end of row. Ch 3 for button loop. Join with sl st to foundation ch. Fasten off.
Flower: With MC, make 2 as given for Bib. Sew 1 Flower to each Bootie as illustrated.
Sew buttons to correspond to button loops.

materials: RED HEART® "Soft Baby ™™ ", Art.E705 (7 ounce/575 yard solid; 6 ounce/430 yard print, multicolor and twinkle skeins)
CA: 5 (5 1/2, 6, 6 1/2) Ounces for Cardigan; 1 3/4 (2, 2 1/4) ounces for Hat
abbreviations: CA, CB, CC = Colors A, B, C
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 13 sts = 3"; 22 rows = 5" in pat with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
CARDIGAN
BACK: With larger hook and CA, ch 50 (54, 58, 62). Row 1 (Right Side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across; turn – 49 (53, 57, 61) sc. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, * tr in next sc, sc in next sc; rep from * across; turn. Row 3: Ch 1, sc in each st across; turn. Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first 2 sc, * tr in next sc, sc in next sc; rep from * to last sc; sc in last sc; turn. Row 5: Rep Row 2. Rep Rows 2-5 for pat until 9 1/2 (10 1/2, 11, 11 1/2)" from beg. Fasten off. Ribbing: With right side facing and smaller hook, attach CB at lower edge; ch 3, work 47 (51, 55, 59) dc across changing to CC in last st; turn – 48 (52, 56, 60) sts. Work Ribbing Row twice with CC, then once with CB. Fasten off.
LEFT FRONT: With larger hook and CA, ch 24 (26, 28, 30). Work in pat same as for back over 23 (25, 27, 29) sts until 8 (9, 9 1/2, 10)" from beg, end wrong side row. Shape Neck: Keeping continuity of pat, work across first 18 (20, 21, 23) sts; turn and leave rem 5 (5, 6, 6) sts unworked. Dec 1 st at neck edge on next 2 rows – 16 (18, 19, 21) sts. Work even until front measures same as Back. Fasten off. Ribbing: Work same as for Back over 22 (24, 26, 28) sts.
RIGHT FRONT: Work same as Left Front, reversing neck shaping.
SLEEVES: With larger hook and CA, ch 32. Work 2 rows in pat same as for Back over 31 sts. Shape sides by inc 1 st each end of every right side row until there are 43 (49, 49, 53) sts, working added sts into pat. Work even until 5 1/2 (6 1/2, 7, 7 1/2)" from beg.
Fasten off. Ribbing: Work same as for Back over 30 sts.
FINISHING-Neckband: Sew shoulder seams. With right side facing and smaller hook, attach CB at right front neck edge, ch 3, dc in next 4 (4, 5, 5) sts, work 9 dc to seam, 16 (16, 18, 18) dc across back, 9 dc down left neck, 5 (5, 6, 6) dc across front changing to CC; turn – 44 (44, 48, 48) sts. Work Ribbing Row twice with CC, then once with CB. Fasten off.
Button Band (right for boys, left for girls): With right side facing and smaller hook, attach CB and work 1 row sc evenly across front edge. Work 3 rows sc with CC, then 1 row with CB. Fasten off.
Buttonhole Band (left for boys, right for girls): Work 2 rows same as for Button band. Mark for 5 evenly spaced buttonholes. Next Row: Ch 1, [sc to marker, ch 2, skip 2 sc] 5 times, sc to end; turn. Next Row: Ch 1, sc in each sc across and 2 sc in each sp; turn. Work last sc row with CB. Fasten off. Mark 5 (5 1/2, 5 1/2, 6)" down from shoulders on front and back. Place center of sleeve tops at shoulder seams and sew in place between markers. Sew side and sleeve seams. Sew on buttons. Weave in ends.
HAT
With larger hook and CA, ch 74 (78, 83). Work in pat same as for Cardigan Back over 73 (77, 81) sts until 4 1/2 (5, 5 1/2)" from beg.
Shape Crown: Ch 1, sc in first sc; * draw up a lp in next 2 sts, yo and draw through all 3 lps on hook – sc2tog made; rep from * across; turn – 37 (39, 41) sc. Rep last row 2 (1, 2) times – 10 (20, 11) sc. Size Medium Only: Ch 1, * sc2tog; rep from * across – 10 sc. All Sizes: Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Weave tail through tops of rem sc; gather tightly and fasten securely. Ribbing: Work same as for Back over 72 (76, 80) sts. Sew back seam. With 1 strand each CB and CC held together, make a 2" pompom. Attach to top of hat.

materials: Patons® Shetland Chunky (100 g / 3.5 oz) Mittens (03607 Harvest Variegate) 4 balls
Sizes 5.5 mm (U.S. I or 9) and 6 mm (U.S. J or 10) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
measurements: One size to fit Average Lady.
gauge: 12 sc and 14 rows = 4 ins [10 cm] with larger hook.
instructions:
Mittens
Right Mitten
**With smaller hook, ch 8. 
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 
1 sc in each ch to end of ch. 7 sc. T urn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. 
Rep last row until work, when slightly stretched, measures 7 ins [18 cm]. 
Change to larger hook. Ch 1. T urn and working along side edge of ribbing, proceed as follows:
1st row: Work 25 sc along side edge evenly spaced. T urn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. 
Rep last row until Mitten above cuff measures 1½ ins [4 cm], ending with RS facing for next row.** 
Shape thumb gusset: 1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. T urn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. T urn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. T urn. 
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. T urn. 
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. T urn. 
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Ch 1 (place marker for thumb). Miss next 11 sc. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. 25 sts. T urn. 
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st and ch 1 sp to end of row. T urn. 
Cont even until Mitten above cuff measures 6 ½ ins [16.5 cm], ending with RS facing for next row. 
***Proceed as follows:
1st row: Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of first 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook– sc2tog made. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 21 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. T urn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 17 sc. 
4th row: As 2nd row. 
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Sc2tog over next 2 sc. 13 sc. Fasten off. 
Sew top and side seam. 
Thumb: With RS of work facing and larger hook, join yarn with ss at ch 1 marker for Thumb. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as ss. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with ss to first sc. 12 sc. 
Rep last rnd until Thumb measures 2½ ins [6 cm]. 
Next rnd: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 6 times. 6 sts. Fasten off leaving a long end. Thread yarn through darning needle and draw through rem sts. Fasten tightly.*** 
Left Mitten
Work from ** to ** as given for Right Mitten. 
Shape thumb gusset: 1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. T urn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. T urn. 
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. T urn. 
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. T urn. 
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 14 sc. T urn. 
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. Ch 1 (place marker for Thumb). Miss next 11 sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. 25 sts. T urn. 
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st and ch 1 sp to end of row. T urn. 
Cont even until Mitten above cuff measures 6½ ins [16.5 cm], ending with RS facing for next row. 
Work from *** to *** as given for Right Mitten. 
Hat
With larger hook, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with ss to first sc.  
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last ss. 2 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join with ss to first sc. 16 sc. 
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last ss. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * twice more. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 20 sc. 
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last ss. *1 sc in each of next 3 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 25 sc. 
5th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last ss. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 30 sc. 
6th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last ss. *1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 36 sc. 
7th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last ss. *1 sc in each of next 5 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 4 times more. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 42 sc. 
8th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Rep from * 4 times more. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 48 sc. 
9th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with ss to first sc. 
10th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * twice more. 2 sc in next sc. Join with ss to first sc. 52 sc. 
11th rnd: As 9th rnd. 
12th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. Rep from * twice more. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 56 sc. 
13th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last ss. *1 sc in each of next 10 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 61 sc. 
14th to 16th rnds: As 9th rnd. 
17th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. Rep from * 3 times more. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 66 sc. 
18th to 20th rnds: As 9th rnd. 
21st rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last ss. *1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 71 sc. 
22nd and 23rd rnds: As 9th rnd. 
24th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 13 sc. Rep from * 3 times more. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 76 sc. 
25th and 26th rnds: As 9th rnd. 
27th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last ss. *1 sc in each of next 14 sc. 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * 3 times more. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 81 sc. 
28th rnd: As 9th rnd. 
29th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last ss. 1 sc in each of next 7 sc. *2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Rep from * 3 times more. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Join with ss to first sc. 86 sc. 
30th and 31st rnds: As 9th rnd. 
32nd rnd: Ch 1. Working from left to right instead of from right to left, as usual (see diagram), work 1 sc in each sc around for reverse sc. Join with ss to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Size 5.5 mm (U.S. I or 9) crochet hook or size needed to obtain tension.
16 inch [40.5 cm] square pillow form and 5 buttons for Pillow.
measurements: Afghan: Approx 46½ x 56 ins [118 x 142 cm], Pillow: Approx 16 ins [40.5 cm] square
gauge: 13 dc and 7 rows = 4 ins [10 cm].
instructions:
AFGHAN
Panel A (make 3)
With A, ch 25.
Foundation row: (WS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. 23 sts. Ch 3. Turn.
1st row: Miss first st. [(Yoh) twice and draw up a loop from front to back around post of next dc. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times – trfp made. 1 dc in next dc] twice. [(Yoh) twice and draw up a loop from front to back. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice] 3 times around post of next dc. Yoh and draw through rem 4 loops on hook – Trfp Cluster made. 1 dc in each of next 11 dc. Trfp Cluster around post of next dc. (1 dc in next dc. Trfp around post of next dc) twice. 1 dc in last dc. Ch 3. Turn.
2nd row: Miss first st. (Yoh) twice and draw up a loop from back to front around post of next st. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) 3 times – trbp made. 1 dc in next st. Trbp around post of next st. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. [(Yoh) twice and draw up a loop. (Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice] 3 times around back of post of next st. Yoh and draw through rem 4 loops on hook – Trbp Cluster made. 1 dc in each of next 9 dc. Trbp Cluster around post of next st. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. (Trbp around post of next st. 1 dc in next dc) twice. Ch 3. Turn.
3rd row: Miss first st. (Trfp around post of next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. Trfp Cluster around post of next st. 1 dc in each of next 7 sts. Trfp Cluster around post of next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. (Trfp around post of next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. Ch 3. Turn.
4th row: Miss first st. (Trbp around post of next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Trbp Cluster around post of next st. 1 dc in each of next 5 sts. Trbp Cluster around post of next st. 1 dc in each of next 4 sts. (Trbp around post of next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. Ch 3. Turn.
5th row: Miss first st. (Trfp around post of next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. 1 dc in each of next 4 sts. Trfp Cluster around post of next st. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Trfp Cluster around post of next st. 1 dc in each of next 5 sts. (Trfp around post of next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. Ch 3. Turn.
6th row: Miss first st. (Trbp around post of next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. 1 dc in each of next 5 sts. Trbp Cluster around post of next st. 1 dc in next st. Trbp Cluster around post of next st. 1 dc in each of next 6 sts. (Trbp around post of next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. Ch 3. Turn.
7th row: Miss first st. (Trfp around post of next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. 1 dc in each of next 6 sts. Trfp Cluster around post of next st. 1 dc in each of next 7 sts. (Trfp around post of next st. 1 dc in next st) twice. Ch 3. Turn.
8th row: As 6th row.
9th row: As 5th row.
10th row: As 4th row.
11th row: As 3rd row.
12th row: As 2nd row.
These 12 rows form pat.
Cont in pat until panel measures approx 54 ins [137 cm] ending on a 12th row of pat and omitting turning ch at end of last row. Fasten off.
Panel B (make 4)
With MC, ch 21.
Foundation row: (WS). 1 dc in 4th ch from hook. 1 dc in each ch to end of ch. 19 sts. Ch 3. Turn.
1st row: Miss first st. 1 dc in next st. Trfp around each of next 6 sts. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Trfp around each of next 6 sts. 1 dc in each of last 2 sts. Ch 3. Turn.
2nd row: Miss first st. 1 dc in next st. Trbp around each of next 6 sts. 1 dc in each of next 3 sts. Trbp around each of next 6 sts. 1 dc in each of last 2 sts. Ch 3. Turn.
3rd row: Miss first st. 1 dc in next st. Miss next 3 sts. Trfp around each of next 3 sts. Working behind last 3 trfp, trfp in each of 3 missed sts – trfp cable made. 1 dc in next st. 5 dc in next st. Drop loop from hook. Reinsert hook in first of 5 dc and draw dropped loop through - bobble made. 1 dc in next st. Trfp cable over next 6 sts. 1 dc in each of last 2 sts. Ch 3. Turn.
4th row: As 2nd row.
These 4 rows form pat.
Cont in pat until panel measures approx 54 ins [137 cm] ending on a 4th row of pat and omitting turning ch at end of last row. Fasten off.
Sew panels tog in the following sequence: B, A, B, A, B, A, B.
Edging: 1st rnd: With RS of Afghan facing, join MC with sl st in any corner. Work 1 round sc evenly around outer edge, working 3 sc in corner. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: With A, ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. *Bobble in next st. 1 dc in each of next 5 sts. Rep from * around, working 3 dc in corners. Join MC with sl st to top of ch 3. Break A.
3rd rnd: With MC, work 1 sc in each st around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 sc in each sc around for reverse sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
PILLOW
FRONT
Panel A (make 1)
Work as given for Afghan until 2 pat reps are complete. Omit turning ch at end of last row. Fasten off.
Panel B (make 2)
Work as given for Afghan until 6 pat reps are complete. Omit turning ch at end of last row. Fasten off.
Sew panels tog in the following sequence: B, A, B.
Top Edging: 1st row: With RS of work facing and MC work 60 sc across top of Pillow Front. Ch 3. Turn.
2nd row: Miss first st. 1 dc in next st and each st to end of row. Ch 1. Turn.
3rd row: 1 sc in each of first 3 sts. *Ch 2. Miss next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of next 11 sts. Rep from * 3 times more. Ch 2. Miss next 2 sts. 1 sc in each of last 3 sts. Ch 3. Turn. (5 buttonholes)
4th row: Miss first st. 1 dc in each st and 2 dc in each ch 2 sp across. Ch 1. Turn.
5th row: 1 sc in each st to end of row.
Edging: Working from left to right, instead of from right to left as usual, work 1 sc in each sc around for reverse sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
BACK
With MC, ch 61.
Foundation row: (WS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Ch 3. Turn. 60 sts.
1st row: Miss first st. 1 dc in next st and each st to end of row. Ch 1. Turn.
2nd row: 1 sc in each st to end of row. Ch 3. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows until work from beg measures 18½ ins [47 cm] ending on a 2nd row and omitting turning ch at end of last row. Fasten off. Place markers on side edges of Pillow Back 2½ ins [6 cm] down from final row.
Finishing: Fold Pillow Back at markers (button placket). Sew sides and lower edge of Front and Back tog. Sew buttons onto Back button placket to correspond to buttonholes. Insert pillow form. Close buttons.
Reverse Sc

materials: RED HEART® Boutique™ Unforgettable™: 4 balls 3945 Parrot.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
gauge: GAUGE: Motif = 6” wide. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook needed to obtain the gauge given.
instructions:
SHAWL
First Strip 
Main Motif 1
Make an Adjustable Loop.
Round 1: Work 8 sc in ring; join with slip st in first sc—8 sc.
Round 2: Ch 1 (does not count as a st), V-st in each sc around; join with a slip st in first dc—8 V-sts
Round 3: Slip st in ch-2 space of first V-st, ch 2 (counts as dch here and throughout), (dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in same space, ch 1, *2-ch shell in next ch 2 space, ch 1; repeat from around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2—eight 2-ch shells.
Round 4: Slip st in ch-2 space of first V-st, ch 2, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same space, ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space, ch 1, *3-ch shell in ch-2 space of next shell, ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space, ch 1; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2—eight 3-ch shells.
Round 5: Slip st in ch-2 space of first V-st, ch 2, (dc, ch 3, 2 dc) in same space, ch 2, sc in next sc, ch 2, *3-ch shell in ch-3 space of next shell, ch 2, sc in next sc, ch 2; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in top of beginning ch-2—eight 3-ch shells.
Fasten off leaving a tail long enough for weaving.
Main Motif 2 (joining on one side)  
Work same as Main Motif 1 through Round 4.

Next row: (WS). Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 25 (28-29) dc (Right Front). 2 dc in each of next 2 marked dc. 1 dc in each of next 32 (37-41) dc (Right Sleeve). 2 dc in each of next 2 marked dc. 1 dc in each of next 55 (63-81) dc (Back). 2 dc in each of next 2 marked dc. 1 dc in each of next 32 (37-41) dc (Left Sleeve). 2 dc in each of next 2 marked dc. 1 dc in each of next 26 (29-30) dc (Left Front). Row 12: Ch 1, turn, (slip st, ch 3, dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in ch-1 space of first small-shell, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, small-shell in next ch-1 space, ch 2, dc in next ch-1 space, ch 2, small-shell in next ch-1 space, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 3, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * to last small-shell, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, small-shell in ch-1 space of last small-shell.
Row 13: Ch 1, turn, (slip st, ch 3, dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in ch-1 space of first small-shell, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next ch-3 space, *ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, small-shell in ch-1 space of next small-shell, ch 1, skip next ch-2 space, (Cl, ch 3, Cl) in next dc, ch 1, skip next ch-2 space, small-shell in ch-1 space of next small-shell, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, sc in next ch-3 space; repeat from * to last small-shell, ch 2, skip next ch-2 space, small-shell in ch-1 space of last small-shell.

FINISHING

With right side facing, join yarn with sc in side of Row 5 at marker so that you are ready to work along the side edge towards the long straight edge (foundation chain), work sc evenly spaced up side edge, across long straight edge, and down other side edge to marker at other end of Row 5, working 3 sc in each corner. 1st row: (RS). Sl st in first st. 1 sc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. 1 dc in each sc to 2 sc before marked st. 1 trfp around trfp 2 rows below. PM on last st. Skip next 4 sc. 1 dc in each sc to last sc. (2 dc. 1 tr) in last sc. Turn.

instructions:
NOTES
1. Ruana is worked in two separate panels that are then joined together lengthwise, but only halfway.
2. Yarn is held doubled throughout.
3. This is an oversized garment. For the best fit, stretch arms out to either side so that elbows are at shoulder height. Measure from elbow to elbow to determine width, then follow instructions with the finished measurement that best matches.
4. Beginning ch-2 and ch-3 do not count as stitches.
5. When changing colors, assure at least 10" (25.5 cm) of yarn tail is left; weave ends into tassels at the end.

RUANA
Right Panel
With 2 strands of A held together, ch 112 (117, 122).
Row 1 (wrong side): Hdc in 3rd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn. – 110 hdc.
Row 2: Ch 3, turn, tr in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 2, turn, hdc in each st across, turn.
Row 4: With B, repeat row 3.
Row 5: With C, ch 2, hdc in each st across, turn.
Row 6: Ch 3, tr in each st across, turn.
Row 7: Ch 2, turn, hdc in each st across, turn.
Next 4 rows: With B, repeat Row 3, then with D, repeat Rows 5-7.
Next 0 (4, 4) Rows: With B, repeat Row 3, then with A, repeat Rows 5-7.
Next 0 (0, 4) Rows: With B, repeat Row 3, then with A, repeat Rows 5-7.
Next 4 Rows: With B, repeat Row 3, then with D, repeat Rows 5-7.
Next 4 Rows: With B, repeat Row 3, then with C, repeat Rows 5-7.
Next 4 Rows: With B, repeat Row 3, then with A, repeat Rows 5-7.
Fasten off.

Left Panel
Work same as right panel but do not fasten off.
Final Row: With B, Ch 2, hdc in each of first 55 (57, 60) sts.
Do not fasten off.

FINISHING
Assembly
Hold panels with right sides facing together and wrong sides facing out. Assure that final row sts of both panels are aligned evenly with each other. With B, slip st the panels together from center of row outward to the edge. Fasten off.

Tassels
Attach a tassel at edge of each tr row as follows:
Cut 20 lengths of yarn in color matching the row, 8" (20.5 cm) each, and fold in half. Using crochet hook, pull the folded edge up through the tr at edge of row. Pull ends through folded loop and pull tight to secure. Weave yarn ends into tassels to conceal. Trim tassels evenly.

Rows 43-146: Repeat Rows 21-22, alternating two rows of A and two rows of B.

Rows 148-157: Repeat Rows 32-41.
Work 2nd half of 2nd keyhole as for first through Rejoining Sts.

Row 169: Skip 1st horiz st, pick up loop in each horiz st until 2 remain; skip next horiz st, pick up loop in final horiz st; slide loops to opposite end of hook and turn – 19 loops.

Special Stitches
V-st (V-stitch) = (Dc, ch 2, dc) in indicated stitch or space.
beg-shell (beginning shell) = (Slip st, ch 3, dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in indicated space.
shell = (2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in indicated stitch or space.
