instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as hdc. Move marker up each row to center ch-2 sp.
Ch 4.
1st row: (RS). 4 dc in 4th ch from hook (turning ch 3 counts as dc). Turn. 5 dc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first dc. 1 hdc in next dc. (1 hdc. Ch 2. 1 hdc) in next dc. PM on center ch-2 sp. 1 hdc in next dc. 2 hdc in last dc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. (1 hdc. Ch 2. 1 hdc) in ch-2 sp. 1 hdc in each of next 3 hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. Ch 1. (1 hdc in next hdc. Ch 1. Skip next hdc) twice. 1 hdc in next hdc. Ch 1. (1 hdc. Ch 2. 1 hdc) in ch-2 sp. Ch 1. (1 hdc in next hdc. Ch 1. Skip next hdc) twice. 1 hdc in next hdc. Ch 1. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
5th to 7th rows: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each st to center ch-2 sp. (1 hdc. Ch 2. 1 hdc) in ch-2 sp. 1 hdc in each st to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
8th row: Ch 2. 2 hdc in first hdc. Ch 1. *1 hdc in next hdc. Ch 1. Skip next hdc.* Rep from * to * to last hdc before center ch-2 sp. 1 hdc in next hdc. Ch 1. (1 hdc. Ch 2. 1 hdc) in ch-2 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * to * to last 2 hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Ch 1. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn.
Rep 5th to 8th rows until Shawl from beg ch measures approx 30" [76 cm], ending on 7th row. Do not fasten off.
Fringe Row: *Ch 10. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 8 ch. Sl st in each of next 2 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. Ch 10. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each of next 8 ch. Sl st in last hdc.
Fasten off.

materials: RED HEART® Heart & Sole®: 3 balls 3941 Riverstone
abbreviations: () = work directions in parentheses into same stitch
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
measurements: Shawl measures 18” [45.5 cm] wide and 58” [147.5 cm] long.
gauge: 2 pattern repeats = 3½” [9 cm]; 4 rows = 4” [10 cm] in pattern. Note: One pattern repeat consists of one fan and the following treble crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SHAWL
First Half
Beginning at center of shawl, ch 64 loosely.
Row 1 (right side): (2 tr, ch 1, 2 tr) in 7th ch from hook (first fan made), skip next 2 ch, tr in next ch, *skip next 2 ch, (2 tr, ch 1, 2 tr) in next ch (fan made), skip next 2 ch, tr in next ch; repeat from * across, turn—10 fans.
Row 2: Ch 4 (counts as first tr), *(2 tr, ch 1, 2 tr) in next ch-1 space, skip next 2 tr, tr in next tr (between fans); repeat from * across working last tr in top of turning ch, turn.
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures about 29” [73.5 cm] from beginning, slightly stretched. Fasten off.
Second Half
Row 1 (right side): With right side facing and working across opposite side of foundation ch, draw up a loop in ch at base of first tr, ch 4 (counts as first tr), *skip next 2 ch, (2 tr, ch 1, 2 tr) in next ch (at base of fan in first half), skip next 2 ch, tr in next ch (at base of tr); repeat from * across, turn—10 fans.
Row 2: Work same as Row 2 of first half.
Repeat Row 2 until second half measures about the same as first half, slightly stretched. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends and wet block to finished measurements.

materials: Simply Soft (170 g/6. oz;288 m/315 yds)
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: yo = yarn over the needle (makes 1 extra stitch)
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
2tr-cl = [(yo) twice and draw up a loop, (yo and draw through 2 loops on hook) twice] 2 times, yo and draw through remaining 3 loops on hook.
Vertical Lace Pattern (foundation chain repeat of 10 plus 9)
Set-up row (WS): 2 dc in 5th ch from hook (counts as dc, miss next ch, 2 dc), skip next ch, 2 dc in next ch, *ch 2, skip next 3 ch, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch, ch 2, skip next 3 ch, 2 dc in next ch, skip next ch, 2 dc in next ch; rep from * to last 2 ch, skip next ch, dc in last ch, turn.
Row 1 (RS): Ch 3 (counts as dc), (2 dc in sp between next 2-dc group) twice, *skip next ch-2 sp, [(2tr-cl, ch 1) twice, 2tr-cl] in next ch-2 sp, skip next ch-2 sp, (2 dc in sp between next 2 dc-group) twice; rep from * across, ending with dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), (2 dc in sp between next 2-dc group) twice, *(ch 2, sc in next ch-1 sp) twice, ch 2, (2 dc in sp between next 2-dc group) twice; rep from * across, ending with dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Rep Rows 1 & 2 for Vertical Lace Pattern
Instructions BACK Ch 79 (89, 99, 109, 129). Work in Vertical Lace Pat until Back measures 18”/45.5cm, ending with a RS row.
Sleeves: With 2nd skein of yarn, ch 22 (22, 22, 32, 32), attach to top of ch 3 at opposite side of Back to working yarn and fasten off.
Next Row (WS): With working yarn, ch 24 (24, 24, 34, 34), 2 dc in 5th ch from hook, skip next ch, 2 dc in next ch, *ch 2, skip next 3 ch, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch, ch 2, skip next 3 ch, 2 dc in next ch, skip next ch, 2 dc in next ch; rep from * 0 (0, 0, 1, 1) time(s) more, then from * to ** once, skip next dc, (2 dc in sp between next 2-dc group) twice, pat across to last dc, skip last dc, ***ch 2, skip next 3 ch, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch, ch 2, skip next 3 ch, 2 dc in next ch, skip next ch, 2 dc in next ch; rep from *** 1 (1, 1, 2, 2) time(s) more, skip next ch, dc in last ch, turn.
Work even in pat until Sleeve measures 8 (8, 9, 10, 11)”/20.5 (20.5, 23, 25.5, 28)cm, ending with a WS row. Fasten off.
LEFT FRONT Ch 39 (49, 49, 59, 69). Work in Vertical Lace Pat until Left Front measures 2 rows less than Back to Sleeve shaping, ending with a RS row.
Shape neck and sleeve Row 1 (WS): Ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in sp between next 2-dc group, 2 dc in sp between next 2-dc group, pat to end of row, turn.
Row 2: Pat to last group of 2 dc, 2 dc in sp between last 2-dc group, skip next dc, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
With 2nd skein of yarn, ch 22 (22, 22, 32, 32), attach to top of ch 3 at opposite side of Left Front to working yarn and fasten off.
Row 3 (WS): With working yarn, ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in sp between next 2-dc group, pat across to last dc, skip last dc, ***ch 2, skip next 3 ch, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch, ch 2, skip next 3 ch, 2 dc in next ch, skip next ch, 2 dc in next ch; rep from *** 1 (1, 1, 2, 2) time(s) more, skip next ch, dc in last ch, turn.
Row 4: Pat to last 2 dc, skip next dc, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 5: Ch 3 (counts as dc), sc in next ch-1 sp, ch 2, sc in next ch-1 sp, pat to end of row, turn.
Row 6: Pat to last ch-2 sp, (2tr-cl, ch 1, 2 tr-cl) in last ch-2 sp, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 7: Ch 3 (counts as dc), sc in next ch-1 sp, ch 2, pat to end of row, turn.
Row 8: Pat to last sc, 2tr-cl in last sc, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 9: Ch 3 (counts as dc), miss next 2tr-cl, (2 dc in sp between next 2-dc group) twice, pat to end of row, turn.
Row 10: Pat to last 2-dc group, dc in sp between last 2-dc group, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 11: Ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in sp between next 2-dc group, pat to end of row, turn.
Row 12: Pat to last dc and turning ch, skip next dc, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Continue even in pat until Sleeve measures same length as Back, ending with a WS row. Fasten off.
RIGHT FRONT Ch 39 (49, 49, 59, 69). Work in Vertical Lace Pat until Right Front measures 2 rows less than Back to Sleeve shaping, ending with a RS row.
Shape neck and sleeve Row 1 (WS): Pat to last group of 2 dc, dc in sp between last 2-dc group, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), skip next dc, 2 dc in sp between next 2-dc group, pat to end of row, turn.
Row 3 (WS): Ch 24 (24, 24, 34, 34), 2 dc in 5th ch from hook, skip next ch, 2 dc in next ch, *ch 2, skip next 3 ch, (sc, ch 2, sc) in next ch, ch 2, skip next 3 ch, 2 dc in next ch, skip next ch, 2 dc in next ch; rep from * 0 (0, 0, 1, 1) time(s) more, then from * to ** once, skip next dc, (2 dc in sp between next 2-dc group) twice, pat across to last group of 2 dc, dc in sp between last 2-dc group, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 4: Ch 3 (counts as dc), skip next dc and ch-2 sp, [(2tr-cl, ch 1) twice, 2tr-cl] in next ch-2 sp, pat to end of row, turn.
Row 5: Pat to last 2 ch-1 sps, sc in next ch-1 sp, ch 2, sc in last ch-1 sp, ch 2, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 6: Ch 3 (counts as dc), miss first ch-2 sp, (2tr-cl, ch 1, 2tr-cl) in next ch-2 sp, pat to end of row, turn.
Row 7: Pat to last ch-1 sp, sc in last ch-1 sp, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 8: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 2tr-cl in next sc, pat to end of row, turn.
Row 9: Pat to last 2-tr cl, skip last 2-tr cl, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 10: Ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in sp between next 2-dc group, 2 dc in sp between next 2-dc group, pat to end of row, turn.
Row 11: Pat to last group of 2 dc, dc in sp between last 2-dc group, miss next dc, dc in top of turning ch, turn.
Row 12: Ch 3 (counts as dc), skip next dc, pat to end of row, turn.
Continue even in pat until Sleeve measures same length as Back, ending with a WS row. Fasten off.
FINISHING Sew shoulder and side seams. Lower and neck edging: With RS of work facing, join yarn with sl st at lower edge of right side seam, ch 1, work sc evenly across Right Front, up and around neck edge, Left Front and Back, working 3 sc in corners; join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Button and Buttonhole Band: Place markers for 3 buttonholes on Right Front edge, having top button ½”/1 cm below first front neck decrease, bottom buttonhole 11”/28 cm below first buttonhole and remaining buttonhole centered between.
Row 1 (RS): Join yarn with sl st in corner sc of lower edge of Right Front, ch 1, (work sc evenly to buttonhole marker, ch 2, skip next 2 sc) 3 times, sc evenly to opposite corner of Left Front, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, (sc evenly to next ch-2 sp, 2 sc in next ch-2 sp) 3 times, sc to end of row. Fasten off. Sew buttons in position on Left Front to correspond to buttonholes. Sleeve edging: With RS of work facing, join yarn with sl st at sleeve seam, ch 1, work sc evenly around Sleeve edge; join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

instructions:
Make an adjustable ring as follows:
Wrap yarn around your finger with the yarn tail to the left and under the working yarn. Insert hook through the circle from front to back. Using the working yarn, yarn over and pull up a loop.

Row 1: (3 sc, ch 2, 3 sc) in ring; tighten beginning yarn tail to close ring.

Row 4: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st to ch-space, (sc, ch 2, sc) in ch-space, sc in each remaining st to last st, 2 sc in last st.
Rows 5-46: Repeat Rows 2-4 fourteen times.
Row 47: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st to ch-space, 3 sc in ch-space, sc in each remaining st.
Fasten off.

Tassels (make 3)
Step 1: Wrap yarn around a 5" (12.75 cm)-wide piece of cardboard 30 times.

With yarn needle, attach tassels at each of three shawl points. Weave in all loose ends.

materials: 4 (5, 6) balls STITCH NATION by Debbie Stoller™ “Bamboo Ewe™” in 5230 Buttercup.
abbreviations: [ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified

gauge: With smaller hook, 12 sts and 4 rows dc = 4”; 1 row dc and 1 row tr = 1¾”. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
COVER UP
Left Back
Starting at left side, ch 15.
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; turn—14 sc. 
Row 2 (right side): Ch 3 (counts a dc here and throughout), skip first 2 sc, *V-st in next sc, skip next 2 sc; repeat from * twice, V-st in next sc, skip next sc, dc in last sc; turn—4 V-sts.
Row 3: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), (dc, ch 2) in each of next 3 ch-1 spaces, dc in last ch-1 space, ch 1, dc in top of turning chain; turn. 
Size L Only
Rows 4-5: Repeat Rows 2-3 once.
Shape Armhole
Row 1: Ch 3, skip next ch-1 space, V-st in each of next 4 dc, dc in 3rd ch of turning chain; ch 28 (31, 34); turn. 
Row 2: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each of next 26 (29, 32) ch sts, sc in each st and each ch-1 space across, ending with sc in 3rd ch of turning chain; turn—41 (44, 47) sc.
Row 3: Ch 3, skip first 2 sts, *V-st in next st, skip next sts; repeat from * across to last 2 sts, skip next st, dc in last st; turn—13 (14, 15) V-sts.
Row 4: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), (dc, ch 2) in each ch-1 space across to last ch-1 space, dc in last ch-1 space, ch 1, dc in top of turning chain; turn—12 (13, 14) ch-2 spaces.
Rows 5-8: Repeat Rows 3-4 twice. 
Row 9: Ch 3, skip first 2 sts, *V-st in next dc, skip next ch-2 space; repeat from * 8 (9, 10) times, dc in next dc; turn—9 (10, 11) V-sts.
Row 10: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), (dc, ch 2) in each ch-1 space across to last ch-1 space, dc in last ch-1 space.

Right Back
Work same as Left Back through Row 3 (3, 5).
Shape Armhole 
Row 1: Ch 3, skip next ch-1 space, V-st in each of next 4 dc, dc in 3rd ch of turning chain, turn. Drop loop from hook. Join a separate strand of yarn in top of first st in Row 1 of Armhole Shaping, ch 27 (30, 33). Fasten off strand.
Row 2: Pick up dropped loop at end of Row 1 of Armhole Shaping, ch 1, sc in first st, sc in each st and ch-1 space across, sc in each ch of added ch; turn—41 (44, 47) sc.
Rows 3-8: Work same as Rows 3-8 of Left Front. Fasten off.
Row 9: With right side facing, skip first 5 ch-2 spaces, join yarn in next dc, ch 3, *V-st in next dc, skip next ch-2 space; repeat from * 8 (9, 10) times, dc in last sc; turn—9 (10, 11) V-sts.
Rows 10-13 (15, 17): Work same as Rows 10-13 (15, 17) of Left Back. Fasten off.

Right Front
Work same as Left Back through Row 1 of Armhole Shaping.
Row 2: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each of next 26 (29, 32) ch sts, hdc in each st and each ch-1 space across, ending with sc in 3rd ch of turning chain; turn—27 (30, 33) sc; 14 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 3, skip first 2 sts, *V-st in next st, skip next 2 sts; repeat from * across to last 2 sts, skip next st, dc in last st; turn—13 (14, 15) V-sts.
Row 4: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), (dc, ch 2) in each of next 8 (9, 10) ch-1 spaces, (tr, ch 2) in each ch-1 space across to last ch-1 space, tr in last ch-1 space, ch 1, tr in top of turning chain; turn—12 (13, 14) ch-2 spaces; 9 (10, 11) dc; 6 tr.
Rows 5-8: Repeat Rows 3-4 twice. 
Row 9: Ch 3, skip first 2 sts, *V-st in next dc, skip next ch-2 space; repeat from * 4 (5, 6) times, dc in next dc; turn—5 (6, 7) V-sts.
Row 10: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), (dc, ch 2) in each ch-1 space across to last ch-1 space, dc in last ch-1 space, ch 1, dc in top of turning chain; turn—4 (5, 6) ch-2 spaces. 
Row 11: Repeat Row 9.
Fasten off.
Sizes M and L Only
Rows 12-13: Repeat Rows 10-11 once. Fasten off.

Left Front
Work same as Right Back through Row 1 of Armhole Shaping. 
Drop loop from hook. Join a separate strand of yarn in top of first st in Row 1 of Armhole Shaping, ch 27 (30, 33). Fasten off strand.
Row 2: Pick up dropped loop at end of Row 1 of Armhole Shaping, ch 2 (counts as hdc), hdc in each st and each ch-1 space across to added ch, sc in each ch across; turn—27 (30, 33) sc; 14 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 3, skip first 2 sts, *V-st in next st, skip next 2 sts; repeat from * across to last 2 sts, skip next st, dc in last st; turn—13 (14, 15) V-sts.
Row 4: Ch 5 (counts as tr, ch 1), (tr, ch 2) in each of next 5 ch-1 spaces, (dc, ch 2) in each of ch-1 space across to last ch-1 space, d c in last ch-1 space, ch 1, dc in top of turning chain; turn—12 (13, 14) ch-2 spaces; 9 (10, 11) dc; 6 tr.
Rows 5-8: Repeat Rows 3-4 twice. Fasten off.
Row 9: With right side facing, skip first 7 ch-2 spaces, join yarn in next dc, ch 3, skip next ch 2 space *V-st in next st, skip next ch-2 space; repeat from * 4 (5, 6) times, dc in last 4th ch of turning ch ; turn—5 (6, 7) V-sts.
Row 10: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), (dc, ch 2) in each ch-1 space across to last ch-1 space, dc in last ch-1 space, ch 1, dc in top of turning chain; turn—4 (5, 6) ch-2 spaces.
Row 11: Repeat Row 3.
Fasten off.
Sizes M and L Only
Rows 15-16: Repeat Rows 13-14 once. Fasten off.
With right sides facing, whipstitch center back seam. Whipstitch Fronts to Back at sides and shoulders.

Skirt
Round 1: With right side facing, join yarn on bottom edge of Back at center seam, ch 1, work 35 (39, 43) sc evenly spaced across to side seam; work 35 (39, 43) sc evenly spaced across to bottom edge of Right Front; starting in bottom left-hand corner of Left Front, work 35 (39, 43) sc evenly spaced across bottom edge of Left Front to side seam; work 35 (39, 43) sc evenly spaced across to center back seam; join with slip st in first sc—140 (156, 172) sc. 
Round 2: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), skip first 2 sts, *dc in next sc, ch 1, skip next sc; repeat from * around; join with a slip st in 3rd ch of ch-4 tch—70 (78, 86) ch-1 spaces.
Round 3: Ch 3, dc in each dc and ch-1 space around; join with slip st in top of turning chain.
Round 4: Ch 4, dc in same st (counts as V-st),ch 1, skip next 3 sts, *V-st in next st, ch 1, skip next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—35 (39, 43) V-sts.
Round 5: Ch 3, dc in each st and ch-1 space around; join with slip st in top of turning chain—140 (156, 172) dc.
Rounds 6-9: Repeat Rounds 4-5 (twice).
Round 10: Ch 5 (counts as tr, ch 1), tr in same st (counts as Tr-V-st), skip next 3 sts, *Tr-V-st in next st, ch 1, skip next 3 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-5—35 (39, 43) Tr-V-sts.
Round 11: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), hdc in each st and ch-1 space around; join with slip st in top of turning chain.
Rounds 12-17: Repeat Rounds 10-11 (3 times).
Round 18: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), skip first 2 sts, *dc in next st, ch 1, skip next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4. 
Round 19: Ch 2 (counts as hdc), hdc in each st and ch-1 space around to last ch-1 space, work 2 (1, 0) hdc in last ch-1 space; join with slip st in top of turning chain—141 (156, 165) hdc.
Round 20: Ch 5 (counts as tr, ch 1), tr in same st (counts as Tr-V-st), skip next 2 sts, *Tr-V-st in next st, skip next 2 sts; repeat from * around; join with slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-5—47 (52, 58) Tr-V-sts.
Round 21: Slip st in next ch-1 space, ch 5 (counts as tr, ch 1), tr in same space (counts as Tr-V-st), Tr-V-st in each of next 2 ch-1 spaces, *(tr, ch 1, tr, ch 1, tr) in next ch-1 space, Tr-V-st in each of next 3 ch-1 spaces; repeat from * 10 (11, 12) times. Sizes M and L Only: (tr, ch 1, tr, ch 1, tr) in next ch-1 space. Size L Only: Tr-V-st in each of next 2 ch-1 spaces. All sizes: Join with slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-5—58 (65, 72) ch-1 spaces.
Round 22: Slip st in next ch-1 space, ch 5 (counts as tr, ch 1), tr in same space (counts as Tr-V-st), Tr-V-st in each ch-1 space around, join with slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-5—58 (65, 72) Tr-V-sts.
Round 23: Ch 3, dc in each st and ch-1 space around, inc 2 (1, 0) dc evenly spaced around; join with slip st in top of tch—176 (196, 216) dc.
Round 24: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), skip first 2 sts, *dc in next st, ch 1, skip next st; repeat from * around; join with slip st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—88 (98, 108) ch-1 spaces.
Round 25: Ch 3, dc in each st and ch-1 space around; join with slip st in top of turning chain—176 (196, 216) dc.
Round 26: Repeat Round 24.
Sizes Medium and Large Only
Repeat Rounds 25-26 (1 [2] times).

Ruffle
Change to larger hook.
Rounds 1-3: Slip st in next ch-1 space, ch 5 (counts as tr, ch 1), tr in same space (counts as Tr-V-st), ch 1, skip next ch-1 space, *Tr-V-st in next ch-1 space, ch 1 skip next ch-1 space; repeat from * around; join with slip st in 4th ch of beginning ch-5—44 (49, 54) Tr-V-sts.
Round 4: Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch 1), skip first st, (dc, ch 1) in each st and ch-1 space around, join with sl st in 3rd ch of beginning ch-4—176 (196, 216) ch-1 spaces. Fasten off. Weave in ends.

FINISHING
With smaller hook, make a ch approximately 84 (90, 96)” long. Fasten off. Tie an overhand knot at each end of drawstring. Beginning at center back, weave one end of drawstring through eyelet round (Round 2) on either side of body to center front, then crisscross ends and weave through eyelets along front of each bodice. Tighten or loosen drawstring to adjust fit as desired. Tie drawstring in a bow at top of Front.

Armhole Trim (optional)
Round 1: For a tighter armhole, using smaller hook, join yarn at bottom of one armhole, ch 2, hdc evenly around armhole; join with slip st in top of turning chain. Fasten off. Repeat Armhole Trim around other armhole.

Round 4: Skip next dc, (3 dc, ch 1, slip

st in corresponding ch-1 space of previous 
motif, 2 dc) in next ch-1 space, slip st in next

space of next V-st; repeat from * around;
ending last repeat at **, join with a slip st in

spaces. Fasten off.

(follow diagram on page 3 for placement):

Round 4: Skip next dc, *(3 dc, ch 1, sl st in 
corresponding corner ch-2 space of previous 
motif, ch 1, 3 dc) in ch-3 space of next 
V-st, slip st in next FPhdc, (2 dc, slip st in
corresponding ch-1 space of previous motif,
2 dc) in next ch-1 space, slip st in next FPhdc,
skip next dc; repeat from * once, (3 dc, ch 1,
slip st in corresponding corner ch-2 space of
previous motif, ch 1, 3 dc) in ch-3 space of
next V-st, **skip next dc, slip st in next FPhdc,
(2 dc, ch 1, 2 dc) in next ch-1 space**, slip st
in next FPhdc, skip next dc, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc)
in ch-3 space of next V-st; repeat from ** to **
once; join with a slip st in first slip st—40 dc;
4 ch-2 spaces; 4 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
FIRST MOTIF
Ch 6, join with slip st in first ch to form ring.
Round 1: Ch 1 (does not count as a st), [hdc, dc, 
ch 2, dc, hdc, ch 1] 4 times in ring; join with a 
slip st in first hdc—8 hdc; 8 dc; 4 ch-2 spaces.
Round 2: Ch 1 (does not count as a st),*FPhdc

Round 3: Ch 1 (does not count as a st), *FPhdc

Round 4: *Skip next dc, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in

space, slip st in next FPhdc; repeat from *
around; ending with slip st in first slip st—40
dc; 4 ch-2 spaces; 4 ch-1 spaces. Fasten off.
BACK END EDGING
Row 1: With right side facing, join yarn in the 
right-hand motif’s corner ch-2 space on back 
bottom edge, ch 1, sc in corner ch-2 space, 
*[(dtr, ch 2) 5 times, dtr] in next ch-1 space,

Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 17 sts, *skip next st,

16 sts; repeat from * across, ending with sc in

6, sc in next 8 sts, skip next st; repeat from *
across, ending with slip st in last sc.
Fasten off.
FRONT END EDGING (work 2)
Work same as Back End Edging across 2 Front 
edges—3 (4, 4) scallops.
SIDE EDGING (work 2)
Row 1: With right side facing, join yarn in row-
end st of Row 2 of End Edging on side edge, 
ch 1 (does not count as a st), hdc in each 
row-end st of Row 2 and Row 1, hdc in each 
corner ch-space and sc in each remaining st 
across, skipping each slip st, hdc in row-end 
st of Row 1 and Row 2 of End Edging on other 
end; turn—160 (186, 212) sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, slip st in each st across.  
Fasten off. 
Repeat Side Edging on other side edge of 
Ruana.
INSIDE AND NECK EDGING:
Row 1: With right side facing, join yarn in 
inside’s right corner in the side of Row 2 of 
Right Front End Edging, 1 (does not count as a 
st), hdc in each row-end st of Row 2 and Row

* to * across, hdc in row-end st of Row 1 and
Row 2 of Left Front End Edging; turn. 
Row 2: Ch 1, slip  st in each st across.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. Wet block for best results. 
Cut 12” (30.5 cm) strands of yarn. Using 15

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hooks: 10mm [US N-15] and 11.5 [US P-16]

instructions:
SHRUG
Body
With larger hook, ch 75 (87, 93, 105, 111, 123, 135, 147); change to smaller hook. 
Row 1 (right side): Ch 4, V-st in 5th ch from hook (beginning skipped ch count as first dc and skipped ch), *skip next 2 ch, V-st in next ch; repeat from * across to last 2 ch, skip next ch, dc in last ch, turn—25 (29, 31, 35, 37, 41, 45, 49) V-sts and 2 dc.
With opposite side of Row 1 facing, place marker in foundation ch of 13th (15th, 16th, 18th, 19th, 21st, 23rd, 25th) V-st for lower center back and in foundation ch of 6th (7th, 7th, 8th, 9th, 10th, 11th, 12th) V-sts at right and left of marked center V-st for collar shaping. Do not remove markers until instructed.
Rows 2–30 (30, 31, 31, 32, 32, 33, 33): Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), V-st in each V-st across to beginning ch, dc in top of beginning ch, turn.
Do not fasten off. Place marker in ch-1 space of 13th (15th, 16th, 18th, 19th, 21st, 23rd, 25th) V-st of last row for top center back. For Armholes, place markers in first and last sts of rows 7 and 24 (6 and 25, 6 and 26, 6 and 26, 5 and 28, 5 and 28, 5 and 29, 4 and 30).
First Armhole
Fold Body in half widthwise with right sides of top and bottom edges together, matching markers at ends of rows. Working through both thicknesses of ends of rows, slip st evenly spaced across side edge to marked sts. Fasten off.
Second Armhole
Working through both thicknesses of ends of rows of other side, join yarn in first row and slip st evenly spaced across side edge to marked sts. Fasten off. Remove markers at ends of rows.
Sleeve Cuff (work twice)
Round 1: With right side of armhole facing, join yarn with sc in Armhole seam, place marker, working in ends of rows, work even number of sc evenly spaced around Armhole (total st count is an odd number), do not join. Move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Sc in first sc, [ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next sc] around.
Round 3: (Ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space around.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, (ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space around.
Round 5: Repeat Round 3; join with slip st in first ch-1 space. Fasten off.
Edging
Round 1 (right side): With lower back edge facing and working in opposite side of foundation ch, join yarn with sc in center marked st, place marker, work even number of sc in each ch, st, and ch-1 space around (total st count is an odd number), do not join. Move remaining 2 markers from opposite side of foundation ch to corresponding sc and move all 4 markers up as each round or row is completed.
Round 2: Sc in first sc, (ch 1, sc) in next sc, [skip next sc, (ch 1, sc) in next 2 sc] around, working (ch 1, sc) in last sc as needed.
Shawl Collar
Row 3: (Ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space around to last ch-1 space before 4th marker, ch 1, slip st in last ch-1 space before marker; leave remaining sts and spaces unworked, turn. Remove 4th marker.
Row 4: Slip st in first ch-1 space, (ch 1, sc) in next 6 ch-1 spaces, place marker on last ch-1 space made, (ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space across to 2nd marked ch-1 space, ch 1, slip st in marked ch-1 space, turn.
Row 5: Repeat Row 4. Remove 2nd marker.
Row 6: Repeat Row 4.
Row 7: Slip st in first ch-1 space, (ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space across to 2nd marked ch-1 space, ch 1, slip st in marked ch-1 space, turn. Remove 2nd marker.
Row 8: Repeat Row 7; change to larger hook. Do not remove 2nd marker. 
Note: In Rows 9 and 10, when instructed to “(ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space”, skip slip stitches as if they are the next single crochet.
Row 9: Slip st in first ch-1 space, place marker on first ch-1 space, (ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space across to 2nd marked ch-1 space, skip slip st, remove 2nd marker, ch 1, sc in same marked ch-1 space as turning slip st of row below, remove marker, (ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space across to marked ch-1 space at lower center, do not turn.
Row 10: Ch 1, sc in marked center ch-1 space, (ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space across to next marked ch-1 space, (ch 1, sc) in marked ch-1 space, skip slip st, remove marker, (ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space across, skipping slip sts as needed, to next marker, do not turn.
Round 11: (Ch 1, sc) in each ch-1 space around; join with slip st in first ch-1 space. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends. For best results, lightly wet or steam block.

Crocodile Stitch Panels (make 2)
Notes: 
1. Wrong side rows are V-st rows and right side rows are Croc-st rows. 
2. The right side of the fabric (the side with the crocodile scales) shows the wrong side of the double crochet (dc) stitches that form the scales.
Ch 111.

Row 2 (right side): Ch 1, turn, Croc-st over first V-st, *skip next V-st, Croc-st over next V-st; repeat from * across—19 Croc-sts.
Row 3: Ch 2, turn, working into the previous V-st row, V-st in V-st at center of first Croc-st, *ch 2, V-st in next V-st, ch 2, V-st in V-st at center of next Croc-st; repeat from * across—37 V-sts.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, slip st in first V-st, Croc-st over next V-st, *skip next V-st, Croc-st over next V-st; repeat from * to last V-st, slip st in last V-st—18 Croc-sts.
Row 5: Ch 2 (counts as dc), turn, working into the previous V-st row, dc in same V-st as last slip st of previous row (first V-st made), *ch 2, V-st in V-st at center of next Croc-st, ch 2, V-st in next V-st; repeat from * across—37 V-sts.
Rows 6–29: Repeat Rows 2–5 six times.
Note: You should have 14 Croc-st rows. To check, count the Croc-st rows diagonally across the panel.
Fasten off first panel and set aside. Do not fasten off second panel.
Climbing Vine Lace Panel
Row 1 (Set-Up Row – right side): Ch 6 (counts as dc, ch 3), turn, Cl in first V-st, dc in next V-st, ch 2, sc in next V-st, *ch 2, (dc, ch 3, Cl) in next V-st, dc in next V-st, ch 2, sc in next V-st; repeat from * to last V-st ch 2, dc in last V-st.
Row 2: Ch 6 (counts as dc, ch 3), turn, Cl in first dc, skip next sc, dc in next dc, *ch 2, sc in next ch-3 space, ch 2, (dc, ch 3, Cl) in next dc, skip next sc, dc in next dc; repeat from * to turning ch-space, ch 2, sc in turning ch-space, ch 2, dc in 3rd ch of turning ch.
Repeat Row 2 until Climbing Vine Lace panel measures about 50” [127 cm], unstretched.

Wash and block long piece to measure about 23 x 59” [58.5 x 150 cm]. Wash and block separate Crocodile Stitch panel to about 23 x 7” [58.5 x 18 cm]. When pieces are dry, slip st separate Crocodile Stitch panel to short ending edge of Climbing Vine Lace pane.

instructions:
Begin at the top center and crochet your way out to the points of a shawl that will turn heads. This is the cozy accessory you’ll grab when you want to be ready for anything!

Pattern Notes
Throughout pattern 3 dc in same st count as a dc group.

PATTERN
Make an adjustable loop with A.
Row 1 (WS): Ch 4 (counts as dc, ch-1 space throughout), (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc, ch 1, dc) in loop. Pull loop closed. Fasten off A. Turn. - 2 dc groups.
Row 2: Join B to first dc with slip st, ch 4, 3 dc in first ch-1 space, (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in next ch-1 space (place marker in ch-1 space to mark center of shawl), 3 dc in tch-space, ch 1, dc in 3rd ch of tch. Fasten off B. Turn – 4 dc groups.
Row 3: Join C to first dc with slip st, ch 4, 3 dc in first ch-1 sp, 3 dc in space between next dc group, (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in next ch-1 space (move marker to ch-1 space), 3 dc in space between next dc group, 3 dc in tch-space, ch 1, dc in 3rd ch of tch. Fasten off C. Turn – 6 dc groups.
Row 4: Join D to first dc with slip st, ch 4, 3 dc in first ch-1 space, 3 dc in space between next dc group across to marker, (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in marked ch-1 space (move marker to ch-1 space), 3 dc in space between next dc group across to tch, 3 dc in tch-space, ch 1, dc in 3rd ch of tch. Fasten off D. Turn – 8 dc groups.
Rows 5-42: Repeat Row 4 changing colors in following order: E, F, A, B, C, D. Fasten off- 84 dc groups.

FINISHING 
Weave in all loose ends

Tassels
Cut 2 pieces of F yarn, 12” (30 cm) each, put aside. Wrap yarn around 6” (15 cm) piece of cardboard 65 times, cut on one side creating 1 bundle of 65 strands. Place bundle evenly between one 12” (30 cm) piece of yarn, tie bundle into place (assure strands are even). Fold bundle so that strands are even, tie second 12” (30 cm) piece of yarn around bundle, 1” (2.5 cm) below knot. Trim bundle ends to make even. Make 2 more tassels in similar manner. Sew tassels to corners of shawl.

Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook

• Braided Cable Pat is worked first as a long panel. 
• Remainder of Shawl is worked lengthwise into side of Braided Cable Pat panel using short-turn rows of slip sts. 
• Take care to work slip sts loosely enough to prevent work from pulling in.

Braided Cable Pat Panel 
Set Up Rows:
Ch 4.
1st row: (RS). 2 dc in 4th ch from hook (turning ch 3 counts as dc). Turn. 3 dc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first dc. 1 sc in next dc. 2 sc in last dc. Turn. 5 sc.

4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. 
5th row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sc. (3 dcfp around post of next dc 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Turn. 13 sts.
6th row: As 4th row. 
Proceed in Braided Cable Pat as follows (see chart on page 3):
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. Skip next 3 sts. (1 trfp around post of next dcfp 2 rows below) 3 times. Working in front of 3 trfp just made, 1 trfp around post of each of 3 skipped dcfp 2 rows below. (1 dcfp around post of of next dcfp 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Turn. 
2nd and alt rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st across. Turn.  
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. (1 dcfp around post of next trfp 2 rows below) 6 times. (1 dcfp around post of next dcfp 2 rows below) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Turn.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. (1 dcfp around post of next dcfp 2 rows below) 3 times. Skip next 3 sts.  (1 trfp around post of next dcfp 2 rows below) 3 times. Working behind 3 trfp just made, 1 trfp around post of each of 3 skipped dcfp 2 rows below. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Turn.

8th row: As 2nd row.

These 8 rows form Braided Cable Pat. 
Cont in pat until Panel from beg measures approx 62" [157.5 cm], ending on a 2nd or 6th row. 
Next row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. (Dcfp3tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Turn. 7 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
Next row:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 2 sts. Dcfp3tog. 1 sc in each of last 2 sts. Turn. 5 sts.
Next row:  Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next st. Sc2tog. Turn. 3 sts.
Next row:  Ch 1. Sc3tog. Do not fasten off.

With RS of Braided Cable Pat Panel, work 216 sc evenly along 1 side edge (see diagram on page 3). Turn.

2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, sl st in each of next 15 sts. Turn.

Cont as established, working an additional 4 sl sts on each row, until all 216 sts have been worked.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sl st in each st to end of row. Fasten off.

With WS facing, join yarn to unworked edge of Shawl at far right corner.
Work 225 sl sts evenly along edge. Turn.

instructions:
Notes
• Shawl is made from 45 Motifs and 8 Triangles arranged following layout diagram.
• Motifs are worked in joined rnds. Triangles are worked back and forth in rows.
• Squares and Triangles are joined tog as they are made using a join-as-you-go technique. The technique replaces some of the sts of 4th rnd with similar sts that also join the motif you are currently making to neighboring motifs. Motifs are joined to neighboring motifs at corners and at the center of side edges.
• The join-as-you-go technique is easy to do once you get the idea. Work 4th rnd as usual EXCEPT, when you reach a corner that needs to be joined to a previous motif, work a motif-join as you work the (dc. Ch 2. 1 dc) at the corner. When you reach the center of a side edge that needs to be joined to a previous motif, work a tr into the center of the side edge of the neighboring motif. Carefully read the description of motif-join in Abbreviations.
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
MOTIF 1
See Diagram on page 4.

Insert hook through center of ring, yarn over (with working yarn) and draw up a loop. Work sts of first rnd in the ring. After the first rnd of sts is worked, pull gently on tail to tighten ring.

Ch 1. 1 dc) in 3rd ch of next ch-5 sp. Ch 3. 1 sc in next dc. 5 sc in next ch-5 sp. 1 sc in next st. Join. Fasten off.

TRIANGLE 1

instructions:
INSTRUCTIONS
The boomerang shawl is worked starting with 3 stitches and increasing one side by two every row and decreasing the opposite side by 1 every row. You continue to work until you reach your desired size. This shawl is worked until you have 110 stitches ending with DC row. The shawl length is an arm span or approximately 60" [152.5 cm]. The shawl will need to be blocked to flatten the edges from curling. Pin to size and spray with water then cover with damp towel to block. The trim is worked separately, blocked then sewn to edge of shawl using a whip stitch.
SHAWL
Row 1: Chain 4. Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across. Ch 2. Turn. (3).
Row 2: Skip 1st st. Dc in next. 3 dc in last st. Ch 1. Turn. (4).
Row 3: 3 sc in first st. Sc in next. Sc tog in last st. Ch 2. Turn. (5).
Rep pattern Rows 2 and 3 until you reach 109 stitches (ending with sc). Complete one final row of dc. Fasten off.
TRIM
Ch 4.
1st row: (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in 4th ch from hook. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 8. Sl st in 6th ch from hook. Ch 7. Sl st in same sp as last sl st. Ch 5. Sl st in same sp as last sl st - trefoil made. Ch 2. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next ch-2 sp. Turn.
3rd row: Sl st in each of first 3 dc and next ch-2 sp. Ch 3. (2 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same sp as last sl st. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows until work measures length to fit along shaped edge of shawl, ending on 2nd row of pat (approx 46 trefoils). Do not turn at end of last row. 
Next row: Working across long edge of Trim, *Ch 3. 1 sc in top of row-end st. Rep from * to end of row, ending with 1 sc in top of beg ch 4. Fasten off leaving a long end for sewing.
FINISHING
Pin all pieces to measurements. Cover with a damp cloth leaving cloth to dry. With RS facing, using whip st, sew Trim to shaped edge of Shawl.

5th row: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Ch 3. Skip next (Ch-1 sp. 1 dc). Working in front of row, sl st in next ch-1 sp 3 rows below. Ch 3. Skip next (1 dc. Ch-1 sp). 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Working into 2 rows below (4th row of Stripe Pat): (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next dc) twice. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. Working into previous row, 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Turn.
7th row: As 5th row
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *Working into 2 rows below (6th row of Stripe Pat): (Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in next dc) twice. Ch 1. Skip next ch-1 sp. Working into previous row, 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Break B. Join C. Turn.

With A, work 4 rows. With B, work 2 rows. With A, work 2 rows. With B, work 4 rows. With A, work 2 rows. With B, work 2 rows. These 16 rows form Stripe Pat. Note that entire skirt, excluding waistband, is worked in Stripe Pat.

2nd row: Ch 2. 3 dc in first dc. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in ch-2 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc in last dc. Turn.

Right Side Shaping: Next row: (RS). Ch 3. Skip next 3 dc. *3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next 3 dc. Rep from * to ch-2 sp. 1 dc in ch-2 sp. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

With RS facing tog, sew side seams of Skirt.

With RS facing, join A with sl st at side seam.
Set-up rnd: Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around top edge of Skirt. Join with sl st to first sc.

Form Waistband Casing as follows:
1st rnd: Ch 2. Working in front loops only, 1 dc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 dc in each st around. Join with sl st to first dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. Working in front loops only, 1 dc in each st around. Join with sl st to first dc.

Fold Waistband between 3rd and 4th rnds, ensuring sts are aligned. 
With WS facing, join A with sl st to any unworked loop from sts of set-up rnd.
Ch 1. Working up through unworked loops of set-up rnd, and through both loops of sts from 4th rnd, sl st rows tog around top of Skirt until approx 2" [5 cm] of waistband remains open. Pull up a long loop and leave yarn attached until elastic is inserted.

Round 9: Ch 1, sc in first dc, S-sc over next 2 dc, [sc in next 3 dc, S-sc over next 2 dc] 15 (17, 19, 21) times, sc in next 2 (4, 2, 4) dc; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 10: Ch 2, [dc2tog, dc in next 18 (21, 23, 26) sc] 4 times; join with slip st in first dc—76 (88, 96, 108) dc.
Round 11: Ch 1, sc in first dc, S-sc over next 2 dc, [sc in next 3 dc, S-sc over next 2 dc] 14 (17, 18, 21) times, sc in next 3 (0, 3, 0) dc; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 12: Ch 2, [dc2tog, dc in next 17 (20, 22, 25) sc] 4 times; join with slip st in first dc—72 (84, 92, 104) dc.

Round 14: Ch 2, [dc2tog, dc in next 16 (19, 21, 24) sc] 4 times; join with slip st in first dc—68 (80, 88, 100) dc.
Round 15: Ch 1, sc in first dc, S-sc over next 2 dc, [sc in next 3 dc, S-sc over next 2 dc] 13 (15, 17, 19) times, sc in next 0 (2, 0, 2) dc; join with slip st in first sc.

Turn size 6 only at end of round.
Size 8 only: 
Round 22: Ch 2, [dc2tog, dc in next 20 sc] 4 times; join with slip st in first dc—84 dc.
Round 23: Ch 1, sc in first dc, S-sc over next 2 dc, [sc in next 3 dc, S-sc over next 2 dc] 16 times, sc in next dc; join with slip st in first sc.
Round 24: Ch 2, [dc2tog, dc in next 19 sc] 4 times; join with slip st in first dc—80 dc.
Round 25: Ch 1, sc in first dc, S-sc over next 2 dc, [sc in next 3 dc, S-sc over next 2 dc] 15 times, sc in next 2 dc; join with slip st in first sc. Turn piece so right side is facing and continue in rows.

Row 1 (right side): Ch 2, working in front loops only, [dc2tog, dc in next 15 (16, 17, 18) sc] 4 times, turn—64 (68, 72, 76) dc.
Row 2 (wrong side): Ch 1, working in both loops, S-sc over first 2 dc, [sc in next 3 dc, S-sc over next 2 dc] 11 (11, 13, 13) times, sc in next 3 dc, cut B after next 2 holes and fold end under, working in double “thickness” of holes, S-sc over next 2 dc, sc in next 2 (1, 0, 4), turn. Row 3: Ch 1, working back loops only, sc in each sc around, turn.
Row 4: Ch 1, working in both loops, sc in each sc around, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in each sc around. Place marker at end of this row.
If you are right-handed, do not turn or fasten off.
If you are left-handed, fasten off. With right side of back of waistband facing, join yarn with slip st in end of Row 2.

Row 1: Ch 1, working across ends of rows, sc in end of first marked row, ch 2, sc in end of next marked row. Fasten off.

Trim ending edge of Sassy Fabric with a slight curve; apply fabric sealant on cut edge and allow to dry thoroughly. Sew button under buttonhole or where desired to adjust for fit. Weave in ends.

With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.

FINISHING
With B (Soft White), whipstitch squares together (tog) as shown in assembly diagram, leaving a 12" [30.5 cm] slit at bottom of each side of Skirt when seaming Front and Back panels tog. Note: Sizes S/M, XL and 4/5XL will have 1 more row of Motifs on Back than Front.
Waistband
Note: Work Waistband and Drawstring using A as ‘self-striping’ yarn - allowing colors to change as they appear.
Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as st.
Join A with sl st in ch-3 sp on upper right corner ch-sp of Front panel as marked in assembly diagram.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 single crochet (sc) in each st and ch-sp around. Join with sl st to first sc. 126 (147 - 168 - 189 - 210 - 231 ) sc.

5th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.

1st st: With A, ch 2. Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Yarn over hook (Yoh) and draw through 1 loop on hook - ch made. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook - sc made.
Rem sts: *Draw up a loop in “ch“ of previous st. Yoh and draw through 1 loop on hook (ch). Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Rep from * until Drawstring measures length to fit waist measurement and approx 20" [51 cm] extra length to tie. Fasten off.

Fold Waistband between 3rd and 4th rnds, ensuring sts are aligned. With WS of Skirt facing, join A with sl st to any unworked loop from 2nd rnd of Waistband. Joining rnd: Ch 1. Working up through both unworked loops from 2nd rnd, and both loops of sts from 5th rnd, sl st edges together to create waistband casing around top of Skirt. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off. Using ch-2 sps worked in 3rd rnd of Waistband as ‘eyelets’, thread Drawstring through Waistband. Knot ends of Drawstring.

Granny Squares [make 18 (21-24-27-30-33) total]
With A, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join. 
4th and 5th rnds: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
Fasten off.

FINISHING
With B, whipstitch squares together (see page 3) into three strips of 6 (7-8-9-10-11) squares. Sew strips tog. Sew back seam. See Assembly Diagrams on page 4.

Waistband
Notes:
• Work Waistband and Drawstring using A as ‘self-striping’ yarn - allowing colors to change as they appear.
• Ch 2 at beg of rnds does not count as st.
Join A with sl st in ch-3 sp as marked in assembly diagram on page 4. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st and ch-sp around. Join with sl st to first sc. 126 (147-168-189-210-231) sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. Working in front loops only, 1 hdc in each sc around. Join.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 27 (27-38-38-48-48) hdc. Ch 2 (eyelet). Skip next 2 hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 3 (3-2-2-3-3) hdc. Ch 2 (eyelet). Skip next 2 hdc. 1 hdc in each st to end of rnd. Join with sl st to first hdc. 
4th rnd: Ch 2. Working in back loops only, 1 hdc in each hdc and 2 hdc in each ch-2 sp around. Join with sl st to first hdc.
5th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st to first hdc. Fasten off.

Drawstring
1st st: With A, ch 2. Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Yoh and draw through 1 loop on hook - ch made. Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook - sc made. 
Rem sts: *Draw up a loop in "ch" of previous st. Yoh and draw through 1 loop on hook (ch). Yoh and draw through 2 loops on hook. Rep from * until Drawstring measures length to fit waist measurement and approx 20" [51 cm] extra length to tie. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Fold Waistband between 3rd and 4th rnds, ensuring sts are aligned. With WS of Skirt facing, join A with sl st to any unworked loop from 2nd rnd of Waistband. 
Joining rnd: Ch 1. Working up through both unworked loops from 2nd rnd, and both loops of sts from 5th rnd, sl st edges together to create waistband casing around top of Skirt. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.

instructions:
CHILD’S VERSION
MOTIF A (make 2).
With MC, ch 5. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.

Break MC.
2nd rnd: Join B with sl st to any dc. Ch 2. (Yoh and draw up a loop) twice in same st. Yoh and draw through 4 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through rem 2 loops on hook – counts as cluster. *Ch 1. (Yoh and draw up a loop) 3 times in next dc. Yoh and draw through 6 loops on hook. Yoh and draw through rem 2 loops on hook – cluster made. Rep from *around, ending with ch 1. Join with sl st to top of ch 2. Break B.
3rd rnd: Join A with sl st to any ch-1 sp. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same sp. *5 dc in next ch-1 sp. (2 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Rep from * 4 times more. 5 dc in next ch-1 sp. 2 dc in last ch-1 sp. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.
MOTIF B (make 4).
Work as for Motif A to end of 2nd rnd.
3rd rnd: Join A with sl st to any ch-1 sp. Ch 3 (counts as dc). 1 dc in same sp. 2 dc in next ch-1 sp. *5 dc in next ch-1 sp. (2 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Rep from * twice more. (2 dc. 1 hdc. 2 sc) in next ch-1 sp. (2 sc in next ch-1 sp) 5 times. (2 sc. 1 hdc. 2 dc) in last ch-1 sp. Join with sl st to top of ch 3. Fasten off.
Join Motifs tog as shown in diagram on page 2 to form 2 uppers.
Sole: 1st rnd: Beg at center back heel seam, join MC with sl st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. Work 1 sc in back loop of each st around.Join with sl st in first sc. 68 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - sc2tog made. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 6 times. 1 sc in each of next 16 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 56 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 6 times. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 44 sc.
5th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 4 times. 1 sc in each of next 10 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 36 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 4 times. 1 sc in each of next 6 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 24 sc. Fasten off. Sew flat sole seam.
LADY’S VERSION
MOTIF A (make 2).
With MC, ch 5. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 4 (counts as tr). Work 17 tr in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 4. 18 tr.
Break MC.
Work 2nd and 3rd rnds as for Motif A of Child’s Version. Do not fasten off.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 3 dc. 3 sc in next dc. *1 sc in each of next 8 dc. 3 sc in next dc. Rep from * to last 4 dc. 1 sc in each of last 4 dc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
MOTIF B (make 4).
With MC, ch 5. Join with sl st to first ch to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 4 (counts as tr). Work 17 tr in ring. Join with sl st to top of ch 4. 18 tr.
Break MC.
Work 2nd and 3rd rnds as for Motif B of Child’s Version. Do not fasten off.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 5 dc. *3 sc in next dc (corner). 1 sc in each of next 8 sts. Rep from * twice more. 3 sc in next st, placing marker on center st (corner). 1 sc in each of next 14 sts. 3 sc in next st, placing marker on center st (corner). 1 sc in each of last 5 sts.
Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Join Motifs tog as shown in diagram to form 2 uppers.
Sole: 1st rnd: Beg at center back heel seam, join MC with sl st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp. Work 1 sc in back loop of each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 80 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sc. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - sc2tog made. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 19 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 8 times. 1 sc in each of next 19 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 66 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) 3 times. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 8 times. 1 sc in each of next 12 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. Join with sl st to first sc. 52 sc.
5th rnd: As 3rd rnd.
6th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 6 times. 1 sc in each of next 11 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 42 sc.
7th rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 4 times. 1 sc in each of next 9 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) twice. Join with sl st to first sc. 34 sc. Fasten off. Sew flat sole seam.

materials: Bernat® Maker™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 317 yds/290 m) Contrast A Aqua (11005) (Soles) 1 ball or 162 yds/148 m
Bernat® Blanket™ (10.5 oz/300 g; 220 yds/201 m) Contrast B Aquatic (10801) (Uppers) 1 ball or 25 yds/23 m

abbreviations: Sc2(3)tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2(3) stitches. Yoh and draw through all 3(4) loops on hook

instructions:
Note: Join all rnds with sl st to first st.
SLIPPERS  Make 2 alike.
Sole Top
With A, ch 14.
See diagram on page 2.
1st rnd: (RS) 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each of next 11 ch. 3 sc in last ch. Do not turn. Working into rem loops across opposite side of foundation ch. 1 sc in each of next 11 ch. 2 sc in same sp as first sc made. Join. 28 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 11 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc.** 2 sc in next sc. Rep from * to ** once more. 1 sc in same sp as first sc. Join. 32 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 12 sc. 2 sc in each of next 3 sc. ** 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to ** once more. Join. 38 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 11 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. 2 sc in next sc.** 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * to ** once more. Join. 46 sc.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. *1 sc in each of next 11 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in next sc.** 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Rep from * to ** once more. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 54 sc.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 4 sc. 1 hdc in each of next 8 sc. (2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc) 3 times. 1 hdc in next sc. (2 hdc in next sc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 sc) twice. 1 hdc in each of next 6 sc. 1 sc in each of next 5 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 3 sc) three times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last sc. Join. 63 sts.
7th rnd: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, loosely sl st in each of first 4 sc. PM on last st made. Sl st around to first st. Join and fasten off.
Sole Bottom
Work as given for 1st to 6th rnds of Sole Top. Fasten off leaving long tail for sewing.
Cut plastic canvas to shape using template on page 3. Hold WS of Top and Bottom Soles tog, ensuring sts are properly aligned, with plastic canvas between them. With yarn needle and long tail, whipstitch soles tog, working in rem loops of Sole Top, through both thicknesses. Fasten off.
Upper
Note: First row will be WS (inside) of Upper.
1st row: Join B with sl st to marked st in Sole Top. Ch 1. (1 sc in next st. Skip next st) 18 times. 1 sc in next st. Turn. 19 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 sc. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in next sc. (1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog) twice. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. 15 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 4 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 3 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of last 4 sts. 13 sts.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 3 sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in next sc. Sc3tog. 1 sc in each of last 3 sc. Turn. 9 sts.
Ch 1. Work flat sl st seam along center top of Upper. 
Fasten off and weave in ends.
Upper Edging
Join B with sl st to Upper at right side edge.

materials: RED HEART® “Super Saver®”: 1 skein each 0373 Petal Pink A, 0774 Lt Raspberry B, 0341 Light Grey C, 0311 White D, 0312 Black E.
Yarn needle, stitch marker, elastic cord (optional).
abbreviations: A, B, C, D and E = Color A, B, C, D and E
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified.
measurements: One slipper measures 5½ (6½, 7½)” long. Directions are for Child’s Size Small. Changes for Child’s Sizes Medium and Large are in parentheses.
gauge: 16 sts = 4”; 10 rounds = 2¼” in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
PIG SLIPPER (make 2)
Sole
Sole is worked, from the center of the foot outwards, in joined rounds. Do not turn at the ends of rounds.
With A, ch 15 (19, 23).
Round 1 (Right Side): Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 8 (10, 12) ch, hdc in next ch, dc in next 3 (5, 7) ch, 5 dc in last ch for toe; working across opposite side of foundation, dc in next 3 (5, 7) ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next 8 (10, 12) ch, 2 sc in last ch; join with slip st in first sc—33 (41, 49) sts.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 13 (17, 21) sts, 2 sc in next st, 3 sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 13 (17, 21) sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc—39 (47, 55) sts.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 16 (20, 24) sts, 2 sc in next st, 3 sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 16 (20, 24) sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc—45 (53, 61) sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in next 18 (22, 26) sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, 3 sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 18 (22, 26) sts, 2 sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc—53 (61, 69) sts. Fasten off.
Upper
Upper is worked, from the ankle opening downwards, in joined rounds. Turn at the end of each round.
With A, ch 29 (37, 45); taking care not to twist ch, join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Children will love wearing their little pig or mouse slippers! They are quick to crochet and are a memorable gift idea.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, sc in first 13 (17, 21) ch, 2 dc in next ch, 3 dc in next ch, 2 dc in next ch, sc in next 13 (17, 21) ch; join with slip st in first sc, turn—33 (41, 49) sts.
Round 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in each st around to last st, 2 sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc, turn—35 (43, 51) sts.
Round 3: Ch 1, sc in first 16 (20, 24) sts, 2 dc in next st, 3 dc in next st, 2 dc in next st, sc in next 16 (20, 24) sts; join with slip st in first sc, turn—39 (47, 55) sts.
Round 4: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc, turn.
Round 5: Ch 1, sc in first 17 (21, 25) sts, 2 dc in each of next 2 sts, 3 dc in next st, 2 dc in each of next 2 sts, sc in next 17 (21, 25) sts; join with slip st in first sc, turn—45 (53, 61) sts.
Round 6: Repeat Round 2—47 (55, 63) sts.
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in first 21 (25, 29) sts, 2 dc in each of next 2 sts, 3 dc in next st, 2 dc in each of next 2 sts, sc in next 21 (25, 29) sts; join with slip st in first sc—53 (61, 69) sts.
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in each st around; join with slip st in first sc, turn. Do not fasten off.
Join Upper to Sole: Hold Wrong Sides of sole and upper together, matching sts. Working through both thicknesses, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Elastic Edging (optional): With Right Side facing, place a length of elastic cord over top edge of ankle opening, leaving ends of elastic cord extending over back of heel. Join A with sc in top edge at back of heel, working over the elastic cord, sc evenly spaced around ankle opening; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off. Pull gently on ends of elastic cord and tie ends together securely.
Face
With A, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1 (Right Side): Ch 1, 8 sc in ring; do not join—8 sc. Place marker for beginning of round, move marker up as work progresses.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—16 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 8 times—24 sc.
Round 4: [2 sc in next sc, sc in next 2 sc] 8 times—32 sc. 
First Ear: Ch 2, [yarn over, insert hook in next st, yarn over and draw up a loop, yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] 3 times (4 loops on hook), yarn over and draw through 3 loops on hook, yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook (first ear made). Fasten off.
Second Ear: With Right Side facing, skip next 3 sc following first ear, join A with slip st in next sc, work same first ear. Fasten off.
Snout: With A, ch 4, 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, 4 sc in last ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, sc in next ch, 2 sc in next ch; join with slip st in first sc—10 sc. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew snout to center of face. With E, embroider French Knot eyes above snout, and straight stitch nostrils on snout. With B, embroider straight stitch mouth below snout. Sew face to top of slipper. Weave in ends.
MOUSE SLIPPER (make 2)
With C, make sole and upper, join sole to upper and add elastic edging (optional) same as for pig slipper.
Face
With C, ch 4; join with slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Work Rounds 1–4 of face for pig.
First Ear: Drop C from hook, but do not fasten off, join A with slip st in next sc, ch 3, 6 dc in same sc. Fasten off A. 
Place dropped loop of C back on hook, working across A-colored sts, 2 sc in top of beginning ch-3, 2 sc in each of next 6 dc, slip st in next 5 sc of face. Do not fasten off.
Second Ear: Work same as first ear, omitting last 5 slip sts. Fasten off.
FINISHING
With E, embroider satin stitch nose on center of face, French Knot eyes above nose, and straight stitch mouth below nose. With D, embroider straight stitch whiskers on both sides of nose. Sew face to top of slipper. Weave in ends.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

instructions:
The instructions are written for 5/6 size. If changes are necessary, the instructions will be written 5/6 (7/8 - 9/10). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes.

USING THIS GUIDE
Click on the underlined words throughout the pattern to access our library of helpful tools.

NOTES
• Join each round (rnd) with slip stitch (sl st) to first stitch (st).
• Chain (ch) 2 at beginning (beg) of rnd does not count as half double crochet (hdc).

Make a slip knot and place on hook.
Slip Knot: Make a loop with yarn and fold it on itself to make a pretzel shape. Then pull through to make slip knot.
Chain: Yarn over hook (Yoh) and draw up a loop. 

Beginning (Beg) at toe with A, ch 3. (See Diagram 1 for beginning of Slipper on page 6).

Hdc: Yarn over hook (Yoh) and draw up a loop in 3rd chain (ch) from hook. (3 loops on hook) Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - hdc made.

1st rnd: 10 hdc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with slip stitch (sl st) in first hdc. 10 hdc in rnd. 1st rnd is complete.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc. Repeat (rep) from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st in first hdc. 15 hdc. 2nd rnd is complete.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 2 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 2 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st in first hdc. 20 hdc. 3rd rnd is complete.

Sizes 7/8 and 9/10 only: 4th rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 9 hdc. 2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 9 hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Join with sl st in first hdc. 22 hdc. 

All sizes: Next rnd: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc around. Join with sl st in first hdc. 20 (22 - 22) hdc. Rep last rnd until piece measures 4 (4½ - 5)" [10 (11.5 - 12.5) cm].

1st row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 12 (14 - 14) hdc. Turn. Leave remaining (rem) sts unworked. 

2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. 12 (14 - 14) hdc. Turn. 
Rep last row until work from beg measures 9¼ (9¾ - 10¼)" [23.5 (25 - 26) cm]. 
Next row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of next 4 (5 - 5) hdc. [(Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - hdc2tog made] twice. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.

Hdc2tog: [Yarn over hook (Yoh) and draw up a loop in next st] twice. (5 loops on hook.) Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - hdc2tog made.

Join back of foot: Fold work in half, working through both thicknesses, sl st in each st to end of row. Fasten off.

Top edging: With Right Side (RS) facing, join yarn with sl st at center back seam. Ch 1. Work 1 rnd of sc evenly around top of Slipper. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. Pompom (optional) make 2: Wind B around 4 fingers 100 times. Tie tightly in the middle and leave a long end for attaching to Slipper. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape. Sew securely to top of Slipper as shown in photo.

instructions:
Sole: With MC, ch 4 (5-6).
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 3 (4-5) sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 (6-7) sc.
Rep 2nd row once more. 7 (8-9) sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 4¼ (4½-5)" [11 (11.5-12.5) cm].

Next row: Ch 1. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 9 (10-11) sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 7½ (8¼-9)" [19 (21-23) cm].
Next row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. 7 (8-9) sc.
Rep last row until 3 (4-5) sc rem. Fasten off.

Upper: Join A with sl st to center back heel of Sole. 
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1. Work 55 (63-71) sc evenly around edge of Sole. Join. Turn.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Break A. Join MC. Turn.
3rd rnd: With MC, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 20 (22-26) sc. (Dc2tog) 3 (4-4) times. Dc3tog. (Dc2tog) 3 (4-4) times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Turn. 47 (53-61) sts.
5th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 16 (17-21) sc. (Dc2tog) 3 (4-4) times. Dc3tog. (Dc2tog) 3 (4-4) times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Turn. 39 (43-51) sts.
6th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 12 (14-16) sc. (Dc2tog) 3 (3-4) times. Dc3tog. (Dc2tog) 3 (3-4) times. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Turn. 31 (35-41) sts.

Size 9/10 only: Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 19 sts. Dc3tog. 1 sc in each sc to end of rnd. Join. Turn. 39 sts.
All sizes: Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st around. Join. Turn.

Leg: Rep last rnd until Leg measures 3 (3½-4)" [7.5 (9-10) cm], ending on a WS rnd.
Next rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. Turn. 33 (37-41) sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join. Turn. 35 (39-43) sts.
Next rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Turn.
Rep last rnd until Leg measures 8 (8½-9)" [20.5 (21.5-23) cm], ending on a RS rnd. Fasten off.

Cuff: With B, ch 35 (39-43). Join with sl st to first ch, taking care not to twist chain.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join. Place marker on first st. 35 (39-43) sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Rep 2nd rnd until Cuff measures 3 (3½-3½)" [7.5 (9-9) cm]. Break B. Join A.
Next rnd: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join. Fasten off.

Slip Cuff over top of Leg of Slipper with WS of Cuff facing RS of Leg. Working through both thicknesses, join A with sl st to any st of last rnd.
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

Pompoms: Wind A around 3 fingers approx 50 times. Remove from fingers and tie tightly in center with length of yarn approx. 12" [30.5 cm] long. Cut through each side of loops. Trim to a smooth round shape. Attach Pompoms to Slippers as shown in picture.

RedHeart.com
Make these cozy slippers in any of the three sizes as a unique gift or to warm your own toes. The fuzzy yarn and sweet face are beautifully designed and fun to wear.
1. Toe is worked in joined rounds; do not turn unless instructed. The first stitch of each round is worked in the same stitch as the join from the previous round. The sides are made in turned rows.
2. Smallest hook is optional and used only for eyelashes. You may prefer to embroider the eyelashes instead of crocheting them.
3. When weaving in ends or sewing with B, keep the yarn tightly twisted so that it will not break.
SLIPPERS

Inner Toe and Sole (make 2)
With medium hook and A, ch 7.
Round 1 (right side): Work 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 4 ch, 2 sc in next ch; working across opposite side of foundation ch, 2 sc in next ch, sc in next 4 ch, 2 sc in the next ch; join with slip st in first sc—16 sc.

Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 2 st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc—20 sc.

Round 3: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st,* sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * to * once, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc—24 sc.

Round 4: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 8 sts, 2 sc in next st,* sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * to * once, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc —28 sc.

Round 5: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 10 sts, 2 sc in next st,* sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * to * once, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc —32 sc.

Round 6: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 12 sts, 2 sc in next st,* sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * to * once, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc —36 sc.

Sizes Medium and Large only:
Round 7: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 14 sts, 2 sc in next st,* sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * to * once, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc —40 sc.

Size Large only:
Round 8: Ch 1, sc in same st as join, *2 sc in next st, sc in next 16 sts, 2 sc in next st,* sc in next 2 sts; repeat from * to * once, sc in last st; join with slip st in first sc —44 sc.

All sizes
Rounds 7-16 (8-17, 9-18): Ch 1, sc in each st; join with slip st in first sc, turn—36 (40, 44) sc.

Note Continue working in rows.
Row 17 (18, 19) (wrong side): Ch 1, sc in front loop only of each of next 14 (16, 18) sts; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—14 (16, 18) sc. Place marker in first st.

Note Unworked stitches will be stitched when attaching the inner toe and sole to the inside of the slipper.

Rows 18-36 (19-41, 20-46): Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.

Row 37 (42, 47): Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—12 (14, 16) sts.

Rows 38-41 (43-46, 48-51): Repeat Row 37 (42, 47) four times—4 (6, 8) sts at end of Row 41 (46, 51). Fasten off, leaving long tail for sewing.

Outer Toe (make 2)
Repeat Rounds 1-16 (1-17, 1-18) of inner toe and sole.

Round 17 (18, 19): Ch 1, sc in each st; join with slip st in first sc—36 (40, 44) sc.

Insert inner toe and sole into outer toe and align the marked stitch to the last stitch of Round 17 (18, 19).

Round 18 (19, 20): Working through both loops of outer toe and in front loops only of inner toe and sole, ch 1, sc in each st, place stitch marker in the 15th (16th, 17th) sc; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.

Slipper Sides
With medium hook, join A with slip st to marked st.

Row 1: Ch 1, sc in same st as join and in next 31 (35, 39) sts; leave remaining 4 sts unworked, turn—32 (36, 40) sc.

Rows 2-4: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog, turn—26 (30, 34) sts at end of Row 4.

Rows 5-16 (5-20, 5-24): Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.

Row 17 (21, 25): Ch 1, sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in each st to last 2 sts, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st, turn—28 (32, 36) sc.

Row 18 (22, 26): Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.

Rows 19-22 (23-26, 27-30): Repeat Rows 17 and 18 twice—32 (36, 40) sc at the end of Row 22 (26, 30).

Rows 23-26 (27-30, 31-34): Ch 1, sc in first 10 (12, 14) sts, sc2tog, sc in each st to last 12 (14, 16) sts, sc2tog, sc in last 10 (12, 14) sts, turn—24 (28, 32) sts at end of Row 26 (30, 34).

Row 27 (31, 35): Ch 1, sc in first 10 (12, 14) sts, sc2tog twice, sc in last 10 (12, 14) sts, turn—22 (26, 30) sts.

Row 28 (32, 36): Ch 1, sc in first 9 (11, 13) sts, sc2tog twice, sc in last 9 (11, 13) sts, turn—20 (24, 28) sts.

Fasten off, leaving long tail. Pin inner sole into bottom of slipper sides. Whipstitch edges of inner sole to wrong side of slipper sides, then hold back edges of slipper sides together and whipstitch through ends of rows to form the back seam of slipper.

Rolled Edging
Note: The stitches of Round 1 should cinch in the opening slightly. If you have trouble spacing them evenly, place a stitch marker at the halfway point, work half the stitches before the marker and the other half after. The stitches of Rounds 2-5 should pull in the edge of slipper a little more but to ensure that the opening does not get too small, use a slightly larger hook if necessary.

With medium hook, join A with slip st to center back edge of slipper opening.

Round 1: Ch 1, work 22 (26, 30) sc evenly spaced around edge of slipper to 4 st at center front of opening, sc in next 4 st, work 22 (26, 30) sc evenly spaced around edge of slipper to center back; do not join—48 (56, 64) sc. Continue working in continuous rounds. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.

Rounds 2-5: Slip st loosely in the front loop of each st. Fasten off.

Fluffy Coat Side 1 (make 2)
With largest hook and B, ch 15 (15, 17). Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch, turn—14 (14, 16) sc.

Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st, turn—14 (14, 16) sc.

Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first 5 (5, 6) sts, sc2tog, place stitch marker in next st; leave remaining sts unworked, turn—6 (6, 7) sts.

Row 4: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in last 4 (4, 5) sts, turn—5 (5, 6) sts.

Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first 3 (3, 4) sts, sc2tog, turn—4 (4, 5) sts.

Rows 6-10 (6-12, 6-14): Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.

Row 11 (13, 15): Ch 1, sc in each st to last st, 2 sc in last st, turn—5 (5, 6) sc.

Rows 12-14 (14-16, 16-18): Repeat Rows 10 and 11 (12 and 13, 14 and 15) once, then repeat Row 10 (12, 14) once more—6 (6, 7) sts at end of Row 14 (16, 18). Fasten off, leaving long tail.

Fluffy Coat Side 2 (make 2)
With right side of fluffy coat side 1 facing and largest hook, join B with slip st in marked st.

Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc2tog in same st as join and next st, sc in last 5 (5, 6) sts, turn—6 (6, 7) sts.

Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first 4 (4, 5) sts, sc2tog, turn—5 (5, 6) sts.

Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in last 3 (3, 4) sts, turn—4 (4, 5) sts.

Rows 4-8 (4-10, 4-12): Ch 1, sc in each st, turn.

Row 9 (11, 13): Ch 1, 2 sc in first st, sc in remaining sts, turn—5 (5, 6) sc.

Rows 10-12 (12-14, 14-16): Repeat Rows 8 and 9 (10 and 11, 12 and 13) once, then repeat Row 8 (10, 12) once more—6 (6, 7) sc at the end of Row 8 (10, 12). Fasten off, leaving long tail.

Ears (make 4)
Note: Do not join rounds. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.

With medium hook and A, make an adjustable ring (see Special Techniques).

Round 1: Work 6 sc in ring—6 sc.

Round 2: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st] 3 times—9 sc.

Round 3: [Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, sc in next st] 3 times—12 sc.

Rounds 4-6: Sc in each st.

Round 7: [Sc in next st, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sts] 2 times—10 sts.

Round 8: [Sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog] 2 times—8 sts.

Round 9: [Sc in next st, sc2tog, sc in next st] 2 times—6 sts.

Rounds 10 and 11: Sc in each st. Fasten off, leaving long tail.

Eyelashes (make 4)
With smallest hook and C, ch 8.

Row 1: Working in the bottom loop throughout, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, [ch 3, slip st in 2nd and 3rd ch from hook, working in foundation ch, slip st in next 2 ch] 3 times—3 lashes made. Fasten off, leaving long tail.

FINISHING
Holding outer edges of fluffy coat together and with B (see Notes about sewing with B), whipstitch seam. Pin fluffy coat to right side of slipper with rolled edging peeking out over the top edge of the fluffy coat. With yarn tails of fluffy coat, stitch under and around the rolled edges. Using photograph as a guide and with yarn tails, stitch each ear, working through both sets of loops of Round 11, to head of sheep. Using yarn tails of eyelashes, stitch eyelashes onto face (or, if desired, using photograph as a guide, embroider eyelashes with C onto outer toe). With C and using photograph as a guide, embroider nose and mouth under the eyelashes. Weave in all ends. Block if desired.

instructions:
SLIPPERS
Snout (Make 2)
1st rnd: With A ch 2; 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with a slip st in first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join. 12 sc.
3rd rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 5 times. Join. 18 sc.
4th rnd: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next 2 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 2 sc) 5 times. Join. 24 sc. Fasten off; this is the lower edge of the Snout.
Outer Slipper (Make 2)
With RS facing attach A in back loop of a sc at the upper edge of Snout.
1st row (RS): Ch 1. 1 sc in back loop of same sc as joining. 1 sc in back loop of each sc around; do not join. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in both loops of each sc across. Turn.
3rd row: Repeat Row 2.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 2 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 5 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last 3 sc. Turn. 28 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 3 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 6 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last 3 sc. Turn. 32 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 3 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 7 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in last 4 sc. Turn. 36 sc.
**Continue in sc increasing 4 sts evenly spaced until there are 64 sts. Then work even in sc until 10½" [26.5 cm] from beginning, ending on a WS row.
Shape Heel
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 4 sc; *(draw up a loop in next st) twice, yoh and through all 3 loops on hook - sc2tog made. 1 sc in next 4 sc. Rep from * across. Turn. 54 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 4 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next 3 sc) 10 times. Turn. 44 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 4 sts. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next 2 sts) 10 times. Turn. 34 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 4 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 10 times. Turn. 24 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 4 sc. (Sc2tog) 10 times. Turn. 14 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 7 times. Turn. 7 sts.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 4 sts. Fasten off. **
Slipper Lining (Make 2)
Toe
With A, ch 5.
1st row (RS): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across. Turn. 4 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc across. Turn. 8 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 3 times. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 12 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 2 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 2 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 16 sc.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 3 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 3 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 20 sc.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 4 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 4 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 24 sc.
7th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 5 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 5 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 28 sc.
8th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 6 sc. (2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next 6 sc) 3 times. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 32 sc.
Work even in sc until 8½" [21.5 cm] from beginning, ending on a WS row.
Shape Heel
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 2 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next 3 sc) 6 times. Turn. 26 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 2 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next 2 sc) 6 times. Turn. 20 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first 2 sc. (Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc) 6 times. Turn. 14 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 7 times. Turn. 7 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. (Sc2tog) 3 times. 4 sc. Fasten off.
Ears (Make 4)
With A ch 7.
1st row (RS): 2 Sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in next 4 ch. 2 sc in last ch. Turn. 8 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next 4 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 6 sc.
3rd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next 2 sc. Sc2tog. Turn. 4 sc.
4th row: Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Turn. 2 sts.
5th row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc. Fasten off.
Tail (Make 2)
With A ch 10. 2 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 2 sc in each ch across. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew center front seam of outer slipper from snout to foot opening for 5" [12.5 cm]. Sew center back seam of outer slipper from heel to foot opening for 1½" [4 cm]. Sew center front seam of lining slipper from toe to foot opening for 2½" [6 cm]. Sew center back seam of lining slipper from heel to foot opening for 1½" [4 cm]. Join foot opening of lining to foot opening of slipper by 1 round sc along edge through both thicknesses, stuffing slipper firmly. Sew on ears as shown. Attach tail at back. With B Embroider eyes, Straight Stitch eyelashes and nostrils.

Sole
