11/2" [4 cm] piece of cardboard for pompoms.
abbreviations: Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 stitches. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook.
measurements: Approx 19" [48 cm] long from cuff to toe.
gauge: 13 sc and 14 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes:
• To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet.
• Pull tie to remove.
• Start crocheting!
• Join all rnds with sl st to first sc.
• To change colors, work to last 2 loops on hook of previous stitch and draw new color through.

Leg Stripe Pat
**With B, work 2 rnds.
With A, work 2 rnds.
Rep from ** to ** twice more.
With B, work 6 rnds.
***With A, work 2 rnds.
With B, work 2 rnds.***
Rep from *** to *** once more.
With A, work 2 rnds.
With B, work 3 rnds.
These 31 rnds form Leg Stripe Pat.

Foot Stripe Pat
With B, work 3 rnds. Join A.
**With A, work 2 rnds.
With B, work 2 rnds.**
Rep from ** to ** once more.
With A, work 2 rnds.
With B, work 6 rnds.
With A, work 1 rnd.
These 20 rnds form Foot Stripe Pat.

STOCKING
Cuff: With A, ch 11.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row:  Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 14" [35.5 cm] ending on a WS row. Do not fasten off. 
Join Cuff:  Working in back loops only, sl st last row and rem loops of foundation ch tog. Do not turn. 
Leg: Rotate to work along side edge of Cuff and proceed as follows:
1st rnd: Ch 1. Work 46 sc evenly around side edge of Cuff. Join with sl st to first sc. Join B. Turn. 
Beg working Leg Stripe Pat.
2nd rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
3rd to 32nd rnds: Keeping cont of Leg Stripe Pat, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
Leg Stripe Pat is complete.

Heel: 1st row:  (RS). With A, ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 22 sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 23 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd row for 2" [5 cm], ending on a WS row.
Shape Heel: 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 15 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 17 sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 9 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 11 sts.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 10 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 12 sts.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 11 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 13 sts.
5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 12 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 14 sts.
6th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 13 sts. Sc2tog. 1 sc in next sc. Turn. 15 sts.
7th and 8th rows:  Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 14 sts. Sc2tog. Turn. 15 sts. 
Fasten off.

Foot
Joining rnd: (RS). Join B with sl st at left side of Heel Base. Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 23 sc of instep. PM. Work 7 sc up right side of Heel, 1 sc in each of next 15 sc across end of Heel and 7 sc down left side of Heel. Join. 52 sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to marker. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog. Join. 50 sts.
First 2 rnds of Foot Stripe Pat are complete. 
Keeping cont of Foot Stripe Pat, rep 2nd rnd until 44 sts rem. 
6th rnd: With B, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
7th rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join.
8th to 20th rnds: Keeping cont of Foot Stripe Pat, rep 7th rnd.
Foot Stripe Pat is complete.

Shape toe: 1st rnd:  With A, ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 9 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join. 40 sts.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. (1 sc in each of next 8 sc. Sc2tog) 4 times. Join. 36 sts.
3rd to 8th rnds:  Cont in same manner, dec 4 sts on every rnd until 12 sts rem. Break yarn, leaving a long end. Draw end tightly through rem sts and fasten securely.

FINISHING
Hanging loop: With A, ch 25. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Fasten off. Fold in half and sew in position at top center back of cuff as shown in photo.
Pompoms (make 9):  Wind B around 1 1/2 " [4 cm] piece of cardboard 100 times. Tie yarn tightly in the middle and leave long ends for attaching to Stocking. Cut loops at both ends and trim to smooth round shape.
Sew Pompoms evenly around base of Cuff as shown in photo.

Notes:

• Ch 3 at beg of rows counts as dc throughout.
FRONT
With A, ch 41. (See diagram on page 3.)
1st row: (WS). 2 dc in 4th ch from hook (skipped ch-3 counts as dc). 1 dc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 40 sts. 
2nd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each dc to last 2 dc. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in last dc. Turn. 1 st inc’d.
3rd row: Ch 3. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn. 1st inc’d.
4th row: As 2nd row.
Rep last 2 rows 4 times more. 51 sts.
Shape Foot: 1st row: (RS). Ch 3. 2 dc in next dc. 1 dc in each of next 18 dc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 21 sts. 
2nd row: Ch 3. Dc2tog. 1 dc in each dc to end of row. Turn. 20 sts
3rd row: Ch 3. 1 dc in each dc to last 3 dc. Dc2tog. 1 dc in last dc. Turn. 19 sts.
4th row: Ch 3. Dc2tog. 1 dc in each dc to last 3 dc. Dc2tog. 1 dc in last dc. Turn. 17 sts.
5th row: Ch 3. (Dc2tog) twice. 1 dc in each dc to last 5 dc. (Dc2tog) twice. 1 dc in last dc. Turn. 13 sts.
6th row: As 5th row. 9 sts.
7th row: Ch 3. Dc2tog. Dc3tog. Dc2tog. 1 dc in last dc. 5 dc. Fasten off.
BACK
Work as given for Front noting RS and WS indications will be reversed. 
SURFACE SLIP STITCH STRIPES
Front: 1st Stripe: (RS). Join B with sl st at right side edge of Stocking at top of 2nd row. With yarn at WS of Front and working across top of 2nd row, sl st in each st to end of row. Fasten off.
2nd to 9th Stripes: Work as for First Stripe, working Surface Sl St stripes across top of every 2nd row.
Back: Work 1st to 9th Stripes as given for Front, noting opposite side of work will be RS.
Join Front and Back
Align Front and Back pieces with WS facing each other. At this point you can determine which side you wish to be the 'front' of Stocking, and which direction you wish the foot to point. Your chosen 'front' should be facing while working the Joining row. 
Joining row: (RS). Join A with sl st to top-left corner of Stocking. Working through both thicknesses, sc evenly down left side edge of Stocking, around foot and up right side edge of Stocking, working 3 sc in top-right corner. Do not fasten off. 
Top edging rnd: Work 23 sc evenly across top front of Stocking to first sc of Joining row. Sl st in first sc of Joining row. Turn stocking to 'back' and work 25 sc evenly across top back edge of Stocking. Join with sl st to center sc of 3 sc at top-right corner. Fasten off. 50 sc around top of Stocking.
Edging Slip stitch row: (RS). Join B with sl st to first sc of Joining row. Sl st in each sc to top right corner of Stocking. Fasten off.
CUFF
Note: Cuff is worked in a continuous spiral. Do not join rnds.
With WS of Stocking facing (looking at inside), join B with sl st to top right corner of Stocking. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Do not join.
2nd rnd: 1 sc in next sc, PM on this st for beg of rnd. 1 sc in each sc around. 
Rep last rnd, moving marker up each rnd until Cuff measures 2" [5 cm] long. Do not fasten off.
Next rnd (fold line): Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc around. 
Next rnd: 1 sc in next sc, PM on this st for beg of rnd. 1 sc in each sc around.
Rep last rnd until Cuff from fold line measures 4" [10 cm] long. Do not fasten off.
Bobble Trim: *Sl st in each of next 4 sts. Bobble in next st. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.
Hanging Loop: With B, ch 18. Sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Fasten off. 
Fold piece in half to form loop and sew ends to side edge of Cuff as shown.

instructions:
WRIST WARMER  (make 2 alike)
Notes: 
• Wrist Warmers are worked in the round (rnd), turning at end of each rnd to alternate Right Side (RS) and Wrong Side (WS).
• When working thumb opening, rnds are not joined and opening section is worked in rows.
Beginning (Beg) at top edge, ch 38. Join with slip stitch (sl st) to first chain (ch) to form a ring, taking care not to twist chain.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each ch around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn. 38 sc.
2nd rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
3rd rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
Repeat (Rep) last 2 rnds until Wrist Warmer measures 7" [18 cm], ending on a WS rnd.
Begin shaping: Decrease rnd: (RS). Ch 1. Single crochet 2 together (sc2tog). 1 sc in each sc to last 2 sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
Next 5 rnds: Work even as before, turning at end of each rnd.
Rep last 6 rnds twice more. 32 sts remain (rem).
Continue (Cont) working even without decreases until Wrist Warmer measures 13½" [34.5 cm], ending on a WS rnd.
Divide for thumb opening (worked in rows): 
1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each stitch (st) around. Do not join. Turn.
2nd row: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.
4th row: As 2nd row.
Close thumb opening (Return to working in rnds):
Next rnd: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
Next rnd: (WS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Turn.
Rep last 2 rnds until Wrist Warmer measures 17" [43 cm]. Fasten off.

instructions:
Notes:
To begin working with the O’Go format, carefully cut plastic tie where the ends of the O’Go meet. Pull tie to remove. To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color. When working from 2 O’gos within one row, make sure colors are different to create “color block” effect.

Ch 39.

2nd row:  Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. (1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc) 8 times. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * once more. Turn.
3rd row:  Ch 1. *1 sc in next sc. (Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 8 times. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * once more. Turn.

With first O’Go, ch 37. With 2nd O’Go, ch 38. Note: Begin each O’Go on different color stripe to achieve contrasting colors (see photo).

Place Pocket Lining: Next row: (RS). With first O’Go, 1 sc in first sc. (Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 8 times. Ch 1. Skip next sc. Work across sts of Pocket Lining: 1 sc in first sc. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc) 8 times. 1 sc in next sc. Join 2nd O’Go. 1 sc in next sc. (Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 8 times. Ch 1. Skip next sc. 1 sc in last sc.  Skip next 38 sts of Shawl. Ch 1. Skip next sc. (1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc) 8 times. 1 sc in last sc. Turn. 74 sts.

2nd row: Ch 1. [1 sc in next sc. (1 sc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. Skip next sc) 8 times. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp. 1 sc in next sc] twice. Turn.

Bpdc (back post double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from back side of work to front and to back again around the post of indicated stitch; yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice. 
Fpdc (Front post double crochet) = Yarn over, insert hook from front side of work to back and to front again around post of indicated stitch; yarn over and pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), [yarn over and draw through 2 loops on hook] twice.
sc2tog (single crochet 2 stitches together) = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

abbreviations: A and B = Color A, and color B

SWEATER
Front

Round 7: Repeat Round 5; change to A in last st—70 dc.

Round 24 (28, 32): Repeat Round 4 once more—206 (238, 270) sc. Fasten off.

Rounds 24 (28)–26 (30): Repeat Rounds 4–6 once more—222 (254) sc. Fasten off.

Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in each st across; change to A in last st, turn.

Row 6: Repeat Row 2.

Medium (Large, X-Large, XX-Large) only

Row 2: Ch 1, sc2tog, sc in each st across, turn—14 (16, 18, 20, 22) sts.
Row 3: Ch 3, dc in each st across, turn.
Rows 4–7: Repeat last 2 rows twice—12 (14, 16, 18, 20) sts.

Left Shoulder
Row 1 (RS): Ch 1, extended sc in next 14 (18, 21, 25, 26, 30) sts, skip 31 (29, 31, 29, 35, 33) sts and place a stitch marker in the next st (to mark the beginning of the right shoulder). Turn- 14 (18, 21, 25, 26, 30 sts).

Fasten off. 
Right Shoulder
Row 1 (RS): Join yarn with slip st in marked st from Row 1 of Left Shoulder, ch 1 (does not count as a st), extended sc in each st across. Turn- 14 (18, 21, 25, 26, 30 sts).
Rows (2 - 7) (2 - 7) (2 - 7) (2 - 7) (2 - 9) (2 - 9): Ch 1, extended sc in each st across. Turn.
Fasten off. 
SLEEVE
Make 2
With 5.5mm [US I-9] hook, Ch 47 (51, 54, 56, 61, 64)
Row 1 (RS): Switch to 5mm [US H-8] hook, extended sc in the 2nd ch from your hook (work in back ridge of foundation ch), extended sc in each ch across. Turn- 46 (50, 54, 56, 60, 64) sts.
Rows 2 - 4: Ch 1, extended sc in each st across. Turn.
Rows (5-18)(5-20)(5-20)(5-22)(5-24)(5-26): Ch 1, extended sc2tog over next 2 sts, extended sc in each st across. Turn- 32 (34, 36, 38, 40, 42) sts.
Row 19 (21, 21, 23, 25, 27): Ch 1, extended sc in each st across. Turn. Repeat previous row until sleeve measures 12” total.
Do not fasten off.
Ribbed Cuff
Note: Cuff is worked perpendicular to sleeve attached on odd numbered rows with sc2tog.
Row 1 (RS): With 4 mm [US G-6] hook, ch 32, sc in the 2nd ch from your hook, (working in the back ridge), sc in each ch across to last ch, sc2tog in the last ch and first st on sleeve edge- 31 sts.
Row 2: Slip st in next st on sleeve edge. Turn. Slip st in back loop of each st across.
Row 3: Ch 1. Turn. Sc in back loop of each slip st across to last, sc2tog in last slip st and next st on sleeve edge.
Repeat Rows 2 - 3 across the edge of the sleeve, ending with Row 3.
Do not fasten off. 
FINISHING
Pin back, front, and sleeves to schematic size, spray with water to block and allow to dry.
Ribbed Cuff Seaming
With the RS of the ribbed cuff facing you bring the first row up to meet the last row. Position your working yarn so that it's on the inside of the cuff. Slip stitch the rows together using the following method: insert your hook (from front to back) into the front loop of the first st of Row 1, insert your hook (from back to front) into the back loop of the first st of the last row, yo and pull thru all loops on your hook. Continue in this way across the ribbed cuff to complete the seam.
Fasten off.
Seaming
Tip: Use stitch markers to help line up your work and hold it in place while seaming. First, Seam Shoulders: Line up the last rows of the front and back panels and seam the shoulders of the front panel to the coordinating stitches of the back panel using the mattress stitch. Next, Attach Sleeves: Find center of the first row of a sleeve and line it up with the shoulder seam. Attach Row 1 of the sleeve to the sweater using the mattress stitch. Lastly, Seam Sleeves & Sides: Beginning nearest the ribbed cuff of a sleeve, seam the sleeve and side of sweater until you reach the top of the slip stitch edging of the front panel.
Cowl Neck
With 5 mm [US H-8] hook, join yarn with slip st on the WS of center back of neck, ch 1, work 96 (98,102, 106, 112, 118) sc around neck opening. Join with a slip st to first sc. Do not fasten off.
Note: Cowl is worked perpendicular to body attached on odd numbered rows with sc2tog.
Row 1 (RS): With 6 mm [US J-10] hook, ch 39, extended sc in 2nd ch from hook, (working in back ridge of ch), extended sc in each ch across to last ch, sc2tog in last ch and first sc on neck. -38 sts.
Note: The right side of the cowl neck will be worked on the wrong side of the sweater so that when it's folded down, the right side of the cowl neck is on the right side of the sweater. 
Row 2: Slip st in next sc on neck. Turn. Slip st in back loop of each st across. 
Row 3: Ch 1. Turn. Extended sc in back loop of each slip st to last, sc2tog in last slip st and next sc on neck.
Repeat Rows 2 – 3 around neck, end with Row 3.
Do not fasten off. 
Cowl Neck Seam
With the RS of the cowl neck facing you bring the first row up to meet the last row. Position your working yarn so that it's on the inside of the cowl. Slip stitch the rows together using the following method: insert your hook (from front to back) into the front loop of the first st of Row 1, insert your hook (from back to front) into the back loop of the first st of the last row, yo and pull thru all loops on your hook. Continue in this way across to complete the seam. Fasten off.
Weave in all ends.

Note: Ch 3 at beg of rows counts as dc.

With B as Color 1, make 7 (10-12-16) Motifs.
With C as Color 1, make 4 (8-12-16) Motifs.
With D as Color 1, make 6 (7-10-17) Motifs.
With E as Color 1, make 4 (7-8-13) Motifs.

Joining Motifs: With RS of matching color Motifs tog, join A with sl st to corner ch-2 sp. Working through both thicknesses, work 1 sc in same sp as sl st and each sc to next ch-2 sp. 1 sc in next ch-2 sp. Fasten off.

CHEST

Special Stitches
FPdc (Front Post double crochet): Yarn over, insert hook from front to back to front again around the post of designated st, yarn over and draw up a loop (3 loops on hook), yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook (2 loops on hook), yarn over, draw through 2 loops on hook.
sc2tog (single crochet 2 together): [Insert hook in next st, yarn over and draw up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through 3 loops on hook.
Pattern Stitch
Seed Stitch (multiple of 2 sts)
Row 1: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * across to last sc, sc in last sc, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * across to last sc, sc in last sc, turn.
Repeat Row 2 for pattern.
Notes
1. Sweater is made from 2 pieces, back and chest. Neckband is worked across top edge of both pieces to form sweater.
2. Different breeds and different dogs vary greatly in size. Place pieces on your dog as you go to check for appropriate length and placement of buttonholes.
GAUGE: With larger hook, 12 sts = 4” (10cm); 11 rows = 4” (10cm) in Seed st. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.

EDGING
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc evenly down long side edge, across lower edge, and up other long side edge, ensuring that you work an even number of sts, turn. Fasten off A.

Row 3 (right side): With right side facing, join A with sc in first st of previous row, sc in next ch-1 space, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * across, to last ch-1 space, ch 1, sc in last sc. Fasten off A.
Row 4 (right side): With right side facing, join B with sc in first st of previous row, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to last sc, sc in last sc. Fasten off.

Beginning at lower edge with larger hook and A, ch 15 (23, 31, 41).

Row 2 (increase row): Ch 1, 2 sc in first sc, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to last sc, ch 1, sc in last sc, turn—16 (24, 32, 42) sts.
Row 3 (increase row): Ch 1, sc in first sc, ch 1, sc in first ch-1 space, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * across to last 2 sc, ch 1, skip next sc, 2 sc in last sc, turn—18 (26, 34, 44) sts.
Rows 4-5: Repeat Rows 2-3—22 (30, 38, 48) sts.
Work even in Seed st pattern until piece measures 4 (7, 10, 13)” (10 [18, 25.5, 33] cm) from beginning.
Shape Sides at Top of Piece
Row 1: Ch 1, sc2tog over first 2 sc, sc in next ch-1 space, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * across to last ch-1 space, ch 1, skip next sc, sc2tog over last ch-1 space and last sc, turn—20 (28, 36, 46) sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, sc in next ch-1 space, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * across to last 2 sc, ch 1, skip next sc, sc in last sc, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc2tog  over first sc and first ch-1 space, *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * across to last 2 sc, sc2tog over last 2 sc, turn—18 (26, 34, 44) sts.
Row 4: Work even in Seed st pattern.

Edging
Row 1 (right side): Ch 1, sc evenly down long side edge, across lower edge, and up other long side edge, ensuring that you work an even number of sts, turn. Fasten off A.
Notes: Before beginning next row, notice that there are 4 “corners” near the lower edge. You will work increases in these corners. If desired, place a marker in each corner. There are less noticeable corners at the beginning of the top side shaping. Do not work increases in these top corners.
Row 2 (right side): With right side facing, and larger hook, join B with sc in first st of previous row, [*ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from * to next marked “corner”, ch 1, skip next sc, (sc, ch 1, sc) in corner sc] 4 times, **ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from ** to last sc, sc in last sc. Move markers up to ch-1 spaces. Fasten off B.
Row 3 (right side): With right side facing, and larger hook, join A with sc in first st of previous row, sc in next ch-1 space, [*ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to next marked corner ch-1 space, ch 1, skip next sc, (sc, ch 1, sc) in corner ch-1 space] 4 times, **ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next sc; repeat from ** across. Fasten off A. Remove markers.
Place chest piece on top of back piece to determine positions of buttonholes. Place 1 (2, 3, 3) markers in ch-1 spaces evenly spaced across the section of both sides of back piece that overlap with straight sides of chest. Work Row 4, working 3 sc (instead of just 1 sc) in each marked ch-1 space for buttonholes.
Row 4 (right side): With right side facing, and larger hook, join B with sc in first st of previous row, [*ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to next corner ch-1 space, ch 1, skip next sc, (sc, ch 1, sc) in corner ch-1 space] 4 times, **ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from ** to last sc, sc in last sc. Fasten off.

NECKBAND
With right side of chest facing and smaller hook, draw up a loop of A in top corner to work across top of chest piece.
Row 1 (right side): Ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next 4 ch; work 6 (14, 18, 24) sc evenly spaced across top of chest, work 16 (24, 32, 42) sc evenly spaced across top of back—26 (42, 54, 70) sts. Fasten off.
Rows 2-3: Work same as Rows 2-3 of Chest Edging.
Row 4 (right side): With right side facing, join B with sc in first st of previous row, ch 1, skip next sc, 3 sc in next ch-1 space (for button hole), *ch 1, skip next sc, sc in next ch-1 space; repeat from * to last sc, sc in last sc. Fasten off.

LEASH
With larger hook and B, ch 4.
Handle
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, turn—3 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, sc in each st across.
Notes: A stitch “2 rows below” is in the row numbered 2 less than the row you are currently working. For example, if you are working Row 3 a stitch 2 rows below is in Row 1. You will be working FPdc on both sides of handle, this makes the handle reversible and more sturdy.
Rows 3-4: Ch 1, sc in first sc, FPdc around next sc 2 rows below, sc in last sc, turn.
Row 5: Ch 1, sc in first sc, FPdc around FPdc 2 rows below, sc in last sc, turn.
Repeat Row 5 until piece measures 12” (30.5 cm) from beginning.
Joining Round: Ch 1, sc in first sc, FPdc around next FPdc 2 rounds below, sc in last sc, fold handling bringing foundation row up to meet current row; working across opposite side of foundation, sc in next st, FPdc around next post st, sc in next st; do not join, work in continuous rounds (spiral)—6 sts. Do not place a stitch marker, the beginning of round will move. Simply work the stitches as instructed.
Next Round: Sc in next st, FPdc around next st, sc2tog over next 2 sc, FPdc around next st, sc2tog over next 2 sts,
Continue Leash: FPdc around each st working around and around until Leash measures about 50” (127 cm) from beginning.
Tab
Work now progresses in rows.
Row 1: Sc in next 4 sts, turn.
Row 2: Ch 1, [sc2tog over next 2 sts] twice—2 sts.
Row 3-4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Thread tab through eye of swivel latch and sew last row to last round of leash.

FINISHING
Sew one button to end of neckband opposite buttonhole. Sew remaining buttons to chest piece opposite buttonholes on back piece. Weave in ends.

instructions:
Neck Ribbing: Ch 4 loosely.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn.

Body: 1st row: (RS). Ch 1. Work 18 ( 26-38-44) sc across long edge of neck ribbing. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc (inc made). 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc (inc made). Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep 2nd and 3rd rows 1 ( 3-5-8) time(s) more. 22 (34-50-62) sc.
Shape Leg Opening: First Side: Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 ( 4-6-8) sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 01 (3-5-5) time(s) more. Fasten off.
Center Section: Next row: With RS facing, skip next 2 ( 4-6-7) sc, join yarn with sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 11 ( 17-25-31) sc. 12 ( 18-26-32) sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 1 ( 3-5-5) time(s) more. Fasten off.
Second Side: Next row: With RS facing skip next 2 ( 4-6-7) unworked sc, join yarn with sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 (3-5-7) dc. Turn. 3 (4-6-8) sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row 1 ( 3-5-5) time(s) more.
Joining row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across Second Side. Ch 2 (4-6-7) loosely. 1 sc in each sc across Center Section. Ch 2 (4-6-7) loosely. 1 sc in each sc across First Side. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 ( 4-6-8) sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 (4-6-7) ch. 1 sc in each of next 12 ( 18-26-32) sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 (4-6-7) ch. 1 sc in each of next 3 (4-6-8) sc. Turn. 22 (34-50-62) sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from Joining Row measures approx 4½ ( 7-10½-11½)" [ 11.5 ( 18-26.5-29) cm], ending with a WS row.
Shape Belly: Next row: (RS). Sl st in each of first 4 (5-7-10) sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in each of next 14 (24-36-42) sc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 14 (24-36-42) sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each sc to last 3 sc. Sc2tog. 1 sc in last sc. Turn.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last 2 rows 1 ( 3-4-5) time(s) more. 10 (16-26-30) sts.
Cont even until work from 1st row after Neck Ribbing measures 10½ (16-22-25)" [26.5 (40.5-56-63.5) cm]. Fasten off. Sew seam from Neck Ribbing to Belly shaping.
Back Edging: With RS facing, join yarn with sl st at seam. Ch 1. Work 1 rnd sc evenly around Belly shaping and back edge, working 3 sc in corners. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Leg Edging: With RS facing, join yarn with sl st in any st of Leg Opening. Ch 1. Work 1 rnd sc evenly around Leg Opening. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.
Leg Bands: Ch 4 loosely.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each st to end of row. Turn. Rep last row until work from beg measures 5 ( 6-8-9½)" [12.5 ( 15-20.5-24) cm]. Fasten off.
Sew Leg Band seam.
Sew Leg Band to Leg Edging.

Working in front loop only of next st, 3 tr in next sc. (1 dc. 1 hdc. 1 sc. 1 sl st) all in next sc. Fasten off A.
Heart Section is now complete. With RS facing, join Color 1 with sl st to any unworked back loop from 2nd rnd of Heart. 

Proceed to work Granny Square Section as follows: 1st rnd: Ch 2. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in same st as sl st. [Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next unworked back loop] 3 times. Ch 1. Join with sl st to first dc.

3rd rnd: Join Color 2 with sl st to any corner ch-2 sp. Ch 2. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in corner ch-2 sp. [(Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next corner ch-2 sp] 3 times. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. Join with sl st to first dc. Fasten off Color 2.

4th rnd: Join Color 1 with sl st to any corner ch-2 sp. Ch 2. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in corner ch-2 sp. [(Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) 3 times. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 2. 3 dc) in next corner ch-2 sp] 3 times. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) 3 times. Ch 1. Join with sl st to first dc. Fasten off.

With WS facing, sew shoulder seams, leaving 12" [30.5 cm] open at neck. PM at sides of Fronts and Back for Sleeves 9 (12)" [23 (30.5) cm] down from shoulders. Sew in Sleeves between markers.

With D, ch 11.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 10 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Cuff Ribbing measures length to fit around Sleeve, when slightly stretched, sewing in place as you work. Fasten off.

BOTTOM RIBBING 
With A, ch 15.

2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Bottom Ribbing measures length to fit around Pullover, when slightly stretched, beg at left side seam, sewing in place as you work. Fasten off leaving a long end to sew seam. Sew last row and 1st row of ribbing tog.

NECK RIBBING 
With B, ch 11.
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of ch. Turn. 10 sc. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Neck Ribbing measures length to fit around Neck opening, when slightly stretched, sewing in place as you work and beg at left shoulder seam. Fasten off leaving a long end to sew seam. Sew last row and 1st row of ribbing tog.

1st row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 hdcbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
2nd row: (WS) Ch 1. 1 hdcfl in each st to end of row. Join B. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 1. Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 1. 1 scfl in each st to end of row. Join A. Turn.
Rep these 4 rows for pat 8 times more, ending final rep on a 2nd row. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Sew shoulder seams, leaving a 10” [25.5 cm] section at center of top open for neckband. Place a st marker 5 (6-7-7½-8-9)” [12.5 (15-18-19-20.5-23) cm] down from shoulder seam on front and back of sweater. Sew sleeves in between stitch markers. Sew side and sleeve seams.
Neckband
Join A with sl st at center back.
1st rnd: Ch 1. Work 40 sc evenly around neckline. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: Ch 2. 1 dc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first dc.
3rd rnd: Ch 2. 1 dcfp around each st around. Join with sl st to first dcfp.
4th rnd: As 3rd rnd. Fasten off.
Hearts (make 2).
With C, ch 3. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. (3 tr. 3 dc. 1 1 tr. 3 dc. 3 tr) in ring. Ch 3. Sl st in ring. Fasten off.
Sew 1 Heart to each elbow.

gauge: 14 dc = 4”; 11 rows = 6” using larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BACK
With larger hook and B, ch 48 (51, 55, 58). 
Row 1 (Right Side): Dc in 4th ch from hook and in each ch across – 46 (49, 53, 56) dc.

Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 5 1/2 (5 1/2, 6 1/2, 6 1/2)” from beginning, end on wrong side row.
Shape Armhole
Next Row (Right Side): Ch 1, turn, slip st in first 5 sts, ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in each st to last 4 sts, leave last 4 sts unworked – 38 (41, 45, 48) sts. 
Work in dc until Armhole measures 5 1/2 (5 1/2, 6 1/2, 6 1/2)”. Fasten off.
Rib 
With right side facing and smaller hook, join A at lower edge, ch 3 (counts as dc), work 45 (47, 51, 55) dc evenly across opposite edge of beginning ch – 46 (48, 52, 56) sts. 
Ribbing Row: Ch 2 (counts as st), [Fpdc, Bpdc] across to last st, hdc in top of turning ch. 
Repeat Ribbing Row until Rib measures 1 1/2 (2, 1 1/2, 2)”. Fasten off.
LEFT FRONT
With larger hook and B, ch 25 (26, 28, 30). 
Row 1 (Right Side): Dc in 4th ch from hook and in each ch across – 23 (24, 26, 29) dc. 
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), turn, dc in each dc, dc in top of turning ch.  
Repeat Row 2 until piece measures 5 1/2 (5 1/2, 6 1/2, 6 1/2)” from beginning, end on wrong side row.
Shape Armhole
Next Row (Right Side): Ch 1, turn, slip st in first 5 sts, ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in each st across – 19 (20, 22, 25) sts. 
Work in dc until Armhole measures 4 (4, 5, 5)”, end with a right side row. 
Shape Neck
Next Row (Wrong Side): Ch 3, dc to last 7 (7, 7, 9) sts, leave remaining sts unworked for Neck – 12 (13, 15, 16) sts. 
Dec 1 st at Neck edge every row twice – 10 (11, 13, 14) sts. 
Work until piece measures same length as Back to Shoulders. Fasten off.
Buttonhole Row: Ch 1, turn, [sc to where marked for Button, ch 2, skip 2 sc] 6 times, sc to end. 
Next Row: Ch 1, [sc to ch-2 space, work 2 sc in ch-2 space] 6 times, sc to end. Fasten off. 
Sew on buttons. Weave in ends.

Button Band

materials: RED HEART® “Soft Yarn”: 3 (3, 3, 4, 4, 4) Balls 9770 Rose Blush A; 2 (2, 2, 3, 3, 3) Balls 9779 Berry B.

abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C

* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated.
gauge: 12 dc = 4”; 8 rows = 4” using 5mm [US H-8] hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
Right Sleeve
With 5mm [US H-8] hook and A, ch 50 (52, 54, 58, 60, 64), slip st in first ch to join. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in each ch around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 50 (52, 54, 58, 60, 64) dc.
Round 2: Ch 3, dc in each dc around, slip st in top of beginning ch.
Upper Right Back
Row 1: Ch 3, dc in next 26 (27, 28, 30, 31, 34) dc, leave remaining sts unworked for Upper Right Front – 27 (28, 29, 32, 33, 35) dc.
Row 2-3: Ch 3, turn, dc in each dc across.
Row 4: With B, ch 2 (counts as hdc here and throughout), turn, hdc in each dc across. 
Row 5: Ch 2, turn, hdc in each hdc across.
Row 6: With A, ch 3, turn, dc in each hdc across.
Row 7: Ch 3, turn, dc in each dc across.
Repeat Rows 4-7 until Back has been worked for 23 (25, 27, 29, 31, 35) rows, end with second row of stripe color. Upper Back measures 10 (11, 12, 13, 14, 15)”. Fasten off.
Left Sleeve
With 5mm [US H-8] hook and B, ch 50 (52, 54, 58, 60, 64), slip st in first ch to join. Place marker for beginning of round.
Round 1: Ch 3, dc in each ch around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 50 (52, 54, 58, 60, 64) dc.
Upper Left Back
Row 1: Ch 3, dc in next 26 (27, 28, 30, 31, 34) dc, leave remaining sts unworked for Upper Left Front – 27 (28, 29, 32, 33, 35) dc.
Row 2-3: Ch 3, turn, dc in each dc across.
Row 4: With A, ch 2, turn, hdc in each dc across. 
Row 5: Ch 2, turn, hdc in each hdc across.
Row 6: With B, ch 3, turn, dc in each hdc across.
Row 7: Ch 3, turn, dc in each dc across.
Repeat Rows 4-7 until Back has been worked for 23 (25, 27, 29, 31, 35) rows, end with second row of stripe color. Upper Back measures 10 (11, 12, 13, 14, 15)”. Fasten off.
Center Back Joining Row: With wrong sides facing, 5mm [US H-8] hook and working through both layers of Upper Backs, join A in first st and sc in each st across to join Upper Backs together along center back seam. Fasten off. 
Lower Back
Row 1: With right side facing, 5mm [US H-8] hook and working along lower edge of Upper Backs, join B in first st of Back, ch 3, dc 61 (65, 71, 77, 83, 89) sts evenly spaced across to first row of opposite Upper Back – 62 (66, 72, 78, 84, 90) dc. 
Rows 2-11: Ch 3, turn, dc in each dc across.  
Fasten off.
Upper Left Front 
Row 1: With right side facing and 5mm [US H-8] hook, join A in first unworked st on Sleeve, ch 3, dc in next 22 (23, 24, 26, 27, 28) sts along front edge of Sleeve, working along edge of rows of Lower Back, dc 17 sts evenly spaced along rows – 40 (41, 42, 44, 45, 46) sts. 
Rows 2-4: Ch 3, turn, dc in each dc across.
Rows 5-6: Change to B, ch 2, turn, hdc in each st across.
Rows 7-10: Change to A, ch 3, turn, dc in each dc across.
Repeat Rows 5-10 until Upper Left Front measures 7 (8, 9, 10, 11, 12)”. Fasten off. 
Upper Right Front 
Row 1: With right side facing and 5mm [US H-8] hook, join B in first unworked st on Sleeve, ch 3, dc in next 22 (23, 24, 26, 27, 28) sts along front edge of Sleeve, working along edge of rows of Lower Back, dc 17 sts evenly spaced along rows – 40 (41, 42, 44, 45, 46) sts. 
Rows 2-4: Ch 3, turn, dc in each dc across.
Rows 5-6: Change to A, ch 2, turn, hdc in each st across.
Rows 7-10: Change to B, ch 3, turn, dc in each dc across.
Repeat Rows 5-10 until Upper Right Front measures 7 (8, 9, 10, 11, 12)”. Fasten off. 
Shoulders
Mark center 6” along top edge of Upper Back for Neck. 
Joining Row: With wrong sides facing, 5mm [US H-8] hook and working through both layers of Upper Back and Upper Front, join A in first st and slip st across Shoulders to Neck marker to join Upper Back and Front Shoulders. Fasten off. 
Repeat for second Shoulder.
Waistband
Row 1: With right side facing and 5mm [US H-8] hook, join B lower edge of Left Front, ch 2, work 26 (27, 28, 30, 33, 40) hdc evenly along Upper Left Front, 62 (66, 72, 78, 84, 90) hdc along lower edge of Back, 26 (27, 28, 30, 33, 40) hdc evenly along lower edge of Upper Right Front – 114 (120, 128, 138, 150, 166) hdc.
Rows 2-4: Ch 2, turn, hdc in each hdc. Fasten off.
Fringe Peplum
With right side facing, 6.5mm [US K-10½] hook and holding 2 strands of A together, join yarn at lower edge of Left Front, ch 70, slip st in next 2 hdc; repeat from * across, ch 70, slip st in last st. Fasten off.
FINISHING
Edging
With right side facing and 5mm [US H-8] hook, join A at lower edge of Right Front above Fringe Peplum, ch 2, hdc in each st around neck edge to lower edge of Left Front, slip st in last st. Weave in ends.
Right Frog Closure
With 3.75mm [US F-5] hook and A, ch 8, slip st in first ch to join, ch 11, slip st in same ch, ch 8, slip st in same ch, ch 7, slip st in same ch. Fasten off.
Left Frog Closure
With 3.75mm [US F-5] hook and A, ch 8, slip st in first ch to join, ch 11, slip st in same ch, ch 8, ch 5, hdc in 2nd ch from hook, work 5 more hdc in same ch, slip st in same 6 hdc, skip first hdc, slip st in next st. Fasten off.
Sew Right Frog Closure in Waistband of Right Front.
Sew Left Frog Closure in Waistband of Left Front, opposite Right Frog Closure. Weave in ends.

gauge: 18 sts and 16 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Tunisian Knit Stitch (Tks). Motif = Approx 4" [10 cm] square.
instructions:
The instructions are written for smallest size. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written thus ( ). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes.

Notes:
• For Tunisian crochet, work all rows with RS of work facing.
• Each row consists of 2 sections - Forward pass (right to left) and Return pass (left to right).
• To change color, work to last 2 loops on hook and draw new color through last 2 loops, then proceed in new color.
• Back and Sleeves worked in one piece. Front and Sleeve worked in one piece.
• Motifs are made separately and attached during Finishing across bottom, along front and around sleeve edges.
• Use standard crochet hook for Motif Edging.

BACK
With A and Tunisian hook, ch 90 ( 108-126-144).
Note: Work into horizontal bumps at back of foundation chain for 1st row. 
1st row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each rem ch to end of chain, leaving all loops on hook. 90 ( 108-126-144) sts on hook. Do not turn.
Return pass: ( Left to right after working Forward pass of each row). Yoh and draw through last loop only (for edge st). *Yoh and draw through 2 loops. Rep from * until 1 loop rem on hook, joining B at end of row. Do not turn.

2nd row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With B, *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row.
Return pass. Join A.
3rd row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With A, *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Return pass. Join C.
Rep last row, changing colors in following sequence for Stripe Pat: C, A, B, A until work from beg measures 11 ( 11-13-11)" [28 ( 28-33-28) cm].
Shape sleeves: With A, ch 45. Fasten off. With RS facing, join chain to left side of work for Left Sleeve.
Return to original Body sts and keeping cont of Stripe Pat, proceed as follows:
1st row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With corresponding color, ch 45 (Right Sleeve). Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each of rem 43 ch. *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Draw up a loop in each of next 45 ch (Left Sleeve). 180 ( 198-216-234) sts on hook. Return pass.
2nd row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Return pass. 
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row until Sleeves measure 8 ( 8-10-10)" [ 20.5 ( 20.5-25.5-25.5) cm]. 
Fasten off.

LEFT FRONT
**With A and Tunisian hook, ch 27 ( 36-45-54).
1st row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each rem ch to end of chain, leaving all loops on hook. 27 ( 36-45-54) sts on hook. Return pass. Join B.
2nd row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With B, *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Return pass. Join A.
3rd row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With A, *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Return pass. Join C.
Rep last row, changing colors in following sequence for Stripe Pat as given for Back until work from beg measures 11" [28 cm].**
Shape sleeve:
1st row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With corresponding color, ch 45. Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each of rem 43 ch. *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. 72 ( 81-90-99) sts on hook. Return pass.
2nd row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Return pass. 
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row until work from beg measure 3" [7.5 cm] shorter than Back to shoulder.
Shape neck: 1st row: With corresponding color, *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to last 0 ( 0-3-3) sts. 72 ( 81-87-96) sts on hook. Leave rem sts unworked. Return pass.
2nd row: Forward pass: (Right to left). With corresponding color, *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Return pass.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row until work from beg measures same length as Back to shoulder. 
Fasten off.

RIGHT FRONT
Work from ** to ** as given for Left Front.
Shape sleeve: With A, ch 45. Fasten off. With RS facing, join chain to left side of work for Right Sleeve.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, proceed as follows:
1st row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With corresponding color, *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Draw up a loop in each of next 45 ch. 72 ( 81-90-99) sts on hook. Return pass.
2nd row: Forward pass:( Right to left). *1 Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Return pass.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row until work from beg measure 3" [7.5 cm] shorter than Back to shoulder.
Shape neck: 1st row: With corresponding color, ch 1. Sl st in each of next 0 ( 0-3-3) sts. *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. 72 ( 81-87-96) sts on hook. Return pass.
2nd row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With corresponding color, *1Tks in next st. Rep from * to end of row. Return pass.
Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row until work from beg measures same length as Back to shoulder. 
Fasten off.

MOTIF [make 26 ( 28-34-38)]
With D and Tunisian hook, ch 7.
1st row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). Draw up a loop in 2nd ch from hook. Draw up a loop in each rem ch to end of chain, leaving all loops on hook. 7 sts on hook. Do not turn.
Return pass for all rows: ( Left to right after working Forward pass of each row). *Yoh and draw through 2 loops. Rep from * until 1 loop rem on hook, joining C at end of row. Do not turn.
2nd row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With C, (1Tss in next st) 5 times. Leave rem st unworked. Return pass. Join D.
3rd row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With D, (1Tss in next st) 4 times. Leave rem st unworked. Return pass. Join C.
4th row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With C, (1Tss in next st) 3 times. Leave rem st unworked. Return pass. Join D.
5th row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With D, (1Tss in next st) twice. Leave rem st unworked. Return pass. Join C.
6th row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With C, 1Tss in next st. Leave rem st unworked. Return pass. Join D.
7th row: Forward pass: ( Right to left). With D, (1Tss in next st) 6 times, working across all sts. Return pass. Join C.
Rep 2nd to 7th rows 5 times more, omitting 7th row on last rep. Fasten off. Sew Foundation ch and last row tog. 
With standard crochet hook, proceed as follows:
Edging: 1st rnd: (RS). Join A with sl st to any st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. Work 40 sc evenly around. Join with sl st to first sc.
2nd rnd: *Sl st in each of next 5 sc. 1 sc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 3 dc in next sc. 1 hdc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. Rep from * 3 times more. Join with sl st to first sl st. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Pin all pieces to measurements. Cover with a damp cloth leaving cloth to dry. Sew shoulders. Sew side and sleeve seams. Following diagrams, sew Motifs across bottom edge, up sides of fronts and around sleeves.
Bottom of Body - 10 ( 12-14-16) Motifs.
Front Edges - 8 ( 8-10-10) Motifs.
Sleeves - 8 ( 8-10-12) Motifs.

materials: RED HEART® “Sport”: 4 (4 1/2, 5) Ounces No. 846 Skipper Blue CA
abbreviations: CA, CB, CC, CD = colors A, B, C, D
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated
[] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
gauge: 16 sts = 4”; 16 rows = 4” with larger hook in Pat A. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions: BACK: With smaller hook and CB, ch 8. RIBBING-Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each across; turn – 7 sc. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each sc across; turn. Rep Row 2 until 52 (56, 60) rows have been worked, changing to CD and larger hook in last sc. BORDER-Row 1 (Right Side): With CD, ch 1, work 53 (57, 61) sc evenly across row ends of ribbing; turn – 53 (57, 61) sc. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, * tr in next st or sp, sc in next st or sp; rep from * across changing to CA in last sc; turn. PAT A-Row 1: With CA, ch 1, sc in first sc, * ch 1, skip next st, sc in next sc; rep from * across; turn. Row 2: Ch 1, sc in first sc, * ch 1, skip ch-1 sp, sc in next sc; rep from * across; turn. Rep Row 2 for Pat A 10 (12, 14) more times, end wrong side row, changing to CD in last st of last row; turn. PAT B-Row 1: With CD, rep Pat A Row 2. Row 2: Rep Border Row 2 changing to CC in last sc. Row 3: With CC, sc in first sc, * ch 1, skip next st or sp, sc in next st or sp; rep from * across; turn. Row 4: Ch 1, sc in first sc and in next ch-1 sp, * ch 1, skip next sc, sc in ch-1 sp; rep from * across to last sc; sc in last sc changing to CB; turn. Row 5: With CB rep Row 3 changing to CA; turn. Row 6: With CA, rep Row 4 changing to CC; turn. Rows 7 and 8: Rep Rows 3 and 4 changing to CD; turn. Row 9: With CD, rep Row 3. Row 10: Rep Border Row 2 changing to CB; turn. With CB rep Pat A Row 2 until 4 (4, 6) rows have been worked. Rep Pat B Rows 1-10 once more changing to CA. Work even in Pat A with CA until 12 1/2 (13 1/2, 14 1/2)” from beg, end wrong side row. Divide for Neck and Shoulders: Row 1: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [ch 1, skip sp, sc in next sc] 7 (8, 9) times, skip sp, hdc in next sc; turn. Row 2: Ch 1, skip hdc, work in pat to end; turn. Row 3: Ch 1, sc in first sc, [ch 1, skip sp, sc in next sc] 6 (7, 8) times, skip sp, hdc in next sc; turn. Row 4: Rep Row 2. Fasten off. With right side facing, skip center 19 sts, attach yarn in next sc; ch 2, skip ch-1 sp, sc in next sc, work in pat to end; turn. Complete to correspond to first side. FRONT: Work same as back until 11 (12, 13)” from beg. Work same as back for neck and shoulder shaping until same length to shoulders. Fasten off. SLEEVES-Ribbing: With smaller hook, work ribbing same as back for 30 (32, 34) rows, changing to CD and larger hook in last sc. Work 31 (33, 35) sc evenly across row ends of ribbing; turn. Rep Row 2 of Border changing to CA. Work in Pat A, shaping sides by increasing 1 st each end of 3rd row, then every 3rd (4th, 5th) row until there are 45 (47, 49) sts, working added sts into pat. Work even until 9 (11, 12)” from beg. Fasten off. FINISHING-Neckband: Sew shoulder seams. With right side facing and larger hook, attach CA at center back neck. Rnd 1: With CA, ch 1, work 74 sc evenly around; join with a sl st in first sc changing to CD. Rnd 2: With CD, ch 1, * sc in sc, ch 1, skip next sc; rep from * around; join changing to CB. Rnd 3: With CB, ch 1, * sc in sc, ch 1, skip ch-1 sp; rep from * around; join; TURN. Rnd 4: Rep Rnd 3 working on wrong side; join; TURN. Rnd 5: Rep Rnd 3. Fasten off. Mark back and front 5 1/2 (5 3/4, 6)” down from shoulder seams. Place center of sleeve tops at shoulder seams and sew in place between markers. Sew side and sleeve seams. Weave in ends.

instructions:

Granny Square Motifs
Make 12 (13-18) with B.
See diagram on page 7.
Notes:
• Motifs begin with Color 1 (shortest color rep) from center of pull-skein, leaving a 4" [10 cm] tail to weave in.
• Each color aligns with 1 rnd in the Motif with 5 colors in total. If too much color is left at end of rnd, pull back some sts and slightly loosen gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change. If too little color is left, pull back some sts and slightly tighten gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change.
• When Motif is complete, cut yarn where Color 5 (longest color rep) ends, leaving a tail for weaving in. Begin next Motif with Color 1 and repeat 5 rnds for each Motif.
• Ch 6 at beg of rnds counts as dc and ch-3 sp.
• Join all rnds with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-6 unless otherwise indicated.

With B and larger hook, beg with Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
4th and 5th rnds: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
Fasten off.

Flower Power Motifs
Make 12 (14-16) with A.
See diagram on page 7.
Notes:
• Motifs begin with Color 1 (shortest color rep) from center of pull-skein, leaving a 4" [10 cm] tail to weave in.
• 2nd and 3rd rnds will be worked in Color 2.
• 4th, 5th, and 6th rnds will be worked in Color 3.
• If too much color is left at end of rnd, pull back some sts and slightly loosen gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change. If too little color is left, pull back some sts and slightly tighten gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change.
• Leave long tail of Color 3 (at least 24" [61 cm] long) at end of Motif to use for joining Motifs during finishing.
• Adjust gauge as needed working 4th, 5th and 6th rounds of Flower Motif to maintain 6" [15 cm] square finished size to match finished size of Granny Square Motifs.
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
• Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st unless otherwise stated.

With A and larger hook, beg with Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. 9 dc in ring. Join. 10 dc. Color 1 complete.
2nd rnd: Color 2 begins. Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as last sl st. 2 dc in each dc around. Join. 20 dc.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next dc. (Ch 3. 1 tr) in same st as last sl st. 3 tr in next dc. (1 tr. 1 dc) in next dc. Sl st in next dc. *(1 dc. 1 tr) in next dc. 3 tr in next dc. (1 tr. 1 dc) in next dc. Sl st in next dc. Rep from * around, ending by joining with sl st to top of ch-3 of previous (2nd) rnd. Color 2 complete.
4th rnd: Color 3 begins. Sl st in first dc (top of ch-3 of 3rd rnd), to beg rnd at start of first Petal. Ch 3. *1 dc in next tr. 1 hdc in next tr. 1 sc in next tr. 1 hdc in next tr. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. 1 tr in dc of 2nd rnd below sl st.** 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * 3 times more, then from * to ** once. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 6 (counts as tr and ch-2). 1 tr in same sp as sl st. *2 dc in next st. Ch 1. 1 dc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Ch 1. Skip next st. 1 sc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. 1 dc in next st. Ch 1. 2 dc in next st.** (1 tr. Ch 2. 1 tr) all in next st. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join to 4th ch of ch-6.
6th rnd: Sl st in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in same ch-2 sp. Ch 3. 3 hdc in same ch-2 sp. Ch 1. *(3 hdc. Ch 1) in each ch-1 sp to next corner ch-2 sp.** (3 hdc. Ch 3. 3 hdc) all in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 hdc in first ch-2 sp. Join.
Fasten off at end of Color 3, leaving approx 24" [61 cm] tail. Motif should measure 6" [15 cm] square.

Solid Motifs
Garment Assembly Begins, Side Panels for size XS/S/M only
MC Solid Motif
Make 3 (4-7) Motifs with MC.
See diagram on page 7.

Note: Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
With MC and larger hook, ch 6. Join with sl st to form a ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3 (counts as dc). 3 dc in ring. Ch 3. (4 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. Ch 1. Join with hdc to top of first dc. 4 groups 4-dc.
2nd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc around post of joining hdc. (1 dc in each of next 4 dc. 2 dc in next ch-3 sp. 1 dtr in ring, working between groups of dc. 2 dc in same ch-3 sp as last 2 dc) 3 times. 1 dc in each of next 4 dc. 2 dc in next ch-3 sp. 1 dtr in ring, working between groups of dc. Join with sl st to top of first dc. 8 dc between corner dtr on each side.
3rd rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in same sp as sl st. (1 dc in each of next 6 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Ch 3 for corner. Skip next dtr. 2 dc in next dc) 3 times. 1 dc in each of next 6 dc. 2 dc in next dc. Skip next dtr. Ch 1. Join with hdc to top of first dc. 10 dc between corner ch-3 sps at each side.

4th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc around post of joining hdc. (1 dc in each of next 10 dc. 2 dc in next ch-3 sp. 1 dtr in next dtr 2 rnds below. 2 dc in same ch-3 sp as last 2 dc) 3 times. 1 dc in each of next 10 dc. 2 dc in next ch-3 sp. 1 dtr in next dtr 2 rnds below. Join with sl st to top of first d. 14 dc between corner dtr on each side.
5th rnd: Ch 3. 1 dc in each of next 14 sts. Ch 3. (1 dc in each of next 15 sts. Ch 3) 3 times. Join with sl st to top of first dc. Fasten off, leaving long tail for joining. Motif should measure 6" [15 cm] square.

Garment Assembly
Following Diagrams (see page 4), sew Motifs tog through both loops into Body using Whipstitch.
WHIPSTITCH
Size XS/S/M only:
Side Panels
Right Back Side Panel: With RS facing and larger hook, join MC with sl st to bottom corner ch-3 sp. Ch 2 (does not count as st). 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. Work 16 hdc evenly across first Motif, having last hdc in corner ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in joining seam. Work 18 hdc evenly across next Motif, working last hdc in corner ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in next joining seam. Turn. 38 hdc.
Next row: Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Side Panel measures 1" [2.5 cm], ending on a RS row. Fasten off.

Left Front Side Panel: Work as for Right Back Side Panel.

Left Back Side Panel: With RS facing and larger hook, join MC with sl st to joining seam of second Motif. Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in corner ch-3 sp. Work 16 hdc evenly across Motif, having last hdc in corner ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in joining seam. Work 19 hdc evenly across next motif, working last 2 hdc in corner ch-3 sp. Turn. 38 hdc.
Next row: Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Side Panel measures 1" [2.5 cm], ending on a RS row. Fasten off.

Right Front Side Panel: Work as for Left Back Side Panel.

All Sizes:
Back Neck Panel: With RS facing, and larger hook, join MC with sl st to right corner of Motif at back neck opening. Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in corner ch-3 sp. Work 16 hdc evenly across Motif, having last hdc in corner ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in joining seam (refer to Assembly Diagram). Turn. 19 hdc.
Next row: Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Back Neck Panel measures 3" [7.5 cm], ending on a RS row. Fasten off.

Sleeve Assembly
Following Diagram (see page 4), sew Motifs tog into Right and Left Sleeves using Whipstitch (Note: Sleeves have different motifs.)

Note: Sleeve Side Sections are worked sideways – 2 Sections for each Sleeve.
Sleeve First Section: With RS facing and larger hook, join MC with sl st to bottom corner ch-3 sp. Ch 2 (does not count as st). 2 hdc in same sp as sl st. Work 16 hdc evenly across first Motif, having last hdc in corner ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in joining seam. Work 18 hdc evenly across next Motif, working last hdc in corner ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in next joining seam. Turn. 38 hdc.
Next row: Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Sleeve First Section measures 2½" [6 cm], ending on a WS row.
Shape side: 1st row: (RS). Sl st in each of first 4 hdc. Ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 4 hdc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
3rd row: Sl st in each of first 5 hdc. Ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 5 hdc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
Rep last 2 rows once more, then 3rd row once. Fasten off.

Sleeve Second Section: With RS facing and larger hook, join MC with sl st to joining seam of second Motif. Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. 1 hdc in corner ch-3 sp. Work 16 hdc evenly across Motif, having last hdc in corner ch-3 sp. 1 hdc in joining seam. Work 19 hdc evenly across next Motif, working last 2 hdc in corner ch-3 sp. Turn. 38 hdc.
Next row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Sleeve Second Section measures 2½" [6 cm], ending on a RS row.
Shape side: 1st row: (WS). Sl st in each of first 4 hdc. Ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 4 hdc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
3rd row: Sl st in each of first 5 hdc. Ch 1. 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each hdc to last 5 hdc. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
Rep last 2 rows once more, then 3rd row once. Fasten off.

Rep for Sleeve Side Sections on second Sleeve. Sew side edges of Sleeve Side Sections to Motifs.

FINISHING
Pin all pieces to measurements. Cover with a damp cloth leaving cloth to dry. Sew in Sleeves.

Sleeve Cuff: With smaller hook and MC, ch 6.
1st row: (RS). 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 5 sl sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sl st in back loop of each st to end of row. Turn. Rep last row until Cuff, when slightly stretched, measures length to fit bottom edge of Sleeve. Fasten off, leaving a long end to join to Sleeve.
Sew Sleeve Cuff to bottom edge of Sleeve. Sew side and sleeve seams.

Body Edging: With smaller hook and MC, ch 12.
1st row: (RS). 1 sl st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch to end of chain. Turn. 11 sl sts.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sl st in back loop of each st to end of row. Turn. Rep last row until Edging, when slightly stretched, measures length to fit lower edge of Body. Fasten off, leaving a long end to join to Body.
Sew Body Edging to bottom edge of Body.

materials: Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4 mm [US G-6]

instructions:
RIBBING (Foundation can be any number of ch sts, minimum 4)
Row 1 (wrong side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end, turn. 
Rows 2-6: Ch 1, sc in back loop of each st to end, turn.
Row 7: Ch 3, dc in back loop of each sc to end, turn.
Repeat Rows 2-7 for Ribbing.

BODY
Make 45 (66, 91) Motifs, joining them into a rectangle of 5 (6, 7) by 9 (11, 13) as you go, as follows:
First Motif
Ch 10, and slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), 23 dc in ring, join with slip st to 3rd of beginning ch-3 – 24 dc.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same st as joining slip st and in each of next 2 dc, (sc, ch 7, sc) in next dc, * sc in each of next 5 sc, (sc, ch 7, sc) in next dc; repeat from * twice more, sc in each of last 2 dc, join with slip st in first sc.
Round 3: Ch 1, (sc, ch 7, sc) in first sc, * skip 3 sc, (7 dc, picot, 6 dc) in next ch-7 space, skip 3 sc, (sc, ch 7, sc) in next sc; repeat from * twice more, skip 3 sc, (7 dc, picot, 6 dc) in next ch-7 space, skip 3 sc, join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

All Remaining Motifs
Ch 10, and slip st in first ch to form a ring.
Rounds 1 and 2: Work same as first Motif.
Round 3: Ch 1, (sc, ch 7, sc) in first sc, skip 3 sc, 7 dc in next ch-7 sp, ch 1, slip st in corresponding picot on adjoining Motif, ch 1, slip st in last dc made on current Motif, 6 more dc in same ch-7 space as last 7 dc made, * skip 3 sc, sc in next sc, ch 3, sc in corresponding ch-7 space on adjoining motif, ch 3, sc again in same sc as last sc made, skip 3 sc, 7 dc in next ch-7 sp, ch 1, slip st in corresponding picot on adjoining Motif, ch 1, slip st in last dc made on current Motif, 6 more dc in same ch-7 space as last 7 dc made; repeat from * for each edge to be joined, then complete Round 3 same as first Motif.
Fasten off.

Edging
With right side facing, join yarn with slip st in first (or rightmost) picot of any Motif along edge.
Round 1: Ch 1, * sc in picot and in each of next 4 dc, hdc in next dc, dc in next dc, ch 1, sc in next ch-7 space, ch 1, dc in next dc, hdc in next dc, sc in each of next 4 dc and in next picot; repeat from * across each Motif edge, join with slip st in first sc.
Fasten off.

3rd rnd: Sl st in next dc. (Ch 3. 1 tr) in same st as last sl st. 3 tr in next dc. (1 tr. 1 dc) in next dc. Sl st in next dc. *(1 dc. 1 tr) in next dc. 3 tr in next dc. (1 tr. 1 dc) in next dc. Sl st in next dc. Rep from * around, ending by joining with sl st to first sl st. Color 2 complete.
4th rnd: With Color 3, sl st in first dc (top of ch-3 of 3rd rnd), to beg rnd at start of first Petal. Ch 3. *1 dc in next tr. 1 hdc in next tr. 1 sc in next tr. 1 hdc in next tr. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. 1 tr in dc of 2nd rnd below sl st.** 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * 3 times more, then from * to ** once. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 6 (counts as tr and ch-2). 1 tr in same sp as sl st. *2 dc in next st. Ch 1. 1 dc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Ch 1. Skip next st. 1 sc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. 1 dc in next st. Ch 1. 2 dc in next st.** (1 tr. Ch 2. 1 tr) all in next st. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join to 4th ch of ch-6.
6th rnd: Sl st in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in same ch-2 sp. Ch 3. 3 hdc in same ch-2 sp. Ch 1. *(3 hdc. Ch 1) in each ch-1 sp to next corner ch-2 sp.** (3 hdc. Ch 3. 3 hdc) all in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 hdc in first ch-2 sp. Join.
Fasten off at end of Color 3, leaving long tail for seaming.
Motif should measure 6" [15 cm] square.

SLEEVES
Block all Motifs to measure 6" [15 cm] square.
Join Motifs as shown in diagrams on page 4 using Flat Sl St seam using long tail of Color 3 from Flower Power Motifs, noting Left and Right Sleeve diagrams.
Seaming with Flat Sl St:
Sl st through back loops only and keeping working yarn to WS of work to create a flat sl st chain detail on RS of work.
Note: Keep working yarn to WS of work so only flat sl st chain is visible on RS.
FLAT SL ST JOIN

POCKET MOTIFS (make 2)
With B, work 1st to 4th rnds of Flower Power Motif.
Fasten off, leaving a long end of Color 3 to sew Motif to pocket.

DRAWSTRING
Using 2 strands of Color 3 from B, make a chain 50" [127 cm] long. Fasten off.

FINISHING
Cut cuffs off sweatshirt sleeves leaving approx ¾" [2 cm] of fabric above cuff seam. Fold cuff flat and PM at both fold lines.

Instructions from now on will be referring to Granny Square sleeves.
Turn Sleeves inside out. With WS of Sleeve facing you, place RS of cuff edge along RS of Sleeve. Match 1 marker to joining seam of 2 Motifs on Sleeve and match other marker to next joining seam of 2 Motifs, then pin cuff in position. Using sewing machine, with Sleeve on top, sew cuff to Sleeve lower edge, stretching cuff as you sew to ‘gather’ lower edge of Sleeve to fit. For best results, try to stitch right above seam edge on cuff and along last round of Motifs (see photos). Turn Sleeves inside out. Finish ‘raw’ edge of cuff seam with serger or overcast stitching as desired.

Mark placement for Sleeves on sweatshirt 12" [30.5 cm] down from shoulder seams. Cut sleeves off sweatshirt following seamline and allowing approx ¾" [2 cm] seam allowance (see photo). Discard sweatshirt sleeves. Cut side seam below armhole of sweatshirt to reach marker.
Turn sweatshirt inside out. Place RS of Sleeve along RS of sweatshirt armhole opening. Match top of Sleeve to shoulder seam and base of Sleeve to lower armhole, then pin Sleeve in position. Using sewing machine, with Sleeve facing you, sew armhole seam sewing just outer edge of Sleeve (along last round of Motifs) to ¾" [2 cm] seam allowed on sweatshirt, tapering to a narrow seam for lower armhole as needed. For best results, try to stitch close to seam edge on sweatshirt. Finish ‘raw’ edge of sleeve seam with serger or overcast stitching as desired.
Place cardboard inside kangaroo pocket to make sure you do not catch stitching through more than top layer of pocket. Pin Pocket Motif in position and using yarn end with large-eyed sharp needle, sew Pocket Motif in position. Rep on remaining kangaroo pocket.
Remove hood drawstring. Using safety pin that will fit into hood eyelet hole, attach new Drawstring to safety pin and draw through hood casing. Knot ends and weave in yarn ends.

materials: RED HEART® “Kids™”: 2 skeins CA and 1 skein CB.
Color Combinations Shown: 2945 Bikini CA and 2734 Pink CB, 2940 Beach CA and 2652 Lime CB, 2945 Crayon CA and 2230 Yellow CB.
Crochet Hooks: U.S. Sizes G-6 [4mm] and I-9 [5.5mm].
Six 7/8” buttons; sewing needle and thread; yarn needle.
abbreviations: CA, CB = Color A, Color B
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
[ ] = work directions given in brackets the number of times specified
measurements: To Fit Chest: 22 (24, 26, 28)”. Finished Chest Measurement: 26 (28, 30, 32)”-buttoned.
gauge: 14 sts = 4”; 11 rows = 6” in dc with larger hook. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
BACK: With larger hook and CA, ch 48 (51, 55, 58).
Row 1 (Right Side): Dc in 4th ch from hook and in each ch across; turn – 46 (49, 53, 56) sts.
Row 2: Ch 3, skip first dc, dc in each dc across and in top of ch-3; turn.
Rep Row 2 until 5½ (5½, 6½, 6½)” from beg, end wrong side row.
Shape Armholes: Ch 1, sl st in first 5 sts, ch 3, dc in next 37 (40, 44, 47) dc; turn, leaving last 4 sts unworked – 38 (41, 45, 48) sts. Work even in dc until armhole measures 5½ (5½, 6½, 6½)”. Fasten off.
Ribbing: With right side facing and smaller hook, attach CB at lower edge, ch 3, work 45 (47, 51, 55) dc across beg ch; turn – 46 (48, 52, 56) sts.
Ribbing Row: Ch 2, * dc around the post of next dc from the front, dc around the post of the next dc from the back; rep from * to last st; hdc in top of ch; turn.
Rep last row until ribbing measures 1½ (2, 1½, 2)”. Fasten off.
RIGHT FRONT: With larger hook and CA, ch 25 (26, 28, 30). Work in dc over 23 (24, 26, 28) sts until front measures same as back to armhole, end wrong side row.
Shape Armhole: Ch 3, dc in next 18 (19, 21, 23) dc; turn, leaving last 4 sts unworked – 19 (20, 22, 24) sts. Work even until armhole measures 33/4 (33/4, 5, 5)”, end right side row.
Shape Neck: Ch 3, dc in next 11 (12, 14, 16) dc; turn, leaving last 7 sts unworked – 12 (13, 15, 17) sts. Dec 1 st at neck edge on next 2 rows – 10 (11, 13, 15) sts. Fasten off.
Ribbing: Work same as back over 22 (24, 26, 28) sts.
LEFT FRONT: Work same as right front EXCEPT work in Stripe pat of 2 rows CA, 4 rows CB until front measures same as back to armhole, end wrong side row.
Shape Armhole: Keeping continuity of Stripe pat, ch 1, sl st in first 5 sts, ch 3, dc in next 18 (19, 21, 23) dc; turn – 19 (20, 22, 24) sts. Work even until armhole measures 3¾ (3¾, 5, 5)”, end right side row.
Shape Neck: Ch 1, sl st in first 8 sts, ch 3, dc in each st to end; turn – 12 (13, 15, 17) sts. Dec 1 st at neck edge on next 2 rows. Fasten off. Work ribbing same as for right front.
LEFT SLEEVE: With larger hook and CA, ch 24 (24, 26, 28). Dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in next 0 (1, 2, 0) ch, [2 dc in next ch, dc in next 4 (2, 2, 3) ch] 4 (6, 6, 6) times, dc in last 0 (1, 2, 0) ch – 26 (28, 30, 32) sts; turn. Work in dc, shaping sides by inc 1 st each end of every right side row until there are 38 (38, 46, 46) sts. Work even until 8¼ (9¼, 10¼, 11½)” from beg. Fasten off.
Ribbing: Work same as back over 22 (22, 24, 26) sts for 2”.
RIGHT SLEEVE: Work same as left sleeve EXCEPT work in Stripe pat of 2 rows CA, 4 rows CB.
FINISHING-Neckband: Sew shoulder seams. With right side facing and smaller hook, attach CB at right neck edge, ch 3, work 14 dc across right edge, 18 (18, 20, 20) dc across back neck, 15 dc down left edge; turn – 48 (48, 50, 50) sts. Work one row of ribbing. Fasten off.
Buttonband (Work on left front for girls, right front for boys): With right side facing and smaller hook, attach CB and work 3 rows sc evenly across front edge. Fasten off.
Buttonhole Band: Mark positions for 6 buttonholes on rem front; attach CB and work 1 row sc. 
Buttonhole Row: Ch 1, [sc to marker, ch 2, skip 2 sc] 6 times, sc to end; turn. 
Next Row: Ch 1, [sc to sp, 2 sc in sp] 6 times, sc to end. 
Fasten off. Sew on buttons.
Sew in sleeves, sewing ends of last row to underarm sts of fronts and back. Sew side and sleeve seams. Weave in ends.

5th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first dc (inc made). 1 dc in next dc. *1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * to last 3 sts. 1 sc in next dc. 1 dc in next dc. 2 sc in last dc (inc made). Turn. 31 (37-43-49) sts. 
Rep 4th and 5th rows 0 (1-1-2) time(s) more, then 4th row 0 (0-1-1) time(s) more. 31 (41-49-59) sts. Work 1 row even in pat.
Leg Openings: Next row: (RS). Pat across 2 (3-5-7) sts. Sl st across next 4 (4-4-6) sts. Ch 1. Pat across 19 (27-31-33) sts. Sl st across next 4 (4-4-6) sts. Pat to end of row. Turn.
Note: All Leg sections are worked at same times using separate balls of yarn for each section.
Work 1 (1½-1½-2½)" [2.5 (4-4-6) cm] in pat, ending on a RS row.
Joining row: (WS). Pat across 2 (3-5-7) sts. Ch 4 (4-4-6). Pat across 19 (27-31-33) sts. Ch 4 (4-4-6). Pat to end of row. Turn.
Next row: Pat across 2 (3-5-7) sts. Pat across 4 (4-4-6) ch. Pat across 19 (27-31-33) sts. Pat across 4 (4-4-6) ch. Pat to end of row. Turn. 31 (41-49-59) sts. 
Cont even in pat until work after neckband measures 5 (6½-8-11)" [12.5 (16.5-20.5-28) cm], ending on a WS row. Place marker at each end of last row.
Back Shaping: Next row: Sl st across first 3(3-5-5) sts. Ch 1. Pat to last 3(3-5-5) sts. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 25 (35-39-49) sts. Next row: Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of first 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook - Sc2tog made. Pat to last 2 sts. Sc2tog over last 2 sts. Turn.
Rep last row 1 (4-5-7) time(s) more. 21 (25-27-33) sts rem. 
Cont even in pat until work after neckband measures 10 (12½-15½-21)" [25.5 (32-39.5-53.5) cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off.
Back Edging: 1st row: (RS). Join yarn with sl st at marker. Ch 1. Work sc evenly across back edge to opposite marker. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Fasten off. Sew neck and belly seam.
Leg Edging: 1st rnd: (RS). Join yarn with sl st at leg opening. 
Ch 1. Work sc evenly around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off.

materials: Red Heart® Granny Square™ All in One™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 417 yds/381 m)
Contrast A 2 2 balls Dove (2016) 15 16 Granny Squares
Contrast B 1 2 ball(s) Totally Teal (2031) 13 19 Granny Squares
Contrast C 1 2 ball(s) Verdant Vine (2030) 13 19 Granny Squares
Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
measurements: To fit chest measurement XS/S/M/L 28-42" [71-106.5 cm]; XL/2/3XL 44-54" [112-137 cm]; Approx finished chest (with edging) XS/S/M 50" [127 cm]; XL/2/3XL 62" [157.5 cm]
gauge: All Motifs = 6" [15 cm] square with larger hook.
instructions:
The instructions are written for size XS/S/M/L. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written XS/S/M/L ( XL/2/3XL). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes.

MOTIFS 
Notes for Red Heart Granny Square All in One yarn:
• Motifs begin with Color 1 (shortest color rep) from center of pull-skein, leaving a 4” [10 cm] tail to weave in.
• Each color aligns with 1 round (rnd) in the Motif with 5 colors in total. If too much color is left at end of rnd, pull back some stitches (sts) and slightly loosen gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change. If too little color is left, pull back some sts and slightly tighten gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change.
• When Motif is complete, cut yarn where Color 5 (longest color rep) ends, leaving a tail for weaving in. Begin next Motif with Color 1 and repeat 5 rnds for each Motif.

CLASSIC GRANNY A
Size XS/S/M/L - make 15.
Size XL/2/3XL - make 16.
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
• Ch 6 at beg of rnds counts as dc and ch-3 sp.
• Join all rnds with sl st to 3rd ch of ch-6 unless otherwise indicated.
Using Contrast A, with larger hook and Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
4th and 5th rnds: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join. Fasten off.

CORNER GRANNY B
Size XS/S/M/L - make 13.
Size XL/2/3XL - make 19.
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd or row counts as dc.
• Ch 6 at beg of rnds counts as dc and ch-3 sp.
Using Contrast B, with larger hook and Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join with sl st in 3rd ch of ch-6. Color 1 ends.
2nd rnd: With Color 2, sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join with sl st in 3rd ch of ch-6. Color 2 ends.
Motif will now be worked in rows, alternating RS and WS.
3rd row: (RS). With Color 3, sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 3. 2 dc in same ch-3 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-3 sp. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
4th row: (WS). Ch 4 (counts as 1 dc and ch-1 sp). (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) twice. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. 1 dc in top of ch-3. Turn. Color 3 ends.
5th row: (RS). With Color 4, ch 3. 2 dc in first ch-1 sp. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) twice. Ch 1. 2 dc in next ch-1 sp. 1 dc in 3rd ch of ch 4. Turn.
6th row: (WS). Ch 4 (counts as 1 dc and ch-1 sp). (3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1) 3 times. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) 3 times. Ch 1. 1 dc in top of ch-3. Turn. Color 4 ends.
Note: Work 7th rnd around entire Motif.
7th rnd: (RS). With Color 5, ch 3. 2 dc in first ch-1 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) 3 times. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. (Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp) 3 times. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 3. Join with sl st to beg ch 3. Fasten off.

BLOCK GRANNY C
Size XS/S/M/L - make 14.
Size XL/2/3XL - make 19.
Notes:
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
• Ch 6 at beg of rnds counts as dc and ch-3 sp.
Using Contrast C, with larger hook and Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join. Color 1 ends.
2nd rnd: With Color 2, sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 3. 1 dc in same ch-3 sp. *1 dc in each of next 3 dc. (2 dc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. 1 dc in each of last 3 dc. 2 dc in next ch-3 sp (same sp as beg ch-3). Join with hdc to beg ch-3. Color 2 ends.
3rd rnd: With Color 3, ch 3. (1 dc. Ch 3. 2 dc) all in sp created by joining hdc of 2nd rnd. *1 dc in each of next 7 dc. (2 dc. Ch 3. 2 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. 1 dc in each of last 7 dc. Join with sl st to beg ch-3. Sl st in next dc and next ch-3 sp. Color 3 ends.
4th rnd: With Color 4, ch 6. 1 dc in same ch-3 sp as last sl st. *1 dc in each of next 11 dc. (1 dc. Ch 3. 1 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. 1 dc in each of last 11 dc. Join with sl st to 3rd ch of ch 6. Color 4 ends.
5th rnd: With Color 5, sl st in next ch-3 sp. [(Ch 3. 2 dc) twice] in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. Skip next 2 dc. 3 dc in next dc. (Ch 1. Skip next 3 dc. 3 dc in next dc) twice. Ch 1.** Skip next 2 dc. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to **. Skip last 2 dc. Join with sl st to beg ch-3. Fasten off.

ASSEMBLY
Note: Join Motifs tog using D (black) as shown in diagrams. Size XS/S/M/L only: Sleeves are joined separately then sewn into Body after Body is assembled. Note folded Motifs on side seams of Body will leave a 24" [61 cm] square total armhole opening for sleeves on each side (see shaded sections on diagram for square armhole sleeve placement).

All Sizes: Join Motifs: Hold RS of 2 Motifs facing each other with sts aligned. With larger hook, join D (black) with sl st in ch-2 corners of aligned Motifs at top right. With RS facing each other, following diagrams, join Motifs, matching lettered sides and working rows of sl st loosely through both thicknesses. Fasten off.

Sleeve Edging: 1st row: (RS). With smaller hook, join D with sl st in lower edge of Sleeve and work 38 sc evenly across. Turn.
2nd to 6th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off. Sew sides of Edging tog.
Lower Edging: 1st row: (RS). With smaller hook, join D with sl st in lower edge of Left Front corner and work sc evenly across lower edge to corner of Right Front. Turn.
2nd to 6th rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Fasten off.
Collar and Front Band: 1st row: (RS). With smaller hook, join D with sl st in lower edge of Right Front and work sc evenly up Right Front, across back neck and down Left Front. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 2 ( does not count as hdc). 1 hdc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. Working into horizontal loop lying below next st (see diagram), work 1 hdc in each hdc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Collar and Front Band measures 6" [15 cm]. Fasten off.

Next row: (RS). Ch 2 (counts as first hdc). V-st in first V-st of previous row. V-st in each V-st to end of row. 1 hdc in top of turning ch 2. Turn.
Rep last row 21 (23-23) times more.

Ch 57 (60-63).

2nd row: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc). V-st in first V-st of previous row. V-st in each V-st to last 2 sts. Hdc2tog over last hdc and turning ch. Turn.

Next row: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc). V-st in first V-st of previous row. V-st in each V-st to end of row. 1 hdc in top of turning ch 2. Turn.
