Fasten off.
FINISHING
Block pieces to measurements, gently stretching to open stitch pattern and form shape. Matching stitches at armhole edge of first front and corresponding stitches at armhole edge of back, sew 16 stitches together for shoulder seam. Repeat to sew second shoulder seam.
Armhole Edging
Round 1 (Right Side): Join yarn with sc in first skipped st at underarm, sc in next 2 sts; working around posts of sts at ends of rows around armhole opening, work 1 sc in end of each sc row and 2 sc in end of each dc row; join with slip st in first sc, do not turn.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Repeat around second armhole.
Body Edging
Round 1 (Right Side): Join yarn with sc in first unworked (unseamed) st at back neck, sc in each st across back neck; sc in each st across last row of first front to last st, 3 sc in last st (corner); working around posts of sts at ends of rows of front edge, work 1 sc in end of each sc row and 2 sc in end of each dc row; working across opposite side of foundation ch, 3 sc in first ch, sc in each ch across to last ch, 3 sc in last ch; working around posts of sts at ends of rows of second front edge, work 1 sc in end of each sc row and 2 sc in end of each dc row; working in sts of last row of second front, 3 sc in first st, sc in each st across; join with slip st in first sc, do not turn.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in each sc around; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (5oz/142g; 236 yds/215 mm)
Contrast B: Pretty’n Pink (0722) or Camouflage (0971) 1 1 1 1 ball
Sizes U.S. I/9 [5.5 mm] and U.S. J/10 [6 mm] Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hooks or size needed to obtain gauge
abbreviations: V-st = (1 hdc. Ch 1. 1 hdc) in indicated space or stitch
measurements: To fit chest measurement: S 19" [48.5 cm], M 20" [51 cm], L 22" [56 cm], XL 24" [61 cm]; Finished chest: S 21½" [43 cm], M 24" [45.5 cm], L 26½" [48.5 cm], XL 29½" [51 cm]
gauge: 6 V-sts and 10 rows = 4" [10 cm] with larger hook in V-st pat.
instructions:
The instructions are written for S. If changes are necessary for larger sizes the instructions will be written S (M - L - XL). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes. Notes: • Vest is made in one piece to armhole, then divided for fronts and back. • Ch 2 at beg of rows doesn’t count as st.

BODY
With A and smaller hook, ch 97 (109-121-133).
1st row: (RS). V-st in 4th ch from hook. *Skip next 2 ch. V-st in next ch. Rep from * to last 3 ch. Skip next 2 ch. 1 hdc in last ch. Turn. 31 (35-39-43) V-sts and 2 hdc.
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. V-st in ch-1 sp of each V-st, ending with hdc in top of turning ch. Turn. Rep last row until work from beg measures 6 (8-9-10)" [15 (20.5-23-25.5) cm], ending on a WS row.

RIGHT FRONT
1st row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. V-st in each of first 6 (7-7-8) V-sts. 1 hdc in next ch-1 sp. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 6 (7-7-8) V-sts.
2nd row: Work even in V-st pat. Turn. Rep last row 0 (0-2-2) times more.
Next row: (RS). Sl st to first ch-1 sp. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. V-st in each of next 4 (5-5-6) V-sts. 1 hdc in next ch-1 sp. Turn. Leave rem hdc unworked. 4 (5-5-6) V-sts.
Next row: Work even in V-st pat. Rep last row 2 (2-0-0) times more. Fasten off A.
With RS facing and larger hook, join B with sl st to first ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. (1 sc between next 2 hdc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 2 (3-3-4) times. 1 sc between last 2 hdc. Turn. 8 (10-10-12) sc.
Next 3 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: (RS). Skip first sc. Sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 7 (9-9-11) sc.
Next 3 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: (RS). Skip first sc. Sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 6 (8-8-10) sc.
Next 3 (5-5-3) rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Size XL only: Next row: (RS). Skip first sc. Sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 9 sc.
Next 3 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: (RS). Skip first sc. Sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 8 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
All sizes: Next row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 (4-4-4) sc. Sl st in each of next 3 (4-4-4) sc. Turn. Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. 6 (8-8-8) sc. Fasten off.

BACK
1st row: (RS). Skip next 1 (1-3-3) V-sts of Body. Join A with sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. V-st in each of next 13 (15-15-17) V-sts. 1 hdc in next ch-1 sp. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked. 13 (15-15-17) V-sts.
2nd row: Work even in V-st pat. Turn. Rep last row 0 (0-2-2) times more.
Next row: (RS). Sl st to next ch-1 sp. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. V-st in each of next 11 (13-13-15) V-sts. 1 hdc in next ch-1 sp. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.
Next row: Work even in V-st pat. Turn. Rep last row 2 (2-0-0) times more. Fasten off A.
Next row: (RS). With larger hook. Join B with sl st to first ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sl as sl st. (1 sc between next 2 hdc. 1 sc in next sc) 9 (11-11-13) times. 1 sc between last 2 hdc. Turn. 22 (26-26-30) sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row 10 (12-12-16) times more.
Next row: (RS). Ch 1. Sl st in each of next 2 (3-3-3) sc. 1 sc in each of next 16 (18-18-22) sc. Sl st in each of last 3 (4-4-4) sc. Turn. Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. 22 (26-26-30) sc. Fasten off B.

LEFT FRONT
1st row: (RS). Skip next 1 (1-3-3) V-st(s) of Body. Join A with sl st in next ch-1 sp. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. V-st in each of next 6 (7-7-8) V-sts. 1 hdc in next ch-1 sp. Turn. Leave rem st unworked. 6 (7-7-8) V-sts and 2 hdc.
2nd row: Work even in V-st pat. Turn. Rep last row 0 (0-2-2) times more.
Next row: (RS). Sl st to first ch-1 sp. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. V-st in each of next 4 (5-5-6) V-sts. 1 hdc in next ch-1 sp. Turn. Leave rem hdc unworked. 4 (5-5-6) V-sts.
Next row: Work even in V-st pat. Rep last row 2 (2-0-0) times more. Fasten off A.
With RS facing and larger hook, join B with sl st to first ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. (1 sc between next 2 hdc. 1 sc in next ch-1 sp) 2 (3-3-4) times. 1 sc between last 2 hdc. Turn. 8 (10-10-12) sc.
Next 3 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: (RS). Skip first sc. Sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 7 (9-9-11) sc.
Next 3 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: (RS). Skip first sc. Sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 6 (8-8-10) sc.
Next 3 (5-5-3) rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Size XL only: Next row: (RS). Skip first sc. Sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 9 sc.
Next 3 rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Next row: (RS). Skip first sc. Sl st in next sc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 8 sc.
Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
All sizes: Next row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 3 (4-4-4) sc. Sl st in each of next 3 (4-4-4) sc. Turn. Next row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each st to end of row. 6 (8-8-8) sc. Fasten off.

LARGE POCKET [Make 0 (2-2-2)]
With A and smaller hook, ch 15.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 14 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row 9 times more. Do not turn at end of last row. Work now progresses in rnds. **Edging 1st rnd: Work in sc evenly around pocket, working 2 sc in each corner. Join with sl st in first sc. 2nd rnd: Sl st in each sc around. Fasten off.} **

Large Pocket Flap [Make 0 (2-2-2)]
With A and smaller hook, ch 17.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row 9 times more. Do not turn at end of last row. Work from ** to ** as given above.

MEDIUM POCKET (Make 2)
With A and smaller hook, ch 11.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of row. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row 7 times more. Do not turn at end of last row. Work now progresses in rnds. Work from ** to ** as given above.

Medium Pocket Flap (Make 2)
With A and smaller hook, ch 13.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc. in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of row. Turn. 12 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row 5 times more. Do not turn at end of last row. Work now progresses in rnds. Work from ** to ** as given above.

SMALL POCKET (Make 2 for size S Only)
With A and smaller hook, ch 9.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc. in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of row. Turn. 8 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row 5 times more. Do not turn at end of last row. Work now progresses in rnds. Work from ** to ** as given above.

Small Pocket Flap (Make 2 for size S Only)
With A and smaller hook, ch 11.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc. in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch to end of row. Turn. 10 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row 3 times more. Do not turn at end of last row. Work now progresses in rnds. Work from ** to ** as given above.

D-Ring Tabs (Make 4)
With A, make a slip knot and place on smaller hook.
1st row: Insert hook into D-ring and work a 5 sc around bar of D-ring. Turn. 2nd and 3rd rows: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off at end of last row.

FINISHING
Pin all pieces to measurements. Cover with a damp cloth leaving cloth to dry. Sew shoulder seams.
Vest Edging: With larger hook, join A with sl st in any st along bottom edge. 1st rnd: Sl st evenly around entire edge of vest, working 1 sl st in base of each V-st and 1 sl st in ch-2 sp between V-sts along bottom edge; 1 sl st in each row-end st along fronts and yokes. 1 sl st in each st across back neck.
2nd rnd: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sl st around, working 2 sc in each corner as needed to keep trim lying flat. Join with sl st in first sc.
3rd rnd: Sl st in each sc around. Fasten off.
Armhole Edging: With larger hook, join A with sl st at base of one armhole and work as for Vest Edging. Rep on other Armhole opening. Position pockets on Fronts as pictured, (larger pockets below, smaller pockets above), sew in place. Fold top edge of pocket flaps under ½" [1.5 cm], sew in place as pictured. Sew one D-ring tab to center bottom of each top pocket. Sew one D-ring tab to bottom edge of Vest centered under each bottom pocket.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein each 365 Coffee A, 235 Lemon B, 726 Coral C, and 631 Light Sage D
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4mm [US G-6] for Small; 5mm [US H-8] for Medium and 5.5mm [US I-9] for Large
abbreviations: dc2tog: [Yarn over, insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up loop, yarn over, draw through 2 loops] 2 times, yarn over, draw through all loops on hook
gauge: 13 dc = 4” (10 cm); 8 rows = 4” (10 cm) using 4mm [US G-6] hook for Small; 12 dc = 4” (10 cm); 7 rows = 4” (10 cm) using 5mm [US H-8] hook for Medium; 11 dc = 4” (10 cm); 7 rows = 4” (10 cm) using 5.5mm [US I-9] hook for Large. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
GRANNY SQUARE MOTIF (Make 2)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 8 sc in first ch from hook, slip st in first sc to join – 8 sc. 
Round 2: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1), [dc in next sc, ch 1] 7 times, slip st to 3rd ch of beginning ch – 8 ch-1 spaces. 
Round 3: Slip st to first ch-1 space, ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), work 2 dc in same space, ch 1, *work (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-1 space for corner, ch 1, 3 dc in next ch-1 space, ch 1; repeat from * 2 more times, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in last ch-1 space, ch 1, slip st in top of beginning ch. 
Fasten off A.
Round 4: With right side facing, join C any ch-3 space, ch 3, work (2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in same space,[ch 1, 3 dc in next ch-1 space] across to next ch-3 space, ch 1, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * 2 more times, [ch 1, 3 dc in next ch-1 space] across to beginning ch-3, ch 1, slip st in top of beginning ch. 
Round 5: Slip st to first ch-3 space, ch 3, work (2 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in same space,[ch 1, 3 dc in next ch-1 space] across to next ch-3 space, ch 1, (3 dc, ch 3, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * 2 more times, [ch 1, 3 dc in next ch-1 space] across to beginning ch-3, ch 1, slip st in top of beginning ch. 
Fasten off C.
Round 6: With right side facing, join B any ch-3 space and repeat Round 4. 
Round 7: Repeat Round 5. 
Fasten off B.
Round 8: With right side facing, join D any ch-3 space and repeat Round 4. 
Fasten off D
Round 9: With right side facing, join A any ch-3 space, ch 3, work (2 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in same space,[ch 1, 3 dc in next ch-1 space] across to next ch-3 space, ch 1, (3 dc, ch 1, 3 dc) in next ch-3 space; repeat from * 2 more times, [ch 1, 3 dc in next ch-1 space] across to beginning ch-3, ch 1, slip st in top of beginning ch. 
Round 10: Ch 3, dc in each dc and each ch-1 space around, slip st in top of beginning ch – 144 dc; 36 dc on each side. 
Fasten off.
FRONT AND BACK (Both Alike)
Left Shoulder
Row 1: With right side facing, join A at any corner dc of Granny Square Motif, ch 3, dc in next 5 dc – 6 dc. 
Rows 2-6 (7, 7): Ch 3, turn, dc in next 5 dc.
Fasten off. 
Right Shoulder
Skip center 24 dc, join A in next dc, ch 3, dc in next 5 dc. 
Rows 2-6 (7, 7): Ch 3, turn, dc in next 5 dc.
Fasten off.
Sew shoulder seams.
Right Side
Row 1: With right side facing, turn to work along right side edge, skip first 11 dc, join A in next st, ch 3, dc in next 24 dc – 25 dc. 
Fasten off A. 
Row 2: With right side facing, join B in first st, ch 1, sc in same space, [ch 1, skip next dc, sc in next dc] across.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, [sc in ch-1 space, ch 1] across to last ch-1 space, sc in ch-1 space, sc in last sc. 
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, [ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space] across to last 2 sc, ch 1, skip next sc, sc in last sc. 
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, [sc in ch-1 space, ch 1] across to last ch-1 space, sc in ch-1 space, sc in last sc. 
Fasten off B. 
Row 6: Turn and join D in first st, ch 1, sc in same space, [ch 1, sc in next ch-1 space] across to last 2 sc, ch 1, skip next sc, sc in last sc. 
Row 7: Repeat Row 3. 
Fasten off D. 
Left Side
With right side facing, join A at lower edge of opposite side of Granny Square Motif, ch 3, dc in next 24 sts, leave remaining sts unworked – 25 dc.
Work as for Right Side.
Sew side seams.
Lower Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join A at one side seam, ch 3, dc 5 sts evenly spaced along row edges of one Side, dc across 36 sts along last round of one Granny Square Motif, dc 12 sts across opposite Side edges, dc across 36 sts along last round of second Granny Square Motif, dc 6 sts evenly spaced along row edges of opposite Side to beginning ch, slip st in top of beginning ch – 96 dc. 
Round 2: Ch 3, turn, [dc2tog, dc in next 14 sts] 5 times, dc2tog, dc in each dc to beginning ch, slip st in top of beginning ch – 90 dc.
Rounds 3-4: Ch 3, turn, dc in each dc, slip st in top of beginning ch. 
Fasten off A. 
Round 5: With right side facing, join C in any dc, ch 1, sc in same space, sc in each sc around, slip st in first sc to join. 
Round 6: Ch 1, sc in same space, sc in next sc, [ch 3, slip st in 3rd ch from hook – picot made, skip next sc, sc in next 2 sc] around to last st, picot, skip last st, slip st in first st. 
Fasten off. 
Armhole Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join C at side seam, ch 1, sc in same space, sc 63 (66, 66) sts evenly spaced around Armhole edge, slip st in first sc to join.
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same space, sc in next sc, [ch 3, slip st in 3rd ch from hook – picot made, skip next sc, sc in next 2 sc] around to last st, picot, skip last st, slip st in first st. 
Fasten off. 
Neck Edging
Round 1: With right side facing, join C at one shoulder seam, ch 1, sc in same space, sc 87 sts evenly spaced around Neck edge, slip st in first sc to join. 
Round 2: Ch 1, sc in same space, sc in next sc, [ch 3, slip st in 3rd ch from hook – picot made, skip next sc, sc in next 2 sc] around to last st, picot, skip last st, slip st in first st. 
Fasten off. 
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Lattice™ (7.8 oz/220 g; 389 yds/356 m)
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
abbreviations: Hdc2tog = (Yoh and draw up a loop in next stitch) twice. Yoh and draw through all loops on hook
Sc2tog = Draw up a loop in each of next 2 sts. Yoh and draw through all 3 loops on hook
Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
V-st = (1 hdc. Ch 1. 1 hdc) all in indicated stitch or ch-1 space of next V-st
measurements: To fit chest measurement: 4 yrs 23" [58.5 cm], 6 yrs 25" [63.5 cm], 8 yrs 26½" [67.5 cm], 10 yrs 28" [71 cm]. Finished chest: 4 yrs 27½" [70 cm], 6 yrs 30½" [77.5 cm], 8 yrs 33½" [85 cm], 10 yrs 36" [91.5 cm].
gauge: 5½ V-sts and 9½ rows = 4" [10 cm] in V-st pat.
instructions:
The instructions are written for size 4. If changes are necessary for larger size(s) the instructions will be written 4 (6-8-10). Numbers for each size are shown in the same color throughout the pattern. When only one number is given in black, it applies to all sizes. 

**STRIPE PAT**: With A - 2 rows, With B - 2 rows, With C - 2 rows. These 6 rows form Stripe Pat. Note: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as st.

**BACK** 
Ribbing: With A, ch 8.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 7 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Ribbing (when slightly stretched) measures 13½ (14½-15½-17)" [34.5 (37-39.5-43) cm], ending on a WS row. Do not fasten off. Do not turn. 

1st row: (WS). With A, ch 1. Work 58 (64-70-76) sc evenly across long edge of Ribbing. Turn. Do not break A. Join B.
Note: See diagram on page 4.

2nd row: With B, ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 2 sc. Skip next ch. *V-st in next sc. Skip next 2 sc. Rep from * to last 4 sc. V-st in next sc. Skip next sc. 1 hdc in each of last 2 sc. Turn. 18 (20-22-24) V-sts and 4 hdc.

3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 2 hdc. *V-st in next V-st. Rep from * to last 2 hdc. 1 hdc in each of last 2 hdc. Turn. 
First 2 rows of Stripe Pat are complete.

Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row until work from work from lower edge measures 9 (10-10½-11½)" [23 (25.5-26.5-29) cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off.

Shape armholes: 
1st row: (RS). Skip first 2 hdc and V-st. Join appropriate color to ch-1 sp of next V-st. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. *V-st in next V-st. Rep from * to last 2 V-sts and 2 hdc. 1 hdc in ch-1 sp of next V-st. Turn. Leave rem V-st and 2 hdc unworked. 14 (16-18-20) V-sts and 2 hdc.

2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in ch-1 sp of next V-st. *V-st in next V-st. Rep from * to last V-st and hdc. 1 hdc in ch-1 sp of next V-st. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 12 (14-16-18) V-sts and 4 hdc.

3rd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog over first 2 hdc. *V-st in next V-st. Rep from * to last 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn.

4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. *V-st in next V-st. Rep from * to last st. 1 hdc in last st. Turn. 12 (14-16-18) V-sts and 2 hdc.

Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row until armhole measures 5½ (6-6½-7)" [14 (15-16.5-18) cm], ending on a WS row. Fasten off.

**Shape shoulders**: Next row: (RS). Skip first hdc and 1 (1-2-2) V-st(s). Join appropriate color with sl st to first hdc of next V-st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next (ch-1 sp and hdc) of same V-st. 1 hdc in (hdc, ch-1 sp, hdc) of next V-st. V-st in each of next 6 (8-8-10) V-sts. 1 hdc in (hdc, ch-1 sp, hdc) of next V-st. 1 sc in (hdc, ch-1 sp, hdc) of next V-st. Fasten off. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

Next row: (WS). Skip first 3 sc. Join appropriate color to next hdc. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in each of next 2 hdc. V-st in each of next 6 (8-8-10) V-sts. 1 sc in each of next 3 hdc. Fasten off. Leave rem sts unworked.

**FRONT** 
Work from ** to ** as given for Back. Keeping cont of Stripe Pat, rep last row until armhole measures 4 rows less than Back before shoulder shaping, ending on a WS row.
Note: See neck and shoulder shaping diagrams on pages 4 and 5.

**Left Front**: Shape neck: 1st row: (RS). Ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. V-st in each of next 4 (4-5-5) V-sts. 1 hdc in ch-1 sp of next V-st. Turn. Leave rem sts unworked.

2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. 1 hdc in ch-1 sp of next V-st. V-st in each V-st to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 3 (3-4-4) V-sts and 3 hdc.

3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. V-st in each V-st to last 2 hdc. Hdc2tog. Turn.

4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first st. V-st in each V-st to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Fasten off.

**Shape left shoulder**: 1st row: (WS). Skip first hdc and 1 (1-2-2) V-st(s). Join appropriate color with sl st to first hdc of next V-st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next (ch-1 sp and hdc) of same V-st. 1 hdc in (hdc, ch-1 sp, hdc) of next V-st. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn.

2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 hdc. Fasten off.

**Shape right neck**: 1st row: (RS). Skip next 2 (4-4-6) V-sts. Join appropriate color with sl st to ch-1 sp of next V-st. Ch 2. 1 hdc in same sp as sl st. V-st in each of next 4 (4-5-5) V-sts. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn.

2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. V-st in each V-st to last V-st and hdc. 1 hdc in ch-1 sp of next V-st. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 3 (3-4-4) V-sts and 3 hdc.

3rd row: Ch 2. Hdc2tog. V-st in each V-st to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn.

4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in first hdc. V-st in each st to last hdc. 1 hdc in last hdc. Fasten off. Do not turn.

**Shape right shoulder**: 1st row: (WS). Skip first hdc and 1 (1-2-2) V-st(s). Join appropriate color with sl st to first hdc of next V-st. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as sl st. 1 sc in next (ch-1 sp and hdc) of same V-st. 1 hdc in (hdc, ch-1 sp, hdc) of next V-st. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn.

2nd row: Ch 1. Sc2tog. 1 sc in each of next 2 hdc. Fasten off.

**FINISHING**: Sew shoulder seams. Neckband: With A, ch 4.
1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 3 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 scbl in each st to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Neckband (when strecthed) measures length to fit around neck edge. Beg at right shoulder seam, sewing in place as you work. Fasten off. Sew neckband seam.

**Armbands (make 2)**: With A, ch 4.

Row 1: With right side facing, join A in same st as last st of Right Lower Back, ch 2, working along edges of row, dc 21 sts evenly spaced to Armhole edge, ch 3, dc in remaining 25 (29, 33, 37, 41) sts of Round 1, dc 21 sts evenly along edge of Lower Back – 46 (50, 54, 58, 62) hdc.

Join Shoulders

Row 1: With wrong side facing, join A to lower corner of Right Front Bodice, ch 1, sc 77 (90, 107, 128, 149) sts evenly spaced across lower edge – 77 (90, 107, 128, 149) sc.

Row 6: Change to B, ch 2, turn, hdc in next sc, [Fpdc in next sc on Row 3, hdc in next 2 sc] across.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 8: With A, ch 2, hdc in next sc, [Fpdc in next Fpdc, hdc in next 2 sc] across.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.

Row 10: Change to B, ch 4 (counts as tr here and throughout), turn, tr in each sc across – 77 (90, 107, 128, 149) tr.
Row 11: Ch 4, turn, tr in same space, tr in first 2 (2, 3, 0, 3) tr, [tr in next 4 (5, 6, 7, 9) tr, 2 tr next tr] 14 times, tr in next 3 (2, 4, 0, 4) tr, 2 tr in last st – 93 (106, 123, 144, 163) tr.

Fasten off.
FINISHING
Weave in ends.

RUNNER
Starting at left side, ch 180. 
Row 1 (Right Side): Dc in 4th ch from hook, dc in each ch across (59 blocks made), turn. 
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), dc in next 3 dc (block made), *ch 2, skip next 2 sts, dc in next dc; repeat from * 56 times, dc in last 3 dc (57 spaces with 1 block on each end), turn.

NOTE: We have included a charted alphabet (both upper and lower case letters) to plan your personalized design. Using graph paper, position your letters and border as desired before you begin.
HOW TO READ FILET PATTERN CHART:
Each square in your chart represents either a “block” (•) or a “space” (open square). 
For “block” = dc in next dc, dc in next 2 sts or ch-2 space, dc in next dc. 
For “space” = dc, ch 2, skip next 2 sts, dc. 
The dc at the end of each square also counts as the first dc of the next block or space. For example, a block followed by a space = dc in next 4 sts, ch 2, skip next 2 sts, dc in next dc.
When following chart, odd number rows are worked right to left and even number rows are worked from left to right.

Note: When joining Back and Front, place small amount of stuffing in each Wing.
Joining Back and Front: 1st rnd:
With WS of Back and Front facing tog, join MC with sl st to side of foundation chain. Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st.
*7 sc up right side of first Wing. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in top st of Wing. 4 sc down left side of first Wing. 4 sc up right side of second Wing. (1 sc. Ch 2. 1 sc) all in top st of Wing. 7 sc down left side of second Wing. 1 sc between Wings. Rep from * around. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd:*Sl st in each of next 8 sc up right side of first Wing. Ch 3. Sl st in first ch of ch 3 - Picot made. Sl st in each of next 5 sc down left side of first Wing. Sl st in each of next 5 sc up right side of second Wing. Picot. Sl st in each of next 8 sc down left side of second Wing. Sl st between Wings. Rep from * around. Fasten off. 
Body: With D, ch 2. 
1st rnd: 4 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join in rnd with sl st in first sc. 
2nd rnd:Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 6 sc. 
3rd rnd:Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. 2 sc in next sc. 1 sc in each of next 2 sc. Join with sl st in first sc. 8 sc. 
4th to 9th rnds:Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
Stuff Body. 
Head: Next rnd:Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 4 times. Join with sl st in first sc. 
Next 2 rnds:Ch 1. 2 sc in each sc around. Join with sl st in first sc. 
Stuff Head. 
Next rnd:Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 8 times. Join with sl st in first sc.
Next rnd:Ch 1. (Sc2tog) 4 times. Join with sl st in first sc.
Next rnd:Ch 1. (Sc2tog) twice. Fasten off.
Sew Body to Wings as shown in picture.
Flower Appliques
(make 2 for each Butterfly).
With D, ch 4. Join in rnd. 
1st rnd:Ch 1. 10 sc in rnd. Join with sl st in first sc. Fasten off. 
2nd rnd:Join A with sl st to any sc. Miss first sc. (3 dc in next sc. Sl st in next sc) 5 times. Fasten off. 
Sew one Flower Applique to each Wing as illustrated. 
FLOWER
(make 1 each with MC, A and B).
Front and Back (make alike).
With C, ch 2. 
1st rnd:5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Join with sl st to first sc. 
2nd rnd:Ch 1. 2 sc in same sp as last sl st. 2 sc in each of next 4 sc. Join with sl st to first sc. 10 sc. Break C. 
First Petal:Join MC with sl st to any sc. 
**1st row: Ch 1. 1 sc in same sp as last sl st. 2 sc in next sc. 3 sc. Turn. 
2nd row:Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. 5 sc. Turn. 
3rd to 5th rows:Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
6th row:Ch 1. Draw up a loop in each of first 2 sc. Yoh and draw up a loop through all loops on hook – Sc2tog made. 1 sc in next sc. Sc2tog over last 2 sc. 3 sts. Turn. 
7th row:Ch 1. Sc2tog over first 2 sts. 1 sc in last st. 2 sts. Turn. 
8th row:Ch 1. Sc2tog over 2 sts. Fasten off.**
Second to Fifth Petals: Join MC with sl st to next sc of 2nd rnd. Work from ** to ** as given for First Petal. 
Note: When joining Back and Front, place small amount of stuffing in each Petal. 
Joining Back and Front:Place Back and Front with WS facing tog. Join MC with sl st between 2 Petals.
Working through both thicknesses, proceed as follows:
1st rnd:*5 sc up right side of Petal. (1 sc. Ch 1. 1 sc) all in top of Petal. 5 sc down left side of Petal. Sl st between Petals. Rep from * around. Fasten off. 
2nd rnd: Join C, with sl st to any sl st between Petals. *Sl st in each of next 7 sc up right side of Petal. Ch 3. Sl st in first ch of ch 3 - Picot made. Sl st in each of next 6 sc down left side of Petal. Sl st between Petals. Rep from * around. Fasten off. 
CRIB RIBBON
With D and larger hook, ch 128. 
1st row:(RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. *Miss next 2 ch. 5 dc in next ch. Miss next 2 ch. 1 sc in next ch.* Rep from * to end of ch. Do not turn.
Working in opposite side of ch, proceed as follows: 2 sc in same sp as last sc. Rep from * to * once more. 2 sc in last ch. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Short Ties (make 3).
With A, ch 15. Fasten off. 
Med Ties (make 3).
With A, ch 20. Fasten off.
Long Ties (make 2).
With A, ch 30. Fasten off. 
Sew Butterflies and Flowers to Crib Ribbon alternating Short and Med Ties as illustrated. Fold 2 long Ties and sew to each end to attach Crib Ribbon to crib. 
Thread ribbon through shells as shown in picture.

materials: Lily® Sugar’n Cream® (Solids: 2.5 oz/70.9 g; 120 yds/109 m; Ombres: 2 oz/56.7 g; 95 yds/86 m)
Size U.S. 7 (4.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.

instructions: Note: When working from chart and joining new color, work to last 2 loops on hook of last st. Draw new color through 2 loops, then proceed in new color. Carry color not in use across top of previous row and work sts around it to prevent stranding. With A, ch 71.  1st row: (RS). 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 70 sc. 2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc across. Turn. Rep 2nd row until work from beg measures 2" [5 cm]. Beg working Chart in sc, reading RS rows from right to left and WS rows from left to right, until 73rd row of Chart is complete. Place marker at end of last row. Chart is shown on page 2. Next row: With D, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row until work from marker measures 3" [7.5 cm], ending on a RS row. Next row – Seam row: (RS). Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Next row: With D, ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. Rep last row until work from marker measures 4" [10 cm]. Fasten oﬀ, leaving a long yarn tail. FINISHING: With long yarn tail, sew final row to rem back loops of Seam row to create casing. Insert dowel in casing to hang. With F, embroider eye and mouth with chain stitch (see chart for placement). Fringe: Cut strands of A 23" [58.5 cm] long. Taking 2 strands tog, fold in half and knot into fringe along bottom edge of Wall Hanging. Trim fringe evenly. Fringe: Cut yarn 10 to 14 ins [25.5 to 35.5 cm] long. Taking 2 or 3 strands together for each fringe knot into fringe across cast on and cast off edges. Trim fringe evenly.

materials: RED HEART® Mixology Solids™: 1 ball each 342 Taupe A and 102 Ivory C
RED HEART® Mixology Print™: 1 ball 959 Retro Print B
RED HEART Mixology Swirl™: 1 ball 9959 Retro D
RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein 313 Aran E
Large eye yarn needle, ¼” diameter x 12” long (6 mm x 30.5 cm) dowel or stick and 1 yd (.91 meters) twine
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, Color B, Color C, etc.
measurements: Wall hanging measures 6½” wide and 11” long (16.5 x 28 cm)
gauge: 6 sts = 4” (10 cm); 4 rows = 4” (10 cm). CHECK YOUR GAUGE.
instructions:
WALL HANGING
With A, ch 11.
Row 1 (right side): Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across; change to B, turn—10 sts. Cut A.
Row 2: Ch 4 (counts as first tr here and throughout), tr in each st across; change to C, turn. Cut B.
Row 3: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and throughout), hdc in each st across, turn.
Row 4: Ch 4, tr in each st across; change to A, turn. Cut C.
Row 5: Ch 2, hdc in each st across; change to D, drop A, turn.
Row 6: Ch 3 (counts as first dc here and throughout), dc in each st across; change to A, turn. Cut D.
Row 7: Ch 3, dc in next 2 sts; change to B, drop A, dc in next 4 sts; change to C, drop B, d in last 3 sts, turn.
Row 8: Ch 3, dc in next 2 sts; change to B, drop C, dc in next 4 sts; change to A, drop B, dc in last 3 sts, turn.
Row 9: Repeat Row 7; change to D at end of row. Cut A, B, and C.
Rows 10–11: Repeat Row 3.
Fasten off.
FINISHING
Refer to photograph as a guide for placement.
Fringe
Cut 24 strands of E, each 8” (20.5 cm) long; separate into 6 groups of 4 strands. Fold strands in half to form a loop. With right side facing and working in opposite side of foundation chains, insert crochet hook from front to back in first stitch. Place fold on hook and draw fold through, forming a loop. Thread ends of strands through loop and pull to tighten. Repeat to attach fringe to next 2 stitches and last 3 stitches. Trim ends evenly.
Hanging Loops
Cut 5 strands of E, each 8” (20.5 cm) long. Fold each strand in half and tie ends together with an overhand knot to form a loop. With right side and top edge facing, thread folded end of loop from front to back through ch-3 space of Row 11, open strands of hanging loop below knot and insert the folded end. Pull up the folded end so knotted end tightens around stitch. Repeat to join remaining 4 hanging loops in top of 4th, 6th, 8th, and last stitches. Adjust as needed to place knots on wrong side. Weave in ends.
Insert dowel or stick through hanging loops and tie on twine for hanging.

materials: YARN: Medium 4: Red Heart® All in One™ Granny Square™ (8.8 oz/250 g; 417 yds/381 m) - Citrus Twist (2002) 1 ball (3 Granny Squares) OR Pink Punch (2001) 1 ball (3 Granny Squares)
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
Piece of cardboard 5" [12.5 cm] wide for tassels.
measurements: To fit around 6" [15 cm] diameter plant pot.
gauge: Motif = Approx 6" [15 cm] square.
instructions:
MOTIF
Make 3.
With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: (RS). Ch 6. (3 dc. Ch 3) 3 times in ring. 2 dc in ring. Join.
2nd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
3rd rnd: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *Ch 1. 3 dc in next ch-1 sp. Ch 1. (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more. Ch 1. 3 dc in last ch-1 sp. Ch 1. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
4th and 5th rnds: Sl st in ch-3 sp. Ch 6. 3 dc in same ch-3 sp. *(Ch 1. 3 dc) in each ch-1 sp to next ch-3 sp. Ch 1.** (3 dc. Ch 3. 3 dc) in next ch-3 sp. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 dc in first ch-3 sp. Join.
Fasten off.

ASSEMBLY
Note: To work Tassel and Straps, use yarn as ‘self-striping’ yarn, allowing colors to change as they appear.
Tassel
Cut a piece of cardboard 5" [12.5 cm] wide. Wind yarn around cardboard 30 times, Break yarn leaving a long end and thread end through needle. Slip needle through all loops and tie tightly. Remove cardboard and wind yarn tightly around loops 2" [5 cm] below fold. Fasten securely. Cut through rem loops and trim ends evenly.
Hanging Straps and Joining Seam
Ch 48. Continue working across edge of 2 Motifs to join as follows: Seaming with Flat Sl St Join: (RS). Sl st 2 Motifs tog, working through back loops only and keeping working yarn to WS of work to create a flat sl st chain detail on RS of work. 
Ch 10. Fasten off leaving long tail.
Rep above steps twice more with rem Motifs to create tube of Motifs.

Note: Keep working yarn to WS of work so only flat sl st chain is visible on RS.
Insert 6" [15 cm] plant pot into center of tube of Motifs, with ch-10 at bottom of Plant Pot. Tie 3 ch-10 tog in an overhand knot where they meet at center of Plant Pot base. Tie Tassel to ends of ch-10 using long tails. Bring 3 lengths of ch-48 to meet above Plant Pot so all 3 lengths are pulled tight. Tie tops of ch-48 tog to create hanging loop.

Weave in ends.

materials: RED HEART® Anne Geddes Baby™: 2 balls 203 Daffodil A
Susan Bates® Crochet Hook: 4mm [US G-6] and 5mm [US H-8]
abbreviations: A, B, C = Color A, B, C
[ ] = work directions in brackets the number of times specified
* or ** = repeat whatever follows the * or ** as indicated
measurements: Crown measures 8” [20.5 cm] diameter x 5” [12.5 cm] tall. Animals are 3¾” [9cm] tall.
gauge: 17 sc = 4” [10cm]; 19 rows = 4” [10cm] in single crochet using 4mm [US G-6] hook and 1 strand of yarn. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
FINISHING
With wrong side together, hold both Crowns together. Fold pieces so first and last Point are together, lining up edges. Holding 2 stands of A together and working through all layers, join yarn at first row and sc evenly alongside edges to join side seam. When side seam is joined, continue to sc evenly spaced along pointed lower edge, working 3 sc in each point, slip st in first st. Turn right side out. Stuff lightly with fiberfill. Insert embroidery hoop along top straight edge and sew top edge closed.

Border
With 2 strands of A held together and 5mm [US H-8] hook, ch 65. Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 64 sc. Row 2: Change to B, ch 1, turn, *sc in next sc, skip next sc, 5 dc in next sc, skip next sc; repeat from * across. Fasten off. Sew edges together. Sew around straight edge of Crown with B ruffles pointing towards Points.

ANIMAL
Make 4; 1 each in C, D, E and F
Animals are worked in continuous rounds. Place marker for beginning of round.

Head
With 1 strand of yarn and 4mm [US G-6] hook, ch 2. Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in first st to join – 6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round. Round 2: 2 sc in each st around – 12 sc. Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] around – 18 sc.

CROWN
Make 2
With 2 strands of A held together and 5mm [US H-8] hook, ch 61. Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 60 sc. Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), turn, dc in each sc across. Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in each dc across. Row 4: Repeat Row 2.

Shape First Point
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 10 dc, leave remaining sts unworked. Decrease Row: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each st to last 2 sts, sc2tog – 8 sc. Next Row: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Repeat last 2 rows twice more – 4 sc. Next Row: Ch 1, turn, [sc2tog] twice – 2 sts. Last Row: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog. Fasten off.

Shape Next Point
*Join 2 strands of A held together in next unworked st on Row 4, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 9 sts. Decrease Row: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in last 2 sts, sc2tog – 8 sc. Next Row: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across. Repeat last 2 rows twice more – 4 sc. Next Row: Ch 1, turn, [sc2tog] twice – 2 sts. Last Row: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog. Fasten off. Repeat from * to make 4 more Points. 

Rounds 4-7: Sc in each sc around. Round 8: [Sc2tog] around – 9 sc. Round 9: Slip st loosely in each sc around. Round 10: 2 sc in each slip st around – 18 sc. Stuff Head with fiberfill. 

Shape Body
Round 11: [Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc] around – 24 sc. Rounds 12-17: Sc in each sc around. Round 18: [Sc2tog] around – 12 sc. Stuff Body with fiberfill. Round 19: [Sc2tog] around – 6 sc. Fasten off. Weave yarn through sts and pull to gather. Knot to secure. Working from center of lower edge to halfway up Body, work backstitch through all layers to outline legs. Work a line of backstitch from one side edge up to shoulders for Arms. Repeat along opposite side.

BUNNY EARS
Make 2 for each Bunny
With 1 strand of same colored yarn and 4mm [US G-6] hook, ch 6. Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 3 chs, 5 sc in last ch, turn to work along opposite edge of foundation ch, sc in next 4 sts. Fasten off. Sew an Ear on either side of Head.

BEAR EARS
Make 2 for each Bear
With 1 strand of same colored yarn and 4mm [US G-6] hook, ch 2. Row 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook. Fasten off. Sew an Ear on either side of Head.

BUNNY SNOUT
Make 1 for each Bunny
With 1 strand of B and 4mm [US G-6] hook, ch 2. Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in first sc – 6 sc. Fasten off. Sew a French knot with matching yarn in center of Snout. Sew Snout in center of Head. With black embroidery floss, sew a French knot for each eye.

BEAR SNOUT
Make 1 for each Bear
With 1 strand of B and 4mm [US G-6] hook, ch 2. Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in first sc – 6 sc. Round 2: 2 sc in each sc around, slip st in first sc – 12 sc. Fasten off. With black embroidery floss, sew a nose in center of Snout with satin stitch. Sew Snout in center of Head. With black embroidery floss, sew a French Knot for each eye.

Hanger
With 5mm [US H-8] hook, join 2 strands of B held together at top of one Animal Head, ch 15. Fasten off. Repeat to attach a Hanger to each Animal.

STAR
Make 8
With 2 strands of B held together and 5mm [US H-8] hook, ch 4, slip st in first ch to form a loop. Round 1: Ch 3, work 9 dc in ring, slip st in top of beginning ch – 10 dc. Round 2: *Ch 4, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in last ch, skip next dc on Round 1, slip st in next dc; repeat from * 4 more times – 5 Points. 

Edging
With wrong sides together, hold 2 Stars together. Holding 2 stands of B together and working through both layers, join yarn in any st and sc evenly alongside edges, working 3 sc in each point, end at first st, slip st in first st. Repeat to make 4 joined Stars. 

Hanger
With 5mm [US H-8] hook, join 2 strands of B held together in between 2 Points, ch 15. Fasten off. Repeat to attach a Hanger to each Star. Attach 1 Star to another to make 2 strands of 2 Stars each. Arrange Stars and Animals around inside top edge of Crown and sew ends of Hangers in place. 

Mobile Hanger
Make 3
With 5mm [US H-8] hook and 2 strands of B held together, ch 30. Row 1: Slip st in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across. Fasten off. Arrange Mobile Hangers evenly spaced around top edge of Crown and sew one end of each in place. 

RING
With 1 strand of A and 4mm [US G-6] hook, work 24 sc around plastic ring, slip st in first sc to join. Sew opposite ends of Mobile Hangers to same spot on Ring. Weave in ends.

materials: Bernat® Roving™ (3.5 oz/100 g; 120 yds/109 m)
Size U.S. K/10½ (6.5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
2 wooden dowels, ½" [1 cm] diameter x 36" [91.5 cm] long.
4 wooden dowel caps with ½" [1 cm] diameter opening.
abbreviations: Scbl = Single crochet in back loop only
gauge: 9 sc and 11 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions:
Notes: 
• Tapestry is worked in intarsia technique. Use separate balls of yarn for each color section in design. Do not carry color not in use across top or back of stitches. 
• To join new color, work to last loops on hook of previous color. Yoh with new color, draw through rem loops and proceed with new color
Bottom Dowel Casing: 
With A, ch 73. 
1st row: 1 sc in 2nd ch from hook. 1 sc in each ch to end of chain. Turn. 72 sc.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until work from beg measures 2" [5 cm], ending on a WS row. 
Proceed as follows:
1st row (fold line): (RS). With A, ch 1. 1 scbl in first sc. 1 scbl in each of next 34 sc. With B, 1 scbl in next sc. With A, 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
2nd row: With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each of first 34 sc. With C, 1 sc in next sc. With A, 1 sc in next sc. With B, 1 sc in next sc. With C, 1 sc in next sc. With A, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
First 2 rows of Chart are complete. 
Cont as established, working Chart in sc to end of Chart. See pages 3 and 4 for Chart.
Do not fasten off. Break B, C, D and E.
Top Dowel Casing: 
1st row (fold line): (RS). With A, ch 1. 1 scbl in each sc to end of row. Turn. 
2nd row: (RS). Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
Rep last row until Top Dowel Casing measures 2" [5 cm], ending on a WS row. 
Fasten off.
Finishing
Fold Top and Bottom Dowel Casings to WS of Tapestry at fold lines. Sew in position at WS of work to form casing, ensuring sts do not show at RS of work.  
Border:
With RS facing, join A with sl st to first rem front loop of fold line at top right corner of Tapestry. 
1st rnd: Ch 1. Working in rem front loops, 3 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 3 sc in last sc. Work sc evenly down left side of Tapestry to next corner. Working in rem front loops of fold line , 3 sc in first sc.  
1 sc in each sc to last sc. 3 sc in last sc. Work sc evenly up right side of Tapestry to first sc. Join with sl st to first sc. Fasten off. 
Optional: Spray paint dowels. 
Insert dowels into Top and Bottom Dowel Casings. Glue Dowel Caps to each end of Dowels. 
Outlines: Using chain st embroidery and A, outline each color section as seen in picture.

materials: RED HEART® Super Saver®: 1 skein 312 Black A and 316 Soft White B
abbreviations: A, B = Color A, Color B
* = repeat whatever follows the * as indicated.
measurements: Spider measures 4” high x 4” (10 x 10 cm) diameter across bottom.
gauge: 5 sts = 4” (10 cm); 5 rows = 4” (10 cm) in single crochet. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.
instructions:
SPIDER (make 3)
Body
With A, ch 2.
Round 1 (right side): Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook—6 sc. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around —12 sc.
Round 3: *Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—18 sc.
Round 4: *Sc in next 2 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—24 sc.
Round 5: *Sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—30 sc.
Round 6: Sc in each sc around.
Round 7: *Sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc; repeat from * around—36 sc.
Rounds 8–10: Sc in each sc around.
Round 11: *Sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around—30 sc.
Round 12: *Sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog; repeat from * around—24 sc.

Head
Rounds 1–4: Work same as Rounds 1–4 of body—24 sc.
Rounds 5–7: Sc in each sc around.
Round 8: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around—12 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing. Stuff lightly. Do not close opening. Hold head on top of body and sew in place.

Eye (make 2)
With B, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook; join with slip st in first sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.

FINISHING
With A, embroider French knot in center of each eye. Sew eyes on head. With embroidery floss, embroider a V-shaped couched stitch for mouth.

Legs
Working between stitches, create 8 small holes on body by inserting and twisting the point of closed scissors into the stuffing. Squeeze a small amount of glue into each hole and insert 1”–1½” (2.5–4 cm) of chenille stem. Allow glue to dry thoroughly before handling. Using photograph as a guide, bend each leg down towards the body at about the midpoint of the stem, then bend up about 1” (2.5 cm) from the end to create the foot.

Round 13: *Sc2tog; repeat from * around—12 sc. Fasten off, leaving a long tail. Stuff lightly. Weave tail through last round and pull stitches closed.

Special Stitch
sc2tog = [Insert hook in next stitch, yarn over and pull up a loop] twice, yarn over and draw through all 3 loops on hook.

Notes
1. Spiders are made in continuous rounds with right side facing. Do not join at end of round until instructed. Place marker for beginning of round and move marker up as each round is completed.
2. Gauge is not critical for this project, but work tightly to ensure that stuffing does not show through stitches.

materials: Red Heart® Super Saver® (7 oz/198 g; 364 yds/333 m)
Size U.S. I/9 (5.5 mm) Susan Bates® Silvalume® crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Each Flag measures approximately 4" [10 cm] wide x 3½" [9 cm] long.
gauge: 12 single crochet (sc) and 15 rows = 4" [10 cm].
instructions: USING THIS GUIDE Click on the underlined words throughout the pattern to access our library of helpful tools. NOTES • Banner is made from triangular flags that are strung onto a long chain for hanging. • Each Flag is worked back and forth in rows from lower tip up to top edge. • Increases are worked at beginning (beg) and end of every other row to create triangular shape. SIZE Each Flag measures approximately (approx) 4" [10 cm] wide x 3½" [9 cm] long. BANNER Flags Make as many as desired using yarn colors of your choice. Make a slip knot and place it on the hook. Slip knot Make a loop with yarn and fold it on itself to make a pretzel shape. Then draw through to make slip knot. Chain (ch) 2. Yarn over hook (Yoh), draw through loop – 1 chain made. Repeat (rep) last step once more – 2 chains made. 1st row: 1 single crochet (sc) in second ch from hook. Turn. Insert hook into second ch from hook under the two top loops (do not count loop on hook as a chain); yoh and draw up a loop. Yoh and draw through both loops on hook – 1 sc made. Increasing Work 2 sc in indicated stitch. 2nd row: Ch 1. 3 sc in first sc. Turn. 3rd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 3 sc total. 4th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in next sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 5 sc total. 5th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn. 5 sc total. 6th row: Ch 1. 2 sc in first sc. 1 sc in each sc to last sc. 2 sc in last sc. Turn. 7 sc total. 7th to 12th rows: Repeat (rep) 5th and 6th rows 3 more times. 13 sc at end of 12th row. 13th row: Ch 1. 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Fasten off. To permanently fasten off yarn, cut yarn leaving a long tail. Pull the end of yarn through loop on hook and pull gently to tighten. Repeat all the previous steps to make more triangular flags. Weave in all yarn tails. Hanging Chain Make a slip knot and place it on the hook. Make ch stitches until hanging chain measures approx 48" [122 cm] or desired length. Fasten off and weave in yarn tails. Finishing Use crochet hook to weave Hanging Chain through spaces between stitches at the top corners of Flags.

materials: Patons® Canadiana™  (3.5 oz/100 g; 205 yds/187 m)
Contrast C Pale Grey Mix (10046) 2 balls
Size U.S. H/8 (5 mm) crochet hook or size needed to obtain gauge.
measurements: Approx 35" [89 cm] wide x 50" [127 cm] long, excluding fringe.
gauge: 14 sts and 12 rows = 4" [10 cm] in Texture Pat.
instructions:
Note: Ch 2 at beg of row does not count as hdc.
Texture Pat (worked over multiple of 6 + 11 foundation ch)
1st row: (WS). 1 hdc in 3rd ch from hook. 1 hdc in each of next 2 ch. *1 dc in each of next 3 ch. Ch 3. Skip next 3 ch. Rep from * to last 6 ch. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch. 1 hdc in each of last 3 ch. Turn. 
2nd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 3 hdc. *Ch 3. Skip next 3 dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 ch 1 row below. Rep from * to last 6 sts. Ch 3. Skip next 3 dc. 1 hdc in each of last 3 hdc. Turn.
3rd row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 3 hdc. *1 dc in each of next 3 dc 1 row below. Ch 3. Skip next 3 dc. Rep from * to last 6 sts. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc 1 row below. 1 hdc in each of last 3 hdc. Turn.
4th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 3 hdc. *Ch 3. Skip next 3 dc. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc 1 row below. Rep from * to last 6 sts. Ch 3. Skip next 3 dc. 1 hdc in each of last 3 hdc. Turn.
Rep 3rd and 4th rows for pat until work measures specified length.
Final row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 3 hdc. *1 dc in each of next 3 dc 1 row below. 1 sc in each of next 3 dc. Rep from * to last 6 sts. 1 dc in each of next 3 dc 1 row below. 1 hdc in each of last 3 hdc. Fasten off.

Section 1
With A, ch 125.
Proceed in Texture Pat until work from beg measures approx 8" [20.5 cm], then work Final row.
Section 2
With B, ch 29.
Proceed in Texture Pat until work from beg measures approx 42" [106.5 cm], then work Final row.
Section 3
With C, ch 23.
Proceed in Texture Pat until work from beg measures approx 42" [106.5 cm], then work Final row.
Section 4
With D, ch 77.
Proceed in Texture Pat until work from beg measures approx 34" [86.5 cm], then work Final row.
Section 5
With E, ch 77.
Proceed in Texture Pat until work from beg measures approx 8" [20.5 cm], then work Final row.

FINISHING
Sew Sections tog as shown in Assembly Diagram.
Fringe: Cut strands of D 12" [30.5 cm] long. Taking 2 strands tog, fold in half and knot into fringe across bottom of Tapestry. Trim fringe evenly.
Dowel Sleeve: Fold over top 2" [5 cm] and sew top edge to WS of work, creating a sleeve for the dowel.
Insert dowel into Dowel Sleeve. Cut 40" [101.5 cm] long strand of D. Tie yarn to both ends of dowel for hanging loop.
Fringe: Cut yarn 10 to 14 ins [25.5 to 35.5 cm] long. Taking 2 or 3 strands together for each fringe knot into fringe across cast on and cast off edges. Trim fringe evenly.

instructions:
HANGING
With 2 strands of A held together and larger hook, ch 64.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 63 sc.
Row 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc here and throughout), turn, dc in next 6 sts, *ch 1, skip next st, dc in next 7 sts; repeat from * across.
Rows 3-4: Ch 3, turn, dc in next 6 sts, *ch 1, skip ch-1 space, dc in next 7 sts; repeat from * across.
Row 5: Ch 4 (counts as dc and ch 1), turn, skip next st, dc next st, *ch 1, skip next st, dc in next st; repeat from * across.
using 2 strands of yarn held together. CHECK YOUR GAUGE. Use any size hook to obtain the gauge.

Rows 6-37: Repeat Rows 2-5.
Rows 38-40: Repeat Rows 2-4.
Row 41: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across – 63 sc.

Tabs
Row 42: Ch 1, turn, working in front loops only, sc in next 9 sc, leave remaining sts unworked.
*Rows 43-54: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 9 sc.
Joining Row: Fold Tab in half to wrong side to line up with wrong side of Row 41, working through both sts of Row 54 and unworked back loops of Row 41, sc in each st across to join*, sc in next 13 sts of Row 41, repeat from * to * for 2nd tab, [sc in next 14 sts of Row 41, repeat from * to * for next tab] twice, sc in next 13 sts of Row 41, repeat from * to * for last tab.

FINISHING
First Point
Row 1: With 2 strands of B held together and larger hook, working across opposite side of foundation ch, join yarn in first ch 1, sc in same ch, sc in next 62 ch – 63 sc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 12 sc, leave remaining sts unworked.
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc to last 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc – 10 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Rows 5-8: Repeat Rows 3-4 – 6 sc on last row.
Row 9: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, [sc2tog] twice, sc in last sc – 4 sc.
Row 10: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 11: [Sc2tog] twice – 2 sc.
Row 12: Sc2tog.
Fasten off.

Second Point
Row 2: With 2 strands of B held together and larger hook, join yarn in next unworked st on Row 1, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 11 sc – 12 sc. 
Work as for First Point. 

Third Point
Row 2: With 2 strands of B held together, join yarn in next unworked st on Row 1, ch 1, sc in same st, sc in next 14 sc – 15 sc. 
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, sc2tog, sc to last 3 sc, sc2tog, sc in last sc – 12 sc.
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. 
Rows 5-12: Repeat Rows 3-4 – 5 sc on last row.
Row 13: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, sc3tog, sc in last sc – 3 sc.
Row 14: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 15: Sc3tog. 
Fasten off.
Fourth and Fifth Point
Work as for Second Point.

Edging
With 2 strands of B held together and larger hook, join yarn in first row along one side edge, sc evenly spaced around Points, working 3 sc in each point. Fasten off. 

LETTERS 
R
With smaller hook and 1 strand of B, ch 8.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 7 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 5, turn, skip 3 sc, sc next sc for center sc, ch 5, turn, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 3 ch, slip st in center sc, sc in 4 ch of first ch-5 space, slip st in edge of Row 1.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
O
With smaller hook and 1 strand of B, ch 17, slip st in first ch to join. 
Round 1: Sc in each ch around. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Y
Make 2
Row 1: With smaller hook and 1 strand of B, [ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch] twice, slip st in first ch, ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, slip st in same slip st. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
A
Make 2
Row 1: With smaller hook and 1 strand of B, ch 8, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 3 ch, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next ch for center bar, sc in next 3 ch of ch-8, turn, ch 4, slip st in tip of center bar, ch 5, turn, sc in 2nd ch from hook and next 3 ch, sc in slip st, sc in last 4 ch, slip st in first st. 
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
L
With smaller hook and 1 strand of B, ch 12.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in next 2 ch, skip next ch, sc in last 7 ch.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
B
Make 2
With smaller hook and 1 strand of B, ch 8. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 7 sc.
Row 2: Ch 5, turn, skip 3 sc, sc in next sc, ch 6, skip next 2 sc, slip st in last sc. 
Row 3: Turn, skip slip st, sc in next 6 ch, slip st in sc, sc in last 5 ch, slip st in edge of Row 1.
Fasten off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
Arrange Letters to spell “Royal Baby” in center of first 2 rows of Squares of Wall Hanging and sew in place. 

PLAQUE
Carry colors not in use loosely alongside of work.
With smaller hook and 1 strand of B, ch 41. 
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across – 40 sc. 
Row 2: Ch 3, turn, dc in each sc across.
Rows 3-4: Change to A, ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Row 5: Change to B, ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 6: Ch 3, turn, dc in each sc across.
Rows 7-42: Repeat Rows 3-6. 
Border Edging
Round 1: Ch 1, turn, sc evenly spaced around all edges, working 3 sc in each corner, slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Ch 1, *sc in each sc to first sc of corner, slip st in first sc, ch 4, slip st in next sc, ch 4, slip st in same sc,  ch 4, slip st in next sc; repeat from *, sc in each sc to first st, slip st in first st. 

CROWN
With smaller hook and 1 strand of C, ch 25.
Row 1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each ch across – 24 sc.
Rows 2-5: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 6: Ch 1, turn, sc in first sc, puff in next sc, *sc in next 3 sc, puff in next sc; repeat from * across to last 2 sc, sc in last 2 sts.
Row 7: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across.
Row 8: Ch 3, turn, dc in each st across.
Row 9: Ch 3, turn, *Bpdc, Fpdc; repeat from * to last st, dc in last st.
Rows 10-11: Ch 1, turn, sc in each st across.
Shape Points
Right Point
Row 12: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 7 sc, leave remaining sts unworked – 7 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc – 7 sc.
Row 14: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. 
Row 15: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 5 sc –  
6 sc.
Row 16: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog.
Row 17: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc –  
5 sc.
Row 18: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc – 6 sc.
Row 19: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 4 sc –  
5 sc.
Row 20: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 3 sc, sc2tog –  
4 sc.
Row 21: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 2 sc –  
3 sc.
Row 22: Ch 1, turn, sc in next sc, sc2tog – 2 sc.
Row 23: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog – 1 sc.
Fasten off

Middle Point
Row 12: Join C in next unworked st of Row 11, ch 1, turn, sc in same st, sc in next 9 sc, leave remaining sts unworked – 10 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. 
Row 14: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 6 sc, sc2tog – 8 sc.
Rows 15-16: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. 
Row 17: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in each sc to last 2 sc, sc2tog – 6 sc.
Rows 18-20: Repeat Rows 15-17 – 4 sc.
Row 21-24: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. 
Row 25: Ch 1, turn, [sc2tog] twice – 2 sc.
Row 26: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog – 1 sc.
Fasten off

Left Point
Row 12: Join C in next unworked st of Row 11, ch 1, turn, sc in same st, sc in next 6 sc, leave remaining sts unworked – 7 sc.
Row 13: Ch 1, turn, 2 sc in next sc, sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog – 7 sc.
Row 14: Ch 1, turn, sc in each sc across. 
Row 15: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 5 sc, sc2tog –  
6 sc.
Row 16: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc, 2 sc in next sc.
Row 17: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog –  
5 sc.
Row 18: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 4 sc, 2 sc in next sc – 6 sc.
Row 19: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 4 sc, sc2tog –  
5 sc.
Row 20: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next 3 sc –  
4 sc.
Row 21: Ch 1, turn, sc in next 2 sc, sc2tog – 
3 sc.
Row 22: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog, sc in next sc – 2 sc.
Row 23: Ch 1, turn, sc2tog – 1 sc.
Fasten off

Edging
With right side facing, join C in any st, sc evenly spaced around edges of Crown, working 3 sc in each point and corners, slip st to first st. Fasten off.

Large Star
With smaller hook and 1 strand of C, ch 2. 
Round 1: Work 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, slip st in first sc.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around, slip st in first sc – 12 sc.
Round 3: [Ch 4, slip st in 2nd ch from hook, sc next ch, hdc last ch, skip next sc, slip st in next sc] 6 times. 
Fasten off. 

Small Star (Make 2)
With smaller hook and 1 strand of C, ch 4, slip st in first ch to form a ring. 
Round 1: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), 11 dc in ring, slip st in top of beginning ch – 12 dc.
Fasten off. 

Sew Crown in center of Plaque. Sew Large Star on Middle Point. Sew one Small Star on each remaining Point. 
Sew Plaque in center of Wall Hanging. Weave in ends.

2nd Foundation row: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each st to end of row. Join B. Turn. 25 sc.

1st row: (RS). With B, ch 1. Working in back loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.

6th to 21st rows: Rep 2nd to 5th rows 4 times more. Break A.
22nd row: (WS). With B, as 2nd row. Join C.
23rd and 24th rows: With C, as 3rd and 2nd rows. Break C.
25th and 26th rows: With B, as 3rd and 2nd rows. Join A. Break B.
27th row: (RS). With A, ch 1. 1 sc in each sl st to end of row. Turn.
28th row: Ch 1. Working in front loops only, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
29th row: Ch 1. Working in both loops, 1 sc in each sc to end of row. Turn.
30th and 31st rows: Rep last 2 rows once more. Do not fasten off.
Note: Twisted Fringe Rows worked across last row and rem loops of 27th and 29th rows. 3 rows of fringe in A in total.
Twisted Fringe Row: **With A, ch 1. *Draw up a loop 10" [25.5 cm] long. Twist loop 30 times. Sl st in same st, allowing twisted loop to coil around itself. Sl st in next sc. Rep from * to end of row. Fasten off. **
With RS facing, join A with sl st to rem loop of first st of 29th row. Rep from ** to **. Rep for 27th row.
Short Sections of 5 Twisted Fringes:

Second Section: Following chart, join A with sl st to 10th st of 14th row. Work 5 fringes as before. Following chart, join B with sl st to 10th st of 16th row. Work 5 fringes as before.
Third Section: Following chart, join A with sl st to 19th st of 22nd row. Work 5 fringes as before. Following chart, join A with sl st to 19th st of 24th row. Work 5 fringes as before.

Thread dowel through 1st Foundation row (dc row).

instructions:
Find more ideas & inspiration: www.redheart.com and www.crochettoday.com
©2012 Coats & Clark
Candy Corn 
Banner
Draped across the mantle or hung in front 
of a window, our Candy Corn Banner helps 
celebrate the spookiest night of the year! 
Simple embroidered accents create the faces 
on these easy to crochet motifs.
Rows 13–15: With C, repeat Row 10 three 
times.
Fasten off.
EYES 
(Make 10 – 2 for each piece of candy corn)
With A, ch 2.
Round 1: Work 5 sc in 2nd ch from hook—5 sc.
Do not join. Work in continuous rounds 
(spirals). Place a marker for beginning of 
round. Move marker up as each round is 
completed.
Round 2: Work 2 sc in each sc around—10 sc.
Round 3: [Sc in next sc, 2 sc in next sc] 5 
times—15 sc.
Slip st in next stitch. Fasten off, leaving a long 
tail for sewing eye to body.
Each piece of candy corn measures about 5½” 
(14cm) tall and 5½” (14cm) wide (at widest).
Notes
1.Each piece of candy corn is made in four
parts: 2 body pieces (for front and back)
and 2 eyes.
2. To change color, work last stitch of old
color to last yarn over. Yarn over with new
color and draw through all loops on hook
to complete stitch. Proceed with new color.
Fasten off old color.
BODY 
(Make 10 – 2 for each piece of candy corn)
With A, ch 3.
Row 1: Work 4 hdc in 3rd ch from hook 
(beginning ch counts as first hdc), turn—5 hdc 
(including beginning ch in the count). 
Row 2: Ch 2 (counts as first hdc here and 
throughout), hdc in first hdc (increase made), 
hdc in next 3 hdc, hdc in top of beginning ch, 
turn—6 hdc.
Row 3: Ch 2, hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 4 
hdc, hdc in top of turning ch, turn—7 hdc.
Row 4: Ch 2, hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 5 
hdc, hdc in top of turning ch and change to B, 
turn—8 hdc.
Row 5: With B, ch 2, 2 hdc in first hdc, hdc in 
next 6 hdc, hdc in top of turning ch, turn—10 
hdc. 
Row 6: Ch 2, 2 hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 8 
hdc, hdc in top of turning ch, turn—12 hdc.
Row 7: Ch 2, 2 hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 10 
hdc, hdc in top of turning ch, turn—14 hdc.
Row 8: Ch 2, 2 hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 12 
hdc, hdc in top of turning ch, turn—16 hdc.
Row 9: Ch 2, 2 hdc in first hdc, hdc in next 14 
hdc, hdc in top of turning ch, turn—18 hdc.
Rows 10–12: Ch 2, skip first hdc, hdc in each 
hdc across, hdc in top of turning ch, turn—18 
hdc. Change to C in last st of Row 12.

FINISHING
Face: Use photograph as a guide. With yarn 
needle and long tail, sew two eyes to five 
candy corn body pieces for fronts. Sew 
one 5mm black button to each eye. With D, 
embroider straight stitch mouth and tongue on 
each front. 
Assembly: Hold one front (with face) and one 
back (without face) with wrong sides together. 
From right side and working through both 
thicknesses, join D with sc in edge, sc evenly 
spaced around to join front and back; join with 
slip st in first sc. Fasten off.
Weave in ends. With yarn needle, thread a 
long strand of D through the tops of the candy 
corn pieces to make banner. Tie knots in 
strand of D to hold pieces in place and space 
as desired.

measurements: Approx 30" [76 cm] deep at center x 51" [129.5 cm] wide, excluding fringe.

instructions:
FLOWER POWER MOTIF
Notes:
• Each Color aligns with specific round(s) in the Motif using 3 Colors in total.
• Motif begins with Color 1 (shortest color rep) from center of pull-skein, leaving a 4" [10 cm] tail to weave in.
• 2nd and 3rd rnds will be worked in Color 2.
• 4th, 5th and 6th rnds will be worked in Color 3.
• If too much color is left at end of rnd, pull back some sts and slightly loosen gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change. If too little color is left, pull back some sts and slightly tighten gauge to re-work sts and finish at color change.

• At end of final rnd, Motif should measure 6" [15 cm] square, with long tail (at least 24" [61 cm]) rem for seaming.
• Adjust gauge as needed working 4th, 5th and 6th rounds of Flower Motif to maintain 6" [15 cm] square finished size.
• Ch 3 at beg of rnd counts as dc.
• Ch 2 at beg of rnd does not count as st.
• Join all rnds with sl st to first st unless otherwise stated.

Make 6 Squares with A, and 5 Squares each with B, C, and D – 21 Squares total.

With Color 1, ch 4. Join with sl st to first ch to form ring.
1st rnd: Ch 3. Work 9 dc in ring. Join. 10 dc. Color 1 complete.
2nd rnd: Color 2 begins. Ch 3. 1 dc in first dc. 2 dc in each dc around. Join. 20 dc.
3rd rnd: Sl st in next dc. (Ch 3. 1 tr) in same st as last sl st. 3 tr in next dc. (1 tr. 1 dc) in next dc. Sl st in next dc. *(1 dc. 1 tr) in next dc. 3 tr in next dc. (1 tr. 1 dc) in next dc. Sl st in next dc. Rep from * around, ending by joining with sl st to top of ch-3 of previous (2nd) rnd. Color 2 complete.
4th rnd: Color 3 begins. Sl st in first dc. Ch 3. *1 dc in next tr. 1 hdc in next tr. 1 sc in next tr. 1 hdc in next tr. 1 dc in each of next 2 sts. 1 tr in dc of 2nd rnd below sl st.** 1 dc in next dc. Rep from * 3 times more, then from * to ** once. Join.
5th rnd: Ch 6 (counts as tr and ch-2). 1 tr in same sp as sl st. *2 dc in next st. Ch 1. 1 dc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. 1 sc in next st. Ch 1. Skip next st. 1 sc in next st. 1 hdc in next st. 1 dc in next st. Ch 1. 2 dc in next st.** (1 tr. Ch 2. 1 tr) all in next st. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. Join to 4th ch of ch-6.
6th rnd: Sl st in next ch-2 sp. Ch 2 (does not count as st). 1 hdc in same ch-2 sp. Ch 3. 3 hdc in same ch-2 sp. Ch 1. *(3 hdc. Ch 1) in each ch-1 sp to next corner ch-2 sp.** (3 hdc. Ch 3. 3 hdc) all in next ch-2 sp. Ch 1. Rep from * twice more, then from * to ** once. 2 hdc in first ch-2 sp. Join. Fasten off at end of Color 3, leaving long tail for seaming.
Motif should measure 6" [15 cm] square (see Notes).

ASSEMBLY
Seaming with Flat Sl St Join: (RS). With Color 3 from A, sl st Motifs tog into 5 Strips as shown in Assembly Diagram I (see page 4), working through back loops only and keeping working yarn to WS of work to create a flat sl st chain detail on RS of work (see diagram).
Sl st Strips and rem Square tog as shown in Assembly Diagram II (see page 4).
Note: Keep working yarn to WS of work so only flat sl st chain is visible on RS.

Top Edging (see diagram)
With RS facing, join B with sl st to top corner ch-3 sp of right-most square of Wall Hanging (marked A on Assembly Diagram III).
1st row: Ch 1. 3 sc in same ch-3 sp. (Ch 23. 3 sc in ch-3 sp of next Square) 5 times. Turn.
2nd row: Ch 1. 1 sc in first sc. Ch 7 (hanging loop). Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc. (1 sc in each of next 23 ch. 1 sc in next sc. Ch 7. Skip next sc. 1 sc in next sc) 5 times. Fasten off. Thread wooden dowel through Top Edging.

Tassel
Cut a piece of cardboard 12" [30.5 cm] wide. Wind C around cardboard 100 times. Break yarn, leaving a long end. Thread end through a needle. Slip needle through all loops and tie tightly. Remove cardboard and wind yarn tightly around loops ¾" [2 cm] below fold.
Attach one Tassel to center ch-3 sp at bottom of Wall Hanging.

Fringe
Cut lengths of yarn 25" [63.5 cm]. Taking 6 strands tog, knot into fringe into each ch-1 and ch-3 sp along bottom edges of Wall Hanging, matching shade of fringe to shade of Square. Trim fringe evenly.

15th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 13 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 13 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 75 hdc.
16th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 14 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 14 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 80 hdc.
17th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 15 hdc. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 15 hdc. Rep from * to last hdc. 2 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 85 hdc.

Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc) 10 times. Ch 1. 1 hdc in next hdc. (Ch 1. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc) 11 times. Ch 1. 1 hdc in next hdc. (Ch 1. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc) 10 times. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc) 11 times. Ch 1. 1 hdc in next hdc. (Ch 1. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc) 12 times. Ch 1. 1 hdc in next hdc. (Ch 1. Skip next hdc. 1 hdc in next hdc) 11 times. Ch 1. 1 hdc in last hdc. Turn. 125 sts.
26th row: Ch 2. 1 hdc in each of first 24 sts. *2 hdc in next hdc. 1 hdc in each of next 24 sts. Rep from * to last st. 2 hdc in last st. 130 hdc. Fasten off.

Weaving
Cut 12 strands of yarn 40" [101.5 cm] long. Taking 4 strands tog, weave yarn in and out along sts on 21st, 23rd and 25th rows as shown in picture, taking care to not pull yarn too tightly.
